data.title: General Manager – Marine & Ports
data.description:
Assystem provides engineering, project management and digital services to optimise the performance and safety of critical infrastructure throughout its lifecycle. 

The company first came to India having acquired Stup Consultants Pvt Ltd in 2021 and L&TIEL in 2024. The company combines its globally recognised expertise in complex project management, with deep-rooted local experience cross full spectrum of infrastructure - from energy, transportation and urban development to water. Today, Assystem has a strong community of 1, 500+ multidiscipline engineering experts connected across 8 offices in India. 

The Assystem Group is one of the world's leading independent nuclear engineering companies, ranked among the top three globally, with 60 years of experience in complex and highly regulated environments. With 8, 000 experts across 13 countries, Assystem supports the development of low-carbon energy. 

For company profile, please visit the website : - www. assystemstup. com

Job Description

Role Objective: 

Provide strategic and operational leadership for the detailed design & engineering of port and marine infrastructure projects. The role will be accountable for end-to-end engineering delivery, business profitability (P&L ownership), and client satisfaction. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Strategic & Business Leadership

- Define and execute the design & engineering strategy for port infrastructure (container terminals, bulk cargo berths, liquid jetties, breakwaters, dredging & reclamation, yard development). 
 - Manage P&L for the design & engineering vertical, ensuring revenue growth, profitability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Support business development & proposals by defining engineering scope, methodologies, and costings. 
 - Drive digital transformation (BIM, 3D modeling, simulation tools) to enhance design efficiency and quality. Engineering & Technical Excellence: 

- Lead the detailed design engineering of complex port & marine structures. 
 - Approve key engineering deliverables - design reports, drawings, technical specifications, BOQs. 
 - Ensure compliance with international codes & standards (PIANC, BS, IS, Eurocodes). 
 - Conduct value engineering, risk analysis, and constructability reviews. 
 - Oversee integration of civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and marine systems into holistic designs. 
 - Master PlanningOperational & Delivery Management: 

- Lead multi-disciplinary engineering teams across geotechnical, structural, marine, and utilities disciplines. 
 - Manage engineering consultants, third parties, and technology partners. 
 - Ensure on-time delivery of design packages aligned with project schedules. 
 - Coordinate closely with EPC/construction teams for seamless execution. Financial & P&L Responsibility: 

- Deliver financial performance against defined revenue, margin, and cash flow targets. 
 - Monitor project budgets, billing, invoicing, and collection cycles. 
 - Ensure profitability through cost optimization and resource utilization. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in productivity, efficiency, and delivery models. Client & Stakeholder Management: 

- Act as the primary technical and commercial interface with clients and government authorities. 
 - Build long-term client relationships ensuring repeat and new business. 
 - Represent the organization in industry forums, technical committees, and client presentations. Quality, HSE & Compliance: 

- Ensure compliance with HSE norms, quality standards, and statutory regulations. 
 - Implement strong QA/QC systems for all engineering outputs. 
 - Champion sustainability and green engineering practices in port design. Key Deliverables: 

- End-to-end delivery of detailed engineering for multiple port projects. 
 - Achievement of P&L, revenue, and profitability targets. 
 - Strong client satisfaction and business growth. 
 - High-quality, safe, and innovative engineering solutions. 

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience: 

- Education: B. E. /B. Tech in Civil/Structural/Marine; M. Tech/M. E. in Port/Marine Engineering preferred. 
 - Experience: 20+ years in port & marine infrastructure engineering with at least 10+ years in leadership & P&L management roles. 
 - Track record in design leadership for large-scale port projects (terminals, breakwaters, dredging, offshore structures). 
 - Proficiency in engineering software (STAAD, Plaxis, SAP, MIKE 21, ANSYS, AutoCAD, BIM tools). 
 - Demonstrated ability to manage P&L, budgets, and large engineering teams. 

Additional Information

We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people's ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

data.title: Senior LLM/GenAI Engineer
data.description:
The Senior LLM/GenAI Engineer is a hands-on coding role responsible for designing, building, integrating and deploying AI-powered applications and agents for enterprise HR workflows. The engineer will develop backend services and application APIs, retrieve and process data from the Databricks data lake, Oracle databases and HRMS systems, and connect that data to grounded LLM experiences. The role combines software engineering, data integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent development to deliver secure, reliable applications for employee self-service, HR policy queries, recruitment support and workforce analytics. 

Key Responsibilities : 

• Write, test and maintain production application code using Python, FastAPI and NodeJS; build backend services and APIs for LLM/GenAI applications rather than prompt-only prototypes. 

• Build and maintain integrations that retrieve and process data from the Databricks data lake, Oracle databases and HRMS systems using SQL, APIs and approved connectors; handle authentication, data mapping, validation and integration failures. 

• Design and implement RAG pipelines that combine HR documents with authorised enterprise data, including ingestion, retrieval, context assembly, source attribution and access-aware responses. 

• Build agents using Google ADK, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks; implement tool and function calling, workflow orchestration, state management and connections to Databricks, Oracle and HRMS services. 

• Engineer and evaluate prompts, retrieval and agent behaviour using representative test cases; validate grounded answers, tool selection and task completion, and implement guardrails and human approval for sensitive actions. 

• Enforce HR data privacy, role-based access control (RBAC), PII protection and audit logging across data access, application APIs and agent tools; optimise reliability, latency, concurrency and inference cost. 

• Deliver end-to-end applications for HR policy assistance, employee self-service, recruitment support and conversational workforce analytics, from requirements and coding through integration testing, deployment and production support. 

• Maintain modular code, automated tests, technical documentation and deployment pipelines; troubleshoot production issues and mentor junior engineers through code reviews and hands-on implementation guidance. 

Required Qualifications & Experience: 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 

• Demonstrable hands-on coding experience building LLM applications and agents, including integrations with Databricks data lake and Oracle databases or HRMS systems. 

• 5-8 years of hands-on software and backend application development experience, with recent experience delivering production-grade LLM/GenAI applications and tool-enabled agents. 

Educational Background

• Required: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 

• Preferred: Advanced certifications in AI/ML, Databricks, Cloud Architecture, or Backend Application Development from recognized institutions. 

Years & Type of Experience

• 5-8 years of hands-on software engineering experience, including application coding, API development, SQL-based data access, automated testing and production deployment. 

• Proven delivery of LLM/GenAI applications and agents that use enterprise data, with practical experience integrating Databricks data lake and Oracle databases or HRMS systems; HR Tech or People Analytics experience is preferred. 

Domain Expertise

• Strong understanding of LLM application architecture, RAG, structured data retrieval, tool calling and multi-step agent workflows, including error handling and evaluation. 

• Ability to translate recruitment, onboarding, employee self-service, HR policy and workforce analytics requirements into working applications with defined data sources, access rules and human review points. 

• Practical understanding of enterprise data governance, record-level access restrictions, PII protection, auditability and secure handling of confidential employee data across applications and agents. 

Digital & Operational Tools

• LLM & Agent Engineering: Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Search, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling and agent evaluation. 

• Enterprise Data & Integration: Databricks data lake, Databricks Genie, SQL, Oracle databases, HRMS APIs, approved connectors, data validation and enterprise data pipelines. 

• Application Engineering: Python, FastAPI, NodeJS, RESTful APIs, backend services, Git, automated testing, deployment pipelines, logging and monitoring. 

• Retrieval & Data Access: FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma or Vertex AI Vector Search; secure SQL queries, document retrieval and access-aware context assembly. 

Leadership Capabilities

• Technical Leadership: Lead application and agent design, contribute production code, review integrations and drive secure, maintainable engineering practices. 

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with HR stakeholders, product managers, data engineers and Oracle/HRMS system owners to define requirements, data access and integration contracts. 

• Mentorship: Coach junior engineers in application coding, SQL, enterprise integrations, RAG and agent development through code reviews and practical guidance. 

• Delivery Ownership: Own implementation from requirements through production support, balancing business value, data privacy, reliability and operating cost.

data.title: Engineering Manager/Team lead – Detail Design WTP, STP, ETP
data.description:
Finding solutions to climate change is the priority of the 21st century, and means switching to low-carbon energy. At Assystem, our mission is to accelerate the energy transition worldwide. To achieve this, our 7, 500 Switchers combine their historical engineering expertise and project management with digital technologies. 

In our 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Asia) of operation, we are working on the production and distribution of low-carbon electricity, through the development of nuclear and renewable energies. We are also supporting the modernisation and development of energy grids, managing the setup and siting for new transmission and distribution networks, and using hydrogen to decarbonise the transport and industry sectors. 

The Assystem Safety & Risk business unit has over 20 years' experience, delivering bespoke, high-quality safety, risk, and reliability consultancy services to high-hazard industries. We help our clients to minimise risk, delivering improved safety and security and fostering a nuclear safety and risk aware culture. Assystem Safety & Risk delivers an integrated and cost-effective service that includes Safety Case, Human & Organisational Factors (HOF), Risk & Reliability (Including Probabilistic Safety Assessment), Security & Resilience, and Process Safety. 

We use deterministic and probabilistic techniques to help our clients to assess the risk associated with facilities and activities and confirm that risks are reduced to a level that is As Low as Reasonably Practicable (ALARP). 

Job Description

Engineering Manager / Team Lead - WTP, STP, ETP

Location: Bengaluru / Delhi

Role Summary

Lead design, engineering, and delivery of water & wastewater treatment projects (STP, ETP, WTP, RO, UF/MF, desalination, pumping stations, water supply/distribution, reclaimed water). Manage multidisciplinary teams, ensure technical excellence, and deliver projects safely, on time, and within budget. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership: Direct detailed design for treatment plants, pumping stations, sludge systems, and water networks. Ensure compliance with codes/standards. 

- Project Management: Oversee feasibility to commissioning, manage budgets, schedules, risks, and coordinate with procurement, construction, and commissioning teams. 

- Process Engineering: Lead hydraulic/process calculations, simulations, equipment sizing, and treatment technology selection (ASP, MBBR, SBR, MBR, RO, UV, chlorination). 

- Team Leadership: Mentor engineers, manage resources, support recruitment, and foster innovation. 

- Client Engagement: Act as primary technical contact, present solutions, manage expectations, and build long-term relationships. 

- Construction & Commissioning Support: Review vendor submissions, resolve technical issues, support plant startup and handover. 

- Quality & Compliance: Implement QA/QC, ensure environmental, health & safety compliance. 

- Business Development: Prepare proposals, bids, budgets, and contribute to strategic growth. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's in Civil/Environmental/Chemical/Water Engineering (Master's preferred). 

- 12-18 years in water/wastewater projects; 5+ years in leadership. 

- Proven experience in STP, ETP, WTP, pumping stations, municipal & industrial water systems. 

- Strong process, mechanical, electrical & instrumentation knowledge. 

Reporting

Reports to: GM/Director - Water Infrastructure, Business Unit Head Direct reports: Process, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil Engineers, CAD/BIM Designers, Project & Commissioning Engineers

Qualifications

Bachelor's in Civil/Environmental/Chemical/Water Engineering (Master's preferred).

Based on candidate, location can be Bengalore/Gurgaon

data.title: Red Team Engineer - Adversary Simulation
data.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

ABOUT US

We are a stealth Frontier AI security startup building foundation models for security. Backed by Tier 1 venture capital firms and built by experts in sovereign AI, foundation models, and cybersecurity. 

We have built models that already outperform frontier LLMs on cybersecurity benchmarks. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Senior Red Team Engineer to run realistic adversary simulations, develop offensive tooling, and close the loop from successful attack to tested detection. 

You will execute full attack chains across endpoints, identity, cloud, and containers while building labs, benchmarks, and autonomous offensive agents. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role with a path to shape the offensive program. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build and execute adversary-simulation plans mapped to real threat-actor tradecraft and critical assets. 

- Run complete attack chains across initial access, execution, persistence, privilege escalation, defense evasion, credential access, lateral movement, collection, and exfiltration. 

- Develop and extend offensive tooling, including loaders, payloads, command-and-control profiles, and modules. 

- Develop and weaponize exploits into reliable, controlled operational capabilities. 

- Build intentionally vulnerable Windows, Linux, container, identity, and cloud environments. 

- Design instrumented, multi-stage kill chains and create the datasets and benchmark environments used to train and measure offensive-security AI systems. 

- Build and evaluate agents that autonomously discover, validate, and exploit vulnerabilities. 

- Execute Active Directory and Entra ID paths including Kerberos, delegation, ACL and ADCS abuse, plus cloud/container paths such as token theft, metadata-service abuse, role chaining, privileged containers, and Kubernetes RBAC escalation. 

- Run a recurring purple-team cadence: for each technique that lands, partner with blue-team and threat-research engineers until a tested detection exists, then retest and track remaining coverage gaps. 

- Operate with disciplined scoping, reproducibility, logging, cleanup, and reporting. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- Strong hands-on experience in red teaming, penetration testing, adversary simulation, exploit development, or offensive-tool development. 

- Demonstrated tool-development ability in C, C++, C#, Go, Rust, Nim, Python, or another relevant language. 

- Working knowledge of Windows and Linux internals and the mitigations that affect offensive techniques. 

- Understanding of memory-corruption classes, exploitability, and debugging or root-cause analysis. 

- Strong Active Directory attack knowledge and familiarity with hybrid Entra ID paths. 

- Current understanding of EDR visibility, evasion, and the limitations of offensive techniques. 

- Creative attack-path reasoning and the ability to describe defensive detections for your own techniques. 

- Strong operational discipline, reproducibility, and clear written communication. 

- We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with AI agents, autonomous security systems, or offensive-security automation. 

- Fuzzing, vulnerability research, kernel research, reverse engineering, or exploit-development depth. 

- Cloud red teaming across AWS, Azure, or GCP. 

- Container and Kubernetes offensive-security experience. 

- Prior blue-team, detection-engineering, or purple-team experience. 

- Published research, CVEs, bug-bounty findings, open-source tooling, or advanced lab and CTF work. 

- Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, or OSCE3 as supporting evidence, not a substitute for demonstrated work. 

- Experience building lab, range, or CTF environments. 

- Physical or social-engineering experience where relevant to the threat model.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

DevOps Engineer

Opening Paragraph

As EY continues to evolve and modernize its digital platforms, we are seeking a talented DevOps Engineer to help accelerate the delivery, reliability, and scalability of our enterprise solutions. This role sits at the intersection of development, operations, automation, and cloud infrastructure, enabling teams to deliver innovative business capabilities faster and more securely. You will play a critical role in supporting modern digital experiences, driving automation, and ensuring our platforms operate efficiently and securely across a global environment. 

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing technology team focused on delivering business-critical services and digital capabilities. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure, automation, and deployment processes that support our applications and platforms. 

You will work closely with development, operations, architecture, and business stakeholders to implement modern DevOps practices, improve operational efficiency, and enhance platform reliability. This role offers exposure to enterprise-scale systems, cloud technologies, automation frameworks, and continuous improvement initiatives while providing opportunities to influence the future direction of our technology landscape. 

Your Key Responsibilities

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational processes that enable successful delivery of applications and services. 

Key responsibilities include: 

- Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure solutions that support application hosting, data processing, analytics, and enterprise services. 
 - Develop and manage Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline software delivery and improve deployment quality and consistency. 
 - Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging capabilities to ensure system health, availability, and performance visibility. 
 - Automate operational and administrative tasks to reduce manual effort, increase efficiency, and improve reliability. 
 - Collaborate with development, operations, product, and business teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements and are delivered successfully. 
 - Support software releases, deployments, and infrastructure maintenance activities as required. 
 - Ensure platforms and services comply with organizational security standards, governance requirements, and regulatory obligations. 
 - Develop and implement best practices for access management, data protection, and system security. 
 - Analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimization strategies to improve scalability and operational efficiency. 
 - Participate in troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of production issues, driving long-term corrective actions and continuous improvement. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Success in this role requires a combination of technical expertise, problem-solving ability, collaboration, and a passion for automation and continuous improvement. You will be effective in a fast-paced environment where you can balance operational excellence with innovation and partnership across multiple teams. 

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

- Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise infrastructure environments. 
 - Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation. 
 - Knowledge of monitoring, logging, and observability tools and practices. 
 - Experience automating operational processes using scripting and automation technologies. 
 - Understanding of security best practices, access controls, compliance requirements, and infrastructure governance. 
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to solve complex technical problems. 
 - Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams in an Agile delivery environment. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills. 

Ideally, You'll Also Have

- Experience with cloud platforms and modern cloud operations practices. 
 - Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies and automation frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of performance tuning, scalability planning, and system optimization. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise application deployments and release management processes. 
 - Experience working within large, globally distributed teams. 
 - Relevant DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure certifications. 

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning. The ideal candidate is proactive, adaptable, and comfortable taking ownership of challenges while working across global teams. You will be someone who embraces innovation, shares knowledge openly, and consistently seeks opportunities to improve processes, technology, and outcomes. A positive attitude, strong communication skills, and the ability to balance independent work with effective teamwork will be critical for success. 

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, you'll have the opportunity to build a career as unique as you are, supported by a global scale, an inclusive culture, and technology to help you become the best version of yourself. You'll work on meaningful projects that impact our people, clients, and business while collaborating with talented professionals across diverse disciplines and geographies. 

We invest in our people through continuous learning, professional development, mentoring, and leadership opportunities. You'll be empowered to bring your ideas forward, challenge the status quo, and contribute to innovative solutions that help shape the future of our organization. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Java Technical Lead - Payment Platform experience
data.description:
Role summary

You will be the senior technical owner for one or more platform domains. Working closely with Architects and Product Management, you will turn the target architecture and product requirements into clear technical specifications, then lead the team that delivers them predictably, with high quality and on schedule. You will spend roughly half your time on technical design, code and reviews, and half on people, planning and cross-team alignment. 

Key responsibilities

Delivery

- Break product goals into well-scoped epics, estimates and milestones with Product and Engineering Management. 
 - Run sprint planning and reviews, track progress and risks, and keep delivery predictable. 
 - Identify and unblock dependencies across teams and external partners early. 
 - Own release readiness: test strategy, rollout and rollback plans, and post-release monitoring. 
 - Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to raise team throughput and code quality. 

Process and engineering practices

- Define and improve the team's delivery process: branching, code review, CI/CD, testing and definition of done. 
 - Set coding, API and data-modelling standards; review critical pull requests across backend and frontend. 
 - Write and review design documents and architecture decision records; represent the team at the Architecture Review Board. 
 - Define SLOs, observability and alerting; lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. 
 - Manage technical debt and keep the technical roadmap aligned with the architecture roadmap. 

Technical leadership

- Translate architecture blueprints into low-level designs, API contracts, data models, sequence diagrams and non-functional requirements. 
 - Keep implementation aligned with the approved architecture; raise deviations and trade-offs early. 
 - Champion secure design: encryption, key management, secrets handling, least-privilege access and audit trails, in line with PCI DSS and internal InfoSec policy. 

People leadership

- Mentor and grow engineers through pairing, design reviews and regular feedback. 
 - Take part in hiring: define the bar, interview and onboard new team members. 
 - Build a culture of ownership, documentation and calm, data-driven decisions. 

Technical environment

Backend: Java / Spring Boot (primary); Node. js (TypeScript) or Python for APIs, integrations and tooling

Frontend: React (TypeScript)

Architecture: Microservices, event-driven design, REST APIs, saga and outbox patterns

Data: PostgreSQL (primary), Redis; NoSQL where the workload warrants it

Cloud and DevOps: AWS (or Azure/GCP), Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags

Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, centralised logging

Security: Cloud KMS/HSM, secrets management, WAF, SAST/DAST

Critical skills

- These are must-haves; candidates should show real depth in each area during interviews. 
 - Delivery leadership: turning high-level requirements into scoped work and shipping it predictably with a team of 5 or more engineers. 
 - Engineering process: code review, test automation, CI/CD, release management and incident management run as a discipline. 
 - Distributed systems: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, failure handling and high-throughput APIs. 
 - Java with Spring Boot, plus working proficiency in TypeScript/Node. js or Python and the ability to review React code. 
 - SQL: schema design, indexing, query tuning, transactions and isolation levels; zero-downtime migrations. 
 - Cloud and infrastructure: Kubernetes in a public cloud, infrastructure as code and observability. 
 - Security fundamentals: encryption, key and secrets management, least privilege and audit trails. 

Required qualifications

- 8+ years building production systems, including 2+ years as a tech lead leading a team of 5 or more engineers. 
 - Proven track record of turning architecture and product requirements into detailed specifications that teams deliver against. 
 - Deep experience with distributed systems and high-availability services. 
 - Strong command of Java and Spring Boot; working knowledge of Node. js (TypeScript) or Python, and React. 
 - Experience running services on Kubernetes in a public cloud, with CI/CD and infrastructure as code. 
 - Working knowledge of security and compliance practices such as PCI DSS; exposure to payments or fintech systems is helpful. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain trade-offs to architects, engineers, product leaders and auditors. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in payments, fintech or banking technology, such as payment gateways, processor integrations, settlement and reconciliation. 
 - Built or scaled a ledger, payment switch or settlement engine handling 1M+ transactions a day. 
 - Led certification with a card network or an acquiring bank. 
 - Shipped an AI/ML or LLM-powered feature to production. 
 - Has used AI coding assistants and agentic tools within a governed SDLC.

data.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an innovative AI Architect who will lead the design and implementation of Agentic AI, Generative AI (GenAI), and Large Language Model (LLM) - driven solutions across enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will bridge research and production-defining AI strategy, architecture, and scalable model pipelines that transform business outcomes and our global clients. 

Key Responsibilities

• Architect and design end-to-end AI systems leveraging LLMs, GenAI, and Agentic AI frameworks. 

• Define AI/ML solution architecture involving data ingestion, model training, orchestration, and deployment across Azure / AWS / GCP. 

• Work on prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and fine-tuning of open-source and proprietary LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, LLaMA, etc. ). 

• Collaborate with data scientists, MLOps engineers, and software developers to operationalize AI solutions in production environments. 

• Design and implement AI agent workflows, leveraging frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel. 

• Ensure responsible AI principles, focusing on security, compliance, and ethical model usage. 

• Define AI governance and observability frameworks for tracking model drift, bias, and performance. 

• Stay updated on Agentic AI, multimodal AI, and self-learning systems, and evaluate emerging GenAI tools and APIs for business adoption. 

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to AI teams, guiding solution design, architecture reviews, and best practices. 

Required Skills & Experience

• 10+ years of experience in software development, with at least 4+ years in AI/ML/GenAI architecture. 

• Strong proficiency in Python, TensorFlow / PyTorch, and transformer-based architectures (BERT, GPT, T5, etc. ). 

• Proven experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus). 

• Hands-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, or similar LLM orchestration tools. 

• Solid understanding of MLOps pipelines, CI/CD, and model deployment using Azure Machine Learning, SageMaker, or Vertex AI. 

• Knowledge of API orchestration, microservices, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). 

• Experience in integrating GenAI capabilities into enterprise apps (chatbots, copilots, document intelligence, code assistants, etc. ). 

• Strong analytical, communication, and solution design skills.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Automation QA Engineer with strong expertise in Playwright and modern test automation practices to validate enterprise-grade Conversational AI, Agentic AI, Chatbot, and Generative AI platforms. 

The ideal candidate should have experience testing AI-powered applications, ensuring response accuracy, validating AI workflows, identifying hallucinations, testing multi-agent interactions, and building automation frameworks that assess both traditional software functionality and AI-specific behaviours. 

This role will work closely with AI Engineers, Product Owners, Data Scientists, and DevOps teams to ensure the reliability, quality, security, and trustworthiness of AI-driven solutions.

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

 - Create automated evaluation metrics for response correctness.

API & Integration Testing

Performance & Reliability Testing

 - Validate recovery and failover mechanisms. 

Security & Compliance Testing

 - Assess AI guardrails and content moderation controls. 

Required Experience

- 5+ years of QA Automation experience. 
 - 3+ years of experience with Playwright automation. 
 - Hands-on experience testing chatbots, conversational platforms, or AI-enabled applications.

Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to challenge AI outputs using data-driven validation techniques. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Strong attention to detail and quality mindset. 
 - Ability to work independently in a fast-paced AI product environment. 

Success Criteria for the Role

The Successful Candidate Should Be Able To

Lead complex patent intelligence engagements across Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences, and Healthcare technologies, while guiding research teams and leveraging agentic AI workflows to deliver reproducible, defensible insights and strategic outcomes for clients. 

Key Responsibilities

• Define research strategy and execution approach for complex patent intelligence engagements across biotechnology and pharmaceutical technologies. 

• Design and optimize AI-assisted search workflows and prompt strategies. 

• Lead large-scale novelty, patentability, invalidation, freedom-to-operate, opposition, and patent landscape projects. 

• Oversee development of claim-element mappings and Evidence of Use (EoU) with precise technical and patent citations. 

• Interpret complex patent claims, patent families, CPC/IPC classifications, sequence-related disclosures, Markush structures, and citation networks. 

• Conduct and supervise technical searches across patent and non-patent literature, including scientific publications, clinical literature, regulatory sources, sequence databases, and product-related information. 

• Validate AI-generated results through expert scientific and technical review. 

• Prepare and review client-ready sections including methodology, sources, findings, claim analysis, and strategic conclusions. 

• Ensure research outputs are scientifically accurate, reproducible, and legally defensible. 

• Improve prompt libraries, search methodologies, and quality assurance frameworks for biotechnology and pharmaceutical research. 

• Lead and mentor a team of strategists and senior strategists, providing scientific guidance and reviewing research outputs. 

• Allocate research tasks, monitor project progress, and ensure high-quality deliverables. 

• Support client discussions by translating complex scientific and patent findings into clear strategic insights. 

Must-have

• 6-10+ years of experience in patent research, IP analytics, or patent intelligence within Biotechnology, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences, or related technologies. 

• Proven expertise in novelty searches, invalidation studies, freedom-to-operate analysis, patent landscapes, claim charts, and drafting support. 

• Strong understanding of patent claims, patent families, classification systems, sequence searching, Markush structures, and citation analysis. 

• Ability to understand and analyze complex scientific disclosures across biologics, pharmaceuticals, molecular biology, and life sciences. 

• Experience leading research teams and managing complex client projects. 

• Excellent analytical thinking, scientific interpretation, and technical writing skills. 

Patent & IP Expertise

• Advanced experience in patent research including novelty, invalidation, FTO, opposition, landscapes, and claim charts. 

• Expertise in interpreting patent claims, families, CPC/IPC classifications, prosecution histories, and citation networks. 

• Experience analyzing composition-of-matter, formulation, method-of-treatment, dosage regimen, biomarker, biologics, process, and platform technology claims. 

• Understanding of Markush claims, chemical structures, biological sequences, antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids, and sequence identity-based claims. 

• Familiarity with global patent databases such as USPTO, EPO, WIPO Patentscope, Google Patents, and Espacenet. 

• Familiarity with scientific and life-sciences databases such as PubMed, Google Scholar, NCBI, UniProt, BLAST, ClinicalTrials. gov, and regulatory databases. 

• Ability to review and guide claim-element mapping and Evidence of Use (EoU) aligned with patent and scientific evidence standards. 

• Experience supporting litigation, licensing, due diligence, competitive intelligence, or portfolio strategy engagements. 

Education Background

• Bachelor's/Master's degree in Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, or related fields. 

• PhD or advanced specialization may be preferred for highly technical biotechnology or pharmaceutical engagements. 

Strong understanding of: 

• Molecular biology and genetics

• Biochemistry and cell biology

• Recombinant DNA and gene technologies

• Proteins, antibodies, peptides, and biologics

• Genomics, proteomics, and bioinformatics

• Pharmaceutical formulations and drug delivery systems

• Pharmacology and drug development

• Small-molecule and biologic therapeutics

• Vaccines and immunology

• Cell and gene therapies

• Diagnostics, biomarkers, and personalized medicine

• Fermentation, bioprocessing, and biologics manufacturing

• Clinical development and regulatory concepts

Tools - Examples

• AI & agentic: ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini; orchestration tools; prompt libraries; evaluation sets

• Patent: Google Patents, Espacenet, Patentscope, USPTO, EPO

• Scientific/NPL: PubMed, Google Scholar, NCBI, UniProt, BLAST, ClinicalTrials. gov

• Other: Sequence-search tools, chemical/biological databases, translators, spreadsheets, visualization and reporting tools

KPIs

• Project delivery quality and audit pass-rate

• Turnaround time adherence across engagements

• Scientific and technical accuracy of research outputs

• Defensibility and reproducibility of patent research findings

• Team mentoring effectiveness and peer-review quality

• Contributions to biotechnology/pharma research playbooks and AI-enabled workflows

• Client satisfaction and engagement outcomes

Levelling Notes

Lead - AI & IP Innovation (Team Leader): 

Leads biotechnology/pharma patent research projects, including patentability, FTO, invalidation, landscaping and competitive intelligence studies. Guides and mentors a team of strategists, conducts quality reviews, translates client requirements into clear project scope and methodology, and ensures timely, high-quality delivery. 

Manager - AI & IP Innovation (Biotechnology): 

Owns a portfolio of biotechnology/pharma engagements and manages multiple research teams and team leads. Acts as the senior point of contact for key clients, drives technical and commercial proposals, and handles the most complex scientific and patent matters. Contributes to practice growth, capability building, and the development of AI-enabled IP research methodologies. 

Service Scope

Novelty/Patentability, Invalidation/Opposition, Freedom-to-Operate, Claim Charts/EoU, Drafting Support, Patent Landscapes, Sequence & Structure-Based Patent Searching, Competitive Intelligence, Due Diligence, Licensing Support, and IP Strategy programs.

data.title: Software Developer in Test
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on SDET with 3-5 years of software testing experience, including strong test automation skills. The role involves developing and maintaining automated tests, validating APIs and database workflows, debugging application issues, and integrating test execution into CI/CD pipelines. The application environment includes C#/. NET, web services, Windows-based components and Microsoft SQL Server. BFSI / Capital Markets experience is preferred, not mandatory. 

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain automated functional, regression and integration tests using C#/. NET or Python. 

• Contribute reusable components to existing automation frameworks; automate REST APIs and web UI flows (Selenium or equivalent). 

• Validate service interactions, business rules, SQL Server data persistence and transaction outcomes. 

• Use SQL queries (including joins) for test-data preparation and database validation. 

• Integrate and execute automated suites through Jenkins/Bamboo pipelines; investigate build and test failures. 

• Use Git/Bitbucket for source control; write or modify basic PowerShell/Python scripts for test execution and QA support. 

• Review requirements, prepare test scenarios (including negative and boundary cases), log defects with evidence, and support defect triage and release testing. 

• Analyse logs and distinguish application defects from automation, test-data or environment issues; maintain test documentation. 

Required Skills & Experience

• 3-5 years of software testing experience, including at least 2 years of hands-on test automation. 

• Good programming skills in C#/. NET or Python (C#/. NET preferred); ability to read code and debug issues. 

• Hands-on experience with an automation framework and REST API testing (Postman, RestSharp or equivalent). 

• Working SQL skills, including joins and database validation; SQL Server preferred. 

• Exposure to CI/CD (Jenkins, Bamboo or equivalent) and source control (Git/Bitbucket). 

• Good understanding of OOP, application/service interactions, test design and debugging. Capital Markets / Domain Knowledge

• BFSI, financial services or Capital Markets experience is an advantage. 

• Basic understanding of orders, trades, positions and the trade lifecycle is beneficial. 

• Exposure to Equities, Options, Futures, FIX protocol or electronic trading workflows is preferred; deep derivatives expertise is not required. 

• Strong automation candidates from other enterprise domains may also be considered. 

Good-to-Have Skills

• Selenium or desktop automation (TestComplete, Ranorex, UFT); NUnit, xUnit or MSTest. 

• Messaging exposure: RabbitMQ, MSMQ or Kafka; basic Windows services and service-based architecture. 

• PowerShell scripting; performance testing with JMeter/k6; Splunk or other log monitoring. 

• Docker/containerisation and awareness of AI-assisted coding tools. 

Candidate Profile

A practical problem-solver who can independently automate defined scenarios, take ownership of assigned modules, communicate defects clearly, collaborate with developers and QA teams, and learn new application and business workflows.

data.title: Head of Production
data.description:
Company Description Electrohms Private Limited is a leading designer of current and voltage sensors serving industrial, railway, solar, wind power, and telecom applications worldwide. With over 40 years of experience, the company is recognized for innovation, product quality, and strong customer commitment. Electrohms now delivers customized smart-sensor solutions with integrated communications to support IoT use cases. The team focuses on on-time delivery, scrap reduction, and productivity improvements, resulting in lower costs and better quality for customers. This culture of continuous improvement creates a dynamic environment for professionals who want to contribute to advanced sensor technologies. 

- Role DescriptionEducation:   

A Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics & related technical field is typically required.   

Experience:   

Extensive experience in senior manufacturing roles, with specific experience in electronics manufacturing (including SMT/THT processes), is often necessary.   

Technical skills:   

Strong knowledge of production processes, quality control, and lean manufacturing principles is essential. Experience with ERP systems and proficiency in MS Office are also important.   

Soft skills:   

Excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, and organisational skills are crucial for managing teams and driving results. The ability to work efficiently under pressure and strong decision-making skills are also vital.   

Certifications:   

Professional certifications such as IPC 610 Standards, Lean Six Sigma or Project Management Professional (PMP) can be beneficial.   

Job Description: 

- Lead the greenfield setup of the manufacturing plant. 
 - Oversee operations of the existing large-scale manufacturing facility in Bangalore. 
 - Provide strategic direction for all manufacturing activities, including technology deployment, plant infrastructure, operational design, and resource planning. 
 - Establish and institutionalise world-class manufacturing practices, driving efficiency, quality, and cost optimisation. 
 - Build and lead high-performing teams; provide direction to managerial staff heading individual plant/unit operations. 
 - Develop and execute long-term capacity expansion plans aligned with business objectives. 
 - Collaborate with global leadership, engineering, design, and supply chain functions to ensure manufacturing readiness for new product introductions. 
 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, etc. ) across all units. 
 - Ensure compliance with global EHS standards and local statutory norms. 
 - Prepare and manage CAPEX budgets and ensure timely execution of plant setup projects. 
 - Report regularly to the board and investors on manufacturing KPIs and strategic milestones. 
 - Production Planning-Planning of Materials, Personnel, Capacity, Equipment & Machinery. 
 - Manage the production assembly line/unit efficiently. 
 - Preparation of W/P, Rejection reports, Preparation, and Presentation of Charts. 
 - Product manufacturing process documentation. 
 - Analysis of line rejections and implementation of corrective actions. 
 - Preparation of Quality Plan and Compliance with ISO Requirements. 
 - Training the Operators in Soldering, ESD Awareness and best practices, Testing. 
 - Special Process Coordinator for soldering and encapsulation, quality plan/control plan, work instructions are prepared for the special process, along with process and operator validation and updation of skill matrix according to validation. 
 - Manage all activities related to SMT and THT assembly machines, equipment, tools, jigs, fixtures, and processes. 
 - Ensure efficient organization and smooth operation of SMT, THT, and manual soldering processes in production. 
 - Ensure all work is performed in compliance with quality standards, technological requirements, and the schedule. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, testing, supply chain, and quality departments to resolve technical issues. 
 - Participate in the launch of new products and the optimization of production processes. 
 - Support root cause analysis, analyze processes, and implement best practices to improve efficiency, quality, and productivity. 
 - Responsible for the department budget, follow up and responsible for managing and controlling the purchasing of the department. 
 - Process documentation development, including work instructions, training guides, and internal quality standards. 
 - Introduction of Kanban systems. 
 - Productivity improvement plans & focus on cycle time reduction. 
 - Focus on automation of the process, Poka-Yoke methods to introduce foolproof methods. 
 - Introduction of Jigs & fixtures to ease the process. 
 - Maintaining disciplined & healthy work culture. 
 - Deep drive Knowledge on special processes like soldering & encapsulation. 
 - Thorough knowledge of IPC 610 H standard & certified IPC 610H specialist. 
 - THT - to be indicated as PTH. 
 - Setting of KRAS for the second level, monitoring & guiding to achieve. 
 - Training for the second level / Supervisors to increase their levels. 
 - Prepare and maintain production reports and personnel records. 
 - Supervise and ensure effective employee relations:   
 - Hire and train skilled operators, technicians, workers, and other support personnel. 
 - Provides employee coaching and development opportunities.   
 - Resolves employee issues through problem resolution.   

Desired Skill Sets/Knowledge Areas: 

1. SMD Components, Soldering Techniques (Wave and Hand). 

2. Testing and analysis. 

3. Debugging Assembly problems. 

4. Subcontracting knowledge. 

5. Developing Jigs & Fixtures. 

6. PCB & ESD Knowledge for Storing/setting up line assemblies. 

7. Quality check of PCB Assemblies & Visual Inspection Standards. 

8. IPC 610H Acceptability for Electronic Assemblies. 

Looking for candidates with strong experience in Production and Quality Control, along with exposure to multiple functional areas of manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in: 

- Production Planning & Control (PPC)
 - Quality Assurance / Quality Control
 - Project Planning and Execution
 - Material Planning and Inventory Management
 - Team Handling and Workforce Management
 - Process Improvement and Productivity EnhancementPreference will be given to candidates who have worked across multiple manufacturing verticals/functions and demonstrated cross-functional leadership in managing production, quality, materials, and project activities. 

Share resumes to manjula. tm@electrohms. com

Principal Engineer & Architect

Role Overview

The Principal Engineer & Architect is the highest technical authority within Apollo Homecare's Engineering organization. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role responsible for designing, building, and scaling our technology platforms. You will solve the organization's most complex technical challenges, define enterprise architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor engineering teams, and remain an active contributor to the codebase. 

You will work across backend, frontend, mobile, cloud, data and AI to build secure, scalable and resilient healthcare technology products. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Architecture

- Design and build scalable, production-grade applications across web, mobile and cloud. 
 - Define enterprise architecture, technology standards and engineering best practices. 
 - Build reusable platforms, frameworks and shared services that accelerate product development. 
 - Make architectural decisions balancing scalability, performance, security and business outcomes. 
 - Lead design reviews and contribute to critical production code. Full Stack Engineering

- Design and develop backend services, APIs, integrations and distributed systems. 
 - Build responsive web and mobile applications using modern frameworks. 
 - Design scalable databases, workflows and enterprise integrations. 
 - Solve complex production issues and optimize application performance. AI & Data Engineering

- Design and build AI-enabled products using LLMs, RAG, vector databases and agentic workflows. 
 - Build scalable data pipelines and data models supporting analytics and AI. 
 - Drive AI-assisted software development across the engineering team. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies and establish best practices. Cloud, Security & Platform

- Design cloud-native solutions on AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Establish CI/CD, observability, Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Define security architecture and ensure compliance with healthcare security standards. 
 - Optimize platform reliability, scalability and cloud costs. Technical Leadership

- Mentor Lead Engineers and Senior Engineers. 
 - Drive engineering quality through architecture reviews and code reviews. 
 - Act as the highest technical escalation point for complex engineering challenges. 
 - Partner with Product, Design and Business teams to deliver scalable solutions. Required Qualifications

- BE/BTech from Tier 1 Engineering Colleges only - CSE /IT (Mandatory)
 - Masters is Computer science is a plus. 
 - Must have experience in a Product based company. 
 - Expert-level software engineering with strong backend, frontend and mobile development experience. 
 - Deep expertise in Node. js, Java or Python and modern frontend frameworks such as React/Next. js. 
 - Strong experience building React Native applications for Android and iOS. 
 - Deep & Proven expertise in distributed systems, REST APIs, microservices and system design. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL, NoSQL, data modelling, and data engineering. 
 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD. 
 - Practical experience building AI-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, vector databases and agentic workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of secure software development, OWASP and modern DevSecOps practices. 
 - Excellent debugging, problem-solving and architectural decision-making skills. Leadership Expectations

- Lead through technical excellence and hands-on execution. 
 - Build reusable engineering capabilities rather than one-off solutions. 
 - Establish engineering standards and promote AI-enabled development practices. 
 - Mentor engineers and cultivate a culture of ownership, quality and continuous learning. 
 - Stay current with modern engineering trends and drive adoption where they create measurable business value. Preferred Experience

- Healthcare, SaaS, Enterprise Software, Logistics or FinTech. 
 - Zero-to-one product development and platform modernization. 
 - Experience building high-scale, cloud-native systems. 
 - Exposure to regulated environments and enterprise integrations.

data.title: Head of Product Engineer (SaaS)
data.description:
Company: ProfitWheel

Product: consumr. ai

Location: Mumbai, India (Relocation to Mumbai is a must)

Role: Full-Time | Individual Contributor + Technical Leadership

Experience: Ideally 5-7+ years of relevant hands-on experience. Exceptional candidates with less experience are welcome. 

About consumr. ai

consumr. ai is an AI-powered consumer intelligence and market research platform that helps businesses understand not just what consumers do, but why they make decisions and what could influence them next. We combine real-world behavioral, intent, and conversational intelligence with AI Twins, multi-agent AI systems, Quantitative Research, Qualitative Research, and advanced analytics to help global brands and agencies make smarter business decisions. 

Our platform is constantly evolving, and we're building technology that challenges how traditional consumer research, AI, and business decision-making work. We are looking for someone who wants to be part of building that future. 

The Role: Lead It! Build It! Own It!

We're looking for a Head of Product Engineering who is as comfortable writing code as they are designing architecture, managing infrastructure, or leading a development team. 

This is not a conventional management position. 

We have a lean engineering team, and we need someone who can independently own technical challenges while providing direction, mentoring, and accountability to the developers working alongside them. 

You'll work closely with product leadership, turning ambitious product ideas into technically sound, scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions. 

Sometimes you'll architect a complex new feature. Sometimes you'll build a proof of concept yourself. Sometimes you'll write frontend or backend code, troubleshoot a production issue, conduct a security review, or help a developer solve a difficult problem. 

You'll be expected to think like a product owner, build like an engineer, lead like a mentor, and operate like someone who takes personal responsibility for the outcome. 

What you'll be responsible for

- Product Engineering & Architecture
 - Own and continuously improve the overall product architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, maintainability, and security. 
 - Translate product vision and business requirements into technical architecture, development specifications, and executable engineering plans. 
 - Independently research new technologies, develop proof of concepts (POCs), and validate technical feasibility before committing team resources. 
 - Take ownership of frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, and core platform services. 
 - Contribute directly to development when needed, including writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimizing production code. 
 - Identify architectural bottlenecks, accumulated technical debt, and opportunities for performance improvements. 

2. AI Engineering & Technology Innovation

- Understand the architecture and operational considerations of modern AI applications, including LLMs, AI agents, RAG, model APIs, and AI-driven workflows. 
 - Help design, integrate, and optimize AI-powered product features with a focus on performance, reliability, cost, and output quality. 
 - Evaluate new frameworks, models, developer tools, and architectural approaches through practical experimentation. 
 - Build POCs that demonstrate how emerging technologies can solve genuine product or business problems. 
 - Stay informed about advances in AI engineering, cloud infrastructure, development practices, and cybersecurity. 

3. Infrastructure, DevOps & Reliability

- Take end-to-end ownership of the product's cloud infrastructure, deployment environments, and operational reliability. 
 - Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, environment configurations, and release processes. 
 - Oversee infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, logging, alerting, backups, disaster recovery, and business continuity. 
 - Ensure the platform can scale efficiently as usage, data volume, and processing requirements increase. 
 - Monitor infrastructure performance and cloud costs, proactively improving efficiency. 
 - Lead technical incident resolution, root-cause investigations, and preventive improvements. 
4. Security, Compliance & Audits

Security should be a foundational engineering responsibility, not something addressed only when a client raises a questionnaire or an audit approaches. 

You'll be responsible for: 

- Establishing and maintaining secure development and infrastructure practices. 
 - Implementing access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, secure API practices, and appropriate data protection measures. 
 - Conducting regular code audits, security reviews, dependency assessments, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Coordinating penetration testing and working through identified security risks. 
 - Maintaining security policies, technical documentation, risk registers, audit trails, and evidence repositories. 
 - Leading technical preparedness for security and compliance reviews, including ISO/IEC 27001 (Information Security Management) and ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management Systems). 

5. Product Discovery, Prototyping & Documentation

We want someone who can take a product conversation and turn it into a working prototype, a documented engineering plan, and eventually a production-ready feature. 

Your responsibility will be to: 

- Understand the underlying business problem and desired product outcome. 
 - Challenge assumptions, ask intelligent questions, and identify technical risks or dependencies. 
 - Research possible solutions and develop working prototypes or POCs where appropriate. 
 - Recommend a technical approach based on feasibility, performance, scalability, security, and development effort. 
 - Create clear architecture diagrams, technical specifications, development requirements, API documentation, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Break approved solutions into actionable tasks for the engineering team. 
 - Remain accountable for the implementation from development through production release. 

6. Sprint Management, Releases & Product Quality

- Own engineering execution through effective sprint planning, task prioritization, estimation, and backlog management. 
 - Establish realistic timelines, clearly communicate dependencies, and proactively flag delivery risks. 
 - Ensure agreed development milestones and release commitments are met. 
 - Maintain structured release cycles, version control, deployment checklists, and accurate release notes. 
 - Establish and enforce code review practices, automated testing, regression testing, and quality assurance standards. 
 - Prevent avoidable production defects and ensure critical bugs are identified, prioritized, and resolved quickly. 
 - Continuously improve engineering processes to increase development speed without compromising product quality. 

7. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

You'll lead a small team of developers, but this is a leadership-through-participation role rather than a purely supervisory position. 

- Provide technical direction, mentorship, and hands-on guidance to developers. 
 - Review technical approaches, unblock development challenges, and help the team improve its engineering standards. 
 - Encourage ownership, accountability, learning, and constructive collaboration. 
 - Work closely with Product, Customer Success, and other internal stakeholders across India and the United States. 
 - Communicate technical challenges and product updates in clear business language, without unnecessary jargon. 
 - Ensure that internal teams are informed about product releases, known issues, fixes, and improvements. 

What we are looking for

Technical Capabilities

- Strong hands-on software engineering experience across frontend and backend development. 
 - Ability to design, build, debug, and maintain full-stack applications independently. 
 - Solid understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, databases, APIs, asynchronous processing, and system integrations. 
 - Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, DevOps, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and application security. 
 - Experience building and operating scalable SaaS applications or complex web-based products. 
 - Strong understanding of software testing, code quality, version control, and secure engineering practices. 
 - Familiarity with modern AI application architectures and the technical challenges of integrating AI into production environments. 
 - Ability to own technical documentation, architecture reviews, and security/compliance readiness. 

Leadership & Communication

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. 
 - Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical product and business stakeholders. 
 - A collaborative, approachable personality with strong interpersonal skills. 
 - Confidence to challenge ideas constructively and recommend better alternatives. 
 - Ability to lead a small team while remaining a highly productive individual contributor. 
 - Strong organizational skills and the discipline to manage multiple technical priorities. 
 - Clear documentation habits and a structured approach to problem-solving. 

Experience & Qualifications

Ideally, you have 5-7 or more years of relevant experience with substantial hands-on responsibility for software engineering, product architecture, technical delivery, or infrastructure. 

Experience as a Tech Lead, Lead Full-Stack Engineer, Principal Engineer, Engineering Lead, or Founding Engineer would be particularly relevant. 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first few months, we'd expect you to: 

- Develop a strong understanding of the product, its architecture, infrastructure, and engineering challenges. 
 - Establish clear engineering priorities and identify opportunities for architectural, security, and operational improvements. 
 - Take ownership of development planning, code quality, deployment discipline, and release management. 
 - Independently prototype and help deliver new product capabilities. 
 - Improve documentation, testing practices, monitoring, and audit readiness. 
 - Build a productive working relationship with the engineering team and cross-functional stakeholders.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten. 

Update JD with format found here and add the Job Description to the Library here!

About The Role

As a Principal Software Engineer at Ethos, you'll be a senior technical leader across engineering. You'll shape the architecture of systems that serve our families, drive complex initiatives that span multiple teams, and raise the quality bar for the whole organization. You stay hands-on in code and design, and you'll be a go-to partner for product and engineering leadership on technical direction. 

Duties And Responsibilities

- Lead the design of complex, cross-team systems with a focus on long-term extensibility, scalability, and reliability, including foundational changes that affect multiple teams. 
 - Drive projects end-to-end across teams and functions, including multi-phase rollouts, milestone planning, and early identification of short and long-term risks. 
 - Set and raise the bar for testing, monitoring, data quality, and engineering standards across pods, and reduce complexity and technical debt where it slows the organization down. 
 - Partner with product and leadership to shape the technology roadmap and contribute to product planning. 
 - Mentor engineers across the organization, lead architecture reviews and interviews, and serve as a role model for Ethos engineering practices and values. 
 - Communicate clearly with audiences from junior engineers to C-level leadership. 

Qualifications And Skills

- 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 4+ years designing complex, high-scale backend systems. 
 - Depth and breadth in backend architecture, with the ability to weigh tradeoffs across reliability, scalability, operational cost, and ease of adoption. 
 - Proven track record of leading multi-team technical initiatives from design through production monitoring. 
 - Strong software engineering practice: design patterns, code review, and unit and integration testing. 
 - Full stack experience in one or more of the following: JavaScript, Python/Django, or Ruby/Rails. 
 - Ability to give structured, actionable feedback, and openness to receiving it and changing course. 

Don't meet every single requirement? If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. 

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. data.title: Systems Architect / Engineer
data.description:
Summary-

We are seeking an experienced Data Science Systems Architect / Engineer who can bridge deep software-engineering and systems-architecture expertise with hands-on Data Science and Machine Learning capabilities. The ideal candidate brings 6-15 years of overall technical experience, with around 2 years dedicated to data-science, ML, and AI-driven system design. In this role, you will lead the architectural definition of ML pipelines, model-inference platforms, and intelligent systems that integrate with Mavenir's core network products. You will collaborate closely with R&D, Product Management, Sales Engineering, and global account teams to deliver production-grade solutions. Telecom / IMS / VoLTE domain experience is a strong add-on advantage. 

Key Job Responsibilties-

Architecture & System Design

- Lead architectural and functional discussions for ML-enabled network solutions, defining end-to-end data, pipeline, and model architectures. 
 - Design scalable, production-grade ML pipelines covering ingestion, feature engineering, model training, inference, and monitoring. 
 - Draft comprehensive functional and development requirements for data/ML systems, APIs, and integration points with core network products. 
 - Collaborate with R&D to review code, ensure implementation meets architectural requirements, and guide CI/CD and deployment practices. 

Data Science & Machine Learning

- Analyze network and operational data using statistical techniques; identify data distributions, correlations, and causation patterns. 
 - Identify preprocessing and post-processing requirements aligned with business logic and telecom protocol specifications. 
 - Experiment with algorithms, architectures, and frameworks to identify the best solutions for network-analytics and automation use cases. 
 - Develop, train, and optimize classical ML, deep-learning, and generative-AI models (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, etc. ). 
 - Implement explainability frameworks (SHAP, LIME) and model-monitoring practices to ensure transparency and reliability in production. 

AI / Agentic & Emerging Technologies

- Build LLM-powered applications, RAG workflows, and agentic systems using modern frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, vector stores). 
 - Integrate ML models with API-based microservices, backend services (FastAPI / Flask / Django), and external telecom systems. 
 - Experiment with GANs for synthetic data generation and augmentation where applicable. 

Domain & Customer Collaboration

- Work with customers, product managers, and industry experts to identify and design ML / AI requirements for telecom solutions (VoLTE, IMS, 5G, Enterprise network). 
 - Understand protocol specifications and telecom KPIs to gain deeper insight into data sources, distributions, and business logic. 
 - Assist Sales Engineering and Business Development in creating technical proposals, RFP / RFI responses, competitive analyses, and white papers. 
 - Develop positioning papers and technical presentations that demonstrate Mavenir's leadership in AI-driven network solutions. Leadership & Intellectual Property

- Mentor junior data scientists, ML engineers, and software developers; promote best practices in coding, testing, and model quality. 
 - Protect Mavenir's intellectual property through patent filings, invention disclosures, and competitive-technology tracking. 
 - Attend occasional off-hour conference calls with offices across the US, Europe, and Asia to support global delivery. 

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Experience Profile

- 6 - 15 years of professional experience in software engineering, systems architecture, or telecom/network engineering. 
 - ~2 years of focused, hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI engineering, including production ML pipeline design and deployment. 
 - Demonstrated track record of leading technical discussions and delivering complex, multi-system solutions. Technical Skills - Core

- Strong hands-on programming in Python and SQL; experience with data modeling, feature engineering, and database technologies. 
 - Solid understanding of ML lifecycle - regression, classification, clustering, time-series, anomaly detection, classical ML (Bagging / Boosting), and Deep Learning (CNN, RNN, Transformers). 
 - Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, and model-evaluation / explainability frameworks (SHAP / LIME). 
 - Experience building REST APIs, microservices, and backend integration workflows (FastAPI / Flask / Django) for ML model inference. 
 - Proficiency with version control (Git), modular code structure, debugging, code optimization, and basic CI/CD practices. Technical Skills - Architecture & Integration

- Experience with API-based systems, service-oriented / microservice architectures, and containerization (Docker / Kubernetes). 
 - Understanding of virtualized product architecture, NFV, cloud-native deployment, and scalable data storage / object-store technologies. 
 - Ability to design and document comprehensive functional / non-functional requirements for data and ML systems. Generative AI & Agentic Systems (Plus)

- Practical exposure to LLMs, embeddings, vector stores, and RAG pipelines. 
 - Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Langflow, MCP) for multi-step AI workflow orchestration. 
 - Familiarity with GANs for synthetic data generation (optional but valuable). 

PREFERRED / ADD-ON ADVANTAGES

Telecom Domain Experience

- Understanding of telecom network architectures and protocols (VoLTE, VoWiFi, IMS, 5G, Enterprise solutions) - strong plus. 
 - Experience with telecom KPIs, network analytics, signaling data, and protocol-level data interpretation. 
 - Prior work with telecom core-network products, NFV infrastructure, or operator-grade deployment environments. Advanced Education & Certifications

- Master's or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Data Science, AI / ML, Electronics / Telecom Engineering, or a closely related field. 
 - Relevant certifications (TensorFlow Developer, PyTorch, AWS / GCP / Azure ML, Kubernetes, etc. ) are a plus. SOFT SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

- Effective oral and written communication skills; ability to explain complex ML / architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to decompose complex issues into actionable tasks and deliver under tight timelines. 
 - Ability to work successfully under limited supervision; self-driven and ownership-oriented from idea to implementation. 
 - Collaborative team player who can adapt to different personalities, work across time zones, and thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment. 
 - Curiosity and commitment to continuous learning, especially in rapidly evolving AI technologies and telecom innovations.
