data.title: AI Evals Engineer [SDET]
data.description:
About the Role: 

We are looking for a hands-on AI Evals Engineer to own how we measure, validate, and continuously improve the quality of our NLP, ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities. You will design and build evaluation frameworks, datasets, and automated quality gates that give engineering and product teams real confidence before and after every release. This is a deeply technical, build-first role. You will write code every day: eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge pipelines, test datasets, and CI/CD integrations. A background in test automation and quality engineering, combined with strong AI fundamentals, is the ideal profile. 

What 'll be Responsible for?

- Design and build end-to-end evaluation frameworks for LLM-powered features, RAG pipelines, copilots, and multi-step agents. 
 - Create and curate high-quality evaluation datasets: golden sets, adversarial and edge-case sets, synthetic data, and production-derived regression sets, with clear versioning and labeling guidelines. 
 - Define task-specific quality metrics and rubrics covering accuracy, groundedness, hallucination, relevance, safety, toxicity, bias, latency, and cost. 
 - Build and calibrate LLM-as-judge pipelines, and validate them against human annotation (agreement, bias, and drift analysis). 
 - Evaluate agentic systems: tool-use correctness, planning and reasoning quality, trajectory analysis, task completion, error recovery, and guardrail adherence. 
 - Run red-teaming and robustness testing: prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and adversarial inputs. 
 - Integrate evals into CI/CD as automated quality gates, with regression detection across model, prompt, and retrieval changes. 
 - Set up online and offline monitoring for production quality: sampling, drift detection, feedback loops, and alerting. 
 - Partner with ML engineers, product managers, and developers to translate product requirements into measurable, testable quality criteria. 
 - Analyze failures, perform root-cause analysis, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for models, prompts, and system design. 
 - Mentor SQE1 and SQE2 engineers, and contribute to evaluation standards, best practices, and reusable internal tooling. 

What We'll look in you?

Technical Skills (Must-Have)

- 6 to 10 years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles, with at least 1 to 2 years on AI/ML or LLM-based products. 
 - Strong hands-on programming in Python; working knowledge of one more language such as Java, TypeScript, or Go is a plus. 
 - NLP: tokenization, embeddings, semantic similarity, text classification, summarization, and NER; classical metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and their limitations. 
 - Machine Learning: supervised and unsupervised learning, train/validation/test methodology, overfitting, data leakage, and metrics such as precision, recall, F1, AUC, and calibration. 
 - Generative AI: transformer and LLM concepts, prompting techniques, fine-tuning vs. RAG, context windows, sampling parameters, hallucination, and non-determinism. 
 - Agentic AI: agent architectures, tool/function calling, planning and memory, multi-agent orchestration, and protocols such as MCP. 
 - Practical experience designing evals for LLM applications: datasets, rubrics, LLM-as-judge, pairwise comparison, and human-in-the-loop review. 
 - Strong test automation foundations: framework design, API and service testing, CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar), and test data management. 
 - Working knowledge of statistics for evals: sampling, confidence intervals, significance testing, inter-annotator agreement, and handling non-deterministic outputs. 
 - Preferred Skills (Good-to-Have)

- Hands-on experience with eval and observability tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, TruLens, OpenAI Evals. . 
 - Experience with LLM and agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or the Claude and OpenAI SDKs. 
 - Familiarity with vector databases and retrieval evaluation (recall@k, MRR, nDCG, context precision and recall). 
 - Experience with AI safety and security testing: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, red-teaming, and guardrail validation. 
 - Exposure to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, data versioning, and production monitoring. 
 - Experience with performance, load, and cost testing of LLM-backed services. 
 - Background in Playwright, Selenium, Appium, REST Assured, pytest, or similar automation stacks. 
 - Cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) experience. 
 - Domain exposure to telecom, messaging, or CPaaS platforms is an added advantage. Behavioral Competencies

data.title: Supervisor, SAM & CLH
data.description:
Role Overview

The Software Asset & CLH Analyst III is the shift lead and technical anchor for one of the three IST-anchored shifts. The role carries two things at once: operational command of the shift - queue ownership, escalation resolution, and the handover into the next window - and the deepest technical expertise on the team, covering Corporate License Hosting server operations and the high-risk legal and contractual gating that junior levels are not authorised to clear. 

On the CLH side the analyst monitors the health of the global floating-licence servers, raises and validates licence file changes when contracts renew or quantities change, reads concurrent-usage metrics from the Altair Floating License Monitor, and works daemon drops to resolution inside the 4-hour SLA. On the governance side the analyst handles EULA and clickwrap reviews, checks the master review register before re-reviewing, routes signed agreements out of the standard queue and into formal legal cases, and supports publisher relationships and business reviews. Three of these roles exist, one per shift, and each is the senior decision-maker on duty when the manager is off the clock. 

CORE COMPETENCIES & EXPERTISE

To maintain operational excellence, analysts must demonstrate proficiency in the following key domains: 

- Foundational Licensing Knowledge: Deep understanding of perpetual, subscription, SaaS, and true-up models, including their unique compliance implications and operational requirements. 
 - Corporate License Hosting (CLH) Expertise: Advanced capability in managing floating-license servers, editing configuration files, working daemon drops within SLAs, and analyzing concurrent usage metrics via the Altair Floating License Monitor. 
 - Governance & Risk Management: Authority to manage high-risk EULA/clickwrap reviews, check master review registers, and enforce the prohibition on signed agreements within standard queues by routing them to formal legal channels. 
 - Compliance & Audit Proficiency: Mastery in constructing Initial and Final License Positions (ELP) by reconciling entitlement against usage evidence, and supporting publisher business reviews. 

Key Responsibilities

- Shift Leadership & Escalation Ownership
 - Own the shift: allocate work across the Level III, Level II and Level I analysts on duty, hold turnaround targets, and act as the senior decision-maker on the floor. 
 - Take and resolve escalations - customer complaints, blocked provisioning, entitlement disputes and licence failures - and judge correctly what must go to the ESAM Manager or the client rather than be absorbed. 
 - Run a clean handover into the next shift: open escalations, at-risk items and in-flight approvals documented and explicitly accepted, so nothing stalls in the gap. 
 - Mentor Level II analysts, review their complex casework, and build the bench for shift-lead cover. 
 - Monitor the portal and ticket queues for the shift, keeping ticket hygiene and category coding correct so reporting downstream is trustworthy. 
 - Corporate License Hosting (CLH) Server Operations
 - Monitor the health of the global licence servers hosting concurrent and floating licences, working daemon drops and service failures to resolution within the 4-hour critical SLA. 
 - Raise and validate 'Licence File Change' requests on contract renewal, quantity change or expiry, editing the flat text configuration files on the hosting servers correctly and reversibly. 
 - Read concurrent checkout and peak-usage metrics from the Altair Floating License Monitor - logging in strictly as a guest, and never entering corporate credentials without explicit system-administrator approval. 
 - Assess new hosting requests against the CLH eligibility criteria: native floating/concurrent licence support, Windows or Linux server compatibility, a supported server daemon (FlexNet preferred, others subject to compatibility review), no geolocation or policy usage restrictions, and an active informative catalogue item for user instructions. 
 - Apply the CLH request-routing matrix on unlisted floating-licence requests - checking the hosted-titles list, brokering spare capacity with the product champion and support owner on publicly shared pools, bypassing pool sharing on private pools, and capturing destination MAC addresses where a requester declines server hosting. 
 - Manage decommissioning: raise the support request to retire the daemon and remove licence files from the server when a hosted product is withdrawn. 
 - High-Risk Legal, EULA & Contract Gating
 - Own high-risk EULA and clickwrap review on the shift - copying non-signed agreements to secure storage and checking the master reviews register to confirm whether an approved review already exists within the last three years before triggering a new one. 
 - Enforce the signed-agreement prohibition: signed agreements are never accepted through the standard unlisted queue and must be routed via the contract intake path to be managed as formal legal cases. 
 - Identify and reject out-of-scope use cases on sight - code to be incorporated into customer-facing products, personal devices, and reverse engineering - using the standard responses and correct onward routing. 
 - Coordinate vendor security assessments and legal-review pipelines, and track the cases needing director-level signature through to execution by the client's signatory. The team never signs. 
 - Support the renewal milestone schedule as the technical owner of licence position - building the Initial and Final Licence Positions from usage scans and consumption snapshots. 
 - Publisher Governance, Audits & Continuous Improvement
 - Support publisher relationships and coordinate Semi-Annual Business Review inputs - performance data, utilisation evidence and action tracking - for the publishers in scope. 
 - Run the shift's weekly and monthly licence audits, and own the accuracy of savings and cost-avoidance entries in the licence-reclaim audit table. 
 - Identify automation candidates and author Business Requirements Documents where a publisher crosses 1, 000 transactions a year, moving work onto robotic process automation or vendor APIs. 
 - Own the technical escalation path into publishers and resellers for entitlement, key and activation failures the shift cannot resolve. 
 - Maintain and improve SOPs for the technical procedures on the shift, so CLH work is repeatable rather than resident in one person's head. 

PERFORMANCE & SERVICE LEVELS

Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift. 

- CLH Critical Response: resolve or contain critical Corporate License Hosting issues - daemon drops, server unavailability, checkout failures - within the 4-hour SLA. 
 - Shift SLA Attainment: hold the shift's queues to the committed targets, with listed software inside 3 days and standard SaaS provisioning inside 1 day. 
 - Escalation Resolution: own every escalation raised on the shift to closure or explicit handover, with no silent ageing. 
 - Handover Completeness: 100% of shifts closed with a documented, accepted handover. 
 - Legal & Authority Compliance: zero signed agreements processed through the unlisted queue; zero agreements signed by the team; 100% register check before a new legal review is raised. 
 - Licence Position Accuracy: Initial and Final Licence Positions delivered on the milestone dates and reconcilable to usage evidence. 
 - Audit & Savings Integrity: weekly and monthly audits completed, with reclamation entries complete and accurate enough to stand as the savings record. 

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

- CLH & Licence Servers: global floating-licence servers, FlexNet and other supported daemons, flat text licence configuration files, and the Altair Floating License Monitor. 
 - Entitlement & Usage: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and consumption tracking, plus usage scans and SaaS consumption snapshots for licence-position work. 
 - Contract & Legal: Deal Radar for contract and event records, and Pactfinder / Accord for legal review pipelines, NDA requests and signature validation. 
 - Queue & Automation: GUTS and Buganizer for ticket and bug management with strict category coding, and gHive / UiPath for automated reclamation. 
 - Financial: SAP Materials Management for purchase orders, amendments and three-way matching. 

Required Skills & Experience

Mandatory

- 6-10+ years in software asset management or software licensing operations, including experience as a shift lead, team lead or senior technical escalation point. 
 - Hands-on Corporate License Hosting or floating-licence server experience: FlexNet or comparable daemons, editing licence configuration files, troubleshooting daemon and service drops, and reading concurrent-usage metrics. 
 - Strong command of EULA and clickwrap review, licence terms and the commercial and legal risk they carry, with the judgment to stop a request rather than pass it through. 
 - Proven licence-position work - reconciling entitlement against deployed and consumed usage and defending the result. 
 - Comfortable working a rotating or fixed non-standard shift, including the NAMER window (22: 00-06: 00 IST). 
 - Clear English communication and the confidence to hold a technical or compliance line with client stakeholders and publishers. 

Preferred

- Software asset management certification (IAITAM CSAM, ITIL, Flexera or ServiceNow SAM credential). 
 - Linux and Windows server administration exposure sufficient to work licence-server issues with infrastructure teams. 
 - Scripting or automation literacy (Apps Script, Python, UiPath) for reclamation and reporting work. 
 - M&A software integration exposure, including termination workflows under privacy constraints. 
 - Experience supporting publisher business reviews and audit responses.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Integration, Officer
data.description:
Who We Are

Charles River Development (CRD) is the FinTech division of State Street. Together with State Street's Middle and Back-office services, Charles River's cloud-based Front Office technology forms the foundation of the State Street Alpha® Platform, the first front-to-back solution in the industry. 

Our vision is to be the world's leading investment platform, shaping the future of the industry and driving new levels of technology-led innovation, resiliency, efficiency and growth for investors and the people they serve. 

CRD Engineering organization is innovating and transforming the platform by moving away from monolithic software to utilizing next generation cloud-based technology that leverages Microsoft Azure, Kafka, Snowflake, etc. Industry momentum has seen CRD grow over 135% in headcount over the last 5 years, and we continue to grow. As a digital innovation leader, we invest into our solutions, processes, systems, and talent. 

Summary

We are seeking a Data Integration Engineer to design, build, and evolve the data integration capabilities powering the Next-Gen Data Platform within the State Street Alpha ecosystem. 

In this role, you will develop cloud-native, scalable, and resilient data integration services using microservices and serverless architectures, including Azure Functions. 

This is a hands-on engineering role for an experienced developer with minimum 09 years of experience who enjoys solving complex data and distributed systems problems. 

The role combines greenfield framework development with ownership of mission-critical enterprise integrations, including the opportunity to ramp up on and support existing internal Java-based import/export frameworks (built on Java and Pentaho Kettle) and enterprise integration frameworks built using Talend-based solutions that remain essential to the platform. 

Responsibilities

Analyze, design, develop, test, and maintain large-scale, cloud-native data integration services using microservices and serverless patterns (e. g. , Azure Functions). 

Contribute to the design and implementation of core data integration platforms and services, with a focus on scalability, resiliency, operability, and performance. 

Build and enhance APIs and services supporting batch, near-real-time, and event-driven data ingestion and transformation workflows. 

Need to have a hands-on experience on any ETL Technology (Must)

Strong Data warehousing Concepts of ETL tools, such as Talend Cloud Data Integration tool

Collaborate closely with architects, business analysts, product managers, and partner engineering teams across CRIMS and the broader Alpha Platform to deliver simple, sustainable solutions to complex problems. 

Develop, test, debug, and deploy software primarily using Java, SQL, and related cloud-native technologies. 

Perform code reviews and provide informed guidance on design and implementation decisions. 

Write unit, integration, and automation tests to ensure a high-quality, reliable platform. Troubleshoot and resolve issues in distributed, cloud-based production systems, including root-cause analysis for mission-critical client implementations. 

Support and enhance existing internal Java-based import/export frameworks (built on Java and Pentaho Kettle) and enterprise integration frameworks built using Talend integrations as part of overall data platform ownership. 

Participate actively in the agile development process, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. 

Mentor and guide junior engineers, demonstrating increasing independence in design and development. 

Produce and maintain technical documentation, design artifacts, and operational runbooks. 

Qualifications

B. S. degree (or foreign education equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field required. 

M. S. degree preferred. 

Experience & Technical Skills

Minimum 09+ years of professional software engineering experience. 

Experience designing and developing cloud-native services, preferably on Microsoft Azure. 

Hands-on experience with microservices architectures, serverless technologies, and event-driven systems. 

Strong proficiency in Java; experience with Spring-based frameworks is a plus. 

Solid experience with SQL and data-intensive applications. 

Understanding of modern data integration architectures, data transformation, and data quality concepts. 

Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and deployment concepts, including networking, security, identity, configuration, and secrets management. 

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based source control, and automated testing frameworks. 

Ability and willingness to ramp up quickly on internal Java-based import/export frameworks (built on Java and Pentaho Kettle) and enterprise integration frameworks built using Talend for ongoing development and production support. 

Demonstrated problem-solving ability in multi-tiered, high-performance, mission-critical systems. 

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, and monitoring/observability tools. 

Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). Familiarity with modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake or similar technologies. Experience working in financial services or with large-scale enterprise data platforms. 

Prior experience supporting client-facing, production-critical systems. 

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with peers in a collaborative, globally distributed team environment. 

Comfortable balancing new framework development with ownership and support of existing enterprise platforms. 

Work Arrangement

Employees are expected to work from the office 4 days per week, in alignment with team and business needs. 

Interested in learning more about us? Visit our www. statestreet. com www. crd. com LinkedIn page: State Street on LinkedIn

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you'll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement:

We are looking for a Machine Testing Engineer to handle testing and validation activities for filling, packaging, and processing machinery. Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)

Key Expectations

Role Overview

We are seeking a thorough SOC Physical Verification & Integration Specialist to drive the physical assembly and signoff of our next-generation SOCs. In this role, you will own the physical integration strategy from the floorplan stage through to tapeout, ensuring seamless assembly of massive multi-hierarchical blocks. You will act as the critical bridge between block-level implementation, top-level integration, and final foundry signoff, ensuring that complex physical bottlenecks are resolved without compromising power, performance, or area (PPA). 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Top-Level Physical Integration: Drive the full-chip physical assembly of very large-scale SOCs (e. g. , multi-billion transistor designs). Manage top-level floorplanning, bump planning, global power grid (PG) integration, and top-level clock/routing integration. 
 - Hierarchical Verification Methodology: Architect and deploy highly efficient, hierarchical physical verification (PV) flows. Define the boundary conditions, abstraction models, and interface rules required to assemble heavily partitioned, massive-scale designs. 
 - Signoff Execution & Debugging: Own full-chip DRC, LVS, ERC, Antenna, ESD, and Latch-up signoff using industry-standard tools (e. g. , Siemens Calibre) at advanced process nodes (5nm, 3nm, or below). 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner tightly with the Physical Design (PD) and Static Timing Analysis (STA) teams. Proactively resolve integration conflicts-such as top-level routing congestion or interface timing violations-ensuring that physical fixes do not disrupt timing closure. 
 - Design Rule Co-Optimization: Work directly with foundry partners to interpret complex design rules and waive or resolve edge-case violations specific to reticle-limit designs. 
 - Automation & Flow Development: Develop robust scripts and utilities to automate physical integration tasks, database merging, and PV result parsing to accelerate the tapeout cycle. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 14-20 Years
 - Technology Focus: Sub-5nm (3nm/2nm)
 - Required Qualifications

 - Strong foundational understanding of Physical Design and Static Timing Analysis (STA) to effectively communicate with implementation teams and assess the timing impact of PV fixes. 
 - Tool Proficiency: * Mastery of top-level integration tools (Cadence Innovus). 
 - Expertise in physical verification suites (e. g. , Siemens Calibre nmDRC/nLVS/PERC, Synopsys IC Validator). 
 - Familiarity with chip/package co-design and bump planning tools. 
 - Programming/Scripting: High proficiency in Tcl, Python, and/or Perl for EDA flow automation and database manipulation. 
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

data.title: Emulation Engineer – AI Inference Systems
data.description:
About the Company

www. enchargeai. com

About the Role

Location: Onsite/hybrid/Remote Emulation Engineer - AI Inference Systems Location: Onsite/Hybrid/Remote Job Description: EnCharge AI is seeking an experienced Emulation Engineer with deep expertise in hardware emulation to help bring up the next-generation AI inference platform, from the accelerator SoC to multi-chip, rack-scale scale-up and scale-out systems. You will set the technical direction for, build, and own the pre-silicon environments that let hardware, firmware, and software teams run real inference workloads months before silicon arrives, and that de-risk tape-out at datacenter scale. This role focuses on emulation model build and partitioning of large AI accelerator SoCs and chiplet-based systems on Siemens Veloce, speed bridges and transactors for PCIe, LPDDR, HBM, Ethernet, and scale-up links, multi-chip and multi-node emulation of scale-up and scale-out fabrics, and pre-silicon bring-up of firmware, drivers, and the AI software stack. You will define and drive the emulation methodology for debug, power and performance analysis, and regression, and carry that infrastructure forward into post-silicon bring-up. 

Responsibilities

- Set the emulation strategy for AI accelerator SoCs and multi-die/chiplet systems, and own the Siemens Veloce emulation environment (Veloce Strato/Strato+ and Veloce CS) end-to-end. 
 - Build, compile, and partition multi-billion-gate designs across emulator boards and systems, managing clocking, memory modeling (HBM, DDR, on-chip SRAM), capacity, and compile turnaround time. 
 - Develop and integrate transactors for PCIe host interfaces, HBM, Ethernet, and die-to-die and chip-to-chip scale-up links (e. g. , UCIe). 
 - Architect multi-chip and multi-node emulation configurations that model scale-up domains and scale-out fabrics, including collective communication traffic (e. g. , all-reduce, all-to-all) across accelerators. 
 - Enable pre-silicon bring-up of boot ROM, firmware, kernel drivers, runtime, and compiler output, and run real inference models (e. g. , LLMs and other transformer models) end-to-end on emulation with the ML software team. 
 - Perform power and performance analysis with Veloce Power App: capture switching activity on realistic workloads for power estimation and peak-power and di/dt analysis, and measure throughput, bandwidth, and latency to correlate against architectural performance models. 
 - Define the emulation debug methodology (full-visibility waveform and trace capture, triggers, assertions, transaction monitors, save/restore) and lead triage of the hardest issues spanning RTL, firmware, and software. 
 - Build and maintain regression infrastructure and automation that keeps emulation models current with RTL releases, integrates with CI, and maximizes emulator utilization and throughput. 
 - Provide technical leadership for emulation across architecture, RTL design, verification, firmware, and system software teams: define emulation plans, milestones, and tape-out readiness criteria, mentor engineers within the emulation team, and drive capacity planning and tool roadmap discussions with Siemens EDA. 
 - Partner as a peer with the FPGA prototyping team on shared RTL releases, and jointly decide which workloads run on emulation versus prototypes. 

Qualifications

- BS/MS/Ph. D. in EE, CE, CS, or related field with deep hardware emulation experience on complex SoCs, including technical leadership of emulation for at least one large SoC program through tape-out. 

Required Skills

- Deep hands-on experience with Siemens Veloce emulation (Veloce Strato/Strato+ or Veloce CS), including compile, partitioning, and runtime flows. 
 - Strong SystemVerilog/Verilog skills, with experience in emulation-friendly coding, design partitioning, and multi-clock-domain designs. 
 - Experience with transactor-based verification (e. g. , AXI/PCIe transactors) for high-speed interfaces such as PCIe Gen5/6, HBM, and Ethernet. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Tcl, and shell, including regression management and CI systems. 
 - Proven ability to debug across the hardware/software boundary and to drive technical direction for emulation across multiple teams. 
 - Experience with emulation-based power analysis platforms a strong plus. 
 - Equivalent experience on Cadence Palladium or Synopsys ZeBu a plus. 
 - Experience with multi-chip/chiplet emulation, scale-up interconnects (e. g. , UCIe, UALink), or scale-out networking (e. g. , RoCE, Ultra Ethernet) a plus. 
 - Experience bringing up firmware, Linux drivers, or software stacks on emulation; proficiency in C/C++, Linux, and embedded debug (JTAG, GDB) a plus
 - Familiarity with AI/ML accelerators, inference workloads, and frameworks such as PyTorch or ONNX Runtime a plus. 
 - We value demonstrated ability over years of experience; motivated, exceptional candidates at any career stage are encouraged to apply.

data.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (DNS, NTP, LDAP, Linux)
data.description:
Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. 

Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%. 

Job Description

We are seeking a highly experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to implement and support our current and future DNS architecture in private/public cloud. You will be directly responsible for ensuring the scalability, resilience, automation, and performance optimization of our DNS environment by leveraging Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, and Terraform, or Pulumi. 

This is a deeply technical role requiring expert-level understanding of DNS, NTP, LDAP and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems. You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi-tenant-isolated services that serve high-throughput, mission-critical applications. 

Key Responsibilities

- Implement and support large scale DNS Architecture that stretches private & public cloud across multiple regions. 
 - Implement and support Infoblox DDI solutions (DNS, IPAM, DHCP), Cloudflare DNS management, Google & AWS DNS services. 
 - Implement and support highly reliable NTP and LDAP services on Linux instances. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as code leveraging CI/CD automation, Ansible, Terraform/Pulumi, Python and Bash for automated provisioning of DNS services. 
 - Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure updates, patches, and rollbacks. 
 - Automate monitoring, alerting, and self-healing with GitOps and observability tools (Prometheus, Loki, Grafana). 
 - Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and scalable operations. 
 - Troubleshoot and analyze performance across hypervisors, storage, and networking. 
 - Support on-call rotation, incident response, and root cause analysis. 

Qualifications

- 5+ in managing global DNS, NTP and LDAP systems on Linux Operating Systems. 
 - Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code with Ansible, Terraform, or Pulumi. 
 - Working experience implementing OpenLDAP & NTP services (preferably Microchip SyncServer systems). 
 - Expertise with Infoblox DDI systems (or similar enterprise DNS systems: BlueCat, Bind9, CloudFlare, GCP and AWS DNS services). 
 - Familiar with various Infrastructure technology stacks like Hypervisor Technologies (KVM, Vsphere, ), storage protocols (SDS) (iSCSI, NFS, CEPH), L2/L3 Networking 
 - Strong Linux (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu) systems engineering background with advanced scripting in Python, Bash, or Go. 
 - Fluency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test frameworks. 
 - Strong experience supporting mission critical 24x7 customer facing production environments. 
 - Demonstrated success building or maintaining multi-region or high-availability OpenStack clusters. 
 - Ability to write technical documentation and contribute to community wikis or knowledge bases and background in large enterprise infrastructure environments. 

Nice To Have

- Familiar with Cisco UCS Blade Servers (or similar server Infrastructure), Block/File Storage (Soft defined storage preferred). 
 - Understanding of security best practices for system patching and security compliance (e. g. , CIS, NIST). 
 - Background in telco, edge cloud environments.

- Position: Senior Red Team Operator

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Red Team Operator to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience conducting adversary emulation, penetration testing, and red team operations against enterprise, aerospace, and mission-critical environments. This role requires strong technical expertise, creative problem-solving, and the ability to simulate real-world threat actors to improve organizational security posture across cyber and RF-enabled systems. 

The ideal candidate will also possess experience or familiarity with missile defense systems, satellite communications, RF spectrum operations, and electronic warfare concepts to support advanced threat emulation and mission-focused assessments. 

Operations

- Conduct red team engagements against enterprise networks, cloud environments, satellite communications systems, wireless infrastructure, and endpoint systems. 
 - Execute adversary emulation activities aligned to real-world threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). 
 - Perform internal and external penetration testing across multiple operational environments. 
 - Simulate cyber and RF-enabled attack vectors against mission systems and communications architectures. 
 - Identify security weaknesses, exploit vulnerabilities, and demonstrate potential operational and business impacts. 
 - Conduct social engineering, phishing, and physical security assessments where authorized.

 - Evaluate mission system resiliency against cyber-electromagnetic activities. 
 - Assist in identifying vulnerabilities associated with space-based communications and sensor architectures.

 - Desired Traits: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills

 - Ability to operate independently in complex mission environments
 - High attention to detail and operational discipline

 - Example Technologies & Environments Enterprise Active Directory environments

data.title: Associate Engineer  FDM 3D Printing (Hardware & Process)
data.description:
About the job

At Drucks, we're building the future of footwear. 

Every pair we make is designed for one person, printed on demand, and manufactured through our in-house 3D printing technology stack. We don't buy machines and run them. We build them, modify them, improve them, and push them beyond what they're designed to do. 

If you've ever looked at a printer and thought "I can make this better", you'll feel at home here. 

This isn't an operations role. This is for someone who loves hardware, understands FDM printing inside out, and enjoys solving problems that don't have documentation or YouTube tutorials. 

What You'll Do

You'll own our print farm and help make it faster, more reliable, and more capable every single week. Your work will include: 

Operating & Optimising the Print Farm

• Run and monitor multiple FDM printers across production

• Maximise machine uptime and minimise print failures

• Calibrate, maintain and continuously improve printer performance

• Develop robust print profiles for production

Process & Material Development

• Tune parameters for TPU, PVA and multi-material printing

• Optimise temperature, flow, speed, cooling, 

retraction and adhesion

• Handle moisture-sensitive materials and establish

reliable material workflows

• Conduct experiments and convert learnings into production-ready SOPs

Hardware, Firmware & Electronics

• Assemble, rebuild and upgrade custom FDM printers

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical and thermal issues down to root cause

Work on Klipper firmware, macros and printer configurations

• Troubleshoot motion systems, extruders, toolchangers, heated beds, drivers, thermistors, control boards and related electronics

• Commission new machines and validate hardware upgrades

Quality & Documentation

• Define print quality standards

• Create and maintain SOPs, parameter libraries and troubleshooting documentation

• Build systems that reduce recurring failures and improve repeatability

• Track defects, identify patterns and drive corrective actions. 

What We're Looking For

• 2-6 years of hands-on experience with FDM 3D printing

• Strong understanding of printer mechanics, electronics and firmware

• Experience assembling, modifying or repairing FDM printers

• Hands-on experience with Klipper (preferred) or similar open firmware

• Ability to diagnose hardware issues rather than simply re-running prints

• Comfortable working with flexible and hygroscopic materials like TPU and PVA

Strong understanding of process optimisation and print quality

• Mechanical aptitude with printer assembly, maintenance and troubleshooting

• Electronics fundamentals including soldering, schematics and low-voltage systems

• Experience creating SOPs and production processes

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Manufacturing Engineering. 

This Role Isn't For You If

• Your experience is limited to SLA or resin printing

• You've only operated commercial "plug-and-play" printers

• Hardware troubleshooting has always been someone else's responsibility

You prefer structured processes over figuring things out from first principles

Why Join Drucks?

You'll work on one of the world's few end-to-end 3D printed footwear platforms. Our team designs the hardware, develops the materials, writes the firmware, builds the manufacturing workflow and ships products that people wear every day. 

You'll have real ownership, work directly with the founding team, and solve problems that don't exist in traditional manufacturing. 

If you enjoy building machines as much as building products, we'd love to hear from you.

Description

Team Leader - Healthcare Contact Center (Member Services)

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Team Leader to oversee and guide a team of customer service representatives working in a voice-based contact center supporting the US healthcare industry. ResultsCX's 30+-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers' evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20, 000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI-powered digital experience platform. data.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Planisware Architect

Location: Pune, India

Company Overview

About SLB

SLB is the world's leading provider of technology for reservoir characterization, drilling, production, and processing to the oil and gas industry. Working in more than 85 countries and employing approximately 100, 000 people who represent over 140 nationalities, SLB supplies the industry's most comprehensive range of products and services, from exploration through production and integrated pore-to-pipeline solutions for hydrocarbon recovery that optimize reservoir performance. Visit www. slb. com for more information. 

We are a global technology company driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe. Global in outlook, and local in practice, we're united in our passion for discovering solutions and in our commitment to creating a sustainable and balanced future. We set the bar high. So we're looking for talented, driven people committed to innovation and success and who act with integrity. We'll give you a platform to develop both professionally and personally, supported by our community of colleagues, co-workers, alumni, and our valued external partners. It's a deep collaboration that enables us all to achieve our goals. Come and be part of one of the world's most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts. 

About SLB India Technology Center

SLB has embarked on a corporate transformation to deliver a step change in the reliability, efficiency and integration of our technologies, products and services. Advanced technologies are key enablers to this and encompass all aspects of business systems, including the organization platform and processes. Investments in, and building strong competences across our technology pillars - IT Central, SAP, Cyber Security, Digital Enterprise Systems, Data and Analytics, Digital Operations, Architecture and Integration, and Governance and Performance are key to an integrated digital that is positioned to deliver superior results. The SLB India Technology Center has a fundamental and critical role in this corporate transformation and for delivering digital solutions to the larger SLB organization. 

About Role

Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft . Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions. 

The end users supported are the global community in Slb using these systems. Both L1 support and L2 support is provided in-house while L3 Development and Support is outsourced to vendors. 

This role will work closely with the Scrum team on defining / change requirements and align with the development team (L3, vendors) for technical design and effort validation. Further, he/she will define periodic release plans and release schedules in coordination with the domain teams and the L3 vendor while being supervised by the Chief Scrum Master. He / she would manage the execution of release activities and co-ordinate with the L3 development teams to ensure releases are delivered on time and within budget. 

Key responsibilities

Technical Responsibilities

- Solution Design & Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of standard as well as customized Planisware solution to address Project Management needs/Stakeholders
 - Strategic Alignment: Work with product management and IT leadership to align Planisware functionality with business strategies and project goals. 
 - Obtain business requirements and use cases / user stories from Product and Service Delivery, Supply, Distribution and Operation Planning Domains for all enhancements. Validate all such requirements and articulate to the L3 teams
 - Customization Framework: Define best practices and frameworks for customizing Planisware to meet the evolving needs of the business. 
 - Integration Strategy: Develop and implement integration strategies to connect Planisware with other enterprise systems. Optimizing the API calls to minimize the performance issues & Cost. 
 - Governance & Best Practices: Establish governance around Planisware usage, ensuring the platform is optimized for scalability, security, and performance. 
 - Performance Tuning: Monitor system performance, ensuring efficient use of resources, and troubleshoot issues as they arise. 
 - Technical Leadership: Provide guidance and mentorship to development teams, ensuring high-quality deliverables Serve as a SPOC to the L3 inhouse / vendor development team and coordinate all development and testing activities. Help development team to understand the error causes on production environment
 - Review and get technical feasibility validation of the technical design provided by L3 for the change requests. 
 - Ensure adoption of Scrum in the development process. Also ensure DevOps is adopted within the team efficiently
 - Work on roll-back scenarios and identify cases where roll-backs are necessary

Release Management

- Assist the Technical Team in the design and development of the release management process
 - Expertise in various PLW modules, including Oscar and PMGo modules. 
 - Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
 - Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
 - Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
 - Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process
 - Periodically reports performance metric dashboard for releases handled. Communicate release details and schedules to the Domains as required

Essential Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
 - 10+ years of overall support/development experience, of which 5 + years on Planisware. 
 - Planisware Certification - Specialist OR Expert
 - 4+ years in Change and Release Management
 - 3 to 4 years of experience building on Web apps / Desktop Apps using technologies like React, Angular, Java ASP. NET, etc. 
 - Good understanding of consuming APIs through Single Page Application (SPA). 
 - Good exposure to database technologies like Oracle, MS SQL Server, etc. 

Key competencies

- In-depth knowledge of the change management process working on the change and release module
 - Should have a thorough understanding and working knowledge of ITIL processes including Application Change and Release Management
 - Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments
 - Very good understanding around building Planisware based solution and Integration / data migration processes
 - Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment
 - Good knowledge of Azure IaaS / PaaS
 - Very good experience of version management. 
 - Experience of providing overall process improvements adopting to the release process
 - Advanced knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle
 - Preferred experience in Oil & Gas industry (though not mandatory)

Other Skills And Abilities

- Self-driven, Proactive, Systems Thinking
 - Open to travel abroad and in India
 - Comfortable working occasional extended hours demanded by emergency release
 - Exposure to Performance Tuning (Tuning concepts - indexes, segments, partitions, query tuning) of database systems would be an added advantage
 - Works well with all personality types

SLB as an employer

data.title: Veeva Analyst
data.description:
Veeva Vault CTMS Analyst

Experience: 4-5 Years

Job Location: Remote

Job Type: Contract (3-6 Months)

Work Timings: 1: 00 PM - 10: 00 PM IST

Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Veeva Vault CTMS Analyst with 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Veeva Vault Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), particularly in post-implementation production support and application maintenance services (AMS). 

The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and administrative support for Veeva Vault CTMS, managing production incidents, system configurations, release management, enhancements, integrations, and compliance activities. 

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of clinical trial operations, pharmaceutical processes, GxP compliance, and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Experience working with large pharmaceutical or life sciences clients is highly preferred. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Veeva Vault CTMS - Production Support

- Provide L1/L2/L3 production support for Veeva Vault CTMS and resolve incidents within defined SLAs. 
 - Troubleshoot issues related to clinical studies, study sites, monitoring visits, milestones, workflows, and user access. 
 - Investigate workflow failures, stuck tasks, permission issues, and system-related errors. 
 - Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent solutions for recurring issues. 
 - Coordinate with Veeva Support and technical teams for product defects and escalations. 
 - Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets using ServiceNow or Jira Service Management. 

2. Veeva Vault Administration & Configuration

- Manage user accounts, roles, security profiles, permission sets, and access controls. 
 - Configure and maintain workflows, object lifecycles, document types, metadata, notifications, and page layouts. 
 - Maintain CTMS master data, including studies, study countries, sites, milestones, and monitoring visit templates. 
 - Support periodic user access reviews and ensure compliance with access management policies. 
 - Generate and maintain reports and dashboards to support clinical operations. 

3. Release Management & Testing

- Review Veeva Vault release notes and assess the impact of new features and enhancements. 
 - Perform release impact analysis and coordinate feature enablement. 
 - Conduct sandbox testing, regression testing, and functional validation before production releases. 
 - Prepare and execute test scripts and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT). 
 - Track defects and ensure their resolution before deployment. 
 - Update validation documentation and coordinate production readiness with QA and business stakeholders. 

4. Enhancements & Change Requests

- Gather business requirements from Clinical Operations teams. 
 - Prepare functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow documents. 
 - Identify opportunities for system enhancements and process improvements. 
 - Coordinate configuration changes and ensure proper testing and deployment through change control. 
 - Maintain enhancement backlogs and prioritise change requests based on business requirements. 

5. Integration & Data Management

- Monitor integrations between CTMS and other clinical systems, including eTMF, EDC, IRT, and data warehouses. 
 - Troubleshoot failed interfaces, integration jobs, and data synchronization issues. 
 - Coordinate with technical teams to resolve API and integration-related issues. 
 - Perform data reconciliation, data validation, and approved data corrections. 
 - Ensure consistency and accuracy of clinical trial master data across connected applications. 

6. Compliance, Documentation & User Training

- Ensure the system remains compliant with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and Good Documentation Practices (GDP). 
 - Support Computer System Validation (CSV), change control, periodic reviews, and audit-trail reviews. 
 - Maintain validation documents, including URS, FRS, RTM, and test evidence. 
 - Support client audits and regulatory inspections. 
 - Conduct user onboarding, training, and refresher sessions for CRAs, study managers, and clinical operations teams. 
 - Maintain SOPs, work instructions, FAQs, and knowledge base articles. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

- 4-5 years of overall experience, with approximately 3-5 years of relevant Veeva Vault CTMS experience. 
 - Hands-on experience in Veeva Vault CTMS production support after go-live. 
 - Strong functional knowledge of Veeva Vault CTMS and clinical trial management processes. 
 - Experience in application maintenance and support (AMS) or managed services environments. 
 - Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences clients, preferably large pharma clients. 
 - Good understanding of clinical trial processes and ICH-GCP (E6). 
 - Hands-on knowledge of Veeva Vault administration, including users, roles, permissions, workflows, and lifecycles. 
 - Experience in incident management, problem management, SLA tracking, and root cause analysis. 
 - Knowledge of release management, regression testing, UAT, and defect management. 
 - Understanding of CSV, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and change control. 
 - Exposure to integrations, APIs, data reconciliation, and connected clinical applications. 
 - Strong documentation, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and handle client-facing responsibilities. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Veeva Vault CTMS, Clinical Operations, or Vault Administrator certification. 
 - Exposure to other Veeva Clinical applications such as eTMF, Study Start-Up, Site Connect, and Site Payments. 
 - Experience with Vault Loader, Vault API, and data migration activities. 
 - Knowledge of legacy CTMS platforms such as Oracle Siebel CTMS. 
 - ITIL Foundation or other IT Service Management certifications. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory audits and inspections. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

Handle plant emergencies related to Boiler-Turbine-Generator (BTG) and coordinate responses. 

Manage emergencies related to switchyards and grid problems to minimize impact on operations.

Energy Conservation And Environmental Compliance

Promote energy conservation in all activities, focusing on Specific Oil Consumption (SOC), Auxiliary Power Consumption (APC), Demineralized (DM) Water usage, and Heat Rate.

Notify and report defects, problems in the plant to the shift in charge in a timely manner.

NA

Meet The Team

As a Customer Quality Engineer (CQE) at Cisco, you will serve as a high-level technical authority and strategic partner for our most critical customers. In this role, you will bridge the gap between the Engineering, Global Supply Chain, and Customer Experience organizations. You will be responsible for driving proactive quality strategies as the customer's advocate, leading high-impact failure investigations, and influencing executive stakeholders through data-driven insights to ensure the reliability and performance of Cisco's global install base. 

Your Impact

- Strategic Quality Engagement: Develop and drive a customer-centric hardware quality engagement model for strategic accounts, ensuring end-to-end visibility and transparency on all quality-related matters. 
 - Executive Technical Leadership: Lead monthly external hardware quality performance deep dives, providing actionable metrics, comprehensive issue summaries, and expert-level Root Cause Analysis (RCA) discussions for key customer stakeholders. 
 - Cross-Functional Orchestration: Coordinate complex customer communications regarding corrective and customer mitigation actions (ECO, PCN, Field Notice), serving as the primary liaison between Account Teams, CX, Operations, Quality, and Engineering for these issues. 
 - Field Mitigation & Remediation: Lead field remediation actions for high-impact events in key customer's networks. Monitor customer's in-service and early-life failure activity, and execute tailored mitigation strategies for large-scale, complex network environments. 
 - Operational Integrity: Implement and track field mitigation agreements, including rigorous monitoring across global service depots and networks to minimize customer risk and downtime. 
 - Proactive Analytics: Apply advanced statistical methods and data analytics to uncover actionable insights, drive proactive issue identification, and conduct customer site audits to resolve installation and operational challenges. 
 - Engineering Integration: Partner with quality and design engineering teams to maintain deep, expert-level knowledge of product architecture, failure mechanisms, and quality trends across the customer install base. 
 - Escalation Management: Provide in-region support for critical escalations, assessing technical impact and executing rapid, effective field actions to resolve high-priority quality issues. 

Minimum Qulaifications

- Education: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related with 8+ years of related experience, or a Master's Degree or related with 6+ years of related experience. 
 - Domain Expertise: Extensive, recognized experience in Product or Customer Quality Engineering with a deep understanding of product architecture and complex failure mechanisms. 
 - Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to analyze the upstream and downstream impacts of technical changes, providing strategic recommendations that improve product performance and reliability. 
 - Leadership & Influence: Demonstrated success leading multiple high-priority projects and acting as a technical lead in cross-functional, matrixed environments. 
 - Advanced Analytics: Exceptional ability to apply statistical modeling and data analytics to identify innovative, long-term solutions to persistent quality challenges. 
 - Communication: Superior ability to influence and align executive-level stakeholders through compelling, data-driven storytelling and clear, professional technical reporting. 

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we're revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era - and beyond. We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Disclaimer

About

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will: 

- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
 - begin with screening or an interview
 - originate from a Cisco email address, and

Role Summary

We're seeking a skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Marine DevOps team. DevOps is a development-oriented approach, and you will implement and maintain a DevOps platform that supports development teams for our products. We are passionate about automating routines, infrastructure, and the whole software development lifecycle. Day-to-day, you will engage directly with internal customers, like Software Engineers, QA Engineers, and numerous other teams, to better optimize their workflows through automation and well-designed systems. Observability and security are also priorities. 

Responsibilities

- Design and manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure) using infrastructure as code (Terraform, OpenTofu).

Requirements

 - Strong experience with container tooling and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes). 
 - Proven experience managing production Kubernetes environments. 
 - Familiarity with cloud security guidelines and best practices on public clouds. 
 - Knowledge of monitoring/observability tools (Sumo Logic, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, ELK). 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and support distributed systems on a global scale

Soft Skills

 - Adaptable and curious about AI-assisted tooling - actively uses tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude to work more effectively and stays current as the ecosystem evolves.

 - Ability to remain calm and effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

data.title: PLC Automation engineer
data.description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION - PLC AUTOMATION ENGINEER

**Company: ** Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd. 

**Location: ** Taloja, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department: ** Automation & Projects

**Designation: ** PLC Automation Engineer

**Experience: ** 2-6 Years

**Employment Type: ** Full-Time

### About Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd. 

Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd. is an industrial automation and control panel manufacturing company and an authorized Siemens Channel Partner. We specialize in PLC/DCS automation, drive systems, control panels and industrial automation solutions for steel, metals, rolling mills and other industrial sectors. 

### Job Purpose

We are looking for a skilled PLC Automation Engineer with hands-on experience in Siemens PLC programming, HMI/SCADA development, drive integration, industrial communication and commissioning. 

The candidate will be responsible for executing automation projects from engineering and software development through factory testing, site commissioning and final handover. 

### Key Responsibilities

**1. PLC Programming & Engineering**

- Develop, modify and troubleshoot Siemens PLC programs. 

- Work on Siemens S7-1200, S7-1500 and S7-300 PLC platforms. 

- Hands-on experience with TIA Portal and STEP 7. 

- Develop PLC logic using LAD, FBD and SCL. 

- Configure PLC hardware, remote I/O and communication networks. 

- Develop motor control logic, interlocks, permissives, sequences and alarms. 

- Perform online monitoring, debugging and fault diagnosis. 

**2. HMI & SCADA Development**

- Develop and modify Siemens HMI applications. 

- Work on WinCC, WinCC Advanced and WinCC Unified. 

- Develop process screens, alarm management, trends and faceplates. 

- Establish PLC-HMI communication and troubleshoot communication issues. 

- Develop operator-friendly process visualization. 

**3. Drive & Automation Integration**

- Configure and integrate Siemens SINAMICS drives. 

- Experience with G120 and S120 drives will be preferred. 

- Interface PLC with VFDs for speed reference, start/stop commands and feedback. 

- Understand motor control, speed regulation, interlocks and protection logic. 

- Troubleshoot PLC and drive communication issues. 

**4. Industrial Communication**

- Knowledge of PROFINET and PROFIBUS. 

- Modbus TCP/IP and Modbus RTU. 

- PLC-to-PLC communication. 

- Ethernet networking and remote I/O configuration. 

**5. Panel Testing & FAT**

- Participate in PLC panel testing at the Taloja factory. 

- Perform I/O testing and signal verification. 

- Verify PLC logic against approved control philosophy and drawings. 

- Conduct functional testing of motors, drives, interlocks and sequences. 

- Coordinate with electrical design and panel manufacturing teams. 

- Prepare FAT reports and close testing observations. 

**6. Site Commissioning & Troubleshooting**

- Execute PLC and HMI commissioning at customer sites. 

- Conduct cold and hot commissioning. 

- Perform field I/O checking and loop testing. 

- Troubleshoot automation-related problems. 

- Coordinate with customers and project teams. 

- Support plant trials, production stabilization and final handover. 

- Travel to customer locations as required. 

**7. Project Documentation**

- Maintain PLC and HMI software backups. 

- Prepare I/O lists and communication architecture. 

- Maintain software version control. 

- Prepare FAT/SAT and commissioning reports. 

- Maintain project-specific technical documentation. 

### Technical Skills Required

- Siemens S7-1200 / S7-1500 PLC. 

- TIA Portal / STEP 7. 

- LAD, FBD and SCL programming. 

- Siemens WinCC / WinCC Unified. 

- SINAMICS G120 / S120 drives. 

- ET200SP distributed I/O. 

- PROFINET / PROFIBUS. 

- Industrial automation and electrical drawings. 

- PLC troubleshooting and commissioning. 

### Industry Experience Preferred

- Steel and Metal Industries. 

- Rolling Mills - TMT, Bar Mill and Wire Rod Mill. 

- Galvanizing Lines. 

- Industrial Furnaces. 

- Material Handling Systems. 

- Pharma, Food & Beverage and Packaging. 

- Water Treatment and Process Industries. 

### Educational Qualification

Diploma / BE / B. Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Instrumentation or Industrial Automation Engineering. 

### Experience

2-6 years of relevant experience in Siemens PLC programming, industrial automation and commissioning. 

Candidates with practical experience in steel plant and rolling mill automation will be given preference. 

### Desired Candidate Profile

- Strong technical and troubleshooting skills. 

- Ability to independently execute assigned automation activities. 

- Good understanding of industrial automation systems. 

- Willingness to travel for customer-site commissioning. 

- Good coordination and communication skills. 

- Responsible for project quality and timely execution. 

- Ability to work within project deadlines. 

### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Timely completion of PLC software development. 

2. Quality and reliability of PLC programs. 

3. Successful FAT and SAT completion. 

4. Reduction in commissioning time. 

5. Effective troubleshooting and problem resolution. 

6. Timely project documentation and software backups. 

7. Customer satisfaction. 

8. Project execution within agreed timelines. 

**Work Location: ** Taloja, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra. 

**Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with current CTC, expected CTC and notice period. **
