data.title: Guest Relations Supervisor
data.description:
Job Description - Guest Relations Supervisor

Company DescriptionGrand Hotel (Bombay) Pvt. Ltd. is a hospitality company with a legacy dating back to 1922, when the Grand Hotel, Mumbai, was established. The company owns and operates two distinctive properties in India, committed to delivering memorable guest experiences through personalised service, comfort, and hospitality. 

The Grand Hotel, Mumbai, is the flagship property, designed by renowned architect George Wittet and located in the historic Ballard Estate precinct of South Mumbai. Valley View Grand Resort, the group's second property, is situated in the picturesque hill station of Panhala, Kolhapur, at an altitude of approximately 3, 000 feet above sea level. 

With over a century of hospitality heritage, the company is committed to maintaining high service standards while blending traditional hospitality with contemporary guest expectations. 

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site role for a Guest Relations Supervisor at Grand Hotel, Mumbai, located in South Mumbai. 

The Guest Relations Supervisor will be responsible for ensuring exceptional guest experiences through personalised attention, proactive service, and effective resolution of guest concerns. The role involves overseeing guest relations activities, monitoring guest satisfaction, coordinating with Front Office and other hotel departments, and ensuring that guests receive a warm, seamless, and memorable experience throughout their stay. 

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a strong service-oriented attitude, and the ability to lead by example while maintaining the hotel's standards of hospitality. 

Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience & Relations

- Welcome and engage with guests in a warm, courteous, and professional manner. 
 - Build rapport with guests and provide personalised attention, particularly to VIPs, repeat guests, corporate guests, and guests with special requests. 
 - Proactively interact with in-house guests to assess satisfaction and identify opportunities to enhance their experience. 
 - Ensure guest requests, preferences, and special arrangements are communicated to the relevant departments and followed through promptly. 
 - Assist guests with information regarding hotel facilities, dining options, transportation, and local attractions. Complaint Handling & Service Recovery

- Handle guest complaints, feedback, and service-related concerns professionally, ensuring timely and appropriate resolution. 
 - Coordinate with the Front Office Manager, Duty Manager, and other department heads to address escalated issues. 
 - Follow up with guests after resolution to ensure satisfaction and restore confidence in the hotel's service. 
 - Record guest feedback, complaints, and corrective actions to help prevent recurring issues. 
 - Escalate serious complaints, unusual incidents, or matters affecting the hotel's reputation to the management. Team Supervision & Coordination

- Supervise daily guest relations activities and guide team members in maintaining consistent service standards. 
 - Coordinate closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Engineering, and Security to ensure smooth guest experiences. 
 - Monitor room readiness, special amenities, guest preferences, and VIP arrangements in coordination with the concerned departments. 
 - Support the Front Office team during peak arrival and departure periods whenever required. 
 - Encourage teamwork, professional conduct, and a guest-first approach across departments. Guest Feedback & Quality Standards

- Monitor online reviews, guest feedback, and satisfaction trends across relevant booking platforms and feedback channels. 
 - Coordinate with the management team in preparing appropriate responses to guest reviews and feedback. 
 - Maintain accurate records of guest preferences, complaints, service recovery measures, and special requests. 
 - Identify recurring service gaps and recommend practical improvements to management. 
 - Ensure compliance with hotel policies, service standards, grooming requirements, and quality assurance procedures. Administrative & Operational Responsibilities

- Maintain effective communication and handover records between shifts. 
 - Prepare guest relations reports and provide updates on guest satisfaction, pending concerns, and service issues. 
 - Maintain confidentiality of guest information and safeguard hotel assets. 
 - Assist with VIP arrivals, special occasions, guest celebrations, and other hospitality arrangements. 
 - Perform additional duties as assigned by the Front Office Manager or Hotel Management. 
Qualifications & Skills
 - A degree or diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality, or a related field. 
 - Prior experience in Guest Relations, Front Office, or Guest Services in a hotel environment. 
 - Previous supervisory experience will be preferred. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; knowledge of Hindi and additional languages would be an advantage. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills with a natural ability to interact confidently with guests from diverse backgrounds. 
 - Excellent complaint-handling, problem-solving, and service recovery skills. 
 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with hotel Property Management Systems (PMS). 
 - Knowledge of online travel agency platforms, guest feedback systems, and online review management would be an advantage. 
 - Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 
 - A professional appearance, positive attitude, and commitment to delivering exceptional guest service. 
Job SummaryThe Guest Relations Supervisor serves as a key point of contact for guests, ensuring that their needs are anticipated, requests are fulfilled, and concerns are resolved promptly and professionally. The role requires close coordination with hotel departments, effective supervision of guest relations activities, and a proactive approach to guest satisfaction. 

The successful candidate will help strengthen guest loyalty, encourage positive reviews, improve service delivery, and uphold the reputation and hospitality standards of Grand Hotel, Mumbai. 

Salary PackageAn attractive salary package will be offered in accordance with industry standards, commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and suitability for the role.

data.title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect WiFi
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's enterprise wireless platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. 
 - Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. 
 - Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. 
 - Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. 
 - Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. 
 - Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. 
 - Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. 
 - Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. 
 - Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. 
 - Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. 
 - Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). 
 - Architecture certifications desirable (e. g. , TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance. 
 - Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable. 

Why is this level of Education Required?

- Deep architecture credentials are needed because the role sets the standards that engineering teams and suppliers must build to, and those standards have to withstand security, compliance and reliability challenge. 

Experience Required

- Overall, 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace. 
 - Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. 
 - Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. 
 - Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. 
 - Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. 
 - Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations. 
 - Extensive experience designing enterprise wireless services across complex campus environments. 
 - Deep knowledge of radio frequency design, capacity, roaming, guest access and wireless security. 
 - Evidence of defining wireless architectures that improved coverage, user experience, resilience or operational efficiency. 

Desirable Requirements

- Advanced wireless certification, such as Certified Wireless Network Expert. 
 - Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Meraki or Juniper Mist wireless platforms. 
 - Experience supporting location services, Internet of Things or operational technology wireless use cases. 

Other Job-Related Skills/Background

- Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. 
 - Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. 
 - Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them. 
 - Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome. 
 - Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright. 
 - Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

data.description:
Job Purpose and Impact

- The Full Stack Developer - Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users. 
 - Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using . NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities. 
 - The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer. 

Key Accountabilities

RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY: 

Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments. 

FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY: 

Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation. 

BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs: 

Develops . NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns. 

OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION: 

Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL. 

ENGINEERING QUALITY: 

Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions. 

PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY: 

Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions. 

COLLABORATION: 

Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements. 

CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: 

Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting. 

Qualifications

Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments. 

Demonstrated experience delivery of user-facing reporting or analytics solutions, with proven ability to guide and mentor other engineers. 

Required Skills: 

Mandatory: 

- Strong experience developing backend services using . NET
 - Strong experience building frontend applications using React
 - Hands-on experience with AgGrid for large, data-intensive reporting views
 - Exposure to cloud-native deployment models and CI/CD pipelines

Good to Have: 

- Experience working with risk, finance, or trading reporting platforms

data.title: SDE-2 (React Native + Full stack)
data.description:
Software Development Engineer - II

Frontend Platform (Orion)

Urban Company | Gurugram

About the Company

Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc. , all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardised, and reliable service experience. To fulfil this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise. 

Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind -

- Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
 - Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
 - Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industry

About the Role & Team

Orion is Urban Company's in-house frontend platform: the framework, component system, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every customer and provider facing entity at Urban Company is built on. It is not a library we adopted; we designed and own all of it. 

Orion is deliberately cross-stack. It spans React Native as the base rendering engine for our customer and partner apps, a micro-frontend architecture, and native Android and iOS layers underneath, with a single component system across all of them. 

At UC we follow a micro frontend architecture, every product flow: a booking flow, a category page, a checkout step is built as an independently developed and independently deployed micro-frontend that renders inside the Orion shell, on both app and web. A team ships its changes without coordinating a release with anyone else. 

Our pod owns that architecture: the shell and its contracts, routing and lifecycle, isolation between micro-frontends, shared state and navigation across them. As the number of micro-frontends grows, holding that boundary clean while keeping the app feeling like one product is among the hardest problems on the platform. 

Orion's server-driven UI lets product teams change what a screen shows without shipping an app release, and its own in-house over-the-air pipeline delivers JavaScript updates straight to users' devices. Every product engineer at Urban Company builds on Orion, which means a change to the platform is felt across the entire company. 

Our pod sits inside the Orion team, and owns the following charters built on top of it: 

- Merchant Platform: Letting integrating partners sell their services from inside Urban Company. Their experience runs in a container inside our app session, integrated SSO auth, deeplinks, order lifecycle, discovery touchpoints, and their orders showing up alongside ours in the customer's bookings. The bar is performance good enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins while keeping in mind the security and stability repercussions. 
 - Third-Party Integrations: Taking Urban Company services into other companies' apps. Their users book us without ever leaving their product, server-to-server booking flows, request journeys, catalogue mapping, idempotency, and reconciliation when the other side goes quiet. 
 - Release & Over-the-Air Delivery: OTA bundles for customer and partner apps, Android, iOS and web release pipelines, canary rollouts. 
 - Platform itself: Because the pod is part of the Orion team, whoever joins also owns and contributes to Orion itself, the shared components, the rendering and navigation layer, the release pipeline. You will not just consume the platform, you will improve it, and what you build there is used by every product team at Urban Company and has a direct impact on both our customer and provider app and website ecosystem. 

This is a genuinely cross-stack charter. A single feature here routinely spans a React Native container, a Node. js service and an event pipeline, which is why we hire strong frontend engineers and grow them across the full stack rather than keeping them on one side of it. 

What You'll Do

- Build the Merchant Platform: Take partner brands live inside the Urban Company app, session handoff, order lifecycle, discovery surfaces. While making it secure and fast enough that our users cannot tell where our product ends and theirs begins. 
 - Take Urban Company Into Other Apps: Design and ship server-to-server booking flows that let another company's users book us from inside their product. From the first partner call through contract design, idempotency, rollout and reconciliation. 
 - Strengthen Orion Itself: Improve the shared components, rendering layer and release infrastructure that every Urban Company product team depends on. 
 - Own and Scale the Micro-frontend Architecture: Evolve the shell, contracts and lifecycle that every product team's surface plugs into, and keep the experience feeling like one app as the number of micro-frontends grows. 
 - Grow Across the Stack: Start in React Native, then take on the Node. js services behind your own features. We expect this, we plan for it, and you will not be doing it alone. 
 - Elevate Technical Standards: Write production-grade code, drive architectural design discussions, and raise the bar on performance, correctness and observability. 

Technology Stack

You will get hands-on exposure to: 

- Frontend (primary): React Native, TypeScript, micro-frontends architecture
 - Native: Kotlin (Android), Swift (iOS)
 - Backend: Node. js, TypeScript
 - Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, redis
 - Events: Kafka, event-driven systems
 - Analytics: Snowflake
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana
 - Architecture: Micro-frontends, server-driven UI, microservices
 - Delivery: In-house over-the-air pipeline, feature flags and experiments

What We're Looking For

- 2-4 years of software engineering experience. 
 - At least 2 years building React Native, or modern web with React/Next. js, shipped to real users at real scale. 
 - Strong JavaScript and TypeScript. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals. 
 - Comfortable debugging on real devices: logs, traces, profilers, network waterfalls. 
 - You already develop with an AI agent. Claude Code is mandatory for every engineer at Urban Company, it is how we write code, debug production issues and find our way around unfamiliar services. You should be comfortable building with an AI coding agent. 
 - Strong ownership mindset. You have taken a feature from spec through build and release, and then watched the metrics. 
 - Open to writing backend. No backend experience needed on day one; genuine interest is the requirement. (Backend code in production in any language is a plus. )
 - Native Android or iOS exposure, server-driven UI, design systems, or hard performance work is a plus. 
 - Experience with mobile release pipelines, CI, or over-the-air delivery is a plus. 
 - Comfortable working in a large codebase you did not write. 

What Can You Expect at UC?

- Massive ownership and direct customer impact. 
 - An AI-native engineering org: Claude Code is standard for every engineer here. It changes what a small pod can own, and it collapses the time it takes to understand a service you have never opened. We are still working out what good practice looks like, and you will help decide it. 
 - Work on the surfaces every Urban Company customer touches, and the platform every product team builds on. 
 - Genuine full-stack growth, frontend to backend, web to native, rather than a single layer for years. 
 - A high-performance, high-velocity engineering culture. 
 - Quick iterations with real-world feedback loops. 
 - Opportunity to grow into senior technical leadership roles. 
 - Exposure to problems involving, Cross-platform rendering, app performance on low-end devices, over-the-air delivery and safe rollback, partner API integration, idempotency and correctness.

Preferred Qualifications

data.description:
Forbes Advisor is a new initiative for consumers under the Forbes Marketplace umbrella that provides journalist- and expert-written insights, news and reviews on all things personal finance, health, business, and everyday life decisions. We do this by providing consumers with the knowledge and research they need to make informed decisions they can feel confident in, so they can get back to doing the things they care about most. 

We are looking for a highly skilled Data Engineer (L3) with strong expertise in Python, data ingestion pipelines and marketing data systems, particularly with the Meta Ads ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering and social/native platforms, enabling scalable data pipelines, high-quality datasets, and lead generation and business decision-making. 

This role goes beyond building pipelines - will be responsible for: 

- Designing scalable data architecture
 - Driving business outcomes (revenue, lead quality, conversion efficiency)
 - Owning how data is used, trusted and acted upon

The ideal candidate will not manage campaign buying or bidding directly but must clearly understand ad platform mechanics, attribution models and lead quality scores and will work closely with the Data Lead / Engineering Lead, acting as a key contributor in shaping solutions, making technical decisions, and delivering high-impact data products. . 

Responsibilities

- Data Engineering & Pipelines
 - Design, build, and maintain robust data data pipelines for social marketing and product data sources (APIs, event streams, batch systems)
 - Develop scalable ETL/ELT workflows / microservices using Python and SQL
 - Ensure high data quality, reliability and observability across pipelines
 - Optimize data models for analytics and reporting use cases
 - Marketing & Ad Platform Data
 - Own ingestion and modeling of data from Meta Ads (Facebook) and other digital marketing platforms
 - Build datasets that support campaign performance tracking, lead funnel analysis, attribution and conversion tracking
 - Understand key concepts such as campaign structure (campaign/ad set/ad level), bidding & optimization signals, attribution windows, pixel / event tracking. 
 - Business Understanding & Collaboration
 - Translate business requirements from marketing, growth and product teams into scalable data solutions
 - Define success metrics tied to revenue and performance
 - Enable self-serve analytics through well-structured datasets
 - Data Quality & Governance
 - Implement validation checks, monitoring and alerting for pipelines
 - Ensure consistency across different marketing data sources
 - Maintain clear documentation of data models and pipelines
 - Business Collaboration & Use Case Ownership
 - Work closely with marketing, growth, and analytics teams to understand real-world use cases and define success metrics tied to revenue and performance
 - Own key use cases such as lead funnel optimization, campaign attribution and revenue reporting and forecasting
 - Ensure data enables decision-making, not just reporting
 - Engineering Standards & Best Practices
 - Design and implement modular, reusable microservices that enable the scalable development of data products. 
 - Drive standardization through well-architected, loosely coupled services that can be leveraged across multiple use cases. 
 - Uphold high standards in code quality and modularity, pipeline reliability and monitoring, documentation and data contracts
 - Contribute to shared frameworks and reusable components
 - Promote best practices across the data engineering team

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Core Technical Skills
 - Strong proficiency in Python (must-have)
 - Advanced SQL skills for large-scale data processing

 - Experience with data orchestration tools (e. g. , Airflow or equivalent)
 - Familiarity with cloud data platforms (BigQuery, etc. )
 - Experience building scalable data ingestion systems
 - Familiarity with microservices-style or modular data systems
 - Strong understanding of performance and cost optimization
 - Ad Platform Knowledge
 - Solid understanding of Meta Ads platform fundamentals
 - Familiarity with campaign hierarchy and metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS), conversion tracking and attribution model, Lead generation workflows and funnel metrics
 - Ability to interpret marketing data beyond surface-level metrics

Good to Have

- Experience with other ad platforms (Google Ads, Bing Ads, etc. )
 - Knowledge of data modeling best practices (e. g. , star schema, dbt)
 - Experience with real-time or near real-time data pipelines

What Success Looks Like

- Reliable, scalable pipelines for marketing data ingestion
 - High-quality datasets enabling accurate campaign and lead analysis
 - Strong partnership with marketing teams, translating business needs into data solutions
 - Improved visibility into lead quality, attribution and campaign performance
 - Clear ownership of end-to-end data use cases, not just components

Why Join Us

- Work at the intersection of data engineering and growth marketing
 - Solve high-impact problems in performance marketing and attribution
 - Own meaningful data products end-to-end
 - Influence both technical architecture and business outcomes
 - Be part of a team that values ownership, impact and engineering excellence

Perks

- Day off on the 3rd Friday of every month (one long weekend each month)
 - Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Program to promote health well-being

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform team
data.description:
Who we are: 

Nirvana is on a mission to harness the power of data to revolutionize commercial insurance and enable a safer world. We are bringing much-needed innovation into the legacy, trillion-dollar commercial insurance industry. We have developed cutting-edge predictive models that use real-time IoT data from billions of connected devices, allowing us to better understand and price risk. Our AI-driven platform fundamentally changes the way an insurance company operates with personalized risk scoring, faster underwriting, modernized claims, and proactive, data-driven insights to help customers prevent accidents. 

We've already proven the scale-serving thousands of fleets and more than doubling our written premiums year over year. Our data moat is growing exponentially with more than 30 billion miles of telematics data, leading to more predictive models and new insights into how we can better understand and reduce risk. Altogether, our loss ratio, efficiency, and customer experience are redefining what can be done in the industry. 

With $270+ million raised, including our Series D round in December 2025, we're only accelerating our growth, with strong support from top-tier VCs including Lightspeed, General Catalyst, and Valor. Nirvana's leadership team has previously helped scale multi-billion-dollar companies from scratch, including Samsara, Glassdoor, and Flexport, and includes industry veterans from Nationwide, The Hartford, and RLI. 

About the role: 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team - the team responsible for the foundational systems that help every engineering team at Nirvana build, ship, and operate reliably. 

You'll work across Terraform-based provisioning, our in-house infrastructure management platform, CI/CD on GitHub Actions across a monorepo, internal AI agent tooling across the SDLC, infrastructure security, and platform-wide observability for uptime, reliability, and cost. 

This is a hands-on platform engineering role for someone who can independently own moderately complex projects end to end while partnering closely with internal engineering customers. You'll help evolve our self-serve infrastructure platform, strengthen CI/CD, expand developer productivity tooling, improve reliability and cost visibility, and build secure-by-default paved roads for product teams. 

As a Senior Engineer, you'll be expected to break down ambiguous problems, drive execution with minimal guidance, and deliver high-quality systems that scale. Over time, this role can grow into ownership of larger cross-team platform initiatives and beyond. 

What you'll do: 

- Build and maintain core platform capabilities across infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD, internal tooling, and developer productivity. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of moderately complex platform projects, including scoping, design, milestones, implementation, rollout, and iteration. 
 - Improve our Terraform-based infrastructure platform and self-serve workflows so engineering teams can move faster with confidence. 
 - Strengthen CI/CD reliability, scalability, and developer experience across GitHub Actions and our monorepo. 
 - Contribute to in-house AI agent tooling that supports the SDLC, from requirements and implementation through deployment and monitoring. 
 - Improve infrastructure security by building secure-by-default patterns, coaching teams, and helping implement technical controls and evidence automation for SOC 2. 
 - Build and refine monitoring, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, and cost observability for platform services. 
 - Participate in on-call, postmortems, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on reliability improvements. 
 - Partner with internal engineering teams as customers: understand needs, design paved roads, drive adoption, and mentor through design reviews, code reviews, and technical planning. 

About you: 

- You have 5-8 years of backend, infrastructure, platform or developer-productivity engineering experience. 
 - You've built and operated infrastructure, internal platforms, or tooling used by other engineering teams. 
 - You write production-quality code in Go and/or Python and have strong distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - You have hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform or similar IaC, and CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions. 
 - You have strong observability, incident management, and operational ownership instincts. 
 - You can independently break down ambiguous problems, make pragmatic decisions, and drive projects to completion. 
 - You communicate clearly with technical and cross-functional partners and can influence without relying on authority. 
 - You are comfortable in high-growth, ambiguous startup environments and bring a strong bias for action. 
 - You take ownership of outcomes, learn quickly, and are willing to work across platform and product areas as Nirvana grows. 
 - Bonus: experience with Kubernetes, cloud cost optimization, security engineering, IAM, secrets management, supply-chain security, SOC 2/compliance controls, or applied AI/LLM tooling for developer workflows. 

Benefits: 

- Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
 - Medical insurance
 - Monthly wellness stipend for anything that gives you joy
 - Hybrid culture and reimbursement for home office equipment
 - Flexible vacation policy and a team that understands building a company is a marathon, not a sprint
 - A culture that gives you the autonomy to do great work and the transparency to make good decisions

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
Hiring for SMA Solar India - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

A company building cloud-based energy-management software. It runs optimisation, simulation and evaluation for solar (photovoltaic) systems, battery storage and EV charging. Its international team of engineers and energy experts is growing, and this hire will set the architecture for how its platform scales. 

About the Role

You'll be the hands-on Software Architect for the platform. You'll design cloud-native, event-driven systems, guide engineers through code reviews and prototypes, and turn business needs into scalable, secure and cost-aware architecture. You'll also stay close to the code yourself. The role is based in Bengaluru. 

What you'll do

- Design distributed, event-driven services: where each service ends, the messaging patterns between them, and how data flows. 
 - Define domain models, API contracts and event schemas that can change over time without breaking other services. 
 - Build prototypes and complex Python backend components yourself, and lead code reviews. 
 - Set the bar for performance, security, reliability and observability, and help troubleshoot production issues. 
 - Guide delivery on the cloud, preferably Azure, using Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. 
 - Work with domain experts to bring solar, battery and EV-charging optimisation into the product. 
 - Set coding, testing and documentation standards across teams. 

What you bring

- A Master's in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, and 10+ years in software, including several years as a tech lead or architect. 
 - You've designed a microservices or event-driven platform that used asynchronous messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT or similar) and ran it in production. 
 - Strong Python backend skills, plus relational databases, data processing and automated testing. 
 - You've taken services to production on a major cloud with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. 
 - You can explain architectural trade-offs clearly to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders on international teams. 
 - You're used to building in iterations with cross-functional agile teams. 

Nice to have

- Experience in energy management, IoT or connected devices, time-series data, AI, or mathematical optimisation.

data.title: SDE- II (iOS + React Native)
data.description:
Urban Company · Engineering

Software Development Engineer - II iOS + React Native

Location: Gurugram · Experience: 2-5 years · Team: Consumer Apps

Every booking, every live job, every partner earnings screen at Urban Company lands on a phone across a wide range of devices, in a wide range of network conditions, and it has to feel instant. We are looking for an iOS engineer to own how that feels. 

About the Company

Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc. , all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardised, and reliable service experience. To fulfil this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise. 

Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company with three key principles in mind: 

- Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services. 
 - Partner empowerment: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood. 
 - Technology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industry. 

About the Role & Team

We are looking for a mobile engineer who is strong in iOS (Swift) and also hands-on with React Native. Most of our app experience is built with React Native on top of native foundations, so you will work on both sides - writing native iOS code where performance and platform features matter, and React Native code for shared product experiences. 

This role is cross-platform by design. If you are iOS-heavy, you should be excited to work on React Native. If you are React Native-heavy, you should be excited to go deep into native iOS. We are clear about this from day one. 

What You'll Do

- Build and ship user-facing experiences across our apps - native iOS where performance and platform features matter, React Native for shared product surfaces. 
 - Work cross-platform every day: native modules, the RN-native boundary, and the New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI). 
 - Own releases end to end - phased rollout, post-release monitoring, and the call to halt or roll back when the numbers say so. 
 - Raise the technical bar - code review, architectural input, and mentoring engineers earlier in their careers than you. 

Technology Stack

Mobile: Swift, React Native, TypeScript

iOS: UIKit and SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, SPM and CocoaPods, Instruments, Xcode

React Native: The New Architecture - Fabric, TurboModules, JSI - and Hermes

Release & Observability: CI/CD and Fastlane-class automation, phased rollouts, crash and ANR monitoring, over-the-air updates

Adjacent Exposure: Node. js and TypeScript services, micro-frontends

What We're Looking For

- People who passed out in 2023 or after: Building mobile applications, with iOS as your primary platform. 
 - Strong hands-on skills in iOS (Swift / UIKit / SwiftUI) and React Native - comfortable in both, with depth in at least one.

data.title: Senior cosmetic formulator
data.description:
About the RoleWe are establishing a new cosmetic manufacturing facility in Noida and are looking for an experienced Cosmetic Formulator and R&D Leader to build and lead our formulation and product development team. 

We are looking for someone who has hands-on industry experience in cosmetic formulation, with a proven track record of developing products that have successfully gone to market. The ideal candidate should have experience working with existing commercial SKUs, understand the entire product development cycle, and possess the technical creativity to develop innovative, high-performance formulations rather than simply replicate existing products. 

This role will be responsible for building our formulation capabilities from the ground up, developing new product formulations, optimizing existing formulations, establishing laboratory processes, and leading a team of chemists to create differentiated cosmetic products. 

Key Responsibilities1. Formulation Development & Innovation
 - Develop innovative, high-performance formulations across skincare, haircare, body care and other cosmetic categories. 
 - Create unique formulations with differentiated textures, sensory experiences, ingredient combinations and performance benefits. 
 - Develop products inspired by global market trends while creating original formulations with a distinct competitive advantage. 
 - Formulate creams, serums, gels, lotions, sunscreens, cleansers, toners, emulsions, masks and other cosmetic products. 
 - Work with advanced active ingredients, functional ingredients, delivery systems, emulsifiers, preservatives and rheology modifiers. 
 - Troubleshoot formulation challenges and continuously improve stability, efficacy, aesthetics and product performance. 2. Commercial Product & Market Experience
 - Bring practical experience with cosmetic products that have already been commercialized and are available in the market. 
 - Understand the journey from laboratory formulation to pilot batch, manufacturing scale-up and commercial production. 
 - Develop formulations that are commercially viable, scalable, stable and cost-effective. 
 - Evaluate competing products, ingredient technologies and global cosmetic trends to identify opportunities for innovation. 
 - Translate product briefs and consumer requirements into technically sound formulations. 3. R&D Laboratory Setup & Operations
 - Establish and organize the formulation laboratory at our new manufacturing facility. 
 - Identify laboratory equipment, instruments, raw materials, testing requirements and operational workflows. 
 - Establish formulation SOPs, documentation systems, batch records and laboratory protocols. 
 - Build a systematic product development process from concept and prototype through validation and production handover. 
 - Develop a structured raw material database, formulation library and product development pipeline. 4. Stability, Testing & Quality
 - Design and execute stability testing, compatibility testing and accelerated stability studies. 
 - Evaluate product parameters including pH, viscosity, texture, appearance, spreadability, sensory properties and performance. 
 - Troubleshoot issues related to separation, oxidation, discoloration, fragrance instability, preservative efficacy and packaging compatibility. 
 - Coordinate with quality assurance and regulatory teams to ensure formulations meet applicable cosmetic regulations and safety requirements. 5. Manufacturing & Scale-Up
 - Transfer formulations from laboratory scale to pilot and commercial manufacturing scale. 
 - Work closely with production teams to establish manufacturing processes, mixing parameters, temperatures, homogenization requirements, addition sequences and processing times. 
 - Troubleshoot manufacturing issues and ensure reproducibility between laboratory batches and commercial batches. 
 - Optimize formulations for manufacturing efficiency, yield, consistency and cost. 6. Team Leadership
 - Recruit, mentor, train and lead a team of formulation chemists and laboratory personnel. 
 - Set R&D priorities, timelines, project milestones and development targets. 
 - Foster a culture of scientific curiosity, innovation, experimentation and accountability. 
 - Review formulations, technical work and development progress while ensuring the team consistently delivers quality results. Required Experience & Qualifications
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline. 
 - Minimum 5-8 years of hands-on experience in cosmetic formulation and product development. 
 - Strong preference for candidates currently or previously working with established cosmetic manufacturers, skincare brands, third-party manufacturing companies or product development laboratories. 
 - Proven experience developing formulations that have successfully launched commercially and are currently sold in the market. 
 - Strong expertise in formulation chemistry, ingredient functionality, emulsification, rheology, preservation, stability and cosmetic product design. 
 - Experience in commercial manufacturing scale-up and production troubleshooting. 
 - Previous experience managing, mentoring or leading a formulation/R&D team is highly desirable. 
 - Ability to independently develop formulations rather than relying entirely on supplier-provided base formulas. Ideal Candidate ProfileWe are looking for a technically strong, hands-on formulator who is equally comfortable working in a laboratory and leading a team. 

The ideal candidate: 

- Has personally developed multiple successful commercial cosmetic SKUs. 
 - Has a strong portfolio of products they have formulated or helped bring to market. 
 - Has the ability to develop genuinely differentiated formulations and innovative textures. 
 - Is knowledgeable about new ingredients, actives, formulation technologies and global beauty trends. 
 - Can build a formulation laboratory and R&D team from scratch. 
 - Understands commercial realities including raw material costs, margins, manufacturing feasibility and scalability. 
 - Is proactive, entrepreneurial and capable of taking ownership of product development. What We Offer
 - Opportunity to lead and build the formulation R&D function at a new cosmetic manufacturing facility. 
 - Freedom to experiment, innovate and develop proprietary formulations. 
 - Access to laboratory infrastructure, raw materials and product development resources. 
 - Leadership role with direct influence over the company's product portfolio and innovation strategy. 
 - Opportunity to build and lead your own formulation team. 
 - Monetary incentiveApplication RequirementsCandidates should share: 

- Updated CV detailing formulation and R&D experience. 
 - List of cosmetic products/SKUs they have developed or contributed to that have been commercially launched. 
 - Categories and formulation technologies they specialize in. 
 - Previous employers and nature of their responsibilities. 
 - Experience in laboratory setup, team leadership and manufacturing scale-up. Candidates without hands-on commercial cosmetic formulation experience will not be considered.

BRAHMA AI is an enterprise AI content platform used by some of the world's largest media & entertainment, sports and advertising companies. BRAHMA AI now combines CLEAR with generative and visual AI, which won a 2026 Technology & Engineering Emmy®. As VP Engineering for the Core Platform, you'll own end-to-end delivery of BRAHMA AI's platform, from understanding the business need to choosing the solution, testing it and rolling it out. You'll lead a global organisation of 75+ software engineers and DevOps, work with product line management on the vision and roadmap, and keep the platform AI-first, scalable and reliable for enterprise customers. The role is onsite in Bengaluru, and you'll stay close enough to the code to build with AI tools yourself.

- Own delivery of the core platform end to end and turn the product roadmap into a delivery plan with product line management

data.title: Software Developer - Product Support Engineering
data.description:
Job Title

Software Developer - Product Support Engineering

Location

Bengaluru/Chennai, India

Summary

1Finity, a Fujitsu company, develops communications-networking solutions spanning open optical and wireless systems, network automation, and applied AI/ML. Our globally distributed engineering and support teams help customers operate critical digital infrastructure with reliability and scale. 

We are seeking a Software Developer to join the Product Support Engineering team in India. The team supports a software-defined networking controller used to manage large Layer 0, Layer 1, and Layer 2 networks. Both roles combine hands-on engineering, complex troubleshooting, customer issue resolution, and cross-functional delivery. 

Responsibilities: 

- Investigate, reproduce, diagnose, and resolve complex software and Controller issues reported by internal and external customers. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and deliver reliable fixes, hot fixes, maintenance patches, and selected product enhancements within agreed timelines. 
 - Design, develop, review, and maintain Java-based components for SDN controller and EMS/NMS platforms. 
 - Create and maintain unit, integration, regression, and automated tests; support release validation and production-readiness activities. 
 - Collaborate with customer support, product management, quality, and engineering teams across regions to drive issues to closure. 
 - Communicate findings, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans clearly, and escalate critical concerns with supporting evidence. 
 - Apply secure coding, code review, CI/CD, and Agile/Scrum practices throughout the software lifecycle. 
 - Adapt quickly to changing priorities and learn unfamiliar technologies in a product-support environment. 
 - For the Senior Technical Lead role, define technical direction, lead design and code reviews, guide partner engineers, and coordinate resolution of high-impact issues. 
 - Collaborate effectively with globally distributed teams. 

What We're Looking For

- 5-8 years of Experience level
 - Demonstrated proficiency in Java, object-oriented design, debugging, and maintainable software development. 
 - Experience developing or supporting EMS, NMS, SDN controller, or comparable distributed network-management platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux environments such as RHEL, Oracle Linux. 
 - Experience with service-oriented or microservices-based systems, REST APIs, XML, and common integration patterns. 
 - Working knowledge of network-management protocols such as NETCONF, GNMI, SNMP, REST/HTTPS, TCP/IP, or LDAP. 
 - Understanding of optical and transport-networking concepts, including SONET/SDH, WDM, OTN, ROADM, and Ethernet services. 
 - Experience with source control, build pipelines, defect tracking, test automation, and engineering collaboration tools. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving capability. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to work independently, collaborate across functions, and deliver in an Agile/Scrum environment. 

1Finity, a Fujitsu company, is a global provider of communications networks that enable a highly connected world. The company combines leadership in open optical and wireless networking with expertise in network automation and AI/ML-driven operations. Through collaboration with a broad ecosystem of technology partners, service providers, hyperscalers, and network operators, 1Finity designs, builds, operates, and maintains mission-critical digital communications infrastructure.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer (Java , Angular)
data.description:
The Job in short

As a Senior Applied AI Software Engineer, you design and deliver complex AI-enabled product capabilities with minimal guidance. This role transitions away from siloed frontend/backend titles toward a T-shaped, full-stack profile spanning UI, APIs, services, and data pipelines. You serve as a technical authority who mentors peers and raises the bar on AI-native engineering practices. 

Meet the job

- As a Senior AI Applied Software Engineer you are a technical cornerstone of your squad. You will design and deliver complex features with minimal guidance, ensuring that both the "engine" (Backend) and the "experience" (Frontend) are performant, secure, and scalable. 
 - Full SDLC Ownership: Lead the entire lifecycle of digital banking products-from initial idea and architectural design to release and maintenance. 
 - Architectural Excellence: Improve system architecture and design components that integrate smoothly across APIs and microservices. 
 - Technical Leadership: Act as a go-to resource for your team, mentoring junior engineers, conducting critical code reviews, and raising the bar for engineering standards. 
 - AI & Innovation: Contribute to the evolution of LLM-based voice assistants and real-time personalization engines using OpenAI and ML models. 
 - Security-First Mindset: Implement "Entitlements" and fraud prevention services with a focus on non-functional requirements like security, scalability, and resilience. 
 - Collaborative Culture: Work in a Pod based model, collaborating with Architects, Product Owners, and UX Designers to align technical solutions with business needs. 

How about you

- Experience: You have 5-7+ years of professional experience building complex, high-traffic products. 
 - Backend Mastery: Solid understanding of Java, Spring JPA/Hibernate, and Maven. Experience with Microservices (Netflix OSS is a plus) and Cloud technologies. 
 - Frontend Expertise: Strong skills in Angular and TypeScript. You are proficient with RxJS and modern build systems (Webpack, Jenkins). Experience with Vue. js is a plus. 
 - System Design: You have a solid grasp of Enterprise Integration Patterns and can design systems that handle complex data flows between services. 
 - The "Senior" Edge: You don't just solve tickets; you identify gaps in tooling, reduce technical debt, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to streamline delivery. 
 - Communication: Excellent English (spoken and written). You can confidently explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and get buy-in for your architectural decisions. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Previous experience in Fintech or Banking is highly considered an advantage.

Saving and Sustaining Lives Through Connected Healthcare

This is where you save and sustain lives

At Baxter, we are deeply connected by our mission. No matter your role at Baxter, your work makes a positive impact on people around the world. You'll feel a sense of purpose throughout the organization, as we know our work improves outcomes for millions of patients. Baxter's products and therapies are found in almost every hospital worldwide, in clinics and in the home. For over 85 years, we have pioneered medical innovations that transform healthcare. This is where you can do your best work-at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives. 

Your role at Baxter

As an Interoperability Engineer, you will be responsible for the verification of medical device digital interoperability. You will ensure that Baxter devices meet defined system and interface requirements for interoperating with other medical devices and healthcare IT systems, such as hospital infrastructure, middleware, and digital applications. 

This role applies a systems engineering foundation with a strong emphasis on requirements‐based verification, interface testing, and system integration activities. The position does not own validation activities, but collaborates closely with teams responsible for clinical and user validation. 

Your team

You will work within a cross‐functional environment that includes Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Verification, Quality, Cybersecurity, IT, and Clinical stakeholders. The team values disciplined execution, collaboration, and clear ownership to deliver compliant and reliable interoperable medical device solutions. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Own and maintain interoperability verification requirements, including traceability from platform requirements to verification evidence
 - Develop and execute verification plans, test cases, and test procedures for interoperability-related requirements
 - Perform platform-level verification testing for device‐to‐device and device‐to‐IT connectivity enabled features
 - Collaborate with Systems and Software Engineering teams to ensure interoperability designs are verifiable and testable
 - Assess interoperability-related changes and determine verification impact and required test coverage
 - Troubleshoot and support resolution of interoperability defects identified during verification and integration testing
 - Generate clear, compliant verification documentation and evidence to support design control and regulatory needs
 - Apply understanding of clinical workflows and intended use when defining representative verification scenarios
 - Demonstrate working knowledge of FDA, ISO, IEC, and software lifecycle standards as they apply to verification of connected medical devices
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of interoperability verification methods, tools, and best practices

What You'll Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Systems, Biomedical, Computer, Electrical, or related discipline)
 - 3+ years of experience in medical device or regulated product development, with a focus on verification activities
 - Systems engineering background with strong experience in requirements management, traceability, and verification planning
 - Hands‐on experience with system, interface, or integration verification testing
 - Familiarity with medical device interoperability concepts, healthcare IT integration, or connected systems
 - Experience participating in design control and change management processes
 - Strong technical documentation, organization, and analytical skills
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills for cross‐functional collaboration
 - Experience with requirements and verification tools (e. g. , DOORS, ALM tools) preferred
 - Exposure to healthcare data exchange mechanisms or interface specifications is a plus

data.title: Lead Expediting Engineer
data.description:
Description

About Us: 

Burns & McDonnell is a leading player in the Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) industry, delivering innovative solutions to clients across Multiple industries like Chemicals, Oil & Gas, Transmission & Distribution, Power among other verticals. . We are proud to be part of a global network with our US parent company. With a track record of successful projects across various industries, we are committed to innovation, sustainability, and client satisfaction. As we continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced lead Expediting Engineers to join our team. 

Position Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Project Lead Expeditor to direct all expediting activities for large-scale EPC projects. Based in our India office, this strategic role is crucial for ensuring the timely and compliant delivery of critical materials and equipment. The position blends hands-on expediting with project team leadership, acting as the central point of contact for all expediting matters on assigned Projects

A key function of this role is to serve as the primary liaison with our US-based counterparts, providing clear and consistent updates to ensure seamless project execution. You will be responsible for driving the project schedule, mitigating risks, and leading a team of project expeditors on assigned project to success. 

Job Description

- Manages a project team of expeditors and provides leadership, guidance and development. 

2 . Provide oversight, monitor compliance, quality, assign projects and tasks to the project expeditor. 

- Manage communication between the client, project team , suppliers, US Counterpart to ensure timely completion of projects. 
 - Anticipate, lead, facilitate, and solve project complex expediting problems. 
 - Field Expediting -Domestic/International supplier for critical packages. 
 - Promote and ensure ethical procurement practices in accordance with code of business conduct requirements and procurement procedures are adhered to on projects. 
 - Lead project procurement expediting processes and multitasking without sacrificing project safety, quality, price or schedule. 
 - Manage review of expediting progress from award to receipt of packages at site assigned to Project Expeditor. 
 - Identify and elevate potential fabrication issues or shipment delays and direct a resolution or recovery plan. 
 - Consult with the supplier and the jobsite to coordinate deliveries and identify, report and resolve discrepancies. 

10. Step-in and support project expeditor on calls with the supplier to resolve issues or to address concerns. 11. Present project status reports to all stakeholders including end client. 

- Step-in for Logictic coordination involving international heavy lift shipments. 

Experience

- Carrier progression should reflect hands-on expereince expediting wide range of equipment and materials , including
 - Rotating equipment (like Compressors, Turbines, Pumps, etc), 
 - Static Equipment( Pressure Vessels, Columns, Reactors, Heat Exchanger, etc), 
 - Mech Packages( like System packages, Modules, etc), 
 - Piping , Structural , Electrical( HV/LVTransformers, Circuit Breakers, Lattice Towers, Capacitor Banks, Conductors, etc) & Instrumentation Items
 - A minimum of 15 years of progressive expediting experience within an EPC environment is mandatory. 
 - Must have 2-3 years of recent experience in a Lead Expeditor role, successfully managing a team of at least 2-3 expeditors. 
 - Proven ability to develop and understand a project's expediting strategy, execution plan, and budget. 
 - Experience working in a pressure vessel fabrication company will be considered a significant advantage. 
 - Strong hold on Change management to take up with the client. 
 - Experience handling logistics for heavy-lift equipment on international shipments. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. 
 - Strong communication skills. 
 - Excellent problem-solving abilities. 
 - Strong attention to detail. 
 - Exceptional written and spoken English is required, as all communication will be with US, UK, and European suppliers and stakeholders. 
 - Strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills. 
 - Meticulous attention to detail and organizational abilities. 
 - Advanced computer literacy

This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

The opportunity

We are seeking a dynamic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on driving data-driven transformations. The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of AI strategy consulting, data & enterprise data assessments and hands-on experience in leading cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and impactful solutions. 

You will work closely with C-suite leaders, operating partners, and portfolio company executives to help them leverage Agentic AI, analytics, and data-driven platforms to unlock value, accelerate digital transformation, and create competitive advantage.

 - Develop and deploy AI implementation playbooks, frameworks, and accelerators that drive tangible value creation.

 - Lead Agentic AI initiatives, translating business and functional requirements into agent architectures, workflows, and capabilities.

 - Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI, LLMs, process mining, and advanced analytics to deliver cutting-edge solutions

 - Experience with Agentic AI frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, semantic kernels, Autogen)

 - Understanding of basic data structures and algorithms

- Data & Analytics Strategy

 - Guide portfolio companies on setting up data governance frameworks, data marketplaces, and analytics COEs. 
 - Design end-to-end data transformation programs, from roadmap creation to solution implementation.

 - Represent the firm at global analyst briefings, industry forums, and thought leadership platforms. 

- Team Leadership & Collaboration

 - Foster collaboration between AI product teams, analytics experts, and sector specialists to deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Drive knowledge sharing and capability-building within the team. 
Skills and Attributes: 

Educational Background

- MBA / PGDM / master's degree in data science, AI, Analytics, or Business Management. Engineering or quantitative background preferred. 

Professional Experience

- 10-12 years of experience in Agentic AI, digital transformation, and strategy consulting. 
 - Proven track record in AI-driven transformation programs, including Agentic AI, GenAI, predictive analytics, and process mining. 
 - Experience in building and deploying accelerators, playbooks, or proprietary platforms for data-driven consulting. 

Soft Skills

- Exceptional client engagement and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives. 
 - Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to translate AI into business value. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership abilities. 

Preferred Certifications

- GenAI and LLM focussed, AI/ML, or data analytics certifications (Google, Microsoft, AWS, Coursera, etc. )

Why Join Us

- Be at the forefront of AI‐driven innovation across multiple client sectors. 
 - Work with global clients to drive real business impact. 
 - Collaborate with a team of AI experts, analytics leaders, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment. 

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. data.title: Engineering Manager, AI Builder Experience
data.description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI - and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience org at MongoDB, we're forming a brand new engineering team to make that happen, and we're looking for the founding Engineering Manager to hire the team, set the technical direction, and ship integrations into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech. 

In this role, you'll be close enough to the code to jump into exploratory work yourself while also building the team, process, and operational rigor to keep a growing integration portfolio healthy long-term. The new team will work mostly in Python and TypeScript while collaborating closely with client library teams and other engineering groups across MongoDB that deliver the underlying driver, platform, and product capabilities needed to support these integrations well. 

You'll collaborate closely and move quickly with product, partners, field teams, the developer community, and open source project maintainers to ship where demand is real, deepen investment where adoption proves out, and evolve the portfolio over time as it becomes a critical part of MongoDB's future in AI. 

MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

Position expectations

- Work closely with recruiting to hire a team of Python and TypeScript engineers who will build and own MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like Langchain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
 - Execute effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities may shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, partner needs, and strategic opportunity. Deliver quickly while keeping a high standard of technical quality
 - Flag issues, concerns, and resource needs early, working with management to triage, staff, borrow expertise, and cross-functionally hand off completed projects as needed
 - Work closely with product managers, program managers, sales, GTM, and peer engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that improve the builder experience and strengthen MongoDB's position in the AI framework ecosystem; help decide where to invest effort and where to pull back
 - Manage dependencies on drivers, platform capabilities, and other MongoDB product surfaces required to deliver excellent framework integrations
 - Collaborate with external teams who own open source projects MongoDB integrates with, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy to work effectively through external maintainer review cycles to land high-quality upstream contributions
 - Jump in to do initial, exploratory work. Guide key decisions, unblock the team, and contribute when needed as projects grow
 - Own the monitoring, operations, maintenance, and ongoing quality of a broad, evolving integration portfolio; develop testing strategy, release readiness, and operational follow-through after launch
 - Help the team build and maintain sustainable engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version compatibility awareness, and strong integration health over time
 - Develop a team that stays current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems, including important frameworks, community discussions, and emerging patterns; maintain awareness of trends and discourse in contemporary AI
 - Bring a research and discovery mindset to the role, using customer, community, partner, and field signals to help guide roadmap and investment decisions; identify emerging opportunities in the ecosystem and help decide where early investment could create strategic advantage

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience building developer platforms, libraries, or other high-scale technical systems, with strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript and an ability to lead teams working across both the Python and TypeScript ecosystems. Experience working with programming language polyglot teams is a plus
 - 3+ years of experience managing a team of software engineers and providing technical leadership for complex projects or products
 - Experience with query optimization (especially MongoDB) and AI coding tools; distributed systems experience would be an asset
 - Demonstrated success hiring, mentoring, and growing high-performing engineering teams, including experience supporting career development, feedback, and performance management
 - Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving technical landscape with frequent context switching, incomplete information, and competing opportunities, while maintaining sound prioritization and strong judgment
 - Strong technical depth in developer-facing software, with the judgment to make and guide architectural trade-offs
 - Experience leading the launch of new features or systems and operating them successfully in production after release
 - Excellent written and verbal technical communication, with a strong instinct to collaborate across engineering, product, and other stakeholder groups
 - A track record of escalating issues early and fostering a team culture that values intellectual honesty and collaboration
 - Comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving spaces and helping teams make progress when customer behavior, technical requirements, or ecosystem priorities are still taking shape
 - Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape, ideally with familiarity across frameworks, retrieval patterns, agent workflows, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas; experience in this area would be an asset
 - Experience working with open source software, external ecosystems, or integrations with third-party frameworks and communities, especially in the Python ecosystem; familiarity with open source contribution models, external maintainers, and engineering work that spans company-owned and upstream repositories would be a plus

Success measures

- In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, the high-level architecture of the platform and integrations, the current portfolio of work, and the key technical and organizational dependencies around the role. You will start building relationships with cross-functional partners, especially recruiting, and develop a hiring plan
 - In three months, in collaboration with our recruiting team, you will have a healthy candidate pipeline and the first members of your new team onboarding. You'll have a hand-off plan with the teams currently owning AI Framework Integrations
 - In six months, you will have staffed the core of your team, demonstrated effective partnership with recruiting, taken responsibility for major initiatives in the upcoming quarter, and improved the team's ability to execute through technical and organizational ambiguity
 - In twelve months, you'll be having active growth conversations with your team members about performance and longer-term career development. You'll have led the development and operation of multiple meaningful features or integrations and helped shape the forward-looking technical and execution strategy for this area

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. QA automation

 - Develop strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and regulatory authorities. Risk & Compliance Management

 - Ensure compliance with local regulations, industry standards, and company quality procedures. 
 - Support governance and regulatory reporting requirements. Team Leadership & Capability Development
