data.title: Engineering Leader
data.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model - which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. 

At Celonis, we're committed to supporting your growth and development, as well as internal career mobility. Our Internal Mobility Program provides you with career path options - not just based on what you've been doing, but based on what you could do for other teams, functions, or locations. We believe in your potential, that's why we hired you, and that's why we're excited to share a new job opportunity with you. 

The Team: 

You will be part of a team that owns the core Data layer. The Data layer includes a purpose built generic storage layer which is highly scalable, elastic, dynamic and open Data Lake that enables our customers to bring their enterprise data to our Data Lake. The Data layer also includes a Process Query Engine which is an analytical database and our core product for process mining that enables our customers to interactively mine enterprise-sized data sets. In order to handle the strong growth of our customer base and their demands, we are continuously expanding our Lake and Engine domain and heavily invest in the performance and scalability of our engine. 

The Role: 

As an Engineering Leader, you will lead and inspire a team of talented engineers and engineering managers, driving the design, development and maintenance of our scalable, secure, and high-performing software that aligns with our strategic goals in the area of process orchestration and automation. You will work closely with product management, design, customer success, and other cross-functional teams to align engineering efforts with our business objectives, ensuring our products meet and exceed our customers' needs. You will play a critical role in defining and executing the technical vision that supports both the immediate growth and long-term success of our product offering while fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration and empowerment of your teams. 

For the Core squad of our Data Lake and Process Query Engine team, we are looking for a leader with experience managing teams with solid experience in system programming and the skills to build a highly parallelized and distributed database and Data Lake with modern C++. As part of a talented engineering team, you'll develop and implement new concepts and algorithms for our Lake and Process Query Engine, take ownership of our solutions to increase reliability and performance, and drive initiatives to shape future innovations. 

The work you'll do: 

- Collaborate with senior leadership and product teams to define the product and technical strategy and roadmap, prioritising engineering efforts to meet business objectives while balancing short-term goals with strategic initiatives. 
 - Ensure the architecture and design emphasize scalability, high availability, and security. 
 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence by promoting best practices in software design, implementation, and delivery. 
 - Provide strategic leadership and guidance to multiple engineering teams, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, collaboration and accountability within the team as well as the department. 
 - Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of key engineering projects, balancing resource allocation and timelines to meet business needs. 
 - Regularly engage with customers and customer-facing teams to stay abreast of how users are interacting with our products, understand their current challenges, and make data-driven decisions to further improve functionality, usability and the value we deliver to our users. 
 - Set clear goals and success metrics for your teams, monitoring progress and adjusting as necessary to meet project and organizational objectives. 
 - Mentor, develop and retain top engineering talent within your organization - ranging from individual contributors to managers - supporting their growth and career development. 
 - Drive team engagement, performance and morale by implementing best practices in team management and creating a collaborative and inclusive work environment. 
 - Communicate strategy, plans and progress to the wider Product and Engineering team, Celonis, stakeholders and customers, determining the right level of communication appropriate for each situation. 
 - Drive the technical vision and guide teams in developing advanced concepts and algorithms for data management and query execution. 
 - Shape and contribute to our development and maintenance processes
 - Take responsibility for the performance, scalability, and reliability of our solutions
 - Provide high-level architectural guidance and mentor engineering leads in solving complex system challenges
 - Take ultimate organizational accountability for the end-to-end delivery, performance, and reliability of your teams' solutions. 

The qualifications you'll need: 

- Proven ability to lead and mentor engineering teams
 - University degree in Computer Science or comparable education
 - 15+ years experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing teams
 - Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and grow engineering teams. Proven track record of building high-performing teams that deliver ambitious results. 
 - Proven experience in managing highly distributed teams across multiple locations, with the flexibility to travel to foster team cohesion, build strong relationships, and ensure effective collaboration. 
 - Experience in delivering high-quality engineering projects that meet or exceed customers' needs. 
 - Experience in building data-driven decision-making practices. 
 - Solid knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Parallel Computing, Distributed Systems or Database Internals
 - Experience in cloud engineering, Linux systems, infrastructure as code, build systems, performance monitoring is a plus
 - An analytical mindset with great understanding of performance and algorithms
 - Excellent communication skills in English, German is a plus

Benefits of Internal Mobility: 

- Exciting options for internal career growth
 - Exposure to new challenges, perspectives, people, and locations
 - Relocation assistance and financial support when permitted
 - Seamless Interview and transition experience 
 - Support and connection to help you settle into your new role

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. 
 - Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. 
 - Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy-24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. 
 - Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. 
 - Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. 
 - Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance. 
 - Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. 
 - Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. 
 - Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values-Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future-drive every decision. 

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand - turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. 

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video. 

Celonis Inclusion Statement: 

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that "The Best Team Wins". We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. 

Your Privacy: 

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis' Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations. 

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
About The Role
About Soar and how we build
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation. 
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here. 
How we work : 
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either. 
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current. 
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end. 
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers. 
Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run. 
What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed. 
Role Summary: We rely heavily on AI throughout engineering and are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who treats AI agents as a core part of how they build software. You will own complex features from design through production, direct agents effectively, and apply strong engineering judgment to everything you ship. You should be equally comfortable accelerating implementation with AI and investigating difficult problems yourself. Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and maintain production features and services, taking ownership of correctness, performance, security, and maintainability. 
 - Use AI agents across planning, coding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation to accelerate end-to-end delivery. 
 - Provide agents with clear requirements, architecture context, constraints, and acceptance criteria; break complex work into verifiable steps. 
 - Inspect and refine AI-generated code. Detect incorrect assumptions, insecure patterns, unnecessary complexity, and missing edge cases. 
 - Build automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; validate actual user journeys and failure paths before declaring work complete. 
 - Create reusable workflows and tool integrations that help agents access the right context and perform tasks within appropriate permissions. 
 - Own changes through review, deployment, observability, and production troubleshooting; investigate root causes and prevent repeat failures. 
 - Collaborate with Product, QA, and other engineers; mentor teammates and document decisions and validation evidence in pull requests. 
Requirements
Requirements: 

- Typically 5+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated engineering depth and ownership. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one production programming language and experience with application design, APIs, databases, version control, and automated testing. 
 - Substantial hands-on experience delivering software with AI coding tools or agents, supported by concrete examples of shipped work. 
 - Ability to reason about, debug, and explain code independently, including code generated by AI. 
 - Practical understanding of context management, tool use, agent limitations, and the trade-offs between model capability, speed, and cost. 
 - Strong ownership and collaboration, including careful handling of credentials, sensitive data, and permissions in AI workflows. 
Nice to have: Experience with agent orchestration, MCP or API integrations, retrieval systems, evaluation suites, cloud platforms, or financial systems. What success looks like: You ship reliable features with clear validation evidence, catch defects in generated code, improve delivery speed, and create reusable practices that raise the effectiveness of the wider team.

data.title: Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

We are seeking a Principal Pre-Silicon Firmware Lead to architect and implement low-level software for our next-generation microcontrollers/ SoCs. You will bridge the gap between hardware architecture and final software delivery. You will own the pre-silicon development lifecycle-including driver development for CAN/CAN-FD/CAN XL stacks -using high-performance enterprise emulation environments and ensures hardware-software co-design that satisfies strict ISO 26262 safety and high-quality engineering frameworks up to ASIL-D. 

What You'll Achieve

Technical Leadership & Hardware Co-Design

- Drive firmware architecture and technical roadmaps for in-house microcontroller/ SOCs. 
 - Align development milestones with SoC architecture, RTL design, verification, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Provide technical mentorship and enforce rigorous coding standards (MISRA C/C++). 
 - Author comprehensive design specifications, firmware architecture documentation, and test strategies. 

Pre-Silicon Validation & Emulation

- Develop early boot code, low-level drivers, and runtime firmware targeting pre-silicon environments. 
 - Lead virtual bring-up and hardware-software co-verification using both enterprise emulation platforms like Cadence Palladium/ Synopsys ZeBu. 
 - Optimize firmware execution speed
 - Debug complex, deep-silicon anomalies using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and internal emulator trace features. 

Communication Drivers & Protocols

- Design, implement, and optimize highly robust peripheral drivers for CAN, CAN-FD, and CAN XL. 
 - Develop and maintain critical application layer protocols, featuring standard diagnostics (ISO 14229), network management, and heavy-duty diagnostic framing fault handling. 
 - Design, implement and Integrate communication driver stacks into industry standard layers (e. g. , AUTOSAR MCAL interfaces). 
 - Deep knowledge of priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and cyclical redundancy check (CRC) validation

Safety & Quality Compliance

- Enforce absolute compliance with ISO 26262 safety requirements. 
 - Participate in safety analyses (FMEA, root cause analysis) to ensure driver-level fault-handling routines are deterministic. 

About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware development, specifically within the embedded semiconductor or safety-critical industry
 - 3+ years acting as a Technical Lead or Principal Engineer guiding architectural decisions and mentoring engineering teams. 
 - Expert proficiency in Embedded C with strict adherence to MISRA guidelines. 
 - Deep knowledge of embedded MCU/SoC architectures, including ARM Cortex-M/R or multi-core safety architectures. 
 - Direct hands-on experience with hardware emulation platforms, specifically Cadence Palladium and/or Synopsys ZeBu systems
 - Authoritative understanding of industrial fieldbus architectures (ISO 11898 standard family), physical/data link layers, priority-based identifier arbitration, bit-stuffing mechanisms, and diagnostic implementations
 - Proficient with professional embedded pipelines, including ARM compiler toolchains, JTAG debuggers (e. g. , Lauterbach), and emulation control scripts
 - Experience with ISO 26262 functional safety requirements up to ASIL-D
 - Understanding of HSM/SHE concepts and secure boot requirements
 - Experience building automated testing setups using Python and continuous integration tools (e. g. , Jenkins)

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: System Performance Engineer (NSP/NPU, AI/ML)
data.description:
Company: 

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area: 

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Engineering

General Summary: 

Job Overview: 

You will be part of System Performance team that is responsible for profiling and optimizing the System Performance on Snapdragon chipsets. This role will require a strong knowledge of AI/ML performance using NPU cores. The knowledge of CPU, DDR, NoCs will be an added advantage. 

Skills Required: 

- A deep understanding of NPU, CPU and DDR architecture internals like
 - NPU: Understanding of NPU micro-architecture, including its specialized processing elements for operations like matrix multiplications and convolutions. 
 - A strong grasp of deep learning fundamentals, including neural network architectures like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), transformers, GenAI etc. 
 - Understanding the distinction between the compute-intensive training of a model (often done on GPUs) and running inference (making predictions) on NPUs. 
 - Knowledge of Model optimization and compression techniques (Quantization, Pruning, Distillation etc. )
 - CPU caches (L1, L2, L3), instruction pipelines, branch prediction, memory hierarchy (including register, cache, and main memory) and multi-core/multi-threaded processing. You need to understand how memory access, instruction dependencies, and contention for shared resources can impact performance. 
 - DDR: Understanding of JEDEC specifications LPDDR4, LPDDR5, LPDDR6, including command and timing parameters (e. g. , tCL, tRCD, tRP), memory organization (rows, columns, banks), and basic view of training and initialization sequences, how a memory controller works and its specific features like command queue, port arbitration, and various control schemes. 
 - Familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow Lite, PyTorch Mobile, and ONNX Runtime for preparing models for deployment. Experience with NPU-specific compilers, such as those from Qualcomm (QNN), Arm (Vela), Intel (OpenVINO), to optimize and orchestrate AI workloads. 
 - Evaluating hardware and software to determine the best fit for specific AI tasks and measure performance metrics like TOPS/W (trillions of operations per second per watt). 
 - Using tools like the Windows Performance Toolkit and Qualcomm's Snapdragon Profiler to analyze and optimize NPU and system-level performance
 - A core understanding of how to use parallel processing architectures for efficient AI computations. 
 - Expertise in how operating systems manage processes, threads, memory, MMU, and interrupt handling. This knowledge is crucial to understanding software for the kernel scheduler and system-level bottlenecks. 
 - Good understanding of Benchmarks CPU (like GeekBench, SpecInt, CoreMark etc) and DDR (like lat_mem, stream, bw_mem etc. ) and how they exercise the underlying CPU/GPU/DDR architecture. 
 - Experience with a variety of performance monitoring tools like Intel VTune, Linux perf, and Utilities like top, vmstat, iostat, and netstat to monitor system resources like CPU, memory, and I/O. Experience with software tools to monitor system hotspots, command bus utilization, and identify memory traffic patterns is critical. This includes validating that the traffic generated by software is as expected. 
 - Good understanding of memory allocation policies, prefetching, and caching to minimize latency and maximize bandwidth. Understanding how an application accesses memory is vital. Skills in profiling code to analyze memory access patterns and then optimizing the code for better data locality. 
 - Analyzing large datasets from performance tests requires strong statistical skills. This can involve creating histograms of transaction latencies and deriving performance metrics to understand a system's behavior. 

Responsibilities Include: 

- Drive Performance analysis on silicon using various System and Cores (i. e. NPU, AI/ML, CPU, Memory) benchmarks like Dhrystone, GeekBench, SPECInt, CNN/GenAI ML networks etc. 
 - Use of Performance tools to analyze the load patterns across IPs and identify any performance bottlenecks in system. 
 - Analyzing Perf KPIs of SoC subsystems like NPU, CPU, Memory, and corelate performance with projection
 - Evaluate and characterize performance at various junction temperatures and optimize running at high ambient temperatures. 
 - Analyze and optimize the System performance parameters of SoC infrastructure like NoC, LP5 DDR, etc. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional global teams to plan and execute performance activities on chipsets as well as make recommendations for next generation chipsets. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 1 to 5 years of industry experience in the following: 
 - Experience working on any ARM/x86 based platforms, mobile/automotive/Data center operating systems and/or performance profiling tools.

data.title: GTM Automation Engineer- B2B SaaS
data.description:
GTM Automation EngineerLocation: Bengaluru (Work From Office)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 2+ years

Compensation: ₹5 - 8 LPA + Performance-Based Bonuses

About ZyluZylu is an AI-powered growth management platform helping salons, spas, and beauty businesses grow revenue, improve customer retention, and streamline operations. 

We serve businesses across India and international markets, including the Middle East and Southeast Asia. 

We're building an AI-driven growth engine to scale customer acquisition through intelligent automation, data, and technology. 

About the RoleWe're looking for a hands-on GTM Automation Engineer to build, integrate, and scale Zylu's inbound and outbound customer acquisition systems. 

You'll work closely with the founders and Growth team to automate prospect discovery, lead enrichment, qualification, personalized outreach, demo scheduling, trial activation, and conversion workflows. 

We don't expect you to rebuild what existing SaaS platforms already do well. We expect you to identify the right tools, integrate them effectively, build what's missing, and make the entire system work reliably. 

This is a technical, execution-focused role where success is measured by business outcomes, not the number of workflows built. 

Key Responsibilities1. Inbound GTM Automation
 - Automate lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, and follow-ups across websites, paid campaigns, organic channels, and trial sign-ups. 
 - Build AI-powered lead qualification, nurturing, and demo-booking workflows. 
 - Automate trial onboarding, activation, engagement, and conversion journeys. 
 - Integrate HubSpot with marketing, sales, product, and customer success systems. 
 - Improve lead response times, conversion rates, and sales productivity through automation. 

2. Outbound GTM Automation
 - Build automated prospect discovery, enrichment, segmentation, and scoring systems targeting salons, spas, and multi-location businesses. 
 - Leverage platforms such as Clay, Apollo, Instantly, and other GTM tools to identify and qualify decision-makers. 
 - Develop personalized, multichannel outreach workflows across email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and calling. 
 - Build signal-based prospecting workflows using new business openings, branch expansions, hiring activity, and other relevant market signals. 
 - Automate follow-ups, reply classification, lead qualification, meeting scheduling, and CRM updates. 3. AI Agents & Integrations
 - Build and deploy AI agents using n8n, LLMs, APIs, and custom code. 
 - Integrate existing SaaS platforms instead of unnecessarily developing custom solutions. 
 - Connect HubSpot, WhatsApp Cloud API, outreach platforms, and Zylu's internal systems. 
 - Implement monitoring, error handling, data validation, and workflow recovery. 
 - Ensure responsible data handling and compliance with applicable privacy laws and outreach platform policies. 4. Analytics & Optimization
 - Build dashboards tracking lead quality, qualified pipeline, demo bookings, conversion rates, and acquisition costs. 
 - Continuously experiment with automation workflows to improve acquisition efficiency and conversion. 
 - Identify manual bottlenecks across marketing and sales and eliminate them through automation. 
 - Document workflows and build repeatable systems that scale without proportional increases in headcount. Required Qualifications
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience building GTM, sales, marketing, or RevOps automation systems. 
 - Strong experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms. 
 - Practical experience with prospecting and enrichment tools such as Clay, Apollo, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Experience integrating CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho. 
 - Ability to work with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and Python or JavaScript. 
 - Hands-on experience using LLMs and AI agents to automate business workflows. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on measurable outcomes. 
 - Ability to independently design, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain production workflows. 

Preferred Skills
 - Experience with WhatsApp Business Cloud API and email outreach infrastructure. 
 - Experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. 
 - Familiarity with SQL, marketing attribution, and funnel analytics. 
 - Experience with B2B SaaS, SMB acquisition, or local-business prospecting. 
 - Exposure to India, GCC, or Southeast Asian markets. 
 - Previous experience as a growth engineer, automation engineer, or early-stage startup operator. What Success Looks Like in 60 Days
 - A functioning inbound automation engine covering lead capture, enrichment, qualification, routing, and follow-ups. 
 - An automated outbound prospecting engine that discovers, enriches, and scores qualified salon prospects. 
 - At least two live outbound campaigns generating measurable qualified pipeline. 
 - Automated demo scheduling, follow-ups, and trial activation workflows integrated with HubSpot. 
 - At least five production-ready GTM automations with monitoring and documentation. 
 - A live dashboard tracking inbound and outbound pipeline performance. 
 - Demonstrable improvements in lead response time, qualified opportunities, and sales productivity. What You'll Get
 - Direct collaboration with Zylu's founders and Growth team. 
 - Ownership of the automation infrastructure behind a growing international SaaS business. 
 - Access to modern AI, automation, and GTM platforms. 
 - High autonomy, meaningful responsibilities, and measurable business impact. 
 - Opportunity to grow into a GTM Engineering or Growth Automation leadership role. Hiring Process
 - Initial Screening: Review of experience and previous automation projects. 
 - Founder Interview: Technical discussion covering architecture, problem-solving, and business judgment. 
 - Practical Challenge: Build a working GTM automation workflow using test data. 
 - Paid Work Trial: A short, 3 to 5-day paid work trial for shortlisted candidates. How to ApplySend us your resume along with examples of automation systems you've built, such as n8n workflows, CRM integrations, AI agents, prospecting systems, or growth automation projects. 

We're more interested in what you've built, how it works, and the business results it delivered than the number of tools listed on your resume.

data.title: Electromagnetic Capability (EMC) Engineer
data.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We're making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!

We are looking for Electromagnetic Capability (EMC) Engineer

Are you a passionate and experienced EMC Engineer looking to make a significant impact on cutting-edge projects? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your expertise in electromagnetic compatibility ensures the reliability and performance of critical systems? Siemens is seeking a talented EMC Engineer with 4-6 years of experience to join our innovative team and contribute to the development of world-class solutions. 

At Siemens, we're dedicated to pioneering technology that transforms industries and enriches lives. As an EMC Engineer, you'll play a crucial role in ensuring our products meet stringent electromagnetic compatibility standards, from initial design to final validation. If you're ready to apply your deep knowledge of EMC design, testing, and problem-solving to complex challenges, we encourage you to apply!. 

You'll make a difference by

As an Experienced EMC Engineer, you will be a key contributor to our product development lifecycle, ensuring electromagnetic compatibility across various systems. Your main responsibilities will include: 

- EMC Design & Compliance: 
 - Enforce and uphold EMC design and manufacturing rules throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Prepare detailed clause-by-clause analyses of customer specifications during the tender phase, including associated cost estimates. 
 - Develop comprehensive EMC Transverse Requirements Specifications for projects, identifying EMC requirements and allocating them effectively to sub-systems. 
 - Create detailed EMC Control Plans, defining EMC activities, deliverables, design requirements, and test strategies based on project EMC requirements. 
 - Conduct thorough design verification, including general architecture, layout of subsystems, electrical interfaces, and HV/MV/LV cabling. 
 - EMC Testing & Validation: 
 - Prepare precise EMC test specifications (both laboratory and field test plans). 
 - Review and verify EMC test specifications and reports provided by subsystem suppliers. 
 - Execute EMC tests on test benches and/or on-site, providing accurate and timely associated test reports. 
 - Compile comprehensive EMC Compliance Files upon project completion. 
 - Problem Solving & Improvement: 
 - Diagnose and resolve complex EMC problems encountered during projects. 
 - Actively participate in the definition, development, and continuous improvement of EMC guidelines, processes, design rules, reference solutions, and return-on-experience documentation. 
 - Contribute to the creation of design review checklists, project document templates, test specifications, and the evaluation of simulation tools and test instrumentation. 
 - Propose and lead EMC R&D initiatives to advance our capabilities. 
Desired Skills: 

We're looking for a highly motivated individual with a solid foundation in EMC engineering and a proactive approach to problem-solving. 

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering (Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field). 
 - Specialization or advanced coursework in Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC). 
 - Mandatory: 4-6 years of professional experience specifically within the EMC domain. 
 - Strong understanding of Power electronics, Electrotechnics, and relevant industry applications (e. g. , Railways: Rolling Stock, Traction Equipment, Signaling, Communication equipment). 
 - In-depth knowledge of sources of electromagnetic disturbances and electromagnetic phenomena. 
 - Expertise in EMC design rules and their practical application, including earthing and bonding principles for electrical equipment on trains. 
 - Proficiency with relevant EMC standards (e. g. , IEC, EN, ISO, FCC, CISPR, MIL-STD), with specific experience in the EN 50121 series (e. g. , EN 50121-3-1, EN 50121-3-2) and other rolling stock standards highly preferred. 
 - Hands-on experience with EMC testing, including test procedures, test instrumentation, and practical testing methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with EMC numerical simulation tools and practices. 
 - Demonstrated experience in EMC project management and coordination. 
 - Advanced level of English (conversational, writing, and reading) for effective global collaboration. 
 - High degree of autonomy, proactivity, and reactivity. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical information, convince stakeholders, and synthesize findings. 
 - A collaborative mindset, eager to share information and experience within the EMC Network.

data.title: ASIC Top Level Verification-SW/C Testcase Developer
data.description:
About This Opportunity

Join our new ASIC top level verification team. 

We specialize in the top-level verification of cutting-edge ASICs that power complex high-performance systems. Our designs are either monolithic ASICs or integrated multi-chip-modules holding several hundreds of processor cores, DSPs as well as ARM cores, tailored hardware accelerator IPs and many high-speed interfaces, including Ethernet, CPRI, and PCIe. 

As an ASIC Top-Level Verification Engineer, you'll be part of a team tackling some of the most challenging verification tasks in the industry, ensuring that our ASICs meet our high standards for performance, functionality, and security. 

You will play an important role in the team developing environments and/or tests run in SystemC/TLM simulation, RTL environments, hardware emulation, and eventually on Silicon. 

What You Will Do

We are looking for people with focus in various areas in ASIC TLV. Exactly what you will do depends on your experience and the needs in the different projects, but typically includes

- SoC level testcase development with possibilities to specialize in special areas related to traffic on external interfaces and/or ASIC internal functionality involving DSPs, MCUs, CPU cores, ARM infrastructure, switches, security, SerDes, DDR and other types of external memory and much more. 
 - Preparing and setting up designs to run in Hardware Emulators, and update and maintain existing emulator platforms. 
 - Participate in defining/documenting verification strategies for the parts of the ASIC assigned to you as a verifier. As input you have documents and information from interaction with various type of stakeholders. 
 - Participate in specification and development of software driven tests written in C. 
 - Debug RTL designs with help of EDA simulation tools and SW debuggers. 
 - But also debug failing test cases using the SystemC/TLM platform or using the hardware emulator, depending on the situation
 - Beside RTL simulations you will debug failing test cases running on any of our other run-platforms, SystemC/TLM simulation, Hardware emulation and on Silicon mounted on boards in the lab. 
 - In case you lack experience of some platform you are expected to develop skills for such tasks. 
 - Contribute to keeping tests clean in the CI regression running on our four platforms. 
 - who occasionally can develop of tests involving UVM VIPs (used in some of our tests)
 - who from time to time will work with gate level simulation (GLS)
 - to work with formal connectivity verification
 - to compile the ASIC designs to run in HW emulators, like Siemens Veloce and Cadence Palladium
 - interested in scripting and in developing and maintaining the TLV CI flow in projects, including visualization of results. 

You will bring

SW/C testcase developers, some with SystemVerilog / UVM experience. 

Preferably experience in one or several areas: 

- AMBA protocols
 - ARM cores/MCUs or processors
 - JTAG and Coresight
 - External interfaces: PCIe, XGMII/Ethernet, xSPI, I3C, UART, GPIO
 - Memory interfaces: DDR, HBM
 - Clock and reset verification

Soft Skills

- Open, inclusive mindset, embracing diversity in culture, nationality, gender, etc. 
 - Collaborative approach, with a focus on team productivity and mutual growth. 
 - Strong drive for innovation, with a proactive interest in refining verification methodologies. 
 - Clear communication skills for effective teamwork and coordination across diverse teams. 
 -

"All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification. "

data.title: Backend Engineer (SD1/SD2)
data.description:
Company Description UltimuttTM is India's first on-demand pet services platform, backed by Prime Venture Partners and Sparrow Capital. The company focuses on delivering instant, at-home grooming within 60 minutes, using trained and background-checked groomers that pet families can trust. UltimuttTM is driven by a mission to make pet services convenient, stress-free, and reliable, so pets receive the care they deserve and pet parents gain peace of mind. The team is passionate about strengthening the bond between humans and animals and expanding access to quality pet care services. 

Backend Engineer (SD1)Experience: 1-3 years · Location: Gurgaon · Work mode: 6 days a week, from office ·  

You will ship backend features end to end (APIs, database changes and the tests that prove them) for the apps our customers, groomers and operations team use every day.   

What you'll do
 - Build and change REST APIs for the customer app, the groomer app and the admin panel, from request validation down to the database. 
 - Write database migrations and JPA entities for new features, and check them with SQL. 
 - Write unit and integration tests for every change, and keep the build green. 
 - Connect third-party services such as payment webhooks, WhatsApp and SMS messages and push notifications, following the patterns already in the code. 
 - Add logs, metrics and alerts to the features you build, so problems show up before customers report them. 
 - Fix production bugs: read the logs and metrics, reproduce the problem locally, and ship the fix with a test that would have caught it. 
 - Build admin tools the operations team asks for, each behind the right permission. 
 - Work with product, operations and the mobile app developers to turn their requests into shipped features. 
 - Write a short design note before larger changes, and update the docs when you change behaviour. Must have
 - 1-3 years building backend services in Java 17+ with Spring Boot (Kotlin is fine). 
 - Solid SQL on a relational database, ideally PostgreSQL: joins, indexes, transactions, schema design. 
 - REST API design: status codes, validation, pagination, error responses. 
 - You write tests as part of the work, not after it. 
 - Comfortable with Git, pull requests, code review and a CI pipeline. 
 - Clear written English: you can explain what a change does and why. Good to have
 - JPA/Hibernate beyond the basics: lazy loading, N+1 queries, transaction boundaries. 
 - Redis, Docker or any AWS experience. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Kafka or SQS, microservices, or Kubernetes. 
 - Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. 
 - Spring Security and JWT-based login. 
 - Debugging with logs, metrics and traces. 
 - The basics of caching, idempotency and rate limiting. 
 - A payment gateway, OTP login or messaging integration you have built. 
 - Experience on a consumer product with real users and real money. 

Backend Engineer (SD2)Experience: 3-6 years · Location: Gurgaon · Work mode: 6 days a week, from office ·  

You will own whole parts of the backend from design to production: scheduling and groomer assignment, payments and refunds, memberships, or cash and payouts. Much of this code moves money or decides who goes where and when, so correctness matters more than speed. You will also review code and help SD1 engineers grow. 

What you'll do
 - Own one or more domain modules end to end: design, build, ship, and keep them healthy in production. 
 - Build features that move money safely: idempotent payment webhooks and refunds, balances derived from ledger entries, pay rates that change on a date without re-pricing the past. 
 - Work on scheduling: slot availability, capacity per zone, and auto-assigning the nearest qualified groomer using geodata and travel times. 
 - Split modules into independently deployed microservices as we grow, with clear contracts between them. 
 - Build event-driven flows on Kafka and SQS: consumers that handle duplicates, retries, dead-letter queues and ordering. 
 - Build product search and catalog for our e-commerce store on Elasticsearch. 
 - Move deployments to containers on Kubernetes, with CI/CD that ships safely and rolls back fast. 
 - Set up observability across services: structured logs, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards and alerts. 
 - Make cross-module flows reliable: transactional outbox, reconcilers and safe retries, so a lost event costs a delay, not data. 
 - Change the schema of a live database without downtime: backward-compatible migrations and backfills. 
 - Own security-sensitive code: authentication, role and permission checks, rate limits, handling of customer personal data. 
 - Work with product, operations and the mobile app developers to shape features before they are built. 
 - Write design docs, break work into tasks for the team, review pull requests, and mentor SD1 engineers. 
 - Lead production debugging: find the root cause from logs, metrics and data, fix it, and add the guard that stops it coming back. Must have
 - 3-6 years building backend systems, at least 2 of them on Java 17+ and Spring Boot in production. 
 - You have designed and shipped a system end to end and can walk through its trade-offs. 
 - Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, reading query plans, indexing, locking, migrations on large live tables. 
 - Hands-on with concurrency and consistency: transactions, idempotency, distributed locks, preventing double bookings and double spends. 
 - Microservices in production: drawing service boundaries, calls between services, independent deployments. 
 - Event-driven systems on Kafka or SQS: producers, consumers, retries, dead-letter queues, at-least-once delivery. 
 - A working grasp of scaling: caching, async processing, rate limiting, fault tolerance, eventual consistency, horizontal scaling. 
 - Integrations with external systems that fail: webhooks, retries, timeouts, reconciliation. 
 - Observability: you have set up logs, metrics, tracing and alerts, and used them to find a production problem. 
 - You have reviewed others' code and mentored a junior engineer. 
 - You own your work in production: incident response and root-cause fixes. Good to have
 - Docker and Kubernetes: building images, deployments, autoscaling. 
 - Elasticsearch or OpenSearch: indexing, relevance tuning, product search. 
 - Prometheus, Grafana and OpenTelemetry. 
 - E-commerce, payments, ledgers, wallets or payouts. 
 - Scheduling, logistics, or on-demand marketplace products. 
 - Geospatial work: PostGIS, routing engines, zone design. 
 - Modular monoliths, domain-driven design, event-driven patterns such as the outbox. 
 - Redis in production: caching, rate limiting, distributed locks. 
 - Spring Security, JWT and OAuth2. 
 - AWS in production (RDS, EC2, IAM, S3, SQS) and CI/CD pipelines.

data.title: Lead Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability - across every location, at enterprise scale. 

Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and cut carbon. 

We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions

- Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle - from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing. 
 - Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. 
 - Sustainability Reporting - Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms. 

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines - united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value. 

Benefits

- Competitive compensation based on market standards
 - We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
 - Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
 - 
 - Flexible Leave Policy
 - Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose
 - We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance. 
 - Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)
 - Flexible Benefit Plan
 - Awards and Bonus
 - Annual performance cycle
 - Quarterly engagement activities
 - A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency
What We're Looking For

We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth & Governance (GnG) squad in India - the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate. 

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier-career engineers. 

AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the right answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers - and to teach a team of earlier-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model. 

What You'll Do

- Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium-to-large projects on them end to end
 - Translate ambiguous problems into engineering-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
 - Act as a primary design and code reviewer - the second layer of judgment on AI-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
 - Set the bar for AI-driven development on the squad - and bring your own view of what that should look like
 - Own a category of reliability and technical-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
 - Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
 - Mentor earlier-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
 - Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross-team initiatives

What Will Help You Succeed

Must-Haves

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 8+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
 - A clear track record of owning projects end to end - from design through production - not just delivering assigned components
 - Currently hands-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
 - Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
 - SQL and relational data modelling at depth - you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
 - Experience building and operating high-volume data pipelines and third-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
 - Experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing - Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at-least-once delivery
 - Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
 - Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for - metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
 - Strong AI-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it - with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
 - Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives - including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
 - Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
 - Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
 - Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
 - Flexibility to join evening meetings up to ~8: 30 PM IST to collaborate with US-based counterparts

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience shipping AI/LLM-backed features to production - latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop design
 - Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake + dbt preferred)
 - Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

data.title: Engineering Manager - AI & Agentic Systems
data.description:
About PlumPlum is an employee insurance and health benefits platform focused on making health insurance simple, accessible and inclusive for modern organisations. 

Healthcare costs in India are rising three times faster than general inflation. Most Indians can't afford health insurance on their own, and as many as 600 million will likely depend on employer-sponsored insurance. Plum is on a mission to provide the highest-quality insurance and healthcare to 10 million lives by FY2030, through companies that care. Plum is backed by Tiger Global and Sequoia. 

About the roleAt Plum, AI isn't a side project. It's how our products work. We're building agentic workflows that read documents, reason over policies and help members get clear, dependable answers, starting with insurance claims. 

We're looking for an Engineering Manager who has built and run AI agent systems in production and can lead a team doing the same. You'll grow a team of engineers, own delivery for AI-powered products, and stay close to the architecture, the code and the production issues yourself. 

What you will own
 - Lead the team: hiring, coaching, performance and growth. Build a team that owns and operates what it ships. 

- Design and ship agentic AI workflows that are reliable in production: clear tool use, safe retries, failure handling, and a path to human review when needed. 

- Decide where AI fits: choose when to use fixed, tested code and when to use models or agents. Keep money-related calculations and policy rules in code you can trust. 

- Stay hands-on with architecture, code reviews and production debugging. 

- Own reliability and safety: safe releases, rollback, incident response, access controls and careful handling of sensitive member data. 

- Partner with product, operations and domain experts to turn real workflows, such as claims, into well-defined AI systems. 

- Champion AI-first engineering: use coding agents and AI tools in your own work and help your team do the same. 

What you'll bring
 - 8-10 years of software engineering experience. 

- Experience managing engineers and developing technical leaders: 1: 1s, hiring, performance and growth. 

- Hands-on experience shipping and operating AI or agent systems in production, beyond prototypes. You can explain what went wrong, how you found it and what you changed. 

- Strong backend and distributed-systems fundamentals: APIs, queues, state management, data contracts and recovery. 

- A hands-on approach: you still write and review code and debug production issues. 

- Day-to-day use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or similar). 

Nice to have
 - Experience with document pipelines: OCR, extracting data from bills or records, schema validation, deduplication and tracking where data came from. 

- Experience designing agent infrastructure: typed tool contracts, durable state, idempotent actions, timeouts. 

- Insurance, claims, fintech or healthcare experience, or working with domain experts on rules such as eligibility, limits and co-pay. 

- Experience with tracing and monitoring of AI systems: quality, latency and cost. 

Your first 90 days
 - Understand our AI workflows, starting with claims, and the biggest technical risks. 

- Set a quality baseline with product and operations. 

- Ship one well-scoped improvement with monitoring, a human fallback and a tested rollback, then plan next priorities from what you learn.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will work directly with business leaders, operational teams, and DI consultants to identify opportunities for transformation, design practical solutions, and independently build and deploy AI-enabled applications. 

You will have opportunities to work on projects such as: 

- Industrial Digital Platforms: Develop and scale digital platforms for manufacturing and industrial businesses, including customer onboarding, data integration, and workflow automation. 
 - Manufacturing & Supply Chain Transformation: Improve factory and supplier visibility through data integration, analytics, AI, and operational dashboards. 
 - Post-Merger Integration (PMI): Support business process standardization, system integration, and AI-driven operational improvements following acquisitions. This is not a conventional software development role. You will help determine what should be built, why it matters, and how to deliver measurable business value-not simply implement predefined technical specifications. 

You will work closely with experienced strategy consultants while taking ownership of technical architecture and implementation decisions. 

This position is particularly suited to engineers who are technically independent, enjoy working with clients, and want to expand their careers from software engineering into business transformation. 

  Key Responsibilities1. Business Problem Solving

- Work directly with client management and operational teams to understand business processes, challenges, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements and implementation plans. 
 - Identify and prioritize opportunities for AI, automation, and digital transformation based on business impact and feasibility. 2. Solution Architecture & Hands-on Engineering

- Work closely with clients to jointly design technical solutions that address their specific business needs and requirements. 
 - Based on the agreed solution design, independently lead hands-on development, implementation, and deployment, including: 
 - Designing and building AI agents, LLM applications, workflow automation, and backend/full-stack solutions. 
 - Integrating applications with enterprise databases, APIs, ERP systems, and other existing platforms. 
 - Developing rapid prototypes, validating solutions with users, and deploying production-ready applications. 
 - Making practical architectural decisions that balance speed, scalability, cost, security, and maintainability. 3. Implementation & Business Impact

- Work closely with DI strategy consultants and client teams to implement, test, refine, and drive adoption of solutions. 
 - Collaborate with client teams to troubleshoot technical and operational issues during implementation. 
 - Work with DI consultants and clients to measure and improve business outcomes, including productivity, cost reduction, quality, and turnaround time. 
 - Support business process and system integration initiatives, including PMI-related projects, in collaboration with DI consultants and client teams. 4. Collaboration & Ownership

- Collaborate with DI's strategy consultants and client stakeholders across business and technology functions. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of technical deliverables, from initial requirements through production deployment. 
 - Communicate technical concepts and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Required Experience & Skills
 - Approximately 4-7 years of relevant hands-on software engineering experience. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and backend or full-stack development. 
 - Practical experience building LLM applications, AI agents, RAG solutions, or workflow automation. 
 - Strong working knowledge of SQL, APIs, databases, and enterprise system integration. 
 - Demonstrated experience deploying applications into production environments used by actual business users. 
 - Ability to independently design technical architecture, write production-quality code, and troubleshoot complex technical issues. 
 - Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into working technical solutions. 
 - Strong ownership, problem-solving ability, communication skills, and execution discipline. 
 - Willingness to work on-site with clients, including visits to manufacturing facilities when required. Preferred Experience
 - Experience in manufacturing, automotive, industrial technology, supply chain, procurement, or enterprise operations. 
 - Experience in client-facing engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting. 
 - Experience integrating ERP systems, operational databases, or heterogeneous enterprise data sources. 
 - Experience delivering AI or automation solutions with measurable operational or financial impact. 
 - Exposure to Japanese or other multinational corporate clients. Prior strategy consulting experience and an MBA are not required. 

What We Value MostWe value demonstrated engineering achievements, independent problem-solving, and business impact more than job titles, academic credentials, or the number of technologies listed on a CV. 

Strong candidates should be able to explain at least one solution they personally designed, developed, and deployed, including: 

- The business problem and users served. 
 - Their individual contributions to architecture, coding, integration, and deployment. 
 - The key technical decisions and challenges they independently addressed. 
 - Evidence of production usage and measurable business outcomes. We welcome candidates from technology companies, consulting firms, enterprise engineering teams, and high-performing startups. 

Why Join DIAI?Build a New Business Practice

Join the founding team of our AI Transformation practice in India and help shape how we deliver technology-enabled business transformation. 

Work on Real Business Challenges

Develop solutions for established industrial and multinational companies, with opportunities to see your work implemented in actual business operations. 

Own Solutions End to End

Take responsibility from business problem identification and solution design through hands-on development, deployment, and user adoption. 

Work Directly with Business Leaders

Collaborate with Japanese and Indian management teams and gain exposure to strategic and operational decision-making. 

Develop a Distinctive Career Profile

Combine deep engineering expertise with business problem-solving, consulting, and enterprise transformation capabilities. 

Compensation & Working EnvironmentDIAI offers a structured, transparent compensation package comprising fixed CTC and performance-linked variable compensation, in accordance with company policies. 

We operate as a strategy consulting firm with a hands-on, entrepreneurial working environment. The role offers substantial individual responsibility and direct client exposure. 

We are looking for candidates who value meaningful ownership, professional growth, and long-term career development alongside competitive compensation.

data.title: Senior Technical Lead - Mechanical Design
data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Lead - Mechanical Design to drive the design, development, analysis, qualification, and product support of high-reliability aerospace and defense mechanical/electromechanical systems. This role is ideal for a senior mechanical engineering professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, colloborating with cross-functional teams, and delivering robust products for demanding aerospace applications. 

The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in mechanical design, aerospace product development, CAD/CAE, GD&T, tolerance analysis, structural and thermal analysis, environmental qualification, and technical leadership. The role involves working closely with systems, electrical, power electronics, thermal, manufacturing, quality, certification, supply chain, program management, customer, and global engineering teams. 

What You Will Do

Mechanical Design & Product Development

- Lead mechanical design and development of aerospace-grade electromechanical products such as actuators, motors, starter-generators and electronic packaging systems. 
 - Own concept design, 3D modelling, detailing, assembly design, drawing release, and engineering documentation. 
 - Develop mechanical architectures that balance performance, reliability, weight, cost, manufacturability, testability, and serviceability. 
 - Design components and assemblies involving sheet metal, machined parts, castings, enclosures, sealing features, connector interfaces, and EMI/EMC shielding. 
 - Support board fitment, enclosure design, packaging optimization, vibration tolerance, and thermal management for aerospace electronic and electromechanical products. 

Analysis, Simulation & Qualification Support

- Lead structural, thermal, modal, vibration, shock, and fatigue analysis activities to support design validation and product performance. 
 - Review FEA and thermal analysis results and guide design improvements based on simulation, qualification, and test outcomes. 
 - Support environmental qualification activities covering thermal, vibration, altitude, EMI/EMC, conducted emissions, and radiated emissions requirements. 
 - Support qualification and verification processes for aerospace products, including DO-160-related test and compliance activities. 

Technical Leadership

- Provide technical leadership across the product lifecycle, from concept development through qualification, certification, production release, and field support. 
 - Mentor engineers, review technical work, establish design best practices, and promote engineering excellence across the team. 
 - Lead technical reviews including PDR, CDR, TRR, design reviews, risk reviews, and root-cause reviews. 
 - Own technical risk identification, mitigation planning, design trade studies, and engineering decision-making for mechanical product development. 
 - Drive design standardization, reuse, cost reduction, manufacturability improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Documentation, PLM & Configuration Management

- Prepare and review engineering documentation, technical reports, design justifications, analysis reports, proposals, and customer presentations. 
 - Manage BOMs, drawing releases, configuration control, and engineering change activities through PLM systems. 
 - Support Engineering Change Requests/Engineering Change Notices and product upgrade activities through PLM systems such as ARAS / Teamcenter / Windchill or equivalent. 
 - Ensure released designs meet internal engineering processes, customer requirements, quality expectations, and aerospace compliance expectations. 

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

- Partner with systems, electrical, power electronics, thermal, software, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, certification, and program management teams. 
 - Represent mechanical engineering in customer discussions, technical reviews, audits, certification reviews, supplier discussions, and program reviews. 
 - Support prototype builds, first article inspection, component prove-out, manufacturing transition, and production issue resolution. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams to deliver projects on schedule while meeting cost, quality, reliability, and compliance targets. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 12-16 years of relevant mechanical engineering experience in aerospace, defense, electromechanical systems, power systems, or electronic packaging domains. 
 - Strong experience in designing and developing actuators, motors, starter-generators, electronic packaging assemblies, or similar high-reliability products. 
 - Hands-on expertise in 3D modelling, detailing, tolerance analysis, drawing release, and engineering documentation. 
 - Knowledge of aerospace design and qualification requirements such as DO-160, MIL-STD-810, environmental, vibration, thermal, and reliability requirements. 
 - Experience with PLM/configuration management systems and engineering change processes. 
 - Excellent written/verbal communication skills and ability to prepare technical reports, proposals, cost estimates, and presentations. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in aerospace or defense product development, qualification, and compliance-driven engineering environments. 
 - Experience with high-reliability design practices, redundancy considerations, thermal management, and safety-critical product development. 
 - Exposure to model-based design / model-based systems engineering tools such as MATLAB / Simulink / Dymola. 
 - Experience in working with globally distributed engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and certification stakeholders. 
 - Experience supporting technical roadmaps, innovation initiatives, risk mitigation, and design maturity improvements. 

Technical Skills

- Aerospace mechanical/electromechanical product design
 - CAD tools: SolidWorks / Inventor / Creo / UG-NX
 - PDM / Vault tools: SolidWorks PDM / Inventor Vault / Teamcenter
 - 3D modelling / detailing / assembly design / drawing release
 - GD&T / tolerance stack-up / DFM / DFA / DFC
 - Structural / thermal / modal / vibration / shock / fatigue analysis
 - Environmental qualification / aerospace compliance
 - PLM / configuration management / ECR-ECN implementation
 - Technical documentation / design reviews / stakeholder communication
 - Team mentoring / technical leadership / risk mitigation / delivery ownership

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to take a senior technical leadership role in the development of high-reliability aerospace and defense products. You will work on challenging engineering problems, collaborate with global teams, mentor talented engineers, and contribute to products where quality, reliability, and performance are critical.

Job Description

Job Title: SAP VIM Consultant

Company: Sony India Software Centre

Job Description: SAP OpenText VIM & IC4S Consultant

Sap OpenText VIM & IC4S 10 to 15 years of industry experience to lead OpenText Invoice Management landscape. 

Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for the end-to-end architecture, blueprinting, implementation, and optimization of OpenText Vendor Invoice Management (VIM) and Intelligent Capture for SAP Solutions (IC4S). 

Deep cross-functional expertise in SAP MM (Materials Management) and SAP FICO (Financial Accounting & Controlling) is mandatory to drive seamless downstream process automation. 

Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of complex OpenText VIM implementations/rollouts across SAP S/4HANA environments. 

Architect inbound document processing, document pipelines, DP document types, process types, global/country-specific exception handling, and approval workflows. 

Configure multi-level approval matrices using SAP Business Workflow and modern SAP Fiori tracking apps

Own the end-to-end design and tuning of OpenText IC4S (Intelligent Capture for SAP). 

Configure Business Entity Determination to accurately match invoice metadata against SAP Master Data (Vendors, Company Codes, Purchasing Orgs). 

Optimize OCR extraction templates, continuous machine learning/adaptive recognition loops, and Single-Click Entry features to achieve >90% field recognition rates. 

Ensure airtight integration with SAP MM: Map line items to Purchase Orders (PO), Goods Receipts (GR), handle price/quantity variances (Logistics Invoice Verification - MIRO), and manage automated block resolutions. 

Ensure airtight integration with SAP FICO: Drive automated Non-PO financial postings (FB60), tax code determinations, cost centre/profit centre allocations, and general ledger accounts mappings. 

Troubleshoot accounting and logistics-related exceptions originating from VIM. 

Act as a trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders, translating financial operations goals into streamlined, automated IT solutions. 

Define best practices for archiving integrations via Archive Link, OpenText Content Server (OTAS), or SAP Content Server. 

Collaborate with ABAP developers to design custom user exits, logic modules, and Z-enhancements while respecting SAP "Clean Core" principles where possible. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 10 to 15 years of dedicated experience in SAP environments, with at least 10+ years of core specialization in OpenText VIM and OCR solutions. 

VIM/IC4S Expertise: Proven track record of at least 3 full-lifecycle implementations of OpenText VIM (v7. 5, v20. 4, or newer) and IC4S / BCC. 

SAP Module Knowledge: Strong, hands-on functional knowledge of SAP FICO (AP, GL, Banking, Taxes) and SAP MM (Logistics Invoice Verification, PO lifecycle, Master Data). 

Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of SAP Archive Link, Document Pipelines, RFC connections, IDocs, BAPIs, and workflow configurations. 

S/4HANA Exposure: Direct experience implementing VIM in SAP S/4HANA using Central Invoice Management or Fiori-based VIM Workplace interfaces is highly preferred. 

Soft Skills: Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, and articulate communication skills to interface confidently with Business users and stakeholders. 

Preferred Certifications
