data.title: Senior Manager - Image AI Research
data.description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you'll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. 

This is an opportunity to play a key role in Dolby's new R&D Center in Bangalore as a Senior Research Manager in our Advanced Technology Group "ATG", the research and technology arm of Dolby Labs. With multiple competencies that innovate on technologies in audio, video, AR/VR, gaming, music, broadcast and user-generated content, areas of expertise related to computer science and electrical engineering, such as AI/ML, computer vision, data science & analytics, distributed systems, cloud, edge & mobile computing, natural language processing, social network analysis, and computer graphics are highly relevant to our research. 

What You'll Do

As a Senior Manager within Dolby ATG research, you focus on three key areas of responsibility: 

- State-of the art, cutting edge, hands-on research: 
 - As a researcher, you will invent and develop the next generation of AI driven image and video analysis, enhancement, and processing technologies. Jointly with Dolby's world-class global research teams, you will set directions, identify projects, and build the next wave of image technologies driving Dolby's cloud and licensing business. 
 - With a solid understanding of both traditional image processing and newer AI technologies, you will not only perform research using signal processing based only solutions, but you will also work at the intersection of classical image processing and new AI algorithms. You will apply these insights to the research of image delivery, analysis, and content creation technologies. 
 - Managing, nurturing, and grooming top research talent: 
 - As a senior leader, you will manage and mentor a small group of researchers working in image processing, computer graphics, computer science, and content enhancement. You will work with your team as a coach and mentor. You are passionate about developing junior, highly talented staff into researchers that work fully independently in a corporate environment. 
 - Contribute to developing a dynamic, flexible, transparent, results-oriented and innovative working atmosphere. 
 - Technology strategy and direction setting: 
 - Jointly with Dolby's world-class global research teams, you will set directions, identify projects, and build the next wave of AI based technologies driving Dolby's cloud and licensing business. 
 - You work with ATG technology leaders to co-define projects and assign your staff to global R&D initiatives led by other technology initiative leads. Work jointly with upper management, lead resource and work allocation. 
 - You will also work with Dolby's Business Groups (BG) to bring the research to life in many products, working closely with product managers, program managers, and BG engineering teams worldwide. 

Education And Desired Experience

- Ph. D. plus 5-10 years of corporate research experience with a degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science. 
 - Very deep understanding and strong record of research in Computer Vision, image analysis, enhancement, compression, and processing technologies. 
 - You are an absolute top expert in AI with a deep and thorough theoretical understanding of the latest state-of the art AI technologies. You have a detailed understanding of all main network architectures, deployment modes, data augmentation and preparation, and theoretical performance analysis of model architectures. Knowledge of NLP and/or multi-modal architectures is highly desired. You have a good understanding of: 
 - Diffusion, autoregressive, or other generative models. 
 - Self-supervised, contrastive learning, auto-encoders
 - Audio, image, or text applications - Source separation, text-to-speech, music synthesis, image segmentation, image captioning, question answering, language models, etc. 
 - Knowledge of Game environments, graphical processing, consumer products, SoC architectures, embedded software, GPU/CPU implementations, algorithm validation and testing, implementation of ML/AI algorithms. 
 - Demonstrated ability to create fundamentally new, novel (patentable) image processing, enhancement, and rendering technologies. 
 - Strong publication record in major image/video/AI conferences and journals (e. g. NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, etc. ). 
 - Strong track of inventing, developing and productizing video technologies in an industrial research environment. 
 - Ability to envision applications of new technologies in the form of innovative product solutions. Strong innovator. 
 - Highly skilled in C/C++, Python. 
 - Experience in managing, guiding and mentoring younger researchers. 
 - Team-oriented work ethic and interest to work in cross-continental teams. 
 - Strong personal interest in learning, researching, and creating relevant new technologies with high commercial impact. 
 - Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills in English. 

All official communication regarding employment opportunities at Dolby will come from an official dolby. com email address. We will never request payment as part of the hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please verify its authenticity before responding

We are seeking an experienced IT&D Manager - Azure DevSecOps engineer to join our global Cloud Platform team. This is a senior, hands-on technical role combining responsibilities of a Senior Cloud Engineer and DevSecOps/Security Engineer, focused on the design, implementation, security, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise Azure cloud platforms. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and operating Azure platform capabilities using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), driving cloud security best practices, embedding security into the software delivery lifecycle, and ensuring governance and compliance across the Azure estate.  - Support onboarding of applications and workloads onto Azure platform services. 

DevSecOps & Cloud Security

- Embed security controls and practices across the software development and delivery lifecycle. 
 - Design and maintain security guardrails for Azure workloads and platform services.

 - Integrate security controls, scans, and compliance checks into deployment pipelines. 
 - Promote Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and automation-first operating models. 
 - Support development teams in adopting DevSecOps practices and secure engineering standards. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new tools and technologies to improve platform capabilities and developer experience. 

Operations & Service Management

- Participate as a member of the L4 support team for Azure platform services, including ticket dispatching and resolution activities. 
 - Occasionally perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures. 
 - Collaborate with support and operations teams to maintain platform reliability and service excellence. 
 - Contribute to operational documentation, knowledge management, and continuous service improvement initiatives. 

Leadership & Collaboration

- Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineers within the team. 
 - Support capability development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and best practices. 
 - Collaborate effectively with stakeholders across Europe, India, and other global locations. 
 - Participate in Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid operating models. 
 - Influence technical decisions and contribute to strategic cloud transformation initiatives. 

The experience we're looking for

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus. 

- 8+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud security roles. Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC) tools (Terraform, ARM) and Azure security best practices. 
 - Strong understanding of: Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, RBAC and Privileged Access Management, Cloud Governance, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL), Security by Design principles, Vulnerability management
 - Experience implementing cloud security controls and compliance frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of cloud security benchmarks and industry standards. 
 - Microsoft Azure certifications (e. g. , AZ-305, AZ-500, AZ-400, AZ-104) - nice o have. 
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 

The skills for success

Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, DevSecOpsCloud Infrastructure Management, Azure Cloud Services, Azure Governance, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Cloud Security Architecture, Cybersecurity Engineering, Security Operations (SecOps), Network Engineering, Enterprise Networking, Compute Services Management, Storage Management, Subscription & Resource Management. 

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy. 

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

data.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. 

Summary

Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in Bangalore. This team makes sure our users can safely browse the web through our secure cloud, protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorized web applications. The services this team builds are a core part of Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which means you will be working directly on one of the fastest-moving problems in security today: how organizations get visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI use without shutting it down. The team also uses AI in how it builds, from code assistants and AI-assisted test generation through to LLM-supported log and incident analysis, so you will be applying these tools as well as defending against their misuse. If you like distributed systems, deep technical problems, and work where the threat landscape changes month to month, this is a strong fit. 

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned: 

- Reliable, performant delivery of Threat Protection and ShadowAI services that detect and control risky web and generative AI application usage for Menlo customers. 
 - End to end ownership of assigned features, from design through production operation and iteration. 

Success Metrics / KPIs: 

- Service availability and latency for owned components meet or exceed team SLOs. 
 - Features delivered on committed roadmap dates, with quality measured by post-release defect and rollback rates. 
 - Automated test coverage maintained or improved on owned code paths. 
 - Detection accuracy for AI application and malicious site coverage, measured by false positive and false negative rates. 
 - Mean time to detect and resolve production issues in owned services. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and own new features and services in the Threat Protection and ShadowAI product area, contributing directly to Menlo's technical roadmap. 
 - Build highly available, scalable distributed systems and APIs, including multithreaded and asynchronous applications, with performance and security considered from the start. 
 - Build and refine the detection and policy capabilities that give customers visibility into generative AI and unsanctioned web application usage in their environments. 
 - Participate in building, deploying, and operating the Menlo Security platform in production, using dashboards, error reporting, metrics, and AI-assisted log and trace analysis to find and resolve defects quickly. 
 - Use AI code assistants and AI-assisted test generation as part of your normal workflow to move faster, while applying your own judgment on correctness, security, and maintainability before anything ships. 
 - Partner with product, security, operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align on requirements, tradeoffs, and schedules. 
 - Write unit and automated tests, conduct code and design reviews for peers, and evaluate emerging technologies that could improve our products. 

Functional Competencies

Required: 

- 3-5 years of professional software development experience with one or more of NodeJS, Go, or Python. 
 - 3-5 years of hands on experience with cloud services such as GCP and/or AWS. 
 - Working experience with Linux and standard development tooling such as git. 
 - Degree in Computer Science or a related field (BE, BTech, or Masters). 
 - Practical fluency with AI coding and debugging assistants, including sound judgment about when to rely on LLM output and when to verify it independently. 
 - Self-directed approach to problem solving, with the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems and technologies with limited guidance. 

Preferred / Nice to Have: 

- Experience building large scale web applications and REST APIs. 
 - Strong grounding in complex data structures and database technologies. 
 - Experience with containers, Docker, and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure as code tooling such as Terraform. 
 - Familiarity with the Tornado web application framework and test automation. 
 - Track record of adapting and improving engineering practices such as test driven development, continuous delivery, agile ceremonies, automation, and maintainable, testable code. 
 - Interest in or exposure to security, threat detection, or AI governance and safety. 
 - Well organized and thorough, with strong attention to detail and documentation. 

MSGL-I4

Follow us on LinkedIn!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo - in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams-reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.

Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, low-level architecture and component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.

Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate-building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE.  - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
 - Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess:

Required Qualifications:

Prior experience with enterprise case management & low-code workforce platforms (PEGA) is important. 

- 10 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, . NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.

data.description:
The group you'll be a part of

You will join the Reliability Engineering team within Infrastructure Platform Engineering. The group keeps Lam's global infrastructure estate available and recoverable across Azure, AWS, GCP, compute, storage, network, and high-performance computing, supporting engineering and operations teams in the US, Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, India, and Korea. 

The impact you'll make

As Senior Manager of Reliability Engineering & AIOps, you lead the team that keeps critical infrastructure running and proves it is ready for the next failure. In this role, you will directly contribute to the availability of the systems Lam's engineering, manufacturing, and business teams depend on every day, and you will build the automation that makes outages rare, short, and unremarkable. 

What You'll Do

Lead, hire, and develop the reliability engineering team, owning on-call health while staying technically hands-on. 

Set the reliability strategy: define the service level objective program, publish an error-budget policy, and drive adoption across platform and service teams. 

Build and run a follow-the-sun on-call and response model across six regions, with clean handoffs and one consistent set of runbooks and severity definitions worldwide

Own the incident management and paging platform end to end, including services, schedules, escalation policies, and routing, configured as code and tuned so alerts fire on real risk rather than noise

Serve as incident commander on major incidents, own executive and stakeholder communications, and lead blameless postmortems with tracked follow-up. 

Own disaster recovery strategy and execution across Azure, AWS, GCP, and core infrastructure platforms, including service-tier recovery objectives, backup and restore validation, failover readiness, DR certification, runbook governance, and recurring exercises measured against RTO and RPO targets

Lead capacity planning and performance engineering across Azure, AWS, GCP, compute, storage, network, and HPC platforms, using demand forecasting, utilization trends, growth modeling, and automation to prevent capacity risk and reduce manual operational work

Define and drive AI Ops requirements for reliability engineering across Azure, AWS, and GCP, including Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and LLM-based operational workflows for incident triage, runbook generation, knowledge retrieval, root-cause analysis, and safe remediation recommendations. 

This is a full-time role on a standard schedule, with participation in a global on-call rotation. 

Who We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 15 years of related experience; or a Master's degree with 12 years of experience; or equivalent experience. 

Experience leading or mentoring a reliability or operations team and setting technical direction

Proven incident command on major outages, plus ownership of a postmortem process

Strong background in disaster recovery planning across Azure, AWS, GCP, and core infrastructure platforms, including restore validation, failover testing, recovery-objective definition, and corrective action tracking after DR exercises or production incidents

Hands-on ownership of an incident management and paging platform at scale, such as PagerDuty

Experience with capacity planning, performance trending, utilization analysis, and infrastructure demand forecasting for globally distributed production environments across Azure, AWS, GCP, and on-premises platforms

Track record of defining and defending service level objectives and error budgets in production

Working depth in observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo or equivalent), infrastructure as code (Terraform), and Python or Go

Practical experience applying AI-assisted engineering and operations tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or enterprise LLM platforms to improve troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and engineering productivity across Azure, AWS, GCP, and hybrid infrastructure, with clear guardrails for security, privacy, auditability, and production safety. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience running global, follow-the-sun operations across multiple regions and time zones. 
 - Capacity and performance engineering at multi-region scale, including Azure, AWS, GCP, high-performance computing, large storage estates, hybrid cloud infrastructure, and proactive capacity governance. 
 - Policy as code, progressive delivery, and chaos engineering in practice. 
 - Experience building or operating AI and agent-assisted automation in operations, with a clear view of its failure modes. 
 - Experience designing or operating AI Ops capabilities across Azure, AWS, GCP, and hybrid environments, including LLM-grounded knowledge bases, agent-assisted incident workflows, prompt and evaluation practices, and supervised automation that can recommend or propose operational changes before execution. 

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. 

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. 

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories - On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. 'On-site Flex' you'll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. data.title: Staff ML Engineer
data.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13, 600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas' enterprise data protection business, the company's solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe. 

We've been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture. 

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

Staff ML Engineer

Level: Staff Software Engineer (Level 5)

Team: Gaia Emblem Engine

Location: India | Type: Full-Time

About The Role

Cohesity is looking for a Staff ML Engineer (Level 5) to help design and scale the Gaia Emblem engine, the intelligence layer powering our next-generation data platform. In this role, you will architect and build large-scale, production-grade ML/LLM systems - spanning model serving, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), GPU infrastructure, and distributed backend services. As a Staff-level engineer, you will set technical direction, mentor senior engineers, and partner closely with Product and Data Engineering to bring Gaia Emblem's roadmap to life. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and drive the technical roadmap for the Gaia Emblem engine, including LLM integration, RAG pipelines, and prompt-engineering frameworks. 
 - Design and operate scalable, GPU-aware infrastructure on Kubernetes (vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or equivalent), including GPU scheduling, autoscaling, and costefficient resource utilization. 
 - Build resilient, high-throughput distributed systems and microservices exposed via gRPC and REST APIs. 
 - Own data engineering pipelines feeding ML workflows, including ingestion, transformation, and storage across SQL, NoSQL, and search systems (PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch). 
 - Define and enforce engineering best practices: CI/CD, test automation, observability, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm). 
 - Lead design reviews, set coding and architectural standards, and mentor engineers across the organization. 
 - Partner with Product, Applied ML, and SRE teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Drive root-cause debugging and performance optimization across distributed, GPUbacked services. 
 - Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and infrastructure patterns to keep Gaia Emblem at the forefront of applied ML engineering. 

Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 8+ years building distributed, production-grade backend systems. 
 - 3+ years of hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, RAG architectures, or applied ML infrastructure. 
 - Demonstrated experience operating services on Kubernetes (vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or similar) at production scale, including GPU-backed workloads. 
 - Track record of technical leadership: driving architecture decisions, leading crossteam initiatives, and mentoring engineers at Staff/Senior level. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required. 
 - Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field preferred. 

Required Skills

- Languages: Python, Java, Go, JavaScript
 - ML/AI: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 - Infrastructure & Cloud: Kubernetes (platform-agnostic - vanilla K8s, OpenShift, EKS, GKE, or equivalent), GPU Scheduling, Docker, Helm Charts, Terraform, AWS, Cloud Computing
 - Distributed Systems & APIs: Distributed Systems, Microservices, gRPC, REST APIs
 - Data & Storage: Data Engineering, SQL, NoSQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, Databases
 - Engineering Practices: CI/CD, DevOps, Test Automation, Git, Debugging, ObjectOriented Programming (OOP)

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

- Node. js, Back-End Web Development
 - Jenkins and other CI/CD tooling
 - Experience with formal verification or correctness-focused engineering practices
 - Prior experience in enterprise data protection, storage, or infrastructure software

Expectations from the Role

- Operate with Staff-level ownership: define the "what" and "how" for a major component of Gaia Emblem, not just execute tickets. 
 - Balance long-term architectural vision with pragmatic, incremental delivery. 
 - Act as a force multiplier - raise the technical bar of the team through design reviews, documentation, and mentorship. 
 - Communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly to both engineering and nonengineering stakeholders. 
 - Be hands-on: this role is expected to write and review production code regularly, not purely architect from a distance. 

Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates: 

For information on personal data processing, please see our Privacy Policy.

Cohesity is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.

In-Office Expectations

Cohesity employees who are within a reasonable commute (e. g. within a forty-five (45) minute average travel time) work out of our core offices 2-3 days a week of their choosing.

data.description:
About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

Mesh is looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to help architect and build the foundation of the world's first global crypto payments network. In this role, you'll operate across the full stack - from backend systems to user-facing applications - driving key technical decisions and shaping the future of digital finance. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and design to lead the development of secure, seamless, and scalable financial experiences. As one of our most senior technical leaders, you'll play a critical role in defining system architecture, mentoring engineers, and influencing product strategy. We're especially excited to meet candidates based in Bangalore, where you'll collaborate closely with our core team and help drive our engineering culture from the ground up. 

What You'll Do

- Own and drive the roadmap, and implementation for multiple areas of focus, balancing short- and long-term priorities against various business needs. 
 - Drive technical architecture decisions and system designs. 
 - Provide technical leadership across teams. 
 - Collaborate closely with leadership, product, and teams to set strategy. 
 - Develop and maintain backend services and APIs. 
 - Work closely with Azure cloud services for deployment and scalability. 
 - Conduct thorough testing, debugging, and prompt resolution of software defects. 
 - Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies. 
 - Create high-quality, efficient, and reliable code following best practices. 
 - Optimize performance and scalability of backend systems for handling large data volumes. 
 - Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in fintech/crypto and backend development. 
 - Build crypto first and secure products to facilitate traditional financial activity, such as payments, transfers etc. 
 - Drive software best practices and architectural considerations on a project-wide level. 
 - Champion best practices in software engineering, infrastructure as code, and DevSecOps. 

Who You Are

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in fintech or payments infrastructure. 
 - Strong backend skills in one or more of: C#, C++, Go, Java, Python. 
 - Proficiency in cloud-native development (Azure), Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD tooling. 
 - A security first mindset: with good knowledge of common security concepts such as AuthN, AuthZ, SAML, API security, encryption etc
 - An understanding of crypto concepts such as blockchains, RPCs, self custody wallets etc. 
 - Solid understanding of RESTful API design principles and microservices architecture. 
 - Prior experience leading engineering in a high-growth startup environment is a plus. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and make critical decisions under pressure. 
 - A passion for innovation, learning, and growth. Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to thrive in a startup environment. 

Why You'll Love It Here

At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role-you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that. " You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big-this is where you'll want to be. 

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time. 

How We Care For Our Team

We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO-and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best. 

We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work. 

Mesh Pay is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Job Summary

The Product Functional Test Mechanical Technician - Level II is responsible for preparing, building, installing, and supporting test articles, test systems, and laboratory equipment used in product validation and functional testing activities. This role supports engine and component testing by performing test setup, instrumentation installation, troubleshooting, engine handling, and data collection activities while ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and engineering standards. 

The position requires hands-on technical expertise in test cell operations, engine systems, laboratory equipment, and test methodologies to ensure accurate and reliable test results that support product development and validation objectives. 

Key Responsibilities

Test Preparation & Execution

- Prepare test articles, fixtures, rigs, instrumentation, and associated equipment for testing activities. 
 - Install instrumentation and measurement devices in accordance with engineering standards and test requirements. 
 - Conduct and support product testing in accordance with approved test procedures, methodologies, and project plans. 
 - Monitor and document test execution to ensure accurate and reliable test results. 
 - Support engine, subsystem, and component functional testing activities. 

Engine Test Cell Operations

- Conduct and monitor engine tests based on approved test plans and engineering requirements. 
 - Perform installation, removal, assembly, and disassembly of engines and related systems within test cells.

Nordson EPS is seeking a highly motivated Sr. DevOps Engineer to support and advance the organization's global software development and delivery infrastructure. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving DevOps processes and platforms that enable efficient, secure, and reliable software development across multiple product lines. 

The DevOps Engineer II will work closely with software engineers, quality assurance, cybersecurity, IT, and engineering leadership to maintain CI/CD pipelines, source control systems, virtualized environments, release management processes, infrastructure automation, and software security practices, supporting the global software organization. The role also includes defining and executing a strategic roadmap to modernize and scale R&D DevOps capabilities. 5% travel may be needed. 

Key Responsibilities

DevOps Infrastructure & Automation

- Design, implement, maintain, and optimize DevOps infrastructure supporting software development and testing activities. 
 - Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) solutions for automated provisioning and configuration management. 
 - Automate build, deployment, and validation processes to improve engineering productivity and software quality. 
 - Establish monitoring, logging, and reporting mechanisms for DevOps systems and services. 

CI/CD Pipeline Management

- Build, maintain, and enhance continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. 
 - Ensure reliable and repeatable software build, testing, packaging, and deployment processes. 
 - Troubleshoot pipeline failures and implement process improvements to reduce build and release cycle times.

Release Engineering

 - Maintain release documentation and ensure traceability of software artifacts. 
 - Support product teams during release planning and deployment activities. 

Virtualization & Image Management

 - Maintain containerized environments and related deployment infrastructure where applicable. 
 - Ensure consistency, scalability, and reliability of engineering environments. 

Security & Compliance

- Implement DevSecOps practices throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Monitor and address infrastructure, application, and supply chain security vulnerabilities. 
 - Support security audits, compliance initiatives, and secure development standards. 
 - Collaborate with cybersecurity and IT teams to implement security policies and best practices. 

Strategic Planning & Roadmap Development

 - Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes and Agile methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of C++/C#. 

Key Success Metrics

- CI/CD pipeline reliability and uptime. 
 - Reduction in software build and deployment cycle times. 
 - Increased automation coverage across development and test environments. 
 - Release quality and deployment success rates. 
 - Security vulnerability remediation and compliance adherence.

data.description:
Automation Engineer - Mumbai

Turn PLCs, HMIs, servo systems and drives into working machines on real shop floors, from first demo to final handover. You will be the technical support behind Luna's automation business, working with Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek products and with our sales team to turn customer requirements into working solutions. 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country. 

What You Will Do

• Study customer machines and processes, and recommend the right PLC, HMI, servo and VFD solution. 

• Program and configure PLCs, HMIs, servo drives and VFDs (Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem, Fatek). 

• Commission systems at customer sites, including wiring checks, parameter setting and communication setup. 

• Run product demos, trials and proof-of-concept tests for customers. 

• Troubleshoot on site and over the phone, and resolve issues quickly to keep customer machines running. 

• Train customer engineers, operators and maintenance teams. 

• Support sales with application inputs, product selection and technical content for proposals. 

• Document every project and share field feedback that improves our solutions. 

Products You Will Work With

Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek PLC, HMI, servo and VFD products.

• BE/BTech/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or Automation Engineering. 

• 2-5 years of hands-on PLC and HMI programming and commissioning (or strong project work for freshers).

• Experience with Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek products.

Real ownership from demo to a running machine, manufacturer certification and technical training, a clear path to senior application roles, travel allowance and reimbursement as per policy, paid leave, and statutory benefits.

data.title: Advanced Process Control Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Boiler & Turbine Control Excellence - Innovate and optimize PID loops for combustion, drum level, and feedwater control, ensuring seamless and highly efficient turbine performance with intelligent load-sharing strategies. 
 - Improve Steam Temperature Control - Implement new control strategies, such as spray attemperation and reheater tuning, to maintain efficient steam conditions, minimize thermal stress, and increase plant longevity. 
 - Advanced Combustion Optimization - Drive efficiency by fine-tuning air-fuel ratios, enhancing emissions control, and optimizing burner management systems for superior heat rate and flame stability. 
 - Improving Unit Rate & Load Optimization - Developing smart load demand control strategies, fine-tuning heat rate optimization, and improving turbine governor tuning to increase fuel efficiency and grid stability. 
 - Reliable Drum Level & Feedwater Control - Engineer multi-element drum level controls with adaptive tuning, ensuring outstanding stability under fluctuating load conditions while minimizing shrink and swell effects. 
 - Implement brand new MPC strategies to minimize process variability, improve system stability, and seamlessly integrate with advanced DCS/PLC systems. 
 - DCS Commissioning (Emerson Ovation) - Lead with expertise in configuring, programming, and commissioning DCS, optimizing plant performance, and ensuring smooth power plant operations. 
 - Innovative Fuzzy Logic & Advanced Control - Harness intelligent control solutions, integrating fuzzy logic with PID and MPC for unparalleled efficiency, adaptability, and process excellence. 
 - Data-Driven Process Optimization & Performance Enhancement - Analyze critical operational data to identify growth opportunities, drive efficiency, and collaborate with plant teams to ensure a future-ready power plant.

- Deep expertise in control system engineering, power plant automation, and turbine control, enabling seamless process optimization. 
 - Proven proficiency in PID tuning, boiler tuning, and process modeling, ensuring maximum efficiency and reliability.

 - Mastery of Model Predictive Control (MPC), multivariable control, and fuzzy logic control, enhancing automation and performance. 
 - Strong background in steam temperature optimization, combustion optimization, and unit rate optimization, leading to greater energy efficiency.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer II (Java Microservices)
data.description:
At Precisely, we're not just building software - we're shaping the future of data integrity. As a global leader in data quality, data enrichment, and location intelligence, Precisely helps thousands of the world's most trusted brands make confident decisions with data they can rely on. We're an AI-first organization, which means artificial intelligence isn't a buzzword here - it's woven into how we build products, how we work, and how we think about solving complex problems for our customers. When you join Precisely, you join a team of curious, driven innovators who believe that better data makes the world run better. If you're ready to do meaningful work at the intersection of AI and data - and help define what's possible - we'd love for you to apply!

Overview

The role will be responsible for translating product strategy and business priorities into a coherent set of features for one or more scrum teams. Take on multiple roles including Feature lead, Developer, product designer, QA, and project manager. Key member of the team strategizing and presenting the future vision of the product to business and technology stakeholders in collaboration with the Product Manager. 

What You Will Do

- Execute the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities. 
 - Helps conduct market and competitive analysis, defines products to serve those needs, the addressable market, ability to penetrate and sell, and overall business justification and strategic fit for products. 
 - Help execute the value proposition and business case. 
 - Provides team leadership through communication and coordination of cross functional teams at all levels of the organization. 
 - Leads architecture for all components in an investment segment. May focus on one component but must have expertise across all components. 
 - Responsible for design of systems in the investment segment. 
 - Actively supports Product Manager in the Product Planning, business performance of one or more products. 
 - Engage with customers throughout the product lifecycle to better glean product insights. 
 - Understand requirements that comes from stakeholders and helps turn them into consumable backlog items for the team. 
 - Write clear, compelling, and detailed (technical) user epics and stories with user acceptance criteria. Participate in story grooming exercises for crisp and unambiguous documentation and communication of features to be developed. 
 - Ensure the backlog is prioritized in order before the sprint. 
 - Coordinate with appropriate architects to ensure tech decisions are made and implemented. Also Identifying business process improvements and opportunities for automation. 
 - Work with the Product Manager and Engineering Leader to propose percentage of effort for different types of value in each release. 
 - Participates in technical and sales enablement. 

What We Are Looking For

- Bachelor's Degree (or higher) in business or technical field. 
 - 8+ years of industry experience in the areas of data engineering and product management. 
 - Expertise in Java for backend development. 
 - Expertise with databases, particularly Mongo Atlas, and developing/consuming REST APIs. 
 - Track record of Designing and developing data products or software products. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, and microservices architecture is a must. 
 - Basic understanding of agile and scrum methodologies is a must. 
 - Experience of AWS/Azure/GCP, Redis, Security Domain, Datadog, Code fresh
 - Working knowledge of data ETL will be preferred. 
 - Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI etc. 
 - Ability to communicate with various stakeholders at all levels of the organization. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Excellent interpersonal skills and active listener. 
 - Able to set and meet time-sensitive goals. 
 - Able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and adapt to change while providing structure to operations and go-to-market teams. 

AI Skills/Knowledge

- AI-assisted development: Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor to support coding, code review, documentation, and test generation. 
 - LLM and agentic workflows: Familiarity with LLM APIs and agent-based workflows, with the ability to apply them thoughtfully in software engineering use cases. 
 - Responsible AI practices: Understanding of responsible AI principles, including bias mitigation, security considerations, explainability, and appropriate use of AI-generated outputs. 

Preferred Skills (a Plus But Not Required)

- Familiarity with frontend scripting languages such as Node. js and React. js
 - Understanding of spark framework along with Snowflake and Databricks. 
 - Hands on Terraform will be advantageous. 

Application and Interview Impersonation Notice: Impersonating another individual when applying for employment, and/or participating in an interview process to assist another individual in obtaining employment, with Precisely Software Incorporated ("Precisely") is unlawful. If Precisely identifies such fraudulent conduct, then as applicable and to the extent permitted by law, the application will be rejected, an offer (if made) will be rescinded, or the employment will be terminated, and legal action may be taken against the impersonators. 

The personal data that you provide as a part of this job application will be handled in accordance with relevant laws. For more information about how Precisely handles the personal data of job applicants, please see the Precisely Candidate Privacy Notice

data.title: Staff Streaming/Messaging Infra Engineer
data.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

About the Team and the Role Join the infrastructure engineering team responsible for building, scaling, and operating eBay's core messaging and real-time streaming platforms. Our infrastructure powers mission-critical, high-throughput applications across eBay's global ecosystem. 

In this role, you will act as a core developer and architect, taking full ownership of both the control plane and data plane for our distributed streaming platforms-including Apache Flink and Apache Kafka-deployed across multiple private cloud Kubernetes clusters spanning various Availability Zones (AZs) and Data Centers (DCs). You will also play a key role in designing and evolving our next-generation streaming lakehouse storage systems. 

What You'll do

- Build a cloud-native distributed systems: Design and develop core Streaming components, supporting independent scaling, high availability, and fault tolerance. 
 - Solve distributed systems challenges: Design and implement replication, consistency, crash recovery, failover, and distributed coordination mechanisms. 
 - Build Streaming Lakehouses: Lead the design and development of our real-time streaming lakehouse storage architecture, enabling low-latency analytical workloads at massive scale. 
 - Ensure Operational Excellence: Drive high availability, automated fault recovery, and zero-downtime operations for large-scale production streaming topologies. 
 - Enhance System Observability: Advance enterprise monitoring, distributed tracing, automated alerting, and failure-diagnosis tooling to maximize platform uptime. 
 - Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional architecture and platform teams worldwide to shape the future of eBay's real-time data ecosystem. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering: Use modern AI coding agents to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and validation while maintaining high engineering standards. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience building production-grade systems software, databases, storage engines, or large-scale distributed systems, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. 
 - Core Distributed Systems Experience: Deep hands-on background in computer science fundamentals (data structures, concurrency, OS internals, and networking) with strong expertise in Java, Rust, or C++. 
 - Stream Processing Engine Expertise: Strong hands-on experience developing, tuning, and operating Apache Flink at scale (e. g. , state backend management, checkpointing tuning, custom operators, Flink Kubernetes Operator). 
 - Distributed Messaging Deep-Dive: Proven experience with Apache Kafka (or Pulsar/RocketMQ), including core broker architecture, partition strategy, and control/data plane management. 
 - Container & Multi-Cluster Orchestration: Solid experience running high-throughput stateful workloads on Kubernetes across hybrid or private cloud environments. 

Nice to Have

- Deep knowledge of embedded storage engines (RocksDB, LevelDB) and memory management. 
 - Active contributions to open-source projects in the streaming ecosystem (e. g. , Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Apache Paimon). 

Why Join Us?

- Build at hyperscale: Solve challenging distributed systems problems that directly impact eBay's global commerce platform. 
 - Work on deep systems engineering: Go beyond application development and work on messaging internals, distributed storage, replication, and fault tolerance. 
 - Shape the architecture: Make meaningful technical contributions to a next-generation cloud-native streaming platform. 
 - Own what you build: Take projects from architecture and implementation through production deployment and operations. 
 - Innovate with AI: Explore modern AI-assisted development practices to accelerate complex systems engineering. 

Additional Details

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay. com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. 

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

data.title: Industrial automation engineer
data.description:
Company Description MachineryFix is dedicated to bringing transparency, speed, and standardization to factory floor maintenance for MSME manufacturing units across India. The company connects vetted ITI and diploma-certified technicians with factories that rely on critical machinery to power nearly half of the nation's exports. By replacing fragmented local networks and volatile pricing with accountable, professional service, MachineryFix helps plant managers reduce downtime and improve reliability. The team focuses on building a trusted ecosystem where manufacturers can access timely, high-quality maintenance support and technicians can find consistent, well-structured work opportunities. 

Role Description As an Industrial Automation Engineer at MachineryFix, you will work on-site in Hyderabad in a full-time capacity, supporting automation and control systems across a variety of manufacturing environments. You will design, implement, and optimize industrial automation solutions, including PLCs, robotics, and process control systems, to improve efficiency and reduce machine downtime. Daily responsibilities include diagnosing and troubleshooting equipment and control system failures, coordinating corrective and preventive maintenance activities, and collaborating with technicians and plant teams to ensure stable, safe operations. You will document system configurations, maintain technical records, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability, standardization, and performance of factory floor automation. 

Sharing an opening for industrial electronics engineers 🔧

MachineryFix (machineryfix. in) is hiring an Electronics Repair & Quality Engineer (Drive / PLC Cards). 

MachineryFix gets faulty drives, PLC cards and control electronics repaired for manufacturers and large industrial clients, working with specialist repair labs across India. They need a strong technical person in the middle: someone who understands what's actually wrong with a card, works it through with the repair lab, and makes sure it really works before it's approved and sent back to the client. 

📍 Hyderabad, or willing to relocate (travel to repair labs and client sites when needed)

🕒 Full-time | 4+ years of experience

What the role involves

• Inspecting incoming faulty cards (VFD power and gate driver boards, PLC and I/O cards, control PCBs), recording symptoms and doing a first-level diagnosis

• Discussing fault findings and repair scope with repair labs, and checking that the quoted work matches the actual fault

• Doing or witnessing bench and load testing of repaired cards

• Checking replaced components, soldering and overall workmanship

• Signing off a repair only once test results confirm the card works, and sending back any repair that fails

• Preparing clear test reports for clients, with photos, replaced parts and results

• Building a record of common failures by make and model to speed up future jobs

What they're looking for

• 4+ years in drive, PLC or industrial electronics card repair (a repair lab, OEM service centre or plant electronics maintenance)

• Component-level fault finding on IGBTs, gate drivers, SMPS, ICs, capacitors and optocouplers

• Confident with an oscilloscope, multimeter, IGBT and component testers, DC power supplies and SMD rework stations

• Experience with drives from ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Yaskawa, Schneider or similar

• Can read circuit diagrams, and trace circuits on boards that come without schematics

• Honest and detail-oriented: this is the person who says no when a repair isn't good enough

• Diploma or B. E. /B. Tech in ECE, EEE, EIE or a related field

Why it's worth a look

• An early, founding-team role with real responsibility from day one

• Cards and drives from many brands and industries, including large enterprise clients

• They want someone who'll grow with the company for the long run

📩 To apply, send your CV to contact@machineryfix. in with a short note on the most difficult card you've repaired. 

- Candidates should possess strong skills in Automation and Process Control, including PLC programming, SCADA/HMI configuration, and industrial control system integration. 
 - Candidates should possess solid Electrical Engineering skills, with the ability to interpret wiring diagrams, manage power and control circuits, and ensure compliance with electrical safety standards. 
 - Candidates should possess proven Troubleshooting skills for mechanical, electrical, and automation-related issues, using diagnostic tools and structured problem-solving methods. 
 - Candidates should possess foundational knowledge of Robotics, including configuration, operation, and maintenance of robotic systems used in manufacturing environments. 
 - Relevant bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or related engineering discipline. 
 - Experience in industrial automation within manufacturing or process industries, particularly with MSME units, is beneficial. 
 - Ability to work on-site in demanding factory environments, adhere to safety protocols, and coordinate effectively with multidisciplinary teams. 
 - Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the capacity to manage multiple assignments and respond quickly to critical machine breakdowns.

data.title: Sr Serviceability Engineer - Life Cycle Manager (LCM)
data.description:
About Nutanix

Nutanix is building a world where infrastructure is invisible, and organizations can focus on the work that matters. Our hybrid multicloud platform helps customers run applications and manage data across private, public, and distributed clouds with simplicity and control. 

About The Team

The Serviceability Engineer role is part of the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix, based in Bangalore. The team is made up of engineers who improve product serviceability, diagnostics, reliability, and the overall customer experience. 

Serving as a critical bridge between Support and Engineering, the team ensures that serviceability and usability are considered throughout the product lifecycle. By analyzing customer issues, monitoring field performance, validating releases, and incorporating customer feedback, the team drives improvements that make Nutanix products easier to deploy, upgrade, troubleshoot, and operate. 

You will report to the Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement. The team works in a hybrid environment that encourages collaboration, technical learning, and ownership. 

Your Role

As a Senior Serviceability Engineer for Life Cycle Manager (LCM), you will help make upgrades predictable, diagnosable, and safe across Nutanix software and hardware environments. You will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality Assurance, Release Management, and Support to improve the serviceability of LCM from product definition through release and post-deployment adoption. 

LCM provides a cluster-aware framework for inventorying and updating software and firmware across a Nutanix environment. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex distributed systems, investigating customer-impacting failures, improving product diagnostics, and influencing teams to prevent recurring issues. 

The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities. 

What You'll Do

- Define and maintain serviceability requirements for LCM features, upgrade workflows, inventory, prechecks, compatibility validation, recovery, and diagnostics. 
 - Partner with Product Management and Engineering during product planning and development to ensure customer troubleshooting and operational needs are addressed early. 
 - Lead serviceability validation for LCM releases, including upgrade-path testing, upgrade and inventory workflows, precheck coverage, failure and recovery scenarios, interoperability, scale, and upgrade resiliency. 
 - Build and maintain representative test matrices across Nutanix software, hypervisors, server platforms, firmware components, cluster configurations, and supported deployment models. 
 - Review field issues, support cases, telemetry, and diagnostic data to identify trends, customer impact, recurring failure modes, and opportunities for product improvement. 
 - Investigate complex LCM failures by correlating application logs, task and workflow data, cluster state, system events, network behavior, and firmware or hardware-management responses. 
 - Work with Engineering to isolate root causes, reproduce issues, define corrective actions, and drive critical and deferred defects to closure. 
 - Review precheck and compatibility behavior to ensure that failures are actionable, accurately classified, and supported by clear remediation guidance. 
 - Evaluate upgrade rollback, recovery, and partial-failure scenarios and help define safe customer outcomes when an upgrade does not complete as expected. 
 - Collaborate with Quality Assurance and test automation teams to improve coverage for upgrade paths, dependency conflicts, hardware variants, network conditions, disconnected or restricted environments, and negative scenarios. 
 - Partner with Release Management and Documentation teams on release readiness, known issues, upgrade guidance, troubleshooting content, and Support enablement. 
 - Translate complex technical findings into clear requirements, defect reports, troubleshooting guides, executive summaries, and customer-safe recommendations. 
 - Represent the customer and Support perspective in design reviews, technical discussions, defect triage, and release decisions. 
 - Mentor engineers and promote serviceability practices that reduce customer effort, support case volume, time to resolution, and avoidable upgrade risk. 

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years of experience in enterprise software, platform engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, technical support, or serviceability. 
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. 
 - Experience working with complex infrastructure products, distributed systems, virtualization platforms, cloud infrastructure, or data-center operations. 
 - Strong experience troubleshooting customer-impacting issues across multiple layers of a technology stack and converting investigation findings into durable product improvements. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Support without relying solely on formal authority. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technical support teams, product leaders, and executive stakeholders. 

Technical Requirements

Life Cycle Management and Upgrade Workflows

- Strong understanding of software and firmware lifecycle management, including inventory, repositories, package or bundle management, prechecks, dependencies, compatibility, upgrade sequencing, and post-upgrade validation. 
 - Experience testing or troubleshooting upgrade workflows involving failure handling, partial completion, recovery, retry, and resumption scenarios. 
 - Understanding of the operational risks associated with infrastructure upgrades and the importance of clear customer-facing diagnostics and remediation guidance. 

Virtualization and Nutanix Technologies

- Hands-on experience with one or more virtualization or hypervisor technologies, such as Nutanix AHV/KVM or VMware ESXi. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure concepts such as clusters, controllers, virtual machines, storage, networking, high availability, and rolling maintenance. 
 - Experience with Nutanix technologies such as AOS, Prism, AHV, or LCM is a plus. 

Systems and Infrastructure Troubleshooting

- Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including process, service, filesystem, permissions, networking, and system-resource analysis. 
 - Ability to analyze logs, task histories, service states, configuration files, alerts, and diagnostic bundles to identify failure patterns. 
 - Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, boot processes, out-of-band management, and hardware-management interfaces such as Redfish or IPMI is preferred. 
 - Understanding of network fundamentals relevant to infrastructure upgrades, including DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS certificates, repositories, and connectivity validation. 

Automation, APIs, and Diagnostics

- Proficiency in Python, Shell, or another scripting language for test automation, log analysis, data extraction, and operational tooling. 
 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and API-driven infrastructure workflows. 
 - Familiarity with observability, telemetry, log collection, diagnostic bundles, and metrics used to detect and troubleshoot product issues. 
 - Experience building or improving automated validation for upgrade, compatibility, failure-injection, or recovery scenarios. 

Serviceability and Quality Engineering

- Experience defining test strategies, test plans, acceptance criteria, release gates, and validation metrics for complex products. 
 - Proven ability to review and prioritize defects using customer impact, frequency, severity, reproducibility, and business risk. 
 - Ability to create high-quality defect reports with clear symptoms, impact, reproduction steps, evidence, suspected scope, and validation criteria. 
 - Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent systems for defect tracking, documentation, and cross-functional execution. 
 - Experience using AI to automate workflows, build task-oriented agents, or analyze defects, bugs, and diagnostic data. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with infrastructure lifecycle management, firmware orchestration, server vendors, or data-center management platforms. 
 - Experience supporting or validating air-gapped, dark-site, proxy-based, or restricted-network environments. 
 - Knowledge of upgrade compatibility models, dependency graphs, release branches, backward compatibility, and interoperability testing. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, continuous validation, or quality dashboards. 
 - Background in technical support, escalation engineering, site reliability engineering, or customer-facing engineering for enterprise infrastructure products. 
 - Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base content, troubleshooting guides, or Support readiness material. 

Why This Role Matters

Infrastructure upgrades are high-trust operations for customers. In this role, you will help ensure that LCM does more than execute an upgrade: it should explain what is happening, identify risks early, recover safely when conditions change, and give customers and Support a clear path to resolution. 

If you enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, working across product boundaries, and turning field experience into better engineering outcomes, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the reliability and usability of Nutanix products. 

Nutanix is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

--
