data.title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer Voice
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's voice and unified communications platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across voice and unified communications to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Minimum Level Of Job-Related Experience Required

- Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 - Extensive experience engineering enterprise voice and unified communications services. 
 - Strong knowledge of Session Initiation Protocol, call routing, session border controllers, quality of service and high availability. 
 - Evidence of improving voice quality, resilience, provisioning or operational support. 

Desirable Requirements

- Professional level unified communications certification, such as CCNP Collaboration or Microsoft Teams Voice Engineer. 
 - Experience with cloud calling, contact centre or emergency calling services. 
 - Experience automating voice provisioning, monitoring or service assurance. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

data.title: Senior Mobile Application Developer (iOS & Apple TV)
data.description:
Hiring for BRAHMA AI - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

Brahma AI builds enterprise technology for content creation, management and distribution. This role focuses on native Apple applications, bringing reliable mobile and television experiences to complex media and enterprise workflows. 

About the Role

As a Senior Mobile Application Developer, you will design, develop and maintain production applications for iOS, iPadOS and Apple TV (tvOS). This is a full-time, hands-on engineering role for someone with 5+ years of mobile development experience who has delivered both native iOS and native tvOS applications. You will independently own features, work with existing complex codebases and troubleshoot production issues. 

What you'll do

- Build and maintain native iOS and tvOS applications using Swift, UIKit and SwiftUI, with reusable components and maintainable MVC/MVVM architectures. 
 - Implement Apple TV navigation, Focus Engine behaviour, Siri Remote interactions and TV-specific application lifecycle handling. 
 - Develop media playback using AVPlayer, AVKit and AVFoundation, including playback controls, subtitles and multiple audio tracks. 
 - Integrate REST APIs, JSON, third-party SDKs, local storage, caching, push notifications and deep links. 
 - Work on streaming reliability, secure media delivery and device communication, including authentication, pairing and real-time integrations. 
 - Diagnose crashes, memory leaks, concurrency issues, buffering and playback failures using Xcode, Instruments, logs and profiling tools. 
 - Own testing, TestFlight distribution, provisioning and App Store releases for the modules you deliver. 
 - Collaborate with Product, QA, UI/UX and Backend teams, review code and contribute to architecture and release planning. 

What you bring

- 5+ years of mobile application development experience, with strong professional native iOS development using Swift. 
 - Actual hands-on native Apple TV/tvOS development experience; theoretical familiarity or cross-platform-only experience is not sufficient. 
 - Practical experience using AVPlayer, AVKit or AVFoundation to deliver production media playback. 
 - Strong UIKit/SwiftUI knowledge, REST API integration experience and working knowledge of Objective-C. 
 - Sound understanding of memory management, multithreading, concurrency, application lifecycle, local persistence and caching. 
 - Experience maintaining released applications, debugging complex production issues and improving performance and stability. 
 - Ability to independently translate requirements into maintainable code, own modules and work effectively in existing codebases. 
 - Experience with Xcode, Instruments, TestFlight, provisioning profiles and App Store deployment. 

Nice to have

- OTT, live-streaming, video-on-demand or enterprise media application experience. 
 - HLS, adaptive bitrate playback, FairPlay DRM, CDN integration and secure media delivery. 
 - QR-code authentication, device pairing, iOS-to-Apple TV communication, WebSockets and local device discovery. 
 - Cross-device synchronized playback. 
 - CI/CD, automated tests, crash analytics and application monitoring.

data.title: AI Full-Stack Developer, Maintenance & Enhancements
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

PULS runs live AI solutions used every day by Purchasing, Finance, Logistics, R&D and Sales: chat agents integrated with SAP, scheduled Azure jobs, document pipelines, workflow apps and dashboards. You will keep them reliable and keep improving them. That means resolving incidents at the root cause, shipping change requests in regular maintenance releases, and keeping everything monitored and documented. You will work from India with core hours overlapping the Munich morning (about 13: 00-18: 00 IST), with no night shifts and no solo on-call, alongside the AI team, DevOps and Cybersecurity. Onboarding is in Munich, with one or two visits a year after that. 

What you'll do

- Own the incident and change-request queue for all live AI solutions: reproduce on the test stage, separate bugs from change requests and agree weekly priorities with the AI Team Lead
 - Fix root causes across the stack: TypeScript/React frontend, Node. js or Python (FastAPI) backend, scheduled jobs, SAP OData integration, PDF and mailbox automation, and write the test that proves each fix
 - Ship enhancements in maintenance releases (new SAP fields, document layouts, extended agent skills) and turn larger requests into specifications for the project team
 - Use Claude Code and Codex to draft fixes and tests, then review, verify on the preview stage and merge
 - Catch rising error rates, silently failed jobs and token-cost drift with KQL in Log Analytics; release prompt, skill and model updates on Azure OpenAI only after regression cases and an LLM-as-judge review pass
 - Run Azure Container Apps and jobs across preview, pilot and production with DevOps: Bicep, rollbacks, Key Vault secrets, Entra app registrations and Teams app updates
 - Take over solutions built by business teams and keep runbooks and documentation current

What you bring

- 4-6 years of full-stack development on production systems you not only built but kept running
 - TypeScript/React and Node. js, plus Python with FastAPI; SQL with PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB
 - Azure in daily practice: Container Apps, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Bicep and the Azure CLI
 - Has shipped LLM applications to production: tool calling, prompt guardrails, RAG (pgvector) and evaluation
 - Real debugging depth, e. g. has traced a 401/403 through an OAuth on-behalf-of chain and an API gateway to its root cause, and reads logs with KQL
 - At least 6 months of daily Claude Code or Codex use on production code. Expect live pairing on a real ticket in the interview
 - Secrets management, RBAC and GDPR as everyday practice; clear written English (C1) for non-technical colleagues in Jira and docs

Nice to have

- SAP OData integration experience
 - PowerShell for Windows-based deployment and operations tooling
 - Microsoft Teams app development

 - Solid foundation in Electrical Engineering, with knowledge of wiring, circuits, and relevant industrial safety practices. 
 - Bachelor's degree or diploma in Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - Experience in industrial manufacturing or plant maintenance environments; exposure to MSME units is an advantage. 
 - Ability to interpret P&IDs, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals, and to maintain clear technical documentation. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and capability to work independently and within cross-functional teams. 
 - Willingness to work on-site at factories, adhere to safety protocols, and engage directly with customers and technicians.

Career Family

Full-stack Engineer

Role Type

Full Time

The opportunity

We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Risk and Compliance Engineering Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Risk Management, Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That's how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. 

We're looking for a Full-stack Engineer (front-end focussed) at EY GDS. You will work on designing and implementing modern web applications with a focus on front-end development using Angular or React. js with TypeScript. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build, deploy, and manage scalable back-end services, APIs, and database integrations that meet business needs and leverage best practices in full-stack development and cloud technologies. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering. We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial and non-financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. 

EY Risk and Compliance Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Engineering (RCE) practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY's RCE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Front-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript and Java-based technologies. 
 - API Integration: Work with REST APIs and GraphQL services for data integration. 
 - Back-End Development: Develop and maintain backend services and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture. 
 - CI/CD Management: Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps. 
 - Collaboration: Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions. 
 - Technology Updates: Stay updated with emerging web technologies and apply best practices in performance and security. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

Required Skills: 

- 4+ years of experience in full-stack application development with strong expertise in React and Java technologies. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with React. js, TypeScript, and modern front-end development practices. 
 - Deep understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), responsive design, and browser compatibility. 
 - Experience with state management libraries, component-driven architecture, reusable UI development, and front-end performance optimization. 
 - Strong proficiency in Core Java (Java 8+) and object-oriented programming principles. 
 - Hands-on experience with Multithreading, Concurrency, Collections Framework, Java Streams, and Functional Programming concepts. 
 - Strong understanding of asynchronous programming using CompletableFuture, Executor Framework, and Thread Pools. 
 - Good knowledge of JVM internals, memory management, garbage collection, and performance tuning. 
 - Extensive experience in developing enterprise applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Data JPA. 
 - Experience in designing and developing Microservices-based architectures. 
 - Strong understanding of RESTful Web Services, API design standards, and integration patterns. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing application security using OAuth2, JWT, and role-based access controls. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar technologies. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Strong proficiency with Git and modern source control practices. 
 - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 

Preferred Experience: 

- Domain: Prior experience in the Financial Services / FS Risk domain. 
 - Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies. 
 - Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues
 - Familiarity with AI/GenAI concepts, such as LLM fundamentals and prompt engineering. Ability to work with AI APIs or AI-powered components in application development. 

Education: 

Degree: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Lead Software Engineer

Job Description Template

Lead Software Engineer

Who is Mastercard?

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team - one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results. 

Technology at Mastercard

What we create today will define tomorrow. Revolutionary technologies that reshape the digital economy to be more connected and inclusive than ever before. Safer, faster, more sustainable. 

And we need the best people to do it. Technologists who are energized by the challenges of a truly global network. With the talent and vision to create the critical systems and products that power global commerce and connect people everywhere to the vital goods and services they need every day. 

Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture. Inclusive and diverse, a rich collaboration of ideas and perspectives. A place that celebrates your strengths, values your experiences, and offers you the flexibility to shape a career across disciplines and continents. And the opportunity to work alongside experts and leaders at every level of the business, improving what exists, and inventing what's next. 

About The Role

Software Engineers at Mastercard design and code a variety of applications covering transaction processing, analytics, user interfaces, and APIs using a blend of cutting-edge technologies across big data, distributed systems, machine learning, and more. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will lead the delivery of these products and solutions with speed and agility as part of a small team. This will involve developing high-performing, highly scalable software solutions and products for some of the world's top brands. Specific tasks vary depending on the project and the business unit that you join in. 

All Staff At Mastercard Are Expected To Demonstrate 'Mastercard Way' Cultural Values Every Day - Own It, Simplify It, Sense Of Urgency, Thoughtful Risk-taking, Unlock Potential, And Be Inclusive - With a Relentless Focus On Our Customers. As a Lead Software Engineer At Mastercard, You Are Expected To Perform The Following General Responsibilities: 

- Lead one or two squads of senior and junior engineers and own the software development and delivery
 - Own complex problems with dependency across services and facilitate cross-functional team interactions to drive resolution
 - Drive prioritization decisions and trade-offs in working with product partners
 - Provide development and architecture guidance to team members
 - Ensure benchmarks are met on quality, performance, info security and other NFRs
 - Guide and mentor teams effectively as per needs. 
 - Communicate effectively and coordinate with various global groups in MasterCard to ensure success of the projects. 
 - Lead various initiatives for improving automation, defect metrics and overall quality. 

All About You

- Full Stack Development hands on experience using Java, Springboot tech stack, Microservice Architecture, Messaging/Event Driven Frameworks, CI/CD on a Cloud Native environment
 - Experience on System design and Architecture, on multi-tier distributed systems
 - Experience using AI tools and ability to explore and adapt to newer skillset
 - Key driver/owner for delivering multiple product features on or ahead of schedule. Extensive experience leading the full product development lifecycle including coordinating/shepherding technical design discussions, documentation, comparing & contrasting approaches, tasking out stories, and architecting test plans. 
 - Strong oral and written communicator with expertise in evangelizing complex ideas/solutions, spanning multiple, often conflicting, requirements. Facilitates discussions amongst technical and business stakeholders across organization and team boundaries to build consensus. 
 - Drives operational excellence by suggesting improvements to product modules/features using test data, performance data, and production metrics. Leverage testing to verify both functional and non-functional application requirements. Drives efforts to build and maintain lower environments that accurately reflect production. 
 - Demonstrable expertise with root cause analysis of issues in multi-tier distributed systems, with the ability to prescribe risk-reward balanced short-, mid- and long-term changes, over multiple release cycles. 
 - Highly regarded mentor. Instills best practices and proactively coaches others to high technical and quality standards. Identifies and sponsors junior teammates for key growth opportunities. 
 - Extensive experience using enterprise tooling and processes to improve products and processes by proposing changes/enhancements to the full SDLC lifecycle. 
 - Approaches discussions and problem solving, across organization and team boundaries with differing motivations/priorities, with empathy and a goal of building consensus. Finds way pitches in and lends support where needed. Valuable partner with organization and business partners in all roles and geographies. 
 - Key technical voice in anticipating, articulating, and evangelizing solutions to technical challenges, spanning org/team boundaries, based on broader industry trends, prioritized based on business needs. 

Equal opportunities considerations

In the US, Mastercard is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard. com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

Company Description B Fouress Private Limited (BFL), based in Bengaluru, India, is a long-established player in the global small hydropower sector, with origins dating back to 1985 and technology partnerships with leading international firms. The company designs and manufactures Kaplan, Francis, and Pelton turbines ranging from 500 KW to 50, 000 KW, along with substations up to 220 kV. BFL operates overseas branch offices in Guatemala, Turkey, Vietnam, and Nepal and serves markets across South & Central America, the Balkans, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Nepal. The organization provides end-to-end services, including design and engineering, installation, commissioning, modernization, and refurbishment of small hydro projects. With decades of experience, BFL focuses on delivering high-performance, model-tested turbines and comprehensive solutions while expanding into new geographies. 
Role Description The QA Manager will oversee quality assurance activities for turbine manufacturing and related hydroelectric project components, ensuring compliance with internal standards, customer specifications, and relevant industry regulations. This full-time on-site role, based in Bengaluru, involves developing and implementing QA policies and procedures, defining inspection plans, and coordinating quality audits across design, production, installation, and commissioning stages. The individual will lead the QA team, monitor non-conformities, manage root cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions to improve product reliability and process efficiency. The role includes collaborating with engineering, production, procurement, and project management teams, managing documentation and certifications, and interacting with clients and third-party inspectors to address quality-related requirements and feedback. The QA Manager will also track quality metrics, prepare reports for leadership, and support continuous improvement initiatives aligned with global best practices. 
Qualifications

- Strong foundation in quality management, including QA/QC processes, standards, audit practices, and root cause analysis. 
 - Experience in manufacturing or heavy engineering, preferably in hydro turbines, power equipment, or similar industrial sectors. 
 - Proficiency in quality tools and methodologies such as ISO standards, FMEA, control plans, statistical process control, and risk-based quality management. 
 - Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications, and collaborate effectively with design, production, and project teams. 
 - Experience managing quality documentation, certifications, and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. 
 - Demonstrated leadership skills, including team management, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with attention to detail and a focus on continuous improvement. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; advanced qualifications in quality management (e. g. , Six Sigma, ASQ certifications) are an advantage.

Around 9 years of work experience in the software engineering role.

Understanding of modern application security, scalability, resiliency, and performance engineering practices. 

Tools & Methodologies

Proficiency with build and dependency management tools such as Maven and Gradle. 

Experience with automation and configuration management tools including Chef and Ansible. 

Hands-on experience with Jenkins, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile software development methodologies. 

Strong understanding of release management practices including Canary, Blue-Green, and Rolling deployments. 

Infrastructure & Cloud

Extensive experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native application development. 

Strong expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift. 

Deep understanding of DevOps practices, infrastructure automation, deployment strategies, and operational excellence in cloud environments. 

Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk, ELK Stack, and related logging platforms. 

AI & Emerging Technologies

Exposure to Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) based solutions, including integrating AI services through APIs and leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and enterprise AI platforms. 

Familiarity with AI-driven application patterns such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent workflows, agentic solutions, and prompt engineering concepts for enterprise applications. 

Good to have Skills

Knowledge of OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing concepts.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and infrastructure automation frameworks.

data.title: Welding Engineer
data.description:
Job Description - Welding Engineer

Department: Quality Assurance

Reporting To: Head - Quality / VP - Foundry Operations

Job Purpose

To ensure all weld repair activities on steel castings are carried out in compliance with customer specifications, international codes, and internal quality standards, while minimizing repair rates and ensuring first-time acceptance. 

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare, qualify, and maintain WPS, PQR, and Welder Qualification Records (WPQ) as per ASME Section IX and customer requirements. 

- Plan and supervise weld repairs on carbon steel, stainless steel, duplex, super duplex, and nickel alloy castings. 

- Review RT, UT, PT, MT, and VT reports and define appropriate weld repair procedures. 

- Coordinate with foundry, heat treatment, machining, and quality teams to ensure timely completion of repair welding. 

- Monitor preheating, interpass temperature, PWHT, and welding consumable storage and usage. 

- Conduct root cause analysis for welding defects and implement corrective and preventive actions. 

- Train, qualify, and monitor welders to improve productivity and weld quality. 

- Maintain complete welding documentation for customer inspections and audits. 

- Support customer, TPI, and third-party inspections related to welding activities. 

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce weld repair rates and improve first-pass acceptance. 

Qualification

- B. E. /B. Tech. or Diploma in Mechanical, Metallurgical, or Welding Engineering. 

- CSWIP 3. 1/3. 2, IWE/IWT, AWS-CWI, or equivalent certification is preferred. 

Experience

- 3-10 years in a steel casting foundry or heavy engineering industry. 

- Experience in pump castings, duplex and super duplex stainless steels, and pressure-containing components is preferred.

Visit us at https: //www. nvidia. com/en-us/geforce-now to learn more about our product. 

We are looking for a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join a team of skilled and motivated engineers. This is deep systems engineering paired with full-stack ownership to develop highly optimized streaming stack, achieve ultra low latencies, strike the right balance between portability and performance and bring GeForce Now to the leanest of consumer devices. Are you an Android expert that is passionate about streaming technology? Then we are keen to hear from you !

What You Will Be Doing

- Build and maintain features across the full Android application stack - Input, Networking, Video Rendering, UI, App Packaging and Distribution. 
 - Define and develop performance benchmarking for targeted impact analysis - profile and continuously tune the software across networking, CPU, GPU, and input using the knowledge of Android tooling ecosystem and AOSP internals. 
 - Innovate, design, and develop features that improve video latency, quality, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability across diverse hardware and Android-based OS environments. 
 - Own features from scoping through delivery - breaking down work, drafting technical requirements and design documents, tracking milestones, handling cross-team dependencies and risks, and proactively surfacing blockers before they slip a schedule. 
 - Contribute actively to code and design reviews, team processes, and methodologies. 
 - Partner across a variety of internal engineering and QA teams and external partners that build Android products. 

What We Need To See

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related area, or equivalent experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience in systems software development with a thorough command of the Android application core concepts such as Activity, Fragment, Service and JNI. 
 - Experience with graphics rendering and video playback pipelines on Android using MediaCodec, EGL and Vulkan. 
 - Hands-on proficiency with Android profiling and debugging tools across networking, input, CPU and GPU such as Dumpsys, Traceview and GPU inspector. 
 - Good understanding of Android build system components like Gradle, Jenkins and AAB
 - Understanding of Android's test infrastructure such as instrumentation, UI automation and unit testing. 
 - Highly proficient in Java and C/C++, and comfortable working in a large, long-lived codebase. 
 - Proficient in visualization tools like Kibana to run statistical data analysis to measure feature performance and effectiveness. 
 - Familiarity with project management tools like Jira, Confluence, Perforce and Git. 
 - Ability to independently drive projects to completion, with excellent written and verbal communication and a proactive approach to identifying problems and pushing them to resolution. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Familiarity with low-latency video streaming pipelines, including video codecs, display, color spaces, scaling and other video processing operations. 
 - Familiarity with video streaming networking technologies such as RTSP and WebRTC. 
 - Contributions or expertise regarding multimedia implementations in AOSP. 
 - Proficiency in using AI developer tools & models for enhanced productivity.

data.title: QA Engineer - Digital Marketing, Associate
data.description:
About This Role

The Team: 

The Global Marketing & Digital Wealth organization at BlackRock is a forward-looking, globally connected team at the center of the firm's most high-impact priorities. We are architects of growth, working across functions and markets to unlock opportunities and accelerate outcomes for the business. In collaboration with both internal and external partners, we design the conditions for success-delivering next-generation campaigns, brand platforms, communications, training, and client experiences. Our work is powered by world-class centers of excellence spanning content strategy, research & analytics, and digital platforms & experiences. 

Within Global Marketing & Digital Wealth, the Global Digital team owns and transforms BlackRock's client-facing digital properties-including BlackRock. com, iShares. com, and Advisor Center-as well as our email marketing channels. The team brings together product, design, engineering, and digital expertise to create connected, personalized experiences that help clients discover, understand, and engage with BlackRock. 

Role And Impact

As more clients hold iShares and engage with BlackRock digitally, the quality of our client experiences matters more than ever. We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our global Digital Experiences team and help ensure that the experiences we build-guiding users through the purchase funnel, personalizing to their needs, and encouraging ongoing engagement-are reliable, accurate, and release-ready. 

The successful candidate will own quality across the delivery lifecycle, from test planning and preparation through execution, automation, and CI/CD integration. They will bring a development-minded approach to testing and help evolve our QA practice toward an AI-assisted model that increases coverage and speed while reducing manual effort. 

Responsibilities

Planning

- Understand requirements and Jira stories; create test plans, assess test automation feasibility, and estimate, schedule, and plan testing activities. 
 - Use AI tools to analyze requirements and user stories, identify gaps or ambiguities early, and propose risk-based test coverage. 

Test Preparation

- Analyze and understand scenarios and application flows, and prepare test scenarios and test cases for new functionality. 
 - Prepare test data and manually execute test cases to understand application flows. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools to generate and refine test scenarios, test cases, and synthetic test data, applying human review to validate accuracy and completeness. 

Test Execution

- Execute new functional test cases for the current release, as well as manual and automated regression packs. 
 - Log defects and retest fixed defects. 
 - Apply AI to triage test failures, cluster related defects, and draft clear, reproducible defect reports. 
 - Leverage AI-enabled visual, accessibility, and content checks to catch regressions across pages, markets, and devices. 

Test Scripting & Integration

- Develop test scripts according to the BlackRock framework and perform dry runs of automation scripts. 
 - Integrate automation with the CI/CD pipeline and complete a full run of automated scripts. 
 - Use AI coding assistants (e. g. , GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test script development, refactoring, and maintenance, including self-healing of brittle locators. 
 - Help build reusable prompts, agent workflows, and standards that scale AI-assisted QA across the team, and measure their impact on coverage, cycle time, and defect leakage. 

User Documentation

- Create and update user manuals. 

Core Skills

- Quality mindset with a development background. 
 - Analytical mindset with the ability to grasp complex concepts easily. 
 - Comfortable working in an agile environment, fluent in English. 
 - Interested in continuously extending testing know-how. 
 - Curious and pragmatic about AI-applies it to improve quality and speed, while exercising sound judgment on AI-generated output. 

Qualifications

Essential Skills and Experience

- 3-7 years of working experience in software testing or QA. 
 - Technology-based university degree or equivalent experience. 
 - Proven ability to assure the quality of developed software and code. 
 - Experience with at least one of the following frameworks: Playwright, Cypress, or Puppeteer. 
 - Experience with CI/CD environments. 
 - Experience with Jira/Azure Boards, Confluence, and Git. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) in testing or development workflows. 

Desirable Skills And Experience

- Practical knowledge of designing and developing test automation solutions. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps. 
 - Strong hands-on knowledge of TypeScript and Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development. 
 - Familiarity with AI-native testing tools, Playwright MCP, or agent-based test generation and execution. 
 - Experience testing AI-powered features (e. g. , chatbots or generative content), including evaluation of output accuracy and consistency. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director - Digital Project Delivery

(This role can be based in any global Worley office)

About Worley

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. 

With more than 40, 000 employees in over 40 countries, we specialise in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. 

The role

Shape how the world's energy, chemicals and resources projects are built and brought to life. As our Digital Construction and Commissioning Delivery Director, you'll lead the team that digitally enables successful Construction and Commissioning (C&C) delivery across Worley's global project portfolio. 

Why this role matters

At Worley, digital enablement spans the full stack of people, process and technology a global EPC company needs. Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Project Delivery (DPD) and joining the DPD leadership team, you'll set the direction for C&C digitalisation and have the authority and autonomy to make it happen. You will own the strategy, technology and corresponding processes that help our project teams deliver better outcomes for our customers. 

DPD is part of Digital Operations at Worley and exists to support Operations, so your work in this global role will have impact across the organisation. 

This is where deep digital expertise meets senior leadership. Rather than writing code yourself, you'll set the technical direction and lead a talented team across multiple locations, bringing them together to turn that vision into results on our projects. You'll engage with functional representatives in Operations to ensure C&C project needs are understood and delivered. 

Worley has placed Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) at the centre of project execution. A key part of this role is supporting the seamless digital enablement of AWP on projects. AI is also central to our digital strategy, and this role will help shape how we adopt AI across C&C delivery. 

What You Will Do

- Set the strategy: Define the strategy for digital enablement of C&C as part of the wider DPD strategy, build the plans to deliver it, and develop strategic relationships with external technology partners that support our DPD ambition. 
 - Own the solution: Take ownership of the C&C technology stack, including tools, integrations, automation, AI, data management and reporting, across its full build-operate-support-retire lifecycle, partnering closely with other parts of the Worley digital team. 
 - Own the approach: Define the end-to-end C&C workflow for digitally enabled projects in collaboration with the project delivery function. 
 - Lead implementation: Drive adoption of the C&C digital way of working, collaborating with the DPD People and Processes team to ensure a consistent approach across project delivery. 
 - Enable our people: Contribute to organisational change management, define the digital competency requirements for project personnel, and support the governance framework that embeds the Worley digital approach. 
 - Deliver standout support: Build a support culture focused on keeping our people productive, using service metrics to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Lead and grow the team: Manage geographically dispersed direct and indirect reports, including subcontractors, and develop and manage the team budget in line with company delegation of authority requirements. 

What You Will Bring

- Demonstrated experience in construction and commissioning. 
 - Strong digital execution expertise and AI capability. 
 - A proven record of directly leading and managing teams. 
 - A relevant university degree. 
 - Experience collaborating across teams to deliver practical solutions. 
 - Experience developing strategies, operating models and frameworks, with a track record of successfully implementing new ways of working. 
 - Experience with digital solutions on projects and awareness of software commonly used for C&C delivery. Knowledge of O3 is preferred. 
 - Thought leadership, with the ability to move between strategic and tactical thinking and work comfortably with new concepts and complexity. 
 - Strong relationship and influencing skills across all levels, cultures and external parties, with the ability to explain complex matters clearly and facilitate discussions with large groups. 

What's In It For You

- A senior leadership role on the DPD leadership team, with genuine authority and autonomy over C&C digitalisation. 
 - The opportunity to shape how digital technology is used to build and commission projects globally. 
 - The opportunity to build capability in deploying digital solutions across a large multinational organisation. 
 - Latitude to explore emerging C&C digital technologies with technology providers that could shape the future of project delivery at Worley. 
 - Applicants must possess valid working rights for the country in which the role will be based.

EY- Assurance - Manager

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements. 

The opportunity

We're looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills. 

The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles

Your Key Responsibilities

- Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates

 - Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others. 
 - Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe. 
 - Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement team's work. 
 - Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service. 
 - Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one's team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.

 - Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance. 
 - Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one's aligned engagements or beyond. 
 - Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team. 
 - Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams. 
 - Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training. 
 - Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery. 
 - Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team's skills. 
 - Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
 - Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. 
 - Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
 - Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
 - Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values. 
 - The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience
 - Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience
 - Articleship with other top or mid -tier accounting firms
 - Experience in either
 - Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews / matters
 - MNC or larger Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service Environment. 
 - Big 4 Firms - Indian & Global practice
Ideally, you'll also have

- Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office. 
 - Interest in business and commerciality. 

What We Look For

- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
 - An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide. 
 - Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career. 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Principal - Platform Engineer Segmentation
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's network segmentation and identity-based access platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across network segmentation and identity-based access to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Overall 10 years and typically 5-7 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 - Strong experience engineering enterprise network security, segmentation or identity based access. 
 - Deep knowledge of 802. 1X authentication, network access control, firewalls, routing and resilient service design. 
 - Evidence of implementing segmentation that improved security coverage, access control or operational resilience. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

#AGTech

Skills

Automation Technology, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Cloud Networking, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Microsegmentation, Network Design, Network Segmentation, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), SRE Observability, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture, Zscaler Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

 - Track outcomes including toil ratio, capacity returned, automation adoption, cycle time, repeat incidents, MTTR, human-error reduction and control effectiveness.

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience, such as Computer Science or Software Engineering. 
 - Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications are desirable.

 - Software engineering for production operations, including APIs, event-driven integration, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, testing and observability. 
 - AIOps and safe autonomous operations, including anomaly detection, decision support and governed remediation.

- Overall 15 years and degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical engineering experience. 
 - Typically 8 or more years of experience in software, platform, infrastructure or reliability engineering, with substantial hands-on ownership of production services and automation. 
 - Demonstrated experience converting recurring operational work into reliable, reusable automation with measurable adoption and benefits. 
 - Advanced programming and automation engineering using Python or an equivalent language, including
 - APIs, testing, packaging, error handling and secure coding. 
 - Deep coding or scripting capability, plus practical experience with APIs, source control, automated testing and CI/CD. 
 - Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management or enterprise orchestration. 
 - Experience instrumenting distributed systems and automation workflows using metrics, logs, traces and events. 
 - Experience applying SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, postmortems, resilience and toil reduction. 
 - Experience designing safe production automation controls for access, secrets, approvals, change, rollback, audit and ongoing support. 
 - Experience leading technical design across multiple teams, mentoring experienced engineers and influencing without formal authority. 
 - Platform engineering depth in at least one domain such as cloud, hosting, networks, containers, databases or digital workplace. 

Desirable requirements: 

- Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications. 
 - Experience with AIOps, generative AI or agentic operations, including evaluation, confidence thresholds, guardrails and human-in-the-loop approval. 
 - Experience creating self-service platforms, service catalogues, golden paths or reusable automation products. 
 - Experience with chaos engineering, game days, automated recovery testing, progressive delivery and pre-change or post-change validation. 
 - Experience integrating observability, ITSM, CMDB, CI/CD and orchestration platforms to reduce operational hand-offs. 
 - Experience operating in a global, multi-supplier environment and assuring supplier-delivered code, documentation, telemetry and knowledge transfer. 
 - Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry, including GxP or validated systems. 
 - Experience measuring capacity returned, repeat-incident reduction, automation execution success, exception rates, control effectiveness and reuse. 

Skills/Background

- Principal-level judgement to distinguish genuine toil from valuable engineering work and to know when simplification is better than automation. 
 - Ability to influence platform, product, operations, security, quality and supplier teams without formal authority. 
 - Product mindset for automation, including users, SLOs, ownership, documentation, lifecycle, support and decommissioning. 
 - Composure during live incidents and discipline to convert restored service into permanent prevention. 
 - Ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineers and senior stakeholders in outcome-oriented language. 
 - Commitment to automate work away rather than becoming indispensable to recurring manual activity. 
 - Learning mindset toward evolving AIOps, agentic automation and platform engineering practices, without adopting technology ahead of control maturity.

- Production-grade software engineering in Python (or equivalent): APIs, testing, packaging, error handling and secure coding, with 8+ years of hands-on production ownership
 - Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and orchestration with CI/CD: Terraform/Ansible, event-driven integrations, automated testing, release and rollback

 - Observability and instrumentation of distributed systems and automation workflows: metrics, logs, traces and events

data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. Job Purpose

We're looking for a Network Automation AI Engineer to design, build, and operate AI agents that automate network operations, ITSM, and lifecycle management across a large enterprise network estate. You'll combine traditional network automation (Cisco, Itential, ServiceNow) with modern agentic AI (LLM orchestration, MCP tool integration, RAG) to build production-grade, safety-gated automation. 

Responsibilities

- Design and build AI agents (using frameworks like Google ADK, LangChain, or similar) that interact with network infrastructure via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or custom tool integrations
 - Write and iterate on system prompts/instructions that ground LLM behavior in real tool schemas, enforce anti-hallucination discipline, and avoid unsafe automation
 - Integrate agents with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow) for incident, change, and CMDB data, and with network orchestration platforms (Itential) for workflow execution
 - Build human-in-the-loop approval workflows for any agent capability that can modify production network state (e. g. , plan → approve/reject → apply patterns), with strict identity/authorization guardrails
 - Develop and maintain backend services (Python, FastAPI) exposing agents via REST/A2A/JSON-RPC protocols
 - Containerize and deploy agents (Docker, Cloud Run, CI/CD via GitHub Actions) with per-agent configuration, environment isolation, and secrets management
 - Instrument agents with observability (OpenTelemetry, structured logging, Cloud Logging) for tool I/O, session traces, and audit trails
 - Collaborate with network engineering teams to translate operational runbooks (EOL/EOS tracking, device lifecycle, LAN/WAN/wireless health checks, config change validation) into agent capabilities
 - Own RBAC/token propagation and security review for agent-to-tool and agent-to-user authentication
 - Test agents against live/staging MCP servers, validate tool schemas, and iterate on prompt engineering based on real session traces
 - Document architecture decisions, known gotchas, and operational runbooks for the agent fleet

Required Qualifications

- Overall 10 Years and strong Python skills; experience building async services (FastAPI, asyncio)
