data.title: Team Lead, ADM Operations
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

Addepar has just launched an Alternatives Product offering that gives Addepar clients the option to have their Private Funds data extracted, processed, validated, and ingested directly from Private Fund documents for a more automated end-to-end solution for handling Alternatives on the platform. This white-glove solution combines proprietary machine learning technology that automatically extracts data from Private Funds documents and human-in-loop review to validate any documents that fail to pass confidence and data quality checks. 

As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the Alternatives Data Ops team is responsible for the human-in-loop review of Private Funds documents, ensuring clients' Alternatives data is processed, validated, and available in Addepar in a timely manner. This role will include managing a team and reviewing Private Fund statements, modifying data that has been incorrectly extracted by our machine learning models, and reprocessing the data within SLAs. The Alternatives Data Ops team plays a critical role in the success of Addepar's Alternatives offering and requires daily communications with the Alternatives Product Team, Machine Learning Operations, clients, data providers (GPs and Fund Admins), and additional personnel across the organization. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Lead and manage a team of Analysts & Senior Analysts ensuring effective work allocation, timely delivery. 
 - Act as a Subject matter expert & support the team on complex document processing
 - Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex Private Fund statement processing exceptions
 - Perform quality reviews and assist the team in modifying incorrectly extracted data
 - Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput. 
 - Act as a primary escalation point for operational and data quality issues. 
 - Partner with our Machine Learning Operations team to identify and relabel documents for model retraining
 - Engage clients, GPs, or Fund Admins on statement data related inquiries
 - Support the Maintenance Alternatives Data Operations workflow procedures and play-books. 
 - Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and standardization. 
 - Partner with Product and Engineering to implement new processes and tooling features that improve Alternatives Data processing UX and increase operational workflow efficiency. 

Who You Are

- Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
 - Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
 - Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
 - Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
 - Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
 - Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
 - Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
 - Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
 - Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.description:
Job Title: IT Lead -IT Engineering

Location: Coimbatore

Immediate joiners or notice period of less than 10 days are needed

This Role: 

The IT Lead, IT Engineering leads the engineering of LogixHealth's Microsoft cloud and workplace platforms: Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Azure including Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Purview data protection, ITSM tooling and automation. The role owns everything beyond day-to-day operations in a healthcare technology environment that handles Protected Health Information (PHI). 

This is a strategic and technical leadership role. The Lead sets the standards and roadmap for these platforms, is the technical authority on design decisions and major incidents, stays hands-on for the most complex work, and leads and mentors the IT engineers who deliver the rest. The Lead turns business and security requirements into a practical platform plan with costs, risks and timelines for the IT Infrastructure Leadership, and serves all LogixHealth locations. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Strategy, Standards and Roadmap

- Own the architecture, design standards and 12 to 24 month roadmap for identity, endpoint management, data protection, cloud and virtual desktop and IT tooling; translate business, security and compliance requirements into options and investment cases with cost, risk and timeline. 
 - Provide input to budgeting, Azure forecasts, Microsoft licensing and tooling decisions; lead projects end to end (requirements, design, pilot, phased rollout, handover) and act as technical approver in design and change reviews. Platform Ownership (Entra ID, Intune, Purview, Azure, AVD)

- Own Entra ID standards: Conditional Access framework, MFA and authentication strategy, Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, application integration and hybrid identity (Entra Connect). 
 - Own endpoint and data protection standards: Autopilot, Autopatch, configuration and compliance policies, Defender for Endpoint, application deployment, Purview DLP and encryption, for Windows and macOS. 
 - Own Azure Virtual Desktop design and operation (host pools, image strategy, FSLogix, autoscaling, capacity, cost and monitoring) and the supporting Azure resources. Security Hardening, Patch and Vulnerability Management

- Own the hardening standard (Microsoft or CIS baselines, Defender for Endpoint and ASR rules, Credential Guard, firewall, device control, encryption, Windows LAPS) and the patch programme: policy and SLAs by severity, monthly cycle, third-party patching, maintenance windows, exception governance and zero-day response. 
 - Own the vulnerability management programme: intake from Defender Vulnerability Management or scanners, prioritisation, remediation SLAs, exception and risk-acceptance register with Security, verified closure and monthly posture reporting with owners and dates for gaps. ITSM Tooling and Automation

- Own the engineering of IT tooling, including ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus design and its integrations with Intune, Entra ID and Microsoft 365, plus monitoring, reporting and self-service automation. 
 - Set automation and documentation standards for the team (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure DevOps or Git) and introduce Infrastructure as Code where it adds value. Incident, Compliance and Team Leadership

- Act as technical lead on major incidents affecting these platforms and on the technical response to security incidents with Information Security; manage Microsoft and vendor escalations; own ISO 27001, SOC 2 and HIPAA evidence for the platform controls. 
 - Lead, mentor and develop the IT engineering team: allocate work, review designs, provide escalation support and build capability across the platforms. Qualifications: 

The following requirements are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the duties. 

Required (Mandatory): 

- B. E. /B. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 9 to 12 years in IT infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 2 to 3 years as technical lead, with at least 4 years hands-on on Microsoft 365 and Azure in a design and build (engineering) capacity rather than support-only roles. 
 - Strong hands-on Microsoft Entra ID: Conditional Access design, MFA and authentication methods, PIM, access reviews, enterprise application SSO and hybrid identity. 
 - Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune: Autopilot, compliance and configuration policies, Autopatch or update rings, Defender for Endpoint, macOS management. 
 - Strong hands-on Azure Virtual Desktop: architecture, host pools, image lifecycle, FSLogix, autoscaling, security and monitoring, with working knowledge of the Azure platform (networking, storage, monitoring, RBAC, cost). 
 - Proven ownership of patch and vulnerability management for an endpoint or VDI estate: hardening standards, Defender Vulnerability Management or Tenable, Rapid7 or Qualys, SLA-based remediation, exception governance and reporting. 
 - PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; proven ability to define a roadmap, lead major incidents, run design reviews and explain architecture, cost and risk to senior management. 
 - Work from office; shifts and on-call as required for a 24×7 healthcare operation; travel between Coimbatore and Bangalore when needed. Preferred (Good to Have): 

- Infrastructure as Code: owning a Terraform (azurerm, azuread) or Bicep practice with module standards, remote state, Git pull-request workflow, pipeline deployment and drift detection, including identity objects managed as code. 
 - Deeper Azure platform design (vNets, NSGs, private endpoints, Azure Files, Compute Gallery, Log Analytics) and Azure DevOps or GitHub CI/CD; Windows 365, Nerdio, Citrix or VMware Horizon to AVD migration. 
 - Microsoft Purview DLP and Defender XDR depth; ITSM tool design or integration (ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, ServiceNow or similar); experience moving from AD-dependent estates to cloud-native Entra ID and Intune; healthcare, HIPAA or other regulated environment. Preferred Certifications (Good to Have): 

Microsoft AZ-104 or AZ-305, MD-102, SC-300, AZ-140; ITIL Foundation; HashiCorp Terraform Associate.

Esko, part of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), is the global leader in packaging and product lifecycle solutions. You will partner closely with Architects, bringing deep implementation expertise to technical decisions while owning the detailed design, implementation, quality, and operational readiness of complex cloud services. 

You will work on shared platform capabilities such as repository and data services, workflow, search, APIs, and other foundational services used across multiple Esko products. What You Will Do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable cloud foundation services used across multiple Esko products. 
 - Own the detailed technical design and implementation of complex capabilities, from requirements through production. 
 - Remain deeply hands-on, writing high-quality code and solving complex distributed systems and engineering problems. 
 - Partner with Architects to translate architectural direction into production software, providing implementation feedback and identifying technical trade-offs. 
 - Improve the reliability, performance, observability, testability, and maintainability of platform services. 
 - Lead code reviews, technical problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex production issues. 
 - Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, code quality, design practices, and operational readiness. 
 - Mentor engineers through hands-on collaboration, reviews, and technical guidance. 

Required Experience

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, cloud-native, or large-scale SaaS applications. 
 - Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java/JVM technologies and modern backend frameworks. 
 - Strong experience designing and building REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. 
 - Experience translating architecture and high-level designs into detailed technical designs and production-quality implementations. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify implementation trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and provide constructive technical feedback during design discussions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts including scalability, concurrency, consistency, availability, resiliency, and fault tolerance. 
 - Experience developing and operating scalable applications on AWS or another major cloud platform. 
 - Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL and Amazon DynamoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, transactions, indexing, and performance optimization 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern software delivery practices. 
 - Experience diagnosing complex production problems using logs, metrics, distributed tracing, profiling, and performance analysis.

Preferred Experience

- Experience with Scala or other functional programming languages and functional programming concepts. 
 - Experience with Kafka, Redis, Akka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, or similar distributed technologies. 
 - Experience building shared cloud platforms or foundation services consumed by multiple products or engineering teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy or large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Experience establishing or improving engineering practices within a team or across related engineering teams. 

What Success Looks Like

- Architectural direction is translated into high-quality, scalable, production-ready implementations. 
 - Cloud platform services become more reliable, performant, observable, testable, and maintainable. 
 - Complex engineering problems are resolved with strong technical judgment and effective collaboration with Architects and other engineers. 
 - Engineers around you become more effective through mentoring, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance. 
 - Engineering standards improve through stronger code quality, automated testing, operational readiness, and disciplined implementation. 
 - You become a trusted technical leader in your area, known for strong engineering judgment, hands-on technical depth, and consistently high-quality execution.

data.title: Senior CQV Engineer
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. 

The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals. 

The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)
 - Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies. 
 - Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems. 
 - Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design. 
 - Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements. 
 - Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner. 
 - Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews. 
 - Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site. 
 - Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction. 
 - System Startup activities

Working Conditions

- The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements. 
 - Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 10-15 year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 
 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.

Overview Of The Specialist, Quality Assurance And Engineering

We're seeking a Specialist, Quality Assurance and Engineering to join one of our Scrum teams and help shape how quality and automation scale across customers facing financial platforms. This role goes beyond test execution, you'll influence test strategy, automation standards, and quality gates, while owning the end-to-end quality of your team's deliverables. You'll partner closely with developers, product owners, and fellow QEs to ensure our solutions are reliable, maintainable, and ready to scale. 

Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development, you will be embedded within the Maxit product team, responsible for ensuring the quality, accuracy, and reliability of Cost Basis Reporting (CBR) web applications and services. This role focuses on validating data‐intensive, API‐driven, and batch‐oriented financial systems built using modern backend and UI technologies. As part of our global Quality Engineering organization, you'll help expand and stabilize our automated testing capabilities while working in a hybrid model alongside teams based in Bangalore, India. 

Duties and Responsibilities of the Specialist, Quality Assurance and Engineering: 

Quality & Test Strategy

- Own the overall quality of your team's deliverables across functional, integration, and regression testing
 - Review product requirements and design effective test plans, scenarios, and test cases with clear traceability
 - Partner with stakeholders to define testing scope, inputs/outputs, and quality expectations
 - Apply risk-based thinking to prioritize high value test coverage and release confidence

Automation & Execution

- Design and build automated tests for UI and/or API layers with an automation first mindset. 
 - Maintain reliable, maintainable, and scalable automation suites with strong regression value. 
 - Execute and support testing activities including functional, integration, regression, and UAT support. 

Continuous Improvement

- Manage defect reporting and proactively identify systemic quality risks. 
 - Troubleshoot failures end-to-end across automation code, environments, test data, and application defects. 
 - Mentor peers and contribute to evolving automation practices and standards. 
 - Passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, and participating in technology communities. 

Skills and Experience of the Specialist, Quality Assurance and Engineering

- 6+ years of experience testing complex web-based applications. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field
 - Strong understanding of testing methodologies including functional, regression, negative, integration, and system testing. 
 - Strong programming experience in at least one modern language used for test automation (e. g. , C#, Java, or TypeScript)
 - Experience building and maintaining UI automation using modern frameworks (e. g. , Selenium or Playwright). 
 - Experience testing APIs using industry standard tools (e. g. , Postman, ReadyAPI, or Rest API)
 - Experience using BDD style frameworks (e. g. , Cucumber). 
 - Perform integration testing involving IBM MQ/messaging queues where applicable. 
 - Familiarity with Bash/Shell scripts. 
 - Perform extensive Oracle DB validation using SQL scripting. 
 - Solid fundamentals in debugging, triage, and root cause analysis, including pipeline failures
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins, or similar)
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills within Agile/Scrum environments

Nice to Have

- Software testing certification. 
 - Experience across multiple automation stacks or languages. 
 - Experience with batch‐driven financial systems.

data.title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
data.description:
Job Title: Platform Engineer - Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance

GCL: D3

Introduction To Role

Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?

In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide. 

You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities-hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery. 

Accountabilities

- Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams. 
 - Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption. 
 - Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails. 
 - Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability. 
 - Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks. 
 - Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption. 
 - Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery. 
 - Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value. 
 - AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices. 

Essential Skills/Experience

- Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline. 
 - GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization. 
 - Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
 - Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures. 
 - Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design. 
 - Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security. 
 - Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments. 
 - Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles. 
 - Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations. 
 - Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts. 
 - Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous. 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies. 
 - Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services. 
 - Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, . NET, or React. 
 - Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement. 
 - Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, platform engineering meets large-scale impact: you will help put data and technology at the heart of how we discover, develop, and deliver medicines. We bring together unexpected combinations of specialists-engineers, scientists, architects, product leaders-around the same table to unlock aggressive thinking and practical outcomes. You will build from scratch as part of an inclusive group of self-starters who share ideas openly, challenge with respect, and take accountability for making things real. We value patience alongside ambition, learn fast from real-world use, and hold high ethical standards because the stakes are patients' lives. 

If you're ready to build the enterprise golden paths that make secure delivery the default and accelerate life-changing science, send us your CV and show us the platform you would create next!

Date Posted

20-Nov-2026

Closing Date

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

data.title: Software Development Manager III, Seller Fulfillment Technology (International FBA Team)
data.description:
Description

Own a core part of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) for Amazon's fastest-growing and most strategic marketplaces - from emerging international markets to the future of FBA in Europe. International FBA builds the software that lets third-party (3P) sellers send inventory into Amazon's network, keep it in stock, and fulfill orders, and we're hiring a Software Development Manager to lead a high-impact engineering charter end to end. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly execution for the engineering charter, translating seller and business goals into a clear, prioritized delivery plan. 

Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers - owning hiring, performance management, and career development, and building a strong bench of technical leaders. 

Drive the architecture and design of high-scale, low-latency, highly available distributed systems, making sound technical and build-vs-adopt decisions. 

Build Generative AI (GenAI) solutions and conversational assistants that simplify complex, multi-step seller workflows into guided experiences. 

Own operational excellence - availability, latency, and correctness - for services with direct seller and business impact; strengthen on-call, reduce operational load, and drive issues to root-cause resolution. 

Manage region-specific complexity across diverse international marketplaces, including local compliance, tax, and capacity requirements. 

Partner across Product, Applied Science, Operations, Compliance, and worldwide (WW) FBA teams to align on shared roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and deliver end to end. 

Represent your area in leadership, business, and operational reviews; communicate crisply in writing (narrative style) and in person to both technical and business audiences. 

Set and uphold a high bar for engineering quality, security, and best practices across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 

A day in the life

You start the morning by scanning your team's operational dashboards and any overnight on-call activity - checking the health of the seller-facing systems you own and making sure nothing is blocking sellers from getting inventory into Amazon. You join your team's daily standup, unblock engineers, and dive into a design review for a new Generative AI (GenAI) conversational assistant feature that will help sellers manage their inventory. 

Midday, you meet with your Product and Applied Science partners to align on the quarterly roadmap and prioritize the next set of deliverables - balancing near-term seller impact against longer-term bets like the Europe FBA transformation. You spend focused time writing or reviewing a technical narrative, and you have a career-development one-on-one with one of your engineers. 

In the afternoon, you make a key architecture decision on a high-scale service, review a peer's design document, and represent your area in a business review with leadership. You close the day by clearing code reviews, responding to your team, and jotting down priorities for tomorrow. Throughout, you're operating as both a builder and a leader - setting technical direction, growing your people, and delivering measurable impact for sellers across International FBA's marketplaces. 

About The Team

International FBA builds the seller-facing software behind Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) across two strategic frontiers. In Emerging Markets - India, UAE, KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), Egypt, Mexico, Brazil, Turkey, Australia, and South Africa - we own the end-to-end seller journey, building region-specific architecture where local law and network economics demand it, and pioneering Generative AI (GenAI) assistants that make selling on Amazon radically simpler. 

In Europe, we're reinventing FBA itself: transforming a fragmented, country-by-country operation into a single, unified European supply chain (the "One EU" vision) - one shipment, one inventory pool, one set of controls - so sellers reach the whole continent effortlessly. 

We're a team of builders who care equally about seller experience and engineering excellence. We work across product, science, and operations, own our systems end to end, and take real ownership of outcomes that move Amazon's international business forward. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: QA Lead
data.description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we're looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works. 

About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a "100, 000-year data gap" - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork's answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world's leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here. 

What you'll do

- Lead Workforce & Operations: Drive day-to-day workforce management for Clippers, Graders, Regraders, SMEs, and ICs across shifts/sites, optimizing staffing, capacity planning, and throughput against SLA targets. 
 - Implement Quality Systems & Methods: Maintain the QMS and apply structured methods (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC) to address recurring defects, calibration drift, gold-sample injections, and consensus checks. 
 - Own SOPs & Process Standards: Build, version-control, and continuously iterate SOPs for existing and new program launches, ensuring floor adoption and structured QA onboarding/re-calibration paths. 
 - Bridge Cross-Functional Teams: Translate engineering data requirements into floor-executable QA criteria, report field issues back with evidence, and represent QA in program launches and crisis calls. 
 - Drive Data-Led Quality: Monitor and analyze key QA metrics-defect/reject rates, inter-grader agreement (kappa), gold-sample pass rates, yield, and escalation volume-to root out quality degradation with data. 

What we're looking for

- Distributed QA/QC Leadership: Proven experience managing large or dispersed grading/QA teams across multiple shifts or sites. 
 - Quality Methods Depth: Strong working command and practical application of RCA, CAPA, FMEA, 8D, SPC, and QMS frameworks. 
 - Analytical & Data-Driven Mindset: Proven track record of building and interpreting quality dashboards, interrogating metrics, and quantifying operational trade-offs. 
 - Stakeholder & Communication Skills: Clear, structured communication skills across all levels-upward to leadership, cross-functionally with engineering, and directly to floor teams. 
 - Hands-on, High Ownership: A proactive problem-solver who thrives on the floor building processes and tackling operational challenges directly, rather than just administering them. 

What success looks like

- QA metrics (defect rates, inter-grader agreement/kappa, gold-sample pass rates) show clear, measurable improvement across all programs. 
 - Quality issues and calibration drifts are caught early, analyzed via structured methods (RCA/CAPA/8D), and systematically resolved. 
 - SOPs are systematically updated, version-controlled, and seamlessly adopted on the floor with full operational alignment. 
 - Engineering requirements are accurately translated into actionable floor criteria, enabling smooth program launches and rapid feedback loops. 
 - Grading and QA operations scale smoothly across teams, shifts, and locations with balanced staffing and clear role execution. 

Our Values

- Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don't shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback. 
 - Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it's OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct! 
 - Always Be Learning We're a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry. 
 - Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description. 

About Instawork

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation's leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies-and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we're doing it at scale. 

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We're looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York and Phoenix, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. 

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www. instawork. com/about.

Support experimentation, feature flagging, A/B testing, and data-driven optimization of consumer journeys. 

YOUR TALENT: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with significant expertise in mobile application development. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading a technical capability, project or engineering team. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in React Native and modern TypeScript/JavaScript development. 
 - Deep understanding of iOS and Android fundamentals, platform capabilities, and mobile application lifecycles. 
 - Strong experience with mobile build, signing, release, distribution, and application store processes. 
 - Proven expertise in frontend and mobile system design, application architecture, and engineering patterns. 
 - Strong understanding of state management, API integration, caching, offline-first, and synchronization patterns. 
 - Experience integrating native iOS and Android modules into React Native applications. 
 - Proven experience in optimizing startup time, rendering, memory utilization, network efficiency, and application responsiveness. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile asset delivery, caching, network efficiency and content delivery considerations. 
 - Understanding of consumer journeys, conversion optimization, personalization, and digital experience quality. 
 - Practical knowledge of WCAG standards, mobile accessibility, and inclusive experience engineering. 
 - Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flags and A/B testing. 
 - Strong understanding of design systems, reusable component libraries, and mobile UX engineering principles. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, communication, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Proven ability to drive architectural decisions, influence technical direction and mentor engineers. 
 - Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity. 
 - Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred. 

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. data.title: Test Design Engineer
data.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We're making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!

We are looking for Test Design Engineer

The Test Design Engineer shall be responsible for design, development, validation and support of automated test systems for electronic modules, PCBAs, sub-assemblies and product test setups. The role requires strong hands-on capability in NI LabVIEW development, test hardware design and integration, with added advantage of embedded system development using C/C++. 

You'll make a difference by

- Develop automated test software using NI LabVIEW for functional test, measurement automation, data acquisition, result logging and report generation. 
 - Design and integrate test hardware including fixtures, adapters, interface circuits, signal conditioning circuits, switching circuits and wiring schemes. 
 - Understand product schematics, test requirements and interface documents to define test strategy and test coverage. 
 - Develop test sequences for PCBAs, electronic modules and system level assemblies. 
 - Interface and control instruments such as power supplies, DAQ cards, DMMs, oscilloscopes, function generators, electronic loads, HiPot testers and communication devices. 
 - Perform debugging of test software, hardware and product interfaces during development and validation phase. 
 - Support verification, validation and handover of test setups to production or test field users. 
 - Prepare required documentation such as test concept, electrical drawings, software logic, user instructions, validation reports and maintenance guidelines. 
 - Support troubleshooting, improvements and upgrades of existing test systems for better reliability, coverage, cycle time and user friendliness. 
 - Coordinate with product design, manufacturing, quality, procurement and suppliers for timely completion of test system development. 
 - Good hands-on experience in NI LabVIEW application development. 
 - Knowledge of LabVIEW architecture, state machine, event structure, data logging, report generation and instrument communication. 
 - Experience in hardware development for test systems including analog, digital and mixed signal circuits. 
 - Ability to read and understand electronic schematics, PCB interfaces and product test requirements. 
 - Experience with DAQ systems, measurement instruments and communication protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CAN, USB or similar. 
 - Basic to good knowledge of C/C++ programming. 
 - Understanding of embedded systems, microcontroller interfaces, firmware flashing and product communication will be preferred. 
 - Knowledge of electrical safety, EHS requirements and safe working practices for test setups. 
 - Good debugging skills for software, electronics hardware and complete test bench integration. 

Desired Skills: 

- B. E. / B. Tech in Electronics, Electrical, or equivalent engineering discipline. 
 - Minimum 3-6 years of relevant experience
 - Experience in automated test equipment development for PCBAs, control electronics, power electronics or railway/industrial products. 
 - Experience in functional test, in-circuit test, boundary scan, HiPot test, insulation test or end-of-line test systems. 
 - Experience in test fixture design, adaptor design, wiring, connector selection and signal routing. 
 - Exposure to PLC/Simatic based automation, Python, TestStand or database connectivity will be an added advantage. 
 - Experience in preparing for test FMEA, test coverage analysis and validation documentation. 
 - Hands-on and problem-solving mindset. 
 - Ability to work independently with ownership of assigned test system development. 
 - Good coordination with cross-functional teams and suppliers. 
 - Clear documentation and communication skills. 
 - Willingness to work on shopfloor, lab and test field environment as required. 

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. 

Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens. 

This role is based in Nashik. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow. 

Find out more about mobility at: https: //new. siemens. com/global/en/products/mobility. html and about Siemens careers at: www. siemens. com/careers.

data.title: Engineer II Software Test
data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Engineer III, Software Test At Thermo Fisher, our mission is to cure cancer with genomic data. It is a close-knit, collaborative, cross-functional setting where we believe none of us is as smart as all of us and we each have something valuable to contribute toward our goal. The software services team is tasked with applying industry best practices to the design, development, and deployment of world-class software products. We are looking to hire individuals with experience with software development and test engineering in clinical and research settings, and who can help us solve the next wave of technical challenges using the latest cloud-based, big-data, and rich analytics toolsets. We are seeking enthusiastic Leader in Software Verification and Validation who will define scope, design, for automated and manual tests for highly advanced bioinformatics software. We require strong coding skills as well as a solid understanding of Quality Assurance principles and Continuous Integration methods. You will drive writing positive and negative smoke and regression test scripts to test product functionality and integration with dependencies. You will drive strategies for test APIs, user interfaces, web services, and/or web apps and write performance, load, and stress tests. You are excited and passionate about participating in an Agile/SCRUM setting to meet and exceed customer expectations and continuously drive towards quality improvements. You like the idea of partnering with users and other team members to brainstorm the best possible approaches to validating systems. You welcome the challenge of working in a fast-paced, discovery-oriented environment and will be genuinely excited about the prospect of creatively exercising your problem-solving skills continuously to ultimately improve the human condition. Essential Functions: 

- Develop and implement software testing Strategy, Methods and Best Practices that allow high quality NGS analytics and instruments software products to be designed, developed, and released into the regulated in-vitro diagnostics/ medical device space. 
 - Effectively work on established software quality standards and KPI metrics to actively help measuring software and bioinformatics product quality. 
 - Work with Leads to implement software quality tracking tools and methodologies to provide on-going visibility and action during software product development lifecycle. 
 - Effectively work with Leads while working with external partners to deliver state of the art Software products in market. 
 - Partner with software and bioinformatics leadership, functional and project managers to identify appropriate scope of software testing, verification and validation required for a project and managing the overall testing activities for projects. 
 - Partner with internal and external stakeholders to drive the requirements for regulated assays and software. Help software development team to understand the complex informatics and visualization requirements leading into design implementation Minimum Qualifications (must have): 
 - Masters/PhD preferred or Bachelors with minimum 4-6 years of work experience and strong track record of industry productivity
 - 04+ experience performing software verification and validation testing, preferably in the medical device/ biotech space
 - Strong understanding of NGS-based regulated software, IVD assay development practices and informatics data analysis pipelines. 
 - Practical experience as a leader in the use of modern software development methodologies/ processes with an ability to direct the use of resources to meet department goals
 - Good understanding in design control for regulated products (e. g. US-IVD, IVD-D, IVD-R, China and Japan regulations) and knowledge of applicable regulations and standards used in IVD and medical device software development (e. g. ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and 21 CFR 820). 
 - Ability to work well with senior leadership.

data.title: Automation Test Engineer
data.description:
Bring more to life. 

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher's 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives-and we're all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. 

You'll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher's system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact - innovating at the speed of life. 

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory's role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1. 2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making-we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence. 

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. 

The Automation test Engineer / Senior Software Engineer for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics is responsible to Architect, Design, Code, Debug and Implement software features, enhancements working collaboratively with team. He or She will develop quick prototypes to demonstrate the design concepts and product ideas to team and management. Furthermore, the candidate will work independently as well as with SME's. 

An Automation Test Engineer's main goal is to ensure the quality, reliability, and correctness of software products by automating the testing process. They build, maintain, and execute automated test suites to find bugs and verify that the software meets its requirements. 

This position reports to the Senior Software Engineering manager of Digital solution - Cloud platform and is part of the Digital Solutions R&D group located in Bengaluru and will be an on-site role. 

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

- Designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts using various frameworks and tools (e. g. , Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, API testing tools). 
 - Creating robust, scalable, and reusable test automation frameworks. 
 - Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Analyzing test results, identifying defects, and working closely with developers to resolve them. 
 - Developing test plans and strategies. 
 - Performing various types of testing, including functional, regression, performance, and API testing. 

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years proven experience in Java/J2EE/. Net Programming.

data.title: Collections Supervisor
data.description:
About PayJoy

  

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.   Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.   Through PayJoy's point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.   PayJoy's credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth. 

  

This role

The Collections Supervisor will manage and implement PayJoy's collections operations mandate in India from launch. The role sets up the first processes, agencies and strategies, then runs day-to-day recovery to keep the portfolio healthy and support PayJoy's growth in the market. 

All collection activity must be fair, ethical and fully compliant with Indian law and regulation. This includes the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) rules on loan recovery and the conduct of recovery agents, effective 1 January 2027, and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. The focus is on preventing delinquency early, recovering overdue amounts efficiently, and treating every customer with dignity. 

Responsibilities
Launch and setup

- Run the launch collections operation: Run PayJoy India's collections processes from as per approved template, including workflows, scripts, contact strategy and escalation paths

- Write the recovery policy: Implement the collections and recovery policy required by the RBI, with Legal and Compliance. This covers recovery triggers, an escalation matrix, a code of conduct, financial distress and deceased-borrower procedures, and borrower compensation

- Select and onboard recovery agencies: Run due diligence on prospective agencies, check that their agents hold IIBF Debt Recovery Agents certification, and agree contracts, performance standards and audit rights

- Manage the first strategy: Define the initial portfolio segmentation, agency allocation and control groups so results can be measured from day one

Operations

- Early delinquency: Run the contact/digital  strategy for accounts 1-30 days past due and monitor results daily

- Agency coordination: Allocate accounts to recovery agencies as directed and follow up on their activity

- Agency performance: Track agency recovery, cost and ROI, and flag underperformance

- Treatment vs control: Report monthly results for the treatment and control groups

- Recovery tests: Run approved tests and report the results

- Device restrictions: Follow the device-restriction process in line with RBI rules

- Payment channels: Help resolve customer payment issues

- Credit reporting: Prepare collections data for monthly credit bureau reporting

- Reporting: Produce daily, weekly and monthly performance reports

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance or a related field

- 3-5 years' experience in collections management, team leadership and customer service, ideally in consumer lending, NBFCs or fintech

- IIBF Debt Recovery Agents certification and applicable regulatory compliance for debt recovery  

- Working knowledge of RBI fair practices and loan recovery rules, including recovery agent conduct and device-restriction requirements

- Experience managing external recovery agencies and IIBF-certified recovery agents

- Knowledge of credit reporting to Indian credit information companies and related compliance standards

- Proficiency with collection management software and Google Workspace or Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

- Strong analytical skills, with experience measuring performance and evaluating strategies

- SQL for data analysis and reporting is a plus

- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work closely with internal teams and external agencies

- Empathy and a supportive approach with customers, plus clear, assertive communication in writing and speech

- Fluent in English and conversant in Kannada, Hindi a plus

Benefits

- 100% Company Funded : Private Health Insurance for employee and immediate family

- Company-funded employee life and disability insurance

- 20 days vacation, unlimited sick leave

- $2, 000 USD annual Co-working Travel perk

- $2, 000 USD annual Professional Development perk

- Phone Finance, headphone benefit, home office equipment allowance and wellness perks

PayJoy is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome and encourage people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 

  

PayJoy Principles

  

Finance for the next billion * Ownership * Break Through Walls * Live Communication * Transparency & Directness * Focus on Scale * Work-Life Balance * Embrace Diversity * Speed * Active Listening
