data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend
data.description:
Overview

Microsoft Advertising is a $15B+ business that helps advertisers connect with customers across search, display, and emerging AI-powered channels. We work closely with leading global brands to improve their return on investment, incubate new initiatives, and shape the future of digital advertising. 

The Microsoft Advertising Web UI team builds modern, scalable, accessible, and AI-powered frontend experiences that enable advertisers to create, manage, analyze, and optimize campaigns. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and partner teams to deliver intuitive, reliable, and high-performance web experiences using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and other modern frontend technologies. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

Product Development, Ownership, and Code Review

- Independently design, code, test, and deliver extensible, maintainable, secure, accessible, and performant Web UI solutions using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern frontend technologies. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of product features, proactively identifying blockers and risks, communicating timeline impacts, and driving strategies to unblock delivery. 
 - Apply a customer-obsessed, product-engineering mindset when making design, quality, performance, and delivery trade-offs. 
 - Deliver timely, high-quality code reviews that improve coding patterns, security, compliance, test coverage, and engineering best practices. 
 - Use automated analysis, telemetry, and engineering metrics to continuously improve code quality and product stability. 

AI-Native Development

- Apply an AI-first mindset and use AI tools responsibly across requirements, design, development, testing, debugging, and documentation. 
 - Take responsibility for the quality, security, and correctness of AI-generated artifacts while helping teammates adopt effective AI-assisted engineering practices. 
 - Experiment with emerging AI capabilities and use engineering-health measures such as Accelerate, SPACE, and ESSP to improve team processes and productivity. 

Design and Architecture

- Lead the architecture and technical design of complex Web UI features, evaluating design alternatives and documenting their strengths and trade-offs. 
 - Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, security, privacy, and compliance requirements. 
 - Identify and manage upstream and downstream dependencies across services and partner teams. 
 - Develop testable architectures and comprehensive strategies covering unit, integration, end-to-end, accessibility, security, and regression testing. 
 - Build reusable UI components, frontend frameworks, and engineering patterns that improve consistency and developer productivity. 

Engineering Excellence

- Drive engineering excellence by applying secure design principles, frontend best practices, automation, and safe deployment processes. 
 - Champion improvements to Web UI performance, accessibility, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience. 
 - Introduce new initiatives, tools, and engineering practices that make development and validation faster and more effective. 
 - Ensure privacy, security, safety, accessibility, and compliance requirements are incorporated throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Mentor and coach engineers through technical guidance, code-review feedback, and leading by example with a strong growth mindset. 

Delivery and Reliability

- Collaborate with product managers, designers, researchers, and engineering partners to drive project plans, release plans, estimation, and delivery. 
 - Use experimentation, feature flags, flighting, success metrics, and guardrail metrics to evaluate product changes and minimize customer impact. 
 - Deploy changes safely using established frameworks, staged rollouts, monitoring, and rollback plans. 
 - Integrate privacy-aware logging, instrumentation, and telemetry into dashboards and alerts to monitor performance, reliability, availability, and usage. 
 - Act as a designated responsible individual during live-site incidents, respond within SLA, communicate status, and drive mitigation. 
 - Reduce incident volume by improving troubleshooting guides, automated tests, monitoring, operational tools, and incident postmortems. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. 
 - Experience developing production web applications using JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework. 
 - Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, software design, testing, and version control. 
 - Experience designing, debugging, and maintaining reliable and maintainable software. 
 - Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, designers, and cross-functional partners. 
 - AI-native development orientation and willingness to use AI tools responsibly throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership of complex or ambiguous technical problems. 
 - Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical decisions and collaborate across teams and time zones. 
 - Growth mindset, openness to feedback, and commitment to continuous learning. 
 - Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security-screening requirements. This includes passing the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

Preferred Qualification

- Master's Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 6+ years of technical engineering experience; OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field and 8+ years of technical engineering experience; OR equivalent experience. 
 - Strong experience with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, state-management technologies, and modern frontend build and testing frameworks. 
 - Experience architecting large-scale, modular web applications and reusable component libraries. 
 - Knowledge of frontend performance optimization, browser behavior, responsive design, telemetry, and experimentation. 
 - Experience implementing accessible experiences using WCAG and inclusive-design standards. 
 - Experience with Azure, distributed services, REST APIs, or GraphQL integrations. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, feature flighting, and safe deployment practices. 
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across UI, API, and data layers. 

#W+D

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Your Job

Koch Capabilities is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and support secure, scalable data, software, and AI-enabled solutions that create measurable business value. In this role, you will combine hands-on engineering expertise with solution architecture capabilities to deliver reusable platforms, products, and AI-powered solutions across Koch. 

The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineer who enjoys solving complex business problems, influencing technical direction, leveraging emerging AI technologies, and mentoring others while delivering high-quality solutions. 

Our Team

KTDS develops reusable data products, semantic layers, ontologies, and AI-ready capabilities that help teams make better decisions, accelerate work, and unlock new opportunities across Koch. We combine business knowledge, modern engineering practices, and AI-enabled delivery approaches to build scalable solutions that drive long-term value. 

This role is based in the Koch Capabilities India office in Bengaluru and requires an in-office presence with flexibility. 

What You Will Do

- Design, build, and support AI, data, and software solutions including data pipelines, APIs, applications, automations, and AI-enabled workflows. 
 - Lead technical delivery across multiple systems while ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with business objectives. 
 - Apply AI-enabled development practices to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering quality and operational excellence. 
 - Partner with architects, business stakeholders, subject matter experts, and product teams to translate business needs into practical technical solutions. 
 - Design and operationalize generative AI, agentic AI, semantic layers, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities. 
 - Evaluate technical tradeoffs and make sound engineering decisions that balance delivery speed, risk, maintainability, and long-term value. 
 - Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, design reviews, and mentoring of other engineers. 
 - Continuously explore emerging technologies, AI models, frameworks, and engineering practices to improve solution outcomes and business impact. 

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing AI-enabled or Generative AI solutions. 
 - Experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting production-grade software, data, and AI solutions. 
 - Experience leading technical design or implementation efforts across complex, cross-functional initiatives. 
 - Strong programming experience using Python and SQL in production environments. 
 - Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience building cloud-native solutions on AWS, including serverless, event-driven, and containerized architectures. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience mentoring and coaching engineers through technical guidance and collaborative development practices. 

What Will Put You Ahead

- Experience building AI-enabled solutions using large language models (LLMs), embeddings, graph databases, graph query languages, semantic technologies, and RAG architectures. 
 - Experience with MCP or similar agent integration standards. 
 - Experience designing verification and evaluation frameworks for AI-generated outputs, including testing, monitoring, observability, and governance controls. 
 - Experience designing distributed systems using microservices, event-driven architecture, API-first design, and modular architecture patterns. 
 - Experience applying DevSecOps and production engineering practices, including infrastructure as code, automated security controls, secrets management, feature flags, and progressive deployment strategies. 
 - Experience with enterprise data and AI platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Fabric IQ, Snowflake, Azure AI Foundry, or Databricks. 
 - Experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions for conversational or action-oriented use cases. 
 - Experience working with reusable platforms, enterprise-scale data products, and AI-enabled business solutions. 
 - Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. 

Who We Are

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. 

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

data.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Java
data.description:
Job Description

About Williams-Sonoma, Inc. 

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization. 

With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide. 

Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center in Pune build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Software Engineer with strong expertise in Java, Microservices, and modern cloud-native development practices. This role combines enterprise software engineering with emerging Agentic AI capabilities to build scalable, intelligent solutions that improve developer productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance supply chain technology platforms. 

Impact of the Role

- Build and scale high-performance, cloud-native applications supporting critical business operations. 
 - Drive adoption of Agentic AI capabilities to improve engineering productivity and software quality. 
 - Accelerate delivery through automation of development, testing, and maintenance activities. 
 - Contribute to innovation initiatives that leverage AI technologies to transform supply chain and enterprise platforms. 

Technology Platforms You Will Work On

- Java 17+
 - Spring Boot
 - Spring Cloud
 - WebFlux
 - Microservices
 - Kafka
 - NoSQL Technologies
 - Oracle
 - PostgreSQL
 - Cassandra
 - React
 - JUnit
 - Mockito
 - Git
 - SonarQube
 - Checkstyle
 - GitHub Copilot
 - Cursor
 - LangChain
 - Semantic Kernel
 - AI Agents

Key Responsibilities

- Engineer high-scale solutions using Java 17+, Spring Boot, WebFlux, Microservices, Kafka, and NoSQL technologies. 
 - Design and implement AI Agents to automate repetitive development tasks, including auto-generating boilerplate code, mapping complex DTOs, and managing script maintenance for evolving APIs. 
 - Ensure 100% unit testing coverage using JUnit and Mockito by leveraging LLMs to generate edge-case test scenarios and test data for complex supply chain workflows. 
 - Propose multiple technical solutions and evaluate how Agentic AI workflows can improve long-term system maintainability compared to traditional hard-coded approaches. 
 - Lead research initiatives and proof of concepts involving LangChain or Semantic Kernel to enable natural language querying of inventory and order data. 
 - Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies and collaborate closely with Pune and global onsite teams. 
 - Solve technical problems using cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices. 
 - Ensure code meets required development standards and is optimized for performance. 
 - Participate in peer code reviews using Git pull requests. 
 - Ensure all aspects of technical design are correctly incorporated. 

Qualifications

- 6+ years of experience in Java/J2EE design and development with a strong focus on Spring Cloud and Microservices. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools. 
 - Understanding of building autonomous agents to handle routine coding and development tasks. 
 - Proficiency in React development. 
 - Strong SQL experience using Oracle and PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with NoSQL databases including Cassandra. 
 - Strong understanding of design patterns and software engineering best practices. 
 - Experience with code quality and static analysis tools such as SonarQube and Checkstyle. 
 - Experience driving automation initiatives to reduce scripting and maintenance effort. 
 - Good communication skills. 

Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center

- Our people-first and performance-driven culture provides opportunities to grow and build a long-term career while supporting the well-being of our associates and their families through comprehensive benefits. 
 - Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with high ownership that empowers engineers to make a real impact. 
 - Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale. 
 - Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges. 
 - Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement. 

About Us

Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd. 

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide. 

Williams-Sonoma India sourcing office was established in 2013. We are based in Gurugram, India. We are sourcing premium products across all categories of Home Furnishing and recorded double digit year-on-year growth. We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

 - Build and develop engineering leadership and technical talent through hiring, mentoring, and development of engineering managers and technical leaders, while establishing an effective global operating model and consistent engineering standards across regions.

 - Ensure software solutions meet GE HealthCare expectations for customer satisfaction, efficiency, simplicity, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, privacy, and operational excellence. 
 - Communicated

Leadership Attributes

- Effective team and group leader. Recognizes and shapes group dynamic, energy, progress, unproductive/disruptive behavior toward desired goals of session. 
 - Systems thinker; can see patterns and relationships, similarities between programs, projects and interfaces. 

Personal Attributes

- Creates a high-functioning team environment where people are motivated, supported, share more, feel more engaged, and ultimately perform better. 
 - Strategic and analytical thinker. Uses critical thinking skills and disciplined approaches to help leaders and leadership teams resolve issues and define solutions. Acts and decides appropriately when all available information may not be possible to obtain. Uses root cause analysis to identify, correct and/or eliminate the causes of problems as well as the problem itself. 
 - Excellent communication skills and the ability to interface with senior leadership with confidence and clarity. 
 - Supports the team to drive through risk and ambiguity. Strong bias towards action and delivery. Proactively identifies and removes project obstacles or barriers on behalf of the team
 - Maintains excitement for a process and drives to new directions of meeting the goal in the face of unfavorable odds and setbacks. Maintains Commitment, Perseverance, Passion as a team role model
 - Preferably, possesses strong existing domain knowledge of healthcare. 

Quality Specific Goals

- Aware of and comply with the GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position
 - Complete all planned Quality & Compliance training within the defined deadlines
 - Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective action as required
 - Drive compliance/closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before approving Design Control FDRs and NPI program milestones
 - Identify continuous improvement activities by initiating the implementation of process and product quality improvement initiatives
 - Aware of and comply with the change management work instruction
 - Develop an open quality culture within the organization that fosters issue discussion and decision-making based on quality and compliance objectives

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or in STEM Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math); MBA or equivalent business experience is plus. 

Qualifications/Requirements

- Minimum 10+ years of experience in engineering leadership/management roles, preferably in healthcare, medical devices, or high-growth tech environments handling complex programs or projects. 
 - Experience translating customer feedback into actionable engineering solutions that improve usability, performance, and satisfaction. 
 - Be an active participant of team and look for optimizing engineering practices and improvement opportunities. 
 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work harmoniously within a team. 
 - Strong software development experience with object-oriented programming languages such as C++ or similar technologies. 
 - Deep understanding of software engineering principles, including object-oriented design, algorithms, data structures, API design, service-oriented architectures, and modern software development practices. 
 - Experience leading engineering teams responsible for complex software products from architecture and design through production deployment and operational support. 
 - Ability to provide technical guidance, evaluate architecture decisions, and drive engineering excellence across teams. 
 - Strong understanding of ultrasound technologies, healthcare workflows, and regulatory environments is highly desirable. 
 - Excellent communication, presentation, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills. 

Desired Characteristics

- Significant experience leading software engineering organizations, including hiring, developing, mentoring, and retaining engineering managers and technical leaders. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work with technical leadership team to implement product development in global matrix environment
 - Demonstrated experience on global product releases throughout the entire NPI cycle
 - Excellent knowledge in engineering, program management and business planning processes having experience with the full product lifecycle. 
 - Self-starter, energizing, results oriented, and able to multi-task

About you: 

We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements: 

Assignment, Context, Job Main Challenges & Key Expectations:

Job Scope: 

- Analyze user stories and oversee the translation of functional requirements into technical tasks. 
 - Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions.

 - Ensure robust documentation, comprehensive unit testing, and effective resolution of issues.

 - Design scalable and reliable architecture while ensuring adherence to security and performance benchmarks. 
 - Utilize tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to identify and resolve code vulnerabilities, technical debt, and code smells. 
 - Conduct and oversee thorough code reviews to maintain quality and enforce secure coding practices. 
 - Integrate DevSecOps practices into the CI/CD pipeline, including automated security scanning using SonarQube (SAST) and Snyk (dependency/container vulnerability checks), secrets management, DAST, and compliance-as-code, ensuring security is a shared responsibility across the development lifecycle.

Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

As a core member of the Ampere Debug Tools team, you will be responsible for the architecture, design, and development of Debug Tools solutions for the next generation of Ampere products. This role is distinguished by deep technical ownership, architecture leadership, and cross-team influence. 

The Debug Tools Team is part of the Ampere Software Team. Our mission is to develop a comprehensive debug strategy and roadmap for internal debug capabilities, as well as to develop and deploy debug solutions for all internal and external Ampere SoC users. 

- Internal users include Debug Tools software users from the Virtual Platform, Emulation, Platform, Design Validation (DV), Post-Silicon Validation, Design For Test (DFT), Firmware, Operating System, Software, Performance, and Application Engineering teams. 
 - External users include partners, ODMs, OEMs, datacenter, edge and embedded customers. 
 - Debug solutions include Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, and OpenOCD debuggers, Arm Self-Hosted Trace for Linux, and utilities for invasive debug, bus trace, instruction trace, array dump, and scan dump. This role will be for the lead of the Arm Development Studio implementation. 

What You'll Achieve

- Architect, design, develop, and deploy software-based Debug Tools for custom 64-bit Armv9 SoC and other processors. 
 - Invent new debug tools and techniques for future products and technologies. 
 - Influence the architecture and design team decisions with knowledge of internal and external debug tools on Ampere SoCs. 
 - Contribute to software architecture and design documents, application notes, and other software product documentation. 
 - Develop tooling for advanced debugging techniques, such as instruction trace, bus trace, array dump, scan dump, and ATE bootstrapping. 
 - Develop open source JTAG and self-hosted trace and debugger software for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Develop Arm Development Studio, TRACE32, and OpenOCD utilities for internal and external use in debugging Ampere microprocessors. 
 - Perform pre-silicon bring-up of debug software on software simulators and hardware emulation platforms. 
 - Collaborate with hardware design, architecture, post-silicon validation, and platform AE teams, as necessary, to resolve critical customer issues. 

About You

 - Proficiency in C/C++, Python, and Bash programming. 
 - Experience using Arm Development Studio, TRACE32 PowerView, OpenOCD, and GDB debuggers. 
 - Experience with instruction trace, bus trace, scan dumps, array dumps, and crash capture. 
 - Experience with version control tools such as git, and software best practices. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and testing methodology skills. 
 - Proven ability to own problems and drive them to a resolution.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

data.description:
Job Description

- This role is a Site Engineering position within Nokia's Product Validation & Test (PV&T) R&D organization, where you will operate as a full member of the PV&T engineering team. Your primary purpose is to serve as PV&T's direct presence and working arm at manufacturing sites, focusing on Test Station Development (TSD). You will be actively involved on the factory floor, responsible for the setup, debugging, and continuous improvement of test stations. A key aspect of the role is driving the implementation of R&D-developed hardware, software, fixture, and procedural changes directly into manufacturing operations. This is distinctly an R&D engineering role situated within the production environment, not a CM test technician, supply chain, operations, or pure program management function. The position specifically covers TSD for either coherent pluggable and/or TROSA stations, requiring deep expertise in at least one of these station families. 

NILightpath

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

- Design, bring up, debug, and improve optical test stations for performance, reliability, and production readiness in PV&T manufacturing. 
 - Work on-site with manufacturing and Contract Manufacturer (CM) teams to integrate stations into the factory test flow, including fixtures, instruments, automation, and measurement procedures. 
 - Analyze station data and provide feedback for station design, test protocols, and Test Station Development (TSD)/R&D. 
 - Manage the transition of R&D changes to factory reality, including software/firmware/fixture updates, procedure changes, and confirmation of line capability. 
 - Develop and maintain test protocols to ensure accurate and repeatable results, proactively addressing compliance, safety, and measurement-integrity issues. 
 - Represent PV&T at the manufacturing site, mentoring others and ensuring visibility and resolution of station-related issues. 

Key Skills And Experience

- Bachelor's or master's in engineering, Physics, or a related field (equivalent industry experience considered). 
 - Typically, 3+ years developing test stations or automated test equipment (ATE) in optical and/or electrical test. 
 - Working knowledge of optical measurement principles and how test hardware/software produces results. 
 - Comfort working in a manufacturing environment and willingness to travel regularly to Nokia/CM sites in Thailand and Malaysia. 
 - Ability to work effectively across hardware, software, and manufacturing teams to resolve issues. 
 - Coherent pluggable / PIC test-station or ATE development, OR TROSA / photonic-assembly test-station or ATE development. 
 - Electrical design, simulation, or schematic/layout support for test hardware; fixture, thermal, or PCB work, including RF and low-frequency analog/digital signals. 
 - Source control and software-driven test infrastructure (e. g. , Git, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket), with Continuous Integration (CI) for hardware test being a plus. 
 - Production data analysis, Statistical Process Control (SPC), or yield/debug of station-limited failures. 
 - Mentoring junior engineers or leading a station bring-up across multiple teams. 

About Us

Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world. 

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we're advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
At Sofueled, quality isn't just the final checkpoint. It's part of everything we build. 

We build web applications, mobile apps, cloud solutions, and digital products for clients across the globe. We're looking for a detail oriented and curious QA Engineer who enjoys breaking things (in the right way), identifying potential issues, and ensuring every product delivers a seamless user experience. 

If you naturally question how things work, spot what others might miss, and believe that a great product is one that works just as well as it looks, we'd love to meet you!

Your Responsibilities

- Test web applications, mobile apps, and software products to ensure functionality, performance, and reliability. 
 - Create, maintain, and execute test cases, test scenarios, and test plans. 
 - Identify, document, track, and report bugs with clear steps to reproduce them. 
 - Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, and exploratory testing. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, designers, and project managers to identify and resolve issues. 
 - Validate product features against business requirements and technical specifications. 
 - Conduct cross-browser and cross device testing to ensure consistent user experiences. 
 - Participate in requirement discussions and identify potential gaps before development begins. 
 - Ensure resolved issues are properly retested before release. 
 - Maintain clear QA documentation and continuously improve testing processes. 

What We're Looking For

We value analytical thinking, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership. 

You'll be a great fit if you have

- 2-5 years of experience in software quality assurance or software testing. 
 - Strong understanding of manual testing concepts, methodologies, and SDLC/STLC. 
 - Hands on experience in writing and executing test cases and test scenarios. 
 - Experience with functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. 
 - Familiarity with bug-tracking tools such as Jira or similar platforms. 
 - Good understanding of web and mobile application testing. 
 - Basic knowledge of API testing using tools such as Postman is an advantage. 
 - Understanding of SQL and database validation is a plus. 
 - Exposure to automation testing using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar frameworks is an added advantage. 
 - Strong analytical, problem solving, and communication skills. 
 - A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaborate with cross functional teams. 
 - Immediate or short notice period preferred. 

This Role Isn't for You If

- You believe testing is simply clicking through an application to check whether it works. 
 - You overlook small details or don't follow through on reported issues. 
 - You prefer working in isolation without collaborating with developers and project teams. 
 - You're uncomfortable questioning requirements or exploring scenarios beyond the obvious. 

Why Join Sofueled?

At Sofueled, you'll get the opportunity to work on diverse digital products, collaborate with talented engineering teams, and contribute directly to the quality of solutions delivered to clients worldwide. 

You'll have the freedom to bring ideas to the table, improve testing practices, take ownership of product quality, and grow your expertise as we build and deliver better technology. 

Don't just find bugs. Help us build better products.

data.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Description

We're looking for a QA Automation Engineer (SDET) with 3 years of experience to own quality on our multi-tenant HRMS SaaS platform, built on a microservices monorepo. This is a full-time, on-site role at our Jaipur office. 

We want someone who thinks like a tester first: you should be able to read a requirement and spot the edge cases yourself, without depending on AI tools to write your test cases. 

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build and maintain automated regression and smoke suites using Cypress, Playwright or Selenium (JavaScript/TypeScript)

• Test REST APIs against Swagger/OpenAPI specs using Postman/Newman, covering JWT auth, status codes, request validation and pagination

• Write SQL queries (PostgreSQL), including joins, to verify data after UI and API actions

• Write test scenarios, test cases and edge cases from requirements using boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, decision tables and state-transition testing

• Validate role-based access (RBAC): what each role (Admin, HR, Manager, Employee) can and cannot see or do

• Test multi-step approval workflows (submit → approve/reject → escalate), including negative and edge paths

• Verify tenant data isolation so that one company's data is never visible to another

• Report clear bugs in Jira with steps to reproduce, expected vs actual results, and evidence

• Work with developers and product managers in Agile/Scrum sprints, from requirement review to release sign-off

Must-have Qualifications

• 3 years of QA experience, including hands-on automation with Cypress, Playwright or Selenium (JS/TS)

• Strong API testing experience with Postman/Newman or similar

• Strong SQL skills (PostgreSQL preferred), including joins

• Strong manual testing fundamentals and test design techniques

• Experience testing RBAC and multi-step approval workflows

• Good knowledge of JavaScript ES6+, Git and Agile/Scrum

• Clear bug reporting in Jira

• Experience with microservices-based or monorepo projects

• Willing to work full-time from our Jaipur office

Good to Have

• Understanding of Server-Driven UI (SDUI), or willingness to learn it quickly

• Multi-tenant SaaS testing experience

• HRMS domain knowledge: leave, attendance, onboarding, payroll (PF, ESI, TDS)

• Basic understanding of event-driven systems (Kafka, background jobs) and testing async flows

• Running automation in CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar) and basic Docker usage

• TypeScript experience

• Basic security testing: OWASP Top 10, IDOR, auth/session issues

• Basic performance testing with k6 or JMeter

How to Apply

Apply here on LinkedIn, or email your resume to hr@codecreatortechnology. com with the subject "Application - QA Automation Engineer (SDET)". You can also call/WhatsApp 70735 88063. 

- If you have a GitHub repo with automation work, please share the link.

data.description:
Overview

We are building a culture of innovators, risk-takers, and imaginative thinkers. To become AI-native, we look for "builders" who use AI and emerging technologies to solve customer problems quickly and well. 

Join The Data Reliability Team As a Senior Staff Software Engineer. Our Mission Is To Make Intuit's Business-critical Data Trusted, Observable, And AI-ready. We Build The Platforms That Measure And Enforce Data Quality, Detect Data And Data Pipeline Failures Early, And Turn Them Into Actionable Alerts & Incidents. Our Work Includes

- Data Quality Monitoring : Profiling the Data and automate schema based Data Quality checks, execute and calculate Data Quality score, Maturity Score Calculation, and Data Parity validation between each hop of the data lifecycle for critical business use cases covering Lake Tables, Kafka Topics and Data Pipeline health. 
 - Data Observability and Alert 2 Incident (A2I): a self-serve detect-and-act capability. Owners onboard Tier 1 assets through a UI or an agentic experience, choose pipeline and data quality signals and thresholds, tune them during an observation period, and get paged through automated incidents before downstream users feel the impact. 1500+ Data assets are managed and monitored under this capability. 
 - Data Observability Dashboard the Intuit-wide command center that gives leaders a single view of Data health. It covers clean-data standards, availability, A2I incident effectiveness, cost and consumption, and the verified or potential business impact of unhealthy data. 

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader and domain expert across multiple teams, responsible for multiple capabilities of a composite platform. You will apply master-level software engineering to design, build, and run backend systems that process high-volume data and operational signals reliably. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will typically drive work across multiple scrum teams (15 to 20+ engineers), influence technology and product direction, tactically strong to deal with conflicts and drive alignments to unblock technical direction of the platform capabilities and balance short-term delivery with long-term business impact. 

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Execution

- Spend 70-85% of your time hands-on across the full software lifecycle: design, build, test, deploy, and operate. 
 - Architect and build scalable, secure, highly available backend services and APIs that power data quality evaluation, signal detection, incident creation, and impact analysis. 
 - Drive the next phase of A2I: Lead the evolution of the Data Observability platform. This includes simplifying the overall Platform and coming up with end to end system for intelligently connecting the issues in one hop of the data lifecycle to consolidate the Incident creation and avoid noise across the entire data lifecycle causing churn for all data producers and consumers across the chain. 
 - Data Observability Dashboard: Create a technical vision for the health observability essentials (logs, traces and metrics) and how to use those to create insightful actionable KPIs for Data Producers and consumers to increase the confidence on the Data Quality and Reliability.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer – Performance & Reliability
data.description:
About Axiado Corporation

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we're a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we're extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. 

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We're small enough that every person's work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company's future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let's talk. 

Job Description

Axiado is a top-tier manufacturer of TCU (Trusted Control/Compute Unit) solutions. We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer - Performance & Reliability to lead the performance characterization and reliability validation of our Secure TCU System, ensuring it meets rigorous data center standards. 

In this role, you will own the test design, execution, and deep-dive analysis for performance and reliability, working closely with development teams to identify bottlenecks and resolve complex system-level issues. 

Key Responsibilities

Performance & Reliability Strategy

- Test Design & Execution: Design and execute comprehensive test plans for performance benchmarking, stress testing, longevity/endurance testing, and thermal/power characterization of TCU/BMC systems. 
 - Workload Analysis: Analyze system behavior under various heavy workloads to identify performance bottlenecks in throughput, latency, and resource utilization (CPU, Memory, PCIe). 
 - Reliability Validation: Conduct Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) prediction, long-duration stability tests, and error injection campaigns to validate system robustness. 

Deep Dive & Issue Resolution

- Root Cause Analysis: Lead the deep-dive investigation of performance degradation and reliability failures. Use advanced debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, firmware traces) to isolate issues. 
 - Developer Collaboration: Work directly with firmware and hardware engineers to reproduce complex bugs, analyze crash dumps, and verify fixes. 
 - Infrastructure Enhancement: Develop and maintain automated performance testing frameworks and reporting dashboards to track regression and trends over time. 

Reporting & Leadership

- Reporting: Generate detailed performance assessment reports and reliability analysis metrics for stakeholders. 
 - Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers on performance testing methodologies and system debugging techniques. 

Qualifications

- Experience: 5+ years of experience in embedded system testing, with a strong focus on performance verification and reliability engineering. 
 - System Knowledge: Deep understanding of TCU, BMC, HMC, RoT (Root of Trust), Secure Boot, TPM, HSM, PCIe (Gen4/5), DDR memory, and networking protocols. 
 - Performance Tools: Proficiency with performance profiling tools, traffic generators, and standard benchmarks (e. g. , SPEC, IOzone, iperf). Experience with thermal and power measurement tools. 
 - Programming: Strong scripting skills in Python for test automation and data analysis; familiarity with C/C++ for code analysis is a plus. 
 - Operating Systems: Strong Linux/Unix skills, including kernel tuning, system monitoring, and log analysis. 
 - Tools: Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) and version control (Git). 
 - Education: BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

Ways to Stand Out

- Experience with AI-driven log analysis or anomaly detection tools to predict reliability issues. 
 - Background in validation of high-speed interfaces (PCIe, CXL) and memory subsystems (DDR5/LPDDR5). 
 - Experience with data center server architecture and thermal management. 
 - Knowledge of industry reliability standards (e. g. , Telcordia, JEDEC). 

Note: We do not expect candidates to meet every single requirement. A strong core of these skills with a problem-solving mindset is what we value most. 

Additional Information

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. 

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. 

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

data.title: Engineering Manager, Managed Gateways
data.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we're looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. 

The Mission

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native SaaS platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a multi-tenant control plane, automation, and platform services that enable customers to securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. 

At its core, building and operating this platform is a large-scale software engineering challenge, involving complex distributed systems, automation, and infrastructure orchestration. The platform must deliver 4-9s (99. 99%+) reliability while operating across multiple clouds, regions, and highly distributed customer environments. Achieving this requires deep software engineering expertise and strong distributed systems fundamentals, with a focus on scalability, resilience, performance, and multi-tenancy. 

As an engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Platform, you will take full ownership of the engineering charter, leading and growing the team while being accountable for the architecture, development, delivery, and operation of this multi-tenant SaaS platform. With Cloud Gateways growing 100% YoY and becoming increasingly central to Kong's API and AI strategy, your work will directly influence product innovation, customer experience, platform economics, and our ability to serve some of the world's largest enterprises at global scale. 

This is a highly technical Software Engineering leadership role building the software platform behind a globally distributed, multi-cloud SaaS infrastructure product, with end-to-end ownership of everything from code to production infrastructure. It sits at the intersection of hardcore software engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale infrastructure ownership. We believe in a you-build-it-you-run-it model, where engineering teams take 100% ownership of the systems they build, from architecture and implementation through deployment, reliability, and production operations. You're expected to stay close to the code and architecture, lead complex engineering challenges alongside your team, and take complete accountability for engineering outcomes. 

What You'll Do

- Own the Managed Gateways Platform engineering charter end-to-end, providing technical direction, building and growing a high-performing team, raising the engineering bar, and taking full accountability for execution and outcomes. 
 - Lead the design and development of core SaaS platform capabilities, including provisioning systems, fleet management, automation frameworks, platform services, and software lifecycle management. 
 - Architect and build highly scalable distributed systems powering a multi-tenant SaaS platform across regions and clouds, driving sound architectural decisions around isolation, scalability, fault tolerance, and blast-radius management. 
 - Drive 100% ownership across the software lifecycle, from design and development through deployment, observability, reliability, and production operations. Establish a strong you-build-it-you-run-it culture where engineering teams are fully accountable for what they build and operate. 
 - Own the reliability, scalability, and performance of the platform and its underlying infrastructure, driving 99. 99%+ availability across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP), with a focus on resilience, capacity management, and infrastructure efficiency. 
 - Stay hands-on in critical engineering challenges, contributing to architecture reviews, complex implementations, production debugging, and high-stakes technical decisions. 
 - Drive platform automation and operational excellence, building self-service capabilities and tooling while strengthening SLOs/SLIs, incident response, root cause analysis, zero-downtime upgrades, and engineering efficiency. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product, engineering, and support teams to shape the platform roadmap, influence product capabilities, and ensure engineering investments translate into customer and business outcomes. 

What You'll Bring

The Toolkit

- Proven experience leading software engineering teams building and operating large-scale software platforms in high-growth environments, with a strong track record of technical leadership and hands-on involvement. 
 - Deep expertise in designing, developing, and operating highly available distributed systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP. Comfortable writing and debugging code, troubleshooting production systems, and making architectural decisions. 
 - Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production. 
 - Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for building scalable platform services and distributed systems. 
 - Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar. 
 - Experience managing critical production incidents, performing root cause analysis, and implementing preventative measures. 
 - Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus. 

The DNA

- Ownership: You take 100% responsibility for the systems, teams, and outcomes you own, driving initiatives from conception to completion without waiting for someone else to connect the dots. 
 - Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision. 
 - Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals. 

Bonus Points

- Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities. 
 - Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e. g. , CKA, CKAD). 
 - Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management. 

About Kong

Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong's unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www. konghq. com.

data.title: Assistant Manager – Quality
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically competent professional with 5-6 years of experience in the electrical switchgear industry to join our Quality & Testing team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in testing, inspection, and quality assurance of Low Voltage (LV) and Medium Voltage (MV) switchboards, along with a strong understanding of applicable IEC standards and customer inspection requirements. 

The role involves conducting electrical tests, ensuring product compliance, coordinating customer and third-party inspections, preparing and closing inspection reports, and driving quality improvements throughout the manufacturing process. The candidate should be capable of independently managing Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), resolving technical and quality concerns, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure product reliability and customer satisfaction. 

A sound technical understanding of LV/MV switchgear products, electrical protection systems, busbar assemblies, control circuits, and relevant IEC standards is essential. The candidate should possess strong communication skills to effectively interact with customers, consultants, inspectors, and internal stakeholders. 

Responsibilities

- Conduct routine, functional, and electrical testing of LV/MV switchboards. 
 - Perform and witness testing activities including: 
 - Insulation Resistance (IR) Test 
 - High Voltage (HV) Test 
 - Functional & Interlock Verification 
 - Protection Relay Testing 
 - Primary & Secondary Injection Tests 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IEC standards and customer specifications. 
 - Lead customer inspections, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), and third-party inspections. 
 - Interface confidently with customers, consultants, and inspection agencies during inspections. 
 - Prepare, review, and close inspection reports, punch points, and quality observations in a timely manner. 
 - Review drawings, BOMs, technical specifications, and quality documentation. 
 - Support root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality issues. 
 - Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams to ensure product quality and timely issue resolution. 
Qualifications

Technical Knowledge & Experience: 

- Hands-on experience in testing and inspection of LV/MV switchboards. 
 - Strong understanding of electrical switchgear products such as: 
 - ACBs, MCCBs, MCBs 
 - VCBs 
 - Protection Relays 
 - CTs, PTs, Metering Devices 
 - Busbar Systems 
 - Working knowledge of applicable IEC standards, including: 
 - IEC 61439 - Low Voltage Switchgear Assemblies 
 - IEC 62271 Series - Medium Voltage Switchgear 
 - IEC 60947 Series - Low Voltage Switchgear & Controlgear 
 - IEC 60529 - IP Protection 
 - 5-6 years of relevant experience in electrical panel/switchboard manufacturing, testing, or quality assurance. 
 - Proven ability to independently handle customer inspections and testing activities. 
 - Good analytical, reporting, and communication skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and customers. 

Candidates from Electrical Switchboard, Switchgear, Power Distribution, Panel Manufacturing, EPC, or Electrical Equipment Manufacturing industries will be preferred. 

Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering.

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

About the position: 

As a Senior Product Validation Engineer, you will be part of firmware verification team that design and develop white box and grey box tests in Python to verify device firmware designs for each firmware/Product/System feature. You will be working closely with product/System architects and firmware engineers to create a comprehensive system verification test for features. In this role, you will be contributing to test strategy, test development, integrating the tests using various development platforms, deploying it on system verification lab for regression runs and perform failure analysis. The role focuses on defining and executing robust firmware/Device/system verification strategies for UCIe/AXI and custom host-device protocols across both pre‐silicon and post‐silicon environments. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborate closely with firmware engineers & architects on product architecture and designs to define the comprehensive verification plan to validate each product features
 - Design, Develop and Integrate the white box and gray box tests on products in roadmap
 - Conduct test plan reviews and code reviews to ensure the tests are scalable and meeting the requirements
 - Participate in driving failure analysis and collaborate with integration/execution engineers for test deployment. 
 - Validate designs against UCIe Specification ensuring compliance with electrical, logical, and transaction-layer requirements. 
 - Define and own firmware/System validation strategy for UCIe front-end subsystems, including resets, interrupts, Logging and error handling. 
 - Define, plan, and execute system-level validation strategies for front-end (PHY + controller) IP, back end(Controller +NAND) IP and SoC-level integration. 
 - Integrate tests into scalable automation frameworks supporting simulation, emulation, and silicon validation. 
 - Debug firmware issues, perform front-end error injection, and expose design or integration defects. 
 - Validate UCIe compliance, robustness of fault detection and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Review and verify firmware trace logs and debug telemetry for correctness and completeness. 
 - Drive validation readiness across pre‐silicon and post‐silicon platforms, ensuring alignment of firmware specs, drivers, and test collateral. 
 - Interface with cross‐functional stakeholders to ensure validation coverage meets product and customer requirements. 
 - Drive compliance and interoperability testing with various endpoints 
 - Proven expertise in defining and driving end-to-end validation strategies across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon platforms for complex SoCs and storage systems. 
 - Strong experience validating hardware IPs in pre-silicon environments (RTL simulation, SystemC/VDK, emulation, FPGA prototyping) and post-silicon environments. 
 - Possess deep understanding of Host SoC integration, firmware-hardware interactions, subsystem interoperability, and system-level debug across the complete product stack. 
 - Proficiency in high-performance/AI compute architectures, accelerator data paths, workload scheduling, and system-level performance validation

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Skills: 

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech degree in CSE/ ECE/ EEE/ IS or related field
 - In-depth knowledge of UCIe/AXI, flow control, ordering rules, error handling, power management
 - Proficiency with protocol analyzers/exercisers (Teledyne LeCroy, Keysight) etc. 
 - Experience with high‐performance storage, networking, or compute SoCs. 
 - Strong expertise in UCIe protocol, DMA, and ASIC front-end architecture. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python/C/C++ based scripting API's. 
 - Hands-on experience with error injection, fault modeling, and silicon debug tools. 
 - Familiarity with pre‐silicon (simulation/emulation) and post‐silicon lab validation flows. 
 - Solid understanding of firmware-hardware interaction and system-level debugging. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in test strategy definition, technical reviews, and mentoring. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to drive issues to closure under schedule pressure. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence technical decisions. 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, C/C++, or Bash. 
 - Minimum 6 - 8 years of related experience in firmware verification or system level testing
 - Knowledge on Git, CI & source code management flow and agile development practices. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis. 
 - Collaborative and proactive communication style. 
 - Attention to detail and quality assurance mindset. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team. 

Additional Information

We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us.
