data.title: Manager - Supplier Quality Development
data.description:
What You'll Do

Lead the Supplier Performance vertical to drive sustainable improvement across supplier quality workstreams, strengthen team ownership and accountability, proactively mitigate supplier quality risks, reduce quality-related business impact, and build a high-performing, data-driven supplier quality culture focused on continuous improvement and customer excellence

- Supplier Performance Strategy: Define and execute the supplier performance strategy aligned with business, Plant, CM's and Divisional Directors priorities. 
 - Performance Governance: Own supplier quality KPIs including SDPPM, DMR, COPQ, DMR closure lead time, repeat issues and supplier responsiveness. 
 - Supplier Improvement: Identify high-impact/worst-performing suppliers & lead structured improvement through DMAIC, 8D, RIE & SQPI-type improvement programs. 
 - DMR Excellence: Strengthen DMR governance with focus on rapid containment, robust RCA, effective corrective actions and elimination of recurrence. 
 - Supplier Development: Drive supplier capability and maturity improvement through assessments, development plans and focused interventions. 
 - Quality Cost Recovery: Establish strong governance for on-time supplier-caused COPQ recovery to hold supplier accountable for Quality. 
 - Cross-functional Leadership: Partner with Operations, Engineering, SCM, Plants and suppliers to resolve systemic supplier quality issues. 
 - Preventive Quality: Shift the organization from reactive issue resolution toward risk identification, prevention and early intervention. 
 - Digital & AI Transformation: Deploy analytics and AI-enabled RCA/8D maturity solutions to improve speed, consistency and effectiveness of problem solving. 
 - Leadership & Talent: Build capability within the Supplier Quality team through coaching, standard work, knowledge sharing and development of future leaders. 
 - Build an integrated, data-driven supplier performance ecosystem, connecting quality KPIs, supplier risks, corrective actions and lessons learned to enable faster and more effective decision-making. 
 - Build a future-ready Supplier Quality team, strengthening AI, digital transformation, analytical thinking and cross-functional leadership. 

Qualifications

BE in (Mechanical , Production, Electrical, Electronics & Industrial Engineering)

- Minimum 15+ years of experience in, Manufacturing / or Process Engineering and Supplier Development quality

Skills

- Experience in working with global customers & suppliers. 
 - Strong working knowledge of manufacturing processes, Ex. Sheet Metal, Molding, Electrical & Electronics, Casting, and Machining. 
 - Proficiency in statistical quality tools, including SPC, Gauge R&R, Process Capability Analysis, and related analytical techniques. 
 - Strong problem-solving with torough knowledge of the 8D problem-solving methodology, with hands-on experience in driving supplier CAPA and ensuring effective root-cause elimination. 
 - Six Sigma Black Belt certification and practical knowledge of Continuous Improvement (CI) tools will be an added advantage. 
 - Effective Communication & Influencing Skills with customers, suppliers, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
 - Strong Interpersonal Skills with the ability to build trusted working relationships. 
 - High Accountability & Ownership, with a strong results-oriented mindset. 
 - Conflict Resolution & Escalation Management, ensuring timely and effective issue resolution. 
 - Effective Time & Priority Management in a dynamic environment. 
 - Strong Presentation Skills with clear and impactful communication. 
 - Sound Decision-Making & Analytical Mindset, supported by data-driven problem solving. 
 - Effective Collaboration & Cross-Cultural Teamwork across diverse and global teams. "

data.title: QA & Release Engineer Lead
data.description:
Role summary

The QA & Release Engineer Lead owns quality engineering and release governance across web, API, data, AI, integration and cloud-platform workstreams. You will define a risk-based test strategy, build the automation architecture, and run the release controls that make production outcomes predictable, secure and auditable. 

You will coordinate teams, environments, defects, dependencies and approvals from sprint planning through post-release validation, acting as the single point of accountability for go/no-go decisions. 

Duties and responsibilities

Quality strategy and governance

- Define the quality strategy, quality gates, entry and exit criteria, and release policy for each engagement. 
 - Apply risk-based prioritisation so test effort tracks business and compliance impact. 
 - Maintain auditable test evidence that satisfies enterprise and public-sector assurance requirements. Testing leadership

- Lead functional, integration, regression, performance, security and resilience testing. 
 - Define approaches for testing data pipelines and AI-enabled features, including model evaluation and non-deterministic outputs. Automation

- Establish UI, API, contract and pipeline automation frameworks. 
 - Embed automated quality gates in CI/CD pipelines. Environments and releases

- Plan environments, test data, deployment checks and rollback validation. 
 - Chair defect triage and release-readiness reviews; own the go/no-go recommendation. 
 - Run post-release validation and feed lessons back into the strategy. People and reporting

- Track and report quality metrics to delivery leads and client stakeholders. 
 - Mentor QA engineers and raise automation capability across the team. 

Skills and abilities

- Quality-engineering and release-management leadership on enterprise platforms. 
 - Automation leadership across UI, API, integration and performance testing. 
 - CI/CD quality gates, environment management and deployment governance. 
 - Hands-on experience testing cloud-native, data-pipeline and AI-enabled solutions. 
 - Working knowledge of model evaluation and non-deterministic testing techniques. 
 - Strong risk management, metrics, audit-evidence and stakeholder-management skills. 

Qualifications and background

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a directly relevant discipline. 
 - 8+ years of directly relevant professional experience. 
 - Demonstrated delivery in complex enterprise or public-sector environments. 
 - Relevant professional or technology certifications preferred (for example ISTQB Advanced/Test Manager, Azure or AWS, ITIL). 

Preferred tools and soft skills

Tools

- GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot or equivalent enterprise-approved AI tools for coding, testing, documentation and analysis, with mandatory human validation. 
 - Role-relevant Microsoft, cloud, engineering, data, design or governance toolsets. Soft skills

- Ownership and accountability. 
 - Clear stakeholder communication. 
 - Structured problem solving and delivery focus. 

What success looks like

- Every release passes defined quality gates with complete, auditable evidence. 
 - Releases ship on schedule with low escaped-defect and change-failure rates. 
 - Automation coverage grows each quarter across UI, API, contract and pipeline layers. 
 - Rollbacks are validated before go-live and rarely needed after. 
 - QA engineers grow in capability and stakeholders trust release-readiness calls.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test — C#.NET Distributed Systems
data.description:
Hyderabad, India | Hybrid - 3 days onsite

Role Overview

Nasuni is expanding the DryvIQ engineering team in Hyderabad. DryvIQ brings intelligent content discovery, classification, sensitivity detection, and policy-driven governance to enterprise unstructured data across cloud and on-premises repositories. 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Test (SDET) to strengthen and scale automated quality across DryvIQ's complex, Kubernetes-based distributed application environment. 

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with a primary focus on C#/. NET test automation. You will maintain, extend, and improve existing automation frameworks, build high-value automated coverage, strengthen test infrastructure, and help automation scale as the DryvIQ platform evolves. You do not need to have built an automation framework from scratch; what matters is demonstrated depth improving and scaling automation in a complex software environment. 

You'll work across APIs, integrations, distributed and asynchronous workflows, containerized deployments, and user-facing functionality. Python and PyTest experience is valuable as we expand reusable tooling and cross-team libraries, but C#/. NET is the primary technical stack for this role. 

This role is for an engineer who approaches quality as a software-engineering problem, applying strong coding, debugging, systems thinking, and test-design judgment rather than focusing only on test execution. 

What You'll Do

- Maintain, extend, and scale existing C#/. NET-based test automation frameworks supporting DryvIQ. 
 - Design and implement reliable automated validation across API, integration, system, UI, regression, and end-to-end testing layers. 
 - Improve framework architecture, reusable components, test utilities, test-data capabilities, diagnostics, reporting, and maintainability. 
 - Build automated testing for Kubernetes-based, containerized, distributed applications, including multi-service and asynchronous workflows. 
 - Identify automation gaps, product risks, flaky tests, and framework limitations and prioritize improvements based on engineering and release impact. 
 - Build automated validation for APIs, microservices, distributed processing, asynchronous jobs, cloud and on-premises repositories, connectors, and enterprise integrations. 
 - Validate installation, deployment, configuration, upgrade, recovery, and failure scenarios in containerized environments. 
 - Integrate automated validation into CI/CD pipelines and improve the speed and quality of release feedback. 
 - Diagnose complex failures using application logs, APIs, Kubernetes/container evidence, telemetry, exceptions, service behavior, and other system evidence. 
 - Partner with developers to improve testability and determine the appropriate balance of unit, API, integration, system, and end-to-end coverage. 
 - Create maintainable automation patterns and reusable libraries that can be adopted by developers and QA engineers. 
 - Contribute to Python/PyTest-based utilities, tooling, or shared libraries as cross-team automation capabilities evolve. 
 - Help QA teammates strengthen automation skills through pairing, code reviews, examples, and technical guidance. 
 - Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools where appropriate for test design, code generation, scenario discovery, debugging, and coverage analysis, while independently validating generated outputs. 
 - Develop appropriate testing and validation approaches for AI-assisted or non-deterministic functionality. 

Qualifications

Must-Have

- 6+ years of software engineering, SDET, test automation, or quality engineering experience with substantial hands-on automation development. 
 - Strong hands-on programming and test automation experience using C# and . NET. 
 - Demonstrated experience maintaining, extending, troubleshooting, and scaling an existing test automation framework. 
 - Experience improving framework reliability, maintainability, reusable components, utilities, test infrastructure, or execution efficiency. 
 - Strong hands-on experience testing Kubernetes-based, containerized, distributed applications. 
 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, containers, distributed-system behavior, service dependencies, asynchronous processing, and failure modes. 
 - Experience building automated validation across APIs, integrations, systems, and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Experience testing microservices, asynchronous processing, or comparable distributed workflows. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to diagnose complex failures using logs, APIs, application exceptions, Kubernetes/container evidence, telemetry, and system behavior. 
 - Strong judgment about what to automate, at which testing layer, and when manual or exploratory testing provides greater value. 
 - Strong collaboration skills working with software engineers, Product, DevOps, and QA peers. 

Preferred

- Hands-on experience with Python and PyTest, particularly for test utilities, reusable libraries, tooling, fixtures, or cross-team automation. 
 - Experience working in engineering environments where C#/. NET and Python-based automation coexist. 
 - Experience creating reusable automation components or shared libraries used across teams. 
 - Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable UI automation technologies. 
 - AWS and/or Azure experience. 
 - AKS, EKS, K3s, or comparable Kubernetes environments. 
 - Cloud and on-premises connectors and storage integrations. 
 - SMB/NFS, S3, Azure Blob, or comparable enterprise data technologies. 
 - Postgres, ClickHouse, Keycloak, OAuth/OIDC, or similar technologies. 
 - Performance, load, reliability, resilience, or failure-injection testing. 
 - Test-data and test-environment architecture. 
 - Practical use of AI-assisted software or test-engineering tools with disciplined validation of generated outputs. 

Ideal

- Significant experience improving automation for a complex product previously dependent on manual regression. 
 - Experience evolving an established automation framework as product scale, architecture, or engineering requirements changed. 
 - Strong experience testing distributed C#/. NET applications. 
 - Enterprise storage, content management, data governance, security, or data-infrastructure experience. 
 - Experience building reusable automation capabilities adopted across engineering or QA teams. 
 - Experience helping manual QA engineers become productive automation contributors. 
 - Experience testing large-scale distributed enterprise applications. 
 - Experience validating AI-enabled or non-deterministic functionality. 

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams-and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits. 

As a Vista-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform-turning massive file stores into secure, actionable, AI-ready data for intelligent automation, analytics, and global collaboration. 

Why Work at Nasuni - Hyderabad

With Vista Equity Partners' backing, our Hyderabad team benefits from access to a global ecosystem of software leaders, cross-portfolio learning, leadership programs, and AI innovation communities-combining the pace of a growing product company with the scale and resources of a global technology investor. 

In this role, you'll help evolve and scale the automation foundation for an increasingly important enterprise product. You'll work at the intersection of cloud, Kubernetes, distributed systems, AI, content intelligence, data governance, and enterprise infrastructure while collaborating with DryvIQ and Nasuni engineering teams globally. 

Benefits At Nasuni Hyderabad

As part of our commitment to your well-being and growth, Nasuni offers competitive benefits designed to support every stage of your life and career: 

- Competitive compensation programs
 - Flexible time off and leave policies
 - Comprehensive health and wellness coverage
 - Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
 - Employee referral and recognition programs
 - Professional development and learning support
 - Inclusive, collaborative team culture
 - Modern office spaces with team events and perks
 - Retirement and statutory benefits as per Indian regulations

To all recruitment agencies: Nasuni does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job boards, Nasuni employees or any other company location. Nasuni is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Nasuni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every team member can thrive. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, caste, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, national origin, or any other status protected by applicable laws in India or the country of employment. 

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, "Nasuni") from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

data.title: Software Engineer II - Java / TypeScript
data.description:
Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

Leverage testing expertise to automate and design innovative test procedures, enhancing quality assurance through creative solutions. 

As a Software Engineer II at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial & Investment Bank in Global Banking Technology, your goal is to ensure that our applications work as they should and meet customers' needs. You'll draw on your testing knowledge and creativity to automate test capabilities and design test and maintenance procedures. You'll also tap our existing test frameworks to tackle specific problems. We take a collaborative approach to quality, which means you'll work with experienced developers, managers and business partners across the organization. You'll receive coaching, mentorship, and continuous feedback to help you become an even better technologist and professional. 

Job Responsibilities

- Create new Manual Test Cases and upload the same into ALM Tools. 
 - Create new test automation scripts and ensure their ongoing maintenance and execution as required. 
 - Develop automation scripts in alignment with the existing test automation framework. Incorporate or update features within the framework based on guidance from technical leads. 
 - Work closely with developers, managers, and other stakeholders to gather all necessary information for effective test case automation. 
 - Design and implement automated API test suites in Java using REST Assured
 - Maintain test cases and document test execution results using QTEST
 - Log and track defects using the ALM tool, ensuring timely resolution and communication. 
 - Conduct peer reviews of automation code developed by other engineers to uphold quality standards. 
 - Participate in coaching, mentorship, and receive ongoing feedback to support professional growth. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

- Formal training or certification on Quality Assurance concepts and 2+ years applied experience
 - Proven ability to write automated tests in Java/ TypeScript/ Python using Playwright, Selenium
 - Good understanding of Object Repositories, XPATHs etc

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Lead AI Engineer - Generative AI & Agentic AI to design, build and productionize enterprise-scale AI solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with deep expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs and modern AI architecture. 

The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking AI solutions from experimentation to production, working across models, data, APIs, cloud infrastructure and enterprise applications, while providing technical leadership to engineering teams. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, build and productionize AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for complex enterprise use cases. 
 - Design and develop LLM-powered applications using RAG, AI agents, tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent workflows. 
 - Build scalable AI services and backend applications using Python, REST APIs and modern microservices architectures. 
 - Design end-to-end RAG architectures incorporating embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking and enterprise knowledge sources. 
 - Develop AI applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex or equivalent. 
 - Work with leading LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent. 
 - Design and implement practices around LLM evaluation, observability, guardrails, security, latency and cost optimization. 
 - Build robust AI/ML pipelines covering experimentation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement. 
 - Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, data platforms and cloud services. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks and technologies and translate them into practical enterprise solutions. 
 - Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions across AI platforms and products. 
 - Establish engineering best practices for building secure, scalable and maintainable AI applications. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across AI engineering initiatives. 
 - Partner with product managers, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to convert business problems into scalable AI solutions. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering or related technology roles. 
 - Strong hands-on development experience in Python, with excellent software engineering and system-design fundamentals. 
 - Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Generative AI and Large Language Models. 
 - Demonstrated experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM applications into production. 
 - Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, LLM orchestration and AI agents. 
 - Experience designing agentic AI workflows, including tool/function calling and complex or multi-agent orchestration. 
 - Experience working with at least one major LLM ecosystem such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or equivalent. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, databases and enterprise application architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure or GCP. 
 - Experience with LLM evaluation, monitoring, observability, responsible AI and guardrails. 
 - Ability to independently own the technical architecture and implementation of complex AI solutions. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication and technical leadership skills. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering/architecture decisions. 

Good to Have

- Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic layers or GraphRAG. 
 - Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, CI/CD and AI observability platforms. 
 - Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Redis or equivalent. 
 - Experience with fine-tuning, model adaptation and open-source LLMs. 
 - Experience with AI security, governance, privacy and enterprise AI architecture. 
 - Hands-on exposure to PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience leading small engineering teams or mentoring senior engineers. 
 - Understanding of data engineering, streaming, distributed data processing and modern cloud data platforms. 

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related quantitative/technical discipline. 
 - Strong academic background, preferably from a premier engineering/technology institution with a demonstrated record of academic and technical excellence. 

What Will Make You Stand Out

We are particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate that they have personally architected and built production GenAI systems, rather than simply experimented with LLMs. 

Strong candidates will be able to discuss real-world experience around: 

- Production RAG and Agentic AI architectures
 - Building scalable Python/API-based AI services
 - LLM evaluation and observability
 - Enterprise data and application integration
 - Security and guardrails
 - Latency and inference-cost optimization
 - Taking an AI solution from prototype → production → scale

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

data.title: Lead Engineer - Ad Tech
data.description:
About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400, 000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. 

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. 

Overview About TII

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn't happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target's global team and has more than 4, 000 team members supporting the company's global strategy and operations. 

Team Overview

Roundel is Target's entry into the media business with an impact of $1B+; an advertising sell-side business built on the principles of first-party, people-based data, brand-safe content environments and proof that our marketing programs drive business results for our clients. 

We are here to drive business growth for our clients and redefine "value" in the industry by solving core industry challenges rather than simply replicating existing industry methods of operation. Roundel is a key growth initiative for Target and aims to lead the industry toward a better way of operating within the media marketplace. 

Target Tech is on a mission to offer the systems, tools and support that our clients, guests and team members need and deserve. We drive industry-leading technologies in support of every angle of the business and help ensure that Target operates smoothly, securely and reliably from the inside out. 

As part of this evolution, we are building intelligent platforms for retail media space like ad decisioning, bidding, ad explanations etc. that combine traditional software engineering with Large Language Models, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs and agentic architectures to solve complex business and engineering problems at scale. 

Role Overview

As a Lead Engineer (Ad Tech & Applied AI), you will provide technical leadership across backend platforms and emerging AI-powered capabilities. 

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to help define the technology strategy for Ad Tech platforms, including DSP, SSP and Ad Servers, supporting self-service advertising needs. You will assess build-versus-buy decisions for new capabilities through POCs and prototypes while considering long-term architecture, scalability, reliability and operational trade-offs. 

A key part of this role will be designing and building production-grade applications powered by Large Language Models and agentic systems from experimentation through production operation and continuous evaluation. We are looking for engineers who have moved beyond conversational AI prototypes and have experience engineering LLM-powered systems that operate reliably within real business workflows. 

You will design architectures that combine deterministic software components with probabilistic AI capabilities, making deliberate decisions about where traditional code, rules and workflow engines should be used versus where LLM-driven reasoning and autonomous agents provide value. 

You will lead engineering efforts to meet functional and non-functional requirements and assist teams in solving complex business challenges through scalable technical solutions. 

You will work closely with engineering managers to build high-performing engineering teams and provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, coaching and mentoring. You will also participate in the selection of technical talent and contribute actively to Target's broader technical community. 

About You

You have 8+ years of software development experience, with experience designing, building and operating complex distributed systems through at least one complete implementation lifecycle. 

You have strong backend engineering fundamentals and are comfortable designing scalable APIs, microservices, asynchronous systems and data-intensive applications. 

You are fluent in Java / Spring and microservices architecture, with experience building highly available production systems. 

You have experience working with databases including RDBMS and NoSQL technologies such as Cassandra and MongoDB, and understand data modeling and storage trade-offs. 

You have experience building distributed event-driven architectures using technologies such as Kafka. 

You understand Ad Tech business fundamentals and how technology supports business objectives, and can translate business vision into technical strategy while understanding architectural and financial trade-offs. 

Experience building or integrating DSP, SSP or Ad Server technology platforms in support of self-service advertising is preferred. 

Applied AI & LLM Engineering

You have hands-on experience designing, building and operating production applications using LLMs, beyond chat interfaces, prompt experimentation and proof-of-concept applications. 

You have designed and optimized production-grade RAG systems, with strong understanding of data ingestion and chunking, retrieval and ranking, context and grounding, hybrid retrieval, and evaluation. 

You have experience with knowledge graphs and graph-based retrieval, and understand when to use vector search, Graph RAG, structured queries, traditional search or hybrid approaches based on the problem and data. 

You understand the engineering trade-offs of production LLM systems, including quality, latency, cost, reliability, observability, security and failure handling, and can systematically improve retrieval and overall system performance rather than relying primarily on prompt engineering. 

Agentic Systems

You have designed or built agentic applications or orchestration frameworks where LLM-powered components interact with tools, APIs, retrieval systems and other agents to accomplish multi-step tasks. 

You Understand Concepts Such As

- Tool/function calling 
 - Agent planning and execution 
 - Workflow and state management 
 - Multi-agent orchestration 
 - Agent memory and context management 
 - Routing and delegation 
 - Human-in-the-loop workflows 
 - Guardrails and policy enforcement 
 - Retry, timeout and fallback strategies 
 - Agent observability and traceability 
 - Evaluation of agent behavior and task completion

You understand the distinction between deterministic and non-deterministic execution paths and can design systems that deliberately combine both. 

You know when a business workflow should remain deterministic and testable using conventional software and when probabilistic reasoning using an LLM or agent is appropriate. 

You design AI systems assuming that model outputs can be incorrect or unpredictable and therefore incorporate appropriate validation, constraints, structured outputs, fallbacks, idempotency, observability and human intervention where required. 

AI Quality & Evaluation

You understand that production AI systems require rigorous quality and evaluation practices beyond model selection and prompting. 

You have experience establishing offline and online evaluation strategies for LLM-powered systems, covering retrieval and response quality, factual grounding, task completion, reliability, latency and cost. 

You can build evaluation harnesses and regression tests with representative datasets, metrics and quality thresholds, and integrate them into CI/CD as deployment and quality gates. 

You can use evaluation, observability and tracing to diagnose quality issues across data, retrieval, context, prompts, models and orchestration, and drive systematic improvements. 

Engineering Leadership

You can translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical architectures and incrementally deliver solutions from experimentation through production. 

You make architecture decisions based on measurable trade-offs rather than technology trends and are comfortable challenging unnecessary complexity. 

You can lead POCs and technical experiments while clearly distinguishing between what demonstrates feasibility and what is required to operate the capability reliably at enterprise scale. 

You have proven technical leadership capabilities and the ability to influence engineers, product leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. 

You enjoy mentoring engineers and raising the technical capabilities of the broader engineering team. 

You collaborate effectively with Product and domain experts and can communicate complex architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

You stay current with evolving engineering and AI technologies through formal training and self-directed learning, while applying new technologies pragmatically. 

You have experience working within CI/CD and DevOps environments and understand production engineering practices including monitoring, observability, resilience, security and operational readiness. 

Useful Links

- Life at Target: https: //india. target. com/
 - Benefits: https: //india. target. com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
 - Culture: https: //india. target. com/life-at-target/belonging

Drive the development of next-generation Automotive Ethernet solutions! Build and integrate reusable embedded software across multiple MCU platforms, take end-to-end ownership of software components, and contribute to ISO 26262-compliant development, platform bring-up, and system-level integration. 

Your role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Design, develop, and integrate embedded software for Automotive Ethernet solutions across multiple software teams, MCU families, and platforms. 
 - Develop reusable software components and well-defined interfaces that support portability across hardware platforms and bare-metal or RTOS environments. 
 - Take ownership of assigned software components, from requirements and design through implementation, verification, documentation, and release. 
 - Collaborate with architecture, hardware, validation, and application teams to align interfaces, resolve dependencies, and address system-level integration issues. 
 - Contribute to ISO 26262-compliant software development, including software safety requirements, safety mechanisms, requirement straceability, and verification evidence. 
 - Perform code reviews, static analysis, unit testing, and integration testing in accordance with applicable coding standards and quality processes. 
 - Investigate complex hardware-software issues and support platform bring-up, customer issue resolution, and continuous improvement of development and test practices. 

Your profile

Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline, with relevant experience in automotive embedded software development. 
 - Strong proficiency in C andhands-on experience with low-level drivers, MCU architectures, hardware abstraction, and bare-metal or RTOS environments. 
 - Experience developing portable software and integrating components across platforms and teams. 
 - Working knowledge of Ethernet fundamentals, switching, and embedded communication interfaces. 
 - Practical experience with ISO 26262 software development, including safety requirements, implementation of safety mechanisms, requirements traceability, and software verification
 - Familiarity with MISRA C, static analysis, unit testing, Git, build systems, and continuous integration.

Staff, Software Engineer
data.description:
About Team

GDF (Global Data Foundation) is part of Walmart's AI & Data organization - the team building the foundational data platforms that power AI, analytics, and decision-making across every Walmart banner and geography, from supply chain and merchandising to customer experience and enterprise AI agents. 

Our newly created platform team is chartered with building next-generation data infrastructure at Walmart scale: reliable, high-throughput data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and platform capabilities that downstream teams across Walmart depend on every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate distributed platform services and APIs using Java and Python, applied

against Kubernetes or equivalent cloud-native infrastructure. 

- Apply domain-oriented design, system design, and low-level design (LLD) rigor to ambiguous platform

problems - evaluating dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, cost, and long-term

durability before writing a line of code. 

- Flex into data engineering work when needed: contribute directly to Spark-based data pipelines and

processing jobs, working comfortably in GDF's data engineering codebase alongside platform work. 

- Build AI, GenAI, and agentic-powered platform capabilities: intelligent developer tooling, workflow

automation, agentic services, and AI-assisted operational tooling (monitoring, incident triage, capacity

planning). 

- Own platform reliability, scalability, and observability - service-level objectives, distributed tracing, 

alerting, and incident response for services you build, with a strong Operational Excellence /

Engineering Excellence discipline. 

- Guide architecture and system design decisions across microservices, event-driven systems, and

enterprise integrations, with an explicit eye toward how platform choices affect downstream data

engineering workloads. 

- Partner with data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers to ensure platform services expose the

right primitives for data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving paths. 

- Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and

production readiness reviews for a team building process from scratch. 

- As a Staff engineer, set technical direction and best practices within your team and technical domain

without needing a management title - mentor other engineers and influence GDF's broader platform

engineering standards. 

- Continuously evaluate emerging platform, cloud, and AI/agentic technologies, adopting them

pragmatically where they improve reliability, productivity, or business value. 

What You'll Bring

- Genuinely hands-on coding: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and

operating large-scale distributed platforms; strong proficiency in Java and Python is required -

comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code, not just directing others. Additional

experience with Go, C++, or Scala is a plus. 

- Operational Excellence (OE) and Engineering Excellence (EE) mindset is a required skill, not a

nice-to-have: SLO/SLA ownership, incident management and blameless post-incident reviews, 

proactive reliability and quality metrics, and continuous improvement built into how you ship, not

bolted on afterward. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or

equivalent practical experience. 

- Deep experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API

design, service contracts, and enterprise system integration - backed by strong system design, 

domain-oriented design (DDD), and low-level design (LLD) skills, with demonstrated ownership of

production code and the judgment to evaluate trade-offs, failure modes, scalability, and cost. 

- Deep understanding of cloud-native engineering practices - CI/CD, containerization, Kubernetes or

equivalent orchestration, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 

- Strong exposure to Big Data / data engineering technologies - Spark required at a working level, with

familiarity in Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, or Kafka - enough to flex into data engineering work confidently, not

just integrate with it from a distance. 

- Full exposure to AI and Agentic technologies: hands-on experience integrating model APIs and

GenAI/LLM tooling, building or operating agentic workflows (tool-calling agents, multi-step

autonomous systems), working with embeddings/vector search, and applying MLOps practices

(feature stores, model lifecycle, retraining pipelines) - not just conceptual awareness. 

- Strong knowledge of reliability engineering - observability, distributed tracing, logging, metrics, 

alerting, incident response, capacity planning, and fault tolerance for large-scale systems. 

- Strong grounding in security, privacy, and enterprise engineering practices, including authentication, 

authorization, data protection, and secure API design. 

- Proven ability to translate ambiguous technical/business problems into clear execution plans, 

particularly within a newly formed team without fully established process. 

- Strong ownership mindset and technical judgment; comfortable operating with high autonomy in a

0-to-1 environment. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Chennai office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives. 

Benefits

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Walmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

Job Summary

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will solve complex problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, supporting transformational projects in cloud technologies and automation for a leading SaaS product in the healthcare industry. You will drive reliability, scalability, and performance across applications, microservices, and infrastructure, partnering with cross-functional teams to ensure a highly available, resilient, and efficient platform. 

Key Responsibilities Monitoring & Alerting

- Develop and maintain comprehensive monitoring for system health, applications, microservices, dependencies, and infrastructure. 
 - Establish baseline metrics and set up customized alerts for deviations, collaborating with development teams to define key indicators and thresholds. 
 - Manage alert routing to appropriate audiences to prevent alert fatigue. 
 - Monitor and debug Microsoft Azure resources and assist support teams with technical troubleshooting. 

Incident Management & Response

- Oversee incident management processes, including triage, severity assessment, and coordination of war rooms with relevant stakeholders (DevOps, development, QA, customer service). 
 - Maintain on-call rotation to monitor, analyze, and resolve critical infrastructure issues and incidents, including emergency response. 
 - Document incidents and perform root cause analysis (RCA), ensuring thorough follow-up and continuous improvement. 
 - Lead postmortem reviews and drive action items to completion. 

Proactive Reliability & Disaster Recovery

- Design and execute tabletop exercises and disaster recovery simulations (e. g. , service/region interruptions, failover testing, traffic management) to validate high availability and resiliency. 
 - Document outcomes and collaborate with DevOps and development teams to implement infrastructure and application improvements. 
 - Create standard procedures for incident scenarios where fixes cannot be immediately implemented. 

Continuous Feedback & Reporting

- Develop dashboards and reports to monitor system performance, error rates, resource consumption, latency, and other key indicators. 
 - Establish consistent reporting schedules for SLA, system utilization, and customer metrics. 
 - Provide feedback to development and DevOps teams to drive improvements in application and infrastructure performance. 

DevOps Pipeline & Automation

- Analyze and optimize DevOps pipelines for efficient and reliable deployment operations. 
 - Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention. 
 - Experience with progressive rollout strategies and canary deployments. 

Collaboration & Communication

- Work closely with cross-functional teams across the organization, including QA, development, DevOps, and customer service. 
 - Clearly articulate technical concepts to non-technical colleagues and stakeholders. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, respect, excellence, and customer service. 
 - Contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing across teams. 
 - Advocate for reliability and operational excellence in architecture and design discussions. 

Capacity Planning & Scalability

- Participate in capacity planning and scalability assessments to ensure systems can meet future growth and demand. 

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience Guidelines

- Bachelor's Degree in computer science or relevant field 
 - 8-10 years of relevant work experience
 - Experience with Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Azure, and AWS. 
 - Significant experience with database technologies, especially Microsoft SQL. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e. g. , Terraform, ARM templates). 
 - Familiarity with observability platforms (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana). 
 - Scripting skills (e. g. , PowerShell, Python, Bash) for automation and tooling. 
 - Security best practices for cloud environments. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Excellent self-management and time management abilities. 
 - Creative problem-solving skills. 
 - Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to a rapidly changing environment. 
 - Technology certifications (e. g. , Azure DevOps Engineer) or willingness to obtain. 
 - Occasional travel may be required. 

Other Preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Or Certifications

- Security Certifications: HITRUST CSF Practitioner, CISSP
 - AI/ML Integration Awareness: Supporting ML pipelines in DevOps workflows
 - Policy-as-Code Tools: Open Policy Agent (OPA), HashiCorp Sentinel
 - Disaster Recovery Planning: High-availability architecture and recovery strategies
 - Cloud Cost Optimization: Performance tuning and resource efficiency
 - Multi-Cloud Experience: Supporting hybrid or multi-cloud environments

data.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension)
data.description:
TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work: 
We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools - automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation - for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. 

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric - you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. 

Who we hire - the DNA: 

- Self-starters and do-ers with grit - hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. 
 - Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly - new tools, new models, new priorities - without drama. 
 - Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. 
 - AI-native. You work with AI on all levels - you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. 
 - Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. 
 - Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. 
 - You consider yourself exceptional - and you like winning. So do we. 
 - No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

What You Will Do: 
The role: 

- Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per-module panels
 - This is the product wedge - what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes. "
 - Real-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward. 

What you'll own: 

- React app + Chrome extension (Manifest V3, content scripts, injected iframe, page-overlay pill)
 - WebSocket-driven real-time UI
 - plugin / module-federation patterns
 - Screen-real-estate management
 - The design system in code
 - Your committed timelines. 

Who you are: 

- A self-starter with a show-me mentality - you move from prototype to real-world product quickly and demonstrate ideas with working UI, not mockups
 - You love new technology and adapt fast when it changes
 - Consistent by discipline: you use shared libraries and established patterns instead of reinventing per feature - consistency is what keeps a small team fast
 - You use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
 - You consider yourself exceptional, love solving hard problems, and like winning. 

What You Will Bring: 

- 7+ years frontend; senior-level React + TypeScript mandatory. HTML5, JavaScript, and graphics skills all ++++ - 
 - You're a master of the browser platform itself, not just a framework user (canvas/SVG/WebGL, animation, rendering). 
 - Strong design/UI skills a +++ - you have taste; your UIs look and feel professional without a designer holding your hand. 
 - Real Chrome Extension experience - Manifest V3, content scripts, the messaging model, injecting UI over a host page. This is core, not a footnote. 
 - Strong API skills - you design and consume clean APIs, and you understand the backend messaging systems behind them (pub/sub, event streams, WebSocket) well enough to reason about ordering, reconnects, and state sync. 
 - Heavy WebSocket / real-time UI; you've built interfaces that update from a live event stream. 
 - Plugin / module-federation or dynamic-component-loading experience. 
 - Performance as a habit - render profiling, virtualization for dense data, sub-frame updates under a firehose event stream; the UI must never be the latency bottleneck. 
 - State management under streaming data - optimistic updates, reconnect/replay handling, conflict resolution. 
 - Extension security fluency - CSP, sandboxing, isolated worlds; we inject UI into other companies' pages and can never break or leak. 
 - Automated UI testing (Playwright-class) as part of shipping, not a QA handoff. 
 - Accessibility and keyboard-first flows as defaults - agents live in this UI 8 hours a day. 
 - A master debugger in the browser - DevTools is an extension of your hands; you see the render bug, the leak, the layout thrash. 
 - Go literacy is a plus (you'll read it).

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Toast has grown to be a leading hospitality software company in the US and is now setting its sights on our next stages of growth. Toast customers who managed several restaurants a few years ago are now expanding their business and adding new locations. New enterprise customers are looking to leverage Toast technology to support the growth of their business in new ways. These exciting new opportunities will require Toast to bolster our product offerings

Are you bready* for a change?

Toast is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Fintech Payments team. In this role, you'll work across the entire Toast platform, including our partner ecosystem. 

As a Senior Engineer on the Funds Management team, you will help evolve our platform currently processing over $150B in annual GPV-to meet Toast's growing global needs. You'll contribute to building best-in-class, customer-facing FinTech products and developing foundational capabilities that empower partner teams to accelerate product delivery and scale efficiently.

- Design, build, deploy, and maintain highly resilient and scalable features across Toast's enterprise management products
 - Lead complex projects that improve functionality and reliability for our customers 
 - Partner with a wide array of teams across Toast 
 - Ensure quality by building automated testing for changes
 - Roll* features out to customers, including monitoring for success
 - Collaborate with UX and PM on the definition and design of features 
 - Mentor and coach other engineers

Do you have the right ingredients*? (Requirements)

- Bachelor's or Master's degree preferred
 - 5+ years experience building backend services and APIs
 - Extensive experience working with an Object Oriented Language like Java or Kotlin, with a deep understanding of testing, quality, and best practices
 - Experience shipping production services and balancing getting things done with platform stability and reliability
 - Experience building backend services and APIs and scaling distributed systems
 - Experience building android applications with kotlin is a plus
 - Focused on delivering positive impact for Toast customers
 - Enjoys working in a team environment with a shared code-base
 - Excellent cross-team communication skills on complex technical topics

We are hiring individuals with a wide range of experience so if you have more or less than these exact roles, please still apply!

Our Tech Stack

Toast's products run on a stack that ranges from guest and restaurant-facing Android tablets to backend services in Java to internal, guest-facing and restaurant-facing web apps. Our backend services follow a microservice architecture written using Java 8 and DropWizard; we use AWS extensively, ranging from S3 to RDS to Lambda. We have our own platform for dealing with user management, service elevations and robust load balancing. Toast stores data in a set of sharded Postgres databases and utilizes Apache Spark for large scale data workloads including query and batch processing. The front-end is built primarily using React and ES6. The main Toast POS application is an Android application written in Java and Kotlin. For data between tablets and our cloud platform we operate RabbitMQ clusters as well as direct tablet communication to the back end. 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture.

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https: //careers. toasttab. com/toast-benefits.

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https: //careers. toasttab. com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https: //careers. toasttab. com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient-when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work-raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other. 

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. TITLE

Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences. 

Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you'll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers. 

Position Overview

We're hiring early-career engineers to join an AI engineering team building LLM-based systems. This role leans toward two things in particular: evaluating whether an AI/LLM system's output is correct, and modelling extracted information as structured knowledge (entities and relationships) so it can be trusted, queried, and reasoned over. If you've built something with an LLM and then asked yourself, "but how do I know if it's any good?" - this role is for you. 

What You'll Do

- Build and extend LLM evaluation harnesses - golden datasets, precision/recall/F1, calibration, LLM-as-judge scoring. 
 - Design and work with knowledge graphs - entity-relationship modelling, graph traversal/queries, embeddings-based similarity and retrieval. 
 - Build GenAI/LLM pipelines in Python - prompting, RAG, structured output. 
 - Write clean, tested code; collaborate with senior engineers; document your work. Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values: 
 - Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance

What You've Done

Education and Work Experience: 

- B. Tech/M. Tech with an AI/ML specialization, or CS/IT with strong, demonstrable AI coursework/projects. with 0 to 2 years of experience
 - Strong Python fundamentals; solid grasp of data structures & algorithms. 
 - Working understanding of LLM fundamentals: prompting, embeddings, RAG, basic evaluation concepts. 
 - A maintained personal GitHub profile with at least one substantive AI/LLM project (academic or personal) - not a cloned tutorial. 
 - Share your resume along with your GitHub profile link. Applications without a working GitHub link showing original project work will not be considered. 

Good To Have

- Exposure to evaluation frameworks/metrics for generative AI (e. g. Ragas, DeepEval, or a self-built LLM-judge approach). 
 - Exposure to knowledge graphs / graph data structures (NetworkX, Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or a well-reasoned custom graph model in a project). 
 - Any agent framework (LangChain/LangGraph or similar), vector databases, any cloud platform, REST API basics (FastAPI/Flask).

A test is defined in the Independent Testing Enterprise Policy as "An independent point-in-time examination of one or more processes, controls, policies and procedures or data sources utilized for managing risk to assess the effectiveness of the control environment. A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre-defined pass/fail criteria. About the Role: We are looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Executive who will monitor operational quality, maintain accurate records, and prepare MIS reports. The role combines strong Excel and data-handling ability with clear communication and documentation discipline, supporting day-to-day operations and ensuring processes meet defined quality standards. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. MIS & Data Reporting

- Prepare and publish daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports on quality metrics, audit findings and operational performance. 
 - Consolidate data from multiple sources, clean and validate it, and ensure accuracy before sharing with stakeholders. 
 - Build and maintain dashboards, trackers and summary views for management review. 
 - Analyze trends, identify deviations and highlight areas needing corrective action. 

2. Quality Assurance Activities

- Conduct routine quality checks and audits of processes, transactions or outputs as per defined SOPs and checklists. 
 - Log non-conformities, track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and follow up until closure. 
 - Support internal and external audits by preparing the required data and evidence. 
 - Assist in identifying process gaps and recommending improvements. 

3. Documentation & Record Keeping

- Create, update and maintain SOPs, work instructions, checklists, formats and audit reports. 
 - Ensure version control and proper filing of all quality and operational records. 
 - Maintain audit trails and make documents readily retrievable. 
 - Prepare clear minutes, reports and summaries of quality reviews. 

4. Operations Support

- Coordinate with operations, production/process and support teams for day-to-day quality-related activities. 
 - Track operational activities, timelines and deliverables, and escalate delays or issues in time. 
 - Support process improvement initiatives and operational reviews. 

5. Communication & Coordination

- Communicate audit findings, observations and reports clearly to team members and management. 
 - Conduct feedback and follow-up discussions with process owners. 
 - Coordinate with cross-functional teams, vendors or clients as required. 

Required Skills & Competencies: 

Technical Skills

- Basic Excel: formatting, sorting, filtering, data entry, basic formulas (SUM, IF, COUNTIF, AVERAGE).

Soft Skills

- Communication: clear written and verbal communication in English and Hindi; able to explain findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Documentation: strong attention to detail, structured writing and accuracy in record keeping. 
 - Analytical mindset, problem-solving ability and ownership of deliverables. 
 - Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines and work with minimal supervision. 

Qualifications: 

- Graduate in any discipline (B. Com / BBA / B. Sc / B. Tech preferred).

data.description:
Job Title - Senior Quality Assurance Engineer - ExamDeveloper

Summary

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you are a highly skilled individual contributor recognized as a technical authority for quality within your area. You lead quality engineering strategy and execution for one or more product squads, combining hands-on testing and automation with release-quality accountability and technical guidance for other quality engineers. 

You design advanced test strategies that anticipate complex system interactions, integration risks, and failure modes, and you establish an automation-first approach with complete, visible coverage. You are frequently consulted on the most challenging defects, complex integrations, performance and reliability concerns, and critical release decisions. You lead through expertise rather than formal authority - mentoring quality engineers, improving practices, and helping teams make sound quality and release decisions. You partner closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Product Architects, Dev Leads, DevOps, security, accessibility, and vendor teams to protect candidate experience, delivery reliability, and product quality. 

The Product

ExamDeveloper is a web-based exam development platform that allows customers to write, review, and manage questions on their exams. Customers rely on ExamDeveloper to support the full workflow around item writing, collaborative review, scoring, and test management for certification and professional assessment programs. 

ExamDeveloper is a leading web-based tool for creating tests that certify test-takers in the professional skills they require. The Senior Quality Assurance Engineer plays a critical role in protecting workflow accuracy, automation reliability, delivery confidence, and product quality as the platform continues to support complex exam-development workflows. 

Key responsibilities

Quality strategy and test design

- Lead test strategy and coverage planning for assigned squad initiatives, releases, and platform changes. 

- Design advanced test approaches spanning functional, regression, integration, negative, accessibility, and API coverage. 

- Define quality gates and test readiness criteria for stories, defects, releases, and production-impacting changes. 

- Ensure stories and defects include clear testing evidence, including test cases executed, edge cases considered, environment details, data notes, and traceability where appropriate. 

- Use metrics, defect trends, and production signals to continuously improve the test strategy. 

Hands-on testing and automation

- Contribute directly to hands-on testing for high-risk, complex, cross-team, or automation-critical work. 

- Create, improve, and review automated tests across UI, API, integration, and regression coverage. 

- Review regression results, identify failure patterns, and drive resolution of flaky, missing, or outdated tests. 

- Use manual, exploratory, accessibility, usability, or complex workflow testing when automation is not practical or sufficient. 

- Promote automation-first practices and ensure tests are reliably incorporated into regression suites. 

Quality ownership and collaboration

- Lead defect triage, retesting, and resolution follow-through, and escalate major quality concerns early. 

- Raise defects with clear reproduction steps, environment details, test data, supporting evidence, and business or user impact where possible. 

- Serve as the technical authority on quality within your domain and inform critical release decisions. 

- Mentor and coach quality engineers in automation, test design, accessibility, and release validation. 

- Provide quality perspective during backlog refinement, design reviews, technical planning, and release readiness. 

- Surface QE capacity, coverage, or dependency risks early when testing scope may affect sprint or release timelines. 

Required education and experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. 

- 5+ years of professional quality engineering, software testing, or test automation experience. 

- Demonstrated experience leading quality for complex, distributed, cloud-based, or customer-facing platforms. 

- Strong experience with test strategy, test design, defect management, regression planning, and release validation. 

- Experience providing technical guidance and mentorship within Agile engineering squads. 

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

- Experience with Gauge-style BDD automation, Selenium/WebDriver, C# step implementations, and sustainable web application test automation. 

- Experience maintaining automated test suites that run on virtual machines, with awareness of potential cloud-based testing infrastructure. 

- Experience with relational databases, test data validation, defect investigation, and evidence-based quality review. 

- Experience with SQL, log analysis, telemetry, dashboards, and production issue investigation. 

- Demonstrated technical leadership in Agile quality engineering, including test planning, automation review, and continuous improvement. 

- Willingness and ability to incorporate artificial intelligence technologies into QA responsibly, including validation of AI-assisted outputs. 

- Experience working with offshore teams, vendors, and globally distributed delivery models. 

Success measures

- Quality strategy and test design are visible, current, and used by the squad. 

- Stories and defects close with clear, reviewable evidence of testing and coverage. 

- Regression coverage and automation reliability improve; missed scenarios trend down. 

- Achieves near-zero critical defect leakage post-release for owned areas. 

- Quality risks are surfaced early and resolved through clear ownership and follow-through. 

- Improves the capability of the broader quality team through mentorship. 

Leadership behaviors

Customer Centricity Ensures advanced and edge-case scenarios are considered so user-impacting failures are prevented before release. 

Raise the Performance Bar Pilots new methodologies, strengthens test architecture and automation, and sets a high standard for quality rigor. 

Exceptional Collaboration for Value Mentors peers, contributes strong input during reviews, and aligns quality priorities across product and engineering. 

Our Leaders Inspire Provides informal leadership during complex releases, steps up during peak workloads, and models expert problem-solving. 

Who we are: 

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson. 

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

Our systems run on Node. js and AWS, and your job is to make them bulletproof under traffic. 

If you're the kind of engineer who gets angry when a request takes 500 ms. . . keep reading. 

What You'll D

Architect Node. js systems that scale from zero to millions - resilient, battle-tested, and ready for anything. 

Tear apart bottlenecks before they become outages. 

Build a backend that auto-heals, scales without begging, and doesn't melt at 1M RPM. 

Own the full lifecycle - from feature idea to scaling in production. 

Guide engineers, set the technical bar, and call out flawed designs. 

Think ahead: design for chaos, failovers, and ugly realities before they happen. 

You're Built for This If

You've watched a system catch fire and brought it back with grit and caffeine. 

You've scaled services under brutal load and lived to tell the story. 

You know Node. js beyond frameworks - profiling, event loop internals, async churn. 

You can rip apart AWS quirks (RDS slow queries, ElastiCache meltdowns, S3 limits) in your sleep. 

You don't wait for instructions - you see a mess and fix it. 

Bonus XP (Things That Impress Us)

You've taken systems to 100M+ users or 6-digit RPS. 

You've crushed AWS bills without slowing down a single request. 

You've built real-time madness: Kafka, Kinesis, WebSockets. 

You've designed secure-by-default infra: IAM, VPC, KMS. 

What's In It For You

Total ownership. Your code decides if we scale or die. 

Zero politics, zero handholding. Just outcomes. 

Massive visibility. If you're good, everyone will know it. 

Work with a team that's already shipped to 100M+ people - and is doing it again. 

If you've fought fires in production, debugged chaos at 3 AM, and still wanted more - you're our kind of engineer.

Responsibilities

Our NuData team at eBay brings together exceptional engineers who are pushing the boundaries of distributed systems to build the next generation of database platforms powering eBay's global marketplace. We are seeking a seasoned Principal Member of Technical Staff (Principal MTS) to serve as a senior technical leader for NuData in Bengaluru. This individual will provide technical vision, architectural direction, and hands-on engineering leadership for the local team while partnering closely with NuData architects, technical leads, and engineers in the U. S. , China, and Ireland. 

In this role, you will help define the technical vision and long-term architecture for NuData's distributed database platforms and translate that vision into practical solutions. You will lead complex technical initiatives, drive key architectural decisions, and guide teams in solving challenging problems involving scalability, availability, performance, consistency, and operational efficiency. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will stay deeply engaged with the technology-designing and implementing critical components, writing and reviewing production code, prototyping new approaches, debugging complex system and production issues, and working alongside engineers to solve some of NuData's hardest distributed-systems problems. You will also engage directly with NuData customers to understand their workloads, address critical technical challenges, and ensure our platforms continue to meet their evolving needs. 

You will also play an important role in strengthening NuData's engineering organization in Bengaluru by mentoring senior engineers and technical leads, raising the technical bar, establishing strong engineering and architectural practices, and developing the next generation of technical leaders. 

What you will accomplish

 - Experience with modern infrastructure technologies and cloud-native environments, including technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker. 
 - Demonstrated ability to diagnose difficult production issues across software, storage, networking, and distributed-system boundaries and drive problems through root cause and long-term resolution. 

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

 - Demonstrated proficiency building production-grade software with AI coding agents, improving engineering velocity while maintaining high standards for quality, availability, and maintainability.

Global Leadership
