The Staff Software Development Engineer role within Clearwater's Agentic Client Interactions & Orchestration (ACIO) is a senior technical leadership position focused on architecting, designing, and delivering large-scale distributed systems that power critical financial reporting and analytics. This role requires deep expertise in scalable system design, agentic architecture, cloud-native platforms, and high-performance data processing. 

You will play a key role in shaping the technical direction, ensuring architectural excellence, and enabling teams to build robust, maintainable systems that support Clearwater's commitment to industry-leading financial reporting solutions. Senior engineers at this level are expected to think strategically, lead through influence, and drive innovations that scale across products and teams. 

Responsibilities

Architecture & Design Leadership

- Own the end-to-end architecture of Clearwater ACIO systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance in large-scale financial data processing. 
 - Define, document, and communicate architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for distributed systems. 
 - Evaluate and implement design patterns for fault tolerance, high availability, and horizontal scalability. 
 - Collaborate with product managers, data architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into system-level designs and technical roadmaps. 
 - Conduct architectural reviews and provide engineering guidance to ensure alignment with strategic technology vision. 

Technical Strategy & Delivery

- Lead the technical strategy, operational excellence, and professional delivery across multiple domains in Clearwater. 
 - Drive improvements in system observability, maintainability, and deployment automation. 
 - Ensure designs and implementations meet security, compliance, and performance benchmarks. 
 - Oversee execution of multi-team, multi-service projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery at scale. 

Mentorship & Collaboration

- Mentor senior and mid-level engineers in architecture thinking, technical design, and distributed systems development. 
 - Build strong relationships with teams across divisions to facilitate cross-system integration and shared technology improvements. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging architectures, and cloud technologies. 
 - Identify opportunities for re-architecting or optimizing existing systems to improve throughput, latency, and cost-efficiency. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, scalability, and engineering excellence across FO Reporting and broader Clearwater teams. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Proven architecture and design expertise in large-scale distributed systems, preferably in financial or analytics platforms. 
 - Exceptional leadership skills and ability to lead through influence as a technical architect or senior tech lead. 
 - Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and data streaming platforms (Kafka, AWS Kinesis, etc. ). 
 - Hands-on experience with public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including scaling, cost optimization, and multi-region deployments. 
 - Proficiency in one or more modern languages (Java, Python, Go, or similar) with deep understanding of concurrency, memory management, and performance tuning. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed data storage, database scaling, and query optimization techniques. 
 - Worked on agentic conversational UX design and architecture. 
 - Developed and deployed systems with complex SLAs in production environments serving high-volume traffic/data. 
 - Excellent communication skills with ability to clearly convey architectural decisions and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Commitment to continuous technical learning, improvement, and community knowledge sharing. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline. 
 - 15+ years of professional software development experience; 5+ years acting in an architecture or principal engineering capacity. 
 - Track record of designing and implementing enterprise-grade distributed systems and owning them through full lifecycle (design → build → deploy → maintain).

data.description:
Job Description

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold "what if. "

What if your ideas could ignite global innovation?

What if your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of your career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it's like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect 70% of the Fortune 500, and we're looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold "what if" can take the world, your community, and your career. 

How we empower our people is extraordinary: we're recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia's Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024 - clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every "what if" into "what's next. "

In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox. 

Associate Software Engineer

We have an opportunity for an Associate Software Engineer to join our Universal Asset Insights team in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Engineering. In this role, you will help build and evolve Infoblox Universal Asset Insights, a cloud-first platform that automates discovery and analysis of IP-based and non-IP-based assets across public clouds, on-premises networks, OT/IoT environments, and third-party applications. Collaborating closely with Product Management, Architecture, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will contribute to scalable microservices, data pipelines, and AI-powered capabilities that give our customers real-time, actionable visibility into their hybrid environments-while using our agentic AI development stack to boost productivity and reliability across the software development lifecycle. 

Be a Contributor - What You'll Do

- Develop cloud-hosted microservices and data pipelines for asset ingestion, transformation, and normalization across hybrid and multi-cloud environments
 - Build extensible integrations, including low-code/no-code patterns, that onboard new asset sources quickly and securely
 - Implement containerized, event-driven services using Docker and Kubernetes that meet scalability and reliability goals
 - Design and implement APIs and data models that expose rich asset and topology data to downstream analytics and user experiences
 - Use AI-assisted tools and agentic frameworks (LLM coding assistants, agents/sub-agents, MCP-style servers) to accelerate coding, testing, and documentation
 - Contribute to architecture reviews and design discussions to keep the platform secure, observable, maintainable, and cost-efficient
 - Implement and tune data storage patterns across relational, time-series, and NoSQL databases to support performant querying and analytics
 - Partner with SRE and Operations on observability (metrics, logs, traces), SLIs/SLOs, and incident response
 - Integrate asset visibility with Infoblox core services (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) and adjacent ecosystems such as CTEM, CAASM, and ITSM
 - Stay current on trends in asset intelligence, ETL, streaming, no-code/low-code, and agentic AI, and share ideas that improve developer productivity

Be Prepared - What You Bring

- 1- 2 years of professional software development experience in Golang/Go, with exposure to backend services
 - Foundational experience with microservices or distributed systems using Docker and Kubernetes on a major cloud platform
 - Basic understanding of data modeling and schema design across relational, time-series, or NoSQL databases
 - Familiarity with event-driven architectures and streaming technologies such as Kafka is a plus
 - Interest or early hands-on experience with AI/agentic frameworks or AI-assisted development tools (code assistants, test generation, intelligent search)
 - Exposure to performance debugging and troubleshooting in test or production-like environments
 - Good understanding of core networking concepts (L2/L3, TCP/IP) and security fundamentals; familiarity with DNS, DHCP, IPAM, CTEM, CAASM, or ITSM a plus
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

Be Successful - Your Path

First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals. 

Six Months: 

- Own well-scoped features or services in Universal Asset Insights, from implementation through unit testing and code reviews
 - Build solid understanding of our asset-ingestion and normalization pipelines and contribute targeted improvements to robustness and efficiency
 - Implement or extend at least one integration or connector that onboards a new asset source or improves data quality
 - Establish consistent use of AI-assisted tools in your workflow and share effective patterns with teammates

One Year: 

- Serve as a subject-matter go-to for specific components (microservice, pipeline segment, or integration module) within the Universal Asset Insights platform
 - Lead design and delivery of small-to-medium architectural improvements that enhance platform extensibility, performance, or observability
 - Drive measurable improvements in code quality or reliability (higher test coverage, reduced defect rates) using agentic/AI capabilities in the SDLC
 - Partner with senior engineers and Product Management on prototypes and feature enhancements that expand the value of asset intelligence

Belong - Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you'll grow and belong here. 

Be Rewarded - Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

- Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
 - Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
 - Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a "No Jerks" policy that keeps collaboration healthy
 - Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
 - Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

Ready to Be the Difference?

Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis

data.title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months. 

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99. 5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences. 

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
 - Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
 - Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149. 1, IEEE 1149. 6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
 - Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
 - Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
 - Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
 - Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
 - Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
 - Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
 - Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
 - Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
 - Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
 - Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
 - 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
 - Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
 - Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
 - Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
 - Expertise deploying IEEE 1149. 1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149. 6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
 - Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
 - Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
 - Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
 - Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
 - Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
 - Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
 - Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
 - You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
 - You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
 - You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
 - You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
 - You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

data.title: AI Backend Engineer
data.description:
Hiring for COSO Intelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

- COSO Intelligence is a construction intelligence platform that uses AI to help construction professionals work with project data and make decisions. 
 - Company website: https: //cosobuild. ai

Job Roles & Responsibilities

- Build production Python APIs and asynchronous workflows for reliable document-grounded AI services. 
 - Develop hybrid RAG retrieval, reranking, query rewriting, chunking and metadata filtering over production vector stores. 
 - Establish labelled AI evaluation datasets and CI/CD release checks for retrieval quality, groundedness and faithfulness. 
 - Enforce strict multi-tenant RLS and query-layer isolation across storage, retrieval, caching and background tasks. 
 - Deliver source-document/page citations and honest refusals when available evidence cannot support an answer. 
 - Build layout-aware extraction and OCR pipelines for messy documents while preserving provenance and page metadata. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 3-5 years of experience with hands-on production backend and AI delivery. 
 - Own production Python services using FastAPI or Django, REST APIs and async execution; PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Docker. Show deployed workloads, queue retries/idempotency, performance and failure handling rather than notebook-only work. 
 - Ship hybrid dense plus sparse/BM25 retrieval with reranking, query rewriting, chunking and metadata filtering. Demonstrate a production vector store such as Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone or FAISS; these are alternatives, not cumulative requirements. 
 - Maintain labelled evaluation sets in CI/CD; use Recall@k, MRR and nDCG for retrieval and groundedness/faithfulness for answers. Explain baselines, regression thresholds, dataset versioning and failure slices. 
 - Enforce tenant isolation through RLS at the database/query layer, not prompts alone. Carry tenant context through retrieval, cache keys and Celery jobs; demonstrate negative cross-tenant tests and least-privilege service access. 
 - Return source-document and page citations tied to evidence actually retrieved; refuse or qualify unsupported answers honestly. Explain citation provenance, unsupported-query tests and failure handling. 
 - Extract messy PDFs, scanned documents and complex layouts using layout-aware extraction/OCR; example tools include Tesseract, docTR, Textract and DocLayout. Preserve page identity, reading order, tables and metadata into retrieval. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: Agent orchestration with human-in-the-loop using LangGraph, Agno, AutoGen or CrewAI; staged actions committed by a human and no unattended database writes. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: Quantized self-hosted model routing using vLLM or Ollama, int4/int8, data sovereignty, open-source fallbacks and cost/latency tradeoffs. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: OpenTelemetry (OTel), structured logging, tracing and operational dashboards. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: PySpark, Parquet and CDC-based ETL. 
 - Preferred, not mandatory: AWS or GCP cloud delivery; LoRA/QLoRA only with judgement about when fine-tuning is unnecessary. 

What We Offer

- Remote work. 
 - Hands-on ownership of backend and document-grounded AI engineering for construction intelligence.

Role at a glance

- Position: Senior Manager, QA, AI-First, ProWMS (1 position, Gurugram or Panchkula)

 - Location: Gurugram: Enkay Tower, Plot B & B1, A Wing, 3rd Floor, Udyog Vihar Phase V, Gurugram, Haryana 122016. Panchkula: Third Floor, HSIIDC Technology Park, Plot No. 12-A, Sector 22, Panchkula, Haryana 134116 (Chandigarh tri-city). Work from office
 - Compensation: INR 15 to 20 Lakhs CTC
 - Employment: Full-Time, Permanent
 - Experience: 5 to 10 years in software QA, preferably on a warehouse management system or other supply chain software
 - Growth path: Senior Manager (SD3) > Director (SD3) > Senior Director (SD3)

The mandate

Prozo builds and runs its own technology: ProWMS for warehouse management, ProOMS for orders, ProShip for shipping and courier allocation, and Control Tower for network-wide visibility. The platform handles about 56, 000 orders a day across 44 warehouse sites, with peaks above 23, 000 API requests a minute. The team releases daily and builds AI-first with Claude. 

Prozo is building an AI-first QA team, with one QA owner for each core product. This role owns quality for ProWMS, Prozo's warehouse management system, which runs inbound, putaway, inventory, picking, packing, returns and billing capture across the network. With daily releases, QA starts at the requirement stage, sits with warehouse operations, and uses AI to test faster and wider than a manual-only team can. 

Key responsibility areas

1. ProWMS Test Design and Execution

- Design and run test cases for inbound, QC, putaway, inventory, cycle counts, allocation, picking, packing, returns, VAS and billing capture. 
 - Test handheld flows on Android devices and ring scanners as warehouse staff use them. 2. Integrations

- Test ProWMS integrations with ProOMS, ProShip, marketplaces, client ERPs such as SAP, and ClearTax e-invoicing. 
 - Check data accuracy across system boundaries, including inventory sync and order status updates. 3. AI-First QA and Automation

- Use Claude and other AI tools to generate test cases, test data and exploratory test plans. 
 - Build regression automation with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or Postman and grow automated coverage release by release. 4. Release Quality

- Own regression testing and release sign-off for ProWMS on the daily release cadence. 
 - Log defects with clear steps, severity and evidence, and track recurring issues to their root cause. 5. Business-Embedded Testing

- Join requirement discussions with business and engineering teams so testing covers business logic as well as screens. 
 - Spend time on the warehouse floor to learn the edge cases that occur in live operations. 

Key performance indicators

- Defects found in production against defects found before release. 
 - Share of ProWMS regression tests automated. 
 - Release sign-offs completed on schedule. 

Qualifications & experience

- B. Tech or higher in Computer Science, IT or a related field from a reputed institute. 
 - 5 to 10 years in software QA, with ownership of a product's release quality. 
 - Experience testing a warehouse management system or other supply chain software is strongly preferred. 
 - Experience with API testing (Postman or similar), SQL for data checks, and a test management tool such as Jira or TestRail. 
 - Hands-on test automation experience and an AI-first working style with tools such as Claude. 
 - Stable tenures, clear written communication, and close attention to detail. 

Working at Prozo

- Completely work from office at the Gurugram corporate office or the Panchkula corporate office. 
 - Monday to Saturday, with the second and fourth Saturdays off. 
 - You will work daily with the ProWMS engineers, product, and warehouse operations teams. 
 - Apply by email to tech. hiring@prozo. com with your resume, current CTC and notice period, and a short note on why this role fits you. 

About Prozo

Prozo is India's integrated supply chain operating system, a technology-led 3PL/4PL platform operating 50+ fulfilment centres across 3M+ sq ft, serving 120+ enterprise brands including Tira (Reliance), Pepe Jeans, Bata, Philips, Daikin, Snitch, bewakoof, and others. Our proprietary technology stack, ProWMS, ProShip, ProOMS, and Control Tower, powers omnichannel fulfilment across D2C, marketplace, quick commerce, and B2B channels. Website: www. prozo. com

data.title: Senior Technical Architect
data.description:
Role: Senior Technical Architect

Location: Kochi/Hyderabad

Notice Period: Immediate to 30days

Experience: 15+ years overall; 5+ years as a technical architect or solution lead

Architecture and delivery

- Define and evolve the solution architecture for claims applications on Azure and . NET, including ASP. NET, C# Web API, Vue. js, React. js, TypeScript, and Kendo UI. 
 - Design the claims platform as microservices: service boundaries around FNOL, documents, vendor orders, payments, and notifications; synchronous APIs versus Service Bus events; and data ownership so services do not share one database. 
 - Define Node. js services where they sit beside the . NET estate, including API boundaries, shared contracts, and how Node services call Azure SQL or PostgreSQL. 
 - Define the mobile architecture on . NET MAUI and Blazor, including shared UI, shared business logic, offline behavior, and how mobile clients call the same Web APIs as the web apps. 
 - Define infrastructure as code with Terraform for resource groups, networking, data services, container registries, and application runtimes so environments can be rebuilt, not hand-configured. 
 - Produce architecture decision records, integration designs, and non-functional designs for security, performance, availability, and observability across web and mobile. 
 - Guide squads from design through release. Review pull requests and designs so the implementation matches the agreed architecture. 
 - Set standards for APIs, front-end structure, mobile packaging, configuration, and secrets. Keep environments consistent across dev, test, and production. 
 - The candidate should have practical experience working with Azure AI services, Document Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs), OCR, prompt engineering, and structured data extraction from complex documents. 
 - Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI and other LLM platforms. Domain

- Apply working knowledge of US property insurance claims: FNOL, coverage and policy interpretation at a solution level, loss adjustment, reserves, payments, subrogation, catastrophe surges, and regulatory expectations that shape system design. 
 - Shape mobile claims journeys for field use: photo and document capture, FNOL intake, status checks, and offline work when connectivity is poor after a catastrophe. 
 - Challenge requirements when they conflict with claims process, data lineage, or audit needs. Translate adjuster and operations workflows into technical scope. 
 - Partner with business analysts, product owners, and client SMEs so technical choices protect claims cycle time and data integrity. Third-party property claims services

- Design and govern integrations with property-claims vendors used in inspection, roof and exterior measurement, imagery, and materials pricing. Required experience includes EagleView, Hover, ITEL, and Nearmap, plus the judgment to onboard similar vendors. 
 - Define how vendor orders, imagery, measurements, material pricing, and reports attach to the claim file without becoming a second system of record. 
 - Set patterns for partner APIs through API Management: authentication, throttling, retries, idempotency, callbacks, and failure handling when a vendor is slow or unavailable during a catastrophe. 
 - Decide what field users capture on device versus what is ordered from EagleView, Hover, Nearmap, or ITEL, including cost, cycle time, and data-quality tradeoffs. 
 - Keep vendor payloads, images, and pricing artifacts in Blob Storage with retention and access rules that match claims audit needs. Identity and security

- Design single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID for web and mobile, including app registrations, conditional access alignment, token lifetimes, and role claims consumed by ASP. NET, the Vue or React front end, Node. js services, and MAUI or Blazor clients. 
 - Define secure token storage and session handling on device. Keep secrets, vendor credentials, and certificates in Azure Key Vault. Define access patterns for App Service, Function Apps, containers, and integration runtimes. Azure platform (must have)

- Design and operate workloads that use App Service, Function Apps, Application Insights, Azure Monitor and alerts, Key Vault, resource groups, Blob Storage, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure Container Registry, Azure SQL, and PostgreSQL on Azure. 
 - Use API Management as the front door for internal, partner, mobile, and vendor APIs. Use Service Bus for claims eventing, vendor callbacks, and asynchronous processing. Use Logic Apps where a low-code integration is the right fit, and Function Apps where code is required. 
 - Use Azure Container Registry for container images consumed by the claims platform. Define image naming, retention, and how pipelines publish and promote images. 
 - Choose and govern the data platform: Azure SQL for relational claims workloads that fit the Microsoft data stack, and PostgreSQL where the service or product standard requires it. Define connectivity, backups, and which system owns each data set. 
 - Define resource-group structure, naming, tagging, and environment separation so cost, access, and release boundaries stay clear. 
 - Instrument web, mobile, Node. js, and vendor-integration paths with Application Insights. Define alert rules and action groups so claims-critical failures page the right team. Platform products in the landscape

- Architect integrations and extension points for NopCommerce, SurveyJS, Salesforce, Titan Forms, and WordPress where those products sit in the client landscape. 
 - Define how survey, commerce, CRM, and content flows exchange data with the claims core without duplicating the system of record. 
 - Shape data-warehouse feeds from operational claims systems and vendor outputs: grain, keys, slowly changing attributes, and reconciliation with source systems. Engineering leadership

- Mentor technical leads and senior developers across web, API, mobile, Node. js, and integration squads. Run design reviews and architecture forums. 
 - Estimate technical effort with delivery managers. Surface risk early when scope, vendor readiness, skills, or environment readiness. 
 - Support production incidents as the technical authority. Drive root-cause fixes, not only workarounds. Must-have skills

Application engineering

- Strong . NET: C#, ASP. NET, and Web API, including modern . NET (not only . NET Framework). 
 - Front end: Vue. js, React. js, TypeScript, and Kendo UI in production applications. 
 - Node. js for APIs or integration services in a production landscape. 
 - Microservices design in production: bounded contexts, API contracts, event-driven integration, independent deployment, and failure isolation. 
 - Mobile development with . NET: . NET MAUI and Blazor, including Blazor Hybrid where a MAUI host embeds Blazor UI. 
 - Practical judgment on what to share between MAUI, Blazor, and the Web API, and what must stay platform-specific. 
 - SSO with Microsoft Entra ID, including securing APIs, SPAs, Node. js services, and mobile clients. Data

- Azure SQL. 
 - PostgreSQL. 
 - Clear ownership of which store is the system of record, and how data moves to the warehouse. Azure (all required)

- App Service
 - Function App
 - Application Insights
 - Monitor and alerts
 - Key Vault
 - Resource groups
 - Blob Storage
 - Logic Apps
 - Service Bus
 - API Management (APIM)
 - Azure Container Registry
 - Terraform for Azure infrastructureWays of working

- Ability to write and present architecture that a client architect and a delivery manager can both use. 
 - Clear written and spoken English for US client forums. Good to have

DevOps

- Azure DevOps Repos
 - Azure Pipelines
 - Azure DevOps Releases (or YAML multi-stage pipelines that replaced classic releases)
 - Mobile build and distribution through Azure Pipelines, including signing and store or enterprise distribution
 - Pipeline steps that build images and push them to Azure Container RegistryAdjacent platforms

- NopCommerce
 - SurveyJS

 - Salesforce

 - Additional property-claims vendors beyond EagleView, Hover, ITEL, and Nearmap
 - Azure certifications (AZ-305 or equivalent) are useful, not a substitute for delivery evidence. Domain

- Hands-on or solution-level experience on US property insurance claims systems or equivalent P&C claims platforms serving US carriers or TPAs.

Assets

Why Husky?

 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.

data.title: Staff Quality Engineer (Remote)
data.description:
- Role Title: Staff Quality Engineer (Remote)
 - Role Type: Full-time
 - Location: Remote

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage. 

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity. 

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development. 

What You'll Do

1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage. 

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing. 

7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality. 

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization. 

What We're Looking For

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture. 

2. Strong hands-on programming skills and experience building production-grade test automation frameworks. 

3. Extensive experience automating web applications, APIs, and complex end-to-end workflows. 

4. Expertise with modern testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent technologies. 

5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure. 

6. Proven experience designing scalable testing systems rather than exclusively writing or maintaining individual test cases. 

7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows. 

8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work. 

9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers. 

10. Ability to independently own quality engineering architecture while remaining deeply hands-on. 

Nice to have

1. You've built AI-powered testing systems or agentic QA workflows used in real development environments. 

2. You've significantly reduced manual regression testing through intelligent automation. 

3. You've designed testing infrastructure that supports rapid product iteration with a small engineering team. 

4. You've worked on testing AI-powered products, including nondeterministic behaviors, model evaluations, or agentic workflows. 

5. You think about quality as an engineering platform rather than a separate phase of software delivery. 

6. You can move comfortably between writing automation code, investigating complex failures, and designing company-wide quality systems. 

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $180, 000 -$250, 000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to support@micro1. ai. 

Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues.

data.title: Staff / Principal Defensive Security Engineer (Frontier Cyber Models)
data.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

LSI (Lean SuperIntelligence) is a security AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity LLMs. LSI-Offense-1 finds, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to attacks. The two train against each other inside LSI Cyber World Models, realistic instrumented enterprise environments where every outcome is verified, and they run on-prem or air-gapped inside the enterprise that owns them. 

LSI is founded by the team behind India's first sovereign LLM and AI labs at Alexa, Uber AI and Salesforce Research, with elite security researchers, and is backed by Accel, Fusion Fund, SVQ, Inventus Capital and Dreamit Ventures, plus angels who led AI and security at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne and Zscaler. 

About the Role

You are the defender in LSI's self-play loop. You will turn what the best detection engineers, threat hunters, malware analysts and incident responders do into the environments, data, rewards and evaluations that make LSI's defense model detect, correlate, investigate and triage real attacks with fewer false alarms. 

You will also architect how the model plugs into a real SOC: the telemetry it reads, the correlations it draws, the evidence it shows and the actions it is trusted to take. Level (Staff or Principal) is set by scope and track record. 

What you'll do

- Set the technical direction and evaluation strategy for detection, alert triage, correlation, investigation and response recommendations. 
 - Build instrumented environments that produce realistic telemetry (EDR, cloud audit, identity, network, Kubernetes, SaaS, AI-agent traces) with ground-truth labels from offense-team attacks. 
 - Encode the analyst: turn detection engineering, hunting and IR tradecraft into tools, investigation playbooks, expert trajectories and reward functions. 
 - Design how the model links weak signals across sources and time into an attack story mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and the asset and identity graph. 
 - Build pipelines where the model drafts, tests and tunes detections (Sigma, KQL, SPL, ES|QL, YARA) against replayed attacks, and extend defensive benchmarks (ExCyTIn-Bench, DiagChain-style, triage precision/recall). 
 - Architect SOC integration with SIEM, XDR and SOAR (Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel, Chronicle, CrowdStrike, Cortex) and run design-partner pilots. 

What you bring

- 5+ years of hands-on defense (8+ for Principal) across at least three of: detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response and forensics, SOC architecture, threat research and intelligence, malware analysis. 
 - Has built detection programs, not just rules: detection-as-code pipelines, coverage models and tuning loops at an enterprise, cloud provider, MDR or security vendor. 
 - Has led investigations against sophisticated adversaries across endpoint, cloud, identity and network. 
 - Strong with query languages and large-scale log pipelines; understands entity resolution, timelines, baselining and why correlations fail. 
 - Has built or extended LLM-driven triage, investigation, hunting or detection-authoring workflows with measured results. 
 - Fluent in Python plus one of Go, Rust or TypeScript; comfortable with Kubernetes, IaC and streaming data. 

Nice to have

- RL environments, simulators, reward functions or verifiers; post-training for agentic tasks. 
 - Hands-on malware reverse engineering (Ghidra, IDA, sandboxes) and original research that shipped detections. 
 - Built agentic SOC or autonomous investigation features at a security vendor or AI lab. 
 - Detection and response for AI systems (OWASP LLM / Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATLAS). 
 - Open-source detection content, publications or talks at Black Hat, DEF CON, SANS, FIRST or similar.

Company Description E STAR Engineers Private Limited is a pioneer in the design, manufacturing, and commissioning of automatic multi-level car and bike parking systems. Versa Networks, Inc. is a vendor of a unified Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) platform. Versa's goal is to provide unprecedented business advantages through a software-based approach that allows for unmatched agility, cost savings and flexibility. We have created a platform that is feature-rich, scalable and easy to use for both enterprise and service provider use cases. 

Job Summary: 

VMS is a core component of Versa's SASE security platform. It collects user identity, authentication, device posture, IoT, UEBA and threat intelligence data and distributes it, per tenant, to Versa enforcement points for Zero Trust, identity-based firewall, micro-segmentation and SSE policies. Data sources include SCIM, passive and active authentication, RADIUS and threat intelligence feeds. We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to lead the testing of VMS, covering functional correctness, tenant isolation, high availability, upgrades and performance. 

Educational Qualification: 

B. E. /B. Tech. or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication or equivalent. 

Professional Qualification:

Quality strategy

 - Provide the quality status for each release, with test results and defect data. 
 - Mentor SDETs and review their test designs and automation code.

 - Measure how long it takes for a change, such as a user logout or a new threat feed entry, to take effect.

- Maintain the installation and upgrade test matrix: ISO and package installs, single-node and HA setups, FIPS and non-FIPS builds, upgrade, rollback and data migration. 
 - Test active/backup failover and data replication, including random failures and reboots, and measure RTO and RPO. 
 - Run performance, capacity, soak and memory-growth tests, and document the supported limits for throughput, record count and tenants. 

Essential Skills: 

- Test automation development in Go or Java, and Python or another scripting language. 
 - Experience testing distributed or stateful systems, such as messaging, streaming, data stores (for example Redis or Kafka) and HA failover. 
 - API and contract testing, preferably with gRPC/Protobuf.

Desirable Skills:

Overview: 

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients. 

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities. 

The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi's regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation. 

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on: 

Reporting & Intelligence - Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners. 

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning - Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages. 

Testing & Exception Management Automation - Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

Job Summary: 

The Business Analytics Int Analyst will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders. 

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation. 

In this role, you are expected to: 

- Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines. 
 - Extract, validate, and analyze test execution data to calculate key quality and performance metrics. 
 - Help draft initial narrative summaries, executive dashboards, and documentation for final test result publication.

 - Track and update sprint milestones, deliverables, and cycle times to ensure on-time testing execution.

Job Description

Title: Test Automation Engineer- Husky (India), Guindy, Chennai-Immediate joiners only

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency. 
 - Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape. 
 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members. 
 - Collaborative Environment: Join a global team of skilled professionals around the globe where your ideas are valued, and collaboration is encouraged to solve complex challenges and drive success. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
data.description:
Hiring for Lapmaster Wolters - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools, with over 200 years of history. Their machines lap, polish and grind surfaces to extreme flatness for 20+ industries worldwide. The company has 600+ employees and revenue above €250 million. 

Lapmaster Wolters is now expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging, one of the fastest-growing areas in chips, driven by AI and next-gen computing. LW Semiconductor India, based in Bangalore, is the new team designing and building this equipment. Joining now means working on cutting-edge semiconductor machines from the ground up. 

About the Role

Lapmaster Wolters is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to own the electrical and power design of semiconductor packaging machines, from concept through commissioning. Based on site in Bengaluru, you will work closely with mechanical, controls, and manufacturing teams to develop robust machine electrical systems for high-precision applications. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys turning system requirements into practical designs, solving issues on the shop floor, and supporting equipment through installation and customer handover. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design electrical architectures, schematics, panel layouts, wiring drawings, and power distribution for semiconductor packaging equipment. 
 - Select and integrate PLCs, motion components, sensors, drives, safety devices, and related electrical hardware. 
 - Own electrical BOMs, wiring standards, grounding, cable routing, and machine safety compliance. 
 - Support build, testing, FAT/SAT, debugging, and commissioning activities at the Bengaluru site and customer locations as needed. 
 - Work with cross-functional teams to resolve design gaps, reduce machine downtime, and improve system reliability. 
 - Prepare technical documentation, change records, and support engineering reviews throughout the project lifecycle. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - 6+ years of experience in machine design, industrial automation, or capital equipment engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with electrical schematics, control panels, and machine power systems. 
 - Good understanding of PLC-based systems, motion control, sensors, safety circuits, and industrial communication. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex machine issues during assembly and commissioning. 
 - Experience working with semiconductor, packaging, or high-precision manufacturing equipment is preferred. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently in an on-site engineering environment. 

Originally posted on: 2 Nov 2026

data.title: Maintenance Manager – Engineering & Utilities
data.description:
Fruit Formulations (FruitFM) is hiring a Maintenance Manager - Engineering & Utilities for our Jejuri plant. You will keep the fruit processing and pulping lines, utilities and facilities safe, reliable and ready for production, especially through the peak fruit season. You will control maintenance cost and build a skilled, responsible maintenance team. 

What you'll do

- Plan and carry out preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance for fruit receiving, washing, destoning, pulping, finishing, evaporation, pasteurisation/sterilisation, and aseptic and hot-fill packing lines
 - Run utilities reliably: boiler (IBR), chillers, refrigeration and cold storage, air compressors, water treatment, ETP, DG sets and power distribution
 - Lead the annual pre-season overhaul and off-season shutdowns so lines are ready before the fruit season
 - Manage critical spares, consumables, AMCs and vendor services within the approved budget
 - Keep food-contact equipment, CIP systems, seals and gaskets in hygienic condition to support food safety (FSSAI, GMP, FSSC 22000 / ISO, Halal and certification audits)
 - Enforce safe work: lock-out/tag-out, permits to work, and statutory inspections
 - Analyse breakdowns and cut downtime, energy and water use; lead, schedule and train technicians across shifts; keep history cards and maintenance logsWhat we're looking for

- Diploma or B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or related engineering
 - 5-10 years of hands-on maintenance experience in food or beverage manufacturing (fruit pulping or fruit processing preferred)
 - Practical knowledge of pulpers, finishers, evaporators, sterilisers, aseptic fillers, pumps, gearboxes, motors, VFDs, boilers and refrigeration
 - Hands-on PLC automation experience: troubleshooting PLC, HMI/SCADA and drive-based control systems (for example Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Delta) on processing and packing lines. Programming or modifying these systems is preferred
 - Able to lead technicians and contractors and solve problems under pressure
 - Comfortable with Excel and maintenance records; CMMS or SAP PM is an advantage
 - Working English and effective Hindi and/or Marathi
 - Full-time, on-site at Jejuri, with availability across shifts and during seasonal peaks
 - Reports to the Plant Head.

data.description:
Job Description - Lead Specialist, Solution Architect

Role: Solution Architect

Division: Pearson Qualifications - Consumer Services

Location: Bangalore or Chennai, India (Hybrid)

About Pearson

Pearson's mission is to "add life to a lifetime of learning. " With more than 20, 000 employees worldwide, we deliver high-quality, digital-first educational experiences that empower learners and educators. Our teams are passionate about creating accessible, sustainable solutions that drive real-world impact. 

About Pearson Qualifications - Consumer Services

Consumer Services creates and operates digital products that help teachers teach and learners build the knowledge, confidence and skills needed to succeed in their qualifications. Our services bring together curriculum-aligned content, learning activities, practice assessment, progress insight and supporting administration for schools, teachers and learners. 

The portfolio includes modern cloud-based products alongside established applications that are being simplified, consolidated or retired over time. The architecture role is focused on evolving a coherent consumer product ecosystem, improving integration and operational quality, and supporting the controlled migration of users and capabilities to strategic platforms. This remit is distinct from systems used to administer and deliver qualifications, examinations, marking and certification. 

Role Summary

As a Solution Architect, you will shape and oversee solutions across Pearson Qualifications Consumer Services. You will work primarily with modern digital teaching and learning products in the UK Secondary Education market (K-12) and Post-16 Education, while also supporting the safe evolution, integration and retirement of applications across the wider consumer portfolio. 

You will translate content, product and business needs into secure, scalable and supportable solution designs, working closely with content, product, engineering, user experience, data, security, service management, and external partners. The role requires strong architecture judgement across customer-facing web applications, APIs, event-driven integration, data, identity, cloud infrastructure and operational readiness. 

You will balance strategic direction with pragmatic delivery, assessing reuse before new build, documenting trade-offs, estimating cost and effort, and ensuring functional and non-functional requirements are addressed. Clear communication, constructive challenge and the ability to guide delivery teams through change are essential. 

Key Responsibilities

- Solution Architecture Design: Lead end-to-end architecture for consumer-facing digital products and supporting services. Define application, integration, data and deployment views that meet functional and non-functional requirements, sometimes including sovereign data requirements in a highly regulated industry. 

- Product and Platform Evolution: Shape roadmaps that simplify the application estate, encourage reuse and support controlled migration from established products to strategic capabilities without disrupting customers. 

- Architecture Options and Trade-offs: Evaluate solution options across technology fit, customer impact, delivery effort, security, operability, scalability, time to market and total cost of ownership. 

- Integration Architecture: Design and govern APIs, events and integration patterns across internal products, enterprise platforms, third-party services and school or customer systems. 

- Technical Leadership and Governance: Act as a design authority through discovery, delivery and release. Maintain alignment with enterprise standards, architecture principles and agreed guardrails. 

- Delivery Team Support: Work closely with engineering leads, developers, testers, DevOps and SRE teams to turn architecture into implementable designs and resolve technical issues. 

- Customer and User Experience Alignment: Partner with product and UX teams to support accessible, coherent and responsive teacher, learner and administrator journeys. 

- Data and Insight: Define appropriate data ownership, contracts and flows for learning activity, assessment, content, subscription and insight use cases. 

- Security and Privacy by Design: Ensure solutions protect customer and learner data and follow Pearson security and privacy standards. 

- Reliability and Operability: Define availability, performance, resilience, observability, support and recovery requirements. 

- Vendor and Partner Oversight: Review third-party architectures and implementation approaches and hold partners accountable for quality and conformance. 

- Documentation and Decision Management: Maintain architecture blueprints, C4 views, interface and event specifications, data flows, non-functional requirements, decision records and transition roadmaps. 

- Cost and Sustainability: Assess infrastructure, platform, licensing and operational costs and promote efficient, maintainable cloud usage. 

- Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Evaluate relevant developments in digital learning, AI, analytics, software delivery and cloud technology. 

- Lifecycle Support: Support solutions from discovery through implementation and live operation, including technical debt reduction, consolidation and decommissioning planning. 

Working Relationships

The role works across product management, engineering, UX and accessibility, data and analytics, information security, SRE and operations, service management, enterprise architecture, commercial teams and external delivery partners. The successful candidate will be comfortable influencing across organisational boundaries without relying on formal authority. 

Essential Experience and Skills

- Extensive Solution Architecture Experience: A proven track record designing and guiding complex enterprise or digital product solutions from concept through implementation and operation. 

- Modern Cloud Architecture: Strong experience with AWS cloud services and cloud-native design, including compute, containers, serverless, networking, storage, managed data services, identity, monitoring and resilience. 

- Java and Web Application Architecture: Strong understanding of Java-based service architectures and modern web applications, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs and distributed systems. 

- Architecture and Design Communication: Ability to create clear architecture blueprints, C4 diagrams, data flows, integration views, interface specifications and architecture decisions. 

- Integration and API Design: Practical experience with API-first and event-driven architectures, contract design, service boundaries and asynchronous messaging. 

- Data Architecture Awareness: Good understanding of transactional data, data modelling, analytics, reporting, ownership, privacy, retention and performance. 

- Security and Privacy: Strong knowledge of secure software design, identity and access management, data protection and application security. 

- Technical Leadership: Experience guiding multidisciplinary teams, reviewing implementation, mentoring colleagues and constructively challenging suppliers. 

- Solution Analysis and Cost Estimation: Ability to make evidence-based recommendations balancing customer value, quality, delivery effort, operational impact and cost. 

- Stakeholder Engagement: Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including explaining trade-offs and gaining alignment. 

- Problem Solving and Adaptability: A pragmatic approach to ambiguity and change, moving between strategic architecture and detailed delivery issues. 

- Business and Customer Focus: Ability to connect architecture decisions to teaching, learning, customer experience, product outcomes and sustainable value. 

Desirable Skills

- AWS Delivery Tooling: Infrastructure as code and CI/CD experience, including Terraform, GitHub Actions or equivalent tooling. 

- Containers and Event Streaming: Experience with container platforms, microservices, Kafka or equivalent technologies. 

- Modern Front-End Architecture: Familiarity with React, micro-frontends, design systems and accessible user experiences. 

- Cloud Data Technologies: Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data warehouses, search, caching and near-real-time analytics. 

- Education Technology: Experience with teaching and learning platforms, digital content, learning management, formative assessment or school-system integration. Knowledge of 1EdTech standards for rostering and LTI integration protocols is desirable. 

- Identity and Subscription Services: Understanding of SSO, roles, entitlements, onboarding, subscription management and digital access control. 

- Legacy Modernisation: Experience planning incremental migrations, coexistence, strangler patterns, user transition and decommissioning. 

- Operational Excellence: Understanding of SRE, observability, performance engineering, business continuity and disaster recovery. 

- AI and Emerging Technology: Awareness of responsible AI in content, teaching, learning, insight and software delivery. 

- Azure Awareness: Familiarity with Azure where consumer services integrate with wider Pearson platforms or enterprise capabilities. 

Education and Certification

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field is desirable, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant architecture and cloud certifications, particularly AWS Solutions Architect, are highly regarded. 

Job Location and Hours

The role is aligned to our Bangalore or Chennai offices in India, working a 45-hour week, 9am to 6pm IST. All our roles are hybrid working; our current policy requires the team to work from their base office three times per week. 

There is a requirement to provide occasional out-of-hours support during business-critical periods. 

This job description describes the primary accountabilities of the role and may evolve as the Consumer Services portfolio and Pearson's technology strategy develop. 

Who we are: 

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson. 

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
