data.title: Senior Test Developer – Automotive Simulation Testing & Failure-Triage Lead
data.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex automotive software failures and leading high-impact validation activities in a fast-paced engineering environment? We are looking for an experienced SWQA Lead with strong automotive domain knowledge, hands-on simulation testing expertise, advanced Python skills, and a proven ability to identify regression-causing changelists (CL's) through systematic bisection. This role is central to Integration testing quality and simulation failure triage. You will lead daily testing activities, analyze various failures and artifacts, identify root causes, isolate culprit changelists (CLs), and coordinate resolution across software, simulation, validation, and infrastructure teams. As the Person in Charge (PIC), you will manage priorities, assign work, remove blockers, improve triage efficiency, and ensure release-impacting issues are driven to closure. You will also apply Agentic AI workflows to accelerate failure investigation, evidence correlation, classification, and reporting. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead daily pre-merge testing, simulation failure triage, task prioritization, team execution, and timely closure of critical issues. 
 - Perform root-cause and signal-level analysis using logs, traces, metrics, videos, and state transitions to isolate software, simulation, configuration, infrastructure, analyzer, or evaluator failures. 
 - Lead the bisections using source-control history, failure patterns, signal evidence, and code-impact analysis to identify culprit CLs and complex multi-change regressions. 
 - Develop Python-based tools and automation for log analysis, failure classification, regression isolation, automated bisection, and reporting. 
 - Apply Agentic AI workflows to correlate diagnostic evidence, identify patterns, summarize failures, recommend investigation paths, and improve triage efficiency. 
 - Collaborate with development, systems, simulation, validation, tools, and infrastructure teams; track quality metrics, communicate risks, mentor engineers, and establish consistent triage practices. 

What We Need To See

- B. Tech. or equivalent degree in CS, CE, ECE, EEE, Automotive Engineering, or a related field, with 8-12 years of relevant automotive software testing and validation experience. 
 - Strong expertise in HIL/SIL, simulation testing, automotive verification workflows, and root-cause analysis using signals, logs, traces, and system-level evidence. 
 - Hands-on validation experience with ADAS and automated-driving functions, including L2, L2PP, and L3/L4 features across perception, localization, prediction, planning, control, and vehicle interfaces. 
 - Advanced Python skills for automation, signal processing, data analysis, visualization, debugging, and validation-tool development. 
 - Proven expertise in bisection using Git, CI/CD pipelines, build artifacts, and change history to identify and validate culprit CLs. 
 - Demonstrated ability to apply Agentic AI workflows. 
 - Proven ability to lead small to mid-sized teams, work with diverse stakeholders, and drive process alignment and continuous improvement. 
 - Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to break down complex process topics into actionable steps. 

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Experience applying AI agents or LLM-based workflows to log analysis, evidence correlation, failure classification, automated bisection, or root-cause investigation.

Job Description

Job Description

HPE GreenLake Platform Cloud (GLCP) team allows you the opportunity to collaborate with both creative and engineering types to build HPE's next generation cloud platform. Combining agile methodologies and a continuous integration and delivery pipeline, the GreenLake Cloud Platform partners with all of HPE and powers HPE's transformation as a true cloud-native provider. It's the cloud that comes to you!

On the GLCP team you will build innovative cloud platform capabilities that enable the delivery of rich HW and SW aaS solutions to customers. Product Overview

HPE VM Essentials (VME) is a next-generation virtualization platform that enables customers to provision and manage KVM-based HVM and VMware ESXi virtual machines through a single, unified management interface. 

The solution includes an enhanced KVM-based HVM hypervisor with enterprise-grade cluster management capabilities such as high availability, live migration, distributed workload placement, integrated data protection, secure hardening, and external storage support. VME is designed to deliver a scalable, resilient, and secure virtualization experience for enterprise workloads. 

Role Overview

As an Engineering Development Manager - Virtualization, you will lead a team responsible for delivering critical capabilities within HPE VM Essentials. You will combine hands-on technical leadership, people management, and execution ownership to drive high-quality outcomes aligned with HPE's product strategy and customer commitments. 

This role requires strong alignment with HPE leadership expectations, including ownership, accountability, collaboration, and customer focus, while maintaining deep technical credibility in systems and virtualization platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical & Execution Leadership

- Own delivery of key virtualization components, ensuring on-time, high-quality, and predictable execution. 
 - Provide architectural oversight to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with HPE's long-term technology roadmap. 
 - Experience in driving development, automation, CI/CD, performance engineering, reliability testing and production readiness. 
 - Ability to work with product management, architecture, QA, support and other teams. 
 - Drive technical decision-making with a strong focus on customer impact, operational excellence, and business value. 
 - Ensure adherence to HPE engineering standards, quality gates, and compliance requirements. 

People Leadership & Talent Development

- Lead, mentor, and develop engineers through coaching, performance management, and career development, in line with HPE's people leadership principles. 
 - Build an inclusive, high-performing team culture that emphasizes ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Actively identify skill gaps and drive upskilling and succession planning within the team. 

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Partner closely with Product Management, Architecture, QA, Support, and Global Engineering teams to align priorities and deliver customer-focused outcomes. 
 - Engage with partners and customers to understand requirements, address escalations, and incorporate feedback into product improvements. 
 - Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

- Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and architectural improvements, balancing innovation with stability and delivery commitments. 
 - Drive adoption of best practices across DevOps, CI/CD, reliability, security, and release management. 
 - Champion a security-first and quality-first mindset across all phases of development. 

What You Need To Bring

Education & Experience

- BE / ME in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Minimum 15 years of industry experience, with demonstrated experience leading engineering teams. 

Required Knowledge And Skills

- Strong experience in the virtualization ecosystem, preferably with KVM-based solutions. 
 - Experience in managing a team for developing, debugging/troubleshooting, and maintaining enterprise-grade infrastructure software
 - expertise in Linux OS, clustering technologies (e. g. , Corosync, Pacemaker), and file systems. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise storage and networking. 
 - Working knowledge on clustering technologies (e. g. , Corosync, Pacemaker), and file systems. 
 - Knowledge on REST APIs, Groovy, Java, C++, Python, Shell Scripting or similar technologies
 - Solid understanding of storage technologies and networking in enterprise environments. 
 - Expertise in software systems design, distributed architecture, and integration across heterogeneous platforms. 

Additional Skills

- Working knowledge on any cloud type (AWS/Azure/GCP . . . etc). 
 - Knowledge on Microservices, Multi tenancy & RBAC. 
 - Knowledge on k8s eco-system, Cloud Identity & Access Management (IAM), Secret and key management (KMS, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault).

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here. 

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

About The Role

At Rocket India, we build technology that simplifies home financing and creates meaningful customer outcomes. You will lead engineering managers and senior technical leaders, improve delivery and operational performance, and ensure that portfolio outcomes align with enterprise standards. 

You will partner with Product, Quality Engineering, Architecture, Security, Data, Operations and Technology Leadership to deliver secure, scalable, resilient and customer-focused solutions while building accountable teams and sustainable engineering capabilities.

Portfolio Execution & Delivery

 - Improve delivery flow and predictability through disciplined work intake, capacity planning, dependency management, commitment management, review turnaround and release readiness. 
 - Escalate systemic constraints, investment needs and cross-portfolio dependencies with evidence and recommended actions. 

Product, Platform & Technology Execution

- Execute approved modernization strategies for applications, platforms, infrastructure, integrations and cloud-native capabilities within the assigned portfolio. 
 - Ensure architecture alignment and adoption of enterprise platforms, reusable APIs, frameworks, libraries, infrastructure modules and engineering patterns.

 - Drive observability, monitoring, alerting, service-level objectives, incident management, problem management, resilience testing and operational readiness. 
 - Ensure accountable closure of corrective and preventive actions arising from incidents, reliability reviews and operational risks. 
 - Improve system reliability, performance, scalability, availability and operational efficiency. 
 - Ensure teams maintain current documentation, runbooks, operational procedures and recovery plans. 

Quality Engineering & Secure Delivery

- Operationalize enterprise quality standards, automated testing expectations, quality gates, release controls and evidence-based deployment decisions across assigned teams. 
 - Ensure appropriate unit, integration, regression, end-to-end, performance, resilience, accessibility and security testing strategies. 
 - Embed security, privacy, compliance, architecture and engineering controls throughout design, development, testing, deployment and operations. 
 - Ensure vulnerabilities, compliance findings and technology risks are prioritized, remediated and escalated appropriately. 

AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation

- Implement enterprise AI engineering standards across assigned engineering teams and products. 
 - Drive responsible adoption of AI-assisted development, engineering assistants, agents, automation, analytics and intelligent operational workflows. 
 - Operationalize AI governance through documented use-case intake, solution evaluation, release readiness, output validation, production monitoring, traceability, human escalation and fallback controls. 
 - Measure AI adoption, engineering productivity, quality, operational outcomes and business impact while protecting security, privacy, architectural integrity and customer trust. 
 - Promote responsible experimentation and scale proven practices within enterprise guardrails. 

Metrics, Data & Continuous Improvement

- Implement enterprise engineering measurement standards and use trusted portfolio-level metrics to drive performance, accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Monitor delivery, flow, quality, reliability, security, operational, adoption, productivity and talent measures. 
 - Ensure portfolio data has clear definitions, accountable ownership, auditable sources, consistent aggregation and actionable insights.

Leadership & Talent Development

 - Identify critical skill gaps and implement targeted capability-development plans. 
 - Foster accountability, ownership, inclusion, innovation, continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Recognize measurable engineering achievements, operational improvements, innovation and customer impact. 

Workforce & Resource Planning

- Translate enterprise workforce and capability strategies into staffing, succession, capacity and skill-development plans for the assigned portfolio. 
 - Manage resource allocation, leadership bench strength, critical-skill readiness and delivery capacity across assigned teams. 
 - Provide data and recommendations that inform enterprise organization-design, workforce-mix and hiring decisions. 
 - Support hiring and talent acquisition aligned with approved portfolio and future capability requirements. 

Vendor & Partner Delivery Management

- Manage delivery performance for vendors, technology partners and outsourced teams supporting the assigned portfolio. 
 - Ensure partner accountability for quality, security, delivery commitments, operational readiness, documentation, remediation and knowledge transfer. 
 - Monitor contract outcomes, delivery measures, cost effectiveness and risks, escalating strategic or commercial issues through the appropriate governance channels.

Key Responsibilities

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java)
data.description:
About Reveleer

Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care. Trusted by 80+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence. 

Why this role is important

The Senior Software Engineer (Java) at Reveleer is a highly experienced individual contributor working on Reveleer's encounter data processing and CMS submission systems for Medicare Advantage. This role focuses on strong execution, sound technical decision making, and delivering high-quality software in a regulated, high-data-volume environment where submission accuracy and timeliness carry direct compliance and revenue impacts. Success means writing reliable, maintainable code, improving the throughput and stability of encounter processing, and owning customer outcomes. 

What Success Looks Like

- Data pipelines for CMS encounter data submission and response-file processing run reliably and at high throughput, with issues surfaced and
 - resolved before they reach CMS deadlines or customers. 
 - Features and services are well designed, implemented correctly, and operate reliably across a multi-tenant platform. 
 - Technical decisions balance delivery speed with maintainability, performance, security, and regulatory accuracy. 
 - Legacy components are modernized safely, reducing security exposure and long-term maintenance costs. 
 - Automated test coverage and delivery automation improve, reducing manual QA and operational toil for the team. 
 - AI-assisted development accelerates delivery (refactoring, test generation) without lowering the quality bar. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain Java services for health care encounter data processing and CMS submissions (EDI X12) within Reveleer's Medicare
 - Advantage member management platform, using Spring, Hibernate, MS SQL, and RabbitMQ. 
 - Build and optimize high-throughput batch and file-processing pipelines for large-volume EDI submission and response handling (837, 277CA, 999), improving throughput, latency, and reliability. 
 - Contribute to the high-scalability modernization goals of the platform: full infrastructure as code (IaC), session and authentication handling, and containerized deployment on AWS (EKS). \
 - Modernize legacy Java components safely, including version upgrades, dependency and security remediation, and migration behind tooling with rollback plans. 
 - Strengthen delivery quality by building automated tests and improving CI/CD pipelines, helping reduce manual QA and operational load across the team. 
 - Apply AI-assisted engineering tools (such as Claude Code) across the development lifecycle (scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, code review). Contribute to system reliability, performance, and security; troubleshoot data and software problems in a compliance-sensitive production environment and improve the systems so they require less manual intervention. 
 - Act as a technical subject matter expert within your domain, supporting other engineers through design input, problem-solving, and code review. Work with product managers, analysts, and stakeholders to translate business and regulatory requirements into technical solutions. 

What You Bring

- 8+ years of Core Java and J2EE enterprise web application development. 
 - Strong object-oriented coding practices and design patterns. 
 - Spring Boot experience highly preferred, along with Spring Batch or equivalent high-volume batch processing experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience building high-throughput data or file-processing systems, with measurable improvements in throughput or latency. 
 - Hands-on experience with EDI/X12 and CMS encounter data processing (EDPS/EDS), or comparable healthcare claims and submission systems. 
 - Advanced SQL, including database and query optimization (MS SQL preferred). 
 - Containerized, cloud-native development on AWS (Docker and Kubernetes/EKS), including multi-tenant SaaS architecture concerns such as tenant isolation and per-tenant configuration. 
 - API development experience. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy Java codebases: version upgrades, dependency and security remediation, and migration tooling. 
 - Experience with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, observability and application instrumentation, and the full software development lifecycle in an Agile environment. 
 - Proficiency in AI-assisted software engineering, with hands-on use of tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, and maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and elevate quality through clear standards and practical coaching. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field required; Master's degree preferred

Desirable Additional Experience

- Message queues and streaming (RabbitMQ, AMQP, Kinesis, or equivalent). 
 - Infrastructure as Code and deployment pipeline configuration for cloud platforms. 
 - Continuous delivery practices (trunk-based development, feature flagging). 
 - Front-end development with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Familiarity with CMS submission channels (ConnectDirect, Edge server) and risk adjustment (HCC).

data.title: Staff Network Reliability Engineer, Cloud Operations
data.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. 

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it. 

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started. 

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible. 

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places. 

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

SUMMARY: HOW YOU WILL IMPACT SKYLO

As a Staff Network Reliability Engineer, Cloud Operations, in the Global Product Support & Customer Success organization, you are the Cloud Infrastructure domain authority within Skylo's production NTN network. Everything runs on the infrastructure you keep healthy - RAN NFs, Core NFs, OSS, BSS, and the observability pipeline itself. When a GKE node fails, when ArgoCD drifts, when a Persistent Volume Claim goes unavailable, when a PostgreSQL replica falls behind, when Prometheus WAL corrupts - you own the response. 

You operate across Skylo's full hybrid cloud estate: GCP public cloud (GKE clusters, Pub/Sub pipelines, Cloud SQL) and on-premise private cloud infrastructure (bare-metal Kubernetes, hyperconverged compute, software-defined storage). You own 24×7 platform health, the observability pipeline (Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), persistent storage operations (PostgreSQL, Redis), and the operational interface with Network Implementation for all GitOps-driven infrastructure changes. 

At Staff NRE level you go beyond keeping the lights on. You define and maintain SLOs tied to network SLA commitments, own error budget tracking, drive toil reduction, and partner with Ops Platform Engineering to automate the infrastructure remediation loop. You are the last technical stop before a Cloud Infrastructure problem becomes an engineering escalation - and you are a force multiplier, mentoring Senior NREs and contributing the operational requirements that shape Skylo's platform roadmap. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure Operations & Health Ownership

- Own 24×7 cloud infrastructure health across Skylo's hybrid production environment: GKE cluster node status, namespace and pod health, Persistent Volume Claim availability, network policies, and multi-cluster federation across Skylo's GCP footprint. 
 - Own on-premise Kubernetes cluster health: bare-metal node availability, container runtime stability, CNI networking, persistent storage arrays (Ceph/Rook or equivalent), and hyperconverged compute platform operations (Harvester, KubeVirt, or KVM). 
 - Monitor and triage infrastructure alarms using OSS dashboards, Grafana/VictoriaMetrics telemetry, GCP Cloud Monitoring, and Loki log correlation - distinguish transient platform events from systemic infrastructure degradation. 
 - Execute and own Cloud Infra runbooks for P2-P4 fault categories: GKE node recovery, pod eviction and rescheduling, PVC repair, database failover execution, Prometheus WAL corruption recovery, ArgoCD drift remediation, and certificate rotation - without requiring engineering involvement for covered fault classes. 
 - Own BSS-IIS GKE cluster monitoring and infrastructure health; maintain runbooks that reflect current cluster topology after every infrastructure change. 

Observability Pipeline & Data Platform Operations

- Own the observability pipeline end-to-end: Prometheus scrape target integrity, VictoriaMetrics retention and query performance, Grafana dashboard coverage and accuracy, OpenTelemetry collector health, and alert routing via Pub/Sub to the OSS. 
 - Maintain database reliability: PostgreSQL streaming replication health, backup and restore procedures, failover testing, query performance monitoring; Redis cluster operations, eviction policy management, and persistence configuration. 
 - Ensure log aggregation pipeline health (Loki or ELK): ingestion rates, retention policies, query performance, and completeness - the observability stack must be operational before the network events it monitors can be triaged. 
 - Partner with NI (Network Implementation & Infrastructure) on all planned infrastructure changes: receive advance notice, validate post-deployment observability, and sign off on operational readiness before the change window closes. 

Cloud Infrastructure Incident Diagnosis & Escalation Authority

- Serve as the L3 escalation authority for all Cloud Infra incidents: take ownership from the Incident Manager, diagnose at the Kubernetes, storage, network, and database layer using kubectl, GCP console, node logs, and infrastructure telemetry, and deliver a resolution or a decision-grade root cause. 
 - Lead Cloud Infra troubleshooting bridges: command the technical investigation for GKE node failures, cluster upgrade failures, storage outages, PubSub pipeline disruptions, database failover events, and ArgoCD sync failures - drive to resolution or clear engineering handoff. 
 - Diagnose and resolve infrastructure failure modes: node NotReady conditions, pod CrashLoopBackOff chains, PVC mount failures, CSI driver errors, network policy misconfigurations, Helm release drift, etcd latency spikes, and cross-cluster federation breaks. 
 - Participate in the global 24×7 on-call rotation as the Cloud Infra domain escalation tier - reachable within defined SLA windows for Sev 1 events; function as the technical decision-maker, not the first responder. 

SLO Engineering & Reliability

- Define and maintain SLOs for all Cloud Infra components: GKE control plane availability, database query latency, storage IOPS, message pipeline throughput, and observability stack uptime - tied directly to network SLA commitments to MNO partners. 
 - Own error budget tracking and the process for trading error budget against deployment velocity; escalate when error budget burn rate requires engineering intervention or deployment freezes. 
 - Drive toil reduction: identify and eliminate manual Cloud Infra procedures; own the roadmap to automated cluster recovery, rolling restarts, storage repair, and certificate rotation in partnership with Ops Platform Engineering. 
 - Lead capacity planning for compute, storage, and network resources across public and private cloud - forecast growth based on subscriber projections and new MNO partner onboarding. 

Root Cause Analysis & Post-Incident Ownership

- Own Cloud Infra RCA end-to-end: lead the investigation, document the complete causal chain from infrastructure trigger through upstream NF impact, and deliver systemic action items with owners, timelines, and measurable success criteria. 
 - Deliver Initial RCA documentation within defined SLA windows; identify systemic infrastructure failure patterns - cluster upgrade regressions, storage controller bugs, network policy drift, resource exhaustion trends - and translate them into engineering requirements. 
 - Contribute to the weekly and monthly Network Performance Report: infrastructure availability, database latency trends, storage IOPS, observability pipeline health, and SLA deviation analysis. 

Runbook Authorship & Operational Standards

- Author, own, and maintain all Cloud Infra runbooks and SOPs: GKE node recovery, database failover, storage expansion, Prometheus WAL repair, ArgoCD rollback, certificate rotation, and cluster upgrade procedures - every procedure tested before production reliance. 
 - Define the diagnostic decision tree for each known infrastructure fault class: entry condition, triage steps, isolation method, resolution action, and escalation criteria - written at the level where a Senior NRE can execute independently. 
 - Validate and sign off on operational readiness for all infrastructure changes: DCI/DCE build-outs, GKE cluster expansions, Kubernetes version upgrades, and new on-premise hardware deployments. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Development

- Partner with OPE as the Cloud Infra domain's primary automation consumer: define Kubernetes event schemas, alert-to-action contracts, and closed-loop policy requirements for infrastructure auto-remediation. 
 - Represent Cloud Infra in NI architecture reviews: define observability and operational readiness requirements for all infrastructure expansions and GitOps pipeline changes before go-live. 
 - Collaborate with Core NRE and RAN NRE on infrastructure-layer issues affecting network functions: pod scheduling, PVC availability, network policy changes, and platform upgrade impacts on NF workloads. 
 - Partner with security teams on infrastructure hardening: patch compliance, RBAC policies, network segmentation, container image scanning, and runtime security monitoring across public and private cloud. 
 - Surface toil and automation opportunities to the Service Assurance & Automation team - document the procedure, frequency, and MTTR cost as structured input to the automation backlog. 
 - Mentor Senior NREs in Cloud Infra domain depth: Kubernetes troubleshooting patterns, storage operations, database reliability, observability pipeline internals, and escalation judgment. 

GitOps, IaC & Platform Engineering Interface

- Own operational oversight of GitOps tooling in production: ArgoCD sync health, Helm chart version management, drift detection, and rollback execution for multi-cluster deployments. 
 - Review and validate Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) changes that impact production - ensure operational impact is assessed and observability is in place before merge. 
 - Engage Skylo's Platform Engineering and NI teams with full operational context when issues exceed operational resolution authority - deliver a structured problem statement, infrastructure telemetry bundle, and a clear question rather than a vague escalation. 

Qualifications

Required

- 8-10+ years of infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or cloud operations in a production 24×7 environment - with direct on-call ownership for Kubernetes-at-scale environments. 
 - Deep Kubernetes expertise: multi-cluster operations (GKE or EKS), node pool management, RBAC, network policies, persistent storage (PVC, CSI drivers), CRD/operator patterns, and production cluster upgrade procedures. 
 - Hybrid cloud operations: hands-on experience operating both public cloud (GCP or AWS) and on-premise/private cloud infrastructure (bare-metal Kubernetes, KVM, or hyperconverged platforms). 
 - Production observability stack ownership: Prometheus (federation, remote write, WAL management), Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, and alerting pipeline design with Pub/Sub or equivalent. 
 - Database reliability: PostgreSQL streaming replication, backup/restore, failover procedures, and performance tuning; Redis cluster operations and persistence management. 
 - GitOps tooling in production: ArgoCD or Flux CD for multi-cluster operations; Helm chart authorship and version management; Terraform or Ansible for infrastructure provisioning. 
 - SRE fundamentals: SLO/SLI/SLA definition, error budget management, toil measurement, capacity planning, and on-call rotation design. 
 - Container and Linux internals: container runtime debugging, kernel-level performance analysis, storage subsystem troubleshooting, and network packet flow understanding. 
 - Runbook authorship: ability to write infrastructure diagnostic procedures at the level where a less-experienced engineer can execute them independently under incident pressure. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication: capable of delivering RCA documents, engineering escalations with structured problem statements, and MNO-facing infrastructure summaries. 

Preferred

- Experience operating cloud infrastructure for telecom or NTN workloads: 5G Core NF hosting, vRAN compute requirements, or satellite ground segment infrastructure. 
 - Software-defined storage expertise: Ceph, Rook, or equivalent distributed storage systems at production scale. 
 - Private cloud platform experience: KubeVirt, Harvester, or OpenStack for VM-container convergence on bare-metal infrastructure. 
 - Networking depth: BGP routing, VXLAN overlays, EVPN fabrics, software-defined networking, and hardware load balancer operations. 
 - Strong development background in Go or Python for building custom automation tooling, Kubernetes operators, or infrastructure lifecycle integrations. 
 - FinOps experience: cloud cost optimization, resource lifecycle automation, and capacity right-sizing across public cloud footprints. 
 - Certifications: CKA, CKS, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, or Red Hat Certified Architect. 

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as: 

- Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
 - Comprehensive benefits plans
 - Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
 - A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
 - Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
 - Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
 - Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

EEO Statement

Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

data.title: Full-Stack Developer
data.description:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for a client-facing Full-Stack Developer to build secure enterprise web experiences, backend APIs, and cloud-hosted applications that support Microsoft, AI, and business platform solutions. 

The developer will use C#/. NET, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, and Azure services to deliver custom-code capabilities that are not suited to low-code platforms alone. The role includes identity integration, API design, testing, deployment readiness, and production troubleshooting. 

The ideal candidate takes end-to-end ownership, communicates confidently with clients, and collaborates across AI, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and DevOps teams. Success in this role means delivering secure, tested, and responsive applications with maintainable architecture and clear operational visibility. 

How You Will Make An Impact

- Participate in client discovery and translate functional and non-functional requirements into practical technical designs. 
 - Develop responsive React-based user experiences and C#/. NET backend services and APIs. 
 - Implement secure authentication and authorization using Entra ID, OAuth, and role-based access patterns. 
 - Integrate Microsoft services, enterprise systems, databases, and external APIs. 
 - Design SQL data access patterns and maintain clear API contracts, error handling, and validation. 
 - Write unit and integration tests; participate in peer reviews and maintain clean, supportable code. 
 - Deploy and operate applications on Azure using App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights as appropriate. 
 - Support CI/CD, release troubleshooting, observability, and root-cause analysis with the DevOps and Test teams. 
 - Explain architecture trade-offs, estimate delivery efforts, prototype rapidly, and document technical decisions and handoff guidance. 

What You Will Bring To The Table

We are looking for a professional who combines technical ownership with strong client partnership. Success in this role requires curiosity, accountability, practical judgment, and the ability to move work forward while keeping stakeholders informed. 

- Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders during discovery, delivery updates, risk discussions, and project handoffs. 
 - Take ownership of outcomes, follow work through to completion, and escalate risks early with supporting evidence. 
 - Use documentation, experimentation, and collaboration to solve unfamiliar problems rather than waiting for step-by-step direction. 
 - Adapt to evolving technologies, priorities, and responsibilities while maintaining quality and security standards. 
 - Contribute to a supportive engineering culture through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and professional client interactions. 

Qualifications

- 4-6 years of relevant professional experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with C#/. NET, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, and SQL. 
 - Solid understanding of authentication and authorization, Entra ID/OAuth, Git, unit testing, Azure development, and secure coding practices. 
 - Strong debugging skills, end-to-end ownership, clean-code discipline, and peer-review practices. 
 - Ability to lead client-facing technical discussions, decompose requirements, estimate work efforts, and communicate architecture trade-offs. 
 - Experience with . NET, . NET Core, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD; familiarity with Jest, React Testing Library, and SPFx fundamentals. 
 - Exposure to Azure OpenAI integration, Next. js, Python, Copilot extensibility, Docker, or Dataverse integration. 
 - Secure, tested, and responsive applications and APIs. 
 - Reliable identity and enterprise-system integrations. 
 - Maintainable custom-code foundations for AI agents, Microsoft 365 (M365), and Power Platform solutions. 
 - Clear monitoring, documentation, and operational handoff. 

Work Schedule: This is a client-facing role. The successful candidate will be expected to participate in client meetings, discovery sessions, demonstrations, delivery reviews, and issue-resolution discussions during the assigned shift. 

Standard Shift: 1: 00 PM to 10: 00 PM India Standard Time (IST), equivalent to 2: 30 AM to 11: 30 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST). During U. S. daylight saving time, the equivalent schedule is 3: 30 AM to 12: 30 PM Eastern Daylight Time (EDT). 

About Us

At Netrix Global, our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals, and commit us to a common purpose. 

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today's most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution. 

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country's top system integrators. 

At Netrix, we're driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction. 

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal. 

To learn more about Netrix Global, please go to www. netrixglobal. com

data.title: Software Sr Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who can take a loosely defined problem and run with it - no detailed user stories, no handoff docs. You'll build and ship production features on our Next. js platform, integrating with Snowflake, ThoughtSpot, Mapbox, and CARTO. This role is built for someone who treats a one-line ask or a rough sketch as enough to start building, fills in the gaps with sound product judgment, and course-corrects fast based on what they learn - rather than someone who needs a spec before they can move. 

What You'll Do

- Take ambiguous, minimally-scoped asks and expand them into a working solution - deciding what "done" looks like rather than waiting for it to be defined
 - Build and maintain front-end features in Next. js/React, including data-heavy dashboards and map-based views
 - Wire up and maintain data integrations with Snowflake (querying, modeling, performance tuning of large datasets)
 - Embed and extend ThoughtSpot analytics (liveboards, search, embedded SDK) inside the app
 - Build interactive geospatial experiences using Mapbox and CARTO (layers, geocoding, spatial queries, custom overlays)
 - Own integration reliability - auth, API contracts, caching, error handling - across all connected systems
 - Prototype fast, ship, observe usage, and iterate - treating shipped code as the primary feedback loop instead of upfront discovery
 - Work with minimal business-side back-and-forth; escalate only genuine blockers, not routine clarification

What You'll Need

- 4+ years building production web apps with Next. js/React, strong TypeScript
 - Hands-on experience with Snowflake (SQL, warehouses, performance/cost tuning)
 - Experience embedding or integrating BI tools (ThoughtSpot, Looker, Tableau, or similar)
 - Experience with geospatial/mapping libraries (Mapbox GL JS, CARTO, or equivalent)
 - Demonstrated track record of shipping features from a vague brief with little oversight this matters more than years of experience alone
 - Comfortable making and owning product/scope decisions without sign-off on every detail

data.title: Plant In charge Quality
data.description:
Job Purpose

To ensure quality assurance and quality control systems of concrete products. Promotion of VAC and optimization of mixes. 

Job Context & Major Challenges

The RMC Industry is highly fragmented and very competitive. As a major RMC player we face competition from other organized players and local players which makes superior service delivery along with quality products important for good margins. There is huge growth in infrastructure which opens up opportunities for setting up commercial and dedicated plants. The plant and its resources need to be cost effective with focus on maximizing capacity utilization. This makes it imperative for each plant to be efficient and profitable. The plant employees need to be focused and deliver high performance in each of their KRAs and accountabilities. 

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 Business Development

- Conducting demos for VAC products to clients to help them understand their functionality

KRA2 Customer Feedback

- Resolve day to day customer grievances related to cracks, workability, slump control, pumping issues cube failures etc. and take corrective and preventive actions based on site feedback
 - Visit customer/ site periodically to gather feedback and identify areas of concern

KRA3 Customer Management

- Provide detailed mix design calculation, physical and chemical analysis of raw material to customer as and when required

KRA4 Maintenance Management

- Ensure the upkeep of the quality control labs with proper product display and availability of relevant BIS codes
 - Ensure calibration of instruments is done before due date

KRA5 MIS

- Conduct physical stock measurement and reconciliation
 - Maintain all the quality records on Labsys and update as per QCI and ISO. Maintain records related to calibration of all testing equipment

KRA6 Planning & Budgeting

- Prepare, consolidate and analyze Plant plan and budget

KRA7 Product Development

- Generate mix and competitor data at plant level for further analysis
 - Arrive at the mix design as per customer's requirements

KRA8 Product Testing

- Conduct testing of cubes of concrete to check if they are as per the Quality Standards
 - Conduct statistical analysis of cubes strength results and monitoring performance of the products
 - Conduct trials for VAC Products to check various functional parameters
 - Check the quality of the raw material to ensure adherence to desired standards and specifications. Reject the material that does not match the required specifications
 - Collaborate with third party testing for the cubes as and when required
 - Undertake trials for performance/ dosage of different admixtures, other special materials and routine products to ensure quality parameters are met

KRA9 Production Execution

- Ensure VAC orders to each plant are executed in time and as per required specifications
 - Track the standard deviation of the produced batch to ensure quality of concrete is within permissible limits and take corrective measures
 - Ensure workability and cohesiveness of concrete at plant and at pouring site
 - Implement moisture corrections during production
 - Monitor the right dosage/ admixture at batching plants during production

data.title: QA Engineering
data.description:
The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth

In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom. 

Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia. However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure-global, regional, or sectoral-across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning). 

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (: ₹90, 000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region. 

This is not an 'offshore' support role. Our India team is a core product hub, operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust. 

The Role: Engineering Confidence

Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline. 

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe. "

Here's what you can look forward to in this role. 

- Engineer the Safety Net: You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast. 
 - Shift Quality Left: You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase. 
 - Pragmatic Quality: While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually. 
 - Drive CI/CD Velocity: You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately. 
 - Guardian of the Client Experience: You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss. 

Our Tech Stack

- Web Automation: We use Playwright for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications. 
 - Backend Automation: We use Cucumber-Scala to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure. 
 - Mobile Automation: We leverage Maestro E2E and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps. 
 - Ops: We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on CI/CD to run your tests on every commit. 

Want to look under the hood? Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at tech. endowus. com

What Success Looks Like

- First 30 Days (Immersion): You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release. 
 - First 90 Days (Ownership): You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage. 
 - First 6 Months (Impact): You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a founder mentality. 

What You Bring (Requirements)

We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline: 

Must-Haves: 

- 4+ Years of Test Engineering: You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation. 
 - Strong Coding Fundamentals: You are proficient in at least one major language (Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding. 
 - Automation Framework Competence: You have experience using and extending frameworks like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. You can write stable, maintainable scripts. 
 - API Testing DNA: You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states. 
 - Collaborative Mindset: You don't wait for a "hand-off. " You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better

Nice-to-Haves: 

- Mobile Automation: Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro. 
 - Performance Testing: Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter. 
 - FinTech Domain: You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments

Why Endowus?

- Modern Stack, Serious Business: You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup. 
 - World-Class Engineering Talent: You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture. 
 - Career Growth with Upside: We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (: 85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category. 
 - Leadership Pedigree: Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more. 

Why NOT Endowus?

We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment. 

- You prefer 100% Automation: If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you. 
 - You prefer a Centralized QA Structure: If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging. 
 - You prefer executing over planning: If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves. 
 - You want 100% Remote: We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration

The Interview Process

We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient. 

- Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission. 
 - Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
 - Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios. 
 - System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management. 
 - Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match. 

Our Investors, recognition, licensing

Founded in 2017, Endowus has raised over US$130 million from investors including UBS, EDBI, Prosus Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Citi Ventures, MUFG Innovation Partners, Singtel Innov8, Samsung Ventures, SBVA, Illuminate Financial, OSK Ventures, Z Venture Capital, and ACF - a joint venture between JLIN LLC and The Wells Investments. Endowus also counts some of the largest billionaire family offices in Asia among its investors. 

Endowus partners with 1, 000+ global fund managers across public markets, private markets, hedge funds, and alternatives to deliver world-class solutions at transparent cost through its fee-only model. Private Wealth clients access curated strategies from firms such as EQT, Carlyle, Partners Group, KKR, Ares, Brookfield Oaktree, HarbourVest, Millennium, Point72, Bridgewater, and more. Recognition includes CNBC's World's Top FinTech Companies 2025, the Financial Times' High-Growth Companies Asia Pacific 2025 (#45), Fortune Fintech Innovators Asia 2024, and the World Economic Forum's Technology Pioneers 2023. The platform has won Asia's Best Digital Wealth Management and Hong Kong's Best FinTech Innovation in Asset Management (Asia Asset Management 2025), Singapore's Best Digital Wealth Management Experience (The Asset Triple A 2025), and Best WealthTech Solution 2023 (Asian Private Banker). 

The Endowus Group comprises licensed companies in Hong Kong and Singapore, and Hong Kong-based multi-family office Carret Private. With group assets over US$12 billion, Endowus is one of the largest independent wealth managers in Asia, estimated to save clients more than US$50 million in fees per year.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in. 

About The Department

Cloudflare's Engineering team builds and runs the software that handles a large share of the Internet's requests. We also build the internal tools and platforms that software depends on. Teams own large areas with real impact and work autonomously within them, whether their customers are external or other Cloudflare engineers. 

About The Team

Developer Productivity builds the internal tools and platforms Cloudflare engineers use to take code from commit to production. We own developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), developer insights and ADLC metrics, AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding. 

We're responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering, and adoption has grown 4 to 6 times over in the last year. We also own the tooling behind Cloudflare's Engineering Codex, the standards every engineering team is expected to meet. 

About The Role

This is a front-line engineering manager role leading a team of 6+ engineers in Bengaluru. The team's initial focus will be on two areas: 

- AI tools for engineers. Agents, agentic systems, MCP servers, evals, and context engineering that change how Cloudflare engineers write, review, and ship code. 
 - Engineering standards and the tooling that enforces them. Continuing to transform our Engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and feedback engineers can act on, instead of checklists and manual review. 

You'll own the product direction for both areas. There are no dedicated product managers on the team. Our users are Cloudflare engineers, and our engineers work as product engineers who talk to users, watch how tools get used, and help decide what to build next. You'll lead that work, deciding what to build and why, and making sure it gets adopted and solves real problems. 

You don't need to write code every day, but you should be able to review a design, debug a broken pipeline, or prototype an agent when the team needs it. 

We move fast. AI tooling changes month to month, so a six-month plan is stale in six weeks. We ship small, put it in front of engineers early, and change course based on what we hear. We'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it next week than spend a month polishing a design doc. We add process only when it solves a real problem. 

You'll partner closely with engineering managers and principal engineers in the US, UK, and Europe, and work with teams across Cloudflare's global organization. The team starts in Bengaluru. As it grows, it may include engineers in other regions. 

What you'll do

- Hire, onboard, and grow your team. Coach engineers to think like product engineers, run career conversations, give direct feedback, and handle performance. 
 - Own the product roadmap. Spend time with the engineers who use your tools, decide which problems matter most, and say no to the rest. 
 - Keep the team shipping. Release in small increments, get feedback from users quickly, and cut process that slows the team down without adding value. 
 - Deliver in both focus areas: agents, MCP servers, and evals the rest of engineering relies on, and Codex standards turned into CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code, with remediation and exception workflows to match. 
 - Measure whether the work is landing: tool adoption, Codex compliance, and what engineers actually think of the experience. 
 - Own operations for the platforms your team runs, including on-call and incident response. 

What we're looking for

- 3+ years managing software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and developing people. 
 - 8+ years of total software engineering experience, with enough recent hands-on work to hold your own in code and design reviews. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI in engineering organizations, such as building agents, running agentic systems in production, or governing how a company uses AI. This is not a model-training or ML research role. 
 - Experience building or running developer tools, internal platforms, or CI/CD systems. 
 - Product and user thinking. You've owned a roadmap, with or without a PM, and you can point to decisions you made because of what users told you or how they actually used what you built. 
 - A bias to action. You've led teams that shipped often and changed direction when the evidence called for it, while still delivering on commitments. 
 - Clear judgment and clear writing. You make sound trade-offs and explain the "why" as well as the "how". Much of your work with partners will happen asynchronously across time zones. 

Bonus points

- You've built MCP servers or LLM evals, or worked on context engineering for agents. 
 - Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation. 
 - Experience measuring developer productivity, using frameworks such as DORA or SPACE, or developer surveys. 
 - You've built a team from scratch or started an engineering presence in a new location. 
 - Familiarity with TypeScript, Go, or Kubernetes-based systems. 

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. 

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2, 400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers--at no cost. 

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 

1. 1. 1. 1: We released 1. 1. 1. 1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers. 

Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process. 

This position may require access to information protected under U. S. export control laws, including the U. S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U. S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license. 

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer. 

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare. com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

data.description:
Principal Engineer

AAVA | Reports to Senior Director, Product Engineering | Technical Strategy and Architecture for the AAVA Platform

About AAVA

AAVA is Ascendion's agentic AI product designed for enterprise software engineering across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from ideation to operations. It coordinates AI agents alongside human engineers under Ascendion's "Engineering to the Power of AI" approach. 

About The Team

You will be joining a team that is aspiring to transform the operating model of how software is delivered across industries with Agentic Software Development Life Cycle. 

The AAVA product development team is a small yet powerful organization within Ascendion, made up of highly ambitious people across product management, design, engineering, quality, data, and customer success. Together, we are building a world-class Enterprise B2B product for managing the Agentic Software Development Life Cycle. 

What sets the team apart is the range of experience in the room. Colleagues come from banking, identity and access management, enterprise SaaS, design and architecture, cloud, and data and AI. Each brings a different view of how software is built, governed and trusted in large enterprises. We treat that variety as a strength: it helps us challenge assumptions, spot risks early, and design for the real needs of customers across industries. These perspectives come together in one shared mission: to give enterprises a reliable way to plan, run and govern agentic development, with AI agents working alongside human engineers from ideation to operations. We build where we can differentiate, integrate where the ecosystem is strong, and abstract complexity for customers, guided by the principles of reliability, security, operational excellence, accessibility, compatibility and abstraction. 

In this role, as Principal Engineer, you will own the long-term technical vision and architecture of AAVA across the platform. You will set architectural principles, resolve the hardest cross-cutting technical problems, and act as the senior technical voice with customers, partners and executives, in an environment that values curiosity, ownership, openness to different viewpoints, and a high bar for quality. 

Skills Required

- Defining platform-wide architecture, standards and roadmap that balance differentiation, integration and abstraction. 
 - Understanding LLM and agent ecosystems (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, MCP, A2A), and anticipating how they evolve and affect platform choices. 
 - Designing multi-model, multi-agent orchestration with evaluation, observability, cost control and graceful degradation. 
 - Designing context engineering systems: retrieval, knowledge graphs, organizational memory, provenance, freshness and permission-aware access. 
 - Architecting versioned artifact repositories for agents, prompts, workflows and evaluations, covering lineage, certification and discovery. 
 - Applying security-by-design to agentic AI: guardrails, identity and authorization, policy-as-code, threat modeling and red-teaming. 
 - Mapping regulations and frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF) to architecture and audit evidence. 
 - Designing for multi-tenancy, scale, resilience and cost at enterprise level, with clear reliability and performance targets. 
 - Evaluating build-versus-buy and partner technologies with rigorous technical and commercial analysis. 
 - Mentoring Staff and Senior Engineers, and shaping the technical hiring bar. 
 - Communicating clearly with CTOs, CISOs, customers and partners, and representing AAVA in technical forums. 
 - Prototyping and building on the hardest platform problems hands-on with AI-assisted tools, and setting the standard for how engineers work with AI. 
 - Designing architecture and interfaces so that teams can build and release independently and quickly once the design is frozen, with minimal rework. 
 - Establishing organization-wide standards for AI-assisted development (guardrails, code provenance, security review, licensing) tied to measurable delivery-speed and quality targets. 

Experience Required

- 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years at staff or principal level or in architecture leadership. 
 - Has architected enterprise B2B platform products at scale, used by Fortune 500 clients. 
 - Has delivered production AI/ML or generative AI systems at enterprise scale, with 2+ years in agentic or LLM-based products. 
 - Has defined architecture that was adopted across several teams or an entire product organization. 
 - Has led platform-level security, compliance or reliability design through audits and certifications. 
 - Has built developer-facing or persona-based products, such as IDE extensions, CLIs, SDKs, portals or marketplaces. 
 - Has influenced engineering executives and product leaders on strategy, investment and risk. 
 - Has a record of technical thought leadership, such as publications, patents, open-source work or conference talks (preferred). 
 - Holds a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. Experience at a software product company, a hyperscaler or an AI platform vendor is preferred.

data.title: QA Engineer – Manual Testing
data.description:
About The Opportunity

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer with strong Manual Testing and API Testing experience, along with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues and provide first-level support. 

The position is with a fast-growing B2B technology company operating in the travel-tech domain. 

You will work closely with product managers, developers and internal stakeholders to test web and mobile applications, identify bugs, validate product releases, troubleshoot issues and help deliver a reliable product experience. 

This role combines hands-on QA testing, technical troubleshooting and occasional customer-facing communication. 

We are looking for candidates with strong fundamentals in manual testing, API testing and regression testing, along with good communication skills. 

Key Responsibilities

Manual & Functional Testing

Perform manual testing across web and mobile applications. 

Execute functional, feature, regression and sprint testing. 

Understand product requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases. 

Identify, document, reproduce and track bugs through resolution. 

Validate fixes and ensure application functionality before production releases. 

Perform end-to-end testing of application workflows and integrations. 

API Testing

Test RESTful APIs using Postman. 

Validate API responses, JSON payloads, status codes and error scenarios. 

Work with Postman collections to execute and document API test cases. 

Collaborate with developers to identify and troubleshoot API-related issues. 

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

Provide first-level technical support to internal teams and occasionally customers. 

Investigate application issues, reproduce reported problems and coordinate with development teams for resolution. 

Assist with technical and system-usage queries. 

Work with logs and debugging information to help identify the root cause of issues. 

Support API walkthroughs and basic technical explanations when required. 

Documentation & Collaboration

Prepare and maintain test cases, test reports, bug reports and QA documentation. 

Work closely with developers, product managers and other stakeholders to define acceptance criteria. 

Participate in sprint planning, testing discussions and release activities. 

Take ownership of assigned features and ensure proper testing before release. 

Mandatory Skills & Experience

Candidates must have practical, hands-on experience in all the following areas: 

Manual Testing: Experience testing both web and mobile applications. 

Regression & Functional Testing: Hands-on experience performing regression testing and feature testing on live product releases. 

API Testing: Practical experience testing REST APIs using Postman. 

Communication: Strong verbal and written English communication skills, as the role involves interaction with internal stakeholders and occasional customer-facing support. 

QA Fundamentals: Ability to understand requirements, prepare test cases, identify defects, reproduce issues and validate fixes. 

Good to Have

Test automation experience using Selenium. 

Performance and load testing exposure using JMeter. 

Basic programming or scripting knowledge, preferably Python. 

Experience with test frameworks such as PyTest, JUnit or JavaScript-based testing tools. 

Familiarity with Jira, Freshdesk, Zendesk or other ticketing and issue-tracking platforms. 

Experience in L1 technical support, application troubleshooting or customer support. 

Exposure to ELK Stack or application log analysis. 

Experience testing microservices, APIs and integrated application workflows. 

Prior experience in TravelTech, E-commerce or B2B technology products. 

Experience & Candidate Profile

2-3 years of relevant experience as a QA Engineer, QA Analyst, Software Tester or similar role. 

Experience working on enterprise-level or customer-facing web and mobile products. 

Ideally, experience working on at least one product for 10-12 months or longer. 

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. 

Ability to think from an end-user perspective and identify scenarios that could break the application. 

Comfortable working in a fast-paced product development environment. 

Strong ownership, communication and collaboration skills. 

Willingness to learn, experiment and use AI tools to improve testing and productivity. 

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

Understand the company's products, QA processes, team structure and documentation. 

Gain an in-depth understanding of the assigned product and its workflows. 

Start independently handling assigned testing tickets and feature releases. 

Develop proficiency in analysing application logs and troubleshooting reported issues. 

Assist with technical queries and API-related walkthroughs. 

Take ownership of test documentation, impact analysis and end-to-end testing for assigned features.

data.title: Senior Automation Test Engineer (Proxmox)
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Automation Test Engineer to lead the quality assurance, verification, and automated testing strategies for our infrastructure and cloud deployment pipelines. 

In this role, your core focus will be architecting and executing robust automated testing suites-primarily utilizing Robot Framework and Python-to validate virtualized environments (Proxmox VE) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates. If you are relentless about quality engineering, passionate about CI/CD pipeline test integration, and excel at validating complex infrastructure systems before they reach production, this role is for you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Automation Framework Development: Design, build, scale, and maintain extensible automated test suites using the Robot Framework and Python to validate system integrations, network configurations, and infrastructure states. 
 - Virtualization & Cloud Verification: Formulate comprehensive test scenarios to validate performance, failover, high availability, and network isolation across Proxmox VE environments. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated test suites directly into deployment pipelines (Jenkins/GitLab CI), enabling automated quality gates, continuous testing, and immediate feedback loops. 
 - Custom Test Scripting & Tooling: Write clean, maintainable Python/Bash scripts to mock services, generate dynamic test data, inspect system health, and parse system/kernel logs for defects. 
 - Defect Analysis & Root Cause Identification: Collaborate closely with infrastructure developers and DevOps engineers to triage test failures, perform deep-dive root cause analyses, and track defects through resolution. 
 - Team Enablement & Best Practices: Foster a culture of quality within the engineering team by defining test automation standards and leading regular Friday knowledge-sharing sessions on modern QA practices and test strategies. 

Requirements

Should be Able to do -

- Test Bed Setup & Environment Readiness : Set up, configure, and maintain test beds on Proxmox VE, using Terraform and scripting (Python/Bash) to provision repeatable, version-controlled test environments, including integration with AWS/OCI where required. 
 - Test Case Execution & Conversion Execute existing test cases, analyze and refine them, and convert them into structured, automation-ready test cases with clear coverage traceability. 
 - Test Case Automation Develop, maintain, and scale automated test suites using Robot Framework (and PyTest where applicable) to validate infrastructure deployments, network configurations, and system integrations. 
 - Regression Calendar Execution & Reporting Plan and execute the agreed regression calendar, triage failures, log and track defects, and publish execution results and coverage reports to stakeholders.
