These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

About the position: 

As a Senior Product Validation Engineer, you will be part of firmware verification team that design and develop white box and grey box tests in Python to verify device firmware designs for each firmware/Product/System feature. You will be working closely with product/System architects and firmware engineers to create a comprehensive system verification test for features. In this role, you will be contributing to test strategy, test development, integrating the tests using various development platforms, deploying it on system verification lab for regression runs and perform failure analysis. The role focuses on defining and executing robust firmware/Device/system verification strategies for UCIe/AXI and custom host-device protocols across both pre‐silicon and post‐silicon environments. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborate closely with firmware engineers & architects on product architecture and designs to define the comprehensive verification plan to validate each product features
 - Design, Develop and Integrate the white box and gray box tests on products in roadmap
 - Conduct test plan reviews and code reviews to ensure the tests are scalable and meeting the requirements
 - Participate in driving failure analysis and collaborate with integration/execution engineers for test deployment. 
 - Validate designs against UCIe Specification ensuring compliance with electrical, logical, and transaction-layer requirements. 
 - Define and own firmware/System validation strategy for UCIe front-end subsystems, including resets, interrupts, Logging and error handling. 
 - Define, plan, and execute system-level validation strategies for front-end (PHY + controller) IP, back end(Controller +NAND) IP and SoC-level integration. 
 - Integrate tests into scalable automation frameworks supporting simulation, emulation, and silicon validation. 
 - Debug firmware issues, perform front-end error injection, and expose design or integration defects. 
 - Validate UCIe compliance, robustness of fault detection and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Review and verify firmware trace logs and debug telemetry for correctness and completeness. 
 - Drive validation readiness across pre‐silicon and post‐silicon platforms, ensuring alignment of firmware specs, drivers, and test collateral. 
 - Interface with cross‐functional stakeholders to ensure validation coverage meets product and customer requirements. 
 - Drive compliance and interoperability testing with various endpoints 
 - Proven expertise in defining and driving end-to-end validation strategies across simulation, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon platforms for complex SoCs and storage systems. 
 - Strong experience validating hardware IPs in pre-silicon environments (RTL simulation, SystemC/VDK, emulation, FPGA prototyping) and post-silicon environments. 
 - Possess deep understanding of Host SoC integration, firmware-hardware interactions, subsystem interoperability, and system-level debug across the complete product stack. 
 - Proficiency in high-performance/AI compute architectures, accelerator data paths, workload scheduling, and system-level performance validation

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Skills: 

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech degree in CSE/ ECE/ EEE/ IS or related field
 - In-depth knowledge of UCIe/AXI, flow control, ordering rules, error handling, power management
 - Proficiency with protocol analyzers/exercisers (Teledyne LeCroy, Keysight) etc. 
 - Experience with high‐performance storage, networking, or compute SoCs. 
 - Strong expertise in UCIe protocol, DMA, and ASIC front-end architecture. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python/C/C++ based scripting API's. 
 - Hands-on experience with error injection, fault modeling, and silicon debug tools. 
 - Familiarity with pre‐silicon (simulation/emulation) and post‐silicon lab validation flows. 
 - Solid understanding of firmware-hardware interaction and system-level debugging. 
 - Demonstrated leadership in test strategy definition, technical reviews, and mentoring. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to drive issues to closure under schedule pressure. 
 - Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and influence technical decisions. 
 - Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, C/C++, or Bash. 
 - Minimum 6 - 8 years of related experience in firmware verification or system level testing along with Gen5/Gen6 PCI-SIG protocol testing
 - Knowledge on Git, CI & source code management flow and agile development practices. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis. 
 - Collaborative and proactive communication style. 
 - Attention to detail and quality assurance mindset. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional team.

data.description:
JD - NPI & Test Automation Engineer (Electronics / Power Systems)

Role summary

The engineer owns NPI support, hardware validation and automated test system development for telecom power products, EV DC chargers and Li-ion battery packs. The role bridges R&D and production: it turns new designs into tested, production-ready products and builds the test setups that cut test time and improve repeatability on the line. 

Key responsibilities

Automated test systems (ATS) and Test Jigs

- Study schematics, rack architecture and engineering documents to define test and validation requirements. 
 - Prepare wiring diagrams and design universal ATS setups that cover multiple product or rack variants. 
 - Integrate and commission test hardware: PLCs (e. g. Siemens S7-200 Smart), relay cards, contactors, programmable DC loads (e. g. Chroma), rectifiers/SMRs and power supplies. 
 - Assemble, wire and verify test setups, then validate them against manual testing before release to production. 
 - Develop Python applications for functional test cases, real-time monitoring, data logging and Excel/report generation. 
 - Design and maintain burn-in, life-cycle and regenerative test setups for batteries and SMRs. 
 - Design simple PCBs for jigs and fixtures (cell simulators, pre-charge test, CAN splitters). New Product Introduction (NPI)

- Take part in Cross-Functional Team (CFT) reviews of design documents, specifications and customer requirements. 
 - Find design, assembly and testing issues at prototype stage and drive corrective actions with R&D. 
 - Review prototype builds, test reports and engineering documents before production release. 
 - Prepare assembly and test documents (SOPs, work instructions) for manual and automated testing. Production support and validation

- Support testing and troubleshooting of telecom power systems, EV DC fast chargers and Li-ion battery packs / BMS. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis of assembly and functional failures with Production, Quality and R&D. 
 - Suggest and implement improvements that raise test coverage, throughput and first-pass yield. Required skills

Area

What we need

Programming

Python, including hands-on test or monitoring tools; PyQt/PySide (GUI), Pandas and Matplotlib preferred

Communication protocols

CAN plus at least two of RS485, RS232, UART, SPI, I2C, Modbus

Automation hardware

PLC programming (Siemens preferred), relay/contactor logic, Arduino or similar controllers

Test equipment

Programmable DC loads, power supplies, rectifiers/SMRs, DMMs, oscilloscopes, data loggers

Electronics & power

Power electronics basics, SMPS/rectifiers, battery packs and BMS, PCB-level troubleshooting

Documentation

Wiring diagrams, test procedures, test reports, SOPs and work instructions

Tools

Git/GitLab, Excel; a PCB tool such as EasyEDA or Altium is a plus

Preferred experience

- Has built and deployed at least one automated test station (ATS) or test jig that is running in production. 
 - NPI experience: prototype reviews, production validation and handover from R&D to manufacturing. 
 - Domain exposure to telecom power systems (48V DC power plants, SMRs), EV DC fast chargers or Li-ion battery packs and BMS. 
 - Experience with regenerative or energy-saving test setups, burn-in and life-cycle testing. 
 - Track record of cutting test or analysis time through automation (with numbers). Behavioural competencies

- Works well in cross-functional teams with R&D, Quality and Production. 
 - Takes ownership from requirement study through to production deployment. 
 - Methodical problem solver; uses root-cause analysis, not trial and error. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including documentation for operators. 
 - Adapts quickly to new products and shifting priorities on the shop floor. Must-have

Good-to-have

B. E. /B. Tech in Electronics, Electrical or Instrumentation

Instrumentation & Control background

2-3 years in hardware testing, test automation or NPI

Telecom power, EV charger or Li-ion battery/BMS industry

Python used for real test or data-logging tools

PyQt/PySide GUI and Pandas/Matplotlib reporting

Hands-on CAN plus one serial protocol (RS485/RS232/UART)

SPI, I2C, Modbus

PLC or relay/contactor-based automation they built themselves

Siemens S7 PLC experience

Regenerative / burn-in test setups; basic PCB design

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust
data.description:
Senior Rust Software Engineer (Desktop Native)

Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" - we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Senior Rust Engineer on the Desktop Native team, you will own desktop autofill and native OS integrations, including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration, built on the same cross-platform Rust SDK that also powers browser autofill. This role is primarily for someone strong in Rust, FFI and language bindings, and native OS-level integration on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with the unusual challenge of delivering secure, reliable native experiences on top of a zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted product. This is not primarily a front-end or UI role. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Design, build, and maintain native desktop integrations including the SSH agent, Autotype, native passkeys, and the DuckDuckGo integration
 - Participate in the hands-on design, development, and evolution of the shared Rust SDK, including language bindings and FFI, consumed across desktop and browser clients
 - Interface directly with OS-level APIs on Windows, macOS, and Linux to deliver reliable native behavior. 
 - Improve performance, reliability, security, and maintainability of native integrations handling sensitive credential data. 
 - Partner with product, design, QA, and the Autofill team to deliver high-quality experiences end to end. 
 - Review pull requests and help raise the quality of native/systems engineering, including community contributions in GitHub. 
 - Identify technical debt and contribute to pragmatic refactoring and architecture improvements to the Desktop Native roadmap
 - Participate in code reviews, learning, and spreading technical knowledge
 - Independently plan, estimate, and deliver new feature work and bug fixes
 - Occasionally review & approve bug fixes submitted by the user community

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

- Strong production Rust experience - 4-6+ years overall backend/systems experience, including FFI and language bindings
 - Native desktop application experience, interfacing directly with OS-level APIs on Windows, macOS, or Linux
 - Experience designing and versioning cross-platform SDKs or shared libraries consumed by multiple client surfaces
 - Experience using AI tooling in your development and testing workflow (Anthropic Claude preferred)
 - Experience with Electron, TypeScript, and other web tech for cross-platform desktop applications and web clients is a plus
 - Collaborative and adaptable mindset
 - Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
 - Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills - you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

WHY WORK WITH US

- Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 
 - Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. 
 - We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world. 
 - Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development. 
 - At Bitwarden, we are passionate about what we do, but not necessarily everything we do. Our engineering team makes it a policy to carve out some time for personal growth, learning, skill building and pursuing personal passions that positively impact the team and company. To ensure that everyone has time to reaffirm their purpose and grow, you are encouraged to self-direct up to 15% of your week to what you feel is important for the company and for yourself. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

data.title: R&D Engineer, IP Quality
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You are someone who gets a quiet satisfaction from finding the bug no one else caught, from writing a script that saves the team three hours a week, from seeing a pattern in test data that points to something fixable. You do not just run tests, you think about what they mean and what they are missing. You know that quality is not something you inspect in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start. 

Scripting is not a chore for you. Whether it is Python or Tcl, you see automation as a way to make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human. You are comfortable sitting with a dataset, pulling it apart, and surfacing the insight that changes how the team approaches the next release cycle. 

You are early in your career but already understand that good engineering is about details, follow-through, and clear communication. You ask questions when something does not make sense. You document what you learn. You show up ready to contribute, not just observe. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the quality work you do here will matter. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Coordinate kickoff and release meetings with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and process alignment throughout development and verification. 
 - Run regression test suites on Embedded Memory IP releases and track results across validation cycles. 
 - Analyze test data to surface trends, flag anomalies, and identify root causes of failures or quality gaps. 
 - Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that streamline testing, reporting, and compliance workflows. 
 - Document test outcomes, process gaps, and improvement recommendations in clear, actionable formats. 
 - Support the team in refining Quality Management System processes based on real-world validation feedback. 

The Impact You Will Have

- Deliver zero-defect Embedded Memory IP to customers by catching issues before they reach production. 
 - Enable faster, more reliable releases through automation that reduces manual testing overhead. 
 - Surface data-driven insights that help engineering teams make better decisions about where to focus next. 
 - Strengthen the Quality Management System so every release cycle is more efficient than the last. 
 - Support the development of IP on advanced technology nodes that power AI, mobile, and smart device applications. 
 - Build a foundation of quality practices that scale as the product portfolio grows. 

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 0 to 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role. 
 - Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation. 
 - Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, you notice when something is off and you dig into why. 

Who You Are

- You can take a messy test log, pull out what matters, and explain it to someone who was not in the room. 
 - You are comfortable working across teams, coordinating meetings, and making sure people have what they need to stay on track. 
 - You do not wait to be told what to automate, you see repetitive work and you build a script for it. 
 - You are adaptable and do not get thrown when priorities shift or requirements change mid-cycle. 
 - You care about doing things right, not just fast, and you are willing to ask for clarity when the path forward is not obvious. 

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of a highly skilled, dynamic team focused on defining and executing processes and methodology for Quality Management of Embedded Memories. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and are committed to continuous learning and improvement, fostering an environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer specializing in Middleware, you will focus on testing applications and systems, ensuring they meet requirements and function as intended. You will utilize your expertise in Service Oriented Architecture, WebServices, and Middleware integration concepts to deliver high-quality solutions. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Test Scenarios and Cases: Create comprehensive test scenarios and cases to verify system functionality and identify potential issues. This involves understanding and managing inter-application dependencies and developing environment availability and refresh plans. 
 - Execute Testing Protocols: Perform functional and non-functional testing at the component integration layers, invoking application interfaces using integration protocols such as WebServices, MQ, JMS, and RMI. 
 - Manage Environment Tasks: Oversee day-to-day environment management tasks, ensuring seamless testing operations and minimizing downtime. 
 - Verify System Requirements: Confirm that the system is built according to requirements, identifying and reporting any discrepancies or defects. 
 - Implement Test Cases for SOA: Design and execute test cases specifically for Service Oriented Architecture, ensuring its successful integration with other systems. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Middleware Integration Expertise: Experience with Service Oriented Architecture, WebServices, and Middleware integration concepts, including functional and non-functional testing at the component integration layers. 
 - Testing Protocol Knowledge: Experience with invocation of application interfaces using integration protocols such as WebServices, MQ, JMS, and RMI. 
 - Test Scenario Development: Experience with developing comprehensive test scenarios and cases to verify system functionality and identify potential issues. 
 - Environment Management: Experience with managing day-to-day environment management tasks, including environment availability and refresh plans. 
 - Component Integration Testing: Experience with performing functional and non-functional testing at the component integration layers, understanding and managing inter-application dependencies. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Middleware Integration Exposure: Exposure to additional middleware technologies and protocols, such as Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or IBM Integration Bus, can be beneficial in this role. 
 - Advanced Testing Methodologies: Familiarity with advanced testing methodologies, such as Test-Driven Development (TDD) or Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), can enhance testing efficiency and effectiveness.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. 

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights. 

How Will You Drive Impact

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes. 

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

- Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins. 
 - Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices. 
 - Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team. 

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

- Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers. 
 - Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production. 
 - Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems - including reconciliation checks - to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions. 
 - Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions. 

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

- Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions. 
 - Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit. 
 - Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability. 
 - Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction. 

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

- Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team - identifying dependencies and escalating risks early. 
 - Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes. 
 - Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery. 
 - Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement. 

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to: 

- Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
 - Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
 - Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
 - Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

- 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated senior-level technical depth and independent ownership of testing in an Agile engineering team. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks and reliable test suites, with strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (Java or Go also valued) and comfort working across languages. 
 - Practical experience using AI in test automation workflows - including LLM-assisted test and test-data generation, agentic/MCP-based automation, testing AI/LLM-powered features, or AI self-healing and visual testing tools - with concrete examples of improved coverage, faster delivery, or reduced maintenance effort and the ability to explain how generated tests were reviewed and validated. 
 - Strong understanding of shift-left testing, continuous testing, risk-based test planning, and the appropriate balance of unit, component, integration, and end-to-end coverage, combined with experience with API automation for REST and/or gRPC services and web automation frameworks such as Playwright (preferred), Selenium, or WebdriverIO. 
 - Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for test data preparation and validation, with the ability to investigate data consistency issues across integrated systems and diagnose failures using logs and API responses. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, working with Git-based code review (GitHub/GitLab), and testing in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, alongside familiarity with test case management and API testing tools such as TestRail and Postman. 
 - Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with developers and product managers, prioritize independently, and communicate quality risks with supporting evidence; prior experience in Supply Chain Management (SCM) and/or FinTech/Payments domains, or with ERP systems and their integrations, is strongly preferred. 

WORK LOCATION

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team. 

About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses - Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios - maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem - connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport - delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players' associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7, 000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2, 000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22, 000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience. 

About The Team

Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally - as well as its flagship site, www. fanatics. com. 

Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world-including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).

Title : Senior Engineering Manager

Direct reports: Principal Domain Engineers; Associate Engineering Managers

The Senior Engineering Manager owns the engineering capability for Customer Platforms, including the engineering standards, practices, tooling and technical context that every engineer and AI agent operates within. The role is established to bridge and unify two software development lifecycles: the squad lifecycle, where engineers build to specifications, and the AI-native lifecycle, where specifications and code are agent-generated with engineers providing human-in-the-loop review before production commit. 

By establishing a single, high standard of engineering across both delivery models, the role enables Officeworks to progressively transition toward an AI-native engineering capability. It ensures that high technical quality, architectural compliance and operational delivery are maintained without dropping performance during the transition. 

In this role you will: 

Engineering Standards and Practice: 

- Own engineering standards, technical practices and code quality across every team, ensuring consistent application regardless of delivery construct. 
 - Set and hold teams accountable to the human-in-the-loop review standard applied prior to production code commits. 
 - Approve significant technical decisions and manage ongoing engineering technical risk across Customer Platforms. 
 - Own the engineering toolchain, developer experience and development environments to ensure efficiency and delivery stability. 

AI Tooling Adoption and Agent Workflow Consistency: 

- Drive and enforce the team's adoption of AI tooling, ensuring consistent use of the latest tooling and agent workflow approaches across all engineering work. 
 - Establish agent workflow standards and maintain the technical context framework within which AI agents operate. 
 - Evaluate emerging engineering tools and AI practices to determine adoption roadmaps and timing. 
 - Measure and evidence engineering productivity and throughput uplift against established baseline metrics. 

Quality Inside Engineering and QA Responsibilities: 

- Lead the integration of quality assurance directly into engineering workflows as QA responsibilities transition into the engineering team. 
 - Drive the execution, oversight, and governance of test development, test execution, and comprehensive defect metrics across all delivery channels. 
 - Maintain code quality standards for agent-generated output and cultivate rigorous review discipline across the engineering cohort. 
 - Drive root-cause investigation when agent outputs fail or drift, feeding learnings back into technical context to prevent reoccurrence.

At Freshworks, we don't just ship software-we shape it to be fast, reliable, and refreshingly simple. You will lead cross-functional technical strategies, champion engineering excellence across teams, and mentor engineers to level up our entire platform ecosystem. 

If you obsess over time and space complexity, love breaking down tough, multi-tier architectural problems, and take pride in leading technical execution without losing touch with the code-you'll feel right at home. 

Impact You Can Create

- E2E Platform Evolution: Own and scale foundational full-stack architectures capable of handling millions of transactions while delivering seamless, high-performance web experiences globally. 

- Technical Guidance (IC4): Act as a technical compass across multiple engineering tracks, translating ambiguous product visions into resilient, modular high-level and low-level designs.

Roles & Responsibilities (R&R)

- Full Lifecycle Ownership: Own the entire software development lifecycle-from gathering functional/non-functional requirements and data modeling to deployment, automation, and production support.

Qualifications

Skills

- Computer Science Foundations: Expert-level grasp of Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), time/space complexity trade-offs, and Object-Oriented Design (OOD) anchored in SOLID principles. 

- System Design (HLD & LLD): Proven capability to design scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant end-to-end multi-tenant systems, including APIs, web architectures, schemas, and data models. 

- Distributed Infrastructure Stack: Solid exposure to RDBMS, NoSQL, caching strategies, microservices architecture, and distributed queuing systems. 

- Modern Web Ecosystems: Strong understanding of frontend engineering paradigms, including component lifecycles, state management, and client-side performance optimization. 

- Cloud & DevOps Practice: Hands-on experience working with CI/CD automation pipelines, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS or GCP). 

- AI Tool Fluency: Practical exposure and experience using generative AI tools to improve day-to-day coding efficiency and technical exploration. 

- Technical Communication: Exceptional logical reasoning with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical thought processes and designs to both engineers and executives. 

Qualifications

- Professional Timeline: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience building and scaling full-stack applications in high-growth product teams. 

- Iterative Sourcing History: A proven track record of building complex systems from scratch and steering them through multiple scale iterations in production. 

- Pragmatic Delivery: Skilled at balancing rapid feature delivery with long-term code maintainability, clean documentation, and scalability. 

- Collaborative Leadership: Experience managing technical initiatives, coordinating cross-functional engineering loops, and mentoring other engineers.

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. data.title: Technical Architect – Application Design & AI Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 12-15 years

Primary Areas: Application Architecture, Enterprise & Cloud Architecture, AI-Assisted Software Engineering, Quality Engineering

Primary Stack: Python/Django, Go/Gin, Angular/TypeScript, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure, Docker, Terraform, Playwright

Role Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Architect to define and evolve the application architecture of Nextpower's engineering and business platforms. 

The role will focus on designing scalable, maintainable, and secure applications across the full technology stack, including domain models, APIs, services, user interfaces, data stores, integrations, and deployment environments. 

The architect will also establish practical guidelines for AI-assisted software development, helping teams use AI tools to improve productivity while maintaining strong standards for design quality, security, testing, maintainability, and responsible use. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role that works closely with product management, engineering, QA, DevOps, security, and subject-matter experts. The role remains hands-on in complex or high-risk areas through design reviews, prototypes, reference implementations, and critical code reviews. 

Key Responsibilities

Application Architecture and Design

- Define target application architectures, reference architectures, and reusable design patterns. 
 - Design end-to-end solutions covering domain models, business services, APIs, user interfaces, persistence, integrations, security, and deployment. 
 - Establish standards for modular application design, service boundaries, API contracts, error handling, configuration, and versioning. 
 - Review major application designs for functional suitability, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational supportability. 
 - Guide teams in selecting appropriate architectural styles, including modular monoliths, microservices, event-driven components, and workflow-based solutions. 
 - Identify architectural risks, design inconsistencies, and technical debt, and drive practical remediation plans. 
 - Remain hands-on through prototypes, proof-of-concepts, reference implementations, and targeted development in uncertain or high-risk areas. 

AI-Assisted Software Engineering

- Define guidelines for the responsible and effective use of AI coding assistants and generative AI tools across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Establish recommended practices for AI-assisted requirements analysis, architecture, coding, testing, documentation, code review, and troubleshooting. 
 - Define quality gates and review expectations for AI-generated or AI-assisted code. 
 - Develop reusable prompts, templates, coding patterns, architectural context, and development workflows that improve consistency and engineering productivity. 
 - Guide teams in using AI to generate and maintain unit tests, API tests, UI tests, documentation, migration scripts, and technical designs. 
 - Define guardrails for security, privacy, intellectual property, licensing, data handling, and human oversight when using AI tools. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI development tools and recommend their adoption where they provide measurable engineering value. 
 - Measure the impact of AI-assisted development on delivery speed, quality, test coverage, maintainability, and developer experience. 

Engineering and Quality Standards

- Set standards for architecture, APIs, authentication and authorization, observability, testing, CI/CD, configuration, and deployment. 
 - Establish expectations for automated unit, integration, API, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Partner with QA and engineering teams to improve testability, regression coverage, and production confidence. 
 - Promote design-for-quality practices, including validation, resilience, diagnosability, performance, and backward compatibility. 
 - Run architecture reviews, critical code reviews, and technical design discussions. 
 - Define and promote engineering practices that reduce defects and prevent the accumulation of technical debt. 

Technical Leadership

- Drive technical alignment across teams and resolve cross-team dependencies. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, constraints, and risks to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads in application design, cloud architecture, software quality, and AI-assisted development. 
 - Collaborate with product management to assess technical feasibility, delivery risks, and sequencing of major initiatives. 
 - Escalate significant technical, security, reliability, and operational risks. 
 - Maintain practical architecture documentation, decision records, standards, and reference implementations. 

Required Skills And Experience

- 12-15 years of experience in enterprise software engineering, with significant experience in application architecture and technical leadership. 
 - Strong experience designing end-to-end business applications and platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of domain modeling, modular design, service boundaries, API-first development, integration patterns, and distributed systems. 
 - Hands-on backend development experience with Python/Django/DRF and/or Go/Gin. 
 - Strong frontend architecture experience with Angular and TypeScript; working knowledge of React is a plus. 
 - Experience designing relational data models, indexes, queries, and persistence strategies using MySQL and PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience with Redis for caching, distributed coordination, or queue-based processing. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, API versioning, asynchronous processing, event-driven systems, and workflow orchestration. 
 - Experience with authentication and authorization standards, including OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC, and secure secret management. 
 - Strong Azure experience, including Container Apps, Functions, Key Vault, storage, networking, identity, and monitoring. 
 - Experience with Docker, Terraform, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD automation. 
 - Experience with observability, logging, metrics, tracing, performance analysis, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Demonstrated ability to use or establish AI-assisted software development practices, including code generation, test generation, design assistance, and documentation workflows. 
 - Ability to assess AI-generated output critically and apply appropriate human review and quality controls. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience building shared engineering platforms, frameworks, libraries, or developer-productivity tooling used by multiple teams. 
 - Experience defining engineering playbooks, architecture standards, coding guidelines, or development governance. 
 - Experience implementing AI-enabled developer workflows or internal engineering assistants. 
 - Experience with agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation, tool-calling agents, or enterprise AI application patterns. 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture, message queues, and workflow orchestration. 
 - Experience with Playwright or other modern UI automation frameworks. 
 - Experience working closely with product, QA, DevOps, security, and enterprise architecture teams. 
 - Experience modernizing legacy applications incrementally while continuing feature delivery.

data.title: Senior Privacy Engineer – Automation & Data Mapping
data.description:
Job Description

The Senior Privacy Operations Engineer bridges privacy compliance and technical implementation, architecting, building, and maintaining the tooling, automation, and data infrastructure that powers the company's global privacy program across UK/EU, US, APAC, and other regions. This role works closely with engineering and product teams to operationalize privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default requirements, and owns the technical backbone connecting privacy management platforms (e. g. , OneTrust), work-management systems (e. g. , Azure DevOps, Jira), and the organization's broader data and cloud infrastructure. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role requiring both strong technical depth and working knowledge of global privacy regulatory concepts. 

Key Responsibilities

Privacy Automation Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain automation for privacy operations workflows, including data subject rights fulfillment, data discovery, data mapping, and privacy assessment triggering. 
 - Build and maintain API and Power Automate integrations between privacy management platforms (e. g. , OneTrust) and internal systems (ticketing/ADO/Jira, identity, data stores), including field mapping, assignment logic, bi-directional status sync, and error handling/logging so systems do not drift apart. 
 - Implement risk-based conditional logic and trigger workflows for privacy assessments (PIAs/DPIAs/TIAs) tied to intake or procurement systems, including escalation paths for high-risk triggers and governance/audit trails over the trigger rules themselves. 
 - Design and maintain automated redaction and exception-flagging pipelines (e. g. , keyword/pattern matching, ML classifiers) for DSAR fulfillment, ensuring a mandatory human-review checkpoint before release and maintaining an audit log of redaction decisions. 

Data Mapping & ROPA Infrastructure

- Build and maintain an automated, event-driven data flow inventory and data mapping pipeline, tied to system/vendor intake and procurement processes rather than periodic manual surveys. 
 - Build and maintain integrations with data discovery and classification tooling (e. g. , OneTrust Data Discovery, BigID, Collibra, AWS Macie, Azure Purview, database crawlers) to automatically feed classifications and data flows into ROPA records. 
 - Implement drift-detection mechanisms that reconcile ROPA records against discovery/mapping tool outputs, and support metrics such as percentage of ROPA records reviewed within a defined window. 
 - Support technical aspects of privacy impact assessments, including data flow diagrams and system/architecture review. 

Privacy-by-Design Engineering & Product Collaboration

- Partner with engineering and product teams to implement privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default controls within products and internal systems. 
 - Assist in the technical implementation of data retention and deletion requirements across structured and unstructured data sources. 
 - Advise engineering teams on technical architecture considerations for new products and features from a privacy and data protection perspective. 

Program Tooling, Reporting & Observability

- Build and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting pipelines (e. g. , ADO Analytics, Power BI) that translate raw work-item and automation data into executive-ready privacy program metrics (DSAR SLA compliance, assessment backlog, incident response times). 
 - Monitor and report on the health of privacy tooling and automated processes, troubleshooting integration or data-quality issues as they arise. 
 - Maintain governance over report definitions and automation/trigger rule changes so metrics and workflows remain consistent and trustworthy over time. 

DSAR & Assessment Automation at Scale

- Design and maintain automated routing of DSAR tasks with data-owner mapping across multiple systems, SLA tracking tied to statutory deadlines, and tiered escalation as deadlines approach. 
 - Build scalable automation and surge-capacity mechanisms (triage automation, templated responses) to support DSAR volume spikes, incorporating lessons learned into ongoing process improvements. 
 - Support automation of assessment intake quality, including conditional required fields, real-time validation, and automated reminders to reduce incomplete submissions. 

Required Qualifications

- 5-7 years of experience in a data engineering, software engineering, or technical privacy/compliance engineering role, ideally supporting privacy or compliance operations at a global or multinational organization. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (e. g. , Python, SQL) and demonstrated experience building and maintaining API integrations and automated workflows (e. g. , Power Automate, custom scripts, middleware). 
 - Hands-on experience building integrations between privacy management platforms (e. g. , OneTrust, BigID, Collibra) and internal systems (ticketing/ADO/Jira, identity, data stores), including field mapping, assignment logic, and bi-directional status sync with error handling. 
 - Experience designing and maintaining automated data discovery and data mapping pipelines across structured and unstructured data sources (e. g. , AWS Macie, Azure Purview, database crawlers) that feed ROPA records. 
 - Experience implementing risk-based conditional logic and trigger workflows for privacy assessments (PIA/DPIA/TIA) tied to intake or procurement systems. 
 - Experience building reporting/analytics pipelines (e. g. , ADO Analytics, Power BI) that translate raw operational data into KPI dashboards for privacy program leadership. 
 - Solid understanding of core privacy concepts (data minimization, purpose limitation, data subject rights, retention) and global privacy regulations (UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, or similar) as applied to technical system design. 
 - Experience working with structured and unstructured data across multiple systems and cloud environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with privacy management platforms (e. g. , OneTrust, BigID, Collibra) and their APIs/connector frameworks. 
 - CIPT certification. 
 - Experience with cloud data infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including native discovery/classification services (e. g. , Macie, Purview). 
 - Experience building automated redaction/exception-flagging pipelines with tuned accuracy and governed human-review checkpoints. 
 - Experience supporting DSAR automation at scale, including SLA tracking/escalation design and volume-spike scaling strategies. 
 - Experience designing event-driven data mapping architectures integrated with CMDB/asset inventory or cloud discovery tooling. 

Skills & Competencies

- Strong systems-design thinking with the ability to balance automation against defensibility and risk 
 - Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global engineering, legal, and privacy teams 
 - Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across integrated systems 
 - Adaptability to evolving regulatory and technical requirements 
 - Clear communication skills to translate technical architecture into terms non-technical privacy and legal stakeholders can act on

What's in it For You?

- Hybrid Work Model: We've adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected. 
 - Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.

data.title: Sr. Engineer - Product Design Validation(Testing & V&V)
data.description:
Position Summary

Product Validation, a global function within Milacron's Technology & Innovation organization, is seeking a results-oriented Senior Engineer. The role will plan and execute validation of injection molding machines, systems, subsystems, and critical components to verify functional performance, reliability, durability, safety, regulatory compliance, and readiness for production release. The Senior Engineer will convert product and design requirements into robust validation plans, acquire and analyze test data, identify design risks and failure mechanisms, and provide evidence-based recommendations to Engineering, Controls, Application, Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Product Management, and Service teams. 

Essential/Key Functions Of The Job

Keeping product performance, consistency, safety, and reliability at the core, the Senior Engineer - Product Validation will perform the following responsibilities: 

- Collaborate with NPD, Product Engineering, Controls/Electronics, Application, Quality, Manufacturing, Service, and Product Management teams to understand product requirements and translate them into a clear Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R), test matrix, instrumentation plan, acceptance criteria, schedule, and resource requirement. 
 - Review technical specifications, drawings, hydraulic and electrical schematics, control sequences, DFMEA outputs, risk assessments, customer requirements, and lessons learned to ensure adequate validation coverage and traceability. 
 - Plan, set up, and execute functional, performance, endurance, reliability, thermal, hydraulic, electrical, structural, noise, vibration, energy-consumption, safety, and application trials on complete machines, systems, subsystems, and components. 
 - Perform testing in accordance with applicable Milacron procedures and relevant standards such as EUROMAP, ISO, EN, IEC, UL/NFPA, and customer-specific requirements, as applicable to the product and market. 
 - Define instrumentation and acquire synchronized test data using calibrated pressure, temperature, flow, force, strain, displacement, vibration, speed, electrical power, current, voltage, and other sensors together with suitable DAQ systems. 
 - Set up and operate DAQ and test data analysis platforms such as HBK QuantumX/Catman or Siemens Simcenter Testlab or National Instruments LabVIEW, or equivalent tools; ensure correct sampling, sensor configuration, signal conditioning, filtering, time synchronization, and data integrity. 
 - Analyze test data using time-domain, frequency-domain, statistical, trend, correlation, cycle-counting, fatigue, thermal, hydraulic, and performance methods; convert results into clear engineering conclusions and actionable design recommendations. 
 - Evaluate machine performance parameters such as cycle time, platen movement, injection speed and pressure, repeatability, energy consumption, temperature stability, hydraulic pressure and flow, clamp force, vibration, deflection, strain, and subsystem response against approved acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of failures using methods such as 5 Why, Ishikawa, fault-tree analysis, design-of-experiments, comparative testing, teardown inspection, and correlation with simulation or field data. 
 - Work with responsible design owners to define corrective actions, verify fixes through re-testing, document residual risks, and support technical closure before design or product release. 
 - Apply DFMEA, reliability science, accelerated life testing, duty-cycle analysis, Weibull/life-data concepts, and test-to-failure approaches, where appropriate, to assess robustness and predict product or component life. 
 - Develop repeatable validation methods, fixtures, test rigs, automation scripts, templates, checklists, and standard work to improve laboratory capability, data quality, test efficiency, and global consistency. 
 - Create concise validation reports containing objective, configuration, instrumentation, procedure, raw and processed data, acceptance criteria, observations, deviations, photographs, conclusions, risks, and recommendations; maintain complete data and configuration traceability. 
 - Maintain validation schedules, test logs, issue trackers, calibration records, equipment utilization, and regular visibility of progress, risks, and decisions to Product Chief Engineers, Product Validation leadership, and relevant stakeholders. 
 - Support benchmarking of competitor machines and assessment of NPD products to generate performance evidence for product strategy, product management, sales, and customer-facing technical discussions without compromising test integrity. 
 - Travel to customer and supplier sites for field validation, critical issue resolution, component trials, supplier development, and pre-validation activities, with appropriate planning, safety controls, and documentation. 
 - Partner with Sourcing and Supplier Quality to evaluate new suppliers, alternate components, localization opportunities, and new technologies through qualification plans, first-article testing, and performance/reliability validation. 
 - Maintain calibration and functional readiness of instruments, sensors, DAQ systems, fixtures, and laboratory equipment; identify capability gaps and raise justified requests for tools, sensors, software, training, and infrastructure. 

Eligibility/Required Qualifications

- Total experience at least 5-7years in field of testing, validation, R&D in the machinery industries (for example but not limited to, Injection molding machineries, Automotive & sister industries, Hydraulic industry, Steel, Heavy machineries) with high/standard production volume. 
 - Bachelor of engineering degree (BE/BTech min required qualification) in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Instrumentations, Control & automation, Electronics, or similar engineering discipline from an accredited 4-year college or university. 
 - Good analytical skills are required to drive the functional needs from product performance & reliability. 
 - Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in product testing, validation, reliability, R&D testing, or test engineering within injection molding machinery, industrial machinery, automotive, hydraulics, heavy equipment, machine tools, or a comparable engineered-product industry. 
 - Demonstrated ability to develop validation plans, define measurable acceptance criteria, execute complex tests, analyze data, and produce release-quality technical reports. 
 - Hands-on experience with measurement of pressure, flow, temperature, force, strain, stress, vibration, displacement, speed, electrical parameters, and other machine-performance variables. 
 - Hands-on experience with DAQ systems and software such as Siemens Simcenter Testlab, HBK QuantumX/Catman, NI LabVIEW, nCode, or equivalent platforms, including sensor selection, signal conditioning, sampling, filtering, and data management. 
 - Working knowledge of hydraulics, electrical and electronic systems, sensors, instrumentation, servo systems, controls, mechanical structures, thermal systems, and machinery safety. 
 - Ability to read and interpret hydraulic and electrical schematics, general arrangement drawings, manufacturing drawings, layouts, specifications, control sequences, and engineering BOMs. 
 - Experience applying DFMEA, DVP&R, root-cause analysis, reliability methods, accelerated testing, and statistical analysis to support successful product launches and resolution of field or laboratory failures. 
 - Working knowledge of applicable machinery validation and safety standards or internal engineering standards, based on product and market requirements. 
 - Strong analytical judgment, troubleshooting ability, attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and ownership of test accuracy and data integrity. 
 - Proficient written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain test evidence, technical risks, and recommendations to engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Ability to manage multiple validation assignments, prioritize laboratory resources, work independently with periodic guidance, and travel to customer or supplier sites when required. 

Who We Are

Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company's 1, 900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27, 000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron's global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America. 

Eeo

The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron. com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. 
 - Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. 
 - Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks-operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. 
 - Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. 
 - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. 
 - Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering-together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
 - Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate-and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 
 - 5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/. NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks. 
 - 3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems-defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging-e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk. 
 - 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI-plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management. 
 - Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production-their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side. 
 - Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e. g. , LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e. g. , Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution). 
 - Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. 
 - Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e. g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale. 
 - Platform admin for reporting Tools: Tableau, Qlik SaaS, ETL tools : Informatica IICS/MDM, SAP BODS, BOE or SLT

Databricks, AWS cloud practitioner

Other: 

- Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. 
 - Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

data.title: Principal Emulation IP Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. Sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe does not faze you. You walk out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. Ask the right questions, push back when something does not make sense, and move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high-speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high-performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best-in-class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work. You read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - Mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification comes naturally to you, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Job Description

What You Will Do
