The company serves a diverse range of industrial clients that rely on high-quality, precision-engineered metal components. Metal Profiles focuses on robust manufacturing processes and continuous improvement to meet demanding quality and performance standards. Team members benefit from exposure to advanced production techniques and quality systems in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment. 
Role Description The Manufacturing Quality Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Indore. This role is responsible for overseeing all quality-related activities on the shop floor, including monitoring production processes, implementing quality standards, and ensuring compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. Day-to-day tasks include establishing and maintaining quality control procedures, leading root cause analysis for defects, coordinating corrective and preventive actions, and managing internal and external quality audits. The Manufacturing Quality Manager collaborates closely with production, engineering, and supplier management teams to drive continuous improvement and reduce non-conformities. The role also involves training team members on quality best practices, maintaining documentation, and reporting key quality metrics to leadership. 
Qualifications

- Strong skills in Quality Control and Quality Assurance to monitor processes and ensure product conformity. 
 - Experience in Quality Management and Quality Auditing to develop systems, conduct audits, and maintain standards. 
 - Knowledge of Supplier Quality to evaluate, approve, and continuously improve supplier performance. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical field; advanced certifications in quality (e. g. , ISO, Six Sigma) are an advantage. 
 - Proficiency in using quality tools such as root cause analysis, CAPA, SPC, and control plans. 
 - Experience in metal fabrication or component manufacturing environments is highly beneficial. 
 - Ability to analyze data, prepare reports, and communicate clearly with cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and capability to lead and coach team members on quality practices.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
data.description:
About RocketlaneRocketlane is a B2B SaaS platform for client onboarding and project delivery. Our product runs on a set of microservices that power projects, resourcing, time tracking, billing and a customer-facing portal. We're also building Nitro, an AI-native layer where Nitro agents do real delivery work for our customers. 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test who can test both: the core platform, and the GenAI and agentic features we build on top of it. 

This is not a "run the regression suite and file tickets" role. You'll own quality for the areas you cover, from functional testing to automation to release sign-off. 

What you'll own
 - Functional testing: Understand features end to end, from requirements to edge cases. Write test plans and test cases, and run exploratory testing before every release. 

- UI and end-to-end automation: Build and maintain Playwright suites in TypeScript for critical user journeys. Keep them fast, stable and free of flaky tests. 

- API and microservices testing: Test REST APIs and the contracts between services. Cover authentication, permissions, data validation and error handling. 

- Distributed systems testing: Test asynchronous flows, background jobs and event-driven workflows across services. Check for data consistency, retries, idempotency and behaviour when a downstream service fails or slows down. 

- Performance and reliability: Run load and performance tests on key services and workflows. Find bottlenecks before customers do. 

- GenAI and agentic testing: Test Nitro agents and other GenAI features for accuracy, consistency and safe behaviour. Build eval suites, curate test datasets from real scenarios, and check tool-use accuracy and handoff to humans. 

- CI/CD and release quality: Wire automated suites into CI so every change is checked before it ships. Provide quality sign-off for the areas you cover. 

- Frameworks and documentation: Enhance our existing test frameworks and tools. Document test strategies, test cases and guidelines for the team. 

Requirements
 - 4-7 years in software testing and test automation for web applications

- Strong programming skills in TypeScript, Java or Python for test automation

- Solid programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design, applied to writing clean, maintainable test code

- Hands-on experience with Playwright or Selenium for UI and end-to-end testing, including building and maintaining a framework

- Strong functional testing skills: breaking down requirements, writing test cases and finding edge cases

- Experience testing REST APIs and microservices, including service-to-service contracts

- A good understanding of distributed systems: async processing, queues or events, eventual consistency and partial failures, and how to test for them

- Exposure to testing GenAI or agentic features, and an understanding of how they fail (hallucination, non-deterministic output, tool misuse)

- CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Daily use of AI coding agents, and the judgement to review the test code they write

- Excellent written communication: bug reports an engineer can act on without a meeting

Nice to have
 - Experience with an LLM eval framework (such as DeepEval, Promptfoo or RAGAS)

- Load testing experience (k6, Locust or similar)

- Security testing experience, including for AI applications

Why this roleYou'll join a team that already tests and automates our platform and AI features, and help raise the bar as both grow. You'll work across the full product: core workflows, the services behind them, and the Nitro agents built on top. You'll work directly with the engineers and PMs building them, and your quality sign-off is a key input to every release. If you want to grow from strong product testing into AI testing, this role is for you.

Description

Great People Work Here. 

BizTX: Co-Creating WOW Through Digital Innovation

It's an exciting time to be part of BizTX at Twinings Ovaltine. At the heart of this iconic brand, we're on a mission to drive exponential growth and productivity through cutting-edge technology to transform the business globally.

Role Purpose: 
To create one clear infrastructure roadmap across cloud and hosting, networks, workplace, site and manufacturing technology, resilience and automation as well as roadmap into a prioritised, funded programme of projects and lead delivery from business case and initiation through execution, go-live, benefits realisation and transition to operations. 

Scope: Global infrastructure strategy, standards, operational performance, site infrastructure and end-to-end delivery of the infrastructure project portfolio. 

Travel: Occasional international travel required. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own and evolve the Global Infrastructure Strategy and Roadmap, aligned to business priorities and the BizTX technology strategy. 
 - Own the end-to-end global infrastructure project portfolio, including demand intake, prioritisation, business cases, funding, resource planning, delivery governance and benefits realisation. 
 - Translate the roadmap into a sequenced annual and multi-year project plan covering cloud, hosting, networks, workplace, sites, manufacturing and operational technology (OT), resilience, lifecycle and automation. 
 - Ensure every project has clear sponsorship, accountable project leadership, scope, outcomes, architecture, budget, resources, milestones, dependencies, risks and stage-gate approvals. 
 - Lead infrastructure portfolio reviews and provide concise executive reporting on project health, budget, schedule, risks, decisions, capacity and benefits. 
 - Hold direct accountability for infrastructure operations, lifecycle, resilience, investment planning and project delivery across UK and India sites. 
 - Directly lead the UK Site Infrastructure Lead and India Site Infrastructure Lead(s), setting clear priorities, objectives, accountabilities and performance expectations.

 - Monitor adoption of global standards, govern justified exceptions, identify technical debt and agree remediation plans with geography and site leadership.

A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement. The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing, and sits within the AI team as a key quality authority. 

Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain scalable, repeatable evaluation datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to measure agent performance, robustness, safety, and alignment (e. g. , faithfulness, hallucination, prompt injection resistance). 

Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test agents under diverse real-world conditions, specifically for agents utilizing Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e. g. , Vertex AI, Gemini models). 

Develop and execute adversarial testing, jailbreaking, and red-teaming methodologies to identify potential harm, bias, toxicity, and unauthorized behavior in agent responses. 

Implement and measure adherence to established ethical guidelines, safety policies, and content-filtering mechanisms across all agent deployments. 

Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations cover regulatory compliance and fairness objectives. 

Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents. 

Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios) covering agent features, tool use, memory, and reasoning capabilities. 

Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating with AI/ML Engineers and Researchers to analyze root causes and validate fixes. 

Integrate evaluation pipelines into CI/CD processes to enable continuous quality assurance and fast iteration cycles. 

Analyze and interpret evaluation results, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics and mitigation recommendations. 

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 

810+ years of overall Software QA experience, with at least 23 years focused on testing or evaluating AI/ML systems, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs). 

Technical Skills AI Agent Evaluation & Safety

Direct experience designing and executing safety evaluations red-teaming, adversarial testing, jailbreaking, bias detection, and toxicity/harmful content measurement for generative AI models. 

Proven track record building and running general evaluations (Evals) for LLM-powered applications, including designing evaluation datasets, metrics, and scoring rubrics. 

Direct or strong conceptual understanding of the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and its components, including agent orchestration, tool use, and session/memory management. 

Experience designing and executing prompt injection attacks and defenses to test agent robustness. 

Hands-on experience with evaluation frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval, Ragas, Giskard, or Hugging Face evaluation tooling. 

Technical Skills Automation & Tooling

Strong proficiency in Python for script development, data processing, test automation, and evaluation pipeline development; PyTest is mandatory. 

Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services relevant to AI/ML (e. g. , Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows. 

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows for automated evaluation and regression testing. 

Soft Skills

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to decompose complex agent behaviors into testable scenarios and measurable outcomes. 

Strong communication skills to articulate complex agent behaviors, risks, and safety findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

Experience working in agile environments, collaborating closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, product owners, and distributed stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting strategies, fine-tuning, and the technical challenges related to alignment. 

Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools (e. g. , Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results at scale. 

Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development. 

Experience testing complex APIs, especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows. 

Experience with GIGO (Garbage-In/Garbage-Out) testing tools or frameworks that specialize in testing model responses to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs. 

Awareness of data poisoning vectors and testing strategies for training and retrieval pipelines. 

Certifications in AI/ML, cloud platforms (GCP), or software testing methodologies.

data.title: SASE Firewall QA Automation Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

NETGEAR is looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help validate our next-generation firewall and cybersecurity platform. In this role, you will build and maintain automated tests that verify firewall behavior across critical security domains including Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Web Gateways (SWG), Virtual Private Networks (VPN), and Software-Defined Wide Area Networks (SD-WAN). 

Working alongside firewall developers and senior QA engineers, you will automate functional, regression, and performance testing against real and simulated network traffic. You will not be expected to know every area of the stack on day one - we will support you in growing across it. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain automated test suites that validate firewall functionality - policy and rule evaluation, NAT, stateful session handling, and traffic filtering across NGFW, SASE, ZTNA, SWG, VPN, and SD-WAN features. 
 - Build and maintain test topologies and lab environments, including virtual machines, containers, and physical firewall appliances. 
 - Generate and shape realistic network traffic to exercise the firewall data plane, and verify observed behavior against expected policy outcomes. 
 - Run test suites in CI, triage failures, distinguish product defects from environment and test issues, and file clear, reproducible defect reports with supporting packet captures and logs. 
 - Contribute to test plans and test-case design from firewall requirements, and help keep automation coverage mapped to those test cases. 
 - Support performance and scale testing - throughput, connections per second, and concurrent sessions - and help identify regressions. 
 - Work with developers to improve testability, and stay current with automation tooling, including AI-assisted test generation, maintenance, and failure triage. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - 2-4 years of professional experience in QA automation or test engineering, preferably for networking or security products. 
 - Strong automation scripting ability in Python and Bash, comfort working in Ubuntu or other Linux environments from the command line, and day-to-day use of Git. 
 - Working knowledge of networking protocols and traffic flows - TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS/SSL, NAT, and routing fundamentals. 
 - Understanding of firewall fundamentals such as packet filtering, stateful connection tracking, NAT, and rule and policy evaluation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Linux networking and firewall tooling - iptables and nftables rule configuration, conntrack for session inspection, and iproute2 (ip addr, ip route, network namespaces, bridges, VLANs) for building and inspecting test topologies. 
 - Proficient in analyzing logs and network captures using tools such as Wireshark, tshark, and tcpdump. 
 - Experience with a test framework and runner such as pytest or Robot Framework. 
 - Experience with REST API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or scripted HTTP clients, for validating firewall management and policy APIs. 
 - Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). 
 - Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools (e. g. , Jira, TestRail, Xray), and good communication skills in an agile, cross-functional team. 

Preferred Qualifications (optional)

- Experience with traffic generation, shaping, and impairment tools such as iperf3, Scapy, hping3, tc/netem, TRex, or commercial testers like Spirent or Ixia. 
 - Contributions to open-source security or networking projects. 
 - Exposure to firewall security testing - IPS/IDS signature validation, TLS/SSL inspection, URL filtering, and threat-feed verification. 
 - Familiarity with virtualization and container tooling for building test labs - Docker and Docker Compose, VMware or KVM, Kubernetes - and with infrastructure-as-code such as Ansible or Terraform. 
 - Exposure to performance and scale testing, and to high-availability and failover validation. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic testing tools - for example LLM-assisted test generation, self-healing test maintenance, or agent-based exploratory testing - and an interest in applying them to network security test suites. 
 - Experience automating network devices and appliances over SSH and CLI using libraries such as Paramiko or Netmiko. 
 - Familiarity with certificate and PKI tooling such as OpenSSL, for generating test certificates and validating TLS/SSL inspection behavior. 
 - Experience validating firewall logging and telemetry - syslog, NetFlow, or IPFIX export - against expected policy events. 

Company Statement

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live. 

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You'll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

data.title: Infrastructure Automation Engineer
data.description:
Business Area: 

IT

Seniority Level: 

Mid-Senior level

Job Description: 

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world's largest enterprises. 

Cloudera IT team is seeking a talented, motivated, and passionate Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevOps) to join the Infrastructure Engineering team within our Technical Operations organization. In this role, you will build and maintain the automation, tooling, and self-service capabilities that enable software engineering teams to consume and integrate with our private cloud environment quickly, safely, and consistently. 

You will play a hands-on part in Cloudera IT's Enterprise-as-Code (EaC) evolution-applying our EaC standard, developed in collaboration with the EaC Platform Architect, to bring infrastructure, network, configuration, and policy under version control. Working closely with our Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer alongside our Sr Infrastructure Solutions Engineer, Sr Platform Operations Engineers, and Sr Systems Engineers, you will support Enterprise Cloud Services Operations, Networking, and Service Desk teams by turning recurring manual processes into automated workflows-making the right way the easy way while growing your DevOps skills on an experienced team. 

As an Infrastructure Automation Engineer you will: 

- Build, test, and maintain automation and tooling (scripts, CLIs, Terraform modules, Ansible roles, pipelines, and self-service workflows) that enable software engineering teams to provision and integrate with our private cloud environment. 
 - Bring creativity and curiosity to everyday automation work by proposing new approaches, building prototypes, and iterating on tools based on user feedback. 
 - Implement infrastructure and configuration as code aligned with IT's Enterprise-as-Code (EaC) and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards-following conventions for repository structure, module design, code review, testing, versioning, and promotion across environments, including bringing manually managed resources under code. 
 - Contribute to improving the EaC standard by sharing gaps, friction points, and improvement ideas from day-to-day implementation with the Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer and the EaC Platform Architect. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform services using GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions, aligned with the EaC standard and incorporating automated linting, testing, security scanning, and policy checks. 
 - Support the Enterprise Cloud Services Operations team by codifying private and public cloud resources and automating operational runbooks. 
 - Support the Networking team with network automation and source-of-truth initiatives (e. g. , NetBox/Nautobot, Ansible, Terraform), such as DNS/IPAM and firewall configuration as code. 
 - Support the Service Desk team by automating repetitive requests and connecting self-service catalog items and ticket workflows (e. g. , ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) to backend automation. 
 - Apply policy-as-code, secrets management, and security controls (e. g. , OPA, HashiCorp Vault) so that automation is secure and compliant by default. 
 - Help software engineering teams onboard to the private cloud by troubleshooting automation and pipeline issues and answering technical questions. 
 - Monitor automation and pipelines, investigate failures and configuration drift, implement fixes, and contribute metrics, logging, and alerting for the tools you build. 
 - Create and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, templates, and examples for your tools. 
 - Participate in a shared on-call rotation to support mission-critical IT services, with clear documentation and runbooks provided. 
 - Grow your skills by collaborating with the Sr Infrastructure Automation Engineer and other senior engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing. 

We're excited about you if you have: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or 4+ years of equivalent experience, including 2+ years of hands-on work in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, or systems engineering. 
 - Hands-on Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform/OpenTofu and Ansible, including writing or extending modules and roles. 
 - Proficiency in Python and shell scripting, with comfort working with REST APIs and JSON/YAML. 
 - Demonstrated curiosity and creativity in solving problems with automation, supported by examples of tools, scripts, or workflows you have built to eliminate manual work. 
 - Experience with Git workflows (branching, pull requests, code review) and CI/CD tools (e. g. , GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 
 - Working knowledge of private cloud platforms (e. g. , OpenStack, VMware vSphere/VCF) and/or public cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Familiarity with containers (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts. 
 - Solid Linux systems administration skills (e. g. , Red Hat, Rocky, Ubuntu). 
 - Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, load balancing). 
 - A security-aware mindset covering secrets management, service accounts, and least-privilege practices. 
 - Good communication skills and a customer-focused approach to supporting internal engineering and operations teams. 
 - Comfort working within shared engineering standards, with a willingness to contribute improvements through collaboration and code review. 

You may also have: 

- Relevant certifications such as HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Red Hat (RHCSA/RHCE), Kubernetes (CKAD), or an associate-level public cloud certification (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Experience with Go or another programming language. 
 - Exposure to policy-as-code (e. g. , OPA, Checkov) and infrastructure testing frameworks (e. g. , Terratest, Molecule). 
 - Exposure to network automation and source-of-truth tools (e. g. , NetBox, Nautobot, Ansible network modules). 
 - Experience integrating ITSM platforms (e. g. , ServiceNow, Jira Service Management) with automation and workflow tools. 
 - Exposure to internal developer portals or platform engineering tools (e. g. , Backstage). 
 - Experience with image pipelines (e. g. , Packer) and bare-metal provisioning (e. g. , Foreman, MaaS). 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). 
 - Exposure to regulated, high-governance, or compliance environments (e. g. , FedRAMP, PCI, ISO 27001, SOC 2). 
 - Personal, open-source, or home-lab automation projects that demonstrate creative problem solving. 

What you can expect from us: 

- Generous PTO Policy 
 - Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
 - Flexible WFH Policy 
 - Mental & Physical Wellness programs 
 - Phone and Internet Reimbursement program 
 - Access to Continued Career Development 
 - Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages 
 - Paid Volunteer Time
 - Employee Resource Groups

EEO/VEVRAA

data.description:
Job Summary

The Cloud/Infrastructure Engineer will help design, implement, and maintain our organization's cloud and on-premise infrastructure. This role owns day-to-day infrastructure work independently while contributing to broader strategy alongside senior engineers. The ideal candidate has a solid understanding of system stability, monitoring, and performance optimization, and can troubleshoot complex issues and drive practical solutions with limited oversight. 

YOUR IMPACT

At Redwood, we strive to automate and optimize our operations and application integrations to support the scale of our business and customer needs. As an observability engineer, you will build and maintain systems that collect, analyze, and visualize data from software applications and infrastructure. You will provide insight into system health and performance, enable proactive problem identification, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our observability solutions in partnership with other teams. 

Responsibilities

- Implement Infrastructure Strategy: Contribute to the design and implement infrastructure initiatives, including data collection pipelines, data processing, and visualization dashboards, with scalability and performance in mind. This includes metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting to provide end-to-end visibility into system behavior. 
 - System Monitoring and Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to optimize efficiency and reliability, including proactive identification of potential issues and preventative measures. 
 - Incident Response and Troubleshooting: Respond to incidents, troubleshoot complex system issues, and perform root cause analysis to help prevent future occurrences. 
 - Tooling and Infrastructure: Configure, manage, and maintain observability tooling and infrastructure (log aggregation, metric collection, distributed tracing, alerting), and contribute to tool evaluation and selection. Work with tools such as Prometheus, Datadog, New Relic, VictoriaMetrics, and similar to capture relevant metrics, logs, and traces. 
 - Alerting and Incident Management: Configure and maintain alerts based on defined thresholds and anomalies, ensuring timely notification of potential issues and supporting rapid incident response. 
 - Data Analysis and Troubleshooting: Analyze collected data to identify performance bottlenecks, root causes, and trends within complex systems, collaborating with engineering teams to resolve problems. 
 - Automation and Optimization: Develop and implement automation for monitoring and alerting to improve response times and reduce manual effort. Create automations for repetitive tasks (e. g. , RMJ automation for new employees). 
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with development, operations, and other teams to apply cloud and infrastructure best practices across the software development lifecycle, ensuring proper instrumentation and data collection. 
 - Capacity Planning: Use observability data to identify potential capacity constraints and support infrastructure scaling decisions. 
 - Security and Compliance: Support security and compliance efforts, including access reviews, in line with organizational requirements. 
 - Problem Solving: Resolve challenges related to system stability, data connectivity, and application configurations. 
 - Dashboard Development: Build and maintain comprehensive, user-friendly dashboards that provide real-time insights into system health, key performance indicators, and operational metrics. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience. 
 - 3-5 years of systems administration/engineering experience. 
 - Solid understanding of Windows Server and Linux systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with layer 2/3 networking, including VLANs, routing, and ACLs; experience with multi-vendor switches and firewalls (e. g. , HP, Dell, Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Sophos) a plus. 
 - Good understanding of monitoring principles and best practices. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (e. g. , Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Scripting and automation skills (e. g. , Python, Bash, PowerShell). 
 - Experience configuring IPSec VPN tunnels, with familiarity with BGP routing and subnet peering across hybrid cloud environments. 
 - Ability to interpret data sets, identify patterns, and draw actionable insights. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present findings to cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Jaeger, Datadog, New Relic, VictoriaMetrics, Zipkin, or similar.

data.title: Sr. SRE Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement. 

The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential. 

Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations

- Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability. 
 - Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents. 
 - Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation. 
 - Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices. 
 - Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
 - Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services. 
 - Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues. 
 - Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases. 
 - Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
 - Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes. 
 - Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation. 
 - Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks. 
 - Monitoring, Observability and Performance
 - Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments. 
 - Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring. 
 - Apply the four Golden Signals-latency, traffic, errors, and saturation-to monitor service health and identify performance issues. 
 - Improve distributed tracing and establish meaningful alerts that reflect actual system health and user impact. 
 - Investigate performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, applications, networks, and distributed systems. 
 - Linux, Networking and Security
 - Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and production infrastructure issues. 
 - Apply networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting. 
 - Follow cloud security best practices for identity and access management, network segmentation, and secrets management. 
 - Support vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and compliance-related activities in collaboration with relevant teams. 

Technical Environment

The role involves cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting, production support, monitoring, and modern reliability engineering practices. Experience with one major cloud platform is important, while exposure to multiple cloud environments can be beneficial. 

Additional exposure to Go (Golang), OpenSearch, ELK Stack, AI/ML production platforms, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, RAG-based workloads, and enterprise observability frameworks would be advantageous.

data.description:
Position Title: QA Engineer |||

About Americana Restaurants International PLC

Americana Restaurants International PLC is a pioneering force in the MENA region and Kazakhstan's Out-of-Home Dining industry, ranking among the world's leading operators of Quick Service Restaurants (QSR) and casual dining establishments. With an extensive portfolio of iconic global brands and a dominant regional presence, we have been driving growth and innovation for over 60 years. 

Our expansive network of 2, 600+ restaurants spans 12 countries throughout the Middle East, North Africa, and Kazakhstan - from Kazakhstan in the east to Morocco in the west - powered by a team of 40, 000+ talented individuals committed to delivering exceptional food, superior service, and memorable experiences. 

In line with our vision for innovation and operational excellence, we have established our Center of Excellence in Mohali, India. This state-of-the-art facility plays a pivotal role in Product Development, IT, Digital, AI, and Analytics, while implementing global IT best practices. Serving as a strategic hub, it strengthens our technology backbone and drives digital transformation across our worldwide operations. 

Your Impact: 

- Data Quality Testing: 
 - Perform data validation to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data across all stages of the ETL pipeline (Extract, Transform, Load). 
 - Verify that data transformations are executed correctly and that business rules are applied properly. 
 - Perform data reconciliation between source systems and target data stores to ensure completeness and correctness. 
 - Automation and Scripting: 
 - Design and implement automated test scripts for validating ETL processes and Big Data pipelines. 
 - Develop and maintain test automation frameworks for scalable and repeatable testing processes. 
 - Work with CI/CD pipelines to ensure automated testing is integrated into the build and deployment process for continuous quality validation. 
 - Performance and Scalability Testing: 
 - Conduct performance testing on ETL processes and Big Data pipelines to assess scalability and efficiency. 
 - Monitor and evaluate the data processing speed, resource utilization, and overall system performance under varying loads. 
 - Collaborate with data engineers to optimize pipeline performance based on test results. 
 - Big Data Platform Validation: 
 - Ensure data accuracy and consistency in large-scale distributed systems like Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Presto, or Kafka. 
 - Perform end-to-end testing across the data flow to validate the transformation, integration, and storage of large datasets. 
 - Validate the integration of ETL pipelines with Big Data tools and databases (e. g. , HDFS, NoSQL, relational databases). 
 - Data Integration and Automation Testing: 
 - Validate integration between multiple data sources (relational databases, NoSQL databases, APIs, external data systems) and the Big Data platform. 
 - Test data exchange across heterogeneous systems, ensuring data is transferred, transformed, and loaded without errors or data loss. 
 - Bug Identification and Troubleshooting: 
 - Identify, document, and track defects found during testing and work closely with the development team to resolve issues. 
 - Perform root cause analysis for defects in data pipelines or data quality issues and ensure they are properly addressed. 
 - Retest fixed issues and ensure regression testing is done to verify that changes did not impact existing workflows. 
 - Documentation and Reporting: 
 - Provide regular test progress reports and communicate the status of testing efforts, including any critical issues or blockers, to stakeholders. 

What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, 
 - 4 + years of experience in QA testing with a focus on CDP, ETL processes and Big Data platforms. 
 - Strong knowledge of ETL processes and understanding of data pipeline architectures (e. g. , Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Hive, Presto). 
 - Experience with Big Data platforms (HDFS, Hive, HBase, Presto, etc. ) and distributed computing environments. 
 - Proficiency in writing and executing SQL queries to validate data across various platforms. 
 - Experience with automation frameworks and tools for ETL testing, such as Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, PyTest, or similar. 
 - Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, and other collaboration tools for issue tracking and test management. 
 - Strong scripting skills in languages such as Python, Java, Scala, or Bash. 
 - Knowledge of CI/CD processes and integration testing in an Agile environment. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues related to data quality, transformation, and integration. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

You will bridge cloud-native engineering and quality engineering by building production-grade test infrastructure, benchmarking systems across AWS, Azure, and Kubernetes, and setting technical excellence standards across the engineering organization. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architecture, Multi-Cloud & K8s Infrastructure Leadership
 - Cloud-Native Test Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable, extensible test automation frameworks and harnesses across AWS and Azure environments. 
 - Kubernetes Automation: Architect dynamic, containerized test infrastructure leveraging Kubernetes (K8s) to spin up ephemeral test clusters, mock environments, and end-to-end integration environments on demand. 
 - Technical Strategy: Drive the overall test and quality strategy across cloud and local topologies, establishing best practices for unit, integration, microservices, chaos, and performance testing. 
 - CI/CD Pipeline Integration: Integrate automated validation systems into localized and cloud-based Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps). 
 - Domain-Specific Ownership
 - Scale Connectors: Build robust testing tools to validate high-volume data connectors, API integrations, and ingestion pipelines across multi-cloud setups (AWS S3/SQS, Azure Blob/Event Hubs). Stress test for concurrency, throughput, message loss, network degradation, and cloud cost efficiency at scale. 
 - Graph Engine & Traversal: Architect test matrices and verification suites for complex Graph databases/architectures (e. g. , AWS Neptune, Neo4j, GraphQL), verifying node-edge relationship queries, indexing performance, and path traversal correctness under heavy concurrent loads. 
 - Reporting & Analytics: Validate data fidelity, aggregation logic, latency, and correctness across high-volume reporting engines and dynamic query visualization platforms. 
 - Local System Testing: Drive local environment and system-level integration testing in our San Jose lab/office-ensuring localized hardware/software dependencies, edge topologies, and containerized local Kubernetes environments (e. g. , Minikube, K3s, Kind) operate seamlessly under real-world scenarios. 
 - Quality Engineering & Operations
 - Identify architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and memory leaks before features hit production across AWS, Azure, and local systems. 
 - Establish standard observability, distributed tracing (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog), and automated reporting dashboards to expose systemic quality issues and pipeline health. 
 - Code review, mentor, and elevate the technical engineering bar across development and quality engineering teams. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in software development, software test engineering, or quality engineering. 
 - Coding Proficiency: Advanced expertise in at least one modern object-oriented language (Java, Python, C++, or Go) with a proven background writing production-level code. 
 - Cloud Platforms (AWS & Azure): Hands-on experience developing test strategies, automating infrastructure, and testing applications deployed on AWS (e. g. , EC2, EKS, S3, Lambda) and Azure (e. g. , AKS, Blob Storage, Event Hubs). 
 - Kubernetes (K8s) & Containerization: Deep experience with Docker and Kubernetes orchestration-ability to write Helm charts, manage K8s test manifests, and debug containerized microservices in distributed clusters. 
 - Distributed Systems & Scale: Proven experience testing, debugging, and benchmarking high-scale distributed systems, data pipelines, APIs (REST/gRPC), and streaming architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc. ). 
 - Graph & Data Layer: Experience testing Graph-based architectures/databases (e. g. , AWS Neptune, Neo4j, GraphQL) and relational/non-relational data stores. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - AWS or Azure Certified Solutions Architect / Developer, or CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator). 
 - Experience designing custom performance, chaos engineering (e. g. , Chaos Mesh, Gremlin), and load-testing platforms for high-throughput messaging/connector hubs. 
 - Deep understanding of low-level system design (LLD), concurrency, multithreading, and network protocols. 
 - Experience establishing dual-target automation setups (validating behavior identical between local on-prem lab environments and public cloud infrastructures). 
 - Proven track record of influencing cross-functional senior leadership (Staff Engineers, Engineering Directors, Product Managers) to prioritize quality, reliability, and system testability. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) who views testing as an engineering problem waiting to be solved. In this role, you won't just be executing

tests; you will design, build, and maintain the automated testing frameworks, infrastructure, and tooling that allow our engineering teams to ship high-quality code at speed. You will sit at the intersection of development and QA, operating as a developer whose primary focus is software quality and reliability. 

What You'll Do

- A minimum of 8 years of work experience is required. 
 - Automation Framework Architecture: Design, build, and scale robust, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch for web, mobile, and APIs. 
 - Code Quality & Testing: Write clean, high-quality automation code (e. g. , using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript) and participate in developer code reviews. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites directly into deployment pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to achieve true continuous testing. 
 - Test Strategy & Execution: Analyse complex business requirements, identify edge cases, and design comprehensive test plans spanning functional, integration, regression, and performance testing. 
 - Tooling & Infrastructure: Build internal tools, mock services, and data generation utilities to unblock the development team and accelerate testing cycles. 
 - Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers and Software Engineers during early design phases to ensure features are inherently testable from day one. 

What You'll Bring

Bonus Skills

data.title: Controls Engineer (PLC and Automation)
data.description:
About Harley Instruments

Harley Instruments has been a trusted for scientific and research institutions and firms since 1979, providing advanced scientific instrumentation and dedicated after-sales support to research and industrial customers across India. Our portfolio includes electron microscopy sample preparation, PVD/CVD, plasma cleaning and etching, thin-film metrology, magnetic field cancellation, laser micromachining and diamond wire sawing. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Controls Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of developing a PLC-based control system for a new thin-film deposition system. This is a ground-up machine development role: from understanding requirements and designing the controls architecture to selecting and procuring hardware, programming, integration, testing and commissioning. This is not a routine PLC maintenance role. Candidates must have personally built and commissioned PLC-based automation systems from scratch. 

Key Responsibilities

• Own the controls project end to end: Translate machine requirements into an executable plan, architecture, schedule and commissioning strategy. 

• Design the controls architecture: Define PLC, I/O, HMI, sensors, actuators, drives, controllers, electrical panels and communication interfaces. 

• Program PLC and HMI: Develop machine sequences, operating modes, alarms, diagnostics, permissives and interlocks using appropriate PLC languages. 

• Select and procure hardware: Prepare I/O lists and BOMs, identify components, evaluate vendors, obtain quotations and coordinate procurement. 

• Develop electrical documentation: Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, cable schedules and control-system documentation. 

• Integrate machine subsystems: Interface the PLC with pumps, valves, vacuum gauges, mass-flow controllers, temperature controllers and other equipment as required. 

• Test and commission: Carry out I/O checks, debugging, functional and safety-interlock testing, system integration and machine commissioning. 

• Drive execution with the team: Coordinate with mechanical, electrical and process engineers; resolve technical issues and maintain project documentation. 

  

Controls Engineer - PLC & Automation

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline. 

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in PLC programming and industrial automation. 

• Demonstrated experience designing, building and commissioning at least one PLC-based machine or automation system from scratch. 

• Practical experience in hardware selection, I/O planning, electrical drawings, PLC/HMI development, integration and commissioning. 

• Hands-on PLC experience with Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Beckhoff or an equivalent industrial platform. 

• Working knowledge of Ladder Logic, Function Block Diagram and/or Structured Text; HMI development; and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Good understanding of digital/analogue I/O, 4-20 mA, 0-10 V, sensors, actuators, drives, PID control and machine interlocks. 

• Able to plan work independently, make sound technical decisions and take responsibility for delivery with minimal supervision. 

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with vacuum systems, PVD/CVD, thin-film deposition, plasma systems or scientific/process equipment. 

• Experience integrating vacuum gauges, mass-flow controllers (MFCs), pressure and temperature controllers. 

• Exposure to control-panel fabrication, vendor coordination and machine-safety circuits. 

How to Apply

Apply through the Harley Instruments LinkedIn Job Profile or share your CV and cover letter via: 

E-mail: nilesh@harleyinstruments. co. in / hr@harleyinstruments. co. in

Website: harleyinstruments. co. in | +91 20 2422 0602

or by DMing the company LinkedIn ID

Leena. ai is an enterprise agentic AI platform automating work across HR, Finance, and Legal functions for global enterprises. We are a Series B+ company headquartered in New York, with our largest engineering hub in Gurgaon. 

The Role We are hiring a hands-on Tech Lead to own a pod of 4-6 engineers within our Knowledge Management / NLP org, or across adjacent agentic AI platform pods depending on fit. You will design and ship production systems that power enterprise knowledge retrieval, grounding, and agentic reasoning across the Leena. ai platform - the engine behind every customer-facing agent. 

This is an IC-heavy leadership role. Expect to spend roughly 60-70% of your time in code, architecture, and design reviews, and 30-40% on mentoring, planning, and cross-functional alignment. 

What You'll Own

- Knowledge & agent architecture: Architect and ship production RAG, knowledge ingestion, and agentic reasoning pipelines that operate across enterprise systems of record (Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, Confluence, SharePoint, and many more). 
 - Evaluation & quality: Build and maintain custom golden datasets and eval harnesses; distinguish retrieval failures from generation failures; set and enforce production accuracy, latency, and cost SLOs. 
 - Multi-LLM orchestration: Work across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini model families. Own model selection tradeoffs (capability vs. cost vs. latency), prompt iteration, function-calling/tool-use patterns, and fallback strategies. 
 - Technical leadership: Set the engineering bar for the pod - design docs, code reviews, on-call

discipline, incident response, and production quality gates. 

- Platform leverage: Partner with Product and Implementation on reference architectures that compress time-to-value for new enterprise deployments. 
 - People growth: Mentor 4-6 engineers; grow at least one to senior-level scope within the year. 

Must-Haves

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production software. 
 - Strong production engineering in Python and Node. js. Comfort reading and contributing to a React frontend when the work crosses the boundary. 
 - Hands-on experience building LLM-powered production systems with at least one major provider

(Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini): RAG pipelines, function-calling / tool-use, prompt and eval iteration loops. 

- Depth in one or more of: information retrieval, NLP, knowledge graphs, semantic search, vector

databases, or chunking / embedding strategies.

familiarity.

ServiceNow, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle, Confluence, SharePoint).

non-trivial engineering problem, and knowledge/NLP is at the core of it.

About the role: We need a Quality Head to own the entire quality function for our sheet metal operations - inspection, QMS, supplier quality and customer audits. You will be the person the customer calls when something goes wrong, and the one who ensures it stops happening. 

Must-have requirements

- Deep, hands-on knowledge of sheet metal processes - laser cutting, shearing, CNC punching, bending, forming, welding and assembly. 

- Ability to read engineering drawings and apply GD&T, including tolerance stack-up on multi-part assemblies. 

- Working command of press shop operations, press tools and press-part defect analysis; weld shop knowledge including projection and robotic welding. 

- Expertise in ISO 9001, with IATF 16949 and PPAP/APQP experience strongly preferred. 

- Fluency in quality tools - 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto, SPC, MSA, CAPA. 

- Metrology competence: vernier, micrometer, height gauge, surface roughness and CMM-based inspection. 

- Proven experience facing customer and third-party audits as the primary technical interface. 

Key responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end QMS and maintain it to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and customer-specific requirements. 

- Direct IQC, in-process and final/outgoing inspection gates across cutting, bending, welding, coating and assembly. 

- Set and monitor quality standards, control plans, SOPs and inspection check sheets for all sheet metal processes. 

- Drive rejection, rework and scrap reduction - track PPM, first-pass yield, scrap rate and cost of poor quality. 

- Lead root cause analysis and CAPA for internal failures and customer complaints, and close them within committed timelines. 

- Act as the customer-facing quality interface: complaints, containment, 8D submissions, audits and approvals. 

- Manage supplier quality - vendor audits, incoming material control and supplier corrective actions. 

- Lead internal audits and facilitate second- and third-party audits; close all observations. 

- Handle new product introduction and engineering changes, verifying quality documentation and sign-off. 

- Ensure calibration and validity of all measuring and test equipment. 

- Build, train and appraise the quality team of engineers, inspectors and metrology technicians. 

- Publish quality MIS and KPIs to management, with analysis and improvement plans rather than raw numbers. 

- Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives with production and engineering.

data.title: AI DevOps Engineer – Platform & Infrastructure
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code. 

What you'll do

- Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
 - Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
 - Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
 - Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
 - Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
 - Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
 - Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

What you bring

- 4-6+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering on production, customer-facing systems
 - Hands-on Azure: Container Apps or AKS, Azure Monitor, Key Vault and Entra ID
 - Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform that you wrote and maintained across environments
 - CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with security scanning and automated quality gates
 - Has operated PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar in production: backups, replication and performance tuning
 - Has designed monitoring and alerting and handled real incidents in live operations
 - Works AI-natively: uses Claude Code or Codex daily. Expect live pairing with a coding agent in the interview
 - English at C1 level and comfort working with colleagues in Munich and 21 markets

Nice to have

- Kubernetes depth, global CDN strategies and China deployments
 - Operating LLM/RAG workloads (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry)
 - FinOps and cloud cost control; WAF/DDoS and hardening in production

data.title: Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer - Frontier Cyber Security
data.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

ABOUT US

Lean SuperIntelligence (LSI) is an AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity foundation models for enterprises. LSI publicly announced LSI-Offense-1 and LSI-Defense-1 on October 9, 2026, alongside the closing of its initial pre-seed financing. 

LSI-Offense-1 discovers, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to threats. The models improve through an offense-defense feedback loop inside LSI Cyber World Models, simulated enterprise environments that turn attack and defense outcomes into training signals. 

The models are designed for enterprise-controlled deployment, including on-premises and air-gapped environments, with customization on private enterprise data. Access is currently limited to selected design partners. 

Founded by Chandra Khatri, LSI brings together foundation-model builders and security researchers. Its announced backers include investors and angels with AI and security leadership experience at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Zscaler, Commvault and Gruve AI. These affiliations do not imply corporate investment by those organizations. 

Learn more: LSI website | Launch announcement | Financing and model news. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer to build the product surface of our frontier security platform, from data model and services through to the interfaces security teams work in every day. 

You will own features end to end: backend services, agent-facing APIs, and the front end where findings, exploit evidence, and remediation workflows are reviewed and acted on. This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad architectural ownership and a direct line to design partners. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own features end to end across data model, backend services, APIs, front end, telemetry, and rollout. 

- Build the interfaces security teams work in daily: finding triage, exploit evidence review, remediation and retest tracking, agent run inspection, and reporting. 

- Design backend services and APIs for scanning, agent execution, evidence storage, and integrations with code hosts, CI/CD, ticketing systems, and cloud accounts. 

- Build product surfaces on top of LLMs and autonomous agents, including streaming output, long-running task state, human approval steps, partial results, and graceful failure. 

- Turn AppSec workflows into product: finding deduplication, severity and reachability context, ownership routing, SLA tracking, and verification that fixes actually close the vulnerability. 

- Design schemas and pipelines for findings, agent trajectories, evidence artifacts, and audit trails. 

- Build multi-tenant foundations including authentication, authorization, RBAC, org and project scoping, audit logging, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. 

- Make agent behavior legible in the interface: what the agent did, what it proved, what it could not, and where a human needs to decide. 

- Own performance, reliability, latency, and cost across the stack, including inference and tool-execution cost surfaced to the user. 

- Set engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and secure-by-default patterns, and treat our own attack surface as a first-class concern. 

- Prototype quickly with design partners, put working software in front of practitioners early, and decide what is ready to ship. 

- Partner with security researchers, agent-harness engineers, and product to move research capability into product without losing rigor. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- At least five years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time spent on cybersecurity products. 

- Strong full-stack ability: modern TypeScript and React on the front end, plus backend work in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, or Rust. 

- Hands-on experience building application-security products, or closely adjacent ones such as code security, vulnerability management, attack-surface management, DevSecOps, offensive-security tooling, or SOC platforms. 

- Working security knowledge across common vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization, and secure design, with the ability to reason about the attack surface of what you build. 

- Experience designing APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workflows. 

- Front-end craft on data-dense technical interfaces, including state management, streaming and real-time updates, and performance under large result sets. 

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and production operations. 

- Ability to scope ambiguous problems, make architectural decisions, and raise the bar for other engineers through code and review rather than process. 

- Clear technical writing and comfort working directly with security practitioners and design partners. 

- We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience building products on LLMs or agents, including tool use, streaming, evaluations, prompt and model versioning, and latency and cost tradeoffs. 

- Product experience in autonomous pentesting, code security, SAST/DAST/SCA, vulnerability management, CTEM, EDR/XDR, or SOC automation. 

- Personal offensive-security depth such as CVEs, bug-bounty findings, advanced CTF performance, or published research. 

- Experience integrating with GitHub or GitLab, CI systems, Jira or ServiceNow, SIEM and EDR platforms, or cloud provider APIs. 

- Experience meeting enterprise requirements such as SSO, SAML, SCIM, audit logging, VPC or on-premise deployment, and air-gapped installs. 

- Experience with real-time systems, websockets, job queues, or event-driven architectures. 

- Design sensibility and the ability to own the user experience for technical workflows without a dedicated designer. 

- Understanding of AI and agent security risks including prompt injection, tool poisoning or misuse, excessive permissions, untrusted content, and sandbox boundaries. 

- Open-source contributions, technical writing, or prior founding-engineer and early-stage experience.

About the Company

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools, with over 200 years of history. Their machines lap, polish and grind surfaces to extreme flatness for 20+ industries worldwide. The company has 600+ employees and revenue above €250 million. 

Lapmaster Wolters is now expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging, one of the fastest-growing areas in chips, driven by AI and next-gen computing. data.description:
About Albertsons

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2, 200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known global banners, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others. Our success is built upon a united team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. This customer-centric focus not only inspires innovation but has also led to remarkable achievements across our digital platforms and omnichannel strategies. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we have transformed shopping into an experience that is not just easy and efficient, but also fun and engaging. Over the past year, we have taken bold, strategic steps to migrate and modernize our enterprise data hub on Google Cloud, revolutionizing our data capabilities, thus becoming the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company. 

About Tech Hub In India

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Sr. Manager, AIDLC at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) workstream end to end: roadmap, delivery and outcomes. You report to the AI First head. 
 - Lead a pod of engineers who build agents across the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Stay hands-on for roughly a quarter of your time. Write code, build prototypes and review agent pull requests, so you judge agent designs and eval results first hand. 
 - Build the organization: define roles and levels, hire and onboard engineers, coach them, and set engineering standards for AI-authored and AI-assisted code. 
 - Set the technical direction for agent architecture: orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP servers (including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP), memory and state management, context engineering and RAG over engineering knowledge. 
 - Make evals a release gate. Every agent, prompt and model change passes golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring calibrated against human review, and regression suites before it ships. Require tracing and observability for agents in production. 
 - Define outcome metrics and measure them against the pre-agent baseline: delivery speed and cost, defects, security findings, cycle time and change failure rate. Report outcomes, not login counts or seat usage. 
 - Drive adoption and change management: run pilots with engineering teams, collect feedback, change how teams work, and retire agents that do not earn their place. 
 - Set governance and guardrails for agents that touch source control, CI/CD and cloud: least-privilege tool access, prompt-injection defence, human approval points, and an action trail that can be reviewed and reversed. 
 - Govern multi-agent systems: trust boundaries between agents, rules for delegation, an audit trail across agent handoffs, and the points where a human must approve. 
 - Govern token and compute cost: budgets, model routing, cost per successful outcome, and usage reporting to leadership. 
 - Run vendor and build-vs-buy evaluations for agent platforms, models and tooling, including multi-model support, with clear criteria. 
 - Use agentic coding tools every day (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and set norms for how the pod and its partner teams use them. 
 - Partner with Security, Cloud, Data, Product, Enterprise Architecture and the AI governance group so agents fit existing toolchains and meet security, legal, risk and compliance standards. 
 - Run agents in production: reliability targets, observability, incident response and a named owner for every agent. 

Experience Required

- AI experience is a MUST. You have personally built and deployed an LLM agent or agentic workflow used by real users in the last 2 years, with evals and tracing in place. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 12-15 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams: hiring, performance management and delivery accountability. 
 - Hands-on programming in Python, Java or TypeScript, used to build agents and the services around them. The agents work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Working depth in agent orchestration, tool/function calling, MCP, memory and state management, context engineering and RAG. You can review a multi-agent design and say where it will fail. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Experience running evals in practice: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, and using the results to block or approve a release. 
 - Experience with tracing and observability for LLM applications, and with guardrails, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Everyday use of agentic coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your own work, not only as a sponsor of them. 
 - Experience owning an adoption program with measured outcomes (cycle time, change failure rate, defects, cost) rather than usage counts. 
 - Experience managing LLM cost: token budgets, model selection and routing, and scaling agent workloads. 
 - Experience evaluating vendors and making build-vs-buy decisions for AI platforms. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Strong communication with senior leadership, engineering teams and risk partners. 
 - A plus: agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, code knowledge graphs or GraphRAG, building internal developer platforms. 

Competencies

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work
 - Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens
 - Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
 - Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals. 

Skills Required

- Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems: design review and governance
 - Agent Evals, Tracing and Observability
 - MCP, Memory and State Management, Context Engineering, RAG
 - Python / Java / TypeScript (hands-on)
 - Cloud Platform Experience (Azure and/or Google Cloud)
 - Engineering Leadership, Hiring and Change Management
 - AI Governance, Guardrails, Token and Compute Cost Management
