Position Summary

The Automation & Analytics Developer works under the guidance of the project manager and senior developers. The role builds, tests and supports automation and reporting solutions for finance processes. The person turns clearly defined business requirements into working solutions using Power Platform, Python, SQL, Excel VBA and Power BI. They also support project tracking, documentation and user adoption. The role is mainly hands-on development, with some project support, and gives the person room to grow their technical and finance-process knowledge. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build, configure and maintain Power Apps applications that meet approved requirements and design standards. 
 - Develop Power Automate workflows that reduce manual effort and improve control over finance activities. 
 - Write Python scripts for data processing, validation, file handling and reconciliation support. 
 - Write and improve SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, validation and reporting. 
 - Build and maintain Excel VBA macros, templates and tools for recurring finance tasks. 
 - Help develop and update Power BI reports and datasets, and check that report figures match the source data. 
 - Take part in requirement discussions with finance users and help turn requirements into technical tasks and prototypes. 
 - Prepare test cases, carry out unit and system testing, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and fix defects with guidance. 
 - Support deployment, handover, user guidance and issue resolution after go-live. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, process maps, test evidence and release notes. 
 - Track assigned tasks, risks and issues, share progress regularly, and raise blockers on time. 
 - Follow information-security, data-privacy, access-control and change-management standards. 

Key Responsibilities Specific To This Roles

- Add user-friendly screens, validation rules, notifications, approvals and exception handling to finance automation solutions. 
 - Run data-quality checks and reconcile source data to output before releasing any change. 
 - Help troubleshoot apps, workflows, scripts, queries and macros, and record the root cause and fix for each issue. 
 - Support approved Snowflake data extraction and integration tasks under guidance. 
 - Work with finance users to understand their pain points, explain how solutions work, gather feedback and support adoption. 
 - Apply development standards, reusable components and peer-review feedback, and share lessons learned with the team. 

Additional Responsibilities Unique To This Position

- Provide hands-on development support across Power Apps, Power Automate, Python, SQL, and Excel VBA, based on project priorities and assigned work packages. 
 - Create user-friendly interfaces, validation rules, notifications, approvals, and exception-handling logic for defined finance process requirements. 
 - Perform data-quality checks and reconcile source and output data before releasing automation or reporting changes. 
 - Assist with troubleshooting application, workflow, script, query, and macro issues; document root cause and corrective action. 
 - Demonstrate awareness of Snowflake concepts and support approved Snowflake-related data extraction or integration tasks under guidance. 
 - Engage with finance users to understand process pain points, explain solution behavior, capture feedback, and support adoption. 
 - Balance technical development responsibilities with the project support, status communication, documentation, risk, and issue-management expectations of the aligned GPP. 

Required Qualifications

- Graduate degree ( BSc, BCA or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics or a related field. Post Graduation is a plus. 
 - 1-2 years of relevant experience in application development, automation, scripting, databases or analytics. Internships and academic projects count. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Power Apps and Power Automate. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL, and of Python or Excel VBA. 
 - Basic understanding of databases, data validation, testing and the software development lifecycle. 
 - Strong problem-solving and documentation skills, and clear communication. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to finance, shared services or business operations processes.

Job Description: 

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Role Definition

Performs implementation, regular problem solving, maintenance and support for a agile software development. 

Responsibilities

- Designing, modifying, developing, writing and implementing software programming applications for target system using agile methods. 
 - Acquiring client requirements; resolving workflow problems through automation optimization. 
 - Writing source codes for new applications, and/or generating and enhancing code samples for existing applications. 
 - Utilizing automated testing tools to perform the testing and maintenance. 

Skill Descriptors

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process. 
 - Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas. 
 - Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes. 
 - Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns. 
 - Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives. 

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. 
 - Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness. 
 - Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work. 
 - Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate. 
 - Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups. 

Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Describes common tools for component-based, object-oriented development. 
 - Describes the objectives, activities and results of unit testing. 
 - Has developed programs in a specific language and for a specific platform. 
 - Interprets functional and technical blueprints; participates in structuring technical components. 
 - Participates in technical and code reviews. 

Software Development Life Cycle: Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace. 

Level Basic Understanding: 

- Summarizes the overall process for developing new software for the company product line. 
 - Differentiates respective roles and responsibilities of software engineering and other functions. 
 - Identifies common issues and considerations for bringing a new product to marketplace. 
 - Describes major phases, checkpoints and deliverables. 

Software Integration Engineering: Knowledge of software integration processes and functions; ability to design, develop and maintain interfaces and linkage to alternative platforms and software packages. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Has experience with designing data exchange interfaces to and from software product. 
 - Describes tools and techniques for extraction, transformation and loading of electronic data. 
 - Cites examples of common linkage requirements for software products and vendors. 
 - Works with integrating software into the customer or partner framework and infrastructure. 
 - Participates in the development of technology interfaces and bridges. 

Software Product Design/Architecture: Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design. 

Level Basic Understanding: 

- Identifies basic design methods and design tools. 
 - Identifies major components of functional and technical design. 
 - Cites examples of good and bad designs. 
 - Describes tasks, activities, deliverables and key concerns of technical design. 

Software Product Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of technical aspects of a software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Maintains and utilizes data related to install base configurations and environments. 
 - Solicits customer feedback; reports and monitors bugs and implementation issues. 
 - Participates in defining and conducting technical acceptance tests. 
 - Participates in creating technical requirements for software development and deployment. 
 - Explains basic environment and product configuration options. 

Software Product Testing: Knowledge of software product testing; ability to design, plan, and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure software product quality and adherence to stated requirements. 

Level Working Knowledge: 

- Participates in test readiness reviews, functional, volume, and load testing. 
 - Describes key features and aspects of a specific testing discipline or methodology. 
 - Tests software components for compliance with functional requirements and design specifications. 
 - Explains procedures for documenting test activities and results (e. g. errors, non-conformance, etc. )
 - Conducts functional and performance testing on aspects of assigned products.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

Job Summary

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Identity Life Cycle Management (LCM) team. You will work on core LCM components, including user provisioning workflows, role-based access control (RBAC) engine logic, and lifecycle event triggers. Under the guidance of senior engineers, you will learn how modern enterprise systems govern identities at scale. Grow into designing robust, end-to-end lifecycle automation services that keep our enterprise customers secure and compliant. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop well-scoped features and enhancements within automated provisioning, deprovisioning, and role assignment workflows. 
 - Troubleshoot and fix defects in lifecycle event processing, sync pipelines, and authorization checks with mentorship. 
 - Integrate with HRIS systems and identity stores to ensure reliable state changes across the identity lifecycle. 
 - Maintain high unit and integration test coverage for all code shipped into CI/CD automation suites. 
 - Utilize AI coding assistants to draft workflow logic, rigorously verifying code output for correctness and performance. 
 - Document technical designs, workflow schemas, and API contracts to enable clear integration across IGA teams. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- Solid foundation in JavaScript or TypeScript, data structures, and algorithms, with hands-on Node. js experience. 
 - Understanding of HTTP, RESTful services, JSON, and web API integration. 
 - Familiarity with relational or NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or PostgreSQL. 
 - Commitment to writing clean unit and integration tests. 
 - Working knowledge of Git, issue tracking, and code review practices. 
 - Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset with an eagerness to learn. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Basic familiarity with RBAC, ABAC, SCIM standards, or Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle flows. 
 - Exposure to systems like Workday, SuccessFactors, Active Directory, or LDAP. 
 - Experience with event-driven architectures or messaging queues such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS. 
 - Hands-on experience with testing frameworks like Jest, Vitest, or similar tools. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Join a team driving innovation in developer platforms and source code management. Grow your expertise in cloud architecture and engineering excellence.

You will work in a globally distributed engineering environment, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors to deliver impactful solutions.

- Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of SDLC platform capabilities with emphasis on SCM systems and workflows
 - Build and review high-quality production code, primarily in Java and Python, ensuring engineering excellence and secure coding practices
 - Drives adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e. g. , AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain.

 - Strong hands-on expertise in Java/Python and public cloud

 - Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching senior engineers/leads on compliant usage patterns and controls.

data.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are-with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody's is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we're advancing AI to move from insight to action-enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence. 

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity. 

Skills And Competencies

- 5-7 years of experience in software quality engineering with hands-on expertise testing Java-based backend services and RESTful application programming interfaces
 - Proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, RestAssured, or Cucumber for user interface and application programming interface testing
 - Strong understanding of relational databases including PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server to perform data validation and verify data integrity across test scenarios
 - Hands-on experience testing Anthropic Claude integrated features, including large language model output validation, semantic evaluation techniques, hallucination detection, and streaming application programming interface behavior
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol and agentic artificial intelligence testing patterns, including tool-use accuracy, context management, and deterministic versus non-deterministic output validation
 - Experience with artificial intelligence security testing, including prompt injection testing, jailbreak validation, sensitive data leakage checks, and application reliability and performance assessments
 - Strong understanding of software design principles and microservices architectures, with the ability to develop effective test strategies and identify system-level edge cases
 - Deep expertise in artificial intelligence, with a track record of implementing advanced AI solutions to drive strategic transformation and operational efficiency. Strong experience using AI tools to lead innovation initiatives. Demonstrated leadership in managing AI-related risks, ensuring ethical governance, and fostering a culture of responsible AI adoption across the organization. 

Education

- Bachelor or Master of Science in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field

Responsibilities

Lead quality engineering and artificial intelligence testing initiatives to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure software solutions across cloud-based platforms. 

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for Java-based backend services and RESTful application programming interfaces to ensure high software quality across releases
 - Own the test strategy for Anthropic Claude integrated features, including large language model output validation, regression baselines, tool-call accuracy verification, context management validation, and end-to-end integration coverage
 - Build and maintain continuous integration integrated evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic artificial intelligence outputs, including rubric-based scoring, automated prompt regression suites, and behavioral drift detection
 - Collaborate with product owners, software engineers, and machine learning engineers to define testable requirements, review acceptance criteria, and ensure high-quality delivery across agile releases
 - Perform database validation testing against PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server environments to verify data integrity, transformation logic, and backend workflow accuracy
 - Conduct artificial intelligence specific security testing, including prompt injection, adversarial input validation, jailbreak testing, and sensitive data leakage assessments aligned with Moody's governance standards
 - Define and enforce synthetic or masked test data standards for artificial intelligence feature testing to ensure appropriate handling of confidential and regulated information
 - Monitor and report quality, performance, and artificial intelligence observability metrics including token consumption, streaming latency, tool-call success rates, model error rates, and reliability indicators
 - Integrate automated testing into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, ensuring quality gates and deployment controls are effective and actionable
 - Conduct test code reviews, mentor quality engineering team members, perform exploratory testing, and drive continuous improvement of testing practices and processes
 - Support performance and load testing of cloud-native software-as-a-service platforms on Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure to validate scalability, availability, and reliability requirements
 - Maintain clear test documentation, traceability matrices, defect analysis reports, and quality metrics to ensure transparency and alignment across stakeholders

About The Team

At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today's risks into tomorrow's opportunities. As part of Moody's Insurance Solutions, the Climate on Demand team develops innovative software, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence enabled capabilities that help organizations understand and manage climate and natural catastrophe risks. You will contribute to building impactful solutions that support informed decision-making, strengthen resilience for customers around the world, and advance the adoption of responsible artificial intelligence across our products and services. 

Moody's is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. 

Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody's Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

data.title: Head of Technology / VP Engineering
data.description:
Hiring: Head of Technology / VP Engineering

Company: KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

Location: Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

Experience: 10-15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

CTC: ₹18-24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

Reporting to: Founder & CEO

About KGIL

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses. 

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries. 

About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with CTO-level capabilities who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem. 

This is not a conventional IT management role. 

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions. 

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains. 

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework. 

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Technology Ownership

- Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms. 
 - Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps. 
 - Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans. 
 - Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance. 
 - Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO. 
 - Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses. 
 - Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient. 

2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to: 

- Backend: PHP, Laravel, Node. js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies. 
 - Frontend: React. js, Next. js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks. 
 - Mobile Applications: Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development. 
 - Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD. 
 - Integrations: REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services. 
 - AI & Automation: AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities. 

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks. 

3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion

- Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries. 
 - Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business. 
 - Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms. 
 - Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions. 
 - Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate. 
 - Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities. 
 - Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards. 
 - Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation. 

4. Technology Architecture & Scalability

- Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures. 
 - Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures. 
 - Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management. 
 - Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability. 
 - Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth. 
 - Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements. 
 - Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations. 

5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment

- Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams. 
 - Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements. 
 - Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously. 
 - Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability. 
 - Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements. 
 - Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks. 
 - Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders. 
 - Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners. 

6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity

- Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring. 
 - Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate. 
 - Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes. 
 - Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices. 
 - Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability. 
 - Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations. 
 - Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets. 
 - Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives. 

7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations

- Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers. 
 - Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs. 
 - Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows. 
 - Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements. 

8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration

- Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams. 
 - Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions. 
 - Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans. 
 - Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions. 

Candidate Requirements

Mandatory

- 10-15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4-5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles. 
 - Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production applications. 
 - Demonstrated expertise across multiple backend, frontend and mobile technology ecosystems. 
 - Strong understanding of system architecture, cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs and cybersecurity. 
 - Experience independently building and launching digital products from concept to production. 
 - Proven ability to recruit, manage and scale multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
 - Ability to evaluate unfamiliar technologies and make sound architecture decisions. 
 - Strong problem-solving capabilities and technical decision-making skills.

data.title: Team Lead, Field Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player-coach - guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission-critical technical work yourself. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you are both the technical anchor for your team and Addepar's technical vanguard in the field, translating complex business requirements into production-grade integrations, automations, and data solutions. 

You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite - from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward-deployed delivery model with hands-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high-performing engineering team. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i. e. 2: 30 PM to 11: 30 PM IST. (hybrid role)

What You'll Do

- Serve as a player-coach: provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to a team of field engineers while remaining a hands-on technical contributor on the most complex engagements
 - Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
 - Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross-functional partners
 - Guide the team through issue resolution, proactively escalate blockers, and maintain alignment with client and internal stakeholders
 - Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
 - Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
 - Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
 - Write and review production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
 - Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
 - Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution, mentoring engineers as they grow
 - Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater team efficiency, and develop internal frameworks and best practices that accelerate delivery
 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence the platform roadmap
 - Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

Who You Are

- Experience: Minimum 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles, with demonstrated experience guiding, mentoring, or leading other engineers
 - Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines; strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
 - Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks; proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
 - Pipelines & Automation: Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations; familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
 - Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
 - Engineering Practices: Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
 - Leadership: A solutions-driven, player-coach mindset - able to balance hands-on delivery with coordinating a team, providing feedback, and a commitment to growing your people-management skills
 - Communication: Outstanding communication skills with the ability to conduct technical presentations and translate complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
 - Organization: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to prioritize and context-switch across simultaneous client engagements and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs
 - Mindset: Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial with a strong work ethic, a bias for action, and a passion for client impact; thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

You will work closely with VOIS CIT management, onshore Test Management and programme stakeholders to align scope, risks, timelines, resource requirements and launch decisions. 

You will also use delivery and defect insights to improve test effectiveness, automation adoption and productivity while reducing customer journey testing (CJT) issues and production defect leakage. The role includes direct leadership and development of 8-10 team members, alongside workforce and performance governance.

 - Secure alignment and sign-off with VOIS CIT management, onshore Test Management and programme stakeholders on scope, risks, timelines, consumption plans, resource requirements and launch readiness 
 - Oversee test preparation, daily execution allocation, progress tracking, FUT, launch testing, defect triage and timely resolution through Leads, SMEs and Defect Management 
 - Ensure adherence to test execution, evidence-management, defect lifecycle and defect-governance standards 
 - Improve quality and productivity through automation demand, scripting handover, audits, capacity optimisation and measurable service-level improvements 
 - Analyse delivery and defect data to identify SDLC improvements, reduce CJT issues and production leakage, and improve overall test effectiveness 
 - Act as an escalation point for delivery and defect risks and provide clear daily and senior-management updates 
 - Showcase SIT outcomes through show-and-tell sessions and success stories 
 - Lead and develop the team through regular performance discussions, skills development, training, Vodafone Spirit behaviours, psychological safety and recognition 
 - Maintain workforce governance across utilisation, attendance, leave, timesheets, extra hours, ZBB submissions, succession planning and replacement planning

Who You Are

- You have a minimum of 8 years' experience in software quality engineering, system integration testing and release delivery within a complex technology environment 
 - You have strong knowledge of SIT delivery, release governance, test planning, execution management, defect management and launch assurance 
 - You can assess scope, delivery risk, capacity, productivity and resource requirements across multiple EPICs and releases 
 - You apply data-led problem-solving to test effectiveness, defect prevention, audit quality and continuous improvement throughout the STLC 
 - You have working knowledge of progression and regression automation, including demand prioritisation, handover and execution governance 
 - You can manage and influence stakeholders across onshore and offshore delivery environments and communicate effectively with senior management 
 - You have demonstrated experience in people leadership, coaching, performance development and capability building 
 - You bring commercial awareness to capacity proposals, productivity commitments and approval discussions 
 - You have a good understanding of test management and defect governance tooling, reporting and evidence standards 
 - You have a B. Tech or equivalent bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related engineering discipline 
 - An ISTQB Certified Tester qualification and ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager or Test Management certification are preferred 
 - Relevant Agile certification, such as Professional Scrum Master, Certified ScrumMaster or SAFe Agilist, is preferred 
 - A relevant cloud or DevOps certification, such as Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or equivalent, is desirable

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

Based on the scope of the role, you will have the opportunity to: 

- Take end-to-end accountability for SIT delivery across complex CCS releases and influence release readiness and service quality 
 - Work with cross-functional and onshore/offshore stakeholders across Quality Engineering, Test Management and programme delivery 
 - Develop leadership experience through direct responsibility for a team of 8-10 colleagues 
 - Contribute to measurable improvements in automation adoption, productivity, test effectiveness and defect prevention

data.description:
Job Summary

This hybrid role is for a seasoned Test Lead with ten to twelve years of experience in complex embedded environments focusing on Windows XP Embedded automation using Python and Robot Framework and Embedded C validation. The Test Lead will oversee end to end test planning and execution assure high quality delivery for research and clinical products and collaborate closely with cross functional teams while working primarily in a day shift with no travel requirements. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design and maintenance of comprehensive test strategies for embedded solutions built on Windows XP Embedded to ensure robust functionality performance and reliability across all targeted configurations and use cases. 
 - Oversee the planning and execution of manual and automated test cycles using Robot Framework and Python automation to deliver predictable and repeatable validation outcomes that align with project milestones and quality benchmarks. 
 - Provide technical guidance on the implementation of test scripts in Python and Embedded C to verify firmware behavior interface stability and error handling while ensuring traceability from requirements to test cases. 
 - Drive continuous improvement of the automation framework by extending reusable Python libraries and Robot Framework resources that simplify test development and reduce execution time for regression cycles. 
 - Coordinate defect management activities by reviewing failures with development and research teams analyzing logs and traces from embedded systems and ensuring timely resolution and retest of defects with clear documentation. 
 - Collaborate with research and product teams in R and D as well as preclinical and clinical domains to understand user scenarios regulatory expectations and product risks then translate them into meaningful test coverage and risk based prioritization. 
 - Ensure that hybrid work execution remains efficient by using secure remote access methods clear communication in English and structured reporting practices that keep all stakeholders informed during day shift operations. 
 - Prepare detailed test reports and metrics that highlight coverage defect trends automation effectiveness and readiness for release enabling informed decisions that protect user safety and enhance societal trust in the company products. 
 - Support test environment setup and maintenance for embedded platforms by installing builds configuring hardware and interfaces and validating that test beds mirror intended production conditions for accurate results. 
 - Contribute to product and process quality by identifying opportunities to refine requirements improve design testability and promote early defect detection within the overall development lifecycle. 
 - Guide junior test engineers in applying structured test design techniques for embedded software fostering consistent use of automation clear documentation standards and effective collaboration without formal people management responsibilities. 
 - Participate actively in cross functional discussions to clarify issues propose test optimizations and align on release criteria ensuring that test insights directly support business goals and positive impact on end users. 
 - Champion the use of systematic risk assessment in embedded testing by mapping potential failure modes to targeted test scenarios thereby reducing field issues and enhancing safety for clinical and preclinical applications. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong hands on experience in testing solutions based on Windows XP Embedded with a proven track record of validating system behavior resource constraints and peripheral interactions in complex setups. 
 - Exhibit advanced proficiency in Robot Framework by designing modular test suites keyword driven scenarios and robust automation pipelines that integrate seamlessly with continuous integration tools. 
 - Apply expert level Python and Python automation skills to build maintainable test scripts utilities and automation harnesses that enable scalable regression testing and efficient analysis of test outputs. 
 - Show solid understanding of Embedded C principles including memory management real time constraints and hardware abstraction so that test cases and automation can effectively validate embedded software behavior. 
 - Bring domain awareness of R and D as well as preclinical and clinical environments by appreciating safety considerations data integrity needs and validation expectations that shape test strategies and documentation. 
 - Utilize excellent English reading writing and speaking skills to communicate requirements defects risks and test results clearly with global stakeholders in a hybrid work setting. 

Certifications Required

ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst or Certified Test Automation Engineer or equivalent certification in software testing and automation.

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse engineering team to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design and build the internal platform services that power Truveta's engineering ecosystem. 

You will build software and reusable abstractions that enable engineering teams to develop, deploy, secure, and operate scalable applications on Kubernetes. You will apply strong software engineering and distributed systems fundamentals to Kubernetes-based platforms, designing APIs, services, controllers, developer tooling, and platform capabilities using technologies such as Kubernetes, Istio, Kong, Conductor, and Microsoft Azure. 

As a senior engineer, you will own technical designs, write production software, shape platform architecture, mentor engineers, and establish engineering practices for building maintainable internal platform services. 

This Opportunity

Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same cutting-edge technological innovations that have transformed other industries. We are looking for passionate senior software engineers who are excited to apply their software engineering and distributed systems expertise to help revolutionize healthcare. 

Truveta engineering teams build sophisticated healthcare and data applications at scale. Our Internal Platform team builds the software platform that enables those teams to move quickly while maintaining high standards for security, reliability, and scalability. 

In this role, you will lead the design and development of Kubernetes-native platform services and developer-facing abstractions that simplify application deployment, networking, service-to-service communication, authentication and authorization, configuration, observability, and application lifecycle management. 

You will help design a platform where infrastructure complexity is encapsulated behind well-designed APIs, reusable services, automation, and paved paths, allowing application engineers to focus on building Truveta products rather than becoming experts in the underlying infrastructure. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the design, implementation, testing, and evolution of software that powers Truveta's internal Kubernetes platform. 
 - Build and evolve platform services, APIs, Kubernetes controllers and operators, libraries, and developer tooling used across Truveta Engineering. 
 - Define reusable abstractions and self-service platform capabilities that simplify how engineering teams build, deploy, secure, and operate applications. 
 - Design Kubernetes-native solutions for service networking, traffic management, identity, authorization, configuration, workload orchestration, and application lifecycle management. 
 - Design integrations and extensions around Kubernetes, Istio, Kong, Conductor, Microsoft Azure, and other cloud-native technologies. 
 - Lead architecture and technical design for significant internal platform capabilities. 
 - Design clean, stable interfaces that shield application developers from unnecessary infrastructure complexity. 
 - Apply strong software engineering practices including API design, automated testing, code reviews, versioning, backward compatibility, CI/CD, and production readiness. 
 - Make sound technical decisions that balance developer experience, scalability, performance, security, reliability, maintainability, and delivery speed. 
 - Partner with application engineering and security teams to identify common developer needs and turn them into reusable platform products and paved paths. 
 - Diagnose complex problems spanning application software, Kubernetes, networking, identity, and distributed systems. 
 - Build observability and diagnostics into platform software to make systems easier to understand and troubleshoot. 
 - Own platform software throughout its lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through deployment and production. 
 - Mentor engineers in software design, distributed systems, Kubernetes, debugging, testing, and engineering quality. 
 - Evaluate and contribute to open-source technologies where they improve Truveta's platform capabilities. 

Key Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of professional software engineering experience building production systems. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages such as C#, Go, Java, Python, or C++. 
 - Proven experience designing and building APIs, distributed systems, backend services, platform services, or developer infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, concurrency, networking, distributed systems, and API design. 
 - Hands-on experience building software that runs on, integrates with, or extends Kubernetes. 
 - Experience designing software for reliability, scalability, security, observability, maintainability, and backward compatibility. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and cloud-native application architectures. 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across software services, Kubernetes, networking, and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical designs, influence engineering decisions, and mentor software engineers. 
 - Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Deep hands-on development experience with Kubernetes, including controllers, operators, admission controllers, custom resources, or Kubernetes APIs. 
 - Experience building production software using C#, . NET, Go, Java, or Python. 
 - Experience with Istio, Kong, Conductor, or similar open-source platform technologies. 
 - Experience with service mesh, API gateways, workflow orchestration, service discovery, networking, or identity platforms. 
 - Experience building internal developer platforms, developer tooling, SDKs, CLIs, control planes, or self-service platform capabilities. 
 - Experience designing abstractions or paved paths used by large numbers of software engineering teams. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure-based distributed applications. 
 - Familiarity with infrastructure as code, GitOps, Helm, CI/CD, and deployment automation. 
 - Experience designing observability and diagnostics for distributed systems using logging, metrics, and tracing. 
 - Experience contributing to or extending open-source projects. 
 - Experience building large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, analytics platforms, healthcare platforms, or systems operating in regulated environments.

Truveta is rapidly building a talented and diverse engineering team to solve complex healthcare and technology challenges. We are seeking a Software Engineer who enjoys building cloud-native software and internal platform services. 

You will design and develop software that makes it easier for Truveta engineering teams to build, deploy, secure, and operate applications on Kubernetes. Patients, doctors, and medical researchers deserve the same cutting-edge technological innovations that have transformed other industries. We are looking for passionate software engineers who are excited to apply strong software engineering fundamentals to help revolutionize healthcare. 

Truveta engineering teams build sophisticated healthcare and data applications at scale. Our Internal Platform team builds software and platform capabilities that enable those engineers to move quickly while maintaining high standards for security, reliability, and scalability.

data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer -  Caretech (m/f/d)
data.description:
Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you'll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading. 

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care. 

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need. 

About The Role

As a product development company with a multi-year history of building robust platform and clinical products, we are shaping the future of European healthcare using healthcare open standards. To support this vision, we are engineering a strictly cloud-agnostic web application and require a Lead DevOps Engineer having 7-9 years of hands-on experience in the field of DevOps to define and drive our infrastructure, deployment, and automation strategies. 

Our engineering culture emphasizes high autonomy, flat team alignment, and pragmatic problem-solving principles inspired by Nordic corporate standards. You will join at a critical transition period to lead our repository migration from Azure DevOps (ADO) to GitHub and architect an AI-native development environment. Your strategic decisions regarding Kubernetes and Terraform will ensure our product deploys seamlessly across both managed cloud and self-hosted environments. 

Technology Stack

- Infrastructure & Provisioning: Kubernetes (K8s), Terraform, networking, capacity planning, load balancing, high availability (HA), and disaster recovery (DR). 
 - CI/CD & Source Control: ArgoCD, Azure DevOps (ADO), GitHub (Transitioning), GitHub Actions
 - AI Tooling: GitHub Copilot, Claude (for AI-native/agentic development workflows)
 - Application Development Technologies: Fundamental knowledge of . NET 10, C#, Angular, and TypeScript is nice to have. 

Responsibilities

- Design CI/CD solutions to enable continuous and seamless application delivery. 
 - Infrastructure Strategy: Define the Infrastructure as Code (IaC) governance using Terraform and Kubernetes, strictly maintaining a cloud-agnostic posture that fully supports self-hosted deployments and Mult cluster environment management. 
 - Release on Demand Architecture: Architect and govern Release on Demand capabilities, decoupling continuous deployment from business releases. Design feature toggle strategies, blue/green deployments, and canary rollouts that align with healthcare compliance and SAFe delivery cadence. 
 - DevSecOps & Compliance: Architect compliance-as-code, integrating automated security gating (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning) directly into GitHub workflows to meet strict European healthcare regulations (e. g. , GDPR, NIS2). 
 - Unified Observability: Define a vendor-neutral telemetry and monitoring strategy (utilizing standards like OpenTelemetry) to ensure consistent logging, metrics, and tracing across both cloud and self-hosted deployments. 
 - Troubleshooting: Ability to diagnose and resolve deployment issues by analyzing application and system logs. 
 - Workflow Architecture: Design and implement robust GitHub Copilot workflows and automated pipeline architectures that support our shift toward agentic and AI-native development. 
 - Strategic Migration: Architect and lead the end-to-end repository migration strategy from Azure DevOps to GitHub without disrupting active development cycles. 
 - Disaster Recovery (DR) Architecture: Design and govern multi-region failover strategies, automated backup architectures, and RTO/RPO standards to ensure the continuous availability of critical clinical systems. 
 - Technical Leadership: Act as the primary DevOps authority within our SAFe/Agile Scrum framework, providing fact-based, pragmatic guidance and mentoring to the broader engineering team. 

Technical Qualifications: 

- Extensive Containerization & IaC: Proven architectural experience designing and managing production workloads using Kubernetes and Terraform. Demonstrated ability to decouple infrastructure from specific cloud vendors. 
 - Advanced Deployment Strategies: Deep architectural knowledge of zero-downtime deployment patterns and feature flag management systems tailored for enterprise platform rollouts. 
 - CI/CD Mastery: Deep structural understanding of Azure DevOps pipelines combined with a strong capability to design, build, and automate sophisticated workflows in GitHub. 
 - Ecosystem Familiarity: Understanding of how . NET (C#) and Angular/TypeScript applications compile, build, and deploy at an enterprise scale. 
 - Security & Telemetry Architecture: Deep understanding of healthcare compliance frameworks, secrets management, and designing vendor-neutral observability stacks (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). 
 - AI-Forward Mindset: Practical experience implementing and optimizing AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude) within CI/CD pipelines and developer environments. 

Professional Attributes: 

- Pragmatic & Fact-Driven: You make architectural decisions based on objective metrics, scalability requirements, and logic. 
 - Self-Starter: You thrive in a high-trust environment, driving alignment and managing complex deliverables independently. 
 - Agile Collaborator: Comfortable operating as a leader within a SAFe/Agile Scrum model, prioritizing clear communication with product owners and development teams. 

What's in it for you?

In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. 

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you're interested in. 

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. 

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity. 

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay alert to recruitment scams: 

- Tieto only communicates via @tieto. com email addresses. 
 - We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment. 
 - If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond - verify it via our official careers site. 
 - For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

Hitachi Energy FACTS technology uses a very high-end system for its control, protection and monitoring. This system is called MACH. data.title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Data Platforms
data.description:
Job Summary: 

As a seasoned Staff Software Development Engineer in Data Platform team you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and optimizing the critical data infrastructure that handles hundreds of millions of requests per minute (RPM) for our ingestion services, processes billions of events daily from Kafka, and manages petabytes of data stored in S3. You will leverage your deep expertise to architect and deliver highly scalable, reliable, and performant data solutions that directly impact our global user base and drive our strategic initiatives. 

About the team: 

Data platforms team at JioHotStar is building the next generation of AI-powered experiences and autonomous agents, leveraging our vast data to create truly innovative products. Beyond traditional data engineering, you'll be instrumental in developing the data foundations for our AI initiatives, including the development of our own MCP server and the infrastructure supporting our cutting-edge AI Agents. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Core Platform Development

- Architecture & Design: Build POCs, create architecture designs, and evaluate trade-offs for new services and migrations
 - Real-time Data Pipeline: Build and maintain highly scalable, accurate, clean and real-time events collection systems
 - Data Foundation for AI & MCP: Specifically design and build data pipelines to support the development and training of AI models and autonomous AI Agents. 
 - This includes creating robust data infrastructure for our MCP, ensuring data quality and availability for personalized learning paths and skill validation. 
 - Data Quality Assurance: Continuously work towards detecting, alerting, and fixing quality issues to build trust in our data
 - System Enhancement: Improve existing systems and services using latest tooling and engineering standards
 - Cost Optimization: Improve unit economics across ingestion, storage, and processing componentsTechnical Leadership & Ownership

- Complete Development Lifecycle: Own the entire development process from ideation to deployment
 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with different teams to achieve common goals through efficient coordination
 - Technical Documentation: Maintain up-to-date documentation with architecture diagrams for entire projects
 - Service Ownership: Take complete ownership of services within your workstream and drive continuous improvement
 - Operational Excellence: Establish and maintain robust monitoring, alerting, and operational procedures for mission-critical data systems. Team Leadership & Growth

- Knowledge Sharing: Write blogs and articles to help team members and the community
 - Architecture Breakdown: Break down high-level architecture into manageable services and tasks
 - Technology Trends: Learn and share new trends in technology, engineering, and productivity
 - Team Productivity: Actively work towards improving team productivity and knowledge
 - Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior team membersBusiness Impact

- Data Governance: Govern data assets across the entire company and audit data posture
 - Time to Insight: Reduce time to insight for data team stakeholders
 - Business Decision Support: Assist and challenge business decisions using data insights
 - Stakeholder Service: Make data available to all stakeholders in an efficient, quick, quarriable, and intuitive manner

Skills and attributes for success: 

- Experience: 8+ years of progressive professional experience in data engineering, with a proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale, high-throughput data platforms, ideally in a consumer-facing or streaming industry. 
 - Extreme Scale Experience: Demonstrated experience working with data systems that handle hundreds of millions of events/requests per minute, billions of daily events, and petabytes of storage (e. g. , S3, HDFS). 
 - Programming: Strong proficiency in at least one major programming language such as Python, Java, Scala, or Go, with a focus on building robust, production-grade data applications. 
 - Distributed Data Processing: Deep expertise and practical experience with distributed data processing frameworks like Apache Spark, Apache Flink, or equivalent technologies for batch and streaming workloads. 
 - AI/ML Data Experience: Specific experience in building data pipelines for Machine Learning model training, inference, and feature stores. Familiarity with data needs for AI Agents or similar intelligent systems. 
 - Messaging & Streaming: Extensive experience with high-throughput messaging queues and stream processing platforms like Apache Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent. 
 - Cloud Platforms: Hands-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and their data-related services, with a strong preference for AWS (S3, EMR, Kinesis, Glue, Redshift, etc. ). 
 - Data Warehousing/Lakes: Strong understanding and hands-on experience with modern data warehousing concepts and data lake architectures (e. g. , Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). 
 - ETL/Orchestration: Expertise in building, optimizing, and orchestrating complex ETL/ELT pipelines using tools like Apache Airflow, Prefect, or other workflow management systems. 
 - Databases: Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational (e. g. , PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e. g. , Cassandra, DynamoDB). 
 - Data Modeling: Advanced data modeling skills (dimensional, Kimball, data vault) for large, complex datasets. 
 - Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of debugging and optimizing complex distributed systems. 
 - Communication: Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor, guide, and technically lead senior and junior engineers. 

About JioStar

Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. It's television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies. 

JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.

data.description:
Description

Alexa+ is Amazon's next-generation personal assistant powered by generative AI - more conversational, smarter, personalized, and built to get things done on any device. 

The Alexa 3P Experiences team is on a mission to expand what Alexa+ can do for customers by building consumer-facing experiences with trusted third-party partners like Thumbtack, Yelp, Uber and more. Using frontier AI technologies - including Large Language Models (LLMs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) capabilities - we create agentic experiences that connect customers with an ever-expanding selection of services through natural conversation. 

As an SDE II on this team, you will design and build category-defining experiences that millions of customers interact with daily. You will work closely with product, design, and partner teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that drive customer discovery, engagement, task completion, and monetization. You will contribute to category scaling frameworks - reusable components that enable partners to build sophisticated experiences with minimal effort. 

We're a team that moves fast, builds with AI-native technologies, and measures success by customer impact. If you want to work at the intersection of generative AI and consumer experiences, this is the place. 

Key job responsibilities

- Building high-quality, consumer-facing 3P experiences and Agentic Experts that enable customers to complete tasks through trusted partners on Alexa+. 

- Designing and developing components for category scaling frameworks that enable partners to build sophisticated experiences with minimal effort. 

- Collaborating closely with product, design, and partner teams to deliver experiences that drive customer discovery, engagement, and task completion. 

- Understanding the business impact of your systems and showing good judgment when making technical trade-offs between speed of delivery and long-term scalability. 

- Driving engineering best practices (e. g. , Operational Excellence, Security, Quality) within the team. 

- Contributing to the professional development of colleagues by sharing knowledge, participating in code reviews, and improving engineering practices. 

A day in the life

A typical day will start with a morning huddle to catch up on what you and your team worked on the previous day. This is usually followed by some whiteboard design discussions on the problems the team is working on. The afternoon is mostly spent on project design and implementation work with a heavy dose of code reviews from and for your team along the way. We are a fun, close-knit team where everyone is ready to roll up their sleeves and help each other out, push boundaries, and have fun doing it!

About The Team

Alexa 3P Experiences is a dedicated organization within Alexa Domains, purpose-built to rapidly expand the choices and selection of agentic experiences on Alexa+. Building on early launches with marquee partners, our mission is to offer customers choice and expanded selection in Alexa's agentic capabilities - positioning Alexa to lead in the next generation of ambient AI interactions. We work closely with cross-functional teams across Alexa for core platform capabilities while owning the end-to-end consumer experience and category innovation. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Role Summary

Seeking a hands-on Lead Engineer with 10-12 years of experience across Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing and ETL/ELT, including strong Azure Databricks expertise. The role will lead delivery of governed Lakehouse and warehouse solutions, scalable data pipelines, dimensional and semantic models, certified metrics and Power BI reporting for Insurance and Benefits Management use cases. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end design and delivery of BI, enterprise data warehouse, data-mart and Azure Databricks Lakehouse solutions. 
 - Design Bronze, Silver and Gold layers using Delta Lake, dimensional models, star/snowflake schemas, facts, dimensions and slowly changing dimensions.

 - Apply Unity Catalog governance, RBAC/ABAC, masking, access policies, employer isolation and secure data-sharing patterns. 
 - Optimize Spark workloads, Delta tables, SQL queries, data models, Power BI datasets, refresh performance, compute and storage cost.

 - Lead technical reviews, estimates, sprint delivery, defect resolution, stakeholder communication and mentoring of distributed engineering teams. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

Azure Databricks; Apache Spark; PySpark; Spark SQL; Python; advanced SQL and T-SQL; Delta Lake; medallion architecture; data warehousing, ODS and data marts; dimensional modelling; star and snowflake schemas; SCD Types 1 and 2; ETL/ELT; Azure Data Factory; Auto Loader and Lakeflow; Databricks Workflows and SQL; Photon; Unity Catalog; ADLS Gen2; Power BI data modelling, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, gateways and refresh; SSIS, Informatica or equivalent ETL exposure; data profiling, quality, reconciliation and lineage; REST APIs; Git; Azure DevOps; CI/CD; Terraform awareness; monitoring, security and performance optimization. 

Experience And Qualifications

- 10-12 years of experience in BI, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, data engineering or enterprise analytics, including technical leadership. 
 - Proven experience delivering production BI and DW platforms using Azure Databricks, Delta Lake and modern cloud-data patterns. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Spark/PySpark, SQL, dimensional modelling, ETL frameworks and Power BI integration. 
 - Experience leading data-engineering workstreams, conducting design and code reviews and mentoring engineers. 
 - Experience collaborating with architects, modellers, business users, QA, DevOps, security and reporting teams in Agile delivery. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering or a related discipline; Azure, Databricks or Power BI certification is preferred. 

Domain Experience

- Insurance or employee-benefits experience across employer, client, plan, member, enrollment, carrier, premium, claims and renewal data is preferred.
