Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. 

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. 

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. 

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. 

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be tasked with taking ownership and acting on it, without being tied to a single team or codebase. As company priorities shift, you will move to where your skills make the biggest difference, whether that is a new product area, a scaling challenge, or an ambiguous problem nobody has framed yet. You should be excited about setting technical direction for large-scale distributed systems, comfortable diving into complexity, and eager to own the architecture, reliability, and operability of what you build, while influencing technical strategy across multiple teams and mentoring engineers at all levels. 

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include: 

- Set technical direction by defining the architecture and technical roadmap for the systems you work on, aligning multiple squads of backend and frontend engineers around a coherent long-term vision. 
 - Drive complex initiatives end-to-end, leading the most ambiguous, cross-cutting projects from problem framing through production and delivering under uncertainty. 
 - Own the architecture by making foundational design decisions, choosing patterns and technologies for scale, reliability, performance, and maintainability, and establishing the standards others build on. 
 - Own operability and lifecycle at scale, shaping deployment, observability, patching, and upgrade strategy so that our systems stay secure, reliable, and current. 
 - Own outcomes, not just tasks, taking accountability from design through production and incident resolution. 
 - Multiply the team by mentoring and growing engineers, raising the engineering bar through design and code reviews, and serving as a force multiplier across the organization. 
 - Influence without authority, driving alignment and technical decisions across teams through clear communication and sound judgment. 
 - See your impact, as your work directly improves how customers deploy, operate, and trust SentinelOne, and is a visible part of key company initiatives. 

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have: 

- 8 or more years of backend development experience, including a track record of technical leadership on large-scale systems. 
 - Proficiency in at least one of Go or Python, with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design. 
 - Solid experience with unit and integration testing, and with both relational and NoSQL databases, including database design and sharding. 
 - Proven experience designing distributed systems, including partitioning, consistency, and availability trade-offs, and architecting high-performance, microservices-based backend systems at scale. 
 - Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture and messaging platforms such as Kafka; experience with high-scale API design and resilience patterns such as circuit breakers; and a deep understanding of operating systems and networking fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and with Docker and Docker Compose. 
 - A strong ownership mindset and the agency to act without waiting to be told; comfort with ambiguity, breaking down unclear problems and delivering under uncertainty; and adaptability, learning new domains quickly and being happy to move between teams. 
 - Proven cross-team influence, driving alignment and technical decisions without formal authority, and a track record of mentoring engineers and contributing to their career growth. 
 - Excellent communication skills, including translating technical complexity into business context and leading projects in a hybrid or remote team. 
 - Open-source contributions, experience with AI coding agents and agentic development workflows, experience architecting software for on-prem, self-hosted, or air-gapped deployments, and hands-on experience with the Kafka ecosystem (Kafka Pub/Sub, Kafka Connect, etc. ) are preferred. 

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

Ishan Technologies is looking for an experienced Cluster Reliability Engineer to manage and maintain the compute infrastructure of Saksham AI Services' 1000+ GPU cluster. 

The role involves managing GPU servers, Linux infrastructure, Slurm and Kubernetes environments, cluster reliability, automation and MLOps operations. The selected candidate will play a key role in ensuring high availability, performance, scalability and reliability of AI training and inference workloads. 

The position will also serve as an L2/L3 technical escalation point, working closely with the 24x7 NOC team, platform engineers, customers and technology partners. 

Key Responsibilities

1. GPU Infrastructure & Server Management

- Receive, rack, configure and maintain GPU servers.

 - Support distributed AI workloads, including data, tensor and pipeline parallelism.

- Handle L2/L3 technical escalations from the 24x7 NOC team. 
 - Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. 
 - Develop automation scripts using Python and Bash. 
 - Maintain operational runbooks and auto-remediation procedures. 
 - Track capacity, GPU utilisation, goodput and service-level performance. 
 - Identify recurring issues and implement long-term corrective actions. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in Linux System Administration. 
 - Experience managing GPU servers, GPU drivers, firmware, BIOS and kernel configurations. 
 - Hands-on experience with multi-GPU accelerator servers. 
 - Strong knowledge of Slurm administration and workload scheduling. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes administration for GPU workloads. 
 - Knowledge of GPU Operator, Helm, Kubeflow and KubeRay. 
 - Familiarity with GPU monitoring, ECC/RAS events and vendor diagnostic tools. 
 - Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki or ELK. 
 - Working knowledge of PyTorch, JAX, vLLM and GPU collective communication libraries. 
 - Experience with Docker, Apptainer and container image management. 
 - Automation experience using Python, Bash and Ansible or Terraform.

Experience Requirements

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels of the organization. 
 - Strong leadership, decision-making, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities. 
 - Ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, and deliver outcomes with limited oversight. 

Role Expectations

This is a senior leadership position requiring a combination of strategic thinking, deep functional expertise, strong people leadership, and hands-on delivery ownership. The successful candidate will be expected to build and scale BCCI's TCoE and CSV capabilities as an integral part of Biogen's global technology organization, while ensuring the highest standards of quality, compliance, and delivery excellence.

data.title: Senior Staff Emulation Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs. 

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. You are comfortable sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe, and walking out with a plan that everyone believes in. 

You do not wait for perfect alignment. You ask the right questions, you push back when something does not make sense, and you move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
 - Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
 - Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
 - Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
 - Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
 - Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

The Impact You Will Have

- Accelerate time to market for high performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
 - Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
 - Drive adoption of best in class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
 - Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
 - Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
 - Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
 - Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting edge digital designs and system architectures

What You'll Need

- 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
 - Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
 - Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
 - Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
 - Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
 - You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work, you read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
 - You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
 - You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
 - You are comfortable mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
 - You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

The Team You'll Be Part Of

Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Wind River's technology has supported historic achievements-from NASA's Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world's first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone. 

With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence-including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a "Top Workplace" for ten straight years-Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging.

 - Leverage UNIX/Linux environments, shell scripting, and command-line tools for test automation, debugging, and workflow optimization.

 - Develop, optimize, and release production test programs for offshore manufacturing and production sites.

data.title: Network Performance Engineer – GPU/HPC Infrastructure
data.description:
About the Role

Ishan Technologies is looking for an experienced Network Performance Engineer to build, operate, optimise and maintain the high-performance network infrastructure supporting Saksham AI Services' 1000+ GPU cluster. The role will focus on backend GPU networking, high-speed Ethernet/RoCE and InfiniBand fabrics, front-end connectivity, storage and management networks. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in data centre networking, network performance optimisation, RDMA technologies, congestion control and collective communication benchmarking. The selected candidate will also act as an L2/L3 escalation point for network and performance-related issues raised by Ishan Technologies' 24x7 NOC team. 

Key Responsibilities

1. GPU Network & Data Centre Infrastructure

- Install, configure and operate high-speed backend GPU networks using RoCEv2/Ethernet or InfiniBand. 
 - Manage front-end, storage and out-of-band management networks. 
 - Configure and maintain switches, network interface cards (NICs), transceivers and fibre connectivity. 
 - Work on rail-optimised leaf-spine network architecture. 
 - Maintain network topology, cable mapping and infrastructure documentation. 2. Network Performance & Optimisation

- Configure and optimise BGP, EVPN-VXLAN and leaf-spine network architecture. 
 - Implement congestion control mechanisms, including PFC, ECN/DCQCN, adaptive routing and QoS. 
 - Monitor network bandwidth, latency, packet loss, link flaps and congestion. 
 - Troubleshoot GPU-to-GPU communication and collective performance issues. 
 - Ensure full-bandwidth network performance across different workload and cluster sizes. 3. RoCE, InfiniBand & RDMA Networking

- Manage RoCEv2 and InfiniBand fabrics for GPU/HPC environments. 
 - Work with NVIDIA UFM and InfiniBand management tools. 
 - Configure and troubleshoot RDMA drivers, SR-IOV and GPUDirect RDMA. 
 - Work with NVIDIA ConnectX and AMD Pensando Pollara networking technologies. 
 - Maintain VLAN/VRF segmentation, PKeys and fabric-level tenant isolation. 4. AI Workload & Collective Communication

- Perform collective communication benchmarking using RCCL, NCCL, MPI and related testing tools. 
 - Conduct RDMA performance testing using perftest, ib_write_bw and ib_read_bw. 
 - Work with nccl-tests and rccl-tests to validate network performance. 
 - Understand how data, tensor and expert parallelism impact network utilisation. 
 - Investigate slow-running AI jobs, communication bottlenecks and straggler GPUs. 
 - Collaborate with compute and MLOps teams to optimise AI workload performance. 5. Network Monitoring & Automation

- Develop network monitoring dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana. 
 - Monitor switch health, link errors, optics performance and network congestion. 
 - Automate network configurations, health checks and compliance activities using Python and Ansible. 
 - Maintain network performance baselines and conduct acceptance testing after infrastructure changes. 
 - Support Kubernetes RDMA networking using Multus, SR-IOV device plugins and network operators. 6. Incident Management & Operations

- Handle L2/L3 network and performance escalations from the 24x7 NOC team. 
 - Lead network incident investigations and root cause analysis. 
 - Coordinate with customers, solution architects, vendors and internal engineering teams. 
 - Plan and execute switch, NIC and optics firmware upgrades under change management. 
 - Maintain network runbooks, technical documentation and operational standards. 
 - Support internet edge connectivity, peering and private customer network links. Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience in Data Centre Networking. 
 - Experience with RoCEv2 or InfiniBand networking. 
 - Strong understanding of BGP, EVPN-VXLAN and leaf-spine architecture. 
 - Knowledge of PFC, ECN/DCQCN, QoS and adaptive routing. 
 - Experience with RDMA, GPUDirect RDMA and SR-IOV. 
 - Hands-on experience with NVIDIA ConnectX, Spectrum-X or AMD Pensando Pollara. 
 - Knowledge of RCCL, NCCL, MPI and collective communication benchmarking. 
 - Experience with NVIDIA UFM and InfiniBand management. 
 - Understanding of VLAN, VRF, PKeys and network tenant isolation. 
 - Experience with 400G/800G networking, optics and fibre connectivity. 
 - Working knowledge of Python, Ansible and network automation. 
 - Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, SNMP and streaming telemetry. Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology. 
 - Preferred specialisations: Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications or related disciplines. 
 - Relevant data centre networking certifications will be an added advantage. Preferred Certifications: 

- Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center. 
 - Arista ACE. 
 - Juniper JNCIP-DC. 
 - NVIDIA Networking (InfiniBand/Spectrum-X) certifications. Experience Requirements

- 6-10 years of overall professional experience. 
 - Minimum 4+ years of relevant experience in Data Centre Networking for GPU, HPC or hyperscale environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with RoCEv2 or InfiniBand fabrics is essential. 
 - Experience with large-scale leaf-spine networks, cabling and optics is essential. 
 - Experience in RCCL/NCCL or MPI performance optimisation is preferred. 
 - Exposure to AMD Pensando, NVIDIA Spectrum-X or ConnectX networking is preferred. Key Competencies

- Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
 - Hands-on approach to network engineering and performance optimisation. 
 - Ability to handle critical production incidents under pressure. 
 - Strong ownership and root cause analysis capabilities. 
 - Effective communication with customers, NOC teams and technical stakeholders. 
 - Willingness to participate in a 24x7 on-call support rotation. 
 - Ability to learn and adapt to evolving AI and GPU networking technologies. Key Success Outcomes

- Stable, high-performance GPU networking infrastructure. 
 - Full-bandwidth collective communication across cluster workloads. 
 - Verified network isolation between multiple customers and tenants. 
 - Improved network performance and reduced communication bottlenecks. 
 - Faster resolution of network incidents and performance escalations. 
 - Standardised, automated and well-documented network operations.

Summary

Position Summary

Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III

Role Overview: As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio-consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability-ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. 
 - Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. 
 - Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability-codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks-operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. 
 - Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. 
 - Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement-rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. 
 - Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production-holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. 
 - Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering-cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering-together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning. 
 - Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate-and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff. 
 - Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives. 
 - Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 
 - 5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/. NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks. 
 - 3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems-defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging-e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk. 
 - 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI-plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management. 
 - Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production-their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side. 
 - Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e. g. , LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e. g. , Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution). 
 - Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. 
 - Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e. g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale.

data.title: V&V Sr. Engineer – Embedded Firmware & IoT
data.description:
About the role: 

Looking for a Senior Verification & Validation (V&V) Engineer to own and execute verification and validation activities for our Energy Monitoring, Industrial IoT, and Connected Device products. 

The role will focus on validating pre-production and production firmware, embedded systems, communication interfaces, sensor/meter integrations, data acquisition, data integrity, connectivity, system reliability, and end-to-end device functionality. 

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working hands-on with embedded Linux/MCU-based systems, HIL setups, test automation, communication protocols, smart energy meters, industrial sensors, and cloud-connected IoT devices. 

You will work closely with Firmware, Embedded Hardware, Cloud, Product, and Manufacturing teams to ensure that releases meet functional, performance, reliability, and data-quality requirements before deployment to production. 

Key Responsibilities

Requirements & System-Level V&V

- Collaborate with Firmware, Hardware, Product, Cloud, and Systems teams to understand product requirements and system architecture. 
 - Participate in requirement analysis and High-Level Design (HLD) reviews from a testability and verification perspective. 
 - Review requirements for clarity, completeness, measurability, and testability. 
 - Develop Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) linking requirements → test cases → test results → defects. 
 - Identify verification gaps, ambiguities, edge cases, and potential failure modes early in the PDLC. 
 - Participate as a V&V stakeholder throughout the complete Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC). 
 - Review and approve relevant V&V documentation and act as a V&V sign-off authority where applicable. 

Firmware Verification & Validation

- Develop comprehensive verification strategies for embedded firmware releases. 
 - Create test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Perform validation of: New firmware features, Firmware upgrades, Configuration changes, Boot and initialization sequences, Device provisioning, Fault handling and recovery, Watchdog and reset mechanisms, Persistent configuration, Time synchronization, Logging and diagnostics, OTA/remote firmware upgrade functionality, where applicable
 - Perform pre-production and production firmware validation. 
 - Validate firmware behavior across different hardware revisions and product configurations. 
 - Verify backward compatibility between firmware, device configuration, communication interfaces, and cloud/backend systems. 

Communication Protocol & Interface Testing

Hands-on validation of embedded communication interfaces including: 

- UART / Serial
 - RS-485
 - MODBUS RTU, MODBUS TCP, TCP/IP
 - LTE / Cellular
 - Wi-Fi
 - LoRaWAN
 - MQTT/HTTP or equivalent IoT protocols, where applicable. 
 - Device-to-meter and device-to-cloud communication. 

Test scenarios should include: Valid and invalid packets, CRC/checksum errors, Packet corruption, Timeout handling, Retries, Duplicate packets, Partial packets, Communication loss/recovery, Device restart during communication, Network switching/reconnection, High-frequency data acquisition, Bus contention, Incorrect meter/sensor responses, Boundary values and malformed data, Long-duration communication stability

Smart Meter & Sensor Validation

- Validate integration and data acquisition from multiple field devices, including: 
 - Energy Meters - Smart energy meters, Voltage/current measurements, Active/reactive/apparent energy, power factor, frequency, Import/export energy, Meter registers, Meter scaling and multipliers, Cumulative and instantaneous parameters, 
 - Water Flow Meters - Pulse/output-based meters, MODBUS-based flow meters, LoRa WAN-based water flow meters, Flow rate and cumulative consumption, Missing/duplicate/out-of-sequence readings, Meter rollover and reset scenarios
 - Gas Flow Meters - Flow rate, Totalized consumption, Meter scaling, Communication failures, Invalid/missing readings
 - Fuel-Level Sensors- PT-based fuel-level sensors, Analog acquisition and conversion, Calibration and scaling, Noise and signal stability, Open/short sensor conditions, Out-of-range values
 - Capacitive Sensors- Sensor state detection, Threshold validation, Noise/bounce handling, Environmental variation, False-positive/false-negative scenarios

Data Integrity & Data Quality Testing

A critical responsibility of this role will be ensuring that field data remains correct from sensor/meter → embedded device → communication layer → backend. 

The engineer should validate: 

- Accuracy of acquired data
 - Data type and scaling
 - Unit conversion
 - Timestamp correctness
 - Sequence numbers
 - Counter values
 - Cumulative values
 - Meter rollover
 - Duplicate data
 - Missing data
 - Out-of-order data
 - Corrupted data
 - Data truncation
 - Decimal/precision issues
 - Endianness
 - Signed/unsigned conversion
 - Floating-point/integer conversion
 - Persistent data after reboot
 - Data consistency during network failures
 - Buffer overflow/underflow scenarios
 - Store-and-forward behaviour
 - Data recovery after connectivity restoration
 - Device-to-cloud data consistencyThe engineer should be capable of performing end-to-end data reconciliation between the physical measurement source and the final cloud/application data. 

HIL & System Testing

Design, develop, and maintain Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and system-level test environments. 

Responsibilities include: 

- Develop HIL test setups for embedded devices. 
 - Simulate meters, sensors, communication interfaces, and abnormal field conditions. 
 - Automate device stimulus and response validation. 
 - Test firmware without requiring physical field devices for every test scenario. 
 - Perform boundary and fault-injection testing. 
 - Validate behavior under - Power cycling, Brownout conditions, Communication failures, Sensor failures, Invalid meter responses, Network outages, Reboots, Watchdog resets, High data traffic, Long-duration operationExperience with programmable power supplies, serial interfaces, RS-485 simulators, protocol simulators, electronic loads, signal generators, and other test instrumentation would be valuable. 

Regression Testing

Own the embedded firmware regression process.   

- Establish and maintain a firmware regression suite. 
 - Identify critical test cases that must run for every release. 
 - Execute: Smoke testing, Sanity testing, Feature regression, Integration regression, System regression, End-to-end regression
 - Maintain regression coverage across multiple hardware and firmware versions. 
 - Identify test cases suitable for automation. 
 - Analyze regression failures and determine whether failures originate from firmware, hardware, test infrastructure, communication, or external systems. 

Test Automation

- Develop and maintain automated testing infrastructure to reduce manual testing effort and improve coverage. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with: Python, PyTest / unittest, Serial automation, UART automation, RS-485/MODBUS automation, TCP/IP socket automation, REST API automation, MQTT automation, Log parsing, Test-result reporting, Automated firmware flashing, Device reset/power-cycle automation, Data comparison and validationAutomation should cover repetitive and high-value scenarios such as: 

Configure Device → Flash Firmware → Connect Meter Simulator → Generate Meter Data → Acquire Data → Transmit Data → Validate Cloud/API Data → Inject Failure → Recover → Verify Data Integrity. 

- Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines is highly desirable. 

Performance, Reliability & Stress Testing

- Design and execute long-duration and stress tests to validate product stability. 
 - The engineer should be able to distinguish between functional failures, resource leaks, timing issues, communication problems, and genuine firmware defects. 

Defect Identification & Root-Cause Analysis

- Identify, reproduce, document, prioritize, and track defects. 
 - Create high-quality defect reports with: Clear description, Preconditions, Environment, Hardware revision, Firmware version, Configuration, Test steps, Expected result, Actual result, Logs, Packet captures, Serial traces, Screenshots/data evidence and Reproducibility
 - Work closely with Firmware and Hardware engineers to isolate root causes. 
 - Perform defect verification after fixes. 
 - Maintain defect regression coverage to prevent recurrence along with History Sheet
 - Participate in RCA, 5W2H, CAPA, and corrective/preventive action discussions, where applicable. 

Production Validation

- Support validation of firmware and hardware before production deployment. 

Documentation & Quality

- Create and maintain: V&V strategy, Test plan, Test scenarios & cases, Test scripts
 - Ensure that V&V processes comply with applicable organizational quality processes and relevant industry standards. 

Required Technical Skills

Embedded Systems: 

Strong understanding of: Microcontrollers and SoCs, Embedded firmware architecture, Bootloader and firmware upgrade concepts, Interrupts, Timers, GPIO, ADC/DAC, PWM, Watchdog, RTC, Flash/EEPROM, Memory management, Embedded debugging

Specific experience with some of the following is strongly preferred: STM32, ESP32, NXP i. MX 6ULL, Embedded Linux, SOM-based embedded systems

Communication Protocols: 

Must have strong practical knowledge of at least several of UART, RS-232, RS-485, Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP, TCP/IP, UDP, MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, LTE/4G, Wi-Fi, LoRaWAN

Candidate should understand practical protocol-level debugging, including: Frame structure, CRC, Addressing, Baud rate, Parity, Stop bits, Timeouts, Retries, Packet sequencing, Connection management, Reconnection and Error handling

data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SMTS Software Quality Engineer to join the HIP Runtime Quality Engineering team within the ROCm ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on defect triage, root‐cause analysis, and scalable test automation for the HIP runtime, ensuring robustness, portability, and performance across AMD and NVIDIA GPU backends. 

The role sits at the intersection of runtime systems, GPU APIs, and CI-driven quality assurance, working closely with HIP runtime developers, compiler teams, and system software engineers to improve test coverage and accelerate issue resolution across a fast-evolving open‐source stack. 

HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language designed for CUDA portability and heterogeneous GPU programming in the ROCm platform. 

Key Responsibilities

Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis

- Own end-to-end triage of HIP runtime failures observed in CI, nightly, and release testing pipelines. 
 - Analyze failures across HIP runtime APIs, including memory management, streams, events, kernels, graphs, and device management. 
 - Perform log analysis, repro reduction, and backtrace debugging across Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Correlate failures across: 
 - ROCr system runtime
 - HIP runtime
 - Driver / firmware interfaces
 - Compiler (hipcc / clang) interactions
 - File high‐quality bug reports with clear reproduction steps, root cause hypotheses, and impact assessment. 

Test Automation & Framework Development

- Design, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks for HIP runtime validation using existing HIP test infrastructure (Catch2-based and custom harnesses). 
 - Expand functional, negative, stress, and regression coverage for: 
 - HIP Runtime APIs
 - Graph APIs
 - Memory copy variants (1D/2D/3D, async/sync)
 - Multi-GPU and peer-to-peer use cases
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines with actionable failure reporting. 
 - Develop Python, C++, and shell-based automation for test execution, result aggregation, and trend analysis. 
 - Drive test flakiness reduction and improve signal-to-noise ratio in large-scale CI. 

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with HIP runtime developers to: 
 - Review test gaps for new features and APIs
 - Validate bug fixes and performance-sensitive code paths
 - Collaborate with: 
 - Compiler and language runtime teams
 - ROCr system runtime teams
 - Release engineering and CI infrastructure teams
 - Contribute test fixes and enhancements upstream in open-source HIP/ROCm repositories. 

Quality Metrics & Continuous Improvement

- Define and track quality metrics such as failure escape rate, test coverage, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR). 
 - Identify systemic issues and propose data-driven quality improvements. 
 - Participate in release readiness assessments for HIP runtime drops. 

Required Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles. 
 - Solid proficiency in C++ with debugging experience (gdb/lldb). 
 - Working knowledge of HIP or CUDA runtime concepts, including kernels, streams, memory models, and device execution. 
 - Experience with Linux-based development and debugging. 
 - Familiarity with CI systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar). 
 - Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for low-level systems or runtime libraries. 

Debugging & Analysis Skills

- Ability to reason about runtime abstractions, concurrency, and asynchronous execution. 
 - Strong skills in failure reproduction, minimization, and log-driven debugging. 
 - Experience triaging issues across hardware-software boundaries is a plus. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with GPU programming models (HIP, CUDA, OpenCL). 
 - Familiarity with ROCm stack components (HIP, ROCr, compilers, drivers). 
 - Experience testing graph APIs, async execution models, or multi-GPU systems. 
 - Prior contributions to open-source system software or test frameworks. 
 - Knowledge of Python-based test orchestration and reporting tools. 
 - Knowledge and application of AI tools in validation and testing. 

What Success Looks Like

- Faster, higher-quality issue triage with actionable root cause insights. 
 - Improved automation coverage for HIP runtime APIs and edge cases. 
 - Reduced CI noise and faster feedback for developers. 
 - Strong collaboration with runtime and compiler engineers to ship stable, high-quality HIP releases.

AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work - whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company. 

This role can be based remotely or from an Atlassian office where eligible. Whatever your preference - working from home, an office, or in between - you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle. We call this TEAM anywhere . 

Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend storage solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing distributed storage systems, APIs, and backend services that power mission-critical applications, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data storage. Your work will directly impact system reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

data.description:
Comscore is looking for a Web Developer, Marketing Operations to add hands-on development capability, technical depth and continuity to the team responsible for comscore. com and its Webflow platform. This role will work closely with the primary website owner and other Marketing Operations team members to develop functionality, troubleshoot technical issues, support integrations and maintain a reliable, accessible and effective digital experience. 

The ideal candidate combines strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript development skills with experience working in modern content-management platforms. This person should be comfortable moving between hands-on coding, Webflow administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing and documentation, and should be capable of providing dependable technical backup for critical website operations. 

What You'll Do

- Develop, maintain and troubleshoot functionality for comscore. com and the Webflow platform. 
 - Build and maintain website functionality using HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript. 
 - Support Webflow administration, including CMS collections, templates, components, forms, redirects, localization and related platform configuration. 
 - Develop and maintain integrations between Webflow and other Marketing and business systems, including Eloqua and related forms, workflows and content-gating functionality. 
 - Work with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and JavaScript-based integrations to connect systems and automate website processes. 
 - Troubleshoot browser-side code, integrations, forms, scripts and other technical website issues. 
 - Support website search, filtering, dynamic content and other interactive functionality. 
 - Support development and automation of Comscore's Rankers/Rankings and other data-driven website experiences. 
 - Perform technical QA and testing for website releases, enhancements and new functionality. 
 - Support website accessibility reviews and remediation and work with internal teams to address security and InfoSec findings. 
 - Implement and maintain analytics, tagging and related tracking functionality as required. 
 - Support technical SEO foundations, website performance and site-quality improvements. 
 - Diagnose and support legacy website dependencies as Comscore completes its transition away from legacy infrastructure. 
 - Follow a platform-first development approach, using native Webflow functionality and approved solutions when they reasonably meet business requirements and using custom code when it provides a clear technical or business benefit. 
 - Write clean, maintainable code and avoid unnecessary technical complexity. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of custom code, integrations, configurations, dependencies and troubleshooting procedures. 
 - Maintain shared access and technical documentation so critical website functionality does not depend on one individual. 
 - Track website development work, issues and dependencies through Monday. com and established Marketing Operations processes. 
 - Collaborate with Marketing, Creative, Content, IT, InfoSec and external partners to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. 
 - Provide technical backup and coverage for critical website operations, integrations and issues. 

About Comscore

At Comscore, we're pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we're united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you're motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we'd love to hear from you. 

Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry's emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore. com. 

Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

data.description:
About Amplify Health

Who We Are

Amplify Health is Asia's leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region. 

We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS-based products, PaaS-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS-based on-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value-chain. 

Our joint-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match. 

We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes. 

Our Vision and Ambition

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery. 

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals' lifestyle/ behavioural choices. 

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia's strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools. 

The Position

Summary

The Lead, Engineering is a senior technical leader responsible for driving the design, development, and evolution of Amplify Health's core product platforms. This role blends deep hands-on engineering capability with architectural leadership, mentoring, and strategic influence. 

As a Lead, Engineering, you will own complex technical domains, shape platform-level decisions, ensure engineering excellence, and act as a trusted partner to Product, Data, Cyber Security, and Infrastructure teams. You will set technical direction, reduce system-level risk, and raise the overall engineering bar across the organisation. 

Responsibilities

1) Technical Architecture & Platform Stewardship

- Lead the design and evolution of scalable, secure, and resilient architectures across core product and platform domains. 
 - Own complex system and solution designs, including data‐intensive, cloud‐native, and security‐sensitive use cases. 
 - Make and document high‐impact architectural decisions, balancing short‐term delivery with long‐term platform sustainability. 
 - Act as a recognised technical authority, guiding design choices across multiple engineering teams. 

2) Product Engineering Delivery & Execution

- Own development of critical product and platform components, contributing hands‐on where appropriate. 
 - Partner with Product leadership to shape the roadmap through technical insight, effort estimation, and delivery trade‐offs. 
 - Ensure teams are well prepared for sprint execution, with clear scope, priorities, and technical direction. 
 - Participate actively in agile ceremonies, driving clarity, momentum, and accountability. 

3) Engineering Excellence & Quality

- Champion best practices in software engineering, including code quality, automated testing, performance, reliability, and observability. 
 - Review pull requests, set engineering standards, and ensure consistent application of best practices across teams. 
 - Identify, prioritise, and lead the reduction of technical debt and systemic architectural risks. 
 - Promote strong operational discipline, including production readiness and incident learnings. 

4) Collaboration & Influence

- Work closely with Product, Data, Cloud Infrastructure, Cyber Security, and Technology Operations teams to deliver integrated solutions. 
 - Translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for non‐technical stakeholders. 
 - Influence technical outcomes across teams and domains without direct line management. 

5) Security, Risk & Compliance

- Partner with security, privacy, and compliance stakeholders to ensure platforms meet regulatory and data protection requirements across markets. 
 - Drive adoption of secure-by-design principles, DevSecOps practices, and infrastructure‐as‐code standards. 
 - Proactively identify technical, operational, and delivery risks and lead mitigation strategies. 

6) Coaching, Mentorship & Capability Building

- Mentor and coach engineers at all levels, raising technical capability and engineering maturity across the organization. 
 - Act as a role model for strong engineering judgement, ownership, and resilience in complex environments. 
 - Contribute to building a high‐performance engineering culture grounded in learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

Candidate Profile

Experience and Qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant engineering experience, including at least 3 years operating at a senior technical lead or principal level. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more of: Node. js, React. js, Java, Python. 
 - Proven experience designing and operating systems on Azure cloud, with strong knowledge of DevSecOps and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 
 - Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated success delivering complex systems in regulated or high-availability environments would be highly advantageous. 
 - Proven experience leading technical design and delivery across multiple teams or domains. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field required; advanced degree preferred. 

Competencies & Core Characteristics: 

We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale-up environment: 

- Technical Domain Expertise: Demonstrated depth in modern software engineering, cloud‐native architectures, and platform design, with the ability to solve complex, ambiguous technical problems. Recognised as a technical authority who sets engineering standards and leads by example through high‐quality design and delivery. 
 - Strategic Architect: Able to design and evolve systems with long‐term scalability, resilience, security, and cost efficiency in mind. Consistently balances immediate product needs with future platform sustainability, making thoughtful architectural trade‐offs aligned to business strategy. 
 - Unifier & Cross-Functional Influencer: Builds strong, trust‐based relationships across Product, Data, Cyber Security, and Operations, aligning diverse stakeholders around shared outcomes. Communicates complex technical concepts clearly and influences decisions without relying on formal authority. 
 - Coach & Talent Multiplier: Acts as a mentor and role model, elevating the technical capability and judgement of engineers across teams. Invests in developing others through coaching, constructive feedback, and fostering a culture of learning and engineering excellence. 
 - Data-Driven Decisiveness: Uses data, metrics, and evidence to guide technical and delivery decisions, while remaining pragmatic in the face of uncertainty. Makes timely, well‐reasoned decisions and takes ownership of outcomes, adjusting course as new information emerges. 

Join Us

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply. 

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Senior Full-stack Engineer - Remote
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Where you'll leave your mark?

- Work across the entire stack - seamlessly transitioning between frontend, backend, and infrastructure tasks rather than staying boxed into one layer
 - Be the go-to person for technical guidance and architectural decisions within the team - assuming a leadership role when systems face challenges and driving effective problem resolution
 - Apply a discerning eye to identify and address premature over-engineering, keeping projects moving efficiently instead of gold-plating
 - Navigate long-term trade-offs - recognise the downstream consequences of programming choices and optimise solutions accordingly
 - Ship with the business in mind - code serves the customer problem it aims to solve, and you thrive on making informed trade-offs that address those problems efficiently

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- A minimum of four years of professional programming experience, preferably within a small team where individual ownership is high
 - Language- and tool-agnostic - not dogmatic about a specific programming language, editor, or library; you pick what fits the problem
 - A holistic engineer - comfortable moving fluidly across frontend, backend, and infrastructure rather than identifying with a single specialty
 - A pragmatist over a perfectionist - you spot over-engineering early and know when "good enough now" beats "perfect later. "
 - Business-aware - you understand that engineering decisions are trade-offs in service of the customer problem, and you're energised by making those calls well

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach

data.title: Validation Process Automation Engineer
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. 

Job Description

Role: Validation Automation Engineer

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Work mode: Hybrid, Weekly 3 Days WFO

Experience: 5-8+ years

Reporting line: Manager

Role Overview

Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) operates a global network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories. BPT is supported by global engineering teams developing and maintaining business-critical laboratory applications, including eLIMS-BPT, Eurofins ELN, eQMS and related platforms. 

As a Validation Automation Engineer within the BPT delivery and validation function, the successful candidate will ensure continuity, accuracy and compliance of release-validation activities while progressively automating repetitive work. The role combines hands-on IT validation, controlled documentation, requirements traceability and software automation. Quality, compliance and human review remain central as existing processes are converted into reliable and reusable solutions. 

Required Experience and Skills: 

- 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, IT validation, test automation or quality/compliance roles supporting regulated applications. 
 - Hands-on experience performing validation activities for major and minor releases, patches, emergency changes and production data updates. 
 - Experience reviewing release scope, user requirements, Product Backlog Items (PBIs), defects and supporting test evidence for completeness and consistency. Ability to prepare, maintain and reconcile validation checklists, Requests for Change (RfCs), Module Functional Definitions (MFDs), release item lists and requirements traceability records. 
 - Good understanding of controlled documentation, document lifecycle, revision history, effectivity dates, review and approval workflows, and audit-ready record keeping. 
 - Ability to identify missing evidence, documentation gaps, traceability discrepancies and incorrectly classified functional, non-functional or technical work items. 
 - Experience coordinating with functional analysts, test engineers, developers, application owners and quality stakeholders to resolve validation gaps without compromising release timelines. 
 - Experience supporting recurring compliance activities such as Production Operational Data Updates (PODUs), SOP updates and controlled document submissions. 
 - Ability to understand manual processes, identify automation opportunities and translate them into maintainable scripts, utilities or workflows. 
 - Experience developing automation with suitable error handling, logging, traceability, version control and human review checkpoints. 
 - Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills, with careful attention to data accuracy and cross-document consistency. 
 - Excellent understanding of SDLC, STLC, change control and Agile/Scrum delivery practices. 
 - Experience working with geographically distributed stakeholders and managing time-sensitive release deliverables. Specific Technical Skills: 

- Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps for PBIs, bugs, user requirements, work item history, release scope, queries and end-to-end traceability. 
 - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, C#, JavaScript or PowerShell for workflow and data automation. 
 - Experience automating validation checklist preparation, evidence collection, work-item history verification, requirements traceability and cross-document reconciliation. 
 - Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for validation checklists, reconciliation, data analysis and controlled reporting. 
 - Experience with Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Office for controlled documentation, templates, references and supporting records. 
 - Working knowledge of quality-management/change-control systems for RfC workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of eJIRA or comparable tools for document-control requests and tracking. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD practices for managing, testing and deploying automation solutions. 
 - Ability to validate automated outputs and maintain automation specifications, test results and change history before using outputs in controlled documentation. 
 - Good understanding of APIs, JSON, XML, SQL and data extraction techniques is advantageous for integrating validation and reporting workflows. Desirable Experience: 

- Experience in a GxP-regulated, pharmaceutical, laboratory or life-sciences environment. 
 - Knowledge of Computer System Validation (CSV), data integrity principles and risk-based validation approaches. 
 - Experience supporting LIMS, ELN, eQMS or other regulated laboratory applications. 
 - Experience automating Azure DevOps administration or reporting activities, including metrics, dashboards, sprint and work-item management. 
 - Exposure to robotic process automation, low-code workflow tools or AI-assisted document and evidence checks within approved quality controls. 
 - Understanding of audit preparation, inspection readiness and quality review expectations. 

Additional Information

Personal Skills: 

- Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; 
 - Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; 
 - Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; 
 - Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); 
 - Structured and clear writing skills; 
 - Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; 
 - Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

data.title: Senior Mobile Application Developer
data.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Mobile Application Developer who can independently design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain native mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in native iOS and Android development, with the ability to build scalable, high-performance, secure, and user-friendly mobile applications. 

The developer will own the complete mobile application development lifecycle, including architecture design, implementation, API integration, performance optimization, testing, debugging, and publishing applications to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. The candidate must ensure feature parity, consistent user experience, and maintainable code across both platforms. 

Key Responsibilities

A. Native Mobile Application Development

- Design, develop, and maintain native iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI/UIKit. 
 - Design, develop, and maintain native Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose/XML. 
 - Develop reusable, modular, and maintainable application components. 
 - Ensure consistent functionality and user experience across iOS and Android. 
 - Implement responsive layouts compatible with different screen sizes and device configurations. 
 - Follow platform-specific design guidelines and development best practices. B. Application Architecture & Engineering

- Design and implement scalable mobile application architecture. 
 - Apply architectural patterns such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, and dependency injection. 
 - Write clean, reusable, testable, and well-documented code. 
 - Implement appropriate state management, asynchronous programming, and background processing. 
 - Manage application lifecycle, memory usage, and resource optimization. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions and architecture decisions. C. API & Backend Integration

- Integrate mobile applications with REST APIs and backend services. 
 - Work with authentication mechanisms such as OAuth 2. 0, JWT, and SSO. 
 - Implement secure API communication and session management. 
 - Handle API errors, retries, offline scenarios, and network connectivity issues. 
 - Integrate third-party SDKs and external services as required. D. Mobile-Specific Capabilities

- Implement push notifications using Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification service (APNs). 
 - Implement local storage, caching, and offline data synchronization. 
 - Work with device capabilities such as camera, microphone, GPS, file access, and biometric authentication. 
 - Implement deep linking and universal links. 
 - Handle background tasks, application permissions, and device compatibility. 
 - Integrate analytics, crash reporting, and application monitoring tools. E. Testing & Quality Assurance

- Write unit tests, integration tests, and UI automation tests. 
 - Debug and resolve application crashes, performance issues, and platform-specific defects. 
 - Ensure compatibility across different iOS and Android versions. 
 - Optimize application startup time, responsiveness, memory consumption, and battery usage. 
 - Collaborate with QA engineers to ensure release quality. F. Deployment & Release Management

- Manage application builds, signing certificates, provisioning profiles, and release configurations. 
 - Publish and maintain applications on Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
 - Manage TestFlight and Google Play internal/beta testing releases. 
 - Handle application versioning, release notes, and production deployments. 
 - Troubleshoot App Store and Play Store review/rejection issues. 
 - Support CI/CD automation for mobile application builds and releases. G. Collaboration & Ownership

- Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and product managers. 
 - Translate product requirements and designs into technical implementations. 
 - Participate in code reviews and enforce development standards. 
 - Estimate development efforts and communicate delivery timelines. 
 - Independently own assigned mobile development modules from requirements through production release. 
 - Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate solutions. 

Required Technical Skills

iOS Development Swift

iOS UI Framework SwiftUI and UIKit

Android Development Kotlin

Android UI Framework Jetpack Compose and XML

Architecture MVVM, Clean Architecture

API Integration REST APIs, JSON

Authentication OAuth 2. 0, JWT, SSO

Database / Storage Core Data, Room, SQLite

Push Notifications APNs, Firebase Cloud Messaging

Asynchronous Programming Swift Concurrency, Coroutines, Flow

Version Control Git

Development Tools Xcode, Android Studio

Testing XCTest, JUnit, UI Testing

Deployment App Store Connect, Google Play Console

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience with Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and Remote Config. 
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD tools such as Fastlane, Bitrise, or GitHub Actions. 
 - Experience with Azure cloud services and backend integration. 
 - Experience implementing offline-first mobile applications. 
 - Experience with accessibility and mobile application security. 
 - Experience with WebSockets and real-time communication. 
 - Experience integrating AI-powered services into mobile applications. 
 - Experience with enterprise application development and SSO integrations. 

5. Experience & Qualification

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - 4-7 years of professional mobile application development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in both native iOS and Android development. 
 - Proven experience publishing and maintaining applications on both the App Store and Google Play Store. 
 - Experience working with production applications and handling real-world performance and scalability challenges. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
