We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help design, build, and evolve Walmart's next-generation International Pricing platforms. 

The International Pricing team enables Walmart's mission of Every Day Low Price (EDLP). At its core, the team is responsible for the systems that help set, manage, approve, and execute prices for first-party items across Walmart's international markets. 

The platforms you build will support multiple countries, each representing a multi-billion-dollar business. You will solve complex engineering and business problems involving large-scale data processing, pricing recommendations, rules and workflows, downstream price execution, resiliency, auditability, and market-specific requirements. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to write production-quality code, lead architecture and design, review critical technical decisions, and mentor engineers across the team. 

About the TeamWalmart International Technology enables our stores, eCommerce operations, associates, and customers across markets outside the United States. 

The International Pricing Engineering team builds and operates platforms that support the end-to-end price-setting lifecycle for first-party merchandise. These capabilities include pricing strategy and recommendations, business-rule evaluation, simulations, approval workflows, manual and automated price setting, markdown optimization, competitive pricing intelligence, and price execution through downstream systems. 

Our goal is to build a scalable, resilient, multi-market pricing platform that supports common global capabilities while accommodating the regulatory, operational, currency, hierarchy, and business-process requirements of individual markets.

Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, automate manual processes, improve developer productivity, and deliver measurable business value.

12+ years of relevant software-engineering experience, including experience building highly available, resilient, and scalable distributed systems. 

Strong hands-on programming experience with Java 17/21, Spring Boot or comparable frameworks, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven systems.

data.title: Head of Engineering
data.description:
About Us: 

Fluent Health is a dynamic healthcare startup revolutionizing how you manage your healthcare and that of your family. We provide customers with high-quality, personalized options, credible information through trustworthy content, and absolute privacy. To assist us in our growth journey, we are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Head of Engineering to play a pivotal role in our future success. 

Company Website: https: //fluentinhealth. com/

The Role: 

Head of Engineering is a transformation mandate, not a maintenance hire. 

This role closes a leadership and execution gap on the engineering team by focusing on how software gets built: team quality, delivery velocity, and developer growth. It is distinct from a pure VP hire or a layer of middle management - it is a high-leverage, hands-on engineering leader embedded with the team. 

The clearest way to frame it: CTO and Principal Engineer apply system-design thinking to the technical system - the architecture, the data that feeds it. You apply that same system-design lens to the team - the people and processes that write the codebase, not primarily the architecture itself. Same rigor, different object. In the shorthand we've used in conversation: Principal Engineer sets the engineering bar, and your mandate is to train the team to reach it. 

The core problem this role solves. The gap isn't tooling, architecture, or AI-adoption rate - those are in reasonably good shape. The gap is quality: defect rate and delivery-on-target are both meaningfully off, and that costs the business in rework, delay, and dev motivation. It is the single largest bottleneck in the business today. 

Root cause is structural more than personnel: accountability currently sits with a separate QA function, so developers treat quality as something to hand off rather than something they own end to end. The fix is dev-level ownership of code and tests (not necessarily full TDD, but the person who wrote the code owns its test suite), paired with legibility (code and tests readable by both engineers and AI) and transparency (team-wide visibility into quality, per developer, through to production). This directly reshapes what the release management and QA team does and how it's structured, so this transition gets designed with that team as an active stakeholder, not decided around them and handed down. 

The role is built around two pillars: 

Delivery transformation. Designing and running an engineering operating model where quality is built in, not inspected out - covering sprint design, squad formation, SDLC ownership, execution discipline in how tickets are picked up and delivered, and cross-functional orchestration between engineering, product, QA, and customer success. 

GenAI adoption programme. Leading the team through the shift from traditional development to GenAI-first engineering practice, done hands-on rather than by mandate. Not just using AI tools - redesigning how engineers think about what they own when code is largely generated. AI-first adoption matters and should happen alongside the quality fix, but it is downstream of quality, not a substitute for it. 

Hands-On Expectation: Player-Coach

This is explicitly a player-coach role, not a coach-only role. 

- The bar is not "code like a traditional IC. " Nobody at Fluent codes without AI anymore. The bar is: use GenAI to produce real, shipped, working code often enough that you are a living example of the exact shift you are asking the team to make, from "I write code" to "I orchestrate and validate it. "
 - We're looking for someone who has already proven they can do this in a recent role, and this position asks you to keep doing it here, visibly, as part of the job, not to hit a quota of production commits. 
 - This isn't about holding the technical bar, that's Principal Engineer's lane. It's about staying close enough to the work, via AI-assisted building, that your coaching comes from lived practice, not theory. 

Responsibilities: 

Delivery operating cadence: 

- Sprint structure, squad formation, deploy unit methodology
 - Delivery health metrics and feedback loops
 - SDLC design: from requirements to shipped feature, inclusive of quality
 - Execution discipline: how tickets are picked up, thought through, implemented, and delivered back to the team
 - You own the policy layer for release and quality: what the cadence should be, the direction of the QA-to-dev-owned-testing transition, the metrics that prove it's working. The release management and QA function owns the operational layer within that model, running the actual calendar, the actual go/no-go call, the actual incident response. Partnership, not ownership of their day-to-day. 

GenAI adoption programme: 

- Phase-gated rollout of AI-assisted development across the engineering team, led hands-on
 - Per-team adoption metrics and sprint-specific targeting
 - Coaching engineers from "I use AI tools" to "I architect AI-first workflows"

Data and systems fluency: 

- Raise team competence in how data is interpreted, queried, harmonized, and safely handled across applications and the core system
 - Reduce quality issues that stem from fragmented thinking, inconsistent query logic, or weak system-level understanding of the data layer
 - Improve how engineers understand the broader system, including architecture implications and the downstream effects of moving and transforming data

Engineering people leadership: 

- Direct reports: the engineering team reports to you
 - Hiring: you own the bar, the process, and the decision
 - Performance and career development: 1: 1s, feedback, growth plans are yours to run. Ivan contributes a technical read on each engineer's code quality and growth as one input among others, since he sees that up close, but he does not co-own the review, the decision, or the process. 
 - Real authority as the target state, see "Where You're Stretching" below for how the first 90-180 days will actually work

Cross-functional orchestration: 

- Engineering ↔ product ↔ QA ↔ customer success alignment
 - Operating model for how teams coordinate across a cycle

Leadership Team interface: 

- Honest engineering voice to the leadership team
 - Engineering reality translated for non-technical stakeholders - without softening it

Working with Principal Engineer: 

Complementary, not overlapping, and explicitly peer-to-peer neither of you reports to the other, and both of you report to CTO: 

- Principal Engineer's Lane: sets the engineering bar, models strong coding and system design, focuses on the system/architecture itself. 
 - Your Lane: improves how the team builds software - delivery accountability, coaching, people and process design, raising engineering maturity across the team. 

You're both expected to operate hand in hand as part of a small engineering leadership group (with CTO, delivery, and QA) that regularly reviews team effectiveness, quality trends, and process changes - and both of you are expected to bring an independent, ongoing view on where the company's technology and process choices should evolve, not just execute within your own lane. 

Leadership Expectations: 

- Serve as a teacher, guide, and mentor to engineers - especially in systems thinking and data fluency. 
 - Help bridge communication and cultural gaps on the team where needed. 
 - Take accountability for improving engineering output in partnership with delivery and QA, with the long-term aim of shifting more quality responsibility left onto development. 
 - Support a flatter org design: a small set of strong technical leads rather than a layered management hierarchy. 

Success Measures: 

- Noticeable improvement in engineering velocity and quality, sprint over sprint, after onboarding. 
 - Better consistency in how engineers reason about data and system implications. 
 - Increased adoption of effective AI-assisted engineering workflows through role modeling and coaching, not mandate. 
 - Stronger day-to-day developer guidance without adding unnecessary hierarchy. 

What This Role Is Not: 

- Treating GenAI as a productivity tool rather than a platform shift
 - A layer of middle management added for its own sake - the org design stays flat
 - A pure coach who directs from the sidelines without writing code or doing the work personally

Where You're Stretching: 

- Worth naming plainly: for most candidates who fit this profile, formal engineering people-management - hiring decisions, performance conversations, career development from the manager's chair - is a genuine stretch rather than an established track record. That's fine, and expected, as long as it's a stretch you genuinely want to grow into, not just a title you're technically capable of holding. It's a real reach, not a formality, and success depends on wanting to guide and elevate people, not just being technically capable of it. 
 - Given that, the first 90-180 days work like this rather than assuming day-one authority produces day-one results: Alex partners with you as a backstop on early hiring decisions and performance conversations, with an explicit checkpoint at 90 days to assess how the people-leadership side is landing. The destination - real authority, from day one in spirit if not in fully-proven practice - doesn't change. How we get there does.

The Principal Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for driving the design, implementation, and management of scalable, secure, and highly available AI solutions that power AOT's portfolio of digital products for the public and private sectors. This role blends deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and hands-on leadership - setting architectural direction, championing AI-assisted engineering practices, and mentoring engineers to build the next generation of intelligent, cloud-native applications.  - Strong command of AI-assisted development tools and workflows (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or any other agentic coding agents) and ability to operationalize them across an engineering organization. 
 - Solid understanding of DevOps, SRE and MLOps practices: CI/CD, IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry) and model monitoring. 
 - Deep understanding of secure coding practices, identity and access management, data privacy, accessibility and compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise and public sector software. Experience with process orchestration and workflow tools (e. g. , M8Flow, Camunda, Airflow, Temporal) is a strong plus. Leadership & Communication
 - Proven ability to lead through influence - driving alignment across engineering teams, product, design and executive stakeholders without direct reporting authority. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Strong mentorship and coaching skills, with a track record of growing senior engineers and tech leads.

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer / QA Lead with 10-12 years of experience in cloud-based network management solutions to join our engineering team.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in testing cloud-managed networking solutions, with a combination of networking, AWS/cloud, REST APIs, Python automation, TypeScript/Playwright and end-to-end system testing. 

This role requires someone who can understand and validate the complete solution across: 

Network Device → LAN/WAN → Internet → AWS Cloud → Cloud Services/APIs → Database → Web/Mobile Application

The candidate should be comfortable troubleshooting issues across both the networking and cloud/application layers. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Network Management Testing

Test Execution

 - Validate cloud services, microservices and distributed workflows.

 - Test reliability, availability, scalability and failure/recovery scenarios.

Hands-on Experience With Tools Such As

- Wireshark

 - ping
 - traceroute
 - iperf
 - nslookup/dig

Ability To Troubleshoot Issues Across

Device → LAN/WLAN → WAN/Internet → Cloud → API → Backend → Application

The candidate should be able to use packet captures, logs, API traces and cloud telemetry to determine the root cause of complex issues. 

Test Automation

Python

Job Title: Blue Yonder (JDA) WMS Technical Architect

Experience Level: Senior / Architect Level (7+ Years Total Experience)

Role Description

We are looking for a hands-on Blue Yonder (JDA / RedPrairie) Discrete WMS Technical Architect to lead technical design, custom development, and system integrations for our DSS delivery team across multiple concurrent client engagements. 

In this player-coach leadership role, you will own end-to-end technical architecture while remaining deeply hands-on in MOCA, Java, Oracle PL/SQL, and Blue Yonder WMS Integrator. Working within an Agile delivery model, you will translate complex warehouse functional specifications into high-performing, upgrade-safe customizations (MODs), set engineering and code-review standards, mentor developers, and safeguard production stability across mission-critical distribution centers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Architecture & Solution Design: Partner with functional consultants and client IT stakeholders to translate FDDs into scalable Technical Design Documents (TDDs), interface specifications, and accurate sprint effort estimates. 
 - Core WMS Customizations (MODs): Architect, build, and maintain server-side business logic using MOCA (custom commands, policy/command overrides, triggers, and local syntax), Java components, and Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures and functions. 
 - Enterprise System Integrations: Design and develop real-time and batch integrations connecting Blue Yonder Discrete WMS with ERP (SAP, Oracle), TMS, parcel carriers, labor systems, and WCS/MHE automation via BY WMS Integrator (events, transactions, IFD mappings, and host adapters), RESTful APIs, and XML/JSON payloads. 
 - Code Governance & Technical Mentorship: Establish and enforce coding conventions, unit-testing rigor, and documentation standards; conduct thorough peer code reviews and mentor mid-level and junior WMS developers. 
 - Performance Tuning & Production Escalations: Lead root-cause investigation for high-severity production incidents using MOCA trace logs, server diagnostics, and SQL execution plans; proactively optimize slow-running queries, wave/allocation bottlenecks, and MOCA processes within SLA targets. 
 - Release Management & Agile Execution: Manage source control branching, merging, and rollout packaging in Git/SVN; coordinate SIT, UAT, dry runs, and go-live deployments while driving sprint planning, stand-ups, and backlog execution in JIRA. 

Required Qualifications

- Overall Experience: 7+ years of software engineering and technical architecture experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in Blue Yonder (JDA / RedPrairie) Discrete WMS. (Note: Candidates with Dispatcher-only WMS backgrounds or generic Java/PL/SQL profiles without Blue Yonder Discrete experience will not be considered). 
 - The Four Core Technical Pillars (Mandatory): 
 - MOCA Development: Expert-level ability to write and debug MOCA commands, triggers, overrides, and local syntax, paired with deep proficiency in MOCA trace analysis. 
 - Java: Proven experience building, extending, and maintaining custom Java components integrated within the Blue Yonder WMS server framework. 
 - Oracle PL/SQL & Data Model Mastery: Strong command of writing complex PL/SQL procedures, functions, and performance-tuned queries, backed by intimate knowledge of the Blue Yonder Discrete schema (inventory, orders, waves, work queues, and policy tables). 
 - Blue Yonder WMS Integrator: Hands-on track record designing, building, and troubleshooting Integrator interfaces-configuring events, transactions, IFD mappings, and host communication flows. 
 - Secondary Database & Scripting Skills: Working proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server (T-SQL queries and stored procedures) and JavaScript (for WebUI / PageBuilder screen customizations). 
 - Integration & Engineering Standards: Practical experience integrating WMS with ERP, TMS, parcel, and MHE/WCS platforms, alongside disciplined daily use of Git or SVN, unit testing, and formal code reviews. 
 - Communication & Deployment Flexibility: Ability to articulate architectural trade-offs clearly to functional consultants and client IT leaders, balance priorities across multiple client projects, and support critical dry runs or go-live cutovers across client time zones as needed. 
Education & Leadership Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree (B. E. /B. Tech, MCA, or M. Sc. ) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Self-directed technical leader who takes end-to-end ownership of architectural quality, thrives in fast-paced Agile sprints, and elevates team output through constructive code reviews and clear documentation.

data.description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time. 

At Nextiva, we're reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation. 

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it's through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are. 

If you're ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong. 

Location: This is an onsite role based at Nextiva's Bengaluru office (Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048). Working together onsite strengthens how we operate, enabling faster decisions, clearer communication, and stronger execution, so you can make a greater impact and move work forward with speed and clarity. 

In-Office Expectation: This role is expected to work onsite four days per week, with the potential to increase to five days per week, as required by the business. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity. 

Summary

We're looking for a QA Engineer II (3-5 years of experience) to help build an AI-assisted test automation framework - one where test generation, maintenance, and failure analysis are accelerated by AI rather than done by hand. You'll design and run automated tests across web, mobile, and API surfaces using Playwright and similar tools, and you'll use AI coding and analysis tools to shorten the loop from "test failed" to "root cause identified. " This role fits someone who treats testing as engineering, is comfortable experimenting with tools that didn't exist a year ago, and can tell the difference between AI that saves time and AI that creates noise. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and cases across web, mobile, and API-based applications, incorporating AI-assisted test authoring and resilient (self-healing) locator strategies. 
 - Accelerate test failure analysis using AI tooling: cluster failures by signature, separate flaky tests from real regressions, extract likely root cause from logs, traces, and screenshots, and generate clear, reproducible bug reports. 
 - Use AI coding and analysis tools (e. g. , Copilot, Claude, Cursor) for test generation, visual testing, and defect prediction - and measure whether they improve coverage, speed, or signal quality. 
 - Use Playwright and similar frameworks to expand automated coverage and reduce manual testing time. 
 - Integrate test suites into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous testing, with failure triage built into the feedback loop. 
 - Write and run automated regression, performance, and smoke tests across multiple platforms and environments. 
 - Continuously improve scripts for reliability, speed, and reusability; retire or repair tests that generate noise. 
 - Partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and DevOps to understand product behavior and ensure coverage reflects real user expectations. 
 - Research new tools, frameworks, and AI/ML testing methods; contribute to internal learning and experimentation. 

Skills

- AI-assisted test engineering: prompting and steering coding assistants to produce maintainable test code, reviewing AI-generated tests critically rather than accepting them wholesale. 
 - AI-accelerated failure analysis: using LLM and ML-based tools to triage CI failures, identify flake patterns, and surface root cause faster than manual log reading. 
 - Test framework design: page-object or component-based structures, data-driven tests, parallel execution, environment abstraction. 
 - Visual and behavioral testing: screenshot comparison, DOM/snapshot diffing, and AI-based visual validation. 
 - CI/CD fluency: wiring tests into GitHub Actions or Jenkins, interpreting pipeline results, gating deployments on test signal. 
 - API and contract testing: Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent. 
 - JavaScript proficiency sufficient to build and debug framework code, not just write test steps. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) as test targets and execution infrastructure. 
 - Mobile and performance testing fundamentals. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent hands-on experience. 
 - Experience with AI-powered QA tools or techniques (test generation, failure triage, visual testing, or similar). 
 - Experience writing automated tests using Playwright or similar frameworks. 
 - Solid scripting/programming skills in JavaScript. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , GitHub Actions) and how automated tests fit into deployment workflows. 

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

QA Tester / QA Automation Engineer

Master Data Management (MDM) IT

Position Summary

The QA Tester / QA Automation Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of Master Data Management (MDM) solutions supporting critical business processes. This role will design, execute, and automate testing activities for MDM applications, integrations, workflows, and data quality processes. 

The ideal candidate possesses experience testing enterprise MDM platforms such as SAP MDG, EnterWorks, Informatica MDM or similar solutions. The candidate should have hands-on experience with both manual and automated testing methodologies and be comfortable validating complex business processes, integrations, and master data lifecycle workflows. 

---

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Testing

· Develop and execute test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scripts for MDM initiatives. 

· Perform functional, regression, integration and system testing. 

· Validate end-to-end business processes across MDM platforms and integrated systems. 

· Execute testing for new features, system enhancements, defect fixes, and platform upgrades. 

· Verify data quality, governance workflows, approval processes, and business rules. 

Test Automation

· Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites. 

· Create reusable automation frameworks supporting web, API, and data validation testing. 

· Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. 

· Identify opportunities to reduce manual testing through automation. 

· Monitor and maintain automated test execution results. 

Data Validation & Integration Testing

· Validate master data creation, updates, approvals, and synchronization across systems. 

· Test integrations between MDM platforms and downstream applications such as: 

o SAP ECC/S4

o E-Commerce Platforms

o Vendor Management Systems

· Validate workflow routing, approvals, duplicate-checking logic, and data quality rules. 

Defect Management

· Identify, document, and track defects through resolution. 

· Collaborate with developers, business analysts, product owners, and data governance teams. 

· Participate in root cause analysis and regression testing activities. 

· Support release validation and production readiness activities. 

Continuous Improvement

· Recommend improvements to testing processes and standards. 

· Contribute to automation strategy and QA best practices. 

· Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. 

---

Required Qualifications

Education

· Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. 

· Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. 

Experience

· 3+ years of Quality Assurance testing experience. 

· Experience testing enterprise applications and integrations. 

· Experience working in Agile development environments. 

Technical Skills

· Test automation tools such as: 

o Tricentis Tosca

o Selenium

o Similar automation platforms

· API testing tools: 

o Postman

o REST Assured

o SoapUI

· Test management platforms: 

o Jira

---

Preferred Qualifications

MDM-Specific Experience (Strongly Preferred)

o SAP MDG

o EnterWorks

o Informatica MDM

o Stibo Systems

· Experience validating: 

o Product/Material Master Data

o Vendor Master Data

o Customer Master Data

· Understanding of data governance concepts and workflows. 

· Experience with data quality, deduplication, validation, and stewardship processes. 

Additional Preferred Skills

· 2+ years of experience with automated testing tools and frameworks. 

· Experience with SAP integrations. 

· Experience testing cloud-based applications and APIs. 

· Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. 

· Familiarity with performance testing tools.

About Persistent

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem. 

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487. 6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7. 8% Q-o-Q and 20. 0% Y-o-Y. Our 29, 500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026. 

About Position

We are seeking a highly skilled GenAI Architect to lead the design and implementation of next-generation AI/ML solutions with a strong focus on GenAI Agents, Agentic AI systems, and Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with architectural leadership to build scalable, production-grade AI platforms that deliver tangible business outcomes. 

- Role: GenAI Architect
 - Location: Pune
 - Experience: Between 5 to 8 Years
 - Job Type: Full Time Employment

What You'll Do

- Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise AI/ML and Generative AI solutions. 
 - Design and develop Agentic AI systems and GenAI-powered applications. 
 - Define AI technology roadmaps aligned with business priorities and innovation goals. 
 - Build scalable architectures integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with enterprise systems and domain-specific knowledge sources. 
 - Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks and knowledge retrieval systems. 
 - Guide development teams in AI engineering best practices, solution design, and deployment strategies. 
 - Evaluate emerging GenAI, Agent Frameworks, LLM orchestration platforms, and AI tooling. 
 - Design AI application workflows, orchestration pipelines, and autonomous agent ecosystems. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify AI use cases and business value opportunities. 
 - Establish AI governance, security, scalability, and operational best practices. 
 - Support proof-of-concept development and drive production adoption of AI solutions. 
 - Mentor engineers, AI developers, and technical teams. 
 - Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Machine Learning, and cloud AI services. 

Expertise You'll Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 5-8 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, solution architecture, or advanced software engineering. 
 - Strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and autonomous AI agents. 
 - Deep understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and enterprise AI applications. 
 - Hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-powered applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python 3. x and AI application development. 
 - Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex. 
 - Expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. 
 - Experience integrating vector databases and knowledge retrieval systems. 
 - Strong understanding of AI orchestration, prompting strategies, and agent workflows. 
 - Experience designing scalable and secure AI architectures. 
 - Familiarity with machine learning pipelines and model lifecycle management. 
 - Strong analytical, architectural, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary and benefits package
 - Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
 - Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
 - Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
 - Annual health check-ups
 - Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds. 

- We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles. 
 - Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. 
 - If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment. 

Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent - persistent. com/careers

"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. "

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer 3
data.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast. 

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Engineer 3, Site Reliability Engineering to drive the reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence of business-critical Martech & Communications platforms. This role requires strong cloud engineering expertise, advanced troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to independently design solutions that prevent incidents and improve application performance. The ideal candidate will leverage cloud-native technologies, observability, automation, and AI-assisted engineering to modernize production operations, improve platform resilience, and reduce operational toil. As a senior individual contributor, you will influence engineering decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with global teams to deliver reliable and efficient customer engagement platforms. You will contribute to our established AI-native engineering practices by leveraging AI-assisted software development tools and building agentic AI applications. You are expected to integrate AI into your daily engineering workflows to improve development velocity, software quality, and efficiency while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals. Success in this role requires a continuous learning mindset, responsible use of AI tools, and a focus on delivering measurable business value while optimizing AI resource consumption and costs. 

Job Description

Core Responsibilities

- Reliability Engineering: Design and implement solutions that improve application availability, performance, scalability, and resilience across cloud-native and distributed platforms. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Engineer and optimize AWS/Azure infrastructure, Kubernetes environments, and containerized applications for reliability, security, and efficiency. 
 - Observability & Monitoring: Build reusable monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting solutions to proactively identify and prevent production issues. 
 - Incident Management: Lead complex production investigations, perform root cause analysis, and implement permanent corrective actions to prevent recurring incidents. 
 - Automation & DevOps: Develop reusable infrastructure, deployment, and operational automation using Python, Bash, Terraform, and CI/CD technologies. 
 - AI-Native Operations: Apply AI-assisted tools for diagnostics, incident triage, anomaly detection, and operational automation. Contribute to observability and reliability of AI-enabled applications. 
 - Performance & Cost Optimization: Improve application performance, capacity planning, cloud resource utilization, and infrastructure cost efficiency. 
 - Security & Operational Readiness: Strengthen security controls, vulnerability remediation, production readiness, and operational governance. 
 - Reliability Metrics: Define and track SLIs, SLOs, and operational KPIs related to availability, latency, incident recovery, and scalability. 
 - Technical Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, influence engineering practices, and collaborate across application development, infrastructure, and security teams. 
 - Production Support: Participate in 24x7 on-call rotations and provide technical leadership during critical incidents. 

Required Skills

- 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or related disciplines. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and application troubleshooting. 
 - Experience supporting business-critical production systems in a 24x7 environment. 
 - Demonstrated ability to independently resolve complex technical issues and implement sustainable engineering improvements. 
 - Cloud: Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure. 
 - Containers: Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized application environments. 
 - CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or comparable technologies. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent tools. 
 - Programming & Automation: Strong Python, Bash, or comparable scripting and automation skills. 
 - Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar platforms. 
 - Reliability Engineering: SLIs, SLOs, incident management, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and capacity planning. 
 - Security: Cloud networking, IAM, secrets management, and secure infrastructure practices. 

Good to have

- Experience with AWS services such as EKS, ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, S3, and API Gateway. 
 - Familiarity with Azure services including AKS, Azure Monitor, and Azure OpenAI. 
 - Experience with advanced observability using OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Kibana, and Prometheus. 
 - Exposure to AI observability platforms such as Langfuse, LangSmith, or Arize. 
 - Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or ChromaDB. 
 - Understanding of LLM applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, and AI infrastructure monitoring. 
 - Experience implementing automated remediation, resilience engineering, and reusable operational tooling. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise Martech platforms, customer engagement systems, or large-scale communications services. 

Employees At All Levels Are Expected To

- Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job. 
 - Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services. 
 - Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences. 
 - Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas. 
 - Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers. 
 - Drive results and growth. 
 - Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead. 
 - Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities. 

Disclaimer: This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications. 

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That's why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details. 

Education

Bachelor's Degree

While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience. 

Relevant Work Experience

5-7 Years

data.title: Quality Control Head Sheet Metal
data.description:
Position- Quality Head - Sheet Metal

Location- Gurugram, Haryana, India

Experience- 10-14 years in manufacturing quality, with minimum 5 years in sheet metal

Education- B. E. / B. Tech Mechanical Engineering

Employment- Full-time, senior management

  

  

About the role: We need a Quality Head to own the entire quality function for our sheet metal operations - inspection, QMS, supplier quality and customer audits. You will be the person the customer calls when something goes wrong, and the one who ensures it stops happening. 

  

Must-have requirements

  

- Deep, hands-on knowledge of sheet metal processes - laser cutting, shearing, CNC punching, bending, forming, welding and assembly. 

- Ability to read engineering drawings and apply GD&T, including tolerance stack-up on multi-part assemblies. 

- Working command of press shop operations, press tools and press-part defect analysis; weld shop knowledge including projection and robotic welding. 

- Expertise in ISO 9001, with IATF 16949 and PPAP/APQP experience strongly preferred. 

- Fluency in quality tools - 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto, SPC, MSA, CAPA. 

- Metrology competence: vernier, micrometer, height gauge, surface roughness and CMM-based inspection. 

- Proven experience facing customer and third-party audits as the primary technical interface. 

  

Key responsibilities

  

- Own the end-to-end QMS and maintain it to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and customer-specific requirements. 

- Direct IQC, in-process and final/outgoing inspection gates across cutting, bending, welding, coating and assembly. 

- Set and monitor quality standards, control plans, SOPs and inspection check sheets for all sheet metal processes. 

- Drive rejection, rework and scrap reduction - track PPM, first-pass yield, scrap rate and cost of poor quality. 

- Lead root cause analysis and CAPA for internal failures and customer complaints, and close them within committed timelines. 

- Act as the customer-facing quality interface: complaints, containment, 8D submissions, audits and approvals. 

- Manage supplier quality - vendor audits, incoming material control and supplier corrective actions. 

- Lead internal audits and facilitate second- and third-party audits; close all observations. 

- Handle new product introduction and engineering changes, verifying quality documentation and sign-off. 

- Ensure calibration and validity of all measuring and test equipment. 

- Build, train and appraise the quality team of engineers, inspectors and metrology technicians. 

- Publish quality MIS and KPIs to management, with analysis and improvement plans rather than raw numbers. 

- Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives with production and engineering. 

  

Interested candidates can share their resume at 8750604449-Harshita Joshi or at payal@metaguise. com

data.description:
Location: Bengaluru

Job Description - Semiconductor SoC Design Leader

Position: VP - SoC Design & Engineering

Experience: 22+ Years

Location: Bangalore / India

Industry: Semiconductor / ASIC / SoC Design

About the Role

We are looking for an accomplished Semiconductor SoC Design Leader with 22+ years of experience and a proven track record of owning end-to-end chip and SoC development. 

The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise across the semiconductor design lifecycle and demonstrated experience leading the development of complete SoCs from architecture and specification through RTL, verification, physical implementation, sign-off, tape-out, and silicon bring-up. 

This is a senior technology and engineering leadership role requiring a combination of strong semiconductor fundamentals, hands-on technical depth, cross-functional leadership, customer engagement, and execution ownership. 

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End SoC Leadership

- Own and drive the complete SoC development lifecycle, from product definition and architecture through tape-out and silicon bring-up. 
 - Define SoC architecture, partitioning, interfaces, IP strategy, performance targets, power targets, and implementation methodology. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams across Architecture, RTL Design, Verification, DFT, Physical Design, STA, Analog/Mixed-Signal, Package, and Silicon Validation. 
 - Establish technical direction, development methodology, schedules, milestones, and execution plans. 
 - Take overall ownership of chip-level technical decisions and deliverables. Chip Architecture & Microarchitecture

- Define and review SoC architecture and microarchitecture based on product requirements. 
 - Drive selection, integration, and development of internal and third-party IPs. 
 - Define system interconnect, memory architecture, clocking, reset, power-management, security, and high-speed interfaces. 
 - Evaluate architecture trade-offs involving PPA, performance, area, power, scalability, cost, and time-to-market. 
 - Review architecture specifications and ensure alignment between product requirements and implementation. Design & Verification

- Provide technical leadership across RTL design, IP integration, subsystem development, and SoC integration. 
 - Drive design quality, coding methodologies, design reviews, and RTL sign-off. 
 - Establish verification strategy covering IP, subsystem, and full-chip verification. 
 - Oversee UVM/SystemVerilog-based verification, formal verification, emulation, FPGA prototyping, coverage closure, and SoC validation. 
 - Ensure comprehensive functional, performance, power, and corner-case verification before tape-out. Physical Design & Sign-Off

- Work closely with Physical Design leadership to drive: 
 - Floorplanning
 - Placement and routing
 - Clock Tree Synthesis
 - Power planning
 - IR/EM analysis
 - Timing closure
 - Physical verification
 - DRC/LVS
 - Sign-off
 - Drive cross-functional resolution of PPA and timing challenges. 
 - Ensure successful transition from RTL to GDSII and tape-out. DFT & Silicon Readiness

- Provide leadership for the complete DFT strategy, including: 
 - Scan
 - ATPG
 - MBIST/LBIST
 - JTAG/IJTAG
 - Boundary Scan
 - DFT insertion and verification
 - Ensure DFT architecture and implementation meet manufacturing and test requirements. 
 - Drive silicon bring-up, debug, characterization, and post-silicon issue resolution. Program & Engineering Leadership

- Build and lead high-performing semiconductor engineering teams. 
 - Define organization structure, technical ownership, and engineering processes. 
 - Mentor senior architects, technical leads, and engineering managers. 
 - Drive execution across multiple parallel SoC programs. 
 - Identify technical risks early and establish mitigation strategies. 
 - Manage dependencies across internal teams, customers, IP vendors, foundries, and technology partners. 
 - Drive design reviews, architecture reviews, milestone reviews, and tape-out readiness reviews. Customer & Business Engagement

- Work closely with customers and business leadership to understand product requirements and translate them into technical execution plans. 
 - Participate in customer discussions, technical presentations, design reviews, and executive-level meetings. 
 - Support technology strategy, new business opportunities, proposals, estimations, and technical solution development. 
 - Act as a senior technical representative for the organization with customers and semiconductor ecosystem partners. Required Technical Expertise

- 22+ years of experience in semiconductor/ASIC/SoC development. 
 - Proven experience in complete end-to-end chip/SoC development. 
 - Strong experience taking SoCs from architecture/specification to RTL → verification → synthesis → physical design → sign-off → tape-out → silicon bring-up. 
 - Strong understanding of the complete ASIC/SoC design flow. 
 - Experience leading complex, multi-disciplinary semiconductor engineering teams. 
 - Strong knowledge of one or more areas such as: 
 - SoC Architecture
 - CPU/Processor Subsystems
 - RTL Design
 - Verification
 - Physical Design
 - DFT
 - High-Speed Interfaces
 - Memory Subsystems
 - Power Management
 - Security
 - Experience with advanced semiconductor technology nodes is highly desirable. 
 - Strong understanding of PPA optimization, timing closure, power optimization, design quality, and tape-out readiness. 
 - Experience with industry-standard EDA tools and semiconductor development methodologies. 
 - Strong understanding of ASIC/SoC product development and silicon lifecycle. Preferred Experience

- Experience with complex SoCs involving CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP or accelerator subsystems. 
 - Experience with interfaces such as PCIe, DDR, LPDDR, Ethernet, USB, MIPI, CXL, SerDes, UCIe, or other high-speed protocols. 
 - Experience with advanced nodes such as 7nm, 5nm, 4nm, 3nm or below. 
 - Experience working with leading semiconductor foundries and technology partners. 
 - Experience managing large engineering organizations and geographically distributed teams. 
 - Prior experience delivering multiple successful tape-outs and silicon products. 
 - Experience in semiconductor startups or high-growth environments is an advantage. Leadership Competencies

- Strong technical vision and strategic thinking. 
 - Ability to make complex architecture and engineering decisions. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities. 
 - Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing engineering teams. 
 - Strong ownership and execution mindset. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to operate effectively at both deep technical and executive leadership levels.

About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better. 

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We're fixing it. And we're moving fast. 

We're an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers. 

We're backed by Walmart, the world's largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech's most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining. 

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don't have time to wait. . . and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we're looking for people who are: 

- Ready to run
 - Hungry and driven by urgency
 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
 - Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

Software Engineers at OnePay build the products & systems that serve our customers and run our company. Besides writing, reviewing, and shipping code, engineers collaborate with others across the company, from product, design, and data to, customer support, ops, and compliance. Software Engineers at OnePay are highly technical, communicative, and emotionally intelligent. 

This role is responsible for: 

- Working closely with other engineers to ship code. We enjoy collaboration and partnering on hard problems. 
 - Building and maintaining documentation. As a growing and remote organization, having the necessary docs are key to our success. 
 - Solving complex problems that arise at scale. We deal with real-world money movement, sensitive financial data at scale, and are creating novel financial mechanics with no real precedent. 

You Bring

- 4+ years professional experience building, shipping - and growing - non-trivial products & services. 
 - Professional experience building, shipping - and growing - non-trivial products & services. 
 - We are hiring at all levels of seniority for backend engineers. 
 - Passion for your craft and care for the people you work with. You value quality across code, communication, and culture. 
 - An act-like-an-owner mentality. We have a bias toward taking action. 
 - A desire to keep growing your skills, and an ability to learn quickly. We hope you'll be here for a while, and there's no better investment than in our people. 
 - The Triple H Factor: Hungry, Humble, Honest

Tools We Use

We use Typescript front to back, with node and NestJS frameworks for server code and React Native for our iOS, Android, and Web clients. We run on a highly distributed cloud-native stack with Kubernetes and AWS, and scale and resiliency are at the heart of everything we build. We also embrace agentic development, so engineers have their choice of a variety of models and agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly. 

What We Offer

- Competitive salary, stock options, and benefits from Day 1
 - Comprehensive health insurance coverage (health insurance, accident and disability insurance, term life insurance), including mental health support and wellness programs
 - Hybrid work model (Bengaluru office three days a week), various time off programs (vacation, sick, other paid leaves, and paid regional holidays)
 - Monthly transport and work-from-home allowances
 - A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Standard Interview Process

Our process varies by role. Most candidates go through: 

- AI-assisted initial screen
 - Interview with Talent Partner
 - Technical or Hiring Manager Interview
 - Team Interview
 - Executive Interview
 - Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay. com.

- Role Title: Staff Quality Engineer (Remote)
 - Role Type: Full-time
 - Location: Remote

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage. 

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity. 

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development. 

What You'll Do

1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage. 

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing. 

7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality. 

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization. 

What We're Looking For

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture. 

2. Strong hands-on programming skills and experience building production-grade test automation frameworks. 

3. Extensive experience automating web applications, APIs, and complex end-to-end workflows. 

4. Expertise with modern testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent technologies. 

5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure. 

6. Proven experience designing scalable testing systems rather than exclusively writing or maintaining individual test cases. 

7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows. 

8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work. 

9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers. 

10. Ability to independently own quality engineering architecture while remaining deeply hands-on. 

Nice to have

1. You've built AI-powered testing systems or agentic QA workflows used in real development environments. 

2. You've significantly reduced manual regression testing through intelligent automation. 

3. You've designed testing infrastructure that supports rapid product iteration with a small engineering team. 

4. You've worked on testing AI-powered products, including nondeterministic behaviors, model evaluations, or agentic workflows. 

5. You think about quality as an engineering platform rather than a separate phase of software delivery. 

6. You can move comfortably between writing automation code, investigating complex failures, and designing company-wide quality systems.

data.title: Backend AI Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend AI Engineer based in India . 

This role offers an opportunity to build the core interfaces and backend services powering an enterprise-grade AgenticOps platform. You will connect real-time operator experiences with asynchronous AI agents, making complex reasoning processes, network activity and automated remediation workflows accessible and manageable. Working across frontend architecture, backend-for-frontend services and modern AI frameworks, you will help create reliable tools for IT and security operations teams. A major focus will be delivering responsive visualizations, low-latency streaming and secure human-in-the-loop controls for autonomous systems. You will also integrate advanced model-serving technologies and open-source automation tools into a cohesive platform. This position is suited to a senior engineer who combines deep full-stack expertise with practical experience building AI-native applications. 

Accountabilities

- Design and develop the primary AgenticOps operator console, including real-time telemetry, interactive multi-agent reasoning traces, execution dry-runs and human-in-the-loop approval and override controls. 
 - Build high-performance dynamic topology and directed acyclic graph (DAG) visualizations to represent enterprise network maps, asset dependencies and live multi-agent execution flows. 
 - Optimize canvas, SVG and WebGL-based interfaces to render large-scale network structures and complex reasoning graphs smoothly and without performance bottlenecks. 
 - Engineer bidirectional, low-latency streaming pipelines using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE) and other relevant protocols to deliver agent activity, tool invocation data and live terminal output. 
 - Develop backend-for-frontend (BFF) services and edge middleware using Go, Python with FastAPI, or TypeScript. 
 - Implement secure session-state persistence, token caching, SAML/OIDC authentication and fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC). 
 - Integrate frontend and backend services with agent runtimes, open-source automation tools and AI model endpoints, including NVIDIA NIMs, vLLM and local small language models. 
 - Build intuitive interfaces for autonomous systems, incorporating progressive disclosure of reasoning, confidence and risk scoring, before-and-after change previews and safety-critical confirmation workflows. 
 - Apply AI-assisted software development practices, including automated component scaffolding, synthetic UI testing and continuous evaluation pipelines, to improve engineering productivity and delivery quality. 
 - Collaborate across engineering and platform teams to connect modern AI frameworks, infrastructure integrations and open-source technologies into a reliable enterprise solution. 

Requirements

- Experience: At least 8 years of experience building enterprise-grade full-stack web applications, including at least 3 years focused on AI/LLM-native interfaces, observability platforms (APM/SIEM) or network operations tooling. 
 - Frontend engineering: Advanced proficiency in TypeScript, React or Next. js, and Tailwind CSS. 
 - State management: Hands-on experience with Zustand and TanStack Query, including managing complex application state and real-time data updates. 
 - Rendering and visualization: Production experience with at least one of React Flow, Cytoscape. js, PixiJS or D3. js, using canvas, SVG or WebGL technologies. 
 - Graph interfaces: Ability to build and optimize large hierarchical graphs, network topologies and multi-step agent reasoning trees. 
 - Real-time communication: Strong experience with SSE, WebSockets and chunked streaming, including partial token rendering and optimistic UI updates under network latency. 
 - Backend and BFF development: Experience building backend-for-frontend services using Go, Python with FastAPI, or TypeScript. 
 - Security and authentication: Practical knowledge of SAML/OIDC authentication, RBAC, session-state management and token caching. 
 - AI and agent frameworks: Hands-on experience with at least one of LangChain, LangGraph or Vercel AI SDK, as well as consuming model endpoints powered by NVIDIA NIMs, vLLM or Ollama. 
 - UX for autonomous systems: Strong understanding of user experience design for non-deterministic software, including human-in-the-loop approval and override processes, progressive reasoning disclosure, confidence and risk indicators, change previews and safety-critical confirmations. 
 - Preferred additional experience: 
 - Familiarity with gRPC-Web. 
 - Experience with OpenClaw or Browser-Use. 
 - Knowledge of local small language model (SLM) deployment. 
 - Exposure to NVIDIA or Cisco platform integrations. 
 - Experience applying AI-assisted software development practices, including component scaffolding, synthetic UI testing and continuous evaluation pipelines. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance frontend performance, backend reliability, security and usability in complex enterprise applications. 
Benefits

- Fully remote working arrangement. 
 - Full-time employment opportunity. 
 - Opportunity to work on an enterprise AgenticOps platform combining AI agents, real-time infrastructure visualization and automated operations. 
 - Exposure to modern AI frameworks, model-serving technologies and open-source agentic tools.

data.title: AI Infrastructure System Engineer
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Infrastructure System Engineer based in India. 

Join a team building and operating large-scale GPU infrastructure that powers advanced AI model training and inference. In this role, you will design software-driven systems to automate the entire lifecycle of GPU clusters, from provisioning and deployment to monitoring, repair, and retirement. You will develop intelligent automation and fleet management platforms that improve infrastructure availability, performance, and reliability across thousands of accelerators. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and AI, you will tackle complex distributed systems challenges at an exceptional scale. This is an opportunity for an engineer who prefers building systems over manual operations and is passionate about eliminating repetitive work through automation. Your contributions will help make large-scale AI infrastructure more autonomous, efficient, and resilient. 

Accountabilities

- Design and develop fleet automation systems to provision, validate, deploy, upgrade, repair, and retire GPU clusters with minimal human intervention. 
 - Build AI infrastructure agents that automate deployments, identify root causes of failures, support incident triage, and execute autonomous remediation. 
 - Develop fleet intelligence platforms to monitor hardware health, firmware, networking, storage, thermal conditions, and workload performance, enabling predictive failure detection. 
 - Create software solutions that maximize GPU availability, utilization, performance, and reliability across large-scale accelerator fleets. 
 - Build automated validation systems for GPUs, InfiniBand and RoCE networks, NVLink and NVSwitch technologies, storage infrastructure, and distributed AI workloads. 
 - Develop internal platforms and tools that enable infrastructure teams to manage systems programmatically rather than relying on manual operations. 
 - Continuously improve deployment speed, operational efficiency, and infrastructure reliability through automation and system optimization. 
 - Collaborate with hardware, networking, platform, and AI engineering teams to advance the capabilities of large-scale AI infrastructure. 

Requirements

- At least 3 years of experience building distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, or large-scale backend software. 
 - Strong software engineering skills in at least one of the following languages: Python, Go, or Rust. 
 - Practical experience developing platforms, automation systems, or developer infrastructure. 
 - Familiarity with Linux and infrastructure technologies such as Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools. 
 - Strong systems-thinking abilities, with the capacity to understand and troubleshoot challenges spanning both hardware and software. 
 - A passion for solving complex infrastructure problems through software engineering. 
 - An automation-first mindset, with a strong preference for building systems that eliminate repetitive tasks and manual processes. 

Bonus Experience

- Experience with GPU infrastructure, CUDA, NCCL, NVLink, or NVSwitch. 
 - Knowledge of InfiniBand or RoCE networking technologies. 
 - Experience with bare-metal provisioning and infrastructure lifecycle management. 
 - Exposure to large-scale AI training or inference clusters. 
 - Familiarity with hardware health monitoring and predictive failure detection. 
 - Experience with distributed storage systems. 
 - Knowledge of AI agents and autonomous infrastructure operations. 

Benefits

- Opportunity to work on large-scale GPU infrastructure supporting advanced AI training and inference. 
 - Exposure to complex engineering challenges across distributed systems, hardware, networking, and AI platforms. 
 - Opportunity to build software and automation systems operating across thousands of accelerators. 
 - Close collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
 - Professional growth through hands-on experience with emerging AI infrastructure technologies.

data.title: C# Tech Lead
data.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world's technology. 

What We Offer

Location: 

Bangalore, IND

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you'll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies-like machine learning and AI-to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers' high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors. 

Job Description

Our Team

You will be part of a global software engineering team responsible for organization's equipment software, which controls advanced X‐ray inspection systems used in semiconductor manufacturing. The team works cross‐functionally with hardware, systems, algorithm, and field teams across the US and India to build reliable, high‐performance equipment software. 

Your Opportunity

As part of this team, engineers will work on software for complex electro‐mechanical and X‐ray systems. For senior engineers and the lead role, this position provides strong opportunities to: 

- Influence system architecture and technical direction
 - Take leadership in organization's emerging Advanced Packaging initiative
 - Drive execution across C# and Python based systems
 - Grow new division and set the roadmap and priorities with organization's leadership
 - Work closely with global teams on next‐generation inspection platforms

Roles and Responsibility

- Technical ownership of major subsystems within APX software
 - Design and review software architecture for controls, hardware abstraction, and system workflows
 - Attract and build an engineering team with expertise in semiconductor inspection software and controls
 - Regularly communicate with core team on roadmap and strategy

Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. As a Software Development Manager (SDM) for Amazon Music International Tech, you will be managing a talented team of engineers building and scaling large scale systems allowing international customers to consume music and spoken word the way the want. You inspire people, motivate the team, drive the culture of innovation, implement engineering best practices, and have commitment and grit to deliver results.

The team lead must bring proven experience leading technical teams, deep equities trading and FIX connectivity expertise, and a collaborative, accountable working style.  - Strong knowledge of the FIX protocol, including session and application layers. 
 - Experience configuring and supporting sell-side broker FIX connectivity. 
 - Detailed understanding of equity order messages and order-state transitions.

data.title: AI DevOps Engineer – Platform & Infrastructure
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code. 

What you'll do

- Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
 - Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
 - Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
 - Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
 - Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
 - Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
 - Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

What you bring

- 4-6+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering on production, customer-facing systems
 - Hands-on Azure: Container Apps or AKS, Azure Monitor, Key Vault and Entra ID
 - Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform that you wrote and maintained across environments
 - CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with security scanning and automated quality gates
 - Has operated PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar in production: backups, replication and performance tuning
 - Has designed monitoring and alerting and handled real incidents in live operations
 - Works AI-natively: uses Claude Code or Codex daily. Expect live pairing with a coding agent in the interview
 - English at C1 level and comfort working with colleagues in Munich and 21 markets

Nice to have

- Kubernetes depth, global CDN strategies and China deployments
 - Operating LLM/RAG workloads (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry)
 - FinOps and cloud cost control; WAF/DDoS and hardening in production

Spectro Cloud helps platform teams and cloud providers modernize and manage infrastructure for the AI era without adding more tools or operational complexity. 

With PaletteAI, enterprises, public sector organizations, neoclouds and sovereign clouds can build, govern and operate full-stack environments across VMs, Kubernetes, edge, regulated and air-gapped locations, and AI infrastructure.
