data.title: AI Automation Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

Our client is looking for an AI Automation Engineer to design, build, and operate AI-powered automations that reduce manual effort across business and engineering workflows. 

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on converting ambiguous, human-in-the-loop processes into reliable, monitored, production-grade automations using LLMs, agentic frameworks, APIs, and workflow orchestration tools. 

Minimum Qualifications

- 3-5 years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Automation Engineering, including at least 1 year of hands-on LLM/AI experience. 
 - Strong Python development skills, including API integration, asynchronous programming, testing, packaging, and maintainable code. 
 - Practical experience using LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, or Amazon Bedrock in production applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI/orchestration framework, such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen. 
 - Demonstrated experience building RAG systems using vector stores such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, or OpenSearch. 
 - Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context design, structured outputs, JSON schemas, tool/function calling, and validation. 
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and building MCP servers to expose internal systems as agent tools. 
 - Strong experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth, token-based authentication, webhooks, pagination, and rate-limit handling. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL and data modeling. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, and CI/CD. 
 - Cloud experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including compute, serverless functions, queues, secrets management, and managed AI services. 
 - Basic Docker/containerization knowledge. 
 - Strong stakeholder-management skills, including requirements gathering, prototyping, demonstrations, and expectation management. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and deploy end-to-end AI automations and agentic workflows integrating LLMs with internal systems, APIs, and data sources. 
 - Design and implement RAG pipelines, including chunking, embeddings, vector search, re-ranking, and grounded response generation. 
 - Develop tool/function-calling integrations that allow AI agents to interact with ticketing systems, ERP platforms, document stores, and internal APIs. 
 - Build MCP servers to expose internal systems as tools for AI agents. 
 - Partner with stakeholders to identify high-value automation opportunities and prioritize an automation roadmap based on ROI and feasibility. 
 - Develop production-grade Python services and jobs, including API clients, data transformations, schedulers, and event-driven handlers. 
 - Build LLM evaluation frameworks using golden datasets, regression testing, accuracy checks, hallucination detection, and quality gates. 
 - Implement observability and tracing to monitor failures, costs, latency, and quality degradation. 
 - Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, approval workflows, and safe fallbacks where full autonomy is not appropriate. 
 - Optimize AI applications for cost and latency through model selection, caching, batching, prompt optimization, and model routing. 
 - Document architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures and support automations after production deployment. 
 - Ensure AI solutions comply with security, privacy, responsible AI, access-control, and PII requirements. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Power Automate, Airflow, Temporal, Prefect, or Dagster. 
 - RPA experience with UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism. 
 - Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, LangFuse, Arize, Braintrust, Ragas, or DeepEval. 
 - Experience designing multi-agent systems, including planner/executor and supervisor architectures. 
 - Experience with document intelligence, OCR, PDF parsing, table extraction, and multimodal/vision models. 
 - Frontend experience with React. js, Next. js, or TypeScript. 
 - Exposure to Terraform, CloudFormation, or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with enterprise AI governance, including audit trails, data residency, AI risk reviews, and access-scoped retrieval. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

data.description:
About NCR VOYIX

NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Quality Engineer to own and drive end-to-end quality assurance across a modern retail/POS platform built on React UI, Go-based services, BFF (Backend for Frontend), and distributed microservices architecture. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in automation testing, API validation, database verification, CI/CD quality governance, and retail transaction workflows. This role requires strong technical troubleshooting, defect isolation, and automation leadership to ensure high-quality releases across business-critical retail systems. 

Job Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks across UI, API, service, and integration layers using modern QA tools and best practices. 
 - Build and maintain robust Playwright-based end-to-end automation covering key POS workflows such as checkout, tender processing, receipts, order management, and lane/device interactions. 
 - Perform comprehensive testing of REST and gRPC APIs, including contract validation, negative-path testing, integration validation, and service-level quality verification. 
 - Validate data integrity through extensive SQL Server testing, including complex query validation, stored procedure verification, data profiling, and backend business rule testing. 
 - Own quality gates within CI/CD pipelines by managing automated test execution, flaky test reduction, coverage enforcement, linting standards, and release readiness criteria. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug issues in Docker-based multi-service environments, identifying failures across frontend, BFF, backend services, and infrastructure dependencies. 
 - Develop and execute risk-based test strategies focused on critical retail business domains including payments, inventory management, customer engagement, loyalty programs, and order processing. 
 - Validate distributed system behavior across React applications, BFF layers, and microservices, ensuring seamless end-to-end functionality. 
 - Test and verify POS device and event integrations, including scanner, printer, cash drawer, and peripheral simulation scenarios. 
 - Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Drive root cause analysis through detailed defect investigation using application logs, API traces, database evidence, and reproducible test

scenarios. 

- Ensure adherence to security and compliance requirements, including PII handling, authentication token validation, and PCI-sensitive transaction workflows. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 7+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or a related quality-focused role. 
 - Strong hands-on experience testing applications built with Go and React technology stacks. 
 - Proven expertise in automated testing across UI, API, integration, and service layers. 
 - Extensive experience with Playwright for end-to-end test automation and debugging. 
 - Strong knowledge of REST and gRPC API testing, including contract validation and negative test design. 
 - Advanced proficiency in SQL Server, including complex queries, joins, stored procedures, data validation, and test data analysis. 
 - Experience owning quality initiatives within CI/CD pipelines and release processes. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker/Compose environments, service dependency troubleshooting, and containerized application testing. 
 - Demonstrated ability to create risk-based test plans aligned with business-critical workflows. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging, and defect isolation skills with evidence-driven problem-solving approaches. 
 - Experience validating distributed systems, microservices, and BFF architectures. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Retail, POS, Payments, Commerce, or Transaction Processing systems. 
 - Knowledge of POS device integration testing, including printers, scanners, payment terminals, and cash drawers. 
 - Understanding of security testing practices related to authentication, authorization, PII protection, and PCI compliance. 
 - Experience with observability and troubleshooting tools for distributed

systems. 

- Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence engineering teams and drive quality improvements across releases.

And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Consulting - QA Engineer - ETL & Data Testing : 

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. 

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY's global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues. 

You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team. 

In line with EY commitment to quality, you'll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. 

In this role, you will apply a strong testing mindset across ETL, database, data validation and functional testing. You will validate source-to-target mappings, data transformations, reconciliations and reporting outputs, and support reliable delivery through detailed test execution and defect management. The position is based in Chennai, Hyderabad or Bengaluru and is intended for candidates who can join immediately. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute detailed test cases for ETL, database, data migration and functional testing. 
 - Perform source-to-target validation, data reconciliation, transformation testing, report validation and end-to-end data flow verification. 
 - Write and execute complex SQL queries for data validation, analysis, defect investigation and troubleshooting. 
 - Interpret business requirements, mapping documents and transformation logic to develop effective test scenarios and expected results. 
 - Validate files, database records, web applications and client applications across integrated workflows. 
 - Document test evidence, raise defects and support issues through the complete defect lifecycle using JIRA or Octane. 
 - Collaborate with developers, business analysts and other stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment. 
 - Support test automation using Selenium, Playwright, Python or a comparable automation tool. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in ETL testing, database testing and functional testing. 
 - Strong SQL proficiency, including the ability to write complex queries for validation and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience in source-to-target validation, data reconciliation, migration testing, data transformation testing and report validation. 
 - Ability to understand business requirements, mapping documents and transformation rules. 
 - Good understanding of QA fundamentals, testing methodologies and defect lifecycle management. 
 - Hands-on experience working in an Agile environment. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Working knowledge of at least one automation tool or language, such as Selenium, Playwright or Python. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools, particularly JIRA or Octane. 
 - Experience in the banking or financial services domain. 

What We Look For

We look for a proactive and detail-oriented team player who takes ownership of assigned testing activities, communicates issues clearly and consistently delivers accurate, high-quality work. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. 

- Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. 
 - Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. 
 - People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. 
 - Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. 
 - How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. 

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. 

"We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion". 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES

Engineering Review and Finalization: 

- Review engineering schemes related to the switchyard, ensuring they meet technical and operational standards. 
 - Finalize engineering schemes after thorough review, making necessary adjustments and optimizations. 
 - Collaborate with the Quality department to assist in quality inspections of the finalized schemes, ensuring they adhere to required standards. 

Project Support: 

- Provide detailed technical specifications to the engineering team to ensure proper equipment sizing and compatibility with system requirements. 
 - Support the tendering process by addressing technical queries during discussions and conducting comprehensive technical evaluations of potential vendors. 
 - Review submitted schemes from Adani's side after contract awards, ensuring they align with project goals and standards. 
 - Oversee the entire product preparation process, ensuring all technical requirements and specifications are met. 
 - Conduct Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) to verify that the product meets all operational and safety standards before deployment. 
 - Witness the commissioning of products at the site, ensuring proper installation, integration, and functionality. 
 - Provide technical support to the project team during the commissioning of protection systems, ensuring all procedures are followed correctly. 
 - Assist in the system charging process, verifying that all protection systems are operational and meet regulatory standards. 
 - Review commissioning documents required for regulatory approvals, ensuring accuracy and completeness, and submit them to the appropriate authorities. 

OEM And Maintenance Support: 

- Conduct Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to evaluate potential failure points and their impacts on the system. 
 - Provide technical recommendations and corrective actions from an electrical system perspective to address identified issues. 
 - Support Annual Overhaul (AOH) and Capital Overhaul (COH) processes by providing technical expertise and ensuring all protection systems are maintained and upgraded as necessary. 
 - Conduct annual internal protection audits to evaluate the effectiveness of current systems and identify areas for improvement. 
 - Coordinate external protection audits every five years, working with third-party auditors to ensure compliance with industry standards. 
 - Manage regular system upgrades, including identifying needs, budgeting, collaborating with OEMs, and overseeing the completion of upgrades. 
 - Coordinate relay settings reviews and provide recommendations based on changes in grid conditions to ensure optimal system performance. 

Regulatory And System Studies: 

- Participate in monthly meetings with government regulators, such as regional power committees. 
 - Prepare and present detailed data on system health and any grid occurrences to the Team Lead Protection for submission to authorities. 
 - Conduct comprehensive power systems studies, including load flow, short circuit, transient stability, and electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies for new plant power evacuation. 

Training And Development: 

- Provide protection-related training to internal and external site engineers to enhance their knowledge and skills. 
 - Develop detailed training materials and conduct workshops to ensure all team members are well-versed in protection systems and procedures. 
 - Conduct technical audits to ensure compliance with standards and identify areas for improvement, providing detailed reports and action plans. 

Root Cause Analysis (RCA): 

- Conduct Root Cause Analyses for equipment failures and ensure implementation across all sites. 
 - Provide recommendations and ensure RCA findings are integrated into maintenance plans. 
 - Investigate recurring failures across units and propose solutions under the guidance of the Head of Department (HOD). 

Management Of Change (MOC): 

- Propose and approve Management of Change (MOC) initiatives to enhance performance, reliability, and safety. 
 - Evaluate and approve all MOC proposals related to switchyard protection systems. 

OEM And Maintenance Support: 

- Conduct Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to evaluate potential failure points and their impacts on the system. 
 - Provide technical recommendations and corrective actions from an electrical system perspective to address identified issues. 
 - Support Annual Overhaul (AOH) and Capital Overhaul (COH) processes by providing technical expertise and ensuring all protection systems are maintained and upgraded as necessary. 
 - Conduct annual internal protection audits to evaluate the effectiveness of current systems and identify areas for improvement. 
 - Coordinate external protection audits every five years, working with third-party auditors to ensure compliance with industry standards. 
 - Manage regular system upgrades, including identifying needs, budgeting, collaborating with OEMs, and overseeing the completion of upgrades. 
 - Coordinate relay settings reviews and provide recommendations based on changes in grid conditions to ensure optimal system performance. 

Mergers And Acquisitions (M&A): 

- Conduct technical due diligence for switchyard protection systems-related aspects in Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) activities. 
 - Review equipment designs, site operations, and provide red flags and cost implications. 
 - Assess ongoing disputes, equipment issues, and contracting terms. 
 - Provide comprehensive due diligence report and cost estimates to the Business Development (BD) team. 

Digitization And Automation: 

- Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency. 
 - Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals/strategy. 
 - Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 

People And Team Engagement: 

- Participate in the recruitment process to attract and retain skilled personnel for the team. 
 - Enhance employee engagement across the team to sustain a positive workplace culture. 
 - Lead, inspire, and mentor the team to foster a high-performance culture and ensure cross-skilling through job rotation, technical, and behavioral training. 
 - Ensure proper succession planning in the team. 
 - Foster a conducive environment for high employee retention by ensuring team satisfaction and professional development. "

With over 4, 300 associates across India, U. S. A, and Canada, we help our enterprise clients thrive with technology-enabled transformation across financial services, healthcare, transportation & logistics, and professional services. 

Our work covers complex, mission-critical applications with the latest technologies, such as high-value complex Application & Product Engineering, Data & Analytics, Cloud, DevOps, Data & MLOps, Quality Engineering, and Business Automation. 

Working with Us

Additional Skills: AWS ACL

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive enterprise application architecture strategy using Core Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices. Also ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Lead strategic technical decisions related to application modernization, framework selection, and cloud-native adoption. 
 - Architect distributed systems, microservices platforms, and API-driven ecosystems aligned with enterprise goals. 
 - Establish engineering standards, governance practices, reusable frameworks, and secure development guidelines across teams. 
 - Lead engineering teams and drive collaboration across cross-functional teams and stakeholders. 
 - Drive implementation of non-functional requirements including scalability, observability, security, and disaster recovery. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, technical discussions, and modernization initiatives ensuring future-ready application ecosystems. 
 - Design and drive enterprise messaging and event-driven architectures using relevant messaging and event-streaming technologies. 
 - Collaborate with leadership teams and enterprise architects to align engineering initiatives with organizational strategy. 
 - Drive adoption of DevOps, CI/CD automation, cloud-native engineering, and containerization practices. 
 - Identify technical risks and architectural gaps proactively while defining mitigation strategies for long-term platform stability. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Provides strong technical leadership aligned with business and technology objectives. 
 - Drives architecture and solution design decisions for scalable, secure, and maintainable applications. 
 - Balances delivery accountability with technical excellence, quality, and team collaboration. 
 - Builds and mentors high-performing teams by fostering ownership, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders for successful delivery. 
 - Demonstrates strong stakeholder management and communication by providing visibility into risks and technical decisions. 
 - Drives engineering excellence through governance standards, automation, reusable frameworks, and best practices. 
 - Promotes a culture of quality, performance optimization, reliability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Leads modernization and cloud adoption initiatives supporting enterprise engineering transformation.

data.description:
Job Description

Drives cross-group platform initiatives (e. g. , identity, config, API gateways) with significant impact on reliability, performance, and compliance across the group. Anticipates and resolves ambiguous distributed-systems problems; sets compatibility and deprecation strategies to minimize downstream risk. Establishes shared observability frameworks, SLOs, and capacity models used by multiple teams. Defines architectural guardrails, security controls, and reference implementations in partnership with SRE and security. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Set group-wide guardrails for platform interoperability, security controls, and client library governance. 
 - Own cross-group programs (e. g. , identity, config, API gateway standards) with measurable reliability/performance impact. 
 - Establish shared observability frameworks and rollout policies adopted by numerous teams; manage deprecation risk. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Leads project initiatives to design software solutions and identify and analyze requirements. Writes and defines foundational code for new projects or prototypes. 
 - Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; coaches engineers across teams or units to drive improvements. 
 - Acts as a subject matter expert within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads process, architecture, and code reviews across projects and/or products/services to drive improvements. 
 - Utilizes modern/emerging technologies to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix highly complex software issues. 
 - Leads strategic initiatives to optimize software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging. 
 - Encourages innovation, research, and relevant industry practices to optimize performance across products and domains. 
 - Resolves and may troubleshoot highly complex and systematic issues requiring innovation related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements innovative API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Leads task and project initiatives for the design and development of software, systems, and services. Defines project or design scope; reviews, influences, and approves scope and design recommendations. 
 - Provides technical guidance, domain expertise, and coaching in software architecture decisions and best practices that drive key organizational decisions, including industry standards and competitive considerations, providing mentorship and coaching for small teams and peers and contributing to both individual and team development across line of business/function. 
 - Utilizes innovative methods to conduct highly complex periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards. 
 - Collaborates with stakeholders across lines of business and externally, to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities. 
 - Implements innovative performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 
 - Conducts regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements and translates into decisions and plans that can have a major impact on the organization. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates with stakeholders internally and externally to lead efforts to understand customer issues, root causes, and mitigation to align and explain rationale behind solutions. 
 - Must provide expert technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues to mitigate recurrence. 
 - Acts as an advisor to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements and solutions based on feedback. 
 - Networks across lines of business to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Guides implementation of strategic solutions for customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots the most complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the security team and leadership teams to establish, follow, and improve upon development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members. 
 - Participates in peer review processes and provides technical leadership with initiatives to ensure quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Demonstrates, contributes to, and shares deep expertise of industry best practices and their application to software development processes. 
 - Implements highly complex secure software development practices/solutions requiring modern/emerging innovation to prevent security vulnerabilities, leveraging automated solutions to augment the manual review process. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Leads project initiatives for periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Acts as subject matter expert to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes. 

Collaboration & Partnership:

data.title: E&A Project Engineer
data.description:
Main Purpose of Job: 

To manage the Noodle or Chocolate Manufacturing lines of the factory with regard to Electrical & Automation Maintenance and ensuring No unplanned downtime. Supply (may include in-house generation) and distribution of electricity to ensure that it is at all times safe, reliable, secure and sustainable. It covers low, medium and high voltage installations. Provide factory/site engineering with the required competence on Factory Automation System (FAS), Process Control System and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to effectively support manufacturing operational activities and continuously improve manufacturing performance. The role has a shared responsibility of tasks together with production, warehouse, QA and auxiliary services etc to ensure full requirement and customer satisfaction. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Management responsibilities: 

Define, propose and monitor the plans and objectives of the electrical team in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Electricity & Automation Manufacturing Execution System (E&AMES) Activity as outlined in the Nestlé Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document. 

Propose and implement work processes, procedures and technical resources relating to the electrical & automation team. 

Lead and coordinate the electrical & automation team and maintain competencies, motivation and performance to achieve the teams mission and objectives. 

Propose and control the electrical & automation component of the site M&I budget and any capital projects. 

Propose and monitor electricity in accordance with the key performance indicators. 

Demonstrate and promote the company's values within the electrical & automation team. 

Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members. 

- Functional responsibilities: 

Ensuring line availability / healtiness of high-speed manufacturing lines and ensuring highest level of efficiency and performance from the lines. Ensure that all personnel performing electrical & automation related activities are legally trained and certified. Question the impact on product safety/quality, people safety and environmental during execution of any activity. 

Ensure at all times the technical integrity/performance of the electrical energy supply and distribution. 

Ensure at all times safe installations and operations through proper design, protection systems, procedures and training. 

Liase with the site Safety Officer on electrical & automation matters relating to safety, electricity distribution, energy conservation, legal compliance, complaints etc. 

Coordinate with Production, Quality Management and Engineering to resolve any electrical & automation issues. 

Supervise and coordinate electrical & automation maintenance and project work by electricians, automation technicians and contractors. 

Ensure proper management of electrical & automation documents (manuals, diagrams, instrument data sheet, software packages/licenses) through efficient filing and archiving procedures. Manage the capturing of electrical energy related information and the distribution of this information to the required stakeholder. 

- Maintenance and Improvement of electrical & automation assets. 

Execute the maintenance of the electrical & automation equipment in accordance with the Nestlé Maintenance Strategy using Consequence Driven Maintenance (CDM) as the multi-disciplined approach to proactively maintain/improve the fixed assets and Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM) as the process to manage the asset lifecycle. Adopt the Maintenance Excellence vision by striving for the M&I "Proactive Domain". Monitor plant and equipment to ensure optimal operation and reduction of planned and unplanned downtime. Develop and implement maintenance and inspection plans to ensure reliability, sustainability and security of electrical distribution infrastructure. Ensure technical integrity and performance of automation equipment. 

- Installation of new electrical & automation assets

Ensure that the justification, request for approval and reporting are in line with the Guidelines for Capital Investment. Ensure that new installations are designed with a high degree of flexibility to better enable the operations to adjust to a changing environment keeping in mind safety and the issues relating to the environment. Facilitate the introduction and implementation of new technologies in coordination with local, market, central technical and PTC engineering. 

- Continuous Improvement

Initiate and drive Continuous Improvement (CI) in electricity supply and distribution with the aim of achieving optimised plant performance. Ensure that all members of the team play an active role in assisting the client in improving the energy usage and reducing waste across the site through continual improvement initiatives. 

We are Nestlé, the largest food and beverage company. We are 308, 000 employees strong driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Our values are rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for our future. With more than CHF 91. 4 billion sales in 2018, we have an expansive presence with 413 factories in more than 85 countries. We believe our people are our most important asset, so we'll offer you a dynamic inclusive international working environment with many opportunities across different businesses, functions and geographies, working with diverse teams and cultures. Want to learn more? Visit us at www. nestle. com. Nestlé is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. data.title: Group Leader – End of Line (Ball, Lid, Saw & Pack)
data.description:
Hiring for 3D Glass Solutions, Inc. - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

3D Glass Solutions (3DGS) is a US advanced-packaging company using its patented photo-definable APEX® glass technology for RF, photonics, IC and system-in-package devices. Through its Indian entity, 3DGS is building a vertically integrated glass-core substrate and chip assembly plant in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, approved under the India Semiconductor Mission. The assembly team is small today, and the people who join now will select tools, qualify the line and build the teams that run it. 

Job Roles & Responsibilities

- Lead development, optimization and qualification of ball attach (strip and singulated), reflow, cleaning, TIM and lid attach, strip saw singulation, laser marking, AVI/X-ray inspection and bake and dry pack for FCBGA, fcCSP and wbCSP products

- Own combined process and equipment ownership for the module: process windows, tool qualification (SAT, IQ/OQ/PQ), equipment capability and module yield

- Own the end-of-line quality gate: lot acceptance, sampling plans, MSL classification, dry pack, packing/labeling controls and outgoing quality data

- Lead root cause analysis for defects such as missing/double balls, ball voids, coplanarity excursions, TIM voids, lid tilt, chipping, burrs and delamination

- Establish AVI and X-ray inspection strategy, recipes, accept criteria and escape/false-call monitoring

- Qualify solder balls, fluxes, TIMs, lid adhesives, blades and jigs with suppliers

- Build, train and certify the end-of-line team of engineers and technicians

- Drive PM optimization, spares strategy and troubleshooting on ball attach, lid attach, saws, laser markers, inspection and dry pack equipment

Ideal Candidate Profile

- 10+ years hands-on in ball attach, lid attach, singulation, inspection and packing at an OSAT, ATMP or IDM assembly site, owning multiple tool types

- Engineering degree in Mechanical, Materials, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial or a related field

- Part of at least one new line installation, qualification or capacity ramp

- Has trained and certified entry-level engineers and technicians in a multi-tool production environment

- Experience with SPC, DOE, FMEA, process characterization, yield analysis and structured troubleshooting

- Prior leadership of engineers, technicians and cross-functional teams in a production or ramp environment

- Willing to relocate to Bhubaneswar, Odisha

- Strong grasp of solder ball metallurgy, coplanarity, TIM/lid adhesive behavior and J-STD-020 MSL/dry pack requirements

- Experience with strip and singulated flows, large-body lidded FCBGA and outgoing quality gate ownership is highly preferred

data.title: Principal/Senior Principal Engineer, Verification
data.description:
Job Overview

Arm's Solution Engineering team is looking for experienced PCIe and CXL experts in leading the efforts for verifying the functionality of High Speed IOs at Sub-system level. New team lead will be responsible to lead verification delivery from the team with the team of experienced verification engineers in the team along with other Architects and RTL designers to build next generation SoCs. 

Arm is building a team to develop best-in-class silicon demonstrators based on Arm's IP compute solutions along with Arm's partner ecosystem targeting premium mobile, infrastructure, iot and automotive markets. Using the latest nodes (e. g. 3nm) and new SoC 3D packaging developments, Arm's ambition is to demonstrate industry best-in-class performance by architecting, designing, implementing, and fabricating powerful silicon test chips. This is a wonderful and unique initiative, where we are bringing in innovative talent and expertise from across the semiconductor industry to drive how the next generation of leading compute on Arm devices are built across the industry, opening up significant potential for the future. 

Would you like to play a key role in defining the solution growth story in Arm?

Responsibilities

- As a verification lead with a knowledge of Sub-System integration verification, IO scenario verification, Interoperability verification with Arm and Third Party IPs, PCIe/CXL and PHY verification at the IP and sub-system level, your primary responsibility to deliver fully verified sub-system to the Arm SoC Teams. 
 - You will work with the highly skilled team to understand and review the architecture and design specifications, and to build a functional and performance verification strategy. 
 - Your key responsibilities will include deep involvement in creating verification and test plans, SystemVerilog/Verilog/UVM testbenches and tests, and debugging of test failures and issues. 
 - You will also contribute to developing and improving the verification methodologies used by the team. 
 - In addition, you'll work closely with other teams on the design microarchitecture, verification methodologies, system performance, etc. 
 - You will guide and support the members of the team as needed to enable the successful completion of project activities. 
 - You will balance other opportunities such as working with Project Management on activities, plans, and schedule as well as guide and support junior members of the team. 

Required Skills And Experience

In addition to bringing your accomplishment of either Bachelors or Master's degree in Computer Science or Electrical/Computer Engineering (or similar field) over 15+ years of experience working in design or verification of sophisticated PCIe or CXL subsystems or SoCs, you will need: 

- Solid understanding of digital hardware design and Verilog HDL. 
 - Strong experience in PCIe or CXL protocol and related Verification. 
 - Experience on working with PCIe & CXL VIPs and Emulation friendly Transactors. 
 - Experience on simulation and emulation platforms. 
 - Good debugging experience using debuggers. 
 - Expertise in UVM based verification. 
 - Good knowledge of verification strategies and test plan creation. 
 - Knowledge on formal methodology. 

"Nice To Have" Skills And Experience

- Experience with Arm-based designs and/or ARM System Architectures
 - Clock domain crossing verification
 - Power aware verification
 - Experience with Perl, Python or other scripting language

Our 10x Mindset

Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

data.description:

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 

Title And Summary

Principal Data Engineer - Data Quality

Overview

We are seeking a visionary and technically strong engineering leader to drive the evolution of our Enterprise Data Quality capabilities and platforms. The Principal Data Engineer, Data Quality will lead the design, development, and adoption of scalable data quality frameworks, services, and engineering practices that improve trust, reliability, observability, and governance of data across the organization. 

This role requires a strategic thinker with deep expertise in data engineering, data quality, metadata management, and platform architecture, capable of influencing enterprise-wide technology decisions and partnering closely with engineering, governance, analytics, AI, and business teams to deliver innovative and scalable solutions. The successful candidate will lead the development of reusable capabilities that enable consistent, automated, and measurable data quality controls across diverse data ecosystems, including batch, streaming, cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments. 

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with business acumen, executive presence, and organizational leadership. They will be responsible for balancing immediate business needs with long-term platform strategy, promoting Data Quality as a Product and Data Quality as Code mindset, while leveraging automation, observability, and emerging AI technologies to improve data trust, operational efficiency, and enterprise-wide adoption. 

Role

- Define and drive the enterprise Data Quality strategy, roadmap, architecture, standards, and best practices. 
 - Lead the design, development, and evolution of scalable data quality platforms, frameworks, and shared services supporting batch, streaming, cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments. 
 - Architect and govern metadata-driven, reusable, and configurable data quality capabilities, including rule management, observability, profiling, anomaly detection, and remediation workflows. 
 - Establish enterprise processes for defining, versioning, deploying, and monitoring technical and business data quality rules. 
 - Design and implement Data Quality observability solutions, including trust scores, quality metrics, SLAs, dashboards, alerts, and executive reporting. 
 - Partner with Data Governance, Data Management, Security, Compliance, and business stakeholders to operationalize quality controls and stewardship processes. 
 - Drive adoption of data quality practices across the data product lifecycle, promoting shift-left quality engineering and Data Quality as Code principles. 
 - Ensure quality frameworks are integrated with metadata management, lineage, catalog, governance, MDM, and data contract capabilities. 
 - Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, and mentoring to engineering teams across multiple programs and domains. 
 - Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of data quality tools, platforms, and emerging technologies. 
 - Collaborate with Analytics, Data Science, and AI teams to ensure trusted, high-quality, AI-ready datasets and data products. 
 - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, machine learning, and automation to improve data quality monitoring, root cause analysis, remediation, and engineering productivity. 
 - Establish engineering standards, operational controls, and CI/CD practices to improve platform reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Define and measure key performance indicators to track quality improvements, platform adoption, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. 
 - Influence enterprise-wide technology strategy and champion a culture of data quality, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

All About You

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline. 
 - 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, or Data Architecture. 
 - 5+ years leading enterprise-scale data quality, observability, or data reliability initiatives. 
 - Deep expertise in Data Warehousing, Lakehouse architectures, Metadata management, Data governance and Data quality frameworks
 - Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, Streaming technologies and Cloud data platforms
 - Strong understanding of Data contracts, Lineage, Master Data Management, Metadata-driven architectures and Data observability
 - Experience designing large-scale distributed systems and platform services. 
 - Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills. 

________________________________________

- Experience leveraging AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI technologies to enhance data quality, observability, engineering productivity, and operational efficiency. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, intelligent anomaly detection, automated root cause analysis, and metadata enrichment capabilities. 
 - Experience supporting AI-ready data platforms, including governance, lineage, trust, and quality controls required for AI and GenAI initiatives. 
 - Demonstrated ability to identify and apply AI-driven solutions to solve complex data engineering and data quality challenges. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

- Role Title: Staff Quality Engineer (Remote)

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage. 

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity. 

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development. 

What You'll Do

1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage. 

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing. 

7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality. 

8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization. 

What We're Looking For

1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture. 

2. Strong hands-on programming skills and experience building production-grade test automation frameworks. 

3. Extensive experience automating web applications, APIs, and complex end-to-end workflows. 

4. Expertise with modern testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent technologies. 

5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure. 

6. Proven experience designing scalable testing systems rather than exclusively writing or maintaining individual test cases. 

7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows. 

8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work. 

9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers.

2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows. 

3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes. 

4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues. 

5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk. 

6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing. 

Apply Now!

TEST AUTOMATION ENGINEER

We are looking for a Test Automation Engineer to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow. 

Position Snapshot: 

- Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
 - Type of Contract: Permanent
 - Grade: Band 2
 - Type of work: Hybrid
 - Work Language: Fluent Business English

The Role: 

As a Test Automation Specialist, you will be working on the Business Applications powering the Nespresso Retail and Trade network, as well as Customer Relations Centers. You will work in an employee-facing applications context, supporting large volumes of internal users and transactions, while being part of a large development organization with a direct impact on the business. 

As a central part of the software engineering community, you will bring deep technical expertise and knowledge to the product team, being part of the technical reference team for Nespresso web applications and focusing on quality strategy and automation practices. You will guide and promote the optimal use of processes and technology to support the cost-effective delivery of business requirements within your area of expertise. 

As the Automation Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the correct execution of the QA and testing strategy across the Retail, Trade, and Customer Service domains, ensuring the quality and reliability of our business applications, with a strong focus on driving the test automation framework. You will work closely with cross-functional delivery teams to ensure the adoption of QA and testing practices, and with Release and DevOps teams to streamline the release cycle and improve the overall quality of our web applications. You will also make a strong contribution to the QA strategy through a community of practice in collaboration with the QA Office. 

In This Role, You Will: 

- Apply the test automation framework and infrastructure, ensuring its reliability and scalability. 
 - Contribute to the creation of a growing full test automation library. 
 - Participate in defining and keeping the QA and testing strategy for our Business Applications up to date. 
 - Participate in defining and keeping the test automation strategy and practices for Nespresso up to date, using industry-standard tools and frameworks to ensure maximum test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Ensure that cross-functional delivery teams in the Retail, Trade, and Customer Service domains follow the defined guidelines and deliver according to the quality standards of Nespresso release cycles. 
 - Mentor and guide QA engineers and testers, providing technical expertise and support in test automation. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, DevOps, and Release Engineers to continuously improve the overall quality and efficiency of the testing process. Actively participate in the QA community of practice alongside QA Leads and the Nespresso QA Office. 

What We're Looking For: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 7+ years of professional experience. 
 - Proven experience as an Automation Test Engineer or in a similar role, specifically in web application testing. 
 - Strong knowledge of API testing methodologies, tools, and frameworks. 
 - Proven experience using Gherkin and Xray. 
 - Proficiency in using test automation tools and frameworks, such as Playwright. 
 - Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. 
 - Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with keen attention to detail. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively in English with people at different levels of the organization. 

Extra Skills That Set You Apart: 

- Passion for technology, test automation, and DevOps, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical populations in a large organization. 
 - Experience working in a global environment and collaborating with virtual teams. 

We Offer You: 

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself. 

- Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
 - Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset. 
 - Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
 - International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits. 
 - The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world's most trusted brands. 

The Hiring Process: 

- Your Application: Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international). 
 - Initial Screening: Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview. 
 - Hiring Manager Interview: Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail. 
 - Stakeholder Interview: Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration. 
 - Leadership & HRBP Interaction: Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP. 
 - Feedback: After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.

About Nespresso: 

The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.

We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.

data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

Keep GSK's standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section. 

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK's Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment. 

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform ownership: run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner's backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Reliability: achieve 99. 9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred. 
 - Everything as code: manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Secure by default: enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards. 
 - Golden paths: build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team's time. 
 - AI Agentic automation: Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails. 
 - Compliance: keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline. 
 - Toolchain rationalisation: be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting. 
 - Developer experience: measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours. 
 - Leadership: set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect's reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 
 - Area of Specialisation
 - Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

- Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
 - Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
 - Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts. undefined
 - Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
 - Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
 - Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Desirable: 

- Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert). 
 - Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc. 
 - Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices
 - Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

Skills

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
The Application Modernization Platform (AMP) team is dedicated to solving one of the industry's biggest challenges: transforming rigid, legacy applications that suffer from poor scalability and high operating costs into modern, microservices-based architectures on MongoDB. An important aspect of this is Data Migration. MongoDB is building a world-class team in India to build tooling that helps customers migrate their data from legacy relational databases to MongoDB in real-time. As companies modernise their application and data ecosystems, they are increasingly drawn to the flexibility and scalability of the document model. The tools developed by the Data Migration team are critical in this journey, helping customers with schema modeling, initial data loads, and continuous data synchronization. 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with experience in the Java ecosystem, streaming systems, and data-intensive applications to join our team. We are building a sophisticated data migration suite using a modern technology stack, which includes Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Debezium, and React. A successful candidate will be a key contributor to our backend services, collaborating closely with product management and other engineers to design and implement cutting-edge products that solve complex customer challenges. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon for our hybrid working model. 

The ideal candidate for this role will have

- 6+ years of commercial software development experience with at least one JVM language such as Java, preferably using the Spring ecosystem
 - Solid experience in software architecture and development
 - Extensive experience with streaming data platforms such as Apache Kafka and Change Data Capture (CDC) tools like Debezium
 - Extensive experience with relational and document data modeling and hands-on experience with at least one SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, etc) and at least one document database (e. g. MongoDB)
 - Exposure to client-side technologies such as JavaScript and React is a plus
 - Good understanding of algorithms, data structures and their time and space complexity
 - Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to the overall technical direction and roadmap of the team
 - Curiosity, a positive attitude, and a drive to continue learning
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Position Expectations

- Contribute high-quality, well-tested code to the modernization and framework team and its surrounding services
 - Collaborate effectively with Product Management, other engineers, and designers to build and deliver on the product roadmap
 - Participate actively in code reviews to enforce best practices and patterns
 - Help troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in our distributed systems
 - Give and solicit feedback on technical design documents and pull requests
 - Perform tasks related to process such as CI/CD, quality, testing, etc

Success Measures

Within the first three months, you will have

- Familiarize yourself with the MongoDB Modernization Infrastructure & Frameworks stack
 - Set up software development infrastructure (tech stack, build tools, etc) to enable development using the relevant tech stacks
 - Started collaborating with your peers and contributed to code reviews and design reviews

Within six months, you will have

- Familiarised yourself with the rest of our the application modernization tool stack
 - Delivered at least one large scale feature that spans the entire tech stack
 - Reviewed and contributed to scope and technical design documents

Within 12 months, you will have

- Become a key contributor to our stack, capable of taking on complex features independently
 - Helped recruit and interview new members of the team
 - Collaborated effectively with other teams at MongoDB on cross-functional projects

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

With offices worldwide and over 67, 000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. 

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
