data.title: Associate Manager-Quality Investigation
data.description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

Every day, everything we do is driven by an unwavering commitment to delivering safe and effective products to patients. Our quality culture, which is both science and risk-based, is designed to be flexible, innovative, and customer-oriented. Whether your role involves development, maintenance, compliance, or analysis through research programs, your contribution is crucial and will have a direct impact on patients. 

Key Responsibility

- Independently review and challenge microbiological deviation, OOS/OOT, contamination, environmental monitoring (EM) excursion, sterility assurance, and objectionable organism investigations to ensure scientific robustness and regulatory compliance. 
 - Evaluate investigation strategy, data integrity, and adequacy of evidence to ensure conclusions are supported by facts and scientific rationale. 
 - Drive effective root cause analysis utilizing structured investigation tools such as 5-Why, Fishbone Analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, and Human Error Reduction techniques. 
 - Assess product, process, patient, and compliance risks and ensure appropriate risk mitigation measures are identified and implemented. 
 - Review and challenge proposed CAPAs to ensure they address the true root cause and are capable of preventing recurrence. 
 - Ensure investigations comply with cGMP requirements, internal quality standards, and regulatory expectations from FDA, EMA, MHRA, PIC/S, and WHO. 
 - Partner with Microbiology, Manufacturing, Engineering, Technical Services, Validation, and Quality teams to strengthen investigation effectiveness and quality culture. 
 - Coach investigation owners on scientific reasoning, critical thinking, technical writing, and investigation best practices. 
 - Identify recurring trends, systemic gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement within microbiological quality systems. 
 - Support contamination control strategies and continuous improvement initiatives related to aseptic processing and sterility assurance. 

Key Deliverables

- Timely closure of microbiological investigations without compromising investigation quality. 
 - Improved effectiveness and depth of root cause analysis. 
 - Reduction in repeat deviations and recurring contamination-related events. 
 - Enhanced quality and regulatory compliance of investigation reports. 
 - Improved CAPA effectiveness and sustainability. 
 - Strengthened contamination control and sterility assurance practices. 
 - Increased capability of site personnel in performing scientifically sound investigations. 
 - Improved inspection readiness and reduction in regulatory observations related to investigation quality. 
 - Development of a robust knowledge base for microbiology-related quality events and lessons learned. 

Education Qualification

- B. Pharm, M. Pharm, M. Sc. Microbiology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline. 
 - 6+ years of experience in sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing, microbiology, quality assurance, or investigation management. 

Required Skills

- Quality Assurance
 - Quality Management Systems (QMS)
 - Microbiological Investigations
 - Root Cause Analysis
 - Risk Management
 - Data Integrity
 - Regulatory Compliance (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PIC/S)
 - Technical Report Review and Approval

Transferable Skills To Develop

- Critical Thinking and Scientific Decision Making
 - Investigative Interviewing Techniques
 - Risk-Based Assessment and Prioritization
 - Data Analysis and Trend Evaluation
 - Technical Writing and Report Critique
 - Influencing Without Authority
 - Problem Solving and Systems Thinking
 - Stakeholder Management
 - Effective Communication and Coaching

Key Investigator & Reviewer Competencies

- Ability to distinguish symptoms from true root causes. 
 - Ability to challenge assumptions and identify investigation gaps. 
 - Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail. 
 - Capability to assess investigation completeness and scientific soundness. 
 - Ability to identify bias and ensure fact-based decision making. 
 - Strong understanding of human performance and human error reduction concepts. 
 - Effective questioning and interviewing skills to obtain factual information. 
 - Capability to evaluate product quality impact and patient risk objectively. 

Values/Behaviours to Develop

Excellence

- Focus on what matters most. 
 - Measure outcomes and drive continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrate scientific rigor in decision making. 
 - Promote a right-first-time investigation culture. 

Courage

- Speak up and challenge unsupported conclusions. 
 - Make quality-based decisions using facts and data. 

Equity

- Demonstrate objectivity, fairness, and consistency in investigation reviews. 

Joy

- Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

data.title: – Quality Leader
data.description:
Introduction

The Quality Leader will design, establish and govern an enterprise Operations Quality Framework for Business Orchestration Services - India. The role converts client requirements, delivery risks and customer expectations into a consistent operating system across multiple practices including Finance & Accounts, HRTT and R&C supporting clients through multiple channels voice, chat, email and back-office processes. Position will own quality governance, assurance methodology, calibration, insight generation, corrective action and continuous improvement, while enabling Operations leaders to improve customer outcomes, compliance and process performance. 

PRIMARY OUTCOME A scalable, data-led and client-aligned quality system that prevents defects, strengthens controls and embeds continuous improvement into daily operations. 

Operations Quality Framework: six accountability pillars

Pillar

Leadership accountability

Expected outputs

- Quality strategy & governance

Define the quality policy, operating model, decision rights and review cadences across accounts and sites. 

Framework, RACI, governance calendar, escalation thresholds and quality plan. 

- Assurance & control

Standardise sampling, evaluation, audit and control-testing methods for all critical transaction types across all support channels including voice, digital and back-office work. 

Quality plans, scorecards, sampling logic, audit trails and control evidence. 

- Calibration & measurement integrity

Lead internal, cross-site and client calibration to sustain scoring consistency and reduce evaluator variation. 

Calibration protocol, variance analysis, certification and recertification of evaluators. 

- Insights, RCA & corrective action

Translate defects, complaints and compliance failures into verified root causes and prioritised actions. 

RCA packs, corrective/preventive action log, risk themes and closure validation. 

- Improvement & prevention

Sponsor Lean Six Sigma initiatives and error-proofing to remove systemic failure demand and rework. 

Improvement pipeline, benefits tracking, control plans and lessons learned. 

- Capability & quality culture

Build QA capability and embed accountability through coaching, knowledge loops and quality communications. 

Competency model, learning plan, coaching standards and quality recognition mechanisms. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

Build and deploy the framework

- Design the end-to-end Operations Quality Framework, including principles, governance, standard methods, decision rights and minimum control requirements. 
 - Convert contractual commitments, client SOPs/DTPs, regulatory obligations and internal policies into measurable quality controls and operating standards. 
 - Create a deployment roadmap for new and existing accounts, including baseline assessment, gap closure, readiness criteria and stabilisation governance. 
 - Establish document control for quality plans, scorecards, SOPs, audit protocols and evidence retention. 

Lead assurance, auditing and compliance

- Govern sampling and evaluation across voice calls, chats, emails and back-office transactions, ensuring coverage is risk-based and operationally practical. 
 - Oversee process audits, control testing and compliance reviews; ensure findings are classified, owned, corrected and validated before closure. 
 - Maintain readiness for client audits and recognised management-system or BPO quality assessments, including ISO- and COPC-aligned requirements where applicable. 
 - Define escalation pathways for material defects, repeat failures, customer impact and compliance breaches. 

Drive quality insights and improvement

- Integrate quality results with operational, customer, complaint and productivity data to identify systemic risk and improvement opportunities. 
 - Lead structured RCA using tools such as 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, Pareto analysis, FMEA and Lean Six Sigma methods. 
 - Govern corrective and preventive actions, including accountable owners, target dates, effectiveness checks and sustained-control reviews. 
 - Sponsor cross-functional improvement initiatives addressing agent knowledge, tools, scripts, workflow design, policy interpretation and upstream/downstream dependencies. 

Govern measurement and performance reviews

- Define a balanced quality scorecard and KPI dictionary, with clear calculation logic, data ownership, thresholds and drill-downs. 
 - Lead weekly, monthly and quarterly operating reviews; present performance, risks, trends, interventions and decisions required to delivery and client leadership. 
 - Ensure reporting distinguishes outcome measures, process measures and control-health indicators rather than relying on a single quality score. 
 - Track action plans to closure and confirm that reported improvement is supported by evidence. 

Lead people capability and stakeholder alignment

- Lead, mentor and develop Quality Managers, Quality Analysts and local quality specialists across locations and accounts. 
 - Establish assessor selection, certification, calibration, coaching and recertification standards. 
 - Partner with Operations, Training, Workforce Management, Technology, Risk/Compliance and client teams to embed quality into process design and daily management. 
 - Act as a change leader for new tools, processes and behaviours through communication, training, adoption tracking and feedback loops. 

Success measures

Role

The final KPI set should be tailored by service line and client contract. The role is accountable for establishing measures across the following categories: 

Category

Illustrative measures

Leadership intent

Customer & outcome quality

Critical-error rate, defect rate, repeat-contact drivers, complaint quality, transaction accuracy

Improve outcomes and reduce customer-impacting failure. 

Control & compliance

Material findings, repeat findings, closure ageing, control effectiveness, audit readiness

Protect clients and the provider from avoidable operational risk. 

Measurement integrity

Calibration variance, evaluator certification, sampling completion, appeal/overturn trends

Ensure quality data is reliable enough for decisions and coaching. 

Improvement & prevention

RCA recurrence, corrective-action effectiveness, rework reduction, improvement benefits

Shift the organisation from detection to prevention. 

Capability & adoption

QA proficiency, coaching completion, knowledge-gap closure, framework adoption

Build sustainable ownership within delivery operations. 

Operating governance

Cadence

Typical participants

Output

Quality and Operations leads

Provider and client leadership

QBR narrative, decisions and roadmap

Executive sponsors and Quality leadership

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. 
 - 15+ years of experience across BPO operations, quality assurance or service-delivery leadership, including substantial experience leading managers and/or direct reports. 
 - Demonstrated experience establishing or transforming quality governance across multi-account, multi-site or multi-channel service environments. 
 - Hands-on expertise in quality assurance, audit, calibration, RCA, corrective action, process standardisation and operational performance review. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred; practical application of DMAIC, FMEA, Pareto, control plans and statistical analysis expected. 
 - Working knowledge of Quality Management Systems and recognised frameworks such as ISO 9001 and COPC, as applicable to the operating environment. 
 - Ability to interpret client contracts, SOPs/DTPs, policy requirements and operational data, and translate them into clear controls and management actions. 
 - Experience with performance dashboards, ERP/workflow platforms such as SAP or Oracle, and analytical tools such as Minitab, Python, Power BI or equivalent is advantageous. 

Leadership competencies

Enterprise thinking

Connects customer outcomes, operational risk, people capability and financial impact. 

Influence and challenge

Constructively challenges weak controls and aligns diverse stakeholders around evidence. 

Analytical judgement

Separates symptoms from root causes and converts data into prioritised decisions. 

Execution discipline

Creates clear ownership, closure criteria and follow-through across complex operations. 

Change leadership

Builds adoption through communication, capability, reinforcement and visible sponsorship. 

Client credibility

Communicates quality performance, risk and recovery plans with clarity and composure. 

Decision rights and interfaces

- Owns: quality framework, quality standards, measurement integrity, assurance methodology, calibration governance and quality reporting standards. 
 - Approves: material changes to quality scorecards, sampling approaches, evaluator certification and audit protocols. 
 - Recommends: risk-based interventions, control strengthening, capability investment and improvement priorities to Operations and client leadership. 
 - Partners with: Operations Delivery, Training, Workforce Management, Technology, Risk/Compliance, HR and client stakeholders. 
 - Escalates: material customer impact, compliance breaches, repeat critical defects, ineffective corrective action and unresolved cross-functional dependencies. 

ROLE VALUE PROPOSITION

Build a quality system that makes performance visible, risk actionable and improvement repeatable across BPO operations.

 - Experience developing test cases and test scripts. 
 - Good knowledge of basic test techniques, including positive and negative testing, interface testing, and database testing.

 - Creative Thinking: You develop practical, effective ways to improve test coverage, uncover edge cases, and strengthen quality processes across complex product areas. 
 - Analytical Skills: You interpret test results, identify patterns and root causes, break down complex issues, and use evidence to guide decisions and recommendations.

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‐scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‐shedding, throttling, and rate‐limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

-Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development:

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. data.title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

Keep GSK's standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section. 

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer - DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK's Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment. 

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone. 

Key Responsibilities

- Platform ownership: run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner's backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Reliability: achieve 99. 9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred. 
 - Everything as code: manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Secure by default: enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards. 
 - Golden paths: build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team's time. 
 - AI Agentic automation: Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails. 
 - Compliance: keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline. 
 - Toolchain rationalisation: be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting. 
 - Developer experience: measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours. 
 - Leadership: set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect's reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google. 

Education & Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 
 - Area of Specialisation
 - Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Experience Required

 - Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
 - Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts. undefined
 - Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
 - Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
 - Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 

Desirable: 

- Certifications in cloud platforms (e. g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

Skills/Background

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

Skills

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

The Azure App Testing team in Core AI provide cloud-scale testing capabilities that help developers validate the reliability, performance, and quality of modern applications. This includes Azure Load Testing for performance testing and Playwright Workspaces for end-to-end functional testing, enabling teams to test at scale without managing their own testing infrastructure. As applications increasingly incorporate AI and autonomous agents, testing is evolving and we are extending the platform to various agentic workloads. Playwright Workspaces provides fully managed, cloud-hosted browsers for developers, automation clients and AI agents can connect to remotely for high-scale secure and performant browser automation workloads. 

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who can provide deep technical leadership to shape the direction of Azure App Testing and deliver secure, reliable, scalable developer services. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will lead architecture and implementation across service boundaries, turn ambiguous customer needs into durable platform capabilities, and raise engineering standards through technical leadership and mentorship. 

Responsibilities

- Define and evolve the architecture of distributed, multi-tenant testing services, balancing reliability, performance, security, operability, and cost. 
 - Lead complex initiatives from design and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and sustained operation, while remaining hands-on in coding and deeply engaged in design and code reviews. 
 - Build scalable execution and orchestration capabilities for load testing and managed browser automation, including scheduling, concurrency, isolation, and resilient failure handling. 
 - Shape developer-friendly APIs, tooling, and CI/CD integrations that make testing a natural part of development and release workflows. 
 - Advance AI-assisted testing with rigorous evaluation, observable behaviour, appropriate safeguards, and meaningful measures of quality and customer value. 
 - Drive live-site excellence through actionable telemetry, service-level objectives, incident response, root-cause analysis, and prevention of recurring issues; participate in the team's on-call rotation. 
 - Embed security, privacy, accessibility, and responsible AI into design and delivery, including identity, access control, and protection of customer test data. 
 - Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, security teams, and customers to set priorities, align architecture, resolve dependencies, and deliver cohesive platform capabilities. 
 - Mentor engineers, foster inclusive technical discussions, and improve engineering practices for testing, deployment safety, serviceability, and developer productivity. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 10+ years of extensive experience designing, building, and operating production software, with demonstrated technical leadership on complex initiatives spanning multiple components or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering skills in one or more languages such as C#, Java, C++, Go, Python, or TypeScript, including maintainable design, automated testing, and effective code review. 
 - Deep understanding of distributed systems, service architecture, API design, concurrency, fault tolerance, and performance engineering. 
 - Experience operating cloud services and diagnosing complex production issues using telemetry, debugging, and structured root-cause analysis. 
 - Ability to lead through influence, explain architectural trade-offs, collaborate across disciplines, and mentor engineers. 
 - A customer-focused approach and commitment to secure, reliable, inclusive engineering. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Azure or comparable cloud platforms, containerised workloads, Kubernetes, and multi-tenant service infrastructure. 
 - Experience with browser automation or end-to-end testing using Playwright, and performance testing using JMeter, Locust, or comparable frameworks. 
 - Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, command-line tools, or integrations with GitHub, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD systems. 
 - Experience improving cloud resource efficiency, execution scheduling, service scalability, and infrastructure cost. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted developer tools or agentic workflows, including evaluation, reliability, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Experience collaborating with open-source communities or building services on open-source technologies. 

#CoreAIIndiaHiring

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. data.title: Senior Platform Engineer
data.description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office. 

Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)

The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline's data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms. 

We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production. 

If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline. 

Why this job's a big deal

As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently. 

You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams. 

This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads. 

In This Role, You Will

- Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
 - Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services. 
 - Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI. 
 - Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments. 
 - Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting. 
 - Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes. 
 - CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
 - Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure. 
 - Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows. 
 - Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production. 
 - Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls. 
 - Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation. 
 - MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
 - Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining. 
 - Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements. 
 - Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage. 
 - Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities. 
 - Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
 - Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services. 
 - Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices. 
 - Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence. 
 - Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions. 
 - Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows. 
 - Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
 - Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains. 
 - Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads. 
 - Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency. 
 - Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues. 

Who You Are

- Degree & Experience: B. Tech or B. E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes. 
 - Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments. 
 - CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools. 
 - Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities. 
 - Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies. 
 - MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations. 
 - Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems. 
 - Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations. 
 - Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills. 

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers. 
 - Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems. 
 - Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices. 
 - Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads. 
 - Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms. 

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE. 

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it's a dream vacation, your cousin's graduation, or your best friend's wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers. 

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that's what our employees tell us). We're a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn't stabilized. 

We're on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration. 

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking. com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable. 

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office. 

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to: 

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location. 

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work. 

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We'd love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary. 

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply. 

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

data.title: Advanced Software Engr
data.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer with 7+ years of hands-on experience in software testing, with strong expertise in both Test Automation and Functional Testing. 

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience designing and developing scalable automation solutions using technologies such as Selenium, Playwright, Python, TypeScript, and Java. The candidate should be comfortable working in an Agile product development environment and collaborating closely with Development, QA/Test, Product, and DevOps teams throughout the software development lifecycle. 

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical skills, quality ownership, analytical thinking, and excellent communication. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, maintain, and enhance automated test frameworks and test suites for web and enterprise applications. 
 - Develop reliable and maintainable automation using Selenium and/or Playwright. 
 - Write automation code using Python, TypeScript, and/or Java. 
 - Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing as required. 
 - Analyze product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs to identify appropriate test coverage. 
 - Develop comprehensive Test Strategies, Test Plans, test scenarios, and test cases based on functional and technical requirements. 
 - Define the appropriate balance between automated and manual/functional testing based on risk, complexity, and business impact. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, test execution efficiency, reliability, and defect detection. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and work with tools such as GitHub and GitHub Actions. 
 - Investigate automation failures, perform root-cause analysis, and distinguish between application defects, environment issues, test-data issues, and automation defects. 
 - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives. 
 - Collaborate effectively with Developers, Test Engineers, Product Owners/Product Managers, and DevOps Engineers to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Participate in defect triage and communicate quality risks, dependencies, blockers, and release-readiness concerns clearly to stakeholders. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement of the team's testing processes, automation architecture, coding standards, and overall quality engineering practices. 
 - Use modern AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot to improve engineering productivity while following appropriate code-review, security, and quality practices. 
 - Mentor and support other test engineers by sharing automation and quality engineering best practices. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

- 7+ years of professional experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering, including significant hands-on experience in automation. 
 - Strong expertise in Test Automation and automation framework development. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Selenium and/or Playwright. 
 - Strong programming/scripting skills in at least one of the following: 
 - Python 
 - TypeScript 
 - Java 
 - Strong experience in Functional Testing, including requirements analysis, test design, test execution, defect identification, and regression testing. 
 - Experience designing and documenting a comprehensive Test Strategy for a product, application, release, or major feature. 
 - Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile, and Scrum practices. 
 - Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams and delivering quality software across multiple sprints/releases. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git and GitHub for source-control and collaborative development. 
 - Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD solutions for automated test execution. 
 - Exposure to GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted software engineering/testing tools. 
 - Ability to analyze automation failures and debug issues across application, automation, API, test-data, and environment layers. 
 - Good understanding of test design techniques, defect lifecycle, regression strategy, risk-based testing, and test coverage. 
 - Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Development, QA, Product, and DevOps teams. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical issues and quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

- Experience with API testing and API automation, for example REST APIs. 
 - Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Understanding of modern automation patterns such as Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable test components, test-data management, and parallel execution. 
 - Experience with test reporting and automated quality metrics. 
 - Exposure to testing applications deployed using cloud and containerized environments. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools for test-case generation, automation-code development, code review, debugging, or test analysis. 
 - Experience mentoring junior engineers or providing technical guidance on test automation. 
 - Familiarity with non-functional quality considerations such as performance, security, accessibility, reliability, and usability testing would be an advantage. 

Education

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline from a recognised institution. 

What We Are Looking For

The successful candidate should be a hands-on Senior Test Engineer, not someone focused only on test coordination or management. We are looking for someone who: 

- Can write automation code, not just execute automated suites. 
 - Has strong functional testing fundamentals in addition to automation expertise. 
 - Can independently define a test strategy and approach for complex features. 
 - Understands quality throughout the complete software development lifecycle. 
 - Can identify what should be automated and what requires exploratory or functional testing. 
 - Is comfortable reviewing requirements and challenging gaps in acceptance criteria and testability. 
 - Can work closely with developers to identify defects early rather than relying only on end-of-sprint testing. 
 - Can collaborate with Product teams to understand customer/business expectations and with DevOps teams to enable reliable automated testing within CI/CD. 
 - Demonstrates ownership, technical depth, attention to detail, and a quality-first mindset. 
 - Communicates clearly, constructively, and confidently across cross-functional teams. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: AI Transformation Lead
data.description:
About ArmorCode

ArmorCode is the agentic control plane for Unified Exposure Management: one platform that unifies, prioritizes, and remediates risk across applications, code, software supply chain, cloud, infrastructure, and AI. 

The ArmorCode Agentic AI Platform ingests findings from 400+ security tools, correlates them with business context in the Context Risk Graph, and puts Anya AI agents to work prioritizing, routing, and verifying fixes. 

The platform is proven at enterprise scale, processing 400B+ findings annually and supporting more than 5, 600 security professionals and 300, 000 developers. Global enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to shorten find-to-fix time and reduce risk. 

ArmorCoders believe in five core values: Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human. Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression. 

About The Role

We are looking for a hands-on AI Transformation Lead to drive the design, development, and technical execution of AI-powered business automations across our organization. Our Business & Technology Automation (BTA) team automates workflows across Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and other business functions. We are looking for an Architect level person who can take this foundation to the next level by identifying the right technical solutions, designing scalable architectures, personally implementing complex automations, and guiding a small team of engineers. This is not a traditional architect or people-management role. We expect approximately 70-80% hands-on engineering involvement, combined with technical leadership, architectural decision-making, and mentoring. 

What You'll Own

- AI Automation Architecture & Development
 - Work directly with business and engineering teams to understand requirements, identify technical challenges, and translate them into executable AI based solutions. 
 - Design and implement end-to-end automations using Python, n8n, LLM APIs, MCP, RAG, and other relevant technologies. 
 - Evaluate systems/apps for a business requirement and make build vs buy decisions
 - Evaluate when to use deterministic workflows, AI agents, LLM-based reasoning, RAG, or combinations of these approaches. 
 - Personally develop complex automations, integrations, and reusable components. 
 - Build and enhance reusable automation frameworks, common libraries, MCP servers, and AI orchestration capabilities. 
 - Design solutions that are secure, maintainable, observable, cost-efficient, and scalable. 
 - Stay current with emerging AI technologies and rapidly evaluate their applicability to business automation. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration & Ownership
 - Engage with teams across Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and other functions to understand automation opportunities. 
 - Convert business requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, and clearly defined engineering tasks. 
 - Work with business stakeholders to establish acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and operational expectations. 
 - Maintain a clear separation of responsibilities: 
 - Business/Functional Teams: Own business requirements, process definitions, AI skill instructions, functional correctness, and ongoing updates to domain-specific knowledge and skills. 
 - BTA Team: Own technical architecture, integrations, automation implementation, execution, monitoring, technical troubleshooting, and maintenance. 
 - Enable business teams to create and maintain their own AI skills and instructions without requiring engineering changes for every functional update. 
 - Technical Leadership & Mentoring
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership to existing junior engineers. 
 - Break down larger initiatives into independently executable engineering tasks. 
 - Delegate implementation work while retaining accountability for architecture, integration quality, and technical delivery. 
 - Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and technical mentoring. 
 - Establish practical engineering standards for Python development, n8n workflows, MCP servers, AI integrations, testing, and documentation. 
 - Balance individual coding responsibilities with helping junior engineers become more independent and effective. 
Who You Are

Core Engineering

- 6-10 years of software engineering or DevOps experience, including substantial hands-on development and system design. 
 - AI driven development with strong debugging skills. 
 - Experience with n8n, including building, debugging, and maintaining production automation workflows. 
 - Practical experience developing MCP servers and integrations. 
 - Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs, including tool calling, structured outputs, prompt engineering, and context management. 
 - Practical experience building RAG systems, including embeddings, vector databases, retrieval strategies, and evaluation. 
 - Good understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, databases, message queues, and event-driven systems. 
 - Experience designing production-quality systems with proper exception handling, observability, and automated testing. 

Architecture & Leadership

- Ability to independently take an ambiguous business requirement from discovery through architecture, implementation, and production rollout. 
 - Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities across multiple interconnected systems. 
 - Experience conducting code reviews and mentoring junior developers. 
 - Ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. 
 - Pragmatic engineering mindset with a preference for simple, reliable, reusable solutions over unnecessary complexity. 

Who Will Thrive In This Role

You are likely a strong fit if: 

- You enjoy writing production code more than producing architecture diagrams. 
 - You can discuss AI architectures at a high level and then personally implement and debug them. 
 - You are comfortable navigating ambiguous requirements and converting them into working systems. 
 - You prefer reusable platforms and components over isolated scripts. 
 - You continuously experiment with emerging AI technologies but remain skeptical of unnecessary complexity. 
 - You enjoy mentoring developers while staying deeply involved in implementation. 
 - You take ownership of technical failures and focus on preventing recurrence rather than applying temporary fixes. 

We are not looking for a solution architect who primarily delegates implementation, an n8n-only workflow developer, or someone whose AI experience is limited to prompt engineering. 

We are looking for a strong software engineer and practical AI architect who can design, build, deploy, troubleshoot, and lead by example. 

Why You Will Love It

- Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and provide career progression paths, enabling our employees to advance in their careers
 - Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance, offering flexible hours and remote work options to promote a sustainable lifestyle
 - Collaborative Environment: Our company fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, where employees can collaborate and learn from each other's experiences
 - Employee Recognition: We value and recognize the contributions of our team members through awards, employee of the month programs, and other forms of acknowledgment. 
 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses, recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team
 - Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health insurance for employees and dependents, to support the overall well-being of our employees. We encourage learning and skilling, and aid our employees to continuously upskill themselves. 
 - Diversity and Inclusion: We are committed to diversity and inclusion, striving to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered

Join ArmorCode and lead the charge in reducing signal fatigue, prioritizing risk and streamlining key cybersecurity workflows. Apply today to be part of a close-knit team, dedicated to democratizing software security and helping build the safest software possible. 

Equal Opportunity

ArmorCode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other legally protected category. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background or characteristics. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

data.title: Sr Software Engineer, Back End
data.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. 

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do - and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. 

Job Summary: 

Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned. 

We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform. Together we own the stack from the app on the merchant's device, through checkout and commerce services and merchant identity, down to the money movement that settles and pays out funds. We are taking over end-to-end ownership of these services, so you will learn the platform properly, then run it. 

Job Description: 

Essential Responsibilities: 

- Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. 
 - Advises immediate management on project-level issues
 - Guides junior engineers
 - Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
 - Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications: 

- 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications: 

Your way to impact

- Set the technical direction for services spanning checkout, commerce, identity and money movement. 
 - Reduce operational and financial risk in payment, settlement and payout flows through better design, automation and observability. 
 - Build trustworthy data pipelines (Python, Spark, Airflow, BigQuery) that give Finance, product and merchants accurate, timely numbers for settlement, payouts, reconciliation and merchant insights. 
 - Lead the Zettle-to-PayPal convergence work on the backend, including the move of legacy merchants onto PayPal One Identity and the integration with PayPal core payments through the TAP API. 
 - Grow the team: mentor engineers, review designs, and make knowledge transfer from Sweden stick. 

Your day to day

- Lead design and delivery of larger changes such as new payment flows, integrations and migrations, writing clear design documents and decision records. 
 - Design, build and operate batch and incremental data pipelines using Python, Apache Spark and Airflow, landing curated datasets in Google BigQuery from our Java services and event streams. 
 - Own pipeline reliability: idempotent and re-runnable jobs, backfills, data quality checks, lineage, SLAs for data freshness and cost control on Spark and BigQuery. 
 - Act as incident commander for your domain; run post-incident reviews and drive the fixes. 
 - Own SLOs, alerting and capacity for your services; work with SRE and PayPal platform teams. 
 - Review code and designs for the team, and coach engineers at CL5 and below. 
 - Partner with product, Finance, security and compliance on payments, settlement, payouts and reconciliation. 
 - Run knowledge-transfer sessions with Sweden and ensure every critical service has at least two people who can operate it. 

What Do You Need To Bring-

- 4 to 7 years of software engineering experience, with deep Java expertise (Spring Boot, Dropwizard) and a record of owning production services. 
 - Must have: hands-on Python and Apache Spark for large-scale data processing, Apache Airflow for orchestration, and Google BigQuery for modelling, querying and optimising analytical data. 
 - Experience designing reliable data pipelines: idempotency, backfills, schema evolution, data quality checks, monitoring and cost and performance tuning. 
 - Proven design of distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including multi-region and failure-mode thinking. 
 - Strong knowledge of payments: authorization, capture, refunds, clearing, settlement, chargebacks and reconciliation. Experience with ledgers, payouts or bank connectivity is a strong plus. 
 - Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope, key management and secure access to sensitive data. 
 - Experience leading cross-team technical work, mentoring, and handling incidents as lead. 
 - Nice to have: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) integration (data extensions, Journey Builder, API or SFTP data feeds), GraphQL federation, OAuth and identity migrations, PSD2/SCA, EU payment schemes (such as Swish or Vipps). 
 - Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden. 
 - A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records. 
 - Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product. 

Subsidiary: 

PayPal

Travel Percent: 

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https: //careers. pypl. com/contact-us. 

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. 

Our Benefits: 

At PayPal, we're committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can't do this without our most important asset-you. That's why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing-physical, emotional, and financial-delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. 

Who We Are: 

Click Here to learn more about our culture and community. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal. com. 

Belonging at PayPal: 

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. 

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. 

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don't hesitate to apply.
