data.description:
Job Description: 

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. 

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. 

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. 

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations. 

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation. 

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services. 

Process Overview

Global Markets Technology provides end-to-end technology solutions for Global Markets businesses including Equities, Prime Brokerage, Interest Rates, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives and Structured Products. Across all these products, solutions include architecture, design, development, change management, implementation and support using various enterprise technologies. In addition, GMT provides Sales, Electronic Trading, Trade Work Flow, Pricing, and Market Risk, Middle office, Collateral Management, Credit Risk, Post-trade confirmation, Settlement and Client service processes for Trading, Capital Markets, and Wealth Management businesses. 

FX electronic trading technology contains a suite of applications, with a complex eco system, architecture, multiple business flows, upstream and downstream dependencies. This is a critical institutional front office trading application supported 24 by 5 supporting all global locations for FX business. 

Job Description*

As a QA lead, the person would be accountable and responsible for the delivery and execution of QA for one of the complex front office FX electronic trading applications. 

The individual should be self-motivated, creative, and proactive, to work successfully in a fast-paced environment including multiple platforms and applications and diverse technologies. The individual will work closely with developers, product owner & other team members throughout the SDLC, executing test iterations, tracking / reporting results, troubleshooting and coordinating defect resolution. The individual should have a strong understanding of SDLC processes and the QA lifecycle and methodology. They are experts in testing practices, strong FX functional domain knowledge, and acts as a "go to" reference for domain expertise and testing SME. As an expert, they play a role in improving functional and automation testing in their area through thorough reviews, coaching, mentoring, and knowledge sharing sessions. This is an individual contributor role. As an expert, they may contribute to program/project level business analysis of key business projects. 

Responsibilities*

- Responsible for defining and leading the software testing approach for solutions at the program or portfolio level to deliver significant business outcomes
 - Defining test strategy, test plans, continuously improving the test quality, reviewing test cases for every change and delivering testing outcomes that meets the target for the first time change success metric. 
 - Leads the test planning, definition, and test cases design of complex features which span multiple teams. 
 - Leads the automation testing efforts and is responsible for the adherence to the enterprise software testing automation coverage requirements that include but are not limited to feature, regression and performance testing
 - Assess the current performance testing pack, suggest improvements and improvements to make it ready for the future. 
 - Execute all levels of testing (System, Integration, and Regression)
 - Act as a domain/functional expertise in FX electronic trading applications
 - Supports/mentors/coaches' team(s) on functional aspects of the application
 - Evaluate the current regression testing tool/technology and work towards migrating to the strategic enterprise recommended automation framework in the long run. 
 - Leads and is responsible for the end-to-end test strategy/creation/adherence, and the integration between teams for a program/portfolio solution. 
 - Analyze the production stability of the application, identify opportunities for improvement in testing process, work with the stakeholders to improve testing effectiveness and ensure the testing metrics are adhered to organization SLAs
 - Responsible for the usage of enterprise AI assisted testing tools in the testing process right from requirements capturing, test plan/cases creation and execution. Ensure strong prompt engineering techniques are used by all functional and automation testers. 
 - Responsible for cross training of testing resources
 - Responds to business user queries related to the business functionality of the application. 
 - Asses the risks during testing process and escalate to all stakeholders and suggest mitigation plans
 - Performs root cause analysis and leads defect triage

Requirements*

Education*

Bachelor's degree in engineering

Certifications If Any

Any certification related to Agile & Functional testing

Experience Range

15- 20 years of experience in Software Testing. 

Foundational skills*

- 12+ years of experience in FX front office electronic trading applications in software testing or business analysis with 5+ years of lead experience
 - Deep SME business knowledge in FX products that includes but not limited FX SPOT, FX Forward, FX Swap, NDF
 - Deep understanding of FX Market data, venues, FX algorithms, electronic trading components
 - Deep understanding of market making and agency-based FX business work flows
 - Deep understanding of FX electronic trading business workflows
 - Understand different distributed systems components such as messaging, caching, multicast, component integrations and ability to relate those to the testing requirements
 - Strong in driving different types of testing such as functional, regression, load, performance and latency
 - Strong observability skills to interpret production/QA logs and look for opportunities for monitoring/observability improvements in lower lane environments, work with development and other stakeholder teams to implement monitoring solutions
 - Strong UNIX commands and usage
 - Experience in testing FX flows on multi-dealer platforms such as FxAll
 - Good in automation testing frameworks and methodology
 - Good in business-driven test case development and test-driven test development methodologies

Desired Skills

- Basic understanding of C++ or Java
 - Good at using AI assisted testing tools and prompt engineering techniques
 - Strong knowledge of CI / CD flows and various tools used

Work Timings- 9. 30 AM to 6. 30 PM. IST (Need to be flexible as per business need)

Job Location- Chennai / Mumbai

Job Type: Employee Regular

Business Area: Human Resources

People Queries and Knowledge Lead

Role Purpose: 

The People Queries and Knowledge Lead is responsible for leading the People Query team while also owning LRQA's global people‐related knowledge and self‐service content ecosystem. 

The role ensures: 

- High‐quality, efficient, and consistent resolution of Tier 1 People Queries 
 - Strong operational governance and service delivery performance 
 - A robust, well‐maintained knowledge base supporting global self‐service 
 - Accurate, user-friendly content powering digital channels 
 - Continuous improvement of Tier 1 operations, content quality, and query deflection

This is a hybrid leadership role spanning People Operations, Knowledge Management, and Digital Enablement, ensuring colleagues can easily access reliable people information while Tier 1 services operate at excellence. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, coach, and support the global People Query team to deliver consistent, high ‐ quality service aligned to SLAs and People Operations standards 
 - Assign and delegate daily activities to team members, ensuring they are delivered to high standards of completion, to meet SLAs and business priorities. 
 - Monitor service delivery metrics and implement corrective actions where needed. 
 - Act as the escalation point for complex or sensitive People queries, ensuring timely, accurate, and customer ‐ focused resolution. 
 - Responsible in identifying areas of knowledge development for the team to allow continuous learning and improvements. 
 - Promote a high ‐ performing team culture focused on accountability, service excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Champion operational excellence and continuous process improvement. 
 - Own and maintain the global People knowledge base, developing and governing clear, accurate, and up ‐ to ‐ date content that enables effective colleague self ‐ service and supports policy and process compliance. 
 - Establish governance for content creation, review, approvals, localisation, and expiry cycles. 
 - Partner with COEs, Payroll, Legal, and in ‐ country HR to validate and maintain content quality and compliance. 
 - Analyse query trends, content usage, gaps, and service data to drive continuous improvement, process optimisation, and standardisation opportunities across People Operations. 

What You'll Bring: 

- HR Professional with experience in directly managing a team in shared service. 
 - Ability to manage multi-country operations and vendor relationships. 
 - Experience with HR databases and ticketing systems (SAP: Success Factors, ServiceNow or Halo) 
 - Excellent communication skills, with ability to turn complex topics into clear, user ‐ friendly content. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and cross ‐ functional collaboration skills. 
 - Excellent organisation and planning skills, motivated by deadlines and KPIs to deliver 
 - Knowledge of automation tools and process improvement methodologies 
 - Strong knowledge of HR processes, policies, and Tier 1/2 operational models 
 - Proven experience managing or contributing to HR knowledge bases, content development, or service portals. 
 - Familiarity with chatbot enablement, content tagging, and automation opportunities. 

Why Join LRQA?

- Be part of a purpose-driven organization shaping a safer, more sustainable future. 
 - Work with global clients and cutting-edge digital solutions. 
 - Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented culture. 
 - Competitive compensation and benefits package. 

Who are LRQA?

LRQA is a leading global assurance partner, combining deep industry expertise with innovative solutions to help organizations manage risk, improve performance, and drive sustainable growth. 

Operating in over 50 countries with a team of 2, 500+ professionals, we support more than 60, 000 clients worldwide through assurance, certification, cybersecurity, inspection, and training services. Our purpose is simple: to help businesses build a safer, more secure, and more sustainable future. 

What We Offer: 

Join a global team where your expertise is valued and your development is supported. We offer a collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional growth, flexible working arrangements where applicable, a competitive salary aligned with the market, and a comprehensive benefits package. 

Pre-Employment Checks

If you are an external candidate who has been successful in securing a role with us , we may carry out legally permitted pre-employment checks as part of our recruitment process. The checks will be determined by your region, country, location and role type, and may include (but not limited to): Identity verification, right to work checks, employment history, education, criminal records and financial history (where applicable). These checks are conducted by our trusted global screening partner, and will adhere to all applicable personal and data protection laws. Any data collected will be stored, retained and processed securely and only used for the purpose of your application. 

For questions about pre-employment checks, please speak directly with your recruiter, and for further information on data protection, please refer to our Privacy Policy below. 

One LRQA

At LRQA, we believe that as a leading Global Leading Risk Management Service provider, we have a reponsibility to create an environment where evryone can thrive. 

We understand that diverse perspectives and shared focus, alongside integrity and togetherness, with ambition and and support, are exactly what is required to buid a workplace where everyone can contribute, grow and flourish. Driven by vision, guided by purpose and powered by expertise, we beleive everyone should have the opportunity to maximise thier potential, Be thier Best and acheive thier goals. 

All rights reserved. Terms of use. Privacy Policy.

Process Overview*

EIT is a centralized group within Global Risk Management responsible for independent testing of operational processes within the eight lines of business and enterprise control functions at Bank of America to ensure the company is in compliance with domestic and international laws, rules and regulations, and that risk and controls procedures are operating effectively. 

Job Description*

The Sampling & Test Development associate is responsible for designing and supporting high-quality manual and automated testing solutions through effective sampling, data validation, and governance practices. This role collaborates with Test Owners, Front Line Units, data partners, and Test Execution teams to ensure accurate data sourcing, sound sampling methodologies, and test structures that support automation. 

The associate independently acquires and validates data from internal and external sources, documents testing procedures and sampling requirements, and resolves issues related to data procurement, sample design, and test development. The role is accountable for maintaining data integrity, implementing changes to sampling requirements, and ensuring accurate tracking of testing activities within the System of Record (SOR). 

Responsibilities*

- Partner with Test Owners, Front Line Units, data providers, and Test Execution teams to develop and enhance manual and automated testing approaches. 
 - Gather, validate, and document data requirements, ensuring accurate sample populations and alignment with test objectives. 
 - Incorporate appropriate sampling methodologies and governance requirements into test plans and execution strategies. 
 - Evaluate and coordinate pilot testing activities, providing recommendations to improve test effectiveness and quality. 
 - Design, maintain, and update sampling procedures, test scripts, and support documentation. 
 - Drive test structures and methodologies that enable automation and scalable testing solutions. 
 - Participate across the testing lifecycle, including intake, planning, execution, reporting, and issue remediation, providing subject matter expertise and guidance. 
 - Analyze, manipulate, and summarize large data sets to support testing activities and deliver high-quality results. 
 - Identify and resolve data sourcing, sampling, and test design issues while maintaining data integrity and compliance standards. 
 - Maintain accurate test status, milestones, and deliverables within the System of Record (SOR). 
 - Lead initiatives focused on process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency. 
 - Escalate and drive resolution of areas requiring process refinement, policy updates, or procedural enhancements. 
 - Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support effective test execution and risk management objectives.

 - SQL, SAS, Python

 - Microsoft Power BI Certification
 - Alteryx Designer Certification

 - DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server

 - 8 to 10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure roles, with a track record of owning reliability for production-critical systems.

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities. 

ReOrbit's top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. data.title: Fincrime Quality Team Lead
data.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world's money. 

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. 

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. 

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. 

For everyone, everywhere. 

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer. 

We're looking for a FinCrime Quality Team Lead to join our growing team. 

Purpose of the role

The main purpose of the Quality Control (QC) Team Lead role is to manage the performance of the QC team on an individual and team level, provide leadership, guidance, and direction to the quality assurance team to ensure the delivery of the right amount of QC reviews at the right time. 

The QC Team Lead is responsible for managing performance and overseeing the activities of the quality assurance team. This includes task assignment, workload management, and ensuring that team members are aligned with priorities and objectives, while also actively promoting a positive and motivating work environment. 

The QC Team Lead guarantees collaboration and opportunities to improve their stakeholders' (their assigned Service Operations area) state and scalability. 

Activities performed on the job

Manages the quality assurance team on an individual and team level

- Performance management
 - Ensure timely delivery of QC reviews and keeps central task assignment documents up-to-date. 
 - Completes demand vs capacity calculation for the QC team and assigned area. 
 - Monitor and track the performance of QC specialists to ensure they meet or exceed set KPIs; identify and address performance issues or areas needing improvement through performance evaluations, feedback from stakeholders, or quality metrics analysis. Responsible for performance evaluation and recognition, assessing team performance, providing feedback, and recognizing achievements. Conducting regular performance reviews, setting and documenting development goals, and acknowledging outstanding contributions
 - Use mentoring, coaching and delegation in their team to create best practices for managing performance and for development opportunities. 
 - Deliver monthly reports on team performance and KPIs. 
 - Provides training and development opportunities for team members. This could include designing and delivering training programs, mentoring junior staff, and facilitating knowledge sharing sessions to enhance team capabilities. 
 - People management
 - Implements a monitoring system (talent map check ins) to identify team talents and provide support and development opportunities to those in need. 
 - Talent map check-ins are completed twice a year by QC Lead
 - Propose decisions for direct reports like salary raise, promotion, leave approval, etc. 
 - Hire, lead, develop and manage their quality team, including amongst others administrative tasks such as scheduling, interviewing, hiring, organising team activities, conducting the GrowWises' etc
 - QC Lead is responsible for holding coaching sessions and 1: 1s with their direct reports generally once every two weeks. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for holding team meeting on a biweekly / monthly basis. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for facilitating the sharing of information, skills, and best practices among team members to enhance collective learning and improve overall performance. QC Lead promotes a culture of knowledge sharing where team members feel encouraged and motivated to share their knowledge and expertise with one another. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for pairing experienced team members with junior or less experienced colleagues to facilitate knowledge exchange. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for regular team building activities to drive engagement in the team. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for action planning based on Wiser Pulse results. 
 - Executing on strategy
QC Lead is responsible for aligning team objectives with broader organisational goals, ensuring the team is clear on the strategy and understands how their work supports it. 

QC Lead is responsible for developing strategies to achieve targets and creating accessible documentation for these strategies. 

- Quality reporting
 - Generating regular and timely reports on quality results, performance metrics, and key findings. The QC Team Lead communicates quality-related information to management and operational counterparts to facilitate decision-making and improve transparency. 
 - Presents and delivers actionable insights and makes sure improvements are owned and followed up based on the stakeholder management framework. 
 - Engage stakeholders to take necessary actions based on report findings and influence results positively. 
 - Change management
 - Effectively manages and communicates changes within their team (and to external stakeholders if needed) to ensure successful outcomes. 
 - Ensures understanding so their team understands the nature and implications of any changes introduced. This involves providing clear explanations, answering questions, and addressing concerns to facilitate comprehension. 
 - Facilitates adaptation and guides your team through changes, provides support, training, and resources as needed to facilitate a smooth transition. 
 - Monitors progress and impact on their team's workflows and objectives. This involves gathering feedback, identifying challenges, and making adjustments as necessary to ensure successful integration. 
 - Manages stakeholder relationships
 - QC Lead is responsible for clear communication with stakeholders. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for engaging with the stakeholders on weekly or monthly meetings to share key findings and insights from QC Reporting. 
 - Conduct meetings with stakeholders according to a clear cadence, ensuring agendas are set, and notes are taken. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for actionable insights to be formed on the stakeholder meetings and to find owners for the agreed actions and follow up and monitor and report impact. 
 - Serving as the primary point of contact for communication between the quality assurance team and other stakeholders, including project managers, developers, and customers. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for collecting stakeholder feedback and acting on shared improvement areas and stakeholder needs. 
 - QC Lead takes part in assigned area's tribe or regional planning where needed to ensure that QC Lead understands the plans / goals / strategy of their stakeholders and make sure that their actions support these objectives. 
 - Proactively informs stakeholders of any changes and responds to queries within a reasonable timeframe. 
 - Operational efficiency
 - QC Lead is responsible for implementing continuous improvement initiatives within their quality assurance team / sharing ideas with peers and management. 
 - QC Lead is responsible for their team's use of tools and technology. This could include providing training on existing tools, and leveraging technology to streamline processes and improve efficiency. 
Qualifications

About you

- You're experienced - with at least 1 year in a FinCrime, Quality Control or Quality Assurance role. 
 - You're knowledgeable - you understand procedures and processes, stay up-to-date, and understand Wise's products, tools, and policies. 
 - You proactively solve problems - identifying and addressing issues to implement improvements that benefit customers and the team. 
 - You're customer-centric - always prioritising customer satisfaction and advocating for their needs within the organisation. 
 - You embrace adaptability - readily accepting change and quickly integrating new processes while maintaining quality. 
 - You're a team player - sharing knowledge and resources to ensure team success and actively engaging in discussions. 
 - You're a strong communicator - tailoring your communication to suit diverse audiences with clarity and respect. 
 - You make data-driven decisions - leveraging data to inform your actions and enhance your impact. 
 - You take ownership - fully committing to your tasks and consistently striving to meet or exceed KPIs. 

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders - without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive. 

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. 

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers. 

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise. Jobs. 

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

data.title: Staff Frontend Engineer (Product UI and Design)
data.description:
About Lexsi Labs

Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab working toward aligned, interpretable and safe superintelligent systems. Our near-term mission is to build safety-aware autonomous systems for mission-critical settings such as banking, insurance, government and healthcare. We believe the institutions that deploy AI should be able to audit, correct and own the risk of the models they rely on, and we build the research and the platform that make that possible. 

Our research spans AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundation model research across language, structured and tabular data, and autonomous systems. We have published 25+ papers in the past 15 months across conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris and London. 

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behaviour. 

About the Role

We are building the platform through which institutions own the AI they depend on. Post-training, alignment, evaluation, deployment and monitoring run inside the customer's own environment, on the methods our labs publish. 

The people using it vary widely. Post-training scientists and AI researchers run experiments at the edge of what current methods can do. AI and ML engineers take models and agents into production. Data scientists build and validate models on enterprise data. Platform and infrastructure teams operate the compute and services underneath. Inside banks, insurers and public institutions, model risk, validation and audit teams need to understand and sign off on results without writing code, and business owners need to see what is running and how it is performing. The same screen often has to serve a researcher and a risk reviewer. 

The interface decides whether frontier model science stays in research papers or becomes something every institution can operate. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will write production React and TypeScript most of the week, own the frontend architecture of the platform, and make the final call on its flows, information architecture and visual design. You will work with a product designer and one or two frontend engineers, setting the standard through code and review rather than management. Expect roughly 70% of your time on building and 30% on design decisions, review and direction. 

What you'll work on

- Own the frontend architecture of a large React and TypeScript application: routing and layout, code splitting, state boundaries, and the contracts between the UI and backend services. 
 - Own the component library and design tokens as a single system used across the application, evolving it incrementally in a live codebase without pausing feature work. 
 - Design and build data-dense interfaces: virtualised tables over large result sets, live metrics and log streams, trace and graph visualisations, side-by-side comparisons, and code and configuration editors. 
 - Build a real-time data layer over SSE and WebSockets with reconnection, backpressure and cache semantics that stay consistent with request-response queries. 
 - Build schema-driven form systems for deeply nested, conditional configuration, validated against backend schemas. 
 - Design interfaces that work for users with very different levels of technical depth, from researchers to risk reviewers, without splitting the product in two. 
 - Make the final call on information architecture, interaction and visual design, and take your decisions from Figma to production yourself. 
 - Set and enforce performance budgets: render profiling, bundle size, and interaction latency on locked-down enterprise machines. 
 - Ship builds that run in restricted and fully offline networks, with reproducible builds, self-hosted assets and no runtime dependence on external hosts. 
 - Meet enterprise requirements in the UI: SSO, role-aware interfaces, auditability, accessibility, and internationalisation including right-to-left layouts. 
 - Raise the engineering bar across the frontend: type safety, testing strategy, tooling and code review. 
 - Work directly with researchers and platform engineers to turn new methods into usable product, often before the method has settled. 

You may be a good fit if you have

- 8+ years building production web applications, including several years as the technical lead on a complex product UI. 
 - Expert-level TypeScript and React, including React 19 rendering and concurrency behaviour and hands-on performance profiling. 
 - Owned the architecture of a large frontend codebase and improved it materially while the team kept shipping. 
 - Led an incremental migration in a live application, such as a component library, state management approach, router or build system. 
 - Built interfaces where performance was the hard problem: tens of thousands of rows, high-frequency streaming updates, large JSON or log payloads, or complex interactive charts. 
 - Deep, practical experience with TanStack Query or equivalent, Tailwind CSS, React Hook Form with Zod, Vite and pnpm. 
 - Built or maintained a design system with tokens, theming, accessibility to WCAG standards and documentation in Storybook. 
 - Designed and shipped product yourself, with a portfolio that shows both the decisions you made and the code that implemented them. 
 - Built for multiple user types with different expertise in the same product, and made it work for each of them. 
 - A testing discipline built on Vitest or Jest, Playwright and API mocking. 
 - Worked without a product manager or a full spec, decided what to build, and defended the decision with evidence. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication of trade-offs to engineers, researchers and leadership. 

Strong candidates may also have

- Built developer tools or ML tooling, such as experiment tracking, training dashboards, evaluation or observability products. 
 - Visualisation depth with ECharts, D3, or canvas and WebGL rendering. 
 - Built graph or trace viewers (React Flow or similar) and embedded code editors (CodeMirror or Monaco). 
 - Shipped software into on-premise, regulated or air-gapped environments. 
 - Built right-to-left and multi-locale products. 
 - Used state machines such as XState for complex multi-step flows. 
 - Instrumented frontends with OpenTelemetry and web vitals. 
 - Shipped LLM-powered product features. 
 - Contributed to open-source frontend libraries. 

If you meet most of this but not all, we would still like to hear from you. 

What this role is not

- Not a people management role at the start. There are no direct reports, and influence comes through code, review and design decisions. 
 - Not a visual design role. You will design, but you will be measured on what ships to production. 
 - Not a ticket-implementation role. You will be expected to question specs and decide what should be built. 

What we expect in the first six months

- Own a set of redesigned core flows end to end, from information architecture through to production. 
 - Establish the component system and tokens as the single source of truth for the application. 
 - Set performance budgets for the heaviest views and bring them within budget. 
 - Put test coverage in place across the core flows. 

How we will evaluate

- A review of shipped work where you can show both the design decisions and the code. 
 - A build exercise on a data-dense screen, assessed on code quality, structure and performance. 
 - A design critique of a flow in our product, where you decide what changes and why. 
 - An architecture conversation on component systems, data and streaming layers, and offline deployment.

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
Hiring for SMA Solar India - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

A company building cloud-based energy-management software. It runs optimisation, simulation and evaluation for solar (photovoltaic) systems, battery storage and EV charging. Its international team of engineers and energy experts is growing, and this hire will set the architecture for how its platform scales. 

About the Role

You'll be the hands-on Software Architect for the platform. You'll design cloud-native, event-driven systems, guide engineers through code reviews and prototypes, and turn business needs into scalable, secure and cost-aware architecture. You'll also stay close to the code yourself. The role is based in Bengaluru. 

What you'll do

- Design distributed, event-driven services: where each service ends, the messaging patterns between them, and how data flows. 
 - Define domain models, API contracts and event schemas that can change over time without breaking other services. 
 - Build prototypes and complex Python backend components yourself, and lead code reviews. 
 - Set the bar for performance, security, reliability and observability, and help troubleshoot production issues. 
 - Guide delivery on the cloud, preferably Azure, using Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. 
 - Work with domain experts to bring solar, battery and EV-charging optimisation into the product. 
 - Set coding, testing and documentation standards across teams. 

What you bring

- A Master's in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, and 10+ years in software, including several years as a tech lead or architect. 
 - You've designed a microservices or event-driven platform that used asynchronous messaging (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT or similar) and ran it in production. 
 - Strong Python backend skills, plus relational databases, data processing and automated testing. 
 - You've taken services to production on a major cloud with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD. 
 - You can explain architectural trade-offs clearly to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders on international teams. 
 - You're used to building in iterations with cross-functional agile teams. 

Nice to have

- Experience in energy management, IoT or connected devices, time-series data, AI, or mathematical optimisation.

Required

The opportunity

The role provides leadership across the full product lifecycle, from product strategy, design and development through validation, production, field support and end-of-life. - Lead the 4000/5000 engineering organization through people leaders, with accountability for a total team of more than 50 employees. Establish clear priorities and accountability while building leadership capability, technical depth, succession and a culture of continuous improvement. 
 - Provide overall technical leadership for current product, new product introduction, product upgrades, validation and lifecycle engineering, ensuring engineering deliverables support platform business and customer objectives.

 - Ability to communicate complex technical issues in clear business and customer terms and influence senior stakeholders. 
 - Experience working effectively across global, cross-functional and culturally diverse teams.

Current product

Protect product quality, reliability and customer outcomes through disciplined issue resolution. 

Future product

Lead development, upgrades and validation aligned to platform strategy and market needs. 

Industrial execution

Ensure manufacturing, supplier, sourcing and capacity changes are technically ready and robust. 

Platform competitiveness

Advance cost, technology, sustainability and customer value without compromising engineering integrity. 

Engineering organization

Build capability, succession, governance and a culture of technical excellence. 

Success profile

Planning: Tactical and Strategic

Advanced | Develops the engineering strategy and roadmap; translates platform priorities into resource and execution plans; anticipates technology, regulatory, customer and manufacturing requirements; balances immediate priorities with long-term platform needs. 

Decision Making and Critical Thinking

Advanced | Evaluates alternatives using engineering evidence, validation results, field information and business risk. Distinguishes immediate containment from permanent solutions and facilitates decisions where functions have competing priorities. 

Technical Excellence

Advanced | Creates an environment of technical rigor and innovation. Ensures robust engineering practices across design, validation, production and field support, and leads resolution of highly complex engine, component, system and manufacturing challenges. 

Communicating for Impact

Extensive Experience | Translates complex technical matters into clear customer and business implications. Explains risk, alternatives and recommendations, integrates disparate inputs and communicates transparently with senior leaders and global stakeholders. 

Customer and Market Focus

Extensive Experience | Ensures engineering priorities reflect customer requirements for reliability, durability, performance, operating cost and product support. Uses field and market insight to identify product improvements and new sources of value. 

Managing People

Extensive Experience | Leads through people leaders to build an accountable, capable and engaged engineering organization of more than 50 employees. Sets clear goals, strengthens leadership capability, coaches and mentors leaders, develops succession depth and addresses capability or performance gaps appropriately. 

Collaborating Globally

Advanced | Builds networks across Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Purchasing and commercial teams. Removes barriers, aligns priorities and promotes shared ownership of platform outcomes. 

Influencing Through Expertise

Advanced | Uses technical expertise, business understanding and evidence to influence high-impact decisions involving product changes, validation, quality, sourcing and investment. Constructively challenges assumptions and promotes data-led decisions. 

What strong performance looks like

- Clear engineering priorities and dependable execution against platform commitments. 
 - Faster, evidence-based resolution of complex technical, quality and field issues. 
 - Robust validation and technical governance for product, supplier and manufacturing changes. 
 - Improved collaboration and accountability across engineering and partner functions. 
 - A stronger engineering talent pipeline, succession depth and culture of technical excellence. 
 - Engineering choices that improve customer value and platform competitiveness while managing risk. 

Candidate perspective

This opportunity suits an engineering leader who combines deep technical judgment with strong people leadership and commercial awareness. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating across strategic and operational horizons, leading through ambiguity and influencing complex decisions across organizational boundaries. The role requires demonstrated experience leading leaders and developing a sizeable, multi-disciplinary engineering organization.

data.title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer LAN
data.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Job Purpose

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's local area network and campus switching platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. 

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across local area network and campus switching to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged. 
 - Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability. 
 - Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards. 
 - Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review. 
 - Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery. 
 - Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes. 
 - Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work. 
 - Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed. 
 - Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred. 
 - Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated. 
 - Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally. 

Key Relationships/Customers

Business Stakeholders

- Internal GSK teams consuming the platform as customers of its self-service capability
 - Quality and compliance functions where the platform supports GxP activity

Tech Stakeholders

- Engineering Director as line manager and owner of the engineering roadmap
 - Platform Architect for reference architectures, patterns and standards
 - Product Owner for backlog order and acceptance of engineering-led items
 - Site Reliability Engineer and Reliability Engineering & Operations for SLOs, observability and incident prevention
 - Other Principal Engineers and platform engineers across the domain

Other

- Managed service partners contributing engineering capacity to the platform. 
 - Technology vendors during evaluation and proof of concept

Professional Qualifications

- Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e. g. , Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics). 
 - Relevant technical certifications desirable (e. g. , a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform). 

Area of Specialisation

- Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant. 
 - Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction. 

Why is this level of Education Required?

- Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion. 

Experience Required

- Overall 15 years typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team. 
 - Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace. 
 - Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform. 
 - Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding. 
 - Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge. 
 - Extensive experience engineering enterprise local area networks and campus switching services. 
 - Strong knowledge of routing, switching, segmentation, resilience and complex fault diagnosis. 
 - Evidence of applying standards and automation to improve deployment quality, reliability or supportability. 

Desirable Requirements

- Professional level enterprise networking certification, such as CCNP Enterprise or JNCIP Enterprise Routing and Switching. 
 - Experience with application programming interfaces, infrastructure as code or network assurance platforms. 
 - Experience supporting manufacturing, laboratory or operational technology networks. 

Skills/Background

- Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work. 
 - Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck. 
 - Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line. 
 - Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not. 
 - Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use. 
 - Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently. 

#AGTech

Skills

Automation Technology, Cisco Switching, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Network Engineering, Networks, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), SRE Observability, System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.description:
About the Team: 

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK's internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. 

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you're passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact. 

Job Purpose: 

The QA & Release Senior Manager is responsible for supporting quality assurance practices and coordinating release management activities across the HR Digital & Technology product portfolio. Working across all HR products, the role ensures that changes are tested to a consistent standard, release readiness criteria are met, and releases are coordinated and communicated effectively across product teams and stakeholders. The role supports the delivery of reliable, secure, and compliant changes by embedding quality activities throughout the delivery lifecycle and maintaining visibility of upcoming releases across the portfolio. Working closely with Product Owners, delivery teams, and service teams, the QA & Release Senior Manager helps ensure that quality is designed-in from refinement through to post-go-live, while supporting a structured and well-governed release process that protects service stability and business outcomes. 

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2-3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Quality Assurance

- Support the implementation of QA standards and test approaches across the HR product portfolio, ensuring functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing is carried out consistently across product teams.

 - Support go-live and hypercare activities, monitoring for release-related incidents, coordinating triage across product teams, and ensuring issues are escalated and resolved in a timely manner. 
 - Documents and tracks release outcomes and contribute to post-release reviews, capturing lessons learned, analysing release success rates, and identifying opportunities to improve release processes and reduce release-related incidents.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer – GenAI / AI Platforms
data.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. 

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. 

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers-because progress starts with fresh ideas. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you-because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work. 

Job Summary

Keeps Equinix's GenAI products and platforms stable and reliable, and makes them more resilient over time. Writes the code and automation that prevents failures, rather than only responding to them. Defines service-level objectives, builds monitoring and alerting, hardens services against dependency and capacity failures, and tests failure and recovery before they happen in production. Leads incident response when issues occur and turns each incident into a lasting fix. Works in a team with senior engineers and with product, platform and security partners to keep AI products, agents, connectors and self-hosted models robust, secure, observable and performant. 

Knowledge and Application

Applies solid knowledge of software engineering and site reliability engineering (SRE) practice: service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, monitoring, alerting, incident response, CI/CD and infrastructure as code. Understands how distributed systems fail and how to contain those failures (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation). Understands how GenAI products behave in production, including model latency, rate limits, quotas, streaming and token cost. Follows established standards and suggests improvements. 

Complexity and Problem Solving

Works on problems of defined scope where analysis requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Diagnoses failures across application, model, data, pipeline and infrastructure layers, and fixes the underlying cause rather than the symptom. Applies existing runbooks and approaches, and improves them. Escalates unusual or high-impact issues. Work is reviewed at defined checkpoints. 

Collaboration and Interaction

Works with AI engineers, product managers, platform and security teams. Reviews designs and releases for reliability risk before they ship. Explains status, incidents and results clearly to partners who are not familiar with the subject. Asks for guidance early and shares knowledge with the team. 

Responsibilities

Reliability and resilience engineering (primary focus)

- Write code and automation that makes GenAI products and platforms more resilient: retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, rate limiting, graceful degradation and fallback between models and providers
 - Run load tests, failure-injection tests and game days to find weak points before users do, and fix what they reveal
 - Harden services running on Kubernetes: health checks, autoscaling, disruption budgets, resource limits and multi-zone deployment
 - Plan capacity ahead of launches and growth, including model-provider quotas, GPU and inference capacity, and database headroom
 - Maintain backup, restore and disaster-recovery plans, and test recovery on a regular schedule
 - Automate repeated operational tasks, and reduce manual work each quarter

Monitoring and service levels

- Define and track service-level indicators and objectives with product owners: availability, latency, error rate, token cost and quality scores
 - Instrument services with logs, metrics and traces (e. g. , OpenTelemetry), from the user request through agent, tool and model calls
 - Build and tune dashboards and alerts for user-facing failures, and remove alerts that are noisy or not actionable

Release and deployment

- Support release readiness for GenAI products and platforms: checks for monitoring, alerts, runbooks, capacity, security review and rollback plan
 - Deploy through CI/CD and GitOps pipelines, using containers and infrastructure as code, with canary rollouts and fast rollback

Incident response

- Take part in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and write blameless post-incident reviews
 - Track post-incident actions to completion, so the same failure does not happen twice
 - Write and update runbooks, and turn recurring incidents into automation or fixes

GenAI and self-hosted models

- Support the reliability of self-hosted open-weight and small language models: serving, GPU usage, scaling, rollout and rollback
 - Monitor model and provider latency, errors, rate limits and cost, and flag capacity and cost risks
 - Apply security, patching, secrets and data-boundary requirements to every deployment

Qualifications

Required

- 2-4 years in site reliability, DevOps, platform or software engineering, with hands-on work on production systems
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience
 - Proficiency in Python or Go, with solid software engineering habits: version control, testing, code review
 - Experience with Linux, containers, Kubernetes and a major cloud platform (Google Cloud preferred)
 - Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform)
 - Working knowledge of monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting
 - Understanding of how distributed systems fail and of common resilience patterns
 - Experience with on-call or incident response, and willingness to join an on-call rotation
 - Familiarity with LLM applications (model APIs, retrieval, agents, tool calls)
 - Clear written and verbal communication

Nice to have

- Experience running GenAI or ML systems in production, including managed model platforms (e. g. , Vertex AI) or model serving (e. g. , vLLM)
 - Experience with observability tools (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and incident tools (e. g. , PagerDuty)
 - Experience with GitOps (e. g. , Argo CD), Helm and canary deployments
 - Experience with load testing or chaos engineering
 - Experience with secrets management (e. g. , Vault) and security scanning
 - Experience building automation or AI agents that reduce operational work

What success looks like

- GenAI products and platforms meet their service-level objectives, and releases ship without avoidable incidents
 - Alerts catch failures before users report them, and each incident ends with a documented fix
 - The same incident does not happen twice
 - Load tests and recovery tests run on schedule, and launches scale without capacity issues
 - Manual operational work goes down each quarter
 - The engineer takes on larger, less defined work each quarter with decreasing guidance

It is also our center of excellence for building scalable platforms, AI-enabled capabilities, and next‐generation healthcare technology. As a Lead Quality Assurance Engineer, you will define how quality is engineered across our platform, not just how software is tested. This is a hands-on role for someone who believes quality is built into engineering from day one. If you are highly technical, deeply execution-focused, and passionate about scaling quality through automation, observability, and AI, Lead Quality Assurance Engineer is for you.

What We're Looking For: 

- 8+ years in software testing/quality engineering, including test automation and/or test architecture, in product environments.

 - Operate effectively in ambiguous, global, fast-moving environments.

data.title: Director Software Eng
data.description:
Job Description

The role operates at the intersection of technology strategy, product discovery, domain‐driven design, and engineering execution, driving rapid experimentation, applied innovation, and technical excellence while respecting real‐world operational, security, and regulatory constraints. Success is measured by validated learning, speed‐to‐insight, and successful transition of ideas into core product organizations. The role is expected to be hands-on with 40% time dedicated to Software Development and the rest on the remaining responsibilities. 

Responsibilities

- Own the end‐to‐end lifecycle of idea incubation from problem discovery and hypothesis framing to prototyping, validation, and graduation or termination. 
 - Establish repeatable incubation frameworks using design thinking, Lean Startup, and experiment‐driven development. 
 - Champion a culture of experimentation, learning velocity, and evidence‐based decision‐making in high‐ambiguity environments. 
 - Ensure early‐stage experimentation incorporates domain realities from Buildings, Security, and Industrial contexts, avoiding innovation that cannot transition to real deployments. 

Technical & Architectural Leadership

- Provide technical direction across incubated initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and production‐ready. 
 - Guide teams in selecting and applying emerging technologies including cloud‐native platforms, SaaS, AI/ML, GenAI, IoT, and edge computing. 
 - Ensure architectural decisions explicitly address non‐functional requirements such as availability, scalability, security, compliance, and operational resilience. 
 - Partner with Architecture and SRE leaders to ensure smooth transition of incubated solutions into enterprise‐scale delivery models and long‐lived product platforms. 

AI SDLC + SW Engineering Skills

End-to-End AI Lifecycle : Data → model → deployment → monitoring

MLOps / LLMOps + CI/CD : Pipelines, versioning, automated deploy & testing

Data & Model Engineering: Data pipelines + LLMs/RAG + model optimization

Software Engineering Fundamentals

- API design, microservices 
 - Clean code, testing 
 - System design

Cloud-native Architecture: Kubernetes, Docker, scalable AI services

Domain‐Driven Engineering Leadership

- Ensure engineering teams deeply understand and design for domain‐specific constraints and requirements, including: 
 - Buildings (commercial buildings, campuses, multi‐site operations, 24×7 uptime expectations) 
 - Security (cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory compliance, secure‐by‐design principles) 
 - Industrial / OT (manufacturing, process industries, legacy systems, safety‐critical environments) 
 - Drive domain‐driven design practices so incubated solutions reflect real operational workflows, asset models, and system boundaries. 
 - Validate that domain requirements are explicitly captured and tested during incubation, not deferred to later product teams. 
Buildings Domain Knowledge

- Has led engineering innovation for software platforms that integrate with Building Management Systems (BMS) such as HVAC, lighting, energy, fire, and life‐safety systems. 
 - Ensure incubated solutions support multi‐site and multi‐tenant building deployments and can scale reliably beyond pilot environments. 
 - Drive interoperability across heterogeneous OT devices, protocols, and vendor ecosystems common in building environments. 
 - Ensure experimentation and pilots account for continuous operations and minimal disruption expectations in live buildings. 

Security & Privacy Knowledge

- Own security‐by‐design and privacy‐by‐design accountability across all incubated software initiatives. 
 - Ensure security requirements align with industrial and OT security standards (e. g. , ANSI/ISA‐62443) and enterprise security policies. 
 - Require and oversee: 
 - Threat modeling and secure architecture reviews 
 - Strong authentication, authorization, and role‐based access control 
 - Secure handling of credentials, secrets, and certificates 
 - Audit logging and traceability for security‐relevant actions 
 - Ensure compliance with data protection and privacy regulations (e. g. , GDPR) and completion of required Privacy Impact Assessments (PIA) prior to graduation of incubated solutions. 
 - Partner closely with Security, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure incubated ideas are viable in regulated environments. 
Industrial & OT Engineering Knowledge

- Led incubation of software solutions for industrial and OT‐centric environments, including manufacturing, energy, and process industries. 
 - Ensure platforms can integrate with industrial control systems (ICS) such as SCADA, PLCs, edge devices, and legacy systems. 
 - Drive architectures that support deterministic performance, high‐frequency telemetry, and near‐real‐time decision support where required. 
 - Balance innovation speed with production continuity, safety, and reliability expectations in live industrial environments. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed for long asset lifecycles, staged rollouts, and controlled upgrade windows typical of industrial customers. 

Organization & Talent Leadership

- Build, mentor, and retain high‐performing engineering leaders and senior technologists. 
 - Develop engineering managers and tech leads capable of balancing experimentation speed with technical rigor and domain responsibility. 
 - Foster an inclusive, high‐accountability culture emphasizing ownership, craftsmanship, and engineering judgment. 

Business & Stakeholder Partnership

- Collaborate with Product, UX, Data, OT, and Business leaders to align incubated ideas with strategic priorities and domain realities. 
 - Translate technical and domain insights into compelling narratives for senior leadership. 
 - Serve as a trusted advisor on innovation strategy, platform evolution, and technology investment decisions. 

Execution & Governance

- Define success metrics for incubation including validated learning, domain readiness, and transition viability. 
 - Ensure disciplined execution through lightweight governance, clear decision points, and risk transparency. 
 - Own budget, capacity planning, and vendor strategy for innovation initiatives. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership roles. 
 - Proven track record leading innovation labs, incubators, or advanced development teams. 
 - Strong technical depth in modern software architectures and distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated success moving ideas from concept to validated product or scaled platform in complex, real‐world domains. 

Preferred Experience & Skills

- Experience with Buildings, Industrial, SaaS, or platform‐based businesses. 
 - Exposure to OT environments, cybersecurity, or regulated systems. 
 - Experience with AI/ML, GenAI, data platforms, IoT, or edge ecosystems. 
 - Familiarity with Lean Startup and design thinking methodologies. 
 - Exceptional ability to operate under ambiguity and drive clarity through experimentation. 
 - Strong storytelling, influence, and executive communication skills. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

Hi All, 

Greetings from HCL Tech. 

We are Hiring: Senior STA Full Chip Lead. 

Locations: Bengaluru, Vijayawada, Noida, Chennai & Hyderabad.

We are seeking a highly experienced Clocking/Constraints/STA Lead to join our Physical Design team. In this critical leadership role, you will not only be responsible for your own technical expertise but also for guiding and mentoring a team of engineers to achieve exceptional timing closure for our IC designs. Full Chip Static Timing Analysis (STA) Engineer verifies that an entire System-on-Chip (SoC) meets all speed and performance requirements across every operational condition without running full logical simulations

Responsibilities: 

· Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive clocking strategies for high-performance ICs. 

· Define and manage timing constraints throughout the design flow, ensuring accurate and consistent timing analysis. 

· Stay up-to-date with the Perform advanced Static Timing Analysis (STA) using industry-standard tools, identifying potential timing violations and bottlenecks. 

· Develop and maintain robust clock tree synthesis (CTS) methodologies for optimal clock distribution and skew control. 

· Drive the creation and execution of a comprehensive clock domain crossing (CDC) verification plan. 

· Collaborate with design engineers, layout engineers, and other physical design teams to address timing closure challenges. 

· Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering their growth and expertise in clocking, constraints, and STA. 

· Latest advancements in clocking methodologies, timing analysis tools, and industry best practices. 

· Lead the evaluation and implementation of new tools and methodologies for improved timing closure efficiency. 

· Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for clocking, constraints, and STA practices within the team. 

Qualifications: 

· Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (preferred) or Bachelor's degree with extensive experience. 

· Minimum of 15+ years of experience in clocking, constraints, and STA for digital IC design. 

· Understanding of On-Chip Variation (OCV/POCV), clock tree architecture, parasitic extraction (SPEF), and gate-level netlists

· Proven leadership experience in managing and motivating a team of engineers. 

· In-depth knowledge of digital design principles, timing analysis methodologies, and clock tree synthesis techniques. 

· Expert-level proficiency in industry-standard STA tools (e. g. , Synopsys PrimeTime, Mentor Questa Timing Analyzer). 

· Strong understanding of clock domain crossing (CDC) verification concepts and methodologies. 

· Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills. 

· Ability to think strategically, solve complex timing closure problems, and make sound technical decisions. 

· Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet aggressive deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

Skills:

· STA tools: Innovus, Synopsys PrimeTime, Mentor Questa Timing Analyze. 

· Understanding of On-Chip Variation (OCV/POCV), clock tree architecture, parasitic extraction (SPEF), and gate-level netlists.
