data.title: Team Lead Manager
data.description:
Company: Midson Estates Pvt. Ltd. 
Position: Team Lead Manager - Real Estate Brokerage
Location: Delhi NCR, with travel to project locations
Employment: Full-time
Reporting to: Business Head / Director
Team responsibility: Sales Advisors and assigned Calling / Lead Generation Executives

About Midson Estates

Midson Estates Pvt. Ltd. is developing a research-led real estate brokerage business, drawing on Midson's experience in financial services and real estate investments. Our focus is on identifying differentiated opportunities, understanding client requirements and supporting transactions through disciplined execution. 

Our initial focus includes plots and land, commercial and leased properties, and selected off-market opportunities across North India. 

Role purpose

Build and lead a productive sales team, taking ownership of the complete brokerage sales process-from lead allocation and client engagement to site visits, negotiations, closure and brokerage collection. 

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can manage daily sales operations independently, develop advisors and deliver results. The Director will participate in selected strategic relationships and important negotiations; routine execution and follow-through remain the Team Lead Manager's responsibility. 

Key responsibilities

1. Team building and leadership

- Support recruitment, selection and onboarding of sales advisors and callers. 
- Set clear individual targets, responsibilities and daily activity expectations. 
- Conduct daily sales huddles, weekly pipeline reviews and individual coaching. 
- Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, ethical selling and consistent follow-up. 
- Address underperformance through documented improvement plans and recommend retention or replacement decisions. 
- Develop a capable deputy and ensure continuity during absence or team changes. 

2. Lead management and business development

- Allocate leads according to advisor capability, client requirements and workload. 
- Ensure prompt contact, qualification and systematic follow-up of every assigned lead. 
- Develop business through referrals, personal networks, channel partners and approved social media activity. 
- Guide advisors in building their own prospecting pipelines. 
- Coordinate with digital marketing and calling teams on lead quality and conversion feedback. 
- Ensure client requirements, budgets, decision-makers and purchase timelines are recorded accurately. 

3. Client meetings and site visits

- Plan and supervise client meetings, property presentations and site visits. 
- Personally attend meetings and visits where leadership support can advance a transaction. 
- Ensure advisors understand the property, pricing, documentation status and client suitability before presenting it. 
- Coordinate with developers, property owners and channel partners for access, availability and commercial information. 
- Maintain clear next steps after every meeting and visit. 
- Organise field activity efficiently without relying on the Director for routine travel or coordination. 

4. Negotiations, closures and collections

- Take ownership of progressing qualified opportunities towards closure. 
- Support advisors in handling objections and negotiating within approved commercial limits. 
- Obtain approval for discounts, commitments or exceptions outside delegated authority. 
- Coordinate booking documentation and transaction milestones with the relevant teams. 
- Track brokerage eligibility, invoicing requirements, payment milestones and collection follow-ups. 
- Escalate stalled transactions with a clear issue summary and proposed action. 

5. Project and inventory coordination

- Work with research and sourcing teams to understand available opportunities. 
- Maintain current information on inventory, pricing, brokerage terms and project updates. 
- Match properties to the client's objectives rather than pushing unsuitable inventory. 
- Route legal, title, approval and documentation questions to designated specialists. 
- Ensure the sales team uses approved facts and materials and makes no unsupported promises. 

6. CRM, MIS and operating discipline

- Ensure all leads, calls, meetings, site visits, offers and next actions are captured in the company CRM. 
- Maintain accurate sales stages and evidence-based revenue forecasts. 
- Submit a weekly dashboard covering activity, conversion, closures, collections and bottlenecks. 
- Track lead ageing, missed follow-ups and reasons for lost deals. 
- Keep client records and transaction history accessible in company systems. 
- Follow agreed processes for lead ownership, handovers and resolution of internal disputes. 

7. Training and performance development

- Conduct regular product briefings, sales role-plays and objection-handling sessions. 
- Coach advisors on client qualification, investment conversations, follow-up and negotiation. 
- Review successful and lost transactions to improve team capability. 
- Run performance recognition and competitions linked to measurable results and service quality. 
- Help advisors become independently productive. 

8. Commercial and service accountability

- Monitor team revenue, collections and controllable sales expenses. 
- Work within approved budgets and expense policies. 
- Resolve client concerns promptly and coordinate post-booking support. 
- Protect confidential client and company information. 
- Maintain transparent communication and professional conduct throughout the transaction. 

Performance measures

Targets will be agreed based on team size, inventory and the operating plan. Performance will be assessed on: 

- Brokerage revenue generated and collected. 
- Conversion from qualified leads to meetings, site visits and closures. 
- Advisor productivity and time taken for new advisors to become productive. 
- Lead response time, follow-up completion and CRM accuracy. 
- Pipeline quality and forecasting reliability. 
- Sales expenses against approved budgets. 
- Client satisfaction, referrals and complaint resolution. 
- Ability to run the team without repeated intervention from the Director. 

Candidate profile

- Preferably 5-8 years of real estate sales or brokerage experience, including at least 2 years leading a sales team. 
- Demonstrated record of personally closing transactions and delivering team results. 
- Experience recruiting, coaching and managing advisors. 
- Strong client qualification, negotiation and relationship-management skills. 
- Working knowledge of Delhi NCR real estate; exposure to other North Indian markets is desirable. 
- Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets and sales dashboards. 
- Able and willing to travel for client meetings and site visits. 
- Strong communication skills in Hindi and English. 
- Experience with investors, business owners or higher-value transactions will be an advantage. 
- Graduate preferred; proven sales and leadership performance will carry significant weight. 

Personal qualities

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through consistently and communicates problems early. The successful candidate will combine commercial drive with integrity, sound judgment and the ability to develop others. 

First 90 days

Days 1-30: Understand inventory and processes, assess the existing pipeline and team, establish CRM discipline and agree targets. 

Days 31-60: Implement regular prospecting, coaching and site-visit routines; strengthen the qualified pipeline and address capability gaps. 

Days 61-90: Demonstrate measurable progress in conversions and collections, reliable reporting and independent management of daily team operations. 

Compensation and growth

Proposed structure: fixed remuneration plus performance-linked incentives, with final terms based on experience and agreed responsibilities. Travel and expense arrangements will be defined in the employment offer. 

The role offers an opportunity to build a team and progress towards broader branch or business leadership responsibilities as performance and business scale justify.

data.title: Software Architect
data.description:
About Aptiv

Aptiv is a global technology company that develops safer, greener and more connected solutions, which enable the future of mobility. Headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, Aptiv has 160, 000 employees and operates 14 technical centers, as well as manufacturing sites and customer support centers, in 44 countries. Visit aptiv. com

Today, our mission is to shape the world with more safer, greener and more connected solutions that's changing the world. We are dedicated to bring the next generation of autonomous vehicles, smart cities and connectivity to life. 

Help shape the future of mobility. 

Imagine a world with zero vehicle accidents, zero vehicle emissions, and wireless vehicle connectivity all around us. Every day, we move closer to making that world a reality. Aptiv's passionate team of engineers and developers creates advanced safety systems, high-performance electrification solutions and data connectivity solutions so that automakers can bring advanced capabilities to more people around the globe. This is how we enable sustainable mobility and help to prevent accidents caused by human error. 

Software Architect

The Software Architect is responsible for defining, governing, and evolving the software architecture of automotive products and platforms. This role leads to architectural decisions from concept through production, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, safe, secure, and aligned with customer, business, and technical requirements. The Software Architect provides technical leadership across cross-functional teams and serves as the key authority for software architecture, quality, and engineering best practices. 

Responsibilities

- Define, document, and maintain software architecture for products and platforms. 
 - Analyze customer, system, safety, cybersecurity, and business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions. 
 - Define software components, interfaces, design patterns, and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, reliability, timing, and security). 
 - Drive architectural reviews, code reviews, technical assessments, and design decisions. 
 - Ensure compliance with software development standards, coding guidelines, and automotive processes. 
 - Collaborate with Functional Safety and Cybersecurity teams to develop safety and security concepts. 
 - Support software DFMEA, verification activities, and production release readiness. 
 - Work directly with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and resolve technical issues. 
 - Support Agile development teams during implementation and ensure adherence to architectural intent. 
 - Participate in PI Planning, technical roadmap development, quotation activities, and Proof-of-Concept initiatives. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across globally distributed teams. 
 - Promote Built-In Quality, software reusability, and continuous improvement. 
 - Define and evolve common software platforms, architectural frameworks, runtime environments, and reusable technology building blocks enabling scalability across programs
 - Manage architectural risks and technical debts, support the long-term technology strategy
 - Adoption of AI-assisted architecture practices to improve engineering productivity

Requirements (required): 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Extensive experience in software development, embedded systems, and software architecture, including the design and delivery of complex software products and platforms. 
 - Proven experience defining and implementing software architecture in complex product development environments. 
 - Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, multi-threaded software, and RTOS platforms (Linux, QNX, OSEK, or similar).

 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical leadership skills. 
 - Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet).

 - Familiarity with GPU/NPU/DSP
 - Automotive Knowledge - ADAS / Perception / Parking
 - CICD knowledge and familiarity with Gerrit workflow
 - Experience with requirements management tools such as DOORS or Polarion. 
 - Familiarity with, ASPICE, MISRA, and automotive software development processes. 
 - Knowledge of Functional Safety (ISO 26262) and automotive cybersecurity principles. 
 - Experience with Git, static analysis tools, and software performance profiling. 
 - Understanding of open-source software governance and licensing. 
 - Experience working within Agile/SAFe environments. 
 - Experience working with global, cross-functional development teams. 
 - Strong communication / presentation skills and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across organizational levels. 
 - Ability to lead technical activities, coordinate development tasks, and provide guidance to team members. 

Why join us?

You grow at Aptiv. 

Aptiv's winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers' toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win. 

You make an impact at Aptiv. 

One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day. 

You have support at Aptiv. 

We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package. 

Your Benefits at Aptiv: 

Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development); 

Life and accident insurance; 

Sodexo cards for food and beverages

Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events; 

EAP Employee Assistance; 

Access to fitness clubs (T&C apply)

Creche facility for working parents

Meet the Next-Generation Aptiv

At Aptiv, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most. 

Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on-advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies. 

Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Join athenahealth as Senior Engineering Manager and lead the teams reimagining how healthcare reaches patients. Based in Bangalore, India, in a hybrid role, you will report to the Director of Engineering, Messaging. You'll drive delivery across multiple teams, run complex projects from plan to production, build and grow a high-performing team, and champion engineering excellence in everything we ship. 

Team Summary

athenahealth's messaging platform connects thousands of practices with their patients, delivering millions of messages every day across text, voice, email and the patient portal. We are reimagining it as an intelligent, outcome-driven platform. Instead of sending fixed reminders, it decides the best next step for each patient and measures whether each message actually helped. As a Senior Engineering Manager on this team, you will lead engineers who are building the platform at scale, moving today's experiences onto it, and using AI to make every patient touch count. Your leadership will shape a culture of quality, outcome, ownership and innovation in one of the most patient-facing parts of athenahealth. 

Essential Job Responsibilities

- Drive engineering excellence through strong design principles, code quality, automated testing, observability, incident management and clear service ownership. 
 - Build an inclusive, accountable and innovative engineering culture while maintaining a high bar for execution and technical craftsmanship. 
 - Own planning, hiring strategy, talent development, succession planning, performance management and the growth of engineers across multiple teams. 
 - Turn product roadmaps and architecture decisions into delivery plans, keep multiple pods moving in parallel, and make priority and trade-off decisions based on data. 
 - Own the production health of the team's services, including service levels, on-call, incident reviews, reliability and cost. 
 - Lead adoption of AI-assisted, specification-driven development and automated validation to help teams deliver faster without compromising quality. 

Additional Job Responsibilities

- Partner with product management, architecture, quality engineering and domain teams to align technical strategy with business outcomes. 
 - Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed leaders, peers and stakeholders. 
 - Facilitate knowledge sharing and spread best practices across engineering teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and machine learning, and recommend adopting those that improve outcomes or efficiency. 
 - Represent engineering in program and project planning to align technical strategy with organizational goals. 

Expected Education & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. 
 - 12+ years of hands-on experience designing and building highly available distributed systems, microservices and data platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on background in Java and Spring Boot, building and running production services on AWS. 
 - At least 3 years of engineering leadership experience managing multiple teams and owning deliverables and outcomes. 
 - Experience leading system design reviews, driving technical discussions and resolving complex engineering escalations. 
 - Ability to make priority and trade-off decisions based on data. 
 - Experience with, or exposure to, building products using AI and machine learning technologies. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with geographically distributed leaders, peers and stakeholders. 
 - Excellent communication, leadership and presentation skills. 
 - Experience with high-volume messaging or notification platforms (text, voice, email) is highly desirable. 
 - Experience leading large platform modernizations or migrations is highly desirable. 
 - Familiarity with healthcare regulations, patient consent and communication compliance is a plus. 

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients - powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. 

Our company culture: Our talented employees - or athenistas, as we call ourselves - spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support. 

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve. 

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces - some offices even welcome dogs. 

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation. 

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

JD for Development Team Lead (. NET)

Position Overview

The Development Team Lead (. NET) is responsible for providing hands‐on technical leadership, mentoring, and delivery oversight for a team building enterprise applications on the Microsoft . NET platform. This role blends deep . NET expertise with people leadership, Agile delivery, and cross‐functional collaboration. The Team Lead works closely with Product, QA, DevOps, Architecture, and Delivery to ensure consistent, predictable, and high‐quality delivery. 

This role will play a key leadership role in the modernization of legacy . NET and WCF-based platforms, helping drive the transition to cloud-ready ASP. NET Core APIs, microservices, and Azure-native architectures. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

- Lead the design and development of applications using C#, VB. NET, ASP. NET Core, ASP. NET MVC, Web API, LINQ, and related . NET technologies. 
 - Guide modernization of legacy VB. NET, WCF, and . NET Framework applications and services into modern C#, ASP. NET Core, and . NET 8+ API architectures where appropriate. 
 - Define and lead migration strategies for legacy WCF/SOAP services, including service decomposition, API design, security modernization, backward compatibility, and transition to RESTful and event-driven architectures. 
 - Provide technical leadership for both the ongoing enhancement of existing WCF-based applications and the strategic modernization of those platforms to ASP. NET Core and cloud-ready architectures. 
 - Evaluate and implement modern integration patterns using REST APIs, microservices, Azure Service Bus, and cloud-native services as part of application modernization initiatives. 
 - Perform and enforce high‐quality code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards, clean architecture, and SOLID principles. 
 - Break down complex technical requirements into well‐scoped stories and tasks. 
 - Work with Architects to align on technical patterns, integration approaches, and long‐term platform direction. 

People Leadership & Coaching

- Provide day‐to‐day support, mentorship, and coaching to developers across varying experience levels. 
 - Foster a positive, inclusive culture centered on learning, ownership, and accountability. 
 - Conduct regular 1: 1s and support career development, skills progression, and performance management. 

Agile Delivery & Planning

- Lead sprint planning, backlog readiness, estimation, and throughput optimization. 
 - Facilitate daily stand‐ups, reviews, and retrospectives; remove team impediments rapidly. 
 - Coordinate dependencies with QA, DevOps, and other teams; ensure release readiness and change control. 
 - Partner with the Delivery Manager (or act in that capacity where needed) to maintain predictable sprint throughput and reliable release timelines. 

Quality & Reliability

- Ensure strong testing practices: unit testing (xUnit/NUnit/MSTest), integration testing, API testing, and automation support and high code coverage targets. 
 - Collaborate with QA to embed quality in the workflow; drive shift‐left testing practices. 
 - Validate that applications meet non‐functional requirements such as performance, resilience, and security. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps to improve CI/CD pipelines, environment stability, and release automation. 

System & Application Ownership

- Provide technical leadership for legacy service modernization initiatives, including assessment, refactoring, migration planning, risk management, and production rollout of WCF-to-. NET Core API transformations. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across environments (DEV/QA/UAT/PROD). 
 - Lead root cause analysis for production incidents and identify long‐term fixes. 
 - Monitor application health using Application Insights, logging frameworks, and dashboards. 

Cross‐Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Product Owners to refine user stories, clarify requirements, and provide estimates. 
 - Work closely with DevOps for CI/CD enhancements and infrastructure needs (Azure preferred). 
 - Collaborate with QA Lead, Architecture, and Security teams to ensure compliance with standards. 

Qualifications

Required

- 8+ years of professional software development experience with . NET Framework, . NET Core, and enterprise application development. 
 - 2+ years in a people leader role. 
 - Strong expertise in C#, with hands-on experience developing, enhancing, supporting, and modernizing applications built on VB. NET, WCF, and the . NET Framework. Experience migrating legacy services to ASP. NET Core and modern API architectures is required. 
 - Hands-on experience designing, developing, supporting, and modernizing WCF/SOAP services, including execution of WCF-to-ASP. NET Core Web API migration initiatives, service contract analysis, authentication modernization, API versioning, and integration modernization. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including SOAP, REST, messaging, service-oriented architecture (SOA), and microservices. 
 - Experience maintaining and enhancing enterprise applications built on WCF, SOAP, and . NET Framework, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and delivery of new business functionality. 
 - Experience building REST APIs, microservices, or modular applications using ASP. NET Core/Web API. 
 - Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions), unit testing frameworks, and design patterns. 
 - Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban) with strong facilitation skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead teams, influence architecture, and deliver complex initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and problem‐solving skills. 

Preferred

- Experience in a multi‐team environment with shared services (QA, DevOps, Architecture). 
 - Experience with Microsoft Azure services including API Management, App Services, Azure Functions, Service Bus, Key Vault, and Application Insights. 
 - Experience modernizing monolithic or service-oriented applications into microservices or cloud-native architectures. 
 - Experience using modernization tools and frameworks such as . NET Upgrade Assistant, migration assessment tools, and automated code conversion utilities. 
 - Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, tracing) and performance tuning. 
 - Exposure to relational and NoSQL data stores, messaging, and event‐driven patterns. 
 - Exposure to DevOps concepts such as IaC (Bicep, ARM, Terraform). 
 - Certifications such as PSM I/II, CSM, PMI‐ACP, or Azure Developer/Architect certifications.

8+ or more years of experience in the Software Engineering industry with a record of increasing responsibility leading software development initiatives, and 3+ years managing teams. 

Deep understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Machine Learning Lifecycle (MLL).

Hands-on experience with GCP technologies such as BigQuery, GKE, GCS, DataFlow, Kubeflow, and Vertex AI - or equivalent services in AWS and/or Azure. 

Familiarity with ML frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLflow, scikit-learn, HuggingFace Transformers, etc. 

Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD tools used to automate deployment to cloud platforms: Terraform, GitHub Actions, Concourse, Ansible, etc. 

Excellent leadership, decision-making, and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into engineering outcomes. 

Experience with AI product lifecycle management, including experimentation tracking, model governance, and release management. 

Experience with Python is ideal; Java/Spring is a strong plus. 

Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred

Are you the person we're looking for?

Provide engineering leadership and mentorship to a team of software engineers. 

Be a strong engineering leader responsible for executing the Conga AI roadmap using agile practice. 

Experience implementing scalable data and AI/ML solutions in a product-driven technology environment. 

Manage, lead, and motivate cross-functional, interdisciplinary teams of software engineers to achieve strategic and tactical business outcomes. 

Mentor and grow engineers in your team, fostering a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement. 

Demonstrated ability to skillfully hire, coach, and performance manage a team of technology professionals. 

Partner with others at Conga to ensure engineering tasks are understood, broken down, and implemented to the highest of quality standards. 

Collaborate with members of the team to solve challenging engineering tasks on time and with high quality. 

Encourage skill growth of your team members. 

Assist and adhere to enforcement of project deadlines and schedules. 

Actively communicate with team members to clarify requirements and overcome obstacles to meet the team goals. 

Highly technical, confident at the operational management level and comfortable in an engineering-heavy organization. 

Track record of being a strong leader, with the ability to influence across teams and levels. 

Work with development teams in an agile context as it relates to software development. 

Here's What Will Give You An Edge. . . 

Provide architectural guidance and technical oversight for AI/ML systems, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and production ready. 

Drive engineering excellence by championing robust design, peer reviews, and efficient CI/CD practices tailored for AI systems. 

Foster strong cross-functional partnerships with Product, Data Science, ML-Ops, and DevOps teams to accelerate delivery and innovation.

The GCC Digital & Product Delivery Leader is accountable for building and leading U. S. Bank's Digital and Product Delivery capability in India. This is an enterprise role. The leader will establish and scale fully-stacked product, agile and experience design teams that serve business lines across the bank rather than any single line of business. 

This is a build role as much as a leadership role. Product management, agile ways of working and experience design capability at the scale and maturity the bank requires are not widely established in the Chennai market. The leader will be expected to evangelize the discipline, attract and develop talent, and set the standards, career paths and ways of working that will define the capability as it grows. 

In the near term, the leader will also serve as the Consumer Digital Product Lead while the organization scales. Additional leadership layers will be introduced as volume and complexity justify them, not before. 

Key Responsibilities

Capability Building and Organizational Leadership

- Establish the Digital and Product Delivery capability in the GCC, covering product management, agile ways of working and experience design across all supported business lines. 
 - Lead, coach and develop a team of six senior leaders spanning Product, Agile and Design, building the leadership bench beneath them as the organization scales. 
 - Champion product management as a discipline in the India market, building the bank's reputation as a destination for product, agile and design talent. 
 - Define role standards, capability frameworks and career paths that support consistent hiring, development and progression. 
 - Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR to attract, assess and retain talent in a market where these skill sets are in short supply and highly competitive. 

Delivery and Business Partnership

- Ensure GCC-based teams deliver against the product roadmaps and outcomes owned by U. S. -based business and product leadership.

 - Maintain continuity of delivery through the transition of work from vendor-based models to the GCC, minimizing disruption to business partners. 
 - Balance line-of-business alignment with enterprise consistency, ensuring teams support specific business partners while operating to common standards. 

Ways of Working and Standards

- Embed the bank's Product Model and Shield Ways of Working across GCC teams, ensuring consistency with U. S. -based practice.

 - Operate within Indian regulatory and labor requirements, including workforce entitlement, shift and site attendance obligations. 
 - Ensure adherence to the bank's risk, compliance and control expectations, and partner with Risk and Audit as the GCC control environment matures. 
 - Manage cost and headcount to plan, contributing to the efficiency objectives underpinning the GCC model. 

Basic Qualifications

- Significant experience leading digital product management, product delivery or equivalent functions at enterprise scale. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading leaders, including building and scaling multi-disciplinary teams. 
 - Experience operating in a global delivery, GCC or captive center environment. 
 - Deep working knowledge of agile ways of working and modern product operating models.

data.description:
Overview

Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. 

Microsoft's Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. 

Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end-to-end intelligence platform. 

Within the Microsoft Fabric Platform team, we are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform: the infrastructure that takes every change from a developer's local environment through validation and deployment to production. Agentic software development is changing the scale of software engineering: GitHub reports that developers and agents made more than five times as many commits in September 2026 as they did a year earlier, and we are planning for a 50 to 100 times increase in the number of features our teams ship. Today's SDLC infrastructure was never designed for that scale, so we are rebuilding it to match that vision. We build our SDLC platform as a product: agent-driven, cloud-native backend services on Azure that provide elastic development and validation environments, high-throughput processing of every code change, and safe, progressive deployment to production across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with AI agents increasingly taking on work across the lifecycle, from feature development to live-site recovery to compliance and security. Every team building features for Microsoft Fabric runs on this platform, so each improvement compounds across a very large engineering organization. We approach the SDLC as a large-scale distributed systems problem, which makes this a backend product development role: we are looking for engineers who love building distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale, and who want to apply that to reinventing how software is built and shipped in the agentic era. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the design of major components of the platform, from architecture through production. 

We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. 

Responsibilities

Lead the design and development of cloud-native backend services for Fabric's next-generation software development lifecycle (SDLC) platform, spanning local development, validation, and deployment to production. 

Architect elastic, on-demand compute and environments on Azure that let engineers and AI agents develop and validate changes in isolated, production-like environments at very high concurrency. 

Build distributed, high-throughput services that scale gracefully with an order-of-magnitude growth in change volume driven by agentic development. 

Design deployment services that roll out changes safely and progressively across Fabric's global, multi-region footprint, with automated health analysis and rollback. 

Build AI agents into the platform itself, for example agents that recover live-site issues and keep changes compliant and secure, so the SDLC runs with minimal human toil and offers similar levels of SLA and reliability guarantees that customers of Fabric get, offered to the developers building on this platform. 

Partner with engineering teams across Fabric to understand their needs, identify dependencies, modernize existing infrastructure for scale, resilience, and cost efficiency, and drive adoption of the platform.

Embody our culture and values

data.title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer, Shipping Tech & Services
data.description:
Description

Amazon Shipping is our externalized business providing small parcel transportation services to sellers and shippers. Amazon Shipping leverages many of the above foundational systems together with operations capabilities to pick up packages from shipper warehouses and inject them into the AFN outbound transportation network to provide an end-to-end parcel delivery product we can sell. 

The Sr. PE in this space will develop deep understanding of Amazon's end-to-end fulfilment and transportation operations in order to support small-parcel transportation for all Amazon marketplaces, its subsidiaries, merchants and off-Amazon shippers. 

This role will need to understand not only how a large set of technical services within Carrier Integration Services (CIS) and Amazon Shipping work together, but also how they interface and enable the adjacent functions, capabilities and programs across First Mile, Middle Mile and Last Mile as we transition to being an end-to-end carrier. 

The Sr. PE will establish the strategy and execution plan to achieve convergence of multiple legacy systems in the carrier space, gracefully manage this transition while both legacy and new systems coexist in production, and strike the right balance between feature velocity and not blocking business launches yet also avoiding accrual of technical debt and throwaway work. 

To do this effectively requires setting a strategy that provides value in both the near and long-term, and aligning 5 to 6 VP stakeholders on the vision and plan. The Sr. PE must possess a broad and deep understanding of the transportation architecture and operations, and create scalable solutions to support heterogeneous functions at scale, such as FC package labeling and sorting, sort center processing, line haul, air and last mile delivery as well as an ever-growing number of programs (e. g. , Sub-Same Day, AmazonDay, Roar, Pharmacy) and advanced capabilities (disruption management, replanning, problem solve, Redirect to Locker). 

The Sr. PE will need to understand not just the technical and product capabilities but the nuances of the businesses they are supporting, and helps to understand and balance conflicting stakeholder objectives, while simultaneously building trust and demonstrating empathy with their customers' needs

Key job responsibilities

- You lead the definition, design, architecture quality, implementation, and delivery of the most advanced, most difficult, most cross-cutting, and/or most ambiguous challenges spanning across ATS. You may own one or more critical components. 
 - You ensure that the teams within ATS and teams in related organizations are aligned to a coherent technical vision and delivering systems that fit well together. 
 - You exert influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness. You hold peers and teams to a high bar. 
 - You are considered to be an authority on technical issues by both the technical and business community and are frequently consulted for making difficult trade-off decisions. You are respected for your technical expertise and have credibility with others based on your accomplishments. You drive awareness about the impact and consequences of technical decisions on the business. 
 - You relentlessly simplify. You demonstrate significant innovation, creativity, and judgement when solving challenging problems. 
 - You identify future skills needed across your organization and advocate for the development and/or acquisition of those skills to senior leaders. You scout top talent and recruit them to Amazon. 
 - You actively mentor senior and Principal engineers. You develop and institutionalize best practices

Basic Qualifications

- 10+ years of professional software development experience
 - 8+ years of programming experience with at least one modern language such as Java, C++
 - 8+ years contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field
 - 2+ years hands-on experience as a senior Principal Engineer leading multiple software engineering
 - Experience shipping successful large-scale supply chain projects

data.title: Principal Technical Operations Engineer
data.description:
Business Unit: 

Cubic Transportation Systems

Company Details: 

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people's lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. 

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic. com. 

Job Details: 

Principal Technical Operations Engineer

Position Summary

The Principal Technical Operations Engineer is a hands-on senior technical leader responsible for the stability, reliability, performance, and supportability of Cubic's production systems. The role involves leading the diagnosis and resolution of the most complex software defects, customer-reported issues, configuration problems, data anomalies related challenges across live, interconnected environments. 

As a technical authority across assigned programs, this engineer influences architecture, design, configuration, production readiness, and lifecycle decisions. The role converts production insights into sustainable engineering improvements, drives the elimination of recurring failure patterns, strengthens observability and automation, and guides cross-functional teams in maintaining operational excellence across mission-critical transportation systems. 

Key Responsibilities

Production Support & Issue Resolution

- Understand the enterprise architecture end to end and own troubleshooting across multiple interconnected and complex software systems. 
 - Lead the investigation and resolution of high-impact software defects, configuration issues, integration failures, data anomalies for complex issues. 
 - Provide technical direction during the most complex cross-system production incidents, coordinating diagnosis across application, integration, database, messaging, and external interface layers. 
 - Perform deep-dive root cause and pattern analysis, converting findings into permanent corrective actions, preventive controls, and prioritized engineering improvements. 
 - Maintain system stability through proactive monitoring, configuration management, capacity awareness, and early identification of operational risks. 
 - Define reusable diagnostic approaches and troubleshooting standards that improve resolution quality, reduce mean time to restore, and strengthen support-team effectiveness. 

Technical Leadership

- Own the technical baseline for system architecture, design, configuration, and operational supportability across the full system lifecycle. 
 - Demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration and advanced expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex technical issues. 
 - Demonstrated experience working in a Technical Business Analyst function, with exposure to analyzing end-to-end business processes and their underlying applications, system components, integrations, and data flows to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and opportunities for operational and technical improvement. 
 - Drive root cause and pattern analysis for recurring production issues, translating findings into scalable engineering improvements and preventive actions. 
 - Champion automation and observability improvements that reduce manual intervention, strengthen reliability, and improve operational efficiency. 
 - Mentor Senior Engineers and support teams, establishing engineering standards, reusable practices, and consistent approaches to complex troubleshooting and technical decision-making. 
 - Bridge Production Operations, Systems Engineering, Development, and business or program teams by translating operational challenges into clear engineering priorities and scalable technical solutions. 

Operational Excellence

- Own the technical relationship with program teams and ensure systems meet agreed performance, availability, reliability, and supportability targets in accordance with service-level commitments. 
 - Drive cross-program operational maturity through standardization, automation, observability, reliability engineering, and measurable continuous-improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop, review, and maintain high-quality operational documentation, including runbooks, configuration guides, architectural support views, known-error records, and incident-response procedures. 
 - Lead post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions address both immediate causes and broader systemic risks. 
 - Use incident trends, recurring failure patterns, service metrics, and operational data to prioritize engineering investments and reduce technical and operational risk. 
 - Influence production-readiness criteria and operational acceptance for new solutions, releases, architectural changes, and major configuration updates. 
 - Interface with customers, partners, and vendors to resolve escalated issues, communicate technical risk, and align on sustainable solutions. 
 - Promote knowledge reuse and operational readiness by strengthening technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and support-team capability. 

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 
 - 10+ years of experience in systems engineering, production engineering, site reliability, or technical operations, with demonstrated ownership of complex, business-critical production environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience working in a Technical Business Analyst function, with exposure to analyzing end-to-end business processes and their underlying applications, system components, integrations, and data flows to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and opportunities for operational and technical improvement. 
 - Advanced expertise in diagnosing and resolving complex software, infrastructure, integration, configuration, messaging, data, and performance issues in live environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with incidents, problem, change, and release management processes in a 24x7 production environment. 
 - Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, log analysis, alerting, performance tuning, and service-health analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of configuration management practices and distributed messaging technologies such as Kafka. 
 - Strong hands-on capability with SQL for production diagnostics, data validation, and issue analysis. 
 - Ability to navigate ambiguity, assess technical risk, establish priorities, and create clarity for technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience participating in rotational on-call or shift-based support for mission-critical production services. 
 - Proven ability to lead customer or client technical discussions, incident reviews, risk conversations, and solution-alignment sessions. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineering, program, operational, and leadership audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in transportation, finance, smart mobility, or another regulated and mission-critical industry. 
 - Experience with high-availability, fault-tolerance, distributed, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience leading reliability engineering, observability, automation, production modernization, or operational maturity initiatives across large-scale systems. 
 - Experience working across technology ecosystems in which applications, infrastructure, integrations, field devices, back-office platforms, and operational processes collectively affect customer-facing services. 
 - Knowledge of security, resilience, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and production-readiness practices for enterprise systems. 
 - Relevant professional certifications in cloud technologies, IT service management, database technologies, systems engineering.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer I
data.description:
Do you enjoy building reliable cloud platforms using Azure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation?

Would you like to help create secure, scalable systems while collaborating with software engineering and security teams?

About The Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at https: //risk. lexisnexis. com/

About Our Team

Our DevOps/SRE team supports a regulated identity and risk platform running on Microsoft Azure across multiple regions, including FedRAMP and UK environments. We own the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, observability and security posture for a portfolio of Java-based services and data pipelines. We are currently modernizing our platform by moving workloads from Kubernetes (AKS) to Azure Container Apps, so it's a great time to join and help shape how our services are built and run. 

About The Role

The Senior DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security and operational maturity of our Azure-hosted platform. The role combines infrastructure-as-code, platform engineering, release engineering and operational support. You will work closely with development, QA, security, release management and central platform teams to deliver automation, observability, compliance and platform modernization initiatives. 

Responsibilities

- Support highly available production services across multiple environments and participate in on-call and major incident response and operational side of databases, caches, file storage, scheduled jobs and ETL pipelines, and the test automation infrastructure used in our pipelines. 
 - Investigate incidents and service degradation, lead recovery, and produce Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) with corrective actions and lead the migration of workloads from AKS to Azure Container Apps (ACA), including environment design, networking, secrets, scaling and observability. 
 - Design, build and operate Azure infrastructure using Terraform, and maintain Kubernetes (AKS) clusters and Helm-based deployments to build and improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including image promotion, GitOps (ArgoCD) and blue/green releases. 
 - Drive container and supply chain security: hardened/FIPS-compliant images, vulnerability scanning and remediation, and FedRAMP compliance controls, in partnership with InfoSec and improve observability through monitoring, logging, tracing, synthetic checks, dashboards, alerting and SLOs. 
 - Manage secrets, identities and TLS certificates, including automated rotation and renewal, cloud networking, including VNet peering, private endpoints, DNS and firewall rules as code. 
 - Track and report on vulnerabilities and compliance, and keep container registries, artifacts and Terraform state well maintained. 
 - Participate in release coordination, change management, disaster recovery, blue/green failover and capacity planning and identify recurring issues and automate operational toil to improve reliability and developer productivity. 
 - Partner with development, QA, database, security and operations teams to promote operational excellence and continuous improvement. 

Requirements

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including AKS, Azure Container Apps, ACR, Key Vault, VNets/private networking, Entra ID and managed identities. 
 - Strong knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, Helm, cloud networking, IAM/RBAC and distributed systems. 
 - Proficiency with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices across multiple environments. 
 - Experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD tooling, including GitOps and progressive delivery (ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts). 
 - Experience securing container workloads, including image hardening, vulnerability remediation (e. g. , Wiz, Defender, Xray), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, Akeyless) and compliance controls; FedRAMP experience is a plus. 
 - Experience with observability tools such as Elastic, Grafana, Prometheus and Open Telemetry. 
 - Strong incident management skills, including technical recovery, RCA facilitation and corrective actions. 
 - Experience with Linux administration and scripting in Bash, Python or PowerShell. 

Our Tech Stack

- Cloud: Microsoft Azure: Container Apps (ACA), AKS, ACR, Key Vault, Azure Firewall, VNets/Private Endpoints, Azure Files, Azure Managed Redis, Azure OpenAI, Azure Monitor
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, tflint, Trivy
 - Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts, KEDA
 - CI/CD & Release: GitHub Actions, JFrog Artifactory, ServiceNow DevOps, Jira
 - Observability: Elastic (APM, logs, synthetics), OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana
 - Security & Compliance: Wiz, Microsoft Defender for Containers, Prisma Cloud, JFrog Xray, Mend, Checkmarx, OpenSCAP, FedRAMP
 - Secrets & Identity: HashiCorp Vault, Akeyless, Entra ID, Managed/Workload Identity
 - Applications & Data: Java/Spring Boot, Tomcat, Apache Hop (ETL), MySQL, Redis
 - Scripting: Bash, Python, PowerShell

Our Commitment to Inclusion

We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups, people with disabilities, career changers, and candidates with non-traditional education or experience. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We are committed to supporting your success. 

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

data.title: Backend Engineer AI
data.description:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely. 

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. 

Atlys is changing that. 

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early. 

The Role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer (AI) to build the systems that bring AI into production at Atlys, helping us make visa processing faster and simpler for travellers around the world. 

This role is for someone with a strong backend foundation in Python who is excited by applied AI and LLMs, and who cares as much about reliability and scale as about shipping new features. 

The Job

- Build AI-native backend services in Python that orchestrate LLMs, agents and tool calls across core product workflows. 
 - Build evals and reinforcement learning loops that measure model quality on real workflows, and use RL techniques (reward modelling, RLHF/RLAIF, RL fine-tuning) to continuously improve agent performance. 
 - Scale for volume and cost with async, event-driven workflows that handle peak demand while keeping latency and token spend in check. 
 - Own systems end to end from design to production, with strong testing, monitoring, observability and evals. 

The Ideal Candidate

You'll likely thrive in this role if you: 

- Have 4-7 years of backend engineering experience, including hands-on work building and running LLM-powered features in production. 
 - Are exceptionally strong in Python, including async Python, and have shipped production services with frameworks such as FastAPI, Django or Flask. 
 - Have hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and the building blocks around them: prompt design, tool calling, structured outputs, RAG and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate or similar). 
 - Know how to evaluate and harden AI systems, including eval datasets, LLM observability tools (Langfuse, LangSmith or similar) and trade-offs between accuracy, latency and cost. 
 - Have solid fundamentals in databases, distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, including PostgreSQL, Redis, message queues (Kafka, SQS or Celery), AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Have exposure to agent frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar), fine-tuning, reinforcement learning (RLHF, reward modelling) or self-hosted models, browser automation (Playwright), or building in fintech, travel or other high-compliance domains (a strong plus). 

What you can expect

- Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create. 
 - Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us. 
 - A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off. 
 - Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together. 
 - Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft. 
 - Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible. 
 - Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software. 
 - An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator. Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. data.description:
About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases and make people's lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today. 

Role Description

We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions. 

This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs. 

Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams. 

The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application 
 - Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues. 
 - Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems. 
 - Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems. 
 - Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices. 
 - Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues. 
 - Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments. 
 - Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services. 
 - Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles. 
 - Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable. 
 - Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required. 

Software Development & Enhancement

- Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions. 
 - Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely 
 - Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality. 
 - Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. 
 - Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards. 
 - Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms. 
 - Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers. 
 - Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs. 
 - Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices. 
 - Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests. 
 - Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment. 
 - Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers. 

Testing, Release & Operational Readiness

- Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases. 
 - Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing. 
 - Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent. 
 - Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification. 
 - Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production. 
 - Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases. 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

- Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI. 

Basic Qualifications And Experience

- Master's / Bachelor's degree with 3-5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations. 

Must-Have Skills

- Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle. 
 - Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments. 
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues. 
 - Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes. 
 - Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations. 
 - Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and basic data-access concepts. 
 - Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and/or TypeScript. 
 - Familiarity with React and Vite, Angular, Vue. js, or another modern front-end framework. 
 - Basic knowledge of Python and FastAPI, or a comparable back-end technology. 
 - Experience developing, testing, debugging, supporting, and deploying software applications. 
 - Understanding of software-testing methodologies including functional, integration, regression, smoke, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Experience creating and executing test cases and documenting test results. 
 - Familiarity with unit and UI testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools. 
 - Familiarity with API testing using Postman or equivalent tools. 
 - Familiarity with defect and work-management platforms such as Jira or Azure DevOps. 
 - Familiarity with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, and code reviews. 
 - Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies. 
 - Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment. 
 - Understanding of secure coding principles, OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, dependency management, and application security. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and external vendors. 

Good-to-Have Skills

- Exposure to GxP or regulated systems and associated validation/compliance activities. 
 - Experience supporting enterprise applications in a production environment. 
 - Familiarity with IT service-management processes and tools such as ServiceNow. 
 - Experience working with SaaS and/or vendor-managed enterprise applications.

 - Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, or application observability tools.

data.description:
Your Role

The DevOps Engineer will design, implement, operate, and continuously improve secure and reliable software delivery platforms for engineering teams. The role owns end-to-end CI/CD automation, Git and GitHub-based development workflows, build and release tooling, containerized execution environments, infrastructure scripting, and operational monitoring. The engineer will partner with software developers, verification teams, security stakeholders, and platform teams to reduce delivery lead time, improve build quality, increase deployment repeatability, and resolve complex pipeline or infrastructure issues. Success requires strong hands-on engineering skills, disciplined troubleshooting, clear documentation, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-cultural, multi-team environment. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, maintain, and optimize Jenkins scripted and declarative pipelines, including reusable libraries, parameterized jobs, parallel stages, artifact handling, quality gates, approvals, notifications, and failure recovery. 
 - Own Git and GitHub workflows, including repository setup, branching strategies, pull requests, code review policies, protected branches, CODEOWNERS, release tags, semantic versioning, and repository permissions in an enterprise environment.

data.title: Principal Engineering Manager
data.description:
Overview

As a Principal Engineering Manager on the GitHub Developer Experience (DX) team, you will lead a team responsible for foundational systems and services that power GitHub's internal engineering and development workflows. DX focuses on improving how GitHub engineering teams build, test, and ship software across the company-operating at significant scale and complexity. Our work spans CI/CD platforms, developer tooling, virtualized infrastructure, and the paved paths that enable teams to move quickly while maintaining reliability and security. 

We provide the tooling, services, and operational support that allow engineers to deliver changes to production safely and efficiently. This includes running highly available, company-wide CI platforms; partnering closely with application and platform teams to improve reliability and performance; and continuously reducing friction in the developer workflow. The team plays a critical role in maintaining trust in GitHub's build and test infrastructure while balancing speed, scale, and stability. 

GitHub's continued growth brings both opportunity and complexity. As a Principal Engineering Manager in this role, you will lead a team operating mission-critical systems in a fast-moving environment. You'll work closely with engineers across the company to improve CI reliability, reduce test flakiness, respond to incidents, and evolve our platforms to meet the needs of a rapidly scaling organization. This role blends people leadership, technical depth, and operational ownership, with a direct impact on the daily experience of GitHub engineers and the quality of the products used by millions of developers worldwide. 

Responsibilities

Our team is distributed worldwide, which means we work both asynchronously and real-time. Your typical week would include: 

- Collaborating with engineering teams, product management, customers, and engineering leadership to align on and understand the problems we want to solve 
 - Unblocking obstacles for your team members as they solve GitHub's most critical problems, often via real-time conversations in Slack or Zoom and with asynchronous communication in GitHub Issues, PRs, Discussions, and Projects 
 - Communicating effectively to stakeholders and leadership of progress and risks 
 - Coordinating work within the team and stakeholders, building relationships, and identifying opportunities and areas of improvement 
 - Ensuring the team produces good architectural design outcomes, secure and resilient systems, and quality code 
 - Ensuring the team iteratively ships features and bug fixes, balancing speed to market with future velocity 
 - Conducting 1: 1s with direct reports to provide regular feedback and ensure career growth and progression

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- 9+ years' experience in software engineering, computer science, or related technical discipline 
 - Proven experience maintaining and delivering production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, Go, Ruby, Rust, Python, JavaScript, C, C++, C#, Java, 
 - 3+ years' experience leading engineering teams delivering complex infrastructure, platform, release, or validation systems. 
 - Experience setting technical direction and driving execution across multiple engineers or teams in a complex cross-functional environment. 
 - Proven ability to hire, coach, and develop engineers while maintaining high standards for technical quality and operational excellence. 
 - Proven ability to partner across organizations, align stakeholders, and improve reliability, delivery predictability, and engineering effectiveness for business-critical systems. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, or related field

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading or owning large-scale CI/CD and build systems, including monolith or monorepo environments, with a focus on reliability, performance, and developer experience. 
 - Proven ability to run operationally critical platforms, including incident response, on-call leadership, observability, and cross-org escalation. 
 - Track record of cross-team collaboration and influence, working with application owners and platform teams to drive best practices and paved paths. 
 - Familiarity with test infrastructure and quality challenges at scale, including diagnosing CI failures and reducing flaky tests. 
 - Experienced people manager able to balance execution, operational stability, and long-term platform investment in complex, high-change environments. 
 - Experience driving strategy and execution across multiple dependent engineering teams. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 - Passionate about fostering good engineering practices and processes 
 - Experience recruiting and retaining healthy teams, managing performance, and calibrating expectations 
 - Experience working remotely and collaborating with distributed teams.
