data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Secure Boot & Debug Security
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. 

AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we're focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. 

About the role: 

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead secure boot, debug security, device lifecycle, and platform-security firmware for Arm-based SoCs. 

The role owns the firmware security architecture from Boot ROM and hardware root of trust through bootloaders, trusted firmware, secure update, production lifecycle, debug access, and operating-system handoff. The candidate will work with SoC architecture, DV, post-silicon validation, firmware, security, manufacturing, and customer teams. 

This is a technical leadership role requiring architecture ownership, low-level firmware development, silicon bring-up, root-cause analysis, and mentorship. 

What you'll achieve: 

- Define secure boot chain-of-trust architecture: 
 - Boot ROM, root of trust, OTP/eFuse/secure NVM, device identity, key hierarchy, authenticated image loading, anti-rollback, recovery boot, and trusted firmware handoff. 
 - Lead secure firmware update design: 
 - signed images, version policy, updates, rollback prevention, interrupted-update recovery, key rotation, and revocation. 
 - Define secure debug and lifecycle architecture: 
 - JTAG/SWD lockdown, authenticated debug unlock, debug certificates/tokens, manufacturing/service/production policies, and lifecycle transitions. 
 - Drive Arm platform security configuration: 
 - TrustZone, MPU/MMU, privilege separation, secure memory partitioning, DMA/IOMMU isolation, bus firewalls, reset/power behavior, and secure peripheral access. 
 - Integrate HSM/TPM, cryptographic accelerators, RNG, key storage, and provisioning services. 
 - Establish secure key-management practices, including key derivation, usage policy, rotation, revocation, and zeroization. 
 - Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware for secure boot, debug security, lifecycle, recovery, and security fault scenarios. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware issues using register traces, boot logs, JTAG, simulation/waveform evidence, and other lab tools. 
 - Identify security-related silicon limitations and define firmware workarounds, errata guidance, and validation coverage. 
 - Lead threat modeling, security architecture reviews, negative testing, and secure firmware design reviews. 
 - Define reusable platform security APIs, reference implementations, test frameworks, integration guides, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across firmware, security, hardware, DV, validation, and customer teams. 

About you: 

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, low-level platform software, SoC firmware, silicon bring-up, or product security. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with secure boot, boot ROM/bootloaders, image authentication, anti-rollback, secure firmware update, and recovery boot. 
 - Experience with hardware root of trust, OTP/eFuse, secure NVM, key provisioning, device lifecycle, and secure debug. 
 - Experience integrating HSM, TPM, secure element, cryptographic accelerator, or hardware key-management solutions. 
 - Strong Arm architecture knowledge: Cortex-M/R/A, TrustZone, MPU/MMU, exception handling, privilege levels, caches, barriers, and memory protection. 
 - Strong SoC knowledge: AXI/AHB/APB, DMA, IOMMU/SMMU, bus firewalls, interrupt controllers, clock/reset domains, and power states. 
 - Expert embedded C/C++ and low-level register programming skills. 
 - Strong debugging experience with JTAG/SWD, GDB, trace, register dumps, crash analysis, and hardware bring-up. 
 - Experience with threat modeling, secure coding, static analysis, code reviews, security testing, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to influence cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Arm Trusted Firmware, TF-M, OP-TEE, U-Boot, UEFI, EDK II, Linux secure boot, or Android Verified Boot. 
 - Experience with DICE, measured boot, remote attestation, secure provisioning, or certificate lifecycle management. 
 - Experience working with RTL, DV, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434, ISO 26262, NIST guidance, PSA Certified, SESIP, or Common Criteria concepts. 
 - Experience in semiconductor, automotive, industrial, IoT, or safety/security-critical platforms. 
 - Python or scripting experience for image tools, automation, log analysis, and security regression. 

What we'll offer: 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits highlights include: 

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so thatyou can feel secure in your health, financial futureand child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

SUMMARY OF BUSINESS: 

Our client is one of the largest manufacturers of interconnect products in the world. We design, manufacture and market electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors, coaxial and flat-ribbon cable, and interconnect systems. The primary end markets for our products are communications and information processing markets, including cable television, cellular telephone and data communication and information processing systems; aerospace and military electronics; and automotive, rail and other transportation and industrial applications. 

Our Client Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Our Client Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that client Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, can positively impact the business. 

ROLE SUMMARY

The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading and developing the Process Engineering, Plating Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Mold & Die Engineering teams to achieve world-class manufacturing performance in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and sustainability. This role drives continuous improvement, process capability enhancement, capacity optimization, technology deployment, tooling excellence, and operational efficiency across the plant. 

The Engineering Manager serves as a strategic partner to Operations, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams, ensuring robust manufacturing processes that support business growth and customer requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Engineering Leadership

- Lead and develop a multidisciplinary engineering organization consisting of: 
 - Process Engineers
 - Plating Engineers
 - Industrial Engineers
 - Mold & Die Engineers

 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive talent development through coaching, mentoring, and technical skill enhancement. 

2. Process Engineering

 - DMAIC
 - 8D
 - A3
 - Fishbone Analysis
 - FMEA
 - Drive process optimization to improve: 
 - Throughput
 - Yield
 - Cycle time
 - Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
 - Support qualification and implementation of new products, equipment, and technologies. 
 - Establish and maintain process control plans and operating procedures. 

3. Plating Engineering

- Lead plating process development, optimization, and compliance activities. 
 - Ensure plating operations meet customer specifications and regulatory requirements. 
 - Improve plating quality through robust process control and statistical monitoring. 
 - Drive chemical consumption reduction, wastewater minimization, and sustainability initiatives. 
 - Partner with Quality and EHS teams to ensure compliance with: 
 - ISO standards
 - Environmental regulations
 - Customer-specific requirements

4. Industrial Engineering

- Lead capacity planning and manufacturing footprint optimization. 
 - Drive labor productivity improvement initiatives. 
 - Develop and maintain: 
 - Standard work
 - Labor standards
 - Capacity models
 - Line balancing studies
 - Improve material flow and factory layout. 
 - Support strategic planning for future capacity expansion and automation deployment. 
 - Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives across the plant. 

5. Mold & Die Engineering

- Lead mold and tooling strategy to support production and new product introduction. 
 - Oversee tool design, maintenance, refurbishment, and lifecycle management. 
 - Improve mold reliability, uptime, and production performance. 
 - Drive preventive and predictive maintenance programs. 
 - Collaborate with suppliers on tooling development and qualification. 
 - Support troubleshooting and resolution of complex tooling issues. 

6. Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

- Lead Lean and Six Sigma projects. 
 - Identify opportunities for: 
 - Cost reduction
 - Waste elimination
 - Productivity enhancement
 - Automation implementation
 - Champion Kaizen activities and operational excellence programs. 
 - Establish engineering KPIs and performance dashboards. 
 - Drive data-based decision making across engineering functions. 

7. New Product Introduction (NPI)

- Support launch readiness for new products. 
 - Ensure manufacturing processes are qualified and scalable. 
 - Lead process validation and production ramp-up activities. 
 - Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams during product transfers and launches. 

8. Safety, Quality and Compliance

- Promote a zero-injury safety culture. 
 - Ensure engineering activities comply with: 
 - Safety regulations
 - Environmental requirements
 - Corporate standards
 - Customer requirements
 - Support internal and external audits.

 - Tooling uptime

Education

Experience

 - Minimum 5 years leading engineering teams.

Technical Competencies:

Leadership Competencies:

The successful Engineering Manager will build a high-performing engineering organization that delivers world-class manufacturing performance, drives innovation and operational excellence, improves productivity and quality, and develops engineering talent while supporting the plant's growth strategy and customer commitments.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Secure Boot & Debug Security
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. 

AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we're focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. 

About the role: 

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead secure boot, debug security, device lifecycle, and platform-security firmware for Arm-based SoCs. 

The role owns the firmware security architecture from Boot ROM and hardware root of trust through bootloaders, trusted firmware, secure update, production lifecycle, debug access, and operating-system handoff. The candidate will work with SoC architecture, DV, post-silicon validation, firmware, security, manufacturing, and customer teams. 

This is a technical leadership role requiring architecture ownership, low-level firmware development, silicon bring-up, root-cause analysis, and mentorship. 

What you'll achieve: 

- Define secure boot chain-of-trust architecture: 
 - Boot ROM, root of trust, OTP/eFuse/secure NVM, device identity, key hierarchy, authenticated image loading, anti-rollback, recovery boot, and trusted firmware handoff. 
 - Lead secure firmware update design: 
 - signed images, version policy, updates, rollback prevention, interrupted-update recovery, key rotation, and revocation. 
 - Define secure debug and lifecycle architecture: 
 - JTAG/SWD lockdown, authenticated debug unlock, debug certificates/tokens, manufacturing/service/production policies, and lifecycle transitions. 
 - Drive Arm platform security configuration: 
 - TrustZone, MPU/MMU, privilege separation, secure memory partitioning, DMA/IOMMU isolation, bus firewalls, reset/power behavior, and secure peripheral access. 
 - Integrate HSM/TPM, cryptographic accelerators, RNG, key storage, and provisioning services. 
 - Establish secure key-management practices, including key derivation, usage policy, rotation, revocation, and zeroization. 
 - Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware for secure boot, debug security, lifecycle, recovery, and security fault scenarios. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware issues using register traces, boot logs, JTAG, simulation/waveform evidence, and other lab tools. 
 - Identify security-related silicon limitations and define firmware workarounds, errata guidance, and validation coverage. 
 - Lead threat modeling, security architecture reviews, negative testing, and secure firmware design reviews. 
 - Define reusable platform security APIs, reference implementations, test frameworks, integration guides, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across firmware, security, hardware, DV, validation, and customer teams. 

About you: 

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, low-level platform software, SoC firmware, silicon bring-up, or product security. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with secure boot, boot ROM/bootloaders, image authentication, anti-rollback, secure firmware update, and recovery boot. 
 - Experience with hardware root of trust, OTP/eFuse, secure NVM, key provisioning, device lifecycle, and secure debug. 
 - Experience integrating HSM, TPM, secure element, cryptographic accelerator, or hardware key-management solutions. 
 - Strong Arm architecture knowledge: Cortex-M/R/A, TrustZone, MPU/MMU, exception handling, privilege levels, caches, barriers, and memory protection. 
 - Strong SoC knowledge: AXI/AHB/APB, DMA, IOMMU/SMMU, bus firewalls, interrupt controllers, clock/reset domains, and power states. 
 - Expert embedded C/C++ and low-level register programming skills. 
 - Strong debugging experience with JTAG/SWD, GDB, trace, register dumps, crash analysis, and hardware bring-up. 
 - Experience with threat modeling, secure coding, static analysis, code reviews, security testing, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to influence cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Arm Trusted Firmware, TF-M, OP-TEE, U-Boot, UEFI, EDK II, Linux secure boot, or Android Verified Boot. 
 - Experience with DICE, measured boot, remote attestation, secure provisioning, or certificate lifecycle management. 
 - Experience working with RTL, DV, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434, ISO 26262, NIST guidance, PSA Certified, SESIP, or Common Criteria concepts. 
 - Experience in semiconductor, automotive, industrial, IoT, or safety/security-critical platforms. 
 - Python or scripting experience for image tools, automation, log analysis, and security regression. 

What we'll offer: 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits highlights include: 

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits includingcrechereimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so thatyou can feel secure in your health, financial futureand child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And thereismuch more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Biocompatibility & Toxicology
data.description:
This is where  your work makes a difference. 

At Baxter, we believe every person-regardless of who they are or where they are from-deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. 

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. 

Here, you will find more than just a job-you will find purpose and pride.   

Your Role at Baxter

Baxter's Front Line Care business unit develops innovative solutions that help clinicians monitor and manage chronic and acute respiratory and cardiac conditions, improving patient outcomes and quality of life. The Principal Engineer, Toxicology & Biocompatibility serves as the subject matter expert for biocompatibility and toxicological safety across the Front-Line Care portfolio, including patient monitors, cardiology devices, vision care products, respiratory systems, non-invasive ventilation (NIV) devices, masks, breathing circuits, tubing, humidification systems, and accessories. 

This role is responsible for developing toxicology strategies, conducting risk assessments, supporting regulatory submissions, and partnering with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle. The position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Manager, Systems Front-Line Care. 

What you'll be doing

- Lead biocompatibility and toxicology activities across Front Line Care products in accordance with global regulatory and quality requirements. 
 - Independently develop and execute Biological Evaluation Plans (BEPs) and Biological Evaluation Reports (BERs) in compliance with ISO 10993-1. 
 - Author, review, and approve Toxicological Risk Assessments (TRAs) in accordance with ISO 10993-17. 
 - Evaluate chemical safety risks associated with device materials, manufacturing processes, and intended use conditions. 
 - Collaborate with laboratory partners and cross-functional stakeholders on material characterization programs per ISO 10993-18. 
 - Serve as the toxicology lead for respiratory and non-invasive ventilation products, including masks, breathing circuits, tubing, connectors, and humidification systems. 
 - Assess inhalation exposure risks and evaluate the impact of heat, moisture, airflow, volatile compounds, and long-term off-gassing in respiratory devices in accordance with ISO 18562. 
 - Assess risks associated with cleaning, disinfection, and reprocessing residues on medical devices. 
 - Support material selection decisions and supplier qualification activities from a toxicological and biocompatibility perspective. 
 - Provide toxicology expertise for FDA submissions, EU MDR Technical Documentation, and global regulatory filings. 
 - Act as the primary toxicology representative during regulatory interactions and audits. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable standards including ISO 10993, ISO 14971, and relevant global regulatory requirements. 
 - Partner with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and Materials Engineering teams to guide product development decisions. 
 - Evaluate the toxicological impact of design, process, material, and supplier changes throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Drive risk-based decision making and provide scientifically sound recommendations to support product safety and regulatory compliance. 

What you'll bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. Advanced degree preferred. 
 - 10+ years of experience in toxicology, biocompatibility, or biological safety assessments within the medical device industry. 
 - Strong hands-on experience performing biocompatibility evaluations in accordance with ISO 10993 standards. 
 - Direct experience with respiratory device evaluations and requirements outlined in ISO 18562. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in assessing inhalation and respiratory exposure risks. 
 - Experience supporting FDA, EU MDR, and global regulatory submissions. 
 - Proven ability to independently develop biological safety strategies and execute complex toxicological assessments. 
 - Strong understanding of risk management principles and application of ISO 14971. 
 - Experience identifying toxicological risks early in product development and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies. 
 - Ability to develop efficient, scientifically justified, and regulatory-defensible testing strategies. 
 - Demonstrated success in supporting regulatory approvals without biocompatibility-related delays. 
 - Strong technical influence and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams. 
 - Experience working with suppliers, external laboratories, and third-party partners. 
 - Working knowledge of FDA regulations, international medical device standards, and product development processes. 
 - Understanding of the design, development, and manufacturing of electromechanical medical devices and systems. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. 
 - Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results within project timelines. 
 - Self-motivated professional with excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Proven ability to drive results in a fast-paced, quality-focused medical device environment.

data.description:

What You Will Do

- Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems. 
 - Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers. 
 - Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data. 
 - Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues. 
 - Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.

data.title: Princ Software Engineer - Mobile
data.description:
About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. 

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate - leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. 

When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career - from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. 

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. 

About The Role

AI is already part of every stage of how we build products, from ideation and design to coding, testing and release. The next step is agentic: AI agents that plan, write, test and ship real mobile code, with engineers designing, directing and reviewing them. We want engineers who build those agents, not just use them. 

As an AI-First Mobile Engineer, you will build across the whole mobile stack of Norton, Avast, AVG and Avira apps used by tens of millions of people: the screens and flows users touch every day, and the shared code underneath them. You will work across: 

- App UI and features: user-facing screens and flows in Jetpack Compose (Android) and SwiftUI/UIKit (iOS), from onboarding and purchase flows to scam protection, VPN, identity and AI-assistant experiences. 
 - Compose Multiplatform (CMP): shared UI across Android and iOS where it makes sense, native UI where it doesn't. 
 - Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) SDKs: shared Kotlin code for business logic, networking and storage, compiled for Android and iOS. 
 - Native SDKs: the Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS) libraries apps use today, and the platform-specific parts of shared SDKs. 

You will be strongest on one platform, work across both, and be comfortable anywhere in the stack, from pixel-level UI to SDK internals. This is a principal-level, hands-on individual contributor role. You write production app and library code, and much of it will be written by agents you set up, direct and review. You will design the agentic workflows the rest of the team relies on, and work alongside engineers in Asia, Europe and North America. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build user-facing features in Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI, from spec to app-store release, including the most complex and highest-risk parts of the apps. 
 - Improve app performance, stability, crash-free rates, startup time, battery use and app size. 
 - Fix critical production issues: crashes, performance regressions and security findings. 
 - Design, build and maintain SDKs used by multiple product teams, in shared Kotlin and in native Android or iOS code. 
 - Own features end to end: API design, implementation, tests, release and support for consuming apps. Keep public APIs stable and migrations short. 
 - Improve how we build, package and release SDKs for both platforms, and measure what our SDKs cost the host app (startup, memory, battery, app size). 
 - Build and run agents that do real engineering work on our apps and SDKs: implementing features from specs, building UI from designs, writing and fixing tests, triaging crashes, upgrading dependencies and moving native code to KMP. 
 - Make our codebases agent-ready: clear architecture docs, agent instruction files (AGENTS. md, CLAUDE. md and similar), fast and reliable tests, and module boundaries an agent can reason about. 
 - Work closely with product, design, backend and QA to achieve the best possible experience for our customers. 
 - Review code from engineers and agents alike, with the judgment to catch what AI gets wrong. Leave the codebase better than you found it. 
 - Write clear specs and design proposals in English that both engineers and agents can build from, and explain trade-offs to engineers, managers and business partners. 

About You

- Agents are how you work. Coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or GitHub Copilot agent mode are your daily tools, and you regularly run several at once on real production work. 
 - You know how agents work under the hood: context engineering, tool design, planning and sub-agents, memory, evals, and where they fail - hallucinated APIs, drift on long tasks, prompt injection. 
 - You have sharp judgment. You know when to trust agent output and when to step in, and you keep AI-written code secure, tested and maintainable. 
 - You can show us. A repo, demo or write-up of an agent or workflow you built, and the measurable difference it made. 
 - 8+ t0 15+ years of professional mobile development, with deep expertise in at least one of Android or iOS and at least one app or library shipped at scale. 
 - Strong command of your primary platform's language, concurrency model and architecture (for example Kotlin and coroutines, or Swift and Swift Concurrency)
 - Readiness to work on the other platform regularly. Some hands-on experience with it is a strong plus. 
 - Hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform: sharing business logic between Android and iOS, structuring shared modules, handling Swift interop and multiplatform Gradle builds. Production experience is preferred, but substantial side projects you can show us also count. 
 - Modern mobile UI: production experience with Jetpack Compose and/or SwiftUI where needed. You care about UX, accessibility, animation and how the app feels in the hand. 
 - Experience with automated testing (including UI tests), CI/CD, app-store release processes and production monitoring. 
 - Good judgement on API design, compatibility and the cost of breaking changes. 
 - Growth attitude: eager to learn, experiment and push boundaries. You get up to speed on a new product, codebase and business in weeks, not months. 
 - Collaboration: at home in a fast-paced, global team across time zones. You mentor other engineers and work easily with product, design and business partners. 
 - Clear written and spoken English. You can explain a technical trade-off to a non-engineer. 
 - Experience with Compose Multiplatform, ideally in production. If you have built CMP side projects and can show them, we want to talk to you. 
 - Built agents that drive mobile apps end to end: UI automation on emulators and simulators with tools such as Maestro, XCUITest or Espresso, and screenshot-based verification. 
 - Building SDKs or libraries consumed by other teams or third parties. 

What's Next

- TA Call
 - Technical Screening

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

About This Role

We are seeking a Software Test Automation Engineer with hands-on experience across manual and automated software testing. You will analyse business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; design and execute functional and integration tests; build and maintain reusable automated tests; perform API testing; support CI/CD execution; and manage defects through to closure. 

The role requires a sound understanding of SDLC, STLC, test-design techniques and the defect lifecycle, together with practical experience working in Agile teams. You will collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts and other stakeholders to embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle and proactively manage quality risks. 

What You'll Do

- Analyse business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios, dependencies and quality risks 
 - Design, document and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases and test data for functional and integration testing 
 - Perform manual testing, including functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, sanity and exploratory testing 
 - Design, develop, execute and maintain automated test scripts for suitable functional and regression scenarios 
 - Identify appropriate automation candidates and improve automation coverage while avoiding unnecessary or low-value automation 
 - Perform API and integration testing, validating requests, responses, error handling and end-to-end workflows 
 - Execute automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines and investigate test failures 
 - Manage defect identification, logging, prioritisation, retesting and closure, providing clear evidence and reproducible steps 
 - Conduct root-cause analysis of test failures, distinguishing product defects from test-data, environment and automation issues 
 - Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts and other stakeholders to establish clear acceptance criteria and embed quality throughout delivery 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives 
 - Maintain requirements-to-test traceability and appropriate coverage of critical business journeys 
 - Track and communicate test execution status, defect trends, regression results and automation coverage 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of test processes, automation frameworks, reusable components and quality-engineering standards 
 - Support test-environment and test-data readiness, highlighting dependencies that could affect delivery 
 - Proactively identify quality risks and improvement opportunities, helping teams prevent defects as well as detect them

Who You Are

- You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or have equivalent practical experience 
 - You have 5yrs- 6yrs hands-on experience in manual and automation testing across the software development lifecycle 
 - You understand functional, integration, regression, system and exploratory testing 
 - You have practical experience developing and maintaining reusable automated test scripts 
 - You have experience with API testing and validating system integrations 
 - You understand SDLC, STLC, the defect lifecycle and test-design techniques 
 - You have experience using defect-tracking and test-management tools 
 - You understand Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD practices 
 - You can apply analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills to investigate test failures and quality issues 
 - You communicate effectively and collaborate across development, product, business and technology teams 
 - You have experience with defect identification, reporting, retesting and root-cause analysis

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

- Work across manual testing, test automation, API testing and CI/CD-integrated quality engineering 
 - Contribute to quality throughout the software delivery lifecycle rather than focusing solely on test execution 
 - Collaborate across development, product, business analysis and other stakeholder groups 
 - Influence test automation coverage, reusable testing components and continuous improvement 
 - Build experience in risk-based quality practices, including defect prevention, root-cause analysis and critical business-journey validation

What Skills You Will Learn

- Test automation design and maintenance, including identification of suitable automation candidates 
 - API and integration testing, including request, response and error-handling validation 
 - CI/CD test execution and failure investigation 
 - Advanced root-cause analysis and troubleshooting across product, data, environment and automation issues 
 - Requirements-to-test traceability and critical business-journey coverage 
 - Quality reporting using indicators such as defect trends, regression results, test status and automation coverage 
 - Cross-functional collaboration within Agile software delivery teams

VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background. 

Join Us

At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this. 

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together. 

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Continuous Improvement

 - Mentorship & influence - shape testing culture and upskill a growing QA team

Roles & Responsibilities

- Author test strategy, test plans, and detailed test cases; review peer test cases and automate the full test cycle
 - Apply advanced programming skills to build and maintain automation systems integrated with CI/CD pipelines and databases
 - Demonstrate hands-on experience across SDLC, STLC, and Defect Life Cycle; drive all phases of testing with precision
 - Exercise strong attention to detail and sharp analytical skills to identify edge cases and systemic quality risks
 - Utilise defect management and test management tools (e. g. Jira, TestRail) to maintain full traceability
 - Troubleshoot and debug complex failures spanning UI, API, and backend layers
 - Champion Agile methodology and cross-functional collaboration; embed quality into every sprint
 - Train and mentor junior teammates; promote engineering best practices within the QA team
 - Explore and integrate AI/ML capabilities into the testing workflow - including intelligent test generation, flaky test detection, and anomaly-based test prioritisation
 - AI Feature Validation - validate AI-powered product features including LLM workflows, prompt-driven functionality, and RAG-based outputs
 - AI Regression Testing - build and maintain test scenarios, benchmark datasets, and regression suites for AI-enabled workflows
 - Learn & Adopt AI Tools - explore and adopt emerging AI testing tools/frameworks (e. g. RAGAS or similar) to improve quality assurance practices

Required Skills & Experience

- 4-8 years of experience in Mobile and Web application testing across diverse platforms and tech stacks
 - Proficiency in automation testing using Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Ranorex; strong API testing skills (REST / GraphQL)
 - Proven experience designing and setting up automation frameworks from scratch (POM, keyword-driven, data-driven, or hybrid)
 - Hands-on experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6
 - Familiarity with ready-made automation frameworks and ability to evaluate, extend, or replace them as needed
 - Experience with mobile automation testing tools (Appium, XCUITest, Espresso)
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to present quality metrics and risks to senior stakeholders
 - Strong programming skills in Python preferred
 - Familiarity with testing APIs, data pipelines, and backend services
 - Exposure to AI/LLM-based applications is a plus
 - BE / ME / BCA / MCA / B. Tech or an equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field

AI Interest - Strongly Preferred

We are actively seeking engineers excited about the intersection of AI and software quality. Experience or curiosity in any of the following areas is highly valued: 

- Using LLMs (e. g. Claude, GPT) to auto-generate, review, or optimise test cases
 - Applying ML models to predict defect-prone areas or prioritise regression suites
 - Building AI-assisted observability and anomaly detection pipelines for test infrastructure
 - Experimenting with agentic testing approaches - autonomous agents that explore and validate application behaviour
 - Familiarity with prompt engineering or fine-tuning models for domain-specific QA tasks
 - Curiosity about testing LLM-based or AI-enabled applications
 - Exposure to prompt-based systems, chatbots, or GenAI products
 - Interest in learning emerging evaluation tools such as RAGAS, LangSmith, or similar

Nice to Have

- Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow)
 - Knowledge of containerised test environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - Contributions to open-source testing tools or frameworks
 - Cloud testing experience (AWS Device Farm, BrowserStack, Sauce Labs)
 - Prior experience in a software engineering role transitioning into QA or quality-focused engineering
 - Experience testing AI/ML or data-driven applications
 - Exposure to cloud-native platforms (Azure / AWS)

data.title: Director, Software Development Engineering
data.description:
Description

Job Location

The primary work location for this role is [insert location] with a hybrid work model. 

About Envestnet

Envestnet is an adaptive WealthTech company that is redefining the future of wealth management by helping advisors meet the moment with its comprehensive technology, actionable insights, and industry leading support. Backed by over 25 years of experience and approximately $7. 0 trillion in platform assets, Envestnet is trusted by over one third of financial advisors across leading banks, wealth managers, brokerages, and RIAs. 

For a deeper look at how Envestnet is shaping the future of financial advice, visit www. envestnet. com. 

The Team You'll Join

You will join Envestnet's Technology team, where we design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and robust WealthTech solutions that power the future of financial advice. The team collaborates closely with product, operations, and business stakeholders to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and enable sustainable growth. Guided by modern engineering practices and a commitment to domain excellence, technical rigor, and collaboration, the Technology team ensures our platforms remain resilient, adaptable, and aligned with evolving business needs making it a core driver of Envestnet's long‐term success. 

How You'll Contribute

Provides leadership and oversight to the Software Development Engineering group. Oversees team efforts to build scalable, secure platforms in support of Envestnet business operations, including wealth management, financial data aggregation and advisor-driven technology solutions. Works across cloud-based architectures, integrating complex data sources and APIs to deliver reliable, high-performance systems. Collaborates with product managers, data scientists and compliance stakeholders to meet both business and regulatory requirements. 

- Define engineering strategy and the execution model for the enterprise CRM integration domain across Tamarac, Envestnet UMP, and MoneyGuide. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery across multiple teams, including the phased rollout: Tamarac engagement inbound, MoneyGuide relationship read, and UMP relationship plus control. 
 - Set domain architecture direction with senior technical leaders: the canonical data model, per-field direction and write authority, echo suppression, entity crosswalk and resolution, and the versioned API and event contract. 
 - Consolidate overlapping canonical-modeling efforts across separate backlogs into one owned contract, and take a stated position on the Envestnet-wide party/Holders framework. 
 - Own Envestnet's data-plane relationship with customer CRM orgs (Salesforce, Dynamics, Redtail, Wealthbox, Advyzon). That means one integration identity and one change-capture subscription per org, schema versioning under Envestnet's control, and per-tenant mapping and entitlement configuration. 
 - Drive compliance and data governance: SOX-relevant audit of reads and writes with dual actor identity, per-firm ingestion scope, redaction of unstructured advisor content, tenant isolation, and advisor-level entitlement extended to delegated agent access. 
 - Manage budget, headcount, and org design, including build-versus-buy decisions on CRM adapters, mapping layers, and per-org licensing. 
 - Implement KPIs: per-object sync freshness, availability, latency, write success and rejection rates, cost efficiency, and quality trends. 
 - Influence prioritization across engineering, product, AI/agent engineering, and partners, including repositioning partner overlays from independent extractors to consumers of the service. 
 - Lead the transformation: retire point-to-point integrations and migrate onto shared streaming, canonical, and observability infrastructure. 
 - Build leadership bench strength through structured succession planning. 
 - Drive adoption of agentic coding practices across the SDLC to increase productivity and cut time-to-delivery. 

What You'll Need To Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including leading managers, technical leads, or multiple teams across a major domain. 
 - Proven ability to define engineering strategy, translate business objectives into multi-quarter plans, and deliver measurable customer and business outcomes. 
 - Experience setting domain-level architecture direction, including platform consolidation, integration modernization, and replacing point-to-point integrations with a canonical shared service. 
 - Deep enterprise CRM integration experience: 
 - Salesforce: managed packages, Change Data Capture, Pub/Sub API and platform events, replay and gap/overflow handling, field-level security, and Financial Services Cloud. 
 - Microsoft Dynamics 365/Dataverse: change tracking and delta tokens, service endpoints, Entra ID service principals, and least-privilege Graph scopes. 
 - Experience designing canonical or master data models and persistent entity crosswalks: per-field direction control, write authority, echo suppression in bi-directional sync, conflict policy, and pre-write constraint validation. 
 - Event-driven architecture background: Kafka/Amazon MSK, the transactional outbox pattern, Debezium CDC, and Kafka Connect sinks. 
 - PostgreSQL at scale (row-level security, partitioning, logical replication) with Flyway migrations. 
 - . NET, xUnit, Reqnroll, RESTful API design and versioning, and consumer-driven contract testing. 
 - AWS (EC2, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, RDS, EKS, CloudWatch, SQS), Kubernetes, Docker, and IaC (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform). 
 - Identity and access management: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, Keycloak, RFC 8693 token exchange for delegated and agent identities, and entitlement models finer than tenant scope. 
 - Experience driving compliance, data governance, and security: SOX audit trails, PII and tax-ID tokenization, data classification, redaction of unstructured content, and retention policy. 
 - Experience with engineering KPIs, OKRs, MBRs, budgeting, headcount planning, org design, hiring, performance management, and succession planning. 
 - Experience with vendor evaluation and build-versus-buy decisions, including security review of vendors needing write access to customer systems of record. 
 - Strong stakeholder management across engineering, product, AI/agent engineering, partners, and business leaders, including commercially sensitive partner conversations. 
 - Experience building leadership bench strength and inspiring high-performing teams through coaching, development, and accountability. 
 - Experience with DevOps, automation, agile/Scrum, and test-driven development. 
 - Experience driving adoption of agentic coding or AI-enabled engineering workflows across the SDLC. 
Nice-to-Haves

- Wealth management or financial services domain experience, including advisor workflows, household and account structures, and portfolio accounting or custodial data. 
 - Familiarity with Redtail, Wealthbox, and Advyzon integration models. 
 - Experience with RabbitMQ and with bridging or consolidating multiple event buses. 
 - SQL Server, Redis, and ElastiCache experience. 
 - Apigee or similar API management experience. 
 - Experience delivering data to a warehouse or lakehouse across a curated medallion boundary (Snowflake sinks, Silver-layer contracts). 
 - Familiarity with MCP-backed agent access patterns. 

Why You'll Enjoy Working at Envestnet

Help shape the future of WealthTech. At Envestnet you'll gain hands-on experience and collaborate with some of the industry's brightest minds to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions that make a real difference. 

We value flexibility in how and where work gets done, and we recognize strong performance with meaningful rewards-because your contributions should drive both business success and your own personal growth. If you're looking for a place where your work has impact, your development is supported, and your contributions are truly valued, Envestnet is where you can build your future. 

The opportunity is now!

Our Investment in You

At Envestnet, our total rewards philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and grow exceptional talent. We offer competitive, market-aligned compensation complemented with performance-linked incentives and rewards programs that recognize and reward impact. 

In addition, we provide a comprehensive suite of benefits - subject to Envestnet's plan eligibility rules - that support your overall well-being, including medical insurance for you and your family, annual health check-ups, free online doctor consultations and telemedicine services, subsidized health club memberships, and an employee assistance program. Our investment in you means supporting you professionally, financially, and personally at every stage of your journey with us. 

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

Envestnet is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of religion, race, color, caste, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, disability, medical condition, nationality, ethnic origin, marital status, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law. This commitment is in accordance with the Constitution of India and applicable labor and employment laws. All employment decisions are made solely based on merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs. 

We strive to provide an inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at [email protected]. Please include your full name, the title of the role you are applying for, and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. 

Recruitment Fraud

At Envestnet, safeguarding the trust and safety of job seekers is a top priority. We are aware that scammers may impersonate Envestnet recruiters or create fake job opportunities to deceive candidates. Review the information on our recruitment fraud awareness page to help you recognize and avoid recruitment fraud.

We are looking for a highly experienced and technically strong Director of Engineering with deep expertise in Backend Engineering, particularly Java-based distributed systems, microservices architecture, and large-scale backend platform development. 

The ideal candidate should have a strong engineering foundation with extensive experience designing, architecting, and scaling high-performance backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven architecture, and cloud technologies. 

The role will primarily focus on Backend Engineering leadership and architecture, while also overseeing Mobile Engineering teams responsible for Android and iOS application development. 

We are looking for a technology leader who can drive backend architecture decisions, lead complex engineering initiatives, manage multiple engineering teams, and build scalable, reliable, and high-performance technology platforms. The candidate must possess the technical depth to challenge architectural decisions, drive engineering standards, and provide strategic direction across the engineering organization. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Backend Engineering & Architecture - Primary Responsibility

- Own the overall backend engineering strategy, architecture, design, and technology roadmap. 
 - Lead the development of highly scalable, distributed, and fault-tolerant backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices. 
 - Drive architectural decisions around distributed computing, service communication, API design, event-driven systems, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Design and scale high-throughput, low-latency backend applications capable of handling significant transaction volumes and concurrent requests. 
 - Drive system design, database architecture, caching strategies, concurrency management, and performance optimization. 
 - Provide technical direction on JVM tuning, multithreading, memory management, and application performance. 
 - Establish best practices around clean architecture, design patterns, coding standards, code reviews, and engineering quality. 
 - Drive backend platform reliability, high availability, fault tolerance, security, and production stability. 
 - Evaluate architectural trade-offs involving scalability, performance, maintainability, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Lead initiatives around monolith-to-microservices transformation, platform modernization, and backend technology evolution. 2. Mobile Application Engineering

- Provide engineering leadership and strategic direction to Android and iOS development teams. 
 - Oversee mobile application architecture, development standards, engineering delivery, and release management. 
 - Ensure seamless integration between mobile applications and backend services through scalable API architecture. 
 - Drive improvements in mobile application performance, security, reliability, and user experience. 
 - Work closely with Mobile Engineering Managers and Technical Leads to ensure efficient execution and delivery. 
 - Ensure alignment between backend and mobile engineering roadmaps. 3. Engineering Leadership & Organization Building

- Lead multiple engineering teams across Backend, Mobile, and Platform Engineering. 
 - Manage and mentor Engineering Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads. 
 - Build a high-performing engineering organization with strong technical ownership and accountability. 
 - Drive engineering productivity, delivery excellence, and continuous improvement. 
 - Establish engineering KPIs covering system performance, code quality, release velocity, availability, and productivity. 
 - Drive technical talent development, leadership succession, and organizational scalability. 4. Cloud, Platform & Infrastructure Engineering

- Drive cloud-native backend architecture across AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Oversee containerization, orchestration, and deployment strategies using Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Drive CI/CD automation, infrastructure scalability, observability, and production engineering. 
 - Establish robust monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident management practices. 
 - Ensure backend infrastructure is secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-efficient. 5. Product & Business Collaboration

- Partner with Product, Business, and Design leadership to translate business requirements into scalable technology solutions. 
 - Own end-to-end engineering delivery and ensure alignment between technology strategy and business priorities. 
 - Participate in strategic product architecture and technology investment decisions. 
 - Balance engineering velocity with long-term platform scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Technical Skills & Expertise

Backend Technologies - Must Have

- Deep expertise in Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, and Spring Framework. 
 - Strong experience in microservices architecture and distributed systems. 
 - Expertise in RESTful APIs, API Gateway, event-driven architecture, and asynchronous processing. 
 - Strong understanding of multithreading, concurrency, JVM internals, garbage collection, and performance tuning. 
 - Hands-on architectural experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and messaging systems. 
 - Strong understanding of system design, scalability, fault tolerance, and high-availability architecture. 
 - Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, database optimization, indexing, and caching strategies. Mobile Engineering

- Experience leading Android and iOS engineering teams. 
 - Understanding of Kotlin, Java, Swift, and modern mobile application architectures. 
 - Experience managing mobile application development, releases, performance, and production support. 
 - Strong understanding of backend and mobile application integration. Cloud & DevOps

- Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized applications. 
 - Cloud-native architecture, infrastructure scalability, and observability. 
 - Experience with production systems, monitoring, incident management, and reliability engineering. Desired Candidate Profile

- 12-16 years of overall experience in software engineering and technology leadership. 
 - Extensive experience in Java-based backend engineering and architecture. 
 - Strong track record of designing and scaling large-scale distributed backend systems. 
 - Must have managed both Backend Engineering and Mobile Application Development teams. 
 - Experience leading multiple engineering teams through Engineering Managers and Technical Leads. 
 - Strong architectural experience in microservices, event-driven systems, API platforms, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience working in product-led organizations, e-commerce, consumer internet, fintech, or high-growth technology companies. 
 - Ability to drive complex technical discussions and independently evaluate architectural decisions. 
 - Strong organizational leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic decision-making capabilities. Critical Requirements

- Backend-First Engineering Leader: Deep technical expertise in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and distributed systems is essential. 
 - Architecture Ownership: Must have designed and scaled large-scale backend platforms and driven complex system architecture decisions. 
 - Backend Team Leadership: Must have led sizeable backend engineering teams and senior technical leaders. 
 - Mobile Leadership: Must have managed Android and iOS engineering teams, with an understanding of mobile architecture and delivery. 
 - Technical Depth: Should be capable of challenging Principal Engineers and Architects on complex system design, scalability, performance, and technology choices. 
 - Product Engineering Experience: Experience building and scaling customer-facing digital platforms in product companies is preferred. Important: This is a backend-heavy engineering leadership position. Candidates with predominantly mobile, frontend, or people-management backgrounds without strong Java backend architecture experience will not be suitable. Backend engineering and architecture will be the primary evaluation criteria.

data.description:
Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Provides guidance, mentorship and training to a direct reporting staff of Agile Dev team members. Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using a range of coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are architecturally sound, high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and little to no guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member IV with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements. Define and execute tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad and deep level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. Utilizes intermediate testing techniques and tools.

Demonstrates customer needs by interpreting into viable solutions and contributes significantly to the system design. Execute Test-Driven (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. Performs broad and detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology to evaluate work. data.title: Principal Data Engineer
data.description:
We are building the Data Hub, a centralized data platform responsible for consolidating legacy data infrastructure, establishing enterprise-grade data foundations, and enabling advanced analytics and AI capabilities across Precision AQ. 

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical leader and hands-on contributor responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and operation of the Data Hub's core platform capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, architecture, and data governance. You will help define the technical direction of the platform while remaining actively involved in designing solutions, building infrastructure, reviewing code, troubleshooting production issues, and improving engineering practices. 

This is not a management role. While you will mentor and guide junior engineers, analytics engineers, and platform contributors, you will not have direct reports. We are looking for an experienced practitioner who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, setting high engineering standards, and leading through expertise and influence rather than organizational hierarchy. 

As a member of the Data Hub leadership team, you will contribute to technology strategy, roadmap prioritization, architecture governance, vendor evaluation, and executive reporting while remaining deeply engaged in day-to-day engineering activities. 

Main Duties And Responsibilities

Infrastructure and Platform Engineering

- Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-native data platform infrastructure. 
 - Develop infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and environment management processes. 
 - Partner with Corporate IT, Security, and platform vendors to ensure compliance, reliability, and operational excellence. 
 - Improve platform observability through monitoring, alerting, logging, and performance tracking. 

Data Architecture and Modelling

- Design scalable data models supporting analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and operational use cases. 
 - Define and evolve data architecture standards, patterns, and best practices across the Data Hub ecosystem. 
 - Ensure data solutions align with governance, lineage, security, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Guide engineering teams in implementing maintainable and extensible data structures. 

Data Engineering and Solution Delivery

- Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines across multiple business domains. 
 - Lead technical design reviews and contribute directly to implementation of complex data engineering initiatives. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Analytics, AI/ML, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Provide hands-on support for critical platform initiatives, migrations, and modernization programs. 

DevOps and Engineering Excellence

- Establish and enforce software engineering, GitOps, DevOps, testing, and deployment standards. 
 - Drive automation across development, deployment, monitoring, and operational processes. 
 - Promote best practices for code quality, documentation, technical debt management, and release management. 
 - Conduct architecture reviews and code reviews to ensure consistency and maintainability. 

Quality, Performance, and Reliability Optimization

- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across pipelines, databases, and infrastructure. 
 - Define and implement data quality frameworks, automated validation processes, and operational controls. 
 - Optimize platform cost, scalability, reliability, and processing efficiency. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis and remediation efforts for production incidents and operational challenges. 

Technical Leadership and Mentorship

- Mentor Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and other technical contributors through coaching, code reviews, pair programming, and design guidance. 
 - Act as a trusted technical advisor across multiple teams and business units. 
 - Share knowledge, develop engineering standards, and promote continuous improvement across the Data Hub organization. 
 - Help elevate the technical capabilities of the broader engineering team. 

Strategic Planning and Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Participate in Data Hub leadership activities, including roadmap planning, prioritization discussions, technology evaluations, and executive reporting. 
 - Provide technical recommendations on platform investments, vendor selection, architecture direction, and engineering standards. 
 - Collaborate closely with Data Product Management, AI/ML teams, business stakeholders, and Corporate IT to ensure alignment between business priorities and technical execution. 

Education And Experience

Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, Information Systems, or related field. Equivalent experience considered. Advance degree preferred but not required. 

Required

- 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical disciplines. 
 - Demonstrated expertise designing and implementing modern cloud-based data platforms. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with data warehousing, orchestration, transformation, and DevOps technologies. 
 - Experience building and optimizing large-scale data pipelines and data models. 
 - Deep understanding of software engineering principles, infrastructure automation, and production operations. 
 - Experience operating in highly regulated, compliance-sensitive, or enterprise environments. 
 - Proven track record of leading technical initiatives through influence rather than direct authority. 

Preferred

- Experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or analytics organizations. 
 - Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, MLOps capabilities, feature stores, or model deployment frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with claims, formulary, commercial, or real-world evidence datasets. 
 - Experience leading enterprise-scale data migrations, modernization programs, or platform consolidations. 
 - Exposure to global engineering teams and distributed delivery models. 

Knowledge, Skills And Competencies

Technical Expertise

- Advanced knowledge of cloud data platforms, modern data architecture, and platform engineering. 
 - Deep expertise in data modelling, query optimization, and analytical data design. 
 - Ability to evaluate and select appropriate technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches. 
 - Expert-level SQL and strong Python skills. 

Infrastructure and DevOps

- Strong understanding of CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, containerization, and deployment automation. 
 - Experience implementing operational monitoring, incident management, alerting, and observability solutions. 
 - Knowledge of security, access management, and platform governance best practices. 
 - Strong understanding of scalability, resilience, and performance engineering. 

Leadership and Influence

- Leads through credibility, expertise, and collaboration rather than formal authority. Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities. 
 - Comfortable facilitating technical discussions and driving consensus among diverse stakeholders and ability to influence architecture and technology decisions across teams. 

Communication and Collaboration

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Effective stakeholder management across engineering, product, business, and executive teams. Strong decision-making and prioritization skills in ambiguous environments. 

Technical Environment

You will work across a modern data and AI ecosystem that may include: 

- Data Platforms: Snowflake, AWS Redshift, S3
 - Transformation: dbt, Matillion
 - Orchestration: Airflow, Dagster
 - Data Governance: Snowflake Horizon
 - Data Quality: dbt tests, Elementary
 - Infrastructure & DevOps: Terraform, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps
 - AI/ML: Snowpark ML, MLflow, Snowflake Feature Store, LangChain
 - Languages: SQL, Python

data.description:
Position Title: Head - Projects (Civil)

Department: Projects

Position Profile

Reports to: Director

Reportees: Civil Project team, Construction Managers, planning, QA/QC and site execution teams

Level: AVP / VP / GM (based on experience and last designation)

Direct interface with: Architects, structural consultants, PMC, hotel operator/brand, MEP and specialist consultants, QS, Billing & Contracts, Finance, HR, Commercial, Legal, Procurement and statutory authorities

Next career path: As per organisation structure and performance

Position Objective: 

The Head - Projects (Civil) will be responsible for end-to-end civil and structural delivery of a Greenfield luxury five-star hotel, providing single-point leadership for execution from pre-construction, excavation and foundations through construction, completion and final handover. The role is accountable for approved time, cost, quality, safety, statutory compliance and stakeholder coordination. 

The ideal candidate will have strong technical and managerial knowledge of hotel construction, civil and structural systems, design management, contracts, QS, BOQs, construction planning, façade, waterproofing, finishes and coordination with MEP, interiors and specialist hospitality systems. The candidate must have personally led five-star hotel projects through completion and handover. 

Qualifications: 

Full-time regular B. E. /B. Tech in Civil Engineering with 25-30 years of post-qualification experience. Must have independently led multiple five-star hotel construction projects, including Greenfield development, from excavation/foundation through completion and final handover. Residential or commercial project experience may be useful but will not substitute for the mandatory five-star hotel construction experience. 

Competencies: 

- Proven leadership in delivery of multiple five-star hotel projects, including Greenfield developments. 
 - Strong civil and structural engineering knowledge and construction execution capability. 
 - Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage complex interfaces and critical paths. 
 - Strong planning, commercial, budgeting, contract and cost-control capabilities. 
 - Expertise in design review, constructability, quality assurance and safety leadership. 
 - Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or similar planning software. 
 - Strong stakeholder management with hotel operators/brands, consultants and contractors. 
 - Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; ability to work under pressure. 

Job Description: 

- Assume single-point responsibility for civil and structural delivery against approved scope, time, cost, quality, safety and compliance parameters. 
 - Develop the project delivery strategy and integrated master plan from pre-construction through completion and handover. 
 - Lead site mobilisation, excavation, foundations, substructure, superstructure, façade, waterproofing, masonry, finishes and external development. 
 - Coordinate design management and constructability reviews with architects, structural consultants, façade specialists, interiors teams, MEP consultants, PMC (if any) and hotel operator/brand representatives. 
 - Review drawings, specifications, BOQs, estimates, tender packages, construction methodologies and value-engineering proposals. 
 - Recommend selection and appointment of civil contractors, specialist vendors and consultants in coordination with Procurement, QS & Contracts. 
 - Lead project planning, scheduling, resource deployment, cost planning, cash-flow monitoring and risk management. 
 - Monitor progress against baseline programme and critical path; identify delays early and implement recovery plans. 
 - Coordinate civil works with MEP, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire and life safety, ELV (Extra Low Voltage), lifts, kitchen, laundry, interiors, landscape and external utilities. 
 - Ensure hotel-specific quality benchmarks, mock-ups, sample rooms and approved finish standards are achieved. 
 - Oversee quality inspections, material testing, method statements, inspection and test plans, and closure of non-conformances. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable approvals, statutory conditions, labour requirements, environmental controls and site safety standards. 
 - Review contractor bills, variations, claims, commitments and forecast final cost with QS & Contracts and Finance. 
 - Lead progress and performance reviews with contractors and consultants; resolve technical and execution bottlenecks. 
 - Build, lead and develop the civil project team; define responsibilities, reporting systems and review cadence. 
 - Maintain project records, drawings, approvals, progress reports, risk registers, change logs and management dashboards. 
 - Coordinate with authorities and utility agencies for construction-related approvals, inspections and connections. 
 - Plan civil-side completion, snagging, defect rectification and readiness for integrated testing and commissioning. 
 - Ensure as-built drawings, warranties, O&M information, quality records and completion dossiers are complete. 
 - Lead civil-side readiness for hotel operator inspections, phased handover and final project handover. 
 - Provide periodic management reports covering schedule, budget, risks, decisions required and corrective actions. 
 - Perform other project-related responsibilities as assigned by management.
