data.description:
Location Details: Remote, India

This is a remote position, so you'll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings. 

Join Our Team. . . 

The Enablement team builds and operates the Linux Patching Automation (LPA) platform - a multi-cluster AWX automation system that patches every Linux host across GoDaddy's fleet. What started as a single-DC patching tool is now a multi-cluster, AI-integrated remediation system spanning multiple data centers. The team owns observability tooling (Loki, Mimir, Grafana, Alloy), ServiceNow integrations, and a system designed to identify and address vulnerabilities!

We need a Staff Engineer whose scope matches the platform's. This role owns the Automation Mesh multi-DC architecture, takes the AI-assisted vulnerability remediation pipeline from MVP to production, and establishes LPA's first service-level objectives and error budget framework. At this level you determine your own methods and procedures, shape the roadmap, and are the recognized technical voice for LPA across partner teams!

What You'll Get To Do. . . 

- Own the Automation Mesh multi-DC architecture - failure domain reasoning, distributed locking, graceful degradation, and concurrency with LB-aware draining across data centers. 
 - Take the AI-assisted vulnerability triage and remediation pipeline from MVP to production: define triage accuracy SLOs, implement guard rails against mis-classified CI types, and expand coverage beyond the initial OS vulnerability scope. 
 - Own and drive down LPA onboarding lead time - establish cluster provisioning patterns, self-service runbooks, and a clear onboarding contract so what currently takes weeks completes in days. Define and own the platform's testing strategy - unit tests, molecule tests, and Execution Environment smoke-test contracts; close the open architectural decision on integration testing and build the foundation that lets the platform scale without quality regressions. 
 - Evolve LPA dashboards to fully replace legacy compliance reporting tooling; build alerting that surfaces patching SLA risk before it becomes a vulnerability ticket. Define LPA's first service-level objectives - patch delivery latency, automation success rate, alert-to-remediation lead time - and instrument them against an error budget, transforming LPA from a best-effort automation tool into a reliability-accountable platform. 
 - Mentor engineers on the team, lead cross-functional program delivery, and communicate architectural decisions to platform consumers and partner teams. Lead the team's AI tooling practice - co-authoring commits with LLMs is the team norm; the Staff Engineer sets the standard for how it's done. 

Your Experience Should Include. . . 

- 10+ years of hands-on SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering experience, including Staff or Principal-level scope. 
 - Ansible at scale - roles, collections, Execution Environment container builds, and lint pipelines; designing reusable role libraries, not just running playbooks. 
 - AWX / Ansible Automation Platform - Automation Mesh, Execution Environments, RBAC, and credential types; must have owned the platform at the architecture level, not just consumed it. 
 - Terraform / IaC - full infra-as-code lifecycle: cluster provisioning via tfvars-driven modules on OpenStack or comparable private cloud. 
 - Kubernetes / K3s operations - cordon/drain, etcd quorum, K8s-aware patching coordination; not just Helm deploys. 
 - ServiceNow integration - CMDB as dynamic inventory, Change Order workflows, VIT/vulnerability tracking; direct REST/API experience required. 
 - Systems architecture and distributed design - fault-tolerant, redundant systems at division scope: concurrency, locking, failure domains. 
 - AI / LLM integration in operations - LLM API integration in workflows; architecture-level AI application, not just prompt writing. 
 - Grafana / Prometheus / Mimir / Loki - building dashboards and alerting rules, not just reading them. 
 - Python scripting - owns and extends the AI vulnerability pipeline, Slack automation tooling, and utility scripts; not optional at Staff level. 
 - SLI / SLO / error budget - must have defined and instrumented service-level objectives and used error budgets to drive reliability trade-offs. 
 - Incident commander experience - on-call rotation ownership, postmortem facilitation; at Staff level you set the incident culture, not just participate in it. 
 - Technical mentorship - documented history of leveling up engineers through code review, pairing, architectural walkthroughs, or formal mentorship. 
 - Cross-functional program leadership - shipped projects requiring alignment across multiple teams without direct authority. 

You might also have. . . 

- HashiCorp Vault - AppRole, PKI, IAM key rotation; our secrets model is Vault-first. 
 - HAProxy or other LB-aware patching / drain logic experience. 
 - Open source community participation - contributions, maintainership, or advocacy. 
 - cPanel / shared hosting fleet context - one of our larger customer segments. 
 - Formal technical decision documentation (ADR, RFC) at a prior employer. 
 - Database awareness - MySQL replica detection, Postgres-backed locking patterns. 

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn't align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

About This Opportunity

Job Title: Software Engineer II - SRE

Location: Bangalore

Job Description

The SRE RunOps Engineer 2 is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of the 7NOW delivery platform and associated services through proactive monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role combines software engineering principles with operations expertise to maintain high-availability systems that support 7-Eleven's digital delivery business. The SRE RunOps Engineer 2 collaborates closely with development teams, product managers, and infrastructure engineers to implement automation, optimize system performance, and drive operational excellence. This position plays a critical role in maintaining service level objectives (SLOs) and enhancing the customer experience for 7NOW users. 

Responsibilities

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents for 7NOW platform services, ensuring minimal downtime and rapid restoration of service
 - Design and implement automation solutions to reduce manual operational tasks and improve system reliability using scripting languages and infrastructure-as-code tools
 - Participate in on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support for critical production systems and respond to s and incidents
 - Collaborate with software engineering teams to improve application observability, implement monitoring solutions, and establish meaningful service level indicators (SLIs)
 - Conduct post-incident reviews and root cause analysis to identify systemic issues and implement preventive measures
 - Develop and maintain runbooks, operational documentation, and standard operating procedures for common operational scenarios
 - Optimize cloud infrastructure costs and resource utilization across AWS or Azure environments supporting the 7NOW platform
 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable safe and efficient deployment of application updates
 - Perform capacity planning and performance tuning to ensure systems can handle current and projected traffic loads
 - Work with security teams to implement and maintain security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements
 - Contribute to disaster recovery planning and execute regular testing of backup and recovery procedures
 - Mentor junior team members and share knowledge through documentation, training sessions, and code reviews

Technical Skills Required

- Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and tooling development
 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure services including compute, storage, networking, and managed services in AWS or Azure
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk
 - Knowledge of configuration management and infrastructure-as-code tools including Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation
 - Solid understanding of Linux/Unix system administration, networking concepts, and distributed systems architecture
 - Experience with CI/CD tools and practices including Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with ability to diagnose complex issues across multiple system layers
 - Excellent communication skills with ability to clearly document technical processes and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
 - Understanding of database technologies including SQL and NoSQL databases, performance tuning, and backup strategies
 - Knowledge of containerization, microservices architecture, and API design principles
 - Ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments with changing priorities and manage multiple concurrent initiatives
 - Experience utilizing AI to improve Observability, troubleshooting and resolution of production issues. 
 - Strong customer service orientation with focus on minimizing impact to end users and maintaining high service quality

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

YEARS OF RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE: 4+

CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES: AWS or Azure cloud certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent) preferred

Privileges & Perquisites

7-Eleven Global Solution Center offers a comprehensive benefits plan tailored to meet the needs and improve the overall experience of our employees, aiding in the management of both their professional and personal aspects. 

Work-Life Balance: Encouraging employees to unwind, recharge, and find balance, we offer flexible and hybrid work schedules along with diverse leave options. Supplementary allowances and compensatory days off are provided for specific work demands. 

Well-Being & Family Protection: Comprehensive medical coverage for spouses, children, and parents/in-laws, with voluntary top-up plans, OPD coverage, day care services, and access to health coaches. Additionally, an Employee Assistance Program with free, unbiased and confidential expert consultations for personal and professional issues. 

Top of Form

Wheels and Meals: Free transportation and cafeteria facilities with diverse menu options including breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages, customizable and health-conscious choices. 

Certification & Training Program: Sponsored training for specialized certifications. Investment in employee development through labs and learning platforms. 

Hassel free Relocation: Support and reimbursement for newly hired employees relocating to Bangalore, India.

data.title: Software Development Engineer, Sidewalk Cloud, Sidewalk Cloud
data.description:
Description

Ring is looking for Software development Engineer to join our growing Sidewalk Cloud services team and help build a nationwide community network that will enable connectivity for millions of IOT devices. You will be responsible for building core cloud services that will provide a scalable backbone to the network and support functionalities like authentication, encryption, message routing, and device life-cycle management. You will develop real-time monitoring and analytics solutions to continuously learn, and help keep customer trust by preventing security incidents and improving network availability. 

As a Software Development Engineer, you will have the opportunity to influence the product roadmap, drive key components of overall system architecture and lead the adoption of best practices within the org. You will work closely with and influence AWS IOT service teams, as well as cross functional teams across Ring, Echo, and Alexa, to bring a unified connectivity solution for our customers. 

Sidewalk cloud team owns all the core services and infrastructure that is backbone of the Sidewalk network. Sidewalk is already enabled on more than 80 million Amazon and Ring devices, with more devices added every day. The team is responsible for scaling the core connectivity and messaging platform for the network. Services follow event driven system architecture that blends various server-less computer technologies. The team believes in choosing the right tool and technology for the job, and has created services in various programming languages like Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, and Python. 

Key job responsibilities

- Manage key components of the core Sidewalk network services and messaging platform that processes millions of messages daily. 
 - Think big; bring fresh ideas and approaches to simplify onboarding new devices on the Sidewalk network and improve customer value. 
 - Evaluate different design choices, prototype new technology, and implement technical solutions that address business requirements. 
 - Contribute to defining product roadmap, understand business impact of system choices, and make technical trade-offs using sound judgment. 
 - Work closely with ML scientists, understand the requirements, design and deliver innovative monitoring solutions to help preserve customer trust. 
 - Develop and integrate generative AI solutions to enhance operational efficiency, including automated debugging tools, intelligent testing frameworks, and AI-powered documentation generation. 
 - Build and maintain AI-powered support systems that can analyze device behavior, perform automated triage, and provide intelligent recommendations for issue resolution. 
 - Create intelligent automation tools that streamline development workflows, including AI-assisted code generation, automated testing environments, and smart deployment processes. 
 - Design and implement AI-driven analytics solutions for monitoring service health, detecting anomalies, and providing proactive insights across multiple dashboards and metrics. 
 - Drive engineering best practices around operational excellence, security, test automation coverage and set standards in the team. 
 - Deal with ambiguity, make data-driven decisions and juggle cross-organization complexity. 
 - Drive consensus when confronted with discordant views by identifying the best path forward and influencing others to follow it. 

About The Team

Since its founding in 2013, Ring has been on a mission to make neighborhoods safer, together for everyone. From the first-ever Video Doorbell, to the award-winning DIY Ring Alarm system, Ring's smart home security product line, as well as the Neighbors app, offer users affordable whole-home and neighborhood security. At Ring, we are committed to making security accessible and convenient for everyone-while working hard to bring communities together. Ring is an Amazon company. For more information, visit www. ring. com. With Ring, you're always home. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.title: Lead QAQC - Mech & Process (Cleanroom)
data.description:
Responsibilities

Responsible for quality assurance of mechanical piping fabrication and erection, with a specialization in high purity and ultra-high purity (HP/UHP) process systems and cleanroom infrastructure. This is a technically demanding role requiring deep familiarity with semiconductor-grade cleanliness standards, orbital welding, and cleanroom construction protocols. Serves as a critical quality interface with the GC, PMC, and specialist sub-contractors. 

- Oversee fabrication and installation quality of HP/UHP piping systems - UPW, CDA, N2, specialty gas, and chemical distribution. 
 - Conduct pre-fabrication audits at spool fabrication shops; verify material traceability (heat certificates, mill certs) per ASTM standards. 
 - Monitor orbital welding operations - welder/operator qualifications, purging protocols, borescope weld inspection. 
 - Review and approve ITPs, WPS/PQR, and welding records for SS 316L, PVDF, and other process pipe materials. 
 - Witness hydro/pneumatic pressure tests, helium leak tests, and particle count tests per system flushing protocols. 
 - Enforce cleanroom construction protocols - gowning, contamination control, material handling, and surface protection. 
 - Track NCRs from identification through verified closure; analyse systemic trends. 
 - Coordinate with GC, PMC, process engineers, and move-in teams for CMIA (Construction to Move-In Authorization) milestones. 

Key Responsibility

- Strong understanding of SEMI, ASME, IS and AWS codes
 - Familiarity with orbital welding, manual GTAW for fittings, flanges, and repair welds under controlled conditionsFamiliarity with Purging and back-purging protocols for stainless steel; oxygen monitoring (
 - Experience in weld coupon qualification, tensile, bend, and borescope visual inspection criteria
 - Familiarity with thermoplastic welding (IR fusion, socket fusion) for PVDF and PP piping systems
 - Strong coordination skills - experienced in daily interface with GCs, PMC, and third-party inspectors
 - Ability to prepare professional quality reports and management presentation decks
 - Proficient in MS Excel (trackers, pivot tables, charts), PowerPoint, and Word
 - Detail-oriented, assertive in quality enforcement, and composed under schedule pressure. 
 - Drive GCs accountability via clarity, technical credibility, documented evidence, and disciplined escalation-not hierarchy. 
 - Ability to read process flow diagrams, P&IDs, isometric drawings, and cleanroom layout drawings
 - Quick to learn proprietary commissioning and quality management platforms used on the project

Qualification

B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, or Process Engineering

Experience

- 10+ years in quality for process/mechanical construction - at least 3 years on HP/UHP or cleanroom projects
 - Prior involvement in FAB construction projects (e. g. , Micron, Intel, GlobalFoundries, Siltronics etc. ), pharmaceutical (ISPE/GMP), or advanced electronics facility preferred. 
 - Experience with high-purity piping, gas distribution systems, and vibration-sensitive installations

Competencies

- Customer Empathy
 - Agility
 - Teamwork
 - Future Ready
 - Deep Domain Knowledge
 - Pioneering
 - Purposeful Pursuit of Goals

data.description:
Company overview: 

PEP is a dynamic personal care company that proudly houses two innovative brands - mCaffeine & Hyphen. With a passion for creating high-performance, conscious, and consumer-loved products, we are redefining the way personal care is experienced. While mCaffeine is India's first caffeinated personal care brand, loved for its energizing and playful approach, Hyphen is built on the philosophy of simplifying skincare through science-backed formulations. Together, our brands reflect PEP's mission to deliver quality, creativity, and care to millions of consumers. We believe in Confidence over all skin & body biases. 

Come, join the pack!

Job Summary: 

The Factory Quality In-Charge is responsible for ensuring that all cosmetic products are manufactured, tested, packed, and dispatched in compliance with GMP, company quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. The role involves managing in-process quality, finished product quality, documentation, investigations, CAPA implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities: 

1. Quality Assurance

· Ensure compliance with Cosmetic GMP (ISO 22716) and company quality systems. 

· Monitor manufacturing and packing activities to ensure adherence to approved SOPs and specifications. 

· Approve line clearance before manufacturing and packing operations. 

· Review and approve Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR) and Batch Packing Records (BPR). 

· Ensure implementation of Good Documentation Practices (GDP). 

2. In-Process Quality Control

· Conduct in-process inspections during manufacturing and packaging. 

· Verify process parameters such as temperature, mixing time, pH, viscosity, weight, fill volume, coding, and labeling. 

· Monitor product appearance, colour, fragrance, and consistency. 

· Ensure sampling is carried out as per approved procedures. 

3. Finished Product Quality

· Review QC test reports before product release. 

· Coordinate product release based on compliance with specifications. 

· Monitor retention samples and stability samples. 4. Non-Conformance & CAPA

· Investigate quality deviations, customer complaints, and product defects. 

· Perform root cause analysis using tools such as 5 Why and Fishbone Diagram. 

· Implement and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). 

· Track effectiveness of CAPA implementation. 

5. Documentation & Compliance

· Maintain quality records, SOPs, specifications, formats, and logs. 

· Ensure proper document control and record retention. 

· Prepare reports for internal and external audits. 

· Support regulatory inspections and customer audits. 

Qualification

· B. Sc. /M. Sc. (Chemistry, Microbiology or Life Sciences), B. Pharm, M. Pharm, or equivalent. 

Experience

· 10 - 14 years of experience in Quality Assurance/Quality Control in the cosmetics, personal care, pharmaceutical, or FMCG manufacturing industry. 

· Experience in handling factory quality systems and GMP implementation. 

Required Skills

· Strong knowledge of ISO 22716 (Cosmetic GMP). 

· Understanding of cosmetic manufacturing and packaging processes. 

· Good knowledge of QC testing parameters (pH, viscosity, microbial limits, stability, etc. ). 

· Experience in deviation investigation, CAPA, and root cause analysis. 

· Knowledge of internal audits and regulatory compliance. · Strong documentation and report-writing skills

data.title: Senior Automation Engineer
data.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Ahmedabad/GiftCity

Description

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Automation engineer to continuously modernize, strengthen and accelerate our test automation frameworks. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who writes excellent production-quality Python code, can diagnose complex technical problems, and turns that expertise into reliable, maintainable and fast automation infrastructure. Our automation stack includes a Python-based backend for Clear Flow in house framework and Playwright with TypeScript for frontend end-to-end testing. The successful candidate will lead framework design and evolution, improve test reliability and execution speed, strengthen CI integration, and mentor other engineers. Experience testing financial technology or trading systems is highly desirable. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead continuous framework modernization: Own the technical direction and ongoing improvement of our automation frameworks, libraries, utilities and test architecture. 
 - Write high-quality Python: Develop and review robust, readable, efficient Python code for backend automation, framework services, test utilities and integrations. 
 - Improve performance and scalability: Profile and reduce test execution time; identify bottlenecks in setup, data handling, environment interaction and parallel execution; improve resource use without sacrificing reliability. 
 - Increase test reliability: Reduce flaky tests, improve diagnostics and failure reporting, strengthen logging and debugging support, and make failures easier to reproduce and resolve. 
 - Develop end-to-end automation: Maintain and improve Playwright/TypeScript UI automation and ensure effective integration with Python-based backend testing. 
 - Improve CI/CD integration: Make automated suites easier to run and troubleshoot in CI pipelines; improve test selection, reporting, repeatability and feedback time. 
 - Design for maintainability: Apply sound object-oriented design, modular architecture, reusable abstractions, clear interfaces and appropriate design patterns-avoiding unnecessary complexity. 
 - Work across teams: Partner with software engineers, quality engineers and infrastructure teams to investigate failures, improve testability and prevent defects earlier. 
 - Provide technical leadership: Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, partnership and practical guidance; establish coding standards and framework-development practices. 
 - Measure impact: Use meaningful metrics such as execution duration, flakiness, failure diagnosis time, framework adoption and regression coverage to prioritize improvements. 
 - Support quality strategy: help with product testing when needed as well help determine where automation provides the greatest value, while retaining sound test design and appropriate exploration or manual testing where needed. 

Essential Skills

- Strong, hands-on Python programming skills. You should be comfortable designing, implementing, debugging, profiling and refactoring non-trivial code-not just writing test scripts. 
 - Typically, 8+ years of relevant software engineering, test automation or framework-development experience, including substantial ownership of automation frameworks. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and evolving reusable automation frameworks, test libraries or developer tooling used by multiple engineers or teams. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, modularity, error handling, testing, debugging and clean-code practices. 
 - Experience building and maintaining integration-level, API or backend automated tests. 
 - Practical experience with Playwright and TypeScript for front end-end end-to-end automation, or the ability to demonstrate equivalent depth and quickly contribute to this stack. 
 - Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and collaborative Agile software development. 
 - Ability to investigate complex failures across application code, test code, test data, environments and infrastructure. 
 - Strong communication and mentoring skills, with the ability to explain design trade-offs and raise engineering quality across a team. 

Desired Skills

- Experience testing financial technology, electronic trading, capital markets, market data, order management or other complex, high-throughput systems. 
 - Experience with development and maintenance of Python-based automation frameworks. 
 - Experience improving large regression suites through parallelization, smarter test selection, test-data management, code coverage, performance profiling and flakiness reduction. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous programming, service integrations, messaging or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience with Linux-based test environments, containers and troubleshooting environment-dependent failures. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools effectively, with appropriate review and validation of generated code. 

What We Bring To The Table

Competitive Benefits & Perks in India We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. 

- Health & Financial Security: 
 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
 - Time Off & Flexibility: 
 - Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. 
 - 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days. 
 - One dedicated day per year for volunteering. 
 - Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development. 
 - An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years. 
 - Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. 
 - Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). 
 - Work-Life Support & Resources: 
 - Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. 
 - Milestone anniversary bonuses. 
 - Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: 
 - Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. 
 - Our Culture: 
 - Forward-thinking, culture-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion. Trading Technologies (www. tradingtechnologies. com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market-leading technology for the end-to-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company delivers "multi-X" solutions, with "X" representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies' clients. 

Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world's largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology-enabled businesses.

The market leader. The premier provider. The best in the business. At Citco, we've been the front-runner in our field since our incorporation in 1948 led to the evolution of the asset servicing sector itself. This pioneering spirit continues to guide us today as we innovate and expand, push beyond the boundaries of our industry, and shape its future. From working exclusively with hedge funds to serving all alternatives, corporations and private clients, our organization has grown immensely across asset classes and geographies. For us, this progress is a pattern that we'll only maintain as we move forward, always prioritizing our performance. So for those who want to play at the top of their game and be at the vanguard of their space, we say: Welcome to Citco.

Fund Administration is Citco's core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry's most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience. 

Responsibilities

- Oversee and support a team of analysts, to ensure Service Level Agreements are met in an effective and efficient fashion.

 - Work with your Manager on KRIs and KPIs and collaborate on mitigating plans around risk and resource constraints. 
 - Liaise with service providers, vendors, agents, counterparties and clients to ensure the timely resolution of issues and exceptions.

 - Contribute towards projects and initiatives that aim to drive the business forward, as it relates to Loan Administration and processing.

 - Contribute to the hiring process and seek the right candidates for the team. 

Qualifications

About You: 

- Bachelor or Master level degree. 
 - 4+ years in Financial Services with experience in leading people 
 - Product knowledge, Domestic, Global and OTC security markets, Fixed Income and derivative product knowledge. 
 - Excellent communication skills. 
 - Strong customer service skills 
 - Experience mentoring and coaching staff. 
 - Knowledge of Hedge or Mutual Funds. 
 - Professional accounting designation is an asset. 

Our Benefits

Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location. 

We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect. 

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

What You Will Do

- Lead a team of AML/TMS investigators on the floor, manage daily work allocation, queue prioritization, shift adherence, productivity tracking, and real-time support for operational issues
 - Oversee end-to-end transaction monitoring alert reviews, including customer profile assessment, transactional behavior analysis, red-flag identification, adverse media review, sanctions/PEP checks, and escalation decisioning
 - Support analysts on complex financial crime scenarios such as structuring, layering, rapid fund movement, unusual transaction velocity, high-risk jurisdiction exposure, mule activity, fraud-linked activity, and suspicious source/destination of funds. 
 - Review investigation narratives, evidence packs, and escalation rationale to ensure suspicious activity is documented clearly and supports SAR/STR filing decisions where required. 
 - Perform sample reviews, identify documentation gaps, validate alert disposition decisions, support calibration sessions, and drive corrective coaching based on QA and client feedback. 
 - Prepare and publish daily/weekly MIS covering volumes, productivity, SLA/TAT, quality, aging, escalations, attendance, staffing, and key risk themes for supervisor/client review. 
 - Act as the first point of contact for operational escalations, floor clarifications, process queries, and high-risk cases, ensuring timely updates to Supervisors, QA, Training, and client stakeholders. 
 - Conduct daily huddles, case walkthroughs, feedback discussions, refresher sessions, nesting support, and performance improvement plans to build analyst capability and consistency. 

What You Will Need

- Minimum 8+ years of overall experience in AML, Financial Crime Compliance, Transaction Monitoring, KYC/CDD/EDD, fraud risk, payments, banking operations, fintech, crypto compliance, or BFSI/BPO financial crime operations. 
 - Currently operating in a Team Lead role or equivalent, managing an on-ground team with ownership of daily production, queue management, SLA/TAT adherence, quality performance, attendance, and reporting. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Transaction Monitoring Systems (TMS), including alert review, investigation documentation, risk assessment, dispositioning, and escalation of potentially suspicious activity. 
 - Experience supporting L2 investigations, SAR/STR escalation preparation, suspicious activity narrative review, and evidence-based case documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of AML/CFT concepts, red-flag typologies, sanctions screening, PEP/high-risk customer review, source of funds/source of wealth considerations, and regulatory expectations. 
 - Experience preparing operational dashboards, daily/weekly MIS, aging reports, productivity and quality reports, and stakeholder updates for leadership or client review. 
 - Exposure to TMS/case management platforms such as Actimize, SAS AML, Verafin, Oracle FCCM, NICE Actimize, or equivalent tools is preferred. 

What Would Be Nice To Have

- Experience in crypto/virtual asset transaction monitoring, including exchange-related activity, wallet behavior review, on-chain/off-chain transaction context, and virtual asset red-flag typologies. 
 - Exposure to blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic, or similar investigation platforms. 
 - Prior experience supporting client-facing reviews, audits, calibration calls, process transitions, new queue launches, or ramp-up of AML/TMS teams. 
 - Certification or working knowledge of CAMS, ICA, CFE, FATF guidance, Travel Rule requirements, or virtual asset regulatory frameworks.

data.title: Global IT Software Engineer Senior Manager & Chapter Lead
data.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. 

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. 

What You'll Do

As a Global IT Software Engineer Senior Manager and Chapter Lead within BCG's Global Services organization, you will lead a team of software engineers responsible for designing, developing, and delivering secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions. You will provide technical direction across custom software development, cloud-native applications, data platforms, and enterprise integrations, helping teams translate business needs into high-quality engineering outcomes. 

You will combine deep technical expertise with strong people leadership to establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, and oversee the delivery of complex technology initiatives. As a Chapter Lead, you will build engineering capabilities, develop talent, and foster a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and technical excellence across global teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead engineering architecture and technical direction: Guide solution design and architectural decisions across custom applications, AWS cloud-native technologies, Snowflake, Python, and MuleSoft, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise architecture principles. 
 - Drive software engineering excellence: Establish and promote engineering standards, design patterns, code quality practices, testing approaches, and modern development methodologies to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. 
 - Oversee technology delivery: Lead the planning and execution of complex software engineering initiatives, managing delivery priorities, technical dependencies, resources, risks, and quality to achieve agreed business outcomes. 
 - Advance cloud-native development and integration: Guide teams in building and modernizing applications, data solutions, APIs, and enterprise integrations using AWS, Snowflake, Python, and MuleSoft, with an emphasis on performance, interoperability, and operational resilience. 
 - Embed security into engineering practices: Partner with security and architecture teams to incorporate application security, cloud security, access controls, data protection, and risk management principles throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Lead and develop engineering talent: Manage and mentor software engineers through regular coaching, performance feedback, career development, and capability-building initiatives, creating opportunities for individual and team growth. 
 - Strengthen global collaboration: Partner with technology leaders, product teams, architects, security specialists, and business colleagues across regions to align engineering priorities, resolve complex technical challenges, and support successful delivery. 
 - Drive continuous improvement: Evaluate emerging technologies, improve engineering processes, encourage knowledge sharing, and introduce practical improvements that strengthen development productivity, solution quality, and long-term engineering capabilities. 

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including custom application development, architecture, and technical leadership. 
 - Strong expertise in cloud-native engineering and AWS, with proficiency in Python and modern development practices. 
 - Working knowledge across Snowflake, MuleSoft, API development, and enterprise integration technologies. 
 - Solid understanding of application security, cloud security, data protection, and secure software development principles. 
 - Demonstrated experience managing complex engineering projects, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and solution quality. 
 - Proven people leadership skills, including managing engineers, coaching, performance management, and developing technical capabilities. 
 - Strong problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills, with experience collaborating across global, cross-functional teams. 

Who You'll Work With

You will be part of BCG's Global IT organization within Global Services, working with a global community of software engineering and development professionals. You will collaborate closely with enterprise and solution architects, cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure teams, product owners, and business technology teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions. As a Chapter Lead, you will foster an inclusive and collaborative engineering environment, encouraging knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and continuous development across globally distributed teams. 

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. 

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. 

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork. 

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws. 

BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

data.description:
Do you want to shape the future of fintech and healthtech? Energized by challenges and inspired by bold goals? Ready to elevate your career alongside driven and talented colleagues? If that sounds like you, explore a career at Alegeus today. Opportunity Happens Here. 

Location Bangalore, India

Reports to Development Manager

About Alegeus

Alegeus, part of Optum Financial, provides consumer-directed healthcare (CDH) solutions for millions of consumer benefit accounts, including FSAs, HSAs, HRAs, dependent care, and wellness programs. Its SaaS and payments platform supports ongoing investment in platform modernization, API-first integration, real-time data access, and AI-enabled automation. 

Role summary

Alegeus is seeking an experienced, hands-on Technical Lead to guide software projects from discovery through production support. You will translate business needs into sound technical designs, lead implementation, and take responsibility for delivery, quality, and operational readiness. The role calls for strong . NET and SQL Server expertise, practical Azure experience, and event-driven integration experience. You will work with product, business, architecture, QA, DevOps, and operations partners, mentor engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, decisions, and risks. 

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership and delivery

- Lead technical delivery from requirements analysis and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Translate business needs into clear technical designs, identify options and trade-offs, and guide the team toward maintainable solutions. 
 - Break work into deliverable components, coordinate dependencies, track progress, communicate decisions, and raise risks early. 
 - Partner with product managers, product owners, and business stakeholders to understand customer needs and the purpose behind requested features. 
 - Collaborate across architecture, QA, infrastructure, DevOps, and operations to deliver reliable end-to-end solutions. 
 - Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, debugging, and knowledge sharing; promote strong engineering practices. 

Platform modernization and engineering

- Maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance the existing ASP. NET/C# and SQL Server platform, including stored procedures and T-SQL code. 
 - Design and deliver C#/. NET services and REST APIs using microservices and event-driven patterns. 
 - Contribute to domain decomposition, domain modeling, and domain-driven design (DDD) as the platform evolves. 
 - Use Azure services such as App Service, Service Bus, and Azure SQL Database; support integration with messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Event Hubs. 
 - Ensure interoperability and data consistency between legacy applications and new services during modernization. 
 - Use source control and CI/CD pipelines to support dependable builds, deployments, and releases. 

Quality, security, and operations

- Champion test-driven development and maintain automated unit, integration, and regression tests. 
 - Lead code reviews, static analysis, refactoring, and test automation to improve maintainability and prevent regressions. 
 - Apply secure SDLC practices, use OWASP guidance to identify and address vulnerabilities, and design appropriate authentication and authorization controls such as OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, SSO, and RBAC. 
 - Protect APIs through token validation, input validation, rate limiting, and safeguards against injection and related attacks. 
 - Troubleshoot production issues, support incident resolution, and improve application reliability and performance. 
 - Document system behavior and technical decisions to support maintenance and future upgrades. 

Product mindset and continuous improvement

- Consider customer and business outcomes when evaluating technical approaches, and explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical partners. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve architecture, engineering processes, performance, and operational support. 
 - Stay current with cloud engineering, microservices, event-driven architecture, and responsible use of AI-assisted software development tools. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 12 or more years of professional software engineering experience at a software product company, including substantial experience building and supporting enterprise applications with Microsoft technologies. Candidates from services or consulting backgrounds should have product-engineering experience in healthcare payments or a similar domain. 
 - At least 2 years leading technical delivery for projects or teams, with demonstrated ownership from requirements through production. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with C#, . NET Framework, and . NET Core or modern . NET; experience designing REST APIs and service-oriented or microservice applications. 
 - Strong database skills, particularly Microsoft SQL Server, including T-SQL, stored procedures, schema design, indexing, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting; experience with PL/SQL is also required. 
 - Experience with microservices and asynchronous messaging, using one or more of Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, or Azure Event Hubs. Kafka experience is preferred. 
 - Practical experience deploying or supporting solutions on Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform, along with modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD, containerization, and infrastructure as code. 
 - Experience across the software development lifecycle and Agile practices, including analysis, design, testing, code review, debugging, deployment, and production support. 
 - Demonstrated ability to understand and troubleshoot legacy C#, SQL, PL/SQL, and stored procedure code using source, tests, and appropriate discovery tools. 
 - Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical topics and decisions in business terms. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience modernizing monolithic applications into domain-oriented microservices using DDD. 
 - Experience in healthcare, consumer benefits, or payment processing; familiarity with claims, eligibility, or EHR workflows is useful. 
 - Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and security considerations for healthcare or payment data. 
 - Experience with container orchestration, such as Kubernetes or AKS. 
 - Experience using generative AI tools for code, tests, or documentation. 
 - Working knowledge of HTML and JavaScript. 

What success looks like

The Technical Lead makes sound technical decisions, keeps delivery predictable, and surfaces issues early. Projects move from clear requirements to production with maintainable code, reliable integrations, effective testing, and operational readiness. Engineers understand the goals, take ownership of their work, and deliver features that create customer and business value. 

Why join Alegeus

Join a team modernizing a large-scale consumer-directed healthcare platform that supports Alegeus' mission to simplify healthcare payments. This role offers the opportunity to shape platform architecture, improve engineering practices, and deepen your experience in cloud engineering, microservices, event-driven systems, test-driven development, and AI-assisted development. 

Technical environment

C# | . NET Framework | . NET Core / modern . NET | ASP. NET Web API | SQL Server | T-SQL | PL/SQL | REST APIs | Microservices | Kafka | RabbitMQ | Azure Service Bus | Azure Event Hubs | Microsoft Azure | CI/CD | Git

Because We Care, We Offer

- A flexible work environment 
 - Competitive salaries, paid vacation, and holidays 
 - Robust professional development programs 
 - Comprehensive health, wellness, and financial packages

SHARED AMBITION. INSPIRED FUTURE. 

At Alegeus, our success is guided by our aligned vision and values-it is how we work together and collaborate to achieve our goals. 

- People First. We pride ourselves in bringing talented people together and treating one another with care. 
 - Partner Powered. We are committed to empowering our partners, knowing our success is shared and we win as one. 
 - Always Advancing. We are driven by potential and relentlessly determined to achieve our goals. 

"I truly believe that people who are well-skilled and talented can go wherever they want in this company. We want to create the best place anyone has ever worked. " - Alegeus employee

Apply now, connect a friend to this opportunity, or sign up for job alerts!

We are committed to a policy of Equal Employment Opportunity and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances. The information collected by this application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity and maintain employment statistics on applicants. 

At Alegeus, being transparent about our compensation philosophy and approach is more than just a legal requirement. As our organization continues to grow and evolve, we have made a commitment to ensure that our compensation framework is equitable, data-driven, consistent, and unbiased, with allowable pay differences based on factors unique to each candidate (think: skills, experience, qualifications, etc. ) in order to attract and retain a highly talented and committed workforce.

In the interim, if you are a California, Colorado, Connecticut, Maryland, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio or Washington resident and this role is physically available in your state or classified as remote, you may be eligible to receive additional information about the compensation and benefits for this role, which we will provide upon request. data.description:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE / FUNCTIONAL CONTEXT: 

The R&D Manager is the owner of the resources in R&D. One of the more important responsibilities is for CPI process and the execution. An important part of the mission is to drive the competence process in R&D to safeguard that the organization have the competence over time to execute the projects and actions needed to safeguard that the right products can be developed. Develop processes that can support shorter time to market and always drive the organization towards short time to market no matter what type of project and actions. 

In line with Tools Divisional strategy and support the needed 'game changing moves'' where a new way of working can push a product line, a new technology or business line in a way that the organization can't bring with traditional operating. Together with operations drive PK reduction and warranty reduction actions to secure our competitiveness. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 

Be technically responsible for all products. 

Safeguard that the products are developed and verified in a way that we guarantee that the quality, performance and PK are on a competitive level at all time. Safeguard that all products comply with legal demands without any exceptions. 

Support global R&D projects and initiatives. 

Utilize the resources of the Hyderabad R&D team to simultaneously support local development initiatives and global projects. Prioritize appropriately based on inputs from global R&D manager. 

Be the owner of the CPI process for the Hyderabad executing department, safeguard that maximum value is generated through the process. 

The CPI process should prioritize agility first and not be overloaded with to large projects/actions. Further develop the KPI in order to have a KPI drive process. 

Competence strategy for R&D, safeguard that the organization have the competence to perform its mission and task. 

Safeguard that the competences needed are available in the organization when they are needed, over time since the technology transformation is constantly moving. 

Responsible for the reimbursed warranty

R&D should be the gatekeeper for the warranty (even if the majority of claims will come from production deviations), constantly drive for lower number of claims. Build the attitude that each claim is a customer that needs help. 

TTM reduction in R&D processes

Drive efficiency and time to market reduction in each R&D process from a cross functional perspective. But is it still important to find ways of working that make R&D less dependent on other department for projects. 

Strategic plans and technology roadmaps for R&D and annual execution plans

Breakdown divisional targets and actions into actions for R&D with annual updated plans. Develop together with the business lines and new technology department technology and product roadmaps that can be executed in the project portfolio process. 

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE: 

Educational: Master of Science or University degree within relevant field (such as Engineering, Data science, or similar)

Experiential: 12+ years of experience R&D of Mining Equipment & Consumables. 

Preferably 3-4 years of relevant experience in R&D Lead in managerial capacity. 

Knowledge: 

- Good knowledge in Material Science, Mathematics to design schematics for potential products and create product dimensions and Project management
 - Analytical ability to perform many research tasks and create design plans for products. 
 - Good Knowledge in Computers, CAD & Simulation Software's. 
 - Knowledge in advance manufacturing will have added advantage. 
 - Knowledge of Audit procedures & relevant standards of ISO 9001: 2015, API SPEC Q1, 7-1 & 7-2. 
 - Knowledge in Quality tools FMEA, PPAP Solid managerial background in R&D, Operation or Marketing
 - Experience from operational responsibility and used to working cross functional. 
 - Well, established professional network within Epiroc, its supplier base and in the mining and construction industry.

Candidate will own technical delivery, and mentor junior engineers. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop scalable, high-performance backend services in Go for hub-native forecourt applications
 - Build event-driven, asynchronous workflows using message queues
 - Design data models and optimize queries in MongoDB
 - Integrate AI capabilities (LLM/ML-based features, AI-assisted workflows) into application services
 - Write clean, testable, well-documented code; participate in design and code reviews
 - Troubleshoot production issues and drive root-cause analysis
 - Collaborate with architects, QA, and product teams; mentor junior developers

About This Opportunity

Job Title: Lead Engineer - SRE

Location: Bangalore

Job Description

The SRE RunOps Engineer 2 is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of the 7NOW delivery platform and associated services through proactive monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role combines software engineering principles with operations expertise to maintain high-availability systems that support 7-Eleven's digital delivery business. The SRE RunOps Engineer 2 collaborates closely with development teams, product managers, and infrastructure engineers to implement automation, optimize system performance, and drive operational excellence. This position plays a critical role in maintaining service level objectives (SLOs) and enhancing the customer experience for 7NOW users. 

Responsibilities

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production incidents for 7NOW platform services, ensuring minimal downtime and rapid restoration of service
 - Design and implement automation solutions to reduce manual operational tasks and improve system reliability using scripting languages and infrastructure-as-code tools
 - Participate in on-call rotation to provide 24/7 support for critical production systems and respond to s and incidents
 - Collaborate with software engineering teams to improve application observability, implement monitoring solutions, and establish meaningful service level indicators (SLIs)
 - Conduct post-incident reviews and root cause analysis to identify systemic issues and implement preventive measures
 - Develop and maintain runbooks, operational documentation, and standard operating procedures for common operational scenarios
 - Optimize cloud infrastructure costs and resource utilization across AWS or Azure environments supporting the 7NOW platform
 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable safe and efficient deployment of application updates
 - Perform capacity planning and performance tuning to ensure systems can handle current and projected traffic loads
 - Work with security teams to implement and maintain security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements
 - Contribute to disaster recovery planning and execute regular testing of backup and recovery procedures
 - Mentor junior team members and share knowledge through documentation, training sessions, and code reviews

Technical Skills Required

- Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, Bash, or PowerShell for automation and tooling development
 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure services including compute, storage, networking, and managed services in AWS or Azure
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, or Splunk
 - Knowledge of configuration management and infrastructure-as-code tools including Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation
 - Solid understanding of Linux/Unix system administration, networking concepts, and distributed systems architecture
 - Experience with CI/CD tools and practices including Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms
 - Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with ability to diagnose complex issues across multiple system layers
 - Excellent communication skills with ability to clearly document technical processes and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
 - Understanding of database technologies including SQL and NoSQL databases, performance tuning, and backup strategies
 - Knowledge of containerization, microservices architecture, and API design principles
 - Ability to work effectively in fast-paced environments with changing priorities and manage multiple concurrent initiatives
 - Experience utilizing AI to improve Observability, troubleshooting and resolution of production issues. 
 - Strong customer service orientation with focus on minimizing impact to end users and maintaining high service quality

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

YEARS OF RELEVANT WORK EXPERIENCE: 4+

CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES: AWS or Azure cloud certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent) preferred

Privileges & Perquisites

7-Eleven Global Solution Center offers a comprehensive benefits plan tailored to meet the needs and improve the overall experience of our employees, aiding in the management of both their professional and personal aspects. 

Work-Life Balance: Encouraging employees to unwind, recharge, and find balance, we offer flexible and hybrid work schedules along with diverse leave options. Supplementary allowances and compensatory days off are provided for specific work demands. 

Well-Being & Family Protection: Comprehensive medical coverage for spouses, children, and parents/in-laws, with voluntary top-up plans, OPD coverage, day care services, and access to health coaches. Additionally, an Employee Assistance Program with free, unbiased and confidential expert consultations for personal and professional issues. 

Top of Form

Wheels and Meals: Free transportation and cafeteria facilities with diverse menu options including breakfast, lunch, snacks, and beverages, customizable and health-conscious choices. 

Certification & Training Program: Sponsored training for specialized certifications. Investment in employee development through labs and learning platforms. 

Hassel free Relocation: Support and reimbursement for newly hired employees relocating to Bangalore, India.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer I
data.description:
Job Description

At Loyalty Partner Solutions GmbH we are pioneers and technology leaders in high-performance loyalty management software for the airline, retail, travel, and transportation sectors. Headquartered in Munich, with teams around the world, we develop comprehensive software solutions for the operation of complex customer loyalty programs, which we implement for our clients worldwide. 

We develop long-term partnerships with our clients, advise them on their digitalization journey, work on innovative ideas together, and put them into practice. 

Among the companies that count on our know-how are Lufthansa, for its frequent flyer program Miles & More, Deutsche Bahn AG for its BahnCard and BahnBonus programs, PAYBACK, and international air carriers such as China Southern Airlines and United Airlines. 

Responsibilities

- Collaborates with Software Engineering teams to support the development, and implementation of features that enhance system resilience, scalability, and performance, ensuring systems can handle varying loads and recover effectively from unexpected disruptions. 
 - Collaborates in the development and implementation of automation tools and frameworks, including infrastructure as code (IaC) practices, to reduce manual intervention and improve system efficiency, with guidance from peers and leaders. 
 - Collaborates with senior engineers to contribute to the architectural design of systems, ensuring that reliability, scalability, and performance considerations are integrated into design discussions with direct guidance from senior colleagues. 
 - Collaborates in the design and execution of chaos engineering experiments and other resiliency testing methods to help identify potential failure points and ensure systems can recover from disruptions, with guidance from peers and leaders. 
 - Supports the development and implementation of disaster recovery plans and business continuity strategies, ensuring systems can recover quickly and effectively from unexpected disruptions. 
 - Collaborates with seniors to promote and implement best practices such as error budgeting, service-level objectives (SLOs), and service-level indicators (SLIs), contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and reliability. 
 - Serves as a key point of contact for customer-facing incident management, helping drive timely resolution and coordinating stakeholders through to recovery. 
 - Works within an ITIL-aligned support organization, applying structured incident, problem, and change management processes to support consistent, repeatable service delivery. 
 - Builds and maintains automation tools and frameworks, including infrastructure as code (IaC), to reduce manual toil, accelerate recovery, and improve operational efficiency across cloud environments. 
 - Helps deploy and operate cloud-native infrastructure on public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), contributing to containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tooling. 
 - Creates and maintains clear, structured process documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles, ensuring operational knowledge is captured, standardized, and accessible across the team. 
 - Collaborates with Software Engineering teams to enhance system resilience, scalability, and performance, ensuring services handle varying loads and recover effectively from disruptions. 
 - Contributes to the definition and monitoring of service-level KPIs, supporting a culture of continuous improvement and reliability. 
 - Supports the development and execution of disaster recovery and business continuity plans, including resiliency testing methods such as chaos engineering experiments. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred. 
 - Experience in customer-facing incident management or technical operations. 
 - Working knowledge of ITIL service management practices (incident, problem, and change management), ITIL certification preferred. 
 - Hands-on DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub). 
 - Experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-based SRE practices. 
 - Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and microservices architecture. 
 - Familiarity with a modern observability stack (e. g. , Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana), including logging, monitoring, tracing, and performance analysis. 
 - Experience with Linux/Unix systems, infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform), and scripting languages (e. g. , Python, Bash), familiarity with object-oriented languages such as Java a plus. 
 - Good written communication skills. 
 - AWS (DevOps) certification preferred. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service. 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express. 

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally: 

- Competitive base salaries
 - Bonus incentives
 - Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 - Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 - Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 - Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 - Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 - Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 - Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. 

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

data.title: Senior Back End Developer
data.description:
Backend Engineers - Java, Spring Boot & Enterprise Integrations

Location: Bengaluru Development Centre | Full-Time

Experience: 3-8 Years

Technology: Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | REST APIs | ERP & Enterprise Integrations

About Tapplent

Tapplent is a US-headquartered global HCM Technology SaaS company building the next generation of AI-powered Human Capital Management, Workforce Intelligence and Human Value Intelligence solutions. Operating across 30+ countries, Tapplent helps enterprises unify people, processes, applications and data through an intelligent technology platform. Our solutions integrate with enterprise ecosystems including ERP, Payroll, Finance, CRM, Identity Management, Communication Platforms and third-party business applications. 

We are looking for engineers who can build robust enterprise products and make complex business systems work together seamlessly. 

The Opportunity

- We are hiring Backend Engineers with strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, API development and enterprise application integrations. 
 - Enterprise integration experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. 
 - You should have practical experience designing, developing and maintaining integrations between enterprise applications, particularly ERP systems, HRMS, Payroll, Finance, CRM or other business-critical platforms. 
 - This is not simply a backend development role. You will help architect and scale a global, multi-tenant SaaS platform, enabling seamless interoperability, secure data exchange, intelligent workflows and cross-platform automation. 

What You'll Own

1. Backend Engineering & Architecture

- Design and develop scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot and Microservices. 
 - Build secure, high-performance REST APIs and distributed applications. 
 - Strengthen platform scalability, reliability, performance and security. 
 - Contribute to architecture, code reviews, testing and engineering standards. 2. Enterprise Application & ERP Integrations, Critical Responsibility

- Design, build and maintain integrations between Tapplent and ERP, HRMS, Payroll, Finance, CRM and external enterprise applications. 
 - Develop REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, middleware connectors, scheduled integrations and event-driven data exchange. 
 - Work with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, or similar systems.
