Job Description

Position: Software Engineer II, Frontend Base Location: New Delhi Location: India (Remote / Hybrid) Experience: 4+ years

About Chegg Skills

As Chegg Skills engineers, our software empowers students to move from "learning" to "earning. " We build the applications and systems that help students make life-changing career transitions into high-growth job opportunities. We take pride in making education accessible to motivated career switchers, and we build the technology that helps them achieve mastery and success. 

In this role, you will play a key role in a fully remote team of diverse, motivated engineers who are rethinking what education can look like. We serve thousands of students and educators every year, and your work will directly shape how those students learn and succeed. 

Chegg Skills is a growing division of Chegg focused on post-collegiate learners. We are continuing to grow our engineering team to support business expansion as more students take the next step in their careers with Chegg. Join us and help scale the engineering foundation for our next phase of growth. 

About The Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer II, Frontend to own the design, quality, and delivery of features across our student- and educator-facing web applications. This role is focused on building React/Next. js product experiences, the GraphQL-powered data layers behind them, and increasingly, AI-powered learning features. You will also contribute across the stack as needed - this is a frontend-first role with full-stack reach, and you should be comfortable enough with backend concepts and AWS infrastructure to ramp into our Kotlin/Java or Python backend services when a task calls for it. 

What You'll Do

- Own frontend features end-to-end - architecture, implementation, testing, staged rollout, and production monitoring - across our student and educator web applications. 
 - Translate product requirements into component architecture, GraphQL query/schema boundaries, and client-state contracts (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar) that other engineers build on. 
 - Debug cross-system issues that surface in the UI - GraphQL supergraph errors, auth/session edge cases, server/client rendering mismatches - by tracing root cause across the stack. 
 - Build AI-powered learning features responsibly: validate model output before it reaches the UI, design graceful fallbacks for unusable responses, and instrument these flows with telemetry. 
 - Apply security and data-protection practices - input validation, secure auth/session handling, careful treatment of user data - as a default part of the code you ship, not a step someone else checks for. 
 - Optimize application performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals) as an ongoing part of feature work. 
 - Own the quality of your changes through automated tests (unit, component, and end-to-end), CI stability, and production validation. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Content Operations to deliver and harden high-impact learner and educator workflows. 
 - Contribute to engineering quality through strong code reviews - including review of AI-generated code - reusable patterns, shared components, and clear documentation that keeps technical debt low. 
 - Ship end-to-end changes across the web application and its supporting APIs/schema, as needed. 

Required Qualifications

- Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of features from design through launch. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with React and Next. js, and comfort working in TypeScript. 
 - Working knowledge of web fundamentals - common security pitfalls (XSS, CSRF, auth/session handling), performance (rendering strategy, bundle size, Core Web Vitals), and accessibility (WCAG/ARIA basics) - and the judgment to apply them without being told to. 
 - Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms - GraphQL (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real-time protocols such as WebSockets - and working with at least one modern client-state approach (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar). 
 - Strong testing and release-validation discipline - unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress). 
 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce. 
 - Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with a CSS-in-JS styling approach and working alongside a component library (e. g. , MUI). 
 - Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure concepts (compute, storage, networking, basic service architecture) and some Node. js backend exposure - enough of a foundation to ramp into our Kotlin/Java or Python backend services when needed, even without prior production experience in those languages. 
 - Experience with Auth0 or similar authentication providers in a Next. js application. 
 - Experience shipping AI-powered UI - streaming responses, structured output rendering, graceful handling of model failures. 
 - Experience contributing to shared component libraries or tooling used across multiple teams/repos. 
 - Familiarity with frontend observability tooling (New Relic or similar). 
 - Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or another consumer-facing product company. 

Tech Stack

- Frontend: React (18/19), Next. js, TypeScript, GraphQL (Apollo tooling, codegen against a shared supergraph), React Query / Redux Toolkit / Zustand, styled-components, MUI
 - Backend (foundational): Node. js, AWS (compute/storage/networking basics) - enough to ramp into Kotlin/Java (Spring) or Python (FastAPI/Django) services owned by backend engineering
 - Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, MSW
 - Auth / Delivery: Auth0, GitLab CI
 - Observability: New Relic
 - AI / ML: OpenAI, AWS Bedrock (via shared backend integrations)

Why do we exist?

Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we've expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student.

data.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and. . . To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale-faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. 

Group/Division

The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets - with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network. 

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. 

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. 

The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world's leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow's electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. 

The Global Service Support Organization (GSS) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA, is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The GSS organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. 

The GSS organization's Engineering group develops data systems for improved diagnostics and predictive maintenance. The data systems monitor the performance of fleets of KLA test and measurement equipment in semiconductor fabrication plant environments. They collect, transform, and store data. They provide visualizations, recommendations based on analytics, and alerts. This exciting position will enable you to interact with a wide variety of engineers and KLA system data. 

Responsibilities: 

Do you have a passion for coding, data exploration, and UI design? Are you looking for a role where you can develop reactive, modern user interfaces working with highly collaborative teams?

As a Software engineer, you will work with our team of software, data and algorithm engineers on the design and development of web applications using real-time data visualization tools. Collaborating with domain experts and software engineers, you will gather requirements, translate user needs to design and develop software specifications, select software components, follow best coding practices, and develop User Interfaces that help our engineers to more effectively monitor, diagnose and optimize KLA semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment.

 - Familiarity with NodeJS, ASP. NET Core, Django or similar back end frameworks
 - Experience working in a service-oriented or microservice architecture
 - Experience with modern software engineering practices (XP)
 - Experience using artificial intelligence in software engineering
 - Experience working in a service-oriented or microservice architecture

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

data.title: SR SIMULATION ENGINEER
data.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world. 

Company

Job Overview

TE Connectivity Ltd. is a $19. 9 billion global technology and manufacturing leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. For more than 85 years, our connectivity and sensor solutions, proven in the harshest environments, have enabled advancements in transportation, industrial applications, medical technology, energy, data communications, and the home. With 90, 000 employees, including more than 8, 000 engineers, working alongside customers in approximately 140 countries, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www. te. com

Bu / Function Description

The Sr. Simulation Engineer will report to Manager R&D/Product DVL Engineer and will be part of Product design and Simulation department of Energy BU. The simulation team supports various product line of Energy business by evaluating designs using standard FEA software's. 

ROLE OBJECTIVE

Drive simulation-led product development using advanced FEA to ensure product robustness and reliability. Standardize simulation practices and develop advanced methodologies. 

Responsibilities

- Validate concept and detailed designs using advanced FEA techniques, assess design robustness, identify critical failure modes and verify functional and performance requirements. 
 - Develop and deploy advanced simulation methodologies: Apply implicit and explicit FEA approaches for nonlinear structural, thermal, dynamic and coupled-field analysis using tools such as ANSYS Workbench, LS-DYNA, HyperMesh and Digimat. 
 - Collaborate with product design and validation teams to optimize product performance, reduce development cycle time, improve product reliability and achieve cost-effective designs. 
 - Correlate simulation results with physical validation and experimental data, identify gaps and continuously improve simulation accuracy and predictive capabilities. 
 - Develop standardized simulation methodologies, workflows, guidelines and quality review processes to ensure consistency, accuracy and repeatability of results. 
 - Evaluate emerging simulation technologies, software capabilities and industry trends to enhance engineering productivity and technical competitiveness. 
 - Review and approve simulation methodologies, assumptions, material properties, boundary conditions and results. Ensure technical robustness and credibility of simulation deliverables. 
 - Mentor, train and develop product development engineers in adopting standardized FEA techniques. 

Candidate Desired Profile

EDUCATION/KNOWLEDGE

- BE/BTech (Mechanical) is mandatory; ME/MTech in Applied Mechanics / Solid Mechanics/Machine Design will be an added advantage. 
 - Knowledge of product, design processes and methodology. 
 - Expertise on CAE tools, Optimization techniques (DOE), and testing methods. 
 - Correlation of Test and simulation data / results. 
 - Able to understand the test standards (IEC/IEEE/UL) and reports which was used in evaluating new product design. 

Critical Experience

- 10+ years of hands-on industry experience in Finite Element Analysis (FEA), preferably in mechanical product development or engineering. 
 - Strong expertise in nonlinear structural analysis using ANSYS Workbench and LS-DYNA
 - Demonstrated experience in advanced material modelling, including plasticity, hyper elasticity and viscoelasticity, with a strong understanding of thermoset and thermoplastic material behavior. 
 - Strong knowledge of contact mechanics, frictional contact and interference fit analysis, including prediction of interface pressure and contact forces. 
 - Hands-on experience in coupled thermal-electrical-structural simulations, including Joule heating, contact resistance and temperature-rise prediction. 
 - Must have hands-on experience in simulating thermoset and thermoplastic components, including appropriate material characterization and modelling. 
 - Experience is power connector industry is an added advantage. 
 - Experience in structural vibration, modal, harmonic and random vibration analysis. 
 - Experience in short-circuit electromechanical force simulations is an advantage, 
 - Experience in transient dynamic, shock, impact and drop-test simulations is an advantage. 
 - Knowledge of creep, stress relaxation, fatigue and thermal cycling analysis for long-term product performance is an advantage. 
 - Experience in developing macros and automation scripts using Python, ANSYS Mechanical scripting and APDL is an advantage. 
 - Experience in simulation-driven design optimization (DOE/optiSlang) is an advantage

COMPETENCIES

- System and Product knowledge: Thorough understanding of customer requirements, product and application needs, required for creating effective designs
 - Conceptual thinking: Being able to see a broad picture, understand problems by putting the pieces together and simplify complex issues. 
 - Communication skills: Fluent communication skills to be able to articulate well with customers and teams across different functions & locations. 
 - Internal stakeholder management: Manage requests, address customer requirements and work effectively with different cross-functional teams. 

What Your Background Should Look Like

Generally requires Bachelors degree in appropriate field with a minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible professional level experience; Masters degree or higher or local equivalent may be preferred at this level

About Te Connectivity

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. 

Our more than 90, 000 employees, including 10, 000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www. te. com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter). 

What Te Connectivity Offers

We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations - the well-being of our employees is our top priority!

- Competitive Salary Package
 - Performance-Based Bonus Plans
 - Health and Wellness Incentives
 - Employee Stock Purchase Program
 - Community Outreach Programs / Charity Events
 - Employee Resource Group

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD

TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te. com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te. com. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities. 

Across our global sites and business units, we put together packages of benefits that are either supported by TE itself or provided by external service providers. In principle, the benefits offered can vary from site to site.

We are looking for a skilled JavaScript Developer with 3 years of software engineering experience who is ready to pivot into a dedicated Quality Engineering / SDET role. Your background in building web applications gives you an unfair advantage: you understand how code breaks, how APIs communicate, and how to write clean, maintainable, and scalable test automation frameworks. In this role, you will own end-to-end product quality by building modern automation suites, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating closely with product and development teams. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Automation Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable UI and API automation frameworks using JavaScript/TypeScript and modern testing tools (e. g. , Playwright, Cypress, Jest, or WebdriverIO).

 - Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis: Debug test failures, isolate root causes in application code, log clear defect reports (Jira), and verify bug fixes.

Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of hands-on experience in JavaScript (ES6+) and/or TypeScript.

 - Solid grasp of RESTful APIs, HTTP protocols, JSON/XML, and browser developer tools.

 - Analytical mindset with a keen eye for edge cases, race conditions, and user experience flaws.

data.description:
About Revantage

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services. 

With a corporate purpose of 'In Pursuit of Better, ' Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company's footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. 

Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry. 

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform. 

India

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality. 

Whether you're building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you'll have the opportunity to truly Build What Matters. 

Role Summary

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester for , a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India. 

The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it. The role supports both the in-flight Oracle implementation - including system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data conversion validation and cutover readiness - and the ongoing steady-state testing that follows go-live, including enhancement testing, defect regression and validation of Oracle's quarterly release updates. The QA Tester partners closely with US-based IT leadership, functional and technical analysts, system integration partners and business process owners to ensure that changes to the Oracle ecosystem are delivered accurately, are thoroughly documented and do not disrupt downstream finance and operations processes. 

Primary Role - Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems

- Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements. 
 - Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, as assigned by the QA Lead. 
 - Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, validating that business processes function correctly from source system, through Oracle, and out to downstream consumers. 
 - Test inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion and property management, banking, treasury, payroll, procurement and reporting systems, including file-based interfaces, APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud flows; validate payload accuracy, error handling, reprocessing and exception reporting. 
 - Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle. 
 - Test reports, dashboards and analytics developed in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio and Fusion Data Intelligence, reconciling output to source data and confirming correct parameters, security and formatting. 
 - Support user acceptance testing, including preparation of business-facing test scripts, coordination of tester schedules, hands-on support to business users during execution, and tracking of UAT results through to closure. 
 - Plan and execute regression testing for Oracle's quarterly release updates, assessing the impact of new features and patches on existing configurations, integrations, reports and extensions. 
 - Log, triage, document and track defects through resolution in the program's defect management tool, including clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence and appropriate severity and priority classification, and partner with functional and technical teams on root cause analysis and retest. 
 - Maintain the test case repository, requirements traceability matrices and test evidence to ensure complete coverage of requirements and to satisfy internal control, audit and SOX documentation standards. 
 - Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change. 
 - Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team. 
 - Provide accurate daily updates on test execution progress, blockers and open defects to leadership. 
 - Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify testability gaps, ambiguous requirements and delivery risks early in the lifecycle. Validate security roles, user provisioning and segregation of duties configurations as part of testing cycles. 
 - Support cutover and post-go-live validation activities, including production smoke testing, hypercare defect triage and verification of fixes in the production environment. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA standards, templates, testing methodology and automation coverage across the Oracle program. 
 - Must be able to work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with a shift aligned to US Central Time and available until 11: 00 AM CT Flexibility is expected during testing cycles, cutover events, quarterly update windows and other peak periods. 
 - daily. 
 - Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned. 

Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, accounting or a related field is required. 

Minimum of three years of software quality assurance and testing experience, including at least one year testing enterprise ERP applications, is required. 

- Must have hands-on testing experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is required; coverage across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management or Procurement is preferred. 
 - Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and cutover, is strongly preferred. 
 - Demonstrated experience testing system integrations and interfaces, including file-based feeds, web services and APIs, and middleware such as Oracle Integration Cloud, is required. 
 - Experience validating reports and data in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio or Fusion Data Intelligence is preferred. 
 - Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently query and reconcile data between source systems and Oracle is preferred. 
 - Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest or similar is required. 
 - Familiarity with Oracle's quarterly update cycle and the associated regression testing approach is preferred. 
 - Working understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including record to report, procure to pay and order to cash, sufficient to test business scenarios meaningfully; real estate, property management or student housing experience is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with SOX and IT general control requirements as they relate to testing documentation and evidence retention is preferred. 
 - ISTQB certification or an equivalent quality assurance credential would be a plus . 
 - Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the discipline to document findings clearly and completely. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, test results and risks clearly to onshore technical and business stakeholders. 
 - Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities against fixed delivery deadlines and to work independently with limited onshore supervision. 
 - Demonstrates a positive attitude and maintains a high level of professionalism when working with onshore stakeholders and leadership across time zones.

data.title: Manager, Programmtic/ETO Industrialization
data.description:
What You'll Do

The Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) Center of Excellence develops and deploys manufacturing solutions for electrical products across global operations. This role leads a Pune-based engineering team responsible for the programmatic industrialization portfolio supporting power distribution product line assemblies across north-america as well as EMEA. The manager owns portfolio delivery, people leadership and the technical quality of manufacturing packages that convert product designs into safe, repeatable and production-ready processes. The scope includes engineer-to-order / programmatic and configurable medium- and low-voltage electrical assemblies, product transfers, new-product and new-line industrialization, manufacturing process development, advanced equipment and automation concepts, digital manufacturing integration, launch readiness and production stabilization. The role works closely with product engineering, plant engineering, operations, quality, supply chain, EHS, IT/OT and equipment suppliers to ensure manufacturing solutions are practical, scalable and aligned with business and plant requirements. 

- Portfolio Leadership: Own delivery of the PDCA programmatic industrialization portfolio and the EMEA advanced manufacturing portfolio, translating business priorities into a governed roadmap, resource plan, milestones, technical deliverables and measurable outcomes. 
 - People Leadership: Build, coach and develop a high-performing team of permanent and contract manufacturing engineers; establish role clarity, technical depth, development plans, succession coverage and an inclusive performance culture. 
 - Programmatic Industrialization: Establish repeatable methods for industrializing configurable and engineer-to-order electrical products across multiple plants, reducing variation while preserving required product and regional flexibility. 
 - Manufacturing Package Ownership: Govern the quality and release readiness of MBOMs, routings, process flows, work-center definitions, standard work, work instructions, tooling requirements, process parameters, inspection points and training content. 
 - Product-to-Process Translation: Ensure product architecture, EBOMs, drawings, specifications, critical-to-quality characteristics and compliance requirements are converted into executable manufacturing methods and controls. 
 - PDCA Portfolio Delivery: Lead standardized industrialization for medium- and low-voltage electrical assemblies, including switchgear, switchboards, motor control centers, busway and related configured products, with emphasis on build-ready documentation, repeatability and efficient deployment. 
 - EMEA Advanced Manufacturing: Lead development and deployment of higher-complexity manufacturing solutions involving automation, semi-automated processes, robotics, integrated testing, vision systems, digital work instructions, MES connectivity, process-data capture, traceability and error proofing. 
 - Electrical Assembly Process Development: Govern assembly concepts covering mechanical build, busbar preparation and installation, wiring, cable processing, torque-controlled fastening, labeling, component verification, functional testing, dielectric testing, final inspection and serialization. 
 - Fabrication Process Development: Provide technical leadership for sheet-metal and fabrication processes including cutting, punching, bending, forming, welding, grinding, deburring, surface preparation, paint or powder coating, curing, inspection and material handling. 

Qualifications

Master Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Production Engineering or a related discipline. 

6 - 8 years of relevant manufacturing engineering or industrialization experience, including leadership of engineers and delivery across multiple plants, programs or regions. 

Skills

Technical Knowledge

Electrical Product Industrialization: Experience industrializing MV/LV switchgear, switchboards, motor control centers, busway, or comparable configurable/engineer-to-order products. 

Product-to-Manufacturing Translation: Strong knowledge of EBOM-to-MBOM conversion, routings, process flows, work centers, standard work, and digital/visual work instructions. 

Electrical Assembly Processes: Expertise in assembly tooling, torque-controlled fastening, wire/cable processing, busbar manufacturing, labeling, functional/dielectric testing, inspection, and traceability. 

Manufacturing & Line Design: Ability to design processes and production lines using product mix, volume, takt, cycle time, capacity, ergonomics, safety, quality, and material-flow requirements. 

Soft Skills

People Leadership: Builds capable teams, develops talent, sets clear expectations, and drives accountability. 

Strategic Thinking: Converts complex product and plant needs into practical, scalable manufacturing strategies. 

Decision Making: Balances safety, quality, delivery, cost, flexibility, maintainability, and lifecycle value. 

Influencing: Works effectively across a global matrix and influences without direct authority. 

Communication: Communicates complex technical and portfolio topics clearly to engineering teams, plant leaders, business stakeholders, and executives. 

Problem Solving: Challenges assumptions constructively and drives fact-based decisions. 

Execution: Manages ambiguity, competing priorities, and change while maintaining delivery discipline. 

Collaboration: Builds strong partnerships with plants, suppliers, and cross-functional teams through launch and stabilization. 

Inclusive Leadership: Creates an inclusive environment and develops future technical and people leaders. 

Global Mindset: Comfortable working across time zones and traveling to manufacturing sites and suppliers as required.

data.description:

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The ideal candidate should have deep hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST API development, database design, and backend integration. Required Technical Skills

- 12-15 years of overall software development experience, with significant experience in backend application development. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in Java and object-oriented programming. 
 - Strong experience with Spring Boot and the broader Spring ecosystem. 
 - Strong experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and backend services. 
 - Good understanding of API design principles, HTTP standards, authentication, authorization, and error handling. 
 - Strong experience in database design, data modeling, normalization, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong proficiency in SQL and database query optimization. 
 - Experience with ORM and persistence frameworks such as Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Strong understanding of backend integration patterns and enterprise application integration. 
 - Experience integrating applications with internal and external services through REST APIs, messaging, or other integration mechanisms. 
 - Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading, asynchronous processing, and transaction management. 
 - Experience developing modular, reusable, and maintainable backend components. 
 - Strong understanding of application security and secure API development. 
 - Familiarity with unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks. 
 - Experience with source control systems such as Git. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern software development practices. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience working on large-scale enterprise applications and distributed systems. 
 - Experience with microservices-based applications. 
 - Knowledge of messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS, or equivalent solutions. 
 - Experience with caching technologies such as Redis or similar platforms. 
 - Experience with API documentation tools such as OpenAPI/Swagger. 
 - Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
 - Understanding of logging, monitoring, tracing, and observability practices. 
 - Experience with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Exposure to event-driven systems and asynchronous integration patterns. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum software development environments. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to translate business and system requirements into robust backend solutions. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability for technical deliverables. 
 - Ability to lead technical discussions and influence solution decisions. 
 - Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams. 
 - Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex backend, database, and integration issues. 
 - Strong focus on software quality, reliability, and engineering excellence. 

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer, Vice President
data.description:
Join us as a Site Reliability Engineer

- In this key role, you'll improve, drive, and embed non-functional and operational characteristics such as availability, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, security, incident response, and capacity planning of our products and services
 - You'll enjoy significant stakeholder interaction, working in collaboration with engineers to ensure a principled approach to deliver change in a safe and secure way
 - This is a chance to join an inclusive team with a collaborative ethos and a commitment to innovation and professional development
 - We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do

As our Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work closely with our feature team and other colleagues to meet defined service level objectives and continually improve systems and environments. You'll define error budgets that support finding the right balance between risk and reliability. 

You'll also provide structure and help to our release process, suggesting and making improvements where possible. You'll scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, evolving them by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity. We'll also look to you to coach and provide guidance to colleagues and the wider team, leading where required. 

In Addition To This, You'll

- Proactively contribute new ideas and innovations to meet short term and longer-term goals
 - Continually balance and manage any potential risks
 - Be accountable for the day-to-day health of both production and non-production environments and respond to any incidents as required
 - Provide technical expertise and input to establish the risk tolerance of products and services
 - Communicate incident status updates clearly and frequently to other teams, customers and stakeholders

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with strong knowledge of reliability systems thinking and experience of software engineering. You'll need experience of using a data driven and scientific approach to fact finding. We'll also look for financial services knowledge, and the ability to identify wider business impact, risk and opportunity, and make connections across key outputs and processes

We're Also Looking For

- Programming / Scripting experience with Python, Go or Bash
 - Experience in Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred)
 - Strong knowledge of deploy and release services, automation, and troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD and blue/green deployments for decisioning engines
 - Deep AWS expertise in high-scale systems and event-driven architectures
 - Strong knowledge of Kafka, API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS (Kubernetes), CloudWatch / Prometheus / Datadog, DynamoDB, Aurora
 - Experience using mathematical and statistical models to assess trends
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to proactively engage with a wide range of stakeholders

Summary

UST is looking for dotnet full stack developer with dotnet core and modern UI frameworks such as typescript / javascript. This is for Bangalore location and 5 days of work from office. 

The Opportunity

Build and maintain production . NET applications backed by SQL Server. You will own features end to end - data model, query layer, API, and UI - and be accountable for the performance and correctness of what you ship. This role requires someone who can read unfamiliar code, identify the actual defect, and produce a complete fix without being walked to it. 

What You Need

Code analysis

Can take an unfamiliar code sample and, without prompting or reframing, state the problem, state the fix, and produce the corrected implementation. 

Reads existing code for correctness and performance problems and delivers a complete, reviewable change - not a direction to explore. 

States the tradeoffs of the fix out loud: edge cases, null and error handling, concurrency, and maintainability. 

Root-cause analysis and debugging

A repeatable process: reproduce, form and test a hypothesis, use logs and telemetry as evidence, apply a targeted fix, cover it with regression tests, and verify after deployment. 

Can describe a specific production defect you did not write - how you found the cause, and how you proved the fix was the fix. 

Data and performance

Practical experience making a real workload faster in any relational database, and able to explain what you changed and how you measured the result. 

Can reason about where work happens between application and database, the cost of a data-access pattern, and the read and write tradeoffs of an index. 

Uses query plans or profiling output as evidence rather than guessing. 

Concurrency and correctness

Experience with systems under concurrent load: race conditions, transaction or locking boundaries, idempotency, and what happens when a process dies mid-operation. 

Ownership and judgment

Demonstrated ownership of a missed or at-risk deadline: can describe a specific project, when the risk was first recognized, what was escalated and to whom, the final outcome, and what changed afterward. 

Challenges unnecessary complexity and proposes simpler designs with explicit tradeoffs on security, recovery, and versioning. 

Ramp speed

Evidence of picking up an unfamiliar language, framework, or domain and shipping production work in it. 

Professional experience building server-side systems with real users and real load, in any language

Global Head of Engineering - Component Forging Business

SVP reporting to COO

Mundhawa, Pune

Lead Global Engineering function of Component Forging Division with an objective of rapid new product development for our global customers and thereby build vital product portfolio for the company.

- Engineering Strategy: Create vision for Engineering Function based on business strategy & objectives while working with clients and teams across the globe. Define & deploy Engineering Strategy pertaining to product development in terms of capabilities, capacity, and infrastructure as well as manufacturing technology to meet business growth aspiration and customer needs. Prepare annual budget & plan for the engineering function. 
 - New Product Identification: Interface closely with Sales & Business Development Leaders and Key Customers to understand new product opportunities pertaining to components, subsystems and/or systems. Conduct market/ competition analysis, visit customers including Purchase, Manufacturing and R&D organisation to understand their priorities and visualise their needs. Obtain RFQ from the customers, prepare detailed product development report and contribute preparing business cases for such opportunities in terms feasibility (make vs buy- cost, time, capabilities) and obtain contract award.

Prepare project plans for critical projects including prototypes approvals, specification finalisation, equipment selection, manufacturing process & process parameters finalisation, Process Optimisation and launch. Provide technical guidance & resources to the development teams accordingly. Ensure optimised but robust method/ process transfer to manufacturing (with built-in Safety and Quality) and smooth commercialisation. Ensure validation of drawing and design document qualification. 
 - Project Management: Deploy appropriate project management tool (MS-P or PLM) defining critical milestones and tasks with duration required to ensure that new products are delivered on time. Review all such projects periodically with stakeholders at stage-gates and identify risks/ bottlenecks pertaining to technical challenges or project timelines (delays) and take proactive actions to mitigate risk. Ensure various stakeholder involved in product development are aligned on objectives. Enable seamless and real-time communication across the stakeholders on project status and technical/ administrative challenges. 
 - Manufacturing / Customer Support: Troubleshoot post commercial challenges pertaining quality, cost and time as raised by manufacturing in terms of efficiency improvement (Yield, Process Time, Product non-conformance, Manufacturing cost) and/ or customer complaint or market failure. Identify new innovative solutions to address such issues using first principles, FMEA, VAVE. Bring new product/manufacturing technology to address customer needs and internal efficiencies. Provide technical support to the business development team in contract estimations and onsite engineering support at customer site. Develop key strategic partnerships and collaborations with clients and technology companies to enhance market-share. 
 - Capability Building: Deploy latest technology and tools in Engineering function pertaining to CAD/CAM/CAE, modelling, analysis using algorithms and simulation. Develop and build solid Engineering Team as per business strategy and plan. Define their priorities and goals. Build deep scientific/ technical expertise in the team by asking rationale, providing literature, publishing papers in reputed journals, and filing patent pertaining to intellectual property. Create and implement best engineering processes and systems to deliver excellence (Timely, Product Cost & Specifications). Represent company in Technology conference and Engineering Institute. Provide exposure to Design team about customers manufacturing process and products though visits and interactions. 

Qualifications And Experience

Graduate/Postgraduate in Mechanical/ Metallurgy Engineering from a reputed institute with 20 plus years of experience in Automobile/ Auto-component (Transmission, Gear-Box/ Drive, Chassis/Suspension) industry in product Design and Development/ Engineering. Last 5 years should be in leadership role in medium to large R & D/ Engineering organisation is a must. Practical application experience of DFSS/ CMMI. 

Knowledge And Skills

Deep expertise in Manufacturing process (Forging, Machining & assembly) and equipment. Profound understanding of Material Science and Metallurgy pertaining to Auto components. Deep knowledge of standards like (IATF, ISO 19000). Hands-on experience in Product Development as well as Project Management process. Customer intimacy and Commercial acumen. 

Personality

Self-Driven, Inspiring, Decisive, Perseverance, Visionary, Personal integrity, and professional ethics. 

KPIs

Timely New Product Development & Launch, Product Cost, Product Failures post commercialisation (robustness), Customer satisfaction index, Product Innovation- Value of new product pipeline.

data.title: Platform Infrastructure DevSecOps Developer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer

The opportunity

In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for an innovative AI-Native DevSecOps Developer to rapidly design, build and ship custom software products that automate, orchestrate and modernize EY's infrastructure platform engineering capabilities. This is not a traditional software engineering role - it is a product builder position for someone who uses AI as their primary development accelerator and who thrives on shipping working software quickly. 

The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-native internal products - self-service infrastructure portals, workflow orchestration engines, policy-as-code enforcement systems and operational automation platforms - built on modern cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes, Temporal, Terraform and Angular. They will have sufficient infrastructure awareness to understand the operational context of what they are building, and will work closely with I&O engineering teams to translate complex infrastructure workflows into elegant, automated, AI-augmented software solutions. 

Your Key Responsibilities

The I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer designs and delivers bespoke internal software products that eliminate manual infrastructure workflows, accelerate provisioning and give engineers and stakeholders real-time, self-service operational visibility. Drawing on AI coding tools as a core development accelerant, this professional dramatically compresses delivery timelines - prototyping, iterating and shipping production-grade software at a pace that traditional development workflows cannot match. 

The role spans the full software development lifecycle - from requirements and architecture through build, test, security hardening, deployment and ongoing improvement - with a security-first mindset embedded at every stage. The developer will own the product delivery end-to-end, partnering with I&O platform engineers, architects and service management stakeholders to ensure what is built reflects the real operational needs of the infrastructure estate and is designed to scale across EY's global data center footprint. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade software rapidly using AI development tools as a primary delivery accelerant (exclusionary). 
 - Deep, active use of AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle, including: 
 - GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI pair-programming tools
 - ChatGPT, Claude or similar LLMs for architecture design, code generation and review
 - AI-assisted test generation, security scanning and code refactoring
 - Prompt engineering for development workflow automation
 - Strong full-stack development capability across front-end and back-end disciplines: 
 - Angular (v14+) for self-service portal and operational UI development
 - Python or Go for back-end services, APIs and automation engines
 - REST and GraphQL API design and implementation
 - Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, particularly Temporal. io. 
 - Strong Kubernetes engineering skills - deployment, Helm charts, operators, RBAC and namespace management. 
 - Infrastructure-as-Code authoring using Terraform and Ansible for provisioning automation. 
 - Strong DevSecOps pipeline development - CI/CD design, security gate integration and automated deployment: 
 - GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines
 - SAST/DAST tooling integration (Snyk, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP or equivalent)
 - Container image scanning and policy enforcement (Trivy, Cosign, OPA/Gatekeeper)
 - Policy-as-Code implementation using Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent. 
 - Experience building AI-native product features, including: 
 - LLM integration via API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent)
 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns for operational knowledge bases
 - AI-driven workflow decision making and self-healing automation
 - Copilot / chat interface integration into operational tooling
 - Sufficient infrastructure platform knowledge to design software that reflects real-world operational constraints: 
 - Virtualization and hyperconverged infrastructure concepts (Nutanix, Hyper-V, VMware)
 - Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
 - Networking concepts - VLANs, DNS, IP management, load balancing
 - Storage and compute provisioning workflows
 - ServiceNow ITSM integration patterns
 - Strong software product ownership mindset - able to take a problem statement from whiteboard to production with minimal hand-holding. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to demo working software and articulate product decisions to both technical and executive audiences. 
 - Strong working knowledge of Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks. 

To qualify for the role, you must have experience with

- Full-stack software product development and delivery - 5-7 years. 
 - AI-assisted software development as an active daily workflow - 2+ years. 
 - Angular front-end application development (v14+) - 3-5 years. 
 - Python or Go back-end service development - 5+ years. 
 - Kubernetes cluster management and application deployment - 3-5 years. 
 - Terraform and Ansible Infrastructure-as-Code authoring - 3-5 years. 
 - Temporal. io or equivalent workflow orchestration platform (Argo, Conductor or equivalent). 
 - CI/CD pipeline development with integrated security gates - 3-5 years. 
 - LLM API integration for production AI-native product features. 
 - Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent policy-as-code enforcement. 
 - REST API design, development and documentation. 
 - Container build, scanning and secure image management (Docker, Podman). 
 - Git-based source control and pull-request-driven development workflows (GitHub, Azure DevOps). 
 - SAST/DAST security tooling integration in CI pipelines. 
 - ITSM platform integration - ServiceNow API or equivalent. 
 - Agile sprint-based delivery with regular demo and release cadences. 
 - Infrastructure provisioning workflow automation (VM builds, network configuration, DNS/IP management). 
 - Helm chart authoring for Kubernetes application packaging and deployment. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or equivalent cloud certification (desired). 
 - Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or CKA certification (better to have). 
 - HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification (desired). 
 - ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary). 
 - Experience building on or integrating with Nutanix platform APIs (NCM, Prism, Calm). 
 - Experience with Temporal Cloud or self-hosted Temporal cluster operations. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio or Azure AI Studio for enterprise AI product development. 
 - Familiarity with GitOps patterns using ArgoCD or Flux for continuous deployment. 
 - Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure automation projects. 

What We Look For

A builder - someone who moves fast, thinks in systems and ships working software that solves real infrastructure problems. We are looking for an individual who genuinely uses AI as a development superpower, who understands enough about infrastructure to design software that works in the real world, and who takes pride in owning a product end-to-end from first commit to production. The ideal candidate has already built something like HCSP - a platform that replaces manual, multi-portal, error-prone operational workflows with a single automated, observable, self-healing system - and is ready to do it again at EY scale. 

What We Offer

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer: 

- Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

 - Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) - Autofill Coverage
data.description:
Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with the leading open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations. Our philosophy on security is that "we are all in this together" - we continue to offer a full-featured free version of Bitwarden so that everyone can be protected with strong password management. We also provide enterprise-grade solutions to some of the largest companies in the world, and will continue to innovate in the identity and authentication market as the world starts to grow beyond passwords. Read more on the Bitwarden blog. 

As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on Bitwarden's Autofill Coverage team, you will help make autofill work reliably on the sites people actually use, and keep it fast and unobtrusive as the product evolves. Autofill is the Bitwarden capability that fills logins, payment details, and identities into web forms across browsers. The Autofill Coverage team maintains and expands a curated dataset of site-specific autofill rules, builds automation that continuously checks autofill across popular websites, and builds lab-based measurement of autofill's performance in the browser. Every engineer on the team works across all of this, so we value curiosity and range over a perfect match to any single tool. This is a hands-on role. You will spend your time writing, reviewing, and shipping code, alongside your teammatesand in close partnership with the wider Autofill team. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- UI Automation: Build and maintain browser automation that checks autofill across popular real-world websites and purpose-built test pages. Keep suites stable as sites change, with reliable locators, sensible waits, and flakiness fixed at its root. 
 - Performance Testing: Run, extend, and maintain lab-based benchmarks that measure how autofill affects page responsiveness, rendering, and memory in the browser. Set up runs, review results, and investigate numbers that look wrong. 
 - Trustworthy Results: Make sure test and benchmark results can be relied on. Confirm that two runs did the same work before comparing them, and flag misleading metrics before anyone acts on them. 
 - Test Scenarios: Build and maintain test pages that recreate tricky real-world patterns, such as dynamic forms, shadow DOM, and iframes, so they can be tested repeatably. 
 - Failure Triage: Reproduce autofill failures found by automation, support, or internal reports. Document them clearly, hand dataset fixes to teammates, and route the rest to the right owner. 
 - Reporting and Observability: Publish results to dashboards, set up alerting on regressions, and report coverage and trends on a regular cadence. 
 - AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants effectively in daily engineering and exercise judgement about where they help and where they do not. Help keep test documentation and Claude skills current as new autofill code lands. 
 - Learning and Collaboration: Pair with senior engineers on hard problems, share what you learn, and review teammates' pull requests with care. 
 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Software Engineer teammates, the Autofill team, Product, and Security on triage, test strategy, and release coordination. 

WHAT YOU BRING

- Overall Experience: 4-8 years in test automation, SDET, or software engineering roles, with hands-on UI automation of web applications and exposure to front-end performance testing. 
 - Technical Stack: We value strong automation fundamentals and a performance mindset over an exact tool match. Experience with load-testing tools such as JMeter or k6 is welcome, but this role centres on performance inside the browser. 
 - Expertise- UI automation with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium/WebDriver, or Puppeteer, including stable locators, waits, and handling flaky tests JavaScript or TypeScript, and Node. js HTML, the DOM, and CSS selectors Front-end performance testing with the Chrome DevTools Performance panel, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, or Core Web Vitals tooling
 - Experience- CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar, and running tests in Docker. Interpreting performance results: percentiles, variance, and comparing runs fairly Dashboards and alerting with Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, or similar. Data or API validation with JSON Schema, Postman, or similar AI-assisted development, preferably Claude Code
 - Familiarity- Chrome DevTools Protocol and browser Performance APIs (PerformanceObserver, Long Tasks, User Timing) Browser extensions and how they are tested (Manifest V3) Shell scripting
 - Engineering Mindset: Curious about why a test failed, not just that it failed. You treat a flaky test or a surprising number as something to understand rather than rerun until green, and you pick up new tools quickly. 
 - Practical experience with containerized environments, automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. 
 - Secure Coding: Familiarity with secure coding practices and care in handling test credentials and sensitive data, with an interest in how security shapes product decisions in a zero-knowledge product. 
 - Collaborative Spirit: A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops. 
 - Open Source Passion: Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet. 
 - Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills, valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions. 

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. 

Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world. 

If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

Join our team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you'll help develop and test software for scientific instruments and laboratory solutions. As a Software Test Engineer III, you'll ensure the quality and reliability of our software products through comprehensive testing strategies. data.title: QA Lead
data.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2, 500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. 

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows-including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence-we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. 

What's Different About This Role

At Payoneer, quality isn't a gate at the end of the pipeline; it's woven into how teams design, build, and ship. This role is the person who makes that real. 

This is a leadership and hands-on role in equal measure. You'll set the quality strategy for large, cross-team features - defining test scope, coverage models, risk areas, and what 'production ready' actually means for each initiative. You'll review developer-written test plans, run E2E and exploratory testing on complex payment flows and microservice integrations, and own post-production validation. You influence architecture from a testability perspective - not as a reviewer, but as a voice in the room when design decisions are made. 

AI is changing how quality engineering works, and this role is where that shift happens at Payoneer. You'll use AI tools to accelerate test design, automate triage, scope regressions intelligently, and build QA workflows that didn't exist before. There's no inherited playbook for what AI-assisted QA looks like at fintech scale - you'll write it. 

What You'll Do

- Own the go/no-go decision for production releases - assess quality readiness, test execution status, and risk posture, and communicate your recommendation clearly to stakeholders
 - Lead end-to-end quality strategy for large, cross-team initiatives - from planning and design through production monitoring and user journey validation
 - Define test scope, coverage models, risk areas, rollout strategies, and quality KPIs for complex, multi-team features
 - Validate complex business flows - payments, integrations, microservices, and event-driven architectures - through E2E, regression, exploratory, and API testing
 - Use AI tools daily to accelerate test scenario design, defect triage, regression scoping, and coverage analysis - and build the QA workflows that make the whole team faster
 - Review and approve developer-written test plans; ensure coverage across positive, negative, edge, integration, and failure scenarios
 - Influence product design and system architecture from a testability perspective - raise quality concerns early, in the design room, not the post-mortem
 - Mentor developers and QA engineers on testing strategy, automation analysis, and quality best practices; standardize QA methodologies, tools, and processes across teams
 - Monitor production quality and own post-production validation; track and manage QA technical debt

What You Bring

- 5+ years in Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering, with meaningful experience in a QA Lead or Senior QA role
 - Hands-on experience with E2E, regression, exploratory, and API testing across web applications, microservices, and event-driven architectures
 - Strong SQL - you use it for defect investigation, data validation, and production analysis, not just basic queries
 - Experience as a QA gatekeeper for production releases - you've made the call under pressure and stood behind it
 - Hands-on experience with tools such as Postman, Swagger, mock tools, and test management systems
 - Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD practices
 - Experience with production monitoring and post-production validation
 - Daily use of AI tools to accelerate test design, scenario generation, defect triage, and regression scoping - genuinely fast, not occasional
 - Clear judgment about when AI-generated coverage is sufficient and when it needs human review and correction
 - Builds QA workflows and automations with AI assistance - not just individual prompts, but repeatable processes the team can rely on
 - Experience building and working with AI agents and AI-assisted tooling to improve testing efficiency and quality processes

Good To Have

- Familiarity with automation frameworks and hands-on automation execution analysis
 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and cloud-native architectures
 - MongoDB and RabbitMQ experience
 - Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

The DNA we're looking for

- Builder's itch. When you see QA teams re-running the same manual regression every sprint, or test plans being written from scratch for every feature, you can't leave it alone. You build the template, the workflow, the automation - and you teach the team to use it. Manual toil that a system could handle doesn't sit right with you. 
 - Grounded confidence. You're the person who delays a release when the data says it's not ready - even when the pressure is on. You make the call, communicate it clearly, and own it. When new information changes the picture, you update fast without drama. You don't need consensus before every decision. 
 - Production instinct. You don't just test the happy path. You're already thinking about failure modes, edge cases, and the scenario that only surfaces when real money is moving through the system. In a financial platform, a defect that slips to production isn't an abstract risk - it's a real person's transaction failing. That weight is present in how you work. 

Curious and adaptive. AI is changing what quality engineering looks like faster than most disciplines. You lean into that - picking up new tools, rethinking what test coverage can mean with AI assistance, and updating how you work before anyone tells you to. The QA playbook you bring on day one won't be the same one you're running six months later. 

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer's partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it. 

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today. 

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

About the role

As a Senior SDET you will own the test architecture and quality bar for the systems your team ships, and mentor other engineers on testability and clean automation practice. 

We are proponents of leveraging best-in-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle - design, development, review, and testing. Beyond the systems you personally test, you'll set the standards other engineers test against - the frameworks, CI/CD scaffolding, and quality gates that let the rest of the team move fast without breaking things.

Bangalore, India (100% on-site)

AI-powered QA

Skills
