data.title: Performance & Security Engineer (AI)
data.description:
AI Test and NFR Engineer - AI, Performance & Security

Role Overview

We are seeking an AI Test and NFR Engineer with 5+ years of experience with strong hands-on expertise in AI/GenAI Testing, AI-Assisted Quality Engineering, Performance Testing, Security Testing, and Non-Functional Testing to contribute to the quality engineering of enterprise-grade AI and SaaS products. 

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in testing AI-powered features (LLM-based assistants, agents, ML-driven analytics), using AI to accelerate test design, test data, automation, and defect analysis, and designing performance, load, stress, scalability, reliability, endurance, and security tests for web applications, APIs, databases, and distributed systems. 

The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to identify AI quality, performance, and security risks early, design effective test strategies, identify bottlenecks and vulnerabilities, and ensure production-ready quality. 

Must-Have: AI Testing & AI-Assisted QA

AI-Assisted QA: Hands-on use of AI for test design, test data generation, performance/security analysis, defect investigation, risk identification, and AI-assisted QA workflows. 

AI/GenAI Application Testing: Experience testing LLM-based features, agents, and ML-driven functionality for accuracy, consistency, safety, and regression, with defined evaluation criteria. 

AI Security & Privacy: Awareness of prompt injection and data leakage risks, and safe use of AI tools with production-like data. 

NFR for AI Systems: Performance, scalability, and reliability testing of AI-backed services. 

Key Responsibilities

1) AI/GenAI Application Testing

- Design test strategies and suites for AI-powered features such as LLM-based assistants, agents, search/RAG, and ML-driven analytics. 
 - Validate AI output for accuracy, relevance, consistency, grounding, and hallucination, using rubrics and acceptance thresholds suited to non-deterministic behavior. 
 - Build and maintain evaluation datasets and golden sets, and run AI regression testing for model, prompt, and data changes (evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, Ragas, or DeepEval are an advantage). 
 - Test agent and tool-calling workflows, including integrations with APIs and databases, error handling, and fallback behavior. 
 - Test safety, guardrails, and AI-specific security risks such as bias, prompt injection, jailbreaks, and data leakage, aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. 
 - Test latency, throughput, concurrency, rate limits, and timeouts of AI-backed services under load. 

2) AI-Assisted Testing & AI-Driven Analysis

- AI-Assisted Test Design: Use AI tools (e. g. , Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) to generate test scenarios, test data, API and performance scripts, and SQL validation queries, while critically validating AI output for accuracy and coverage. 
 - AI-Driven Analysis: Apply AI to analyze logs, API responses, and performance metrics for faster defect triage and root-cause identification, with awareness of data privacy when using production-like data. 
 - AI-Assisted QA Workflows: Build reusable prompts and AI-assisted workflows for the QA team and integrate them into regular test cycles. 
 - AI Result Validation: Verify that AI-generated test results, analysis, and pass/fail verdicts are correct by cross-checking them against requirements, source data, and independent manual or automated checks, and by spot-checking for false passes, missed defects, and hallucinated findings before relying on them. 

3) Performance Testing, Tools & Monitoring

- Design and execute performance test strategies, plans, scenarios, and realistic workload models based on business and technical requirements. 
 - Perform load, stress, spike, endurance/soak, scalability, and volume testing for REST APIs, web applications, backend services, databases, and integrated systems. 
 - Define and validate performance benchmarks and acceptance criteria for response time, throughput, latency, concurrency, and resource utilization. 
 - Analyze system behavior under peak and sustained loads, identify degradation patterns and bottlenecks across application, API, database, infrastructure, and network layers, and perform capacity analysis as users, transactions, and data volumes grow. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Apache JMeter or similar tools, including parameterized and data-driven tests; BlazeMeter or other cloud-based platforms is an advantage. 
 - Use monitoring and observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Splunk, or equivalent) to correlate test results with CPU, memory, database, network, JVM/application, and service-level metrics, and analyze logs to find the root cause of degradation. 
 - Work with Engineering and DevOps teams to investigate bottlenecks and validate performance improvements; experience in cloud and distributed environments is preferred. 
 - Perform performance regression testing for major releases and architectural changes, support production-readiness assessments, and prepare reports with observations, risks, and recommendations. 

4) Security Testing

- Strong understanding of web application and API security concepts. 
 - Good understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and common application security vulnerabilities; awareness of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications is an advantage. 
 - Hands-on experience with Burp Suite and/or OWASP ZAP. 
 - Perform security testing of web applications, REST APIs, and backend services. 
 - Test authentication and authorization mechanisms, including JWT, OAuth, session management, and role-based access control. 
 - Perform security testing for common vulnerabilities such as: 
 - Injection
 - Broken access control
 - Authentication and session-related vulnerabilities
 - Security misconfiguration
 - Sensitive data exposure
 - API security vulnerabilities
 - AI/LLM-specific vulnerabilities (e. g. , prompt injection, sensitive data leakage)
 - Perform positive and negative security testing for APIs and application workflows. 
 - Identify, document, prioritize, and track security vulnerabilities. 
 - Work closely with developers to understand security findings and validate remediation. 
 - Perform security regression testing after vulnerabilities are fixed. 
 - Support vulnerability assessment and security readiness activities before releases. 
 - Experience with SAST, DAST, dependency/security scanning, or vulnerability management tools is an advantage. 

5) API, Data & Quality Engineering

- API & Backend Testing: Hands-on experience in REST API testing using Postman, Swagger, or similar tools, including functional, negative, boundary, concurrency, performance, security, and integration testing. Ability to analyze API behavior, logs, and downstream service/database interactions is preferred. 
 - Database & Data Testing: Good understanding of SQL and database testing, including data validation, reconciliation, integrity, consistency, and database performance analysis across application layers and backend services. 
 - Functional & Exploratory Testing: Good understanding of SDLC/STLC with experience in functional, integration, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing; ability to identify functional gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks. 
 - Quality Engineering & Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, Infrastructure, and QA teams to identify performance, security, scalability, and quality risks early. 

6) Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in AI-assisted testing and AI/GenAI application testing, including LLM-based features, agents, or ML-driven functionality. 
 - Hands-on use of AI tools (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) for test design, test data, scripts, and defect analysis, with critical validation of AI output. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in Performance Testing and Security Testing. 
 - Strong experience with JMeter or equivalent performance testing tools. 
 - Hands-on experience with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or equivalent security testing tools. 
 - Good SQL and database testing knowledge. 
 - Experience testing web applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Good experience with JIRA or similar defect management tools. 
 - Experience working closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams. 

7) Skills & Attributes

- Strong understanding of how LLMs and AI systems behave (prompts, context, non-determinism, hallucination) and how to test them. 
 - Ability to define evaluation criteria for AI output, with awareness of responsible AI (bias, safety, privacy, security). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong understanding of performance engineering concepts and application bottleneck analysis. 
 - Strong understanding of web and API security principles. 
 - Ability to analyze large volumes of performance metrics and identify meaningful trends. 
 - Ability to investigate complex performance and security issues across multiple application layers. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, databases, and cloud environments. 
 - Good understanding of requirements, business workflows, and data models. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a quality-first mindset. 
 - Ability to independently design effective AI, performance, and security test scenarios. 
 - Good understanding of manufacturing processes is preferred. 
 - Functional understanding of ERP systems and data models is an advantage. 
 - Exposure to CSV, GxP, or other regulated environments is a plus. 
 - Experience with AI/ML applications or data-heavy platforms is an advantage. 
 - Good communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product engineering environment. 

8) What We Offer

- Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses. 
 - Comprehensive health and wellness benefits. 
 - Opportunity to test and shape AI-powered enterprise platforms and AI-assisted QA practices. 
 - Culture focused on innovation, learning, and technical excellence. 
 - Regular workshops, training programs, and tech talks. 

About Mareana

Mareana builds cutting-edge enterprise digital AI products focused on Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Sustainability. Our AI-driven platforms solve complex data challenges and deliver real-time insights, enabling businesses to accelerate digital transformation. 

We have delivered more than $1B+ in business value to global clients, including leading firms in life sciences, consumer goods, chemicals, food & beverage, and manufacturing. We are recognized by Gartner as a "Cool Vendor in AI" and have been featured in Silicon Review and Manufacturing Insights.

NationsBenefits is a healthcare fintech and benefits company that partners with Medicare, Medicaid and commercial health plans. Its supplemental benefits, flex card and member engagement solutions help members get more from their benefits and help plans improve outcomes. Our platforms process high volumes of real-time benefit transactions for millions of members

Role Summary: 

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader to own two connected charters from Hyderabad: 

1. Platform Engineering: the core, cloud-native . NET Customer platform that powers our payments, benefits adjudication and member-facing products. 

2. Consumer Direct Healthcare (CDH): the products and systems for consumer-directed accounts such as FSA, HSA and HRA. 

You will set the technical vision, build and grow a large engineering organization, and work closely with product, operations, compliance and business leaders in India and the US. This is not a purely managerial role. We expect you to stay close to architecture, code quality and delivery, and to step into the details when needed. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Platform Engineering:

• Own the . NET microservices and API ecosystem, cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred), CI/CD, observability and developer tooling. 

• Drive reliability through SLOs, incident management, disaster recovery and performance engineering. 

• Plan and validate capacity ahead of demand, including open enrollment and other seasonal peaks, through load, stress, soak and failover testing. 

• Design for horizontal scale using autoscaling, caching, asynchronous messaging and data partitioning, so growth in members and transactions doesn't require re-architecture. 

• Modernize legacy systems (for example, migrating to modern . NET versions) and reduce technical debt without disrupting live operations. 

• Champion engineering excellence: code reviews, testing automation, DevSecOps and documentation standards. 

Consumer Direct Healthcare: 

• Own the technology strategy and delivery for CDH products, including account administration, contributions, claims and reimbursements, card transactions, and eligibility and reconciliation. 

• Partner with product and compliance teams to translate regulatory and plan requirements into scalable technical solutions. 

• Oversee integrations with banks, card processors, payment networks, health plans, employers, retailers and third-party administrators. 

• Ensure real-time card authorization and claims processing meet strict latency and accuracy requirements at peak volume. 

• Identify opportunities to use data and AI to improve member experience, automation and fraud and risk controls. 

Leadership and Collaboration: 

• Lead, mentor and develop a 40+ person organization, including managers, architects and senior engineers. Build a strong leadership bench and succession plan. 

• Hire, onboard and retain top engineering talent in Hyderabad. Build a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous learning.

• Strong hands-on technical background in the Microsoft . NET stack (C#, . NET Core / modern . NET, ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework), with experience in distributed systems, microservices and cloud-native architecture (Docker/Kubernetes, and Azure preferred).

data.title: Solution Architect - Integration Specialist
data.description:
The Integration Architect & Specialist will be responsible for designing, governing and enabling enterprise integration architectures that seamlessly connect applications, platforms, data, APIs and external ecosystems. 

The role will define and implement scalable, secure, resilient and reusable integration patterns across legacy and modern technology environments, enabling real-time and batch integration, API-led connectivity, event-driven architecture and seamless business-process orchestration. 

The role will work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Application, Data, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Product and Engineering teams to ensure consistent and robust integration across the enterprise. 

1. Enterprise Integration Architecture

* Design end-to-end integration architectures across enterprise applications, platforms, data and external systems. 

* Define integration strategies and architecture patterns across legacy, on-premise, cloud and SaaS environments. 

* Design synchronous and asynchronous integration solutions. 

* Define reusable integration patterns, standards and reference architectures. 

* Ensure integration architectures are scalable, resilient, secure and cost-effective. 

* Identify opportunities to simplify fragmented integration landscapes and reduce point-to-point integrations. 

2. API Architecture & Management

* Design and govern API-led integration architectures. 

* Define API standards, design principles, lifecycle management and governance. 

* Design RESTful and, where appropriate, GraphQL APIs. 

* Define API security, authentication, authorisation, throttling and versioning. 

* Establish API reuse and discoverability across the enterprise. 

* Support API productisation and external ecosystem integrations. 

* Define API gateway and management architecture. 

3. Event-Driven Architecture

* Design event-driven and real-time integration architectures. 

* Define enterprise event models and event-driven integration patterns. 

* Design solutions using event streaming and messaging platforms such as Kafka or equivalent technologies. 

* Establish appropriate patterns for: 

* Event publishing

* Event consumption

* Event orchestration

* Event routing

* Message transformation

* Retry and failure handling

* Design architectures capable of supporting high-volume, low-latency transactions. 

If this role aligns with you current responsibilities, kindly send your resume at Biswajet. Sahoo33@generalicentral. com

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to manage the continuous availability, reliability, and functionality of DCS and PLC systems. This includes scheduling and performing regular system backups, maintenance, and troubleshooting, as well as coordinating with OEMs for system upgrades. The role also involves managing hardware and software resources, network integrity, and cybersecurity measures to prevent data loss and system vulnerabilities. 

Responsibilities

Lead - DCS_PLC (Distributed Control System_ Programmable Logic Control)

System Reliability And Maintenance

Ensure the availability and functioning of all control loops in auto mode, maintaining reliability of equipment protection under BTG. 

Schedule and execute regular backups of DCS and PLC systems to prevent data loss. 

Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of DCS and PLC hardware to minimize downtime. 

Monitor system alarms daily and ensure the healthiness and redundancy of systems. 

Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) for annual maintenance activities and system upgrades. 

Manage the proper functioning of Operator Workstations (OWS) and Engineering Workstations (EWS). 

Maintain periodical backups and availability of historian systems for data integrity and recovery. 

Hardware And Software Management

Manage the availability of DCS and PLC hardware and software, including necessary spares for emergency replacements. 

Maintain up-to-date DCS and PLC licenses and manage renewals to avoid operational disruptions. 

Conduct patch updates of DCS and PLC software to address vulnerabilities and enhance system performance. 

Upgrade DCS and PLC systems proactively to prevent obsolescence and maintain compatibility with new technologies. 

Network And Cybersecurity

Manage the storage, backup, and restoration of systems in compliance with cybersecurity policies. 

Ensure the healthiness and redundancy of the DCS and PLC network, preventing single points of failure. 

Oversee the transfer of data to third-party systems, such as Pi servers, ensuring secure and reliable communication. 

Review and strengthen network security measures to protect against cyber threats and unauthorized access. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department. 

Promote the safety of personnel and equipment through rigorous training and strict adherence to safety protocols. 

Implement risk management practices to mitigate potential hazards and ensure operational continuity. 

Develop and maintain emergency response plans to address potential incidents swiftly and effectively. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Provide support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement field related ZFO action items and AWMS for continuous improvement in maintenance practices. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas. 

Drive the implementation of digital transformation initiatives. 

Analyse data trends and system performance to identify opportunities for automation and digitization enhancements.

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Vendor

Experience in the power generation, petrochemical, oil and gas, or heavy industrial sectors.

Company Description Megawin Switchgear is a leading Indian brand specializing in medium voltage products, including switchgear, dry-type transformers, and protection and control solutions for voltage classes up to 36kV. The company focuses on innovation that enhances productivity, operator safety, reliability, and sustainability for its customers. Its solutions are designed to reduce downtime, lower ownership and maintenance costs, and extend product life cycles. Megawin serves a wide range of sectors, including power utilities, large process industries such as steel, cement, textile, mining, power generation, and T&D, as well as commercial establishments, national infrastructure projects, and renewable energy production. This breadth of applications offers team members exposure to diverse and complex engineering environments. 

Role Description The PLC Programmer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Salem. The PLC Programmer will design, develop, and test PLC programs for medium voltage switchgear and related power control systems, ensuring safe and reliable operation. Daily activities include reading and interpreting electrical drawings, configuring I/O, programming logic sequences, and integrating PLCs with protection relays, SCADA, and HMI interfaces. The role involves troubleshooting and commissioning systems on-site, diagnosing control issues, and implementing corrective actions in collaboration with project, design, and service teams. The PLC Programmer will document control logic, maintain version control, support after-sales service and upgrades, and adhere to relevant safety and quality standards.

- Candidates should possess skills in PLC programming, ladder logic, function block programming, and experience with common PLC platforms (such as Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider, or similar).

 - Candidates should possess skills in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, control wiring diagrams, and understanding of medium voltage protection and control concepts. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in testing, troubleshooting, and diagnosing PLC and control system issues using appropriate tools and methodologies. 
 - Candidates should possess skills in documentation of programs, preparation of technical reports, and clear written and verbal communication with cross-functional teams.

About Us

Engineering Manager, WMS

Summary

Anchanto, a leading global B2B SaaS enterprise, seeks an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the critical development and operations of its Warehouse Management System (WMS). This platform is central to the daily operations of brands, retailers, and logistics partners, managing complex workflows including inventory control, order fulfillment, and omnichannel commerce. The Engineering Manager will drive the engineering and quality assurance teams, fostering a culture of outcome ownership rather than mere task oversight. Reporting to the Engineering Head of WMS, this leader is responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and technical excellence of a mission-critical system that supports high-volume, real-time warehouse operations across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and AWS environments. The role demands a strategic partner who can balance technical innovation with operational stability while guiding the team through a transition to an integrated, AI-first working model. 

Responsibilities

- Delivery Management: Ensure predictable engineering output by managing capacity planning, identifying risks early, and executing recovery strategies to meet 90-day commitments with high accuracy and zero delays. 
 - Quality Engineering Leadership: Establish and maintain rigorous standards for code quality, test coverage (including RSpec, integration, and load testing), and deployment frequency. Own the metrics for change failure rates and ensure independent QA sign-off remains unaffected by delivery pressures. 
 - System Reliability & Performance: Directly manage service availability and latency, overseeing incident response and root cause analysis to resolve recurring issues. Target 99. 9% uptime for owned services and sub-200ms P95 latency for critical APIs while reducing Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR). 
 - Technical Architecture & Security: Operate within established architectural and security guardrails to protect multi-tenant isolation and system performance. Enforce secure software development lifecycle practices, including threat modeling, static and dynamic analysis, and compliance with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 standards. 
 - Cost Optimization: Monitor and optimize engineering costs related to compute, storage, and AI tooling, ensuring that cost-per-delivered-item and infrastructure expenses trend downward without compromising quality. 
 - AI Integration: Drive the adoption of AI coding assistants (such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot) to shift the team toward spec-driven delivery. Lead the transition of AI-enabled features, such as intelligent slotting and capacity forecasting, from pilot programs to production-grade solutions. 
 - Team Development & Staffing: Manage the full lifecycle of team members, including hiring, performance reviews, and career growth planning. Foster a culture of continuous learning that encourages engineers to evolve from specialists into versatile product builders. 
 - Hands-on Technical Contribution: Engage directly in solution design, prototyping, and complex implementation tasks where necessary to unblock the team. Gradually increase team autonomy to reduce dependency on the manager for routine decisions. 
 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with the Engineering Head, Product Management, Delivery Managers, and other technical leads to align on priorities, manage technical debt, and ensure smooth go-live processes. 
 - Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation teams, and Security groups to manage customer commitments, handle escalations, and ensure release readiness. 

Requirements

Requirements: 

- Experience: 9 to 18 years of software engineering background, including a minimum of 4 years in a leadership role managing engineering teams and owning delivery outcomes. 
 - Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in Ruby on Rails backend development at scale, with strong knowledge of asynchronous processing (Sidekiq/Redis), PostgreSQL performance tuning, and high-throughput system architectures. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Proven experience building distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including EKS/Kubernetes, ECS, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Aurora, S3, API Gateway, and Redis. 
 - System Design: Strong capability in designing scalable, multi-tenant architectures with robust handling of idempotency, retries, backpressure, and failure scenarios. 
 - Reliability Engineering: Solid background in observability (metrics, logs, traces), SLO/SLI definition, incident management, and maintaining strict on-call discipline. 
 - DevOps & Automation: Proficiency with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CodePipeline), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm), and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK). 
 - Quality Assurance: Demonstrated experience leading QA engineers or quality practices, with a focus on maintaining independent sign-off and improving DORA metrics. 
 - AI & Modern Tooling: Practical experience utilizing AI coding tools to enhance productivity and a track record of transitioning teams to spec-driven workflows. 
 - Security Compliance: Familiarity with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls, GDPR, PII handling, and secure SDLC practices including threat modeling and vulnerability scanning. 
 - Leadership Skills: Ability to calibrate performance levels, coach team members, manage underperformance, and guide teams through organizational change. 
 - Preferred Qualifications: Experience with monolith-to-microservices migration and domain knowledge in WMS, OMS, TMS, or 3PL logistics. 
 - Core Behaviors: A mindset focused on outcome ownership, execution discipline, systems thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a structured leadership framework while maintaining the autonomy to solve problems proactively. 

Benefits Why Join Anchanto

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business. 

- Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.

data.title: Chief rolling Stock Design & specification engineer & Project Manager ( Rolling Stock)- BID Position
data.description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems. 

Context

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations. 

Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly. 

SYSTRA's unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services. 

SYSTRA India's comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc. ). 

Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc. 

Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation. 

Currently, we are bidding for Metro projects across India. The position of Chief Rolling Stock Design & Specification Engineer & Project Manager (Rolling Stock) is the key position in these BIDs. 

Missions/Main Duties

- Design & Technical Specification Management: Lead the formulation, review, and approval of comprehensive technical specifications and detailed designs for metro trainsets-covering car body structures (aluminum/stainless steel), bogies, propulsion systems, braking systems, HVAC, passenger interiors, and the Train Control and Management System (TCMS). 
 - Manufacturing & Factory Quality Oversight: Monitor rolling stock manufacturing processes at production plants, oversee material sourcing, assembly lines, and static testing, and enforce rigorous Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) standards through factory audits and pre-shipment inspections. 
 - Project Scheduling & Financial Control: Administer the rolling stock procurement contract, monitor manufacturing and delivery milestones against the master project schedule, evaluate change orders, and manage financial forecasts to prevent cost overruns. 
 - Complex Systems Interfacing & Compatibility: Coordinate critical technical interfaces between trainsets and other core metro sub-systems-specifically Signaling (CBTC/ATO) for automatic train operation, Track Alignment for gauge and dynamic clearance safety, Traction Power for energy supply, and Depot Maintenance Equipment (e. g. , pit wheel lathes, train wash plants). 
 - RAMS & Safety Compliance: Ensure the rolling stock fleet complies with stringent Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety (RAMS) standards, international crashworthiness norms, fire safety regulations (e. g. , EN 45545), and statutory environmental requirements. 
 - Testing, Commissioning & Statutory Trials: Direct Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Static Tests, Type Tests, and rigorous dynamic on-track testing (commissioning trials on mainlines) to secure safety clearances and certification from railway safety regulators (e. g. , CMRS). 
 - Warranty, Spares & Operations Handover: Oversee the Defect Liability Period (DLP), manage initial spare parts inventory (spares and special tools), review comprehensive maintenance manuals, and manage the final asset handover to the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) team. 

Profile/Skills

- He/She should be Graduate in Engineering
 - He/She should have minimum 20+ Years of post qualification experience. 
 - He/She should have minimum 15+ Years of experience in relevant assignment. 

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It's not a job - it's a career!

Workplace Type

On-site

data.title: Delivery Manager
data.description:
Role Summary

The Delivery Manager is accountable for the end-to-end application delivery, quality and performance, managing operational leads across key delivery functions while remaining actively involved in resolving delivery challenges and driving continuous improvement. The role goes beyond traditional project coordination, planning and reporting. The Delivery Manager is expected to establish and govern quality gates, delivery-readiness criteria, impact-assessment practices, application knowledge, cross-functional effectiveness measures and continuous-improvement mechanisms throughout the delivery lifecycle. The Delivery Manager will proactively identify systemic delivery weaknesses, challenge insufficient readiness, facilitate cross-functional decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure that lessons from defects, incidents and Root Cause Analysis result in sustainable preventive improvements

Responsibilities: -

End-to-End Delivery Ownership

Own delivery across the complete lifecycle from requirements and planning through development, testing, release and production support. 

Establish integrated delivery plans covering scope, schedule, milestones, resources, dependencies and releases. 

Drive delivery commitments across BA, DEV, QA, Product/ITPO, Architecture and Support teams. 

Balance scope, timeline, quality, capacity and business priorities to achieve predictable delivery outcomes. 

Cross-Functional Delivery & Quality Governance

Orchestrate effective collaboration across BA, DEV, QA, Product/ITPO and technical teams, ensuring clear ownership and effective hand-offs. 

Establish appropriate quality gates, Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), entry/exit criteria and release-readiness controls. 

Govern Impact Assessment / Change Impact Analysis and dependency management across applications, integrations, interfaces and business processes. 

Ensure quality and delivery controls are not compromised to meet timelines. 

Application Knowledge & Team Capability

Ensure BA, DEV and QA teams maintain sufficient application, functional and technical knowledge to independently perform their responsibilities. 

Identify capability and knowledge gaps impacting productivity, quality or delivery outcomes. 

Establish effective onboarding, Knowledge Transfer (KT), Reverse KT, cross-skilling and knowledge-retention mechanisms. 

Align team capacity, competencies and skills with planned delivery commitments. 

Quality, Testing & Release Management

Govern development quality, peer/code reviews, QA readiness, test-environment readiness, regression coverage and release readiness. 

Ensure QA has appropriate environments, test data, access and dependencies to execute planned testing. 

Monitor defect trends, rework, reopened defects, UAT/production leakage and release quality, and address underlying causes. 

Drive effective Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive measures for recurring quality issues. 

Team Performance, Delivery Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Establish and actively govern performance KPIs across BA, DEV, QA and Product/ITPO, holding operational leads accountable for results and driving measurable improvements in quality, productivity and predictability

Establish appropriate functional measures, including: 

BA: refinement effectiveness, backlog readiness, requirement-related defects/rework and acceptance-criteria quality. 

DEV: committed vs. delivered stories, defect creation rate, rework, peer-review effectiveness and spillover. 

QA: stories tested, defect detection, defect leakage, regression effectiveness and test-cycle completion. 

Product/ITPO: backlog/prioritization readiness, decision turnaround, pending clarifications and acceptance turnaround. 

Analyze cross-functional cause-and-effect to identify systemic delivery problems rather than reviewing individual team metrics in isolation. 

Governance, Risk & Stakeholder Management

Lead project and delivery governance with business, client and technology stakeholders. 

Own risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, scope changes and escalation management. 

Provide transparent reporting on delivery health, quality, milestones, capacity, risks and release readiness. 

Build stakeholder confidence through realistic commitments, proactive communication and clearly owned recovery plans when delivery deviates. 

Service, Resource & Commercial Management

Govern application/service performance alongside project/change delivery, including relevant incidents, problems, changes, KPIs and SLAs. 

Manage resource demand, capacity, skills and delivery forecasts against the delivery pipeline. 

Coordinate third-party/vendor dependencies and commitments where applicable. 

Maintain awareness of effort, utilization, resource cost and commercial implications of delivery decisions.

10+ years of relevant IT experience, with substantial experience in Project Management, Delivery Management or Application Delivery leadership. 

Demonstrated ownership of complex, end-to-end application delivery. 

Strong experience in project planning, execution, risk management, dependency management and stakeholder governance. 

Experience with Agile and/or hybrid delivery environments. 

Strong understanding of application development and testing lifecycles. 

Experience with quality management, defect management and production/release governance. 

Experience managing application support/service delivery alongside change/project delivery is strongly preferred. 

Experience working with globally distributed technical and business stakeholders. 

Experience with enterprise application environments and cross-system dependencies. 

MUST HAVE: 

DELIVERY CAPABILITIES

End-to-end Project & Delivery Management

Application Delivery Management

Agile / Hybrid Delivery

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Requirements / Backlog Governance

Release Management

Quality & Defect Management

Stakeholder / Client Management

Resource & Capacity Management

RCA / Continuous Improvement

ServiceNow

PRINCE2

data.title: Senior Endpoint Engineering & Security Automation Engineer
data.description:
About Rapido

Founded in 2015, Rapido is India's leading multi-modal mobility platform. What began with bike taxis has rapidly evolved to include auto-rickshaws, cab-hailing, and peer-to-peer deliveries. Today, Rapido commands a dominant 70% market share in bike taxis, 40% in auto rides, and holds the second-largest position in the cab segment with a 22% share-establishing us as the overall market leader in ride-hailing. 

With over 4 million rides completed daily and more than 2 billion rides served to date, Rapido operates in 200+ cities and is aggressively expanding toward a presence in 500 cities. In 2024, we proudly achieved unicorn status with a valuation of $1. 1 billion. 

Driven by technology and innovation, we're expanding into new categories while remaining committed to improving last-mile connectivity and empowering livelihoods at scale. 

About the Role

Rapido is looking for a highly skilled Senior Endpoint Engineering & Security Automation Engineer to design, develop, automate, and secure its enterprise endpoint infrastructure. 

This is an engineering-first role that requires deep technical expertise in endpoint operating systems, endpoint management platforms, security architecture, scripting, API integrations, and infrastructure automation. 

The individual will be responsible for building scalable endpoint management solutions, establishing and enforcing security baselines, developing custom compliance and remediation frameworks, and integrating endpoint telemetry with enterprise security platforms. 

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently identifying complex endpoint security and operational challenges, designing technical solutions, developing production-grade automation, and implementing automated controls across a large enterprise device fleet. 

We are looking for an engineer who builds solutions and automation frameworks, rather than someone who primarily administers endpoint management consoles. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Endpoint Engineering & Architecture

- Design, implement, and maintain enterprise endpoint architecture across macOS, Windows, and mobile operating systems. 
 - Develop secure, scalable, and standardized endpoint provisioning and lifecycle management workflows. 
 - Engineer zero-touch provisioning, device enrollment, configuration management, and device decommissioning processes. 
 - Establish operating system configuration standards, endpoint hardening policies, and device security baselines. 
 - Own technical integrations between endpoint management, identity, security, and enterprise IT systems. 
 - Troubleshoot complex operating system, kernel, agent, network, certificate, authentication, and device management issues. 
 - Evaluate emerging endpoint technologies and recommend architectural improvements. 2. Endpoint Security Baseline & Continuous Compliance

- Design and maintain endpoint security baselines aligned with CIS Benchmarks, NIST guidelines, and enterprise security policies. 
 - Develop automated compliance checks covering: 
 - OS versions, patch levels, and security updates. 
 - Disk encryption and recovery-key escrow. 
 - EDR agent health and endpoint protection status. 
 - Firewall, antivirus, and security configurations. 
 - Unauthorized and vulnerable software. 
 - Local administrator privileges and privilege escalation. 
 - Browser versions, extensions, and security configurations. 
 - Screen-lock, password, and authentication policies. 
 - Device certificates and security agent health. 
 - Configuration drift and policy deviations. 
 - Develop automated detection and remediation mechanisms for non-compliant endpoints. 
 - Implement risk-based device compliance scoring and exception management. 
 - Integrate device compliance status with identity and conditional access controls. 
 - Build dashboards to monitor endpoint posture, vulnerabilities, remediation progress, and security trends. 3. Endpoint Automation & Software Development

- Develop production-grade automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and REST APIs. 
 - Build custom tools and services for endpoint inventory, software discovery, policy validation, and automated remediation. 
 - Develop integrations between MDM/UEM platforms, identity providers, cloud platforms, and security systems. 
 - Implement event-driven workflows using APIs, webhooks, schedulers, and message queues. 
 - Build automated endpoint lifecycle workflows covering employee onboarding, role changes, offboarding, and device recovery. 
 - Automate software deployment, version enforcement, patch management, and rollback workflows. 
 - Apply software engineering best practices, including Git, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and secure secret management. 
 - Design resilient automation with retries, error handling, audit trails, idempotency, and rollback mechanisms. 4. Scalefusion UEM/MDM Engineering

- Own the engineering, implementation, and technical optimization of Scalefusion MDM/UEM. 
 - Design and implement device profiles, security policies, application management, and compliance configurations. 
 - Develop API-driven integrations and automation using supported Scalefusion capabilities. 
 - Automate device enrollment, policy assignments, software deployments, inventory collection, and lifecycle management. 
 - Engineer custom reporting and telemetry pipelines using available Scalefusion APIs and device data exports. 
 - Integrate Scalefusion with Google Workspace, identity platforms, endpoint security solutions, and internal automation services. 
 - Diagnose complex MDM policy conflicts, enrollment failures, agent issues, and configuration drift. 
 - Evaluate platform limitations and develop secure, scalable, and supportable engineering solutions. 5. macOS & Windows Platform Engineering

macOS Engineering

- Strong understanding of macOS architecture, launchd, configuration profiles, PPPC/TCC, FileVault, Gatekeeper, System Extensions, and Apple security frameworks. 
 - Experience with Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, and Apple MDM protocols. 
 - Develop shell scripts and automation for macOS configuration, security validation, and software deployment. 
 - Troubleshoot complex macOS security, permissions, certificate, and MDM-related issues. Windows Engineering

- Deep knowledge of Windows security architecture, registry, services, Group Policy, BitLocker, Defender, and device configuration policies. 
 - Develop PowerShell automation for endpoint configuration, hardening, and remediation. 
 - Understand Windows event logs, endpoint telemetry, patch management, and application deployment. 
 - Troubleshoot complex Windows security, identity, and device management issues. 6. Identity, Zero Trust & Endpoint Security Integration

- Integrate endpoint security posture with identity and access management systems. 
 - Engineer device trust, certificate-based authentication, and conditional access mechanisms. 
 - Work with Google Workspace, Scalefusion OneIdP, SSO, SAML, OAuth 2. 0, and OpenID Connect. 
 - Support endpoint integrations with Netskope, EDR/XDR, and enterprise security monitoring platforms. 
 - Develop automated controls to identify and restrict risky or non-compliant endpoints. 
 - Design secure certificate provisioning, rotation, revocation, and lifecycle workflows. 
 - Implement least-privilege principles across endpoint configurations and automation services. 7. Endpoint Observability & Security Problem Solving

- Build centralized endpoint observability and compliance reporting solutions. 
 - Aggregate telemetry from MDM, EDR, identity, software inventory, and operating system logs. 
 - Investigate security configuration drift, agent failures, unauthorized software, and endpoint vulnerabilities. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering fixes. 
 - Identify recurring operational issues and eliminate them through automation. 
 - Develop endpoint health metrics, technical alerts, and security risk indicators. 
 - Collaborate with Information Security, Infrastructure Engineering, and IT Operations teams on endpoint-related incidents and remediation. Required Technical Skills

data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Secure Boot & Debug Security
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. 

AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we're focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. 

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead secure boot, debug security, device lifecycle, and platform-security firmware for Arm-based SoCs. 

The role owns the firmware security architecture from Boot ROM and hardware root of trust through bootloaders, trusted firmware, secure update, production lifecycle, debug access, and operating-system handoff. The candidate will work with SoC architecture, DV, post-silicon validation, firmware, security, manufacturing, and customer teams. 

This is a technical leadership role requiring architecture ownership, low-level firmware development, silicon bring-up, root-cause analysis, and mentorship. 

What You'll Achieve

- Define secure boot chain-of-trust architecture: 
 - Boot ROM, root of trust, OTP/eFuse/secure NVM, device identity, key hierarchy, authenticated image loading, anti-rollback, recovery boot, and trusted firmware handoff. 
 - Lead secure firmware update design: 
 - signed images, version policy, updates, rollback prevention, interrupted-update recovery, key rotation, and revocation. 
 - Define secure debug and lifecycle architecture: 
 - JTAG/SWD lockdown, authenticated debug unlock, debug certificates/tokens, manufacturing/service/production policies, and lifecycle transitions. 
 - Drive Arm platform security configuration: 
 - TrustZone, MPU/MMU, privilege separation, secure memory partitioning, DMA/IOMMU isolation, bus firewalls, reset/power behavior, and secure peripheral access. 
 - Integrate HSM/TPM, cryptographic accelerators, RNG, key storage, and provisioning services. 
 - Establish secure key-management practices, including key derivation, usage policy, rotation, revocation, and zeroization. 
 - Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware for secure boot, debug security, lifecycle, recovery, and security fault scenarios. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware issues using register traces, boot logs, JTAG, simulation/waveform evidence, and other lab tools. 
 - Identify security-related silicon limitations and define firmware workarounds, errata guidance, and validation coverage. 
 - Lead threat modeling, security architecture reviews, negative testing, and secure firmware design reviews. 
 - Define reusable platform security APIs, reference implementations, test frameworks, integration guides, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across firmware, security, hardware, DV, validation, and customer teams. 
About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, low-level platform software, SoC firmware, silicon bring-up, or product security. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with secure boot, boot ROM/bootloaders, image authentication, anti-rollback, secure firmware update, and recovery boot. 
 - Experience with hardware root of trust, OTP/eFuse, secure NVM, key provisioning, device lifecycle, and secure debug. 
 - Experience integrating HSM, TPM, secure element, cryptographic accelerator, or hardware key-management solutions. 
 - Strong Arm architecture knowledge: Cortex-M/R/A, TrustZone, MPU/MMU, exception handling, privilege levels, caches, barriers, and memory protection. 
 - Strong SoC knowledge: AXI/AHB/APB, DMA, IOMMU/SMMU, bus firewalls, interrupt controllers, clock/reset domains, and power states. 
 - Expert embedded C/C++ and low-level register programming skills. 
 - Strong debugging experience with JTAG/SWD, GDB, trace, register dumps, crash analysis, and hardware bring-up. 
 - Experience with threat modeling, secure coding, static analysis, code reviews, security testing, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to influence cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Arm Trusted Firmware, TF-M, OP-TEE, U-Boot, UEFI, EDK II, Linux secure boot, or Android Verified Boot. 
 - Experience with DICE, measured boot, remote attestation, secure provisioning, or certificate lifecycle management. 
 - Experience working with RTL, DV, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434, ISO 26262, NIST guidance, PSA Certified, SESIP, or Common Criteria concepts. 
 - Experience in semiconductor, automotive, industrial, IoT, or safety/security-critical platforms. 
 - Python or scripting experience for image tools, automation, log analysis, and security regression. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.title: Principal Process Architect - Core Finance Systems
data.description:
Overview

Intuit's mission is powering prosperity around the world. We do this by attracting the world's top talent, delivering innovative solutions for consumers, small businesses, self-employed professionals, and accounting experts. Every day we innovate with our flagship products: TurboTax, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, and Credit Karma. For over 100 million customers, we deliver more money, more time, and more confidence. 

Responsibilities

We are seeking a Principal Process Architect to spearhead end-to-end process design and implementation across Core Finance, encompassing plan-to-perform and underlying financial operations. Operating as a senior individual contributor, you will collaborate with key technology and finance leaders to turn strategic goals into actionable outcomes-simplifying complex workflows, re-architecting processes, driving full-scale automation, and enabling real-time analytics. In this role, you will hold complete accountability for key transformation workstreams, managing every phase from target-state workflow design and data alignment to requirements definition, implementation, and organizational adoption. 

Responsibilities

- Strategic Process Architecture: Influence and shape the transformation roadmap by providing process architecture expertise that aligns with core finance priorities, supporting a cohesive enterprise-wide operational strategy. Codify the delivery model into reusable playbooks so it can be replicated across the Finance teams and new initiatives. 
 - Program & Sprint-Based Execution: Drive cross-functional execution of a program from discovery through delivery, ensuring it is delivered on time, to a high standard of quality, within budget, and in accordance with stated business and technical objectives. 
 - Discovery & Prioritization: Lead structured discovery through the use of a process intelligence tools and stakeholder sessions and workshops to quantify when process time is spent and the current state landscape. Translate observed friction into prioritized opportunity pipeline across levers such as automating manual work, fixing the data model, changing the operating model (process), or solve through system changes/enhancements . 
 - Operational Excellence & Innovation: Streamline ambiguous & inefficient processes within the core finance function. Focus on accelerating and optimizing operations by replacing manual tasks with automated capabilities or process improvements. Design AI-enabled solutions and processes hands-on through prototype, test, and refine cycle, separating what AI can solve from what requires data remodel or engineering. 
 - Solution Design & Development: Collaborate with IT and finance business stakeholders to design scalable financial solutions and automations. Ensure that new capabilities are innovative, repeatable, and aligned with organizational growth. 
 - Data Reconciliation & Automation: Structure and reconcile high-volume transaction data across disparate systems, identify root causes of discrepancies, and architect automated, controlled workflows for detection and resolution on packaged ERP/SaaS and custom finance applications. 
 - Stakeholder Influence & Decision Support: Act as a trusted advisor to finance leadership, using data and analysis to inform prioritization and decision-making; influence senior stakeholders without direct authority to harmonize on strategy and sequencing. 
 - Analytical Decision Support: Utilize advanced data analysis to guide executive decision-making. Execute strategies that integrate stakeholder requirements across the end-to-end financial journey. 
 - AI & Automation Enablement: Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and modern finance technologies to streamline processes, improve insights, and accelerate finance transformation outcomes. 
 - Adoption & Change Leadership mindset: Spearhead the change management efforts by working with the change team for transformation initiatives, including developing and executing targeted communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and detailed training programs to ensure successful adoption and full integration of new processes and systems. 

Key Competencies

- ERP fluency: Can configure, test, and troubleshoot core ERP Cloud modules without hand-holding from IT. 
 - Speed with discipline: Moves fast and delivers in small, visible increments, without skipping discovery or letting solutions get ahead of the evidence. 
 - Builder mindset: Comfortable building Claude/AI solutions, not just specifying them - writes prompts, builds agents and workflow automation, and turns an idea into something testable within days. 
 - Rigor and candor: Grounds every claim in observed data or documented sources, reports progress honestly, and knows the difference between built, piloted, and adopted. 
 - User empathy: Understands how analysts actually work and treats friction as a capability or tool gap, not a performance issue. 
 - Systems thinking: Sees how a change in one process ripples into adjacent cycles across Finance, and designs with those dependencies in mind. 
 - Systems thinking: Sees how a change in one process ripples into adjacent cycles across Finance, and designs with those dependencies in mind. 
 - Clear communication across time zones: Leads with the answer, adapts to executive, partner, and builder audiences, and works effectively with global stakeholders through strong asynchronous communication and reliable overlap hours. 

Qualifications

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a strong process and transformation leader with experience

spanning finance processes, business systems, and cross-functional program delivery. They understand core finance and accounting deeply enough to engage credibly with finance stakeholders, while also bringing the structured thinking and technical fluency needed to guide solution design and systems-enabled change. 

They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, and influencing across a complex

stakeholder environment. They can balance strategic roadmap thinking with practical execution, and they bring a modernization mindset that includes process simplification, connected processes, and thoughtful application of AI and emerging technologies. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of progressive experience in finance/accounting roles with deep domain expertise in financial systems, processes, and large-scale transformation projects. 
 - Subject matter expertise in the core financials, including Plan-to-Perform, Record-to-Report, Fixed Assets, Source-to-Pay, and direct & Indirect tax. 
 - Demonstrated hands-on experience building processes and leveraging automation or AI-enabled solutions, such as LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, and workflow automation. 
 - Experience with process discovery and mapping methods, such as process mining or task monitoring, value-stream mapping, and user interviews. 
 - Ability to connect the core financials end-to-end process design with the data model, AI/automation, and technology to cross-process dependencies (planning, forecasting, and budgeting)
 - Proven track record of orchestrating large-scale, multi-year finance transformation programs, effectively managing dependencies between technical implementations (ERP & SaaS) and business process re-engineering efforts. 
 - Expert understanding of core accounting principles (e. g. , US GAAP, IFRS) and their application in a systems environment. 
 - Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into a scalable system architecture. 
 - Excellent communication skills to work effectively with stakeholders across the organization. You must be able to influence cross-functional senior leaders to use data and insights to inform business strategies. 
 - Proven ability to lead large-scale change initiatives, operate without boundaries, and influence actions that align teams on business strategy. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree (MBA) or a professional certification (CPA). 
 - Experience with Oracle Cloud ERP and EPM Cloud modules
 - Experience working in technology and fintech industries
 - Formal training and experience in project management and change management methodologies. 

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

data.title: Senior IT Platform Engineer
data.description:
As a Senior IT Platform Engineer, you will be a key technical contributor within Melexis's Global

IT Platforms team, supporting the container, automation, observability, and CI/CD platforms

that power our global semiconductor design, software engineering, and manufacturing

operations. 

Working closely with the Platform team, you will replace manual operational toil with

declarative Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), GitOps pipelines, and self-service automation. All

infrastructure mutations follow strict GitOps and peer-review workflows, ensuring high

reliability, auditability, and security across our hybrid cloud (Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud) and

on-premises environments. 

Expectations & Responsibilities

Infrastructure-as-Code & Self-Service Automation

- Develop, refactor, and maintain modular Terraform code and Python / Bash automation scripts for cloud and on-premises platform services via Merge Request workflows. 
 - Build and maintain self-service automation jobs in Rundeck and GitLab CI/CD to eliminate repetitive service desk requests for development teams. Kubernetes & Container Runtime Platforms

- Maintain and troubleshoot Kubernetes workloads, Helm charts, Istio ingress configurations, and container lifecycle tooling across on-premises Kubernetes clusters and managed cloud clusters (GKE / ACK). 
 - Support application teams in migrating legacy workloads to hardened, rootless container standards. 

Enterprise Observability & Logging

- Drive the modernization of Melexis's monitoring stack: build and maintain Prometheus, Grafana, Icinga / Nagios, and OpenTelemetry / Fluent-bit log shipping pipelines. 
 - Define actionable alerting rules, reduce alert noise, and maintain operational dashboards for platform Configuration Items (CIs). CI/CD & DevOps Tooling Operations

- Administer, scale, and optimize core developer platforms including GitLab CE, GitLab Runners, and JFrog Artifactory / Xray. 
 - Manage Linux server configuration states using SaltStack across global sites. 
 - Operational Excellence & Incident Support
 - Act as the primary morning escalation point for platform service desk tickets (ITSD), monitoring alerts, and cross-site support (covering APAC / China and Europe). 
 - Write and maintain clear Operations & Support manuals in Confluence and contribute to root-cause analysis (RCA) and ISO 27001 documentation evidence. 

Job Requirements

- Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as a Platform, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) in a multi-site enterprise environment. 
 - Infrastructure as Code & Scripting: Strong production proficiency in Terraform (writing reusable modules, CI-driven plans, state hygiene) and automation scripting in Python and Bash. 
 - Kubernetes & Containers: Proven hands-on experience operating Kubernetes (on-premises and/or cloud), Docker / Containerd, Helm, Ingress controllers (Istio / NGINX), and network policies. 
 - Observability Stack: Deep practical experience configuring and operating
 - Prometheus, Grafana, centralized log forwarding (Fluent-bit / OpenTelemetry), and Linux monitoring (Nagios / Icinga). 
 - CI/CD & Configuration Management: Strong hands-on experience building GitLab CI/CD pipelines, managing GitLab Runners, and using configuration management tools (SaltStack, Ansible, or similar). 

- Enterprise Linux & Networking: Solid command of Enterprise Linux (Rocky / RHEL, Debian / Ubuntu) and core networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, TLS certificates, load balancing, proxies). 
 - Cloud Fundamentals: Working experience developing infrastructure modules for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Logging) within a least-privilege, GitOps-driven deployment model. 

Soft Skills & Working Style: 

- Disciplined adherence to GitOps, peer-review, and change-management processes (never making manual out-of-band production changes). 
 - Ownership mindset: able to take technical requirements and translate them into reliable, self-documenting code. 
 - Fluent written and spoken technical English; proactive communicator in a distributed team. 

Nice-to-Have Competencies (Strong Plus)

- Experience with Alibaba Cloud (ACK, ECS, OSS) or hybrid cloud connectivity. 
 - Experience integrating applications with HashiCorp Vault (Vault Secrets Operator, AppRoles). 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL administration and backup tooling. 
 - Experience with JFrog Artifactory & Xray administration. 
 - Familiarity with ISO 27001 compliance standards and audit evidence collection.

You are expected to dive deep into the code and infrastructure, diagnose the root cause, and implement the solution.

data.description:
About Us We are building India's first agentic AI platform for credit management. Our proprietary AI agent goes far beyond offering financial advice-it actively negotiates with banks, lenders, and credit bureaus on behalf of millions of users to resolve credit issues autonomously. 

The Role We are looking for a high-ownership React Native Engineer to join a small, high-bar core frontend team. You will own the client stack behind our consumer finance super-app (spanning Loans, Personal Finance, and Credit pods) as well as our real-time conversational AI experience. 

We aren't looking for developers who simply stitch UI screens together. We want engineers who understand what happens underneath React Native-on the JS thread, across the native boundary, and inside the OS. 

What You'll Build & Own

- AI-Native Conversational UI: Architect real-time streaming chat interfaces capable of rendering polymorphic message types and inline actionable widgets from a single data stream. 
 - Transport-Agnostic Networking: Design resilient real-time communication layers (WebSockets, HTTP long-polling/SSE, Push) with robust connection lifecycle management, reconnection, and back-pressure handling. 
 - Offline-First Data Architecture: Architect local persistence, sync strategies, conflict resolution, and schema migrations using SQLite / WatermelonDB. 
 - Native & Performance Engineering: Write custom native modules (Java/Kotlin, Swift/Obj-C) and leverage the New React Native Architecture (JSI, Fabric, Turbo Modules) to optimize startup time, JS thread/frame budgets, memory, bundle size, and battery usage. 
 - Mobile Edge-Case Mastery: Handle app backgrounding, OS process death, OAuth token refresh, network degradation, and error recovery cleanly. 
 - Platform & Internal SDKs: Build reusable internal modules, shared libraries, and well-tested TypeScript tooling used across multiple product pods. What We're Looking For

- Deep React Native Internals: Strong command of React Native internal architecture, networking protocols, and performance optimization. 

- Hands-On Native Development: Proven experience building native modules using Java or Kotlin (iOS native development in Swift/Objective-C is a strong plus). 

- Core JS/TS Mastery: Deep understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript internals, debugging capabilities, and memory/thread profiling. 
 - New Architecture & Systems Thinking: Practical understanding or implementation experience with JSI, Fabric, and Turbo Modules, alongside WebSockets and offline-first architectures. 

- Strong Plus: Experience scaling consumer super-apps or fintech products, building internal/open-source frameworks or SDKs, and shipping measurable gains in startup time, app size, network efficiency, or crash rates. Interview Process & Work Setup

- Work Mode: 5 days Work From Office / Hybrid (Bangalore)
 - Process: 40-min Conversational AI Interview → Two 60-min Deep-Dive Technical Rounds (Fundamentals, Hands-on Coding, Code Review & System Design) → 20-min Team & Culture Fit Discussion.

With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

Job Description

We are seeking a talented and innovative Product Development Engineer to join our team in Bengaluru, India. As a Product Development Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing cutting-edge products from concept to production. 

- Define Manufacturing Test Flows & Test Methodologies for 3D NAND Flash memory based products to meet customer quality requirements
 - Participate in the implementation of Low Cost Test solutions to meet target DPPM
 - Work in close collaboration with cross-functional R&D teams to finalize the manufacturing test requirements for each of the test phases including the pass/fail criteria for a given product. 
 - Validate the manufacturing test programs against the specified requirements by running sample units in lab environment and verifying the test results as well as the parameters of the tested units
 - Drive the new product migration from R&D to High Volume Manufacturing Phase, support technical issues & coordination with cross functional teams
 - Failure Analysis & RMA support for internal customer & field issues seen on our products during qualification and post deployment into mass production
 - Monitor product yield, test time and DPPM. Provide technical solutions for yield improvement, TTR and DPPM reduction; and come up with detail plans and drive for implementation of the these with R&D and factory personnel
 - Help team members in line with the changing dynamics of the product deliverables. 
 - Effectively represent Product Engineering function in various technical and functional forums. 
 - Work with teams in different time zones, in case required. 

Qualifications

Must haves

- Bachelor's +8yrs or Master's +6yrs in Electrical/Electronic Engineering
 - Hands on experience with Lab Equipment (Testers, Oscilloscopes, Signal Generators, Logic Analyzers)
 - Good with understanding software programs written in C and C++ and able to step through the code if required
 - Able to work comfortably with Windows and Linux (Ubuntu) Operating systems
 - Ability to troubleshoot and analyze complex problems with minimal data points
 - Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines
 - Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills
 - The ideal individual must have proven ability to achieve results in a fast moving, dynamic environment. Self-motivated and self-directed, however, must have demonstrated ability to work well with people. A proven desire to work as a team member, both on the same team and outside of the team

Nice to haves

- Work experience in product validation especially from a Semiconductor manufacturing testing perspective
 - Background in Semiconductor Manufacturing Processes/Operations and Flash Memory Architecture
 - Knowledge of IC Test Methodologies, System Testing and Communication Protocols such as USB, eMMC, SAS, PCIe/NVMe etc. 
 - Programming skills in C, C++, or Python
 - Good with Statistical analysis tools and correlating large data sets

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us.
