data.title: Principal Software Engineer, Secure Boot & Debug Security
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing by developing SoCs and platform solutions focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable AI compute for cloud, edge, and physical applications. 

AI is showing up in essentially every part of the technology landscape, and we're focused on delivering the performance, efficiency, and reliability those workloads require. Ampere is building compute silicon and platforms for AI applications spanning a broad range of industries. We focus on solving exciting challenges in areas such as robotics and automotive, among others, but the core of our work is enabling efficient AI at scale and across multiple application domains. 

About The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead secure boot, debug security, device lifecycle, and platform-security firmware for Arm-based SoCs. 

The role owns the firmware security architecture from Boot ROM and hardware root of trust through bootloaders, trusted firmware, secure update, production lifecycle, debug access, and operating-system handoff. The candidate will work with SoC architecture, DV, post-silicon validation, firmware, security, manufacturing, and customer teams. 

This is a technical leadership role requiring architecture ownership, low-level firmware development, silicon bring-up, root-cause analysis, and mentorship. 

What You'll Achieve

- Define secure boot chain-of-trust architecture: 
 - Boot ROM, root of trust, OTP/eFuse/secure NVM, device identity, key hierarchy, authenticated image loading, anti-rollback, recovery boot, and trusted firmware handoff. 
 - Lead secure firmware update design: 
 - signed images, version policy, updates, rollback prevention, interrupted-update recovery, key rotation, and revocation. 
 - Define secure debug and lifecycle architecture: 
 - JTAG/SWD lockdown, authenticated debug unlock, debug certificates/tokens, manufacturing/service/production policies, and lifecycle transitions. 
 - Drive Arm platform security configuration: 
 - TrustZone, MPU/MMU, privilege separation, secure memory partitioning, DMA/IOMMU isolation, bus firewalls, reset/power behavior, and secure peripheral access. 
 - Integrate HSM/TPM, cryptographic accelerators, RNG, key storage, and provisioning services. 
 - Establish secure key-management practices, including key derivation, usage policy, rotation, revocation, and zeroization. 
 - Lead pre-silicon and post-silicon firmware for secure boot, debug security, lifecycle, recovery, and security fault scenarios. 
 - Debug complex hardware/firmware issues using register traces, boot logs, JTAG, simulation/waveform evidence, and other lab tools. 
 - Identify security-related silicon limitations and define firmware workarounds, errata guidance, and validation coverage. 
 - Lead threat modeling, security architecture reviews, negative testing, and secure firmware design reviews. 
 - Define reusable platform security APIs, reference implementations, test frameworks, integration guides, and technical roadmaps. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across firmware, security, hardware, DV, validation, and customer teams. 
About You

- Bachelor's degree with 8 years or Master's degree with 6 years of experience in embedded firmware, low-level platform software, SoC firmware, silicon bring-up, or product security. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with secure boot, boot ROM/bootloaders, image authentication, anti-rollback, secure firmware update, and recovery boot. 
 - Experience with hardware root of trust, OTP/eFuse, secure NVM, key provisioning, device lifecycle, and secure debug. 
 - Experience integrating HSM, TPM, secure element, cryptographic accelerator, or hardware key-management solutions. 
 - Strong Arm architecture knowledge: Cortex-M/R/A, TrustZone, MPU/MMU, exception handling, privilege levels, caches, barriers, and memory protection. 
 - Strong SoC knowledge: AXI/AHB/APB, DMA, IOMMU/SMMU, bus firewalls, interrupt controllers, clock/reset domains, and power states. 
 - Expert embedded C/C++ and low-level register programming skills. 
 - Strong debugging experience with JTAG/SWD, GDB, trace, register dumps, crash analysis, and hardware bring-up. 
 - Experience with threat modeling, secure coding, static analysis, code reviews, security testing, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to influence cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Arm Trusted Firmware, TF-M, OP-TEE, U-Boot, UEFI, EDK II, Linux secure boot, or Android Verified Boot. 
 - Experience with DICE, measured boot, remote attestation, secure provisioning, or certificate lifecycle management. 
 - Experience working with RTL, DV, emulation/FPGA, and post-silicon validation teams. 
 - Familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434, ISO 26262, NIST guidance, PSA Certified, SESIP, or Common Criteria concepts. 
 - Experience in semiconductor, automotive, industrial, IoT, or safety/security-critical platforms. 
 - Python or scripting experience for image tools, automation, log analysis, and security regression. 

What We'll Offer

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

Job Details

Principal Engineer - Cybersecurity Engineering, Operations, Automation, and AI Enablement

Role Summary

The Principal Engineer, Cybersecurity Engineering, Operations, Automation, and AI Enablement will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for designing, engineering, and scaling automation, operational reliability, AI-enabled productivity, and modernization capabilities across global cybersecurity services. 

This role supports the Sr. Director - Cybersecurity Operations, Automation, and AI Enablement and will help convert cybersecurity strategy into practical engineering outcomes. The Principal Engineer will work across cyber defense, endpoint and infrastructure security, cloud security, data and AI security, IAM, application security, vulnerability management, SOC, incident response, risk, and compliance teams. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. The successful candidate must be able to design automation, integrate security platforms, improve cyber service reliability, support 24x7 operating models, and enable responsible AI use across cybersecurity teams. 

This is not a traditional SOC analyst role, security operations manager role, or tool administration role. It is a senior engineering role focused on building the technical capabilities that allow cybersecurity teams to operate faster, safer, more consistently, and at global enterprise scale. 

Position Purpose

The Principal Engineer will help establish India as a strategic cybersecurity modernization and engineering hub. The role will provide deep technical leadership for automation, cyber platform integration, operational readiness, AI enablement, production support, and service health across Cyber Architecture & Engineering. 

The role exists to reduce manual work, improve control reliability, accelerate cyber delivery, and help cybersecurity operate as a modern engineering organization.

- Alert enrichment

Support modernization of cybersecurity architecture and engineering by reducing manual, fragmented, and tool-centric work. 

Drive Reusable Technical Patterns That Improve

 - Product-oriented operating models

 - Cross-domain integration
 - Metrics and reporting
 - Automation reuse

 - Global delivery consistency

Challenge inefficient manual processes and replace them with repeatable, measurable, and automated engineering solutions. 

- 24x7 Cyber Engineering Support Enablement

Help design and support a follow-the-sun cyber engineering support model based in India. 

Enable support for prioritized cybersecurity platforms, automation workflows, telemetry integrations, and service health processes. 

Responsibilities May Include

- Defining technical support procedures
 - Creating support runbooks

 - Engineering monitoring and alerting
 - Troubleshooting platform and integration issues

 - Improving handoff between India, U. S. , and other global teams

The role will support 24x7 readiness but should not be positioned as a generic operations queue owner. The focus is engineering-led support, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Leadership and Behavioral Expectations

The Principal Engineer Must Be Able To

 - Convert ambiguous modernization goals into clear engineering solutions. 
 - Balance speed, security, reliability, control, and supportability.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. Master's degree in computer science, information systems, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience preferred. 8+ years of experience in security engineering, infrastructure engineering, cybersecurity, systems engineering, or a related field required. data.title: Senior Platform Quality and Observability Engineer
data.description:
- Experience: 9+ years in software or quality engineering, including 6+ years building test automation, performance testing or observability for production distributed systems, with ownership of the results. Experience limited to manual testing or tool administration does not meet this requirement. 
 - Observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation, collectors, context propagation and the GenAI semantic conventions. Structured logging and metrics. Cloud monitoring platforms such as Azure Monitor and Application Insights, with log query languages such as KQL at depth, dashboards and alert design. LLM observability platforms such as Langfuse or LangSmith, including SDK integrations and management APIs. 
 - Performance engineering: Load, soak and stress test design, workload modeling, percentiles rather than averages, bottleneck analysis across CPU, memory, connection pools and rate limits, capacity statements, and tooling such as Locust, k6, JMeter or Azure Load Testing. 
 - Benchmarking and measurement: Experimental design with controls, labeled datasets with expected results, precision, recall, F1 and confusion matrices, the limits of small samples, reproducibility, and controlled comparison of detectors, models or prompts. 
 - Test engineering: Unit, integration, contract and end-to-end suites designed from requirements, mocking and test data strategy, integration into CI, and the discipline to keep suites deterministic. 
 - LLM evaluation and agent fluency: LLM API mechanics, tokens and cost, agent loops and tool calls as they appear in a trace, retrieval, evaluation with golden datasets and judge rubrics using tools such as promptfoo, DeepEval or RAGAS, and the role of an AI gateway and guardrails such as PII detection. 
 - Technical specification and writing: Writing technical specifications, acceptance criteria and test plans from product requirements, maintaining traceability between them, and producing design documents, findings and runbooks that are accurate, concise, state numbers with their limits, and are usable by engineers, reviewers and AI coding tools. 
 - Python engineering: Typed, asynchronous Python with production HTTP clients, package design and publishing, pytest with fixtures and mocks, command-line tooling, and data analysis libraries such as pandas. Ability to work productively in other languages when the work requires it, using AI coding tools to accelerate the transition while holding the same engineering standard. 
 - Distributed systems literacy: Working knowledge of the request lifecycle across gateway, service and store, including retries, timeouts and idempotency, queues and caches, sufficient to instrument services correctly, interpret traces and contribute to design discussions. 
 - Identity and access: OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect and JWT, managed identities and workload identity, sufficient to authenticate test clients, scheduled jobs and dashboards, and to diagnose authentication and authorization failures. 
 - Data and storage: SQL, log and time-series stores, the backing stores of observability tooling, such as PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis and object storage, at an operational level, and immutable storage and retention concepts. 
 - Cloud and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes including scheduled jobs with workload identity, CI/CD pipelines such as Azure DevOps, working proficiency in Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code tooling, and working inside private networks with no internet egress. 
 - AI-native delivery: Fluent use of AI coding agents to accelerate harness and tooling development, with every output reviewed, tested and understood before it is submitted. 
 - Communication: Professional command of spoken and written English, with the ability to explain designs, problems and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, give and receive feedback articulately, restate technical direction accurately, and raise risks early and in writing. 

PREFERRED

- LLM observability platforms: Self-hosting, scaling and upgrading an LLM observability platform such as Langfuse, including its scoring and dataset APIs. 
 - Evaluation tooling: Extending an evaluation framework such as promptfoo with custom providers and assertions, and deploying its self-hosted or enterprise edition with pipeline integration. 
 - Guardrail evaluation: Benchmarking PII detection or content safety services on labeled data. 
 - Cost attribution: Chargeback or showback reporting for a shared platform service. 
 - Reliability engineering: Service level objectives, error budgets and alert tuning for a shared platform. 
 - Regulated industry: Financial services or another regulated industry, including audit and record-keeping obligations.

Job Description

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Infrastructure Platforms team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile delivery team to validate and assure market-leading ServiceNow solutions in a secure, stable, and scalable way.  - Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. 

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience 
 - Hands-on practical experience in QA/testing within the Software Development Life Cycle, including test design, execution, defect management, and release validation. 
 - Experience testing ServiceNow configurations/customizations and understanding of core platform components (tables, forms, lists, ACLs, notifications, workflows/Flow Designer). 
 - Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and QA in iterative release cycles; familiarity with CI/CD concepts and environment promotion practices. 
 - Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e. g. , Jira, ServiceNow Agile Development, or similar). 
 - Basic understanding of web technologies and APIs (HTTP, REST, JSON) and ability to validate integrations using logs and test tools (e. g. , Postman or equivalent). 
 - Ability to create clear, actionable documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Understanding of security and controls concepts relevant to testing (e. g. , access controls/roles, data handling, auditability, evidence capture). 
 - Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e. g. , for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. 
 - Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. 

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

- Experience with ServiceNow test automation (e. g. , ATF - Automated Test Framework) and/or automation frameworks/tools used alongside ServiceNow.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself. 

The Solution Architect provides technical leadership and designs complex solution architectures that support business strategy and streamline technology-enabled workflows. This role partners closely with business owners, product, data, and engineering teams to document current-state systems and design scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-based solutions. This position focuses on emerging technologies, including AI, Generative AI, and machine learning, and guides solutions from research and analysis through architecture, delivery support, and operational readiness. 

What You Will Do

- Lead discovery with business and technology partners to understand objectives, constraints, current-state systems, and integration points. 
 - Document current-state architecture and define target-state designs including system context diagrams, component designs, integration patterns, and data flows. 
 - Design and modernize applications into cloud-compatible or cloud-native architectures using microservices, serverless, and event-driven patterns where appropriate. 
 - Create strategies, roadmaps, and migration designs for transitioning applications and data workloads to cloud platforms. 
 - Design AI and ML-enabled solutions, including model integration into products and business processes, and patterns for scalable inference and low-latency serving where needed. 
 - Design Generative AI solution patterns, such as retrieval-augmented generation, tool and API integration, prompt and context management, and evaluation approaches. 
 - Define reference architectures for AI platforms and enabling capabilities, such as data pipelines, feature and embedding generation, vector storage, model endpoints, and integration with enterprise APIs. 
 - Define integration patterns for agent toolchains using standards and common approaches such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), skills and plugin manifest standards, function calling with JSON Schema tool definitions, OpenAPI-based tool specifications, and event-driven or message-based tool execution patterns. Ensure integrations address authentication and authorization, data minimization, auditability, and isolation boundaries.

About InLogic AI

Our work spans agentic AI platforms, intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle, AI-assisted quality engineering, and knowledge and retrieval systems for regulated industries such as healthcare and financial services.

We are looking for an experienced AI leader who combines hands-on understanding of agentic AI and machine learning with strong project management and execution discipline. You will lead InLogic's AI delivery team, own the end-to-end execution of agentic AI programs, and act as the bridge between engineering and executive leadership - translating business goals into delivery roadmaps and turning technical progress into clear, decision-ready updates for executives and clients.

•          Set clear goals, conduct performance reviews, and build a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous learning. 

•          Partner with HR on hiring, onboarding, capability building, and career development for the AI team. 

Executive & Stakeholder Engagement

Required Qualifications

•          AI/ML Foundation: Solid understanding of machine learning concepts, the model lifecycle, MLOps / LLMOps, and data pipelines. 

•          Agentic AI: Practical experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, and agent orchestration frameworks.

•          Cloud: Working knowledge of at least one major cloud AI stack (Azure AI / Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI). 

•          Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to present to C-level audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications

•          Certifications such as PMP, SAFe (POPM / SPC), CSM / CSPO, or cloud AI certifications. 

•          Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (e. g. , NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act). 

•          Experience in regulated domains such as healthcare, insurance, or BFSI. 

•          Exposure to AI in the software development lifecycle (coding, testing, and requirements agents).

Key Competencies

•          Technical credibility with engineers and business fluency with executives

•          Structured problem-solving and data-driven decision making

•          Ownership, accountability, and calm under ambiguity

•          Coaching mindset and team-building ability

Success Measures (First 12 Months)

•          Agentic AI initiatives delivered to production on agreed scope, timeline, and budget.

•          A stable, skilled AI team with defined roles, growth plans, and healthy retention.

Interested candidates may share their updated resume with the InLogic AI Talent Acquisition team, highlighting relevant agentic AI projects, team leadership experience, and delivery outcomes.

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

About Litmus

At Litmus, we're building evals for humans and redefining how talent is evaluated. Teams like Mercor, Wispr, Composio, Neo Scholars, Astranis, and more are already using Litmus to build their technical teams. 

We're at an inflection point. Every company in the world will soon be powered by neo-humans (agent assisted people). But building evals to measure neo-human performance is unexplored and difficult. It requires studying the limits of model & human capabilities across all sectors of knowledge work, designing realistic environments that you can profile multiple people against, and answering where a human adds value over a purely agentic system. 

At Litmus, we're solving this problem. We deliver hiring insights to companies by capturing how candidates use tools, reason, and make decisions in their interviews, giving agentic graders the evidence to evaluate candidate skillset and predict job performance. 

The role

We're building an engineering team with complementary strengths across infrastructure, product engineering, and AI research. Depending on your expertise, your work could involve: 

Platform & infrastructure

• Architect, build, and scale reliable infrastructure that powers our hiring and evaluation platform

• Own technical decisions across distributed systems and platform infrastructure, supporting high-throughput workloads

Product engineering

• Own product features end-to-end, from technical design through deployment and iteration

• Work closely with engineering and talent leaders at frontier technical teams and turn recurring customer needs into reusable platform capabilities

AI evaluation & research infrastructure

• Design RL environments, evaluation rubrics, and reward signals that expose meaningful limits in neo-human systems. 

• Develop experiment orchestration and tracking systems for reproducible evaluations across humans and agents. 

• Build meta-optimization systems that use evaluation results, human and agent trajectories, and failure analysis to iteratively improve evaluation design. 

What we look for

Required qualifications

• Proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Node. js. 

• A track record of building, shipping, and operating production systems OR experience in an early stage team

• Ability to break down ambiguous problems and move quickly from ideas to execution

• Strong independent judgment, with a willingness to challenge assumptions and take ownership of decisions

• Ability to learn quickly, incorporate feedback, and improve based on evidence

High signals

• Ex-founder

• Experience operating distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), or serverless architectures

• Experience building high-throughput data pipelines and distributed data processing systems

• Experience with production-quality ML training, evaluation, or research infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning, LLM fine-tuning, or post-training

You'll work directly alongside the founders, shaping product and technical direction. If you have deep expertise in one or more of these areas and are passionate about the mission, you'd be a good fit at Litmus. 

Remote worldwide. Full-time. Open to all experience levels, including new graduates. We do not offer visa sponsorship. 

This role does not include equity.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (React Native)
data.description:
About Neo

AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet - yet most organizations fail to capture its value. Neo is changing that. 

Founded by Bhavin Turakhia - Co-Founder of Zeta, Radix, and Titan - Neo is building an integrated, AI-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first-class participant in every workflow: 

Tasket - A radically reimagined, AI-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work. 

Friday - AI Assistant, co-worker and agent platform, pre-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000+ SaaS platforms. 

Studio - AI-native suite for co-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents. 

Scribe - AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note-taking and actually does your work while on the call

About the role

As a Mobile Engineer you will build and ship features across the Neo suite's React Native the surfaces where people carry Tasket, Friday, and Scribe in their pocket. 

We are proponents of leveraging best-in-breed AI tools at every step of the engineering lifecycle - design, development, review, and testing. This requires a different engineering mindset: a lean team of senior, hands-on, AI-adept engineers, resulting in ultra-rapid iteration cycles and fast output. You will work within this approach, from design through to production. 

You'll own well-scoped components end to end - from a feature's UI down to how it behaves on a real device - and grow your judgment on the trade-offs that only show up once something ships. 

Responsibilities

Build

- Build features across Neo's cross-platform apps (React Native) - the interfaces where people delegate work to Friday and pick up Tasket, Studio, and Scribe on the go. 
 - Take a spec to a shipped feature by directing agents through implementation, then reviewing the result against device behaviour, not just the simulator. Architecture & systems judgment

- Own components and screens end to end - state management, navigation, and how they hold up under real network and device conditions. 
 - Contribute to design discussions on offline behaviour, sync, and app performance. Agent leverage

- Use agents to move from spec to working UI quickly, then validate the output by hand against the craft and correctness bar. 
 - Structure well-defined tasks - a screen, a component, a bug - so agents can execute them reliably. Quality & ownership

- Own performance and correctness on real devices - startup time, jank, memory, and behaviour across OS versions and screen sizes. 
 - Triage and fix crashes and platform-specific issues; keep release quality high across app store submissions. 

Skills

- AI-native engineering practice - Comfortable directing coding agents against a clear spec and validating their output against device-level reality, not just what compiles. 
 - Cross-platform mobile fundamentals - Solid command of React Native/TypeScript (preferred), including state management, navigation, and the native bridge/platform-channel layer when you need to drop below the framework. 
 - Native platform awareness - Working knowledge of Android and iOS build, release, and permissioning models - enough to debug a platform-specific issue without waiting on a native specialist. 
 - Performance & reliability - Reasons about startup time, rendering performance, offline/sync behaviour, and memory use on real, low-end devices, not just flagship hardware. 
 - API integration - Comfortable consuming REST/GraphQL APIs, handling auth, and building resilient network and caching layers for a mobile client. 

Experience & Qualifications

- 4+ years building and shipping production mobile apps
 - 1+ years in React Native (preferred) or equivalent cross-platform frameworks. 
 - Have taken at least one app through real app-store release and iteration cycles. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical depth. 

Equal Opportunity

Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

data.title: Software Development Engineer, Last Mile Platform Services, SDE
data.description:
Description

Amazon's Last Mile Technology team brings new technology to the hardest problems in last mile delivery. We want a top-in-class experience, not only for the customer receiving a package but also for the transporters who deliver millions of them every day. Real innovation in this space is part of who we are. 

How Amazon speaks to its transporters is one of the most critical systems in Last Mile. The Rabbit Communications Platform owns every surface Amazon uses to reach a Delivery Partner, Delivery Associate or Flex driver: Newsfeed, push notifications, in-app messaging, automated calls and automated customer contact. It runs on Android, iOS and wearables, worldwide. When a severe-weather shelter-in-place directive has to reach a driver in their own language, or a customer's gate code needs to travel from one delivery to the next, those journeys run on what we build. And for the driver, every one of them ends on the phone in their hand. 

We are looking for talented Android and iOS Software Development Engineers to design and build the client side of these mission-critical systems. You will work on hard problems at fleet scale, on devices that are moving, often offline and running low on battery, and you will have the autonomy to deliver impactful solutions. You will develop and operate tier-1 communication surfaces in native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift). 

You will learn how to build server-driven, self-service client surfaces that take app releases off the critical path for communications. You'll design driver-safe interaction patterns for people who are behind the wheel or walking to a door. You'll engineer offline-first sync and message delivery across 1-to-N broadcast and 1-to-1 push. You'll internationalize and localize an app that runs in dozens of languages, including right-to-left scripts, across global markets. You'll extend these experiences to wearables. And you'll hold the crash-free rate, startup latency, battery, data-usage and accessibility standards that a Tier-1 app must meet on a wide range of devices, while the team that builds it also runs it. 

It's always Day 1 at Amazon. Are you up for the challenge?

Key job responsibilities

As a key member of the Last Mile Delivery Technology team you will be an innovator, playing a direct role in shaping and building products that partner teams rely on and customers love on top of Amazon's technology. You will be part of a strong team in a fast-paced, start-up like environment where agile development is embraced, innovation is encouraged, large-scale projects are the norm, and work-life balance is a top priority. We aim to work smarter, not harder, and regularly iterate to maintain and improve work-life balance. As an SDE-II at Amazon, you will have the opportunity to positively impact millions of customers by identifying opportunities, designing solutions, collaborating with world-class engineers and delivering large, impactful, end-to-end projects and improvements. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 - Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.description:
Role purpose

This is a hands-on role for a Senior engineer who leads by building. You'll lead engineering on a multi-year programme to modernize and migrate a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. You'll write production code across the full stack but will be primarily responsible for Backend (Java back ends, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines). You'll also set up and run the programme's AI-augmented delivery model, using AI agents and assistants to speed up discovery, code conversion, testing and deployment while meeting the control standards a global custodian needs. 

Key responsibilities

Hands-on full-stack engineering

- Design and write production code for cloud-native services and user interfaces, especially for the most complex or highest-risk components. 
 - Build Java/Spring Boot microservices and APIs (REST and Kafka/MQ event-driven), with Oracle persistence on ECS/EKS. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Harness or similar), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), secrets management (Vault/CyberArk) and observability. 
 - Some knowledge of ReactJS/Typescript
 - Do daily code reviews and pair with engineers, and debug production-grade issues yourself. 

Engineering leadership

- Lead the modernization engineering team and set standards for architecture, code quality, testing and release. 
 - Own technical delivery plans, estimates and release quality, working with Architecture, Platform, Data, QE and the existing application support teams. 
 - Lead engineering for cutover, parallel runs and handover to run teams. 

AI-augmented delivery

- Use AI tools hands-on every day (for example GitHub Copilot, Devin, Blitzy and agent frameworks), and lead from your own experience of what works. 
 - Build agent workflows, prompt libraries and codebase knowledge context (knowledge graphs, vector databases, MCP integrations). 
 - Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests. 
 - Track AI productivity and quality (throughput, defect rates, rework, cost per migrated application) and report outcomes to leadership. 

Risk, controls and governance

- Put human review checkpoints, audit trails and secure-coding gates on all AI-generated code, in line with State Street technology risk, information security and model governance policies. 
 - Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live. 

People and capability

- Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team. 
 - Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmes. 
 - Java: expert in Java 17+, Spring Boot, JPA, REST API design, Kafka/IBM MQ messaging and performance tuning. 
 - DevOps: practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates. 
 - AWS: compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR. 
 - Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle and with migrating from Sybase or SQL Server. 
 - AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results. 
 - Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code (COBOL, C/C++, PowerBuilder). 
 - Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment. 

Preferred

- Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting. 
 - Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents. 
 - AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification. 

Success measures (first 12-18 months)

- Personally delivered production code and reference implementations across the front end, back end and pipelines. 
 - An AI-augmented delivery model running across the programme, with productivity gains measured against a baseline. 
 - Modernization releases delivered to plan, with no material production incidents at cutover. 
 - A permanent full-stack team in place, able to run and evolve the new platform. 
 - No audit or control findings related to how AI is used in delivery. 

Leadership attributes

You make decisions and are comfortable with ambiguity. You're equally credible writing code, reviewing a pull request or presenting to senior stakeholders. You set the technical bar by example.

data.title: Quality Assurance Engineer, Prime Video Sports
data.description:
Description

Love sports? Want to change the world? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Rolland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. Every day we face the challenges of a fast-paced market and expanding technology set. And we're building at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded-owner, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling new experiences to our customers. If this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

Who We Are

We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach. 

What We're Looking For

We are looking for an experienced QA engineer to drive manual and automated testing within Prime Video Sports across a broad technology stack. This role involves deep involvement on projects from design to development & deployment. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to the future of the Prime Video Sports customer experience. Successful candidates for this position demonstrate ability to multi-task, quickly adapt to new development environments and changing business requirements, learn new systems, create reliable/maintainable automated tests, find creative and scalable solutions to difficult problems, and ability to communicate clearly and concisely both written and orally. If you are the one that's excited about entrepreneurial thinking, creating technology solutions for complex problems we want to hear from you. 

What You Will Do Here

You will work with groups such as Product Management, UX designers to understand customer usage models and develop test plans and suites that approximate real-world environments and regression tests driving the software development process toward quality-centric methodologies. You will also work with Software Development Engineers to understand features and technical implementation. In this role, you will be responsible to deliver manual/automated solutions to test customer facing features. You will be empowered to choose the right highly scalable and available technology to solve complex problems in software quality assurance. 

What You Will Get From Us

A great team to work with and the chance to build at a proven top tier company. You will get a startup like culture with the stability of an established industry leader. You will get support and resources from some of the smartest people in the industry to continue learning. 

Key job responsibilities

- Test Planning and Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for new features and product releases. 
 - Bug Identification and Resolution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify, document, and resolve software defects. 
 - Automation tooling: Develop, extend, and maintain automated tests on iOS, Android, Web, and Living Room Clients to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure a seamless integration of quality throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Actively participate in retrospectives and contribute to process improvements to enhance overall product quality. 

Basic Qualifications

- 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
 - Experience in manual testing
 - Experience in automation testing
 - Experience scripting or coding
 - Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with at least one automated test framework like Selenium or Appium
 - Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality

If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Hydro Prokav Pumps, part of Ingersoll Rand, a leading progressive cavity pump (PCP) manufacturer and exporter headquartered in Coimbatore, India. Experience in implementing quality control procedures, conducting inspections, monitoring production processes and ensuring that the pumps meet customer specification and applicable industry standards. data.title: Software Engineer II – Engineering QA
data.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, "Who are you working for?"-a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. 

Position Summary

At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients' lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care. The Software Engineer II - Full-Stack QA Engineer to join our Global Marketing Systems Team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive testing strategies, developing automated test frameworks, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software applications. You will work cross-functionally with development, product, and operations teams to identify risks, define test cases, and drive quality initiatives across our software portfolio The individual will primarily partner with the Marketing Initiatives to understand business requirements and use cases and author and execute testing plans/scripts in line with the defined use cases. 

If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team!

Key Responsibilities

Manual Testing & Test Design

- Design and execute comprehensive manual test cases covering functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing scenarios
 - Perform exploratory testing to identify edge cases and potential defects in complex software systems
 - Create and maintain detailed test documentation and test case repositories

Test Automation & Framework Development

- Develop, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts using industry-standard tools and programming languages
 - Design scalable automation architectures supporting multiple platforms and technologies (Web, Mobile, APIs, Databases)

data.title: Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
data.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is looking for a seasoned engineering leader to own the vision, execution, and operational excellence of its cryptography, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and certificate services. These Tier 0 platforms form a critical layer of trust for OCI-enabling secure identities, encrypted communications, and certificate lifecycle management for cloud services and customer workloads at scale. 

As Manager, you will lead a high-performing organization responsible for building and running these security-critical services. You will combine deep technical judgment with strong people leadership: setting a bold platform strategy, guiding the evolution of highly available distributed systems, and developing leaders who can consistently deliver in a fast-paced, high-accountability cloud environment. 

Do you thrive on leading teams that operate critical cloud infrastructure at global scale? Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking an accomplished engineering leader to lead a high-performing organization responsible for core cryptographic services, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and certificate lifecycle capabilities that secure OCI resources and customer workloads. 

These are Tier 0 cloud services: foundational systems that establish trust, protect communications and identities, and enable secure operation across the Oracle Cloud. You will set the technical and organizational direction for this strategic service portfolio, balancing long-term platform vision with the operational rigor required of highly available, security-sensitive distributed systems. 

You will lead and grow a team of senior engineers, serving as both a technical authority and people leader. You will guide the design, delivery, and operation of resilient, scalable, and secure cryptographic platforms; raise the bar for engineering excellence; and translate an evolving PKI and certificate-management strategy into measurable execution. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

- Provides oversight to the team on the development of components of distributed systems, including the use of distributed state management tools. 
 - Monitors and enables optimization of code and/or systems for large-scale data processing. 
 - Guides team to implement scalability requirements for assigned components. 
 - Coaches team to leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 
 - Ensures team accurately implements and executes performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

- Provides guidance to the team in building fault-tolerant systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by leading the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 
 - Guides the design of components to effectively handle service disruptions. 
 - Coaches team on various approaches to handle network unreliability, including retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

- Guides team to implement testing and alarming configurations for detecting and addressing issues/failures. 
 - Ensures team effectively supports recovery efforts by reviewing and aligning on runbooks and operational procedures. 
 - Coaches team on building and customizing dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

- Manages the implementation and design of functional requirements and testing for features within an existing system. 
 - Coaches team on implementing test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 
 - Guides the implementation of data replication and synchronization techniques within the team to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

- Leads team efforts in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 
 - Ensures teams are following protocols for preventing interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 
 - Manages team in effectively implementing automation scripts and tooling when troubleshooting operational issues. 
 - Creates schedules and manages operational support rotations. 

Compliance & Security: 

- Manages team implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, overseeing encryption techniques and access controls. 
 - Manages execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, ensuring continuous improvement of security measures. 
 - Reviews documentation and ensures cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations. 

Automation & Change Management: 

- Leads the maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 
 - Coaches team on change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Creates and owns the execution plan for the team's work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets (when applicable) to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements. 
 - Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work. 
 - Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align on expectations and shared objectives. 
 - Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration. 
 - Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture. 

Problem Solving: 

- Leads team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate. 
 - Directs team to analyze data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot moderately complex errors. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Actively seeks learning opportunities for self and team to enhance knowledge and skills in key areas and remain current with industry advancements. 
 - Uses feedback and training to elevate personal and team skills, modeling a commitment to learning. 
 - Identifies skill gaps within the team and supports team members in learning opportunities by providing resources and fostering an environment that encourages knowledge-sharing. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Identifies and recommends improvements and encourages the team to share ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. 
 - Reviews and provides feedback on team members' ideas and seeks input from others on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

Performance and Development: 

- Coaches and provides direction to team members in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. 
 - Facilitates goal-setting discussions with team members, ensuring individual goals are aligned with broader team goals. 
 - Identifies development opportunities to help team members improve performance. 
 - Contributes to the talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, assessing promotion eligibility, and managing talent resources. 

About Us

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer- Noida
data.description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the design, automation and reliability of our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines on AWS. 

The DevOps team runs the cloud infrastructure behind NeoXam's SaaS offering and its sales and demo environments, and provides solutions and tools to Engineering. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership, from infrastructure design to production operations. You will set technical direction for the team, mentor other engineers and shape standards adopted across Engineering. 

What You Will Work On

- Design, build and maintain secure, multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines for multiple NeoXam products
 - Provision and manage AWS infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred; CloudFormation or equivalent) across multiple accounts and environments
 - Deploy, operate and scale containerised workloads on Kubernetes (Amazon EKS) in production using Helm and GitOps (Argo CD or Flux), and support Docker-based internal Engineering workloads
 - Design for resilience: Multi-AZ and cross-region architectures, backup and restore, and regular disaster recovery exercises, including failback, against contractual RTO/RPO
 - Build observability (metrics, logs, traces and alerting) with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch or equivalent, giving SaaS, Support and clients real visibility into production health
 - Define and enforce DevSecOps practices: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, SSO integration (Keycloak, SAML 2. 0/OIDC), container image scanning, SBOM generation and SAST/SCA in the pipeline
 - Keep operating systems, Kubernetes and open-source components patched and supported, and remediate vulnerabilities within agreed SLAs
 - Automate configuration management, change management and routine operational tasks to reduce manual toil
 - Lead incident response and blameless postmortems, define SLOs/SLIs, and drive reliability improvements based on real usage and incidents
 - Optimize cloud costs through monitoring, rightsizing and commitment planning (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances)
 - Produce evidence for security and compliance audits (ISO/IEC 27001) and provide technical input to client security questionnaires and due-diligence reviews
 - Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and write the runbooks, standards and architecture decision records the team works from

What We Are Looking For

- 6-9 years of DevOps, SRE or infrastructure engineering experience, including running production SaaS workloads
 - Experience in designing scalable, secure and cost-effective cloud architectures for production environments. 
 - Strong hands-on AWS experience (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS for PostgreSQL, EFS, S3, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and multi-account setups with AWS Organizations; Azure or GCP experience is a plus
 - Production-grade Kubernetes and Docker experience, including Helm and multi-tenant cluster design (namespace isolation, RBAC, network policies)
 - Strong Infrastructure as Code skills, Terraform preferred
 - Solid CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or equivalent) and GitOps practices
 - Strong scripting ability in Python, Bash or Go for automation
 - Hands-on experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/Loki, CloudWatch or equivalent)
 - Solid Linux system administration and networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, VPCs, firewalls, gateways and WAFs
 - Practical DevSecOps experience: identity and access management, secrets management, vulnerability scanning and remediation
 - Experience designing and testing backup and disaster recovery solutions
 - A track record of leading production incidents and mentoring other engineers
 - Comfortable working end-to-end and autonomously, from design to production operations
 - Experience working with global teams across Asia, Europe and the US
 - Clear written and spoken English

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with the AWS Foundational Technical Review (FTR) and AWS Well-Architected Framework Review (WAFR)
 - Experience in regulated environments (ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, DORA)
 - Experience with Keycloak and SSO federation across multiple identity providers
 - AWS certifications (Solutions Architect - Professional, DevOps Engineer - Professional) or CKA/CKS
 - Experience with financial services software
 - French language skills

Who You Are

- A builder: energised by improving systems that other teams depend on
 - Pragmatic: you pick the right tool, not the flashiest one
 - Autonomous: you drive towards outcomes without waiting to be told what to do next
 - Detail-oriented: you take reliability and security seriously
 - A mentor: you raise the bar for the engineers around you
 - A clear communicator: you explain technical trade-offs to engineers, Support and clients

Why Join

- Ownership of infrastructure and delivery pipelines that power a global fintech platform
 - Hands-on work with a modern AWS, Kubernetes and observability stack
 - Direct visibility with engineering leadership on architecture decisions
 - A path to growing scope and influence as the initiative matures

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better. 

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We're fixing it. And we're moving fast. 

We're an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. - Ready to run

 - Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

Software Engineers at OnePay build the products & systems that serve our customers and run our company. IoT Software Developer

Do you want to work on software applications that connect industrial machines, edge devices, and cloud platforms?

As an IoT Edge Software Developer within the Device Engineering Team (DET), you will contribute to the development, maintenance, and support of software running on edge devices that collect machine data, communicate securely with cloud platforms, and enable remote management at scale. You will work with Windows-based edge devices, cloud-connected applications, and device lifecycle management processes that support customers worldwide. 

This role is ideal for a developer who enjoys hands-on software development, troubleshooting complex device and connectivity issues, and working at the intersection of industrial systems, edge computing, and cloud technologies. 

If you want to build software where industrial IoT, edge computing, and cloud technologies converge, the Device Engineering Team is where it happens. 

Responsibilities

Technical Implementation

- Implement software components and features based on provided designs, specifications, and guidance.

Delivery & Execution Excellence

Collaboration & Growth

 - Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 - Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD pipelines
 - Familiarity with DevSecOps concepts
 - Familiarity with device communication protocols such as MQTT, OPC-UA, or similar technologies
