data.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together. 

The Lead DevOps Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership for the cloud platforms, delivery pipelines, and production operations supporting Claims Global Claims Operations and Claims AI solutions. This role owns the engineering standards and automation required to move services, data workloads, and AI/ML capabilities safely from development through production at enterprise scale. 

The ideal candidate is a senior DevOps and platform engineer who can design secure AWS infrastructure, build reusable CI/CD patterns, operate Kubernetes-based workloads, establish SRE practices, and lead engineers through complex releases and production events. The role requires strong judgment across speed, reliability, security, compliance, and cloud cost. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Cloud Platform & Infrastructure Engineering
 - Design, build, and operate secure, scalable, highly available AWS infrastructure for application, data, and AI/ML workloads
 - Create reusable Infrastructure-as-Code modules using Terraform and CloudFormation, with versioning, automated validation, policy controls, and documented consumption patterns
 - Engineer container platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS, including ingress, autoscaling, secrets, configuration, service networking, and workload isolation
 - Define environment strategy, account and network patterns, capacity models, backup and recovery controls, and production-readiness standards
 - Optimize platform performance, resilience, and cloud cost using measurable capacity, utilization, and unit-cost indicators
 - CI/CD, Release Engineering & Developer Enablement
 - Architect and maintain standardized CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, and/or Jenkins for application, infrastructure, data, and AI/ML deployments
 - Implement automated build, test, security scan, artifact management, approval, deployment, and rollback controls across environments
 - Enable safe release patterns such as blue-green, canary, feature flags, progressive delivery, and automated rollback based on service health
 - Build paved-road templates, reusable actions, documentation, and self-service capabilities that improve developer productivity and reduce deployment variability
 - Partner with engineering teams to remove delivery bottlenecks and improve deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and recovery time
 - Reliability, Observability & Production Operations
 - Establish SRE practices including service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, operational readiness reviews, and reliability backlogs
 - Implement end-to-end observability across metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, pipelines, infrastructure, and business-critical workflows
 - Lead incident response, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for complex production issues; improve runbooks and operational automation
 - Eliminate recurring operational toil through automation, resilience testing, capacity planning, and failure-mode remediation
 - Own or influence on-call readiness, escalation paths, disaster recovery validation, and controlled production ramp-up
 - DevSecOps, Governance & Compliance
 - Embed security throughout the delivery lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, container and IaC scanning, secrets detection, and artifact provenance
 - Implement least-privilege IAM, secure secrets management, encryption, network controls, vulnerability remediation, and auditable deployment approvals
 - Partner with architecture, security, risk, and compliance teams to meet enterprise controls and healthcare data protection expectations, including HIPAA-aligned handling of protected health information
 - Apply policy-as-code and guardrails without creating unnecessary friction for engineering teams
 - AI/ML Platform Enablement
 - Enable reliable deployment and operation of AI/ML, GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI services, including model and prompt configuration, vector stores, evaluation gates, and runtime monitoring
 - Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to implement MLOps/LLMOps patterns for packaging, promotion, observability, rollback, and governance
 - Support secure integration of AWS services such as Amazon Bedrock, S3, Lambda, ECR, EKS, CloudWatch, IAM, and related data services
 - Technical Leadership & Collaboration
 - Lead platform design reviews, production-readiness reviews, release planning, and technical decision-making across multiple delivery teams
 - Mentor DevOps and software engineers, set coding and automation standards, and provide actionable design and code-review feedback
 - Communicate risks, trade-offs, dependencies, operational health, and remediation plans clearly to engineering, product, business, and leadership stakeholders
 - Coordinate across application, data, AI/ML, architecture, security, infrastructure, and support teams to deliver measurable outcomes
 - Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements. 
Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 10+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, SRE, or software infrastructure roles
 - 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience delivering production systems using core services such as EKS, EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC, ECR, CloudWatch, and load balancing
 - 5+ years of experience building enterprise CI/CD and release automation using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or comparable platforms
 - 4+ years of Infrastructure-as-Code experience using Terraform; experience creating reusable modules, testing IaC, and managing remote state
 - 3+ years of hands-on Kubernetes and Docker experience in production, including deployment, scaling, networking, security, and troubleshooting
 - 2+ years leading technical designs, mentoring engineers, and coordinating delivery across multiple teams
 - Experience with observability platforms and practices covering metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards, and incident response
 - Experience implementing DevSecOps controls, cloud security, secrets management, IAM, vulnerability management, and compliance evidence
 - Solid scripting or programming capability in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Go, plus proficiency with Git and Linux

Preferred Qualifications

- AWS certification such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional or AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
 - Certified Kubernetes Administrator or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer
 - Experience with Argo CD, Helm, GitOps, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, or comparable platforms
 - Experience operating data platforms and distributed workloads using Spark, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Kafka, Databricks, or modern lakehouse technologies
 - Experience enabling MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, Amazon Bedrock, vector databases, RAG, semantic search, or AI evaluation and monitoring
 - Experience supporting claims, provider, eligibility, prior authorization, utilization management, or other healthcare workflows in a regulated environment
 - Experience with resilience engineering, chaos testing, disaster recovery exercises, FinOps, and platform-product operating models

Capability And Expected SG29 Proficiency

- AWS & cloud architecture - Designs production-grade infrastructure, networking, IAM, resilience, and cost controls
 - CI/CD & release engineering - Creates reusable enterprise pipelines and safe deployment patterns with measurable delivery outcomes
 - Kubernetes & containers - Operates secure EKS environments and troubleshoots workload, networking, scaling, and platform issues
 - Infrastructure as Code - Builds governed, tested, reusable Terraform modules and automated environment provisioning
 - SRE & observability - Defines SLOs, improves availability, leads incidents, and reduces recurring operational toil
 - DevSecOps - Automates security controls, evidence, vulnerability remediation, secrets, and policy enforcement
 - Technical leadership - Leads cross-team designs and releases, mentors engineers, and communicates risks and trade-offs
 - Healthcare & AI enablement - Applies compliance-aware DevOps patterns to claims, data, and AI/ML production workloads

Success Measures for the Role

- Improved deployment frequency and lead time while maintaining or reducing change failure rate
 - Reduced mean time to detect and mean time to restore for production incidents
 - Higher adoption of standardized pipelines, IaC modules, observability, and security controls
 - Measurable improvement in platform availability, release predictability, recovery readiness, and cloud cost efficiency

At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.

Platform Software Development:

 - Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions.

 - Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project.

 - Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

 - Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning:

Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

data.title: Infrastructure engineer, SRE
data.description:
Join us as an Infrastructure Engineer

- You'll engineer infrastructure technology for public and private cloud environments, complying with security, resilience, sustainability, and operational requirements with observability and guardrails built in
 - You'll also use automation to provide testing and a route to live for the product, working with customers to help them use our products appropriately through a users' CI or CD pipeline
 - This is a chance to work with colleagues across the bank to share engineering best practices, allowing you to expand your network and gain exposure for you and your work
 - We're offering this role at associate level

What you'll do

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll contribute to and manage the selection, creation and maintenance of technologies required to meet the needs of our customers, strategic targets and architecture outcomes, along with developing products using modern engineering practices and tools. 

We'll look to you to collaborate with stakeholders to inform product roadmaps, detailing lifecycles of the technology from new products through to end of support and retirement. You'll also support engineered products and respond to user feedback, new feature requests and resolve production issues wanted by the Product Owner. 

Additionally, You'll

- Develop technical skills through continuous learning and development
 - Work within a team to design intuitive, self-service infrastructure products
 - Contribute to the delivery of infrastructure as code solutions
 - Work with users to help use our products and gain feedback
 - Provide operational support for pattern or product related issues
 - Generate innovative ideas and drive the delivery of those through product features

The skills you'll need

To thrive in this role, you'll have experience in software development or automation scripting such as Python or Shell, with an understanding of the software development lifecycle. You'll also have experience in utilizing modern infrastructure as code via tooling. 

We'll expect you to bring a good understanding of Agile working practices and toolsets with the ability to relate everyday work to the vision of the feature team, platform and domain. 

Furthermore, You'll Need

- Minimum four years of experience in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related cloud platform roles
 - Minimum three years of strong experience in AWS products & services, with strong focus on security, and controls
 - Extensive automation experience with demonstrable skills in IaC using Terraform, and Python
 - Practical experience of designing, and using CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, automated testing and deployments
 - Software development or scripting skills, with experience of the SDLC along with good understanding of Agile methodologies and toolsets such as Jira
 - Drive to make sure that solutions have security considered from the outset
 - excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills
 - Capacity to focus on the customer, empathise with them

data.title: AI Engineer – Healthcare & RCM
data.description:
Hiring for Moative - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices. 

About the Role

You'll build and deploy AI agents, automations and data workflows for US healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM). You'll own each workflow end to end, from understanding how billing teams work today through deployment, evaluation and ongoing improvement. You'll work alongside AI/ML engineers, data scientists and domain specialists, directly with billing and operations teams. The role is based in Chennai, hybrid with 3 days a week in the office. 

What you'll do

- Build agents for payer-portal automation: claim status checks and EOB retrieval across inconsistent portal layouts
 - Build voice agents for payer follow-up, integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech
 - Turn fragmented healthcare data (scanned PDFs, EOBs, ERAs, incomplete records) into validated, structured inputs
 - Analyse claim journeys and revenue-cycle bottlenecks and surface AI-assisted insights into practice performance
 - Evaluate accuracy and completion rates on representative test sets, and monitor failures and operating costs
 - Add retries, exception queues and human escalation to every workflow
 - Apply privacy and security controls: access restrictions, audit trails, and no patient data in logs or model inputs
 - Measure outcomes such as time saved, claims processed and turnaround, with the teams using the systems

What you bring

- 2-5 years of professional AI engineering (not just internships or academic projects), including systems used in real operations
 - You've deployed and supported an LLM application or AI agent in production, using RAG, tool calling or multi-step workflows, and can explain how it was evaluated, what failed and how you fixed it
 - Hands-on AI or automation work on healthcare RCM workflows such as claim status, AR follow-up, denials, payment posting or payer interactions
 - Strong production Python and SQL, API integration, and working JavaScript/TypeScript
 - Browser or UI automation with Playwright, Selenium or UiPath, with error handling and human escalation
 - Deployment and monitoring on AWS, Azure or GCP using containers, version control and automated testing
 - Experience handling sensitive data with access controls and secure logging

Nice to have

- Delivering for US healthcare providers, RCM companies or payer-facing operations
 - Practice-management or EHR integrations, payer portals, EOB or ERA data
 - Voice agents, MCP integrations, Kubernetes, serverless or event-driven architectures

Originally posted on: 30 Oct 2026

data.title: Automation Tester
data.description:
As an Automation Tester, you will design, develop, and execute automated testing solutions to ensure the quality, stability, and performance of enterprise applications. You will work closely with development and business teams to identify defects, improve test coverage, and support continuous delivery through automation and performance testing. 

What You'll Do and How You'll Succeed

Automation Testing

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright. 
 - Execute automated testing across application releases and enhancements. 
 - Identify opportunities to increase test coverage and reduce manual testing effort. 
 - Support continuous improvement of test automation frameworks and practices. 

Performance Testing

- Design and execute performance and load testing scenarios. 
 - Analyse test results and identify performance bottlenecks. 
 - Support optimisation efforts by working closely with development teams. 
 - Ensure applications meet performance and scalability requirements. 

Defect Management & Quality Assurance

- Identify, log, track, and validate defects throughout the testing lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to resolve issues effectively. 
 - Support quality assurance activities and ensure testing deliverables meet project requirements. 
 - Maintain accurate testing documentation and test execution records. 

We'd Love to Hear From You If. . . 

Experience

- You have 3-6 years of experience in automation testing. 
 - You have hands‐on experience using Playwright for test automation. 
 - You have experience in performance testing. 
 - You have experience in defect management. 

Technical Expertise

- You have strong experience with Playwright automation testing. 
 - You have proficiency in Java and/or Python for test automation development. 
 - You have experience using JMeter for performance and load testing. 
 - You have knowledge of test automation frameworks, test execution, and defect tracking processes. 

Ways of Working

- You communicate effectively with technical and non‐technical stakeholders. 
 - You collaborate closely with development and testing teams to ensure quality outcomes. 
 - You demonstrate strong analytical and problem‐solving skills. 
 - You maintain attention to detail while working within project timelines. 
 - You are proactive in identifying quality improvements and automation opportunities. 

Assignment Details

- Working Hours: 9: 00 AM to 6: 00 PM IST. 

---

Who We Are

Thakral One is a consulting and technology services company headquartered in Singapore, with a pan-Asian presence. We focus primarily around technology-driven consulting, adoption of value-added bespoke solutions, enabling enhanced decision support through data analytics, and embracing possibilities in the cloud. We are heavily inclined towards building capabilities collaboratively with clients and believe strongly in improving grounded and practical outcomes. 

This approach is possible through our partnership with leading global technology providers and internal R&D teams. Our clients come from Financial Services, Banking, Telco, Government, Healthcare, and Consumer-oriented organisations.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - UI and API Testing
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens' workload management solutions - including Accelerator, PBS Professional, and Grid Engine -are trusted by some of the world's leading technology companies to run mission-critical computing workloads. 

Siemens also provides web-based solutions that enable users to submit, monitor, and manage compute workloads through an intuitive interface, simplifying access to complex computing environments. 

We are looking for a Software QA Engineer who will play a key role in automating and validating complex, enterprise-grade systems across Linux and Windows environments. As part of our Quality Center of Excellence, you will collaborate with experts in security, performance, and automation testing while acting as a strong advocate for quality across the entire development lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Contribute across the full software development lifecycle within Agile Scrum teams, ensuring quality from design to release. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management and R&D to review requirements, influence design, and validate solutions. 
 - Design and implement robust functional, integration, stress, and performance test cases for web-based applications and microservices. 
 - Develop, maintain, and optimize automated test suites using Python, including UI, backend, and REST API testing. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests, analyze results, and validate end-to-end workflows, including job submission, monitoring, and management, along with integration and scalability. 
 - Identify defects and actively support resolution by providing clear reproduction steps and root-cause analysis. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience). 
 - 4+ years of experience in Software QA, testing enterprise-grade web applications or distributed systems. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, Pytest, and Playwright for developing and maintaining automated test frameworks. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in web application testing, REST API testing, and microservices-based architectures. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and integration of automated tests into build and deployment workflows. 
 - Experience testing applications across Linux and Windows environments. 
 - Experience using QA test management systems to ensure functional and regression coverage. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the flexibility to collaborate across global, distributed teams and time zones. 

Join our Digital World

A collection of over 377, 000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us Transform the every day!

Siemens is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

If you believe in technology with purpose and are interested in learning more about Siemens Digital Industries Software before you apply then check out our Mission / Vision and our software portfolio, meet the team and join our Talent Community today so that we can stay connected in the areas that interest you: www. siemens. com/careers/transformtheeveryday/

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being.

data.title: Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer - Frontier Cyber Security
data.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

ABOUT US

Lean SuperIntelligence (LSI) is an AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity foundation models for enterprises. LSI publicly announced LSI-Offense-1 and LSI-Defense-1 on October 9, 2026, alongside the closing of its initial pre-seed financing. 

LSI-Offense-1 discovers, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to threats. The models improve through an offense-defense feedback loop inside LSI Cyber World Models, simulated enterprise environments that turn attack and defense outcomes into training signals. 

The models are designed for enterprise-controlled deployment, including on-premises and air-gapped environments, with customization on private enterprise data. Access is currently limited to selected design partners. 

Founded by Chandra Khatri, LSI brings together foundation-model builders and security researchers. Its announced backers include investors and angels with AI and security leadership experience at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Zscaler, Commvault and Gruve AI. These affiliations do not imply corporate investment by those organizations. 

Learn more: LSI website | Launch announcement | Financing and model news. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer to build the product surface of our frontier security platform, from data model and services through to the interfaces security teams work in every day. 

You will own features end to end: backend services, agent-facing APIs, and the front end where findings, exploit evidence, and remediation workflows are reviewed and acted on. This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad architectural ownership and a direct line to design partners. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own features end to end across data model, backend services, APIs, front end, telemetry, and rollout. 

- Build the interfaces security teams work in daily: finding triage, exploit evidence review, remediation and retest tracking, agent run inspection, and reporting. 

- Design backend services and APIs for scanning, agent execution, evidence storage, and integrations with code hosts, CI/CD, ticketing systems, and cloud accounts. 

- Build product surfaces on top of LLMs and autonomous agents, including streaming output, long-running task state, human approval steps, partial results, and graceful failure. 

- Turn AppSec workflows into product: finding deduplication, severity and reachability context, ownership routing, SLA tracking, and verification that fixes actually close the vulnerability. 

- Design schemas and pipelines for findings, agent trajectories, evidence artifacts, and audit trails. 

- Build multi-tenant foundations including authentication, authorization, RBAC, org and project scoping, audit logging, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. 

- Make agent behavior legible in the interface: what the agent did, what it proved, what it could not, and where a human needs to decide. 

- Own performance, reliability, latency, and cost across the stack, including inference and tool-execution cost surfaced to the user. 

- Set engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and secure-by-default patterns, and treat our own attack surface as a first-class concern. 

- Prototype quickly with design partners, put working software in front of practitioners early, and decide what is ready to ship. 

- Partner with security researchers, agent-harness engineers, and product to move research capability into product without losing rigor. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- At least five years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time spent on cybersecurity products. 

- Strong full-stack ability: modern TypeScript and React on the front end, plus backend work in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, or Rust. 

- Hands-on experience building application-security products, or closely adjacent ones such as code security, vulnerability management, attack-surface management, DevSecOps, offensive-security tooling, or SOC platforms. 

- Working security knowledge across common vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization, and secure design, with the ability to reason about the attack surface of what you build. 

- Experience designing APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workflows. 

- Front-end craft on data-dense technical interfaces, including state management, streaming and real-time updates, and performance under large result sets. 

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and production operations. 

- Ability to scope ambiguous problems, make architectural decisions, and raise the bar for other engineers through code and review rather than process. 

- Clear technical writing and comfort working directly with security practitioners and design partners. 

- We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience building products on LLMs or agents, including tool use, streaming, evaluations, prompt and model versioning, and latency and cost tradeoffs. 

- Product experience in autonomous pentesting, code security, SAST/DAST/SCA, vulnerability management, CTEM, EDR/XDR, or SOC automation. 

- Personal offensive-security depth such as CVEs, bug-bounty findings, advanced CTF performance, or published research. 

- Experience integrating with GitHub or GitLab, CI systems, Jira or ServiceNow, SIEM and EDR platforms, or cloud provider APIs. 

- Experience meeting enterprise requirements such as SSO, SAML, SCIM, audit logging, VPC or on-premise deployment, and air-gapped installs. 

- Experience with real-time systems, websockets, job queues, or event-driven architectures. 

- Design sensibility and the ability to own the user experience for technical workflows without a dedicated designer. 

- Understanding of AI and agent security risks including prompt injection, tool poisoning or misuse, excessive permissions, untrusted content, and sandbox boundaries. 

- Open-source contributions, technical writing, or prior founding-engineer and early-stage experience.

 - SQL and relational databases - PostgreSQL, Azure SQL or equivalent - and REST API integration with third-party services. 
 - Docker, and deploying and running a service on a cloud platform - Azure strongly preferred.

data.title: SDE I - SDET

Hiring for Swiggy - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

Swiggy is a leading consumer internet and food-commerce platform operating at high transaction scale across India. This Full Stack SDET role supports product-quality work across Java services, APIs, web/mobile automation, data validation, and debugging workflows that protect customer and partner experience.

- Design, implement, and maintain Java-based automated tests for APIs, services, web flows, and mobile flows across Swiggy product systems.

data.description:

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. 

Accountabilities

data.title: Senior Manager Engineering - AI/Agentic [T500-30271]
data.description:
About Albertsons

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2, 200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known global banners, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others. Our success is built upon a united team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance the customer experience. This customer-centric focus not only inspires innovation but has also led to remarkable achievements across our digital platforms and omnichannel strategies. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we have transformed shopping into an experience that is not just easy and efficient, but also fun and engaging. Over the past year, we have taken bold, strategic steps to migrate and modernize our enterprise data hub on Google Cloud, revolutionizing our data capabilities, thus becoming the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company. 

About Tech Hub In India

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Sr. Manager, AIDLC at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) workstream end to end: roadmap, delivery and outcomes. You report to the AI First head. 
 - Lead a pod of engineers who build agents across the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Stay hands-on for roughly a quarter of your time. Write code, build prototypes and review agent pull requests, so you judge agent designs and eval results first hand. 
 - Build the organization: define roles and levels, hire and onboard engineers, coach them, and set engineering standards for AI-authored and AI-assisted code. 
 - Set the technical direction for agent architecture: orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP servers (including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP), memory and state management, context engineering and RAG over engineering knowledge. 
 - Make evals a release gate. Every agent, prompt and model change passes golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring calibrated against human review, and regression suites before it ships. Require tracing and observability for agents in production. 
 - Define outcome metrics and measure them against the pre-agent baseline: delivery speed and cost, defects, security findings, cycle time and change failure rate. Report outcomes, not login counts or seat usage. 
 - Drive adoption and change management: run pilots with engineering teams, collect feedback, change how teams work, and retire agents that do not earn their place. 
 - Set governance and guardrails for agents that touch source control, CI/CD and cloud: least-privilege tool access, prompt-injection defence, human approval points, and an action trail that can be reviewed and reversed. 
 - Govern multi-agent systems: trust boundaries between agents, rules for delegation, an audit trail across agent handoffs, and the points where a human must approve. 
 - Govern token and compute cost: budgets, model routing, cost per successful outcome, and usage reporting to leadership. 
 - Run vendor and build-vs-buy evaluations for agent platforms, models and tooling, including multi-model support, with clear criteria. 
 - Use agentic coding tools every day (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and set norms for how the pod and its partner teams use them. 
 - Partner with Security, Cloud, Data, Product, Enterprise Architecture and the AI governance group so agents fit existing toolchains and meet security, legal, risk and compliance standards. 
 - Run agents in production: reliability targets, observability, incident response and a named owner for every agent. 

Experience Required

- AI experience is a MUST. You have personally built and deployed an LLM agent or agentic workflow used by real users in the last 2 years, with evals and tracing in place. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 12-15 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams: hiring, performance management and delivery accountability. 
 - Hands-on programming in Python, Java or TypeScript, used to build agents and the services around them. The agents work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Working depth in agent orchestration, tool/function calling, MCP, memory and state management, context engineering and RAG. You can review a multi-agent design and say where it will fail. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Experience running evals in practice: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, and using the results to block or approve a release. 
 - Experience with tracing and observability for LLM applications, and with guardrails, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Everyday use of agentic coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your own work, not only as a sponsor of them. 
 - Experience owning an adoption program with measured outcomes (cycle time, change failure rate, defects, cost) rather than usage counts. 
 - Experience managing LLM cost: token budgets, model selection and routing, and scaling agent workloads. 
 - Experience evaluating vendors and making build-vs-buy decisions for AI platforms. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Strong communication with senior leadership, engineering teams and risk partners. 
 - A plus: agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, code knowledge graphs or GraphRAG, building internal developer platforms. 

Competencies

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work
 - Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens
 - Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
 - Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals. 

Skills Required

- Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems: design review and governance
 - Agent Evals, Tracing and Observability
 - MCP, Memory and State Management, Context Engineering, RAG
 - Python / Java / TypeScript (hands-on)
 - Cloud Platform Experience (Azure and/or Google Cloud)
 - Engineering Leadership, Hiring and Change Management
 - AI Governance, Guardrails, Token and Compute Cost Management

data.title: Java GenAI Developer – Spring Boot, Microservices, RAG & LLMs
data.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Java Developer with Generative AI expertise to design, develop, and integrate AI-powered applications. 

The role will combine strong Java-based backend development with hands-on experience in Large Language Models, AI frameworks, cloud technologies, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, and vector databases. 

The position will contribute to business objectives by delivering scalable AI-enabled applications, intelligent automation, chatbots, copilots, search solutions, and secure enterprise technology services. 

Software Requirements

Required Software Skills

- Java: Strong professional experience in Java application development. 
 - Spring Boot: Hands-on experience developing scalable backend applications and services. 
 - Microservices: Experience designing, developing, integrating, and supporting microservices. 
 - REST APIs: Proficiency in designing, developing, integrating, and securing RESTful APIs. 
 - Distributed systems: Understanding of distributed-system principles, service communication, scalability, reliability, and fault handling. 
 - Generative AI and LLMs: Hands-on experience developing or integrating solutions using Large Language Models. 
 - AI platforms: Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic Claude, or equivalent AI platforms. 
 - AI orchestration frameworks: Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks. 
 - Prompt engineering: Knowledge of prompt design, testing, optimization, grounding, and response evaluation. 
 - RAG: Experience designing or implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures. 
 - Embeddings and vector databases: Knowledge of embeddings, semantic search, indexing, retrieval, and vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Weaviate, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Databases: Good understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases. 
 - Development and deployment tools: Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes. 
 - Cloud platforms: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Agile practices: Experience working in Agile development environments and participating in code reviews. 

Preferred Software Skills

- Python for AI/ML integrations. 
 - Knowledge of AI governance, model evaluation, and responsible AI practices. 
 - Exposure to MLOps and AI deployment frameworks. 
 - Experience building enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions. 
 - Familiarity with AI observability, monitoring, logging, and performance evaluation tools. 
 - Experience with automated testing, deployment validation, and production support for AI applications.

- Specific software versions are not mandated in the requirements. 
 - Candidates should have experience with current, production-supported versions of Java, Spring Boot, AI frameworks, cloud platforms, databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools. 
 - Candidates should be able to assess compatibility, manage upgrades, document changes, and support production lifecycle activities. 
 - The role requires 5-7 years of overall professional experience, including practical Generative AI and LLM integration experience. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable Java-based applications. 
 - Build and integrate Generative AI solutions using LLMs. 
 - Develop AI-powered chatbots, copilots, intelligent search, and automation solutions. 
 - Implement RAG architectures using embeddings, semantic search, retrieval pipelines, and vector databases. 
 - Integrate AI models through APIs and AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent tools. 
 - Develop scalable backend services and microservices using Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Design and implement RESTful APIs and distributed application services. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver practical solutions. 
 - Optimize the performance, security, scalability, reliability, latency, and maintainability of AI-enabled applications. 
 - Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to support application and AI solution requirements. 
 - Use Git, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms to support application delivery and deployment. 
 - Participate in Agile development practices, code reviews, testing, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Document application architecture, API specifications, prompts, data flows, RAG designs, test results, and operational procedures. 
 - Apply AI governance, data protection, responsible AI, and secure development practices. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation, resource efficiency, application reliability, and sustainable technology operations. 
 - Contribute to measurable outcomes such as timely feature delivery, improved response quality, reduced defects, reliable releases, and successful adoption of AI-enabled solutions. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

- Strong Java development experience. 
 - Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, exception handling, testing, and maintainable code. 
 - Experience developing Java-based APIs, microservices, integrations, and backend services. 
 - Ability to write modular, scalable, testable, secure, and production-ready code. 

Preferred

- Python for AI/ML integrations, data preparation, automation, and model interaction. 
 - Experience with additional programming or scripting languages used in cloud-native and AI application development.

Databases/Data Management

- Good understanding of SQL databases. 
 - Good understanding of NoSQL databases. 
 - Ability to design data access patterns, queries, schemas, and application integrations. 
 - Understanding of embeddings, metadata, semantic search, vector indexing, retrieval, and ranking. 
 - Experience working with vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Weaviate, or equivalent technologies.

Preferred

- Experience with data pipelines supporting RAG applications. 
 - Familiarity with document processing, chunking, metadata tagging, and data ingestion. 
 - Exposure to data validation, reconciliation, lineage, and knowledge-base management. 
 - Experience with data preparation for model evaluation or domain-specific AI solutions. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential

- Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Understanding of cloud-native application development and deployment. 
 - Experience with cloud compute, storage, networking, identity, monitoring, security, and service integration. 
 - Ability to deploy and support AI-enabled applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.

Preferred

- Experience with cloud-based AI and machine-learning services. 
 - Familiarity with serverless services, managed databases, container orchestration, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Exposure to MLOps, model deployment, AI observability, and cloud-based evaluation platforms. 
 - Understanding of cloud cost optimization and sustainable AI workload design. 

Frameworks and Libraries

- Java and Spring Boot. 
 - Microservices frameworks and REST API technologies. 
 - LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent AI orchestration frameworks. 
 - RAG architectures and related retrieval frameworks.

 - Frameworks supporting prompt management, model routing, response validation, and AI safety.

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

The role will lead the design and delivery of reusable cloud engineering, automation and DevOps capabilities, and provide senior technical ownership of Tribe Passport, a strategic ATO platform for engineering and management insights.

 - Identify opportunities for developer self-service and engineering productivity improvement, using automation to remove repetitive manual activities and operational toil. 

Tribe Passport

- Provide senior technical ownership for Tribe Passport, including solution architecture, engineering standards, code quality, release readiness, resilience and production stability. 
 - Evaluate engineering requirements and translate them into architectural designs, delivery plans, epics and technical work packages, identifying dependencies and trade-offs early.

 - Tribe Passport remains a secure, resilient, maintainable and strategically relevant engineering-insight platform. 
 - Complex platform and application engineering problems move efficiently from architecture to production, with clear ownership and measurable acceptance criteria. 
 - Engineering controls covering security, OSS, deployment and operational readiness are embedded in engineering workflows rather than evidenced manually afterwards. 
 - Cloud and platform capabilities are designed for reuse and scale, reducing duplication and reliance on platform-specific implementation knowledge. 
 - Engineering teams benefit from clear technical standards, mentoring and reusable patterns that allow them to deliver more independently. 

Your Skills And Experience

- Extensive hands-on software and/or platform engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership of complex enterprise applications, cloud platforms or engineering capabilities. 
 - Strong development capability in Java and/or Python, with the ability to review code and designs, troubleshoot complex issues and contribute directly when required. 
 - Deep practical Google Cloud experience, ideally across GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, Secret Manager, IAM/service accounts, networking, load balancing and observability. 
 - Strong infrastructure-as-code and automation experience, particularly with Terraform, including the development of reusable modules, templates and engineering patterns.

data.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
Bloomreach is building the world's premier agentic platform for personalization. We're revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. 

- We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. 
 - We're making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise - available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. 
 - We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. 

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine - Loomi - so that personalization isn't only autonomous. . . it's also consistent. From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1, 400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. 

Bloomreach is seeking a seasoned Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join our Search Quality team and lead the design and implementation of machine learning and Al-driven solutions that improve search relevance and discovery experiences for our customers. The Search Quality team focuses on building intelligent, scalable solutions that understand user queries, product catalogs, and behavioral signals to deliver the most relevant search results. We work at the intersection of Machine Learning, Information Retrieval, Search Relevance, and Software Engineering to solve challenging problems across the search stack. This is a Staff ML Engineer role, so we are looking for someone who can combine strong ML expertise with solid software engineering skills and take end-to-end ownership of complex technical problems. You will work closely with engineers, architects, and product teams to research, build, evaluate, and productionize ML-driven solutions for search. 

Your Responsibilities

- Own the technical roadmap and provide architecture leadership for ML and AI-driven relevance solutions. 
 - Design, develop, and enhance ML/AI models and algorithms for Search and Relevance. 
 - Own model evaluation and experimentation frameworks to ensure high-quality deployments. 
 - Work with search queries, product catalogs, user behavior, and other data to identify patterns and improve search quality. 
 - Work closely with software and data engineers to integrate and scale ML components into production systems. 
 - Analyze search and relevance data to identify problems and drive improvements. 
 - Mentor engineers and influence cross-team decisions to align engineering and product goals. 
 - Stay up to date with developments in Machine Learning, Information Retrieval, and Generative AI. 

Qualifications

- BE/B. Tech/ME/M. Tech in Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong mathematical foundation and excellent programming skills, primarily Python, alongside proficiency in a backend language such as Java or Go. 
 - 8+ years of experience building ML-driven systems and algorithms in production. 
 - Strong software engineering skills, with experience building low-latency, scalable distributed systems in a cloud production environment (AWS/GCP/Azure). 
 - Strong background in Search, Information Retrieval, Ranking, or Search Relevance, working with large-scale data and ML systems. 
 - Hands-on experience applying LLMs to Search/ML problems, including quality, latency, and cost trade-offs. 
 - Experience working across multiple merchants, domains, and languages. 
 - Strong background in NLP and Search Quality techniques, including intent identification, query understanding, data analysis, and domain-specific ML model tuning. 
 - Relevant search retrieval experience in at least one area: RAG, lexical search, vector search, or recommendation systems. 
 - Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
 - Effective communication skills in English, both verbal and written. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience building or working with LLM evaluation frameworks. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing hybrid search architectures. 

More things you'll like about Bloomreach: 

Culture: 

- A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don't clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. 
 - We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. 
 - We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. 
 - We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. 
 - We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. 
 - We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. 
 - The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4. 7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4. 9/5

Personal Development: 

- We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. 
 - Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges. * 
 - Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. 
 - Bloomreachers utilize the $1, 500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc. )*

Well-being: 

- The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges. * 
 - Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app. * 
 - We organize 'DisConnect' days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. 
 - We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. 
 - Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers. *

Compensation: 

- Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member's role, seniority, and location. * 
 - Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus. * 
 - We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3, 000! 
 - We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months. )

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful!

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

data.title: Front End Developer - Manager
data.description:
Role purpose

You'll build the user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a hands-on senior development role. You'll build data-heavy, real-time ReactJS/TypeScript applications that replace legacy desktop and web UIs. You'll own front-end integration with back-end services over REST APIs, WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE). You'll also set front-end standards and tooling for the team, and use AI coding tools as part of your everyday work. 

Key responsibilities

Front-end development

- Design and build complex ReactJS/TypeScript applications for trade processing, reconciliation, settlement and operations monitoring users. 
 - Build high-performance, data-heavy UIs: large grids (e. g. AG Grid), virtualised lists, filtering, dashboards and live status views. 
 - Design reusable component libraries, state management (e. g. Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query) and accessible, consistent UI patterns. 
 - Write clean, modern JavaScript (ES6+) and strongly typed TypeScript, and keep API contracts type-safe. 
 - You will have decent experience of understanding and changing Java backend code

Real-time and API integration

- Integrate with server-side services over REST APIs, including authentication, pagination, caching, retries and error handling. 
 - Build robust WebSocket clients (native WebSocket, STOMP or Socket. IO) for two-way, low-latency updates. Handle reconnects, heartbeats, back-pressure, message ordering and subscription management. 
 - Implement SSE streams for one-way server push (e. g. job status, cycle progress, alerts), including reconnection and event replay. 
 - Choose the right pattern (REST, WebSocket or SSE) for each use case, working with back-end engineers on message design and contracts. 
 - Make real-time screens perform well under heavy update volumes: batched rendering, memoisation and throttling. 

Build tooling and quality

- Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm/pnpm and Vite, including workspaces/monorepos, dependency management, environment configuration and bundle optimisation. 
 - Work with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) for front-end build, test and deployment. 
 - Write unit, component and end-to-end tests (Vitest/Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress), and use mock servers for REST, WebSocket and SSE testing. 
 - Handle front-end security: SSO/MFA integration, token handling, XSS/CSRF protection and dependency vulnerability scanning. 

AI-assisted development

- Use GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and/or Devin to speed up component building, refactoring, test generation and legacy UI analysis. 
 - Review all AI-generated code for correctness, accessibility, performance and security before merging. 

Leadership

- Set front-end standards, review code and mentor other developers. 
 - Work with business analysts and users to turn legacy screens and workflows into modern, usable interfaces. 
 - Support releases, cutovers and early-life support. 

Required Experience And Skills

- 8+ years in software development, with 5+ years building production ReactJS applications. 
 - ReactJS: expert in hooks, context, component design, performance tuning and state management. 
 - TypeScript/JavaScript: strong in TypeScript (generics, typing API contracts) and modern JavaScript, including async patterns. 
 - Build tooling: practical experience with npm, pnpm and Vite (including migrating from Webpack or similar). 
 - WebSockets: strong experience building and supporting production WebSocket integrations, including reconnection and state recovery. 
 - SSE: practical experience using Server-Sent Events/EventSource for streaming updates. 
 - REST APIs: strong experience consuming and designing contracts with server-side services (OpenAPI/Swagger). 
 - Decent Java knowledge
 - Testing: Jest/Vitest, React Testing Library and an end-to-end framework. 
 - Git, CI/CD and agile delivery. 
 - Regular use of AI coding assistants in professional delivery. 

Preferred

- Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot back ends (e. g. Spring WebSocket/STOMP, SSE endpoints), to work well with back-end teams. 
 - Experience with Kafka-backed real-time UIs or streaming gateways. 
 - Experience replacing legacy UIs (GWT, PowerBuilder, desktop/Citrix applications). 
 - Experience in financial services, ideally trading, settlement or operations monitoring. 
 - Familiarity with AWS front-end hosting (S3/CloudFront, API Gateway WebSockets). 

Success measures (first 12 months)

- Delivered production front ends for modernized applications, on schedule. 
 - Real-time features are stable under production load, with reliable reconnection and no data loss for users. 
 - Shared component library and front-end standards adopted across the team. 
 - Faster, smaller builds and good test coverage, measured against a baseline. 
 - Measurable productivity gains from AI tools, with no drop in quality. 

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. 

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you'll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

Our team owns the dashboards that customers use every day to understand how Bloomreach is delivering value to their business. This includes merchandising and search configuration tools, analytics and insights dashboards, and reporting experiences that help customers measure performance, understand shopper behavior, and make data-driven decisions to improve product discovery and business outcomes. 

Working across React. js, Java Spring Boot, and Python, we build full-stack solutions that combine rich user experiences with scalable backend services and data pipelines, enabling customers to get the most out of the Bloomreach platform. 

The Role

As a Full Stack Software Engineer II on the Dashboard Team, you will build and maintain the customer-facing applications that power Bloomreach's search, merchandising, and analytics experiences. You'll work across the stack, developing intuitive React-based user interfaces, scalable Spring Boot APIs, and Python-based data processing services that enable customers to configure, monitor, and optimize their search experience. 

You'll collaborate closely with Product, Design, and fellow engineers to deliver reliable, performant, and user-friendly features used by customers every day. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and maintain customer-facing dashboard features using React. js, Java Spring Boot, and Python. 
 - Develop intuitive, responsive, and performant user interfaces for search, merchandising, and analytics workflows. 
 - Build scalable backend services and REST APIs using Spring Boot. 
 - Develop and maintain Python services and data pipelines that power customer insights and dashboard analytics. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to translate product requirements into high-quality software. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices. 
 - Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and technical planning. 
 - Monitor production systems, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to improving system reliability and performance. 
 - Continuously improve developer productivity, code quality, and application performance. 

What You'll Bring

Technical Skills & Experience

- 3-6 years of professional software development experience. 
 - Strong programming experience in Java, with hands-on experience building backend applications using Spring Boot. 
 - Experience building modern web applications using React. js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. 
 - Experience developing RESTful APIs and integrating frontend applications with backend services. 
 - Experience writing Python applications or services for automation, data processing, or backend development. 
 - Good understanding of relational databases and SQL. 
 - Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. 
 - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development practices. 
 - Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes is a plus. 

Engineering Mindset

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 
 - Passion for building high-quality customer-facing products. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, agile environment. 
 - Strong communication skills and willingness to learn from peers. 
 - Ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive features to completion. 

What Success Looks Like In The First 30/60/90 Days

First 30 Days: Learn & Ramp Up

- Team & Product Understanding: Build a strong understanding of the Dashboard team's mission, development processes, and engineering practices. Become familiar with the customer workflows around search, merchandising, and analytics dashboards. 
 - Technical Onboarding: Set up your development environment, understand the architecture of our React, Spring Boot, and Python services, and learn how the different components interact. 
 - Build Relationships: Collaborate with teammates, actively participate in design discussions and code reviews, and become comfortable with the team's development and release processes. 
 - First Contribution: Successfully deliver your first production change, such as a bug fix or a small feature enhancement. 

First 60 Days: Build & Own

- Feature Ownership: Independently deliver medium-sized features across the frontend and backend, taking ownership from design through production deployment. 
 - Technical Proficiency: Develop a solid understanding of the Dashboard platform, APIs, and data pipelines that power customer-facing analytics and configuration experiences. 
 - Operational Excellence: Participate in production support, investigate issues, and contribute to improving application reliability, performance, and code quality. 
 - Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver high-quality user experiences. 

First 90 Days: Deliver Impact

- End-to-End Ownership: Lead the implementation of a significant feature or enhancement, collaborating with stakeholders and ensuring a smooth production rollout. 
 - Technical Contributions: Proactively identify opportunities to improve application performance, developer experience, system reliability, or maintainability, and help drive those improvements. 
 - Engineering Excellence: Become a trusted contributor through thoughtful code reviews, technical discussions, and by sharing knowledge with the team. 
 - Customer Focus: Demonstrate a strong understanding of customer needs by building features that improve usability, performance, and the overall dashboard experience. 

More things you'll like about Bloomreach: 

Culture: 

- A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don't clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. 
 - We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

Head of Internal Controls and Quality Assurance

India Middle East and Africa

Primary location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
