data.title: Staff DFT Engineer
data.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www. analog. com and on LinkedIn and X. 

We are seeking a Staff DFT Engineer who can own and drive the complete DFT strategy for complex SoCs from architecture through production silicon. This role requires deep hands-on expertise, strong technical judgment, and the ability to lead and mentor junior engineers while collaborating cross-functionally with design, PD, validation, and manufacturing teams. 

The ideal candidate operates independently, makes architecture-level decisions, and is accountable for test quality, coverage, and silicon readiness. 

Responsibilities: 

DFT Architecture & Planning

- Own DFT architecture definition at chip and subsystem level
 - Define scan, compression, LBIST, MBIST, boundary scan, and test access strategies
 - Drive testability requirements early in the RTL design phase
 - Balance coverage, test time, power, area, and schedule tradeoffs

DFT Implementation (End-to-End Ownership)

- Lead and execute: 
 - Scan insertion, stitching, and DRC closure
 - ATPG (stuck-at, transition, path delay)
 - Test compression and pattern optimization
 - Own DFT signoff including coverage, IR drop, power, and timing impacts
 - Debug and resolve DFT issues across RTL, synthesis, P&R, and gate-level stages

ATPG & Test Quality

- Generate, analyze, and optimize ATPG patterns
 - Achieve high fault coverage with minimal pattern count
 - Review and sign off on: 
 - Fault coverage reports
 - Pattern volume and test time
 - Diagnose coverage holes and drive design or methodology fixes

Silicon Bring-Up & Production Support

- Support first silicon bring-up, failure analysis, and yield ramp
 - Debug scan, BIST, and tester-related failures
 - Collaborate with ATE and manufacturing teams to improve yield and test robustness
 - Drive ECOs for DFT-related silicon issues

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Act as DFT technical lead for one or more chips
 - Guide and review work of junior and senior DFT engineers
 - Define best practices, checklists, and reusable DFT methodologies
 - Provide technical direction and design reviews

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with: 
 - RTL designers
 - Physical design (PD)
 - Functional verification
 - Product engineering and manufacturing
 - Communicate DFT requirements and risks clearly to stakeholders

Preferred/Nice-to-Have Experience: 

- Experience with high-volume production test, ATE bring-up, and test cost optimization. 
 - Exposure to safety-critical applications (automotive, industrial) and standards (e. g. , ISO 26262) from a test/reliability standpoint. 
 - Experience with on-chip debug, trace, and design-for-debug features. 
 - Scripting skills in Python/Tcl/Perl for DFT automation, log analysis, and flow integration. 
 - Prior experience mentoring or leading small DFT teams or task forces. 

Qualifications and Experience: 

- Proven experience in leading DFT teams through end-to-end SoC execution, from architecture to silicon bring-up. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in developing DFT architecture from scratch for complex SoC designs. 
 - Strong team management and leadership experience with a track record of mentoring and growing engineering talent. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a closely related field. 
 - 7+ years of hands-on experience in DFT methodologies and industry-standard test techniques. 
 - Deep knowledge and hands-on experience with: 

Logic BIST (LBIST)

Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG)

DFT Rule Checks (DFT DRC)

Scan chain compression and stitching

Low-power DFT techniques and constraints

Memory BIST (MBIST) including repair mechanisms

Boundary Scan (IEEE 1149. 1)

Analog DFT strategies

JTAG architecture and TAP integration

DFT-specific STA constraints

- Proficient in using industry-standard DFT EDA tools, including cadence, Siemens. 
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using Perl, Tcl, and/or Python. 
 - Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals, including RTL design, Lint/CDC, low power checks, and the full ASIC design flow. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex DFT issues efficiently. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively in cross-functional and team-oriented environments.

Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U. S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position - except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U. S. C. 1324b(a)(3) - may have to go through an export licensing review process.

data.title: Test Automation Expert – Substation Automation Software Development Projects
data.description:
At Siemens Energy, we can. Our technology is key, but our people make the difference. Brilliant minds innovate. They connect, create, and keep us on track towards changing the world's energy systems. Their spirit fuels our mission. 

Our culture is defined by caring, agile, respectful, and accountable individuals. We value excellence of any kind. Sounds like you?

Let's Talk About You

You are a skilled Test Automation Expert with a passion for advancing the reliability and quality of substation automation software. You thrive in environments where rigorous testing, automation frameworks, and continuous improvement are essential. You translate complex requirements into robust automated test scenarios and collaborate closely with development, product, and quality teams to ensure delivery of high-integrity solutions for grid and substation automation. 

A Snapshot of Your Day

Your day begins by reviewing new feature requirements and updating automated test scripts to reflect the latest changes. You sync with software developers to clarify technical details and ensure test coverage for critical modules. Before lunch, you execute automated test suites, analyze results, and report defects using Solution Manager or equivalent tools. In the afternoon, you participate in sprint planning, refine test data management strategies, and contribute to functional and quality reviews. You close the day by optimizing test automation frameworks and sharing insights with the team to drive continuous improvement. 

How You'll Make an Impact

Test Automation Strategy & Execution

- Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for substation automation software, ensuring coverage of key functional and non-functional requirements. 
 - Collaborate with functional teams to identify test scenarios, set up test data, and document detailed test steps. 
 - Integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines and support on-demand test cycles for rapid validation. 

Quality Assurance & Reporting

- Track test script development progress and execution status, maintaining transparent reporting in Solution Manager and other tools. 
 - Analyze test results, identify defects, and work with development teams to ensure timely resolution and retesting. 
 - Prepare and present detailed test reports for review by stakeholders, including live demonstrations of automated scenarios. 

Frameworks, Tools & Methodologies

- Adopt and enhance automation frameworks (e. g. , TOSCA, Worksoft) and ensure adherence to best practices and standards. 
 - Support tool setup, configuration, and license management for the automation team. 
 - Contribute to the evolution of automation strategies and scripting handbooks. 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

- Act as a central coordination point between test automation, development, and functional teams. 
 - Participate in governance meetings, quality reviews, and sprint retrospectives to drive improvements in test coverage and efficiency. 
 - Mentor junior team members and share expertise in automation best practices. 

Data Management & Test Governance

- Manage test data creation and scenario execution documentation. 
 - Ensure functional teams provide necessary data and steps for automation, and develop scripts for master data creation as needed. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 5+ years in test automation for industrial or grid automation software projects, with hands-on expertise in automation frameworks and tools. 
 - Technical Skills: Proficiency in scripting languages, test automation tools (TOSCA, Worksoft, or similar), and integration with CI/CD environments. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Understanding of substation automation concepts, protocols (IEC 61850, IEC 104, DNP3), and grid technologies is a strong plus. 
 - Collaboration: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working in cross-functional teams. 
 - Analytics: Familiarity with test dashboards, reporting tools, and data-driven optimization. 
 - Methodologies: Exposure to agile development, PLM stage-gates, and structured test governance processes. 
 - Language Proficiency: Fluency in English; German is a plus. 

About The Team

You will join a collaborative software development and test automation team working closely with Grid Technologies and regional engineering organizations. The team operates within structured PLM and test governance frameworks, focused on delivering robust, scalable, and innovative substation automation solutions. Strong engagement with regional and global stakeholders ensures that your work directly contributes to the reliability and advancement of modern grid infrastructure.

data.title: Integrated Product Team Lead
data.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

IPT Lead is responsible for playing a critical role in the development of cutting-edge gas turbine products. 

Will lead and coordinate a multidisciplinary and global team of engineers responsible for the design, manufacturability, serviceability and fleet introduction of gas turbine, turbine blades and vanes and will work closely with stakeholders, interface partners in engineering, manufacturing, service, procurement, and program management on engine level to ensure that all targets of the turbine project are successfully achieved. 

How You'll Make an Impact (Gas Turbine, R& D, India)

▸Lead and coordinate a multidisciplinary and global Integrated Product Team (IPT) developing turbine blades and vanes within Large Gas Turbines R&D. 

▸Provide technical expertise and guidance to the IPT members (aerodynamics, heat transfer, mechanical integrity, mechanical design) to ensure that all targets of your turbine project are successfully met. 

▸You manage all relevant interfaces by working closely with manufacturing, service, and technology as well as other interfaces within engineering (e. g. , casing, rotor, combustion, whole engine model, performance). 

▸Ensure your turbine project is completed on schedule, within budget, and complies with technical specifications. 

▸Identify and manage technical and commercial risks associated with the turbine project

▸You regularly report your team's progress to the engine level project manager (PM), as well as to involved stakeholders. 

What You Bring

▸University degree in mechanical engineering and a proven background of more than 5 years in R&D project management, preferably in the field of gas turbine design

▸Deep understanding of design activities that are required during a gas turbine, turbine project (aerodynamics, heat transfer, mechanical integrity, product definition, manufacturing, service)

▸Strong leadership skills and experience in leading multidisciplinary and global teams

▸Good understanding of design for manufacturing and manufacturing process

▸Strong communication, inter-cultural awareness, and presentation skills

▸ Pro-active mindset, analytical and organizational skills, willingness to communicate as well as expertise in networking and change management. 

About The Team (Power Generation)

In the large steam and gas turbine domain, we offer services and solutions for gas turbines, large steam turbines, large generators, and associated control technology. Our portfolio serves customers such as power utilities, Independent Power Producers (IPPs), Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) firms, and industrial clients. We provide a comprehensive range of offerings including maintenance, operation, digital services, modernization and upgradation, plant flexibilization, as well as control and digitalization solutions (digital control systems, field instruments, and equipment) and professional consulting. 

Our power generation portfolio also includes industrial steam turbines (ranging from 10 kW to 250 MW), condensers, and service offerings designed to extend the lifespan and efficiency of industrial steam turbines through heat recovery solutions. We cater to a wide range of process industries-including oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, paper & pulp, sugar & ethanol, and marine-helping customers reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. A key focus area is delivering integrated industrial decarbonization solutions built on electrification, automation, and digitalization, while supporting sustainability through carbon-optimized energy systems and hydrogen generation. 

Who is Siemens Energy India?

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets. 

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio offering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www. siemens-energy-india. com

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https: //www. siemens-energy. com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character - no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

data.title: Technical Specialist
data.description:
The Technical Specialist owns platform fit, architecture, design correctness, technical integrity, quality, governance, standards and best practices for delivered applications, ensuring the solution is technically sound and fit for implementation. You will review feasibility and platform fit, generate, review and approve estimates, and define the high-level solution architecture. You will review integration, security, scalability and performance implications, set technical standards and guardrails, and standardise HLD and DLD guidelines and documentation. You will also standardise the prompt registry and AI toolchain, provision the base code, confirm that work packets are technically sound and buildable, resolve architecture-level decisions and escalations, support technical reviews during delivery, and address technical escalations. 

Must have: Knowledge of technology and platform capabilities and limitations, AI-assisted architecture and design capabilities and limitations, the functional implications of technology choices, capability versus cost comparison of AI tools, architecture patterns and design principles, UML and system design notation, API and integration concepts, data modelling basics, security, data protection and access control, cloud fundamentals, scalability and performance basics and technical governance. Skills in preparing HLDs and DLDs, drawing architecture diagrams, reviewing technical designs, assessing trade-offs and constraints, validating integration and security decisions, translating business needs into technical structure, effective prompting and technical auditing. Rigorous thinking, clear explanation of technical ideas, decision-making, collaboration with business and engineering teams and a constructive review style. A quality focus, objectivity, accountability for design choices, discipline, careful judgement and attention to detail. A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or IT (or equivalent practical experience), TOGAF Foundation or Practitioner, and Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert or an equivalent cloud architecture certification. 

Good to have: Knowledge of industry platforms, microservices or modular design patterns, event-driven design, DevOps concepts and AI-assisted software design, with skills in reviewing DLDs for technical completeness, creating reference architecture diagrams, evaluating alternative technical approaches and using AI tools for design summarisation and comparison. Influencing without authority, facilitating technical workshops, calm handling of disagreement and a mentoring mindset. Curiosity, patience, continuous learning and perseverance in resolving hard problems. A Kubernetes or platform architecture certification relevant to the stack.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:

data.title: Testing Engineer
data.description:
The Testing Engineer owns test design, test coverage, defect analysis, UAT support and release readiness, making sure the solution is tested properly before it moves forward. You will review functional specifications, mock-ups and validations, create test scenarios and test cases, and execute functional, regression and smoke tests. You will track and analyse defects, support UAT with users, and check that fixes work after re-test. You will also support test deployment and release readiness, and prepare test evidence and sign-off support notes.

Skills in writing test cases, executing tests, analysing defects, preparing test data, retesting fixes, supporting UAT coordination and using AI tools for test drafting and defect summarisation. Meticulousness, objectivity, persistence, collaboration with developers and business users and clear defect reporting. A quality focus, attention to detail, persistence, reliability, a bias for evidence and ownership of defect closure. A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, IT, computer science or a related field, and ISTQB Foundation or higher. 

Good to have: Knowledge of risk-based testing, boundary and negative testing, performance and security testing basics, test management tools and AI-assisted test design, with skills in creating regression packs, supporting test deployment readiness, using test tools effectively and creating clear test evidence and reports. Calmness during issue closure, patient follow-through, the ability to challenge defects clearly and strong review discipline. Calmness under pressure, curiosity, continuous learning and a constructive mindset. An Agile testing certification, a tool-specific certification for test management or automation, or training in AI-assisted test generation. 

Apply Now

data.description:

 - We'll look to you to drive the build of effortless, digital first customer experiences

 - We're offering this role at vice president level

As a Data Engineer, you'll be looking to simplify our organisation by developing innovative data driven solutions through data pipelines, modelling and ETL design, inspiring to be commercially successful while keeping our customers, and the bank's data, safe and secure. 

You'll drive customer value by understanding complex business problems and requirements to correctly apply the most appropriate and reusable tool to gather and build data solutions. data.title: Automation Engineer Hyderabad
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

The Automation Engineer designs, builds and supports secure, reliable automation across enterprise services. The role turns manual and complex processes into maintainable workflows using RPA, PowerShell, APIs, SQL and enterprise platforms. It owns automation end to end from process analysis and design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement while partnering with service owners and technology teams to improve efficiency, consistency and operational control. 

Work you'll do

As an Automation Engineer on the Enterprise IT Automation team, you will be responsible for: 

- Design, develop, and maintain production-grade robotic process automation (RPA) and PowerShell solutions, including reusable modules, workflow validation, logging, error handling, retries, and recovery. 
 - Translate operational processes into workflows that define inputs, decisions, approvals, exceptions, notifications, audit requirements, and rollback procedures. 
 - Integrate enterprise platforms through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs), PowerShell modules, and other interfaces; transform data; and use Microsoft SQL Server for process state, configuration, audit, and reporting. 
 - Develop Transact-SQL (T-SQL) queries and database objects; promote code, configuration, and database changes through controlled environments; and apply Git, peer review, Pester, PSScriptAnalyzer, testing, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices. 
 - Monitor deployed automation, diagnose cross-system issues, address recurring failures, maintain runbooks, protect credentials and sensitive data, uphold least-privilege access and Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) approval and change processes, and improve reliability, supportability, and operational controls. 
 - Partner with service owners and technical teams to identify automation opportunities and, where practical, measure effort saved, cycle-time improvements, consistency, and risk reduction. 

The team

The team delivers automation solutions that support enterprise IT services across Deloitte. Working with service owners and technology teams, the team improves operational efficiency, reliability, security, and consistency through scalable workflows and integrations. Team members collaborate across platforms to modernize processes, strengthen controls, and provide dependable support for business-critical services. 

Location: Hyderabad

Shift Timings: 2: 00 PM to 11: 00 PM IST / 1: 00 PM to 10: 00 PM during UK daylight saving time

Qualifications

Required: 

- Bachelor of Engineering/ Bachelor of Technology
 - 8+ years of experience developing and supporting automation solutions in an enterprise organization. 
 - Experience developing RPA and PowerShell automation, including functions and modules, parameter validation, object pipelines, error handling, remoting, configuration, data transformation, and API integration. 
 - Experience using Microsoft SQL Server and Transact-SQL (T-SQL) to build queries, manipulate data, and develop tables, views, stored procedures, schemas, and audit or staging data. 
 - Experience integrating Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs using Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) methods, authentication, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), pagination, rate limits, error handling, and retry strategies. 
 - Experience using Git, code review, testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) concepts, debugging, structured logging, production change management, and technical documentation. 
 - Experience supporting production automation or applications in Windows enterprise environments, including Windows Server, Active Directory, service accounts, permissions, Domain Name System (DNS), network paths, and unattended or scheduled execution. 

Preferred: 

- Microsoft Power Automate certification
 - Microsoft Azure certification
 - Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) certification
 - Experience integrating GraphQL APIs. 
 - Experience with one or more of ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online, SharePoint Patterns and Practices (PnP) PowerShell, Microsoft Teams, CyberArk, TeamCity, or PowerShell Universal. 
 - Experience with one or more of Azure DevOps Server, Team Foundation Server, GitHub, Microsoft Identity Manager, System Center Configuration Manager, System Center Operations Manager, System Center Virtual Machine Manager, Microsoft Intune, Citrix, SolarWinds, Jamf, Absolute, Venafi, Qualys, Varonis, Microsoft Azure, or Amazon Web Services. 

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. 

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work. 

Professional development

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India . 

Benefits To Help You Thrive

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially-and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you. 

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

data.title: Quality Automation Specialist, Playwright & API Testing, AVP
data.description:
Join us as a Quality Automation Specialist

- In this key role, you'll be undertaking and enabling automated testing activities in all delivery models
 - We'll look to you to support teams to develop quality solutions and enable continuous integration and assurance of defect free deployment of customer value
 - You'll be working closely with feature teams and a variety of stakeholders, giving you great exposure to professional development opportunities
 - We're offering this role at associate vice president

What you'll do

Joining us in a highly collaborative role, you'll be contributing to the transformation of testing using quality processes, tools, and methodologies, significantly improving control, accuracy and integrity. You'll be making sure repeatable, constant and consistent quality is built into all phases of the idea to value lifecycle at reduced cost or reduced time to market. 

It's a chance to work with colleagues at multiple levels, and with cross-domain, domain, platform and feature teams, to build in quality as an integral part of all activities. 

Additionally, You'll Be

- Supporting the design of automation test strategies, aligned to business or programme goals
 - Evolving more predictive and intelligent testing approaches, based on automation and innovative testing products and solutions
 - Collaborating with stakeholders and feature teams and making sure that automated testing is performed and monitored as an essential part of the planning and product delivery
 - Designing and creating a low maintenance suite of stable, re-usable automated tests, which are usable both within the product or domain and across domains and systems in an end-to-end capacity
 - Applying testing and delivery standards by understanding the product development lifecycle along with mandatory, regulatory and compliance requirements

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with experience of automated testing, particularly from an Agile development or CI/CD environment. You'll be an innovative thinker who can identify opportunities and design solutions, coupled with the ability to develop complex automation code. 

You'll have a good understanding of Agile methodologies with experience of working in an Agile team, with the ability to relate everyday work to the strategic vision of the feature team with a strong focus on business outcomes. 

We'll Also Look For You To Have

- Eight to twelve years of proven QA Automation experience, including a minimum of two years of hands-on Playwright experience for UI and API testing

 - Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, and Java
 - Proven experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines
 - Solid understanding of REST APIs with hands-on experience using Postman and Swagger
 - Exposure to AWS cloud environments is preferred

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. 

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization: 

- Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. 
 - Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. 
 - Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. 
 - Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. 
 - Implements software testing (e. g. , functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. 
 - Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. 
 - Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. 

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design: 

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. 
 - Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. 
 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. 

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support: 

- Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. 
 - May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. 
 - Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. 
 - Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. 
 - Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently. 
 - Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e. g. , future enhancements). 

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance: 

- Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. 
 - Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. 
 - Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. 

Development Operations - System Maintenance: 

- Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e. g. , for critical vulnerabilities). 
 - Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

- Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD102170

Position Overview

Autodesk is building an artificial intelligence (AI)-first application platform that delivers connected experiences across its products and enables customers and internal teams to work more effectively through agent-driven workflows. 

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Pune engineering team, you will help shape the backend and platform capabilities that power agent-driven applications, workspace experiences, and integrations. 

You will lead technical design, develop scalable and reliable services, and contribute to large-scale applications used across Autodesk products and teams. Working closely with product managers, architects, and fellow engineers, you will deliver robust solutions that evolve with the platform's growing needs.

- Design, develop, and operate scalable backend and platform services that support agent-driven applications and workspace workflows
 - Lead the technical design of Representational State Transfer (REST) application programming interfaces (APIs), GraphQL services, data models, integrations, and distributed system components
 - Build reliable integrations that connect applications with AI agents, tools, and workflow components
 - Design and implement distributed services that prioritize scalability, availability, resilience, and maintainability

 - Strong understanding of microservices architecture, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems concepts
 - Experience working with relational databases or non-relational (NoSQL) databases

 - Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement improvements that enhance service reliability
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical designs and work effectively across teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building shared platform services or distributed systems that support multiple products, applications, or engineering teams
 - Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems, containerization technologies, or infrastructure automation
 - Experience optimizing performance, scalability, reliability, and observability in production environments
 - Familiarity with data privacy principles, access control mechanisms, and data retention considerations for software services

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a technically proficient and collaborative software engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and building reliable, scalable backend systems. You combine strong architectural judgment with hands-on development expertise and are motivated by opportunities to contribute to AI-driven platform capabilities. 

- Demonstrates strong ownership of technical design, development, deployment, and operational excellence
 - Applies sound engineering judgment to balance scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability
 - Enjoys working with emerging AI technologies and exploring practical applications of agent-driven workflows
 - Approaches complex technical challenges with analytical thinking, creativity, and a structured problem-solving mindset
 - Collaborates effectively with product managers, architects, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders
 - Communicates technical concepts clearly and contributes constructively to architectural discussions and design decisions
 - Promotes high-quality engineering practices through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and continuous improvement
 - Takes a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production issues while improving system resilience
 - Supports the professional growth of fellow engineers through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance
 - Adapts to evolving platform requirements and embraces opportunities to learn and apply new technologies

data.title: Head of Digital Enablement Services
data.description:
Head of Digital Enablement Services

Woolworths Group India is partnering exclusively with Zinnov Group to recruit for this position. 

About the role

The Head of Digital Enablement Services will play a critical role in shaping the future of digital operations by leveraging automation, AI, cloud technologies, and engineering best practices to improve service resilience, efficiency, and customer outcomes. This role is the primary liaison and key point of contact for the Digital Enablement function within Service, Operations, and Infrastructure (SOI). Based in Woolworths India office, the successful candidate will lead a team of 75+ professionals to ensure Woolworths Digital Domain Enablement continually strives for best-in-class practices across digital operations, reliability engineering, and engineering foundations. They will optimise the team's enablement, support, and automation capabilities for the short, medium, and long term. 

What you'll experience

- We champion modern, sustainable ways of working, featuring structured hybrid working models, flexible hours, and family-friendly policies designed to support work-life harmony. 
 - We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, psychological safety is actively cultivated, and every voice is heard. 
 - Access senior executive sponsorship, continuous leadership coaching, and clear pathways for ongoing professional advancement. 
 - Enjoy competitive performance bonuses, 20 days annual leave, comprehensive healthcare coverage for you and your dependants. 

Key Responsibilities

- Delivery & Operations: Direct daily operations, delivery timelines, resources, and budgets for Engineering, Operations Support, Intelligence, and Automation teams. 
 - Strategic Alignment: Actively influence the enablement and operations strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with the wider Digital Technology strategy. 
 - Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the bridge between SOI and W Digital senior executives in Australia and IT senior leadership in India. 
 - Incident Management: Serve as an escalation point for critical operational incidents, providing leadership to minimise business disruption (which may include after-hours support). 
 - Team Development: Facilitate continuous training and capability development to upskill the team for evolving digital technologies. 

Technical Expertise

- Industry Background: Ideally comes from the retail technology background with eCommerce experience. 
 - Leadership Experience: Must have a proven track record leading regional capability centers and large professional teams in India (including managing managers and technical leads). Experience navigating matrixed/Agile organisations is required. 
 - Technical Breadth: Broad engineering experience spanning modern technology domains like software development, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud platforms (Azure and GCP), AI, automation, Container hosting (ie: AKS) and databases. 
 - Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of Operations Automation, Reliability, Support Engineering, and Quality Assurance frameworks. 

Soft Skills & Attributes

- Mindset: Customer and team-first mentality with a collaborative, growth-oriented mindset. 
 - Influence: Ability to achieve outcomes across the organisation through influence and relationships, rather than relying on hierarchical authority. 
 - Commercial Acumen: Commercially oriented, willing to take informed risks, and capable of prioritising decisions that create business value. 
 - Problem Solving: Exceptional ability to distill complex, multi-team problems into simple solution sets that diverse stakeholder groups can easily understand. 
 - Resilience: High resilience in the face of challenges, willing to lean into problems outside their formal domain to protect business objectives. 

Key Results

- Team Health: "Voice of Team" with the main metric being the business unit advocacy. 
 - Financial Discipline: Budget adherence and optimal resource allocation across the 75+ person team. 
 - System Health: Security, resilience, and performance of supported solutions. 
 - Innovation: Demonstrable increases in operational efficiency driven by automation and intelligence initiatives. 

Career Experience

- 18+ years of progressive experience across Digital Enablement, Technology Operations, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Service Management (ITSM), Platform Operations, and Enterprise Technology functions within large-scale, customer-centric organizations. . 
 - Minimum 12+ years in senior leadership roles, leading digital operations, engineering enablement, reliability, support, and automation functions with accountability for service delivery and business outcomes. 
 - Strong expertise in modern technology environments, including cloud platforms (Azure/GCP), DevOps, SRE, automation, AI-driven operations, container platforms (AKS/Kubernetes), and observability practices. 
 - Experience influencing technology strategy and transformation roadmaps, aligning operational priorities with enterprise technology and business objectives. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills, partnering with senior technology and business leaders across global, matrixed, and Agile organizations. 
 - Preferred experience in Retail, eCommerce, FMCG, or large-scale GCC environments, with a track record of leveraging automation and operational intelligence to improve efficiency, resilience, and business value. 

Location: Corporate Edge, Level 10, M3, Block Acacia, Embassy Manyata Business Park, Nagavara

Everyone belongs at Woolworths Group

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are key to realising our purpose of better together for a better tomorrow. We recognise the value our team's diversity brings to our business, customers, and communities and that teams with diverse experiences and backgrounds enrich our group and are better able to innovate and solve problems. As one of the largest employers in Australia and New Zealand, we aim to create a truly inclusive workplace where everyone feels that they belong, can be their best selves, and reach their full potential. 

We encourage all candidates to apply; please let us know in your application if we can support you with any adjustments in the hiring process. 

About Woolworths

Woolworths Group is one of Australia's largest retailers, serving millions of customers across supermarkets, digital channels, supply chain operations, and related businesses. Through a strong focus on innovation, analytics, and technology, Woolworths continues to transform the retail experience and deliver better outcomes for customers, partners, and communities. 

As a data-driven organization, Woolworths invests heavily in advanced analytics, business intelligence, and digital capabilities to support strategic decision-making and operational excellence. Joining Woolworths means working in a collaborative environment where insights and innovation directly influence business success. 

At Woolworths, you will have the opportunity to work on large-scale retail and digital transformation initiatives, leveraging data to enhance customer experiences, optimize operations, and influence key business decisions.

data.title: Product & Engineering Lead
data.description:
Product & Engineering Lead

SVECTOR | Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Full-time, On-site

Level: Founding technical leadership

Reports to: Founder-CEO

Scope: Company-wide, across all SVECTOR business lines

About SVECTOR

SVECTOR builds intelligence infrastructure for enterprises and institutions. We develop software that connects fragmented data, reasoning, human judgment and operational workflows, so organizations can make better decisions and act with precision. 

Our work spans VERDICT (talent and leadership intelligence), enterprise AI and autonomous software engineering, financial intelligence, healthcare, industrial operations, defence-related secure systems and emerging intelligent software. 

We are a lean, founder-led company where technical depth, independent thinking and the ability to execute matter more than hierarchy. 

About the Role

We are hiring a Product & Engineering Lead to take hands-on ownership of engineering execution across SVECTOR, working directly with the Founder-CEO. 

This is not a role limited to one product. You will turn research and product direction into working software, improve existing systems, build reusable technical foundations and guide a small engineering team as the business grows. Some products need to be built from scratch. Others need better implementations, complex data integrations or enterprise deployment. 

You will move between architecture, coding, debugging, AI-system design, technical planning and production delivery. This is neither a project-coordination role nor a management-only role. You are expected to build, review, test and ship. 

Priorities will follow product maturity, customer needs and available resources. We will not push every business line at once. 

What You Will Do

Architecture and product engineering

• Turn ambitious, sometimes incomplete product ideas into clear specifications, architecture decisions, milestones and acceptance criteria. 

• Design systems end to end: backend services, APIs, frontend, databases, data pipelines, AI components and deployment. 

• Assess feasibility, find failure points early and explain trade-offs in speed, quality, reliability, cost and maintainability. 

• Decide what should be shared across SVECTOR and what must stay specific to a product or domain. 

• Challenge unnecessary complexity and keep architecture documents and diagrams usable. 

Hands-on development

• Personally write, review, debug, refactor and test production code. 

• Build critical features and prototypes, and trace failures to the root cause instead of patching around them. 

• Set standards for Git workflow, code review, automated testing, releases and documentation. 

• Use AI coding tools for speed, but understand and verify every significant change yourself. 

AI, data and decision systems

• Build practical AI workflows using LLMs, retrieval, structured outputs, tool use and document understanding. 

• Engineer data ingestion, indexing and search, with outputs that link back to evidence. 

• Add evaluations, monitoring, error handling and human review paths. 

• Handle hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, latency and inference cost. 

• Know when plain software is more reliable than adding AI. 

Delivery and team leadership

• Turn approved priorities into weekly engineering plans with owners, dependencies, tests and proof of completion. 

• Guide engineers, interns and contractors through technical decisions, code reviews and delivery. 

• Raise blockers early with the problem, what was tried, the options and your recommendation. 

• Judge progress by working software. A demo or an activity update is not a completed release. 

• Support engineering hiring and build a small team that can ship without the Founder supervising every task. 

Enterprise readiness, security and reliability

• Prepare products for enterprise use: authentication, role-based access, audit logs, data protection, monitoring, backups and recovery. 

• Support cloud, private-cloud, on-premise and isolated deployments where customers need them. 

• Integrate with customers' existing applications, data sources and identity systems. 

• Review deployment risks and rollback plans before customer releases. 

• Protect confidential customer, candidate, healthcare, financial and security-sensitive data. 

• Work with legal and security specialists where requirements go beyond engineering. 

• Make sure customer-facing technical claims match what is actually built and tested. 

Products You May Work On

• VERDICT: role mandates, candidate evidence, assessment workflows and talent intelligence. 

• Enterprise AI: software automation, cross-system integration and reusable application infrastructure. 

• Financial intelligence: company and capital analysis, risk signals and scenario workflows. 

• Industrial intelligence: telemetry, event pipelines, monitoring and operator decision tools. 

• Defence and secure systems: controlled environments, data fusion and auditability. 

• Healthcare intelligence: claims, reimbursement and operational workflows. 

• Emerging applications, as their technical and commercial needs are validated. 

You are not expected to know every industry. You are expected to understand different technical problems, spot reusable components, work with domain experts and make disciplined engineering decisions. 

What You Bring

Software engineering

• Strong Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or equivalent production languages. 

• Backend development, REST APIs and SQL databases (PostgreSQL preferred), plus frameworks such as FastAPI, Django or Node. js. 

• Frontend experience with React, Next. js or similar. 

• Solid grounding in system design, data modeling, debugging, performance and secure coding. 

AI and infrastructure

• Experience putting AI or data-processing features into working applications, not only demos. 

• Understanding of LLM APIs, retrieval, embeddings, structured output, evaluation and their limits. 

• Git, Docker, CI/CD, Linux, at least one major cloud platform, monitoring and automated testing. 

Ownership and leadership

• Evidence that you personally shipped meaningful software and made the technical calls. 

• Comfort working from ambiguous requirements without detailed instructions. 

• Experience reviewing code or directing other developers. 

• Clear written communication and the willingness to challenge weak assumptions with evidence. 

Experience: about 3 to 6 years is a useful reference. Demonstrated work matters more than your degree, previous title or exact years. 

Working With the Founder

You will work daily with the Founder, who keeps responsibility for company strategy, major product direction and consequential budget or customer commitments. You will have real ownership of agreed technical work, implementation choices, engineering standards and day-to-day delivery. We expect you to challenge proposals constructively, explain trade-offs and execute agreed decisions independently. 

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: understand current systems and priorities, identify material technical risks, contribute working code and present a credible engineering plan. 

• By 60 days: own agreed workstreams, set practical review and testing standards, and deliver verified improvements with less Founder involvement. 

• By 90 days: show reliable releases, clear engineering ownership, better technical quality and a repeatable delivery process that can support several products. 

This Role Is Not For You If You Want

• A management-only role with no code. 

• A coordination role built around meetings and reporting. 

• A narrow role limited to assigned tickets. 

• A large engineering organization with fixed processes. 

• A remote or hybrid arrangement. 

Location

Full-time and on-site in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The role involves close daily work with the Founder and the team. Candidates based elsewhere should be willing to relocate. 

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your resume and, where available, GitHub, deployed products, architecture work or technical writing. Be ready to discuss: 

1. A product or system you personally built, including your exact contribution. 

2. A difficult engineering failure or architectural trade-off and how you resolved it. 

3. How you would turn an ambiguous product objective into a working, tested release. 

Shortlisted applicants may complete a technical discussion, an architecture exercise or a practical review of previous work.

 - Lead vulnerability management for Infoblox products, cloud infrastructure, and SaaS services, from scanning and triage through Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) analysis, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting
 - Oversee the team's role as a second- and third-line escalation point for incident response, ensuring effective investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned
 - Guide security engineering across cloud, Kubernetes, identity, and endpoint infrastructure, including hardening, security tooling, and automation
 - Review technical work, unblock complex problems, and provide hands-on leadership during critical vulnerabilities and security incidents
 - Establish and execute an AI and automation roadmap for vulnerability management, incident response, and security engineering, prioritizing high-value workflows and measurable outcomes
 - Set quality, safety, and governance practices for AI tools and agents, including human review, secure data handling, and appropriate access controls
 - Measure and report impact, including time to remediate, service-level agreement (SLA) adherence, incident response performance, hours saved, and reduced response times

Be Prepared - What You Bring

- 10 or more years of experience in security engineering, product security, cloud security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, or a related discipline, including at least three years of direct people management experience
 - A demonstrated record of building and developing teams, growing engineers into stronger contributors and leaders, setting expectations, and managing performance
 - Hands-on expertise in vulnerability management, including scanning tools, CVE analysis, Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS), risk-based prioritization, and remediation with engineering teams
 - Practical incident response experience, including leading investigations and coordinating response across teams
 - Strong working knowledge of cloud security in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud; Kubernetes and containers; and common attack paths across infrastructure and applications
 - Experience with security tooling such as cloud-native application protection platforms (CNAPP), cloud security posture management (CSPM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), security information and event management (SIEM), and vulnerability scanners
 - Scripting and automation experience in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages
 - A record of driving AI adoption and automation on a security team, with measurable results; hands-on experience with AI/large language model (LLM) tools and agentic workflows; and understanding of risks such as prompt injection, data exposure, and over-permissioned agents
 - Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP as they relate to vulnerability management and incident response, plus strong communication skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across time zones

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you'll grow and belong here.

data.title: Principal software engineer
data.description:
Experience: 10+ years

Location: Noida

Employment Type: Full‐time

Team: Platform / Systems / Security Engineering

Role Summary

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer who combines deep systems expertise with security-first design. You will lead architecture and development across Linux kernel, boot loader, and user‐space middleware, building secure, reliable, and performant platforms that power our next-generation [products/platforms]. You'll set technical direction, elevate engineering standards, mentor senior engineers, and partner with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-impact outcomes. 

What You'll Do

- Design and implement security features in boot loader complementing secure boot, measured boot, and chain of trust. 
 - Design and implement security features in Linux kernel features (e. g. , device drivers, filesystems, networking stack, security modules). 
 - Build and optimize user‐space middleware (e. g. , IPC frameworks, OpenSSL, DPDK) leveraging Userspace drivers. 
 - Implement and integrate security protocols (e. g. , TLS 1. 3, DTLS, IPsec, SSH, ) and hardware-backed key management. 
 - Drive threat modeling, secure design reviews, and code audits, ensuring compliance with best practices (e. g. , ASLR, stack canaries, SELinux/AppArmor policies). 
 - Lead performance and reliability engineering including profiling, tracing (ftrace, eBPF, perf), memory safety, and resource efficiency. 
 - Define platform CI/CD for low-level software (artifact signing, SBOMs, reproducible builds, Yocto/Buildroot/DEB/RPM pipelines). 
 - Mentor and grow engineers, guide technical roadmaps, and make pragmatic build/buy/OSS leverage decisions. 
 - Collaborate with Design team, IP team, DevOps, product, and QA to meet functional, performance, and certification goals. 

Qualifications (Required)

- 10+ years of professional experience in systems/embedded/platform engineering, including technical leadership at team or org scale. 
 - Expert in C/C++ for systems-level development; nice to have proficiency in Rust for memory‐safe components. 
 - Demonstrated depth in Linux kernel internals (at least two areas): drivers, MM, scheduler, net, filesystems, security modules (LSMs), eBPF. 
 - Hands-on boot loader development and customization (U‐Boot, GRUB, secure boot flows, measured boot, boot-time diagnostics). 
 - Strong knowledge of security protocols and cryptography (TLS/IPsec, X. 509/PKI, key exchange, HSM/TPM, secure storage, attestation). 
 - Experience building user‐space middleware (IPC, service management with systemd, observability/logging, configuration frameworks). 
 - Proficiency with Linux build systems and distributions for embedded/platform (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, Buildroot) or enterprise (Deb/RPM). 
 - Proven ownership of architecture/design documents, RFCs, and shipping production-quality platform software. 
 - Debugging mastery using kernel/user tools (kgdb, crash, perf, ftrace, strace, gdb, BPF tools) on real hardware/virtualized targets. 

Nice to Have

- Trusted execution & firmware: ARM TrustZone, OP‐TEE, Intel SGX/TDX, AMD SEV, TF‐A, UEFI, ACPI/Device Tree. 
 - Virtualization & containers: KVM/QEMU, Kata Containers, cgroups, namespaces; container security (seccomp, SELinux/AppArmor). 
 - Networking & storage: DPDK, SR-IOV, NVMe, RDMA, io_uring; high‐throughput low‐latency pipeline design. 
 - Safety/security certifications: FIPS 140‐3 validation, Common Criteria, ISO 27001/21434, AUTOSAR, IEC 62443. 
 - Secure software supply chain: artifact signing, SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), SLSA levels, reproducible builds. 
 - Scripting/automation: Python, Bash; Bazel/CMake/Meson; advanced CI (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, Buildkite). 
 - Observability: eBPF tracing, LTTng, SystemTap, ETW analogs; production telemetry & fleet operations. 
 - HW familiarity: SoC bring‐up, board support packages (BSP), JTAG, oscilloscopes, power/thermal profiling.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

The Team

Engineering - Our engineering team is at the core of our products - connected directly to the mission of preventing cyberattacks. We are constantly innovating - challenging the way we, and the industry, think about cybersecurity. Our engineers don't shy away from building products to solve problems no one has pursued before. We define the industry, instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, excited by the prospect of a challenge, and empowered by the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are only enabled by a secure digital environment. 

Job Summary

Join Palo Alto Networks' NGFW group to build enterprise-managed devices and the next-generation platform powering our security stack. As a Sr. Principal Software Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical interface between PANW and hardware teams to build platform firmware, cloud management agents, and drive board bring-up for new hardware generations. This pivotal role sits at the intersection of embedded Linux, cloud-connected agent software, and platform hardware, requiring you to integrate advanced security stacks on pre-commercial chipsets. You will define and build cutting-edge features across network and security layers, directly shaping the future of our device firmware platform. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the device firmware platform, including kernel configuration, package management, and image build pipelines using partner SDKs. 
 - Maintain and extend the cloud device agent, managing WebSocket connections, ZTP onboarding, and telemetry reporting. 
 - Integrate the PANW SCM cloud agent into the firmware for device registration, configuration sync, and telemetry export. 
 - Drive board bring-up for new device hardware generations, including bootloader, device tree, and driver integration. 
 - Serve as the primary technical liaison to hardware teams, triaging issues, reviewing firmware, and negotiating BOM changes. 
 - Manage firmware signing and secure boot processes, validating attestation flows from SCM. 
 - Maintain the device configuration schema and site template repository, syncing with the controller API contract. 
 - Build and deploy advanced networking and security capabilities on the platform. 

Qualifications

- BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - Minimum of 15 years of experience in network driver or firmware development. 
 - Deep expertise in Linux kernel networking driver frameworks and vendor SDK integration. 
 - Hands-on experience with embedded networking SoCs and vendor SDK or driver stacks. 
 - Strong proficiency in C programming, with experience in kernel and driver debugging under hardware constraints. 
 - Strong experience in packet processing, parsing, and networking (L2-L4) protocols and architecture. 
 - Experience in data plane forwarding and network processor programming. 
 - Proficiency in shell scripting and Python for build automation. 
 - Strong understanding of next-generation networking standards at the frame and protocol level. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Open-source Linux kernel driver experience. 
 - Familiarity with netfilter, iptables, or eBPF for data path integration. 
 - Working knowledge of secure boot chains, firmware signing, and TPM integration. 
 - Experience in DPDK packet processing and performance tuning. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

data.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced embedded software engineer to lead the architecture, development, and integration of embedded platforms spanning MCU firmware, RTOS, embedded Linux, platform-management protocols, and hardware-backed security. 

This role combines system-level technical ownership with hands-on development and debugging. You will drive the design of secure, resilient, and recoverable platforms while guiding the translation of complex requirements into reusable, validated software solutions. 

Required Skills And Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant engineering discipline, with 10+ years of embedded software experience and a demonstrated track record of technical ownership for complex platforms or subsystems. 
 - Strong hands-on proficiency in C and low-level embedded software development, with deep expertise in processor architecture, interrupts, DMA, synchronization, memory protection, and hardware-software interactions. 
 - Substantial expertise in one or more of the following areas: Zephyr OS, RTOS-based MCU development, or embedded Linux platform development, complemented by practical experience integrating firmware, drivers, middleware, and host-side software. 
 - Demonstrated implementation or architectural experience in at least one of the following domains: firmware development, secure boot, platform security, or specification-driven software development. 
 - Proven ability to lead complex debugging efforts, conduct architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and resolve technical trade-offs while remaining actively involved in implementation. 
 - Strong communication, technical documentation, planning, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with a proven ability to take ambiguous technical challenges from investigation through implementation and validation. 
 - Nice to have: 
 - Experience with Rust. 
 - Experience with FPGA-based firmware development. 
 - Upstream open-source contributions. 
 - Experience developing software for NXP MCUs or MPUs. 
 - Experience with secure boot, hardware-backed security, trusted firmware, secure firmware updates, or recovery systems, including the ability to reason about trust boundaries, failure modes, and the security implications of design decisions. 
Key Responsibilities

- Own the software architecture and technical direction for embedded platforms. Analyze hardware and requirements documentation, and translate system requirements into software architecture, component boundaries, interface definitions, implementation plans, and validation strategies. Identify technical risks early and use prototypes to evaluate uncertain design decisions. 
 - Architect firmware, drivers, subsystems (e. g. , security), middleware, and applications while ensuring effective hardware-software integration. Address initialization dependencies, asynchronous communication, concurrency, resource constraints, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Remain hands-on with critical development activities. Implement and review complex drivers and middleware, support platform bring-up, and lead root-cause analysis across hardware, firmware, protocols, and operating system components. 
 - Lead engineering quality and technical execution by establishing design review and validation standards, mentoring engineers, guiding work breakdown and delivery planning, and coordinating with cross-functional teams, architects, customers, and open-source communities.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

Job Description: 

Okta Workflows is the secure, no-code automation platform that empowers organizations to build identity-centric workflows across cloud applications - all without writing code. Our intuitive drag-and-drop interface allows enterprises to automate complex business processes at scale, enhancing productivity, enforcing security, and simplifying IT operations. 
Customers like Netflix, MGM, and NTT rely on Workflows to automate high-impact identity scenarios with speed and confidence. 

As we continue to scale, we're investing in extensibility, developer experience, and performance. Join us to help shape the future of cloud automation and low-code development. 

Position Description

We're hiring a Principal Engineer (full stack) to join the Flow Builder team within Okta Workflows. This team owns the core flow builder user experience and associated backend services that enables both internal teams and customers to build powerful workflows and automation experiences with ease. 

You will define the technical roadmap, architect elegant solutions to our most complex engineering challenges, and drive an engineering culture that prioritizes hyper-scalability, rigorous standards, and rapid iterative delivery. As a technical leader at Okta, you will have the autonomy to investigate bleeding-edge technologies, establish enterprise-wide best practices, and architect next-generation enterprise software. Partnering closely with product leadership, UX designers, and technical architects, you will refine strategic requirements to deliver an unparalleled customer experience. 

Role Details: 

- Drive Architectural Excellence: Architect, design, build and spearhead the development of highly scalable software systems. Set the gold standard for software engineering architecture, patterns, and processes across multiple teams. 
 - Strategic Technical Leadership: Partner directly with Product Management, Engineering Directors, and Principal Architects to define the technical vision, scope complex cross-functional initiatives, and map out long-term execution strategies. 
 - End-to-End Ownership: Take ultimate responsibility for the lifecycle of mission-critical code-from high-level system design and implementation to automated testing strategies, global delivery, and observability. 
 - Tackle Systemic Complexity: Lead the design and implementation of entirely new product lines while proactively identifying, strategizing, and working down deep architectural technical debt. 
 - Champion Engineering Culture: Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, and retrospectives. Establish the frameworks for continuous CI/CD improvements and operational excellence. 
 - Cross-Functional Influence: Act as a central technical pivot point, collaborating seamlessly with QA, Technical Support, Documentation, and UX to ensure cohesive product delivery.   

- Force Multiplier: Mentor senior, staff, and mid-level engineers. Cultivate a culture of continuous learning, knowledge-sharing, and technical ambition across the engineering organization.   

Experience:   

- Technical Track Record: 13+ years spent architecting, delivering, and operating enterprise grade large-scale distributed systems engineered for global performance. 
 - Modern Web Ecosystems: Deep technical fluency across JavaScript and TypeScript, with proven success building state-heavy React frontends alongside highly concurrent Node. js and Express backend environments. 
 - API & Service Architecture: Advanced expertise designing, versioning, and securing enterprise APIs across RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC protocols in microservices and event-driven patterns. 
 - Quality & Automation Frameworks: Experience in modern testing methodologies, including TDD strategies using modern test automation tools like Playwright etc. , that ensure robust continuous deployment. Nice to Haves: 

- Deep expertise in data modeling, query optimization, and scaling relational databases (PostgreSQL).

 - Extensive hands-on experience with containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform). Education and Training:
