data.title: Senior Quality Performance Engineer - AI
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

As a Performance Engineer, you will be a key member of the Product Quality Engineering team driving improvements in performance, scalability and reliability of our products and services. You will work within our agile software development process and will certify products for release readiness for performance, scalability and reliability and will carry out performance benchmarking for our products & services at global scale. 

The ideal candidate for this position will have strong background in performance testing & engineering in enterprise software platforms and applications. The candidate should have experience in architecting and driving complex performance testing / engineering projects that measure the characteristics of systems running under dynamic, real-world workloads. 

In this role you will create infrastructure, automation, and tools that drive realistic loads against the core services of our platform. You will also enable peers in engineering, customer support, and cloud teams to leverage our tools to provide related services. 

Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end performance engineering for enterprise and AI-enabled applications, including APIs, microservices, and model-serving endpoints. Define SLOs and performance budgets, and integrate performance gates into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Design and execute load, stress, soak, and spike tests using JMeter and BlazeMeter, with k6 or Locust for API and streaming workloads. Build realistic workload models from production telemetry, including think time, arrival rates, concurrency, and token-based payloads for LLM endpoints. 
 - Diagnose performance bottlenecks across application, database, cache, queue, and model-serving layers. Use distributed tracing, profiling, and GPU, CPU, and memory telemetry to isolate root causes. Drive fixes to closure and verify them with before-and-after benchmarks. 
 - Make performance tests deterministic and reproducible through version-controlled test assets, environment parity, masked test data, and statistically sound baselines. Reduce flaky results and test cycle time. 
 - Participate in the SDLC from design reviews and capacity planning through release readiness and production monitoring. Identify performance risks in architecture and code before they reach test environments. 
 - Establish and improve the performance testing practice through reusable frameworks, test libraries, standards, and coaching. Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate script creation, log analysis, and anomaly detection. 
 - Communicate findings clearly in writing and verbally, including concise root-cause reports and capacity recommendations written for both engineers and business stakeholders. 
 - Manage concurrent initiatives, production incidents, and release commitments, prioritizing by business risk. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 5 to 10 years of performance testing and engineering experience, including work on mission-critical software products and services. 
 - BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field. 
 - Hands-on experience developing performance testing strategies, processes, and methodologies for enterprise applications. 
 - Experience with JMeter or comparable load-testing tools, including workload modeling with concurrency, arrival rate, and scheduling, and with a range of samplers and protocols (HTTP/S, JDBC, gRPC, WebSocket, or streaming APIs). 
 - Experience creating test data management scripts and running high-concurrency, volume, and capacity tests. 
 - Working knowledge of performance monitoring and profiling tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry-based tracing, along with OS-level, JVM, and database internals. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience diagnosing database-layer performance issues and recommending fixes such as indexing, query rewrites, and connection pool tuning. 
 - Proven ability to perform root cause analysis on complex, multi-tier performance problems and recommend solutions that the engineering team can act on. 
 - Solid understanding of concurrency, multithreading, and distributed system architectures. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to engineers, architects, and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience load testing AI or LLM-enabled systems, including token throughput, time-to-first-token, streaming latency, and concurrency limits on inference endpoints. 
 - Experience benchmarking model-serving or RAG pipelines, including vector database query performance and GPU/CPU/memory profiling. 
 - Experience with BlazeMeter, k6, Locust, or Gatling, and with integrating performance gates into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience defining SLOs, performance budgets, and capacity models for production systems. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools to accelerate test script generation, log analysis, or anomaly detection. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to a performance engineering practice through shared frameworks, standards, or training. 

Additional Information

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

LRL takes potential marketable products from Research through product registration and approval, enabling MDU's business needs of the future through information and technology solutions. Within this portfolio, Clinical Supply & Delivery (CS&D) owns the systems and platforms that move investigational drug product - from packaging and labeling through distribution and fulfillment - to clinical trial sites, reliably, compliantly, and on time for trial execution. The CS&D Technical Lead Architect owns end-to-end technical architecture for these platforms - moving CS&D from point-solution delivery to a coherent, agentic-AI-enabled architecture, and from reactive engineering support to proactive, roadmapped portfolio transformation. 

Path/Level: R5 (CS&D Technical Lead Architect)

This role is split roughly 70% hands-on technical execution - building agentic architecture, integration patterns, and platform capability directly - and 30% strategy, roadmap ownership, and portfolio-level transformation planning. The CS&D Technical Lead Architect shapes the future technology landscape for CS&D's clinical supply and trial-material delivery platforms, aligning business strategy with technology investment, AI/agentic innovation, and architecture to drive operational excellence, compliance, and scalable transformation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Portfolio Architecture Ownership (Hands-On) - design, build, and directly implement the technical architecture for CS&D's critical platforms - containerized services, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and integration layers; own architecture roadmaps and standards for the platforms in scope, preparing decisions ahead of delivery rather than resolving them reactively. (placeholder - confirm scope: demand/supply forecasting, packaging & labeling, distribution and site-level fulfillment, trial-material tracking)
 - Agentic AI & Portfolio Transformation - drive a portfolio-wide exploration of AI/agentic opportunities across CS&D's platforms; evaluate build-vs-buy for each opportunity; own and evolve a staged, roadmapped vision for shifting CS&D's architecture toward agentic-based patterns wherever viable, sequencing the transformation gradually rather than as a single cutover; convert validated proofs-of-concept into production-grade, reusable agentic architecture. 
 - Governance, Risk & GxP/GCP Compliance - embed audit-readiness, security and change-control thinking into architecture patterns; ensure designs meet FDA/EMA and internal IT/quality policy requirements, including GMP, GCP considerations relevant to clinical trial material handling; maintain architecture documentation supporting audit, inspection, and CSV readiness across the platforms owned. 
 - Technology Evaluation & Platform Modernization - evaluate emerging cloud, data, and AI/agentic technologies for CS&D applicability; run staged proofs-of-concept before adoption; identify and retire technical debt, consolidating and simplifying the platform footprint. 
 - Business & Product Partnership - partner with product managers and business stakeholders to translate business goals, capabilities, and value-streams into technical solutions; lead architectural discussions and decision-making, facilitate knowledge-sharing, and manage expectations through clear communication. 
 - Decision-Making (Platform-Scoped) - hold design and integration decision authority within the CS&D platforms owned end-to-end; approve implementation-level architecture and integration patterns; escalate - rather than unilaterally resolve - enterprise-architecture, investment-level, or cross-portfolio GxP risks that sit outside platform scope. 
 - India-Led Global Ownership - represent CS&D Tech in relevant architecture forums; build shared ownership and accountability between the India team and global stakeholders; grow India as the technical decision-making center for the platforms owned, not just a delivery location. 
 - Talent Development & Technical Leadership - conduct code reviews and provide hands-on guidance to development teams; mentor engineers toward stronger architecture and agentic-design capability; contribute to hiring and technical talent planning. 

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas

Enterprise & Solution Architecture

- Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Architecture
 - Generative AI
 - Architecture Design Patterns (N-tier, Microservices, Event-Driven/Reactive, Batch/Micro-Batch/Real-Time)
 - Containerization & Orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
 - CI/CD & DevOps (GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline/Copilot)
 - Cloud Platforms (AWS: EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, Glue, Redshift/Redshift Spectrum, Athena)
 - Event-Driven Architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS/SQS)
 - API & Integration Architecture
 - Data Architecture (RDBMS, NoSQL, Data Pipelines, Search Engines)
 - Spark/PySpark, Hadoop
 - Caching & CDN (Redis, CloudFront)
 - Front-End & Back-End Development (React, Node. js, Python, Django/Flask)
 - Cloud/Platform Migration
 - Security & Compliance Architecture (GxP, GCP, CSV)
 - Platform Engineering
 - Portfolio-Level Problem Breakdown

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred). 
 - 12+ years in solution/enterprise architecture or senior technical leadership, with direct, ongoing coding/build involvement - not oversight-only experience. 
 - Proven experience designing, building, and deploying agentic/AI architecture, including evaluating build-vs-buy for AI/agentic capability; experience implementing AI/ML tech stacks within production programs. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices. 
 - Strong grasp of architecture design patterns - N-tier, microservices, stateful vs. stateless, request-response vs. loose-coupling vs. reactive, batch/micro-batch/real-time processing. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with fullstack experience (React, Node. js). 
 - Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB), search engines, and AWS ETL services (Glue, Data Pipeline, Redshift Spectrum). 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS). 
 - Ability to design, build, and unit test applications on the Spark framework in Python, including PySpark for batch and streaming workloads. 
 - Experience operating in regulated (GxP/GCP) environments, including computer system validation (CSV) and inspection-readiness practices. 
 - Experience with clinical trial data - its structure, sourcing, and use in supply chain / trial execution contexts. 
 - Track record translating business goals and value-streams into technical architecture decisions. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead architectural discussions without requiring a formal people-manager structure. 

Additional Qualifications / Competencies

- Strategic and analytical thinking - sequencing a multi-year agentic transformation roadmap rather than one-off point solutions. 
 - Experience representing India-based technical teams in global architecture or governance forums. 
 - Comfort operating in ambiguity, driving clarity around architecture dependencies and transformation sequencing. 
 - Experience leading platform or data migration initiatives.

data.title: Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Reporting to: Director; working closely with Production, R&D, Purchase, Stores, Engineering, Fulfilment and Finance

Employment: Full-time

Location: CC Manufacturing Unit, Bangalore (Onsite)

Experience: 6+ years in Quality Assurance / Food Safety, including at least 2 years in a managerial role

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

CTC: Up to ₹10 LPA + Benefits

Role Purpose

To lead and take overall responsibility for Quality Assurance, Food Safety and Quality Management Systems at CC Pet Foods, ensuring that all manufactured products consistently meet defined quality, nutritional, safety, regulatory and customer requirements. 

He/ she will establish and drive a preventive, process-oriented quality culture across raw material sourcing, manufacturing, packaging, storage and dispatch. 

The role is accountable for developing robust quality systems, managing the QA team, ensuring regulatory compliance, preventing product failures and driving the company's First Time Right and Zero Compromise on Food Safety philosophy. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance

- Own, implement and continuously improve the factory-wide Quality Management System (QMS). 
 - Develop and enforce SOPs, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), HACCP plans and food safety controls. 
 - Lead implementation, certification and maintenance of ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 or equivalent food safety management systems. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable Indian regulatory requirements, relevant BIS standards, customer specifications and internal quality policies. 
 - Establish quality policies, inspection standards, testing protocols and acceptance criteria across manufacturing operations. 
 - Lead internal, external, customer and certification audits, ensuring timely closure of non-conformities. 
 - Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready quality documentation. 

2. Raw Material & Supplier Quality Management

- Establish quality specifications and acceptance standards for meat, poultry, fish, organs, vegetables, grains, flours, oils, supplements, additives and packaging materials. 
 - Own incoming material inspection, testing, acceptance, rejection and quarantine procedures. 
 - Ensure compliance with approved specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COA), temperature requirements and other quality parameters. 
 - Lead supplier quality qualification, evaluation, audits and performance improvement initiatives. 
 - Coordinate with Purchase and Stores to address supplier quality issues and establish corrective actions. 
 - Ensure material traceability, proper storage conditions and FIFO/FEFO compliance. 
 - Develop risk-based inspection and sampling plans for critical raw materials. 

3. Manufacturing Process Quality Assurance

- Own in-process quality assurance across wet food, baked products and dehydrated treats manufacturing. 
 - Establish and monitor critical quality parameters and process controls across weighing, mixing, cooking, baking, dehydration, cooling, filling and packaging. 
 - Ensure manufacturing compliance with approved formulations, process specifications and batch records. 
 - Monitor and validate critical process parameters including time, temperature, moisture, water activity, product weight and packaging integrity. 
 - Establish preventive controls against cross-contamination, foreign-body contamination and process deviations. 
 - Lead investigations into manufacturing non-conformities and implement sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Work with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce rejection and achieve First Time Right production. 

4. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

- Take overall responsibility for factory hygiene, sanitation and food safety standards. 
 - Establish and monitor personnel hygiene, cleaning, sanitation and environmental monitoring programmes. 
 - Ensure effective hygiene zoning and segregation of raw, semi-processed and finished products. 
 - Oversee cleaning verification, ATP testing, environmental swabbing and microbiological monitoring. 
 - Monitor pest control, waste handling, water quality and other environmental conditions affecting food safety. 
 - Lead food safety risk assessments and ensure timely mitigation of identified hazards. 
 - Conduct periodic GMP and hygiene audits across production, storage and utility areas. 

5. Finished Product Quality & Batch Release

- Own finished product quality standards and release procedures. 
 - Ensure appropriate physical, chemical, microbiological and sensory testing before product release. 
 - Establish product specifications for nutritional composition, moisture, water activity, packaging integrity, net weight, appearance and shelf life. 
 - Review batch manufacturing records, process deviations and quality testing results. 
 - Exercise authority to approve, hold, reject or release finished product batches based on defined quality and food safety criteria. 
 - Ensure effective management of non-conforming products, retention samples and product stability studies. 
 - Oversee packaging quality, seal integrity, batch coding, labelling and traceability compliance. 

6. Laboratory & Quality Testing Management

- Manage internal quality laboratories and coordinate testing with approved external laboratories. 
 - Establish testing plans for raw materials, in-process samples, environmental samples and finished products. 
 - Oversee microbiological, chemical, physical and nutritional quality testing. 
 - Ensure laboratory equipment calibration, maintenance, method verification and testing accuracy. 
 - Review laboratory reports, investigate out-of-specification results and approve corrective actions. 
 - Establish laboratory testing budgets, consumable requirements and equipment procurement plans. 
 - Work closely with R&D on formulation validation, shelf-life studies and new product development. 

7. Quality Documentation, Traceability & CAPA

- Establish and maintain robust documentation and record-control systems. 
 - Ensure end-to-end batch traceability from raw material receipt through manufacturing and dispatch. 
 - Lead investigations into customer complaints, product defects, contamination risks and quality failures. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). 
 - Establish product withdrawal and recall procedures and conduct periodic mock recall exercises. 
 - Maintain quality dashboards, deviation records, audit findings and management review reports. 
 - Ensure all quality records are complete, accurate and readily available for audits. 

8. Continuous Improvement & Quality Performance

-

- Define, monitor and report quality KPIs to senior management. 
 - Lead initiatives to reduce rejection, rework, process losses, customer complaints and cost of poor quality. 
 - Identify recurring process deviations and implement preventive improvements. 
 - Participate in equipment commissioning, process validation, new product trials and manufacturing scale-up. 
 - Collaborate with Production, R&D, Engineering and Procurement to improve product consistency and manufacturing efficiency. 
 - Promote data-driven quality decisions and continuous improvement across departments. 

9. QA Team Leadership & Department Management

- Lead, mentor and develop the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams. 
 - Define department structure, responsibilities, manpower requirements and shift coverage. 
 - Set performance objectives, review team performance and develop technical capabilities. 
 - Establish training programmes covering GMP, HACCP, hygiene, quality inspection, documentation and food safety. 
 - Manage the QA department budget, laboratory expenses and quality-related resources. 
 - Build a culture of accountability, integrity, disciplined execution and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure independent and objective quality decisions, including escalation of critical food safety risks to management. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Dairy Technology or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification will be an advantage. 
 - Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within food manufacturing, meat processing, ready-to-eat foods, pet food or FMCG. 
 - At least 2 years of experience managing QA/QC teams and factory-level quality systems. 
 - Strong working knowledge of GMP, GHP, HACCP, ISO 22000 and food safety management systems. 
 - Proven experience in implementing quality systems, conducting audits and managing regulatory compliance. 
 - Hands-on understanding of microbiological testing, food chemistry, raw material inspection and finished product quality. 
 - Experience with thermal processing, retort foods, baking, dehydration, packaging and shelf-life validation will be preferred. 
 - Demonstrated ability to investigate quality failures, conduct root cause analysis and implement CAPA. 
 - Experience managing supplier quality, customer complaints, product traceability and recall procedures. 
 - Proficiency in ERP systems, MS Excel and digital quality documentation. 
 - Strong leadership, analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities. 
 - Good written and spoken communication skills in English, Hindi and Kannada. 
 - High standards of professional integrity and the ability to make independent quality decisions. 

What We Offer

- Salary: Up to ₹10 LPA, based on experience and qualifications. 
 - Paid leave and public holidays as per company policy. 
 - Health insurance and applicable employee benefits. 

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send their CV to careers@caninecraving. com, along with a short note highlighting their quality leadership experience and an example of a significant quality or food safety challenge they successfully resolved. 

Application Deadline: 15 December 2026

data.title: Senior Quality Assurance Manager
data.description:
Location: Hyderabad

Reports To: VP Engineering / SVP R&D

Experience: 12+ years (3+ in leadership)

About OvalEdge

OvalEdge is an enterprise-grade AI-powered Data Intelligence platform that unifies Data Catalog, Data Governance, Data Quality, and Analytics into a single, AI-native SaaS product. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies globally, OvalEdge helps organizations discover, govern, and operationalize their data assets at scale - accelerating data-driven decisions while ensuring compliance and trust. Our platform delivers both cloud-hosted SaaS and on-premises deployments to meet the diverse infrastructure needs of enterprise customers. 

The Role

We are looking for a stronger Senior QA Manager candidate profile - to own quality engineering for the OvalEdge product platform. This is a hands-on leadership role: you manage a team and get into the weeds. You write test plans, debug automation suites, design AI evaluation pipelines, run performance reviews, and lead sprint QA planning. 

You come from a product development organization. You know what it means to ship a SaaS release with enterprise SLAs and support customers running on-premises deployments. You treat quality as a shared outcome, not a handoff at the end of a sprint. 

And when release pressure builds and corners are being cut, you are the person in the room who holds the line - calmly, with data, in terms leadership can act on. Professional courage on quality is a requirement of this role, not a personality bonus. 

What You'll Do

Quality Strategy & Ownership

• Define and own the end-to-end QA strategy for the OvalEdge platform - spanning functional, regression, integration, performance, security, and AI/LLM testing. 

• Establish release quality gates and acceptance criteria in partnership with Engineering and Product; quality sign-off is a release gate, not a formality. 

• Build and maintain a quality metrics dashboard - escaped defects, automation coverage, defect density, test cycle time - and drive continuous improvement against these targets. 

• Own the test environment strategy for both SaaS and on-premises deployment configurations; ensure parity between environments. 

• Implement test frameworks for planning, tracking, reporting and analytics. 

• Adopt AI and leverage it to the maximum extent possible for efficient test preparation, execution, analysis and reporting. 

• Own quality risk communication to leadership - when a release carries unacceptable risk, surface it early, frame it in business terms, and be prepared to defend the position. 

Hands-On Testing & Automation

• Remain hands-on: write, review, and debug test cases, automation scripts, and test frameworks alongside the team - this is not a purely managerial role. 

• Design and evolve a scalable test automation framework (Playwright) integrated into CI/CD pipelines for continuous regression coverage. 

• Lead API, integration, and end-to-end testing across REST APIs (RESTAssured, Postman etc. ), and third-party connectors - including OvalEdge's MCP-based enterprise integrations. 

• Establish performance and load testing practices (JMeter, Gatling, or equivalent) for both SaaS and on-premises deployments at enterprise scale. 

• Drive shift-left testing - embed QA practices in design and development, not just the testing phase. 

OvalEdge Senior QA Manager

AI & GenAI Testing

• Build and own the AI testing strategy for OvalEdge's GenAI, Agentic AI, and RAG-powered capabilities - this is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought. 

• Implement LLM evaluation pipelines using frameworks such as DeepEval, RAGAS, TruLens, and Promptfoo; define metrics for hallucination rate, faithfulness, context precision, and answer relevance. 

• Design agent behavior test suites - validate multi-agent orchestration, failure recovery, and goal completion under adversarial conditions. 

• Establish AI-specific quality gates in CI/CD: automated LLM regression tests that block releases when quality thresholds are breached. 

• Stay current on AI testing trends and tooling; evaluate and adopt emerging frameworks as the platform evolves. 

People Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, mentor, and grow a team of QA engineers and automation engineers; conduct structured 1: 1s, career conversations, and performance reviews. 

• Build a technical career ladder for the QA function - clear expectations at each level - so growth is transparent and retention improves. 

• Define team goals, ownership, performance measures, development plans, and succession plans. 

• Hire for the team: own the QA hiring process including JD definition, technical assessment design, and interview calibration. 

• Champion a culture of quality ownership across Engineering - QA is everyone's responsibility, not a separate gate at the end. 

• Champion automation-first approach within the team using tools, including AI, and upskill the team. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with the Senior Enterprise Architect on quality architecture standards - test strategy aligns with the platform's broader engineering and AI roadmap. 

• Work closely with DevOps to integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines and maintain reliable, fast feedback loops for every commit. 

• Collaborate with Product Management on acceptance criteria, edge case coverage, and enterprise customer scenarios - especially for data governance and compliance use cases. 

• Engage with Customer Success to close the feedback loop on production issues - field signals should drive test coverage improvements before problems recur. 

• Partner with Security on application security testing, VAPT coordination, and secure SDLC practices. 

What You'll Bring

Required

• 12+ years in software quality engineering within a product development organization. 

• 3+ years in a QA leadership role managing a team of engineers, with direct ownership of quality strategy for a commercial software product. 

• Experience in hiring, goal setting, performance management, mentoring, and career development. 

• Mandatory hands-on experience: must be able to write, debug, and review test cases and automation scripts - this is a player-coach role. 

• Proven experience testing both SaaS (multi-tenant, cloud-hosted) and on-premises enterprise software deployments. 

• Strong automation engineering skills - Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent - with working knowledge of Python or Java. 

• Experience with API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured) and CI/CD integration (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent). 

• Strong experience in Deep AI testing is a must. Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI/LLM testing practices - including familiarity with evaluation frameworks such as DeepEval, RAGAS, or equivalent. 

• Strong grasp of enterprise software quality - data correctness, security, multi-tenancy isolation, performance at scale, and compliance. 

OvalEdge Senior QA Manager

• Demonstrated ability to advocate for quality at the leadership level - including the professional courage to push back on release timelines or scope when quality thresholds are not met, backed by data and articulated as business risk, not personal preference. 

Nice to Have

• Experience testing Data Catalog, Data Governance, Data Lineage, Analytics, or Data Management products. 

• Exposure to performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6) for enterprise-scale SaaS workloads. 

• Familiarity with security testing (OWASP, VAPT coordination) and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance testing. 

• Experience with observability and monitoring tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, Grafana) as part of production quality feedback. 

• ISTQB Advanced or equivalent certification. 

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (required). 

• Master's degree or equivalent professional certification (preferred). 

What Success Looks Like

In your first 60 days, you will have audited the current QA state, identified the top 5 quality risks, and presented an initial roadmap to the R&D leadership. Within 12 months, the team will show measurable improvement across these dimensions: 

Area: Release Quality

Metric: Escaped defects in production

Target: < 5% of total defects

Area: Automation Coverage

Metric: Regression suite automation

Target: > 80% coverage

Area: AI Testing

Metric: Agent/LLM evaluation pass rate

Target: Improving QoQ

Area: Cycle Time

Metric: QA cycle time per sprint

Target: < 20% of sprint duration

Area: Team Growth

Metric: Engineers promoted or upskilled

Target: 1+ per year

Why OvalEdge

• Own quality for a platform at the intersection of AI and enterprise data - one of the highest-growth segments in B2B software. 

• Player-coach role with real technical depth - you will not be pushed into a purely administrative position. 

• Direct influence on product strategy and engineering standards from day one. 

• Competitive compensation, equity participation and a flexible, energetic work environment in Hyderabad.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics
data.description:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth. 

Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics

Role Overview

As a Senior QA Engineer in the CAN QA team, you will own validation of how our devices read, interpret and report vehicle data, from the CAN bus through the device to the cloud. You will develop test strategies for J1939 and OBD-II integrations, automate protocol and signal-level testing, investigate complex field issues, and provide evidence-based release-readiness recommendations. 

This is a hands-on role for someone equally at home with a CAN trace, a bench power supply and a truck cab, and who can convert requirements, DBCs, logs and field evidence into reliable qualification coverage. 

What You Will Own

- Validation strategy and release qualification for CAN-based vehicle features, new vehicle onboarding and customer configurations. 
 - Requirement-to-test coverage for vehicle signals, diagnostics, power modes and end-to-end telematics workflows. 
 - Root-cause investigation of signal mismatches, intermittent CAN failures and vehicle-specific field issues. 
 - Reusable CAN simulation, trace replay, fault-injection and automated regression capabilities. 
 - Technical guidance through test-design reviews, automation reviews and structured defect triage. 

Key Responsibilities

Vehicle Networks and Diagnostics

- Validate SAE J1939 PGN/SPN decoding for vehicle speed, odometer, engine hours, fuel, DM1/DM2 faults and other supported signals. 
 - Validate OBD-II modes, PIDs, DTCs and VIN handling using SAE J1979 and ISO 15765-4. 
 - Verify scaling, offsets, units, ranges, rollover, timeouts, stale data, source-address handling and not-available values. 
 - Test J1939 transport protocol (BAM and RTS/CTS), request messages, address claim and bus-off recovery. 
 - Correlate device-decoded values with trusted CAN tools and OEM or dealer diagnostic systems. 

Power Modes and CAN Wake-up

- Validate wake-up on CAN traffic and ignition, sleep after bus silence, shutdown and recovery across supported configurations. 
 - Measure quiescent current and verify that the device causes no unwanted wake-ups, excessive bus traffic or vehicle battery drain. 
 - Validate ignition (KL15) and battery (KL30) scenarios, brownouts, power interruptions and repeated ignition cycles. 

Bench, HIL and Vehicle Testing

- Set up and execute bench, HIL and in-vehicle tests using CAN interfaces, programmable power supplies, ignition control and harnesses. 
 - Simulate ECUs, replay recorded traces, inject protocol and signal faults, and reproduce field scenarios in the lab. 
 - Validate integrations across commercial and passenger vehicles, makes, models and model years, including in fleet yards and at customer sites. 

End-to-End Feature Validation

- Validate CAN-derived data from vehicle bus to cloud for fleet features such as fuel consumption, fuel-level trends, idle fuel, refueling and suspected fuel theft. 
 - Validate CAN-derived inputs supporting ELD/HOS workflows, including engine power state, vehicle motion, distance, engine hours and malfunction scenarios, against product requirements and the FMCSA ELD rule. 
 - Support validation of EV signals (state of charge, charging state, energy usage) and OTA/firmware regression for vehicle-specific releases. 

Test Design, Automation and Debugging

- Translate product requirements, protocol specifications, DBC files and field use cases into risk-based, traceable test plans. 
 - Build maintainable Python, CAPL or equivalent automation for CAN simulation, trace replay, signal verification, negative testing and regression. 
 - Analyze CAN traces, device and application logs, power measurements and cloud telemetry to isolate failures across the vehicle, harness, firmware, configuration and cloud layers. 
 - Create clear defect reports with reproducible steps, trace evidence, expected versus actual behavior and impact. 
 - Work with development teams to close gaps in testability, diagnostics and observability. 

Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in QA or validation of embedded, automotive, telematics or IoT products, with substantial hands-on CAN work and a track record of owning test strategy, traceability and release-readiness decisions. 
 - Strong CAN 2. 0A/B fundamentals, including 11-bit and 29-bit identifiers, arbitration, error handling and bus-off behavior. 
 - Hands-on expertise in SAE J1939, with working knowledge of OBD-II. 
 - Experience interpreting DBC files and validating raw frames, decoded signals, scaling, timing and invalid-data behavior. 
 - Hands-on experience with one or more CAN analysis and simulation platforms, such as Vector CANalyzer/CANoe, Intrepid Vehicle Spy, PEAK PCAN or Kvaser, and scripting in Python, CAPL or an equivalent language. 
 - Strong embedded-system debugging and root-cause analysis skills across hardware, firmware, network and backend boundaries, with the ability to explain technical risks and evidence clearly to cross-functional stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Understanding of CAN wake-up and sleep behavior, ignition concepts, power-state transitions and sleep-current measurement. 
 - Comfort working with vehicle harnesses, multimeters, programmable power supplies and bench equipment. 
 - Working knowledge of UDS (ISO 14229) and ISO-TP, including diagnostic sessions, reading and clearing DTCs, and reading data identifiers. 
 - Awareness of CAN FD and experience with HIL systems or ECU/network simulation. 
 - Exposure to J1708/J1587 on older heavy-duty vehicles. 
 - Python experience with libraries and frameworks such as python-can and pytest, including data-driven and parameterized testing. 
 - Experience with Linux-based environments, SocketCAN and can-utils (candump, cansend), shell tools, log analysis, Git and code-review workflows. 
 - Experience in fuel management, ELD/HOS (FMCSA), vehicle diagnostics, EV telemetry or other CAN-based fleet features. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools for test design, log triage or trace analysis. 
 - Experience with Jira, Confluence and CI-based automated testing for traceability, defect management and qualification reporting. 

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status. 

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly.

About Skan AI

Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work. 

Why Skan AI

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes. 

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises. 

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself. 

ROLE SUMMARY

The Lead DevOps Engineer designs, builds, and maintains the CI/CD pipelines, deployment tooling, and infrastructure automation that power Skan's customer delivery operations. Working within the Customer Ops team, this role is the engineering engine behind deployment velocity - ensuring that customer environments are provisioned, upgraded, and maintained reliably, securely, and at pace. 

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure operations. The DevOps Engineer is responsible for making deployment a repeatable, automated, and quality-assured activity - eliminating manual overhead, enforcing DevSecOps standards, and giving the wider Customer Ops and Systems Engineering teams the tooling they need to operate efficiently at scale. 

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

As Skan's enterprise customer base grows, so does the complexity of managing deployments across cloud-hosted, customer-hosted, and hybrid environments. Without dedicated DevOps engineering, deployment activities are manual, inconsistent, and slow - creating delivery risk, increasing the chance of environment-related incidents, and preventing the Customer Ops team from scaling without linear headcount growth. 

The DevOps Engineer provides the automation and tooling layer that makes Skan's customer delivery operations scalable, auditable, and professionally run - directly supporting SLA commitments, deployment quality, and time-to-value for enterprise clients. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for customer environment deployments, upgrades, and patch cycles - covering cloud-hosted and customer-hosted models
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management using Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Helm, Ansible)
 - Implement and enforce DevSecOps practices across all product and client deployment pipelines - including security scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code controls
 - Develop and maintain deployment tooling, scripts, and environment templates that reduce manual effort and improve deployment consistency
 - Support Systems Engineers during new customer environment builds, patch cycles, and major upgrades - providing tooling, automation, and hands-on assistance
 - Build and maintain ops process tooling: SLA tracking dashboards, deployment status portals, environment health monitors, and internal reporting utilities

 - Identify and remediate deployment bottlenecks, pipeline failures, and infrastructure configuration drift across customer environments
 - Collaborate with the SRE team to align infrastructure design with operational monitoring and incident response requirements
 - Participate in change management processes - ensuring all production environment changes are logged, reviewed, and reversible
 - Contribute to the Automation Engineering team's agentic workflow initiatives - developing automation that further reduces operational toil
 - Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for all pipelines, playbooks, and environment configurationsKEY DELIVERABLES

- CI/CD pipeline designs and live implementations for all customer deployment models - cloud, on-prem, and hybrid
 - Infrastructure-as-Code templates and reusable deployment playbooks - maintained, versioned, and documented
 - DevSecOps controls documentation and compliance evidence for all customer-facing pipelines
 - Automated environment provisioning and teardown scripts - reducing manual setup time per new customer deployment
 - Deployment metrics dashboard: pipeline success rate, deployment frequency, lead time, and change failure rate - reported monthly
 - Ops tooling: SLA trackers, status portals, and environment health dashboards operational and actively used by Customer Ops teams
 - Target: pipeline success rate ≥ 95%; zero unplanned production outages attributable to deployment tooling failuresKEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of experience. 
 - CI/CD platforms: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps - pipeline design, implementation, and maintenance at enterprise scale
 - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm, Ansible - provisioning, configuration management, and drift detection
 - Container platforms: Docker and Kubernetes - build, deployment, and runtime management in production environments
 - DevSecOps: security scanning (SAST/DAST), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or equivalent), policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel)
 - Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP - provisioning, networking, IAM, and cost-aware infrastructure management
 - Scripting and automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell - automating deployment workflows and operational tasks
 - Monitoring integration: ability to instrument pipelines with observability hooks compatible with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent
 - Change management: familiarity with ITSM processes and structured change control in enterprise environments
 - Collaboration skills: able to work effectively with Systems Engineers, SRE, and customer-facing teams in a fast-moving environment
 - Documentation: clear, maintainable runbooks and pipeline documentation - written for both technical peers and operational teams

This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with an expectation to work from the office three days a week.

data.title: Software Development Manager
data.description:
Description

Ask any Customer Service Associate what slows them down and they'll show you: the field that doesn't autofill, the extra click on every third contact, the lookup that opens in another tab. None of these earns a spot on a roadmap by itself. Together they cost tens of thousands of associates minutes every day, and well over a thousand such requests reach us every year from the people on the front line. 

Your team fixes them. Based in Hyderabad, it has a mandate no other team has: go into any codebase across the associate workspace, ship the fix through the owning team's pipelines and review process, and move to the next one. Each month a scored list of associate-raised problems arrives. Your team sizes them, embeds with the teams that own the code, and ships. Every fix credits the associate who raised it. 

What sets this role apart is that you run a mechanism, not just a team. The monthly intake with product leaders, the capacity math, the working relationships with a dozen engineering managers whose code your engineers touch, and the quarterly story to senior leadership about what got better are all yours. You'll also be the one who can say, with evidence, where the workspace's architecture makes small fixes hard. That feeds directly into the 2027 effort to rebuild it as one AI-assisted experience. 

You'll lead seven engineers directly and work as a peer with a senior program manager who runs intake and a senior engineer who sets the technical bar, with evenings that overlap partner teams in Seattle, Toronto, and Austin. If you like shipping every week and reading the thank-you notes, this is the job. 

Key job responsibilities

Own the fix-it mechanism end to end: monthly intake with product and senior leadership, engineer-led estimation, sequencing against capacity, delivery, and a readiness check before each fix reaches associates. 

Deliver through embedded execution. Your engineers join the team that owns the affected code as temporary members, follow its design and review norms, use its pipelines and tests, and leave the codebase better than they found it. You make that model work across teams in three cities. 

Hire, grow, and retain a team of software engineers spanning early-career to senior. Set and hold the bar on design, code, testing, and documentation, and coach engineers through promotion. 

Build and keep trust with every engineering manager whose codebase your team touches. Negotiate access, review bandwidth, and release windows; resolve design disputes through principal engineers rather than around them. 

Measure what matters: fixes shipped, associate impact per fix, and mechanism health, reported quarterly to senior leadership. 

Deliver through others: remove blockers, make scope calls, and keep stakeholders informed without surprises. 

Make the team AI-native: use AI tooling to raise velocity and quality across unfamiliar codebases. 

A day in the life

Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. Mornings in Hyderabad start with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, and a 1: 1. Late afternoon you unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review; your evening overlaps North America for a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates. 

About The Team

Your main job is keeping fixes flowing from associates' complaints to production. You start your day with the month's intake list alongside your program manager and a product leader: which problems made the cut and what each will take. Then a design review for a fix in another team's component, checking it follows their patterns, then a 1: 1. You unblock an engineer waiting on a Seattle team's review, and when North America comes online you take a call with that team's manager about release windows. Beyond the usual: quarterly, you tell senior leadership, with numbers, what got better for associates. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Leadership responsibilities

Impact

data.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Product Platforms
data.description:
About AlphaSense

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents - including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www. alpha-sense. com. Come join us. 

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the teams building shared product platforms at AlphaSense. The domain covers two connected areas: the API-first platforms that power multiple product surfaces, integrations, and agentic workflows, and the usage platform that meters and reports AI credit consumption across our product features. 

Both areas are built as products, not as internal plumbing. That means well-designed APIs, clear contracts, strong reliability guarantees, and a roadmap driven by real product needs. Our consumption platform is business-critical: it underpins how AlphaSense packages, prices, and reports on AI capabilities, so accurate, timely, and auditable metering is a hard requirement rather than an implementation detail. 

This is a people-management role. The immediate team is largely based in EMEA/US, so global people management is preferred. You'll own hiring, growth, delivery, and the operational health of your teams, and you'll partner closely with Product, Platform, SRE, and Finance/RevOps to set direction. You'll stay technical enough to hold credible design discussions, review architecture, and push back where it matters, but your leverage comes through the engineers you grow and the systems they own. You'll work alongside Principal Engineers in long-term technical direction rather than duplicating that work. 

Responsibilities

- Lead, grow, and develop a team of backend and platform engineers across the API and usage/consumption areas
 - Own delivery: roadmap commitments, execution quality, and predictable outcomes for platforms with many internal and external consumers
 - Own the direction of usage metering and AI credit accounting, including accuracy, auditability, latency, and cost of the metering pipeline itself
 - Partner with Product to shape a platform roadmap driven by real product and customer needs
 - Hire strong engineers, build a healthy pipeline, and raise the bar with every offer
 - Uphold API governance, versioning strategy, and backward compatibility, and hold the line on contracts that other teams depend on
 - Own operational excellence: SLOs, observability, on-call health, and follow-through on incidents
 - Partner with Finance, RevOps, and Pricing on consumption models, entitlements, quotas, overages, and reporting
 - Create clarity in ambiguous, cross-team problems and break them into work your teams can execute
 - Grow senior ICs and tech leads, and make succession and technical ownership explicit
 - Communicate technical trade-offs and risk to engineering and business stakeholders across time zones. 

Requirements

- Proven experience managing backend or platform engineering teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development
 - Strong hands-on engineering background in backend or distributed systems prior to management, with the ability to engage credibly in design and code reviews today
 - Experience with product platforms or shared services consumed by multiple product teams
 - Track record of delivering and operating APIs at scale, with strong grounding in RESTful API design
 - Experience with data-intensive systems: high-volume event ingestion, aggregation, and reporting
 - Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to influence technical direction across teams
 - Strong written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice To Have

- Experience with consumption or usage-based business models: metering, rating, entitlements, quotas, and billing integrations
 - Experience with AI cost, token, or credit accounting systems
 - Experience building or enabling agentic and AI-driven workflows, including orchestration, state management, and integration patterns
 - Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent integration patterns
 - Some experience with GraphQL (design, usage, or operating in production)
 - Experience working in large-scale, distributed systems environments
 - Experience working closely with Platform and SRE teams
 - Experience leading globally distributed teams

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense's commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination. 

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works. 

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note

- AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training. 
 - All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense. com email address. 
 - If you're unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page. 

If you believe you've been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

data.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. 

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds. 

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1. 85B+ from the world's top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. 

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling. com addresses. 

About The Benefits Marketplace Team

- Benefits is one of the most complex and critical parts of managing a workforce. Employers must navigate insurance carriers, brokers, plan configurations, eligibility rules, enrollment processes, and regulatory requirements, often across fragmented systems. 
 - Rippling's Benefits Marketplace is transforming this experience by bringing benefits discovery, enrollment, administration, and carrier integrations into a unified platform. 
 - We're building highly scalable systems that connect employers, employees, insurance carriers, and benefits providers while automating complex workflows across the employee lifecycle. 
 - The team operates at the intersection of product engineering, distributed systems, marketplace infrastructure, and complex integrations, solving challenging problems around data consistency, scalability, reliability, and automation. 

About The Role

- We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead and scale a high-performing engineering team within Benefits Marketplace. 
 - This is a high-ownership role combining deep technical leadership, product development, and people management. You'll drive the architecture and execution of critical systems, influence product direction, and help shape the future of Rippling's Benefits platform. 
 - You'll work on complex engineering challenges involving distributed systems, carrier integrations, asynchronous workflows, and business-critical transactions. 
 - We're looking for someone with a strong product-building mindset, exceptional technical judgment, and a proven ability to develop engineers and deliver complex products at scale. 
 - You'll be expected to remain close to the technology, challenge architectural decisions, drive execution, and build a culture of engineering excellence. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and grow a high-performing engineering team, attracting, mentoring, and developing exceptional engineering talent. 
 - Own the technical strategy, architecture, and execution of critical Benefits Marketplace products and services. 
 - Build scalable, reliable backend systems supporting benefits enrollment, eligibility, carrier integrations, and complex business workflows. 
 - Drive architectural decisions involving distributed systems, APIs, asynchronous processing, data consistency, and fault tolerance. 
 - Partner with Product, Design, Platform, and senior engineering leaders to define roadmaps and translate ambiguous business problems into scalable solutions. 
 - Stay technically engaged through system design reviews, architectural discussions, critical code reviews, and production troubleshooting. 
 - Lead end-to-end product development, balancing execution velocity, engineering quality, and long-term scalability. 
 - Build a culture of strong ownership, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. 

What You Will Need

- 12-17 years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management experience. 
 - Strong technical foundation in backend engineering, distributed systems, system design, and scalable architecture. 
 - Proven experience building and scaling complex, customer-facing products from conception to production. 
 - Strong coding and architectural expertise in languages such as Java, Python, Go, C++, Scala, or equivalent. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing engineering teams, develop senior engineers, and maintain a high technical bar. 
 - Strong product mindset with the ability to translate customer and business needs into technical strategy and execution. 
 - Experience driving engineering roadmaps, setting priorities, managing dependencies, and delivering complex initiatives. 
 - Ability to operate in ambiguous environments, make sound technical trade-offs, and influence decisions across teams. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across global engineering and product organizations. 
 - Experience building marketplace platforms, enterprise SaaS, fintech, or integration-heavy products is a plus.

data.title: Staff, Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose: 

- Enterprise AI (EAI) builds AI products that combine real modelling work with user-facing applications, and ships them to production. Full Stack Engineers move across data, models, platforms, APIs and interfaces in a single workflow. In our operating model, digital workers do much of the hands-on build. They generate services, APIs, interface components and tests, run evaluations and monitor what is in production. Our engineers set the architecture and standards that work is built to, and own the quality of what ships. 
 - EAI products and agents draw on a governed context layer that makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed. Full Stack Engineers build the products and agents that consume it, and decide how that context reaches users. 
 - The Full Stack Engineer II independently builds and ships AI-integrated features, working closely with GSK business teams to prototype against real data and workflows at a days-to-weeks cadence. The role owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in those features, makes evidence-based calls on what to continue or stop, and contributes reusable components others adopt. 

Responsibilities: 

- Own use cases from problem framing through working prototype and first production version, at a days-to-weeks cadence and without close supervision. 
 - Qualify incoming asks: challenge underspecified problems, assess feasibility and define scope before committing to work. At the end of each piece of work, form and defend an evidence-based recommendation to continue or stop, presented clearly to business and EAI leadership. 
 - Work closely with business teams, prototyping against real data and workflows and building trusted relationships with product owners and engineering leads. 

Required skills: 

- 16+ years of overall professional experience & 10+ years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments. 
 - Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed, independently and under time pressure. A startup, lab or innovation-team background is an advantage. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, Go or similar, with experience designing and shipping backend services and complete UI features. 
 - Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, tool use, prompt engineering and evaluation, including evaluation pipelines and LLM-specific monitoring in production. 
 - Daily use of AI coding agents as the primary mode of development, with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject. 
 - A track record of raising team standards through code review and documentation, and of contributing reusable engineering patterns that others adopted. 

Education : 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred skills: 

- Prior experience as a Full Stack Engineer, Customer Engineer or Solutions Architect, ideally at an AI-native company or hyperscaler. 
 - Experience in regulated industries, such as life sciences, healthcare or financial services, and familiarity with GxP, GDPR and SOX. 
 - Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 

Skills

AI Platforms, AI Systems, Data Analysis, Full Stack Development, Machine Learning (ML), ML Platforms, Model Evaluation, Performance Analysis, Product Delivery, Product Design, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. data.title: Platform Engineer ,Associate Director
data.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others. 

If you're looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions. 

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist

In This Role, You Will

- Own service readiness and operational governance by defining and tracking NFRs and maintaining runbooks, SOPs and operational artefacts 
 - Oversee operational readiness reviews to confirm production standards are met and risks are managed before release 
 - Deliver continuity through backup and restore and DR planning including regular testing, validation of RTO and RPO targets and remediation actions 
 - Run monitoring, alerting and observability to support incident response, major incident triage, service restoration, RCA and problem management 
 - Manage vulnerability remediation and patching across Windows and Linux OS and platform components prioritising by risk and producing audit-ready evidence 
 - Operate and improve GCP and Kubernetes (GKE) platform services including upgrades, node pools, add-ons, capacity and availability management and workload troubleshooting 
 - Apply core cloud controls across IAM, networking, logging and monitoring to keep platform operations secure and supportabl 
 - Reduce operational toil through automation for checks, patch orchestration, reporting and evidence capture using PowerShell, Bash, Ansible and Python

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements: 

- Bring substantial experience in platform engineering, infrastructure or cloud operations, SRE or production support with strong incident, problem and change management discipline 
 - Demonstrate hands-on experience operating GCP infrastructure at scale including IAM, networking and observability 
 - Show strong Kubernetes experience, ideally GKE, including cluster lifecycle management and troubleshooting 
 - Apply strong Windows and Linux administration capability including patching, troubleshooting and operational hygiene 
 - Build and maintain automation using PowerShell, Bash, Ansible and Python 
 - Produce clear operational documentation including runbooks, SOPs and support evidence suitable for audit and assurance 
 - Deliver backup, restore and DR practices including testing and validation against RTO and RPO targets 
 - Support effective incident triage, RCA and problem management with a focus on reducing recurring issues and alert noise 
 - Building reliable cloud platforms

If you want your work to translate directly into stable services and smoother operations this role gives you the scope to make that happen. You'll set the standards for production readiness, strengthen resilience through tested DR and improve security operations through disciplined patching and evidence. You'll also have the space to automate away manual effort so teams can focus on improving the platform not firefighting it. keep our GCP and Kubernetes estate reliable, secure and ready for change. 

You'll achieve more when you join HSBC. 

www. hsbc. com/careers

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

data.title: Software Engineer -Backend
data.description:
- Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
 - Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands-on experience?
 - Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?

If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!

Who We Are

Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability - built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we're trusted by over 6, 000 businesses from fast-growing SMEs to global enterprises. 

We automate how money moves into and out of a business - payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection - through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure. 

As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we're the platform finance teams trust to run mission-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune. 

The Team

At Modulr we are focused on building autonomous squads that are focused on working in

the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on

a particular growth area. Each squad is small and cross-functional. We have big ambitions and have many interesting challenges ahead. 

Summary

In this role you will design, build, and evolve the next generation of Modulr's event-driven payments platform. You'll work across the full engineering lifecycle-from shaping technical approaches to delivering production-grade software-within a squad that values ownership, excellence, and continuous improvement. 

Specific duties

- Engineering & Architecture
 - Design and develop backend services using Java (17+) or similar OO languages. 
 - Build and evolve microservices and distributed, event-driven components in a cloud-native environment. 
 - Contribute to architectural patterns that support throughput, resilience, reliability, and observability. 
 - Design clean, well-documented RESTful APIs and service contracts. 
 - Work with relational data stores, especially PostgreSQL, and contribute to data modelling. 

Distributed Systems & Reliability

- Engineer solutions for concurrency, idempotency, fault tolerance, retries, and high availability. 
 - Improve system performance, reduce latency, and identify bottlenecks across services. 
 - Build systems with strong observability-logs, metrics, tracing-ensuring issues can be diagnosed quickly. 

Quality & Testing

- Develop comprehensive automated tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber. 
 - Participate in design and code reviews, helping raise engineering standards across the team. 
 - Advocate for code quality, maintainability, and long-term technical health. 

DevOps, Cloud & Tooling

- Use and improve deployment pipelines and operational tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS services). 
 - Contribute to internal frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering best practices. 
 - Help shape the evolution of our platform toward a more flexible, modern architecture. 

Collaboration & Delivery

- Work in an agile environment, contributing to planning, design discussions, and iterative delivery. 
 - Collaborate across squads to shape technical solutions that span multiple systems. 
 - Document best practices, reference architectures, and design approaches others can rely on. 

About You

You're an engineer who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and enjoys solving complex, system-level problems. You bring: 

- Expertise in Java or another OO language with willingness to work in Java. 
 - Strong understanding of OOP, design patterns, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Experience building and operating microservices in production. 
 - Ability to reason about concurrency, performance, and system behaviour under load. 
 - Clear, proactive communication and a collaborative, team-first mindset. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills supported by sound engineering judgement. 
 - Ability to manage complexity, balance competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work. 
 - A growth mindset-you enjoy learning, improving, and helping others grow. 
 - A self-starter attitude with a passion for ownership and continuous improvement. 

What We Offer You

- Bonus - Our annual discretionary bonus, paid in May for the previous year, is based on both company and individual performance. 
 - Insurance Coverage - Comprehensive medical, life, and accident insurance provided to support you and your family's wellbeing. 
 - Holidays & Leave - A generous annual leave allowance, your birthday off, and menstrual leave for female employees, with the flexibility to choose days to suit your personal schedule. 
 - Learning & Development - Our onboarding programme, ModStart, equips you for success. Learning doesn't stop there; we'll continue to support your development through various channels and opportunities. 
 - Mental Health, Wellbeing & Inclusion - Access to accredited therapists, coaches, counsellors, management training, and mindfulness sessions with company-funded hours and flexible top-up options. 
 - Company-Wide Events - Participate in collaborative and engaging events with colleagues across the business. 

ModInclusion

At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it's also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.
