data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring processMinimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. 
 - 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. 
 - Experience in low-level systems programming languages (e. g. , C++ or C). 
 - Experience in software performance analysis and improvement, and High-Performance computer architectures (e. g. , CPU, memory subsystem, multiprocessing). 
 - Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field. 
 - Experience with performance analysis and tuning. 
 - Experience with inference performance concepts. 
 - Experience with C++, distributed systems, and technical infrastructure. 
 - Experience using AI tools and building developer solutions. 
 - Track record of individual contribution to engineering projects. 

About The Job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. 

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions. 

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google's flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google's products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company. 

Responsibilities

- Design and implement robust, scalable, and testable C++ code for bulk data processing operators and service backends. 
 - Build and maintain high-throughput data pipelines using Conduit, optimizing for Google-scale throughput (capable of millions of QPS). 
 - Connect and optimize native integrations with Google storage systems (Spanner, Woodshed, Colossus) and ML serving platforms (Uniserve, SUP, Ares). 
 - Take ownership of code quality by writing comprehensive unit/integration tests, contributing to documentation, and proactive debugging/refactoring. 
 - Collaborate with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to clarify ambiguous requirements, suggest architectural improvements, and participate in design reviews.

data.title: Manager / Senior Manager – Operational Excellence & Quality Management
data.description:
Manager / Senior Manager - Operational Excellence & Quality Management

Industry: Flexible Packaging Manufacturing

Experience: 7-10 Years

Company: Nexibles

1. Role Overview

Responsible for improving manufacturing productivity, operational efficiency, product quality and profitability through Six Sigma, TQM, Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement. 

Must have strong factory-floor experience, preferably in flexible packaging manufacturing, including printing, lamination, slitting and pouch making. 

2. Key Responsibilities

1. Operational Excellence: Improve plant productivity, OEE, throughput, machine utilization, capacity utilization and production efficiency. Reduce downtime, setup time, changeover losses and process bottlenecks. 

2. Quality Management (TQM): Strengthen quality systems across incoming materials, in-process production and finished goods. Improve quality parameters, reduce defects, rejection, rework and customer complaints. 

3. Six Sigma & Lean Manufacturing: Implement DMAIC, SPC, FMEA, RCA, Kaizen, 5S and process standardization projects to improve quality, productivity and efficiency. 

4. Flexible Packaging Process Optimization: Optimize printing, lamination, slitting and pouch-making processes. Reduce registration errors, colour variations, delamination, sealing defects and material wastage. 

5. Quality Systems & CAPA: Conduct root cause analysis, manage corrective and preventive actions, strengthen inspections, internal audits and process controls. Ensure customer quality requirements are met. 

6. Cost Optimization & Waste Reduction: Reduce film, ink, adhesive, solvent and other raw material losses. Improve first-pass yield, material utilization, conversion costs and manufacturing margins. 

7. MIS & Performance Monitoring: Develop operational dashboards, monitor KPIs, track improvement projects and present weekly/monthly performance reports to Plant Management and senior leadership. 

8. Training & Team Development: Train production, quality and shop-floor teams in Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, SOPs, problem-solving and continuous improvement. Drive quality ownership and process discipline. 

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

- B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Polymer, Chemical Engineering or related discipline. 
 - 7-10 years of experience in manufacturing operations, quality management or operational excellence. 
 - Strong preference for flexible packaging manufacturing experience. 
 - Practical knowledge of printing, lamination, slitting and pouch making. 
 - Proven experience in Six Sigma, TQM, Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrated results in productivity improvement, rejection reduction and cost savings. 
 - Strong knowledge of OEE, SPC, FMEA, DMAIC, Kaizen, 5S and Root Cause Analysis. 
 - Experience working with Production, Quality, Maintenance and Plant Management teams. 

4. Preferred Skills & Certifications

- Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt. 
 - Lean Manufacturing and TQM. 
 - ISO 9001, ISO 22000 and BRCGS Packaging Materials. 
 - Knowledge of printing, lamination, films, adhesives and packaging quality parameters. 
 - Minitab or equivalent statistical tools. 
 - ERP systems, Excel, MIS and operational dashboards. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional factory improvement projects. 

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on the following performance areas: 

1. Manufacturing Efficiency : - Improve OEE, production output (throughput) and capacity utilization. 

2. Quality Improvement : - Reduce product defects, rejection and rework. 

3. Material Utilization : - Reduce wastage of film, ink, adhesives and other raw materials. 

4. Cost Reduction : - Achieve measurable annual cost savings through process improvements. 

5. Production Yield : - Improve first-pass yield (producing good-quality products without rework). 

6. Process Stability : - Reduce variations and inconsistencies in manufacturing processes. 

7. Equipment Performance : -Reduce machine downtime, setup time and changeover time. 

8. Customer Satisfaction : -Reduce customer complaints and recurring quality issues. 

9. Continuous Improvement : -Successfully implement Lean, Six Sigma and TQM projects. 

10. Process Standardization : -Ensure proper implementation of SOPs and process controls. 

6. Ideal Candidate Profile

An experienced manufacturing professional with 7-10 years of experience, preferably in flexible packaging, who can: 

- Work directly on the factory floor. 
 - Understand manufacturing processes, machines and quality parameters. 
 - Analyze production data and identify root causes. 
 - Implement sustainable process improvements. 
 - Reduce wastage, rejection and manufacturing costs. 
 - Lead cross-functional teams. 
 - Present measurable business improvements to senior management. 

Most important expectation

Success will be measured through tangible and sustainable improvements in manufacturing productivity, quality consistency, operational efficiency, waste reduction and profitability. 

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at: Email: sneha. singh@perusalglobal. com

data.title: SDET Lead
data.description:
SDET Lead - Globeia

Location: Gurugram, Onsite

About Globeia: 

Moving to another country means proving who you are, again and again. Fingerprints, police clearances, apostilles, translations, visas. Today that process is slow, confusing and built around government counters. Globeia exists to fix it. 

We started in 2020 and we are fully bootstrapped. No outside investors, no burn for the sake of burn. Every city we open is paid for by customers who need us. Today Globeia is live in 70 cities across North America, Europe, the UK, Australia and India, with offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Toronto, London, Lisbon, Barcelona, Madrid, Sydney, Melbourne and Gurugram. By the end of this year we will be live in more than 100 cities. 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and versatile SDET Lead/Automation Engineer to lead our testing efforts across our entire application suite. In this role, you will be responsible for full-cycle testing from exploratory manual testing to architecting and building out our automated testing frameworks from scratch. You will also leverage the latest AI-driven QA tools to accelerate test creation and improve coverage. If you have a deep understanding of modern QA methodologies, love breaking software to make it better, and want to own the quality standards for a growing engineering team, this is the perfect opportunity. 

Key Responsibilities

- Test Strategy & Execution: Perform comprehensive all-around testing, including functional, integration, regression, performance, and cross-browser testing for both frontend and backend systems. 
 - Automation Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated testing frameworks from the ground up for web applications and APIs. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Leverage AI-powered testing tools and coding assistants to accelerate test script generation, create intelligent test data, and reduce test maintenance overhead. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to ensure code quality upon every deployment. 
 - API & Backend Testing: Thoroughly test RESTful and GraphQL APIs to ensure data integrity, security, and performance. 
 - Manual & Exploratory Testing: Identify edge cases and complex user flows that require manual validation before translating them into automated scripts where applicable. 
 - Defect Management: Track, document, and triage bugs clearly, working closely with full-stack developers and product managers to resolve issues quickly. 
 - Quality Advocacy: Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for QA, mentor team members, and foster a culture of quality across the organization. 

What We're Looking For

- Experience: 5+ years of QA experience, with at least 2-3 years focused heavily on building test automation frameworks from scratch. 
 - Core Languages: Strong programming skills in JavaScript or TypeScript for writing maintainable test scripts. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise with modern UI automation tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. 
 - AI Testing Experience: Familiarity with AI-driven testing platforms (e. g. , Mabl, Testim, Percy) or using AI coding assistants (like GitHub Copilot) to optimize testing workflows. 
 - API Testing: Proven experience testing APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent automated libraries. 
 - Performance/Security: Basic understanding of performance testing (e. g. , JMeter, k6) and standard web security vulnerabilities. 
 - DevOps Basics: Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Vercel, etc. ). 
 - Problem Solving: A meticulous eye for detail and the ability to anticipate how users might break a system in the real world. 

Why Join Us

- Build and own the QA automation infrastructure from day one. 
 - Work with cutting-edge QA technologies, including AI-driven testing frameworks. 
 - Work closely with a collaborative, modern engineering team. 
 - Clear career progression and the opportunity to build out a QA team in the future. 
 - Competitive salary, benefits, and a flexible work environment. Location: Gurugram

Job Description

The Role

insightsoftware is a global provider of comprehensive solutions for the Office of the CFO. As a Software Development Engineer in Test 2 on the Certent Disclosure Management (CDM) team, you'll be an engineer first. You'll work inside the codebase alongside developers to make CDM testable at every level, pushing coverage down the test pyramid so that most quality is proven by fast, reliable unit, component, and integration tests rather than slow end-to-end suites. Working closely with development and DevOps, you'll help ensure CDM ships reliable, high-quality releases to enterprise customers. 

What You Will Do

- Refactor production C# code to improve testability: introduce dependency injection, create seams, decouple components, and remove hard-coded dependencies. 
 - Write characterization tests to safely bring legacy code under test before changing it. 
 - Pair with developers on design and on unit, component, and integration test strategy, and help them write better tests themselves. 
 - Use AI coding agents to write and refactor tests and production code. Own the agent rule files and tooling that govern how they write tests (e. g. , AGENTS. md, MCP servers). 
 - Define and evolve the team's test architecture, deciding what belongs at each level of the pyramid and actively shrinking reliance on E2E tests. 
 - Review PRs, including agent-generated changes, for testability, test quality, and coverage, not just for whether tests exist. 
 - Review requirements and acceptance criteria early to shape testable designs. 
 - Build and maintain quality gates in CI pipelines (test stages, coverage, reporting, flaky-test detection). 
 - Develop reusable test libraries, fixtures, and test data builders in C#. 
 - Maintain a lean, targeted set of E2E and UI tests (Selenium, Ranorex) for critical user journeys across web and desktop. 
 - Contribute to API and performance testing. 
 - Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives. 

What You Bring

Core Skills

- Strong proficiency in C# and . NET, with experience writing and refactoring production code, not only test code. 
 - Deep experience with unit testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest) and mocking libraries (Moq, NSubstitute, or similar). 
 - Solid understanding of dependency injection, SOLID principles, and techniques for breaking dependencies in legacy code. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot agent mode, Cursor), the judgment to spot weak or incorrect agent output, and the ability to teach others to do the same. 
 - Experience writing integration and component tests (e. g. , WebApplicationFactory, Testcontainers, in-memory or containerized databases). 
 - A clear point of view on the test pyramid and when each type of test is the right tool. 
 - Experience with CI/CD and source control (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, Bitbucket). 
 - Working experience with UI automation (Selenium, Ranorex, or similar). 
 - Experience in Agile Scrum/Kanban teams. 

Nice to Have

- TDD experience. 
 - BDD experience (e. g. , Reqnroll, SpecFlow, Gherkin). 
 - Contract testing (e. g. , Pact), mutation testing (e. g. , Stryker. NET), coverage tooling (e. g. , Coverlet). 
 - Performance or load testing experience. 
 - Experience in financial reporting or other regulated domains. 

Experience

data.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. 

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. 

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. 

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 

About The Role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the Semantic Layer team in Bengaluru. You'll own the health, delivery, and growth of the team behind MetricFlow - building and coaching a group of engineers, setting technical direction in partnership with your leads, and ensuring one of the most important projects in the modern data stack keeps shipping with quality and momentum. 

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend most of your time growing people, running a healthy delivery process, and shaping strategy - but you'll stay close enough to the code and the architecture to make sound technical calls and earn the trust of a senior engineering team. You'll also be the steward of a public, community-facing open-source project, balancing the needs of internal roadmap and external contributors. 

About The Team

The Semantic Layer team owns the systems that turn dbt models into trusted, reusable business metrics. At the heart of this is MetricFlow - the open-source semantic engine that powers the dbt Semantic Layer. MetricFlow lets data teams define metrics once in code and consume them consistently across BI tools, notebooks, AI agents, and downstream applications. 

This team is the steward of MetricFlow as an open-source project: shipping releases, reviewing community contributions, evolving the query compiler, and ensuring it integrates cleanly with the broader dbt ecosystem. The team works at the intersection of language design, query compilation, and distributed data execution - solving problems that directly shape how thousands of organizations measure their business. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers building MetricFlow - hiring, onboarding, career development, performance management, and day-to-day support. 
 - Own delivery for the Semantic Layer team: planning, prioritization, execution, and predictable shipping of high-quality software. 
 - Partner with your senior and staff engineers to set technical direction across metric definitions, query compilation, dimensional modeling, and SQL generation for multiple data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and others). 
 - Steward MetricFlow as an open-source project - set the bar for how the team triages issues, reviews external pull requests, manages releases, and engages the community on GitHub and in Slack. 
 - Collaborate with engineering leaders across the dbt platform, dbt Core, and the Semantic Layer service to ensure MetricFlow integrates seamlessly with the rest of the dbt ecosystem. 
 - Partner with product, design, and developer-relations counterparts to translate customer and community feedback into a clear, well-sequenced roadmap. 
 - Drive engineering excellence in performance, reliability, and observability of metric query execution at scale. 
 - Foster a culture of design docs, thoughtful code review, and durable engineering - shipping fast without shipping sloppy. 

Skills We're Looking For

- Experience managing software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management, with a track record of shipping production systems. 
 - A strong engineering foundation - you've built and shipped production software yourself and can engage credibly on architecture and technical tradeoffs with a senior team. 
 - Familiarity with the technical domain: SQL fundamentals, how analytical query engines and data warehouses execute queries, and systems that involve parsing, compilation, or transformation (query planners, DSL compilers, type systems, or rule-based engines). 
 - Solid grasp of software design principles: clean APIs, modularity, testability, and backwards compatibility - and the judgment to hold a team to them. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication - you can explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineers, product managers, and external community members. 
 - Experience leading in a distributed, asynchronous team environment. 

Nice to have

- Experience leading or contributing to a popular open-source project, including managing a community of external contributors. 
 - Familiarity with dbt, MetricFlow, LookML, Cube, or other semantic-layer technologies. 
 - Background in data warehousing internals, query optimization, or analytical SQL dialects. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and release engineering for Python libraries. 
 - Exposure to building developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or CLIs. 

Why join us

- Impact at scale: Your team's code will run inside the data platforms of tens of thousands of companies, including some of the world's largest enterprises. 
 - Open-source ownership: You'll lead the team behind a foundational open-source project - visible, reviewed, and used by the global data community. 
 - A team that values craft: We invest in design docs, code review, and durable engineering. We ship fast, but we don't ship sloppy. 
 - Competitive compensation: Market-leading salary, equity, comprehensive health insurance, generous time off, learning and wellness stipends, and home-office support. 

Perks And Benefits

100% employer-paid medical insurance
 - Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 
 - RSU stock grants*
 - Professional development and training opportunities
 - Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
 - Monthly cell phone stipend
 - Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

data.title: Solutions Architect
data.description:
Who we're looking for

A Client-Facing Builder-Architect: someone who can talk trade-offs with a client in the morning and be deep in the logs with the dev team by the afternoon. You bridge business goals and technical execution, and you stay close enough to the code to know what you're advising on. 

As a Solution Architect, you own the end-to-end technical solution. You're the person a client's leadership trusts to turn a business goal into a design, and the person engineers trust to make that design work in practice. Your mantra: design, validate and deliver the right end-to-end solution. 

Here's what you look like: 

- A trusted advisor. You're a technical sounding board for client technology and business leaders, and you translate dense tech into business value, risk and cost. 
 - A zero-ego builder. No ivory tower. You write proofs of concept, review critical code and dig through logs alongside the developers. 
 - Calm when it counts. When production breaks or an escalation lands, you get methodical and steady, and the room settles with you. 
 - Diplomatic with pushback. You handle client trade-offs and disagreements with confidence and good grace. 
 - Commercially pragmatic. You pick business outcomes and delivery speed over a perfect, over-engineered stack. 
 - Globally minded. You lead distributed teams and bridge US client expectations with India-based delivery pods. 
 - Full-stack engineering mindset: Demonstrate a full-stack engineering mindset, with the ability to understand and work across the complete application stack, including frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, cloud infrastructure, deployment, security, performance, and observability, as relevant to the solution. 
 - AI-forward. You use generative AI and AI-assisted engineering tools (LLMs, GitHub Copilot, Claude) in solutions and delivery workflows, with human oversight, security, privacy and governance. 
 - At home in digital learning. You're comfortable with frameworks like LTI, Ed-Fi, QTI and CEDS in enterprise platform ecosystems. About the role

We're hiring a Solution Architect: a client-facing technical leader who turns business objectives into end-to-end solutions, then drives them from presales all the way through implementation and production. 

You'll blend client advisory, solution architecture, hands-on problem-solving and delivery leadership. You'll be comfortable in a room with senior client stakeholders, and close enough to engineering to validate decisions and untangle complex technical challenges yourself. 

Location: Mumbai

Level: Solution Architect

What you'll do

- Sit down with client technology and business leaders to understand their strategic goals, business challenges and technical constraints. 
 - Lead discovery, solution definition, architecture design, technology selection and technical planning for complex applications and enterprise solutions. 
 - Lay out solution alternatives, build-versus-buy assessments, modernization strategies and technology roadmaps in terms of business value, risk, cost and delivery impact. 
 - Define the end-to-end architecture across application, integration, data, cloud, security and infrastructure, as the solution needs. 
 - Stay hands-on: build proofs of concept, run critical code reviews, validate technical designs, run system diagnostics and solve the complex problems. 
 - Guide engineering teams through implementation and keep the delivered solution true to the architectural intent and business requirements. 
 - Own technical risk across the solution lifecycle: set mitigation and contingency plans and drive critical issues to resolution. 
 - Partner with Project Managers and delivery leadership to balance technical feasibility, delivery commitments, scope and commercial considerations. 
 - Hold the bar on technical quality: performance, scalability, security, reliability, accessibility, maintainability and production readiness. 
 - Spot opportunities for AI-enabled product capabilities and AI-assisted engineering, and guide their implementation with appropriate human oversight, security, privacy and governance. 
 - Lead technical solutioning for presales: discovery, architecture proposals, feasibility, estimation inputs, risk assessment and client presentations. 
 - Build trusted relationships with client CTOs, technology leaders, engineering leaders and product stakeholders, and surface modernization opportunities that support account growth. 
 - Lead and mentor distributed engineering teams and technical practitioners, keeping client expectations and delivery execution aligned. What you'll bring

- Strong expertise in solution architecture, enterprise application design, distributed systems, microservices, APIs and integration patterns. 
 - Hands-on proficiency in full stack technology, and the ability to validate designs through code, prototypes and technical reviews. 
 - Solid experience with cloud-native architectures, AWS or Azure, containers, Kubernetes and infrastructure automation. 
 - An understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, event-driven architectures, security, performance, reliability and observability. 
 - Practical experience bringing generative AI or AI-assisted engineering tools into solution or delivery workflows. 
 - Strong consulting, presales, presentation, negotiation and executive communication skills. 
 - A track record of leading distributed teams, handling ambiguity and turning complex technology decisions into business outcomes. Experience and qualifications

- Typically 10-15 years of relevant technology experience, with significant solution architecture and technical delivery experience. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related discipline. 
 - Relevant cloud architecture or enterprise architecture certifications are a plus. How you work and communicate

- Advisor and builder: you can present the options to a client leader and then prove the hard parts in code. 
 - Owner: you care how the whole solution performs in production, not just whether the proposal won. 
 - Calm under pressure: you stay methodical during outages and client escalations. 
 - Commercially aware: you weigh scope, timelines and cost alongside technical feasibility. 
 - Bridge builder: you translate between clients, delivery leadership, project managers and engineers, in terms each of them can use. 
 - Clear communicator: you explain complex trade-offs in business terms, with confidence and diplomacy. 
 - Mentor: you guide Technical Architects and engineers, and you share context generously.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Azure Infrastructure
data.description:
Job Title: Site Reliability Engineer

Location: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time

ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facility management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. ServiceChannel is well established, but even after almost 20 years we still retain the spirit of a startup. We are primed for success and we are currently on a high growth trajectory. We are committed to creating a great product for our customers and a great work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally. 

ServiceChannel's DevOps team is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our expanding Infrastructure team. As an SRE you will own the monitoring and reliability of the ServiceChannel platform. You will run incidents, set up and tune alerts, and trace problems to their root cause across the application and the infrastructure. You will bring deep and broad Azure knowledge, strong Elastic Cloud skills, and enough . NET to read the code and see why it is failing, and you will use what you learn to improve our systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Running incidents from detection through resolution, keeping stakeholders updated, and driving each one to a confirmed root cause. 
 - Owning monitoring and alerting: setting up, tuning and maintaining alerts for the platform. 
 - Investigating and troubleshooting to find what is broken and which part of the infrastructure is causing it, based on how the ServiceChannel platform maps to that infrastructure. 
 - Root cause analysis using data to identify the scope and scale of impact, and writing the RCA with follow-up actions to prevent recurrence. 
 - Writing and maintaining runbooks, and updating them after each incident. 
 - Operating and maintaining the Azure, Windows Server and Elastic Cloud environments day to day and keeping them highly available, including patching, disks and server rotation. 
 - Handling DevOps support requests for access, provisioning and environment changes across Azure, Elastic and Service Bus. 
 - Managing DNS, private endpoints, traffic routing, VPN, SSL/TLS certificates and Key Vault secrets, including renewals and expiry alerts. 
 - Responding to security and compliance items, such as CVEs and audit requests. 
 - Improving and automating systems based on what incidents and investigations reveal. 
 - Measuring and optimizing the service: defining and tracking SLIs and SLOs, right-sizing capacity, reviewing Azure cost, and finding availability, performance and security improvements. 
 - Working closely with Engineering, Customer Support and the US team to bridge gaps in code, infrastructure and knowledge, with clear handoffs at the end of each shift. 
 - Participating in a weekly on-call rotation covering 12: 00 AM ET to 12: 00 PM ET to troubleshoot production issues. 

Skills & Experience

- Deep and broad knowledge of Azure infrastructure and how its features and services work, including the following. 
 - Compute and apps: App Services, Functions, Container Apps, Virtual Machines
 - Integration and messaging: API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid
 - Traffic and networking: Front Door, Application Gateway, load balancers, virtual networks, private endpoints, VPN gateways
 - Data: Storage accounts, Redis, and working familiarity with Azure SQL and SQL Server
 - Identity and access: Entra ID, RBAC, SSO (SAML)
 - Monitoring and security: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Key Vault
 - AI: working familiarity with Azure AI Foundry
 - Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical problems and their impact clearly to engineers, Customer Support and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Hands-on experience running Elastic Cloud in production: search, cluster management, Logstash and Kibana. 
 - Comfortable with Docker containers. 
 - Working knowledge of . NET and C#: reading code and stack traces to tell whether a failure comes from the code, its configuration or the infrastructure. 
 - Proven ability to lead incidents and troubleshoot production issues down to root cause. 
 - Skilled at building and tuning monitoring and alerting systems, using Azure Application Insights, incident. io, distributed tracing and anomaly detection. 
 - Solid understanding of SRE practices: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets and blameless postmortems. 
 - 3+ years of relevant experience focused on service reliability: DevOps, systems administration, application development, build, release, and deployment. 
 - Broad Windows Server knowledge: managing VMs, domain controllers and Group Policy (GPO), adding and managing disks, troubleshooting Windows DNS, IIS and services, and working over RDP. 
 - Working experience with configuration management and automation tools (Ansible preferred, or similar). 
 - Solid grounding in networking and security, including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs and private connectivity. 
 - Experience managing SSL/TLS certificates and secrets, including renewals, rotation and expiry alerts, and controlling Key Vault access with RBAC. 
 - Experience supporting complex distributed systems that must stay up 24x7. 
 - Familiar with CI/CD pipelines and tooling (GitHub, TeamCity, Azure DevOps, Octopus), and Git workflows. 
 - Strong track record of writing clear runbooks, RCAs and technical documentation. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. 
 - Nice to have: PowerShell and Bash scripting, Azure DSC, Terraform, Kubernetes, AWS, and experience using AI assistants to script, troubleshoot and automate faster.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Enterprise Advanced)
data.description:
Enterprise Advanced is a distributed team across Europe and India that builds the software running MongoDB on any infrastructure, at global scale - from on-prem data centers to private cloud. You'll work primarily on Ops Manager and Automation, the systems that let customers deploy fault-tolerant, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes. Our software manages some of the largest self-managed MongoDB deployments in the world, with production clusters running hundreds of shards and nodes under a single deployment. 

The main focus of this team is to adapt our software to manage MongoDB clusters which are deployed in data centers or private cloud platforms. 

You will work on the core functionality for all of our products. Our team's end users are some of the largest businesses in the world, deploying massive clusters and processing huge amounts of data. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

What you'll do

- Design, implement, test, and release features for Enterprise Advanced Product
 - Own end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from design through incremental shipping
 - Troubleshoot and resolve issues surfaced in customer deployments running at scale
 - Apply engineering judgment and MongoDB's core values across planning, design, and code review

A great fit for this role will be

- You enjoy distributed-systems problems; consistency, fault tolerance, and scale are the daily reality, not edge cases
 - People who like ambiguity and are comfortable defining their own approach with guidance, not step-by-step instruction
 - You're flexible! You're willing to take on a wide variety of responsibilities, learning as you go
 - You're a self-starter! You're comfortable organizing your own time, acting on feedback and prioritizing with guidance from senior members of your team

- 7+ years experience with a language such as Java or GO

 - Good knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals (data structures and algorithms)
 - Good understanding of Object Orientation concepts
 - Ability to think conceptually and design modular, complex systems

 - Experience working directly with production systems
 - Experience with multiple programming languages

 - Experience or interest in full-stack web application development

What is in it for you

Role Description We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and optimise the distributed backend services and enterprise integration layers that power our platform at global scale. In this role, you will take ownership of mission-critical components in the booking pipeline, lead complex third-party supplier API integrations, champion architectural standards, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers across the team.   

Roles & Responsibilities

- Ensure Platform Reliability & Scale: Deliver high-availability, low-latency backend services that reliably handle high-volume booking transactions across global travel management networks. 
 - Deliver Robust API Integrations: Architect, build, and maintain fault-tolerant third-party supplier integrations across complex REST and XML/JSON endpoints. Architect and implement high-reliability connectors to integrate supplier and travel partner REST/SOAP APIs across varying payload formats (JSON and XML). 
 - Optimize System & Database Performance: Proactively identify and eliminate backend bottlenecks, optimizing MS SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and data models for sustained transactional throughput. 
 - Uphold Engineering & Code Excellence: Enforce high standards through disciplined peer code reviews, comprehensive automated testing, and solid object-oriented design practices. 
 - Lead System Architecture & Technical Documentation: Produce clear UML diagrams, data flows, and technical interface specifications to ensure seamless maintainability and knowledge transfer across distributed teams. Design, code, test, high-volume backend services using C#, ASP. NET, and MS SQL Server. 
 - Drive Modernization Initiatives: Identify opportunities to refactor legacy components, streamline service communication (such as modernizing WCF endpoints), and adopt forward-looking development practices. 
 - Code Quality & Technical Governance: Lead comprehensive code reviews, champion engineering best practices, maintain code maintainability, and ensure thorough test coverage. 
 - Technical Documentation & System Design: Produce clear architecture diagrams, UML schematics, workflow charts, and interface specifications to document complex technical solutions. 
 - Database Design & Performance Tuning: Design relational database schemas, optimize queries, create efficient indexes, and troubleshoot database bottlenecks to support high transactional loads. 
 - Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance, and constructive feedback to junior and mid-level software engineers. 

Skills/Experience

- 6 to 8 years of professional software engineering experience building scalable enterprise applications. 
 - Proven expertise in C#, . NET, and MS SQL Server. 
 - Solid hands-on experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs handling high-volume JSON and XML payloads. 
 - Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Design (OOD) principles, Design Patterns, and architectural modeling using UML. 
 - Practical working experience with WCF services and IIS configuration/hosting. 
 - Demonstrated ability to profile, debug, and optimize application throughput and database queries. 

Technology Exposure

- Core Languages & Frameworks: C#, . NET / . NET Core, WCF
 - Data & Persistence: MS SQL Server (Complex Queries, Stored Procedures, Indexing & Query Tuning)
 - API & Integrations: REST Web APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML/XSD
 - Hosting & Web Servers: IIS, Windows Server Environments
 - Design & Modeling: Object-Oriented Design (OOD), UML, System Architecture
 - Methodologies & Tooling: Agile / Scrum, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Unit Testing frameworks

Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

Did you know? Alternative investing has the potential to generate higher returns compared to traditional investments over the long term. AI and Machine Learning are revolutionizing the way alternative investments are managed and analyzed. Investors are using these technologies to gain insights, see opportunities, and optimize their investment strategies. 

Addepar is building solutions to support our clients' alternatives investment strategies. The alternatives data management product is a serverless, modular and terraformed stack. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, implement and deliver modern software solutions that ingest and process ML-extracted data. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including data scientists and product managers to build intuitive solutions that revolutionize how clients experience alternatives operations. 

You will work closely with operations engineering on document-based workflow automation and peer engineering teams to define the tech stack. You will iterate quickly through cycles of testing a new product offering on Addepar. If you've crafted scalable systems, or worked with phenomenal teams on hard problems in financial data, or are just interested in solving really hard technical, critically important problems, come join us!

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Architect, implement, and maintain engineering solutions to solve complex problems; write well-designed, testable code. 
 - Lead individual project priorities, achievements, and software releases. 
 - Collaborate with machine learning engineers to bring ML-extracted data into the backend stack of the application in Python or other languages. 
 - Collaborate with product managers and client teams on product requirements iterations, design feasibility and user feedback. 
 - Document software functionality, system design, and project plans; this includes clean, readable code with comments. 
 - Learn and promote engineering standard methodologies and principles. 

Who You Are

- At least 3 years of Backend development experience
 - In-depth knowledge of Python or Java similar
 - Experience with NoSQL databases
 - Experience with serverless architecture
 - IaC (infrastructure as code), preferably terraform
 - Solutions-oriented, with exceptional analytical and problem solving skills
 - Experience with AWS is a strong plus. 
 - Experience with DynamoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch
 - Familiarity with writing, debugging, and optimizing SQL queries
 - Knowledge of front end development is a plus. 
 - Experience in fintech (wealth/portfolio management domain) is a plus. 

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

data.title: Software Engineer II - C# [T500-30840]
data.description:
Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients. 

About Leggett & Platt: 

Founded in 1883, Leggett & Platt (NYSE: LEG) is a global manufacturer that designs and produces innovative products and components used in homes, offices, and vehicles around the world. The company serves customers across industries through its expertise in bedding, furniture, flooring, specialty products, and comfort technologies. Driven by a mindset of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, Leggett & Platt has spent more than 140 years creating solutions that support everyday comfort and help people live and work better. 

Leggett & Platt is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team at our Development Center in Trivandrum, India. This is an excellent opportunity to own complex, high-impact features as part of a single engineering organization that spans Trivandrum and the United States. In this position, you will design and build scalable software solutions, provide technical leadership to fellow engineers, and partner daily with product and engineering counterparts across both locations to keep priorities and delivery in sync. We are looking for a highly collaborative engineer who communicates clearly across distance and time zones, takes ownership of outcomes, and continuously raises the bar on engineering quality. 

What you will be doing as Senior Software Engineer: 

- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable software applications in partnership with cross-functional teams spanning Trivandrum and the United States. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of complex features, from technical design through implementation, testing, and production deployment. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Software Engineers, conducting code reviews and guiding best practices. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, QA, and engineering counterparts in the US to translate business requirements into technical designs and sprint plans, ensuring Trivandrum and US teams work as one cohesive unit. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code following established engineering standards and design patterns. 
 - Participate in and help drive Agile/Scrum ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues, working cross-functionally to identify root cause and implement lasting fixes. 
 - Contribute to architectural decisions and technical roadmap discussions alongside senior engineering and architecture leadership. 
 - Champion automated testing, CI/CD practices, and DevOps culture to improve release quality and velocity. 
 - Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their potential application to improve team productivity and product quality. 
 - Document technical designs, APIs, and system behavior to support knowledge sharing across globally distributed teams. 
 - Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering efficiency and code quality. 

To be successful in this role, you will need: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 - 6+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex features or systems. 
 - Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e. g. , C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python). 
 - Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and design patterns. 
 - Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and working with relational and/or NoSQL databases. 
 - Proven track record thriving on a globally distributed engineering team, collaborating effectively with colleagues in the United States across overlapping hours and building strong working relationships despite the distance. 
 - Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development lifecycle practices. 
 - Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to varied audiences across time zones and cultures. 
 - Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on ambiguous problems. 

Things we consider a plus: 

- Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with front-end frameworks (React, Angular) or mobile development (Android/iOS). 
 - Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform). 
 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code). 
 - Familiarity with microservices architecture and event-driven systems. 
 - Relevant certifications (Azure, AWS, or similar). 

Reasons You'll Love It Here: 

Our benefits may vary slightly by location, but at our Trivandrum office you can expect a comprehensive package including group health insurance for you and your family, Provident Fund (PF) and gratuity contributions, generous paid time off including earned leave, casual leave, sick leave, and public holidays, and paid parental leave. We also strongly encourage and provide opportunities for learning and professional development. Our Learning & Development team has put together in-house training on subjects like front-line supervisor essentials, technical leadership, how to manage conflict in the workplace, and many others. 

What to Do Next: 

Now that you've had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available. 

Our Commitment to You: 

We're proud of the fact that we are strongly rooted in being an inclusive, people-focused organization. Our company culture reflects values like integrity, ownership, and authenticity. We take these to heart, and if you do as well, you'll fit right in. Leggett & Platt Inc. is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds. 

Since 1883, Leggett & Platt (NYSE: LEG) has been creating a wide variety of innovative products that can be found in most homes, offices, and automobiles. Today our growing company consists of more than 23, 000 employee-partners in 120 manufacturing facilities located in 23 countries, including our engineering Development Center in Trivandrum, India. We're not just hiring; we're building a better company.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
Equifax is transforming how global credit, data, and analytics platforms are engineered. Based in our Trivandrum Technology Hub and reporting to a Senior Software Engineer, the Software Engineer (Full Life Cycle) is Equifax's core individual contributor engineering role building, testing, deploying, and operating software and AI-native systems end-to-end with no separate QA handoff. Quality, security, compliance, and technical documentation are owned directly by you as the engineer writing the code, enforced through automated testing, quality gates, and AI-assisted validation embedded in the CI/CD pipeline. You will also apply Context Engineering practices building prompt workflows, integrating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and implementing hallucination guardrails in production applications. 

What You'll Do

- End-to-End Full Life Cycle Execution: Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate reliable, scalable microservices and cloud-native features end-to-end without downstream QA, SDET, or Technical Writing handoffs.

 - Applied AI & Context Engineering: Implement prompt engineering patterns, integrate RAG pipelines, manage knowledge base context payloads, and build hallucination-prevention guardrails into production services. 
 - Cloud-Native Development & Operations: Build and maintain containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), troubleshoot production issues, analyze root causes, and ensure high service availability. 
 - Technical Documentation & Agile Collaboration: Maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation as code alongside your services and collaborate actively in sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives within a globally distributed engineering team. 

What Experience You Need

- Experience & Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) with 4-6 years of hands-on software engineering experience building production web applications or distributed microservices. 
 - Core Backend & Full-Stack Development: 3+ years of hands-on experience writing, debugging, and optimizing production code in Modern Java (JDK 17+), Spring Boot, and TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 - Cloud & Container Fundamentals: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying cloud-native applications on GCP (or AWS/Azure) utilizing Kubernetes (GKE/EKS) and Docker. 
 - Automated Testing & CI/CD Ownership: Demonstrated experience owning code quality end-to-end using automated testing frameworks (e. g. , JUnit, Mockito, WireMock, RestAssured) and working with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), Helm Charts, and Terraform. 
 - Context Engineering & LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating LLMs into software workflows specifically building or consuming RAG pipelines, structuring prompts/context windows, and validating AI outputs for accuracy and safety. 

What Could Set You Apart

- GCP Data & Messaging Ecosystem: Hands-on experience working with Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Bigtable, GCS, or Cloud Composer (Airflow). 
 - Frontend Web Development: Experience developing responsive UI components using Angular 
 - Database & Modern Build Tooling: Proficiency with relational/NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cloud SQL) and modern build/version control tools (Maven, Gradle, Git). 
 - Regulated Domain Experience: Prior experience building secure, compliant software within FinTech, banking, credit, or data-intensive enterprise environments.

data.description:

Job Description

As a Group Engineering Leader - Quality, for the Player Experience pillar you will automate, validate and ship software with AI as an important part of how you work reporting to the Head of Engineering. 

This job is hybrid model. 

Title: Group Engineering Leader - Quality Engineering & Automation

Role purpose: Lead quality across a large product or technology portfolio. Build and coach a blended team of manual testers and automation engineers, while making automated, risk-based testing part of everyday engineering and release work. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and grow a large, distributed QA team across manual testing, automation, API, performance, and specialist testing. 
 - Set a portfolio-wide quality strategy, standards, release gates, and clear ownership across teams. 
 - Drive a pragmatic shift from manual-heavy regression to automation, prioritizing high-value, repeatable tests. 
 - Own the Playwright strategy: framework design, coding standards, reusable components, test data, environments, reporting, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Ensure coverage spans UI, API, integration, regression, and critical end-to-end journeys. 
 - Work with engineering, product, architecture, and delivery leaders to build quality in from requirements and design through production.

 - Improve flaky-test management, failure triage, and feedback speed so automation is trusted by delivery teams. 
 - Build capability through hiring, coaching, career paths, and clear expectations for both manual and automation roles.

Qualifications

 - Strong working knowledge of Playwright, preferably with TypeScript or JavaScript, and experience operating it in CI/CD.

data.title: Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability
data.description:
Job Description

Principal, Design for Safety & Reliability

Engineering CoE

- Product safety and reliability
 - India

Reports to

Head of Engineering - Education Segment

Business

Schneider Electric

- Education Equipment and Services

Location

Bangalore, India, with travel to plants, partners and customer sites across the segment's markets

Scope

Global: product safety and reliability for the full training-solutions portfolio - Smart Energy, Smart Buildings, Smart Factory, Digital Blocks, Data Centers and Fundamental Learning - across design, industrialisation and the installed base

About The Education Segment

Schneider Electric's Education Segment provides technical training solutions that close the skills gap in energy, automation and digital technologies. We equip technical and vocational institutes, universities, government skilling programmes and industry academies with hands-on training labs, curricula, digital learning, train-the-trainer programmes and certification. 

Demand is rising fast. Governments are investing heavily in workforce skilling, industry faces acute technician shortages, and the energy transition and smart manufacturing need new skills at scale. The segment has already helped more than 200, 000 young people gain job-ready skills. 

We are now building a dedicated, multi-country organisation to grow the business across six markets, with its own business development, engineering and delivery teams. Engineering is at the heart of what we offer: training solutions built on real industrial technology. 

Purpose of the role

Make every Education Segment training solution safe for learners and trainers, and reliable over years of daily classroom use. Our labs put students in direct contact with real industrial equipment: LV and MV electrical systems, batteries, solar, motors and drives, robots and connected devices. Safety and reliability must be designed in from the start. 

As the single technical authority for product safety and reliability in the Engineering CoE, you will set the design rules, risk-assessment methods and reliability standards that every Product Architect works to. You will review and approve designs before release, lead reliability testing and field-failure analysis, and work with the Principal, Conformity Assessment so products can be certified in every target market. 

Market overview

Institutions are buying more advanced training equipment, with higher voltages and power, battery storage, robotics and connected systems, often used by beginners. Governments, accreditation bodies and customers expect equipment that is safe by design, meets local standards and keeps working through heavy use. 

A single safety incident or poor field reliability can damage trust with institutions and governments across a whole market. Strong design for safety and reliability is therefore a core part of the segment's competitive position and of Schneider Electric's reputation. 

Key responsibilities

Safety and reliability framework

- Define the Education Segment's product safety and reliability policy, design rules, checklists and standards library, aligned with Schneider Electric's product safety governance. 
 - Set safety requirements specific to training use: protection against electric shock, touch-safe connections, safe access to live parts during exercises, fault simulation, emergency stops, and safe use by beginners. 
 - Set reliability targets and design-margin rules for each product family, covering expected lifetime, duty cycles and classroom handling. 

Design for safety

- Lead hazard analysis and risk assessment (for example FMEA, HAZOP and fault-tree analysis) for new and upgraded products, with the Product Architects. 
 - Apply relevant safety standards, such as IEC 61010 (laboratory equipment), IEC 61439 (LV assemblies), IEC 62271 (MV switchgear), IEC 60204-1 (machinery), IEC 62368, ISO 10218 (robots) and battery safety standards. 
 - Cover the hazards specific to the portfolio: LV and MV electrical risk, arc flash, battery storage and thermal runaway, PV DC circuits, rotating machinery, robots and cobots, and the safety effects of cybersecurity weaknesses in connected equipment. 
 - Review and approve safety design at each release gate, and define safe-use instructions, labelling, guarding and personal protective equipment requirements. 

Design for reliability

- Lead reliability engineering: component derating, design reviews, reliability prediction (for example MTBF) and design-for-maintainability rules. 
 - Define and run reliability and durability testing, including accelerated life, thermal, vibration, transport and repeated wiring-cycle tests for classroom use. 
 - Assess the reliability of suppliers and locally procured items with Quality and Global Supply Chain. 

Industrialisation and quality

- Define safety-critical characteristics and routine production tests, such as insulation, earth continuity, dielectric and functional safety checks, with the Industrialization Leader and plants. 
 - Approve first-article and pilot builds for safety and reliability before volume production. 
 - Make sure safety requirements carry through to local assembly, partner production and country localisation. 

Field safety and reliability

- Set up incident reporting and field-failure analysis across the installed base with the operations centres, Technical Specialists and service partners. 
 - Lead root-cause analysis of safety incidents and reliability failures, and drive corrective and preventive actions, including field notices or recalls when needed. 
 - Track field reliability data and feed lessons back into design rules and the product roadmap. 

Certification support

- Work with the Principal, Conformity Assessment to prepare safety and reliability evidence, risk assessments and test reports for certification in each target country. 
 - Monitor changes in safety standards and regulations, and assess their impact on the portfolio. 

Capability building

- Train Product Architects, engineers, delivery teams and partners on safety and reliability design, safe installation and safe lab operation. 
 - Contribute safety content to train-the-trainer programmes, so institutions run labs safely. 
 - Build a strong safety culture in the Engineering CoE and grow the safety and reliability capability as the organisation scales. 

Success measures

Measure

Target

Safety performance

Zero serious safety incidents involving Education Segment equipment

Design governance

Every new and upgraded product passes safety and reliability review before release

Field reliability

Field failure rate falling and meeting targets for each product family

Certification readiness

Safety evidence ready on time for certification in all target countries

Corrective action

Root-cause analysis and corrective actions closed on time

Framework

Safety and reliability policy, design rules and test methods defined and in use

Capability

Engineers, delivery teams and trainers trained on safety and reliability

Key relationships

- Internal: Head of Engineering; Principal, Conformity Assessment; Product Architects and Senior Engineers (Smart Energy, Smart Buildings, Digital/IIoT, Data Centers); Industrialization Leader; Operations Head, Technical Specialists and the operations centres; Schneider Electric product safety, quality and Global Supply Chain teams. 
 - External: test laboratories, certification and standards bodies; manufacturing partners and suppliers; institutions, trainers and accreditation bodies; insurers and safety regulators where relevant. 

Candidate profile

- 12+ years in product safety, reliability engineering, compliance or design engineering for electrical, automation or industrial equipment. 
 - Critical: deep expertise in electrical product safety and risk assessment, with hands-on use of IEC safety standards such as IEC 61010, IEC 61439, IEC 60204-1 and IEC 62368. 
 - Proven reliability engineering skills: FMEA, derating, reliability prediction, accelerated life and environmental testing, and field-failure analysis. 
 - Knowledge of battery, MV and machinery or robot safety is a strong advantage. 
 - Experience taking products from design through industrialisation, with safety-critical production tests and supplier quality. 
 - Experience with training or educational equipment, or other products used by non-experts, is a strong plus. 
 - Able to influence engineering teams and make firm safety decisions without relying on hierarchical authority. 
 - Degree in Electrical, Electrical & Electronics or Mechanical Engineering; master's or a recognised safety or reliability certification (for example CRE or functional safety) preferred. Willing to travel across India and the segment's markets.

This role combines hands-on Flutter and Dart development with native iOS expertise, mobile architecture, CI/CD, test infrastructure, release engineering, observability, and platform operations. You will own critical parts of the mobile lifecycle, from design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident response. 

The ideal candidate has strong technical judgment, understands mobile systems deeply, and can improve both the product and the engineering systems behind it. You will partner with Product, Design, Backend, Platform, Security, and Support teams while mentoring engineers and establishing scalable mobile engineering practices. 

This is an opportunity to shape Weave's mobile architecture, improve developer experience, and deliver reliable communication tools that healthcare practices depend on every day. 

If you're excited by meaningful ownership, technical influence, and building products that power real-world businesses - you'll thrive at Weave.

What You Will Own

- Mobile Architecture: Design and evolve scalable Flutter/Dart applications with native iOS and Android integrations.

What will make us love you?

 - You use AI thoughtfully with strong engineering judgment and review standards.

Role Overview

Lead design, development and technical quality of native iOS applications supporting BSRO customer, store workflows. Build reliable, secure and accessible experiences using modern Apple platform technologies. 

Key Responsibilities

Native iOS engineering

- Develop and maintain production applications using Swift and current Apple SDKs; use SwiftUI for new declarative interfaces where appropriate and UIKit for established or specialised flows. 
 - Apply modular architecture and separation of concerns, using MVVM or clean/layered patterns where suitable. 
 - Build reusable UI, navigation, state management and adaptive layouts for supported iPhone/iPad form factors. 

Concurrency, data & networking

- Use Swift structured concurrency (async/await, Task, actors) and Combine where appropriate. 
 - Integrate REST/GraphQL APIs with typed models, validation, error handling, retry policies and secure token management. 
 - Implement persistence and caching using SwiftData/Core Data, Keychain and file storage; design offline and synchronisation behaviour. 

Platform integration

- Integrate push notifications, deep links, biometrics, camera, location, maps and other device capabilities. 
 - Integrate approved analytics, crash reporting, feature flags and authentication SDKs while managing privacy and SDK lifecycle. 
 - Handle permissions, app lifecycle, background tasks, network changes and OS compatibility. 

Quality, security & performance

- Create unit/UI tests using XCTest, Swift Testing and XCUITest as appropriate. 
 - Profile startup, rendering, memory, battery and network usage using Instruments and Xcode diagnostics. 
 - Apply secure storage, privacy-by-design and secure coding; ensure VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and accessibility support. 

CI/CD, release & leadership

- Maintain signing, provisioning, certificates, entitlements and environment configurations. 
 - Contribute to Xcode Cloud or approved CI workflows, Fastlane and TestFlight/App Store releases. 
 - Investigate production defects and mentor peers; collaborate with Product, UX, Android, backend, QA and Security. 

Qualifications

- 7+ years of professional iOS development with strong hands-on Swift expertise. 
 - Strong practical experience with SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, iOS SDKs and app lifecycle. 
 - Strong understanding of concurrency, memory management, networking, persistence and architecture. 
 - Experience with REST APIs, JSON, OAuth 2. 0/OIDC or enterprise authentication and secure token handling. 
 - Experience with automated unit/UI testing and CI pipelines. 
 - Experience profiling performance, memory, crashes and device/OS compatibility. 
 - Knowledge of App Store Connect, TestFlight, signing, provisioning and release management. 
 - Independently own complex features and technical designs, lead reviews, mentor developers and resolve cross-component issues. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Swift 6 language features and strict concurrency checking, compatible with product deployment targets.

Personal Attributes

The Supplier Quality Engineer establishes quality targets and goals to include quality cost reduction, warranty reduction and overall supplier rating. 

Responsibilities

- Monitor and resolve supplier process control performance issues by developing robust quality control plans and implementing sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Drive permanent resolution of supplier issues reported by Vertiv plants and by Customers. 
 - Initiate and lead supplier performance improvement by partnering with supplier to identify, understand and abate issues for New Product Introduction, First Article Inspection (FAI) and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) as well as Mass Production. 
 - Lead and own PPAP requirements associated with a change. 
 - Lead problem definition and reactive problem solving through containment, identification of root cause and corrective action with Supplier Corrective Action Report (SCAR). 
 - Develop 8D and supplier reports on reported issues. Communicate internally and externally on outcomes of investigations. Work with internal teams, including Engineering, Service, Manufacturing / Operations, Sales, Offering Management, and Plants Quality to resolve quality issues impacting Vertiv plant and customers. 
 - Ability to simplify complex information and concisely prepare both verbal and written executive summaries to Leadership Team. 
 - Perform supplier on-site audits to monitor supplier Quality Management System (QMS) compliance and effectiveness. 
 - Identify areas for cost reduction across assigned supplier base including internal supplier process, quality improvements. 
 - Visit Suppliers to proactively see installations and document improvement needs. Visit suppliers to understand the nature of the issue and get definite corrective action initiated in the organization. 
 - Evaluate potential new suppliers by conducting on-site audits and scoring of Quality Management System
 - Monthly reporting and status updates to management on Supplier performance and various quality initiatives to business management. 
 - Supports the execution and maintenance of an ISO 9001 certified Quality Management System. 
 - Other responsibilities may be assigned from time to time as needed, based on the evolution of the company and the requirements of the department/position. 

Qualifications

Minimum Job Qualifications: 

- 1-3 years of experience in a Supplier Quality Engineer role or related field. 
 - Experienced with problem solving tools and techniques (i. e. 8-D, 5 Whys, 7 Ways, DOE, eCAR, Fishbone, Pareto, Six Sigma, First Piece, PPAP). 
 - Can manage multiple tasks by based on priority, difficulty and severity. 
 - Background in applying statistical tools for process and product development and control (i. e. Gage R&R, Process Capability, Control Plans, SPC, Process Failure Mode Effects Analysis (PFMEA). 

Preferred Qualifications

- 3-5 years of experience in a Supplier Quality Engineer role or related field. 
 - Knowledge of metal fabrication/machining, electrical components, wiring

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's Degree with minimum 1-3 years of experience

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

- Frequent Standing
 - Working in a manufacturing environment around machinery and equipment
 - Protective Equipment Required (safety shoes, eyewear, earplugs, gloves, etc. where required)

Time Travel Required

- 80 %

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.
