data.title: AI QA Engineer
data.description:
About Us

At apexanalytix, we're lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we've been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We're the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here. 

And you'll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you'll be helping build that reputation. 

Read more about apexanalytix - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/about/

Quick Take

As an AI QA Engineer, you'll drive the quality, reliability, and safety of the AI solutions we deliver to our Global 2000 clients, including GenAI and agentic applications, RAG pipelines, and ML models used across our products. This role is for an engineer with a solid data science/AI background who understands how models behave and is skilled in LLM evaluation, end-to-end AI testing, and ML model validation, helping us ship production-grade AI with confidence. 

The Work

- Own the test strategy for our AI products, covering LLM features, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and ML models. 
 - Write and execute test plans, cases, and reports; manage the defect lifecycle; and perform exploratory testing of AI features. 
 - Define acceptance criteria and quality metrics for non-deterministic outputs (accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, relevance, cost) using LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation. 
 - Build and maintain golden datasets, ground-truth labels, and regression suites with subject-matter experts, reflecting real scenarios and edge cases. 
 - Develop automated evaluation pipelines (DeepEval, Ragas, promptfoo, LangSmith) that run in CI/CD on every prompt, model, retrieval, or code change. 
 - Test agentic behavior-multi-step planning, tool calling, integrations, error handling, and fallbacks-to verify agents' complete tasks correctly and stay within guardrails. 
 - Validate ML models and data pipelines for data quality, segment performance, bias/fairness, and drift, using statistical methods to compare versions. 
 - Perform adversarial and safety testing: prompt injection, jailbreaks, PII leakage, and compliance checks. 
 - Monitor production AI quality through observability tooling, triage degradations, lead root-cause analysis, and partner with Data Science, AI, and engineering teams on fixes and release sign-off. 

The Must-Haves

- B. S. /M. S. in Computer Science, Data Science, ML/AI, Statistics, or related field. 
 - 2-3 years in AI/ML, data science, or AI-focused QA, including 1+ year of hands-on test automation, ideally for production ML systems. 
 - Working knowledge of ML model building, evaluation metrics, and LLM behavior (prompting, context, RAG). 
 - Experience evaluating GenAI applications (RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, function calling) with DeepEval, Ragas, or similar. 
 - Strong Python with PyTest, API testing, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Grounding in statistics and experimentation (sampling, significance testing, model A/B comparison), plus SQL and data validation tools such as Great Expectations or Evidently. 
 - Experience testing document and image analysis solutions that extract insights from unstructured data. 
 - Ability to define pass/fail criteria and rubrics for non-deterministic outputs and translate business requirements into measurable quality standards. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication with technical and business stakeholders across time zones. 

The Good-to-Haves

- Synthetic test data generation, including privacy-safe datasets, edge cases, and adversarial scenarios. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes, and MLOps tooling for deploying and testing AI applications. 
 - Familiarity with AI risk and governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and responsible AI practices (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, bias testing, PII protection).

data.title: QA Engineer - Automation and Cloud
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a smart, analytical and technically strong QA Engineer who is passionate about product quality and enjoys solving complex technical problems. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in both manual and automation testing, along with good programming fundamentals and a solid understanding of APIs, backend systems, databases and cloud environments. 

We are not looking for someone who simply executes predefined test cases or raises defects. We want an engineer who thinks critically, understands how applications work internally, investigates issues independently and takes complete ownership of product quality. 

The individual will be responsible for owning the quality of assigned features/modules end-to-end, from understanding requirements and designing test scenarios to automation, debugging, defect investigation and release validation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Manual Testing & Quality Assurance
 - Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and acceptance criteria to develop comprehensive test scenarios. 
 - Design and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory and end-to-end test cases. 
 - Identify edge cases, negative scenarios and potential failure points that may not be explicitly covered in requirements. 
 - Independently own testing activities for assigned features/modules. 
 - Validate complex business workflows, application behaviour and data integrity. 
 - Identify, reproduce, document and investigate defects with clear technical details. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product managers to ensure issues are understood and resolved. 
 - Participate in release validation and provide quality sign-off for assigned modules. 
 - Automation Testing
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts using suitable automation technologies. 
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities and test scripts. 
 - Perform UI automation as well as API automation. 
 - Demonstrate good programming fundamentals, including OOP concepts, functions, data structures, exception handling and scripting. 
 - Maintain automation suites and troubleshoot flaky or inconsistent test cases. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, reliability and execution efficiency. 

Preferred technologies: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pytest, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java. 

Candidates with strong automation fundamentals in one technology should be comfortable transitioning to another. 

- API & Backend Testing
 - Perform comprehensive API testing, including positive, negative, integration and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Validate request/response payloads, headers, authentication, status codes and business logic. 
 - Understand REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS and basic authentication mechanisms. 
 - Investigate issues across frontend, backend and service integration layers. 
 - Understand backend execution flows and dependencies between services. 
 - Read and interpret application code to identify potential root causes of defects. 
 - Database & Data Validation
 - Write SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, aggregations and other data-validation operations. 
 - Validate data consistency and integrity across application layers. 
 - Investigate database-level issues and discrepancies. 
 - Possess a good understanding of relational databases and basic NoSQL concepts. 
 - Independently validate backend data against expected business outcomes. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure Understanding
 - Possess a good understanding of cloud computing fundamentals, preferably AWS and/or Azure. 
 - Understand how applications are deployed and operate in cloud environments. 
 - Analyse application logs, cloud logs and monitoring information to investigate issues. 
 - Understand environment configurations, environment variables, service dependencies and application connectivity. 
 - Possess basic networking knowledge, including DNS, ports, HTTP/HTTPS, timeouts and connectivity. 
 - Have working knowledge of Linux commands and command-line troubleshooting. 
 - Understand Docker fundamentals and container-based application deployment. 
 - Have basic familiarity with Kubernetes concepts. 

The ability to independently investigate application and environment-related failures using logs, configurations and other diagnostic information will be a significant advantage. 

- CI/CD & Engineering Collaboration
 - Understand Git, version control and basic branching workflows. 
 - Understand CI/CD pipelines and investigate automation or pipeline failures. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product managers and DevOps teams. 
 - Independently investigate technical issues before escalating them. 
 - Communicate defects, investigation findings and root-cause observations clearly. 
 - Production & Performance Testing Exposure
 - Participate in investigating production issues by analysing logs and helping identify potential causes. 
 - Understand the importance of application stability, reliability and performance. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6 will be an advantage. 
 - Basic understanding of security testing, authentication, authorization and role-based access control is desirable. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

- 2-4 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance. 
 - Strong fundamentals in manual testing and test case design. 
 - Practical experience in automation testing. 
 - Good programming fundamentals and scripting capabilities in at least one programming language. 
 - Experience with UI and API testing. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON and HTTP protocols. 
 - Good SQL proficiency and understanding of relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Ability to analyse application logs and troubleshoot issues. 
 - Good understanding of backend systems and application architecture. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud environments, preferably AWS or Azure. 
 - Familiarity with Linux, Git, networking and CI/CD fundamentals. 
 - Ability to read application code and independently identify or narrow down potential root causes. 
 - Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving abilities. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on exposure to both AWS and Azure. 
 - Experience with Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Exposure to microservices-based architectures. 
 - Docker and Kubernetes troubleshooting experience. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools. 
 - Exposure to production issue investigation. 
 - Experience improving existing automation frameworks. 

What We Are Looking For

- Someone who is naturally curious, analytical and inquisitive. 
 - Someone who thinks beyond predefined test cases and proactively identifies potential problems. 
 - A debugging-first mindset rather than a ticket-closing mindset. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability for assigned features/modules. 
 - Someone who can investigate problems independently instead of relying on developers for every technical clarification. 
 - An individual who is comfortable reading code, understanding application behaviour and working with backend systems. 
 - Someone who can quickly learn unfamiliar technologies and tools. 
 - A proactive team player with clear communication and collaboration skills. 

About Company

Hi there! We are Auriga IT. We power businesses across the globe through digital experiences, data and insights. From the apps we design to the platforms we engineer, we're driven by an ambition to create world-class digital solutions and make an impact. Our team has been part of building the solutions for the likes of Zomato, Yes Bank, Tata Motors, Amazon, Snapdeal, Ola, Practo, Vodafone, Meesho, Volkswagen, Droom and many more. 

We are a group of people who just could not leave our college-life behind and the inception of Auriga was solely based on a desire to keep working together with friends and enjoying the extended college life. Who Has not dreamt of Working with Friends for a Lifetime. 

Come Join In!

data.title: Head of AI Engineering (Agentic Systems)
data.description:
About the role

LexHive is hiring a Head of AI Engineering to lead how we build, ship and run AI across the business. 

AI is already in production at LexHive, and teams across the company rely on it every day. You will turn this work from a small, fast-moving effort into a dependable engineering practice. You will own the AI roadmap. You will set the standards for how AI-written code is built, reviewed and deployed. And you will show the business that each system is accurate before it gets more autonomy. 

This is a senior, hands-on role. You will write code, review architecture, and lead a small team. 

What you'll own

- The AI roadmap. Turn business problems into a sequenced plan of AI products. Agree it with product and operations leaders, then deliver against it. 
 - Production AI systems. Own the AI systems we run today from end to end, and keep them reliable as usage grows. 
 - Evaluation and accuracy. Build the measurement that tells us whether an AI system is right, and report accuracy in a way that non-engineers can read and trust. 
 - AI engineering practice. Make coding agents such as Claude Code the default way the team builds. Set the guardrails that keep that code safe to run and easy to change: tests, code review, CI/CD, configuration kept out of the code, and version control for prompts. 
 - Security and data protection. Our systems handle sensitive legal and health information. You will own least-privilege access, PII handling, secret management, authentication on every endpoint, and security testing for AI systems. 
 - Models and cost. Choose the right model for each job. Run fair comparisons across commercial and open-weight models, and keep AI costs visible and under control. 
 - The team. Lead and grow a small AI engineering team. Hire well, and coach engineers to work at the speed that coding agents make possible. Work closely with the core engineering team so that standards stay shared across the company. 

What success looks like in the first 90 days

- You have taken ownership of our production AI systems, and the teams who rely on them know who to call. 
 - Every production AI system has an accuracy report that a business leader can read and act on. 
 - The team builds with coding agents and ships through one shared review and deployment process. 
 - You have a roadmap for the next set of AI products, agreed with leadership and ordered by business value. 
 - You have completed a security review of the AI systems, with the top risks closed or on a dated plan. 

What you bring

- 10+ years relevant experience in building software or machine learning systems, including at least 3 years leading engineers. 
 - A track record of taking LLM-based systems from prototype to production, and keeping them running once real users depend on them. 
 - Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex. You have a clear view on how to test and review code that no person wrote line by line. 
 - Strong evaluation skills. You have measured model accuracy where labels are scarce, and you can explain the numbers to people who do not write code. 
 - Applied machine learning beyond prompting, for example classification, ranking, or decision models. 
 - Strong Python, and experience with a major cloud platform (AWS preferred), including serverless services and managed model platforms. 
 - Experience with retrieval: embeddings, vector databases, and search over large sets of documents. 
 - Experience turning unstructured documents into structured data. 
 - Clear written communication. You write the design document before the code. 
 - Comfortable working some hours that overlap with the US. 

Preferred

- Experience in a regulated domain such as legal, healthcare, insurance or financial services, including HIPAA or similar privacy rules. 
 - Voice or conversational AI running in production. 
 - Experience with case management systems or workflow automation tools. 
 - Startup experience building a function from zero. 
 - Familiarity with US disability benefits processes. 

How we work

- Competitive, performance-linked compensation. We pay for impact. 
 - Ownership of an AI function that is already in production, with direct visibility to leadership. 
 - Real users from day one. Teams across the company use what you build every working day. 
 - Remote-first flexibility, and a team that values output over hours logged. 
 - A fast-moving environment where your ideas ship quickly. 

If you have shipped AI that people depend on every day, and you want to set how a whole team builds with it, we'd like to meet you.

 - Passion for adopting emerging technologies and driving continuous innovation. 

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients - helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that's differentiated - and we've done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren't just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80, 000 employees in 1, 200 offices across 42 countries. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There's also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. 

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https: //www. morganstanley. com/about-us/global-offices into your browser. 

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. 

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

data.title: Technical Lead
data.description:
Business Unit Overview: Flipkart Commerce Cloud (FCC)

Flipkart Commerce Cloud (FCC) is the global enterprise wing of Flipkart, providing AI-driven retail intelligence to international retailers. We offer a modular SaaS suite (including Marketplace technology, Retail Media platforms, and Pricing engines) built on Flipkart's homegrown expertise in navigating complex markets. We empower global enterprises across the world to unlock high margin revenue through scale-tested technology. 

The Role

We are looking for seasoned engineers who are quality-conscious, product thinkers, and business cognizant, not mere coders. 

In this role, you will own the engineering of one or more modules within the Supply Chain ecosystem in Flipkart Commerce Cloud, working closely with adjacent Supply Chain teams. You will be a hands-on technical leader who designs, codes, and drives execution alongside your team. 

You will be expected to: 

• Design and code independently across multiple tech components of your Supply Chain modules, in areas such as inventory, order management, fulfilment, and logistics. 

• Develop a deep understanding of non-functional requirements, such as consistency, reliability and availability, scale, and horizontal scalability, and make tech stack decisions accordingly. 

• Actively mentor engineers and take ownership of codebase quality through code reviews, design reviews, and engineering best practices. 

• Amplify the impact of your work with the scale that Flipkart operates at, which demands super efficient solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Thought Leader for Tech and Domain

• Own your Supply Chain modules from product conceptualization to realization, working with product teams. 

• Drive the technical roadmap, focusing on platformisation, generic and reusable components, and own tech metrics like product reliability, performance, and availability. 

• Create tech designs and solutions for complex systems with minimal supervision, and write production code on the critical path. 

• "Go to" person within the team on your modules and the related Supply Chain domain concepts. 

• Good understanding of partner ecosystems and interfaces, such as WMS, OMS, ERP, and marketplace and carrier integrations. 

• Familiar with academic research, industry trends, and standards in supply chain and distributed systems. 

2. Lead By Example

• Lead technical execution across teams with cross-functional stakeholders. 

• Set the bar for engineering quality through hands-on design, coding, and reviews. 

• Mentor and guide team members on everything from structured problem solving to development of best practices. 

• Contribute to Senior Engineer hiring and help improve hiring culture within the team. 

• Accountable for onboarding team members. 

3. Be a Champion

• Break down problems into components, identify dependencies, understand priorities, plan for iterations and feature creep, and provide accurate estimates that feed into the larger plan. 

• Communicate with stakeholders in an effective and timely fashion. Capable of unblocking self and other teams whenever necessary. 

• Finish deliverables on time, ensure functional correctness and completeness, and contribute to non-functional aspects without supervision. 

• Accountable for quality of deliverables and artifacts in adherence to defined processes for the team. 

• Estimate cost of resources (including tech and non-tech resources). 

Requirements

• Education: B. E/B. Tech/M. Tech or any other similar qualification. 

• Experience: 8 to 11 years of experience as a hands-on technology leader, with significant experience in Supply Chain, Inventory, Order Management, Fulfilment, Logistics, or a related domain. 

• Platform Experience: Experience building enterprise platforms and SaaS products. 

• Leadership: Experience leading and managing a team of 5 to 10 engineers and delivering high quality projects on time. 

• Coaching: Experience building, developing, and coaching engineers on a team with strong technical talent. 

• Technical Depth: Deep understanding of technology and architecture in a highly scalable and available setup, including distributed systems, data consistency, and high-throughput, low-latency services. 

• Innovation: Experience with new open source technologies and their adoption into product development.

data.title: AEM Tech Lead
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Opening paragraph

AEM Tech Lead is a key member of the EY Digital Experience Platform's delivery team in GDS. This resource will use technology components from both Adobe, Microsoft and other platform components to bring to bear innovative solutions to business problems. 

The opportunity

This opportunity within the EY Digital Experience Platform's delivery team will help in the growth of your career. You will have the opportunity to work with the Adobe cloud suites and will collaborate with the broader team. Lead a team of delivery team members to provide deep technical development expertise, guidance and best practices and coding standards. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Partner with wider technology teams and business to understand functional and non-functional requirements from a business and from a platform perspective
 - Lead a team of AEM developers & other delivery team members to provide deep technical development expertise, guidance and best practices and coding standards
 - Carry out necessary AEM development work - components, templates, services, necessary configurations
 - Conduct code reviews and technical design reviews. 
 - Estimate efforts and identify technical risks and propose mitigation plan. 
 - Trouble shoot production issues and provide technical guidance during critical incidents. 
 - Optimize performance, dispatcher, caching strategy. 
 - Document findings, learnings and recommendations
 - Share knowledge on new AEM features, capabilities, technologies, architecture methodologies, standards, leading practices. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

How your skills and experience will make an impact, followed by sub-headings: 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- 8 to 10 years in IT environment
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience of working with AEM
 - Hands-on development experience with AEM 6. x onwards including AEM as Cloud Service. 
 - Adobe Experience Manager - components, templates, workflows, MSM and Rollout, translations and workflows, UI customisations, reporting, 
 - Deep knowledge of Java, Maven, JCR, OSGI, Sling Framework, HTL (Sightly), AEM dispatchers, Restful APIs. 
 - HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, jQuery, AJAX
 - Knowledge of Cloud Manager CI/CD pipelines, GitHub
 - Code Quality Tool/Framework: SonarQube, Junit, Mockito
 - Adobe certifications such as AEM Sites Developer and or AEM Cloud Service required

Ideally, you'll also have

- Excellent communication skills, facilitation and influencing. 
 - Understanding of the Adobe Experience Cloud suite of products. 
 - Experience of Adobe's Project Firefly highly desirable. 
 - Experience of additional Adobe solutions such as a Target, Analytics beneficial. 

What We Look For

- Loves creative use of technology, likes experimentation, is not afraid to try, fail fast and learn. 
 - Analytical, logical approach to problem solving. 
 - Action oriented. 

What Working At EY Offers

Reward statement plus an outline of the culture and environment in this part of the firm. If not covered elsewhere, this may include language about the interesting, varied and important work; the freedom and autonomy you'll have in the role; the feedback you will receive that you can learn from to achieve mastery at something; opportunities for personal growth and career advancement; or who and how you will be connected to others. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.description:
Recruitment Scam Notice: Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as "name@cvent. com" email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent. 

If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent. com. 

For more information, visit Cvent's Recruitment Fraud Notice. https: //www. cvent. com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud. 

About Cvent: 

www. cvent. com

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6, 000+ employees and ~34, 000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we're transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection. 

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4. 6B in 2023. 

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections. 

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection. 

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we're committed to continuous learning and adaptation-AI isn't just a tool for us, it's part of our DNA. We're looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you'll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. 

Throughout our interview process, you'll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you're excited to be part of a team that's leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we'd love to meet you. 

Role Overview

Splash is Cvent's event marketing platform. We are standing up a new engineering team in Bengaluru with a single charter: build the AI-powered features that will define the next generation of Splash. You will build this team from zero, then lead it as a peer to the established Splash engineering and product teams in Bengaluru, North America, and Spain, who own adjacent parts of the platform and with whom you will plan, design, and ship. 

This is an AI-first role in two senses. The team ships AI into the product, and the team builds software with AI: agentic coding tools, spec-driven development, and disciplined review of AI-generated output are the default way of working here, not an experiment. We are looking for a manager whose value comes from engineering judgment and a high quality bar rather than from the volume of code they personally write. You will decide what gets built and how, set the standard for what is good enough to ship, and hold the team to it. 

Reporting line: Director of Engineering, Splash India. Team size: 4-5 engineers by the end of the first year, hired by you. 

In This Role, You Will: 

Build the team (your main job in year one)

- Hire the founding team from 0 to 4-5: define the roles and levels, run the hiring loop end to end, close candidates, and onboard them to be productive quickly. 
 - Establish the team's engineering standards, operating rhythm, and ways of working from day one, including how AI tools are used, reviewed, and measured. 
 - Create a culture where engineers own outcomes, learn fast, and hold a high bar for quality. 

Lead delivery of AI features for Splash

- Own execution of the AI feature roadmap for Splash in partnership with Product, Design, and the Splash teams in Bangalore, North America, and Spain. 
 - Make architecture and technology decisions for the team's services and front ends; ensure what ships meets non-functional requirements (security, scalability, resiliency, accessibility, performance) and responsible-AI expectations. 
 - Run the team across time zones: coordinate dependencies, manage production issues and incidents, and keep stakeholders informed with clear, honest status. 

Set the engineering bar in an AI-native workflow

- Define how the team works with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development: what a good spec looks like, when to delegate to an agent, and what must be verified by a human. 
 - Be the quality gate. Review designs, AI-generated code, tests, and evaluations for correctness, security, and maintainability, and teach the team to do the same. 
 - Keep the team's tooling and practices current as the AI development landscape changes, and share what works with the wider Splash organization. 

Grow people

- Coach engineers, set goals, give direct and timely feedback, and run performance reviews and career development. 

Here's What You Need: 

These are requirements, not nice-to-haves. We expect candidates to meet all of them. 

- People management and hiring. 12+ years of software engineering experience, with depth in backend systems and 3+ years managing software engineers, with a track record of hiring, onboarding, and growing strong engineers, and the appetite to do that here from the ground up. 
 - Depth in our stack. Java with Spring Boot for backend services; React or Next. js with TypeScript on the front end; GraphQL APIs; relational and NoSQL databases; event-driven microservices on AWS. 
 - Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic software development. You use tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or GitHub Copilot agents in your own work: writing specs an agent can execute, reviewing and correcting its output, and knowing where these tools fail. This must be lived experience, not familiarity with the concepts. 
 - Strong engineering judgment. You can evaluate a design or a change for correctness, security, scalability, and maintainability without having written it yourself, and you have a track record of owning non-functional requirements for production systems. 
 - Experience shipping AI product features. You have taken LLM-powered functionality to production (for example retrieval, agents, or structured generation) and understand evaluation, prompt and model lifecycle, cost, latency, and failure modes. 
 - Cross-geography collaboration. Proven ability to work as a peer with engineering, product, design, and SRE teams in other regions and time zones, including in a matrixed or distributed organization. 
 - Clear communication. You write specs, decisions, and status updates that people in other time zones can act on without a meeting, and you can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Education. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Nice to Have: 

- Experience forming a team from scratch (0 to N): defining roles and levels, standing up the hiring loop, and establishing norms rather than inheriting an existing team. 
 - Experience in event, marketing, or martech products, or other B2B SaaS with high-volume customer-facing workflows. 
 - Experience building evaluation frameworks or observability for LLM features in production.

Join Ericsson as a Senior Software Architect with deep experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and strong knowledge of Java security. You will lead the architecture of cloud-native, microservices-based solutions that deliver robust, scalable, and high-quality software products.

data.description:
Java Full Stack Developer with Backend Focus

Role

Java Full Stack Developer - Backend Focus

Grade

Assistant Vice President

Location

Mumbai

Reports To

TBC

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. 

Position Purpose

Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java-based backend services and middle business layer components within enterprise full-stack applications. Own backend architecture decisions, API design, data access patterns, and integration with upstream and downstream systems. Work competently across the existing frontend layer using Angular/TypeScript/React. Bring the depth of an experienced backend engineer with the breadth to contribute across the full stack. Leverage AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of day-to-day engineering practice. 

Direct Responsibilities

- Design and Develop scalable full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular). 
 - Design and optimize high-performance APIs with security, caching, and fault tolerance. 
 - Design and Develop robust backend services with efficient database interactions. 
 - Build responsive UI with seamless backend integration. 
 - Automate CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable software delivery. 
 - Lead cloud-native deployments with containerization, auto-scaling, and cost optimization. 
 - Enforce Quality-first engineering: Unit, integration, and ensure high code quality with SonarQube. 
 - Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and drive technical excellence across the team. 
 - Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust, compliant technical solutions. 

Contributing Responsibilities

- Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions, particularly around API design, data layer, and system integration
 - Participate in code reviews and enforce clean code and quality gate standards
 - Support knowledge transfer and capability building within the India Solutions team
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, infrastructure) on integration and delivery
 - Improving DevSecOps maturity and SDLC practices within the team

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

- Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
 - Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
 - Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

Specific Qualifications

Experience Level: 8+ years

- 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale
 - 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments
 - Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills. 
 - Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React
 - Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture
 - Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

Domain Experience

- Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred
 - Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous
 - Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

Technical Skills

Required

Skill Group

Details

Core Java & JDK 21+

- Modern language features - records, sealed classes, pattern‐matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional). 
 - Concurrency & Parallelism - virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives. 
 - JVM & GC tuning - G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‐dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‐system (JPMS) usage. 
 - Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
 - Build & Unit‐test foundation - Maven/Gradle multi‐module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‐image awareness. 

Spring Ecosystem

- Spring Boot 3. x - create micro‐service skeletons, auto‐configuration, actuator health‐checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2). , 
 - Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) - entity mapping, query‐hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation. 
 - Spring Cloud basics - service discovery (Eureka), API‐gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‐breaker (Resilience4j). 
 - Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration
 - Spring Security- CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‐server setup, basic role‐based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS. 

Database & Data Access Engineering

- SQL & query optimisation - complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‐plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL). 
 - Database optimisation - (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
 - ORM performance - JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‐level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints. 
 - NoSQL & caching - when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‐aside), basic data‐modeling, and TTL/eviction policies. 
 - Migrations & transactions - Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‐DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‐level choices. 

Design & Architecture

- Clean / Hexagonal architecture - ports‐and‐adapters, dependency‐inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring. 
 - Domain‐Driven Design basics - bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing. 
 - API‐first & contract - OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‐driven contract testing (Pact). 
 - Event‐driven patterns - Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‐box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation. 
 - Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security. 
 - Microservices design Pattern ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy

- Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions
 - Caching Strategies (Redis, CDN)

DevOps

- Containerisation & K8s - Docker multi‐stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes. 
 - CI/CD pipeline - Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‐analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
 - Observability starter - expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK. 
 - Runtime security, secret‐management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)
 - Canary/blue‐green release patterns

Testing & Quality Engineering

- Test‐pyramid implementation - unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact). 
 - Performance & load testing - JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results. 
 - Static analysis & coverage - SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set. 

Frontend

Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks. 

AI Tools

Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e. g. , Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas

Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design. 

Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants

Behavioral Skills

- Sets technical direction for multiple squads and aligns it with business objectives
 - Cross-functional collaboration across frontend, QA, DecvSecOps and infrastructure teams
 - Balances speed, quality, and regulatory constraints in a fast-moving environment and is results oriented
 - Ensures that security, data‐privacy, and regulatory requirements are baked in. 
 - Structured communication of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
 - Adaptability to legacy and greenfield environments delivering modern, cloud‐native solutions. 
 - Leverages generative AI to boost productivity and foster a culture of experimentation

Education Level: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience

Picture yourself brightening someone's day. When you join our Hotels team, that's exactly what you'll do every time you come to work! As an Engineering Manager, you're not just overseeing the daily operations of physical building and systems maintenance and repairs - you're spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. 

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

 - Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. - HVAC, Electrical, or Plumbing/Gas Fitter trade-qualified advantageous

About Us

At Hilton, we don't just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests-we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we've welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. 

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World's Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we're setting new standards for the future of travel. 

Whether you're starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career-and help us make every stay a little more magical. 

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we're more than a great place to stay-we're a great place to work.

About the jobLike Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer (SWE) goes way beyond just Search. SWE Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a SWE Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Our client is implementing an enterprise Data Governance Platform (Torro) within its Azure Landing Zone, across DEV, UAT, Pre-Prod and PROD environments. - Lead enablement of technical lineage and source-to-platform metadata flows.

- Approve customizations, extensions and API-based integrations, and work with the vendor on product issues. 
- Establish repeatable patterns for onboarding further enterprise data sources.

Qualifications

This is a full practice-head mandate. It spans the business, the client, the technology and the people. 

1. Practice Vision, Strategy & P&L

• Own the practice vision, strategy, business plan and growth charter, and the revenue, cost and margin performance that goes with it. 

• Position DataOps as a differentiated, board-level growth engine for the firm, and not just a delivery function. 

• Track market shifts (platform engineering, AI-native operations, agentic tooling, data reliability, observability, FinOps) and turn them into capabilities and offerings. 

• Act as the senior-most technical and business voice for DataOps, in the firm, with clients and with partners. 

2. Budgeting & Financial Discipline

• Drive the annual operating plan rolling forecasts and practice budget

• Manage pyramid shape, bench cost, utilisation, rate realisation and cost-to-serve to protect and expand margins as the team grows. 

• Run pricing and deal governance: commercial constructs (T&M, fixed price, managed services, outcome-linked), estimation standards, risk-adjusted deal reviews and margin gates. 

• Maintain a transparent practice scorecard shared with founders and portfolio heads every month. 

3. Go-to-Market & Business Development

• Define the practice GTM: target industries and client profiles, offering packaging, pricing and playbooks. 

• Lead account mining in strategic clients to expand wallet share, with joint account plans alongside Sales and Account Management. 

• Support new-logo pursuits: executive sponsorship, solution workshops, RFP / RFI responses, orals, estimations and win themes. 

• Enable Sales and Pre-Sales with playbooks, battlecards, reference architectures and credentials. 

• Build thought leadership through POVs, whitepapers, conference keynotes, customer roundtables and analyst briefings. 

4. Technology, Offerings & Partnerships

• Build differentiated, IP-led and industry-specific offerings, for example: managed DataOps / data platform operations, data reliability and observability, MLOps / LLMOps accelerators, cloud and platform migration factories, FinOps for data, and internal developer platforms. 

• Own the hyperscaler and ISV alliance strategy (AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake and peers): partner tiers, competencies, co-sell motions, funded engagements and joint go-to-market. 

• Set the IP roadmap: what to build, what to productise and what to retire, backed by an investment case and adoption targets. 

Run a technology radar and evaluate emerging tools and patterns before clients ask about them. 

5. Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership

• Provide senior oversight of complex, strategic engagements across infrastructure, cloud and data platforms, CI/CD, orchestration, security, observability and reliability. 

• Set architecture principles and technology standards, and chair architecture review boards for high-impact programmes. 

• Guide the hard calls (batch vs. streaming, build vs. buy, deployment models, automation strategy) using scalability, reliability, security and cost as the yardsticks. 

• Stay hands-on enough to challenge designs and keep the credibility of your principal architects. 

6. Client & Executive Engagement

• Be the trusted advisor to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and VP Engineering on cloud transformation, data platform modernisation, DevOps and platform engineering, MLOps / LLMOps adoption and engineering productivity. 

• Translate client business problems into scalable, secure and cost-efficient DataOps solutions. 

• Sponsor strategic accounts, hold executive business reviews and build relationships that last beyond a single engagement. 

7. Delivery Governance & Risk

• Own quality, SLA adherence, client satisfaction and delivery health across the portfolio. 

• Institutionalise engineering standards: CI/CD, automated testing, Infrastructure as Code, observability, release and incident management. Track delivery with measures such as DORA metrics, MTTR and automation coverage. 

• Oversee risk and compliance: information security, data privacy, contractual obligations, audit readiness and third-party risk. 

• Work with Delivery and Programme leadership to resolve escalations, dependencies and capacity constraints early. 

• Drive continuous improvement through post-project reviews, retrospectives and reusable assets. 

8. Talent Management & Leadership Development

• Lead and mentor a 200+ member organisation through a clear leadership layer of Engineering Managers, Solution Architects and Technical Leads. 

• Define role expectations, career paths (including a strong technical / architect track), performance management and calibration. 

• Own succession planning for the practice's critical roles and build a visible pipeline of future practice leaders. 

• Drive retention and engagement with a culture of ownership, engineering craft and continuous learning, and act early on attrition hotspots. 

9. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

• Turn the sales pipeline into a rolling workforce plan covering skills, levels, locations and timing. 

• Lead niche and lateral hiring for architects and senior engineers, and personally close key leadership hires. 

• Build a campus and early-career pipeline (academies, apprenticeships, bootcamps) that feeds the base of a healthy pyramid. 

• Manage supplementary staffing (contractors and partner vendors) as a flexible capacity lever without diluting quality or margin. 

• Measure hiring on quality, speed and cost, and partner with TA to strengthen the practice's employer brand. 

10. Competency Management & Centres of Excellence

• Build the skill framework and role-based competency matrix for the practice, and keep it aligned to demand. 

• Define certification roadmaps across cloud, Kubernetes, data platforms and AI, with targets tracked by level. 

• Establish and staff Centres of Excellence (for example Platform Engineering & SRE, MLOps / LLMOps, Data Reliability & Observability, FinOps, DevSecOps) that publish POVs and set standards. 

• Partner with L&D on academies, labs and reskilling paths that convert bench time into billable capability. 

11. Practice Growth, Expansion & M&A

• Expand wallet share in existing accounts and build cross-practice synergies with the firm's data engineering, analytics and AI teams. 

• Open new markets, geographies and delivery centres in step with client demand and partner priorities. 

12. Cross-functional Leadership

• Work as one leadership team with Finance, HR, L&D, Talent Acquisition, Partnerships, Marketing, Sales and Legal / Risk to deliver the practice and firm objectives. You are expected to earn influence across functions, and not only within your own organisation. 

Who you are

Essential

• 16+ years in software engineering, Data platforms, Cloud, DevOps or DataOps, with a track record of leading and growing large technology organisations of 100+ professionals (200+ preferred). 

• Proven ownership of a practice or business-unit P&L (revenue, margin, utilisation, forecasting, pricing) in a consulting, IT services, systems integration or comparable client-facing firm. 

• A record of managing senior leaders: Engineering Managers, Solution Architects, Technical Leads and Principal / Staff engineers. 

Demonstrated experience in go-to-market: building offerings, supporting large pursuits and RFPs, and growing accounts. 

• Working relationships with hyperscaler and / or ISV partner organisations, with experience turning alliances into pipelines. 

• Deep technical credibility in DevOps, CloudOps, DataOps and / or MLOps and LLMOps: AWS, Azure or GCP, Kubernetes and containers, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability and cloud-native architectures. 

• Strong grounding in modern data platforms and data engineering ecosystems. 

• Comfort with CXOs. You can whiteboard with a CTO, negotiate with a CIO and coach a senior architect in the same day. 

Preferred

• Experience building or scaling a practice from the ground up, or turning around an under-performing one. 

• Background in managed services, platform engineering or SRE organisations. 

• Experience creating IP, accelerators or productised offerings that clients paid for. 

• FinOps, enterprise security, governance and compliance experience. 

• Experience running globally distributed teams and multi-geography delivery.

data.title: Senior Platform Owner - Risk & Compliance
data.description:
Job Description

Own and drive the strategy, delivery, operational health and continuous improvement of the assigned Risk and Compliance platform portfolio, with primary responsibility for AML transaction monitoring and regulatory compliance applications. 

The Senior Platform Owner is accountable for translating business priorities and regulatory requirements into an integrated platform roadmap and delivering initiatives within agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality standards. The role balances change delivery with platform stability, ensuring that both vendor-provided solutions and in-house applications remain secure, resilient, supportable and aligned with the Bank's technology strategy. 

Acting as the principal technology partner to Compliance stakeholders, the role coordinates cross-functional delivery and support teams, manages strategic vendor relationships and drives measurable improvements in platform capability, service performance and total cost of ownership. 

This position owns technology delivery and platform performance. Compliance policy, risk acceptance, monitoring methodology and regulatory interpretation remain with the designated business and control owners. 

Responsibilities

- Own the platform strategy and roadmap: Define and maintain a prioritised, multi-year roadmap aligned with Risk and Compliance objectives, regulatory commitments, enterprise architecture and technology modernization priorities. 
 - Lead end-to-end delivery: Oversee the initiation, planning, design, development or configuration, integration, testing, deployment and stabilization of initiatives across COTS products and in-house applications. 
 - Translate requirements into executable outcomes: Partner with Compliance and business owners to establish clear requirements, acceptance criteria, delivery milestones and measurable success indicators. 
 - Deliver AML transaction monitoring capabilities: Lead technology changes supporting transaction data ingestion, monitoring scenarios, alert generation, case management and reporting, with appropriate business approval and validation. 
 - Manage delivery execution: Coordinate engineering teams, vendors and shared technology services; manage dependencies, resources, budgets, risks and issues; and escalate threats to committed outcomes promptly. 
 - Embed quality and control requirements: Ensure delivery incorporates security, data quality, traceability, testing, change governance and operational readiness, including appropriate validation of upgrades, configuration changes and data migrations. 
 - Drive value realization: Track delivery performance and post-implementation outcomes, ensuring solutions achieve agreed business benefits and transition effectively into production support. Own platform service health: Establish and monitor service-level objectives and performance indicators covering availability, reliability, capacity, processing timeliness and recovery capability. 
 - Protect monitoring continuity and data integrity: Ensure controls identify incomplete, inaccurate or delayed data feeds, failed processing and integration issues that could affect transaction monitoring coverage or downstream compliance processes. 
 - Oversee incident and problem management: Coordinate timely service restoration, stakeholder communications, root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions, working with support teams and vendors. 
 - Maintain lifecycle currency: Own plans for patching, upgrades, license management, technical debt reduction and remediation of unsupported or end-of-life components. 
 - Strengthening security and recoverability: Work with relevant technology and control teams to maintain access controls, vulnerability remediation, audit logging, backup arrangements and tested disaster recovery capabilities. 
 - Maintain operational readiness and evidence: Ensure platform documentation, application inventories, support procedures, monitoring dashboards and control evidence remain complete and current. 
 - Drive continuous improvement: Use service trends, incidents, user feedback and cost analysis to improve performance, supportability, automation and operational efficiency. 
 - Serve as the primary technology counterpart: Build trusted relationships with Compliance, Financial Crime, Risk, Operations and other business stakeholders, maintaining a shared understanding of priorities and platform capabilities. 
 - Establish clear ownership and decision-making: Agree responsibilities across platform teams, business owners, data owners, technology services and vendors, including escalation routes and approval authorities. 
 - Manage competing priorities: Balance regulatory deadlines, business enhancements, platform resilience and technical debt through transparent, risk-based prioritisation. 
 - Provide effective governance and reporting: Present clear updates on roadmap progress, delivery commitments, financial performance, service health, dependencies and emerging risks to relevant governance forums. 
 - Support assurance and remediation: Coordinate technology input, evidence and remediation delivery for audits, compliance reviews and regulatory engagements, in partnership with the accountable control functions. 
 - Enable adoption and business readiness: Ensure stakeholders are prepared for platform changes through effective communication, training coordination, support arrangements and post-implementation feedback. Develop strategic vendor relationships: Build partnerships with product vendors and implementation partners that support the Bank's long-term Risk and Compliance technology objectives. 
 - Align product and platform roadmaps: Engage vendors on product direction, capability gaps, upgrade paths, scalability and support commitments, ensuring these inform the Bank's investment decisions. 
 - Manage vendor performance: Establish and review service levels, delivery milestones, support responsiveness, defect resolution and contractual obligations; drive corrective action where performance falls short. 
 - Support sourcing and commercial decisions: Partner with Procurement, Legal and relevant control teams on product evaluations, statements of work, licensing, renewals and commercial negotiations. 
 - Optimise build-versus-buy choices: Assess vendor solutions and in-house development options against functional fit, integration complexity, delivery risk, supportability and total cost of ownership. 
 - Manage dependency and exit risk: Maintain appropriate knowledge transfer, documentation, continuity arrangements and transition plans to reduce vendor concentration and lock-in. 
 - Promote practical innovation: Evaluate emerging capabilities with business and control stakeholders, ensuring adoption is supported by clear value, appropriate governance and sustainable operating arrangements. 

Qualifications

- Masters in computer / information Technology
 - 10-15 years in enterprise technology, preferably banking or financial services
 - Experience in Middle East and Indian Banks
 - Strong experience implementing, integrating, or managing transaction monitoring solution
 - Proven leadership of engineering squads and ownership of end-to-end technology delivery
 - Demonstrated custom in-house application development and automation of legacy manual regulatory processes
 - Technical knowledge of Java/Python, APIs, microservices, databases, workflow engines, and enterprise integrations
 - Experience with Agile, SDLC, DevOps, CI/CD, production support, and technology governance
 - Strong stakeholder and vendor management across business, compliance, technology, and geographically distributed teams
 - FCRM, Solytics, Oracle or comparable financial crime platforms
 - Exposure to AI/ML and Gen AI use case implementation in compliance technology
 - Exposure to latest development frameworks such as ReactJs and NodeJs
 - In-depth knowledge and experience of compliance data requirements and governance RPA, rule-based automation, intelligent document processing, and AI/ML-enabled compliance capabilities
 - Large-scale banking modernization and regulated-environment data governance
 - Decision-making and problem-solving
 - Excellent communication and delivery leadership

data.description:
Job Description: 

Director, Data Engineering

Data Experience (DEx)

- Decisioning
 - Dentsu Global Services (DGS)

Team: Data Experience (DEx) - Data Engineering

Reports to: Practice Lead / Group Lead, Data Engineering

Level: Director (DGS)

Location: Offshore (DGS, India)

Employment: Dentsu Global Services

About The Role

The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability - owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on. 

This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner - using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the offshore (DGS) Data Engineering team - setting architecture and delivery standards, reviewing code and design, mentoring engineers, and owning quality across the portfolio. 
 - Own the Databricks Lakehouse end to end: ingestion, Medallion (bronze/silver/gold) modeling, Unity Catalog governance, Lakeflow pipelines, and performance. 
 - Design and build robust, scalable pipelines that bring together media and marketing data from many platforms into governed, analytics-ready datasets. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted data development across the team - using Databricks Genie, Copilot, and Claude Code to accelerate pipeline build, transformation, and debugging without sacrificing rigor. 
 - Establish and enforce data taxonomies, schema standards, data quality checks, and a single source of truth for core media data. 
 - Partner with visualization, data science, and ad ops teams to source data correctly, validate it, and resolve discrepancies between platform truth and downstream reporting. 
 - Contribute to the productization of the data platform - moving from bespoke, client-by-client pipelines toward reusable, standardized, semi-automated data products. 
 - Manage capacity, utilization, and delivery health for the DGS engineering team, coordinating closely with onshore leadership on staffing and priorities. 

Core Skills & Requirements

Databricks & Data Engineering

- Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning. 
 - Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale. 
 - Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance - building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery. 
 - Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus. 

AI-Assisted Data Development

- Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling - Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents. 
 - Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality. 
 - A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty. 

Media & Marketing Data Fluency

You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means. 

- Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate. 
 - Understanding of how reach and frequency work - served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping - and the implications for how data must be modeled. 
 - Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics - pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows. 
 - Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes. 
 - Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data. 

Leadership

- Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model. 
 - Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team. 
 - Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders. 

Preferred / Nice To Have

- Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns. 
 - Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform. 
 - Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics). 
 - Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment. 
 - CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines. 

Qualifications

- 10+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity. 
 - Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production. 
 - Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement). 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Dentsu is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

Location: 

IND-DGS Office-Chennai-Tyche Towers

Brand: 

Paragon

Time Type: 

Full time

Contract Type: 

Permanent

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
At R1, we're transforming how healthcare works by combining nearly two decades of revenue cycle expertise with advanced technology, including analytics, AI, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration. We pair that technology with the irreplaceable expertise of our people to help hospitals, health systems and medical groups improve financial performance, simplify administrative complexity and create better experiences for patients and providers. 

All Together Better defines our culture and the way we work. We're a diverse, global team united by a shared mission to make healthcare work better for all. Across technology, operations and support functions, our people bring deep expertise, empathy and ingenuity to the work we do. Here, collaboration fuels progress, adaptability sparks innovation and every voice can help shape what's next for R1 and the future of healthcare. 

About R1 RCM

R1 RCM is a leading provider of technology-driven solutions that improve the patient experience and financial performance of healthcare providers. In India, our teams work across Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and Chennai to make healthcare simpler through technology, operational expertise, and innovation. Our inclusive culture values different perspectives, continuous learning, accountability, and high-quality outcomes for customers and patients. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior R&D Engineer to join our India-based R&D team. This is an individual-contributor role for an engineer who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with applied AI/ML, cloud-native architecture, and rapid experimentation. You will take ambiguous business or healthcare problems from discovery through proof of concept and production-ready implementation, while raising the technical, quality, and engineering standards of the team. 

You will serve as an in-house technical and functional expert for the team's problem space, understand how services and data flows interact, and work with product, engineering, security, architecture, and business stakeholders to build reusable, secure, observable, and scalable solutions. 

What You Will Do

- Own the end-to-end delivery of R&D initiatives, from problem framing, feasibility analysis, experimentation, and architecture through implementation, demonstration, transition, and measurable outcome tracking. 
 - Design and build production-grade AI-enabled and enterprise applications using Python and/or C#/. NET, modern APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, and suitable frontend technologies such as React or Angular. 
 - Apply machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and intelligent workflow patterns where they create demonstrable business value. 
 - Architect cloud-native solutions on Azure and/or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, managed data services, messaging, secure identity, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD. 
 - Decompose complex, ambiguous problems into small, testable, and independently deliverable components; select pragmatic approaches based on value, risk, cost, latency, accuracy, and operability. 
 - Design secure integration patterns and APIs for enterprise systems, relational and NoSQL data stores, model services, and high-volume or asynchronous workloads. 
 - Write production-ready, testable, maintainable code; lead meaningful refactoring; review pull requests; and eliminate recurring classes of defects through improved design and engineering practices. 
 - Drive automated testing, observability, performance measurement, security-by-design, model evaluation, and operational readiness across team solutions. 
 - Proactively identify execution gaps, technical risks, dependencies, and scaling constraints, then propose and implement practical mitigations with minimal guidance. 
 - Build reusable accelerators, reference implementations, design patterns, technical documentation, and implementation guides that improve delivery across the R&D and broader engineering organization. 
 - Coach engineers, share knowledge, support technical hiring, and influence adoption of engineering-wide standards and initiatives without relying on formal authority. 
 - Communicate findings, trade-offs, outcomes, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Typically 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on ownership of complex solutions; experience leading technical delivery within a team is expected. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, C#, or both, with sound knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean architecture, data structures, and software engineering fundamentals. 
 - Hands-on experience delivering AI/ML solutions using frameworks or services such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit-learn, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Practical experience with generative AI and LLM-based systems, including prompt and context design, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, grounding, safety, latency, and cost considerations. 
 - Experience with NLP and unstructured data processing. Exposure to document intelligence, computer vision, conversational AI, or intelligent workflow automation is strongly relevant. 
 - Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and building distributed, microservices-based, or event-driven applications. 
 - Cloud engineering experience on Azure and/or GCP, including cloud-native design, containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices. 
 - Strong working knowledge of SQL and data modeling, plus experience with at least one NoSQL, search, vector, cache, or messaging technology. 
 - Demonstrated use of automated testing, code review, logging, monitoring, tracing, performance optimization, and secure software development practices. 
 - Ability to operate independently, learn unfamiliar domains quickly, manage shifting R&D priorities, and convert experiments into reliable engineering outcomes. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder collaboration, and the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms, healthcare technology, revenue cycle management, clinical or insurance documents, EHR integrations, or high-volume transaction systems. 
 - Familiarity with healthcare privacy, security, and regulatory practices, including HIPAA and applicable data-protection requirements. 
 - Full-stack development experience . 
 - Experience with broker/message-bus patterns, CQRS, ports-and-adapters, hexagonal or onion architecture, service-oriented architecture, and resilient distributed-system design. 
 - Exposure to additional cloud platforms such as AWS and to infrastructure-as-code practices such as Terraform. 
 - Experience with MLOps or LLMOps, model and prompt evaluation, experiment tracking, model monitoring, human-in-the-loop workflows, and responsible AI controls. 
 - Experience with analytics or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau. 

Success in This Role

- R&D ideas are converted into validated, reusable capabilities with clear evidence of technical feasibility and business value. 
 - Solutions are secure, observable, testable, cost-aware, and designed for a credible path from proof of concept to production. 
 - The team executes with greater clarity and fewer recurring defects because of stronger architecture, reusable components, automation, and technical coaching. 
 - Stakeholders receive honest, concise, and evidence-based communication about risks, options, progress, and outcomes. 
 - The engineer becomes a trusted domain expert who anticipates change, identifies opportunities, and improves outcomes for customers and patients. 

Level Expectations

- Independence: Proactively solves complex problems and drives delivery with minimal guidance. 
 - Scope: Influences the team's services, architecture, delivery practices, and adjacent technical domains. 
 - Impact: Improves business outcomes, solution reliability, engineering effectiveness, and the team's ability to execute. 
 - Leadership: Coaches peers, leads project groups through influence, creates space for diverse input, and helps the team adopt broader engineering initiatives. 
 - Quality and security: Owns a team-level quality mindset and actively partners with security and platform stakeholders on standards and upcoming changes. 

How We Work

At R1, we anticipate change, identify better ways to serve customers and patients, and hold ourselves accountable for high-quality outcomes. We build connections across teams, value different perspectives, share what we learn, act with integrity, and proactively solve problems for ourselves and others. 

Working in an evolving healthcare setting, we use our shared expertise to deliver innovative solutions. Our fast-growing team has opportunities to learn and grow through rewarding interactions, collaboration and the freedom to explore professional interests. 

Our associates are given valuable opportunities to contribute, to innovate and create meaningful work that makes an impact in the communities we serve around the world. We also offer a culture of excellence that drives customer success and improves patient care. We believe in giving back to the community and offer a competitive benefits package. To learn more, visit: r1rcm. com

Visit us on Facebook
