data.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Purpose

To lead the reliability, availability, performance, and continuous improvement of Air Arabia's mission-critical Java-based applications and airline reservation systems by implementing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices. Responsible for driving operational excellence through proactive monitoring, automation, incident management, scalability improvements, and collaboration with cross-functional teams, while ensuring compliance with organizational policies, industry standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. 

Key Result Responsibilities

- Lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) initiatives for Java-based microservices and monolithic applications supporting mission-critical airline operations and Passenger Service Systems (PSS). 
 - Establish, monitor, and continuously improve system reliability by defining and managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets. 
 - Lead and facilitate root cause analysis (RCA) for complex production incidents, ensuring timely resolution and implementation of preventive measures to minimize recurrence. 
 - Drive architectural enhancements to improve system performance, scalability, resilience, availability, and operational efficiency through optimization techniques such as caching and distributed system design. 
 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to team members by promoting best practices in incident management, production support, troubleshooting, and operational excellence. 

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued

- Collaborate closely with software engineering, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to enhance application design, improve system reliability, and ensure production readiness. 
 - Own and define CI/CD pipeline standards, GitOps practices, and infrastructure automation strategy, setting the framework that engineers across the team execute against. 
 - Set the containerization and orchestration strategy (Docker, Kubernetes) for the team, defining standards for scalability, resilience, and high availability that other engineers implement. 
 - Own the on-call escalation framework, ensuring adequate coverage and clear escalation paths, and lead post-incident reviews. 
 - Evaluate new tools and technologies to strengthen reliability and represent SRE in capacity planning and release readiness reviews. 
 - Own reliability reporting to management, translating SLA/SLO performance and incident trends into clear business updates. 

Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering/ Computer Science/ Information Technology. 
 - Fluent in English Language. 
 - Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and troubleshooting complex production issues within enterprise environments. 
 - Airline, aviation, or travel industry experience, particularly with Passenger Service Systems (PSS), is preferred. 
 - Proficiency in MS Office. 
 - Strong knowledge of SQL with experience in database design, optimization, and performance tuning; experience with Oracle Database is an advantage. 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems, system architecture, scalability, high availability, and resilient application design. 
 - Proficiency in monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, or Datadog, used to drive proactive incident detection and reliability strategy. 

Work Experience

- With 6-8 years of experience in Software Engineering, SRE, or Production Support (Java Applications). 
 - Hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting both microservices and monolithic application architectures. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization, orchestration, and production deployment (mandatory). 
 - Experience with JBoss Application Server or similar enterprise Java application servers is an added advantage. 
 - Proven experience designing and governing CI/CD pipeline standards, GitOps practices, and Git-based workflows across multiple teams. 
 - Hands-on experience with caching technologies (e. g. , Redis) and messaging platforms to improve application performance and reliability.

data.title: Sr Technical Consultant - Azure Cloud, DevOps, Sql & Site Reliability Engineering(SRE)
data.description:
Overview

- The BYX Platform provides shared cloud provisioning, compute, storage, observability and runtime capabilities for enterprise applications and implementation teams. 
 - We are seeking an astute Cloud Platform with a strong technical foundation and hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, containers, observability, networking and production automation. 

Our Current Technical Environment

- Cloud and Compute: Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, node pools, container workloads, Azure Container Registry, KEDA, Dask, autoscaling, CPU, memory and GPU capacity. 
 - Observability: Logs, metrics and traces; collectors and exporters; Elastic/Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, dashboards, alerts and correlation identifiers. 
 - Data and Storage: MongoDB/Atlas, SQL, Redis, NFS, managed storage, replicas, regional capacity and service quotas. 
 - Networking and Security: DNS, CIDR, private endpoints, firewall rules, allowlists, TLS/certificates, SPNs, API keys, tokens, image-pull credentials and Git-hosted secrets. 
 - Operations and Automation: Linux, Git, CI/CD deployment workflows, infrastructure automation and scripting using Bash, Python or PowerShell. 

What You'll Do

- Review and act on incidents, service requests, infrastructure requests and provisioning failures logged by implementation teams and platform users. 
 - Own L2/L3 cloud-platform issues from initial triage through recovery, validation, communication, root-cause analysis and closure. 
 - Troubleshoot Kubernetes pods, deployments, replicas, services, events, health checks, node pools, scheduling and resource constraints. 
 - Diagnose container image-pull, startup, shutdown, registry-authentication, rollout and workload-reconciliation failures. 
 - Investigate CPU, memory, GPU, quota, region, placement and capacity issues affecting platform workloads. 
 - Troubleshoot workload and event-driven autoscaling using Kubernetes metrics and technologies such as KEDA. 
 - Support Azure resource provisioning, provider operations, resource lifecycle workflows and reconciliation between desired and actual state. 
 - Diagnose ACR, private endpoint, firewall, allowlist, CIDR, DNS, TLS and runtime-connectivity problems. 
 - Trace logs, metrics and distributed telemetry from the workload through collectors, exporters and observability ingestion pipelines. 
 - Support Elastic/Logstash/Kibana ingestion, index mappings, access, dashboards, alerts and environment filters. 
 - Investigate operational issues involving MongoDB/Atlas, SQL, Redis, NFS and related managed data or storage services. 
 - Support certificates, service principals, API keys, image-pull credentials and infrastructure credential rotation. 
 - Support regional releases, environment configuration, disaster-recovery workflows and post-deployment validation. 
 - Develop automation to improve platform reliability, reduce manual provisioning and shorten incident recovery time. 
 - Maintain runbooks, dashboards, alerts, known-error records and diagnostic procedures for use by platform support teams. 
 - Participate in capacity planning, incident reviews, change reviews, release readiness and an agreed production on-call rotation. 

What We Are Looking For

- Minimum 5-10 years of relevant work experience in Azure cloud infrastructure, DevOps, site reliability engineering or platform operations. 
 - This role includes Rotational Shifts(Night shifts of 2 months in Year)
 - Hands-on production experience with Microsoft Azure services and operational troubleshooting
 - Strong Kubernetes troubleshooting skills covering workloads, events, services, networking, scheduling, scaling and resource management. 
 - Experience with a container registry; Azure Container Registry experience is highly relevant. 
 - Practical observability experience across logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alerts. 
 - Experience with Elastic Stack components-Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana-or a closely comparable platform. 
 - Working knowledge of DNS, TLS/certificates, CIDR, firewalls, proxies, load balancing and private networking. 
 - Strong Linux administration, application log analysis and production incident-troubleshooting skills. 
 - Scripting experience with Bash, Python or PowerShell for diagnostics and operational automation. 
 - Experience troubleshooting CI/CD deployments, configuration changes and failed rollouts. 
 - Working knowledge of Git, service identities and secrets-management fundamentals. 
 - Working knowledge of MongoDB/Atlas, Redis, SQL or NFS operations is preferred. 
 - Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, Bicep or ARM templates and Kubernetes packaging such as Helm is preferred. 
 - Experience with incident response, Root Cause Analysis, post-incident reviews and controlled production changes. 
 - Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across application, security, networking and vendor teams. 
 - Willingness to participate in a scheduled production on-call rotation and planned out-of-hours changes when required. 

Our Values

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success - and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

data.description:
Introduction

At IBM Infrastructure & Technology, we design and operate the systems that keep the world running. From high-resiliency mainframes and hybrid cloud platforms to networking, automation, and site reliability. Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Working in Infrastructure & Technology means tackling complex challenges with curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies and colleagues worldwide to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions that power innovation.  - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a willingness to take on call-out responsibilities

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

 - Active participation in Kubernetes communities and forums
 - Vendor management skills to ensure optimal service levels and cost control
 - Ability to mentor and train teams on Kubernetes best practices and operational strategies

data.description:
About The Team

At Zillow our mission is to give people the power to unlock life's next chapter. The Elevate Engineering team plays an important part in connecting advertisers with the hundreds of millions of customers that visit Zillow websites each month. From scaling ad experiences that fuse on-site and social media together, to building marketplaces where consumers can shop for products and services, we have a big responsibility in how advertisers and customers engage with each other. We love it!

We are a dynamic team that makes a significant impact with its contributions. Members of this team have the opportunity to: 

Work on products and initiatives that directly generate revenue

Collaborate with multiple teams across our consumer brands and corporate operations

Have their ideas heard and often implemented as new products, features or solutions

Use and evolve best-in-breed technology

Showcase leadership (and be appreciated for it!)

Develop a career path in new and relevant ways

Continuously learn with countless internal and external training opportunities

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer you are a key contributor to the Web Ad Platform: leading the team's most important initiatives, designs, and operational events on revenue-critical ad surfaces across Zillow's web and app experiences. In this role you will: 

- Act as the focal point for projects by writing designs and tech specs, driving estimates, reviewing work, and communicating progress. 
 - Design, code, document, and operate technical solutions that are scalable, performant, maintainable, and secure, treating testability, resiliency, and observability as first-order concerns. 
 - Own the health of what you ship: set the standard for dashboards, metrics, alarms, and runbooks; participate in on-call; lead diagnosis and resolution of critical incidents and drive permanent fixes. 
 - Work across the stack: React/TypeScript micro-frontends, GraphQL federation, and backend services, plus ad-tech integrations (Google Ad Manager/GPT, Prebid, viewability and identity vendors). 
 - Decompose large initiatives into workstreams you and others can own end-to-end. 
 - Ship experiments safely through ZEXP with clear guardrail metrics, rollback paths, and data-informed decisions. 
 - Use AI coding assistants to amplify your expertise while exercising judgment on when to trust, revise, or set aside generated output. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technical Program Managers, Ad Ops, and page-owner teams (Search, Home Detail Page, Rentals, iOS/Android) to adapt and extend solutions for advertising use cases. 
 - Help refine team processes through agile ceremonies; support growth of the team through interviewing, onboarding, and mentorship. 
 - Stay abreast of emerging trends and patterns in ad technology and the broader industry. 

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

Our People: 

With over 2, 000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We're proud to be a part of that. 

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About The Role

We're hiring an experienced Sr. SDE for our Industries team within Special Projects. The team turns our core platform into purpose-built solutions for specific verticals, such as restaurants, healthcare, real estate, automotive, home services, and fitness. 

As an Sr. SDE, you'll build frontend-heavy full stack features that make our platform feel native to each industry. That means rich, interactive interfaces like floor plans, booking and scheduling views, industry dashboards, and guided setup flows. It also means configurable UI that adapts to each vertical's data models and workflows. You'll own the experience end-to-end, from component design to the APIs behind it, making sound technical trade-offs across UX, performance, scalability, and maintainability, while working closely with product, design, domain experts, and core platform teams. 

This role suits someone who cares about polished, fast, intuitive interfaces, is comfortable owning the backend that supports them, learns new domains quickly, and uses AI tools to work faster and better. 

What You'll Do

- Build rich, interactive industry experiences in Vue 3 and TypeScript, such as visual floor-plan editors, scheduling and resource views, dashboards, and multi-step onboarding flows
 - Design reusable, configurable UI components that render industry-specific objects, fields, and workflows without forking the core product
 - Lead the technical design of frontend-heavy features, turn product and design concepts into high-quality interfaces, and shape the UX with designers and domain experts
 - Evaluate frontend and full stack architectural trade-offs, balancing experimentation speed, user experience, performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability as solutions mature
 - Own frontend performance, accessibility, and responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile web, including views used live by staff on shared devices
 - Build and extend the APIs behind your features using Node. js/NestJS, with Firestore, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis as data layers
 - Handle real-time and async UI states, such as live updates, optimistic updates, background job status, and conflict handling
 - Work with core platform and app teams to reuse and improve shared components and design system patterns
 - Own the full development lifecycle for significant features and initiatives: technical design, building, testing, deploying, measuring, and maintaining. 
 - Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance, sharing learnings and helping raise engineering quality across the team

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on frontend architecture and complex web applications
 - Deep expertise in Vue (Vue 3 preferred) or a comparable modern framework, plus TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
 - Experience building complex interactive UI, such as drag-and-drop, canvas or SVG rendering, calendars and timelines, or data-dense dashboards
 - Strong understanding of state management, component architecture, and frontend performance optimization
 - Solid backend skills to work end-to-end: API design, data modeling, and Node. js (NestJS a plus)
 - Experience with real-time data, async workflows, and keeping UI state consistent with backend state
 - A strong eye for UX, accessibility, and detail, with the ability to make good product decisions when specs are incomplete
 - Openness to using AI tools (e. g. , Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to speed up development and improve code quality
 - Curiosity about how different industries work, and comfort learning from non-technical domain experts

Bonus Points

- Experience with canvas libraries like Konva, Fabric. js, or PixiJS
 - Experience building design systems or shared component libraries
 - Experience with metadata-driven or schema-driven UI, such as form builders, custom objects, or configurable layouts
 - Background in vertical SaaS or industry-specific products, such as restaurant POS, booking, healthcare, or real estate tools
 - Familiarity with GCP services like Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub
 - Experience with frontend testing (unit, component, and end-to-end, e. g. Playwright)

Why Join Us?

- You'll shape what our platform looks and feels like for entire industries, often building the first screen a new vertical's customers see
 - You'll build interfaces that business owners and their staff use live, every day, to run their operations
 - You'll join a small, high-leverage team that values product thinking, craft, and moving fast with confidence, including using AI to build smarter

data.description:
About HeyMarvin

HeyMarvin is one of the fastest-growing research platforms in the galaxy. Some of the largest companies (such as Microsoft, Best Buy, LinkedIn, Sonos, and 7-11) use HeyMarvin as their secret weapon for building customer-centric solutions. 

Funded by notable investors like OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and first PayPal board member Scott Banister, HeyMarvin is an AI-native research system that integrates all your customer feedback and research into one central, searchable hub - so anyone can get the answers they need, when they need them. 

We are headquartered in Oakland, CA, with more than 100 passionate employees across three countries. We're united by our mission: To build a future where every strategic business decision is grounded in the voice of the customer. 

For more info, visit www. heymarvin. com. 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to join a fast-growing, well-funded Silicon Valley-based startup. This role offers a high level of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to work in a collaborative, high-performance environment with competitive compensation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop and deploy backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency and scalability
 - 
 - Architect Distributed Systems: Design and implement robust microservices using Golang and Django that can handle concurrent processing of high-volume research data (e. g. , video, audio, and large-scale text datasets). 
 - Optimize AI Workflows: Build and refine asynchronous task queues (using tools like Celery or Redis) to manage long-running AI inference tasks without impacting the responsiveness of the user-facing API. 
 - Database Performance: Design and maintain efficient schemas for both relational databases (PostgreSQL) and specialized storage (Vector databases for AI search), ensuring millisecond-level query performance as data scales into the millions of records. 
 - Load Management: Implement caching strategies and rate-limiting to protect service integrity during traffic spikes from global enterprise customers. 
 - Build and operate infrastructure, toolset and deployment pipelines
 - 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own and automate the provisioning of cloud resources on AWS (using Terraform or CloudFormation) to ensure environments are reproducible and scalable. 
 - CI/CD Optimization: Streamline the path from "code commit" to "production" by building automated testing and deployment pipelines that allow the team to ship multiple times a day with high confidence. 
 - Observability & Monitoring: Implement comprehensive logging, tracing, and alerting (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog) to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and system health issues before they affect users. 
 - Developer Experience: Create internal CLI tools or scripts to simplify the local development environment and improve the velocity of the entire engineering team. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to create beautiful products
 - 
 - API Stewardship: Design clean, well-documented, and intuitive RESTful or GraphQL APIs that enable frontend teams to build seamless and high-performance user interfaces. 
 - Full-Stack Synergy: Work closely with product designers and frontend engineers to understand the "Jobs to be Done, " ensuring that backend logic perfectly supports complex research workflows. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Participate in rigorous code reviews and architectural whiteboarding sessions, fostering a culture of high-quality code and continuous learning. 
 - Rapid Prototyping: Transition quickly from experimental AI features to production-ready services, balancing speed-to-market with long-term code maintainability. 
 - Handling and owning security and compliance aspects for the software that the team produces. 
 - 
 - Enterprise-Grade Compliance: Build and enforce the technical controls necessary to maintain SOC2, GDPR, or HIPAA compliance, ensuring customer data is treated with the highest level of privacy. 
 - Data Isolation: Implement strict multi-tenant architecture patterns to ensure that sensitive research insights from one organization (e. g. , Microsoft) are never accessible or leaked to another (e. g. , 7-11). 
 - Proactive Security: Conduct regular vulnerability scanning, dependency audits, and security reviews of the codebase to defend against OWASP Top 10 threats. 
 - IAM & Encryption: Manage complex Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles and ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. 
Qualifications

- 7-9 years of experience in backend engineering
 - Strong skills in: 
 - 
 - Python (Django)
 - Golang
 - Problem-solving and debugging
 - API development and database management
Good To Have

- Familiarity with DevOps practices (Docker, AWS, CI/CD)
 - Experience building scalable and distributed systems
 - Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently
 - Practical, solution-oriented thinker comfortable in fast-paced, low-process environments

Why Join Us?

Joining HeyMarvin as a Senior Software Engineer means being part of a high-growth, transparent, and empowering environment where your work has direct impact. You'll collaborate with talented teammates, work with modern technologies, and help build a world-class product at the intersection of AI, research, and enterprise software-while having the autonomy to shape both your role and the company's future. 

About The Team

You'll be joining a lean, high-performing team that values ownership, speed, and thoughtful execution. The team operates with minimal bureaucracy and emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering meaningful outcomes. 

Compensation

₹45-50LPA, plus benefits.

You will take on a technical leadership role within the Test Development Engineering team, responsible for architecting, developing, and deploying Automated Test Equipment (ATE) solutions for cutting-edge, highly complex ASICs and SoCs.  - Manufacturing Deployment: Lead the seamless transfer and release of robust test programs to offshore assembly and test (OSAT) partners. Resolve complex test-related issues in high-volume manufacturing.

data.title: TEAM LEAD - HARDWARE
data.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28, 000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Job Purpose: 

- Lead & drives functional excellence in engineering solution and provide knowledge base, services and technical understanding for the "Hardware Engineering" applications following the industry standards and its regulatory requirements. 
 - Manage all aspect of project life cycle from pre-sale proposal support and Engineering support as per the scope. 
 - You will be reporting to the Engineering Manager. 
 - Can work independent and handle technical tasks and activity on HW and any 3rd party interfaces as applicable in the projects. 
 - This may include travel for short or long-term work assignments within India or overseas for customer meetings, project training and site support. 
 - Organize and schedule job tasks with your team. 
 - Provide leadership to the assigned team and Improve Productivity. 
 - Manage team regarding people development and issue resolution
 - Manage Global partner including the regional solution teams and Global Programme Managers

Your Responsibilities

- Deliver and build the assigned projects on time with good quality/ cost effectiveness and customer satisfaction
 - Take on challenging tasks and be a solution provider to internal and external partners & industry team on solutions
 - Keep improving self-engineering capabilities and exchange best practice with other team members to improve team's capabilities
 - Lead technical implementation in whole life-cycle of project delivery
 - Collaborate and work with Technical Lead / SMEs to clarify technical issues and share workloads
 - Present solution to the partners and coordinate development tasks with team members
 - Work with PM for scope management, deliver execution plans & monitor the execution with good quality, cost effectiveness, customer acceptance and customer satisfaction
 - Work with Global Programme Managers and PM for WBS development
 - Develop quality process and ensure strict adherence
 - Work closely & guide the proposal team for support on estimation and proposal delivery
 - Ensure project implementation follows the procedure of SSB standard. 
 - Promote project cost reduction through continuous process improvement, by applying and maximizing reusable engineering standards in project delivery
 - Drive business growth & strengthen foot print of GEBS as technology CoE
 - Work for the optimization of procurement processes and identify process improvement opportunities
 - Support in AOP planning
 - Ensure that all audits (internal/external) are adequately documented and significant risk are dealt in a timely manner
 - Engage with various stakeholders to identify opportunities for increased engagement, seek feedback on deliverables and to improve overall engagement
 - Ensures deliverables provided by the GEBS are delivered within exceptional good quality on time and on budget with high levels of Internal Customer Satisfaction. 
 - Manage utilization of all resources and ensure accurate capacity planning. 
 - Responsible to manage resources appropriately and to assign right skills to the work. 

Job Related Competencies

- Good understanding on AutoCAD, ACAD-Electrical / ePlan / CEWS / CREO / RA Advisor. 
 - Good understanding on DOL, S/D, VFDs, Soft-Starters, Servo, PLC, MCC & Safety System Designing. 
 - Good Knowledge of Product Selections and their applications. 
 - Good understanding of design calculations like Heat, Load, cable sizing, Cable Duct etc. 
 - Good understanding of mechanical design of different types of enclosures (GA/Layout design). 
 - Good understanding of developing a control circuit based on the process and application requirements. 
 - Must be aware of electrical design standards e. g. IEC, JIC/NEMA, UL, ATEX, CE codes etc. 
 - High level of expertise in RA products/Hardware such as Control Logix, VFDs etc. 
 - Good understanding of Server Client architecture. 
 - Experience with at least one third-party PLC systems migration. 
 - Knowledge of IT software platforms, prior hands-on experience with migrations, awareness of latest updates on upcoming automation technologies (Cloud solutions, IIoT) would be an added advantage either
 - Conduct research into systems issues and products
 - Record of managing multiple and complex customer projects and a good understanding about Project Management. 
 - Major Commissioning Know-How experience and troubleshooting methods. 
 - Is flexible / responsive to manage global needs & expectations about GEBS engineering deliveries
 - Manage team performance to develop team capability and motivate the team. Create developmental plans for any identified gaps. 
 - Support best practice sharing and knowledge transfer among teams to improve competency of whole team. 
 - Assess and develop competency and capabilities among the team. Encourage multi-skilling within the team to ensure better use. 

Desired temperament -

- Creates an optimal work environment by establishing and maintaining positive and respectful work relationships. 
 - Understand the importance of collaboration and aligning the organization to drive the necessary objectives. 
 - Holds self and team accountable for keeping commitments, maintaining standards, and achieving goals. 
 - Leads with ethics and integrity; and flexible while also seeking initiatives
 - Help create and influence a culture that Inspires individuals and teams to stretch beyond what they thought they could do. 
 - Addresses Conflict and other barriers to Collaboration effectively & constructively, adapting to cultural norms and expectations
 - Maintain transparency in communication with all stakeholders. 
 - Understand and manage complexity at various levels in the organization

Benefits

- We provide a working environment with a creative company, paired with a great compensation package, great benefits, and a supportive atmosphere where you can sharpen with new challenges and development opportunities. 
 - Hybrid work-from-home and at a determined Rockwell Automation facility. 
 - Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities, 
 - Support from our 24/7 employee assistance program. 

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. 

At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

Rockwell Automation's hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

data.title: Technical Team Leader – Mechanical Commissioning (CxA)- Datacenter
data.description:
FPC Global are the world's leading digital building experts, we offer full-service integrated technology consultancy and professional services to the built environment. 

We partner with clients to improve asset performance, operational efficiency, sustainability outcomes, and digital maturity across complex portfolios. 

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Commissioning Technical Team Leader to lead the commissioning delivery team of hyperscale and colocation AI data-centre projects. 

The role will provide technical leadership, people management and client-facing governance across the complete commissioning lifecycle from L0-L6, with a strong focus on L4 Functional Performance Testing (FPT) and L5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST). 

This position is site-centric and requires hands-on leadership through Integrated Systems Testing, including failure mode and fault tolerance validation, ensuring systems meet design intent, availability objectives and operational readiness requirements in line with Uptime Institute, IEC, IEEE, and NFPA standards. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and mentor a team of 15-20+ leads and commissioning engineers. 

- Own mechanical commissioning strategy, planning, execution and technical governance. 

- Lead L4/L5 commissioning, including FPT, IST, failure-mode and concurrent-maintainability testing. 

- Provide technical oversight across HVAC, chilled-water systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, AHUs, DX/In-Row cooling, containment and high-density liquid/immersion cooling systems. 

- Lead commissioning of HSD/fuel systems, including bulk/day tanks, transfer systems, filtration, leak detection and generator auto-fuelling interfaces. 

- Oversee fire protection and life-safety systems, including fire pumps, wet/dry/pre-action systems, clean-agent systems, VESDA, dampers and smoke-control systems. 

- Oversee plumbing and utility systems, including water storage, makeup water, drainage, sump systems, leak detection and associated utilities. 

- Review P&IDs, equipment submittals, control sequences, Sequence of Operations (SOO), cause & effect and commissioning test scripts. 

- Lead TAB/hydronic balancing, equipment performance testing, controls/BMS integration and functional testing. 

- Validate mechanical integration with BMS, EPMS, electrical systems, fire/life-safety and data-center controls. 

- Manage commissioning issues, RCA, risk registers, punch lists and technical close-out. 

- Act as senior technical interface with hyperscale clients, CxA teams, MEP contractors, consultants and OEMs. 

- Drive commissioning quality, safety and readiness for operational handover. 

Requirements

- 15+ years overall mechanical engineering, testing and commissioning experience. 

- 8+ years data-center or mission-critical mechanical commissioning experience. 

- Proven leadership of at least 2 complete L2 to L5 commissioning cycles. 

- Proven experience of leading at least 2 ISTs of hyperscale datacenter projects. 

- Experience managing 15-20+ Cx engineers. 

- Strong hands-on knowledge of HVAC, chilled-water systems, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC, BMS/controls, fuel systems, fire protection and utilities. 

- Experience with high-density/liquid cooling is highly desirable. 

- Strong understanding of Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA and applicable local codes/standards. 

- Strong knowledge of Sequence of Operations, controls integration, TAB, hydronic balancing and failure-mode testing. 

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 

- Strong client-facing communication and technical leadership skills. 

Qualifications

Preferred Certifications

CxA/CBCP | CDCP/CDCS | Uptime Institute ATD | ASHRAE-related credentials

Additional Information

data.title: Assistant Vice President – Quality Assurance (AML)
data.description:
Job Title: Assistant Vice President - Quality Assurance (AML)

Department: ISPL CEFS AML Operations

About Business Line/Function

CEFS team is leveraging an integrated model; the Team delivers a comprehensive range of solutions to various business lines of the Group across the globe. The services include referential data management, Know Your Customer (KYC), Due Diligence preparation (client recertification and onboarding), credit administration and post-trade client services, AML transaction monitoring and Actimize support Projects. 

Position Purpose

An Assistant Vice President (AVP) for Quality Assurance (QA) within the Anti-Money Laundering (AML) domain occupies a middle-management role. They act as a critical line of defense, ensuring that the processes used to detect, prevent, and report money laun dering and terrorist financing are effective, compliant, and operating according to regulatory standards. 

Responsibilities

- Alert Disposition & Investigation Validation
 - Decision Accuracy Review: Auditing a sample of "Closed/No Suspicion" alerts to ensure that investigators have provided sufficient rationale and that the activity truly does not warrant an escalation. 
 - Investigation Quality Assessment: Evaluating the depth of the "investigative trail"-ensuring investigators have looked beyond the single alert to review the client's historical behavior, source of wealth, and related party transactions. 
 - Narrative & Documentation Audit: Verifying that the written rationales in the Case Management System (CMS) are clear, logical, and would stand up to scrutiny from a regulator or internal auditor. 
 - Red Flag Identification: Ensuring that specific typologies (e. g. , structuring, smurfing, rapid movement of funds, or unusual geographic activity) were correctly identified and addressed during the investigation. 
 - Detection Logic & System Effectiveness (The "Second Line" view)
 - Threshold & Scenario Testing: Partnering with the TM Tuning team to validate whether current detection scenarios (rules) are effective or if they are producing excessive false positives/missed true positives. 
 - False Positive Analysis: Analyzing trends in "false positives" to identify if specific rules require recalibration or if they are no longer capturing relevant risk. 
 - Model Validation Support: Providing QA insights during the periodic review of the Transaction Monitoring System (TMS) to ensure the mathematical logic of the alerts aligns with the bank's risk appetite. 
 - Regulatory Reporting (SAR/STR) Oversight
 - Reporting Quality Assurance: Performing a final check on Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) or Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to ensure the "Who, What, Where, When, and Why" is clearly articulated. 
 - Timeliness Monitoring: Ensuring that the time elapsed from the initial alert trigger to the final regulatory filing meets the statutory deadlines (e. g. , the "30-day rule"). 
 - Escalation Integrity: Verifying that all alerts that met the threshold for "suspicion" were actually escalated to the SAR filing stage and not inappropriately dismissed. 
 - Risk-Based QA Strategy & Metrics
 - Risk-Based Sampling Design: Instead of random sampling, designing a QA program that prioritizes high-risk segments (e. g. , PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, or correspondent banking) for deeper scrutiny. 
 - Error Trend Analysis: Categorizing errors (e. g. , "failure to identify source of funds, " "insufficient profile review, " or "incorrect data entry") to identify systemic training gaps. 
 - KPI/KRI Development: Defining and tracking specific Key Quality Indicators (KQIs) such as: 
 - Error Rate per Investigator. 
 - Percentage of overturned decisions (where QA disagrees with the Investigator). 
 - Average age of open alerts (Backlog Management). 
 - Stakeholder & Remediation Management
 - Feedback Loop Management: Implementing a formal process to provide "Return to Investigator" (RTI) feedback, ensuring that errors are corrected and lessons are learned. 
 - Remediation Oversight: Leading the QA effort during "look-back" projects (remediation exercises) where a systemic failure requires the re-review of months or years of transaction data. 
 - Audit Liaison: Acting as the subject matter expert (SME) for Transaction Monitoring when interviewed by Internal Audit or external regulators regarding the effectiveness of the monitoring program. 
 - People 
 - Provide leadership and direction to the CEFS department and its employees, set conditions and manage its resources in order to optimize departmental services for maximum fulfillment of (internal and external) client needs within determined strategy and budget. 
 - Work with ISPL CLM Operations sub-departments to develop a strong expertise & knowledge on end to end process / delivery. Coach & mentor top talent and define clear career path for them
 - Promote, within ISPL Client Engagement Operations department, a mindset around accountability, continuous improvement, client focus, change management & innovation
 - Proven aptitude to lead and manage high performing teams
 - Team Attrition & Engagement: Maintaining high employee morale and managing turnover within the monitoring team. 

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

- Proficiency in MS Office and VBA Macros. 
 - Rapid adaptability to new systems. 
 - Strong technical aptitude. 
 - Commitment to continuous technological learning. 
 - Logical problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Ability to work autonomously and collaborate with global teams. 
 - Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills. 
 - Decisive leadership on complex business and technical issues. 
 - Preferred experience in banking, payments, or compliance. 

Specific Qualifications

- Minimum 10-14 years of experience along with Bachelor's Degree - in management, finance, science, economics, related field or equivalent experience. 
 - Prior experience in similar domain. 

Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)

- Collaborative teamwork. 
 - Strong oral and written communication. 
 - Ability to synthesize and simplify information. 
 - Strong organizational skills. 

Transversal Skills

- Strong analytical skills. 
 - Process development and adaptation. 
 - Project management proficiency. 
 - Meeting, seminar, committee, and training facilitation. 

Key Performance Indicators & Collaboration For The Role

- Departmental SLA Compliance: The percentage of total team alerts and investigations completed within regulatory or internal timelines. 
 - Resource Utilization & Capacity Planning: Efficiency in managing headcount against alert volumes (ensuring the team is neither over-burdened nor under-utilized). 
 - Backlog Management: Ability to control and reduce the volume of aged/overdue alerts to prevent regulatory breaches. 
 - Cost Per Alert/Investigation: Managing the operational budget by optimizing the cost of processing a single alert (balancing headcount vs. automation). 
 - Talent Development: Success in upskilling Associates into Seniors and Seniors into Leads (succession planning). 
 - Audit & Regulatory Exam Performance: The ability to defend the department's processes and findings during internal audits or external regulatory examinations. 
 - IT & Product Management: Partnering with technical teams to drive system upgrades, rule tuning, and the implementation of automation/AI tools. 
 - Cross-Functional Project Leadership: Leading multi-departmental task forces for large-scale system migrations or regulatory remediation projects. 
 - Representing CEFS ISPL locally and globally in all required forums, decision making and execution at ground level. 

Direct Report to: Vice President (VP)

Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent

Location: Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185, 000 employees, including more than 145, 000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group's commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. data.title: Manufacturing Manager 1
data.description:
Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Develop, qualify, and maintain Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and related welding documentation for hardfacing, overlay welding, and valve fabrication applications. 
 - Define welding parameters, consumables, preheat requirements, interpass controls, and process specifications to achieve consistent, high-quality results. 
 - Drive welding process improvements that enhance quality, productivity, efficiency, and cost performance. 
 - Provide technical support for the fabrication of Triple Offset Valves, Ball Valves, pressure-containing components, and critical valve assemblies. 
 - Prepare weld maps and provide guidance on welding sequences, distortion control, and fabrication best practices. 
 - Investigate welding-related issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable industry codes, standards, customer requirements, and internal quality expectations, including ASME, API, ISO, and related specifications. 
 - Support non-destructive examination (NDE) activities, including PT, RT, UT, and MPI, and verify conformance to acceptance criteria.

data.title: Quality and Project Platforms Lead
data.description:
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. 

Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide - and counting. 

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11, 000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. 

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www. opella. com. 

About You

You will lead a team of 5 to 10 experts and platform owners covering three connected areas: 

Digital Quality, meaning GxP processes, computer system validation, and the Digital Control Framework. 

Testing and quality engineering, including test strategy, test management and automation on Xray and Tricentis Tosca. 

The Atlassian platform, where Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud carry project delivery, documentation and compliance evidence for Opella Digital. 

The role is both platform owner and people manager. There is no intermediate management layer, so you lead senior specialists directly and stay close enough to the work to challenge a validation rationale, review a test automation approach, or settle a Jira workflow design. 

We are looking for someone with 12 to 15 years of experience who owns the outcome rather than the task, simplifies processes that have grown complicated, and works comfortably across Digital, Quality and the business functions. 

What you will do

Lead the team

Line manage 5 to 10 experts and platform owners, including internal staff and partner resources. Set direction and priorities across three areas at once. Give each platform owner clear accountability, decision rights and a roadmap they own, then hold them to it. Run objective setting, performance and development conversations, coaching, and skills, backup and succession planning. Shape resourcing, capacity and the balance between insourced and partner-delivered work. Own the budget and vendor relationships for the platforms in scope. Build one team culture across quality, testing and platform engineering rather than three separate groups. 

Digital Quality, policy and validation governance

You are the global owner for GxP-relevant Digital Quality policies, standards, SOPs and work instructions, and for making them usable in practice. You own the Digital Control Framework: control design, control ownership, testing of control effectiveness, evidence retention and remediation tracking. 

The role covers controlled document management for CSV and CSA, data integrity under ALCOA+, cloud and SaaS governance, and electronic records and electronic signatures under 21 CFR Part 11. Digital solutions must meet GxP, ICH, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements, including how protected health and personal data is handled across regulated and commercial systems. 

You provide quality oversight for computer system validation using GAMP 5 and CSA principles, take risk-based decisions and document the reasoning. You govern validation plans, risk assessments and test strategies, and you review and approve URS, functional specifications, UAT reports, validation summaries and Authorization for Use. You manage validation deviations and CAPAs, oversee change controls for validation impact, and run GxP periodic reviews. You also govern digital supplier management: vendor inventories, assessments, quality agreements and performance monitoring. 

Testing, strategy, tooling and delivery assurance

Own the global test strategy and testing standards for Opella Digital across functional, integration, regression, performance and user acceptance testing, in both GxP and non-GxP systems. You are accountable for Xray as the test management layer in Jira and for Tricentis Tosca as the automation platform, covering roadmap, licensing, environments, upgrades, integrations and adoption, working through the platform owners in your team. 

Grow automation coverage on the systems that matter most, such as ERP, supply chain, commercial and web, and make automated evidence usable for validation where the regulations allow it. Keep traceability intact from requirement to test case to execution to defect, which serves delivery quality and inspection readiness at the same time. Set testing metrics such as coverage, defect leakage, automation rate and cycle time, and use them to change how the teams work. Get involved early enough with project and product teams that testing is planned in from the start rather than added at the end. 

Atlassian platform

Own Jira and Confluence on Atlassian Cloud, along with Jira Service Management, the Marketplace app portfolio and the integrations with the rest of the digital toolchain. Define and govern project templates, workflows, schemes, permissions and space structures so that they support agile delivery and the traceability a regulated environment needs. 

Cloud releases arrive continuously, so the platform roadmap has to cover release and change management, app rationalization, performance, cost and license optimization. Work with Cybersecurity, Identity and Internal Audit on security, privacy, access management, data residency and audit requirements, including the controls needed for Jira and Confluence to hold GxP-relevant records. Drive adoption and standardization across Digital and the business so the standard way is also the easy way, and run platform operations to agreed service levels with a clear support model and incident and problem management. 

Collaboration, audit and inspection readiness

Partner with Digital, Manufacturing, R&D, Quality and Supply Chain teams to give GxP and testing guidance during system modernization. Work with Cybersecurity, Data Privacy and Internal Audit specialists so requirements are managed in one central framework rather than several. Build and deliver global training on digital and GxP policies, data integrity, validation, testing and Atlassian practices. 

Keep evidence packages and stakeholder coordination ready for audit at any time, not only when one is announced. Act as the subject matter expert during Health Authority inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA and others) and internal or external audits covering digital systems, validation and data integrity, and lead CAPA development and effectiveness checks for findings related to digital quality governance. 

About You

We look at potential, character and culture fit alongside experience. 

You have 12 to 15 years of experience across digital quality and compliance, software testing and platform ownership in a regulated industry such as pharma, healthcare or life sciences. 

You have managed people for at least 3 to 5 years, ideally senior specialists and platform owners in a flat structure, including hiring, coaching, performance management and leading work delivered through partners. 

You have owned an enterprise SaaS platform yourself, including its roadmap, budget, vendors, lifecycle, adoption and service levels. 

You know test strategy, test management, automation and the validation lifecycle for GxP digital systems. 

On tooling, you have worked hands on with Jira and Xray for test plans, executions, traceability matrices and dashboards. You understand how Tricentis Tosca automation is designed, maintained and scaled in a large system landscape. You can configure and govern Jira and Confluence Cloud, including workflows, permissions, apps and admin and security controls. You are familiar with ServiceNow, Veeva Vault or equivalent document management systems. 

On regulation, you know GxP, ICH guidelines, HIPAA and 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and signatures, together with GAMP 5, CSA, IT general controls and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. You have run GxP supplier qualification activities. 

You are fluent in English and comfortable working with stakeholders across a global matrix organization. 

The Opella leadership behaviors we are looking for

We assess every candidate against our four behaviors. 

Behavior What it looks like in this role All in. Together. You lead one team across quality, testing and platforms, and you partner across Digital, R&D, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, asking for help and giving it freely. Courageous You challenge how validation and testing are done today, take considered risks on automation and platform change, and speak up during inspections. Outcome-Obsessed You own the compliance and delivery result, not only the task, and follow through with integrity and speed. Radically Simple You make GxP frameworks and platform configurations simple enough for teams to understand and apply. 

Opella is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every candidate feels respected.

data.title: Staff Engineer/ Senior Staff Engineer-Regulatory V&V
data.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Staff/Principal Engineer - Mechanical Testing, Verification & Validation (V&V) to lead the development and execution of comprehensive verification strategies for innovative orthopedic and medical device products. This role will serve as the technical authority for mechanical, biomechanical, fluidic, and system-level testing, ensuring products meet performance, safety, reliability, regulatory, and commercialization requirements for global markets including the United States and Europe. 

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in medical device testing, biomechanics, statistics, failure analysis, test method development, regulatory submissions, and scientific experimentation. This individual will define verification strategies, develop novel test methodologies, lead cadaveric and animal tissue studies, support regulatory submissions, and represent the organization during regulatory audits. 

What You will do: 

- Lead end-to-end V&V strategy for complex orthopedic and medical device programs from concept through commercialization. 
 - Serve as the technical authority for biomechanics and orthopedic device testing, including mechanical, structural, fluid, fatigue, and durability performance. 
 - Develop scientifically robust test methods, including novel methodologies, test method validation, measurement system analysis, and appropriate acceptance criteria. Design and analyze experiments using DOE, applied statistics, reliability engineering, and risk-based approaches. 
 - Lead failure investigation and root-cause analysis, translating findings into design improvements and risk mitigations. 
 - Ensure compliance with medical device design controls and risk management, including ISO 14971, ISO 13485, FDA QMSR/21 CFR Part 820, and applicable ASTM/ISO standards. 
 - Lead Regulatory testing strategy, face regulatory audits, provide verification evidence for global regulatory submissions, including FDA 510(k), De Novo, PMA-supporting activities, and EU MDR. 
 - Direct advanced preclinical and engineering evaluations, including cadaveric/animal testing and interpretation of FEA/CFD analyses where applicable. 
 - Provide cross-functional technical leadership, influencing R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and product-development strategies across multiple franchises. 
 - Build organizational capability and innovation, mentoring engineers, strengthening laboratory/testing competencies, and advancing biomechanical and verification sciences. 

What You Need: 

Education

- Master's or Ph. D. in: Mechanical Engineering Biomechanical Engineering Biomedical Engineering Medical Device Engineering Related technical discipline

Experience

- 7-12 years of medical device/ highly regulated product development and verification experience. Extensive experience supporting orthopedic or musculoskeletal products. Demonstrated success leading complex verification programs through commercialization. Experience supporting FDA and global regulatory submissions. 

Required Technical Expertise

Core Technical Competencies

- Verification & Validation (V&V). Medical Device Design Controls. Biomechanics. Orthopedic Device Testing. Mechanical Engineering. Fluid Mechanics. Structural Mechanics. Fatigue & Durability
 - Failure Analysis. Reliability Engineering. Design of Experiments (DOE). Applied Statistics. Measurement Systems Analysis. Test Method Validation. Risk Management (ISO 14971)

Regulatory Knowledge

- FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR. FDA 510(k). De Novo. PMA support testing. EU MDR
 - ISO 13485. ASTM Standards. ISO Device-Specific Standards. GHTF/IMDRF Guidance

Preferred Skills

- Cadaveric and animal model testing. FEA and CFD interpretation. Six Sigma Black Belt or Advanced Statistics training
 - Scientific publication or patent experience. Laboratory accreditation experience (ISO 17025)

Leadership Expectations

- Functions as a recognized subject matter expert and thought leader. Provides technical direction across multiple product franchises. 
 - Influences R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, and Quality strategies. Mentors engineers and develops organizational testing capabilities. Drives innovation in biomechanical and verification sciences. 

The successful candidate will be recognized as the organization's technical authority in medical device verification and biomechanics, capable of developing novel scientific test methodologies, defending regulatory submissions, leading global verification programs, and enabling successful product launches across the U. S. and European markets. 

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
We're a game changer that optimizes supply chains of the world's leading companies with our very own smart software and services. 

Are you passionate about cutting-edge cloud technology? Do you believe in balancing stability and adventure when it comes to technology? Ready to join a place where smart solutions meet human collaboration?

Become a DevOps Engineer at OMP! The world of supply chain planning offers plenty of interesting challenges for you to solve. Read on to learn more. 

Your challenge

As a DevOps Engineer, you're responsible for automating the deployment of our software solutions. You interact with software engineers, functional product managers, and ICT professionals daily. Using your technical skills, you provide internal tooling for development and QA teams around the globe. 

We believe in an integrated approach, where every team member is involved in all steps of the software development life cycle: analysis, architectural design, programming, and maintenance. We expect you to be the proud owner of your work and take responsibility for it. 

With 6+ years of relevant experience in Azure DevOps, you'll leverage your expertise to continuously enhance our CI/CD pipelines, ensuring efficient and reliable delivery of software products. 

Together with a tight-knit group of 5-6 team players, you develop, maintain, and support key elements of our infrastructure: 

- Continuous integration and production systems 
 - Release and build management 
 - Package management 
 - Containerization and orchestration

You'll also collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve any bottlenecks, ensuring seamless integration across the development lifecycle. 

Your team

As our new DevOps Engineer, you'll be part of a large, fast-growing, international team located in Belgium (Antwerp, Ghent, Wavre), Spain (Barcelona), Ukraine (Lviv), and the US (Atlanta). Software Development creates leading software solutions that make a difference to our customers. We make smart, robust, and scalable software to solve complex supply chain planning challenges.

Essential talents and qualifications: 

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related field
 - 6+ years of relevant experience
 - Pride in developing high-quality solutions and taking responsibility for their maintenance.

Bonus Points If You Have

- A background in DevOps, ICT, or technical support. 
 - Customer support experience or other relevant work experience, including internships. 
 - Understanding of Windows networks and Active Directory. 
 - Experience with transferring applications into the cloud. 
 - Programming skills. 

Your future

We find the perfect intersection of your talents and our evolving needs. Our talent management program supports your personal development and empowers you to build a career in line with your ambitions. 

Many of our team members who start as DevSecOps Engineers grow into roles in DevOps/Cloud architecture, project management, or people management. 

Our offer

At OMP, we offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself. 

- Continuous learning: Access customized training, coaching programs, and on-the-job development opportunities. 
 - Flexibility: Flex your schedule with working from home, adaptable hours, and the autonomy to shape your routine. 
 - Collaborative culture: Cross-team collaboration and creative challenges that encourage you to share knowledge, celebrate wins, and grow together. 
 - Benefits: An attractive salary package including additional extralegal vacation days, and other competitive benefits.

 - Innovation: Fuel innovation through collaboration, experimentation, and out of the box thinking. 

Our Company

We're a leading game changer that optimizes supply chains with our very own smart software and services. With a team of 1, 400+ passionate, creative minds from over 70 nationalities, we help the world's largest companies to run their supply chains more efficiently and sustainably. Our customers include BASF, Johnson & Johnson, L'Oréal, Nestlé, and Procter & Gamble. 

Ready to be smart with heart? Join our team where technical expertise and human connection create solutions that scale globally and make a lasting impression.

We're a global, multi-disciplinary team that's putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

You will partner closely with mechanical engineering teams in China, as well as program management, hardware, software, manufacturing, and quality teams, to drive successful product launches from development through mass production.  - Prior experience developing automotive audio, amplifier, infotainment, telematics, or related electronic products. 
 - Exposure to thermal, vibration, and structural analysis for automotive electronic systems. 
 - Experience leading engineering teams, mentoring junior engineers, or serving as a technical expert within global organizations. 
 - Familiarity with product launches across multiple regions and manufacturing locations. 

Things To Know

- This role is based in India and requires close collaboration with global engineering teams, particularly colleagues located in China. 
 - Occasional domestic and international travel may be required to support customer meetings, supplier visits, manufacturing plants, and program launch activities. 
 - Professional proficiency in English is required for effective communication with global teams and customers. 
 - Flexibility to support meetings across multiple time zones is important due to the global nature of the role. 
 - Successful completion of a background verification process is required as a condition of employment. 
 - Candidates must be legally authorized to work in India. 
 - This role supports customer-facing automotive programs where adherence to quality, confidentiality, and product compliance requirements is critical. 

What You Can Expect

- A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week. 
 - Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
 - Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
 - Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
 - Tuition reimbursement support
 - Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
 - An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you - all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want. 

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology

Ever since the 1920s, we've been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected. 

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today's most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world's ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.

data.title: Lead Control Panel Engineer
data.description:
Job Requirements

Who We Are: 

About Quest Global

Quest Global is an organization at the forefront of innovation and one of the world's fastest growing engineering services firms with deep domain knowledge and recognized expertise in the top OEMs across seven industries. We are a twenty-five-year-old company on a journey to becoming a centenary one, driven by aspiration, hunger and humility. 

We are looking for humble geniuses, who believe that engineering has the potential to make the impossible, possible; innovators, who are not only inspired by technology and innovation, but also perpetually driven to design, develop, and test as a trusted partner for Fortune 500 customers. 

As a team of remarkably diverse engineers, we recognize that what we are really engineering is a brighter future for us all. If you want to contribute to meaningful work and be part of an organization that truly believes when you win, we all win, and when you fail, we all learn, then we're eager to hear from you. 

The achievers and courageous challenge-crushers we seek, have the following characteristics and skills: 

What You Will Do

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Panel Engineer with strong expertise in DCS (Distributed Control Systems) and Balance of Plant (BOP) cabinet engineering for Power plant applications. This role will be responsible for the design, development, integration, and technical support of packaged systems (such as Control panels, Electrical system etc. ), including architecture, internal components, power distribution, and wiring, specifically tailored for DCS/BOP integration with plant control systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- System Design and Architecture: Lead the design of complete packaged systems, including the overall cabinet layout, internal components, power distribution, and system architecture. Ensure that designs meet project specifications, industry standards, and customer requirements. Select appropriate components (e. g. , DCS controller, I/O cards) based on system requirements.  - Collaboration and Coordination: Work closely with stakeholders to ensure the system design aligns with all aspects of the project. Provide technical guidance and support throughout the design, testing, and installation phases. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive system design documents, schematics, and manuals. Ensure that all designs comply with company standards, industry regulations, and customer specifications. 
 - Support: Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, and internal disciplines. Provide technical sales support for generation of customer proposals. Engineering support during assembly of control panels for troubleshooting and modifications. 

What You Will Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation/Electrical Engineering, Control or Mechanical Engineering. At least 5 years of experience in designing and integrating control systems, with a focus on DCS/PLC platforms and BOP cabinet systems. Experience in upgrading complex control systems, including managing cabinet system architectures and ensuring minimal system downtime during upgrades. 

Technical Skills: 

- In-depth knowledge of control systems, particularly DCS/PLC platforms. 
 - Familiarity with safety-critical systems and their integration into control systems. 
 - Experience with electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and system layouts.

 - Familiarity with PLM tools and proficiency with both solid modelling and 2-dimensional CAD tools for system design (e. g. , Creo, AutoCAD Mechanical & Electrical).
