Soft Skills: 

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with various engineering teams. 
 - Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with gas, steam, or combined-cycle power plants
 - Knowledge of redundancy concepts, safety systems, and interlocks
 - Exposure to international projects and multicultural engineering teams
 - Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Location: Chennai / Hyderabad / Pune

Travel: Up to 10%

data.title: Frontier AI - IAM Automation Engineer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

Frontier AI - IAM Automation Engineer

Today's world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of professionals who collaborate to support the business by protecting information assets. Our Information Security professionals enable the organization to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and respond to security events as they happen. 

Within Information Security, we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions across the security lifecycle. You will join a team of security-focused professionals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative and secure solutions that provide business value. 

The opportunity

As part of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) organization, the Frontier AI - IAM Automation Engineer will design, develop, engineer and advance secure, scalable automation and Agentic AI capabilities across enterprise, cloud and hybrid environments. The role combines deep IAM expertise with software engineering and emerging AI technologies to modernize authentication, federation, authorization and related IAM processes. 

The Engineer will develop Agentic AI-driven automation across Microsoft Entra ID, Agent ID, M365, workload identities, federated credentials, session and token protection, and secrets and certificate-based authentication. This includes integrating AI agents with IAM platforms, APIs, security controls and enterprise workflows while establishing reusable patterns and guardrails for security, auditability, reliability and operational control. 

Working with Architecture, Product, Operations, application teams, Security and vendors, the Engineer will translate complex requirements into secure, supportable solutions aligned with IAM standards and EY's global technology and security strategies. The individual will provide technical leadership from design through production and operational handover, mentor engineers, and promote engineering quality and leading practices. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design and development of complex IAM automation and Agentic AI solutions using Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Functions, Power Platform, Ansible, Azure CLI, ARM templates, Copilot Studio and Foundry, together with PowerShell, Python, NodeJS, ReactJS and . NET. 
 - Architect AI-augmented IAM capabilities, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration patterns, adaptive access control, predictive threat detection, identity analytics and intelligent workflow automation. 
 - Establish reusable frameworks, engineering standards and guardrails for scalable, resilient, maintainable, observable, secure and operationally supportable IAM automation and AI capabilities. 
 - Provide technical leadership across Microsoft Entra ID, M365, workload identities, federated credentials, authentication, authorization, session management, token protection, certificates and secrets management. 
 - Design secure integrations using REST APIs, Microsoft Graph API, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and related standards, with appropriate identity, authorization and security controls for AI agents, applications and workloads. 
 - Apply Zero Trust and least-privilege principles to machine-to-machine and agent-to-service interactions, including secure credential, certificate and secrets management. 
 - Automate IAM security, compliance and audit controls and establish logging, monitoring, alerting and incident-response integrations using Azure Monitor, Microsoft Sentinel or comparable platforms. 
 - Design and maintain secure CI/CD, DevSecOps and Infrastructure as Code patterns using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, ARM templates or equivalent technologies, with appropriate testing and deployment controls. 
 - Conduct architecture, technical design and code reviews; guide engineers on IAM, automation, software engineering, DevSecOps and Agentic AI implementation practices. 
 - Serve as the technical escalation point for complex IAM automation and AI issues, leading root-cause analysis and working with engineering, architecture and vendors such as Microsoft, Ping and Auth0 to resolve systemic problems. 
 - Advise internal clients on applying Agentic AI to IAM processes to improve automation, security, user experience and operational efficiency while reducing risk. 
 - Evaluate emerging AI, identity and automation technologies through prototypes and reusable patterns, assessing design alternatives, technical trade-offs and architectural, security or operational risks. 
 - Plan and lead delivery across development, testing and production, ensuring appropriate documentation, monitoring, support models, operational readiness and successful transition to operations. 
 - Build trusted stakeholder relationships, translate business and security requirements into practical solutions, identify dependencies and risks early, and mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, technical standards and leading practices. 

Skills And Attributes For Success

- Strong IAM engineering expertise across authentication, authorization, federation, MFA, SSO, identity lifecycle management, OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, SAML and Zero Trust. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including application, workload and non-human identities, federated credentials, service principals, managed identities, least privilege and credential management. 
 - Advanced enterprise automation experience using Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Power Platform, Ansible and Azure CLI, with the ability to create scalable, reusable automation solutions. 
 - Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Agentic AI architectures and AI/ML solutions, including multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, tool-enabled agents, human-in-the-loop patterns, AI security and applications within IAM, cybersecurity or enterprise automation. 
 - Experience designing integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST APIs, JSON, OAuth/OIDC and Microsoft Graph API or equivalent orchestration and tool-integration standards. 
 - Strong software engineering and scripting skills in one or more technologies such as Python, PowerShell, NodeJS, ReactJS, . NET, Bash or Ruby. 
 - Experience securing secrets, keys and certificates with Azure Key Vault, CyberArk or comparable platforms, combined with observability, threat detection, monitoring and incident-response integration using Microsoft Sentinel or similar services. 
 - Advanced experience with Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps and CI/CD using Terraform, ARM templates, CloudFormation, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or GitLab CI, including secure code, credential and deployment controls. 
 - Ability to design secure, scalable, available, resilient, maintainable and supportable solutions, with strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across IAM, cloud, automation, containers and application integrations. 
 - Strong technical leadership, mentoring, documentation and stakeholder-management skills, with knowledge of secure SDLC, ITSM, Change Management, production support and operational readiness while remaining a hands-on engineer. 

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of relevant technology experience, including substantial experience in IAM, authentication engineering, access management, security engineering or enterprise identity platforms. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on cloud automation or software engineering experience using scripting, APIs, DevOps and Infrastructure as Code, including enterprise-scale IAM automation across cloud, hybrid or distributed environments. 
 - Around 2 years of hands-on experience developing, integrating or deploying AI/ML, Generative AI or Agentic AI solutions, preferably within IAM, cybersecurity, cloud or enterprise automation. 
 - Demonstrated experience with enterprise authentication, authorization, identity protocols and access management solutions. 
 - Experience leading technical design and implementation through development, testing, production deployment and operational transition, including architecture documentation and resolution of complex cross-technology issues. 
 - Ability to assess technical trade-offs, translate security, architecture and business requirements into practical solutions, and work effectively both independently and through technical leadership within globally distributed, multidisciplinary and multicultural teams. 

Ideally, you'll also have

- Deep hands-on experience with the Microsoft Entra ID and Azure ecosystem, including Azure DevOps, Microsoft Graph, CI/CD and infrastructure automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Copilot Studio or Foundry, including MCP servers, clients or equivalent patterns for securely exposing enterprise tools to AI agents. 
 - Experience implementing secure identity and authorization patterns for AI agents and workload identities, including AI governance, security and responsible-AI considerations for production solutions. 
 - Experience designing reusable automation platforms, frameworks, APIs and shared engineering capabilities rather than only individual scripts. 
 - Strong knowledge of OAuth 2. 0, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM and related identity protocols, together with identity threat detection, Conditional Access, identity analytics and Zero Trust architectures. 
 - Experience with CyberArk, Azure Key Vault or comparable secrets and privileged-access-management platforms in large-scale, globally distributed IAM environments. 
 - Relevant certifications in areas such as Microsoft Azure, Identity, Security, DevOps, AI/ML, Automation or ITIL. 

What We Look For

We seek a hands-on engineer who combines sound IAM fundamentals with automation and AI / ML experience and curiosity about emerging technologies. The successful candidate is structured, security-minded and comfortable collaborating across application, infrastructure, architecture and operations teams. 

What We Offer

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The benefits package focuses on physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can explain the benefits available in your country. 

- Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
 - Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a significant impact, your way. 
 - Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
 - Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.title: Staff IT Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to be the technical anchor for Agentic AI in IT Quality Engineering - setting the architecture, standards and roadmap for custom Agentic AI applications across an Enterprise IT landscape spanning Salesforce, SAP, custom Licensing and Entitlement management applications, and AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM platforms. You will decide how agents plan, act, retrieve context and hand back to a human across these systems; how they are evaluated, governed and operated in production; and how the wider engineering team builds them well. This is a hands-on role: you will still design and write the hardest parts yourself. 

At Palo Alto Networks we are moving towards an AI-First engineering culture. You will shape the direction of our own internal AI platform tools for test generation, automation scripting, execution and quality reporting, and lead the engineers who build on them. 

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Technical Direction

Agentic Architecture: Define the reference architecture for agentic systems across the landscape - planner-executor orchestration, multi-agent coordination, state, memory and recovery - and choose frameworks such as LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen or CrewAI on evidence rather than fashion. 

Event-Driven Enterprise Integration: Architect event-driven pipelines that connect Salesforce (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Apex, Flows), SAP (OData/BAPI services and business-object events) and custom Licensing, Entitlement, AI Custom Quoting, Provisioning and ITSM applications to AI processing with production OAuth2 lifecycle, least-privilege access and idempotent writes to systems of record. 

Context & Knowledge Architecture: Set the retrieval strategy across the estate - vector and graph stores (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate or Milvus; Apache AGE or Neo4j), advanced topologies (Graph RAG, Corrective RAG, HyDE, agentic retrieval), and the ingestion, freshness and access-control rules that keep context correct. 

Tool & Protocol Standards: Own the standards for tool definitions, JSON function schemas and MCP servers across teams, so that agent tool calls are schema-validated, auditable and traceable back to Jira. 

Model Strategy: Decide when prompting and retrieval are enough and when model customisation is justified - and lead resource-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) where it is. 

Quality, Safety & Governance at Scale

Evaluation Strategy & Release Gates: Define how AI agents - ours and the ones other teams build that the business depends on - are evaluated before release: golden sets, calibrated LLM-as-judge, adversarial testing, and risk-tiered release gates that block what should be blocked. 

Autonomy & HITL Governance: Set the autonomy model - which decisions an agent may take alone, which need human approval, and how that changes as evidence accumulates - and make sure it is enforced in code, especially where agents write to systems of record. 

LLMOps & Platform Reliability: Architect secure AI gateways, token-budget and rate-limit controls, model deployment pipelines, drift monitoring and automated rollback; own service levels, cost and incident response for production agents. 

Responsible AI & Data Governance: Partner with security and data-governance owners to define guardrails on intellectual property and data privacy - managed secrets, explicit opt-in for any step that sends content to an external service, and an audit trail a reviewer can follow. 

Leadership & Influence

Design & Review Board: Lead design reviews for agentic and AI-integrated systems across Salesforce, SAP and custom platforms, and set the code and design standards for both human-written and AI-generated code. 

Roadmap & Strategy: Partner with engineering leadership, QE leads, product managers and enterprise architects to turn quality and business goals into a sequenced AI engineering roadmap - and say plainly what will not work. 

Mentorship & Capability Building: Mentor Senior AI Engineers and AI Engineers, grow the next AI Architects, and shape the reference implementations and training that move engineers up our AI capability ladder. 

Cross-Organisation Influence: Represent IT Quality Engineering in enterprise architecture and AI governance forums, and drive adoption of AI-native engineering practice beyond your own team. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 7-10 years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years in applied AI/ML, of which at least 2 years building LLM-based or agentic systems that reached production. 

Leadership Track Record: 2+ years as a technical lead, staff engineer or architect driving architectural decisions and leading cross-functional technical initiatives to production. 

Programming Mastery: Expert proficiency in Python and strong proficiency in Java or TypeScript/Node. js; excellent software design is a given. 

Agentic Systems Architecture: You have designed and led production agentic systems - planner-executor orchestration, multi-agent coordination, state and memory, HITL control - and can explain the trade-offs you made and what you would change. 

Distributed & Event-Driven Systems: Deep experience with microservices, event-driven architecture and message queues (e. g. , Kafka, Pub/Sub), including idempotency, ordering, back-pressure and failure recovery. 

Retrieval at Scale: You have designed production RAG systems over vector and/or graph stores, including access-controlled ingestion and measured retrieval quality. 

Evaluation & Governance: You have established evaluation and release-gating practice for LLM systems - golden sets, LLM-as-judge calibration, adversarial and prompt-injection testing - that was adopted beyond your own team. 

Enterprise Integration: Deep experience integrating with enterprise platforms - Salesforce, SAP or comparable CRM, ERP or ITSM systems - including OAuth2 lifecycle, safe write patterns and data-governance constraints. 

Cloud, LLMOps & CI/CD: Strong experience with GCP/AWS/Azure, Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD at enterprise scale, and operating AI services with observability, cost controls and rollback. 

AI-Assisted Development: Deep fluency with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, and a track record of setting team practice for reviewing what they produce. 

Education: B. E. /B. Tech/M. Tech in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 

Preferred Qualifications

Model Customisation: Hands-on fine-tuning with resource-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA), including data preparation and evaluation of the tuned model against its base. 

Integration Platforms: Event-driven enterprise integration in practice - SAP business-object events and workflow triggers, Salesforce Platform Events or Change Data Capture, and middleware such as SnapLogic or MuleSoft. 

Model Context Protocol: Designing MCP server estates used across teams - tools, resources and prompts, with versioning and access control. 

Managed AI Platforms: Production experience with Vertex AI or an equivalent managed AI platform. 

AI Security: Threat modelling for agentic systems - prompt injection, tool misuse, data exfiltration and red-teaming practice. 

Quality Engineering at Scale: Architecting test automation or quality platforms (Playwright, REST Assured, Selenium or PyTest), including AI-assisted test generation or self-healing automation. 

Domain Expertise: Deep grounding in B2B sales, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), the Quote-to-Cash lifecycle, or licensing, entitlement and provisioning flows. 

Industry Contribution: Publications, conference talks or significant open-source contributions in agentic AI, retrieval or LLM evaluation. 

WAYS OF WORKING

Evidence over Assertion: You measure before and after, you publish the number with its method attached, you say plainly when a result is inconclusive - and you hold the team's claims to the same standard. 

Curiosity with Rigour: You enjoy new tooling but you test it before you trust it, and you know the difference between a demo and a system. 

Strategic Influence: You change direction with evidence and clear writing rather than authority, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. 

High Autonomy: You take ambiguous, cross-system problems and turn them into a plan a team can execute, and you raise risks early rather than late. 

Builder's Bias: You would rather ship a narrow capability that works and is trusted than a broad one that only demos well - and you set that standard for the team. 

GROWTH PATH

This role sits at the AI Architect tier of our internal AI capability ladder (AI User → AI Engineer → AI Architect), and you will operate there from the start: planner-executor orchestration at scale, multi-agent systems with human-in-the-loop control, event-driven integration across the enterprise IT landscape, and model customisation. From here the role grows in scope from a single programme to the AI engineering direction of IT Quality Engineering - and in the number of engineers you bring up the same ladder. 

THE TEAM

You will be part of a growing, passionate and dynamic team, with the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects centred on what we believe is one of the most significant mission statements in the world. We also strive to be the most people-centric company ever - that means we are constantly working to make your experience amazing, and you are part of the team breaking the boundaries of what the workplace can be. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Position: Azure DevOps Engineer

Join Epiroc Mining India Private Ltd in Bengaluru as an Azure DevOps Engineer and play a crucial role within our Research and Development department. This position offers the opportunity to lead the DevOps strategy for automation platforms, delivering scalable CI/CD systems and driving cloud-native deployments aligned with DevSecOps best practices across global mining operations. 

About The Role

As an Azure DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of efficient continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines using industry-leading tools such as Jenkins, GitHub, and Azure DevOps. You will manage complex Git version control workflows and automate release processes to ensure rapid and reliable software deployments. 

Your role includes overseeing cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure platforms, leveraging Infrastructure as Code technologies like Terraform to build scalable, cost-effective, and resilient environments. You will support hybrid cloud and edge computing architectures vital for our autonomous mining solutions. 

Containerization is paramount to this role; you'll manage Docker and Kubernetes deployments, architecting scalable solutions that improve deployment reliability and enable advanced rollout strategies such as canary and blue-green deployments. 

Monitoring and operational excellence are essential, where you'll implement robust logging, alerting, and incident management protocols rooted in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to ensure high system availability and swift issue resolution. 

Security integration through DevSecOps practices is a key responsibility, embedding security within CI/CD pipelines, managing access controls, secrets, and compliance to uphold our enterprise standards for secure software delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub, and Azure DevOps to enable seamless software delivery. 
 - Manage Git workflows including branching strategies, code reviews, and release automation to support collaborative development. 
 - Design and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure using AWS and Azure platforms with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 
 - Oversee container orchestration via Kubernetes and Docker to improve deployment efficiency and reliability. 
 - Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting tools to ensure system performance and reliability in line with SRE practices. 
 - Automate routine tasks and deployment processes through scripting languages such as Python and Bash. 
 - Integrate security best practices into every stage of the CI/CD pipeline to ensure compliance and secure software releases. 
 - Collaborate with global interdisciplinary teams spanning India, Sweden, and Australia to drive DevOps initiatives aligned with business goals. 
 - Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation in DevOps practices. 

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. 
 - 6 to 9 years of proven experience in DevOps or Platform Engineering roles.

data.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Sr. Engineer - Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab. The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement. 

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab. 
 - Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements. 
 - Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems. 
 - Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions. 
 - Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures. 
 - Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions. 
 - Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability. 
 - Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions. 
 - Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams. 
 - Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities. 
 - Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers. 
 - Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure. 
 - Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation. 
 - Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required. 
 - Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement. 
 - Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities. 
 - Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting. 

Key Technical Skills

- Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing. 
 - Hands-on experience with reliability and environmental testing. 
 - Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing. 
 - Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing. 
 - Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test-system vs. product failures. 
 - Strong data analysis and interpretation skills. 
 - Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices. 
 - Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes. 
 - Strong technical documentation and reporting skills. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's/Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline. 
 - Typically 5-8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions. 
 - Hands-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred. 
 - Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage. 

Key Competencies

- Reliability & Failure Analysis
 - Laboratory & Test Management
 - Technical Problem Solving
 - Data Analysis
 - Root Cause Analysis
 - Product Testing & Validation
 - Project Ownership
 - Cross-functional Collaboration
 - Attention to Detail
 - Technical Documentation

 - Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
 - Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions
 - Laboratory equipment availability and utilization

Key Responsibilities

 - Automate functional, integration, and end-to-end qualification for storage protocols, REST APIs and CLI workflows.

 - Hands-on experience with NFS/NFS-Ganesha; pNFS knowledge is a plus. 
 - Experience with storage/performance tools such as FIO, VDBench, IO500, tcpdump/Wireshark, or eBPF. 
 - Experience with Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, REST APIs, Containerization concepts and Kubernetes. 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, high availability, and fault tolerance
 - Familiarity with storage concepts and protocols such as NFS, SMB, S3, or POSIX file systems
 - Strong Linux operating system administration, troubleshooting, and network debugging skills (tcpdump, routing, logs)
 - Hands-on experience integrating test automation into Jenkins or similar CI/CD systems

Nice to Have

- Exposure to NVMe/NVMe-oF, SPDK, RocksDB, WAL/transaction processing, or distributed storage systems

Education

data.title: Sr.Engineer - Project Quality
data.description:
Role Summary

Quality representative within a customer development project. Ensures product and process conformity within the customer APQP process Develops and implements robust control plans. Ensures a time customer PPAP approval. 

Main Tasks

Project Quality Management

- Own all project quality activities from project approval through final closure (Gate 7). 
 - Act as the primary quality interface with customers throughout APQP. 
 - Ensure customer-specific and internal MANN+HUMMEL quality requirements are implemented across all project phases, including supplier APQP. 
 - Develop and implement quality control plans from development through serial production. 
 - Monitor project quality status, communicate risks and escalate deviations or delays. 
 - Guide and coach project teams on APQP tools and quality methodologies. 
 - Exercise authority to stop processes or product deliveries in case of serious quality, safety or regulatory non-conformities. 

B. APQP, Validation and PPAP

- Provide quality inputs for D-FMEA and P-FMEA development and reviews. 
 - Review and align customer and internal drawings with Product Engineering, Process Engineering and Metrology, ensuring dimensional feasibility and appropriate inspection methods. 
 - Support design and process validation planning, execution, root cause analysis and corrective actions. 
 - Define and implement serial production gauges, measurement fixtures and inspection methods in coordination with relevant functions. 
 - Ensure accurate execution and documentation of dimensional measurements throughout project phases, excluding purchased components. 
 - Ensure conformity of development samples, including inspection, documentation and release before customer submission. 
 - Initiate deviation permits for any product, process or functional non-conformity, wherever required. 
 - Define functional requalification requirements in coordination with R&D and the customer, considering technical requirements and cost implications. 
 - Coordinate with SQE to ensure customer-specific requirements, requalification and PPAP requirements are reflected in supplier quality documentation. 

C. Customer Quality and Project Closure

- Coordinate customer product and process approvals (ISIR/PPAP) and ensure final approval within agreed project timelines. 
 - Drive corrective actions and escalation wherever PPAP approval or project milestones are at risk. 
 - Lead problem-solving activities for customer complaints and internal deviations before full PPAP approval. 
 - Support Plant Quality in resolving customer complaints and updating quality documentation after PPAP. 
 - Ensure effective handover to Plant Quality, including control plan implementation, serial production controls and customer quality interfaces. 

D. Global Project Quality Responsibilities (Applicable to Global Header Projects)

- Lead PQE activities during project phases 0-3 and coordinate local PQEs. 
 - Transfer PQE ownership to local sites from phase 4 onwards and monitor progress through regular coordination meetings. 
 - Ensure consistent application of MANN+HUMMEL and customer quality standards across manufacturing locations. 
 - Coordinate global D-FMEA, master P-FMEA and control plan concepts for common part families. 
 - Align customer/internal drawings, measurement strategies, gauges and fixtures across production locations. 
 - Coordinate quality inputs for common Tier-2 supplier parts and support supplier PPAP requirements. 
 - Monitor local project maturity, IPT and PPAP approvals to achieve project milestones. 
 - Share lessons learned and quality improvements across manufacturing sites. 

Experience

Qualification

- university degree (bachelor or master) in engineering
 - Technician with job experience in quality engineering
 - English Ianguage skills(fluent) Local standard Language in site. 

Experience (preference)

- Automotive Industry
 - Practical mass production experience
 - Relevant process experience (plastic injection, plastic welding, assembly, end of line test)

The candidate should have strong collaboration and communication skills to work with suppliers, plant functions and SQEs, be capable of managing multiple quality concerns simultaneously, and demonstrate a proactive approach to problem-solving and risk management. 

Supplier Quality Plant Engineer (SQP)

Location: Hoskote, Bangalore - 562122

Main Responsibilities

- Manage purchased-part quality concerns and assess risks to plant operations, other Volvo sites and customers. 
 - Secure immediate containment through segregation, inspection, sorting, rework and replacement with suppliers and plant functions. 
 - Manage supplier Inspection Reports and quality claims in accordance with Volvo Group processes and SPQAM requirements.

 - Monitor Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) arising from supplier-related quality issues and drive actions. 
 - Coordinate supplier visits at the plant and facilitate the necessary support. 

Competence And Experience

- Degree in Mechanical, Automobile or a relevant engineering discipline. 
 - Experience in supplier quality, manufacturing quality or production, preferably in automotive. 
 - Technical knowledge of manufacturing, assembly, handling, packaging and logistics. 
 - Knowledge of automotive quality standards, core quality tools, Lean, root-cause analysis and 8D methodology. 
 - Experience in containment, supplier claims and corrective-action verification. 
 - Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications, with knowledge of dimensional inspection and measurement techniques. 
 - Analytical, structured and preventive mindset, with independent working and timely decision-making under production pressure. 
 - Strong collaboration and assertive supplier communication skills, professional English and willingness to travel.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer (Manual)
data.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a QA Engineer with 3-4 years of hands-on testing experience who can own end to end QA testing. From understanding the requirement, to designing test coverage, to automating the regression suite, to signing off the release. 

This is a hands-on role for someone who is strong in functional and exploratory testing. You will work closely with developers, product owners and the release team in an agile, fast-moving environment. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Test Design & Execution

- Analyse requirements, user stories and API contracts; identify gaps, edge cases and ambiguities before development begins. 
 - Write clear, traceable test scenarios and test cases covering functional, integration, negative, boundary and data-validation paths. 
 - Execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, cross-browser and cross-device testing across web and mobile application journeys. 
 - Perform exploratory and risk-based testing to surface defects that scripted cases miss. 
 - Validate business rules and calculations - points accrual, eligibility, caps, redemptions, reconciliation with precision. Defect Management & Release Quality

- Log well-documented defects with clear reproduction steps, evidence, logs and severity; drive them to closure with developers. 
 - Own regression sign-off for assigned modules and communicate release readiness with a clear view of residual risk. 
 - Verify fixes, run post-deployment validation on staging and production, and support UAT with business stakeholders. 
 - Maintain test data sets, test environments and documentation so testing is repeatable across programs and tenants. 

Collaboration & Improvement

- Work closely with product and development team, participate actively in sprints grooming, planning, stand-ups and retrospectives. 
 - Report on test coverage, execution progress, defect trends. 
 - Suggest and implement improvements to test processes, coverage strategy and tooling. 
 - Use AI-assisted tools responsibly to accelerate test case generation, test data creation and regression analysis. 

Test Automation

- Exposure to test automation - build, extend and maintain automated test suites for UI, API and data-validation layers. 
 - Convert high-value manual regression cases into reliable, maintainable automated tests. 
 - Support API and backend testing, including request/response validation, authentication flows, error handling and database-level assertions. 

Required Skills: 

- 3-4 years of professional experience in software testing
 - Strong grasp of QA fundamentals: SDLC/STLC, test design techniques, defect life cycle, agile/Scrum delivery. 
 - Proven ability to test Mobile Application, web and REST APIs
 - Comfortable writing and debugging queries against a relational or document database to validate data. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication. Able to articulate scenarios, not just report failures. 
 - Attention to detail, and the discipline to be the last line of defence before a release reaches customers. 
 - Exposure to security testing basics (OWASP Top 10)
 - Working knowledge on SQL (Postgres/MySQL) & MongoDB queries
 - Diagnose the issue - make sense out of Application Logs and dashboard [ELK, Grafana, Kibana etc]
 - Good to have: ISTQB certification or equivalent

data.title: Quality Engineer-Functional
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer with a functional focus, you specialize in designing and executing testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies. Your expertise spans across all levels of testing, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Design Test Scenarios: Create optimized test scenarios, plan testing activities, estimate work efforts, and identify test environment and data requirements to ensure thorough testing of applications and systems. 
 - Execute Testing: Perform manual and automation testing, execute test cases, report test status, and address defects through creation, triage, and resolution to ensure high-quality deliverables. 
 - Analyze Test Outcomes: Apply analytical and cognitive techniques to analyze test outcomes, driving continuous improvements in testing processes and overall quality. 
 - Utilize Testing Tools: Leverage various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality, ensuring optimal testing outcomes. 
 - Report Defects: Identify, document, and report defects, collaborating with teams to resolve issues and improve overall product quality. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Exposure to Testing Methodologies: Experience working with various testing methodologies, including functional, system integration, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to design and execute testing for applications and systems built using custom technologies. 
 - Core Testing Skills: Exposure to core testing, technical testing, and business domain/processes, enabling the creation of optimized test scenarios, planning testing activities, estimating work efforts, and identifying test environment and data requirements. 
 - Testing Tools and Techniques: Experience working with various testing tools, BDD/TDD approaches, and test accelerators to enhance test efficiency and quality. 
 - Manual and Automation Testing: Exposure to both manual and automation testing, including executing test cases, reporting test status, and addressing defects through creation, triage, and resolution. 
 - Analytical and Cognitive Techniques: Experience applying analytical and cognitive techniques to analyze test outcomes, driving continuous improvements in testing processes and overall quality. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Proficiency in BDD/TDD: Experience working with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) approaches to enhance test efficiency and quality, ensuring optimal testing outcomes. 
 - Familiarity with Test Accelerators: Exposure to test accelerators, leveraging them to streamline testing processes and improve overall quality. 
 - Knowledge of Testing Tools: Experience working with various testing tools, utilizing them to enhance test efficiency and quality, and ensuring thorough testing of applications and systems.

data.description:
About Tide

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting. 

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France. 

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love. 

Tide Facts

- Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
 - Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
 - Over $300 million raised in funding
 - 3, 000 Tideans globally
 - We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Role

Here at Tide, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Team Leader to oversee our Acquiring Transaction Monitoring team in our first line of defence with experience in transaction monitoring within the card acquiring space or merchant banking, with a deep understanding of fraud detection, compliance, and risk management. This role requires strong leadership skills, along with a deep understanding of fraud prevention, risk management, and compliance within the payments ecosystem. 

Your team will be responsible for the monitoring of the transaction and behaviours across our customer base, ensuring we put our genuine members first, whilst spotting and investigating potentially suspicious activity. This role is a key element of our team, so we're looking for someone who is a passionate investigator, possesses good knowledge on merchant payments, who will help reduce risk to tide, and let our members get back to doing what they love. 

- Lead, manage, and mentor a team of Transaction Monitoring Analysts, ensuring they meet performance metrics, including transaction reviews, case resolution times, and fraud detection accuracy. 
 - Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and develop individual training plans to improve team capabilities. 
 - Manage resources of the team by effective capacity forecasting and monitoring, setting priorities, work allocation and reallocation where necessary. 
 - Supervise the monitoring of acquiring transactions, ensuring suspicious activities are detected in real-time or through post-transaction analysis. 
 - Oversee the monitoring of merchant acquiring activities, including card payment authorizations, settlements, chargebacks, and disputes, ensuring all processes follow best practices. 
 - Ensure all monitored transactions comply with industry regulations and standards, including AML, and card network rules (Visa, MasterCard, etc. ). 
 - Develop strategies to reduce fraudulent activities across merchant card payments and ensure merchants meet compliance requirements. 
 - Use data-driven insights to recommend improvements in transaction monitoring processes and fraud mitigation strategies. 
 - Keep the team updated on emerging fraud trends and adjust detection rules and constantly measure, assess and improve our risk policies, procedures and controls across products
 - Foster a collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement and high operational efficiency. 
 - Representing your area in front of different stakeholders, including internal and external auditors. 

What We Are Looking For

- You are willing to work in flexible shift patterns. 
 - 3-5 years of experience in merchant banking, card acquiring, merchant acquiring, transaction monitoring, or merchant card payments with automated processes and data driven decisioning tools/culture. 
 - Proven leadership experience, with a track record of managing teams in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. 
 - Deep understanding of card acquiring processes, merchant acquiring systems, payment networks (Visa, MasterCard, etc. ), and fraud detection methodologies. 
 - Analytical mindset with a proven ability to interpret complex transaction data and identify fraud patterns. 
 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience in handling escalations and coordinating cross-functional teams. 
 - Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard. 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard. 

Disclaimer

It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That

- Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. 
 - All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel. 
 - Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide. co email address. 
 - Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf. 

If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide. co

Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. 

Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy. 

Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

data.title: Lead Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Lead Software Engineer

Location: Remote

As Chegg Skills engineers, our software empowers students to move from "learning" to "earning. " We build the applications and systems that help students make life-changing career transitions into high-growth job opportunities. We take pride in making education accessible to motivated career switchers, and we build the technology that helps them achieve mastery and success. 

In this role, you will play a leading role in a fully remote team of diverse, motivated engineers who are rethinking what education can look like. We serve thousands of students and educators every year, and your work will directly shape how those students learn and succeed. 

Chegg Skills is a growing division of Chegg focused on post-collegiate learners. We are continuing to grow our engineering team to support business expansion as more students take the next step in their careers with Chegg. Join us and help scale the engineering foundation for our next phase of growth. 

About The Role

We're hiring a Lead Software Engineer, Backend to own the delivery execution of a team building backend services, APIs, and distributed systems for learner-facing and operational experiences. This is a backend-first role with full-stack reach - and the team you lead has that same full-stack reach, not backend-only depth. You need enough fluency across the stack to review a frontend PR, unblock a stuck UI engineer, or make a cross-stack architecture call, not just depth in backend. 

This role sits above individual technical ownership: you are accountable for the team's delivery rhythm, you proactively coach engineers before they get stuck, and you act as the technical filter between Product and the team - refining ambiguous asks before they ever reach an engineer's backlog. 

What You'll Do

- Own the team's delivery rhythm and milestone execution - break major epics into milestones with clear dependencies, spot team-wide delivery risk early, and escalate with options already framed, not after deadlines slip. 
 - Act as the technical filter between Product/PM and the team - refine ambiguous product asks into structured technical tasks before they hit the backlog, shielding the team from scope creep and chaotic requirements. 
 - Proactively coach engineers on the team - pair on complex bugs and designs, and spot technical struggles before they become delivery blockers, not just when asked. 
 - Set and enforce the team's technical and AI-usage norms - review standards, AI code-ownership expectations, and guardrails the whole team follows, so responsible AI usage is the default rather than something you re-check on every PR. 
 - Review, unblock, and make architecture calls on frontend work (React/Next. js or equivalent), even where you are not hands-on daily - your team's engineers have full-stack reach, and you need to be able to lead across the stack, not just deep in backend. 
 - Design and build backend services and distributed systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability, and set the technical roadmap others on the team execute. 
 - Build and extend GraphQL-powered APIs and workflow-driven systems that support learner-facing and operational experiences. 
 - Improve reliability for integration-heavy and asynchronous workflows, including retries, idempotency, error handling, and recovery paths. 
 - Review PRs with a systemic lens - prevent tight coupling, catch AI-generated code that duplicates existing modules, and enforce long-term maintainability over short-term velocity. 
 - Drive cross-squad initiatives to completion, producing artifacts (shared tooling, workflow templates, register items) that other teams adopt without reinventing them. 
 - Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Engineering, Platform/SRE, and Content Operations to deliver and harden high-impact workflows. 
 - Treat hiring, calibration input, and team-health contributions as first-class work, not something you respond to only when chased. 

Required Qualifications Technical

- Most qualified candidates will likely bring 7+ years of professional software development experience building production backend systems. 
 - Strong backend system design experience - distributed systems, scalability, reliability patterns, and service architecture. 
 - Strong experience with Java/Kotlin and/or Python-based backend systems (Spring, FastAPI, Django, or similar frameworks), plus API design and GraphQL integration. 
 - Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Temporal, AWS Step Functions, Airflow, or similar). 
 - Experience debugging production issues end to end, from symptom to root cause, fix, and prevention. 
 - Experience working on async or integration-heavy systems, including retries, timeouts, idempotency, and workflow/state handling. 
 - Strong testing and release-validation discipline in environments where engineers own quality directly. 
 - Experience with observability and operational ownership, including dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and participation in on-call support. 
 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce. 
 - Enough exposure to React/Next. js or frontend web applications to review, unblock, or make architecture calls on frontend work - not necessarily hands-on daily, but enough to lead engineers who have full-stack reach. 

Leadership & Scope

- Has owned a team's delivery rhythm - breaking epics into milestones, spotting cross-team delivery risk weeks before it becomes a miss - not just their own workstream. 
 - Has coached or mentored engineers with a concrete, named outcome (a promotion, a specific skill gap closed), not generic "mentored juniors" language. 
 - Has reviewed, unblocked, or made architecture decisions on frontend/web work, or has managed engineers who were themselves frontend or full-stack. 
 - Has acted as the technical filter between Product/PM and an engineering team - refining ambiguous requirements before they reached engineers. 
 - Has driven cross-squad initiatives to completion, producing artifacts (shared tooling, workflow templates, register items) that other teams adopted without reinventing them. 
 - Has set or enforced team-wide technical or AI-usage norms - review standards, AI code-ownership expectations - not just personal practice. 

Tech Stack

- Backend: Python (FastAPI / Django), GraphQL, Kotlin / Java, Spring-based services, Temporal
 - Frontend: React / Next. js, Node. js, Auth0-integrated web flows
 - Cloud / Delivery: AWS, Docker, GitLab CI
 - Observability / Operations: New Relic, Rootly, Playwright
 - AI / ML: OpenAI, AWS Bedrockk

Why do we exist?

Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. Our recent research study called State of the Student shows that nearly 3 out of 4 students are working to support themselves through college and 1 in 3 students feel pressure to spend more than they can afford. We founded our business on provided affordable textbook rental options to address these issues. Since then, we've expanded our offerings to supplement many facets of higher educational learning through Chegg Study, Chegg Math, Chegg Writing, Chegg Internships, Chegg Skills, and more to support students beyond their college experience. These offerings lower financial concerns for students by modernizing their learning experience. We exist so students everywhere have a smarter, faster, more affordable way to student. 

Video Shorts

Life at Chegg: http: //youtu. be/Fwf90zgaOLA

Chegg Corporate Career Page: https: //jobs. chegg. com/

Chegg India: http: //www. cheggindia. com/

Chegg Israel: http: //www. chegg. com/about/working-at-chegg/israel/

Chegg Skills: https: //www. chegg. com/skills

Chegg out our culture and benefits!

http: //www. chegg. com/about/working-at-chegg/benefits/

Chegg is an equal opportunity employer

Job Description - Engineering Manager

- Location: Bangalore, India 
 - Experience: 7-10 years (2+ years as Engineering Manager)

Work set up - Hybrid

About Skillz

If you want to build, own, and see your impact - join Skillz and level up your career. 

Skillz is the competition infrastructure platform that powers real-money, skill-based tournaments inside mobile games. We didn't just enter the competitive gaming market - we invented it. Founded in 2012 by entrepreneur and inventor Andrew Paradise, Skillz built the category from scratch: the patented matchmaking, identity, payments, fraud protection, and developer tools that make fair, real-stakes competition possible at scale. 

Skillz hosts billions of casual mobile gaming tournaments for millions of players worldwide and is revolutionizing the gaming industry. By fostering social competition within games, the Skillz platform helps developers build multi-million dollar franchises by enabling real-money activity in their games and providing operational support while connecting players through fair, enjoyable, and meaningful competition. 

Today, Skillz is part of FIRY - a global holding company operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Alongside RZR, our AI-driven ad network, and Beamable, our backend and LiveOps platform, Skillz sits at the center of a compounding data flywheel that no standalone competitor can replicate. 800, 000+ daily tournaments. $7. 5 billion in lifetime prizes paid to players. 90 million registered users. 

Key Competencies

Industry Background: 

7-10 years total engineering experience with at least 2 years in a people-management or tech-lead role. Prior experience building consumer mobile apps in online gaming, RMG, or casual gaming is strongly preferred. 

Team Building & Scaling: Proven ability to hire, onboard, and ramp engineering teams from scratch (4-6 engineers, frontend-heavy with backend support). Experience conducting technical interviews, defining leveling frameworks, and building team culture in a fast-growing startup environment. 

Technical Depth - Frontend / Mobile (primary): Deep hands-on experience with React Native and React/TypeScript in production consumer apps. Strong understanding of RN internals (New Architecture, Hermes, native modules and bridging for iOS/Android), app performance (cold start, memory, bundle size, rendering), state management, and React Native for Web. Experience with server-driven UI, modular / shared component architectures, and app-store release management is a strong plus. 

Technical Depth - Full Stack (secondary): Solid working knowledge of backend services and API design (REST/GraphQL, Node. js or JVM-based services), databases and caching, and how client and server contracts evolve with backward compatibility. Ability to make sound system design and build-vs-reuse decisions across client and server. 

Delivery & Execution: Track record of shipping product features on time in agile environments, including mobile release trains, staged rollouts and hotfixes. Comfortable owning sprint planning, capacity allocation, technical debt management, and release processes. Can balance speed-to-market with code quality. 

Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience partnering with Product, Design, LiveOps, Content, Analytics and platform teams to translate roadmap priorities into engineering plans. Ability to push back on scope, negotiate timelines, and communicate technical constraints to non-technical stakeholders. 

Quality & Reliability Ownership: Experience owning client and platform reliability: CI/CD for mobile, automated testing, crash reporting and monitoring, incident response, and on-call rotations. Understanding of security best practices for payment-adjacent flows (deposits, KYC, wallet). 

Startup Mindset: Comfortable with ambiguity, context-switching between high-priority initiatives (codebase merge, growth features, game integrations, meta features), and making pragmatic build-vs-reuse decisions with limited resources. 

People Management Expectations

- Hire, retain, and develop the careers of the engineers on your team. 
 - Coach and motivate your team to ensure high productivity and teamwork, and help each individual achieve their potential. 
 - Encourage and drive initiatives that promote innovation and technical excellence. 
 - Interface with other internal teams to prioritize features and functionality based on resources available and business priorities. 
 - Clearly communicate any risk areas to upper management and come up with risk mitigation plans. 
 - Experience building relationships and influencing stakeholders across multiple disciplines, including communicating highly technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 - Work with Product Leadership and core engineering teams to develop and track detailed schedules, dependencies, and critical paths. 
 - Collaborate effectively with all project stakeholders, including Product Management, Finance, Data teams, etc. 

Experience

- 7-10 years total engineering experience with 2+ years as Engineering Manager or Tech Lead. 
 - Hands-on production experience with React Native and React/TypeScript (frontend / mobile), with working experience on backend services (Node. js or JVM) and API design. 
 - Has shipped and scaled a consumer mobile app on iOS and Android, including app-store release management and performance optimisation. 
 - Proven track record of hiring and ramping engineering teams from scratch (4-6 engineers, frontend-heavy). 
 - Experience designing scalable client architectures, reviewing code, and maintaining high-quality standards across engineering teams. 
 - Background in the gaming industry (online gaming, RMG, or casual gaming) is strongly preferred. Experience with Unity or embedding games in a host app is a plus. 
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD (e. g. , GitHub Actions / Fastlane / Jenkins), crash reporting and monitoring tools, and cloud infrastructure (AWS). 
 - Understanding of security best practices for payment-adjacent flows (deposits, wallet, KYC data handling). 
 - Strong tenure in past roles (2+ years per role) with a consistent track record of career progression and team impact. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience. 

Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

 - Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Temporal, AWS Step Functions, Airflow, or similar). 
 - Experience debugging production issues end to end, from symptom to root cause, fix, and prevention. 
 - Experience working on async or integration-heavy systems, including retries, timeouts, idempotency, and workflow/state handling. 
 - Strong testing and release-validation discipline in environments where engineers own quality directly. 
 - Experience with observability and operational ownership, including dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and participation in on-call support. 
 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce. 
 - Enough exposure to React/Next. js or frontend web applications to review, unblock, or make architecture calls on frontend work - not necessarily hands-on daily, but enough to lead engineers who have full-stack reach. 

Leadership & Scope

- Has owned a team's delivery rhythm - breaking epics into milestones, spotting cross-team delivery risk weeks before it becomes a miss - not just their own workstream.

 - Has reviewed, unblocked, or made architecture decisions on frontend/web work, or has managed engineers who were themselves frontend or full-stack.

About the Role: 

GSK's Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering leads the FDE function - the front of the Enterprise AI delivery pipeline that proves AI ideas with the business through PoCs, PoVs, MVPs and (where appropriate) first production versions, before handing proven solutions off to the Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies - Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI - and this role brings that model to GSK. 

This Staff role leads the Forward Deployed Engineering function with direct line management of the FDE team (Lead, Senior, and Forward Deployed Engineers, flat reporting structure). The Staff sets FDE strategy and engagement priorities, owns Director-level BU sponsor relationships, and represents Enterprise AI on FDE matters to GSK leadership. The role continues to contribute technically at the frontier of AI-augmented engineering - humans steer, agents execute. 

Why This Role Exists: 

Enterprise AI's ability to build credibility with the business depends on engineers who can land inside BU problems, prove value quickly, and hand off cleanly. The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering builds and leads the function that makes this happen. 

- Leads the FDE function - setting strategy, building the team, and owning the standards that determine whether the function delivers credibly. 
 - Owns the BU senior relationships that bring AI use cases to Enterprise AI and sustain engagement through the delivery cycle. 
 - Continues to contribute technically on the most strategic FDE engagements - keeping the Director's judgement grounded in current AI engineering reality. 

Key Responsibilities: 

FDE Function Leadership: 

- Lead the Forward Deployed Engineering function - strategy, structure, hiring, development, and standards. 
 - Hire, mentor, and develop the FDE team - creating development paths from G8 through to G5. 
 - Set the standards for AI-native engineering practice within the function - agent workflows, prompt and pattern libraries, handoff hygiene. 

BU Engagement & Strategic Delivery: 

- Own relationships with Director and Senior Director-level BU sponsors across business units that bring AI use cases to Enterprise AI. 
 - Take on the most strategic FDE engagements personally - the ones that set precedents for the function. 
 - Make and defend portfolio-level kill/continue decisions across FDE engagements with BU and Enterprise AI leadership. 

Cross-Functional Leadership: 

- Coordinate with the Solutions Engineering and Operations Engineering functions on the delivery pipeline; represent FDE in Enterprise AI leadership forums. 
 - Influence vendor strategy and tooling choices for AI-native engineering practice within Enterprise AI. 

Governance & Reporting: 

- Ensure the FDE function operates within Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report governance from the prototype stage onward. 
 - Provide regular reporting to Enterprise AI leadership on FDE function performance - engagement pipeline, outcomes, team development, and capacity. 

Required Functional Experience: 

- At least 18+ years of experience in software engineering and AI/ML engineering, with significant time leading senior engineering teams or functions. 
 - Demonstrated experience taking AI ideas from sketch to working software at speed, in customer-facing engineering roles. 
 - Strong technical depth in GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, and evaluation. 
 - Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development. 
 - Experience hiring, mentoring, and developing senior engineering talent. 
 - Track record of representing engineering functions to senior business stakeholders. 

Preferred Experience: 

- Prior leadership experience at an AI-native company (Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI, or similar) - Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, Director of Solutions, or equivalent. 
 - Experience in regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, financial services). 
 - Experience setting AI engineering standards at organisational scale. 

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master's degree/ Ph D in Computer Science, Mathematics or statistics or related field is advantageous. 

Skills

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Artificial Intelligence Ethics, Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS), Classification Models, Deep Learning, Intelligent Automation (IA), Machine Learning (ML), Model Evaluation, Predictive Modeling, Python (Programming Language), Test Documentation

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
