data.title: GenAI Platform Engineer – LLM Gateway
data.description:
Role Summary

The GenAI Platform Engineering team builds and runs the shared platform that lets Pfizer colleagues and applications use generative AI safely and at scale. At its core is the enterprise GenAI Gateway: a single, governed entry point to large language models from multiple providers, with self-service access, routing, usage and cost transparency, and observability built in. Around it, we deliver evaluation, observability and agentic tooling - MCP integrations, agent registries and reusable agent skills - for teams across the company. 

We run the platform as a product: self-service over tickets, automation over manual approvals, small and frequent releases, and reliability we can measure. We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help evolve the Gateway and its ecosystem. You will keep it secure, fast and current in a fast-moving open-source landscape. You will work closely with a globally distributed team and with the teams that build on the platform. 

This is an individual contributor role. 

Role Responsibilities

Platform engineering

- Design, build and operate features of the enterprise LLM gateway, mainly in Python: 
 - multi-provider model access
 - routing and failover
 - API key and access management
 - budgets, usage metering and chargeback
 - Integrate agentic capabilities into the platform with the right security controls. Examples include Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool calling across providers, and agent-to-agent connectivity. 
 - Keep the platform's open-source foundations current. Assess upstream releases, maintain and retire Pfizer-specific extensions, and deliver upgrades without regressions. 
 - Contribute to the platform's admin and self-service experiences, including web UI, portals and developer documentation. 

Quality, reliability and security

- Build and maintain automated quality gates in CI/CD. These include unit, integration, contract and performance/load tests that protect every release. 
 - Instrument services with metrics, traces and logs (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Langfuse). Use them to find and fix latency, error and cost issues. 
 - Take part in the support/on-call rotation. Lead root-cause analysis of production incidents, and turn the findings into lasting fixes and blameless postmortems. 
 - Apply secure-by-default engineering: 
 - identity and access controls (SSO, OAuth 2. 0/OIDC, RBAC)
 - secret handling
 - dependency pinning and supply-chain hygiene
Enablement and collaboration

- Evaluate emerging GenAI capabilities hands-on, such as model routing, guardrails and agent registries. Turn the results into clear recommendations on whether to adopt them. 
 - Help consuming teams onboard and succeed. Write guides and runbooks, and create reusable assets such as code samples and AI agent skills. 
 - Work in the open. Make InnerSource contributions, review code, and engage with open-source communities and vendors by reporting issues and proposing fixes upstream. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building GenAI/LLM-based applications or platforms used in production. 
 - Strong Python skills for backend services: async programming, FastAPI or similar, REST APIs and streaming responses. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM provider APIs (e. g. , OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), including tool/function calling and integrating multiple providers. 
 - Experience delivering and running services on AWS with containers and CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Docker, GitHub Actions), with automated testing built into the workflow. 
 - Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with distributed, cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with an AI/LLM gateway or API gateway, including routing, key management and cost tracking. 
 - Experience running and extending open-source software in production, including patches, upgrades, regression testing and upstream contributions. 
 - Knowledge of agentic AI patterns and tooling: 
 - MCP
 - LangGraph/LangChain or similar frameworks
 - multi-agent orchestration
 - RAG and vector search
 - Experience with performance/load testing and observability tooling (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Prometheus/Grafana). 
 - Experience with Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). 
 - Frontend skills (React, TypeScript) for internal tools and portals. 
 - Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) and interest in building reusable agent skills. 
 - Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or other regulated environments. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers or delivering technical enablement, such as workshops, documentation and onboarding. 
 - AWS certification. 

WORK SCHEDULE

- Regular collaboration with colleagues in European time zones. 
 - Participation in the team's support rotation. 

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. 

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

data.title: Java Developer – Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka & REST APIs
data.description:
Job Summary

Synechron is seeking a Java Developer with experience in Java, Java EE, Spring Boot, microservices, Kafka, and OBMA-related application environments. 

The role will focus on developing, maintaining, testing, and supporting scalable Java-based applications and services. The position will involve applying web development frameworks, RESTful services, relational databases, SQL, version control, Agile practices, and messaging technologies to deliver maintainable enterprise solutions. 

The role will contribute to business objectives by delivering reliable application features, improving existing functionality, resolving technical issues, supporting scalable services, and maintaining software quality throughout the development lifecycle. 

Software Requirements

Required Software Skills

- Java: Strong programming experience in Java. 
 - Java EE: Strong knowledge of the Java EE platform and enterprise application development. 
 - Spring: Experience with Spring and Spring-based application development. 
 - Spring Boot: Experience developing and maintaining applications and services using Spring Boot. 
 - Microservices: Understanding of microservices architecture and service-based application development. 
 - Kafka: Experience with Kafka-based messaging or event-driven application integration. 
 - OBMA: Experience with OBMA as applicable to the assigned application environment. 
 - Web development frameworks: Experience with Spring, Hibernate, JSF, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Relational databases: Knowledge of relational databases and SQL. 
 - RESTful web services: Understanding and practical experience with RESTful services. 
 - Git: Experience with Git or equivalent version control systems. 
 - Agile methodologies: Familiarity with Agile software development practices. 
 - Software engineering: Ability to write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-documented code. 
 - Debugging: Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical issues. 

Preferred Software Skills

- Experience with additional Java web development frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with event-driven architecture, message processing, and asynchronous communication. 
 - Exposure to automated testing, CI/CD, build, deployment, and application monitoring tools. 
 - Experience with cloud-based application development and deployment. 
 - Familiarity with performance tuning and production application support. 

Version And Experience Guidance

- Specific software versions are not mandated in the requirements. 
 - Candidates should have experience with current, production-supported versions of Java, Java EE, Spring Boot, Kafka, OBMA, Git, SQL, and related frameworks. 
 - Candidates should be able to assess compatibility, support upgrades, follow version-control practices, and maintain application stability. 
 - The requirement details specify at least 3 years. of Java software development. 

Overall Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain Java-based applications and systems. 
 - Design, develop, and support Spring Boot services and microservices. 
 - Implement and maintain Kafka-based messaging and event-driven integrations. 
 - Contribute to application development and support activities involving OBMA. 
 - Develop web applications using Spring, Hibernate, JSF, or related frameworks.

 - Work with relational databases and SQL to support application functionality and data access. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, scalable, reusable, and well-documented code.

 - Identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, maintainability, automation, and sustainable resource use. 
 - Contribute to measurable outcomes such as timely feature delivery, reduced defects, stable application releases, and efficient issue resolution. 

Technical Skills (By Category)

Programming Languages

Essential

- Strong Java programming skills. 
 - Strong understanding of Java EE. 
 - Understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles. 
 - Ability to write modular, reusable, scalable, testable, and maintainable code. 
 - Ability to develop Java services, application components, integrations, and supporting utilities. 

Preferred

- Experience with additional programming or scripting languages used in enterprise application development. 
 - Familiarity with asynchronous, event-driven, or distributed application development.

Databases/Data Management

Essential

- Knowledge of relational databases. 
 - Strong working knowledge of SQL. 
 - Understanding of tables, relationships, joins, indexes, constraints, transactions, and data integrity. 
 - Ability to develop, analyze, and optimize SQL queries. 
 - Ability to integrate Java applications with relational databases. 
 - Understanding of secure data access and appropriate data-handling practices. 

Preferred

- Experience with database performance tuning and query optimization. 
 - Exposure to stored procedures, database validation, migration, and data-integrity testing. 
 - Familiarity with additional database technologies. 
 - Understanding of data retention, backup, recovery, and lifecycle considerations. 

Cloud Technologies

Essential

- Understanding of application deployment and support across development, testing, and production environments. 
 - Understanding of application scalability, availability, configuration, and operational support. 
 - Ability to work with environment-specific settings, service integrations, and application dependencies. 

Preferred

- Exposure to cloud-based application development and deployment.

 - Understanding of cloud resource optimization and sustainable application operations. 
 - Experience supporting distributed or hybrid application environments. 

Frameworks and Libraries

Essential

 - Kafka messaging and event-integration capabilities. 
 - OBMA-related application technologies, as applicable to the assigned environment.

Preferred

- Libraries supporting messaging, caching, logging, monitoring, and observability. 
 - Frameworks supporting automated testing and application performance monitoring. 
 - Exposure to cloud-native application frameworks. 
 - Technologies supporting asynchronous processing and event-driven architecture. 

Development Tools and Methodologies

Essential

- Git or equivalent version control system. 
 - Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies. 
 - Experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and support. 
 - Experience participating in code reviews and applying coding standards.

 - Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments. 
 - Experience with automated unit, integration, and regression testing. 
 - Familiarity with Agile ceremonies, iterative planning, and continuous improvement. 
 - Exposure to application monitoring, logging, and production support processes. 

Security Protocols

Essential

- Understanding of secure software development practices. 
 - Knowledge of application authentication, authorization, access controls, and secure configuration. 
 - Ability to apply input validation, output validation, secure API practices, and appropriate error handling. 
 - Understanding of secure database access and protection of sensitive information.

Preferred

- Familiarity with secure RESTful service implementation. 
 - Exposure to encryption, secrets management, security testing, and audit logging. 
 - Experience integrating security checks into development and deployment processes. 
 - Knowledge of secure Kafka configuration, message protection, and service-to-service access controls. 

Experience Requirements

 - Java experience: Strong hands-on experience with Java and Java EE applications. 
 - Framework experience: Experience with Spring, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JSF, or equivalent Java web development frameworks.

 - Delivery experience: Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies, Git, code reviews, testing, and application support. 
 - Industry preference: Experience delivering enterprise-scale, business-critical, secure, or highly available applications is preferred. 
 - Alternative experience pathways: Equivalent combinations of relevant Java development experience, technical training, substantial application delivery, open-source contributions, or demonstrable production implementations may be considered. 
 - Outcome evidence: Candidates should demonstrate contributions to timely feature delivery, improved code quality, stable application releases, reduced defects, successful issue resolution, or maintainable software solutions. 

Day-to-Day Activities

- Develop, enhance, test, debug, and maintain Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Kafka integrations, RESTful services, database components, and OBMA-related application functionality. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams through requirements discussions, technical design sessions, Agile meetings, code reviews, testing activities, and release planning.

 - Make technical decisions within the assigned scope and escalate risks related to application quality, security, performance, maintainability, delivery timelines, and operational support. 

Qualifications

 - At least 3 years of experience in Java software development. 
 - Demonstrated experience with Java, Java EE, Spring Boot, microservices, Kafka, OBMA, relational databases, SQL, RESTful web services, and Git. 
 - Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies and experience developing clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-documented code. 
 - Commitment to continuous professional development through training, technical experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continued learning in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Kafka, databases, APIs, security, and modern software engineering. 

Professional Competencies

- Applies structured problem-solving to analyze requirements, investigate defects, debug complex issues, and implement maintainable solutions. 
 - Works effectively with cross-functional teams and contributes to collaborative development, code reviews, testing, and delivery activities. 
 - Communicates technical information clearly through documentation, design discussions, code reviews, status updates, and stakeholder interactions. 
 - Adapts to changing business requirements, technologies, messaging patterns, application dependencies, and delivery priorities through continuous learning. 
 - Identifies practical opportunities to improve code quality, application performance, messaging reliability, maintainability, security, automation, and sustainable resource use. 
 - Manages multiple tasks effectively, prioritizes work, maintains attention to detail, meets deadlines, and remains focused during time-sensitive delivery or support activities.

About Titan

At Titan, we're redefining email for entrepreneurs, innovators, and creators-transforming it into a powerful tool for business growth. Built by a team that deeply cares about helping businesses succeed, Titan is more than just an email platform.

At Titan, backend engineers aren't just writing APIs-they're solving complex, real-world problems. We emphasize: 

- Scale & Performance: Every system is built to scale infinitely. 
 - Stability & Quality: Every system we build is engineered for resilience. 
 - Beyond Features: We follow coding standards, do unit-testing and review our code constantly. Unlike large engineering teams where individual impact can get diluted, every engineer here contributes meaningfully.

- Design and build scalable, high-performance backend systems, following coding principles such as modularity, extensibility, abstraction, and separation of concerns.

 - Monitor system performance, track relevant metrics, and implement alerts to improve reliability. 
 - Collaborate across functions- we believe the best idea wins, no matter where it comes from.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Postgres & Python)
data.description:
About us

We're the team behind Ikka Dukka, a Delhi-based premium gifting and lifestyle brand. We've delivered corporate campaigns of 1 to 20, 000+ pieces for companies in banking, finance, tech and real estate. 

Out of that work we're building a separate B2B software platform. A working version is built and being prepared for its first corporate clients. It was built quickly with AI coding tools, and it works. We now need an engineer to take it over, make it solid and launch it. 

The platform lets companies run recurring and large-scale gifting programmes end to end: recipient data, gift selection, orders, inventory, dispatch tracking, exceptions and reporting. For clients, it saves money (less admin, fewer failed deliveries, less waste) and makes money (programmes that keep customers and employees engaged, and data on what works). Full product details are shared with shortlisted candidates under NDA. 

The role

You'll own the platform's technology. Not a list of tickets: the technical roadmap, the weak spots, what to fix, what to leave alone and what to build next. 

This isn't a role for an "AI expert. " The value is in the data and workflow. We need a strong engineer who uses AI coding tools every day to move fast, and who can tell when generated code is insecure, inefficient or simply wrong. Some features call an LLM, so you'll need to ship those safely. No machine-learning background is needed. 

The stack is a React and Python platform on Postgres, with a lot of logic in the database itself. 

You'll work directly with our product owner (co-founder), an experienced technical advisor who reviews architecture and security at key points, and the founders and operations team. No layers of management. 

What you'll work on first

- Getting to know the platform and making it secure and reliable, including fixing the biggest risks in security, data handling and testing
 - Setting up proper testing and staging, and proving the platform works at real campaign volumes
 - Getting it ready to launch with our first corporate clients, including keeping each client's data separateOngoing

- Own the technical roadmap and drive development without waiting to be told
 - Turn business needs into practical technical solutions
 - Build and ship across backend, database, frontend and integrations (couriers, Shopify, client data files)
 - Run the system in production: hosting, backups, monitoring, fixing issues
 - Keep client data separate and secure, in line with India's DPDP Act
 - Keep the codebase clean and documented, so a second engineer could join without a rewriteMust have

- 3-6 years building, shipping and running web applications with real users (exceptional candidates outside this range considered)
 - Deep PostgreSQL: row-level security, database functions, and migrations on a live database without losing data. This is the most important skill for the role
 - Strong backend development, API integrations and modern deployment; Python a plus
 - Comfortable building frontend screens in React
 - You've owned a product or major system, not just worked on tickets inside one
 - You've debugged production failures and can explain what went wrong
 - You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) daily, and know when not to trust them
 - Sound security judgement: authentication, permissions, secrets, customer data
 - Multi-tenant experience, or a clear understanding of how to keep each client's data separate
 - You'd rather improve an existing codebase than rewrite it, and you're comfortable working without someone reviewing every change
 - Clear communication with non-technical peopleParticularly valuable

- Supabase or FastAPI experience
 - Shipping LLM features in production: cost limits, prompt injection, what data goes to the provider
 - B2B SaaS; Shopify, logistics or CRM integrations
 - Enterprise security reviews, data-protection compliance, or regulated clients such as banks
 - Early-stage startup experienceApply  with your CV, links to things you've built, and a short note on how you use AI tools, including one time the AI got it wrong. 

Location based in Delhi.

data.title: SDE 2
data.description:
We build Intellishala, a school platform for CBSE classrooms in Grades 9-12: an NCERT-grounded AI tutor, a question bank, online tests, and class analytics for teachers and admins. It is live with real students and teachers in pilot schools in Himachal Pradesh and we are onboarding more schools for the April 2027 session. 

The role

SDE 2, backend and platform. Full-time, remote in India. 

Today one person approves every pull request, runs every migration and runs every production deployment. This role exists so that two people can. You will own the server side of Intellishala and, after a supervised ramp, run production evenings yourself. 

What you'll do: 

- Build the tooling for a school's session start: roster upload with a dry-run preview, class archiving and year rollover. This is your first project and it has an April deadline. 
 - Write additive migrations, rehearse them on staging, and write the runbook that production follows. 
 - Review and approve pull requests, including code produced by AI coding tools, which we use under strict written rules. Reviewing what the tool wrote is the job; trusting it is not. 
 - Harden ops: guarded scripts, error handling, monitoring, incident fixes. 
 - Build the backend behind the mobile apps so the frontend engineer stays on the apps. What we work with: TypeScript, Next. js (App Router), Prisma, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Vercel, OpenAI APIs. 

You should have

- 3-5 years building and running production web services, with at least one you were responsible for after launch. You have broken production and can tell us what you changed afterwards. 
 - TypeScript in production and Next. js App Router (server components, route handlers, server actions). 
 - Real PostgreSQL: SQL you write yourself, indexes, transactions, row-level security, plus an ORM (ideally Prisma). 
 - Auth you can explain: sessions versus tokens, refresh and revocation, OAuth with Microsoft or Google, rate limiting. 
 - The habit of writing things down: migrations, runbooks, decisions. 
 - Notice period of 30 days or less

data.title: Manager, Quality
data.description:
Nordson India is seeking an experienced Quality Manager to lead the Quality function for its manufacturing operations in Bangalore. 

This position will serve as the site quality leader and independent voice of the customer, with responsibility for supplier quality, incoming inspection, in-process quality, final inspection and testing, customer quality, and the effectiveness of the site Quality Management System. 

The successful candidate will establish a prevention-focused and data-driven quality operating system that ensures product conformity, strengthens supplier and process capability, improves customer satisfaction, and reduces Cost of Poor Quality. The role will lead ISO 9001 compliance, quality audits, APQP and PPAP activities, PFMEA and Control Plan deployment, nonconformance management, corrective actions, customer complaint resolution, supplier development, and Zero Defect initiatives.

data.title: Sr. Functional Consultant- App Services (Business Analyst- QA)
data.description:
Key Skills: Business Analysis, Quality Assurance, SQL, Customer-Facing, Functional Consultant

Seeking a customer-facing Functional Consultant with 5-7 years of experience in business analysis, requirements management, testing, and enterprise SaaS implementations who can drive requirements-to-release delivery and partner closely with customers, business stakeholders, and engineering teams

Build What Matters At Model N

At Model N, we help life sciences companies solve complex revenue challenges so they can operate smarter and bring important innovations to market faster. We are looking for people who like practical problem solving, cross-functional work, and seeing the impact of what they build. 

If you are energized by turning complex business requirements into working solutions for life sciences customers, this could be a great fit. 

About The Role

We are looking for a Sr. App Services Functional Consultant to join our Life Sciences Application Services team. In this role, you will own requirements and testing for life sciences application implementations, from business analysis through release readiness. You will work closely with business stakeholders, development teams, and customers to help Model N deliver solutions that meet business objectives and quality standards. 

This role matters because customers depend on well-defined, well-tested solutions to bring innovations to market, and strong requirements and quality work is what makes that possible. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own requirements elicitation and documentation, analyzing business processes and running reviews through approval and sign-off so solutions match business objectives. 
 - Translate approved requirements into clear, actionable solutions that development teams can build against. 
 - Own test planning and execution, including test case development, defect management, fix validation, and support for regression and UAT, so solutions meet functional and quality standards before release. 
 - Drive end-to-end ownership of project deliverables, coordinating stakeholder communication across requirements, UAT, and training. 
 - Manage live production issues and support implementation cycles to keep customer rollouts on track. 

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

- Learn Model N's life sciences applications, implementation methodology, and team processes. 
 - Build working relationships with key business stakeholders and development partners. 
 - Take ownership of requirements and test activities on at least one active project. 

First 6-12 months

- Consistently deliver requirements and test cycles that clear review and sign-off without rework. 
 - Lead UAT and release readiness for implementation cycles, with fewer defects reaching production. 
 - Become a trusted point of contact for customers and internal teams on requirements and quality. 

How You Will Grow And Make An Impact

At Model N, our competency model helps us talk about growth, impact, and how work gets done. 

- SME skills - You deepen your expertise and begin sharing knowledge with others, through requirements templates and test practices. 
 - Problem-Solving skills- You solve complex problems such as tracing a production defect back to its root requirement or test gap. 
 - Decision Making skills- You provide credible insights that influence team decisions, such as flagging design risks in requirement reviews before they reach development. 
 - Solutioning skills- You identify opportunities and drive improvements, such as tightening how requirements and test cases are created and be a part of solutioning. 
 - Delivery Skills- You consistently deliver strong outcomes across requirements, testing with quality
 - AI skills - You apply AI to improve efficiency, quality, and execution, such as supporting requirements analysis, test design, and defect triage. 

We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing. 

Job Qualifications

Required

- Typically 5-7 years of relevant experience. 
 - Hands-on experience with business systems, enterprise applications, and testing methodologies, including at least 2 years in implementation, development, or quality assurance. 
 - Experience gathering, documenting, and validating business and functional requirements, including facilitating reviews and sign-offs. 
 - Experience designing, executing, and maintaining test cases and a Requirements Traceability Matrix, including supporting regression, UAT, and test cycle planning. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and SDLC best practices, with proficiency in UML. 
 - Customer-facing project leadership experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools (e. g. , ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to improve productivity, decision-making, or problem solving in a professional or personal context. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

Preferred

- Practical experience applying AI tools across the QA lifecycle, such as requirements analysis, test design, automation support, defect triage, and root cause analysis preparation. 
 - Experience delivering formal presentations tailored to different audiences. 
 - Experience with enterprise software implementations in life sciences, SaaS, or PE-backed companies. 
 - Interest in leveraging AI, automation, or modern technologies to improve outcomes. 

How We Work

Our DARE core values - DREAM, ALIGN, RESPECT, and EXCEL - shape how we work together. 

- We solve practical problems that matter to our customers and teams. 
 - We work across functions and value clear, respectful communication. 
 - We recognize good work and support growth over time. 
 - We are curious about better ways to work, including thoughtful use of AI and modern tools. 

We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing. 

Compensation, Benefits, And Inclusion

At Model N, your well-being and growth matter. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support employees personally and professionally. 

Benefits and compensation for this position will be provided in accordance with Model N's India programs and applicable local requirements. 

Bring Your N Factor

We are not just looking for a checklist of skills. We are looking for people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a point of view. 

If this role sounds interesting and you can see yourself adding value, we would love to hear from you.

data.description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Life & Environmental Sciences Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across biology, ecology, environmental science, and life science AI training projects. You will review AI-generated life/environmental science content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for scientific accuracy, biological reasoning, ecological context, environmental systems thinking, terminology quality, data interpretation, safety awareness, clarity, formatting, instruction-following, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong life/environmental science expertise, strong English communication skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote science-focused teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your life and environmental sciences quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that science training data is accurate, evidence-aware, environmentally contextualized, clearly explained, and aligned with client expectations. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check life and environmental science items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Scientific review: Evaluate AI-generated biology, ecology, environmental science, sustainability, conservation, climate, and life science explanations for accuracy, clarity, and scientific rigor. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, quality expectations, and life/environmental-science-specific review standards. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around biological concepts, ecosystems, environmental systems, data interpretation, sustainability claims, safety, and rubric interpretation. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain life/environmental sciences project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, calibration tasks, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and scientific review requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply life and environmental science guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Risk review: Flag misleading environmental claims, unsupported health/ecology statements, unsafe experiment or field recommendations, flawed data interpretation, or overconfident scientific claims. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for life and environmental science AI training projects. 
 - Native fluency in Punjabi

Your Profile

- Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, or equivalent professional experience in Biology, Environmental Science, Ecology, Conservation Biology, Earth Science, Public Health, Agriculture, Marine Science, Sustainability, Life Sciences, or a related field. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear written feedback. 
 - 3+ years of experience in life science research, environmental science, teaching, fieldwork, lab work, conservation, sustainability, science communication, academic review, or related scientific workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of biology, ecology, ecosystems, biodiversity, evolution, genetics, physiology, environmental systems, climate change, pollution, conservation, sustainability, and scientific methods. 
 - Ability to evaluate life/environmental science content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as incorrect biological claims, oversimplified ecological relationships, unsupported environmental claims, flawed causal reasoning, unsafe recommendations, or misleading data interpretation. 
 - Familiarity with tools or methods such as field sampling, lab methods, ecological surveys, environmental impact assessment, GIS, statistics, climate/environmental datasets, literature review, or scientific visualization is preferred. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of researchers, educators, reviewers, environmental specialists, annotators, trainers, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, calibration tasks, and documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, LLM evaluation, scientific QA, environmental content review, academic review, or rubric-based review is a strong plus.

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. 

If you like what we're saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and evolve the quality strategy for this product. The product's risk sits in cross-service behavior - where agent runs, tool calls, external integrations, and cloud infrastructure meet. The role blends hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features and AI behavior with designing and building the automated test system - acceptance, integration, contract, and post-deployment validation - that lets the team ship quickly without breaking critical engineering workflows. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a QA Automation Engineer on this team, you will: 

Test strategy and hands-on testing

- Define and own the product's test strategy across unit, functional, integration, acceptance, post-deployment, and exploratory testing. 
 - Perform hands-on manual and exploratory testing of new features, AI-agent behavior, and edge cases before and alongside automation. 
 - Design approaches for testing non-deterministic AI/LLM behavior, tool-use correctness, and prompt regressions. 

Automated coverage

- Build browser-level acceptance tests that cover key user journeys end to end, from the UI down to persistence and background processing. 
 - Create validation for MCP endpoints, including authentication flows, client compatibility, and tool schemas. 
 - Design contract and replay-based tests for critical external integrations where live systems are slow, expensive, or unstable. 
 - Strengthen test coverage for the highest-risk execution surfaces: sandboxed code execution and the agent's remote sessions on user machines. 

Release confidence and test infrastructure

- Add post-deployment smoke tests that catch environment, configuration, and identity failures, giving rollback confidence. 
 - Introduce failure-injection scenarios - service restarts, network loss, expired tokens, rate limits - to prove the product degrades gracefully. 
 - Improve test data, fixtures, fake connectors, and CI test categorization; manage flaky tests and keep pipelines fast and trustworthy. 

Collaboration and quality leadership

- Partner with engineers to make features testable and define acceptance criteria before implementation; mentor the team in testing practices. 
 - Monitor quality signals from CI, static analysis, telemetry, production incidents, and user feedback, and build release-readiness reporting. 

What We Value

- Must have strong C#/. NET test development skills: xUnit/NUnit-style frameworks, mocks and fakes, test fixtures, and CI integration
 - 6+ years of experience in quality engineering / test automation for complex web and API platforms. 
 - Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. We expect you to be strong in several of the following and interested in learning the rest: 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. 
 - Solid experience with API and integration testing, including authentication and distributed-system failure modes. 
 - Experience with browser automation such as Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent. 
 - Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, and the ability to design test strategies rather than only execute predefined cases. 
 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, test categorization, flaky-test management, and post-deployment smoke testing. 
 - Ability to investigate failures using logs, traces, telemetry, screenshots, and reproducible minimal scenarios. 
 - Experience testing AI/LLM products, agentic workflows, streaming responses, or other non-deterministic behavior is a strong advantage. 
 - At least 1 year of hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex in your daily work. 
 - Familiarity with open-source agents (e. g. , OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, or similar) and how they behave in practice. 
 - Passion for the AI space and the flexibility to try new technologies: you stay on top of market trends and bring the ecosystem's best practices - better memory, context management, and agent autonomy - into how we build and test the product. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux and containerized environments (Docker), enough to test and investigate sandboxed code execution, is a strong advantage. 
 - Experience with Test containers, contract testing, Azure identity, or Windows automation is a plus. 
 - Proven ability to lead quality direction, influence engineers, and raise the testing bar across a team. 
 - Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. 

Benefits

- Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference. 
 - Culture - Inclusive and diverse company culture. 
 - Work-life balance - We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace. 
 - Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes. 
 - Career & Growth - Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take. 

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. 

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks. 

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone's experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated. 

WHO WE ARE?

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world's leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3, 000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. 

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

data.description:
Job Summary

This hybrid role seeks a Lead Quality Engineer with eight to twelve years of experience to own end to end quality engineering for complex applications using Playwright TypeScript and RestAssured within a property and casualty insurance environment ensuring resilient solutions high test coverage and consistent delivery quality for day shift projects without travel requirements. 

Responsibilities

- Drive the overall quality engineering strategy for web and service applications by defining clear objectives and quality gates that align with business goals in property and casualty insurance projects. 
 - Design robust automated test frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript to validate complex user journeys across multiple browsers and environments with high reliability. 
 - Develop and maintain scalable RestAssured based test suites for validating application programming interfaces that support core insurance policy and claims functions. 
 - Create comprehensive test plans and detailed test cases covering functional regression integration and end to end scenarios tailored to insurance products and workflows. 
 - Coordinate with product owners business analysts and engineering teams to clarify requirements and translate them into testable acceptance criteria focused on customer outcomes. 
 - Review application architecture and data flows within insurance systems to identify high risk areas and define appropriate testing depth and coverage. 
 - Implement robust continuous testing practices by integrating automated suites into continuous integration pipelines to ensure rapid and reliable feedback to development teams. 
 - Monitor and analyze test execution results to identify patterns root causes and emerging quality risks and propose actionable mitigation steps. 
 - Guide engineering peers in effective test design techniques such as boundary value analysis decision tables and data driven testing for complex insurance rules. 
 - Define and track quality metrics such as defect leakage test coverage stability of automation suites and time to detect issues to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Prepare clear test summary reports and risk assessments for stakeholders highlighting impacts on policy issuance claims processing billing and customer experience. 
 - Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure that testing practices align with regulatory expectations for property and casualty insurance operations. 
 - Mentor team members in modern quality engineering practices including automation first mindset shift left testing and effective use of Playwright TypeScript and RestAssured. 
 - Drive initiatives to improve test data management by defining reusable anonymized datasets that accurately represent diverse insurance scenarios and edge cases. 
 - Coordinate defect triage discussions with cross functional teams to prioritize issues based on business impact ensuring that critical defects in policy and claims flows are resolved promptly. 
 - Optimize test execution efficiency by identifying redundant cases refactoring fragile scripts and adopting parallel execution strategies across environments. 
 - Partner with infrastructure teams to ensure that test environments are stable representative and adequately instrumented for observability and debugging. 
 - Engage in exploratory testing sessions focused on complex insurance scenarios to uncover usability issues workflow gaps and unexpected behaviors. 
 - Provide input into release readiness decisions by summarizing quality risks residual defects and areas requiring additional monitoring in production. 
 - Drive adoption of best practices in code reviews for test automation assets ensuring maintainability readability and consistency across frameworks. 
 - Identify opportunities to use service virtualization and mocks for dependent services to reduce environmental constraints and improve automation reliability. 
 - Participate in backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies to ensure that quality considerations and testing efforts are accurately estimated and planned. 
 - Influence tool selection and quality processes by evaluating emerging frameworks and approaches that can enhance coverage and productivity for hybrid teams. 
 - Engage with business stakeholders to explain quality findings in non technical language connecting defects and risks to real customer and agent impacts. 
 - Encourage a culture of shared responsibility for quality where developers testers and analysts collaborate closely to prevent defects rather than only detect them. 
 - Document testing standards guidelines and reusable patterns so that distributed hybrid teams can deliver consistent and repeatable quality outcomes. 
 - Align day to day activities with the organization mission by ensuring that reliable insurance systems enable customers to access protection products and services without disruption. 

Qualifications

- Possess professional experience of eight to twelve years in quality engineering with a clear focus on automation and end to end validation of complex enterprise applications. 
 - Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in designing developing and maintaining Playwright based automation frameworks using TypeScript for user interface testing. 
 - Exhibit proven experience in building RestAssured based test automation for validating application programming interfaces data contracts and integration flows. 
 - Show deep domain understanding of property and casualty insurance including policy underwriting endorsements claims processing and billing workflows. 
 - Apply solid knowledge of software testing principles including different levels of testing test design techniques and risk based testing strategies. 
 - Utilize practical experience with continuous integration tools and version control systems to integrate and manage automated suites as part of the delivery pipeline. 
 - Display strong analytical and problem solving abilities with a focus on root cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions for recurring defects. 
 - Communicate clearly with technical and non technical stakeholders providing concise explanations of risks coverage and test outcomes. 
 - Adapt effectively to a hybrid work model demonstrating self discipline collaboration skills and proactive communication across remote and onsite contexts. 
 - Leverage familiarity with agile methodologies such as scrum or kanban to plan execute and report on testing activities within iterative delivery cycles. 
 - Maintain awareness of security performance and reliability considerations in testing strategies particularly for customer facing insurance applications. 

Certifications Required

Certified Software Quality Engineer CSQE or ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer or equivalent quality engineering certification.

data.title: QA Engineer - Automation and Cloud
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a smart, analytical and technically strong QA Engineer who is passionate about product quality and enjoys solving complex technical problems. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in both manual and automation testing, along with good programming fundamentals and a solid understanding of APIs, backend systems, databases and cloud environments. 

We are not looking for someone who simply executes predefined test cases or raises defects. We want an engineer who thinks critically, understands how applications work internally, investigates issues independently and takes complete ownership of product quality. 

The individual will be responsible for owning the quality of assigned features/modules end-to-end, from understanding requirements and designing test scenarios to automation, debugging, defect investigation and release validation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Manual Testing & Quality Assurance
 - Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and acceptance criteria to develop comprehensive test scenarios. 
 - Design and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory and end-to-end test cases. 
 - Identify edge cases, negative scenarios and potential failure points that may not be explicitly covered in requirements. 
 - Independently own testing activities for assigned features/modules. 
 - Validate complex business workflows, application behaviour and data integrity. 
 - Identify, reproduce, document and investigate defects with clear technical details. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product managers to ensure issues are understood and resolved. 
 - Participate in release validation and provide quality sign-off for assigned modules. 
 - Automation Testing
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts using suitable automation technologies. 
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities and test scripts. 
 - Perform UI automation as well as API automation. 
 - Demonstrate good programming fundamentals, including OOP concepts, functions, data structures, exception handling and scripting. 
 - Maintain automation suites and troubleshoot flaky or inconsistent test cases. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, reliability and execution efficiency. 

Preferred technologies: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pytest, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java. 

Candidates with strong automation fundamentals in one technology should be comfortable transitioning to another. 

- API & Backend Testing
 - Perform comprehensive API testing, including positive, negative, integration and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Validate request/response payloads, headers, authentication, status codes and business logic. 
 - Understand REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS and basic authentication mechanisms. 
 - Investigate issues across frontend, backend and service integration layers. 
 - Understand backend execution flows and dependencies between services. 
 - Read and interpret application code to identify potential root causes of defects. 
 - Database & Data Validation
 - Write SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, aggregations and other data-validation operations. 
 - Validate data consistency and integrity across application layers. 
 - Investigate database-level issues and discrepancies. 
 - Possess a good understanding of relational databases and basic NoSQL concepts. 
 - Independently validate backend data against expected business outcomes. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure Understanding
 - Possess a good understanding of cloud computing fundamentals, preferably AWS and/or Azure. 
 - Understand how applications are deployed and operate in cloud environments. 
 - Analyse application logs, cloud logs and monitoring information to investigate issues. 
 - Understand environment configurations, environment variables, service dependencies and application connectivity. 
 - Possess basic networking knowledge, including DNS, ports, HTTP/HTTPS, timeouts and connectivity. 
 - Have working knowledge of Linux commands and command-line troubleshooting. 
 - Understand Docker fundamentals and container-based application deployment. 
 - Have basic familiarity with Kubernetes concepts. 

The ability to independently investigate application and environment-related failures using logs, configurations and other diagnostic information will be a significant advantage. 

- CI/CD & Engineering Collaboration
 - Understand Git, version control and basic branching workflows. 
 - Understand CI/CD pipelines and investigate automation or pipeline failures. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product managers and DevOps teams. 
 - Independently investigate technical issues before escalating them. 
 - Communicate defects, investigation findings and root-cause observations clearly. 
 - Production & Performance Testing Exposure
 - Participate in investigating production issues by analysing logs and helping identify potential causes. 
 - Understand the importance of application stability, reliability and performance. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6 will be an advantage. 
 - Basic understanding of security testing, authentication, authorization and role-based access control is desirable. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

- 2-4 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance. 
 - Strong fundamentals in manual testing and test case design. 
 - Practical experience in automation testing. 
 - Good programming fundamentals and scripting capabilities in at least one programming language. 
 - Experience with UI and API testing. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON and HTTP protocols. 
 - Good SQL proficiency and understanding of relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Ability to analyse application logs and troubleshoot issues. 
 - Good understanding of backend systems and application architecture. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud environments, preferably AWS or Azure. 
 - Familiarity with Linux, Git, networking and CI/CD fundamentals. 
 - Ability to read application code and independently identify or narrow down potential root causes. 
 - Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving abilities. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on exposure to both AWS and Azure. 
 - Experience with Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Exposure to microservices-based architectures. 
 - Docker and Kubernetes troubleshooting experience. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools. 
 - Exposure to production issue investigation. 
 - Experience improving existing automation frameworks. 

What We Are Looking For

- Someone who is naturally curious, analytical and inquisitive. 
 - Someone who thinks beyond predefined test cases and proactively identifies potential problems. 
 - A debugging-first mindset rather than a ticket-closing mindset. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability for assigned features/modules. 
 - Someone who can investigate problems independently instead of relying on developers for every technical clarification. 
 - An individual who is comfortable reading code, understanding application behaviour and working with backend systems. 
 - Someone who can quickly learn unfamiliar technologies and tools. 
 - A proactive team player with clear communication and collaboration skills. 

About Company

Hi there! We are Auriga IT. We power businesses across the globe through digital experiences, data and insights. From the apps we design to the platforms we engineer, we're driven by an ambition to create world-class digital solutions and make an impact. Our team has been part of building the solutions for the likes of Zomato, Yes Bank, Tata Motors, Amazon, Snapdeal, Ola, Practo, Vodafone, Meesho, Volkswagen, Droom and many more. 

We are a group of people who just could not leave our college-life behind and the inception of Auriga was solely based on a desire to keep working together with friends and enjoying the extended college life. Who Has not dreamt of Working with Friends for a Lifetime. 

Come Join In!

data.title: Assistant Manager/Manager Airside Controls & Automation
data.description:
Role: Assistant Manager/Manager -Airside Controls

Location: Gurgaon, India

Full/ Part-time: Full time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. 

About The Role

This role involves in designing and developing electrical and control systems for AHU units. 

Job Responsibilities

- Design and develop electrical and control systems for Air Handling Units (AHUs) in accordance with project specifications, customer requirements, applicable codes, and engineering standards. 
 - Develop and design electrical control panels, including MCC/control panels, starter panels, VFD/VSD panels, DOL and star-delta starter systems, control transformers, power supplies, protection, switching, and control devices. 
 - Select, specify, and appropriately size electrical and control components, including motors, VFDs, contactors, overload relays, MCBs, MCCBs, fuses, relays, sensors, actuators, terminal blocks, and associated accessories. 
 - Prepare and review electrical schematics, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams (SLDs), panel layouts, and interconnection drawings. 
 - Develop AHU control philosophy and control logic for supply, return, and exhaust fans; fresh-air and return-air dampers; heating and cooling systems; chilled-water valves; electric heaters; humidifiers; filtration systems; and associated monitoring and protection functions. 
 - Develop, configure, program, and troubleshoot microprocessor-based controllers for HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - Configure, program, and troubleshoot temperature, pressure, humidity, airflow, and other process control systems used in HVAC applications. 
 - Select, configure, integrate, and troubleshoot field instrumentation and devices, including temperature, humidity, pressure, differential-pressure, airflow sensors, actuators, valves, and controllers. 
 - Develop and configure HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, control, alarm management, data visualization, and system diagnostics. 
 - Design and implement communication and interface requirements between AHU electrical/control systems and Building Management Systems (BMS) and other HVAC automation platforms. 
 - Perform system integration, functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning of electrical and automation systems. 
 - Diagnose, debug, and optimize existing electrical, control, and automation systems to improve system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Prepare electrical control panel designs using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical engineering design tools, with preference for hands-on experience in panel design documentation. 
 - Perform electrical engineering calculations, including connected load, operating load, cable sizing, protective device selection, breaker ratings, short-circuit ratings, control transformer sizing, and panel ratings. 
 - Ensure all electrical and automation designs comply with applicable IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and other relevant international/local standards, as well as customer and project-specific requirements. 
 - Review and interpret AHU mechanical drawings, equipment layouts, and technical specifications to ensure effective coordination and integration of electrical, mechanical, and control systems. 
 - Prepare and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs), cable schedules, I/O lists, equipment/component specifications, terminal schedules, technical datasheets, and other engineering documentation. 
 - Review customer specifications, tender requirements, approved drawings, and technical submittals, and incorporate relevant requirements and engineering changes into the design. 
 - Coordinate closely with Mechanical Engineering, Controls/Automation, Production, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and Service teams to ensure timely and successful project execution. 
 - Provide technical support to the manufacturing and assembly teams during control panel fabrication, panel wiring, component installation, AHU assembly, and inspection activities. 
 - Provide technical support to the Service and Commissioning teams during site installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer handover. 
 - Conduct design verification, functional testing, electrical testing, and system validation to ensure compliance with design requirements and expected equipment performance. 
 - Investigate electrical, instrumentation, control, and automation-related issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Maintain and control engineering drawings, software programs, technical documentation, revisions, and as-built records for current and future projects. 
 - Support the development and implementation of engineering standards, design guidelines, standard control philosophies, and reusable design solutions for AHU applications. 
 - Identify opportunities for cost optimization, component standardization, design simplification, and product improvement without compromising safety, quality, reliability, or performance. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives related to AHU electrical systems, automation architecture, control logic, panel design, manufacturing processes, and field performance. 

Education Preferred

Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering / Electronics & Electrical engineering, having 7-11 years of work experience in Airside products

Experience Preferred

Design & development experience required as below: 

Ø Essential Competencies/ Primary Skill Set

- Electrical System & Control Panel Design: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in designing electrical systems, control panels, starter panels, MCC panels, and associated control and protection circuits. 
 - AHU/HVAC Electrical & Automation Systems: Sound understanding of electrical, controls, and automation systems used in Air Handling Units (AHUs) and HVAC applications. 
 - Motor Control & Protection: Proficiency in motor starting, control, protection, interlocking, and selection of appropriate protective devices for HVAC and industrial applications. 
 - VFD/VSD Applications: Practical knowledge of Variable Frequency Drives/Variable Speed Drives, including selection, configuration, parameterization, integration, and troubleshooting. 
 - Microprocessor/PLC/DDC-Based Controllers: Knowledge and experience in configuring, programming, integrating, and troubleshooting microprocessor-based, PLC, and DDC controllers used in HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - HVAC Instrumentation & Field Devices: Good understanding of HVAC sensors, transmitters, actuators, control valves, dampers, and other field devices, including their selection, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. 
 - HMI/SCADA Systems: Experience in configuring and troubleshooting HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, process visualization, alarm management, data acquisition, and operational control. 
 - BMS Integration & Communication Protocols: Understanding of BMS integration and industrial communication protocols for seamless communication between AHUs, controllers, field devices, and building automation systems. 
 - Electrical Load & Cable Sizing: Competence in electrical load calculations, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, protective device selection, short-circuit ratings, and control panel sizing. 
 - Electrical Schematics & Panel Documentation: Ability to develop and interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, terminal schedules, and interconnection drawings. 
 - AutoCAD/EPLAN: Proficiency in using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical design software for developing and maintaining electrical drawings and control panel documentation. 
 - System Integration, Testing & Commissioning: Ability to integrate electrical, controls, instrumentation, and automation systems and conduct functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities. 
 - Electrical & Automation Troubleshooting: Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose electrical, instrumentation, control, communication, and automation-related issues and implement effective corrective actions. 
 - Electrical & HVAC Standards: Good working knowledge of relevant electrical and HVAC standards, including IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and applicable customer/project-specific standards and requirements. 
 - Ability to interpret customer specifications and deliver technically sound, compliant engineering solutions
 - Ability to drive cross-functional collaboration (Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Manufacturing, Sourcing) for project execution
 - Good communication skills to manage customer interactions, technical clarifications, and submittal approvals

Ø Desirable Competencies/ Secondary Skill Set

- Experience in handling customer-facing engineering discussions and approvals during project execution
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced ETO/project environment
 - Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment. 
 - Analytical thinking, Problem solving, adaptability and strong communication skills. 
 - Self-starter who can work on his/her own initiative, balance demand load & prioritize

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary. 

- Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
 - Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
 - Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way. 

Join us and make a difference. 

Apply Now!

Job purpose: 

Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing. 

The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments. 

Key competencies

- 8-12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership. 
 - Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure successful project outcomes in Agile environments. 
 - Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification. 
 - Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets. 
 - Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis. 
 - Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms. 
 - Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities. 
 - Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow. 
 - Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios. 
 - Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance. 
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation. 
 - Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)

- Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
 - Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
 - Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms. 
 - Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation. 
 - Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines. 
 - Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform integrations. 
 - Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.
