data.description:
DeepIntent is the leading healthcare marketing platform, purpose-built to help marketers plan, activate, and optimize data-driven campaigns with speed and precision. Trusted by the world's top healthcare brands and their agencies, DeepIntent uniquely unites media, identity, and real-world clinical data to power privacy-safe, omnichannel marketing across every screen. Backed by patented technology and proven outcomes, DeepIntent's platform delivers measurable audience quality and script lift at scale. Learn more at www. deepintent. com. 

What You'll Do

We're hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer, Mobile to be the technical lead for mobile on our AI product experiences team. Hybrid, Pune, India. 

Our newest product is an agentic AI platform for healthcare marketers and their agency teams. Its mobile app is built in React Native for iOS and Android. You'll own how that app is architected, built, signed, tested, released and kept healthy in production. 

This is not a role for a Swift or Kotlin specialist. AI writes much of our code, so what matters most is that you know how mobile apps get built and shipped at quality. You bring the judgment on builds, pipelines, store releases and production health, and you direct AI to do the rest well. 

- Own the mobile architecture of our React Native app: module boundaries, state and data layers, navigation, native module strategy and the path through React Native's New Architecture. 
 - Own the build and release pipeline end to end: Xcode and Gradle builds, code signing and provisioning, environment configs, reproducible builds and mobile CI/CD (such as GitHub Actions, Fastlane, EAS or Bitrise). 
 - Run releases like a product: TestFlight and Play internal tracks, phased and staged rollouts, safe over-the-air updates, versioning and fast rollback. 
 - Own store readiness: App Store and Google Play review, privacy manifests and data safety declarations, with the healthcare data we handle in mind. 
 - Make the app fast and reliable: startup time, app size, memory, frame rate and crash-free sessions, tracked with crash reporting and performance monitoring (such as Sentry or Crashlytics) and clear targets. 
 - Build the mobile experience of an agentic AI product: streaming responses, long-running agent tasks, push notifications that bring users back to results, and human approval before agents act. 
 - Secure the app: enterprise SSO and OAuth/PKCE flows, secure token storage, biometric unlock and tenant-safe handling of sensitive data. 
 - Set the mobile test strategy: unit, component and end-to-end tests (such as Detox or Maestro) on device farms in CI, so issues in AI-generated changes are caught before users see them. 
 - Lead solutioning across squads: write and review design docs, and work with product, design, backend and QA from idea to release. 
 - Set the standard for AI-native mobile development: how engineers use coding agents to build features, native glue code and tests, triage build failures and crash reports, and review AI output. 
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews and pairing. 

Who You Are

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years building and shipping production apps to the App Store and Google Play. 
 - You've owned a production mobile app through major upgrades, not just built screens. 
 - Hands-on mobile build and release experience: you've set up and debugged Xcode and Gradle builds, signing, provisioning profiles, keystores and mobile CI/CD. 
 - You've run apps at scale: staged rollouts, OTA updates, hotfixes, store rejections and the incident when a release goes wrong. 
 - Comfortable reading and changing native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) and Android (Kotlin/Java) code when a native module or build issue demands it. Deep expertise in one platform is a plus, not the bar. 
 - Solid grasp of mobile app architecture and state management, and able to work in TypeScript and React quickly with AI's help. 
 - Experience with mobile observability and performance: crash triage, symbolication, profiling, and startup and app-size budgets. 
 - Strong mobile security and privacy fundamentals: auth flows, secure storage, data in transit and at rest, and store privacy requirements. 
 - Has shipped real mobile work using AI across the SDLC (design, coding, testing, reviews, documentation), not just experimented with it. 
 - Uses agentic coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot) every day and picks up new ones quickly. 
 - Treats AI as a pair programmer and owns the output: reviews, tests and debugs AI-generated code, especially code that touches builds, native layers and user data. "The AI wrote it" is never an excuse. 
 - Understands the security and data-privacy guardrails for using AI tools, given the healthcare data we work with. 
 - Solution-oriented with an open mind: starts from the problem and the user outcome, not the ticket or the habit of hand-writing every line. 
 - Proven ability to lead technical work across teams, influence without direct authority and mentor senior engineers. 
 - A clear communicator who can explain trade-offs to engineers, product and business stakeholders. 
 - Production experience with React Native, especially owning an app through major version upgrades, is a plus. 
 - Experience building mobile experiences for AI or LLM products, including streaming chat, voice or agent-driven workflows, is a plus. 
 - Experience with Expo and EAS (Build, Submit, Update) or similar managed tooling is a plus. 
 - Experience leading a React Native New Architecture migration (Fabric, TurboModules, Hermes) is a plus. 
 - Enterprise mobile experience, including SSO with identity providers, MDM and B2B app distribution, is a plus. 
 - Experience working on healthcare, ad tech or other regulated-data products is a plus. 
 - Experience sharing code across web and mobile (monorepos, React Native Web) is a plus. 
 - Open-source contributions, technical writing or speaking on mobile or AI-native engineering are a plus. 

We believe great work starts with great support. That's why DeepIntent offers a competitive, holistic benefits package designed to empower you both professionally and personally. 

Here's what you can expect when you join our team based in the US: Competitive base salary plus performance based bonus or commission, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K match program, flexible PTO policy and paid holidays, remote friendly culture with flexible work options, career development and advanced education support, WFH and internet stipends, plus many more perks and benefits!

Here's what you can expect when you join our team based in India: Competitive base salary plus performance based bonus, comprehensive medical insurance, and paid holidays. Hybrid-friendly culture with flexible work options, professional development reimbursement, WiFi reimbursement and health and wellness allowance plus many more perks and benefits!

Here's what you can expect when you join our team based in Europe: Competitive base salary plus performance-based bonus, comprehensive medical insurance, and flexible PTO. Hybrid-friendly culture with flexible work options, professional development reimbursement, WiFi reimbursement, and parental leave plus many more perks and benefits!

DeepIntent is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do great work together. DeepIntent is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We recruit, hire and promote into all job levels the most qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, national origin, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), parental status, age, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, transgender status, sexual orientation, marital, family or partnership status, political affiliation or activities, military service, immigration status, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state and local laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in advance. DeepIntent's commitment to providing equal employment opportunities extends to all aspects of employment, including job assignment, compensation, discipline and access to benefits and training. 

CCPA Notice: If you are a California resident applying for a role at DeepIntent, we may collect personal information as part of the application process in accordance with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). To learn more about the categories of information we collect and your rights, please contact PeopleOps@deepintent. com to see our full Applicant Privacy Notice.

data.title: Sr Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. 

Position: Sr. Principal Software Engineer

Grade: T5

Experience: 12- 16 Years

Location: Bangalore/Noida

Job Responsibilities

R&D support of application and product engineers for customer problems and requests. This consists of problem analysis, debugging and fixing, or the development of new features and enhancements to improve synthesis results with respect to timing, area and power. 

This job will suit applicants looking to continue their software engineering career in an intellectually stimulating and challenging problem domain. There is a significant research element to the work that Cadence does that is truly innovative; we don't know what the answers are when we start out!

Mentoring and support will be provided to the successful candidate to both enable contribution to the large EDA problem domain and to develop their programming skills into professional software engineering skills. 

Job Qualifications

BE/BTech/ME/MTech- Computer Science or others

Required Skills

The candidate should have hands-on experience in RTL Coding. The candidate should be able to

- write, update, and optimize register-transfer level code using System Design Guide standards in VHDL or Verilog. 
 - run functional simulations (using Xcelium), static timing analysis, and design-for-test checks to find bugs. 
 - validate, test, and investigate performance/accuracy issues in the simulator. 

Knowledge of Design-For-Test (DFT) and/or Memory-Built-In-Self-Test (MBIST) is a plus. 

We're doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can't.

data.title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

About the Company and Team

Oracle is a global technology company delivering enterprise software, database technologies, and cloud infrastructure that help organizations run critical business applications and services. 

Join Oracle's Database organization and contribute to the development and operation of scalable, reliable, cloud-native services. 

The role combines modern backend engineering, infrastructure automation, DevOps practices, and production operations. Engineers contribute across the full software lifecycle, from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. 

The team also embraces AI-assisted software development, using tools such as Codex to accelerate engineering workflows while maintaining strong standards for code quality, security, and reliability. 

As platform capabilities evolve, engineers will have opportunities to contribute to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations that connect cloud services with AI agents. 

Job Summary

Oracle India is seeking a Principal Software Engineer (IC4) with 7+ years of professional software engineering experience to design, develop, deploy, and operate highly available cloud-native backend services. 

You will work on complex engineering challenges involving Java, SQL, distributed systems, microservices, infrastructure automation, and production service reliability. 

In this hands-on role, you will build scalable backend capabilities, improve deployment automation, strengthen observability, and troubleshoot complex production incidents. You will collaborate with engineering, Support, and Operations stakeholders to deliver reliable services and continuous platform improvements. 

You will also use Codex and other agentic development tools for code exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation, while independently reviewing and validating generated output. 

As the team's capabilities expand, you will contribute to the design, development, and operation of MCP servers and AI-agent integrations. 

The role is suited to an experienced engineer who combines strong backend development fundamentals with practical cloud engineering, production ownership, and a continuous-improvement mindset. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Develop cloud-native backend services: Design, build, test, and maintain reliable, scalable services using modern cloud technologies, Java, SQL, and Agile engineering practices. 
 - Automate infrastructure and deployments: Develop scripts, infrastructure configurations, and automated deployment workflows using technologies such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines to support repeatable global service deployments. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development: Use Codex and other agentic coding tools extensively for code exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. Independently validate generated output for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Ensure production service reliability: Respond to production escalations, lead incident recovery and root-cause investigations, and implement improvements to reduce recurring issues and strengthen service availability. 
 - Improve monitoring and observability: Instrument services, enhance diagnostics, and use monitoring systems, alerts, and dashboards to detect, investigate, and resolve operational problems. 
 - Collaborate across engineering and operations: Partner with Support, Operations, and project stakeholders to resolve technical challenges, coordinate service improvements, and maintain operational readiness. 
 - Drive engineering quality: Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, improve engineering practices, and create technical and operational documentation that makes services easier to maintain and operate. 
 - Contribute to AI integration capabilities: Support the design, development, and operation of MCP servers and related integrations with AI agents as platform requirements evolve. 

Qualifications And Skills

Mandatory

Experience And Education

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend development and production systems. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent software-development experience. 

Backend Software Engineering

- Strong hands-on programming skills in Java and SQL. 
 - Experience designing, developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining production backend services. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including code quality, maintainability, performance, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience participating in code reviews and delivering reliable production software. 

Cloud and Distributed Systems

- Practical experience developing or operating cloud-native services. 
 - Understanding of distributed systems, microservice architectures, and highly available services. 
 - Ability to reason about scalability, service availability, failure handling, and operational reliability. 

DevOps and Infrastructure Automation

- Experience automating software deployments or installations using scripting and engineering tools. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version-control practices. 
 - Ability to contribute to service instrumentation and repeatable deployment workflows. 

Production Operations and Reliability

- Experience troubleshooting production software and investigating service failures. 
 - Strong root-cause-analysis and problem-solving skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate with Support and Operations teams during incidents and service improvements. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring, alerts, logs, and operational diagnostics. 

AI Assisted Engineering and Collaboration

- Ability and willingness to use Codex or comparable agentic development tools as part of everyday engineering work, while independently validating generated results. 
 - Ability to work effectively in an Agile development environment. 
 - Strong technical communication, documentation, collaboration, and continuous-improvement skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience developing commercial software products that process large data volumes in highly available distributed environments. 
 - Hands-on experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure-as-code technologies. 
 - Expertise in one or more public cloud platforms: OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience using Grafana dashboards, alerts, or comparable monitoring tools. 
 - Experience with Git, Bitbucket, or similar version-control tools. 
 - Experience designing or developing MCP servers. 
 - Experience integrating cloud services with AI agents. 
 - Familiarity with JavaScript and Node. js. 
 - Prior experience using Codex or other agentic coding tools and validating their output. 

Experience improving CI/CD pipelines

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. 

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

data.title: Senior Platform Engineer (AI Focused)
data.description:
ABOUT EARNINAs one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.   We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and excited to bring on world-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey. 

EarnIn is becoming an AI-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products. 

As a company, we are becoming AI-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly. 

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Senior Platform Engineer (AI Focussed), you will design, build, and operate AI-assisted capabilities within platform-owned infrastructure and developer tooling. You will work across Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, FinOps, and infrastructure-as-code to embed AI directly into the systems that power software delivery - from MCP servers, LLM Gateways, and agentic workflows to automated diagnostics and cost optimization. 

You will join the Platform Engineering organization. The team's mission is to provide reliable, scalable tooling that helps engineers build, test, deploy, and operate software efficiently. In this role, you will split your time between standard platform engineering and AI engineering, with a focus on shipping production-grade AI-assisted workflows inside existing systems.   This is a hands-on engineering role. Success is measured by real adoption and measurable improvements in developer efficiency, platform reliability, and operational cost.   

This position will be a hybrid role based in our Bengaluru office, with 2 days on-site as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View HQ. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.   

WHAT YOU'LL DO  

- Design and build MCP servers that expose platform capabilities as safe, well-scoped tools for AI agents and developer-facing assistants. Contribute to enterprise MCP patterns, LLM tooling, agentic guardrails, knowledge repositories, and framework rollout. 
 - Design structured, agentic workflows for platform operations - incident triage, deployment validation, config remediation, capacity planning - and drive AI-assisted code review and developer tooling (e. g. , CodeRabbit, Claude/Cursor) with tool-use, validation steps, and human-in-the-loop gates. 
 - Operationalize LLM-based features inside platform tooling: structured prompting, RAG, output validation, and evaluation harnesses. Implement LLM gateway and router patterns to control costs, route models, and enable observability of AI workloads. 
 - Design and evolve GitOps-based continuous delivery, Kubernetes infrastructure on AWS EKS, and infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize. 
 - Strengthen observability, reliability, and operational excellence: SLOs, error budgets, metrics/traces/logs, and automation that improves MTTD/MTTR. 
 - Extend the developer control plane with paved paths, scorecards, and self-service actions. 
 - Instrument platform cost signals - compute, observability, and AI/LLM spend - and build FinOps automation that surfaces waste and supports cost-aware engineering decisions. 
 - Define success metrics upfront and run time-bound experiments to evaluate impact on developer efficiency, reliability, and cost. 
 - Document usage guidance, patterns, and best practices to support consistent adoption of proven AI workflows. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR  

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 4+ years in platform, infrastructure, or backend engineering with hands-on experience operating production systems in a cloud environment (AWS preferred). 
 - Strong coding skills in Python and/or Go, with experience building and operating production services. 
 - Deep experience with Kubernetes (EKS preferred), GitOps (Argo CD), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and Terraform/Helm/Kustomize for infrastructure automation, service mesh. . 
 - Solid observability skills (Datadog APM/metrics/tracing/logs) with a track record of improving reliability and driving SLO/error-budget culture. 
 - Hands-on experience building or integrating MCP servers - designing tool surfaces, managing scope and auth, and connecting AI agents to real infrastructure. 
 - Practical experience with structured or agentic AI workflows (e. g. , planning/execution separation, human-in-the-loop validation, RAG, tool-use patterns) used in production environments. 
 - FinOps experience: cloud cost attribution, workload optimization, and AI/LLM spend control. 
 - Familiarity with LLM gateway/router patterns for cost control, model routing, and observability of AI workloads. 
 - Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with partner teams in a distributed environment. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools) as part of your software development workflow At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E-Verify participant.   

EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Takes proactive steps to design and architect infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Performs data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides health and performance reporting. Identifies opportunities for automation. Communicates about services and identifies and explains the potential impact of changes. Provides support for technology and documents incidents. Experiments with new tools and assesses potential impact and develops knowledge of site reliability trends. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Capacity Ingestion and Management: 

- Takes proactive steps to design and architect infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality. 
 - Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads. 
 - Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures and features that are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements. 
 - Independently identifies opportunities for and drives prototyping (e. g. , testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding). 

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management: 

- Performs data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. 
 - Independently monitors services, maintains up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and documents their condition. 
 - Leverages comprehensive knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e. g. , software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery). 
 - Provides health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data. 
 - May independently perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services. 
 - May perform standard and non-standard decommissioning (e. g. , shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed. 

Automation: 

- Identifies opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits. 
 - Develops automation tools or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures. 
 - Independently conducts testing to ensure automation performs the task correctly and produces expected results. 

Technical Communication and Guidance: 

- Communicates the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology within and sometimes beyond immediate team. 
 - Identifies and explains the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact on team operations. 

Troubleshooting and Resolution: 

- Provides operational support for technology, escalating incidents and other standard and non-standard issues arising within Oracle services. 
 - Participates in on-call shifts to address issues. 
 - Resolves technical issues spanning various services, investigating and debugging products in order to reach SLOs (service level objectives). 
 - Documents incidents and performs root cause analyses according to standard reporting methods. 
 - Independently performs post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence. 

Innovation and Improvement: 

- Experiments with new tools and technologies to assess their potential impact on and improve infrastructure performance and reliability, ensuring adherence to security standards. 
 - Independently identifies and executes improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments to ensure efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability. 
 - Develops knowledge of site reliability trends and shares new information with team members, management, and beyond to help others build, test, deploy and run services. 
 - Performs standard and non-standard analyses and provides clear data on production to contribute to business development decisions (e. g. , design changes). 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices. 

Continuous Learning: 

Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. 

Continuous Improvement: 

Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work. 

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. 

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. 

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle. com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. 
 - Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. 
 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers.

data.description:
About Albertsons: 

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2, 200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known global banners, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco and others. This customer-centric focus not only inspires innovation but has also led to remarkable achievements across our digital platforms and omnichannel strategies. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we have transformed shopping into an experience that is not just easy and efficient, but also fun and engaging. Over the past year, we have taken bold, strategic steps to migrate and modernize our enterprise data hub on Google Cloud, revolutionizing our data capabilities, thus becoming the first fully cloud-based grocery tech company. 

About Tech Hub in India: 

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Software Engineer I, AI Engineering (AIDLC) at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Position Title: Software Engineer I, AI Engineering (AIDLC)

Roles & responsibilities: 

- Build and test parts of agents for the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) pod, guided by senior engineers. 
 - Contribute to agents for stages of the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Implement tool/function calling and use MCP servers, including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP, in the agents you work on. 
 - Implement RAG pipelines and basic memory and state handling for your agents. 
 - Write evals for the parts you build: a small golden dataset, simple LLM-as-judge checks and regression tests. Run them before each change. 
 - Add tracing and logging to your agents, and use traces to debug failures. 
 - Follow the pod's guardrails, including prompt-injection defenses and human-in-the-loop approval points. 
 - Write production code every week. Use agentic coding tools daily (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and check every change they produce before you commit it. 
 - Take part in code and agent reviews, and learn from the feedback. 
 - Report how your agents perform against the baseline the pod sets, and learn to watch token cost. 
 - Work with senior engineers and partner teams to meet security and compliance standards. 

Experience Required: 

- AI experience is a MUST. You have built an LLM agent or RAG application end to end, with at least one eval. An AI internship, coursework or a personal project counts. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 3-6 years of software engineering experience. Recent graduates with a strong AI project or internship are welcome to apply. There is no CGPA cutoff. 
 - Programming fundamentals in Python, Java or TypeScript: you write clean, tested code. 
 - Prompt engineering basics, and tool/function calling and MCP basics. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Understanding of RAG and of how an agent keeps memory and state. 
 - Understanding of how to evaluate an LLM application with a golden dataset, and why tracing matters. 
 - Responsible use of AI coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor): you review and understand code before you accept it, and you know when not to trust the output. 
 - A plus: cloud exposure on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Willingness to learn from code reviews and from senior engineers. 

Competencies: 

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason 
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions 
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally 
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work 
 - Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens 
 - Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
 - Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals. 

Skills Required: 

- Python / Java / TypeScript Fundamentals 
 - LLM Agent Basics: Prompting, Tool Calling, MCP 
 - RAG and Basic Evals 
 - Responsible Use of AI Coding Tools

data.title: Software Engineer | Cloud Native BNG Solution Testing, Scale & Performance, Python | 8-12 year
data.description:
Meet the Team

The Cisco cnBNG Solution Testing team validates carrier-grade broadband solutions running on IOS-XR routing platforms, including Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, and NCS 5500/5700. Our focus is ensuring that cnBNG solutions meet demanding service-provider requirements for functionality, scale, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and operational readiness. We validate the cnBNG solution end-to-end across Control Plane and User Plane functions, subscriber protocols, forwarding, high availability, and platform infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and customer deployments, with an automation-first approach and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices. 

Your Impact

As a Software Engineer in the cnBNG Solution Testing team, you will own end-to-end solution, scale, performance, and resiliency validation of cnBNG deployments. 

You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. You will work extensively with traffic-generation platforms such as Keysight IXIA and Spirent, analyze system and forwarding performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with development teams to drive defects to resolution. 

- You will play a critical role in assessing product quality and providing evidence-based recommendations for release readiness. 
 - Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane, subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements. 
 - Own scale and performance qualification, including subscriber scale, session setup/teardown rates, throughput, latency, packet loss, convergence, CPU/memory utilization, and system behavior under sustained load. 
 - Develop realistic service-provider test topologies covering PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, L2TP, subscriber policies, accounting, QoS, and subscriber lifecycle scenarios. 
 - Build and validate large-scale cnBNG deployments with multiple Control Plane and User Plane nodes. Develop strong proficiency with Keysight IXIA and Spirent traffic generators, including subscriber emulation, protocol emulation, traffic generation, traffic analysis, performance benchmarking, and large-scale test execution. 
 - Create traffic profiles that model real-world broadband deployments, including mixed IPv4/IPv6 traffic, multiple packet sizes, bidirectional traffic, QoS classes, and subscriber service profiles. 
 - Validate CUPS / CP-UP separation, including session programming, state synchronization, state replay, reconciliation, Control Plane and User Plane failures, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Perform comprehensive high-availability and resiliency testing, including SRG geo/warm standby, process restart, node failures, link failures, ISSU, NSR/NSF, control-plane failures, and subscriber session continuity. 
 - Validate IOS-XR forwarding functionality including L2/L3 forwarding, FIB/adjacency, MPLS/L3VPN, H-QoS/policing, ACLs, mirroring, OAM/BFD, slowpath, and NPU forwarding behavior. 
 - Develop and maintain scalable Python-based test automation using pyATS/Genie or equivalent frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites. 
 - Build reusable automation libraries for topology setup, subscriber provisioning, traffic generation, fault injection, statistics collection, verification, and automated result analysis. 
 - Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks across software, forwarding hardware, NPU resources, CPU, memory, and control-plane interactions. 
 - Perform soak, longevity, stress, negative, boundary, and capacity testing to uncover issues that may only appear under sustained or extreme workloads. 
 - Validate subscriber QoS, accounting, lawful intercept, policy enforcement, and other service-provider features under functional and scale conditions. 
 - Validate CLI, YANG models, model-driven telemetry, gRPC/NETCONF/gNMI, and operational data required for managing and troubleshooting large cnBNG deployments. 
 - Debug sophisticated solution-level issues using IOS-XR logs, traces, telemetry, packet captures, core dumps, IXIA/Spirent statistics, and platform/NPU diagnostics. 
 - Perform detailed root-cause isolation, determining whether failures originate in the Control Plane, User Plane, forwarding infrastructure, Silicon One NPU, automation environment, traffic generator, or external network components. 
 - Partner closely with development, platform, system architecture, and customer-facing engineering teams to reproduce defects and drive them to closure. 
 - Define measurable test exit criteria and provide data-driven release-quality and readiness recommendations based on functional, scale, performance, and resiliency results. 
 - Use Git and modern software-development practices for automation code, test reviews, defect management, and CI/CD integration. 
 - Actively use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for automation development, test generation, log analysis, failure clustering, defect analysis, and troubleshooting while responsibly validating AI-generated output. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and help improve solution-testing methodology, automation architecture, scale infrastructure, and overall engineering quality. 

Minimum Qualifications (Must-Have)

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, 
 - Telecommunications, or a related field. Strong experience in system, solution, scale, performance, and resiliency testing of networking products or carrier-grade networking solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of test methodologies covering functional, integration, system, regression, scale, performance, stress, longevity, failover, and high-availability testing. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Keysight IXIA and/or Spirent traffic-generation platforms, including
 - protocol emulation, subscriber emulation, traffic generation, scale testing, and performance analysis. 
 - Strong Python programming and experience developing scalable test automation using pyATS/
 - Genie or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD and continuous regression pipelines. 
 - Strong IP networking fundamentals, including L2/L3 forwarding, IPv4/IPv6, routing, MPLS/L3VPN, and QoS. Knowledge of broadband/subscriber technologies and protocols including PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, and L2TP. 
 - Experience configuring, validating, and solving IOS-XR or another carrier-grade network operating system. 
 - Ability to design and implement large-scale network topologies and systematically characterize capacity, throughput, latency, convergence, resource utilization, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong understanding of high availability, duplication, subscriber-state management, and fault- recovery mechanisms. 
 - Strong Linux skills and experience with Git, debugging tools, packet collections, logs, telemetry, and defect-management systems. 
 - Strong solving and analytical skills with the ability to isolate sophisticated issues across traffic generators, network protocols, software, hardware, and forwarding layers. 
 - AI-assisted engineering is a must: use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot and a working understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), reusable AI skills, prompt/context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output, including AI-assisted log and defect analysis. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience validating cnBNG, BNG, or broadband subscriber solutions. 
 - Experience with CUPS / Control Plane-User Plane separation and large-scale distributed User
 - Plane deployments. 
 - Sophisticated experience with IXIA BreakingPoint/IxNetwork and/or Spirent Test Center, including automation APIs and large-scale subscriber/traffic emulation. 
 - Experience with Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700, Silicon One, or comparable carrier-grade routing platforms and NPUs. Experience validating subscriber scale, session churn, traffic performance, convergence, and long-duration stability. 
 - Experience with SRG geo/warm excess, ISSU, NSR/NSF, and service continuity testing. 
 - Knowledge of SRv6/Segment Routing, MPLS, EVPN/VPLS, TE/GRE tunnels, BFD, BGP Flowspec, and ACLs. Experience with YANG, gRPC, NETCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, and telemetry. Experience building automated performance dashboards, test-result analytics, failure classification, and regression trend analysis. 
 - Familiarity with Aha/Jira APIs engineering and defect-management integrations. 

Why Cisco?

We've been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. 

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you'll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium's mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Within this organization, the Quality Engineering team partners with the Equities Transactional Systems team on Comet, the firm's next-generation equity post-trade platform covering trade lifecycle event processing, positions, P & L, option expiry and corporate actions, built as high-throughput services and data pipelines on AWS. 

What You'll Do

- Own test strategy and execution for new features, partnering with developers, business analysts, and Middle Office and Operations stakeholders from design through release. 
 - Translate business rules into comprehensive test scenarios and edge cases across the trade lifecycle, including trades, positions, P & L, option expiry, corporate actions, as-of events, backdated events, and corrections. 
 - Independently calculate expected realized, unrealized, and mark-to-market P & L results, and reconcile exceptions against source-of-truth datasets and legacy systems. 
 - Design, build, and maintain automated test coverage across Java/Spring Boot microservices, REST and GraphQL APIs, Kafka event flows, batch jobs, data workflows, and user interfaces. 
 - Validate batch and workflow behavior, including reruns, failures, idempotency, and cache consistency between Redis and the database. 
 - Build data-validation and reconciliation checks to protect the integrity of setup data, positions, balances, and downstream outputs. 
 - Expand regression coverage and quality gates within CI pipelines to continuously validate changes. 
 - Track, triage, and document defects with clear reproduction steps; use logs and metrics to support root-cause analysis, verify fixes, and support release readiness through environment validation, smoke and sanity testing, access and entitlement checks, and test sign-off documentation. 

What You Bring

- Prior fintech or capital-markets experience in quality engineering for pre-trade or post-trade equity systems within a hedge fund, investment bank, asset manager, or fintech organization. 
 - 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering and test automation. 
 - Hands-on knowledge of corporate actions and option expiry, including their impact on positions and P & L. 
 - Strong Java test-automation skills, including JUnit or TestNG, REST Assured, Spring Boot Test, and Mockito. 
 - Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs, including contract, schema, authentication, and entitlement validation.

data.description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY's solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies. 

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today's data-rich world. 

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy. 

Job Description

Develop, execute, and maintain automated tests for healthcare data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and reporting outputs. Use SQL and Python to validate data mappings, reconcile source and target records, and identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or incorrectly transformed data. Work within established frameworks to provide dependable validation evidence and timely feedback on data quality. 

Reporting and collaboration

Report to the Senior Manager QE Technology and Innovation and receive technical guidance from the Senior Data Quality Engineer and Principal Quality Architect. Collaborate with Data Engineering, product QEs, analysts, and the Healthcare SME to validate assigned data flows against documented business rules. 

Key Responsibilities

Review data requirements, source-to-target mappings, business rules, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios and expected results. 

Develop and maintain SQL- and Python-based automated checks using approved data-testing frameworks and reusable utilities. 

Validate data completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, and referential integrity across assigned datasets. 

Reconcile source and target records, counts, totals, and key attributes across ingestion, transformation, and reporting layers. 

Test batch and incremental loads, schema changes, error handling, retries, and recovery scenarios under senior technical guidance. 

Prepare approved synthetic or masked datasets and follow access, privacy, and sensitive healthcare data-handling procedures. 

Execute data regression tests within CI/CD pipelines, analyze failures, and maintain clear validation results and test evidence. 

Document reproducible data defects, collaborate with Data Engineers on investigation, and verify fixes and affected downstream outputs. 

Use approved AI tools to assist with SQL, Python, test scenarios, and failure analysis while validating generated outputs and protecting sensitive data. 

Maintain existing data-quality checks and alerts, contribute to code reviews, and add regression coverage for assigned production data issues. 

Page

Experience And Qualifications

3+ years in software testing, quality engineering, or data validation, including 2+ years of hands-on ETL/ELT or database testing and SQL-based validation. Experience may overlap. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

3+ years of relevant testing or data-validation experience, including 2+ years validating data pipelines, transformations, or databases. 

Hands-on SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, and reconciliation queries across related datasets. 

Working Python skills for automated data checks, test execution, result comparison, and debugging. 

Understanding of ETL/ELT, relational data models, source-to-target mappings, data-quality dimensions, and batch or incremental processing. 

Experience using Git, defect-tracking tools, and automated testing practices; familiarity with CI/CD workflows. 

Ability to explain data discrepancies, produce reproducible evidence, collaborate with engineers, and handle confidential information responsibly. 

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare data experience involving clinical, laboratory, patient, provider, claims, eligibility, or other relevant workflows. 

Exposure to a cloud data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or GCP and frameworks such as pytest, dbt tests, or Great Expectations. 

Familiarity with API or file-based integrations, HL7/FHIR where relevant, and approved AI coding or testing assistants. 

Success measures

Reliable automated coverage of assigned critical data rules and reconciliation controls, with timely completion of planned validation work. 

Clear, reproducible evidence for data defects and dependable verification of fixes and regression outcomes. 

Reduced manual reconciliation effort and growing independence in SQL, Python, data testing, and failure investigation. 

Working expectations

Collaborate with India engineering teams and U. S. stakeholders with agreed working-hour overlap. Follow shared testing standards and approved data-access policies, and support release validation and production data investigations under senior guidance.

At ELLKAY, we are committed to operating as a hybrid workplace, offering employees flexibility in how they structure their time between in-office and remote work. We recognize the significance of fostering connections, collaboration, and creativity within our office culture and its positive impact on our business. Our philosophy of operating as a hybrid workplace underscores our dedication to enabling employees to tailor work-life balance to their individual preferences. For those who do not live within 40 miles of one of our offices, we are open to considering remote work for candidates whose skills and experience strongly align with the role. While we prioritize a hybrid work environment for most roles, we understand the importance of flexibility and are open to remote work for specific positions and specialized skill sets.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer | Onsite
data.description:
About Pristine Data AI

Pristine Data AI is an AI-native, agentic go-to-market platform. We replace the fragmented sales stack (data, enrichment, sequencing, calls, research, reporting) with one full-funnel platform. Revenue teams use it to find prospects with natural language search, enrich records from multiple data sources, personalize outreach with real context, and act on live buying signals. 

The role

We're hiring a Senior QA Engineer to own the quality of our product, full-time and onsite in our Chennai office. The job goes beyond confirming that a feature works. You'll need to know whether it does what our customers need, so we want someone who learns who our buyers and users are, what they're trying to get done, and what success looks like for them. That understanding is what makes UAT smooth instead of a scramble at the end. 

What you'll do

- Design and run test plans and test cases for web and AI-driven features, covering positive, negative, edge and regression scenarios
 - Do manual and exploratory testing across the platform, find defects, trace root causes and see them through to closure
 - Turn business goals and customer success criteria into acceptance criteria before development starts, not after
 - Work closely with engineering, product and data teams to resolve issues and raise risks early
 - Review product requirements and push back when something is unclear or untestable
 - Take part in release planning and help define quality standards, QA processes and documentation
 - Use AI tools thoughtfully to move faster: generating test cases, building test data, analyzing logs and speeding up regression coverageHow we think about AI

We're AI-native from the ground up, and we expect our team to work that way too. We want people who use AI to do better work faster, and who also know where it falls short and when to check its output. If you've built AI into your QA workflow, tell us how. 

What we're looking for

- Strong grounding in QA and software testing, including setting up and maintaining QA processes
 - Hands-on manual testing experience with web applications, ideally data-driven or AI-based products
 - Experience with functional, regression, integration and system testing
 - Comfort with Jira or similar tools, test management tools and version control
 - Real curiosity about the business: who buys, who uses the product and what a good outcome looks like for them
 - Clear communication: precise bug reports, good questions and concerns raised early
 - Critical thinking and systematic problem-solving
 - Comfort with agile, fast-moving teams and shifting priorities
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experienceNice to have

- Experience with test automation tools or frameworks
 - Prior senior or lead QA experience
 - Experience testing LLM-powered or agentic features, where outputs aren't deterministic
 - Exposure to B2B SaaS, sales tech or GTM toolsHow we work

We value ownership, integrity and respect. We give direct feedback and expect it back, and we share what we know with each other. 

Location: Onsite, Chennai, India. This role is not remote or hybrid.

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. data.description:
About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com

Join the RISC-V Revolution!

We are looking for a senior hands-on engineer to lead Zephyr RTOS architecture and platform enablement for MIPS RISC-V based MCU and embedded compute products. This role combines deep low-level development with technical ownership, upstream engagement, mentoring, and cross-functional delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the Zephyr enablement architecture and technical roadmap across MIPS RISC-V processors, SoCs, FPGA platforms, and virtual development platforms. 
 - Lead porting and platform bring-up covering boot flow, exception and interrupt handling, timers, SMP where applicable, memory architecture, devicetree, Kconfig, and build integration. 
 - Define scalable BSP, SoC, board, and driver architecture aligned with Zephyr conventions and upstream-quality expectations. 
 - Design and review device drivers, middleware integration, samples, tests, and production-quality SDK deliverables. 
 - Lead complex debugging across kernel, toolchain, architecture, hardware, and driver boundaries using emulation, FPGA, and silicon. 
 - Establish automated build and regression strategy using Zephyr testing infrastructure and CI/CD systems. 
 - Drive upstream contributions, technical discussions, reviews, and maintenance strategy within the Zephyr ecosystem. 
 - Work closely with CPU architecture, SoC, FPGA, tools, validation, safety, and customer teams; convert product requirements into executable software plans. 
 - Mentor engineers, raise engineering quality, and provide technical direction without losing hands-on ownership. 

Ideally, You'll Have

- 8+ years of embedded software development experience, with substantial hands-on work in C and low-level platform software. 
 - Deep Zephyr RTOS expertise across kernel configuration, architecture or SoC ports, devicetree, Kconfig, west/CMake, board support, drivers, and test infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of RTOS internals, concurrency, interrupt architecture, memory management, boot flows, multicore systems, and real-time performance. 
 - Proven experience leading complex BSP, SDK, RTOS, or silicon-enablement programs from architecture through release. 
 - Experience with bare-metal firmware, first-board or first-silicon bring-up, device drivers, and hardware/software debugging. 
 - Strong debugging capability using GDB, OpenOCD, Segger J-Link, Lauterbach, trace tools, and hardware logs. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, test automation, Python or shell scripting, code review, release quality, and software configuration management. 
 - Ability to communicate architecture and execution trade-offs clearly to hardware, software, program, and customer stakeholders. 

Strong Differentiators

- Zephyr maintainer-level expertise or meaningful upstream contribution history. 
 - RISC-V architecture expertise, including privilege modes, interrupts, timers, SMP, cache or memory-ordering considerations, and toolchain integration. 
 - Experience with networking, Ethernet, TCP/IP, security, MCUboot, secure firmware update, or device management. 
 - Experience enabling RTOS software on pre-silicon models, FPGA, and production silicon. 
 - Exposure to functional safety or secure software development for automotive, industrial, or infrastructure applications. 

What You'll Get

- A charter to shape Zephyr strategy and execution for a new RISC-V platform. 
 - Direct access to CPU architects, platform software, FPGA, validation, and toolchain teams. 
 - Visible technical ownership spanning architecture, upstream ecosystem, customer enablement, and release quality. 
 - A path to grow as a principal technical contributor or broader technical leader. 

MIPS by GF is a microprocessor pioneer with deep roots in RISC-based computing. Today, MIPS is building RISC-V processor solutions for high-performance and embedded applications, combining CPU architecture expertise with platform software, tools, and ecosystem enablement.

data.title: Senior AI Specialist
data.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world's most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12, 000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog. 

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them. 

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills-and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale. 

Job Overview

Coursera is seeking a Senior AI Specialist to own the technical design and delivery of complex AI applications for business and customer needs. You'll turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions, working across data exploration, experimentation, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and deployment. This is a hands-on senior IC role: you'll lead architectural decisions independently, build critical components, and resolve difficult problems across models, agents, applications, and data. You'll partner with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, LLMOps, and forward-deployed teams to deliver solutions within enterprise and customer environments. Your work will establish reusable approaches and technical standards that improve AI quality, reliability, security, and delivery across projects. 

About your skills: 

AI Systems Architecture - Design end-to-end applied AI solutions, combining models, retrieval, agentic workflows, and application services while balancing quality, scalability, security, and cost. 

AI Delivery & Reliability - Build production grade AI components and reliable data workflows, integrating enterprise data, models, and tools into tested, maintainable applications. Define how AI quality is measured and monitored, using evaluation frameworks, agent tracing

Technical Leadership - Own complex technical decisions, lead design and code reviews, AI evals, and guide cross-functional teams from experimentation through validated production deployment. 

What you'll be doing

- Own AI solution architecture - Translate ambiguous requirements into robust system designs, service boundaries, data contracts, and implementation plans. Lead build v/s buy decisions and document trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, reliability, security, and cost. 
 - Architect RAG systems. Design retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using vector databases, sparse and dense retrieval, hybrid search, metadata filtering, and reranking. Define document parsing, chunking, embedding, and indexing strategies. 
 - Evaluate and fine-tune models. Determine when model adaptation is warranted over prompting or retrieval. Curate training and validation datasets, implement supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient techniques such as LoRA, and benchmark against baseline models for task accuracy, safety, latency, and cost. 
 - Develop AI services and data integrations. Build critical Python/TypeScript services, APIs, and asynchronous workflows. Partner with Data Engineering on ingestion and indexing pipelines, including normalization of customer data, schema validation, incremental updates, lineage, and recovery. 
 - Build enterprise agentic systems. Develop stateful workflows with task decomposition, planning, multi-step tool use, dynamic tool selection, structured outputs, memory management, and multi-agent orchestration where justified. Build tool and MCP integrations with validated inputs, scoped permissions, and human approval for sensitive actions. Evaluate retrieval and agent quality against defined accuracy and grounding metrics. 
 - Implement AI security, and governance controls. Implement defenses against prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, and retrieval access violations. Contribute threat models, adversarial tests, and evidence for governance reviews. Translate centrally defined policies into application controls for identity, tenant isolation, data residency, retention, and auditability. 
 - Adapt solutions to enterprise environments. Work with Engineering and forward-deployed teams to implement cloud, hybrid, and customer-controlled deployments. 
 - AI evaluation and production observability. Define evaluation datasets and measure retrieval quality, groundedness, task completion, tool correctness, latency, and cost. Combine deterministic checks, calibrated LLM-as-judge, and human review. Partner with LLMOps on CI/CD release gates, prompt and model versioning, tracing, and safe rollouts and rollbacks. 
 - Own technical quality and system reliability. Set and enforce quality standards across the team, with accountability for code quality, maintainability, and production reliability. Lead architecture and code reviews, mentor AI Specialists, and drive root-cause analysis across model, retrieval, application, and data layers. Improve developer productivity through reusable libraries, reference architectures, tooling, and runbooks. 

Qualifications

- 6+ years in applied AI, machine learning, or software development, including architecture and production ownership of complex AI systems. 
 - Experience applying enterprise AI controls, including scoped tool authorization, tenant isolation, PII handling, prompt-injection defenses, audit logging, and human approval for sensitive actions. 
 - Experience designing enterprise semantic layers or context graphs that connect business entities, relationships, and definitions across systems. 
 - Strong experience with cloud deployments using GCP/AWS including serverless technologies, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Docker and Kubernetes and model platforms such as Vertex AI, Bedrock, etc. 
 - Familiarity with centralized LLM gateways such as LiteLLM, covering multi-provider routing, fallbacks, rate limits, token budgets, caching, and access policies. 
 - Production-grade development using Python, TypeScript, and SQL, with typed interfaces, APIs, asynchronous processing, and automated testing. 
 - Build enterprise agentic systems using LangGraph, Mastra, or equivalent frameworks, including planning, multi-agent orchestration, state and memory management, checkpointing, and failure recovery. 
 - Applied knowledge of LLM inference and context engineering, including structured outputs, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation-driven model selection or fine-tuning. 
 - Practical work with Databricks, Spark, and Postgres, spanning analytical and transactional workloads, batch and real-time pipelines, and normalization of messy customer data. 
 - AI evaluation using Braintrust or equivalent, including golden datasets, custom scorers, regression testing, and calibrated LLM-as-judge to measure task success, tool correctness, safety, and cost. 
 - Worked on enterprise AI observability layers, including agent traces, model and tool spans, prompt versions, error attribution, latency, token usage, and cost tracking. 

For more information about how Coursera collects and uses your personal information, please see our Coursera + Udemy Global Applicant Privacy Notice. 

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera. org/udemy. com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. 

If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.
