data.title: PRINCIPAL, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
Job SummaryAs a Principal Software Engineer for Global CRM (GCRM) specializing in Seller Acquisition & Onboarding, you will be the strategic architectural cornerstone of our marketplace's growth engine. This is a high-visibility, high-impact leadership role where you will design and scale the multi-platform infrastructure that powers the acquisition and integration of millions of global sellers. Fusing Salesforce-centric workflows with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) microservices, responsive front-end portals, data analytics, and advanced AI automation, you will establish a frictionless, intelligent, and highly secure onboarding experience at a massive global scale. 

Job Ad DescriptionAre you ready to redefine how a marketplace attracts and onboarding global sellers at scale? The GCRM team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to architect the future of our Global Seller Onboarding and Acquisition Funnels. 

In this role, you will lead the technical strategy across a modern, multi-tiered tech stack. You will bridge the gap between enterprise Salesforce engineering, robust GCP cloud services, modern web-based front-ends, data analytics platforms, and next-generation AI/ML engines. If you are passionate about driving business growth through complex integrations, automating seller vetting, and designing "data-first, AI-ready" architectures that handle massive transaction volumes, this is the opportunity for you. 

About

About the TeamThe Global CRM (GCRM) team is the backbone of the Marketplace ecosystem. Within GCRM, the Seller Acquisition & Onboarding team is responsible for architecting and scaling the global platform that powers the end-to-end seller entry journey. Our mission is to build seamless, high-performance systems that manage: 

- Global Acquisition Funnels: Engineering robust lead capture and marketing-to-sales pipelines to attract high-quality global sellers. 
 - Intelligent, Automated Onboarding: Building secure workflows to verify, vet, and set up sellers efficiently with minimal human intervention. 
 - Multi-Platform Tech Integration: Designing complex, real-time integrations that seamlessly link Salesforce, GCP microservices, rich front-end seller portals, downstream data analytics, and predictive AI pipelines. 

As a Principal Engineer in GCRM, you will tackle distributed systems challenges, optimize global APIs, and define the architectural standards that empower our marketplace to scale internationally. 

What you'll do· Architect End-to-End Solutions: Define the technical vision and system architecture connecting Salesforce, GCP backends, front-end portals, and downstream AI/data analytics platforms. 

- Salesforce Architecture Leadership: Design enterprise-grade architectures where Salesforce serves as a primary system of record and engagement, implementing highly optimized custom workflows, LWC components, and robust APIs. 
 - Scale Cloud Services on GCP: Design, build, and deploy high-performance microservices, event-driven pipelines, and database solutions on Google Cloud Platform to complement the core CRM. 
 - Drive Front-End Portal Strategy: Guide the architectural direction of our seller-facing portals and internal tools, ensuring intuitive, high-performance, and responsive user experiences. 
 - Embed AI & Automation: Architect pipelines that integrate AI/ML and LLM capabilities directly into the onboarding journey (e. g. , automated document verification, seller risk scoring, and personalized onboarding tracks). 
 - Unlock Data Analytics: Work closely with data science and analytics teams to design pipelines that track seller funnel metrics, conversion rates, and friction points, converting data into actionable business strategy. 
 - Lead Technical Solutioning: Drive technical planning, high-scale third-party integrations, and system-level design reviews for multi-quarter initiatives across global teams. 
 - Mentor and Cultivate Talent: Champion engineering excellence by mentoring staff, senior, and junior engineers, conducting architecture reviews, and establishing clean-code and DevOps best practices. 
 - Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Product Management, Security, Compliance, and Business Operations to deliver compliant, secure, and user-friendly onboarding solutions. 

What You'll bringYou have a deep interest and passion for technology. You have a proven track record of driving critical business initiatives with Data, CRM, and Cloud architectures. You love writing and owning high-impact system designs, writing code, and collaborating with cross-functional partners who challenge you. You are a strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership abilities, comfortable leading technical direction in a fast-paced, agile global environment. 

- 10+ years of experience in software development with a heavy focus on enterprise solutions, distributed systems, and CRM-integrated architectures. 
 - Expertise in Salesforce Architecture: Advanced knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Shield, and Governor Limits, with an emphasis on high-volume, multi-tenant data processing. 
 - Advanced Cloud Engineering (GCP): 4+ years of hands-on experience designing cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, or Kubernetes). 
 - Full-Stack & Front-End Mastery: Strong architectural experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, or LWC) used in building highly responsive seller-facing portals. 
 - AI, ML, and Data Pipelines: Proven experience implementing and integrating AI/ML models, agentic workflows, or Data Cloud platforms to automate complex workflow decisioning. 
 - Complex Integration & Messaging: Extensive experience with real-time integrations using Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), Kafka, REST/SOAP APIs, and gRPC. 
 - Data Modeling & Analytics: Strong foundation in CRM and relational/non-relational cloud databases, ensuring optimized retrieval, analytics, and business intelligence reporting. 
 - DevOps & Security: Mastery of enterprise CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Copado), automated testing, data masking, encryption, and secure-by-design principles for sensitive seller data. 
 - Strategic & Technical Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders, drive architectural consensus across teams, and guide engineering organizations toward modern architectural patterns. 

About Walmart Global TechImagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts, and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. 

People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives

BenefitsBeyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits, maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

BelongingWe aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers, and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity EmployerWalmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Infrastructure Specialist: Cloud Application Operations, you will provide 24/7 technical support for cloud-based solutions, addressing issues related to application, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure. You will handle Level 1. 5 remediation across the fleet using a standard workflow and incident handling process. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Provide Technical Support: Address issues related to application, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure, utilizing various tools and technologies, including APIs, application services, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, microservices, containers, Kubernetes nodes, middleware components, network, security, and infrastructure. 
 - Manage Incident Resolution: Receive and record incident information, select appropriate actions to resolve issues, and communicate the solution or action plan to the client, ensuring timely and effective resolution. 
 - Ensure Cloud Elasticity: Manage Application ID and provide cloud elasticity by auto-scaling resources based on business requirements, ensuring efficient resource utilization. 
 - Monitor Client Environment: Utilize monitoring tools like IBM APM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, NewRelic, Runscope, Netcool OmniBus to monitor the client's environment, identifying potential issues and taking proactive measures. 
 - Deliver Service Management Reports: Provide daily, weekly, and monthly integrated service management reports across the solution, ensuring transparency and visibility into service performance. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Exposure to Cloud Technologies: Familiarity with cloud-based solutions, including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, microservices, containers, and Kubernetes nodes, with the ability to address related technical issues. 
 - Experience with Monitoring Tools: Exposure to monitoring tools like IBM APM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, NewRelic, Runscope, and Netcool OmniBus, with the ability to utilize them to identify potential issues. 
 - Understanding of ITIL Processes: Familiarity with ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change management, and Integrated Service Level Management, with the ability to apply them in a cloud application operations context. 
 - Experience with Ticketing and Automation Tools: Exposure to ticketing tools like ServiceNow, IBM Control Desk & Remedy, and automation tools such as Rundeck and IBM Runbook Automation, with the ability to effectively utilize them. 
 - Knowledge of Cloud Application Architecture: Understanding of high-level cloud application architecture, with the ability to perform initial analysis on incidents and manage Application ID and cloud elasticity. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Familiarity with Scripting Languages: Exposure to scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash would be beneficial for automation and efficiency in cloud application operations. 
 - Knowledge of Cloud Security: Familiarity with cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks would be advantageous in ensuring the security and integrity of cloud-based solutions. 
 - Experience with Agile Methodologies: Exposure to Agile methodologies and DevOps practices would be valuable in collaborating with development teams and ensuring smooth deployment of cloud applications.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer
data.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support. 

This role is a part of Bluehost's innovation team, the group building the AI-native backbone of our platform while the rest of the business scales around us. You'll design async, production-grade backend systems that treat AI as a first-class citizen: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and provider-agnostic LLM integration, all woven into products millions of small businesses depend on. We want a true go-getter who can take an idea from whiteboard to production without waiting to be told how. 

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture 
 - Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents 
 - Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor 
 - Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service 
 - Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features 
 - Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load 
 - Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe 
 - Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt 
 - Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, with real async I/O experience 
 - Hands-on experience designing and scaling REST or async APIs, including dependency injection and clean service architecture 
 - Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, or similar) and building AI-readiness into backend systems from the ground up 
 - Real experience with vector databases and RAG-style retrieval architectures, not just reading about them 
 - Strong relational database skills: schema design, query optimization, and migration discipline 
 - AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in DevOps and SRE practices, with at least 6 years of hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure for cloud-native applications. 

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, build, and maintain scalable infrastructure on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure). 
 - Develop and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and testing. 
 - Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance, reliability, and availability. 
 - Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and post-mortem reviews. 
 - Implement and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation. 
 - Develop and maintain observability solutions (monitoring, logging, alerting) using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, etc. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to ensure best practices in application reliability, scalability, and security. 
 - Automate operational tasks and improve system efficiency through scripting and tooling. 
 - Ensure compliance with security standards and participate in audits. 

Requirements

QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or related roles. 
 - Strong expertise in cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure). 
 - Proficient in infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation). 
 - Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI). 
 - Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, Go, etc. ). 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog). 
 - Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills. 
 - Experience with security best practices and compliance. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications in cloud platforms or DevOps/SRE. 
 - Experience in high-availability, distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with database management and performance tuning. 
 - Experience with configuration management tools. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: GIS Performance Testing - Senior Associate
data.description:
The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You'll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services-solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We'll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference-every day. 

As a GIS Performance Testing - Senior Associate, you will assess how geospatial applications perform in field service and asset management settings within our Advisory practice. At PwC Acceleration Center India, this client-facing role brings performance testing to technology initiatives involving GIS and Maximo. You will examine system behavior across mapping, asset information, and operational workflows, then turn your findings into recommendations that help clients make informed decisions as they modernize field operations. 

As a Senior Associate, you will manage assigned testing workstreams, apply critical thinking to ambiguous performance issues, and use appropriate methods and technology resources to develop dependable deliverables. You will review junior colleagues' work and offer feedback that helps them connect technical findings to broader client priorities. By anticipating questions and communicating tradeoffs clearly, you will build meaningful client relationships while navigating changing project needs. You will also deepen your understanding of asset-intensive operations, refine your technical skills through feedback, and uphold professional standards and the firm's code of conduct. 

Responsibilities

- Designing GIS performance test plans for field service and asset management workflows, translating client requirements into measurable scenarios, workload profiles, and acceptance criteria
 - Executing load and performance tests across geospatial applications and IBM Maximo Manage integrations, capturing response times, throughput, and system behavior under expected demand
 - Investigating bottlenecks in application integrations and middleware, using architecture diagrams and test data to distinguish configuration, development, and infrastructure issues
 - Evaluating how GIS interactions affect Maximo work management, field service mobility, and asset lifecycle processes, including dispatch and maintenance use cases
 - Coordinating tests of data exchanges involving platforms such as ESRI and Smart Energy Water where applicable, documenting interface behavior and dependencies
 - Developing findings and recommendations from test results, using digital and AI-assisted tools with human review to support technical decisions and client discussions
 - Managing assigned testing workstreams, tracking milestones, defects, and retests while adapting coverage to changing solution requirements and project priorities
 - Reviewing junior team members' test scripts and findings, providing feedback on testing methods and communicating progress to client stakeholders and delivery teams

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
 - At least 3 years of experience
 - Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Preference for a Master's degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Engineering and Business, Industrial Engineering, Management Information Systems, Materials Science and Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Production Engineering
 - Testing GIS application performance across field service and asset management workflows
 - Integrating IBM Maximo Manage with GIS platforms and enterprise systems
 - Analyzing performance findings and translating data into recommendations for client teams
 - Guiding junior colleagues through testing tasks and incorporating stakeholder feedback

Cotecna is a global provider of testing, inspection and certification services. Its digital products support customer portals, field inspection, laboratories, compliance records, certificates, document workflows and operational teams across high-stakes global supply chains. - Own the automation strategy while remaining hands-on with framework design, test development, debugging and execution across Cotecna's digital products.

data.description:
Job Description: Quality Engineer - Oracle Fusion Finance

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Quality Engineer with hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Finance and automation testing tools. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing manual and automated tests to ensure product quality and support continuous improvement initiatives within our QA processes. 

Key Responsibilities

· Serve as the Senior Quality Engineer and Oracle Fusion Finance Subject Matter Expert (SME), ensuring quality across General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), Expense Management, Tax, and Financial Reporting business processes. 

· Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts and test automation frameworks for Oracle Fusion Finance applications using tools such as Playwright, Opkey, or equivalent automation platforms. 

· Create and manage test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test execution activities using JIRA, Zephyr, Xray, or similar test management tools. 

· Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, Finance stakeholders, and business users to define testing requirements, validate business processes, and ensure comprehensive test coverage. 

· Perform integration testing, API testing, data conversion/migration testing, and database validation, including SQL-based data reconciliation between Oracle Fusion Finance and upstream/downstream systems. 

· Analyze test results, identify defects, perform root cause analysis, and partner with development teams to ensure timely issue resolution. 

· Ensure end-to-end requirements traceability, support audit and compliance requirements, and drive continuous quality improvements throughout the SDLC and Agile delivery lifecycle. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

· 7+ years of experience in QA Manual and Automation Testing for enterprise applications, including UI, REST API, and database testing. 

· Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Oracle Fusion Finance with hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management, Expense Management, Tax, Financial Reporting, and Period Close Processes. 

· Strong functional understanding of Oracle Fusion Finance, with working knowledge of related Oracle Fusion modules such as Procurement, Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Supply Chain, and HCM to support end-to-end business processes and integrations. 

· Proven experience testing Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials applications, including business process validation, integration testing, regression testing, data conversion testing, financial reconciliation, and user acceptance testing (UAT). 

· Prior experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) to Oracle Fusion ERP migrations, including data validation, financial reconciliation, end-to-end business process testing, and parallel testing to ensure functional and financial consistency across both platforms. 

· Hands-on experience developing and maintaining test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Opkey, or equivalent automation platforms. 

· Experience with test management and defect tracking tools including JIRA, Zephyr, Xray, or similar solutions. 

· Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using tools such as Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms. 

· Strong proficiency in SQL scripting, financial data validation, reconciliation, and backend/database testing. 

· Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and finance business processes. 

· Strong verbal and written communication skills, with experience collaborating across Finance, business, functional, and technical teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline. 

· Relevant Oracle Cloud Financials certifications, such as Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Certified Implementation Professional, are highly desirable. 

· Experience implementing or supporting Oracle Fusion Financials Cloud in large-scale enterprise environments. 

· Exposure to Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Financial Reporting Center (FRC), Smart View, OTBI, BI Publisher, ADFdi, and cross-functional business process testing.

data.title: Software QA Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Software QA Engineer to join the team responsible for one of X-Rite's strategically important desktop software products. This product plays a critical role in our customers' workflows and has a large installed base worldwide. 

The primary focus of this role is validating product quality through manual testing, exploratory testing, and systematic regression testing. The successful candidate will work closely with software developers, product managers, application support teams, and fellow QA engineers to ensure the reliability, usability, and stability of the product. 

This position is ideal for a quality-focused professional who enjoys understanding complex software systems, investigating defects, and representing the voice of the customer throughout the development process. 

Key Responsibilities

- Execute functional, integration, system, and regression testing for a business-critical Windows desktop application. 
 - Design, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and test cases. 
 - Perform exploratory testing to identify defects and quality risks not covered by scripted test cases. 
 - Validate new features, bug fixes, and software releases. 
 - Reproduce, isolate, document, and verify software defects. 
 - Work closely with developers to investigate issues and validate resolutions. 
 - Participate in requirements reviews and sprint planning activities to help identify quality risks early. 
 - Verify software behavior across different configurations, workflows, and usage scenarios. 
 - Collaborate with Application Support teams to reproduce customer-reported issues. 
 - Assist in maintaining test documentation, test procedures, and quality records. 
 - Contribute to release readiness assessments and product quality evaluations. 

Required Qualifications & Professional Knowledge

- 3+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance. 
 - Experience testing Windows desktop applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies and best practices. 
 - Experience creating and executing detailed test cases and test plans. 
 - Experience performing exploratory, functional, integration, and regression testing. 
 - Ability to investigate, reproduce, and clearly document software defects. 
 - Experience using defect tracking and test management systems. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Attention to detail and a structured approach to testing. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively within globally distributed teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing commercial software products. 
 - Experience validating complex user workflows and business processes. 
 - Experience participating in release testing and software certification activities. 
 - Experience working closely with software development teams. 
 - Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar defect management tools. 
 - Experience working in geographically distributed engineering organizations. 
 - Familiarity with test case management solutions like QATouch. 

Nice to Have

- Experience testing Windows desktop applications
 - Basic understanding of software development concepts and software architecture. 
 - Exposure to test automation tools and automated testing concepts. 
 - Experience testing applications that interact with hardware devices. 
 - Experience with installation and upgrade testing. 
 - Familiarity with installer technologies such as MSI, WiX, or InstallShield. 
 - Familiarity with Agile software development processes. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 3+ years of software quality assurance experience. 
 - Experience testing commercial software products in a professional environment. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong passion for software quality and customer satisfaction. 
 - Curiosity and persistence when investigating difficult defects and intermittent issues. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a methodical testing approach. 
 - Ability to think from the customer's perspective and identify real-world usage scenarios. 
 - Good organizational and documentation skills. 
 - Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ownership mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality software releases. 
 - Comfortable working in a global organization with colleagues across multiple time zones. 
 - Appreciation for the business value and customer impact of mature software products with large installed customer bases. 

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team. 

We Offer

- A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment. 
 - Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field. 
 - A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model. 
 - A human-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R&D department. 
 - Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career. 
 - The opportunity to work on business-critical data platforms that support decision-making across the company. 
 - Be part of building products that address real-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value. 
 - Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America. 
 - A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenges. 
 - The freedom to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and influence technical direction. 
 - Opportunities to take ownership of meaningful areas of product quality and see the impact of your work on customer success. 
 - QA engineers are trusted to contribute not only test results, but also insights, ideas, and improvements that help shape our products and development processes. 

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross-functional teamwork sets us apart. 

X-Rite Pantone, a Veralto company, provides complete end-to-end color management solutions for clients in every industry where color matters. At X-Rite Pantone, you'll deftly blend the art and science of color to help customers inspire, select, measure, formulate, communicate and match color so that users get color right the first time, every time. And along the way, you'll build a vibrant career through rich skill-building opportunities, on-the-job learning, and coaching and training that supports your continued development and growth.

We are looking for a results-driven engineering professional to join the Process Engineering and Product Quality organization, supporting the development and advancement of manufacturing technologies for high-precision medical imaging equipment, including Computed Tomography (CT) and Positron Emission Tomography (PET) systems. 

This role will lead New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing process development, industrial automation, equipment testing, and continuous improvement initiatives. The successful candidate will collaborate with global and local cross-functional teams to improve product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and operational reliability while driving digital transformation and ensuring compliance with medical device Quality Management System (QMS) requirements. 

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world. 

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

- Lead New Product Introduction (NPI) activities and manufacturing transfers for existing products, partnering with global and local Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to ensure manufacturing readiness and smooth production transitions. 
 - Design, develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes, industrial automation solutions, Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), testing equipment, and manufacturing aids to improve production efficiency and product reliability. 
 - Drive technical problem-solving initiatives to resolve manufacturing and medical equipment testing challenges, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and implementation of sustainable corrective actions. 
 - Collaborate with Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) teams to implement Lean Manufacturing, factory modernization, digital transformation, and process automation initiatives. 
 - Lead process qualification and validation of assembly line tools, manufacturing processes, and testing equipment to ensure robust and compliant production operations. 
 - Conduct process risk assessments, failure analysis, and structured problem-solving activities to improve factory and field quality performance and reduce Defects Per Unit (DPU). 
 - Manage Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) and coordinate the implementation of engineering changes on the manufacturing floor while ensuring appropriate documentation and process controls. 
 - Ensure effective implementation and adherence to Quality Management System (QMS) requirements and applicable medical device regulatory standards across manufacturing processes. 
 - Explore opportunities to leverage AI, Machine Learning (ML), advanced analytics, and digital tools to improve manufacturing process monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency. 
 - Coach and mentor Process Engineering team members in manufacturing automation, process development, risk analysis, structured problem-solving, and QMS practices. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, Robotics and Automation, Electrical, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 
 - 7+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing engineering, process engineering, industrial automation, equipment development, or related engineering functions. 
 - Hands-on experience in manufacturing process development, equipment design or development, Special Purpose Machines (SPMs), and equipment troubleshooting. 
 - Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing process improvements, and production engineering activities. 
 - Working knowledge of electromechanical assemblies, electronic components, and Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs). 
 - Practical experience with structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, failure analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies. 
 - Experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS), process qualification, validation, and manufacturing documentation requirements. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple engineering priorities. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare technical documentation, engineering reports, and process-related records. 

Desired Characteristics

- Experience in medical device or high-precision medical equipment manufacturing, particularly CT, PET, or other complex electromechanical systems. 
 - Exposure to AI, Machine Learning (ML), Power BI, or advanced manufacturing analytics for process optimization and digital transformation. 
 - Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies; Green Belt certification is an advantage. 
 - Experience working with global engineering teams on product development, manufacturing transfers, or NPI programs. 
 - Familiarity with manufacturing automation, factory modernization, and advanced manufacturing technologies. 
 - Experience driving manufacturing quality improvements, DPU reduction, and equipment reliability initiatives. 
 - Ability to mentor engineering team members, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive technical initiatives through to completion. 

Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you'd expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you'll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

We are seeking a Senior Quality Engineer with strong healthcare-domain knowledge and hands-on experience in data validation, test automation, and end-to-end quality engineering. Qualifications

- Strong Quality Engineering experience in healthcare data validation and test automation. 
 - Hands-on Epic and/or Oracle Health (Cerner) experience, including clinical workflows and data structures.

 - Proficiency in Python or a comparable scripting language. 
 - Experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, APIs, integrations, and CI/CD. 
 - Knowledge of healthcare data and interoperability standards. 
 - Experience leading QA projects, performing root-cause analysis, and mentoring team members. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Working knowledge of AI-assisted testing or Generative AI is preferred
 - 5+ years of experience in software Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering, including data validation and test automation. 
 - 3+ years of experience testing healthcare applications, integrations, or healthcare data.

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Engineering Manager

Realty of America India (Remote)

Location: Remote, India

Reports to: Director, Product & Engineering

Type: Full-time, Permanent/Contract

About Realty of America

Realty of America is a fast-growing, technology-first real estate brokerage. We support 3, 300+ agents today and are scaling rapidly toward 5, 000 and beyond. Our internal team has grown to roughly 80 staff across operations, brokerage, onboarding, agent experience, finance, and product engineering. We build our own internal tools, including our core platform Rex, alongside integrations into best-in-class third-party SaaS such as Brokerage Engine, SkySlope, Close, Follow Up Boss, RealScout, and others. As we scale, we need a strong engineering leader to own delivery, architecture, and team health for the systems that run our business. 

Why this role exists

Rex and our surrounding platform are the operational backbone of a brokerage scaling past 3, 300 agents. As agent count and staff headcount grow, engineering complexity grows with it. We need someone who can own a team end to end: set technical direction, hold the line on production hygiene, push back on product and business where needed, and build a team that gets stronger over time. This is not a ticket-execution role. It is ownership of outcomes for the areas under your team. 

What you will own

Engineering Leadership

- Facilitate discussions and lead decision-making on all engineering aspects of your team. 
 - Define and execute engineering plans for the areas under your ownership. 
 - Drive engineering best practices across the team. 
 - Define, implement, and maintain hygiene of production systems, both engineering and process, for your areas. 

Business & Delivery Ownership

- Own the health of the business functions directly served by your team. 
 - Challenge product and business on outcomes, channel feedback into execution, and be accountable for engineering output. 
 - Manage all relevant stakeholders, including business, product, operations, and clients or vendors. 

Team Building

- Hire, mentor, and retain a best-of-class engineering team. 
 - Build a team culture around ownership, technical rigor, and accountability. 

Architecture & Systems Design

- Design and develop solutions ranging from simple to complex, including large-scale distributed systems where relevant to Rex and its surrounding platform. 
 - Drive design and architecture of multiple subsystems alongside other senior engineers. 

What we are looking for

Required experience

- 8-10 years of software development experience, including 4+ years leading teams. 
 - Proven track record designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Proven track record building and managing high-performing software development teams. 
 - Practical experience driving design and architecture of multiple subsystems with senior engineers. 
 - BTech, MTech, or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. 

Required ways of working

- Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly to a variety of audiences, including non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Judgment and initiative. We are looking for someone who proposes, pushes back, and owns outcomes, not someone who waits for direction. 
 - Willingness and proven ability to work hours that overlap meaningfully with US Central Time. 
 - Comfort being accountable for both the technical and business outcomes of your team's work. 

Nice to have

- Past experience with startups or other fast-paced, high-growth environments. 
 - Real estate, fintech, or other regulated-industry software experience. 
 - Experience scaling a platform through significant user or transaction growth. 

What we offer

- Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience. 
 - You report directly to the Director of Product
 - and shape engineering strategy for your area from day one. 
 - Remote-first, with the option of working from our India office once it launches. 
 - The opportunity to lead a team building the core platform for a brokerage scaling toward 5, 000+ agents.

data.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. You will support technician performance, prioritizing technician tasks while monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, provide training to technicians, and accelerate your career growth in the process. Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Delivering success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring while promoting a positive and effective team culture. Accountable for overall data center service compliance and quality. Monitor operational KPIs and ticket performance, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions to improve efficiency and service delivery. Drive continuous improvement by reviewing operational processes, identifying inefficiencies, evaluating process changes, and implementing sustainable improvements. Collaborate across teams and functions to address operational challenges, manage dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure seamless service execution. Manage assigned projects, programs, and operational initiatives, ensuring effective planning, execution, resource coordination, and adherence to service delivery objectives. Demonstrate end-to-end ownership and accountability for 24/7 critical data center operations, proactively managing business risks, ensuring operational readiness and service excellence, and responding to incidents beyond standard working hours, including weekends, as required. Provide guidance on and holds team accountable for compliance with Data Center Services (DCS) business unit and service-level policies, procedures, deadlines, and service-change policies. Ensures technicians are trained on procedures for installation, deployment, replacement, and post-execution quality check processes. Verify post-execution quality checks have been performed appropriately by technicians and takes corrective action as needed. Escalate issues through appropriate channels and follow up on issue resolution, sharing knowledge related to issue resolution with appropriate teams. Review process changes to evaluate impact on service execution and share relevant information about change with stakeholders across functions and disciplines. Lead team and triage meetings, prioritizing work across your team, and rebalance priorities to respond to changes. Complete required safety training, conduct daily safety briefings, and participate in on-site safety committees. Ensure technicians and vendor resources comply with all safety procedures (e. g. , Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use). Promote a culture of safety and empower technicians to take action, speak up, and report safety concerns and/or incidents. Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience, displaying accountability and ownership of the data center facilities. Embody our culture and values.

- Associate degree in Computer Science or related field and/or equivalent work experience, AND 6+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or related experience working with technical teams. 
 - 3+ year(s) experience directing, supervising, or managing others. 
 - 4+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. 
 - 3+ years' experience working in a production, mission-critical 24x7x365 data center environment. 
 - Applicable certifications: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation, ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC), Certified Data Center Professional (CDCP), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Six Sigma Green Belt).

data.title: Associate Lead - Software Engineer
data.description:
Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Fountainhead

Job Purpose

The AI Engineer - Generative AI role exists to support the design, development, and deployment of GenAI applications using modern LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG techniques. The position contributes to the organization's AI initiatives by building prototypes, fine?tuning models, and assisting senior engineers in implementing scalable GenAI solutions

Duties And Responsibilities

- GenAI Development
 - Build and test GenAI applications using LLMs (OpenAI, Azure, Vertex, etc. ). 
 - Create and refine prompts for different business scenarios. 
 - Implement basic RAG workflows using embeddings and vector databases. 
 - Assist in fine tuning domain specific models under senior guidance. 

B. Prototyping & POCs

- Support quick POC development for business use cases. 
 - Convert prototypes into working demos with minimal supervision. 
 - Document experiments, results, and prompt iterations. 

C. Engineering Support

- Develop simple APIs or integration components for GenAI features. 
 - Work with senior engineers on testing, debugging, and model evaluation. 
 - Follow coding best practices, clean documentation, and version control. 

D. Research & Continuous Learning

- Stay updated with the latest LLM models, tooling, and GenAI techniques. 
 - Evaluate model performance and experiment with new capabilities. 
 - Contribute ideas for improving current AI solutions. 

Key Decisions / Dimensions

- Model Selection & Customization
 - Choosing the right Speech To Speech, STT, TTS, and S2S models for various Indic languages and dialects. 
 - Deciding between open-source vs. commercial APIs based on latency, cost, and control. 
 - LLM/SLM Strategy
 - Selecting appropriate LLM/SLM architectures for dialogue management and negotiation logic. 
 - Deciding what to fine-tune, distill, or quantize, and what to leave generic. 
 - Edge vs. Cloud Architecture
 - Making trade-offs between on-device processing and cloud-based orchestration. 
 - Defining what runs locally for speed/privacy and what needs backend support. 
 - Emotion & Dialogue Logic Integration
 - Mapping emotional cues to appropriate TTS responses and negotiation tone. 
 - Designing fallback logic for unrecognized or hostile user responses. 
 - Voice Biometrics Algorithm Evaluation
 - Choosing and testing biometric algorithms for authentication and anti-spoofing. 
 - Deciding thresholds for matching, rejection, and fraud escalation. 

Major Challenges

Building a bot that doesn't just answer but negotiates with human-like reasoning. 

Running large models (Speech to Speech/LLM/STT/TTS) in low-latency, low-bandwidth environments without cloud dependency. 

Understanding caller emotions in noisy, multilingual conditions (anger, hesitation, sarcasm). 

Ensuring STT and TTS pipelines work well with dialect-rich, low-resource Indian languages. 

Preventing fraud via recorded calls or deepfake voices. 

Bot must learn from failed interactions

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Educational Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 2 years of experience in AI/ML, with exposure to Natural Language Processing (NLP) and speech technologies. 
 - Bachelor's/Master's/PhD in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related fields. 
 - 7-12 years of experience across Data Engineering, ML Engineering, and AI solution delivery. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise with Python, SQL, cloud services (Azure/GCP/AWS), Spark, ML frameworks. 
 - Deep experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, vector stores, and GenAI platforms. 
 - Proven leadership experience managing Data/ML/AI teams. 
 - 
 - Strong interest and foundational knowledge in Generative AI. 
 - Ability to experiment, iterate, and think creatively with prompts. 
 - Good problem-solving and debugging skills. 
 - Basic understanding of model evaluation and data handling. 
 - Eagerness to learn, high curiosity, and good communication skills.

data.title: MLOps Engineer
data.description:
Insight Global is seeking an AI DevOps / MLOps Engineer to support and scale the infrastructure powering enterprise AI applications and services. This role focuses on the operational side of AI systems, ensuring model-driven applications are reliable, observable, secure, and production-ready. 

The ideal candidate is an infrastructure-focused engineer who has experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms, automating deployments, improving system reliability, and supporting AI workloads in production environments. 

What You'll Do

- Deploy, operate, and optimize AI services running on Kubernetes environments. 
 - Support MLOps and AI platform tooling, including workflow orchestration, model evaluation pipelines, and AI-enabled automation services. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using modern GitOps practices. 
 - Improve system reliability through health checks, readiness probes, autoscaling, rollback strategies, and resiliency patterns. 
 - Develop observability solutions across logs, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and operational runbooks. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across containers, services, networking, secrets management, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Collaborate with AI, platform, and operations teams to establish scalable operating practices for AI systems. 
 - Participate in incident response activities and drive continuous improvements based on lessons learned from production events

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in DevOps, MLOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting production Kubernetes environments. 
 - Experience with machine learning platform technologies such as Kubeflow or similar workflow orchestration tools. 
 - Strong understanding of Docker, Helm, ArgoCD, GitOps methodologies, and modern CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience supporting production systems with monitoring, alerting, incident management, and operational support processes. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services and AI technologies, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, RAG architectures, or LLM-powered applications. 
 - Strong understanding of reliability engineering concepts including scaling, retries, failover, health monitoring, and service recovery. 
 - Experience creating technical documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio. 
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies including Kafka, Event Hub, or Service Bus. 
 - Experience supporting Python-based application environments utilizing FastAPI, Uvicorn, or Gunicorn. 
 - Familiarity with SLO, SLI, incident response, and production support best practices. 
 - Experience supporting AI platforms, RAG pipelines, vector search applications, or enterprise LLM deployments. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are an engineer who enjoys building stable, scalable platforms that enable AI applications to operate reliably in production. You have a strong operational mindset, thrive in cloud-native environments, and are comfortable troubleshooting complex infrastructure challenges. Your background combines DevOps excellence with exposure to modern AI platforms and services. 

Technical Environment

- Kubernetes
 - Kubeflow
 - Docker
 - Helm
 - ArgoCD
 - GitOps
 - Azure
 - Azure OpenAI
 - Azure AI Search
 - CI/CD Pipelines
 - Observability & Monitoring
 - RAG Architectures
 - LLM-Based Services
 - Service Reliability Engineering Practices

Plan A Technologies is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer with strong experience in . NET, Angular, and SQL Server databases to design, develop, and maintain scalable applications within a microservices architecture. Benefits: Vacation, Brand New Laptop, and More: You'll get a generous vacation schedule, and other goodies. 

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

Job Description

About the Company and Team

Oracle is a global technology company delivering enterprise software, database technologies, and cloud infrastructure that help organizations run critical business applications and services. 

Join Oracle's Database organization and contribute to the development and operation of scalable, reliable, cloud-native services. 

The role combines modern backend engineering, infrastructure automation, DevOps practices, and production operations. Engineers contribute across the full software lifecycle, from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. 

The team also embraces AI-assisted software development, using tools such as Codex to accelerate engineering workflows while maintaining strong standards for code quality, security, and reliability. 

As platform capabilities evolve, engineers will have opportunities to contribute to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations that connect cloud services with AI agents.

You will work on complex engineering challenges involving Java, SQL, distributed systems, microservices, infrastructure automation, and production service reliability. 

In this hands-on role, you will build scalable backend capabilities, improve deployment automation, strengthen observability, and troubleshoot complex production incidents. data.title: Senior Automation Tester
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

data.title: Pharmacovigilance Audit Manager
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Pharmacovigilance Audit Manager based in India. 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to lead audit activities and strengthen quality and regulatory compliance across a global healthcare environment. You will oversee risk-based audits and assessments of pharmacovigilance operations, internal processes, facilities, and third-party service providers. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will ensure adherence to applicable regulations, GxP standards, and internal quality requirements. You will also provide expert guidance on complex compliance matters, support regulatory inspections, and drive corrective and preventive actions. In addition to leading audits, you will mentor fellow auditors, contribute to training initiatives, and support continuous improvement across the organization. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient safety, product quality, and regulatory excellence. 

Accountabilities

As Pharmacovigilance Audit Manager, you will lead the planning, execution, and reporting of pharmacovigilance audits while providing technical expertise on quality and regulatory compliance. You will work with internal teams and external partners to identify risks, strengthen audit processes, and ensure that corrective actions are effectively implemented. 

- Independently plan, conduct, and report routine and non-routine pharmacovigilance audits, assessments, and inspections in accordance with the annual audit schedule and applicable procedures. 
 - Lead risk-based audits of pharmacovigilance activities, data, internal facilities, and operational processes to verify compliance with corporate policies, internal standards, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Manage complex and business-critical audits, including due diligence, for-cause, cross-functional, and sensitive audits involving systems and service providers. 
 - Support fellow auditors throughout the planning, execution, and reporting stages of audit activities. 
 - Ensure consistent application of audit procedures, diagnostic tools, standard methodologies, and risk-based assessment approaches. 
 - Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) following audit findings. 
 - Evaluate quality and pharmacovigilance agreements, compliance programs, annual product and promotional reviews, trackers, reports, and performance metrics. 
 - Assess the effectiveness of quality systems and compliance processes within local operating companies and third-party organizations. 
 - Ensure appropriate documentation practices and compliance with regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and internal standards. 
 - Identify non-conformances, assess associated risks, and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive measures are implemented. 
 - Support local operating companies in preparing for regulatory inspections and maintaining inspection readiness. 
 - Participate in regulatory inspections in leadership capacities when required, including acting as inspection host or backroom lead. 
 - Identify auditor training needs, contribute to the development and maintenance of training materials, and deliver training sessions. 
 - Coach and mentor pharmacovigilance auditors, provide constructive performance feedback, and support their professional development. 
 - Review and approve relevant training curricula and ensure personal training requirements are completed on time. 
 - Supervise junior auditors and contractors when required, and deputize for the Audit Manager or Team Lead as needed. 
 - Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with key stakeholders to achieve organizational objectives. 
 - Share regulatory and business expertise, conduct peer reviews of audit reports, and provide independent advice on quality and compliance matters. 
 - Interpret and apply regulatory requirements and internal policies to complex or unusual compliance situations. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced pharmacovigilance professional with substantial expertise in auditing, regulatory compliance, and quality management. You should demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, sound technical judgment, and the ability to manage complex audit activities within global, cross-functional environments. 

- Approximately 15 years of professional experience in pharmacovigilance. 
 - 3-5 years of specific experience in pharmacovigilance auditing. 
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline, such as Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, or a related biomedical field. 
 - Proven expertise in pharmacovigilance and GxP requirements, particularly within complex international operating environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience independently planning, conducting, and reporting risk-based audits. 
 - Strong understanding of regulatory compliance frameworks, quality systems, audit methodologies, and corrective and preventive action processes. 
 - Experience assessing internal operations, third-party service providers, pharmacovigilance agreements, and compliance programs. 
 - Proven ability to drive business results through collaborative, end-to-end project delivery. 
 - Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Familiarity with emerging AI capabilities and their potential application to business and compliance processes. 
 - Ability to work effectively within a matrixed organization and collaborate with stakeholders from diverse professional and cultural backgrounds. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide clear regulatory guidance and communicate complex compliance issues. 
 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple audits, projects, and priorities independently. 

Benefits

- Fully remote working arrangement from India.

 - Exposure to complex international pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory compliance activities. 
 - Opportunities to deepen technical expertise and develop new professional skills across different business areas.

data.title: Pharma/Clinical Operations QA/Test Engineer
data.description:
EazyML, Recognized by Gartner, EazyML (www. EazyML. com) specializes in Responsible AI. Our solutions facilitate proactive compliance and sustainable automation and The company is associated with breakthrough startups like Amelia. ai. 

You will be responsible for testing and validating GenAI- and Agentic AI-powered solutions for pharmaceutical Clinical Operations. This is a hybrid role combining Clinical Operations domain expertise with functional QA and software testing capabilities. 

You will help ensure that our AI solutions not only function correctly but also produce clinically accurate, meaningful, and reliable outputs. This includes understanding clinical trial workflows, reviewing requirements, developing and executing test cases, identifying defects, and validating AI-generated insights and recommendations. 

The ideal candidate has practical experience in Clinical Operations, understands software testing methodologies and basic QA automation, and is comfortable working with GenAI and Agentic AI technologies. You do not need to be an advanced programmer or AI engineer, but you should be able to work effectively with technical teams and evaluate solutions from both a functional and clinical operations perspective. 

Key responsibilities

Core QA and test planning

- Review business requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria to ensure solutions meet clinical operations needs. 
 - Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and user acceptance test cases. 
 - Validate application functionality, reports, dashboards, conversational interfaces, and AI-powered workflows. 
 - Identify, document, reproduce, and track defects through resolution using Jira or similar tools. 
 - Maintain test plans, test cases, test data, execution results, and defect reports. 
 - Collaborate with developers, product managers, and domain experts to resolve functional issues and improve solution quality. 

Pharma clinical operations domain and preferably GxP validation

- Apply working knowledge of clinical trial processes, including study start-up, site selection, patient recruitment, screening, enrollment, site performance, monitoring, and trial execution. 
 - Validate clinical operations workflows, business rules, operational metrics, and AI-generated insights against real-world clinical trial practices. 
 - Assess the accuracy and relevance of trial performance metrics, including enrollment rates, screening failures, site productivity, study milestones, and operational risks. 
 - Understand the role of clinical systems such as CTMS, EDC, eTMF, and related clinical trial platforms. 
 - Review AI-generated clinical operations reports, summaries, and recommendations for domain accuracy, completeness, and practical usefulness. 
 - Apply awareness of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), data integrity, confidentiality, and regulated pharmaceutical environments. 
 - Support risk-based validation and appropriate documentation for solutions used in GxP-relevant workflows, where applicable. 

GenAI and LLM evaluation

- Evaluate GenAI-generated responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, consistency, and alignment with supporting information. 
 - Identify hallucinations, unsupported claims, incorrect calculations, missing information, and misleading conclusions. 
 - Verify that AI-generated clinical insights and recommendations are grounded in appropriate source data and documents. 
 - Develop representative test scenarios, reference datasets, and expected outcomes for clinical operations use cases. 
 - Test AI responses across different prompts, clinical scenarios, input variations, and edge cases. 
 - Understand the non-deterministic nature of LLM outputs and apply appropriate evaluation criteria rather than relying solely on exact text matching. 
 - Collaborate with clinical domain experts and engineers to improve AI response quality and reliability. 

Agent and RAG testing

- Understand the fundamentals of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, including how they retrieve information, use tools, and execute multi-step workflows. 
 - Test AI-powered workflows from a business-user perspective to ensure tasks are completed accurately and logically. 
 - Validate information retrieved from clinical trial documents, operational databases, and other approved sources. 
 - Check whether AI agents correctly interpret user requests, follow business rules, and produce appropriate outputs. 
 - Test exception handling, missing or conflicting information, and situations requiring human review or escalation. 
 - Verify that changes to data sources, prompts, models, or workflows do not introduce functional or domain-related errors. 
 - Identify potential risks involving sensitive clinical data, inappropriate information disclosure, or unsupported automated actions. 

Automation and CI/CD

- Execute and maintain automated functional and regression test cases using established QA tools and frameworks. 
 - Use tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or similar platforms for application and API testing. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate repetitive test scenarios and improve testing efficiency. 
 - Apply basic scripting or programming knowledge, preferably Python, to support test execution and data validation. 
 - Understand how automated testing fits into software development and CI/CD processes. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to develop and improve automated test coverage. 
 - Explore the use of GenAI tools to assist with test case generation, test data preparation, test automation, and defect analysis. 

Quality ownership

- Ensure solutions meet functional requirements and clinical operations expectations before customer delivery. 
 - Define and apply practical acceptance criteria for functional and AI-generated outputs. 
 - Communicate defects, test outcomes, quality risks, and release readiness to project stakeholders. 
 - Support user acceptance testing and customer validation activities. 
 - Maintain clear testing documentation and evidence of validation. 
 - Collaborate with domain experts and engineering teams to continuously improve solution reliability. 
 - Incorporate customer feedback and previously identified issues into regression testing. 
 - Help establish repeatable QA processes for GenAI- and Agentic AI-powered applications. 

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Clinical Research, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - Approximately 4-8 years of relevant professional experience combining Clinical Operations, clinical systems, software QA, or functional validation. 
 - Strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical Clinical Operations, including the clinical trial lifecycle, operational processes, terminology, and performance metrics. 
 - Experience with functional software testing, test case development, defect tracking, regression testing, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Ability to interpret clinical operations requirements and translate them into realistic test scenarios. 
 - Working understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and Agentic AI concepts, including their capabilities and limitations. 
 - Familiarity with software test automation concepts and tools; advanced programming expertise is not required. 
 - Basic understanding of API testing, data validation, and scripting concepts. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify both functional defects and clinically incorrect or misleading outputs. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with business and technical teams. 

Nice to have

- Experience working with pharmaceutical companies, CROs, clinical technology vendors, or life sciences consulting organizations. 
 - Hands-on experience with clinical operations platforms such as CTMS, EDC, eTMF, or clinical analytics applications. 
 - Experience testing or validating GenAI applications, conversational AI solutions, RAG systems, or AI agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks such as Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, or similar tools. 
 - Basic Python, SQL, or JavaScript scripting experience. 
 - Experience with QA automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or pytest. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD environments, Git, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins. 
 - Knowledge of GCP, GxP, GAMP 5, computer system validation, Computer Software Assurance (CSA), 21 CFR Part 11, and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. 
 - Experience validating clinical trial analytics, operational dashboards, KPIs, risk indicators, or AI-generated decision-support insights. 
 - Familiarity with data privacy, security, and responsible AI principles in pharmaceutical applications. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments or with globally distributed technology teams.
