Job Description

What We Do

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don't just make things - we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets. Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in Artificial Intelligence, risk management, big data, mobile and more. 

We are seeking entrepreneurial Agentic Software Engineers to join a newly formed AI Agentic Systems team. This team is tasked with solving firmwide, large-scale compute infrastructure challenges by architecting and deploying autonomous "swarms" of agents. These agents will interface seamlessly with human teams, and complex digital substrates to optimize, analyze, and manage our global technology footprint. 

As a founding member of this team, you will help incubate a new paradigm of software engineering-moving beyond static automation to dynamic, goal-oriented agentic systems that operate across the totality of the firm's business units. 

Key Responsibilities

- Agentic Orchestration: Design and deploy multi-agent systems (swarms) capable of autonomous planning, reasoning, and execution across distributed cloud environments. 
 - System Integration: Build robust interfaces between AI agents, and human stakeholders to ensure high-fidelity feedback loops and operational transparency. 
 - Infrastructure at Scale: Develop agentic solutions for complex compute infrastructure problems, including real-time observability, predictive optimization, and automated capacity planning. 
 - Substrate Development: Contribute to the "agentic substrate"-the underlying platform and tooling that allows agents to securely access data, execute code, and interact with firmwide APIs. 
 - Cross-Functional Incubation: Partner with diverse business units to identify high-impact use cases for agents, translating ambiguous business needs into technical agentic workflows. 

Required Qualifications

- Software Engineering Excellence: Strong proficiency in Python, Go, or C++ with a deep understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native architecture (AWS, Azure, or internal private clouds). 
 - Agentic Experience: Direct experience deploying LLM-based agents in production environments. Familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGPT, or custom-built orchestration layers. 
 - Problem-Solving Domains: Proven track record of applying agentic patterns to at least two of the following: 
 - Data Analysis: Autonomous synthesis of large-scale datasets. 
 - Observability: Self-healing infrastructure and automated root-cause analysis. 
 - Optimization: Dynamic resource allocation and cost management. 
 - Planning: Multi-step task decomposition and execution in non-deterministic environments. 
 - Entrepreneurial Mindset: Ability to thrive in a 0-to-1 environment, comfortable with ambiguity, and driven to build systems that have never existed before. 
Preferred Skills

- Experience with Digital Twin technology and its integration with real-time telemetry.

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. data.title: Solution Architect for Global Partner Card
data.description:
Position Overview

Job Title: Solution Architect for Global Partner Card, VP

Location: Pune - Magarpatta, India

Corporate Title: Vice President

Role Description

- IT (Information Technology) Architects are responsible for a significant segment of the bank's architecture and ensuring it supports overall bank strategy; designing and overseeing the construction of complex IT systems and infrastructure, aligning technology solutions with business goals and requirements. 
 - Work includes analyzing an organization's needs, evaluating existing systems, and designing comprehensive solutions that meet functional and technical specifications using a deep understanding of one or more various technology domains, such as infrastructure architecture, application development, data platforms, cloud computing, security with the appropriate business domain knowledge. 
 - They collaborate with stakeholders, including business leaders, project managers, and developers, to gather requirements and translate them into architectural designs; considering factors like scalability, performance, reliability, security, and cost-effectiveness when creating blueprints for IT systems. 
 - They define architecture principles to guide solution design, develop the target technology estate to support the organization's business strategies, develop roadmaps to enable transition to the target estate, govern the transition and provide guidance and support throughout the implementation process, ensuring that solutions are built according to architecture principles and align to the roadmaps and organization's target architecture. 
 - They often act as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, helping to communicate technical concepts in a clear and understandable manner. 

What We'll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy

- Best in class leave policy
 - Gender neutral parental leaves
 - 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 - Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 - Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 - Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 - Accident and Term life Insurance
 - Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end solution architecture for Global Partner Card applications, aligning business requirements and technology decisions with enterprise architecture principles, business priorities and platform modernization goals. 
 - Define target-state architectures and transition roadmaps for Java and Spring Boot microservices; assess the existing application landscape, identify dependencies and technical debt, and guide phased delivery toward the target estate. 
 - Translate business and functional requirements into solution designs covering application components, service boundaries, REST API contracts and end-to-end data flows; define integration patterns, versioning and backward compatibility. 
 - Define Oracle-backed data and persistence architecture, including data models, ownership, transaction boundaries, consistency, access patterns and schema evolution; guide the appropriate use of Spring Data JPA/Hibernate and JDBC. 
 - Design reliable integrations across card applications, partner systems and shared services; evaluate synchronous REST and asynchronous messaging approaches, including timeouts, retries, circuit breakers and idempotency. 
 - Embed security and privacy requirements into solution architecture, including Spring Security, authentication, authorization, secrets management, sensitive-data protection and auditability; collaborate with security and control stakeholders to address applicable requirements. 
 - Lead architecture reviews and maintain solution documentation, architectural decisions, standards and reusable patterns; evaluate technology options and trade-offs, secure required approvals and manage architecture risks and exceptions. 
 - Define measurable non-functional requirements for scalability, performance, availability, resilience and recoverability; partner with engineering and QA teams to validate architectural assumptions through prototypes and appropriate testing. 
 - Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to define deployment and operational architecture, including CI/CD, environment configuration and container or cloud approaches where applicable; balance maintainability, cost and delivery constraints. 
 - Define observability and operational requirements, including Spring Boot Actuator health checks, metrics, logging, tracing and alerting; ensure application and database designs support agreed service objectives and production diagnostics. 
 - Provide architectural guidance throughout implementation and review delivered solutions for alignment with approved designs and roadmaps; support production readiness and resolve design-level issues identified through incidents and root-cause analysis. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders, enterprise and domain architects, engineers, QA, operations and vendors to align cross-domain dependencies and communicate architectural decisions; mentor teams and guide resolution of design and delivery trade-offs. 

Your Skills And Experience

- At least 10 years of experience in Java solution design and software development, with demonstrated experience owning end-to-end solution architecture and guiding enterprise application delivery. 
 - Strong experience translating business requirements into architectural designs, defining target states and transition roadmaps, and evaluating technology trade-offs across scalability, reliability, security, maintainability and cost. 
 - Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot and Spring Framework, supported by practical development experience; ability to assess design patterns, configuration, dependency management and transaction handling, and guide implementation teams. 
 - Proven experience designing microservices and REST APIs, including service boundaries, API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility and end-to-end integration; ability to evaluate synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns. 
 - Strong experience with Oracle-backed data architecture, including relational data modeling, data ownership, access patterns, transaction boundaries, consistency and schema evolution; sound knowledge of SQL performance, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate and JDBC. 
 - Experience incorporating security, privacy and auditability into solution designs, including authentication, authorization, Spring Security, secrets management and sensitive-data protection; ability to work with security and control stakeholders. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed-system design and measurable non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, resilience and recoverability; experience evaluating failure scenarios, idempotency, retries and circuit breakers. 
 - Experience leading architecture reviews, documenting architectural decisions and managing design risks, dependencies and exceptions; ability to validate designs through prototypes and testing, and assess alignment with architecture principles and roadmaps. 
 - Sound knowledge of deployment and operational architecture, including CI/CD, environment configuration, observability and production readiness; familiarity with Spring Boot Actuator, metrics, logging and tracing, and experience resolving design-level production issues. 
 - Proven ability to influence business and technical stakeholders, collaborate with enterprise and domain architects and vendors, and mentor engineering teams; strong communication skills to explain complex designs, negotiate trade-offs and guide delivery in an Agile environment. 
 - Desirable: experience with cards or payments applications and transaction processing, together with practical exposure to asynchronous messaging, container-based deployment and cloud architecture. 

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 

How We'll Support You

- Training and development to help you excel in your career
 - Coaching and support from experts in your team
 - A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
 - A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About Us And Our Teams

Please visit our company website for further information: 

https: //www. db. com/company/company. html

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively. 

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group. 

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

data.title: Director of Engineering
data.description:
Position: Director of Engineering

Location: Bangalore / Delhi

Employment type: Full-time, hybrid

Reporting to: CEO, Aplyd

Role composition: Approximately 90% hands-on engineering and applied AI; 10% team management

About Aplyd

Aplyd, part of the Athena Infonomics Group, builds digital and applied AI solutions across rural development, agriculture, micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), and urban services. 

We bring together technology, domain expertise, and an understanding of field realities to solve practical problems. Our focus is on building solutions that people can use, institutions can sustain, and communities can benefit from. 

The opportunity

Some of the most interesting engineering problems emerge where data is imperfect, infrastructure is uneven, and the consequences of getting a solution right are meaningful. 

At Aplyd, you might work on interpreting satellite imagery to support agricultural decisions, detecting patterns in field video, forecasting demand for public services, or developing optimization models for resource allocation. Alongside the models, you will build the applications, data pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure that make these capabilities useful in practice. 

We are looking for a Director of Engineering who is technically curious, deeply engaged in building, and motivated to make a difference through their work. 

You will work directly with the CEO to shape technology choices and take solutions from early exploration to dependable operation. This is an opportunity to combine the technical involvement of a principal engineer with ownership of Aplyd's engineering direction. 

We have deliberately designed this role around approximately 90% hands-on technical contribution and 10% team management. Your work will include architecture, coding, data engineering, model development, experimentation, deployment, debugging, and optimization. You will also guide a lean team through clear priorities, thoughtful reviews, and practical mentorship. 

The technical breadth we are looking for

Our Work Requires Different Methods For Different Problems. We Are Therefore Looking For Demonstrated Experience Across Multiple Applied AI Domains, With Substantive Implementation Experience In At Least Two Of The Following Areas

- 
 - Computer vision: Image classification, object detection, segmentation, tracking, or visual measurement. 
 - Video intelligence: Event detection, activity recognition, spatiotemporal analysis, or video processing pipelines. 
 - Geospatial analytics and remote sensing: Satellite imagery analysis, spatial modelling, earth observation, or raster and vector processing. 
 - Predictive modelling: Supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical modelling, and decision support using structured data. 
 - Time series forecasting: Temporal modelling, backtesting, uncertainty estimation, and forecasting under changing conditions. 
 - Anomaly detection: Identifying unusual patterns or operational deviations in temporal, spatial, or multivariate data. 
 - Optimization: Mathematical programming, constraint-based optimization, scheduling, or resource allocation. 
We value the ability to explain your decisions: how you framed a problem, understood the data, selected a baseline, tested an approach, and adapted it for actual use. 

Experience with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational AI, and agentic workflows is welcome as part of this broader foundation. For this role, experience must extend beyond chatbot development, prompt engineering, LLM API integration, and orchestration frameworks to include substantive work in the applied AI domains above. That breadth is essential to the problems Aplyd is working to solve. 

What You Will Do

Shape the architecture and build the technology

- 
 - Own Aplyd's technical architecture and translate organizational priorities into a practical engineering roadmap. 
 - Write, test, review, and maintain production code across applications, services, data pipelines, and AI components. 
 - Build prototypes, test the assumptions behind them, and develop promising approaches into reliable systems. 
 - Make thoughtful choices about technology stacks, system design, and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Investigate difficult engineering problems directly, including performance bottlenecks, integration failures, and data issues. 
 - Develop reusable capabilities that help Aplyd deliver effectively across projects. 
Develop applied AI solutions across domains

- 
 - Work with domain experts to translate practical challenges into well-defined modelling, analytical, or optimization tasks. 
 - Contribute directly to data exploration, feature engineering, model development, and evaluation. 
 - Select techniques based on the problem, available evidence, and operating constraints. 
 - Establish meaningful baselines and evaluate accuracy, robustness, latency, cost, and usefulness. 
 - Build reproducible workflows for training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining. 
 - Address issues such as data leakage, class imbalance, missing data, distribution shifts, and model drift. 
 - Integrate model outputs into applications and decisions, with appropriate human review and traceability. 
Establish strong digital and data foundations

- 
 - Build reliable capabilities for data collection, ingestion, validation, transformation, storage, and access. 
 - Work across structured, unstructured, spatial, temporal, image, and video data. 
 - Define clear data models, API contracts, metadata, and data quality practices. 
 - Connect field applications, government platforms, partner systems, and external datasets. 
 - Design for practical conditions such as intermittent connectivity, low bandwidth, varied devices, and uneven data quality. 
 - Embed security, privacy, access controls, and appropriate consent mechanisms into system design. 
Take solutions into dependable operation

- 
 - Build infrastructure appropriate to each solution's scale, budget, and reliability needs. 
 - Establish automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, containerization, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Implement useful application and model monitoring, logs, metrics, and alerts. 
 - Own deployment, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and recovery practices. 
 - Optimize compute, storage, inference, and cloud costs. 
 - Ensure systems are documented and maintainable as their use grows. 
Stay close to the people using the technology

- 
 - Work directly with governments, field teams, rural communities, and sector specialists. 
 - Participate in discovery, field visits, pilots, and implementation reviews as needed. 
 - Understand existing workflows and the conditions that influence adoption. 
 - Turn evolving requirements into testable prototypes and achievable delivery milestones. 
 - Explain technical choices and trade-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. 
 - Use feedback and deployment evidence to improve the solution. 
Lead through technical contribution

- 
 - Set clear priorities and help a lean engineering team deliver with focus. 
 - Mentor colleagues through pairing, code reviews, design discussions, and troubleshooting. 
 - Help recruit engineers and specialists as organizational needs evolve. 
 - Coordinate external technical partners where needed. 
 - Encourage curiosity, sound judgment, shared ownership, and constructive technical debate. 
What You Will Bring

Essential experience and capabilities

- 
 - A strong record of personally building and shipping software and applied AI solutions, including systems used in production. 
 - Practical experience across multiple applied AI domains, with substantive depth in at least two of the areas described above. 
 - Current coding proficiency and confidence working directly in complex or unfamiliar codebases. 
 - Strong Python skills for applied AI and data engineering, together with the ability to build the services and integrations needed to operationalize solutions. 
 - Sound software engineering fundamentals across algorithms, data structures, system design, databases, APIs, testing, and debugging. 
 - A practical understanding of statistics, machine learning evaluation, and experimental design. 
 - Experience with relevant ML frameworks and libraries, supported by a clear understanding of their methods and trade-offs. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, deployment automation, and production monitoring. 
 - Ownership across the delivery lifecycle, from problem definition and implementation to deployment and iteration. 
 - The ability to make progress with a small team, limited resources, and evolving requirements. 
 - Clear communication and an interest in learning from users and domain experts. 
 - A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
Experience That Would Be Especially Valuable

- 
 - Building products or technical capabilities from an early stage. 
 - Working in agriculture, rural development, MSMEs, public services, or urban systems. 
 - Using spatial databases, GIS tools, satellite imagery, or large image and video datasets. 
 - Building offline-first applications, edge inference systems, or tools for low-connectivity environments. 
 - Implementing MLOps, model serving, data versioning, and reproducible experimentation. 
 - Contributing to open-source software, technical research, independent projects, or other work that reflects sustained technical curiosity. 
The working style that fits this role

You are likely to enjoy this opportunity if you find yourself asking how a system works, why a model fails on a particular dataset, or whether there is a simpler way to solve a difficult problem-and then opening the code or running an experiment to investigate. 

You enjoy turning an incomplete problem statement into something tangible. You are comfortable moving between modelling, software, data, and infrastructure, while knowing when to seek deeper expertise. You care about readable code, reproducible results, and what happens after a deployment reaches its users. 

A startup mindset is central to this role: initiative, resourcefulness, short learning cycles, and personal ownership of delivery. We are looking for someone who enjoys building with a lean team and can establish just enough structure to help good work move forward. 

Candidates may have developed these strengths in startups, research teams, product organizations, or larger companies. For those coming from a large multinational or traditional enterprise IT environment, the most relevant experience will be recent, direct ownership of coding, applied AI, architecture, and production delivery in a lean setting. Experience centred primarily on enterprise IT service delivery, governance, vendor coordination, or people management would need to be complemented by substantial hands-on product engineering and applied AI work. 

What Success Looks Like

During the first year, you will help establish: 

- 
 - A focused technology roadmap connected to priority problems and realistic milestones. 
 - Working solutions that progress from experimentation to dependable use. 
 - Reliable data pipelines and interoperable systems that support multiple applications. 
 - Applied AI capabilities evaluated against meaningful baselines and monitored after deployment. 
 - Engineering practices that support quality, security, maintainability, and affordable operation. 
 - A capable, lean team that benefits from your technical guidance and direct contribution. 
 - Evidence that the technology is useful to the people and institutions it is intended to serve. 
Why join Aplyd?

This role offers the opportunity to stay deeply technical while shaping an organization's engineering direction. 

You will work closely with the CEO, collaborate with domain experts and communities, and encounter problems that demand both intellectual curiosity and practical ingenuity. You will have room to experiment, responsibility for making solutions work, and a clear connection between your engineering decisions and their real-world value. 

If you enjoy building, learning across disciplines, and applying technology to meaningful problems, we would welcome a conversation. 

APLYD is an Equal Opportunities Employer

APLYD, part of the Athena Infonomics group, is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status. 

AI Proficiency and Responsible Use

Proficiency in the responsible and sophisticated use of AI is a mandatory requirement for all roles, across all levels and functions at APLYD and Athena Infonomics.

data.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200, 000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions. 

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. Executes software development projects with high quality design and architecture with a focus on performance, scalability, and stability. You will apply strong software engineering expertise and practical knowledge of public key infrastructure (PKI), digital certificates, key management, and signing automation to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

Experience and expertise

data.title: Staff Software Engineer – AI Platform
data.description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1, 500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore. 

The Role

We are currently seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure to join the AI Platform team that powers seamless insights and interaction through natural language and data intelligence across our AI products. 

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll architect, build, and operate the backend and platform systems that power AI Platform. You'll work across service design, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, event-driven processing, observability, CI/CD, and production reliability, helping shape the technical direction of a platform that supports scalable, client-facing AI experiences. 

This role requires a strong software engineering foundation combined with deep infrastructure and systems thinking. We are looking for an engineer who can write high-quality production code, make sound architectural tradeoffs, and own platform capabilities end-to-end - not someone focused only on scripting, cloud configuration, or infrastructure tooling in isolation. 

You will collaborate closely with frontend, product, and AI/ML engineers to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable systems that align with Addepar's standards of performance, resilience, and trust. 

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and operate backend services and infrastructure that power AI Platform products. 
 - Write high-quality production code for platform and service layers, with strong emphasis on maintainability, reliability, and performance. 
 - Architect and evolve distributed systems that support AI Platform capabilities such as real-time interactions, asynchronous processing, and secure data workflows. 
 - Build and extend cloud-native infrastructure across core services, networking, storage, identity, and observability layers. 
 - Design and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, environment management, and drift-safe workflows. 
 - Build and operate Kubernetes/EKS-based services, including deployment strategies, health checks, scaling configuration, and containerization workflows. 
 - Design and improve CI/CD pipelines, release workflows, and engineering productivity systems. 
 - Build and maintain asynchronous and event-driven systems using queues, RPC/service communication, and resilient failure-handling patterns. 
 - Design and evolve relational and NoSQL data models, including schema design, migrations, replication, and access patterns. 
 - Build and maintain observability across metrics, logs, tracing, dashboards, and alerting. 
 - Apply secure-by-default engineering practices across IAM, secrets, encryption, network isolation, and production operations. 
 - Mentor engineers through code review, design review, incident reviews, and technical guidance. 
 - Drive technical decisions that improve platform reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and long-term system health. 

Who You Are

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - At least 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in backend, infrastructure OR platform oriented work. 
 - Strong proficiency in at least one production backend language such as Python (preferred), Go, OR Java and the ability to work effectively across a polyglot environment. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, debugging, code quality, testing, and operational ownership. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure in production environments. 
 - Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code workflows such as Terraform or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience with Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, and modern deployment practices. 
 - Experience designing or extending CI/CD pipelines in production environments. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, microservice communication, message queues, asynchronous processing, and failure handling. 
 - Experience with both relational and NoSQL database design in production systems. 
 - Strong observability and production-debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills. 
 - Ability to operate as a software engineer first: we are not looking for someone who is only strong in scripting, cloud configuration, or infrastructure tooling without corresponding depth in production software engineering. 

Bonus

- Experience with AI/ML platform tooling such as Databricks, Spark, MLflow, or model-serving systems. 
 - Experience with real-time streaming or WebSocket-based systems at scale. 
 - Experience with multi-region architectures, data residency, or failover design. 
 - Experience in fintech or other highly regulated environments. 
 - Experience optimizing platform cost, performance, and reliability tradeoffs at scale. 

Important Note: This role requires working from our Pune office 3 days a week (Hybrid work model)

Our Values

- Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes. 
 - Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
 - Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success. 
 - Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
 - Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. 

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews, " and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar. com.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Job Title: Senior SRE

Location: Bangalore

Position Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) will help keep Kaseya's globally distributed SaaS production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. This role combines software engineering and operations capabilities to strengthen infrastructure monitoring, automate operational tasks, resolve incidents, and improve the stability and capacity of production environments.

- Support and maintain Kaseya's globally distributed SaaS infrastructure. 
 - Manage and monitor virtual machines across hybrid virtualization environments, including Hyper-V, VMware, Amazon EC2, and Microsoft Azure. 
 - Enhance and support global infrastructure and cloud software monitoring solutions. 
 - Collaborate effectively with R&D, Customer Success, Support, and Operations teams. 
 - Investigate and resolve hardware, operational, infrastructure, performance, and application incidents. 
 - Perform preventative maintenance and troubleshooting to maintain infrastructure and application stability. 
 - Provision new servers as required to anticipate and meet production server capacity needs. 
 - Participate in weekly maintenance activities and rotational on-call support, including after-hours work when required. 

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of Windows administration experience, including Active Directory, IIS, disk management, Windows patching, and performance troubleshooting, along with experience administering Linux-based production systems such as Ubuntu and RHEL. 
 - Experience with virtualization technologies and processes, including P2V, vMotion, and VMware vCenter. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure. 
 - Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and load balancing. 
 - Strong fault analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills; ability to work effectively in a distributed team and manage multiple priorities. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Basic scripting experience in PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Datadog. 
 - Working knowledge of databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. 
 - Working knowledge of container technologies such as Docker. 
 - Relevant Microsoft and/or Linux certifications. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Development

You will work with other developers to make sure that solutions developed are secure, reusable, maintainable and performant.

Quality

- Participate in code reviews to gain feedback on your technique from senior peers and to give advice to junior peers. Review senior developers' code to enhance your skills and knowledge. 
 - Write automated unit tests for any newly created code; and
 - Perform manual testing to ensure any changes made to the system are of a high standard and the system hasn't regressed. Collaboration / Communication
 - Engage in the collaboration and communication channels in the organisation. Participate in solution design to ensure that creative solutions and tough problems solved are called out appropriately to the developer community, and where they lead to visible outcomes, to the broader FNZ teams and clients. 
 - Collaborate with other developers to share knowledge, best practices, useful technology, and opportunities for cross-project system design / solutions. 
 - Mentor new starters to ensure they understand both platform and SDLC. 
 - Deliver knowledge-sharing sessions on topics of your personal expertise. 

Technology

- Stay up to date with industry practices, new technologies, tools and methods and suggestion adoption that are best suited to FNZ. 
 - Proactively resolve technical (environmental, coding and testing) issues that impede development progress. Assist in the resolution of technical issues when requested. 
 - Create novel solutions to problems by incorporating cutting edge technology or generic concepts. 

Functional Area Responsibilities

Analyst Developers at FNZ are all-rounders who can work across the full stack. This role involves working with complex business requirements in a wide range of functional areas in the financial services and platform domain. In this role, you are responsible for continued learning both in the FNZ business domain and your technical skills as a professional software engineer. You achieve this growth through hands-on work, training and interaction with your senior colleagues. You are also responsible for collaborating with internal and client SMEs to deliver complex data mapping solutions for migrations: analyzing, designing and maintaining ETL workflows, resolving issues, testing and providing post-implementation support. Analyst Developers own non-functional requirements and are responsible for ensuring that their code complies with coding standards, is secure and performs well. At entry-level, you are responsible for learning best-practice in these areas from your senior peers. 

Experience Required

Primary requirements

- Bachelor's degree or higher (min A- average for under-graduate, first class for post-graduate); 
 - Confident, and able to take initiative in a delivery-focused environment; 
 - Independent, self-directed working style; 
 - Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic fast-paced industry; 
 - Enjoy working as part of a high-performance team; 
 - Hard-working, innovative and takes pride in their work; and
 - Passionate about creating innovative solutions for customers. 

Secondary requirements

- Some experience with one or many programming languages; 
 - Experience with the following modern and legacy development products and frameworks: Microsoft . NET, C#/VB. NET, ASP. NET, MVC, WebAPI and SQL Server, Javascript, ReactJS, jQuery. 
 - Experience with web development
 - Familiarity with financial products and markets
 - Understanding of web services and enterprise integration patterns. 
 - Familiar with tools for code analysis and automated testing

About FNZ Culture

Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. At FNZ we know that great impact is only possible with great teamwork. That's why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team. 

The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world. 

- Customer obsessed for the long-term
 - Think big and make an impact
 - Act now and own it all the way
 - Challenge, commit and win together

Read more about The FNZ Way and our values: www. fnz. com/culture

Opportunities

- Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams - experts in their respective fields - who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact. 
 - Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world's largest companies; 
 - Working in a flexible and agile way that meets the needs of the business and personal circumstances; 
 - Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority; 
 - We provide global career opportunities for our best employees at any of our offices in the UK, EU, US, Canada, South Africa and APAC. 

Commitment to Equal Opportunities

At FNZ, we recognise that diversity, equity and inclusion are important factors contributing to our success. We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals. Recruitment decisions at FNZ are made in a non-discriminatory manner without regard to gender, ethnicity/race, faith, age, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, socio-economic background, disability or military veteran status where all applicants and employees are valued and respected. In addition, we want to ensure accessibility needs are well supported, if you require specific support please advise us. 

About FNZ

FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back. 

We created wealth's growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution. 

We partner with the world's leading financial institutions, with over US$2. 5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP). 

Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.

Education & Experience

 - Strong understanding of Linux and operating system internals, including scheduling, memory management, synchronization, and performance profiling. 
 - Experience with distributed systems, storage architectures, and networking fundamentals. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and experience developing automation and performance analysis tools. 
 - Working knowledge of JavaScript and modern development practices. 
 - Understanding of parallel programming, concurrency, and scalability concepts.

Storage Systems, Object Storage, File Storage, Distributed Systems, Linux Internals, Performance Engineering, Network Performance Analysis, Benchmarking, Scalability Testing, Automation, Python Development, JavaScript Development, Root Cause Analysis, Cloud Storage Architectures, Observability, Testing & Automation

data.title: Engineer I - Android Development [T500-30804]
data.description:
Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients. 

About Leggett & Platt: 

Founded in 1883, Leggett & Platt (NYSE: LEG) is a global manufacturer that designs and produces innovative products and components used in homes, offices, and vehicles around the world. The company serves customers across industries through its expertise in bedding, furniture, flooring, specialty products, and comfort technologies. Driven by a mindset of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, Leggett & Platt has spent more than 140 years creating solutions that support everyday comfort and help people live and work better. 

Leggett & Platt is seeking an Android Developer to join our engineering team at our Development Center in Trivandrum, India. This is an excellent opportunity to build and own native Android experiences as part of a single engineering organization that spans Trivandrum and the United States. In this position, you will design, build, and maintain high-quality Android applications, working daily with product, design, and backend counterparts across both locations to ship polished, reliable features. We are looking for a highly collaborative engineer who takes pride in craftsmanship, communicates clearly across distance and time zones, and continuously raises the bar on app quality and performance. 

What you will be doing as Android Developer: 

- Design, build, and maintain native Android applications using Kotlin and modern Android architecture components (Jetpack Compose, MVVM/MVI). 
 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers across Trivandrum and the United States to define requirements and deliver polished user experiences. 
 - Write clean, testable, well-documented code following Android development best practices and company coding standards. 
 - Integrate RESTful APIs and backend services, including services hosted on Microsoft Azure, into mobile applications. 
 - Implement and maintain automated unit, integration, and UI tests to ensure app quality and stability. 
 - Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers and upholding engineering quality standards. 
 - Own the release process for Android applications, including versioning, build configuration, and Google Play Store submissions. 
 - Diagnose and resolve performance issues, crashes, and bugs across a range of Android devices and OS versions. 
 - Collaborate with QA to define test plans and ensure comprehensive test coverage before releases. 
 - Stay current with Android platform updates, new APIs, and industry best practices, recommending adoption where appropriate. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements for automated build, test, and deployment of Android applications. 
 - Partner with iOS and backend engineering counterparts to ensure feature parity and a consistent user experience across platforms. 

To be successful in this role, you will need: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 - 4+ years of professional experience building and shipping native Android applications. 
 - Strong proficiency in Kotlin (Java experience also considered). 
 - Hands-on experience with modern Android architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI) and Jetpack libraries (Compose, Navigation, Room, Work Manager, Lifecycle). 
 - Experience with asynchronous programming using Coroutines and/or Flow. 
 - Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with JSON/serialization libraries. 
 - Familiarity with dependency injection frameworks (Hilt or Dagger). 
 - Experience with unit testing (JUnit, Mockito) and UI testing (Espresso). 
 - Proven track record collaborating effectively with globally distributed teams, including counterparts in the United States across overlapping hours. 
 - Solid understanding of Git version control and collaborative development workflows. 
 - Strong debugging and performance-tuning skills across a range of devices and Android OS versions. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts to varied audiences across time zones and cultures. 

Things we consider a plus: 

Reasons You'll Love It Here: 

Our benefits may vary slightly by location, but at our Trivandrum office you can expect a comprehensive package including group health insurance for you and your family, Provident Fund (PF) and gratuity contributions, generous paid time off including earned leave, casual leave, sick leave, and public holidays, and paid parental leave. We also strongly encourage and provide opportunities for learning and professional development. Our Learning & Development team has put together in-house training on subjects like front-line supervisor essentials, technical leadership, how to manage conflict in the workplace, and many others. 

What to Do Next: 

Now that you've had a chance to learn more about us, what are you waiting for! Apply today and allow us the opportunity to learn more about you and the value you can bring to our team. Once you apply, be sure to create a profile, and sign up for job alerts, so you can be the first to know when new opportunities become available. 

Our Commitment to You: 

We're proud of the fact that we are strongly rooted in being an inclusive, people-focused organization. Our company culture reflects values like integrity, ownership, and authenticity. We take these to heart, and if you do as well, you'll fit right in. Leggett & Platt Inc. is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds. 

Since 1883, Leggett & Platt (NYSE: LEG) has been creating a wide variety of innovative products that can be found in most homes, offices, and automobiles. Today our growing company consists of more than 23, 000 employee-partners in 120 manufacturing facilities located in 23 countries, including our engineering Development Center in Trivandrum, India. We're not just hiring; we're building a better company. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

- Production experience with Jetpack Compose at scale. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Mobile services or Azure-hosted backend integration. 
 - Experience with CI/CD tools for mobile (Fastlane, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise). 
 - Experience publishing and managing apps in the Google Play Console, including staged rollouts and A/B testing. 
 - Familiarity with Material Design guidelines and accessibility best practices. 
 - Exposure to Kotlin Multiplatform or other cross-platform approaches. 
 - Experience with push notifications, deep linking, and analytics/crash reporting SDKs (Firebase, App Center). 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows (e. g. , GitHub Copilot, Claude Code).

data.title: Lead Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
About Onit

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions. 

We're a team of innovators using AI at the core to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we're looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech. 

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we'd love to meet you. 

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Lead Quality Engineer with 8-10 years of experience in manual testing, test automation, API testing, and performance testing of enterprise SaaS applications. 

The ideal candidate should have strong product understanding and business acumen, with the ability to independently analyze requirements, identify functional gaps, design comprehensive test scenarios, and validate complex business workflows. 

This role requires a balanced approach to manual and exploratory testing, automation engineering, and technical leadership, ensuring high-quality product delivery through proactive defect prevention, comprehensive test coverage, and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop a deep understanding of product functionality, business workflows, customer use cases, and functional requirements to ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 - Perform hands-on manual, functional, exploratory, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing of new features, enhancements, and complex enterprise workflows. 
 - Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and Engineering teams to analyze requirements, clarify expected behaviour, identify functional gaps, and proactively assess testing risks. 
 - Design and maintain comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test data covering critical business workflows, edge cases, and customer-specific use cases. 
 - Drive automation coverage across functional, regression, integration, and critical end-to-end business workflows using Playwright. Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable, reusable, and reliable test automation frameworks. 
 - Lead defect triaging, root cause analysis, and preventive quality improvement initiatives to reduce production defects. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to quality engineers in manual testing, automation development, test design, and quality engineering best practices. 
 - Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and release readiness assessments to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test case design, automation development, debugging, and overall QA productivity. 
 - Take end-to-end ownership of feature quality, ensuring comprehensive functional validation, automation coverage, and release readiness. 

Required Skills

- Experience: 8-10 years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering, including manual testing, test automation, and technical leadership. 
 - Manual & Functional Testing: Strong expertise in manual, functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing of complex enterprise SaaS applications. 
 - Product & Business Understanding: Ability to quickly understand product functionality, business workflows, customer use cases, and requirements to identify functional gaps, edge cases, and potential customer-impacting issues. 
 - Test Strategy & Design: Proven experience designing comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, and test data based on business requirements, acceptance criteria, and risk-based testing approaches. 
 - UI Test Automation: Advanced hands-on experience with Playwright, including designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and reusable automation frameworks. 
 - Database & SQL: Strong SQL skills for backend data validation, data integrity checks, and testing complex business workflows. 
 - CI/CD Integration: Experience integrating functional and API automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent tools. 
 - Defect Analysis & Troubleshooting: Strong debugging, defect triaging, root cause analysis, and automation failure investigation skills. 
 - AI-Assisted Quality Engineering: Practical experience using AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or other LLM-based solutions for test case generation, automation scripting, debugging, and improving QA productivity. 
 - Agile & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working closely with Product Managers, Developers, Architects, and DevOps teams in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to mentor quality engineers, review test scenarios and automation code, establish testing standards, and drive continuous quality improvements. 
 - Ownership & Accountability: Ability to independently own end-to-end feature quality, from requirement analysis and manual validation through automation, defect resolution, and release readiness. 

Benefits & Perks That Support You

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond: 

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members. 

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually. 

Family Support: Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement. 

Income Protection: 100% employer-paid life and disability insurance. 

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident. 

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Flexi, NPS. 

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community. 

Our Commitment to Applicants

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we're looking for. 

Onit Values

Customer First - Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs. 

Purposeful Innovation - Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise. 

Win as One - Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly. 

Intentional Growth - Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: QA Engineer for F2B Test Management, AS
data.description:
Position Overview

Job Title: QA Engineer for F2B Test Management, AS

Location: Pune - Magarpatta, India

Corporate Title: Associate

Role Description

- Quality Assurance (QA) is responsible for ensuring testing strategies, plans and deliverables are executed for all applications and programs of work within their domain. 

Work includes: 

- Designing and conducting testing procedures and frameworks to verify software and other technical products to ensure expected functional performance 
 - Investigating instances where software and technical products do not perform as expected 
 - Designing and conducting quality assurance practices to support business development activities 
 - Driving the adoption of recognized best practice and policy and contributes to the ongoing improvement of methodologies and assets for the business 
 - Working with their counterparts across the business to raise the standard of QA across the bank
 - Recording of defects and the collation of metrics and KPI information for reporting purposes
 - Testing disciplines include: Performance Testing, Test Automation, Test Processes, Testing Products

What We'll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you'll enjoy

- Best in class leave policy
 - Gender neutral parental leaves
 - 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 - Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 - Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 - Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 - Accident and Term life Insurance
 - Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your Key Responsibilities

- End-to-end test management and delivery for the Cards domain, from requirements analysis and test planning through execution, closure and release-readiness assessment. 
 - Define and maintain risk-based test strategies, scope, plans, estimates, resource requirements, schedules and entry and exit criteria, aligned with program milestones and business priorities. 
 - Work with business analysts, developers and stakeholders to identify critical Cards business journeys, integration dependencies and functional and non-functional requirements; maintain traceability from requirements to test cases, results and defects. 
 - Coordinate test environment and test data readiness across dependent applications and teams, ensuring prerequisites are met and escalating constraints that could impact test delivery. 
 - Plan and coordinate functional, integration, end-to-end and regression testing across Cards applications and interfaces; coordinate performance and other applicable non-functional testing with specialist teams. 
 - Drive test automation priorities and reusable regression coverage with the testing team, balancing hands-on test execution with overall delivery coordination and continuous improvement. 
 - Manage the defect lifecycle, including triage, prioritization, ownership tracking, retesting and closure; work with delivery teams to resolve blockers and escalate quality risks promptly. 
 - Track and communicate test progress, requirements coverage, execution results, defect trends, resource needs and delivery risks through clear metrics and stakeholder reporting; contribute to sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives. 
 - Coordinate user acceptance testing with business stakeholders, consolidate test evidence and assess exit criteria; provide a documented release-readiness recommendation, highlighting outstanding defects and residual risks for authorized stakeholder acceptance. 
 - Complete test closure activities, capture lessons learned and drive improvements to test processes, reusable assets and quality practices in collaboration with the broader QA & Testing community. 

Your Skills And Experience

- Experience in end-to-end test management, including risk-based test strategies, planning, estimation, requirements traceability, test environment and test data readiness, defect management and release-readiness assessment. 
 - Hands-on experience designing, developing, executing and maintaining automated API and end-to-end regression tests using Karate or a related test automation framework, with a focus on reusable test assets and reliable coverage of Cards business journeys. 
 - Strong experience testing REST APIs and validating JSON and XML payloads, supported by practical knowledge of Postman and SQL Developer for API testing and data validation. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to report test progress, explain defects and quality risks, resolve dependencies and collaborate effectively across business and technology teams; good English language skills. 
 - Knowledge of the Cards domain and experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery teams, including requirements analysis, test case design, sprint ceremonies and coordination of functional, integration, regression and user acceptance testing. 
 - Bachelor's degree with a focus on IT or data evaluation, or comparable professional experience. 
 - Practical experience with Java and related automation tools such as Selenium or REST Assured; experience using Quality Centre/ALM, Jira and Confluence for test management, defect tracking and documentation, and Performance Centre or a related tool for performance testing. 

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 

How We'll Support You

- Training and development to help you excel in your career
 - Coaching and support from experts in your team
 - A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
 - A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About Us And Our Teams

Please visit our company website for further information: 

https: //www. db. com/company/company. html

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively. 

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group. 

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients. 

About Leggett & Platt: 

Founded in 1883, Leggett & Platt (NYSE: LEG) is a global manufacturer that designs and produces innovative products and components used in homes, offices, and vehicles around the world. The company serves customers across industries through its expertise in bedding, furniture, flooring, specialty products, and comfort technologies. Driven by a mindset of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, Leggett & Platt has spent more than 140 years creating solutions that support everyday comfort and help people live and work better. 

Leggett & Platt is seeking a Software Testing Engineer to join our engineering team at our Development Center in Trivandrum, India. This is an excellent opportunity to own software quality as part of a single engineering organization that spans Trivandrum and the United States. In this position, you will design and write automated test code, build out test automation frameworks, and partner daily with developers and product counterparts across both locations to catch issues before they reach production. We are looking for a highly collaborative engineer who codes as comfortably as they test, communicates clearly across distance and time zones, and continuously raises the bar on product quality. 

What you will be doing as Software Testing Engineer: 

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks to validate software functionality across web, API, and/or mobile applications. 
 - Collaborate with Software Engineers and Product Management across Trivandrum and the United States to understand requirements and define test strategies. 
 - Write and execute manual and automated test cases covering functional, regression, integration, and performance testing. 
 - Build and maintain test automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, or Cypress. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous testing and fast feedback for engineering teams. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with engineers to reproduce, triage, and verify fixes. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retrospectives), contributing a quality-focused perspective to planning and estimation. 
 - Perform API testing using tools such as Postman or REST Assured, validating contracts, edge cases, and error handling. 
 - Contribute to test plans, test strategy documents, and quality metrics reporting for engineering and business stakeholders. 
 - Conduct exploratory testing to uncover edge cases and usability issues not covered by automated suites. 
 - Collaborate with Cloud/DevOps engineering to support test environment provisioning and test data management. 
 - Champion quality best practices and a shift-left testing culture across the engineering organization. 

To be successful in this role, you will need:

data.description:
About Shopflo

Shopflo is a D2C checkout and cart platform powering 1, 500+ brands across India, now part of Pine Labs. We help e-commerce brands convert better with faster, smarter checkout: higher prepaid adoption, lower RTO, better upsells, and one-click logins through Shop Pass. 

Why This Role Matters

Growth-stage D2C brands are scaling fast, and checkout is often where they leak the most revenue. Most of them won't come to us; we need to go to them. As Team Lead - Mid Market Outbound, you'll build and run the engine that finds, opens, and closes these brands, leading a team of outbound sellers while still closing deals yourself. 

What You'll Own

- Leading, coaching, and growing a team of outbound AEs and SDRs, with hands-on help on calls, demos, and deal strategy. 
 - Team revenue targets for the mid-market outbound segment, plus a personal closing quota as a player-coach. 
 - The outbound playbook: ICP definition, account lists, multi-channel sequences (email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp), messaging, and cadence. 
 - Account research and targeting, using tools like Apollo, HubSpot, and AI-led research to pick the right brands and the right people. 
 - The full sales cycle on strategic mid-market deals: discovery, checkout audits, demos, solutioning, negotiation, closure, and handover. 
 - Competitive displacement, including brands moving from other checkout providers. 
 - Funnel metrics across the team: activity, connect rates, meetings booked, conversion by stage, and pipeline coverage. 
 - Weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting accuracy, and strong HubSpot hygiene across the team. 
 - Hiring and onboarding new outbound team members, and building ramp plans that get them productive quickly. 
 - Close work with Partnerships, Solutions, Onboarding, and Marketing to sharpen messaging and ensure smooth go-lives. Who You Are

- 4+ years in B2B sales, ideally in SaaS, payments, eCommerce, AdTech/MarTech, or the D2C ecosystem, with a strong outbound track record. 
 - Experience leading, mentoring, or coaching sellers, formally or informally. 
 - Strong understanding of D2C/eCommerce businesses and online conversion metrics. 
 - Consultative seller who can still close fast, comfortable with founders and senior stakeholders. 
 - Data-driven: you run your team by the numbers and know which levers move the funnel. 
 - Comfortable with HubSpot, Apollo or similar prospecting tools, dashboards, and sales analytics. 
 - AI-forward: you use tools like Claude for account research, personalisation at scale, call prep, and team productivity. 
 - Existing relationships across the D2C ecosystem are a strong plus. 
 - Organised, commercially sharp, and self-driven, with an operator mindset and a bias for action. What We're Looking For

A builder who can design an outbound motion, lead a team to hit it consistently, and still step in to close the deals that matter. Someone who raises the bar for everyone around them. 

Why Shopflo

Real ownership of a segment and a team, direct access to leadership, and the chance to shape how Shopflo grows in mid-market, with the backing of Pine Labs and the pace of a startup.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer — Embedded C / Firewall Client
data.description:
SonicWall  is a cybersecurity forerunner  with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone  in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization-enterprise, government agencies and SMBs-around the world. For more information, visit  www. sonicwall. com  or follow us on  Twitter,   LinkedIn,   Facebook  and  Instagram. 

About the Role

SonicWall is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to develop and maintain the Content Filtering Service client embedded in SonicOS - the firmware running on SonicWall firewall appliances worldwide. This module intercepts live traffic, queries the CFS rating servers in real time, and enforces URL-based content filtering policies at the packet level. This is security-critical code: a policy bug is a traffic bypass on a deployed security appliance. 

The codebase is in C with a split Control Plane / Data Plane architecture, multi-blade cache synchronization, and multiple firmware version upgrade paths. 

Responsibilities

- Maintain, harden, and extend the CFS client module across both the control plane and data plane. 
 - Own the binary UDP protocol implementation between the firewall and the CFS rating servers, ensuring correctness and compatibility across protocol versions. 
 - Develop and maintain complete IPv4 and IPv6 support across all code paths. 
 - Own the firmware upgrade and migration paths, ensuring they are atomic, failure-safe, and correctly handle all supported version transitions. 
 - Improve reliability of inter-blade cache synchronization on multi-blade appliances. 
 - Collaborate with the server-side on coordinated protocol changes. 
 - Document the concurrency model, upgrade invariants, and dataplane integration for long-term maintainability. 
 - Collaborate asynchronously with a US-based team and the India-based server team. Requirements

- Expert-level C  (not C++): disciplined manual memory management, pointer arithmetic, and systems design. 
 - Multi-core concurrency in C: reader-writer locks, spinlocks, atomic operations, and memory ordering. 
 - Kernel-level networking: deep understanding of how a packet moves through a firewall dataplane - TCP/UDP processing, flow cache, connection tracking. Userspace socket programming alone is not sufficient. 
 - Strong IPv4 and IPv6  across all code paths. 
 - Comfortable navigating and owning a large C codebase with multiple subsystems. 
 - Experience with network testing and debugging tools: packet capture (Wireshark/tcpdump), traffic generators, GDB. 
 - Good written English for remote, asynchronous collaboration. Nice to have: 

- Experience with multi-blade or multi-ASIC hardware platforms (Octeon/CVMX or similar). 
 - Understanding of symmetric encryption (AES-CBC, DES) at the C implementation level. 
 - Prior experience on a security appliance, network device, or UTM firmware codebase. 
 - Familiarity with TLV binary protocol design and versioning. 
 - Experience with C fuzz testing or sanitizers (AFL, AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer). Education & Experience

At least 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years' experience; or equivalent experience preferred. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.

data.title: Staff AI Engineer (Lead)
data.description:
Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to shape the next generation of AI at Rapid7. We're looking for Staff AI Engineers to drive the design and delivery of sophisticated LLM and agentic AI systems, influencing technical direction across teams and solving complex, cross-functional challenges. You'll establish engineering best practices, guide architectural decisions and mentor other engineers, helping translate customer needs into scalable AI solutions that advance our product and platform capabilities. 

About The Team

AI is reshaping cybersecurity on both sides. Attackers can use AI to strike at machine speed, and only AI-powered defense can keep up. At the same time, organizations can only adopt AI with confidence if it is secure. Rapid7 sits at the intersection of security and AI, and we are building industry-defining products for this new era. 

Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most. 

About The Role

As a Staff AI Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, build and ship LLM and agentic AI systems across Rapid7's security products, owning the technical solutions for your area end to end. You understand LLMs from transformer internals to fine-tuning and inference optimization, stay hands-on with hard problems, and know where LLMs shine and where they fall short, choosing the right approach among LLMs, predictive AI and classical ML. Specifically, your focus will be to: 

- Lead the design and architecture of LLM and agentic AI systems within Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation, contributing to the technical roadmap for your area
 - Recommend model strategy for your projects, including when to use frontier or open-source models and when to fine-tune, distill, or post-train
 - Fine-tune, distill and post-train open-source LLMs on security data, from data curation through training, evaluation and deployment
 - Apply and improve engineering practices for context engineering, inference optimization and evaluation, optimizing LLM inference to balance quality, latency and cost
 - Establish evals as the release gate for the AI systems you ship
 - Lead design reviews for your projects and work through complex technical trade-offs
 - Stay hands-on by prototyping and building critical model, training and inference code

 - A strong communicator who can explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, building alignment around engineering decisions
