data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

 - Cost & Unit Economics: Own infrastructure and LLM spend as a line item. Drive gross margin through inference cost optimization, model routing, caching, and infrastructure right-sizing, and report on it like a P&L owner. 
 - Forward-Deployed Enterprise Engagement: Sit across the table from customer CTOs and architecture teams at Meta-, IndusInd-, and VFS Global-scale accounts. Win technical evaluations, unblock production deployments on-site, and translate what you hear into the roadmap. 
 - Hands-On Leadership: Write and review design documents, review critical pull requests, and build features end to end yourself when the org needs it - schema, service, API, and UI, shipped to production, not handed off. Own the deployment path: you can take a change through CI/CD, Kubernetes, and AWS without a DevOps engineer in the loop, and you understand the infrastructure well enough to make the on-call calls yourself. Debug production when it matters. Your credibility with the team is earned in the code. 

Our Tech Stack

- Core Platform: Node. js and TypeScript services, MongoDB clusters, Redis, event-driven pipelines (Kafka, BullMQ, RabbitMQ), Kubernetes and Docker on AWS, and a custom DAG-based workflow orchestration engine with durable, idempotent execution. 
 - AI and Orchestration: LangGraph for multi-agent workflows, Anthropic Claude via API (primary LLM), Claude Code and Antigravity for AI-assisted development. 
 - Search and Retrieval: AWS OpenSearch for full-text and semantic search, PGVector for vector similarity within Postgres, Pinecone and Qdrant for vector workloads. 
 - Backend and Infrastructure: Next. js, AWS Lambda, Postgres, Supabase. 
 - Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Jaeger, Sentry, LangFuse, LangSmith. 
 - Design and Prototyping: Lovable for design reference and rapid UI scaffolding. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations at B2B SaaS companies. You have managed managers, not just engineers, and have grown an org from roughly 10 to 50+ while keeping it shipping. 
 - You have run the stage we are entering. You have been the senior-most engineering leader while a company scaled from low single-digit millions to $20M+ ARR, and you know what breaks in the org, the architecture, and the customer relationships along the way. 
 - Distributed systems at a scale beyond ours: you have built or operated multi-tenant platforms handling 1B+ events or executions a month, across regions, at 99. 99% availability, and you carry the incident post-mortems to prove it. 
 - Genuine ML depth, not just LLM API fluency. You have trained or fine-tuned models, designed evaluation frameworks, and can reason about model behavior, training dynamics, and failure modes from first principles. You will be the person who raises the bar for our AI engineers, so you need to be able to see over it. 
 - Hands-on experience productionizing agentic systems and RAG - orchestration, tool use, memory and context management, retrieval quality evaluation, and the cost, latency, and reliability engineering that keeps them running under real enterprise load. 
 - You have led a company through SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 and passed security due diligence with banks or similarly regulated enterprises. Compliance is a system you have built, not a checkbox you have watched someone else tick. 
 - A proven hiring record: you have built interview loops, hiring bars, and career ladders, hired senior engineers and managers who stayed, and can show the org chart you left behind. 
 - Still technical, and provably so. In the last twelve months you have shipped a production feature from scratch, deployed it yourself, and been paged for it. You are fluent in the DevOps layer - Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, AWS networking and IAM, infrastructure as code - not just conversant with it, and you can stand up or debug an environment without waiting on someone. The team should want you in the room when things break, and trust you to fix it. 
 - Fluent communication with founders, boards, and customer CTOs. You can defend an architecture to a bank's security team and explain a gross margin tradeoff to an investor in the same afternoon. 
 - Bonus: experience with the WhatsApp Business Platform, CPaaS or messaging infrastructure, CRM and marketing automation, or voice AI.

At Techversant, we build AI-driven business solutions for global clients. We are looking for a

Lead - AI Engineering & Enablement to advance AI-assisted development and testing

across our client engagements.

teams to integrate AI tools into project workflows, build reusable utilities and translate

technical capabilities into measurable delivery improvements.

with client teams in North America.

- Implement and refine AI-assisted workflows across development, code review, self- testing and quality assurance.

data.title: Electrical Commissioning Engineers
data.description:
We Are Hiring : Bulk Material Handling Cranes, Port Crane Engineers & Commissioning Professionals. 

We are looking for experienced, hands-on technical professionals to join our port crane / Bulk Material handling cranes team for commissioning, Service, and Maintenance operations. If you have proven field experience in heavy port machinery or heavy Material handling cranes and thrive in fast-paced site environments, we want to hear from you. 

1. Mechanical Technician ( Code -MT )

Qualification: ITI

Experience: Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience working on port cranes

Additional Advantage: Practical knowledge of welding and gas cutting. 

Scope of Work: 

Support all on-site erection, commissioning, preventive, and breakdown maintenance activities. 

Inspect, service, and repair mechanical assemblies (gearboxes, wire ropes, brakes, couplings, slew bearings) to ensure high equipment reliability and uptime. 

Assist the engineering team during load testing, alignment, and mechanical adjustments. 

2. Mechanical Engineer ( Code - ME )

Qualification: Diploma or B. E. /B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering

Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience with hands-on exposure to Ship-to-Shore (STS) cranes or Grab ship unloaders. 

Additional Advantage: Basic working knowledge of hydraulic systems and heavy diesel engines. 

Scope of Work: 

Supervise and execute mechanical maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities on STS and port cranes. 

Read and interpret mechanical assembly drawings and hydraulic schematics to diagnose faults and reduce equipment downtime. 

Coordinate technician teams and ensure compliance with port safety and OEM quality standards. 

3. Electrical Service Engineer ( Code - ESE )

Qualification: Diploma or B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation Engineering

Experience: Minimum 3 years of service/maintenance experience on port cranes

Scope of Work: 

Read and interpret electrical schematics, control circuit diagrams, and panel layouts to identify components and isolate faults. 

Troubleshoot PLC hardware, control circuits, sensors, limit switches, and crane safety interlocks. 

Respond promptly to on-site breakdown calls and provide direct technical support to clients to restore crane operations safely. 

4. Commissioning Engineer ( Code - CE )

Qualification: Diploma or B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Automation / Mechatronics Engineering

Experience: 3-5 years of experience with port cranes or Bulk Material handling cranes & its commissioning activities. 

Technical Expertise: Strong familiarity with ABB AC500 PLC and ABB ACS800 drive systems. Siemens drive. 

Scope of Work: 

Plan, schedule, and lead end-to-end crane commissioning activities, including cold/hot checks, parameter tuning, and load trials. 

Troubleshoot complex faults across PLCs, VFDs/Drives, motors, and automation networks. 

Support in-house engineering teams and subcontractors in planning maintenance schedules, providing ongoing technical training and field expertise. 

Assist clients with high-priority breakdown resolution and root-cause analysis. 

Common Requirements & Competencies (All Positions)

Proactive Maintenance Mindset: Ability to foresee potential wear, operational bottlenecks, or recurring maintenance issues before they escalate into major breakdowns. 

Client & Vendor Coordination: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to maintain constructive, professional relationships with port clients, subcontractors, and OEM vendors. 

Language: Working knowledge of Hindi (in addition to English) is a distinct advantage for smooth site coordination. And preferably the local site language. 

Sites intended Engineers will be posted : Krishnapatnam, Haldia, Karaikal, Gopalpur, Gangavaram. 

Safety Compliance: Strict adherence to port HSSE norms, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and Permit-to-Work (PTW) procedures. 

Share your resumes with a clear note of Job applied for, code & Location. 

Send resumes on- vizag. office@genmasolutions. com               www. genmasolutions. com

data.description:
Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page. 

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow-people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level. 

Job Description

Job Summary

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Lead AI Platform & Automation Engineer to own and scale our enterprise AI platform capabilities. This role will serve as the primary owner of the IBM watsonx platform and Google Cloud Vertex AI platform, while providing support to Azure driving adoption, standardization, automation, and governance across the organization. The role also includes leading a team responsible for day-to-day AI model and application onboarding, pipeline automation, DevSecOps integration, BI tooling, and AI governance-including maintenance of IBM watsonx. governance and vertex AI. 

This is a high-impact position suited for a technically strong leader who can lead technical team, architect solutions, scale platforms, and align multiple teams across engineering, data science, and business domains. 

Key Responsibilities

Platform Leadership

- Serve as the lead owner of IBM watsonx and Google Vertex AI platforms, overseeing configuration, governance, and operational maturity. 
 - Drive platform onboarding strategy, enablement, and hands-on support across data science, engineering, and analytics teams. 
 - Standardize reusable frameworks, templates, and infrastructure patterns for both platforms to accelerate project delivery. 

AI & ML Pipeline Automation

- Architect and manage enterprise-wide CI/CD and MLOps pipelines for: 
 - Model training, tuning, evaluation, and deployment 
 - Data ingestion, transformation, and streaming 
 - Infrastructure provisioning and teardown (IaC) 
 - Build and maintain reusable templates for AI applications, workflows, and serving endpoints in IBM watsonx. ai and Vertex AI. 

Agentic AI Enablement

- Design and operationalize pipelines for Agentic AI systems using LLMs, orchestration agents, and decision engines. 
 - Integrate intelligent agent workflows with platform capabilities and monitor lifecycle behavior and governance adherence. 

AI Governance (incl. watsonx. governance)

- Implement and operationalize AI governance frameworks using IBM watsonx. governance. 
 - Define model approval workflows, track metadata, enforce responsible AI policies, and ensure transparency, bias detection, and explainability. 
 - Collaborate with legal, compliance, and information security teams to embed AI governance across all AI/ML systems. 

DevSecOps & Automation

- Integrate DevSecOps practices into pipelines-automating vulnerability scans, access policies, and secrets management. 
 - Embed security compliance and quality gates into all CI/CD workflows across AI and application domains. 

Business Intelligence & Semantic Modeling

- Provide architectural guidance to BI teams using Power BI and Looker. 
 - Oversee data modeling, semantic layer standardization, and connectivity to enterprise data lakes and warehouses. 

Team Leadership

- Lead and mentor a cross-functional team of AI platform engineers, MLOps practitioners, BI analysts, and DevSecOps engineers. 
 - Define goals, delivery milestones, documentation standards, and best practices for scalable operations. 

Qualifications

Education

- Bachelor's or master's in computer science, Engineering, or related technical field. 

Experience

- 8+ years in cloud engineering, MLOps, or platform leadership roles. 
 - 3+ years leading enterprise platform delivery and infrastructure automation. 
 - Proven experience managing IBM watsonx and Vertex AI in production environments. 
 - Hands-on delivery of secure, automated pipelines using Terraform, GitOps, and containerized workflows. 
 - Experience implementing AI governance and compliance using commercial tools and internal frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Looker) and semantic modeling techniques. 

Technical Skills

- Platforms: IBM watsonx. ai, watsonx. governance, Vertex AI, Azure ML 
 - Automation: Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps 
 - Languages: Python, Bash, YAML 
 - Containers: Docker, Kubernetes 
 - ML Tools: MLflow, TFX, or similar 
 - Governance: Bias detection, metadata tracking, model lineage, risk management

Preferred Qualifications

- Certifications: GCP, IBM, or Azure AI/MLOps certifications 
 - Experience with Agentic AI systems (e. g. , LangChain, IBM Orchestrate, or custom frameworks) 
 - Familiarity with NIST, EU AI Act, or internal model risk governance frameworks 
 - Prior experience deploying internal platform-as-a-service offerings for AI/ML

Employee Type

Permanent

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Location- Gurugram, Haryana, India

Experience- 10-14 years in manufacturing quality, with minimum 5 years in sheet metal

Education- B. E. / B. Tech Mechanical Engineering

Employment- Full-time, senior management

About the role: We need a Quality Head to own the entire quality function for our sheet metal operations - inspection, QMS, supplier quality and customer audits. You will be the person the customer calls when something goes wrong, and the one who ensures it stops happening. 

Must-have requirements

- Deep, hands-on knowledge of sheet metal processes - laser cutting, shearing, CNC punching, bending, forming, welding and assembly. 

- Ability to read engineering drawings and apply GD&T, including tolerance stack-up on multi-part assemblies. 

- Working command of press shop operations, press tools and press-part defect analysis; weld shop knowledge including projection and robotic welding. 

- Expertise in ISO 9001, with IATF 16949 and PPAP/APQP experience strongly preferred. 

- Fluency in quality tools - 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto, SPC, MSA, CAPA. 

- Metrology competence: vernier, micrometer, height gauge, surface roughness and CMM-based inspection. 

- Proven experience facing customer and third-party audits as the primary technical interface. 

Key responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end QMS and maintain it to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and customer-specific requirements. 

- Direct IQC, in-process and final/outgoing inspection gates across cutting, bending, welding, coating and assembly. 

- Set and monitor quality standards, control plans, SOPs and inspection check sheets for all sheet metal processes. 

- Drive rejection, rework and scrap reduction - track PPM, first-pass yield, scrap rate and cost of poor quality. 

- Lead root cause analysis and CAPA for internal failures and customer complaints, and close them within committed timelines. 

- Act as the customer-facing quality interface: complaints, containment, 8D submissions, audits and approvals. 

- Manage supplier quality - vendor audits, incoming material control and supplier corrective actions. 

- Lead internal audits and facilitate second- and third-party audits; close all observations.

data.title: HCM Tester
data.description:
We're looking for a Senior Tester to take ownership of quality across the EmpowerHR product. This is a hands-on functional testing role with real depth - you'll be testing complex payroll calculations, award interpretation, leave accruals and compliance logic where close enough isn't a thing. 

You'll join a collaborative product team that spans our offshore delivery centre and our Australian offices, working alongside developers, business analysts and product owners as one team. You'll be the person the team trusts to find the problem before the customer does - and to explain clearly why it matters. 

What you'll do

• Own functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing across EmpowerHR releases

• Design and maintain test plans, test cases and reusable regression suites for complex payroll and HR scenarios

• Test the hard stuff: award and enterprise agreement interpretation, pay calculations, tax and

superannuation, leave accruals, terminations, back-pays and end-of-financial-year processing

• Verify compliance-driven change - legislative updates, STP reporting and ATO requirements

• Investigate and reproduce customer-reported defects, then log them with the detail developers

actually need

• Support UAT with customers and internal consultants, and help translate their feedback into

actionable work

• Contribute to test estimates, sprint planning and release readiness decisions

• Mentor and lift the testing capability of others in the team - sharing what good looks like

• Look for the patterns behind recurring defects and push for improvements to how we build, not just how we test

What you'll bring

ESSENTIAL

• 6+ years in software testing, with recent experience in a senior or lead-capable role

• Deep functional and regression testing expertise on complex, business-critical applications

• Strong analytical thinking - you can read a requirement, spot the gap, and work out the edge case nobody documented

• Confidence with SQL for data validation and investigation

• Experience with Jira (or similar) for defect and test management

• Comfortable working in Agile delivery teams

• Excellent written and verbal English - you'll be communicating with Australia-based colleagues and customers daily

• Genuine attention to detail, and the judgement to know what's worth escalating

HIGHLY REGARDED

• Payroll, HR or finance domain experience - award interpretation or Australian payroll legislation

especially

• Exposure to test automation and a willingness to grow that skill set (Selenium, Playwright or similar)

• Experience testing integrations and APIs

• ISTQB certification

• Experience working with distributed teams across time zones

Why you'll want to work here

• Real ownership. You'll shape how quality works on a product used by organisations right across

Australia, not just execute someone else's test script. 

• Domain depth. Payroll is genuinely complex. You'll build expertise that's rare and portable. 

• One team. Our offshore team isn't a separate function - you'll sit inside the product team, in the conversations that matter. 

• Room to grow. Clear pathways into test leadership, automation or business analysis, and the

support to get there. 

• A culture that means it. We put people first. That includes ours.

data.title: AI Solutions Architect
data.description:
ABOUT BLOOM AI

Bloom AI is an applied AI firm building AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions. 

We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations turn information into intelligence and action. 

Our approach combines reusable AI capabilities with hands-on solution development in real enterprise environments. We work closely with business teams to rethink workflows, design intelligent systems and deploy solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. 

Bloom AI is based in the U. S. and India (Delhi/NCR). 

THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on AI Solutions Architect who can design, build and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and agentic systems. 

This role sits at the intersection of AI architecture, data engineering and software development. 

You may come from a backend engineering, data engineering or data science background, but you should have evolved into building end-to-end AI solutions. 

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked on multiple AI/LLM projects, solved different types of problems and gained practical experience making architectural decisions across agent orchestration, data, context management, application development and deployment. 

You should be equally comfortable designing a solution architecture, evaluating technology choices, writing code, integrating data sources and taking a working solution into production. 

This is not a traditional software engineering role, a prompt-engineering role or a PowerPoint-only architecture role. We need someone who understands how AI systems work end-to-end and can personally build what they design. 

You will work across client engagements, reusable Bloom AI capabilities and internal technology development, taking ownership of solutions from architecture through production deployment. 

You will be part of the core team, reporting directly to the CEO. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Leading a small team, you will: 

Architect Bloom AI Capabilities and Client Solutions

- Design end-to-end AI solutions combining LLMs, agents, enterprise data, APIs and applications. 
 - Mak architectural decisions around agent orchestration, context, memory, workflows and technology choices. 
 - Build modular, reusable solutions that work across different cloud and enterprise environments. 

Build agentic applications

- Develop multi-agent systems, agentic workflows and LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or similar. 
 - Implement tool calling, RAG, semantic search, agent memory and state management. 
 - Build evaluation, monitoring and reliability mechanisms for production AI systems. 

Engineer data and context systems

- Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI applications. 
 - Design retrieval and context architectures using relational, vector and graph databases. 
 - Build knowledge retrieval, entity relationships and persistent context capabilities. 

Develop and deploy end to end systems

- Build backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or similar technologies. 
 - Develop functional frontend applications and integrate with enterprise systems. 
 - Deploy secure, scalable applications across cloud platforms using modern engineering practices. 

Solve enterprise client problems

- Translate business challenges into practical AI architectures and working solutions. 
 - Work across multiple client projects, from solution design and prototyping through deployment. 
 - Evaluate technical approaches, collaborate with stakeholders and develop reusable capabilities for Bloom AI. 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 4-7 years of professional experience, with a foundation in backend engineering, data engineering, data science or related technical disciplines. 
 - Hands-on experience across multiple AI/LLM application projects, preferably involving different use cases, data environments or architectural approaches. 
 - Demonstrated ability to take ownership of solution architecture and technical implementation, rather than contributing to only one component of a system. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, with solid software engineering and API development skills. 
 - Practical experience building agentic applications or multi-agent systems, beyond basic chatbots and prompt-based applications. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar. 
 - Strong understanding of LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, embeddings, vector databases and context management. 
 - Strong understanding of data modeling, SQL, databases, data integration and retrieval architectures. 
 - Working knowledge of full-stack application development, including modern frontend frameworks such as React or Next. js. 
 - Familiarity with graph data structures, entity relationships and graph-based retrieval concepts. 
 - Experience taking AI applications from prototype through testing, integration and production deployment. 
 - Experience with at least one major cloud platform and familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD and modern engineering practices. 
 - Ability to evaluate different technical approaches and make sound architectural trade-offs. 
 - Strong independent problem-solving skills, curiosity and comfort working with ambiguous requirements. 
 - Lead R&D efforts for Bloom AI

Above all, we are looking for someone who has built several AI solutions, understands the architectural decisions behind them and can independently design and implement new ones. 

GOOD TO HAVE

- Startup or 0-to-1 product development experience. 
 - Experience working on enterprise AI projects across different business functions or client environments. 
 - Experience integrating with marketing, sales or commercial systems, such as CRM, marketing automation, campaign platforms, content management systems or sales enablement tools. 
 - Experience working directly with enterprise clients and translating business requirements into technical solutions. 
 - Experience building AI applications for financial services, research or other knowledge-intensive domains.

Description

We are looking for a highly skilled iOS/tvOS Developer to join our team and take a leading role in building and enhancing our OTT video streaming applications. Your primary responsibility will be to develop and optimize a custom video player experience for both iOS and tvOS, leveraging AVPlayer and related media frameworks. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and backend engineering teams to deliver a seamless, high-performance user experience.

data.description:
[This is a work-from-office arrangement, based in our Pune office]

Minimum Qualifications

- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping production-ready features independently with full test coverage. 
 - Strong command of at least one backend language (Python, Go, or equivalent) and TypeScript to contribute across the full stack. 
 - Understanding of REST API design, event-driven architecture, relational and non-relational databases and distributed systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent), and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or equivalent). 
 - Fluency with observability tooling (Datadog, Sentry or equivalent) and the ability to own incident investigation and resolution within your domain. 
 - Proficiency with AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) across the development lifecycle, from building features and writing tests to reviewing code and investigating bugs. 
 - Working knowledge of TDD and/or DDD, and the judgment to apply either where it strengthens quality and maintainability. 
 - English Proficiency
 - Kindly include your Github page in CV

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building or integrating with payment systems, marketplace infrastructure, or multi-tenant SaaS platforms. 
 - Familiarity with API gateways, webhooks, or third-party integrations in production. 
 - Security-conscious engineering practices including input validation, secret management and compliance-aware design (SOC 2, PCI DSS, or equivalent). 

About the Job

Bakuun is building a global platform spanning hospitality distribution, marketplace operations, payment infrastructure and property management. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack, you will own features and systems end-to-end across our payment, distribution and marketplace infrastructure. You will ship systems that move real money and real bookings at scale, with the autonomy to design them well and the ownership to see them through to production. AI coding assistants are part of daily work here, amplifying what one engineer can build while you stay accountable for everything that ships. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. 

Responsibilities

- Own your features and systems end to end, from technical design through build, testing, release, and production monitoring. 
 - Build reliable, scalable frontend and backend services that support our payment, distribution and marketplace infrastructure. 
 - Design integrations that fail safely, applying idempotency, retries, timeouts, and reconciliation to close the incident patterns. 
 - Write and maintain automated tests across unit, integration, and edge cases, treating test quality as a first-class engineering output. 
 - Work safely in legacy code, characterization tests first then change in small verifiable steps. 
 - Use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) for tests, data setup, feature tracing, log analysis, and ticket and PR drafting, while owning the result. Review every change before it ships, check it against the ticket and target branch, keep it in scope, and never put secrets or production data into AI tools. 
 - Know the systems you own in depth, from architecture and dependencies to production behaviour, API contracts, and data flow, so you can anticipate the impact of a change and surface risks early. 
 - Contribute to design discussions, code reviews, and improvement proposals with evidence-based reasoning, raising concerns early.

data.title: AI Operations Efficiency Specialist (GTM)
data.description:
AI Operations Efficiency Specialist

Strict Application Requirement: Please only apply if you have 3+ years of solutions-development experience inside a fast-paced, hard-driving agency (RevOps, delivery, marketing or consulting). Applicants whose experience is exclusively in-house, corporate or non-agency environments will not be considered. 

About Us

Set 2 Close is a HubSpot Elite Partner agency passionate about empowering businesses to maximize their sales and marketing potential. We partner with fast-growing startups and established mid-sized firms across North America, Australia, and Europe to deliver advanced inbound sales, marketing systems, and complex tech stack integrations. We are a Certified B Corporation (B Corp). Our culture and operating philosophy are anchored by five core values: 

- TEAM (Trust, Empathy, Accountability, Mastery): We lead with trust, practice empathy, own our outcomes, and relentlessly pursue mastery. 
 - Partner Growth is our Obsession: We build relationships that compound over time, measuring ourselves by what our partners achieve. 
 - Data Informed, Outcome Driven: We do not guess when we can measure; every decision is traceable to evidence and accountable to a result. 
 - Professional Excellence, Every Day: Our partners deserve an expert in the room, every time. Excellence is our minimum standard. 
 - Never Walk Alone: No partner faces a challenge without us beside them, and no team member carries a problem alone. One unit. One scoreboard. 

We're Looking For an AI Operations Efficiency Specialist

Location: Remote (India or Philippines) · Reports to: VP of Operations · Product sphere: Operations

Are you a solutions builder who sees a team repeating the same task for the third time and has a working automation built by Friday? We are seeking a hands-on AI Operations Efficiency Specialist, strong in solutions development, to find, build and measure AI-enabled improvements across our operations: delivery handoffs, reporting, recruiting and HR admin, finance and project-management workflows. 

You will report to our VP of Operations, who also leads our company-wide AI efficiency program, which makes this the anchor role of three AI specialists (Sales Enablement, Operations, Marketing). You will work hands-on with our delivery, sales and operations teams, getting into the detail of how work really flows. Your job is to bring our integrations together in our centralized AI architecture, the shared layer that connects our tools, skills and automations, and to set the build standards the others follow: how automations are documented, tested, logged and handed over. Success here is not only hours saved. It is a team that delivers measurably more efficiently, with the human coordination across it running smoothly. 

Key Responsibilities (What Success Looks Like)

- Find the Waste: Map our internal processes, measure the manual hours in each, and rank opportunities by efficiency gain against effort, so the build queue is driven by evidence (Data Informed, Outcome Driven). 
 - Delivery and Handoff Automation: Automate the path from signed SOW to project setup, kickoff, task creation, time-log hygiene and status reporting, so delivery teams spend their time on client work (Partner Growth is our Obsession). 
 - Reporting and Admin Workflows: Build automated reporting packs, utilization and capacity views, and finance and admin workflows that replace spreadsheet and copy-paste work (Professional Excellence, Every Day). 
 - Recruiting and HR Administration: Automate scheduling, interview-note and scorecard compilation, and pipeline tracking for our recruiting process. Automation supports our people; it never makes a hiring decision (TEAM). 
 - Set the Build Standards: Define and maintain how automations are documented, tested, logged, named and handed over, and how data access is limited. Run a monthly review of all AI automations with the VP of Operations (Never Walk Alone). 
 - Protect Data: Follow our written data and AI use policy, which you will be onboarded to on day one, connecting tools with least-privilege access and handling client and company data accordingly, flagging risks before they become incidents (Professional Excellence, Every Day). 
 - Enable and Drive Adoption: Document each automation, train the process owners, keep a ranked backlog, and check that handoffs between people run smoothly, so changes stick (TEAM). 
 - Prove the Impact: Report overall efficiency gains (how much our teams deliver per person and per project), cost per deliverable, handoff quality and automations in production to the VP of Operations every month, with the numbers behind them (Data Informed, Outcome Driven). Requirements (Proven Evidence Required)

- Agency Solutions-Development Record: 3+ years of solutions-development experience inside a fast-paced, hard-driving agency (not an in-house or corporate role), with at least three production workflows you can walk us through: the problem, what you built, and the hours or cost it saved. 
 - Process Thinking: Skill in mapping a process end to end, finding where time is lost, and measuring the before and after. You can show us a process map and a savings calculation you produced. 
 - AI and Agent Building: Practical experience building with large language models (such as Claude or GPT): prompt design, connecting tools and data sources, agent workflows, and testing output quality, including how you catch errors and hallucinations. 
 - Integration Skills: Working knowledge of REST APIs and webhooks, at least one major no-code workflow-automation platform, and enough Python, JavaScript or Google Apps Script to build what no-code cannot. 
 - Business Systems Fluency: Experience connecting many business systems (project management, CRM, documents, reporting) into one coordinated whole. HubSpot experience preferred. 
 - Documentation and Governance: A habit of documenting, version-controlling and testing what you build, and of limiting data access to what each automation needs. 
 - Clear Communication: Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to work with process owners who are not technical. 
 - Availability: A fixed daily window that overlaps with our North American afternoon, for check-ins with our salespeople, solutions architects and your lead. The rest of your schedule is flexible and yours to build in. Bonus Points (The Extra Edge)

- Effort-Based Delivery Models: Experience estimating, managing or reporting delivery using story points or similar effort-based models. 
 - Reporting and Data Skills: SQL or dashboard-building experience. 
 - Program Leadership: Experience setting automation standards for a team or leading other builders. 
 - HubSpot Certifications: Active certifications such as Revenue Operations or Platform Consulting. 
 - Recruiting or HR Operations: Experience automating hiring or onboarding administration. Why Work With Us

- A Real Mandate: You set the standard for how a HubSpot Elite Partner builds, tests and measures AI automation across operations, working directly with the VP of Operations, with full access to our Claude environment and the credits you need to build (Data Informed, Outcome Driven). 
 - Room to Grow: This is the anchor role of our AI efficiency program, with a path to lead it as the team scales and support for your continued learning (Professional Excellence, Every Day). 
 - Elite Culture: Join a collaborative international team that operates as one unit with one scoreboard, and where you never walk alone (Never Walk Alone). 
 - Competitive Compensation: Pay benchmarked to your local market for senior automation talent, with details shared at offer. Ready to Make Operations Run Itself?

If you love finding the efficiencies hidden in a business and giving them back, we want to hear from you. Apply today and include a short video or write-up of one process you automated: how you found it, what you built, and the hours or cost it saved.

-

 - Working knowledge of secure software development, threat modelling, identity and access management, secrets management, dependency scanning and vulnerability remediation.

 - Experience working in agile, cross-functional delivery environments and contributing throughout discovery, build, test, release and production support.

A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

data.title: Staff Engineer
data.description:
About The Company

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology by developing solutions designed to deliver reliability and performance in an always-connected world. Its global team works to understand customer needs and provide value through innovative network technologies. Aurora Networks, formerly CommScope's Access Networks Solution segment, is a leading provider of access network solutions. Its end-to-end portfolio supports service providers around the world with products for hybrid fiber-coaxial (HFC), passive optical network (PON), and broadband applications. 

At Vistance Networks, employees are encouraged to contribute to what comes next in communications. The company brings together people who are passionate about technology, customer outcomes, and building dependable solutions for a world in motion. 

About The Role

Vistance Networks is seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join its cable access engineering team. In this specialized position, you will work closely with US-based systems architects and software and hardware engineering teams to develop and maintain firmware for next-generation Full Duplex (FDX) Cable Amplifiers and smart RF nodes. 

The role focuses on the intersection of embedded Linux, Broadcom broadband system-on-chip (SoC) platforms, RF control systems, and cable plant telemetry. You will contribute to firmware that initializes and manages RF processing hardware, supports dynamic control loops, and enables remote monitoring and configuration. This is a hands-on engineering opportunity involving software development, hardware integration, board bring-up, and collaboration across distributed teams. 

Qualifications

A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered. Candidates should have approximately five or more years of hands-on embedded software or firmware development experience, with strong proficiency in modern C and C++. 

Applicants should bring substantial experience with Embedded Linux, including kernel or driver development, Linux networking internals, and low-level hardware interaction. Familiarity with peripheral interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, and GPIO is important. Practical experience with gNMI, Protobuf, JSON, and MQTT for device configuration or streaming telemetry is also expected. You should communicate technical concepts clearly in English and be comfortable coordinating with distributed engineering teams, including aligning with US working hours. 

Additional experience with DOCSIS 3. 1, DOCSIS 4. 0 Full Duplex, Extended Spectrum DOCSIS, CableLabs specifications, or YANG data modeling is valuable. Knowledge of RF fundamentals, AGC control loops, and amplified cable transmission paths is an advantage. Experience with Broadcom broadband SoCs and SDKs, RF test equipment, or collaboration with RF engineers will help you contribute quickly. 

Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and integrate low-level firmware using Broadcom SDKs for broadband and cable access SoCs. Initialize, configure, and monitor digital and analog RF processing hardware, and implement control functions for Automatic Gain Control, Automatic Level Control, tilt adjustment, dynamic power management, and echo cancellation. 

Build and maintain Linux kernel drivers, character devices, and user-space daemons that interact with hardware registers, memory-mapped I/O, and on-board peripherals. Manage interfaces to RF attenuators, equalizers, power amplifiers, and environmental sensors through I2C, SPI, and GPIO. 

Design management and telemetry agents using gNMI, Protobuf, JSON, and MQTT to support remote configuration and real-time reporting of device health and RF performance. Participate in architecture planning, design and code reviews, and technical discussions with US-based firmware, hardware, RF, and systems teams. Bring up and validate custom SoC evaluation boards and production amplifier hardware using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, RF spectrum analyzers, and related tools. 

Benefits

Join a global communications technology organization working on products that support service providers and broadband networks. You will collaborate with experienced, cross-functional teams and contribute to specialized firmware used in evolving cable access solutions. The role offers opportunities to deepen your expertise across embedded Linux, broadband SoCs, RF systems, telemetry, and hardware validation while helping deliver technologies for connected communities. 

Equal Opportunity

Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The company welcomes qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and veterans, and is committed to providing fair consideration in its employment practices.

data.title: AI Full-Stack Developer, Maintenance & Enhancements
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

PULS runs live AI solutions used every day by Purchasing, Finance, Logistics, R&D and Sales: chat agents integrated with SAP, scheduled Azure jobs, document pipelines, workflow apps and dashboards. You will keep them reliable and keep improving them. That means resolving incidents at the root cause, shipping change requests in regular maintenance releases, and keeping everything monitored and documented. You will work from India with core hours overlapping the Munich morning (about 13: 00-18: 00 IST), with no night shifts and no solo on-call, alongside the AI team, DevOps and Cybersecurity. Onboarding is in Munich, with one or two visits a year after that. 

What you'll do

- Own the incident and change-request queue for all live AI solutions: reproduce on the test stage, separate bugs from change requests and agree weekly priorities with the AI Team Lead
 - Fix root causes across the stack: TypeScript/React frontend, Node. js or Python (FastAPI) backend, scheduled jobs, SAP OData integration, PDF and mailbox automation, and write the test that proves each fix
 - Ship enhancements in maintenance releases (new SAP fields, document layouts, extended agent skills) and turn larger requests into specifications for the project team
 - Use Claude Code and Codex to draft fixes and tests, then review, verify on the preview stage and merge
 - Catch rising error rates, silently failed jobs and token-cost drift with KQL in Log Analytics; release prompt, skill and model updates on Azure OpenAI only after regression cases and an LLM-as-judge review pass
 - Run Azure Container Apps and jobs across preview, pilot and production with DevOps: Bicep, rollbacks, Key Vault secrets, Entra app registrations and Teams app updates
 - Take over solutions built by business teams and keep runbooks and documentation current

What you bring

- 4-6 years of full-stack development on production systems you not only built but kept running
 - TypeScript/React and Node. js, plus Python with FastAPI; SQL with PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB
 - Azure in daily practice: Container Apps, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Bicep and the Azure CLI

Surya at a Glance

Surya was founded in 1999 by Mr. D. N. Prahlad (an early employee of Infosys), to create software products. Headquartered in Bangalore, we also have offices in the USA, and France. 

Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for Financial Control & Risk Management (Balance sheet management, Regulatory & Compliance & Other Risk areas) of banks and financial services industry. We provide web based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. 

We help more than 75 banks, hedge funds and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in USA and France. 

Surya is an equal opportunity employer. 

Why Surya

Suryaʼs business and prime focus is software engineering. At Surya, you will be expected to work hard and smart. We are a meritocracy, implying your career depends only on your merit. We have people amongst us who are experts in the field but adapt quickly to changes. Surya looks for entrepreneurial spirit and indeed makes employees shareholders of Surya. All this makes Surya a fun place to be. 

What We're Looking For

- An unwavering attention to detail and care towards your work. Suryans double-check PRs they submit for review. Each variable name is thought through in detail; attention is paid towards how decisions made today will affect the future. 
 - An absolute commitment towards doing the best work of your life, while helping others to do the same. We deliver with utmost focus on the job at hand. The team works towards crafting the best products for our users, and customers. Working as a team, Suryans go above and beyond when it results in a better end product. 
 - You should be comfortable working in an agile environment. You are also expected to participate in code reviews - both receiving and offering them as needed. You are needed to communicate flexibly with your team pitching in on designs, features and ideas for the product, wherever needed. 
 - You should be open to receiving and providing constructive feedback, with a relentless pursuit of constant improvement. 

What You Will Work On

The specific project you work on is decided based on the list of available projects at the time. While what you work on will change over time, we assure you that youʼll work with people who care deeply about their work and deliver with great attention to detail. 

Your Growth at Surya

Suryaʼs growth is driven by ordinary people who have extraordinary dreams and are bold enough to pursue them. Our leadership team, including our Managing Director, is composed primarily of people who joined Surya as freshers. Through our process of continuous feedback, and regular 1-1 conversations, we believe in upskilling our team, and enabling each of them to grow along paths they find satisfying.

Job Description

Senior Application Engineer shall be a member of the Applications team in Microchip's Secure Computing Group responsible for: 

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and improve embedded firmware for Secure Computing products. 
 - Assist in onboarding customers with secure Platform Root Of Trust devices by providing technical expertise and guidance. 
 - Experience in system understanding, Hardware integration testing, system integration and troubleshooting. 
 - Handle customer clarifications, deliver technical demos, and present solutions effectively to prospective and existing customers. 
 - Manage and resolve customer issues through Salesforce ticketing system while ensuring timely communication and support. 
 - Contribute to internal development efforts related to secure Platform Root Of Trust devices
 - Testing embedded firmware for Secure computing products. 
 - Work with multi-site cross-functional teams. 
 - Develop customer application notes to support product adoption. 

Requirements/Qualifications

- Bachelor's / Master's Engineering Degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering
 - 7 to 9 year's of experience in firmware development & testing for embedded systems, microprocessors, and microcontrollers. 
 - The candidate should be very strong in C programming in an embedded environment. 
 - Experience in writing scripts in python. 
 - Experience in Basic Crypto and Security algorithms is preferrable. 
 - Experience with ARM Architecture, Linux and command line build tools (preferred)

 - This position is for individual with Hands on and for individual contributor role.

 - Good Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, Self-motivated, team player, capable of multitasking. Professional Communication skills are a definite must for this position. 
 - Seasoned using embedded debugging tools such as Oscilloscope, debuggers and protocol analyzers
 - Experience in deployment and testing of embedded software products
 - Experience in Verification and validation of embedded software products
 - Familiarity with cross-platform development and debugging tools
 - Familiarity with command line build tools
 - Knowledge/experience in I2C, SPI or other networking & real-time content streaming protocols
 - Very good team player and good at communication within and outside of the organization
 - Knowledge/experience in MPLAB/ KIEL IDE and tool chains is a Plus
 - Experience in Security, Azure platform and IOT platform is preferable. 
 - Candidate with education from reputed institutes with good academic records is preferred

Travel Time

No Travel

data.title: Specialist II, Process Compliance Review and Analysis
data.description:
Job Overview

It is the responsibility of the post holder to provide all clients, both internal and external, with the appropriate quality of service in a safe and cost-effective manner. The individual will be expected to comply with the legal requirements of the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974, the COSHH regulations 1989 and the EC (European Commission) Directives 1992/3 as documented in the Company's Health and Safety Manual. 

Summary Of Responsibilities

- Take ownership of assigned aspects of quality reviews on projects. 
 - Compile metrics and identify quality trends. 
 - Assist in addressing periodic client quality reviews and other ad-hoc client quality findings. 
 - Prepare initial drafts of Corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Perform ongoing review of a sample of various cases or safety reports for global regulatory submissions, labeling / regulatory documents for Fortrea clients e. g. , Annual Reports (IND and other), PSURs, PADERs, Clinical Study Reports, Core Data Sheets, USPI, centralized SPC's, Med Guides etc. 
 - Assist with the overall functional quality operations associated with products including the entire adverse events process: which may include safety data collected from clinical trials and/or post marketing setting (i. e. , unsolicited reports). 
 - Manage and review expeditable adverse events, product quality complaints and medical information to the required standard and submit them to the client and the regulatory agencies (if required) within the agreed/stated timelines. 
 - Take ownership of assigned CAPAs with respect to ensuring that the actions are closed and produce documentary evidence to that effect in coordination with the project managers. 
 - Contribute to process reviews, own certain aspects of the reviews and use the results to help identify process improvements and develop process standards. 
 - Contribute to designing and tracking training schedule and training material for new hires and existing team. 
 - Help initiate discussion forums on Quality errors within assigned project and identify process improvements, share best practices across projects. 
 - Assist in coordinating respective client or external audits of the assigned projects. 
 - Draft sections of the Quality Management Plan for assigned project. 
 - Coordinate with the project team to support the Client during regulatory inspections at client sites with support from Quality Lead / Quality Manager. 
 - Implement and promote use of consistent, efficient, and quality processes to meet timelines and deliverables according to requirements and standard operating procedures and assume accountability for the deliverables. 
 - To respond/review to medical information queries/product quality complaints/general queries that may be received over the telephone call, email, fax etc. 
 - Review recorded information that may be received over the telephone call, email, fax etc. 
 - Execute drug safety data management processes - a combination of call intake review, call dialogue documentation review and case follow-up. 
 - Guide safety associates in managing voice calls (as required). 
 - Perform any other support activities as assigned - tracking various types of information and metrics, ongoing QC of defined process steps, training, reconciliation of data from multiple sources. 
 - Perform Analysis of data and if required, suggest strategies for process improvement/excellence. 
 - Perform and Review of analysis of data performed and drive strategies for process improvement/excellence. 
 - All other duties as needed or assigned. 

Qualifications (Minimum Required)

- Bachelors/Masters/PhD degree in Medicine or Alternative medicine, Medical Science, Pharmaceutical science, Nursing, Life Sciences, or related area. 
 - Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements. 

Experience (Minimum Required)

- Three years of overall work experience in the pharmaceutical industry, biotechnology, or CRO industry primarily in Pharmacovigilance / Safety writing with at least One year of experience in Peer review/Quality review. 
 - Knowledge of regulatory requirements viz. GPV and applicable EU and FDA guidelines. 
 - In-depth understanding of case processing and assessment. 
 - Knowledge of Quality Assurance. 
 - Awareness of lean methodology concepts. 
 - Technical proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of applications. 

Preferred Qualifications Include

- Experience in generating quality metrics with trend analysis, authoring, and coordinating Corrective and Preventive Action Reports is preferred. 
 - Experience in assessing quality of a case/safety report from a medical, scientific and documentation perspective is preferred. 

Physical Demands/Work Environment

- Office Environment or remote. 
 - Available for travel 10% of the time including overnight stays as necessary consistent with project needs and office location. 

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

data.title: Director Projects (Thermal Power Generation)
data.description:
CLIENT : Heavy Engineering MNC undertaking erection and commissioning of ultra-supercritical thermal plants and high value mega contracts. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an accomplished and execution-oriented Director - Projects (Thermal Power) to lead the execution, project management and commissioning of multiple ultra-supercritical thermal power projects, each of 800 MW and above capacity, across different locations. 

The incumbent will provide strategic and operational leadership throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring timely execution, commissioning, quality, safety, cost control and adherence to the highest technical and regulatory standards. The role requires a seasoned thermal power professional with extensive hands-on experience in large-scale project execution, strong stakeholder management capabilities and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams across geographically dispersed project sites. 

Key Result Areas

- Project Execution & Delivery
 - Lead the end-to-end execution of multiple large-scale thermal power projects of 800 MW and above, from construction through erection, testing, commissioning and commercial operation. 
 - Ensure achievement of project milestones, timelines, budgets and contractual commitments. 
 - Monitor project progress across locations, identify critical bottlenecks and implement corrective measures. 
 - Drive coordination among engineering, procurement, construction, erection and commissioning teams. 2. Construction, Erection & Commissioning

- Oversee civil and structural works, boiler and turbine-generator erection, coal and ash handling systems, fuel supply systems, cooling water systems, electrical and instrumentation works, and balance-of-plant packages. 
 - Ensure systematic planning and execution of pre-commissioning, testing, trial runs, performance guarantee tests and final commissioning. 
 - Resolve complex technical and site execution challenges to minimize delays and cost overruns. 
 - Ensure seamless integration of all major equipment and systems for reliable plant operation. 3. Project Planning & Monitoring

- Establish project execution strategies, detailed schedules, resource plans and milestone-based monitoring systems. 
 - Review progress against approved baselines and drive recovery plans wherever required. 
 - Monitor contractor performance, equipment deliveries, manpower deployment and site productivity. 
 - Implement robust reporting mechanisms and provide periodic project status updates to senior management. 4. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

- Lead large, multidisciplinary project teams comprising project directors, construction managers, engineering specialists, contractors and commissioning professionals. 
 - Coordinate with equipment suppliers, EPC contractors, consultants, government authorities, utilities and other stakeholders. 

5. Cost, Quality, Safety & Compliance

- Drive project cost control, budget adherence, claims management and effective utilization of resources. 
 - Ensure compliance with approved engineering specifications, quality standards, applicable statutory requirements and environmental regulations. 
 - Establish and enforce stringent EHS standards across all project sites. 
 - Ensure quality assurance and quality control throughout construction, erection and commissioning. 

Incumbent profile: 

- 20 years of experience in the thermal power sector, with substantial exposure to large-scale power plant construction, execution and commissioning. 
 - Proven track record of delivering 800 MW and above thermal power units, preferably ultra-supercritical projects. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in project execution, erection, testing, commissioning and integrated project management. 
 - Experience managing multiple project sites simultaneously. 
 - Strong leadership, strategic thinking, decision-making and ability to interact with senior management.

data.title: Technical Lead – Algorithm Developer
data.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips - the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world - like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world. 

What We Offer

Location: 

Bangalore, IND

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Technical Lead - Algorithm Developer

Location : ITPL, Bangalore

What's In It for You?

- Work with the best: Join a team of algorithm experts and researchers who are passionate about solving complex challenges in semiconductor inspection. 
 - Innovate at scale: Contribute to the development of cutting-edge detection algorithms that power the next generation of optical wafer inspection tools
 - End-to-end impact: Be involved in the full lifecycle-from concept and feasibility to implementation and integration-of algorithms that directly influence product performance
 - Shape the future: Your work will help enable the production of advanced microchips, driving innovation across industries from AI to consumer electronics
 - Own your work: Drive projects independently from problem definition to production deployment, with visibility across the organization. 

Our Team

We are an algorithm research and development group composed of highly skilled developers who thrive on pushing technological boundaries. We focus on designing and implementing advanced detection, classification, and calibration algorithms for optical inspection systems used in semiconductor manufacturing. With a strong emphasis on innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence, we turn complex challenges into impactful solutions that shape the future of chipmaking. 

What You'll Do

- Drive end-to-end algorithm development projects independently, from problem statement refinement to production deployment
 - Develop and optimize image processing algorithms for defect detection, pattern recognition, anomaly detection, classification, and image registration on optical wafer inspection data
 - Design and implement solutions that effectively combine classical mathematical algorithms with deep learning approaches to solve complex inspection challenges
 - Work with large-scale semiconductor inspection datasets, including building data pipelines and curating domain-specific data for algorithm development
 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including Field, Marketing, Product, Applications, Software, and Systems teams to gather requirements and integrate algorithmic solutions
 - Perform concept and feasibility studies, algorithm validation, and benchmarking on large datasets to demonstrate effective solution through data-driven approaches
 - Write optimized, production-quality code and work with software teams to integrate algorithms into the inspection tool
 - Work with chip design data (GDSII, OASIS) and understand system-level interactions involving optics and physics
 - Perform system calibrations and address image processing challenges related to optical systems
 - Travel to customer sites for solution demonstrations and issue resolution
 - Present technical solutions to internal stakeholders and customers

What You Should Have

- Master's degree or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Image/Signal Processing, Computer Vision, or related field from a premier engineering institute
 - 7-15 years of experience in algorithm development for image processing and computer vision
 - Strong mathematical foundation with expertise in applied mathematics for algorithm development
 - Strong background in classical computer vision and image processing (filtering, segmentation, feature extraction, pattern recognition, anomaly detection, image registration)
 - Experience with deep learning approaches (CNNs, object detection, semantic segmentation) and frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow
 - Proven track record of combining classical and deep learning methods to deliver end-to-end solutions
 - Proficient in Python programming with ability to write optimized, production-quality code
