data.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited ("ADSIPL"). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. 

You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

Key job responsibilities

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world's largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role. 

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to): 

- Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance. 
 - Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
 - Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
 - Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
 - Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
 - Liaising with internal teams & management groups
 - Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
 - Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
 - Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc. 

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience. 

People Management. 

As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management. 

Incident Management. 

You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management. 

Vendor Management. 

An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same. 

Process Improvement. 

You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. 

Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Basic Qualifications

- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in software development and experience in technical support
 - 5+ years of operations management experience
 - 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
 - Experience in facilities management, or experience in project management

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 6+ months of network and operating system support experience
 - 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
 - Knowledge of six Sigma/Lean processes
 - Experience creating and implementing large-scale programs
 - 2+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. 

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2, 500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. 

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA

PURPOSE

We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Manager who has progressed from a Software Developer to Technical Lead and ultimately into Engineering Management. 

This role is not a traditional Project Manager or Scrum Master position. The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in architecture discussions, influence technical decisions, guide solution design, and lead software engineering teams in delivering high-quality products. 

The Engineering Manager will serve as the technical bridge between Architects, Product Owners, Development Teams, QA, DevOps, and Senior Leadership, ensuring business objectives are translated into scalable and sustainable technical solutions. 

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with strong people leadership capabilities and is comfortable challenging technical assumptions, driving technical roadmaps, and influencing architecture decisions. 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Actively participate in architecture and solution design discussions alongside Enterprise Architects and Technical Architects. 
 - Drive technical decision-making and ensure architectural choices align with product strategy and long-term business objectives. 
 - Review and challenge proposed designs to ensure scalability, maintainability, performance, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Lead technical roadmap definition and execution. 
 - Guide teams in adopting engineering best practices, coding standards, design patterns, and modern development methodologies. 
 - Assess technical feasibility, technical debt, and implementation complexity during planning exercises. 

Engineering Leadership

- Lead and manage cross-functional software engineering teams including Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Technical Leads, and Contractors. 
 - Mentor Technical Leads and Senior Developers on architecture, design, and engineering excellence. 
 - Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership. 
 - Drive engineering effectiveness through metrics and data-driven decision making. 

Product & Delivery Ownership

- Collaborate closely with Product Owners to translate business goals into technical solutions. 
 - Break product roadmaps into technical epics, features, and user stories. 
 - Ensure user stories are technically sound, properly estimated, and aligned with architectural principles. 
 - Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, and prioritization activities. 
 - Drive predictable delivery without compromising technical quality. 

Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and delivery challenges. 
 - Influence and collaborate with Architects, Product Management, Engineering Leadership, and other stakeholders. 
 - Communicate technical strategies, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 - Build alignment across globally distributed teams. 

Technology & Innovation

- Stay current with emerging technologies, AI-assisted development, cloud-native architectures, and modern engineering practices. 
 - Drive adoption of automation, DevOps, observability, and AI engineering tools including GitHub Copilot. 
 - Champion continuous improvement initiatives across development lifecycle processes. 

Qualifications

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Essential

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least: 
 - 4+ years as a Software Developer / Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead. 
 - 3+ years leading software engineering teams. 
 - Demonstrated career progression from Software Engineer → Technical Lead → Engineering Manager. 
 - Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale software products. 
 - Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications. 
 - Experience leading architecture reviews and technical design workshops. 
 - Hands-on software development background in: 
 - Java and/or . NET ecosystems
 - REST APIs and Microservices
 - Event-driven architectures
 - Cloud Platforms (Azure preferred)
 - Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices. 

Highly Desirable

- Experience with: 
 - Kubernetes
 - Docker
 - Azure Services
 - Kafka/RabbitMQ
 - API-led integrations
 - React/Angular front-end architectures
 - AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot)

MUST-HAVE TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

- Software Architecture
 - Technical Solution Design
 - Domain Driven Design (DDD)
 - Cloud-Native Architecture
 - Microservices Architecture
 - System Integration
 - API Design and Governance
 - DevOps & CI/CD
 - Security by Design
 - Performance & Scalability Engineering
 - Technical Risk Management
 - Engineering Estimation & Planning
 - Technology Roadmap Development

PEOPLE LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES

- Coaching and Mentoring
 - Talent Development
 - Technical Leadership
 - Stakeholder Influence
 - Strategic Thinking
 - Decision Making
 - Communication
 - Conflict Resolution
 - Cross-functional Collaboration

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. 
 - Cloud certification (Azure/AWS/GCP) , Nice to Have. 
 - TOGAF, Azure Architect, or equivalent architecture certification is nice to have. 
 - Agile certifications are beneficial but not a substitute for strong software engineering experience. 

What We Offer

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever. 

🏡 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans. 

🌎 Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

data.title: Medical Coding Audit Manager
data.description:
Manages the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Evaluation team supporting Veradigm's enterprise coding capability. The team reviews the outputs of AI agents against clinical documentation to confirm that codes are supported, billable, and accurate, and its judgments establish the clinical ground truth used to measure how our AI agents perform. 

Owns the scoring guide that defines how agent output is judged, incorporating input from the reviewers who apply it. Adjudicates disagreements between reviewers, measures and reports inter-reviewer agreement, and defines the clinical metrics reported to customers, so that accuracy claims made commercially and under federal transparency requirements are defensible. Builds and develops a distributed team of certified coders, plans capacity across specialties, and extends the team's scope across coding, chart preparation, and clinical note quality as the AI roadmap expands. 

Essential Functions / Major Job Responsibilities

- Develops and maintains the scoring guide with clinical experts, updating it as specialties and agent behaviors expand. 
 - Manages daily operations for the review team, including assignments, priorities, capacity, and throughput. 
 - Adjudicates dual-review disputes, documenting rationale and identifying reviewer error versus guide ambiguity. 
 - Tracks inter-reviewer agreement, using low agreement to refine guidance rather than penalize staff. 
 - Runs calibration rounds across reviewers to set throughput benchmarks and validate scaling readiness. 
 - Reports clinical metrics, accuracy, claims inclusion, and risk impact, to leadership, product teams, and clients. 
 - Plans specialty coverage, starting with internal medicine and expanding as scope broadens. 
 - Expands scope into chart prep and note quality, establishing evaluation criteria for subjective tasks. 
 - Validates automated scoring through sampling and reports divergences between automated and expert review. 
 - Coordinates design-partner evaluations to maintain consistent review standards across teams. 
 - Enforces approved data access boundaries, authorized data tiers, and compliant review tools. 

Job Requirements

- Bachelor's Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent technical or business experience
 - 8+ years relevant work experience; 2-3 years at the Expert level or equivalent experience - Preferred
 - 4 Years ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding across multiple specialties, with strong attention to detail and a high accuracy rate
 - 2 Years coding auditing or coding quality review
 - 2 Years outpatient or ambulatory coding in a multi-specialty or large group practice setting
 - 1 Year developing coding guidelines, audit criteria, or annotation standards that others apply
 - 1 Year reviewing output from automated or computer-assisted coding tools, or other structured annotation work
 - Medicare Risk Adjustment or HCC coding experience - preferred
 - 2-4 years relevant leadership experience, including leading distributed or remote teams - preferred

Certifications

- CPC, CCS, or CCS-P - AAPC or AHIMA coding certification, active -Required
 - CPMA - Certified Professional Medical Auditor - Preferred
 - CRC - Certified Risk Adjustment Coder - Preferred

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

- Expert-level knowledge of medical coding, including ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, modifier application, E/M documentation guidelines, and CMS claims processing rules. 
 - Ability to write clear, unambiguous evaluation criteria that multiple reviewers can apply to reach the same conclusion on the same record. 
 - Working understanding of measurement concepts relevant to human review, including inter-rater agreement, sampling, and the difference between reviewer error and ambiguous guidance. 
 - Ability to explain coding reasoning to engineers and product managers who have no coding background, and to translate their technical questions into coding terms. 
 - Sound judgment in cases where documentation is incomplete or coding guidance does not clearly apply, and the discipline to distinguish confident conclusions from uncertain ones. 
 - Proven ability to lead others, including where the next-level leader is not in the same location or time zone. 
 - Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in an environment where standards and processes are still being established. 
 - Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as they apply to handling clinical information and de-identified data. 

Working Arrangements

- Standard work week or as defined by assignment requirements. 
 - Primarily works in a standard office environment or remotely. 
 - Requires periodic overlap with United States time zones to collaborate with Applied Intelligence, product, and engineering teams. 

Travel

You will contribute to projects aimed at cleaning up and restoring the environment by ensuring the quality of field data, assessing subsurface conditions, and developing effective remediation strategies for clientele within a variety of business sectors, including electrical utility, solid waste, mining, manufacturing, oil and gas, renewable energy, and others. 

The individual will have the opportunity to take on project management responsibilities, tackling the most challenging environmental issues of today, leveraging cutting-edge technology applied in the remediation industry, including 3D visualization modeling, forensic studies and investigation, high resolution site characterization (HRSC), remediation systems engineering design, etc. Additionally, the ideal candidate will help grow our remediation team in India. 

This position will provide technical support to our US teams. You will manage all aspects of environmental site assessment and remediation projects for USA-based sites from initial site assessments to hydrogeologic investigations, development of conceptual site models, contaminant fate and transport, remedial action design, and implementation. Experience with emerging contaminants of concern, including PFAS and experience investigating coal combustion residuals (CCR) is strongly preferred. 

The successful candidate will develop and support multiple projects from a remediation and environmental engineering perspective, as well as manage and complete independent project tasks. 

The Senior Engineer Will Perform The Following Duties

- Experience of working in diverse global teams, functioning seamlessly with US-based project managers and regional offices. This includes a demonstrated history of collaborating with US-based project teams to complete project- and portfolio-specific tasks.

 - Other duties, as assigned. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in civil, environmental, or related engineering program.

 - Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of US environmental regulations (e. g. , EPA, state-specific codes) and design requirements. 
 - Ability to work independently or as part of a team. 
 - Experience investigating and managing coal combustion residual (CCR) related projects for power generation clients strongly preferred.

data.title: Site Reliability Engineer - Market Data (, Chennai)
data.description:
About GoCharting

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools - footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading - to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world. 

The Role

You will make GoCharting's live market-data and trading services reliable, by building the monitoring, alerting and runbooks yourself and by fixing the causes of outages. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Chief Technology Officer. Traders depend on live prices at the market open, so one engineer needs to own uptime, observability and incident response across the platform. At 12 months, our alerts should catch problems on live feeds and core services, and each incident should end in a written review and a fix. 

What you'll do

- Build monitoring and alerting - cover live data feeds, exchange connections and core services, with alerts that name the failing part
 - Respond to incidents - lead the response, restore service, and write a review that names the cause and the fix
 - Define reliability targets - set service-level objectives for data freshness and uptime, and report against them weekly
 - Write runbooks - document how to detect, triage and recover each critical service so any engineer on duty can follow them
 - Harden infrastructure - manage cloud infrastructure as code, and remove single points of failure
 - Cover the market open - join the weekly rotation for the 08: 30-09: 30 IST market-open window

What we're looking for

Must-haves: 

- 5+ years in site reliability, DevOps or infrastructure operations on production systems
 - Hands-on: you personally build monitoring, alerting and runbooks, and do not only advise
 - Has run production services on a major cloud provider (AWS, DigitalOcean, Google Cloud or Azure) with Linux and containers
 - Has used a metrics and alerting stack, such as Prometheus and Grafana or an equivalent
 - Has been on call for a production service and written post-incident reviews
 - In person in our Chennai office, 5 days a week, and able to take part in the weekly 08: 30-09: 30 IST market-open rotationNice-to-haves: 

- Infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar (adds repeatable, reviewable infrastructure changes)
 - Real-time or streaming systems, such as WebSocket feeds or Kafka (adds understanding of our main workload)
 - Synthetic monitoring of user journeys from several regions (adds detection before users notice)
 - Defining and tracking service-level objectives (adds a measured reliability target)
 - Trading, fintech or market-data operations (adds speed in learning our domain)

Logistics

Location Chennai, India - in person, office-based

Employment type Full-time

Entity ProCharting Private Limited

Reports to Chief Technology Officer

Start date ASAP

Travel None

About GoCharting

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading platform. Traders use professional orderflow tools - footprint charts, volume and market profile, cumulative delta, DOM trading - to read the market and place orders through their broker, all in the browser. Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world. 

The Role

You will build and ship features in GoCharting's web trading terminal, writing the code yourself from ticket to production. The role is full-time and in person in our Chennai office, and it reports to the Engineering Manager for Client Engineering. You will take well-scoped features and fixes raised by active traders and own them through review and release. At 12 months, you should be the engineer the team trusts with a feature area of the terminal, shipping steadily without close supervision. 

What you'll do

- Ship terminal features end to end - build the feature in React and TypeScript, get it through code review and QA, and release it to traders
 - Fix defects reported by traders - find the cause, fix it properly and add a test so it stays fixed
 - Keep the terminal fast - profile slow screens, busy charts and long lists, and remove the cause of the slowdown
 - Work with product and design - turn a written spec and a design into working UI, and raise gaps in the spec early
 - Write clear pull requests - say what changed, why, and what could break
 - Learn the trading domain - charts, market data and the trader's workflow, from the people who use them daily

What we're looking for

- 3+ years building production web applications with React and TypeScript
 - Has shipped features to production in a team codebase, through code review and a release process

 - Has built or maintained a UI that updates in real time, for example with WebSockets, live lists or charts

data.title: Production Head
data.description:
Company Description Supreme Tech is a leading manufacturer of precision sheet metal parts and assemblies, based in Chennai, India and established in 1986. The company is recognized by its customers for consistently high product quality and reliability. Supreme Tech operates with robust quality and safety systems, holding ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 14001: 2015, ISO 45001: 2018, and ISO 3834-2: 2005 certifications. These certifications reflect a strong commitment to process excellence, environmental responsibility, and occupational health and safety. Team members join a stable, established organization focused on continuous improvement and long-term partnerships with its clients. 
Role Description The Production Head is a full-time, on-site role based at Supreme Tech's manufacturing facility in Chennai. This role oversees end-to-end production operations, including planning, scheduling, resource allocation, and workflow optimization to meet delivery commitments and quality standards. The Production Head leads and mentors production teams, coordinates with procurement, quality, and maintenance functions, and ensures adherence to safety and environmental regulations. Daily responsibilities include reviewing production data, resolving bottlenecks, managing budgets and cost controls, and driving process improvements and lean initiatives. The role also involves reporting on key performance indicators, supporting audits, and aligning production activities with overall business goals. 
Qualifications

- Strong skills in Production Planning and Production Management to oversee daily operations and meet output targets. 
 - Competence in Operations Management to optimize processes, resources, and workflows across the shop floor. 
 - Experience in Team Management to lead diverse production teams, manage performance, and build a collaborative work culture. 
 - Ability in Budgeting to manage production costs, monitor resource utilization, and support financial efficiency. 
 - Proven experience in a manufacturing environment, ideally in precision sheet metal or related engineering industries. 
 - Knowledge of ISO-based quality, safety, and environmental management systems and compliance requirements. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills, with attention to quality and safety. 
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

data.title: Mechatronics & Robotics Lead (New Product/ Prototype Builder)
data.description:
Our client says: 

About Us: 

We are an innovative 3D printer manufacturer based in Pune, operating as a lean, fast-paced hardware R&D startup. We specialize in end-to-end design, custom machine fabrication, precision hardware build-outs, and on-site installation. We spend our energy and resources where it counts most - on machine engineering, high-performance components, and rapid prototyping. Having established our core machine platform, we are now scaling up production and custom enterprise deployments. 

Role Overview: 

We are seeking a hands-on, high-ownership New Product Development Lead to work directly with the founders and translate conceptual ideas, rough sketches, and prototype mechanisms into robust, production-ready machinery. You will serve as the technical backbone of our hardware development, bridging mechanical architecture, robotics, electronics, and motion firmware. 

This role operates in a high-autonomy, garage-style prototyping environment - ideal for engineers who love getting their hands dirty, building real physical machinery from the ground up, and avoiding corporate red tape. We are eager to hire you if you have rock-solid fundamentals in robotics, automation, and mechatronics, and want to be part of building a high-scale enterprise from scratch. 

Key Roles and Responsibilities: 

- Translate founder ideas, functional sketches, and early proof-of-concept setups into production-grade CAD designs, electrical systems, and working industrial machines. 
 - Lead the end-to-end mechatronics architecture, integrating kinematics, gantry motion control, closed-loop stepper/servo drives, extruders, heated chambers, and structural enclosures. 
 - Architect and execute system electronics, including wire harness design, sensor selection/interfacing (limit switches, thermistors/thermocouples, inductive probes), and power management. 
 - Configure, flash, and tune motion control firmware (Klipper, Marlin, RepRap, or custom controllers) for precise trajectory, acceleration, and G-code execution. 
 - Implement Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles to continuously optimize Bill of Materials (BOM) costs and production turnaround. 
 - Collaborate closely with regional Pune fabrication vendors, machine shops, and internal technicians for rapid prototyping, CNC machining, and sheet metal fabrication. 
 - Supervise bench testing, pre-shipment quality control (QC), and support field troubleshooting during complex on-site machine installations. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Concept-to-functional prototype delivery timeline. 
 - Machine reliability and uptime during stress-testing and initial field deployments. 
 - First-Time-Right rate during hardware-software integration and on-site commissioning. 
 - BOM cost reduction percentage across iterations without sacrificing positioning accuracy or build speed. 

Requirements & Qualifications

- Experience: 8 to 10 years in robotics, mechatronics, automation systems, special-purpose machinery (SPM). 
 - Education: M. E. / M. Tech in Mechatronics, Robotics & Automation. 
 - Culture Fit: A true "maker/builder" who thrives in a lean, fast-paced workshop setting; excited about physical bench testing, rapid iterations, and direct collaboration with technical founders. 
 - Key Skills: 
 - Expert in SolidWorks/ Fusion 360, DFM/ DFA, and sheet metal/ tolerance design. 
 - Deep understanding of motion kinematics (Cartesian, CoreXY, Delta, or multi-axis), linear guides, and ball screws. 
 - Hands-on experience with stepper/ servo drivers, microcontroller/ PLC wiring, sensor integration, and firmware configuration/ tuning.

data.title: Website Management and Manual Testing QA
data.description:
Job Summary

As a Website Management and Quality Check Engineer (Manual) at Taxmann, you will play a crucial role in managing website and ensuring its quality and functionality. You will work closely with the development and content teams to manage content uploads, plan deployments, perform manual and regression testing, and provide valuable feedback to improve our website. The ideal candidate will have a strong analytical mindset, excellent communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-quality software. 

Key Responsibilities

- Website Management: Manage day-to-day website operations and regularly check pages, navigation, links, downloads, and key user journeys to identify issues and ensure smooth functioning. 
 - Content Uploading: Upload, update, and manage approved content, documents, images, and other website materials through the content management system (CMS). Verify accuracy, formatting, links, and display before and after publishing. 
 - Manual Testing: Perform comprehensive manual testing of the website across browsers and devices to identify defects, inconsistencies, and usability issues. 
 - Test Planning: Collaborate with the development team to create detailed test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on requirements and specifications for website updates and new features. 
 - Execution: Execute test cases to verify website functionality and usability, ensuring all requirements are met. Perform smoke testing after each deployment to verify key functionality on the live website. 
 - Defect Identification: Identify, document, and prioritize defects and user-reported issues, and work with the development team to facilitate their resolution and verify fixes. 
 - Regression Testing: Conduct regression testing to ensure that software changes, content updates, and deployments do not negatively impact existing functionality. 
 - Deployment Planning: Coordinate with the development and content teams to plan deployment schedules, confirm testing completion and approvals, maintain release checklists, and coordinate post-deployment checks and rollback readiness. 
 - Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation, including test cases, test results, defect reports, content update records, and release notes. 
 - Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless communication and alignment on website updates, deployment priorities, and quality objectives. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Proactively suggest process improvements to enhance website management, content uploading, and the quality assurance process. 

Qualifications

- Proven experience in website management, content uploading, manual software testing, and quality assurance. 
 - Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC), testing methodologies, and deployment processes. 
 - Familiarity with content management systems (CMS), testing tools, and bug tracking systems (e. g. , ALM, JIRA etc. ). 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Attention to detail and a methodical approach to website management and testing. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. 

Skills: - Website administration, Manual testing and Software Testing (QA)

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer, IT - Data Operations Engineering
data.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. 

Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. 

As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help build and operate the platforms that power Edwards' global data and analytics solutions. We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to support Data Operations Engineering and own the operational backbone of our data platforms, including infrastructure as code, continuous integration and delivery, data quality monitoring and incident response, observability, security operations, and cloud cost optimization. Our multi-cloud estate includes Databricks and Snowflake, with data services moving to Azure while AWS continues to host corporate source systems. 

How You Will Make An Impact

- Build and maintain modular Terraform components that provision cloud and Databricks platform capabilities, including workspaces, cluster policies, secret scopes, networking, and Unity Catalog storage credentials and external locations, consistently across environments and clouds. 
 - Design and operate automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines that deploy data platform code and infrastructure through development, staging, and production with approval gates and controlled promotion. 
 - Monitor data quality and pipeline health, own first-line response to production alerts, resolve issues directly where possible, and escalate only when the root cause requires deeper pipeline or platform change. 
 - Build, test, and continuously improve runbooks for recurring failure modes, automating remediation when the response can be made safe and repeatable. 
 - Apply AI- and agent-assisted operations capabilities to accelerate detection, triage, and remediation as those capabilities mature. 
 - Build end-to-end observability across Databricks, Snowflake, and orchestration services by bringing platform and execution metadata into unified dashboards, alerting, and pipeline service-level monitoring. 
 - Containerize and operate platform workloads, orchestration, and CI runners on Docker and Kubernetes across EKS and AKS. 
 - Operate and re-host Apache Airflow, consolidating self-managed instances onto Kubernetes or a managed runtime, while supporting migration of legacy build tooling to GitLab CI. 
 - Embed security operations into the platform lifecycle through secrets management, short-lived credentials, least-privilege access, encryption key policies, audit logging, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Drive cloud cost optimization through cost attribution, policy enforcement, right-sizing, tagging standards, and anomaly alerting. 
 - Support secure cross-cloud connectivity and data movement between AWS-resident source systems and the Azure data platform. 
 - Identify opportunities for automation, reusable standards, reliability improvement, and technical debt reduction, and provide technical guidance to team members. 

What You Will Need (Required)

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or cloud infrastructure roles. 
 - Strong hands-on experience administering and automating workloads on both Amazon Web Services and Microsoft Azure, including identity, networking, and storage services. 
 - Demonstrated expertise building modular, reusable infrastructure with Terraform across multiple environments. 
 - Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI or an equivalent platform, including environment promotion, approval gates, and secrets handling. 
 - Strong proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes, including EKS or AKS and running CI/CD or orchestration workloads on Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience operating Apache Airflow, including DAG deployment, scheduling, retries, backfills, pools, and failure recovery. 
 - Solid Linux systems administration, shell scripting, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Hands-on experience implementing metrics, logging, dashboards, and alerting using tools such as Datadog or Grafana. 
 - Demonstrated experience monitoring pipeline and data quality, owning first-line triage of production alerts, and writing and executing runbooks for recurring failures. 
 - Working knowledge of secrets management, least-privilege access control, encryption key management, audit logging, and vulnerability remediation. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud cost monitoring, attribution, tagging standards, and right-sizing practices. 
 - Proficiency in Python or another scripting language used for automation and tooling. 
 - Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills with the ability to work across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. 
 - Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to quality, controls, and long-term outcomes. 
 - Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

data.title: Staff Engineer – Enterprise IT Automation
data.description:
Netradyne harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth. 

About Netradyne: 

Netradyne provides AI-powered technologies for fleet management and safer roads. An award-winning industry leader in fleet safety and video telematics solutions, Netradyne empowers thousands of commercial fleet customers across North America, Europe, and Asia to enhance their driver performance, reduce risk, and optimize operations. 

Netradyne sets the standard among transportation technology companies for enhancing and sustaining road safety, with an industry-leading 25+ billion miles vision-analyzed for risk and an industry-first driver scoring system that reinforces safe behaviours. Founded in 2015, Netradyne is headquartered in San Diego with offices in San Francisco, Nashville, the UK and Bangalore. 

For more details visit: www. netradyne. com

About the Role: 

Netradyne is seeking a highly skilled and experienced dedicated Enterprise IT Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team in Bangalore. This role is critical and serve as the centralised enabler of generative-AI adoption across the enterprise. As a Enterprise IT Automation Engineer, you will turn fragmented, team-by-team AI experimentation into reusable, secure, and scalable capabilities that every function - Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, HR, Admin, Legal, and Finance. 

This is a hands-on, build-first role for an engineer who can solution Agentic AI workflows and agents, integrate them into day-to-day operations, and partner with business leaders to ideate, prototype, and scale high-impact use cases. You will operate as a horizontal force-multiplier across the organisation initiatives and embedding responsible AI into how Netradyne works. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Design, build, and maintain reusable Agentic AI Agents, workflows, MCP connectors, and assistants for business and support functions, prioritising templates that scale beyond a single team. 
 - Integrate MCP Connectors with Gen AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Open AI, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, into existing Enterprise IT & business systems. 
 - Automate business workflows and cross-functional processes, and continuously optimise systems for performance, cost-efficiency, reliability, and scalability. 
 - Apply solid software-engineering practices (version control, testing, observability) to AI solutions so they are maintainable, monitored, and production-grade. 
 - Partner with function teams to ideate, prototype, and scale AI use cases from concept to production, embedding into their workflows rather than handing off in isolation. 
 - Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, CS, Product, Engineering, HR, Admin, Legal, and Finance to identify high-value automation and Gen AI opportunities aligned to organisational goals. 
 - Ensure ethical and secure AI deployment in line with Netradyne's Responsible AI principles, data-protection obligations (including GDPR), and InfoSec policies. 
 - Support governance of Gen AI tool budgets and purchases org-wide, including visibility into shadow-AI spend and usage-based billing models. 
 - Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance the performance of deployed automation tools and AI systems, ensuring scalability and reliability in production. 
 - Stay current with advances in Gen AI, agentic frameworks, and IT automation, and translate them into actionable recommendations for continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of experience in an IT engineering with at least 5+ years of experience in IT automation, AI tools solution and implementation 
 - Hands-on experience designing and shipping Gen AI solutions using tools such as OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Github Co-pilot & Others. 
 - Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Java, or similar, with the ability to build and integrate APIs and workflows. 
 - Working knowledge of AI / ML frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, and agentic / workflow automation (e. g. , n8n, Zapier). 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, and / or Google Workspace). 
 - Experience with Microsoft productivity and platform tooling: O365, SharePoint, and the Microsoft 365 / Power Platform ecosystem. 
 - Demonstrated ability to integrate AI solutions with existing IT systems, with a focus on scalability, security, and reliability. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Experience deploying Gen AI in a high-speed, AI-driven organisation, with a focus on innovation and scale. 
 - Familiarity with IT security frameworks and identity tooling (LDAP, Entra ID, SSO / IdP, VPNs). 
 - Exposure to SOC automation, AI-driven ITSM, and / or InfoSec response automation. 
 - Understanding of SaaS / Gen AI cost governance, usage-based billing, and license management. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and leading cross-functional technical initiatives. 

Why Join Netradyne?

- Help define and build a brand-new, high-visibility Agentic AI Solutions at the centre of the company's AI strategy. 
 - Work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real enterprise impact, across every department. 
 - Collaborate with talented professionals in a collaborative, inclusive, innovation-driven environment. 
 - Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and strong opportunities for professional growth. 

We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any legally protected status. 

If there is a match between your experiences/skills and the Company's needs, we will contact you directly. 

Netradyne is an equal-opportunity employer. 

Applicants only - Recruiting agencies do not contact. 

Recruitment Fraud Alert!

There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Netradyne employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Netradyne does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set-up and does not use recruitment or job-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in '@netradyne. com' or '@us-greenhouse-mail. io'. 

Please review and apply to our available job openings at Netradyne. com/company/careers. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission's job scams website.

data.title: Senior Database Administrator – Database Platform
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to design, build, and manage reliable, scalable, and secure database infrastructure. 

In this role, you will contribute to the evolution of database architecture, standards, automation, and operational best practices. You will work closely with engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure database platforms support high levels of performance, availability, scalability, and reliability. 

The role involves managing database infrastructure across on-premise and cloud environments, with a strong focus on automation, infrastructure-as-code, and reducing manual operational effort. 

Key Responsibilities

Database Administration

- Deploy, configure, maintain, patch, and upgrade SQL Server and PostgreSQL database environments across development, testing, and production. 
 - Ensure database servers are securely configured and aligned with operational standards. 
 - Manage backup, restore, and maintenance strategies to ensure data protection and system availability. 
 - Support and maintain database platforms across multiple environments. 

Cloud Database Management

- Deploy and manage database infrastructure within Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Provision and manage database servers using Compute Engine virtual machines and managed services such as Cloud SQL. 
 - Configure networking, storage, security, and access controls for cloud-hosted database environments. 
 - Implement backup, replication, and disaster recovery strategies for cloud-based database systems. 

High Availability & Disaster Recovery

- Design, implement, and maintain high availability and disaster recovery solutions. 
 - Configure and support database replication technologies, including transactional replication where required. 
 - Work with technologies such as SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, and PostgreSQL replication. 
 - Conduct regular testing of backup and recovery procedures. 

Monitoring & Operations

- Implement and maintain database monitoring and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, SQL Monitor, or similar platforms. 
 - Proactively monitor database performance, availability, and operational health. 
 - Provide database platform expertise and operational support to engineering teams. 
 - Participate in an on-call rotation to support production systems. 
 - Support out-of-hours deployments, maintenance, and operational activities when required. 

Performance Optimization

- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve database performance issues. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to optimize SQL queries, indexing strategies, and database schema design. 
 - Continuously improve database performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 

Automation & Platform Tooling

- Develop automation and tooling for database provisioning, patching, backup management, and routine maintenance. 
 - Reduce manual operational work by implementing repeatable and automated database processes. 
 - Maintain automation scripts, configurations, and operational tooling in version-controlled repositories. 
 - Apply engineering practices such as source control, code reviews, and CI/CD to database automation and operational workflows. 

Governance & Collaboration

- Contribute to the development and maintenance of database standards, procedures, and best practices. 
 - Ensure strong database security, access control, and auditing practices. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, and application teams to support database performance and reliability. 

Required Skills & Experience

- Strong production administration experience with SQL Server and PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience deploying and managing database infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Knowledge of GCP services such as Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, persistent storage, networking, and IAM. 
 - Strong experience designing and supporting High Availability and Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) architectures. 
 - Hands-on experience with SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Groups and Failover Clustering. 
 - Knowledge of database replication technologies, including transactional replication. 
 - Experience with database installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, backup, and recovery. 
 - Strong understanding of database security and access control best practices. 
 - Experience implementing monitoring and alerting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, SQL Monitor, or similar database observability platforms. 
 - Experience automating database administration tasks using PowerShell, Python, or similar scripting languages. 
 - Familiarity with Git, version control, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and application development teams. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with additional database technologies such as Couchbase or CockroachDB. 
 - Experience managing large-scale database platforms supporting multiple engineering teams. 
 - Strong focus on automation, platform engineering, and reducing manual operational work. 

What We're Looking For

- A technically strong DBA with a focus on building reliable and scalable database platforms. 
 - Someone who takes ownership of database performance, availability, and operational efficiency. 
 - A professional with a strong automation mindset and experience improving operational processes. 
 - A collaborative team member who can work effectively with developers, engineers, and infrastructure teams. 

Equal Opportunity

15. Support commissioning, process validation and ramp-up activities of pilot and production lines. 16. Guide cell design optimization using electrochemical modeling, DOE techniques and statistical analysis. 

17. Lead root-cause investigations of electrochemical, mechanical and manufacturing related failures. 

18. Drive development schedules, risk management and milestone tracking for cell development projects. 

19. Drive localization initiatives and alternate source development.

 - In-depth knowledge of Li-ion battery cell operation, performance and failure modes. 
 - 10+ years of Industry experience in development of lithium-ion batteries. 
 - Hands-on experience with prismatic cell development preferred. 
 - Experience working with pilot-line or gigafactory scale manufacturing environments. 
 - Experience in EV and ESS energy storage applications.

Manager, Software Engineering - Cloud Engineering

This position is for a Manager, Software Engineering in the Platform Services team within the Vantage Core - Platform Software organization. The team builds core cloud platform services that power provisioning, lifecycle management, and runtime operations of Teradata compute infrastructure across public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud). These highly reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure services are used by multiple engineering teams and enterprise customers.

 - Platform services for orchestration, scaling, and configuration management across public cloud platforms.

 - Secure and reliable connectivity enablement for cloud-deployed compute systems.

Teradata Labs, the technology research and development (R&D) organization within Teradata Corporation, has been turning innovative decision support technology into business results for over 30 years. Our R&D team of analytic architects, database developers and engineers work to understand and advance emerging technologies to invent the next wave of cutting-edge analytic data solutions.

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, empathetic, and creative engineering leader who is ready to participate in an agile team environment and contribute to the success of Teradata. Given our team's focus on cloud platform solutions, the ideal candidate should have deep hands-on cloud experience on AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.

 - Proven ability to influence technical decisions across teams and drive engineering alignment. 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills. 

Technical

 - Experience designing infrastructure automation and provisioning systems using cloud APIs, SDKs, and Infrastructure as Code tools.

We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. data.title: Quality Specialist Launch Team
data.description:
Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Primary Purpose Of The Position

Working as part of a team of Process experts, the role will have responsibility predominantly for New Build, New Line and Line Conversion start- up performance. He/she is responsible for quality matters in order to guarantee respect of the law for environment matters, optimization of processes in term of quality and chemical usages. He/she achieved outstanding results in his/her previous role working in quality area. Responsibility will predominantly be for Efficiency, Spoilage and Quality in the first instance with secondary responsibility for other KPIs such as Material usages, Production Supplies and respect of environmental prescriptions as appropriate to the area of expertise. 

Essential Responsible Areas

- Achieve Efficiency and Spoilage targets for all New Builds, New Lines, and Line Conversions in alignment with the approved start-up curves, ensuring rapid progression to stable and capable operations. 
 - Lead Quality performance during the start-up phase, taking full responsibility for delivering compliant, consistent, and specification-conforming product from first production through handover. 
 - Ensure product quality and food safety compliance by continuously monitoring processes, materials, and outputs during start-up and taking immediate action on any deviations. 
 - Oversee inspections and audits, ensuring the local quality team executes process checks, material inspections, and finished product audits to required standards. 
 - Specialize on all gauges, inspection devices, and measurement equipment ensuring they are correctly maintained, calibrated, validated, and monitored to ensuring correct working condition giving to reliable quality verification, becoming the go-to support within Ball 
 - EMEA for all related operational issues. Track quality trends and performance indicators, identifying early signals of variation and initiating corrective or preventive actions to stabilize and improve process capability. 
 - Support the Plant Quality Manager with implementation and maintenance of ISO, HACCP, and other regulatory or customer-driven food safety/quality systems. 
 - Support the execution of SOPs, SPC, and other quality management tools, ensuring process consistency and repeatability during ramp-up. 
 - Train production and quality staff in process understanding, quality expectations, defect prevention, inspection standards, and food safety practices, ensuring a capable and autonomous workforce. 
 - Ensure trained backups are available for all critical quality and food safety roles to maintain operational continuity during and after start-up. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, and suppliers to prevent defects, reduce variability, and strengthen process quality throughout the start-up phase. 
 - Collect, analyse, and report quality and food safety data, providing insights that drive decision-making, improve performance, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

 - 3+ years in a comparable position with demonstrated expertise in quality assurance, customer support, and relevant products. 
 - ISO, Food Safety and audit experience preferred. 
 - Green Belt Certification preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of the full Can making process and subject expert in at least one specific area. 
 - Ability to transfer Can making process knowledge to others 
 - Strong capability in equipment setup, troubleshooting, optimisation, and supporting line performance
 - Competent computer skills for data analysis and report writing
 - English communication skills (minimum communicative level)
 - Preferred: Experience with line launches or rebuild projects 
 - Ownership mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and waste reduction
 - Ability to mentor and develop less experienced team members 
 - Strong attention to detail and adherence to specifications 
 - Effective communication across all departments and levels 
 - Strong teamwork and collaboration mindset
 - Results-driven, proactive, and forward-thinking
 - Continuous improvement mindset with strong waste-reduction focus
 - High attention to detail and commitment to excellence
 - Able to work autonomously and collaboratively
 - Strong engagement and communication skills across all levels
 - Passionate about coaching, mentoring, and developing others
 - Flexible and willing to travel at short notice
 - Empathetic and supportive in team environments

Work Environment: This role supports central functions and offers flexible work arrangements including hybrid or fully remote options, subject to role requirements and manager approval. 

Hiring Range: 62, 300 - 89, 690 EUR gross per year. The final salary will be determined based on the candidate's education, experience, knowledge, skills, and competencies, while taking into account internal equity and industry benchmarks. Please note that the salary range is related to Germany as base location, however relevant local range applies to candidates based in other locations. 

Incentive Plan: This position is eligible to participate in Ball's annual incentive compensation program. 

Comprehensive Benefits Package: Defined contribution pension, life insurance, accident and disability insurance, employee assistance program, and meal assistance. 

Ball Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, faith, ability, or orientation. When you join Ball you belong to a team of over 16, 000 members worldwide. Our products range from infinitely recyclable aluminium cans, cups to aerosol bottles that enable our customers to contribute to a better world. 

Each of us has a deep commitment to diversity and inclusion which is the foundation of our culture of belonging. Everyone at Ball is making a difference by doing what we love. Because what we create may change, but what we will always make is a difference.

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced CPU/SoC Validation Engineer with strong knowledge of ARM Generic Interrupt Controller (GIC) architecture and hands-on experience in post-silicon validation, system-level debugging. The engineer will own validation of interrupt-controller functionality across CPU, firmware, power-management, and OS interactions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute post-silicon validation plans for ARM GICv3/GICv4 and CPU interrupt subsystems. 
 - Validate GIC components including: Distributor (GICD)Redistributor (GICR)CPU interface and system registersInterrupt Translation Service (ITS)SGI, PPI, SPI and LPI interrupt flows
 - Validate interrupt routing, prioritization, masking, preemption, affinity, acknowledgement and EOI behavior. 
 - Develop stress scenarios covering: Concurrent interrupt generationHigh interrupt ratesMulti-core interrupt routingSGI broadcast and targeted SGIsInterrupt migration and CPU hotplugInterrupt handling during CPU idle and low-power transitions
 - Validate GIC behavior across CPU power collapse, suspend/resume, reset and DVFS transitions. 
 - Debug complex issues involving lost interrupts, unexpected routing, interrupt latency, stuck interrupts and incorrect GIC state. 
 - Analyze key GIC registers such as GICD, GICR, ICC system registers, ICH virtualization registers and ITS state. 
 - Validate interactions between the GIC and OS/kernel, firmware, hypervisor and power-management software. 
 - Work closely with CPU architecture, firmware, kernel, power-management, design and verification teams to root-cause silicon issues. 
 - Use hardware/software debugging techniques including register dumps, trace, kernel logs, crash dumps and waveform/trace correlation. 
 - Develop automation and stress workloads for interrupt validation and regression testing. 
 - Track validation coverage, defects, risks and closure status through engineering tracking systems. 

Required Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of ARMv8/ARMv9 architecture. 
 - Strong understanding of ARM GICv3/GICv4 architecture. 
 - Good knowledge of: SGI / PPI / SPI / LPIInterrupt affinity and routingPriority masking and preemptionGroup 0 / Group 1 interruptsSecure and Non-secure interrupt handlingGIC Distributor and RedistributorCPU interface registersITS and MSI-based interruptsVirtual interrupts / vGIC concepts
 - Understanding of CPU power states, clock/power collapse, reset sequences and low-power entry/exit. 
 - Programming/scripting experience with C/C++, Python and shell scripting. 
 - Experience with JTAG/debuggers and SoC debug methodologies is desirable. 

Preferred Experience

- 7 to 16 years of experience in CPU/SoC post-silicon validation or silicon bring-up experience. 
 - Validation of ARM-based multicore SoCs. 
 - Knowledge of virtualization, hypervisors and virtual interrupt handling. 
 - Experience debugging interactions among GIC, CPU low-power states, DVFS and firmware. 
 - Ability to convert architectural requirements into validation scenarios, stress tests and measurable coverage.

data.description:
Company: 

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area: 

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary: 

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

General Summary: 

Ownership of System Memory Management [SMMU] IP test bench and collaterals for the next generation System-on-chip (SoC) for smartphones, tablets and other product categories. System Memory Management Unit does virtual to physical address translation, dynamic allocation and access control of DDR memory, designed as per ARM SMMU architecture spec. 

Job responsibilities include

- Ownership of DV test bench and other associated collaterals (Checkers, Trackers, Scoreboards, Assertion, Functional Coverage)
 - Develop test plan and test cases to cover design feature set, follow up with stake holders on code coverage, functional coverage closure at different levels of test bench
 - Work closely with System Architects, Design, emulation teams on failure debugs, code/functional coverage closure
 - Debug of regression signatures and identifying bug fixes
 - Developing/Deploying scripts/tools for validation (Certitude, VC Formal, Fishtail)
 - Debug and root cause post silicon issues in collaboration with Design, SW and test teams
 - Work with SoC level performance modeling team on latency, bandwidth analysis

Required Skillset Include

- Strong debugging, Analytical and problem-solving skills
 - Expertise on UVM, System Verilog coding
 - Knowledgeable about ARM bus protocols (AXI, AHB, APB, CHI), Virtual Memory concepts, SoC system architecture
 - Experience in developing Monitors, Scoreboards, Sequencers that utilize scripts, System Verilog, UVM, and methodologies to increase the rate with which bugs are found and resolved
 - Post-si bring-up and HW-SW debug experience would be a plus. Knowledge & exposure to silicon debug tool chains would be an added advantage
 - Communication and collaboration skills to work with a large world-wide design organization

data.title: Chief Technology Officer
data.description:
Chief Technology Officer

Cue Home Innovation Labs

· Ahmedabad · Full time, on site

Role

We are looking for a CTO who will take complete ownership of Cue's technology and hold

it for the next three to five years while we grow. 

There are two halves to the job. Run and scale the platform we have built. And take this

company AI native inside the next nine to eighteen months, in the product and in the way

we work. 

The cash is modest for the seniority. The equity is meaningful. You will work beside the

founder every day, and you will have the standing of a co-founder in how this company is

run. 

What Cue Home is

Cue Home is a brand-agnostic smart home operating system, built in India. Our own gateway

hardware, our own cloud platform, apps live in both stores, and a system that keeps the

house running whether or not the internet does. It is deployed in homes, in enterprises

and in large real estate projects, and it is moving now from pilot installations to full

production. 

Hardware, firmware, cloud, mobile and protocol engineering, in one product. 

And we are building toward something larger. A lifecycle management platform for the smart home: design, planning, installation, integration and control, across more than 45 product categories and over 2, 000 brands, for the thirty-year life of an Indian home. The full stack of a smart home. 

What you will own

- The whole technology function: platform, hardware, firmware, mobile, cloud and release. 

- The architecture and the roadmap. You decide where we go technically, and you defend it. 

- The AI native transition, end to end. 

- The engineering team. You will lead them, grow them, and hire the next set. 

- Engineering quality and security as a standing discipline, not a project. 

- The technical half of every investor and partner conversation. 

Today the founder ( Non-technical ) carries much of this. The point of this role is that he stops. 

Who we are looking for

- Around six to nine years building software, with real time spent close to hardware or embedded

  systems. 

- You have taken a product from working to shipped at scale, and owned what happened

  after it shipped. 

- You have led a small engineering team, and people stayed. 

- You have built with LLMs and agents in earnest, not a weekend demo. You know where they

  hold and where they fall over. 

- You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room, and the one who

  is accountable. 

- You want to be in Ahmedabad, in the office, with the team. 

What matters more than any of the above: you want to own something, and you are willing

to give it three to five years. 

The Payout

Meaningful equity vesting over four years, with cash that is fair but deliberately modest

for the level. A seat in every company decision, not only the technical ones. A review of

your title and your standing at twelve months. 

Three to five years is the minimum commitment we are asking for. On almost everything

else, for the right person, we are flexible. Tell us what you need and we will have that

conversation properly. 

How to apply

Write to harnish@cuehome. in. Keep it structured, in this order. 

1. Your name and qualifications. (50 words)

2. Why you think you fit this role best. (250 words)

3. The product you were most deeply involved in building. What it was, what you owned, and what happened to it after it shipped. (400 words)

4. Your minimum monthly cash expectation. A number, not a range. We would rather know now than in the third conversation. 

Four answers and your CV. Nothing else.

P-1492

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems - from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers - and customer obsessed - we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started in Bengaluru , India ! As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale. 

The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Software Engineer with a deep understanding of low-level systems to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and optimizing application frameworks that form the building blocks for all software development at Databricks. This is not a full-stack role; your expertise will be focused on the intricate details of system internals, performance, and efficiency. 

What We Look For

- Design, implement, and maintain core system infrastructure and low-level software components. 
 - Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability through meticulous analysis and innovative solutions. 
 - Work with JVM internals, memory management, concurrency, and distributed systems. 
 - Collaborate with other senior engineers and architects to define technical strategies and roadmaps. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence. 
 - Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and architectural decision-making. 
 - Troubleshoot complex system issues and provide effective resolutions. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 12+ years of professional experience in software development. 
 - Deep understanding of Java Virtual Machine (JVM) internals, including garbage collection, JIT compilation, class loading, and memory model. 
 - Proficiency in at least one JVM language and extensive experience with its runtime environment. 
 - Strong programming skills in Scala/Java/Rust or other systems-level languages. 
 - Extensive experience with operating system concepts; including processes, threads, concurrency, scheduling, and I/O. 
 - Proven track record of building and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and reliable systems. 
 - Experience with distributed systems concepts and technologies. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration abilities
 - Experience with performance profiling and tuning tools. 
 - Contributions to open-source projects related to JVM or systems software. 
 - Experience with RPC frameworks. 

If you are a systems-level expert with a passion for optimizing the core of technology and possess a deep understanding of JVM internals, we encourage you to apply and help us build the future. 

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20, 000 organizations worldwide - including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 - rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents.
