data.title: Project Manager (with Scrum Master skills)
data.description:
Ascentt is building cutting-edge data analytics & AI/ML solutions for global automotive and manufacturing leaders. We turn enterprise data into real-time decisions using advanced machine learning and GenAI. Our team solves hard engineering problems at scale, with real-world industry impact. We're hiring passionate builders to shape the future of industrial intelligence. 

Project Manager (with Scrum Master Skills)

Locations: Indore, Madhya Pradesh/ Pune

Work Arrangement: Office-based

Role Type: Full-time

About Ascentt

Ascentt is a technology consulting and AI services firm that partners with global enterprises to deliver complex data, AI, and digital transformation programs. Our teams work directly with enterprise client stakeholders on high-visibility engagements where delivery discipline, transparency, and outcomes matter. We offer a collaborative environment, direct exposure to global clients, and the opportunity to shape how modern Agile delivery works on AI-driven programs. 

Role Overview

As a Project Manager at Ascentt, you will lead the Agile delivery of one cross-functional Scrum team building technology and AI-driven solutions for enterprise clients. 

This is a hands-on Agile leadership role. The delivery environment entails enterprise-scale programs, cross-team dependencies, and direct engagement with client stakeholders. The seniority of this role lies in the judgment it requires, knowing when to coach, when to facilitate, when to challenge, and when to escalate. 

We are looking for someone who leans into problems, engages the right people, drives closure, challenges teams constructively, and operates comfortably with internal and client stakeholders. 

Work Location & Client Collaboration

This is an office-based position at Ascentt's Indore or Pune location. Regular presence in the office is required. 

Because Ascentt works with global enterprise clients, the Senior Scrum Master will need the flexibility to overlap with U. S. client working hours as needed for Agile ceremonies, stakeholder discussions, planning sessions, and issue resolution. 

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Planning

- Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of technical projects, also serving as Scrum Master for the delivery team
 - Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, and timelines
 - Develop and maintain detailed project plans; track progress, dependencies, and critical path

AI-Enabled Project Management

- Leverage AI tools to streamline project tracking, generate status summaries, and surface risks or delays earlier
 - Use AI-assisted reporting to improve turnaround and consistency of status updates to leadership
 - Drive adoption of AI-driven PM tools and practices as part of continuous process improvement

Stakeholder & Team Coordination

- Coordinate internal technical teams, business teams, and third-party vendors
 - Facilitate communication between engineering teams, product owners, and business stakeholders
 - Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives

Risk, Issue & Requirements Management

- Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, changes, and escalations
 - Identify potential roadblocks and drive timely resolution
 - Ensure technical requirements are clearly defined, documented, and understood by development teams

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Monitor project performance, schedules, budgets, and key delivery metrics
 - Prepare and present regular project status reports to leadership and stakeholders

Agile Delivery (Scrum Master)

- Serve as Scrum Master for one cross-functional Agile delivery team, leading sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
 - Facilitate Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives)
 - Ensure ceremonies produce clear decisions, commitments, and actions - and that the team establishes and stays focused on clear sprint goals. 
 - Partner with the Product Owner to maintain a healthy, prioritized, appropriately refined backlog. 
 - Surface unclear requirements, unresolved questions, dependencies, and readiness gaps before work enters a sprint. 
 - Use Agile metrics (predictability, carryover, cycle time, throughput) to to identify trends and drive team improvement. 
 - Coach the team on Agile principles, accountability, and effective performance of their roles. 

Process Improvement

- Drive continuous improvement in project management processes and delivery methodologies

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of overall experience in software development or technology delivery environments, including experience managing technical projects end-to-end. 
 - 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Agile delivery leader for cross-functional software or technology teams. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading project planning and delivery - scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and stakeholder reporting - alongside facilitating the full set of Scrum ceremonies and applying Agile principles in real-world delivery environments. 
 - Strong track record identifying and driving resolution of impediments, delivery risks, dependencies, and cross-team escalations. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile delivery metrics (velocity, burndown, cycle time) and traditional project metrics (schedule, budget, milestones), and how to apply both to improve predictability and delivery outcomes. 
 - Experience leveraging AI tools for project tracking, status reporting, or risk surfacing, with an interest in driving continued adoption of AI-driven PM practices. 
 - Proficiency with Jira or comparable Agile/project work-management tools. 
 - Strong facilitation, coaching, communication, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both technical and business stakeholders and present to leadership. 
 - Experience in distributed or global delivery environments, with flexibility to overlap with U. S. client hours as required. 

Preferred Qualifications

- CSM, PSM, SAFe Scrum Master, PMI-ACP, or comparable Agile certification. 
 - Experience with enterprise clients in a consulting environment. 
 - Exposure to AI, Generative AI, data, cloud, or other emerging-technology delivery environments. 
 - Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or related industries. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful project manager with scrum master skills creates an environment in which: 

- Projects deliver on scope, schedule, and budget, with risks and dependencies caught early
 - Sprints run predictably - stable velocity, few blockers, high-value ceremonies
 - Status reporting to leadership is fast, clear, and AI-assisted
 - Engineering, product, and business teams stay aligned with minimal miscommunication or rework
 - Impediments and escalations get resolved quickly
 - AI tools are actively used to reduce manual PM overhead
 - Delivery processes keep improving sprint over sprint
 - Distributed team members stay fully integrated across time zones

Ultimately, this role's impact is visible in the team's ability to anticipate and resolve delivery challenges, make better decisions, and consistently deliver valuable outcomes.

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

data.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI (CAD/EDA)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the better part of a decade building CAD infrastructure that has to hold up under real silicon development pressure, not just proof-of-concept demos or similar domains. You know that the difference between a flow that gets adopted and one that gets worked around is usually in the details no one else thought about. Lately, you have been watching the explosion of agentic AI and LLM orchestration, and instead of seeing hype, you see exactly how autonomous agents could transform the way IP gets designed, verified, and managed across its lifecycle. 

You are someone who can sit with IP designers who need faster turnaround on design and verification and walk out with a multi-agent workflow spec that actually solves their problem. You do not wait for the AI platform team to tell you what is possible. You prototype, you integrate, you prove the concept, and then you scale it. You have strong opinions about what makes infrastructure scalable, and you are not afraid to push back when a proposed solution will not survive the challenges of a scalable production use. 

At Synopsys, you will work at the center of Silicon Lifecycle Management (SLM) IP development in the AI Center of Excellence team, architecting AI Infrastructure, building Agents from scratch, leveraging when possible and customizing to the team needs. The problems are hard, the scale is real, and what you build will reshape how thousands of engineers work. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Architect and define the next generation of AI-powered CAD infrastructure for Silicon IP development, building and integrating autonomous agents into core design and verification workflows
 - Build Agentic frameworks and Agents to improve Engineering productivity of the organization
 - Deploy and operationalize Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform directly into the SLM IP development loop, building orchestration layers that connect LLMs, agents, and EDA toolchains across design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing
 - Design multi-agent workflows that automate IP design tasks, verification loops, and lifecycle analytics, turning manual bottlenecks into autonomous, scalable processes
 - Partner with IP design teams, CAD engineers, and global AI platform teams to align architecture with real engineering needs and deployment constraints
 - Build and maintain the infrastructure layer that connects silicon design phases with AI-driven automation, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across the full IP lifecycle
 - Prototype, test, and validate new AI-CAD integrations in live development environments, iterating based on feedback from design teams and measurable workflow improvements
 - Drive technical strategy and roadmap for AI-augmented CAD systems within SLM, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete engineering solutions
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the team, fostering best practices

The Impact You Will Have

- Enable IP design and verification teams to move faster by automating repetitive, high-friction tasks through intelligent agent-driven workflows
 - Reduce time-to-market for SLM IP by building scalable CAD infrastructure that adapts to design complexity without linear increases in manual effort
 - Set the technical foundation for how Synopsys integrates agentic AI into silicon development, influencing architecture decisions across the broader EDA organization
 - Improve design quality and lifecycle visibility by embedding AI-driven analytics and telemetry into the core IP development flow
 - Accelerate adoption of Synopsys' Agentic AI platform by proving its value in one of the most demanding, high-stakes engineering environments in the company
 - Shape the future of CAD infrastructure at Synopsys, defining patterns and practices that will scale across multiple IP families and product lines
 - Directly influence how thousands of engineers experience their daily workflows, making complex silicon development more efficient, predictable, and autonomous

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph. D. in Computer Science, VLSI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
 - 12+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying advanced CAD flows and infrastructure in silicon design environments
 - Proven experience implementing Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent platforms, LLM orchestrations, or autonomous software agent systems in production settings
 - Mastery of Python and C++ for building production-grade infrastructure, plus strong proficiency in EDA scripting languages like Tcl, Perl, and Shell
 - Track record of building agents and orchestration layers that interact with design, verification, synthesis, PnR, and timing flows
 - Technical understanding of silicon design phases, particularly IP development, verification, and lifecycle management workflows, is a plus
 - Experience with Silicon Lifecycle Management concepts such as in-chip sensing, telemetry, and analytics is a strong plus

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room full of IP designers talking about verification bottlenecks and walk out with a clear architecture for an agent-driven solution that actually fits their workflow
 - You prototype fast and iterate based on real feedback, not theoretical requirements, and you know the difference between a demo that impresses and a system that ships
 - You have a point of view on what makes CAD infrastructure scalable and maintainable, and you are comfortable defending that view with technical depth and real-world examples
 - You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, especially when integrating cutting-edge AI technologies into established silicon development environments where stability and correctness are non-negotiable
 - You think in systems, understanding how changes in one part of the CAD flow ripple through design, verification, and downstream lifecycle analytics
 - You do not need perfect documentation or fully baked requirements to get started, you ask the right questions, align stakeholders, and find a path forward

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will be part of the Silicon Lifecycle Management IP Development team in Bangalore, working at the intersection of advanced IP design and AI-driven automation. This team is responsible for building the infrastructure and workflows that power SLM IP development across Synopsys, and you will be the principal engineer defining how agentic AI gets integrated into that foundation. You will collaborate closely with IP designers, CAD engineers, and Synopsys' global Agentic AI platform teams, bridging technical domains and driving alignment across a distributed, highly technical organization. This is a Principal Individual Contributor role with significant technical leadership responsibilities across multiple globally distributed engineering teams. This role may evolve into leading a small team of AI infrastructure engineers as adoption scales. 

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: AI Full-Stack Developer, Maintenance & Enhancements
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About The Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About The Role

PULS runs live AI solutions used every day by Purchasing, Finance, Logistics, R&D and Sales: chat agents integrated with SAP, scheduled Azure jobs, document pipelines, workflow apps and dashboards. You will keep them reliable and keep improving them. That means resolving incidents at the root cause, shipping change requests in regular maintenance releases, and keeping everything monitored and documented. You will work from India with core hours overlapping the Munich morning (about 13: 00-18: 00 IST), with no night shifts and no solo on-call, alongside the AI team, DevOps and Cybersecurity. Onboarding is in Munich, with one or two visits a year after that. 

What You'll Do

- Own the incident and change-request queue for all live AI solutions: reproduce on the test stage, separate bugs from change requests and agree weekly priorities with the AI Team Lead
 - Fix root causes across the stack: TypeScript/React frontend, Node. js or Python (FastAPI) backend, scheduled jobs, SAP OData integration, PDF and mailbox automation, and write the test that proves each fix
 - Ship enhancements in maintenance releases (new SAP fields, document layouts, extended agent skills) and turn larger requests into specifications for the project team
 - Use Claude Code and Codex to draft fixes and tests, then review, verify on the preview stage and merge
 - Catch rising error rates, silently failed jobs and token-cost drift with KQL in Log Analytics; release prompt, skill and model updates on Azure OpenAI only after regression cases and an LLM-as-judge review pass
 - Run Azure Container Apps and jobs across preview, pilot and production with DevOps: Bicep, rollbacks, Key Vault secrets, Entra app registrations and Teams app updates
 - Take over solutions built by business teams and keep runbooks and documentation current

What You Bring

- 4-6 years of full-stack development on production systems you not only built but kept running
 - TypeScript/React and Node. js, plus Python with FastAPI; SQL with PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB
 - Azure in daily practice: Container Apps, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL, Key Vault, Service Bus, Entra ID, Bicep and the Azure CLI
 - Has shipped LLM applications to production: tool calling, prompt guardrails, RAG (pgvector) and evaluation
 - Real debugging depth, e. g. has traced a 401/403 through an OAuth on-behalf-of chain and an API gateway to its root cause, and reads logs with KQL
 - At least 6 months of daily Claude Code or Codex use on production code. Expect live pairing on a real ticket in the interview
 - Secrets management, RBAC and GDPR as everyday practice; clear written English (C1) for non-technical colleagues in Jira and docs

Nice to have

- SAP OData integration experience
 - PowerShell for Windows-based deployment and operations tooling
 - Microsoft Teams app development

data.title: Data Steward, SAPAC (contract)
data.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers - and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers. 

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it. 

Please Note - This is a 24-month contractual position

Job Purpose

The Data Steward is the operational execution lead for commercial data quality across SAPAC, supporting the Data Coordinator and the respective business data owners. The role performs recurring data verification, audits, sampling and correction activities, directly supports designated markets, and produces the reporting required to identify and resolve data quality issues - flagging the underlying cause of each issue so that it can be addressed at source. 

Output: accurate data, completed corrections under owner approval, managed exceptions, root causes flagged, and timely data quality reporting. 

Key Responsibilities

Recurring verification and reporting (all markets, under the agreed allocation)

- Post-load price verification after every price load: sample SKUs against the approved price file and flag mismatches for correction (accuracy - distinct from the Data Coordinator's quarterly audit of timeliness) 
 - All cost-to-price reconciliation: spare parts each price-increase cycle (selling price versus current transfer price per part, flagging negative or below-threshold margins) and completeness checks on capital and consumables reconciliation 
 - Monthly contract-expiry report per market: contracts expiring within 90 days with no renewal action, and the on-time renewal rate 
 - Monthly preventive-maintenance completion reporting using the regional tracker template 
 - Quarterly customer-master-to-pricing audits where applicable: affiliations, hierarchies and classifications that drive pricing conditions 
 - Quarterly customer master hygiene runs: duplicate detection, entity and payer verification, classification checks 
 - Quarterly point-of-sale service-contract reconciliation and warranty-versus-installation allocation sampling 
 - Rotating monthly contract-record completeness sampling by market (expiry, pricing and coverage fields) 
 - For every recurring exception, record the likely underlying cause (process, ownership, system) alongside the correction, so patterns can be addressed by the Data Coordinator and the business owner

Direct execution for designated markets (primary executor)

- Prepare, validate and load price files into SAP for designated markets - reviewed by the Data Coordinator, verified and signed off by the market's Finance Director 
 - Execute installed base corrections and cleansing, customer master de-duplication and corrections, and contract-record completion, each under business-owner approval 
 - Capture point-of-sale service contracts into the portfolio and maintain preventive-maintenance tracking where local capacity is limited 
 - Enter and maintain distributor installation and end-customer data received under the regional collection standard 
 - Keep the execution log: every change, its approving data owner, and turnaround - reported to the Steering Committee via the Lead

Installed base (all markets)

- Execute the corrections arising from the installed base accuracy programme coordinated by the Data Coordinator; maintain the underlying data for the country accuracy score

Support and enablement

- Handle hands-on support requests from non-designated markets - price-file validation, IB corrections, de-duplication - logged and reported, with the Steering Committee managing the balance against verification work 
 - Maintain the single current repository of data SOPs using existing global platforms (GetBasic, GetLibrary, GetQMS, the Finance Manual) rather than local copies 
 - Produce one-page filter, currency and refresh-cycle guides for the global dashboards and support market training

Phase 2 (from month 6, gated)

- Zone and region performance reporting for India, building on work already under way with the Service Director 
 - Account-history and customer summary requests for sales and service teams, once scoped by the Steering Committee

Requirements

Must have: 

- 4-8 years in data operations, master data maintenance, finance operations, order management or service administration 
 - Hands-on SAP experience in at least two of: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and service-contract records - including creating and maintaining records, not only reporting on them 
 - Advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, reconciliations); Power BI a strong advantage 
 - Meticulous attention to detail and the persistence to work through large record sets methodically 
 - The habit of asking why an error occurred - able to recognise when a data problem is really a process or ownership problem, and to say so 
 - Good written and spoken English; able to explain an exception clearly to a colleague in another country 
 - Comfortable working across cultures and time zones with people who do not report to you

Good To Have

- An analytics background or interest - the role has a Phase 2 pathway into reporting and analytics work 
 - Medical-device, pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience 
 - Exposure to service-contract or installed-base administration 
 - Experience with distributor or channel data

About Us

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12, 000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries. 

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

data.title: Co-Founder
data.description:
Scale To Unicorn is building a next-generation growth company that combines performance marketing, AI, automation, and technology to help businesses acquire customers and scale revenue. 

Our vision is to build more than a marketing agency - we want to create scalable growth systems, AI-powered sales infrastructure, and technology-driven solutions for businesses across India, USA, UK, UAE, and Canada. 

We are looking for an ambitious individual to join the founding team and take ownership of our technical and revenue engines. 

Your Mission: Build Technology. Drive Revenue. Scale the Business. 

1. Technology & CTO Responsibilities

- Lead the company's technology vision and product development. 
 - Build AI-powered tools, automation systems, AI agents, and intelligent sales workflows. 
 - Develop internal SaaS products, CRM integrations, and scalable business solutions. 
 - Manage website development, APIs, backend infrastructure, and technical architecture.

- Own the company's revenue generation and client acquisition strategy. 
 - Acquire high-ticket clients across international markets. 
 - Lead sales calls, negotiations, presentations, and deal closures. 
 - Build outbound sales systems, partnerships, and acquisition channels. 
 - Develop strategies to increase recurring revenue and client retention. 
 - Help establish Scale To Unicorn as a trusted international growth partner. 

3. Founding Team & Leadership

- Work directly with the founder on business strategy and execution. 
 - Take complete ownership of technology and/or revenue targets. 
 - Build teams, systems, and processes from scratch. 
 - Participate in important business decisions and long-term company planning.

We are looking for someone who: 

- Has strong technical knowledge and can actually build products, not just manage developers. 
 - Understands AI, LLMs, automation, APIs, software development, and modern tech stacks. 
 - Has an understanding of sales, business development, and revenue generation. 
 - Can communicate confidently with international clients. 
 - Thinks like an entrepreneur and executes like an operator. 
 - Is comfortable taking risks, solving difficult problems, and working in uncertainty.

 - Someone unwilling to take responsibility for outcomes.

Build. Sell. Grow. Earn.

What you'll do

- Define the platform QA strategy, roadmap and end-to-end quality lifecycle.

 - Experience designing scalable automation frameworks, rather than only maintaining existing test cases. 
 - Knowledge of performance and scalability testing using tools such as JMeter, k6 or equivalent. 
 - Knowledge of security traffic generation or simulation using Ixia BreakingPoint, Scapy, Snort/Suricata generators or equivalent; these tools are alternatives, not cumulative requirements.

 - A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Computer Engineering or a related field.

Nice to have

Key Responsibilities1. Leadership & Team Management

•              Lead and manage the complete Design & Engineering Department, including a multidisciplinary team of design engineers. 

•              Define and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for the design team, ensuring productivity, quality, and adherence to project deadlines. 

•              Plan departmental resources and monitor design schedules to ensure timely completion of project deliverables. 

•              Mentor and develop Design Engineers, Senior Engineers, and the overall technical team, providing technical guidance and career development support. 

•              Drive a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration across the design organization. 

2. Structural, Mechanical & Solar Design

•              Lead the design and engineering of ground-mounted solar structures, solar mounting systems, structural steel components, sheet metal parts, fabricated assemblies, and automobile components. 

•              Oversee structural design and CAD modelling of products/structures (e. g. , solar trackers, poles, pressure vessels, enclosures, or equivalent structural systems) ensuring compliance with international safety, durability, and reliability standards. 

•              Direct structural analysis using STAAD Pro, ANSYS, and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to validate designs against wind loads, seismic conditions, buckling, and long-term environmental durability. 

•              Review and approve design calculations, structural drawings, 3D models, fabrication drawings, BOMs, and technical documents, including detailed GD&T for manufacturability and assembly feasibility. 

•              Guide design calculations, thermal simulations, and CFD analysis as required for product validation. 

3. Design Optimization & Manufacturing Feasibility

•              Drive design optimization and value engineering to reduce material consumption, weight, cost, wastage, and manufacturing complexity. 

•              Ensure designs are optimized for manufacturing, fabrication, galvanizing, transportation, installation, and site assembly, applying DFM/DFA principles. 

•              Ensure designs meet customer requirements, project specifications, applicable standards, quality requirements, and manufacturing feasibility. 

•              Establish and maintain design standards, standard components, templates, calculation methods, and engineering procedures. 

4. Compliance, Quality & Documentation

•              Own and drive DFMEA processes for UL and other regulatory/international certifications. 

•              Ensure design documentation complies with industry standards (ISO, ASME, ASTM, IS) and internal quality systems. 

•              Ensure proper revision control, design documentation, engineering change management (ECN), and BOM accuracy. 

•              Establish and maintain drafting manuals, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and document control systems. 

•              Ensure secure and organized CAD data management using PLM tools (Windchill, Vault, PDM). 

5. Cross-Functional & Business Collaboration

•              Coordinate with Projects, Production, Quality, Procurement, Sales, Planning, NPD, and Site teams for effective design execution. 

•              Resolve critical design and technical issues arising during manufacturing, fabrication, galvanizing, installation, or project execution. 

•              Partner with sales and marketing teams to provide technical support, design clarifications, and proposal input for new business opportunities. 

•              Prepare and present technical documentation, design presentations, and progress reports to senior management, customers, consultants, and project stakeholders. 

•              Represent the design function in discussions with international offices/teams for global project alignment, training, and knowledge sharing. 

6. Process, Automation & Continuous Improvement

•              Champion automation initiatives (e. g. , Drive works, Python scripting) to streamline design workflows and reduce cycle time. 

•              Support the development of new products and improved solar structure designs. 

•              Manage multiple concurrent projects, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards. 

Required Technical SkillsStructural & Solar Engineering

•              Strong knowledge of structural steel design and solar mounting structures. 

•              Experience in designing ground-mounted solar structures and related structural systems will be highly preferred. 

•              Good understanding of wind loads, dead loads, live loads, seismic loads, load combinations, deflection, buckling, and structural stability. 

•              Knowledge of steel sections, structural members, bolted connections, welded connections, and foundation interfaces. 

Sheet Metal & Fabrication

•              Strong experience in sheet metal design and steel fabrication engineering. 

•              Knowledge of flat patterns, bend allowance, bend deduction, tolerances, and material selection. 

•              Strong understanding of fabrication processes including cutting, punching, drilling, bending and forming, rolling, welding, grinding, assembly, and galvanizing. 

•              Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA). 

Automotive Components (Added Advantage)

•              Experience in the design and development of automotive components, precision-engineered parts, and machined components will be an added advantage. 

•              Understanding of CNC, VMC, and HMC machining processes, including machining feasibility and component manufacturability. 

CAD, FEA & PLM Software

•              Proficiency in CAD tools such as SolidWorks, NX, Creo, UGNX, and AutoCAD. 

•              Strong command of FEA tools (ANSYS Workbench) and structural analysis software (STAAD. Pro). 

•              Strong knowledge of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) principles. 

•              Familiarity with CAD data management/PLM tools (Windchill, Vault, PDM). 

•              Working knowledge of design automation tools (Drive works, Python) is a plus. 

•              Proficiency in MS Excel and engineering calculation tools. 

Standards Knowledge

•              Familiarity with international and domestic standards such as ISO, ASME, ASTM, IS, and UL certification processes. 

Required Experience10-15 years of total experience in Design & Engineering, preferably with significant experience in one or more of the following: 

•              Solar Mounting Structures / Solar Structural Systems

•              Structural Steel / Steel Fabrication

•              Sheet Metal Manufacturing

•              Renewable Energy / Heavy Engineering / Industrial Engineering Products

Candidates with experience in Solar Mounting Structure design and manufacturing will be given strong preference. 

Minimum 3-5 years of experience in a senior leadership role such as Design Manager, Engineering Manager, Lead Design Engineer, or Head of Design is preferred. 

Preferred Qualifications•              Certification in SolidWorks or an equivalent CAD platform. 

•              Experience working with international teams/offices for design review and validation. 

Educational Qualification•              B. E. / B. Tech / M. E. / M. Tech - Mechanical / Structural Engineering or other relevant disciplines. 

•              (M. Tech) in a relevant specialization (Structural Design) is an added advantage.

 - Practical understanding of PLC-HMI communication and industrial automation systems.

- Experience with Allen-Bradley CompactLogix and ControlLogix PLCs.

 - Knowledge of AutoCAD electrical/control drawings. 
 - Understanding of industrial communication protocols and field-device integration.

Qualification

Diploma / B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation or a related engineering discipline. 

Experience & Candidate Expectations

 - Lead the integration and optimisation of video playback functionality across device platforms, including live and on-demand streaming, adaptive bitrate playback, subtitles, audio tracks, DRM, advertising, and error recovery. 
 - Evaluate new device platforms, operating systems, SDKs, player technologies, and manufacturer requirements; provide technical recommendations and delivery estimates. 
 - Partner with Player Engineering to resolve complex playback issues across different device hardware, operating systems, network environments, and DRM implementations. 
 - Drive performance optimisation for low-memory, low-powered, and legacy devices, including application start-up time, navigation responsiveness, video start time, memory usage, and crash rates. 
 - Work closely with SDET and QA teams to establish device test strategies, automation approaches, certification readiness, and release-quality gates. 
 - Collaborate with external platform partners, device manufacturers, and certification bodies to meet technical, compliance, and release requirements. 
 - Mentor engineers, provide technical direction and code/design reviews, and raise engineering standards across the Device Engineering team. 

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Required Qualifications: 

- 8+ years of Software Engineering experience, preferably in Media Streaming or OTT platforms. 
 - Demonstrable experience building, porting, or maintaining consumer applications across multiple connected-TV or device platforms. 
 - Strong experience with relevant technologies JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, React. js
 - Deep understanding of OTT video streaming and playback technologies, including HLS, MPEG-DASH, adaptive bitrate streaming, manifests, codecs, captions/subtitles, and multi-audio support. 
 - Strong practical knowledge of DRM technologies, including Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay, and device/platform-specific DRM constraints. 
 - Experience with connected-device ecosystems such as Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Android TV/Google TV, Amazon Fire TV, Roku, Apple TV, Chromecast, STBs, or game consoles. 
 - Strong understanding of device constraints, including hardware variation, CPU/GPU limitations, memory management, remote-control navigation, network variability, and operating-system fragmentation. 
Strong debugging and problem-solving capability, including diagnosing complex production issues using logs, telemetry, crash reports, and playback/QoE analytics. 
 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineering, product, operational, and external partner stakeholders.

data.title: Director Of Engineering - Intelligence Platform & Applications
data.description:
About Truveta

Truveta transforms healthcare into intelligence. Built with and owned by US health systems united by a mission of Saving Lives with Data, Truveta powers breakthrough discoveries, auditable data fit for regulatory submissions, and AI that improves patient care. 

At Truveta, we are building something that has never existed before, bringing together healthcare, science, and technology to tackle some of the most important challenges in human health. Our mission calls us to think big, move with urgency, and build with purpose. We are looking for exceptional people who are energized by hard problems, inspired by the opportunity to improve health, and committed to building a company and culture where talented people can do their best work. 

Our team is a special combination of software, health, and big data experience. We are building a talented team of passionate, mission-oriented, and innovative thinkers. 

Who We Need

Join Truveta's Intelligence organization and lead a team of engineers building the next wave of healthcare AI. Your team will build adaptive agentic systems that keep learning, reason over complex data and real customer use cases, and drive real-world impact in healthcare. Guided by Truveta's mission of Saving Lives with Data, you'll help turn health data into intelligence that clinicians and researchers can use to make proactive, data-driven decisions. 

We're looking for an Intelligence Pod Lead at the Truveta India Development Center (IDC): a hands-on technical leader with depth in applied agentic AI and large-scale engineering, a solid grounding in machine learning fundamentals, and a record of helping the engineers around them do their best work. You'll set your pod's technical direction, own what it delivers from start to finish, and still write code and make the key architecture calls. You'll grow a high-performing team that ships scalable, self-improving AI agents and the platform systems that support them. These systems will learn from large and varied healthcare data and deliver useful insights through automation and reasoning. 

Location: Hyderabad, India. 

This Opportunity

Patients, clinicians, medical researchers and healthcare decision makers deserve the same large-scale innovation and AI that has already transformed how people work, create and communicate in many other fields. As an Intelligence Pod Lead, you'll turn ambitious AI ideas into reliable production systems that improve research and development, business strategy, operations and care delivery across healthcare. 

You'll own a focused problem space end to end: defining the technical roadmap, breaking down ambiguous problems, guiding design and evaluation, and making sure your team delivers measurable results. You'll be a force multiplier. Your judgment, mentoring and technical leadership will raise the bar for your pod and for the wider Intelligence organization. 

If you want purposeful work and the chance to influence how AI supports learning, decision-making and discovery in healthcare, this role lets you lead and keep growing. You'll work in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where your leadership directly shapes how healthcare becomes more connected, intelligent and impactful. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the team's technical direction. Define and own the technical vision, architecture and engineering roadmap for your pod's area, such as agentic workflows, knowledge curation and retrieval, structured reasoning and automated evaluation. Make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation, performance, cost and reliability. 
 - Architect agentic AI systems. Design multi-agent workflows with frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI that combine reasoning, planning, memory and tool use. Apply strong context engineering, agent harnesses and deterministic guardrails so long-running agents stay reliable. Use interoperability protocols such as MCP, A2A and Agent Skills to build goal-driven systems that work smoothly with other agents and services, and use observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Drive knowledge curation and retrieval strategy. Oversee the design of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, knowledge graphs built from unstructured documents, embedding strategies and vector stores (e. g. , FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search) that ground reasoning in trusted healthcare data. 
 - Build and develop the team. Hire, mentor and coach engineers, set a high bar for engineering quality, and build a culture of ownership and fast, thoughtful iteration. Partner closely with product, data and engineering counterparts across time zones. 
 - Champion responsible AI. Make sure your team's systems reflect ethical AI principles and meet privacy, security and regulatory expectations for healthcare data, so healthcare intelligence advances responsibly at scale. Build in agent security (defenses against prompt injection and tool poisoning, sandboxing, and agent identity with least-privilege access) and human-in-the-loop safeguards against automation bias in clinical settings. 
 - Keep learning and help the team learn. Stay ahead of new AI architectures, agentic frameworks and approaches to reasoning and retrieval. Bring curiosity, humility and a bias toward iteration, and help the team adopt new ideas thoughtfully. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience building and deploying scalable, production-ready ML systems in a collaborative engineering environment. 
 - 2+ years in a technical lead or similar role, including setting technical direction and mentoring engineers. 
 - A track record of taking complex ML or AI systems from concept to production with measurable impact. 
 - Deep, hands-on proficiency with agentic AI frameworks (e. g. , LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and a working understanding of interoperability protocols such as MCP, A2A and Agent Skills. 
 - Experience building production agent harnesses with guardrails and context engineering. 
 - Experience designing and operating semantic search systems with knowledge graphs and/or RAG, vector databases and embeddings (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search or similar). 
 - Strong expertise in agentic evaluation, including designing metrics, evaluators or reward models for continuous improvement, and evaluating agents at the agent and trajectory level. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, with expert proficiency in Python and experience designing scalable systems in modern cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP). 
 - Excellent communication skills, including explaining technical trade-offs clearly to engineers, product partners and leadership, and working effectively across time zones and geographies. 
 - B. S. or M. S. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related technical field. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with healthcare, life sciences or other regulated data (e. g. , EHR, claims, clinical text), including privacy and compliance considerations. 
 - Experience running ML experiments and training at scale, including distributed training, GPU optimization and inference serving. 
 - Experience with MLOps and LLMOps practices: CI/CD for models, observability, drift monitoring and production evaluation loops. 
 - Publications, open-source contributions or patents in applied ML, NLP or agentic systems.

Aurora Networks also develops Service Assurance software that helps providers monitor and manage networks, improve operational efficiency, and deliver a stronger broadband experience to their customers. 

About The Role

Vistance Networks is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to help innovate, design, develop, and maintain software for Aurora Networks Service Assurance products and systems. In this senior individual contributor role, you will work across a range of technologies and collaborate closely with product management, software engineering, and quality assurance teams. 

You will help translate customer and product needs into secure, scalable, and high-performing solutions. The role calls for a broad technical perspective, sound judgment, and the ability to understand system-level requirements while identifying detailed design considerations and dependencies. You will contribute to an Agile engineering environment focused on dependable delivery, continuous learning, and improvement. 

Qualifications

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related field is required. Candidates should have at least 12 years of relevant experience with a bachelor's degree, or at least 10 years with a master's degree, building and scaling software products for large-scale distributed systems. 

Successful candidates will bring advanced proficiency in Java, Kotlin, and Python, along with strong knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and complex algorithms. Experience supporting AI and machine learning analytics use cases is valuable. You should also have experience designing, troubleshooting, and performance-tuning distributed applications on Linux, as well as strong knowledge of network programming and protocols such as sockets, TCP/IP, UDP, SNMP, gNMI, and gRPC. 

Hands-on experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, web services, microservices, REST APIs, and data pipeline technologies such as Kafka, Apache Airflow, or RabbitMQ is expected. Candidates should understand SQL, NoSQL, or hybrid database technologies and have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment. Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills are essential. Experience with telecom, cable, or PON network management, cloud-native architecture, and Azure or AWS is an advantage. 

Responsibilities

Partner with product management to clarify requirements, evaluate options, and shape practical, innovative solutions. Design, build, and maintain optimized, secure, scalable software for distributed systems. Assess architecture and implementation dependencies, and apply a system-wide perspective to technical decisions. 

Write comprehensive unit tests and collaborate with quality assurance engineers to support thorough system testing. Break down work, develop estimates, communicate progress, and deliver against agreed timelines and commitments. Contribute to engineering practices, processes, tools, and a culture of quality and continuous improvement. You may also take ownership of software modules and provide technical guidance to junior engineers. 

Benefits

At Vistance Networks, you can contribute to communications technologies used by service providers worldwide while working with colleagues who value innovation, customer focus, and collaboration. The company offers opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and help build solutions for evolving connectivity needs. You will join a dynamic engineering environment that encourages new ideas, continuous learning, and meaningful contributions to the future of broadband networks. 

Equal Opportunity

Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The company does not discriminate in its employment practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law. People with disabilities and veterans are encouraged to apply.

data.description:
Job Description

Supports team members in designing and architecting infrastructure and service and shares guidance on practices for reliability and functionality. Provides direction to ensure accurate forecasting and ensure systems have adequate resources, identifying resource gaps. Maintains a collaborative relationship with the software development team to create reliable, scalable infrastructures. Monitors data collection and ensures team members optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. Aids in incident response activities to ensure service reliability. Monitors health and performance reports. Implements standards for identifying and recommending automation. Ensures team members communicate information and articulate the impact of changes. Serves as a senior management point and shares expectations for documentation. Sets expectations for experimenting with new technology, executing improvements, building site reliability knowledge, and providing clear data. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Capacity Ingestion and Management: 

- Supports team members designing and architecting infrastructure and/or service, sharing guidance on practices and terms for reliability and functionality. 
 - Supervises team members and provides direction to ensure accurate forecasting of demands for infrastructure and response to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads and identifying resource gaps. 
 - Maintains a collaborative relationship with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements. 
 - Implements expectations for identifying opportunities for prototyping and manages prototyping initiatives (e. g. , testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches. 

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management: 

- Monitors data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection, ensuring team members maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability. 
 - Provides support to team members monitoring services, ensuring they maintain up-to-date knowledge of performance and document their condition. 
 - Leverages advanced knowledge to aid team members in performing incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e. g. , software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery). 
 - Monitors comprehensive health and performance reporting and ensures team members take appropriate actions based on trends in data. 
 - Ensures team members adhere to procedures when performing provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services. 
 - Encourages team members to experiment with new approaches for and perform decommissioning (e. g. , shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed. 

Automation: 

- Implements standards for identifying and recommending opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits to enhance operational efficiency. 
 - Takes a proactive role in reviewing and offering feedback on design, automation tools, or scripts, acting as a leader during implementation. 
 - Shares strategies for conducting testing on automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results. 

Technical Communication and Guidance: 

- Reviews and provides feedback on release notes and ensures team members communicate comprehensive information about the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology with customers and immediate and related teams. 
 - Proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact across team operations. 
 - Serves as a resource to team members on what information to communicate and how to communicate. 

Troubleshooting and Resolution: 

- Serves as a senior management escalation point for incidents and complex issues arising within Oracle services. 
 - Monitors the resolution of technical issues spanning multiple services, ensuring effective investigation and debugging techniques are leveraged to achieve SLOs (service level objectives). 
 - Shares expectations for documenting incidents performing root cause analyses, guiding team members to capture essential information for analysis and future reference. 
 - Implements guidelines for post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence. 
 - Ensures team members adhere to service level agreements (SLAs) made with customers. 

Innovation and Improvement: 

- Sets expectations for conducting experiments and evaluating cutting-edge tools and technologies to optimize infrastructure performance and reliability, taking proactive steps to adhere to security standards. 
 - Manages and contributes to the prioritization of initiatives to improve performance bottlenecks and deployments, ensuring efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability. 
 - Implements standards for developing and maintaining knowledge of site reliability trends and sharing valuable insights and information with team members, management, and beyond to promote innovative building, testing, deploying, and running services. 
 - Leverages analyses and data from teams to contribute to business development decisions (e. g. , design changes). 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

- Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

- Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

- Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions. 

Continuous Learning: 

- Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization. 

Continuous Improvement: 

- Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement. 

Performance and Development: 

- Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

data.title: Senior Manager – DevOps & DevSecOps Engineering
data.description:
Job Description: Senior Manager - DevOps & DevSecOps Engineering

Location: Bengaluru Millenia

Duration: 12 Months

Experience Range: 6 to 15 Years

Minimum Qualification: B. Tech / B. E. / MCA

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager - DevOps & DevSecOps to define, execute, and scale the DevOps and DevSecOps engineering strategy for CarelonRx engineering teams in India. In this leadership role, you will align engineering standards with enterprise technology and security priorities, drive shift-left security automation, mature enterprise CI/CD capabilities, and foster AI-enabled engineering productivity. You will lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers while collaborating seamlessly with global US stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- DevOps & DevSecOps Strategy and Engineering Excellence
 - Define and execute the DevOps/DevSecOps strategy and roadmap for India engineering teams aligned with enterprise priorities. 
 - Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, infrastructure as code (IaC), cloud-native development, security automation, and release management. 
 - Drive shift-left security adoption, embedding automated checks early in the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 
 - Develop reusable DevOps patterns, templates, and platform capabilities to prevent fragmented, one-off solutions. 
 - Reduce manual deployment friction and improve deployment consistency, repeatability, and reliability. 
 - CI/CD & Platform Engineering
 - Own and mature enterprise CI/CD capabilities using GitHub Actions, Harness, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Establish standardized pipelines covering build, test, security scanning, artifact management, deployment, and rollback. 
 - Implement policy-as-code and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and cloud-native tooling. 
 - Partner with platform engineering teams to deliver self-service developer capabilities and golden paths. 
 - Security Integration (DevSecOps) & Compliance
 - Embed automated security controls across the SDLC: SAST, DAST, SCA, container/image scanning, secrets detection, IaC scanning, dependency management, and SBOM generation. 
 - Translate cybersecurity policies into automated engineering guardrails. 
 - Establish risk-based vulnerability remediation and exception-management workflows. 
 - Ensure pipelines and environments comply with healthcare regulatory standards for protected health information (PHI) and audit readiness. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure Automation
 - Drive DevOps practices across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Promote automated infrastructure provisioning, environment management, and secure cloud configuration patterns. 
 - Support containerized and Kubernetes-based platforms, partnering with cloud engineering to maximize resiliency and scalability. 
 - Observability & Operational Excellence
 - Establish standards for logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, and alerting. 
 - Partner with SRE/operations to improve production reliability and proactively detect performance issues. 
 - Track core engineering metrics (DORA metrics, availability, deployment success, security vulnerability coverage). 
 - India Team Leadership & Global Collaboration
 - Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of DevOps/DevSecOps engineers and technical leads in India. 
 - Function as a unified engineering organization with US stakeholders, ensuring clear governance across time zones. 
 - Build India capability toward full engineering and platform ownership, establishing robust support and escalation models. 
 - Developer Productivity & AI-Enabled Engineering
 - Identify and eliminate bottlenecks across developer workflows to maximize productivity. 
 - Evaluate and scale AI-assisted engineering for code analysis, security remediation, pipeline troubleshooting, and operational insights. 

Key Success Measures

- DORA Metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and MTTR. 
 - Automation & Adoption: CI/CD pipeline adoption, percentage of automated deployments, and IaC coverage. 
 - Security & Compliance: Pre-production vulnerability identification, critical/high vulnerability remediation time, and automated security coverage. 
 - Developer Experience: Onboarding speed, developer satisfaction, and reduction of manual production tasks. 

Required Skills & Competencies

- Experience: 6-15 years of technical and leadership experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, and Cloud Engineering. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong technical experience with core AWS platform architecture (Organizations, Account Design, VPC, Subnets, segmentation strategies) and multi-cloud environments (Azure/GCP). 
 - CI/CD & Automation: Expertise in GitHub Actions, Harness, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Terraform, and configuration management tools. 
 - Security Tooling: Deep hands-on knowledge of SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and secret management. 
 - Leadership: Proven track record of building, leading, and scaling high-performing technology teams in a global GCC model.

data.title: Energy - Platform Engineer - CI/CD Pipeline
data.description:
Profile: Platform Engineer

About SolarSquare

At SolarSquare we are building the Home-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full-stack D2C residential solar brand - designing, installing, maintaining (after-sales), and financing solar systems for home-owners across India. 

In a few short years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service, and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission. 

What Platform Is Here To Do

Platform builds the systems every other team depends on and makes them simple to use. In practice that means: 

- Designing systems and the contracts between them so teams can work together without knowing each other's internals. 
 - Hiding complexity behind clean interfaces: one way to authenticate, publish an event, schedule work or call a vendor, instead of five. 
 - Treating cost as a design requirement. A service should be cheaper to run next quarter than it is today. 
 - Keeping the architecture small enough for one person to understand and able to scale without a rewrite. 
 - Defining the guardrails, templates and standards that engineers and coding agents both build within. 

What You'll Do

- Write TRDs precise enough for an agent to execute and clear enough for a new engineer to review, then drive them to production, checking and correcting what the agents produce. 
 - Build and run shared backend services such as authentication, event streaming, scheduling and deep linking, and the integrations that connect them. 
 - Find the same problem being solved in three places and replace it with one service, library or guardrail. 
 - Make the infrastructure calls for what you own (data stores, queues, caching, scaling, failure handling) and write down the trade-offs. 
 - Turn what works into org-wide practice: reusable skills, agent instructions, review checklists and sessions that bring other pods along. 
 - Question decisions, including leadership's, when the evidence points to a better way. 

You'll Fit If

- You have 3 - 6 years building backend systems in production, with strong fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, networking, and how databases and queues behave under load. 
 - You think in systems and interfaces. You can explain why a boundary sits where it does, and you notice when an abstraction has started costing more than it saves. 
 - You work hands-on with AI coding agents every day and have opinions, backed by experience, on where they help, where they fail and how to constrain them. 
 - You write well. Your design docs remove ambiguity instead of moving it somewhere else. 
 - You can't leave a known problem alone, and you insist on doing things the right way. When you find a better practice, you make sure the rest of the org adopts it, not only your team. 
 - You move fast because your designs are clear, not because you skip steps. You would rather cut scope than ship something you will need to apologise for. 
 - You know containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure well enough to deploy and debug your own services without waiting on anyone. 
 - You judge your work by what it changed for the people using it: cost saved, hours removed, incidents that stopped recurring. 

The Tech You'll Work With

- AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Kafka, Redis, and Datadog, Prometheus and Grafana for observability, alongside coding agents and internal tooling built on top of them. 

(ref: hirist. tech)
